papers.title: How Sampling Strategy Affects Imbalance Mitigation in LiDAR Segmentation: A Study of Structured vs. Random Point-Based Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Class imbalance in LiDAR point clouds poses challenges for semantic segmentation in autonomous navigation and urban mapping. While 2D vision has numerous mitigation techniques, their effectiveness in 3D remains unclear. We benchmark six reweighting schemes and five imbalance-aware losses across three datasets (DALES, S3DIS, STPLS3D) using two architectures (KPConv, RandLA-Net). Inverse-frequency weighting degrades performance by up to 12% compared to uniform weighting, with catastrophic failures in minority classes. Uniform weighting performs within 2% of complex losses for structured sampling (KPConv) but benefits less for random sampling (RandLA-Net, up to 4.6% gap). Loss landscape analysis reveals a complex interplay: for structured sampling, imbalance ratio determines landscape geometry on real LiDAR data but decouples from it on synthetic data; for random sampling, landscapes show high sensitivity to dataset geometry regardless of imbalance ratio. For the two evaluated point-based architectures, these results suggest that the interaction between sampling strategy (structured vs. random), imbalance severity, and data acquisition characteristics shapes which mitigation approaches are effective.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究 LiDAR 点云语义分割中类别不平衡缓解方法与采样策略的交互。作者在两个架构（KPConv 的结构化采样与 RandLA-Net 的随机采样）、三个数据集（DALES、S3DIS、STPLS3D）上对比六种重加权方案和五种不平衡损失。主要发现是逆频率加权相比均匀加权最多降低 12% 性能并在少数类上出现灾难性失败，而均匀加权在结构化采样下与复杂损失的差距在 2% 以内，在随机采样下差距可达 4.6%；损失景观分析进一步揭示不平衡比率、数据获取特性与采样方式共同决定缓解策略的有效性。
Motivation: LiDAR 点云中的类别不平衡会阻碍自动驾驶与城市场景的语义分割，而 2D 视觉中大量不平衡缓解技术在 3D 点云中的有效性尚不明确，需要系统评估。
Method: 在 KPConv（结构化采样）和 RandLA-Net（随机采样）两种架构上，跨 DALES、S3DIS、STPLS3D 三个数据集基准测试六种重加权方案和五种不平衡感知损失，并结合损失景观（loss landscape）分析考察不平衡比率与数据几何的影响。
Result: 逆频率加权相比均匀加权性能最多下降 12%，且少数类出现灾难性失败；对结构化采样，均匀加权与复杂损失的差距在 2% 以内，而对随机采样差距最高达 4.6%。损失景观显示，结构化采样下真实 LiDAR 数据的不平衡比率决定景观几何而合成数据上两者解耦，随机采样下景观对数据几何高度敏感而与不平衡比率关系不大。
Conclusion: 对于两类点云架构，采样策略（结构化 vs. 随机）、不平衡严重程度和数据采集特性三者的交互决定了哪种缓解方法有效，提示不能简单移植 2D 的不平衡处理经验。

papers.title: Concept-based explanation of gene expression prediction from H&E images
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in pathology foundation models have enabled accurate prediction of spatial transcriptomics (ST) from routine H&E images. However, existing explainability methods for vision transformer (ViT)-based models are largely limited to local heatmaps and do not reveal how morphological concepts contribute to ST predictions. Here, we introduce an explainable framework that combines relevance propagation and concept discovery to link transcriptional programs to tissue morphology. We developed a ViT-based framework for virtual ST from H&E images that combines ViT-aware layer-wise relevance propagation with relaxed archetypal TopK sparse autoencoder-based concept discovery. This approach provides both local explanations and global insights into the morphological patterns associated with transcriptional programs. We applied the framework to colorectal cancer ST data from the HEST-1k cohort and evaluated its generalizability in TCGA COAD. Our architecture accurately predicts clinically relevant ST signatures and accompanying molecular phenotypes. Measured and predicted gene expression profiles reveal substantial spatial heterogeneity of the colorectal cancer subtypes iCMS2 and iCMS3 across a large number of samples. Spatially resolved and aggregated iCMS classification achieve weighted F1 scores of 0.872 and 0.819 (0.770 in TCGA COAD), respectively, and both stratify patient outcome. Beyond prediction, our framework establishes a relevance-based concept atlas linking molecular phenotypes to histopathological representations. Comparison of activation- with relevance-derived concepts demonstrates that relevances provide a more direct link between tissue morphology and downstream predictions. We establish a general strategy for concept-based explanation of spatial prediction, and our framework is readily applicable to a broad range of ViT-based pathology models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于概念的可解释框架，用于从 H&E 图像预测基因表达（虚拟空间转录组）。框架结合 ViT 感知的逐层相关性传播 (layer-wise relevance propagation) 与松弛原型 TopK 稀疏自编码器 (relaxed archetypal TopK sparse autoencoder) 的概念发现，在 HEST-1k 结直肠癌数据和 TCGA COAD 上验证。iCMS2/iCMS3 亚型分类的加权 F1 分别为 0.872（空间解析）和 0.819（聚合），TCGA COAD 上为 0.770，且两种分类都能对患者预后分层。摘要还指出相关性派生的概念比激活派生的概念更能直接联系组织形态与下游预测。
Motivation: 现有病理基础模型能从 H&E 图像预测空间转录组 (spatial transcriptomics)，但可解释性方法大多局限于局部热图，无法揭示哪些形态学概念 (morphological concepts) 贡献于转录程序预测。
Method: 提出一个可解释框架，将 ViT 感知的逐层相关性传播与松弛原型 TopK 稀疏自编码器结合，用于概念发现，从而同时提供局部解释和关于转录程序相关形态模式的全局洞察；框架在结直肠癌 ST 数据上开发，并在 TCGA COAD 上评估泛化性。
Result: 摘要报告该架构能准确预测临床相关的 ST 信号及伴随的分子表型；iCMS2 和 iCMS3 亚型的空间解析与聚合分类分别达到 0.872 和 0.819 的加权 F1（TCGA COAD 上为 0.770），且都能对患者预后分层。对比表明，相关性派生的概念比激活派生的概念提供了更直接的组织形态与下游预测之间的联系。
Conclusion: 摘要建立了一种用于空间预测的概念化解释的通用策略，并称该框架可方便地应用于广泛的基于 ViT 的病理模型。

papers.title: Chronocooked: A Benchmark for Implicit Interval Timing in Reinforcement Learning Agents
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents Chronocooked, a reinforcement learning (RL) benchmark suite for studying implicit interval timing in RL agents. Inspired by Overcooked, the suite comprises cooking scenarios that require temporal decision making. The tasks and reward functions are designed such that temporal information is unobserved yet critical for optimal performance. The environment is intentionally kept simple to enable controlled experiments and support biologically plausible models. Evaluation metrics are designed to expose limitations in timing abilities of RL agents, and we report baselines using a non-recurrent, a recurrent, and a biologically plausible model. This work ultimately aims to underscore the need to incorporate time perception and temporal processing in artificial agents designed for human robot interaction and deployment in time dependent human societies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chronocooked，一个用于研究强化学习 (RL) 智能体隐式间隔计时 (implicit interval timing) 能力的基准套件。受 Overcooked 启发，该套件由需要时间决策的烹饪场景组成，任务和奖励函数被设计为时间信息虽不可观测但对最优表现至关重要。作者设计了能够暴露 RL 智能体计时能力局限的评估指标，并报告了非循环、循环和生物学合理模型的基线结果。
Motivation: 现有 RL 智能体普遍缺乏时间感知和时间处理能力，这在人机交互以及部署于时间依赖的人类社会场景中会成为关键短板，因此需要一个受控的基准来系统研究该问题。
Method: 构建一组简单且可控的烹饪场景，通过任务设计与奖励函数使时间信息成为隐式但关键的决策变量；环境刻意保持简单以支持受控实验和生物学合理模型 (biologically plausible models)，并设计专门的评估指标来暴露智能体在计时能力上的不足。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，仅报告了使用非循环、循环以及生物学合理三类模型的基线结果，用以展示当前 RL 智能体在隐式间隔计时任务上的局限性。
Conclusion: 工作旨在强调在面向人机交互和时间依赖社会场景的人工智能体中，必须纳入时间感知与时间处理机制；Chronocooked 为后续研究提供了可复现的评估平台。

papers.title: Random Quadratic Form with random forcing: Metastable synchronization by noise
papers.abstract_en: We study the Random Quadratic Form (RQF) on a sphere in the presence of random Brownian forcing. We show that the forcing does not effectively change the law of the process but affects the synchronization properties of the system. While the RQF without forcing exhibits partial synchronization due to the intrinsic symmetries, the introduction of an arbitrarily small forcing results in long-term symmetry breaking and leads to full synchronization. In this work we focus on the small forcing regime and recover the multiscale behavior of the two-point process. We show that in the first stage the model converges to an anti-polar configuration due to the symmetries of the RQF and in the second stage the two clusters meet due to the symmetry breaking phenomenon. The model is motivated by continuous-time machine learning models such as Neural ODEs and continuous-time formulations of transformers. In particular, the results of this work explain the role of the bias and the scale of its initialization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究球面上随机二次型（Random Quadratic Form）在随机布朗力扰动下的同步行为。作者证明任意小的随机力虽然不实质改变过程的概率分布（law），但会破坏系统内禀对称性，使原本的部分同步变为长期完全同步；在小扰动区间内，两点过程呈现多尺度行为：先因RQF对称性收敛到反极（anti-polar）构型，再因对称性破缺使两个聚簇相遇。该模型受Neural ODE和连续时间Transformer等连续时间机器学习模型启发，用以解释偏置项及其初始化尺度的作用。
Motivation: 该工作关注随机动力系统中的同步与对称性破缺现象，其动机来自连续时间机器学习模型（如Neural ODE、连续时间Transformer）中对偏置项和初始化尺度的理论理解需求。
Method: 作者在小随机力（small forcing）区间内分析球面RQF加布朗驱动的两点过程，识别出两个时间尺度：第一阶段由RQF对称性驱动系统收敛到anti-polar构型，第二阶段由对称性破缺导致两个聚簇合并，从而恢复系统的多尺度行为。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，主要定性结论是：任意小的随机强制虽不改变过程的law，但会导致长期对称性破缺，使系统从部分同步转为完全同步，并且两点过程呈现两阶段多尺度动力学。
Conclusion: 作者强调该结果可用于解释连续时间机器学习模型中偏置（bias）的作用以及偏置初始化尺度对同步行为的影响。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究球面上随机二次型（Random Quadratic Form）在随机布朗力扰动下的同步行为。作者证明任意小的随机力虽然不实质改变过程的概率分布（law），但会破坏系统内禀对称性，使原本的部分同步变为长期完全同步；在小扰动区间内，两点过程呈现多尺度行为：先因RQF对称性收敛到反极（anti-polar）构型，再因对称性破缺使两个聚簇相遇。该模型受Neural ODE和连续时间Transformer等连续时间机器学习模型启发，用以解释偏置项及其初始化尺度的作用。
summary_sections.motivation: 该工作关注随机动力系统中的同步与对称性破缺现象，其动机来自连续时间机器学习模型（如Neural ODE、连续时间Transformer）中对偏置项和初始化尺度的理论理解需求。
summary_sections.method: 作者在小随机力（small forcing）区间内分析球面RQF加布朗驱动的两点过程，识别出两个时间尺度：第一阶段由RQF对称性驱动系统收敛到anti-polar构型，第二阶段由对称性破缺导致两个聚簇合并，从而恢复系统的多尺度行为。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，主要定性结论是：任意小的随机强制虽不改变过程的law，但会导致长期对称性破缺，使系统从部分同步转为完全同步，并且两点过程呈现两阶段多尺度动力学。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调该结果可用于解释连续时间机器学习模型中偏置（bias）的作用以及偏置初始化尺度对同步行为的影响。

papers.title: Bounded Semantic Planning and Deterministic Compilation for Reliable Enterprise Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: Direct text-to-SQL asks a language model to do two jobs: interpret the business question and construct the complete relational query. In enterprise schemas, SQL can execute successfully while using the wrong relationship role or aggregation grain. We study an alternative placement of the stochastic boundary. A multi-turn planner grounds phrases and selects from question-specific governed options; graph traversal, role predicates, grain lowering, SQL construction, and deterministic checks are implemented in code. We evaluate this semantic path compilation (SPC) system against direct DDL-to-SQL generation on the ACME insurance benchmark. On a 38-question adjudicated comparison set with three runs per question, SPC was adjudicated correct on every run for 37 questions (97.4%), compared with 21 (55.3%) for the baseline. The paired discordance was 16 questions in favor of SPC and none in favor of the baseline (two-sided exact McNemar p=3.05x10^-5). SPC answered all 38 questions correctly at least once and produced one refusal and no adjudicated wrong-but-executed run across 114 run outcomes; the baseline produced 29 adjudicated wrong runs and seven additional judge-flagged data-only coincidences on the same set. A strict-equivalence sensitivity analysis increased the paired difference. Additional SPC runs with GPT-5.4 and Gemini-3.6-Flash showed similar question-level robustness, although their per-run verdict artifacts were not preserved. Six additional benchmark items are retained in an all-item analysis and documented separately by failure class. The study supports an end-to-end systems result, not a causal claim that compilation alone produced the gain, because SPC receives governed semantic artifacts that the DDL baseline does not.
papers.comment: 10 sections, 2 figures, 6 tables. Preprint. Code and research artifacts are described in the manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对企业级 text-to-SQL 中语言模型同时承担语义解释与完整查询构造的问题，提出语义路径编译 (semantic path compilation, SPC)：由多轮规划器在代码中完成短语接地、图遍历、角色谓词、聚合粒度降低 (grain lowering) 与确定性校验。在 ACME 保险基准的 38 个问题、每问 3 次运行的仲裁比较集上，SPC 有 37 个问题 (97.4%) 每次运行都被判正确，而直接 DDL-to-SQL 基线为 21 个 (55.3%)；配对不同性为 16 个问题支持 SPC、0 个支持基线 (双侧精确 McNemar p=3.05×10^-5)。作者明确将该结果定位为端到端系统效果，而非编译本身带来增益的因果结论。
Motivation: 直接的 text-to-SQL 要求语言模型同时完成两件事：解释业务问题并构造完整的关系查询。在企业 schema 中，SQL 即使执行成功也可能使用了错误的关系角色或聚合粒度，因此需要重新考虑随机性边界 (stochastic boundary) 的放置位置。
Method: 提出 SPC 系统：多轮规划器负责接地短语并从问题特定的受控选项中选择，而图遍历、角色谓词、粒度降低、SQL 构造与确定性检查均在代码中实现。评估中将 SPC 与直接 DDL-to-SQL 生成进行对比。
Result: 在 38 问仲裁比较集上，SPC 对 37 个问题 (97.4%) 的所有运行均判正确，基线为 21 个 (55.3%)；配对不同性 16 比 0，McNemar p=3.05×10^-5。SPC 对全部 38 问至少正确一次，114 次运行中出现 1 次拒答、0 次被仲裁为错误但已执行；基线出现 29 次错误运行和 7 次仅数据巧合。敏感性分析增大配对不同性，使用 GPT-5.4 和 Gemini-3.6-Flash 的额外运行也显示相似的问题级稳健性。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是端到端系统结果，不能断言仅凭编译就带来增益，因为 SPC 获得了 DDL 基线没有的受控语义工件 (governed semantic artifacts)。另有 6 个额外基准条目按失败类别单独记录，纳入全条目分析。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Turning spectra into images improves plant trait retrieval with 2D-CNNs
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral reflectance spectroscopy enables non-destructive estimation of plant functional traits, yet current deep learning approaches process spectra as one-dimensional sequences, which limits how they capture long-range inter-band dependencies. We asked whether transforming 1D spectra into 2D image representations improves multi-trait prediction with convolutional neural networks (CNN). We compared nine transformations using EfficientNet-B0 on the GreenHyperSpectra dataset (7,897 labeled spectra, eight traits, 400-2450 nm), benchmarked against published 1D CNN results on the same split. Trained from scratch, the simplest transformation, a direct Reshape of the spectrum into a 2D grid, performed best ($R^2 = 0.684 \pm 0.001$) and improved on the state-of-the-art 1D baseline ($R^2 = 0.587$, $+0.097$). We then pretrained a 2D masked autoencoder (MAE-2D) on 139,000 unlabeled spectral images. Linear probing, which freezes the encoder and trains only a multilayer perceptron head, reached $R^2 = 0.646$ and exceeded every 1D self-supervised counterpart, including the fine-tuned MAE-1D ($R^2 = 0.641$). Under cross-dataset evaluation all models lost most of their accuracy and none beat the 1D baseline significantly. To identify which wavelengths drive each prediction, we applied Integrated Gradients and Grad-CAM and unfolded band importance back to the spectral axis. Protein ($r = 0.45$) and leaf water ($r = 0.33$) agreed with sensitivities simulated by the PROSAIL radiative-transfer model, while carotenoids ($r = 0.06$) and leaf area index ($r = -0.11$) did not, showing that the model reads established leaf chemistry for traits with sharp absorption features. The representational advantage of 2D spectral images, rather than architectural complexity or ImageNet pretraining, drives the gain over 1D approaches.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将高光谱 1D 反射光谱重排成 2D 图像、再用 2D CNN 进行多植物功能性状估算。在 GreenHyperSpectra 数据集（7,897 条标注光谱、8 个性状、400-2450 nm）上，最简单的直接 Reshape 变换配合 EfficientNet-B0 从零训练达到 R²=0.684，超过已发表的 1D CNN 基线（R²=0.587）。用 139,000 张无标注光谱图像预训练 2D 掩码自编码器（MAE-2D）后，线性探针达到 R²=0.646，高于微调的 MAE-1D。作者认为性能提升来源于 2D 光谱图像的表示优势，而非架构复杂度或 ImageNet 预训练。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法把光谱当作一维序列处理，难以捕捉长距离波段间的依赖关系。作者希望验证将光谱转化为 2D 图像是否能提升多性状预测精度。
Method: 系统比较九种光谱到 2D 图像的变换方式，用 EfficientNet-B0 在相同数据划分上训练；随后在 139,000 张无标注光谱图像上预训练 2D 掩码自编码器（MAE-2D）并进行线性探测；解释性方面使用 Integrated Gradients 与 Grad-CAM 将波段重要性映射回光谱轴，并与 PROSAIL 辐射传输模型模拟的敏感性对比。
Result: 最简单的直接 Reshape 方法表现最好（R²=0.684±0.001），比 1D SOTA 基线（R²=0.587）高 0.097；MAE-2D 线性探针（R²=0.646）超过所有 1D 自监督对应方法，包括微调的 MAE-1D（R²=0.641）。跨数据集评估时所有模型精度大幅下降，均未显著超过 1D 基线。归因分析中蛋白质（r=0.45）和叶水（r=0.33）与 PROSAIL 模拟一致，而类胡萝卜素和叶面积指数不一致。
Conclusion: 2D 光谱图像的表示优势（而非模型复杂度或 ImageNet 预训练）驱动了相对 1D 方法的性能提升；但该优势在跨数据集泛化上不明显，且模型解释性仅在具有尖锐吸收特征的性状上成立。

papers.title: Hoeffding adaptive splitting trees for data stream classification with concept drift and ensemble learning
papers.abstract_en: Ensembles of decision trees are well-established methods for data stream classification. In ensemble learning, Hoeffding Trees are widely adopted as base learners, performing periodic split attempts according to the Hoeffding bound. Recent studies, however, indicate that this standard splitting mechanism lacks adaptability, while adaptive trees that trigger splits in response to performance degradation have achieved superior results. In this paper, we identify limitations in the use of adaptive-splitting decision trees as ensemble base learners, showing that change detectors often fail to promote sufficient diversity within ensembles. To address this issue, we propose two novel decision tree models, termed Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees. These models combine the periodic splitting strategy of Hoeffding Trees, which fosters ensemble diversity, with adaptive splitting mechanisms that employ change detection algorithms to identify performance decay and determine split points. Experimental results demonstrate that Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees enhance ensemble performance and achieve state-of-the-art results across a comprehensive evaluation, including benchmark comparisons, computational cost analysis, and concept drift adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对数据流分类中的集成学习，指出自适应分裂决策树作为集成基学习器时，变化检测器往往无法为集成提供足够的多样性。为此提出两类新模型 Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees，将 Hoeffding Tree 的周期性分裂策略（有利于集成多样性）与基于变化检测的自适应分裂机制相结合。实验表明该方法在基准比较、计算成本分析和概念漂移适应上取得当前最佳结果。
Motivation: 标准 Hoeffding Tree 的周期性分裂机制缺乏适应性，而自适应分裂树虽有更好表现，但作为集成基学习器时，其变化检测器难以促进足够的集成多样性，限制了集成性能。
Method: 提出两种 Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees 模型，兼具 Hoeffding Tree 的周期性分裂以维持集成多样性，以及利用变化检测算法识别性能衰减并决定分裂点的自适应分裂机制。
Result: 实验结果显示，所提出的 Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees 能够提升集成性能，并在包括基准比较、计算成本分析和概念漂移适应在内的全面评估中达到当前最佳结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合周期性分裂与自适应分裂能够兼顾集成多样性与概念漂移适应性，并强调该方法在数据流分类集成中的有效性。

papers.title: X$^2$Localizer: Cross-grained Alignment for Progressive Cross-view Video Geo-localization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view Video Geo-localization (CVG) aims to localize ground-view videos by retrieving their corresponding geo-tagged aerial images. However, CVG approaches rely on fixed-length inputs and post-hoc refinement, hindering online-oriented localization under partial or dynamic observations. In this work, we formulate Progressive Cross-view Video Geo-localization (PCVG) as a deployment-oriented extension and evaluation protocol of CVG, enabling localization under varying temporal budgets, prefix-based inference, random-start evaluation, and long-range localization with interruptions. To explore PCVG, we introduce X$^2$Localizer, a cross-grained alignment framework that jointly supervises global prefix-to-aerial retrieval and token-aggregated frame--aerial-tile matching with a budget-dependent asymmetric objective. Furthermore, we introduce a Sliding-Window Re-Localization (SWRL) strategy that dynamically refreshes candidate regions for failure recovery and long-range deployment without full-sequence reprocessing. Extensive experiments show that X$^2$Localizer preserves conventional full-video performance, with marginal gains of +0.1 Recall@1 and +0.3 Recall@10, while substantially improving early localization. In the challenging single-frame setting, X$^2$Localizer improves coarse retrieval by +4.7 Recall@1 and +11.5 Recall@10 over the previous state-of-the-art method. With SWRL, our approach further enables robust progressive localization under random-start and long-distance scenarios, narrowing the gap between benchmark evaluation and real-world deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted to The 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出渐进式跨视角视频地理定位 (Progressive Cross-view Video Geo-localization, PCVG) 这一面向部署的评测协议，并给出 X$^2$Localizer 框架，通过跨粒度对齐 (cross-grained alignment) 联合全局前缀-航拍检索与 token 聚合的帧-航拍瓦片匹配，配合预算相关的非对称目标函数。作者还提出滑窗重定位 (Sliding-Window Re-Localization, SWRL) 策略以支持随机起点和长距离场景。实验表明该方法在保持完整视频性能的同时显著提升早期定位能力。
Motivation: 现有跨视角视频地理定位方法依赖固定长度输入和事后精炼，难以在部分或动态观测下进行面向在线应用的自适应定位。作者希望定义并解决部署导向的渐进式定位问题，缩小基准评测与实际部署之间的差距。
Method: 提出 X$^2$Localizer 框架，采用跨粒度对齐：全局前缀到航拍图像的检索、token 聚合的帧到航拍瓦片匹配，并使用预算相关的非对称目标联合监督。另提出 SWRL 策略，动态刷新候选区域以支持失败恢复和长距离部署，无需全序列重处理。
Result: X$^2$Localizer 在保留完整视频性能的同时获得边际提升（Recall@1 +0.1，Recall@10 +0.3），并显著提升早期定位；在单帧设置下较此前最优方法提升粗检索 Recall@1 +4.7、Recall@10 +11.5。结合 SWRL 后，在随机起点和长距离场景下实现稳健的渐进定位。
Conclusion: 作者强调渐进式定位协议与 SWRL 策略能够支持在线、部分观测下的鲁棒定位，从而缩小基准评测与真实部署之间的距离。

papers.title: Orbit-Planner: Towards Latent World Models for On-Orbit Obstacle Avoidance of Satellite Agents
papers.abstract_en: Satellite agents for on-orbit navigation tasks need to predict collision risks using limited onboard observations. However, conventional planners often rely on predefined maps and fixed environmental assumptions, limiting their adaptability in dynamic on-orbit scenarios. In this paper, we propose Orbit-Planner, a two-stage latent world model for on-orbit obstacle avoidance. Orbit-Planner learns action-conditioned spacecraft dynamics to perform future-state rollouts in latent space, and introduces a Physics Probe to decode physical state changes from imagined latent trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that Orbit-Planner can perform long-horizon latent rollouts and recover physical states from imagined trajectories. In closed-loop obstacle-avoidance navigation in Isaac Sim, it attains a success rate of 91.7%. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhijianLi2003/Orbit_Planner.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to AP-GARSS 2026. Project page: https://zhijianli2003.github.io/Orbit_Planner/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Orbit-Planner，一种两阶段潜在世界模型 (latent world model)，用于卫星智能体的在轨避障。它学习以动作为条件的航天器动力学，在潜空间中进行未来状态 rollout，并引入物理探针 (Physics Probe) 从想象的潜轨迹中解码物理状态变化。在 Isaac Sim 的闭环避障导航中达到 91.7% 的成功率。
Motivation: 传统规划器依赖预定义地图和固定环境假设，难以适应动态在轨场景；卫星智能体需要用有限的星上观测来预测碰撞风险，现有方法缺乏这种适应性。
Method: 提出两阶段潜在世界模型：第一阶段学习动作条件化的航天器动力学，在潜空间中进行未来状态 rollout；第二阶段引入 Physics Probe，从想象的潜轨迹中解码物理状态变化。
Result: 实验表明 Orbit-Planner 能够进行长时程潜空间 rollout，并从想象轨迹中恢复物理状态；在 Isaac Sim 的闭环避障导航任务中取得 91.7% 的成功率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将潜空间 rollout 与物理状态解码相结合可提升动态在轨场景下的避障能力，并公开了代码与项目页面。

papers.title: Training-Free Reconstruction-Based AI-Generated Image Detectors Are Inherently Vulnerable to Adversarial Examples
papers.abstract_en: The impressive visual quality and ubiquity of AI-generated images call for reliable and robust detection methods. Reconstruction-based detectors have emerged as a promising direction for transparent and training-free identification of synthetic images. However, due to their fundamentally different mode of operation (compared to standard, classifier-based methods), little is known about their adversarial robustness. In this work, we propose two novel attack methods targeted at detectors that leverage autoencoder reconstruction error. We find that by constructing imperceptible adversarial examples, the distance between original and reconstruction can be artificially increased, causing fake images to be wrongly classified as real. Our evaluation including images from three state-of-the-art generators and three detectors demonstrates that detection performance is significantly decreased, even if attacked images additionally undergo real-world degradations. Critically, our adversarial examples naturally transfer across detectors, as they all share the same principle, pointing towards an inherent vulnerability of reconstruction-based detectors.
papers.comment: Accepted at AI4MFDD (AI for Multimedia Forensics & Disinformation Detection) Workshop, ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于重建（reconstruction）的AI生成图像检测器在对抗样本下的鲁棒性，提出两种针对利用自编码器重建误差的检测器的攻击方法。通过构造肉眼不可见的对抗扰动，可以人为增大原图与重建图之间的距离，使伪造图像被误判为真实图像。实验覆盖三个最新生成器和三个检测器，结果显示检测性能显著下降，且攻击在经历真实世界退化后仍然有效；对抗样本还能跨检测器迁移，表明该类检测器存在内在脆弱性。
Motivation: 重建式检测器以训练免费（training-free）和透明的方式识别合成图像，但其运行机制与基于分类器的方法根本不同，目前对其对抗鲁棒性知之甚少。
Method: 提出两种针对使用自编码器重建误差的检测器的攻击方法，通过构造不可察觉的对抗样本，人为增大原始图像与重建图像之间的距离，使虚假图像被错分为真实图像。
Result: 在三个最先进的生成器和三个检测器上的评估表明，检测性能被显著降低，即使攻击图像额外经历真实世界退化（real-world degradations）仍然有效；且对抗样本天然具有跨检测器迁移性。
Conclusion: 作者认为由于重建式检测器共享相同的工作原理，对抗样本的迁移性指向该类检测器的一种内在脆弱性。

papers.title: Reconstruction: A Blind Benchmark for Recovering Research Ideas from Pre-Publication Bibliographies
papers.abstract_en: Can a language model recover the true research idea of a published paper when given only that paper's pre-publication bibliography? We introduce Reconstruction, a blind idea-recovery benchmark that withholds the seed paper and all contemporaneous or future literature, and asks models to propose hypotheses that an independent large language model judge matches against the held-out ground-truth idea. A strict anti-leakage protocol-temporal citation cutoff, anonymous reference IDs, and frozen per-paper bibliographies, which prevents prompt-time leakage of the seed idea. Across six scientific domains and 643 evaluated papers, seven frontier models achieve only modest Match rates (approx. 3-15%). We then evaluate a reference-only multi-agent (top 4) pipeline that combines cross-model review with a Swiss tournament over aligned hypothesis slots, without external web search. Cross-model review plus tournament selection raises Match rates to approx. 23-42% across all six domains, which is an observed approx. 2.4x lift over the best single-model baseline. This draft reports the protocol, anti-leakage design, and current results as an arXiv timestamp.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Reconstruction，一个盲测研究想法恢复基准：只给出一篇论文的投稿前参考文献列表，要求语言模型推断该论文的真实研究想法，并由独立 LLM 评审对照被隐藏的 ground truth。摘要报告六个科学领域、643 篇论文上，七个前沿模型仅取得约 3-15% 的 Match rate；结合跨模型评审与 Swiss tournament 的多智能体流水线可将其提升至约 23-42%（相对最佳单模型约 2.4 倍）。工作以 arXiv 时间戳形式记录协议、防泄漏设计与当前结果。
Motivation: 现有能力评测难以确定语言模型能否仅从参考文献的引用结构中恢复一篇论文的核心研究想法；作者希望构建一个严格防泄漏的盲测基准来检验该能力。
Method: 提出 Reconstruction 基准：隐藏种子论文以及所有同期或未来文献，仅提供带匿名编号的时间截断参考文献列表，要求模型生成研究假设，再由独立 LLM 判断其与隐藏 ground truth 的匹配程度；同时评测一个不借助外部网络搜索的仅参考文献多智能体流水线（top 4），结合跨模型评审与对对齐假设槽的 Swiss tournament 选择。
Result: 七个前沿模型在六个领域上的 Match rate 约为 3-15%；多智能体流水线将 Match rate 提升到约 23-42%，较最佳单模型基线观测到约 2.4 倍提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为该协议和防泄漏设计可用于量化模型从预发表参考文献中恢复研究想法的能力，并指出当前结果只是 arXiv 时间戳阶段的状态。

papers.title: Toward Better Assessment of LLMs' Performance in Clinical Error Detection
papers.abstract_en: Automated detection of errors in clinical documentation is a promising application of large language models (LLMs), yet decisions to deploy such models rest on benchmarks that evaluate each clinical note in isolation. Error-detection benchmarks are typically constructed by injecting errors into notes, such that each erroneous note has a natural counterpart. Aggregate discriminative metrics (e.g., balanced accuracy or F1) do not exploit this structure. We show that this omission is consequential. In particular, evaluating 15 diverse LLMs on 4 standardized clinical error-detection test sets across 3 languages, we find that 13 of 15 models fall below the level of random pairwise discrimination, even while achieving F1 scores that standard practice would read as moderate. We also observe that the underlying bias patterns differ across languages: the same model can default to "no error" on one language and over-flag errors on another. To diagnose where discrimination breaks down, we further introduce a procedure to score the evidence models cite in their outputs. We find that while models consistently locate error-relevant content, they fail to produce the corresponding correct verdict on the clean counterpart. Finally, we show that F1 and pairwise accuracy are driven in opposite directions by the same underlying bias, so that ranking models by F1 may systematically promote the weakest discriminators. For safety-critical clinical NLP applications, we advocate for supplementing aggregate metrics with paired evaluations in benchmark reporting. Code and analysis scripts are available at https://github.com/healthylaife/paired-clinical-eval.
papers.comment: Accepted at Machine Learning for Healthcare (MLHC) 2026; to appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR), Vol. 340
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型 (LLM) 在临床文档错误检测中的评估方式，指出现有基准孤立地评估每份病历，忽略人为注入错误所形成的配对结构。作者在 3 种语言、4 个标准化临床错误检测测试集上评估 15 个 LLM，发现其中 13 个模型的配对判别能力低于随机水平，尽管其 F1 分数按常规标准看属于中等。进一步分析表明，模型能找到与错误相关的内容，却未能在干净对照样本上给出正确判定，并且 F1 与配对准确率受同一偏置驱动而背离。
Motivation: 临床文档错误检测的部署决策依赖基准测评，但现有基准按单条病历孤立评估，且聚合判别指标（如 balanced accuracy、F1）没有利用注入错误后每条病历都有天然对照样本这一结构；作者证明这种忽视会产生严重后果。
Method: 提出在基准报告中补充配对评估 (paired evaluation)，用配对判别能力衡量模型区分错误病历与其干净对照的能力；同时引入一个程序来对模型输出中引用的证据进行评分，以诊断判别崩溃发生的环节。
Result: 在 4 个测试集、3 种语言上评估 15 个 LLM，13 个模型的配对判别低于随机水平，尽管 F1 读起来尚可；语言间偏置模式不同，同一模型在一种语言上默认报"无错误"，在另一种语言上则过度标错；模型能定位错误相关内容但无法对干净对照给出正确结论；F1 和配对准确率被同一偏置反向驱动，按 F1 排序可能系统性地把最弱判别器排到前面。
Conclusion: 作者主张在安全关键的临床 NLP 应用中，基准报告应当用配对评估补充聚合指标，而不是只报告 F1 一类整体指标。

papers.title: PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning
papers.abstract_en: LLMs remain unreliable for long-horizon planning, often generating logically inconsistent or non-applicable plans. Recent hybrid methods instead translate natural language into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), allowing symbolic planners to produce verifiable plans. However, existing methods frequently rely on rigid generation pipelines, a partial PDDL definition, or human feedback. Furthermore, their evaluation is hindered by the lack of standardized benchmarks with automated verification. To address these limitations, we present PDDLCoder, an agentic framework for PDDL generation from natural language that iteratively generates, analyzes, and refines planning specifications. We further introduce NL-pddlgym, a benchmark dataset comprising 711 planning problems across 23 domains with executable gym environments for the automated verification of plan applicability. Experiments on the NL-pddlgym test set containing 106 problems across 4 held-out domains show that PDDLCoder generates applicable plans for 89.6\% of tested planning problems. This improves upon our adaptations of previous PDDL generation methods, which achieved up to 45.3\%, and outperforms direct LLM planning approaches, which reached up to 74.5\% on the same test set. Our work demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic PDDL generation for planning and establishes a reproducible benchmark for future research on LLM-assisted symbolic planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PDDLCoder，一个通过迭代生成、分析和修正 PDDL 规划规范来从自然语言生成可验证规划方案的 agentic 框架，并引入 NL-pddlgym 基准数据集（23 个域、711 个规划问题，附带可执行 gym 环境用于自动验证）。在包含 4 个留出域、106 个问题的测试集上，PDDLCoder 对 89.6% 的问题生成可应用规划，明显高于改编的既有 PDDL 生成方法（最高 45.3%）和直接 LLM 规划方法（最高 74.5%）。
Motivation: LLM 在长时程规划中常产生逻辑不一致或不可应用的规划；现有将自然语言转成 PDDL 的混合方法依赖固定生成流程、不完整的 PDDL 定义或人工反馈，且缺少带自动验证的标准化基准来评估。
Method: 提出 PDDLCoder agentic 框架，让模型循环地生成、分析和修正规划规格；同时构建 NL-pddlgym 基准，为各规划问题提供可执行的 gym 环境，以自动验证规划的适用性。
Result: 在含 106 个问题、4 个留出域的 NL-pddlgym 测试集上，PDDLCoder 为 89.6% 的问题生成可应用规划；对比的既有 PDDL 生成方法改编版本最高 45.3%，直接 LLM 规划方法最高 74.5%。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果展示了 agentic PDDL 生成对规划任务的有效性，并为 LLM 辅助符号规划研究提供了可复现的基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DRAFE: Domain-Robust Asymmetric Fusion of Heterogeneous Detection Transformers for Cross-City Fine-Grained Traffic Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning-based object detectors are fundamental to intelligent transportation systems, enabling traffic monitoring, vehicle analytics, and infrastructure management. However, achieving both fine-grained vehicle recognition and robust cross-city domain generalization remains challenging. We present the Domain-Robust Asymmetric Fusion Ensemble (DRAFE), which combines independently trained LW-DETR and RF-DETR detectors for cross-city fine-grained traffic object detection. DRAFE employs a two-stage training strategy that first pretrains complementary detectors on diverse public traffic datasets using pseudo-label expansion and human-in-the-loop annotation refinement, producing a curated corpus of 6,049 images and 203,619 annotations, before challenge-compliant fine-tuning on the Project Hafnia Track 6 dataset. At inference, DRAFE applies anchor-conditioned class-consistent matching, reliability-weighted coordinate fusion, agreement-aware confidence recalibration, and complementary hypothesis recovery. On AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6, DRAFE achieves 0.4022 mAP, ranks sixth among 25 participating teams, and improves by 0.0553 mAP over a preliminary ensemble evaluated under identical benchmark conditions.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Code available at: https://github.com/dyagbobli/VisionOps-Trainer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DRAFE（Domain-Robust Asymmetric Fusion Ensemble），将独立训练的 LW-DETR 与 RF-DETR 检测器组合，用于跨城市细粒度交通目标检测。方法采用两阶段训练，先在多个公开交通数据集上用伪标签扩展与人在回路标注精炼得到 6,049 张图像、203,619 个标注的语料，再在 Project Hafnia Track 6 数据集上按竞赛要求微调；推理阶段使用锚点条件类别一致匹配、可靠性加权坐标融合、一致性感知置信度重校准与互补假设恢复。在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6 上达到 0.4022 mAP，在 25 支队伍中排名第六，比同基准下的初步集成方案提高 0.0553 mAP。
Motivation: 现有深度学习目标检测器在智能交通系统中可支撑交通监控和车辆分析，但难以同时实现细粒度车辆识别和稳健的跨城市域泛化，这是该工作要解决的核心问题。
Method: 提出 DRAFE 集成框架，组合两个独立训练的异构检测器 LW-DETR 和 RF-DETR；训练阶段先用公开交通数据进行伪标签扩展与人在回路标注精炼，再在挑战赛数据集上微调；推理阶段通过锚点条件类别一致匹配、可靠性加权坐标融合、一致性感知置信度重校准和互补假设恢复来集成检测结果。
Result: 在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6 上，DRAFE 获得 0.4022 mAP，在 25 个参赛队伍中排名第六，相比相同基准条件下的初步集成版本提升 0.0553 mAP。
Conclusion: 作者认为异构检测器的非对称融合结合两阶段训练与细粒度推理策略，可以在跨城市细粒度交通目标检测中取得明显改进。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Working Set of a Coding Agent: Coherence Debt in Repository-Scale Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Repository-scale coding requires an agent to keep tests, imports, configuration, and migration rules consistent within a bounded context window. We model this as reconstructing a coupled-fact graph: at each edit, a required fact comes from recent context or parametric memory, and the facts covered by neither form coherence debt. We supply and withhold each channel and inject faults across seven models and five harnesses. As expected, no model completes a task on an unseen API with both channels empty, and putting the facts in the prompt restores success. When a rename defeats what models memorized about a real library, all seven fail in the same place, passing and missing the same tests. Availability decides the outcome and distance does not: withholding a fact costs exactly the work it supports, and a supplied fact works as well far from the edit as next to it. Harnesses pay unequal prices for it: configurations that all pass every test differ more than tenfold in tokens consumed because they rebuild the same content at different rates, and spending more recovers nothing when facts are withheld. A missing fact produces wrong work rather than absent work: an agent asked to act acts, fabricating the file or guessing the value, so instruments built on reads look for a hole already filled. How often it says it is blocked instead is a property of the model, from every trial to none. Availability does not settle every edit: where standard and code disagree, agents follow the standard even when it prescribes the worse code, so a stale convention file costs more than no file. Because parametric memory substitutes for reading, on SWE-bench, where models likely know the repositories, reads no longer predict success. Harnesses should keep the facts an edit depends on available when the agent writes, and check that availability against what the agent produces rather than what it reads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究仓库规模编码任务中，代码智能体在受限上下文窗口内保持测试、导入、配置等事实一致的机制。作者将任务建模为重建耦合事实图 (coupled-fact graph)，把既不在近期上下文也不在参数化记忆中的事实定义为相干债务 (coherence debt)，并通过跨七个模型和五个工具链 (harness) 的实验考察事实可用性对任务成败、代币消耗和产出行为的影响。
Motivation: 仓库规模编码要求智能体在有限上下文内保持多类事实一致，但现有工作未系统研究事实的可获得性 (availability) 如何决定成败与成本，以及缺失事实时智能体如何表现。
Method: 作者通过人为供应或扣留近期上下文与参数化记忆两个渠道，并在不同工具配置下注入故障，比较各模型在事实可得与不可得时的行为；同时分析代币消耗、读写行为和遵循标准与代码冲突时的决策。
Result: 摘要报告：当两个渠道都为空时，没有模型能在未见 API 上完成任务，而把事实放入提示即可恢复成功；重命名真实库对象后七个模型在相同位置全部失败；事实扣留造成的代价恰等于其所支持的工作量，距离远近不影响；通过全部测试的配置之间代币消耗相差十倍以上；缺失事实导致错误产出而非缺勤，模型会编造文件或猜测值；模型报告受阻的频率因模型而异；当标准与代码冲突时模型偏向标准；在 SWE-bench 上读取与成功不再相关，因为参数化记忆可替代读取。
Conclusion: 摘要建议：工具链应在智能体写入时保持其编辑所依赖的事实可用，并应依据智能体实际产出的内容而非其读取内容来核验可用性；同时指出陈旧约定文件的代价可能高于没有文件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hypergraph-based Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Incremental Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Modern Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (M-RAG) systems are fundamentally limited by the binary connectivity paradigm of traditional simple graphs, which fails to capture the intricate, high-order correlations among heterogeneous entities, such as the N-ary relationships between a visual chart, its scattered textual descriptions, and underlying numerical data. Furthermore, existing refinement strategies often rely on exhaustive, full-page reconstruction to align cross-modal information, leading to prohibitive computational redundancy and the introduction of contextual noise in long-form document processing. In this paper, we propose Hyper-M2RAG, a novel framework that redefines multimodal document retrieval through High-order Hypergraph Representation Learning. We first formalize the document structure as a Multimodal Hypergraph, utilizing hyperedges as unified semantic containers to encapsulate multi-way associations across text, images, and tables, thereby transcending point-to-point modeling. To mitigate semantic fragmentation caused by physical pagination, we introduce an Anchor-driven Incremental Refinement mechanism. Rather than performing a global sweep, our approach identifies boundary-crossing anchor nodes and reconstructs their local hyper-topology using one-hop neighborhood contexts. This targeted refinement effectively bridges cross-page knowledge gaps with minimal computational footprints. Extensive evaluations on multimodal benchmarking datasets demonstrate that Hyper-M2RAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both retrieval precision and generation coherence. Our code is available at https://github.com/ShenAoChen2001/MMHRAG.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hyper-M2RAG 框架，用高阶超图表示学习 (High-order Hypergraph Representation Learning) 重新定义多模态文档检索。作者将文档结构形式化为多模态超图，以超边作为统一语义容器封装文本、图像和表格之间的多路关联，并引入锚点驱动的增量精炼 (Anchor-driven Incremental Refinement) 机制，只重构跨页边界锚节点的一跳邻域局部超拓扑。实验表明该方法在检索精度和生成连贯性上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 传统简单图的二元连接范式无法捕捉多模态实体间复杂的高阶关联，例如视觉图表、分散文本描述与底层数值数据之间的 N 元关系；同时现有精炼策略依赖全局全页重构，计算冗余大且在长文档处理中引入上下文噪声。
Method: 提出 Hyper-M2RAG，先通过多模态超图将文档结构形式化，利用超边封装跨模态多路关联；再提出 Anchor-driven Incremental Refinement，识别跨页边界锚节点并用一跳邻域上下文重构局部超拓扑，避免全局扫描。
Result: 摘要报告在多模态基准数据集上，Hyper-M2RAG 在检索精度和生成连贯性方面均显著优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 该方法以最小化计算开销弥合跨页知识鸿沟，摘要强调其有效性和效率，并已开源代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Do Explanations Help In-Context Learning? A Comparative Study of Natural Language Explanation Types and Faithfulness
papers.abstract_en: Natural language explanations (NLEs) are increasingly used as inputs, for example, as few-shot rationales that influence model behavior in in-context learning (ICL). However, it remains unclear how different types of NLEs compare in their effects on downstream model performance in explanation-augmented prompting. Therefore, we provide a comparative evaluation across six benchmarks and four instruction-tuned models, studying how NLE source (human-written when available, self-generated explanations, generated by an external LLM) and NLE selection (random vs faithfulness-based filtering) affect downstream utility of NLEs when used in ICL settings. Our extensive evaluation shows that, on classification-style benchmarks, adding NLEs to few-shot prompts often improves accuracy over few-shot prompting without explanations; among NLE sources, externally generated LLM-NLEs often provide strong downstream utility and remain competitive with human rationales where both are available, whereas self-NLEs are more sensitive to the selection strategy. On math reasoning, the effects are more model- and source-dependent. We further show that faithfulness-based selection of self-NLEs yields small average gains overall, but can improve or reduce performance depending on the metric, task, and model. Different faithfulness metrics can disagree substantially, affecting which self-NLE examples are selected and their downstream predictive utility. Robustness tests with randomly swapped and out-of-distribution rationales indicate partial robustness, suggesting that semantic alignment contributes to performance gains. Overall, our results provide insights for selecting and reporting explanations that influence model behavior in practical prompting pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了自然语言解释（NLE）作为少样本提示输入时，不同来源（人类撰写、自生成、外部LLM生成）和不同选择策略（随机 vs 基于忠实度过滤）对上下文学习（ICL）下游性能的影响。在六个基准和四个指令微调模型上评估，发现分类任务上加NLE通常能提升准确率，外部LLM生成的NLE效果好且可与人类rationale竞争；数学推理上效果依赖模型和来源。还研究了忠实度选择的影响及鲁棒性。
Motivation: 尽管NLE越来越多用于ICL提示，但不同NLE类型对下游任务性能的影响尚不清楚，缺乏系统比较。
Method: 跨六个基准、四个指令微调模型，比较NLE来源与选择策略，并做基于忠实度（faithfulness）的过滤，以及随机交换和分布外rationale的鲁棒性测试。
Result: 分类风格基准上加NLE通常提升准确率；外部LLM生成的NLE强且可与人类rationale竞争，自生成NLE对选择策略更敏感。基于忠实度的选择总体带来小幅平均增益，但可提升或降低性能；不同忠实度度量差异大，鲁棒性测试显示部分鲁棒，语义对齐有贡献。
Conclusion: 结果为指导实际prompt流水线中选择和报告NLE提供见解，说明NLE效用受来源、选择、任务和模型的影响。

summary_sections.motivation: 尽管NLE越来越多用于ICL提示，但不同NLE类型对下游任务性能的影响尚不清楚，缺乏系统比较。
summary_sections.method: 跨六个基准、四个指令微调模型，比较NLE来源与选择策略，并做基于忠实度（faithfulness）的过滤，以及随机交换和分布外rationale的鲁棒性测试。
summary_sections.result: 分类风格基准上加NLE通常提升准确率；外部LLM生成的NLE强且可与人类rationale竞争，自生成NLE对选择策略更敏感。基于忠实度的选择总体带来小幅平均增益，但可提升或降低性能；不同忠实度度量差异大，鲁棒性测试显示部分鲁棒，语义对齐有贡献。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果为指导实际prompt流水线中选择和报告NLE提供见解，说明NLE效用受来源、选择、任务和模型的影响。

papers.title: A Shop Floor Production Scheduling Case based on RFID-supported Smart Factory
papers.abstract_en: Radio frequency identification (RFID) technology has been widely implemented for real-time data collection in manufacturing shop floors, which, in turn, can be used to support dynamic shop floor production planning and scheduling. Within such an environment, uncertainty in operation and production processes collectively contribute to the dynamicity in manufacturing, thereby hampering the scheduling system from achieving maximal utility. To highlight the importance of handling such uncertainty, this paper addresses the problem of dynamic shop floor scheduling for a real-life case smart factory equipped with RFID technology. Feasible production sequence mining and real-time processing rate estimation are conducted on RFID-collected production data to quantify the operation and production uncertainties. A deep reinforcement learning approach based on the RFID data analysis is then presented for shop floor production scheduling. Simulation studies based on real-life case data have demonstrated the feasibility and practicality of the proposed dynamic production scheduling framework. Specifically, it is observed that the proposed framework outperforms existing dispatch methods in terms of minimizing operation makespan, including first in first out (FIFO), last in first out (LIFO) and deep Q network (DQN).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对配备 RFID 技术的智能工厂车间，研究动态生产排程问题。作者基于 RFID 采集的生产数据进行可行生产序列挖掘和实时加工速率估计，量化操作与生产过程中的不确定性，并据此提出一种基于深度强化学习的车间调度框架。基于真实案例数据的仿真表明，该框架在最小化完工时间 (makespan) 上优于 FIFO、LIFO 和 DQN 等现有调度方法。
Motivation: 制造车间的操作和生产过程中的不确定性会带来动态性，阻碍调度系统发挥最大效用；现有方法对这类不确定性处理不足，需要结合 RFID 实时数据来支撑动态调度决策。
Method: 对 RFID 采集的生产数据进行可行生产序列挖掘与实时加工速率估计，以量化操作和生产不确定性；在此基础上提出基于 RFID 数据分析的深度强化学习车间生产调度方法。
Result: 基于真实案例数据的仿真验证了所提动态调度框架的可行性与实用性，结果表明该框架在最小化作业完工时间上优于 FIFO、LIFO 和 DQN 等现有派工方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调处理操作与生产过程中的不确定性对车间动态调度的重要性，并表明所提框架在实际场景中具备可行性。

papers.title: HarmTrace: Anchor-Calibrated Decoupled Optimization for Fine-Grained Target Identification in Harmful Memes
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal harmful meme detection is typically formulated as image--text harmfulness classification. A model may correctly predict harmfulness while misidentifying the attacked target or its supporting evidence. We therefore extend harmful meme detection with fine-grained target identification, asking what type of target is attacked, who is targeted, and where the target appears in the meme. The model predicts harmfulness for every meme and, for harmful memes, outputs the target category, target entity, textual mention, and visual region. To support this task, we introduce Meme3W, which unifies multiple public harmful meme datasets and provides human-verified annotations for harmful instances. We further introduce Joint Record Accuracy (JRA), a strict record-level metric requiring the harmfulness label and all target-identification fields to be jointly correct. Experiments with representative multimodal large language models reveal a substantial gap between harmfulness accuracy and JRA. To narrow this gap, we propose HarmTrace, an anchor-calibrated decoupled optimization framework. HarmTrace strengthens target-entity supervision through entity-aware supervised fine-tuning. It then applies Conditional Target-identification Policy Optimization (CTPO) to decouple harmfulness and target-identification advantages, restricting target-identification optimization to label-correct responses for harmful examples. CTPO uses a Virtual Positive Anchor (VPA) as a fully correct reference for target-identification advantage normalization. HarmTrace improves both JRA and harmfulness accuracy across the evaluated backbones, with JRA on the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone increasing from 17.58\% to 52.51\%. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/llly1234/HarmTrace-for-Harmful-Memes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把有害模因检测从单纯的图像-文本危害分类扩展到细粒度目标识别，要求模型同时输出危害标签以及被攻击目标的目标类别、目标实体、文本提及和视觉区域。作者引入统一数据集 Meme3W 和严格的记录级指标 Joint Record Accuracy (JRA)，并提出 HarmTrace 框架来缩小危害准确率与 JRA 之间的差距，在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上将 JRA 从 17.58% 提升到 52.51%。
Motivation: 现有多模态有害模因检测通常只做图像-文本危害分类，模型可能危害判断正确却错误识别被攻击的目标或其支撑证据，导致细粒度错误。因此需要一种任务设定，要求模型说明谁被攻击、被攻击目标的类型以及目标在模因中出现的位置。
Method: 提出 HarmTrace，一个锚定校准的解耦优化框架。它先通过实体感知的有监督微调 (entity-aware supervised fine-tuning) 增强目标实体监督，再应用条件目标识别策略优化 (CTPO)，把危害性与目标识别优势解耦，并只在有害样本的标签正确响应上做目标识别优化；CTPO 用虚拟正锚点 (Virtual Positive Anchor, VPA) 作为完全正确的参考来归一化目标识别优势。
Result: 在代表性多模态大语言模型上的实验显示，危害准确率与 JRA 之间存在显著差距。HarmTrace 在所有评估的骨干网络上同时提升 JRA 和危害准确率，其中 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干的 JRA 从 17.58% 提高到 52.51%。
Conclusion: 作者指出，细粒度目标识别、Meme3W 数据集和 JRA 指标为有害模因检测提供了更严格的评价方式，而 HarmTrace 通过锚定校准的解耦优化有效缩小了危害分类与目标识别之间的性能差距，并为相关研究开放了代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cost Scales with Change, Not Corpus Size: Incrementally Maintaining an Evolving Semantic Substrate
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented and agentic question-answering systems increasingly re-derive the meaning of a corpus at query time. Put plainly, instead of re-deriving what a corpus means on every question, the work is done once when a document arrives and is thereafter merely consulted -- a compiler, not an interpreter, of meaning. An alternative is to compile that meaning once, at ingest time, into a compact, queryable semantic substrate and maintain it as the corpus evolves. The central objection is maintenance cost: rebuilding a truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) on every change appears prohibitive, and a change of embedding model seems to force a full re-embedding. We argue and show empirically that maintenance cost scales with the amount of change, not corpus size. On a controlled synthetic pilot (dimension 256, rank 32, a corpus grown from 3,000 to 9,000 documents over 50 update events), incremental low-rank updates were 33.7 times cheaper per update than full re-SVD and 23.8 times cheaper cumulatively, while the incremental subspace tracked the full recomputation to within floating-point precision (maximum principal-angle drift below 1e-11 degrees; recall@10 = 1.0). An orthogonal Procrustes virtual axis update recovered 0.95 mean cosine to truly re-embedded vectors by re-embedding only about 10 percent of the corpus. The results support maintaining, rather than repeatedly reconstructing, a semantic substrate.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted and presented at the 2026 International Electronics Symposium (IES), Yogyakarta, Indonesia, August 1-3, 2026 (IEEE technically co-sponsored). Authors' accepted version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对检索增强与智能问答系统在查询时反复推导语料语义的问题，提出在摄取时一次性将语料编译为可查询的语义基底，并随语料演化增量维护。作者在合成实验（维度256、秩32，语料从3000增至9000文档，50次更新事件）中表明，增量低秩更新每次比完整重算SVD便宜33.7倍，累计便宜23.8倍，且子空间跟踪到浮点精度；用正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新仅重嵌入约10%语料即可恢复0.95平均余弦相似度。
Motivation: 现有检索增强系统在每次查询时重新推导语料含义，代价高。核心质疑是维护成本：每次变化都重建SVD似乎不可行，更换嵌入模型似乎需要全量重新嵌入。本文针对维护成本是否随语料规模增长的问题展开论证。
Method: 提出在摄取时把语料编译为紧凑可查询的语义基底，并采用增量低秩更新来维护该基底；同时用正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新应对嵌入模型变化，避免全量重新嵌入。
Result: 在合成数据（维度256，秩32，语料从3000增至9000文档，50次更新）上，增量低秩更新比全量re-SVD每次便宜33.7倍、累计便宜23.8倍；子空间与全量重算的最大主角度漂移低于1e-11度，recall@10=1.0。正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新在仅重嵌入约10%语料时恢复0.95平均余弦相似度。
Conclusion: 摘要结论支持维护（增量更新）而非反复重建语义基底，并指出维护成本随变化量而非语料库大小扩展。

papers.title: Palmyra x6 Technical Report: An Agentic, Tool-Use Model Post-Trained via Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Palmyra x6 is a large language model optimized for use with enterprise-oriented agentic tasks. The model was built by post-training a Mixture-of-Experts base model with Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning on a compact corpus of verified, synthetic tool-use trajectories, optimized with a Muon + Adam hybrid. The recipe is deliberately conservative and deliberately controlled: 626 trajectories, a single epoch, a low learning rate, and a KL anchor to the frozen base. The model shows substantial gains over the previous default model for Writer Agent, and compares favorably with several recent models on public benchmarks, scoring the highest on BFCL Core at $0.785$ and posts the highest six-benchmark mean of the cohort. Furthermore, the model has shown itself to be competitive or leading relative to comparators in our bias and safety evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Palmyra x6 是一篇技术报告，介绍一个面向企业级智能体（agentic）任务的大语言模型。该模型在 Mixture-of-Experts 基座上通过 Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning 进行后训练，仅使用 626 条经过验证的合成工具调用轨迹、单 epoch、低学习率，并以 KL 散度锚定到冻结基座。摘要报告该模型在 Writer Agent 上显著优于此前默认模型，在公开基准上取得 BFCL Core 0.785 的最高分，并拥有对比组中最高的六基准平均分，同时在偏见与安全评测中表现有竞争力或领先。
Motivation: 论文针对企业级智能体任务对工具调用（tool-use）能力的需求，旨在通过受控的后训练配方优化大语言模型的智能体性能，而非依赖大规模数据或激进训练。
Method: 方法是对 Mixture-of-Experts 基座模型进行 Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning：在仅含 626 条验证过的合成工具使用轨迹的小型语料上训练一个 epoch，使用低学习率，并以 KL 锚（KL anchor）约束到冻结基座；优化器采用 Muon 与 Adam 的混合方案。
Result: 模型在 Writer Agent 上较先前默认模型有大幅提升；在公开基准中 BFCL Core 得分为 0.785，为对比组最高，且六项基准的平均分也为对比组最高；在偏见与安全评估中与对比模型相比具有竞争力或领先。
Conclusion: 作者强调这种刻意保守且受控的后训练配方（小规模轨迹、单 epoch、低学习率、KL 锚定）足以带来强的智能体与工具调用表现。

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy: Assessing Calibration of Geospatial Foundation Models and Their Sensitivity to Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) are most commonly ranked and selected by accuracy on standard benchmark conditions via averaged ranks. We show that this protocol is too narrow: the promised deployment in critical EO tasks requires further angles of analysis, mainly calibration, the agreement between a model's confidence and its correctness. Across 16 frozen encoders, four classification and five segmentation datasets, and two orthogonal stress axes, every encoder degrades as corruption intensifies, and the ranking changes as well. Across the four classification benchmarks, EO-pretrained and ImageNet-pretrained encoders are indistinguishable on clean accuracy and clean calibration, and EO pretraining provides no more stability under shift than ImageNet pretraining. Under shift the GeoFMs drift further into overconfidence than the ImageNet-pretrained encoders, at every grade and in every corruption family. A centered kernel alignment (CKA) analysis ties this to representational rigidity: EO-pretrained embeddings move less under corruption while losing just as much task information and remaining overconfident. We apply three commonly explored uncertainty quantification methods and find that temperature scaling and deep ensembles cannot counteract the degradation, while a Gaussian-process probe roughly halves ECE under severe cloud only by tripling it on clean data. In selective prediction experiments, we find that confidence-based abstention cannot defer around confidently wrong predictions, and advocate that benchmark rankings and evaluations should therefore operate across a multitude of conditions and metrics to more holistically evaluate model development progress and close the gap to real world deployment scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑仅用平均准确率排名来评估地理空间基础模型（GeoFM）的现有协议，提出还需考察校准（calibration）这一置信度与正确性一致性的维度。作者在16个冻结编码器、四个分类和五个分割数据集、两条正交压力轴上评估，发现所有编码器随腐蚀增强而退化且排名改变；EO预训练与ImageNet预训练在干净准确率和干净校准上无差异，而分布偏移下GeoFM比ImageNet预训练编码器更倾向于过度自信。CKA分析将其归因于表示刚性：EO预训练嵌入在腐蚀下移动更少但同样丢失任务信息并保持过度自信。
Motivation: 现有GeoFM大多仅按标准基准条件下的平均准确率排名和选择，忽略了模型置信度与正确性的匹配程度，而这对于关键地球观测（EO）任务的实际部署至关重要。
Method: 提出更全面的评估协议：在16个冻结编码器、四个分类和五个分割数据集上施加两条正交压力轴，用居中核对齐（CKA）分析表示变化，并对比温度缩放、深度集成和高斯过程探针三种不确定性量化方法，同时做基于置信度的选择性预测实验。
Result: 摘要报告所有编码器随腐蚀增强而退化且排名变化；在四个分类基准上EO预训练与ImageNet预训练编码器的干净准确率和干净校准不可区分，且EO预训练在偏移下的稳定性不优于ImageNet预训练。偏移下EO预训练编码器在每个等级和每个腐蚀族中更过度自信；温度缩放和深度集成无法抵消退化，高斯过程探针在严重云污染下大致将ECE减半但在干净数据上使其翻三倍；置信度弃权无法规避自信错误预测。
Conclusion: 摘要主张基准排名和评估应跨多种条件与指标进行，以更全面地评价模型开发进展并缩小与实际部署场景的差距。

papers.title: Degradation-Aligned Self-Supervised Learning for State of Health Estimation of Lithium-Ion Batteries under Label Sparsity
papers.abstract_en: An accurate estimation of the state of health (SOH) underpins a safe and optimized use of the battery system. Although compelling, data-driven SOH estimation models typically require large amounts of high-quality labeled cycling data, while in practice such labels are often sparse in both quantity and coverage. Therefore, in this work, we propose a degradation-aligned self-supervised learning (SSL) framework based on a convolutional neural network-gated recurrent unit (CNN-GRU) model, which learns aging-consistent representations from unlabeled data through a cycle-order ranking objective as the pretext task for pretraining, thereby enabling robust SOH estimation after fine-tuning on sparsely labeled data. Test results showcase that the proposed ranking-based SSL approach proves to endow the pretrained model with degradation-aligned information from unlabeled data, and after fine-tuning the model can carry out accurate, robust SOH estimation, even when only an extremely limited amount of 1% of unevenly distributed labeled training data is available, where the MAE of 1.718% and RMSE of 2.329% can be achieved on the test cell. In addition, in-depth analyses are presented regarding the influences of label distribution of battery degradation data. We believe this work could shed new light on SOH estimation of lithium-ion batteries under label sparsity in real-world applications.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对锂离子电池健康状态（SOH）估计中标签稀疏的问题，提出一种基于退化对齐的自监督学习（SSL）框架，采用CNN-GRU模型，以循环顺序排序（cycle-order ranking）作为 pretext task 在无标签数据上预训练，然后微调用于稀疏标签下的SOH估计。测试结果显示，即使仅使用1%的不均匀分布标注训练数据，在测试电池上仍可实现MAE 1.718%和RMSE 2.329%。
Motivation: 数据驱动的SOH估计模型通常需要大量高质量带标签循环数据，而实际应用中标签在数量和覆盖范围上往往稀疏，限制了模型的实用性。
Method: 提出退化对齐的自监督学习框架，基于CNN-GRU模型，利用循环顺序排序目标作为预训练 pretext task，从无标签数据中学习与老化一致的表示，再在稀疏标签数据上微调。
Result: 在仅1%的不均匀分布标注训练数据下，微调后的模型在测试电池上取得MAE 1.718%和RMSE 2.329%；研究还分析了电池退化数据标签分布的影响。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作可为真实应用中标签稀疏条件下的锂离子电池SOH估计提供新思路。

papers.title: Interactive Whole Slide Images for RL-based Tumour Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Whole-slide image (WSI) analysis remains computationally challenging due to the extremely large spatial resolution of slides and the sparse distribution of tumour regions. We propose an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework for sequential tumour segmentation directly on WSIs. Instead of treating the slide as a predefined collection of candidate patches, we formulate the WSI itself as a hierarchical multi-resolution environment through which an agent navigates using movement, zooming, and tumour selection actions. The agent jointly processes local observations and a global thumbnail representation within an actor-critic architecture trained using proximal policy optimization (PPO). Experiments on pulmonary adenocarcinoma WSIs demonstrate the feasibility of direct sequential tumour segmentation on full slides, achieving comparable coarse segmentation quality relative to patch-based approaches operating at similar magnification levels, while reducing inference time to a few seconds per slide. We further analyse the impact of environment design and action-space granularity. Our results suggest that modelling WSIs as interactive environments provides a promising direction for RL-based computational pathology
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端强化学习框架，直接在整张全切片图像 (WSI) 上进行肿瘤的序贯分割，将 WSI 建模为分层多分辨率环境，智能体通过移动、缩放和选择肿瘤等动作进行导航。作者使用 actor-critic 架构和近端策略优化 (PPO) 训练，在肺腺癌 WSI 上验证了可行性，能以与基于 patch 的方法相当的粗分割质量将每张切片的推理时间降至几秒。
Motivation: WSI 分析因切片空间分辨率极高且肿瘤区域分布稀疏而计算困难，传统方法将切片视为预定义的候选 patch 集合，本文希望让模型直接在整个 WSI 上进行序贯分割，避免预先 patch 化。
Method: 将 WSI 形式化为分层多分辨率环境，智能体利用移动、缩放和肿瘤选择动作进行导航；在 actor-critic 架构中联合处理局部观察和全局缩略图表示，并使用近端策略优化 (PPO) 进行训练。
Result: 在肺腺癌 WSI 上的实验表明，直接对整张切片进行序贯肿瘤分割是可行的，在相似放大倍数下可获得与基于 patch 方法相当的粗分割质量，同时推理时间缩短到每张切片几秒；作者还分析了环境设计和动作空间粒度的影响。
Conclusion: 摘要认为将 WSI 建模为交互式环境为基于强化学习的计算病理学提供了有前景的方向。

papers.title: Variational Outlier-Robust Gaussian Process Regression with Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Outliers can substantially distort Gaussian process regression (GPR) due to its conventional Gaussian observation likelihood, leading to inaccurate model learning and prediction. To address this limitation, this article introduces a generative GPR model that captures observation-specific contamination and adaptively mitigates the influence of outliers. Subsequently, a variational generalized expectation-maximization procedure is used to learn the latent variables and GPR model parameters. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets under different contamination settings demonstrate that the proposed method remains competitive with-and in several cases outperforms-robust GPR baselines in prediction accuracy. Moreover, the proposed method shares the cubic computational scaling of the compared GPR methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高斯过程回归（GPR）在常规高斯观测似然下易被异常值扭曲的问题，提出一种带生成式建模的变分鲁棒 GPR 模型：显式建模每个观测的污染信息，并自适应降低异常值对学习与预测的影响。作者采用变分广义期望最大化（variational generalized EM）过程联合学习潜变量与 GPR 参数。在合成和真实数据的不同污染设置下，该方法与鲁棒 GPR 基线相比预测精度相当，且在若干情形下更优，同时保持与所比较 GPR 方法一致的三次方计算复杂度。
Motivation: 常规高斯观测似然使 GPR 对异常值敏感，异常值会显著扭曲模型学习和预测；该文目标是构造能够显式处理观测特定污染并自适应抑制异常值影响的鲁棒 GPR 模型。
Method: 提出一个生成式 GPR 模型，通过捕获观测特定的污染（observation-specific contamination）来识别异常值并自适应减轻其影响；随后使用变分广义期望最大化过程学习潜变量和 GPR 模型参数。
Result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集、不同污染设置下的实验表明，所提方法在预测精度上与鲁棒 GPR 基线相当，且在多种情况下优于基线；其计算复杂度与所对比的 GPR 方法相同，均为三次方（cubic）量级。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在保持 GPR 原有三次方计算复杂度的同时改善了异常值鲁棒性，可作为鲁棒回归的通用方案；但未报告具体数据集名称或数值增益。

papers.title: GeoPose: Patient-agnostic CTA-to-DSA registration through projection-space calibration
papers.abstract_en: Aligning intraoperative biplanar digital subtraction angiography (DSA) to pre-procedural computed tomography angiography (CTA) requires rapid and accurate 3D-to-2D registration. Optimization-based methods are sensitive to initialization and may require hundreds of iterations, whereas learning-based approaches commonly rely on patient-specific training. We propose GeoPose, a population-trained framework that estimates the C-arm pose in a learned canonical frame and transfers it to the native frame of an unseen CTA through projection-space calibration and transform composition. A population-trained residual network refines the pose, followed optionally by low-budget image-driven optimization. GeoPose requires neither patient-specific adaptation nor explicit inter-volume preregistration. On 80 DSA observations from 20 held-out patients, optimization-free GeoPose achieved a carotid mean projected centerline distance (mPCD) of 5.8 mm and a clDice of 0.45, compared with 14.5 mm and 0.28 for the best-performing baseline, while requiring only 0.15 s. After 25 optimization iterations, GeoPose reached an mPCD of 4.6 mm and a clDice of 0.58 in approximately two seconds. Under the same budget, native-initialized optimization achieved 14.6 mm and 0.15, respectively. GeoPose thus provides rapid native-frame registration with fixed population-level weights and the geometric correspondence required for downstream biplanar 3D vascular reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoPose，一种面向 CTA 与术中双平面 DSA 配准的人群训练框架。它估计 C 臂在学习的规范坐标系中的位姿，再通过投影空间校准与变换组合将位姿迁移到未见过的 CTA 原生坐标系，无需患者特化适应或显式体间预配准。在 20 位留出患者的 80 个 DSA 观测上，免优化 GeoPose 达到平均投影中心线距离 (mPCD) 5.8 mm、clDice 0.45，仅需 0.15 秒；经 25 次优化迭代后达到 mPCD 4.6 mm、clDice 0.58。
Motivation: 术中双平面 DSA 与术前 CTA 的对齐需要快速准确的 3D-to-2D 配准。优化类方法对初始化敏感且需要数百次迭代，而学习类方法通常依赖患者特化训练，缺乏可直接泛化到新患者的人群级方案。
Method: GeoPose 是人群训练的框架，先在学习的规范坐标系中估计 C 臂位姿，再通过投影空间校准和变换组合将位姿转移到未见过 CTA 的原生坐标系；人群中训练的残差网络负责位姿细化，并可选地接上低预算的图像驱动优化。
Result: 在 80 个来自 20 位留出患者的 DSA 观测上，免优化 GeoPose 取得颈动脉平均 mPCD 5.8 mm、clDice 0.45，而最优基线为 14.5 mm 和 0.28，且运行仅需 0.15 秒；进行 25 次优化迭代后，GeoPose 在约两秒内达到 mPCD 4.6 mm、clDice 0.58，而同样预算下原生初始化优化仅达到 14.6 mm 与 0.15。
Conclusion: GeoPose 使用固定的人群级权重即可实现快速的原生坐标系配准，并具备下游双平面 3D 血管重建所需的几何对应关系，无需患者特化适应。

summary_sections.result: 在 80 个来自 20 位留出患者的 DSA 观测上，免优化 GeoPose 取得颈动脉平均 mPCD 5.8 mm、clDice 0.45，而最优基线为 14.5 mm 和 0.28，且运行仅需 0.15 秒；进行 25 次优化迭代后，GeoPose 在约两秒内达到 mPCD 4.6 mm、clDice 0.58，而同样预算下原生初始化优化仅达到 14.6 mm 与 0.15。
summary_sections.conclusion: GeoPose 使用固定的人群级权重即可实现快速的原生坐标系配准，并具备下游双平面 3D 血管重建所需的几何对应关系，无需患者特化适应。

papers.title: CACSurv: Concordance-Aligned Comparative Learning with Large Language Models for Cancer Survival Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Cancer survival prediction supports treatment planning, risk stratification, and follow-up management. Existing methods use structured clinical variables, whole-slide images, genomic profiles, or multimodal inputs, while patient reports remain underexplored. We study report-centric survival prediction using reports that organize pathological, clinical, and molecular evidence. Large language models (LLMs) can reason over such reports, but case-wise time regression introduces two mismatches. First, a formulation mismatch arises because survival evaluation depends on ordering comparable patients, whereas independent time predictions do not enforce ranking consistency. Second, a supervision mismatch arises because a censored patient's observed time indicates survival beyond that point and cannot serve as an exact regression target, although it still implies orderings relative to patients who died earlier. To address these mismatches, we propose CACSurv, a Concordance-Aligned Comparative framework for report-centric survival prediction. CACSurv reformulates survival modeling as mini-cohort comparative reasoning, where an LLM predicts relative prognostic orderings. We introduce concordance-aligned rewards derived from comparable relations under right censoring, enabling censored outcomes to provide ranking supervision without exact event-time targets. At inference, Monte Carlo Reference Aggregation compares each patient with sampled references and aggregates positions into a cohort-level ranking. We establish TCGA-SurvReport, a benchmark covering six TCGA cancer cohorts. CACSurv achieves the highest C-index on all six cohorts and an average C-index of 0.722, outperforming the strongest published survival model by 6.5 percentage points and the strongest LLM time-regression baseline by 4.2 percentage points. Our code, models, and dataset will be available at https://github.com/xmed-lab/CACSurv.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CACSurv，一个面向以患者报告为中心的癌症生存预测的 Concordance-Aligned Comparative 框架。作者指出 LLM 逐病例时间回归存在公式不匹配和监督不匹配，因此将生存建模重构为 mini-cohort 比较推理，用一致性对齐奖励在右删失下提供排序监督，并在推理时通过 Monte Carlo Reference Aggregation 生成队列级排名。在六个 TCGA 队列组成的 TCGA-SurvReport 基准上，平均 C-index 达 0.722，超过最强已发布生存模型 6.5 个百分点、最强 LLM 时间回归基线 4.2 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有生存预测多依赖结构化临床变量、全切片图像、基因组或多模态输入，患者报告这一信息源未被充分探索。LLM 虽能对报告推理，但逐病例时间回归与生存评估依赖患者间排序不一致，且右删失患者的观测时间只能说明其生存超过该时刻，不能作为精确回归目标，却仍隐含相对排序信息。
Method: 提出 CACSurv，把生存预测转化为 mini-cohort 比较推理，让 LLM 直接预测相对预后排序；引入由右删失下可比关系推导的一致性对齐奖励（concordance-aligned rewards），使删失结果无需精确事件时间即可提供排序监督。推理阶段使用 Monte Carlo Reference Aggregation，将每个患者与采样参考比较并聚合位置得到队列级排名，同时构建了 TCGA-SurvReport 基准。
Result: 在六个 TCGA 癌症队列上 CACSurv 均取得最高 C-index，平均 C-index 为 0.722，较最强已发布生存模型提升 6.5 个百分点，较最强 LLM 时间回归基线提升 4.2 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于报告的比较式排序监督能够有效利用右删失数据，且该框架在六个队列上的一致性优势明显；代码、模型与数据集将公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Zero-Shot Domain Generalization for ID Cards Presentation Attack Detection
papers.abstract_en: Presentation-Attack Detection (PAD) for national ID cards is limited by the lack of publicly available genuine samples, making it difficult for systems to generalize across countries. This paper introduces two main innovations: (1) a Prototypical Network head using an EfficientNet-V2-b0 backbone that requires only four genuine samples per class to create reliable prototypes; and (2) an episodic training regime that keeps PAD classes fixed while varying the card domain, allowing the network to learn universal attack cues. Evaluated on a large multi-country dataset and the public DLC-2021 benchmark, this method achieves an average Equal Error Rate of around 9\%, outperforming conventional softmax and CLIP zero-shot baselines even with data from a single source country. This approach provides accurate, privacy-preserving PAD while minimizing data collection, facilitating scalable cross-jurisdictional remote onboarding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对国家身份证展示攻击检测（PAD）中真实样本稀缺、跨国家泛化困难的问题，提出基于 EfficientNet-V2-b0 骨干的原型网络头（Prototypical Network head），每类仅需四张真实样本即可构造可靠原型；同时设计保持 PAD 类别固定、变换卡片域的情景式训练（episodic training），使网络学习通用的攻击线索。在多国数据集和公开 DLC-2021 基准上，平均等错误率（EER）约为 9%，优于 softmax 和 CLIP 零样本基线，即使仅使用单一来源国数据也有效。
Motivation: 国家身份证 PAD 缺乏公开可用的真实样本，系统难以跨国家泛化，限制了大规模远程身份核验的实际部署。
Method: 提出带 EfficientNet-V2-b0 骨干的原型网络头，每类仅需四个真实样本即可构造原型；并采用情景式训练，固定 PAD 类别同时变换卡片域，迫使网络学习与具体卡片域无关的通用攻击线索。
Result: 在大型多国数据集和 DLC-2021 公开基准上取得约 9% 的平均等错误率（EER），优于常规 softmax 和 CLIP 零样本基线；即使只用单一来源国数据训练也能达到该水平。
Conclusion: 该方法以极少的真实样本实现准确且保护隐私的 PAD，有助于数据采集最小化，并能支撑跨司法辖区的规模化远程开户流程。

papers.title: Ultra: Unsupervised Cross-Task Optimization for Reliable Restoration Segmentation Collaboration under Adverse Weather
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Adverse Weather Semantic Segmentation (UDA-ASS) aims to transfer semantic knowledge from labeled normal-weather images to unlabeled adverse environments. Existing approaches implicitly assume that restoration and segmentation provide mutually beneficial guidance. However, under severe degradation and without target-domain supervision, the validity of cross-task optimization directions becomes fundamentally unidentifiable, leading to hallucination-driven error propagation. In this work, we propose a novel Unsupervised Restoration-Segmentation Collaborative Learning Framework (Ultra), which reframes cross-task interaction as direction selection under uncertainty and causal effect estimation, enabling reliable collaboration through candidate direction generation and intervention-based filtering. In detail, we propose CTDN and CMIL. The former exploits complementary visual structures and semantic information to generate candidate optimization directions and performs cooperative direction selection between restoration and segmentation. The latter reformulates cross-task information transfer from correlation-based propagation into causal effect assessment, suppressing hallucination propagation. Extensive experiments on three widely used UDA-ASS benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Beyond segmentation, our framework achieves better unsupervised restoration results than existing UDA-ASS restoration methods and generalizes to unsupervised restoration and object detection collaboration tasks. Code and models will be available at https://github.com/Wang-Shiqin/Ultra.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ultra 框架，将无监督域适应下的恶劣天气语义分割中的复原-分割协作重构为不确定性下的方向选择与因果效应估计。通过 CTDN 生成并筛选候选优化方向、CMIL 以因果效应评估替代相关性传播，抑制严重退化时幻觉驱动的错误传播，在三个 UDA-ASS 基准上取得最先进分割性能，并提升无监督复原效果。
Motivation: 现有方法默认复原与分割会相互提供有益指导，但在严重退化且无目标域监督的情况下，跨任务优化方向的有效性根本无法识别，容易导致幻觉驱动的错误传播。
Method: 提出无监督复原-分割协同学习框架 Ultra，包含 CTDN 与 CMIL：CTDN 利用互补的视觉结构与语义信息生成候选优化方向，并在复原与分割之间进行协作方向选择；CMIL 将跨任务信息传递从基于相关性的传播重构为因果效应评估，以抑制幻觉传播。
Result: 在三个广泛使用的 UDA-ASS 基准上取得最先进的分割性能；无监督复原结果优于现有 UDA-ASS 复原方法，并能泛化到无监督复原与目标检测协作任务。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过候选方向生成与干预式过滤能够实现可靠的跨任务协作；代码和模型将公开。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: SQuad: Sub-Quadratic Attention Distillation for Efficient Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) spend most of their compute inside the Self-Attention operation, whose cost grows quadratically, $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$, with the number of latent tokens $n$. For the task of video generation, the token count is large, so this term dominates runtime and memory, and thereby caps the resolution and duration we can generate. Linear $\mathcal{O}(n)$ and low-rank $\mathcal{O}(nk)$ surrogates of Self-Attention trade the full softmax $QK^T$ for cheaper kernels, but rarely recover the original's expressivity, leaving a stubborn quality gap. Motivated by this, we propose SQuad, a Sub-Quadratic Attention Distillation framework that achieves a complexity of $\mathcal{O}(n\sqrt{n})$ in the resulting distilled Attention, naturally balancing the efficiency v/s expressivity trade-off. Instead of training our own Video DiT from scratch, which is prohibitively expensive, we fit a pretrained full softmax Self-Attention DiT into our proposed SQuad-Attention one by distilling the former in two stages: Flow-Matching Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), followed by improved Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD2) which additionally makes the sampling more efficient. On the Wan~2.2 5B text-to-video model, SQuAD matches the quadratic teacher on VBench ($83.20$ v/s $83.08$) while cutting the per-step per-block attention FLOPs by $\sim$$67\times$ and attention latency by $\sim$$11\times$, and end-to-end DiT latency by 2$\times$, all while also generating a video in only $6$ Neural Functional Evaluations (NFEs) instead of the default $100$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SQuad，一个次二次注意力蒸馏框架，将预训练的完整 softmax 自注意力视频 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 蒸馏为复杂度为 O(n√n) 的 SQuad-Attention 版本，用于高效视频生成。蒸馏分两阶段：Flow-Matching 监督微调 (SFT) 和 DMD2 分布匹配蒸馏，后者还使采样更高效。在 Wan 2.2 5B 文生视频模型上，SQuad 在 VBench 上与二次复杂度的教师模型基本持平，同时大幅降低注意力 FLOPs 和延迟。
Motivation: 视频 DiT 的大部分计算开销来自自注意力，其成本随潜在 token 数 n 呈二次增长，限制了可生成的分辨率和时长。线性 O(n) 和低秩 O(nk) 的近似通常损失表达力，存在难以消除的质量差距。
Method: 提出 SQuad 框架，采用次二次注意力蒸馏，得到复杂度 O(n√n) 的注意力机制，在效率与表达力之间取得平衡。为避免从头训练视频 DiT，作者将预训练的完整 softmax 自注意力 DiT 拟合为 SQuad-Attention 结构，先用 Flow-Matching SFT 再用改进的 Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD2) 进行两阶段蒸馏，同时提升采样效率。
Result: 在 Wan 2.2 5B 文生视频模型上，SQuad 在 VBench 上达到 83.20，与二次复杂度的教师模型的 83.08 相当；每步每块注意力 FLOPs 降低约 67 倍，注意力延迟降低约 11 倍，端到端 DiT 延迟降低 2 倍，并且仅用 6 次神经函数评估 (NFE) 生成视频，而默认需要 100 次。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过蒸馏得到的 O(n√n) 次二次注意力能够在几乎不损失生成质量的情况下大幅压缩视频 DiT 的计算和延迟，并支持更少的采样步数。

papers.title: Physics of Agents: Statistical Mechanics Predicts Collective Behavior of AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly operate as part of interacting systems rather than in isolation. As agents exchange information and jointly make decisions, their interactions can improve collective reasoning but may also produce herding, polarization, or amplify shared biases. Understanding and predicting these collective dynamics is therefore important for designing effective and aligned multi-agent systems. Here, we study over 10,000 communities of language-model agents that repeatedly exchange messages and revise their opinions across objective mathematics questions and subjective political statements. Despite substantial diversity in possible behavior, the individual and group dynamics can be represented by three characteristic regimes: indifference, polarization, and consensus. AI agents start indifferent and build conviction as they interact. On objective questions, communication improves collective accuracy, while on subjective questions it often drifts group opinions toward the right in the political spectrum. We explain these observations with a statistical-mechanics formalism in which agents stochastically favor lower social pressure. Given only initial opinions, our model predicts individual trajectories, outperforms all standard baselines, generalizes to unseen community graphs, and reproduces the observed group archetype distributions. Our fitted model parameters reveal the mechanics underlying our key observations: i) communities operate below the critical social temperature, which explains conviction buildup; ii) attractive ties outweigh repulsive ones, which favors consensus; and iii) agents holding the correct answer exert the strongest pull, which drives truth-seeking. Overall, our results demonstrate that collective behavior of AI agents, like that of other complex systems, follows compact and predictive dynamical laws.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型智能体群体互动时的集体行为，基于超过10,000个社区的重复杂消息交换与观点修正实验，识别出无差异、极化、共识三种特征状态。作者提出统计力学框架，认为智能体随机偏好更低的社会压力，该模型仅凭初始观点即可预测个体轨迹，并在客观数学与主观政治问题上复现群体动力学。
Motivation: 智能体常作为交互系统的一部分运作，信息交换与共同决策既可能提升集体推理，也可能导致羊群效应、极化或共享偏见的放大，因此理解并预测这些集体动力对设计有效且对齐的多智能体系统至关重要。
Method: 采用统计力学形式，将智能体建模为随机偏好较低社会压力的个体；在客观数学问题和主观政治声明两类任务上，让智能体反复交换消息并修订观点，并利用初始观点拟合模型以预测个体轨迹与群体原型分布。
Result: 实验显示客观问题上沟通提升集体准确率，主观问题上群体意见常向政治光谱右翼漂移；拟合模型在预测个体轨迹上超越所有标准基线，可泛化到未见过的社区图，并复现群体原型分布。参数分析表明社区运行在临界社会温度以下（信念积累）、吸引性联系强于排斥性（倾向共识）、持正确答案的智能体拉力最强（求真）。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为，AI智能体的集体行为与其他复杂系统类似，遵循紧凑且可预测的动力学定律。

papers.title: Learning Generalizable Reconstruction of High-Dimensional Neural Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Accurate reconstruction of long-duration neural recordings is challenging because local field potentials (LFPs) are high-resolution, multichannel, transient, and variable across subjects. We present PCA-DMD, a scalable operator-theoretic framework that segments LFP recordings into overlapping windows, projects them into a compact PCA space, learns linear Koopman evolution in the latent space, and reconstructs continuous signals through inverse projection and overlap-add aggregation. On 200,000-sample hippocampal recordings, PCA-DMD outperformed Classical DMD, SpDMD, MrDMD, and HODMD, achieving KLD=0.0761 and HD=0.0847. In all-pair cross-subject zero-shot generalization at 300,000 samples, correlations were 0.9504-0.9800, with HD=0.0010-0.0072 and KLD=0.0005-0.0022, without target-subject fine-tuning. Out-of-sample temporal prediction showed close one-step agreement on temporally held-out LFP segments across the unseen interval and multiple channels. Scalability analysis from 400,000 to 900,000 samples showed stable zero-shot reconstruction, with mean correlation remaining about 0.965-0.968 while computational cost increased predictably. External validation on an independent 93-channel Allen Neuropixels recording yielded mean and median channel-wise correlations of 0.7427 and 0.7990, respectively. Koopman spectral and mode analyses revealed dominant eigenvalues concentrated near the unit circle. PCA-DMD therefore provides an interpretable, generalizable, and computationally scalable framework for reconstructing high-dimensional neural dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PCA-DMD，一种基于算子理论的框架，用于从局部场电位 (LFP) 中重建高维神经动态。方法将 LFP 记录分段为重叠窗口，投影到紧凑 PCA 空间，在隐空间中学习线性 Koopman 演化，再通过逆投影和重叠相加重建连续信号。摘要报告其在海马记录上优于多种经典 DMD 变体，并在跨受试者零样本泛化、时间外推和外部数据集验证中表现稳定。
Motivation: 长时间神经记录的重建具有挑战性，因为 LFP 是高分辨率、多通道、瞬态且跨受试者变异的信号，现有方法难以同时满足可扩展性和泛化性。
Method: 提出 PCA-DMD 框架：将 LFP 记录切分为重叠窗口，投影到低维 PCA 空间，在隐空间中使用线性 Koopman 演化建模动态，最后通过逆投影和 overlap-add 聚合重建连续信号。
Result: 在 200,000 样本海马记录上，PCA-DMD 优于 Classical DMD、SpDMD、MrDMD 和 HODMD，取得 KLD=0.0761、HD=0.0847；300,000 样本的跨受试者零样本泛化中，相关度为 0.9504-0.9800，HD=0.0010-0.0072，KLD=0.0005-0.0022；独立 93 通道 Allen Neuropixels 数据上通道级平均/中位相关度为 0.7427/0.7990。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 PCA-DMD 提供了可解释、可泛化且计算可扩展的高维神经动态重建框架，Koopman 谱分析显示主导特征值集中在单位圆附近。

papers.title: Probabilistic Circuits as Reasoning Machines in Artificial Intelligence (Part I)
papers.abstract_en: This cumulative habilitation thesis studies probabilistic circuits (PCs) as a powerful and tractable framework for reasoning and learning under uncertainty in artificial intelligence (AI). It first advocates for probability as a core language for AI, emphasizing its connections to logic and information theory; the conceptual simplicity of probabilistic reasoning---based primarily on the sum and product rules; the parallels between probabilistic inference and human cognition; and the role of probability in optimal decision making. However, probability also faces significant computational challenges, as probabilistic inference is NP-hard in almost all probabilistic models. PCs address these challenges through structural constraints that ensure exact computation of a wide range of inference queries in polynomial time, such as marginals, conditionals, most probable explanations, expectations, and more advanced inference tasks. This thesis synthesizes a decade of research across foundations, algorithmic developments, and empirical validation of PCs. Key contributions highlighted in this work are foundational theory of PCs, Bayesian approaches for learning PCs, scalable implementations and integration with deep learning, hybrid models that combine PCs with intractable models, and connections with symbolic machine learning paradigms. This is the first part of my Habilitation Thesis. The second part is omitted, as it comprises the cumulative part of the thesis and has been published at various venues (see Chapter 5).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是 habilitation 论文的第一部分，系统研究概率电路 (probabilistic circuits, PCs) 作为人工智能中可处理的不确定性推理与学习框架。摘要先论证概率作为 AI 核心语言的地位及其与逻辑、信息论、人类认知和最优决策的联系，随后指出一般概率推理在几乎所有概率模型中是 NP-hard 的，而 PC 通过结构约束保证边缘、条件、最可能解释、期望等大量推理查询在多项式时间内精确计算。论文综合了作者十年间在 PC 基础理论、贝叶斯学习、可扩展实现与深度学习集成、与不可处理模型结合的混合模型以及符号机器学习联系方面的研究。
Motivation: 概率推理在几乎所有概率模型中都是 NP-hard 的，构成主要计算挑战；需要一种既能保持概率推理概念简洁性、又能在多项式时间内精确回答多种推理查询的框架，PC 正是为解决这一缺口而研究的。
Method: 通过结构性约束定义 PCs，使一大类推理查询可多项式时间精确计算；论文综合了 PC 的基础理论、贝叶斯学习方法、可扩展实现及与深度学习的集成，并探讨将 PC 与不可处理模型结合的混合建模以及符号机器学习范式的联系。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值实验，主要贡献是总结并综合十年研究，突出 PC 基础理论、贝叶斯学习、可扩展实现、混合模型及符号机器学习连接等方向。
Conclusion: 本文为 habilitation 论文的第一部分；第二部分（累积部分）被省略，因为其内容已发表于多个会议（见第 5 章）。

papers.title: CUBICS: Situation-aware performance estimation for safety-relevant ML components
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) is a key technology driving innovation today, but ensuring ML safety remains a major challenge for safety-related applications. A promising idea is to build proven-in-use arguments from field data, e.g. by running ML components (MLCs) in shadow mode or within safety envelopes so that their outputs can be monitored as 'safe probes' without affecting safety. These probes can then be used to build a statistical argument about field performance in a Bayesian way. However, many Bayesian field-data approaches in safety engineering model failures as a simple Bernoulli (or binomial) process with a single global failure probability and i.i.d. trials, which is rarely adequate for MLCs whose performance depends strongly on context. Statistical evidence is also about coverage of relevant situations, including edge cases, and building a single integrated statistical model for the entire system is usually not feasible. To address these challenges, this paper introduces CUBICS, a context-modular framework for per-component, situation-aware performance estimation of safety-relevant ML components. CUBICS partitions the operational design domain into situations and, for each safety-relevant component, defines a set of situation-specific assumptions and probabilistic guarantees that are represented and updated in a Bayesian manner using Subjective Logic (SL). By combining these guarantees with beliefs about how often each situation occurs, CUBICS derives an overall risk estimate for each component without requiring a monolithic system-level statistical model, and thus provides a building block for modular, field-data based safety assurance.
papers.comment: To be published in the proceedings for the 37th International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CUBICS，一个面向安全相关 ML 组件（MLC）的上下文模块化性能估计框架。作者指出基于现场数据（field data）的贝叶斯安全论证常把失败建模为单一全局失败概率的伯努利过程，不适合性能强烈依赖情境的 ML 组件；CUBICS 将运行设计域划分为情境，为每个组件定义情境特定的假设与概率保证，并用主观逻辑（Subjective Logic, SL）以贝叶斯方式表示和更新，最终组合情境发生频率得到组件级风险估计，无需构建系统级统一统计模型。
Motivation: 安全工程中基于现场数据的贝叶斯方法通常假设 i.i.d. 伯努利失败过程，这对性能依赖上下文的 ML 组件不充分；同时统计证据需要覆盖相关情境与边缘情况，而构建整个系统的单一统计模型通常不可行。
Method: CUBICS 将运行设计域（operational design domain）划分为情境，对每个安全相关组件定义情境特定的假设与概率保证；这些保证使用主观逻辑（SL）以贝叶斯方式表示与更新，再与情境发生频率的信念结合，推导每个组件的总体风险估计，作为模块化现场数据安全论证的构建块。
Result: 论文在方法论层面提出上述框架，摘要未给出具体实验数据或基准结果。
Conclusion: CUBICS 提供一种无需系统级整体统计模型即可进行组件级、情境感知性能估计的途径，可作为模块化、基于现场数据的安全保证（safety assurance）的基础组件。
Relevance: 2
