papers.title: DeepInsight II: One Trace from Benchmark to Robot
papers.abstract_en: Across a Physical AI stack, evaluation maturity is inversely aligned with deployment risk: foundation models enjoy mature, standardized harnesses, while the embodied layers on which deployment actually turns remain fragmented across benchmark-specific simulators, embodiments, and interfaces. The first DeepInsight report (v1) unified evaluation across this stack behind three abstractions---task, resource, and result---but its quantitative evidence centered on the foundation-model layer; navigation and manipulation (System 1) and whole-body control (System 0) remained simulation case studies, and physical execution was outside its empirical scope. DeepInsight II keeps that substrate fixed and quantifies the embodied half. First, it reproduces released-checkpoint references across two navigation and four manipulation benchmarks under their native protocols. Second, MotionBench places four released whole-body controllers under one workload and metric contract, then carries a qualified within-family cohort from parallel simulation to matched real-robot trials in which simulated and physical rollouts share a parent trace identity while retaining execution-domain-specific records, making the sim-to-real gap a native reduction rather than a reconciliation across toolchains. Third, a composed System 2--1--0 study extends trace localization into five evidence-grounded handoff labels, each mapped to a concrete repair action, with a measured repairability criterion and physical episodes testing the same attribution under hardware-observable state. The contribution is therefore not a new evaluation architecture, but empirical continuity from benchmark execution to matched robot evidence and repair-oriented diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是DeepInsight系列的第二份报告，在保持v1提出的task/resource/result三抽象不变的前提下，专门量化embodied层（System 0/1/2）的评估。具体工作包括：按原生协议复现两个导航和四个操作基准的已发布checkpoint参考；提出MotionBench，将四个已发布的全身控制器置于统一工作负载和指标契约下，并从并行仿真推进到匹配的真实机器人试验，使sim-to-real差距成为原生归约；还开展了System 2-1-0组合研究，将trace定位扩展为五个有证据支持的handoff标签并映射到具体修复动作。作者强调贡献不是新评估架构，而是从基准执行到匹配机器人证据和面向修复的诊断之间的经验连续性。
Motivation: Physical AI评估栈中评估成熟度与部署风险呈倒挂：基础模型层已有成熟标准化测试框架，而决定部署成败的embodied层仍碎片化于各基准专属的模拟器、具身形态和接口。v1报告只对基础模型层提供了量化证据，导航/操作和全身控制仍停留在仿真案例，物理执行不在其经验范围内。
Method: 固定v1抽象基座，针对embodied半场做三件事：1）在原生协议下复现两个导航和四个操作基准的released-checkpoint参考；2）MotionBench将四个已发布全身控制器放在同一工作负载与指标契约下，并将合格的同族队列从并行仿真带到匹配的真实机器人试验，仿真与物理rollout共享父轨迹身份但保留执行域特定记录；3）组合System 2-1-0研究把trace定位扩展为五个证据支持的handoff标签，每个标签映射到一个具体修复动作，并用硬件可观测状态在物理回合中检验同一归因。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值指标，但报告称该方法使sim-to-real差距成为原生归约而非跨工具链的对齐，并给出了可测量的可修复性判据（measured repairability criterion）。

papers.title: Supervising the Path to Fine Scales: GalerkinFlow for Scientific-Field and Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Most super-resolution models learn from paired data by supervising only the final high-resolution output. This provides little control over how the prediction should evolve between the downsampled observation and its fine target. We introduce GalerkinFlow, an equation-agnostic framework that turns each coarse--fine pair into supervision along an entire reconstruction path. At a random sample of intermediate states on the reconstruction path, the model predicts the coarse-to-fine residual velocity and uses coarse-anchor point to define a pseudo-endpoint. We show that the reconstruction loss of this pseudo-endpoint is exactly related to the intermediate velocity loss through a known time-dependent weight. Consequently, every intermediate state contributes supervision toward the same fine target, rather than serving only as an internal step toward an endpoint loss. Because intermediate states already reveal part of the missing fine-scale structure, we additionally supervise the coarse endpoint used during one-step inference. A finite-difference objective further constrains local spatial variation. GalerkinFlow combines convolutional features with scale-conditioned Galerkin operator mixing and requires no governing equation or physical metadata. It achieves the lowest raw-space errors among the evaluated equation-agnostic baselines on Navier--Stokes and Darcy Flow, while remaining competitive on DIV2K.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GalerkinFlow，一个方程无关 (equation-agnostic) 的超分辨率框架，将每个粗-细样本对转化为沿整个重建路径的监督。模型在路径上的随机中间状态预测粗到细的残差速度，并借助粗锚点定义伪端点；摘要证明该伪端点的重建损失与中间速度损失之间存在已知的时变权重关系，因此每个中间状态都直接为同一细目标提供监督。该方法结合卷积特征与尺度条件的 Galerkin 算子混合，不需要控制方程或物理元数据，并在 Navier-Stokes 与 Darcy Flow 上取得最低的 raw-space 误差，在 DIV2K 上保持有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有超分模型大多只监督最终高分辨率输出，对预测如何从降采样观测逐步演化为细尺度目标缺乏控制。
Method: 提出 GalerkinFlow：在重建路径的随机中间状态上预测粗到细残差速度，用粗锚点定义伪端点并建立其损失与中间速度损失的精确关系；额外监督一步推理中使用的粗端点，并用有限差分目标约束局部空间变化。
Result: 在所评估的方程无关基线中，该方法在 Navier-Stokes 和 Darcy Flow 上取得最低 raw-space 误差，并在 DIV2K 上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调中间状态本身已揭示部分缺失的细尺度结构，因而所有中间状态都朝同一细目标提供监督，而非仅作为端点损失的内部步骤。

papers.title: VCE-Skill: Enhancing Skill Self-Evolution with Version-Change Experience
papers.abstract_en: Agents increasingly rely on reusable skills to encode task knowledge, tool-use procedures, and validation rules. Existing skill self-evolution methods primarily revise skills using execution trajectories collected from current tasks, leaving the evolution knowledge accumulated in public skill version histories largely untapped. Our pilot study reveals a clear complementarity between the two sources: public skill changes provide reusable evolution priors, whereas trajectories provide evidence grounded in the current task. Motivated by this, we propose VCE-Skill, which distills noisy and implementation-specific public skill changes into reusable, structured version-change experience and adaptively fuses it with trajectory-derived proposals from the base evolver, thereby exploiting external experience while retaining task-specific evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VCE-Skill improves skill self-evolution, increasing mean scores by 3.20--4.98 points; transfer experiments further show that the resulting skills achieve stronger cross-model transfer performance. Our work highlights public skill version changes as a previously underexplored yet effective source of prior knowledge and advances trajectory-driven skill self-evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能体技能自进化问题，提出 VCE-Skill，利用公共技能版本历史中蕴含的演化知识来改进技能更新。作者将嘈杂且实现特定的公共技能变更蒸馏为可复用的结构化版本变更经验，并与轨迹派生的提案自适应融合。摘要报告该方法在技能自进化任务上平均分提升 3.20–4.98 点，且所得技能具有更强的跨模型迁移性能。
Motivation: 现有技能自进化方法主要利用当前任务执行轨迹来修订技能，忽略了公共技能版本历史中积累的演化知识；试点研究表明公共技能变更提供可复用的演化先验，而轨迹提供当前任务证据，两者具有互补性。
Method: 提出 VCE-Skill，把公共技能变更蒸馏成结构化、可复用的版本变更经验，并在基础进化器（base evolver）产生的轨迹派生提案基础上自适应融合该经验，从而在利用外部经验的同时保留任务特定证据。
Result: 大量实验表明 VCE-Skill 改善了技能自进化，平均分提升 3.20–4.98 点；迁移实验进一步显示所得技能具备更强的跨模型迁移性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调公共技能版本变体是一个此前未被充分挖掘但有效的先验知识来源，并推进了基于轨迹的技能自进化方向。

papers.title: One Residual with Three Reuses: A Wristband Front End for Gesture Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Continuous wrist-worn hand sensing for gesture interfaces and motor symptom monitoring needs an always-on front end that fits inside a coin-cell power budget while pairing a micro-electro-mechanical-systems (MEMS) inertial measurement unit (IMU) with a 60 GHz frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar to stay robust under occlusion and on-body drift. We present a design study of such a wristband front end in which classifier wake-up gating, mmWave versus IMU routing, and innovation-based EKF measurement reweighting share a single on-chip residual generator. The shared generator occupies 14.4 KB of program memory and 278 B of state and runs at 110K multiply-accumulates (MACs) per frame on an Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus class edge microcontroller unit (MCU). Across four public sensor data corpora (IPN Hand, SHREC 2021, MiliPoint 60 GHz FMCW radar, EAT-Radar) the front end reaches detection probability $P_D = 0.72/0.80$ at a 1% false-alarm rate, sustains a 47% classifier invocation energy reduction at 90% gesture detection recall, and lowers pose tracking root-mean-square error by $4.6\times$ under measurement bias drift relative to an adaptive Kalman with $R$-inflation baseline. Measured silicon power and on-body capture are deferred to follow-on hardware; the contribution here is a design study.
papers.comment: 3 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Design study: results are from four public corpora; measured silicon power and on-body capture are out of scope and deferred to follow-on hardware work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于腕带式手势感知前端的设计研究，提出让分类器唤醒门控、毫米波与 IMU 路由选择、基于创新的 EKF 测量重加权共享同一个片上残差生成器，以在硬币电池功耗预算内实现连续手部感知。该生成器占用 14.4 KB 程序内存和 278 B 状态，在 Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus 级 MCU 上每帧运行 110K 次乘累加。在四个公开传感器数据集上，前端在 1% 虚警率下达到 P_D=0.72/0.80，在 90% 手势检测召回率下降低 47% 分类器调用能耗，并在测量偏差漂移下将位姿跟踪 RMSE 相比自适应 Kalman 基线降低 4.6 倍。实测硅片功耗和穿戴采集留待后续硬件工作。
Motivation: 连续腕戴手势感知需要始终在线的感知前端，同时要在硬币电池功耗预算内工作，并在遮挡和佩戴漂移下保持鲁棒性；现有方案难以同时满足 MEMS IMU 与 60 GHz FMCW 雷达的配对需求。
Method: 提出一个设计研究，核心是让三种功能共享单一片上残差生成器：分类器唤醒门控、mmWave 与 IMU 路由选择、基于创新的 EKF 测量重加权，从而降低资源占用。
Result: 在 IPN Hand、SHREC 2021、MiliPoint 和 EAT-Radar 四个公开语料上，前端在 1% 虚警率下达到检测概率 0.72/0.80；在 90% 手势检测召回率下实现 47% 的分类器调用能耗削减；相对自适应 Kalman 的 R-inflation 基线，在测量偏差漂移下位姿跟踪 RMSE 降低 4.6 倍。
Conclusion: 本文贡献仅限于设计研究，未包含实测硅片功耗与穿戴场景采集数据，这些指标被推迟到后续硬件工作验证。

papers.title: Automating Learner Assessment: Benchmarking Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for EEG-Based Familiarity Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Objective assessment of learning remains a fundamental challenge in education. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a direct, non-invasive window into the neural correlates of knowledge acquisition, including cognitive familiarity. This study benchmarks fifteen machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models for EEG-based familiarity prediction across two cognitive domains: faces (factual knowledge) and mathematical equations (conceptual knowledge). Using continuous EEG data from 23 participants, we extract spectral features (Power Spectral Density) across six frequency bands. We show that while standard stratified cross-validation yields artificially high classification performance (up to 0.9853 F1-score using CNN) due to temporal leakage across neighboring epochs, a rigorous trial-independent validation (Group K-Fold) drops the peak performance to 0.6038 F1-score (using CNN), which is still statistically significant above the 25% chance level. This highlights the critical necessity of trial-independent evaluation to avoid overestimating model generalizability. Furthermore, feature importance and SHAP analysis reveal that temporal and frontal Gamma and Beta oscillations are the most critical biomarkers for familiarity. This work establishes a realistic benchmark for EEG-based cognitive monitoring in educational technologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评测了15种机器学习和深度学习模型在EEG数据上的熟悉度预测任务，覆盖面孔（事实知识）和数学方程（概念知识）两个认知域。基于23名参与者的连续EEG信号提取六频段功率谱密度特征，作者发现标准的按层分层交叉验证会因时间泄漏产生虚高的F1分数（CNN达0.9853），而改用试次独立的Group K-Fold验证后峰值降至0.6038，仍显著高于25%随机水平。特征重要性和SHAP分析表明颞叶与额叶的Gamma和Beta振荡是最关键的熟悉度生物标志物。
Motivation: 教育中学习成果的客观评估仍是根本性挑战，EEG提供了知识获取神经关联的直接窗口，但缺乏对EEG熟悉度预测模型泛化能力的严谨基准，尤其是评估协议中的时间泄漏问题。
Method: 在连续EEG数据上提取六个频段的功率谱密度（PSD）特征，分别采用标准分层交叉验证和试次独立的Group K-Fold验证，对15个ML/DL模型进行基准测试，并用特征重要性和SHAP分析识别关键生物标志物。
Result: 标准分层交叉验证下CNN达到最高F1分数0.9853，但Group K-Fold验证下峰值降至CNN的0.6038，仍显著高于25%随机水平；颞叶和额叶的Gamma与Beta振荡被识别为最重要的熟悉度相关特征。
Conclusion: 摘要强调试次独立的评估协议对避免高估模型泛化能力至关重要，该工作为教育技术中的EEG认知监测建立了现实基准。

summary_sections.motivation: 教育中学习成果的客观评估仍是根本性挑战，EEG提供了知识获取神经关联的直接窗口，但缺乏对EEG熟悉度预测模型泛化能力的严谨基准，尤其是评估协议中的时间泄漏问题。
summary_sections.method: 在连续EEG数据上提取六个频段的功率谱密度（PSD）特征，分别采用标准分层交叉验证和试次独立的Group K-Fold验证，对15个ML/DL模型进行基准测试，并用特征重要性和SHAP分析识别关键生物标志物。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调试次独立的评估协议对避免高估模型泛化能力至关重要，该工作为教育技术中的EEG认知监测建立了现实基准。

papers.title: Listen, Reason, and Segment: Aligning LALMs with Editorial Judgment for Media Chapterization
papers.abstract_en: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) have made rapid progress on standardized benchmarks, yet their deployment in practical media workflows, curation, archival indexing, and content distribution remains largely unrealized. We identify automated audio chapterization, the task of segmenting continuous audio streams into thematically coherent chapters, as a demanding and commercially consequential setting that exposes this gap. Chapterization is challenging because boundaries are defined less by objective acoustic events than by subjective editorial judgment, requiring models to reason sequentially over long acoustic contexts and approximate creator-authored boundary decisions. We present AudioChaps, a post-training framework for aligning end-to-end LALMs for this task via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) guided by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. To support training and evaluation, we curate three datasets: AudioChaps-Alignment, derived from creator-annotated chapter boundaries on YouTube; AudioChaps-CoT, which provides structured supervision for well-formatted, high-quality, and evidence-grounded boundary reasoning; and AudioChaps-Eval, a held-out benchmark for audio chapterization. Applying GRPO directly without a Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) cold start, AudioChaps-R1-Zero already improves average F1 by 33 points over the state-of-the-art LALM Audio-Flamingo-3-Think. The AudioChaps framework produces our final aligned LALM, AudioChaps-R1, which improves average F1 by 49 points. These results demonstrate that GRPO-trained LALMs can reliably transform unstructured auditory streams into navigable, structured media. Our code, models, and dataset resources will be released upon acceptance at https://github.com/ta012/AudioChaps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动化音频章节化 (audio chapterization) 任务，提出 AudioChaps，一个通过 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 和 Chain-of-Thought (CoT) 推理来对齐端到端大型音频语言模型 (LALM) 的后训练框架。作者整理了三个数据集（Alignment、CoT、Eval），并报告在不做监督微调 (SFT) 冷启动的情况下，AudioChaps-R1-Zero 相比最先进的 LALM Audio-Flamingo-3-Think 平均 F1 提升 33 个百分点，最终模型 AudioChaps-R1 提升 49 个百分点。摘要将该方法定位为把非结构化音频流转化为可导航结构化媒体的途径。
Motivation: 大型音频语言模型在标准化基准上进展迅速，但其在媒体工作流、策展、归档索引和内容分发中的实际部署仍很有限。自动音频章节化被指出是暴露这一差距的、要求高且具有商业价值的场景，因为章节边界更多由主观编辑判断而非客观声学事件决定，模型需要顺序推理长声学上下文并近似创作者设定的边界。
Method: 提出 AudioChaps 后训练框架，用 CoT 推理引导的 GRPO 对齐端到端 LALM；并策展三个数据集，分别是基于 YouTube 创作者标注边界得到的 AudioChaps-Alignment、提供结构化边界推理监督的 AudioChaps-CoT，以及用于评估的 AudioChaps-Eval。
Result: 摘要报告，直接应用 GRPO 而不使用 SFT 冷启动的 AudioChaps-R1-Zero 已经在平均 F1 上比最先进的 LALM Audio-Flamingo-3-Think 高出 33 个百分点；最终对齐模型 AudioChaps-R1 将平均 F1 提升 49 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，GRPO 训练的 LALM 能够可靠地将非结构化音频流转换为可导航、结构化的媒体内容；代码、模型和数据集将在论文被接收后发布。

papers.title: Automatic Cephalometric Landmark Localization on CBCT-Derived Digitally Reconstructed Radiographs for Skeletal Malocclusion Classification
papers.abstract_en: Manual cephalometric landmark annotation is important for craniofacial assessment but is labor-intensive and difficult to scale. We introduce CephViT, a Vision Transformer-based model for automated 2D lateral cephalometric landmark localization, and evaluate its use in downstream skeletal malocclusion classification. CephViT was trained and benchmarked on a public lateral cephalogram dataset, achieving a mean radial error of 1.28 +/- 1.42 mm and a successful detection rate of 92.0% at 3.0 mm. Because the private evaluation cohort consisted of 3D CBCT scans, lateral cephalogram-like digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) were generated from each volume and used as 2D inputs to the landmark localization model. Landmark coordinates were normalized into a common coordinate frame, and skeletal malocclusion classification was performed using landmarks shared between the reference and DRR-based pipelines. Classification performance using DRR-localized landmarks was comparable to that obtained using manually annotated reference landmarks, with accuracies of 70.0% and 68.3%, respectively. These results support the feasibility of automated cephalometric analysis on CBCT-derived DRRs for skeletal malocclusion assessment.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the ODIN 2026 Workshop, held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CephViT，一个基于 Vision Transformer 的模型，用于自动化 2D 侧位头颅标志点定位，并将其用于下游骨骼性错颌畸形分类。模型在公共头颅 X 线数据集上达到 1.28±1.42 mm 的平均径向误差和 92.0% 的 3.0 mm 内成功检出率；在私有 CBCT 队列中，通过生成 DRR 作为输入，DRR 定位标志得到的分类准确率（70.0%）与手动标注标志（68.3%）相当。
Motivation: 手动头颅标志点标注对颅面评估很重要，但耗时且难以规模化，需要自动化方法；同时私有评估数据为 3D CBCT，需要将其转化为类头颅 X 线的 2D 输入。
Method: 引入 CephViT，一种 Vision Transformer 模型，从 2D 侧位头颅图像定位标志点；对 3D CBCT 体积生成数字化重建 X 线片（DRR），并将标志点坐标归一化到公共坐标系，再基于共享标志点执行骨骼性错颌畸形分类。
Result: 公共数据集上平均径向误差为 1.28±1.42 mm，3.0 mm 内成功检出率为 92.0%；使用 DRR 定位标志点的分类准确率为 70.0%，与使用手动参考标志点的 68.3% 相当。
Conclusion: 摘要认为结果支持在 CBCT 衍生的 DRR 上实现自动化头颅测量分析用于骨骼性错颌畸形评估的可行性。

papers.title: FLEET: Token-Based Feature Extraction for Event Camera-based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras generate asynchronous, high-frequency data streams offering spatially sparse information at lower latency than traditional cameras.In principle, these properties should be ideal for the design of control policies.However, reinforcement learning research in this field remains limited as existing approaches fail to fully exploit the sensor's properties.CNN-based methods negate the sensors benefits by aggregating events into sparse grids. This couples compute cost to sensor resolution and blurs the temporal information. Meanwhile, existing generative baselines rely on the availability of trajectory data to pretrain the model. We propose FLEET (Feature Learning from Events via Efficient Tokenization), a feature extractor that processes event sequences directly. Leveraging random Fourier features and cross-attention, our architecture compresses variable streams into fixed-size latent representations. This decouples inference cost of the feature extractor's backbone from the sensor's resolution, enabling end-to-end learning without auxiliary losses. We validate FLEET on a new, high-throughput benchmark. The results demonstrate that our sequence-based approach surpasses SOTA performance and exhibits superior robustness to variations in observation frequencies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FLEET (Feature Learning from Events via Efficient Tokenization)，一种面向事件相机强化学习的特征提取器。FLEET 直接处理事件序列，利用随机傅里叶特征 (random Fourier features) 和交叉注意力 (cross-attention) 将可变长度的事件流压缩为固定大小的隐表示，从而将骨干网络推理成本与传感器分辨率解耦，并支持无辅助损失 (auxiliary losses) 的端到端学习。作者在新的高通量基准上验证，称该序列化方法超越现有 SOTA 性能，并对观测频率变化表现出更强的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 事件相机产生异步高频、空间稀疏的数据，原理上适合控制策略设计，但现有 RL 方法未能充分利用传感器特性。CNN 方法将事件聚合到稀疏网格，使计算成本与传感器分辨率耦合且模糊时间信息；已有的生成式基线则依赖轨迹数据预训练，限制了该领域研究。
Method: 提出 FLEET 特征提取器，直接处理原始事件序列而非聚合网格。架构采用随机傅里叶特征与交叉注意力机制，将可变长度的事件流压缩为固定大小的潜在表示，解耦推理成本与传感器分辨率，并通过端到端训练避免辅助损失。
Result: 在一个新的高通量基准上，FLEET 的序列化方法在性能上超过现有 SOTA，并在观测频率变化场景下表现出更优的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，直接处理事件序列并解耦推理成本与传感器分辨率可以更充分地发挥事件相机的优势，实现端到端学习。

papers.title: Data-Driven Reconstruction of Spatially Resolved Electron and Ion Energy Distributions from Macroscopic Plasma Quantities with Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Spatially resolved EEDFs/IEDFs provide essential kinetic information about low-temperature plasmas (LTPs) and play a central role in determining transport, chemical reaction rates, and plasma surface interactions. While kinetic simulations directly resolve these distributions, experimental measurements remain challenging and are often invasive, spatially limited, or require assumptions regarding the distribution shape such as a Maxwellian. However, several macroscopic plasma observables can be measured non-invasively using advanced diagnostic techniques, providing spatially resolved information about the plasma state. An important inverse problem is therefore whether readily measurable macroscopic plasma quantities contain sufficient information to reconstruct the underlying kinetic state. In this work, we investigate this problem by learning a nonlinear mapping from spatially resolved macroscopic plasma observables to the corresponding spatially resolved EEDFs/IEDFs using a deep learning framework. Paired datasets comprising 2D macroscopic observables and spatially resolved EDFs are generated using 2D-3V PIC-MCC simulations. Three representative learning paradigms, a U-Net, a FNO, and a MeshGraphNet, are employed in this study to learn this inverse mapping. The predicted EDFs reproduce both bulk plasma and sheath characteristics with good agreement to the PIC-MCC reference data, with the FNO providing the best overall performance. Beyond conventional metrics, physics-based validation demonstrates that the reconstructed EDFs accurately recover the corresponding density and temperature, and rate coefficients. These results demonstrate that macroscopic plasma observables encode sufficient information to infer important kinetic properties in LTPs, providing a potential foundation for surrogate kinetic modeling and next-generation plasma diagnostics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究低温和等离子体（LTP）中，能否从可非侵入测量的宏观等离子体可观测量出发，重建空间分辨的电子/离子能量分布函数（EEDF/IEDF）。作者用 2D-3V PIC-MCC 模拟生成配对数据集，并训练 U-Net、FNO 和 MeshGraphNet 三种深度学习模型学习该逆映射。结果显示 FNO 整体性能最佳，重建的 EDF 能较好恢复体等离子体与鞘层特征，并准确还原密度、温度及速率系数。
Motivation: 实验测量 EEDF/IEDF 往往具有侵入性、空间分辨率有限，且常需假设分布形状（如 Maxwellian）；而宏观等离子体可观测量可以非侵入地获得空间分辨信息。因此一个关键逆问题是：这些宏观量是否包含足够信息来重建潜在的动力学状态。
Method: 通过 2D-3V PIC-MCC 模拟生成由二维宏观可观测量与空间分辨 EDF 组成的配对数据集，然后采用三种代表性学习范式——U-Net、FNO（Fourier Neural Operator）和 MeshGraphNet——学习从宏观量到 EEDF/IEDF 的非线性逆映射。
Result: 预测的 EDF 在体等离子体和鞘层特性上与 PIC-MCC 参考数据吻合良好，其中 FNO 取得最佳整体性能；超越常规指标，基于物理的验证表明重建的 EDF 能准确恢复对应的密度、温度和速率系数。
Conclusion: 宏观等离子体可观测量编码了足够信息来推断 LTP 中的重要动力学属性，为替代性动力学建模（surrogate kinetic modeling）和下一代等离子体诊断提供了潜在基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Context Misleads: Intent-Guided Decoding for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves large language models by grounding generation in external evidence, but it also introduces a source trust problem: retrieved context may be useful, irrelevant, or even misleading. Existing RAG systems often apply a fixed trust policy toward retrieved evidence, which can either over-trust incorrect context or underuse context when the user explicitly asks for context-following behavior. Therefore, we propose Intent-Guided Decoding (IGD), a framework that arbitrates between retrieved context and parametric memory according to user intent. IGD uses answer-level filtering and token-level correction to steer the final decoding trajectory between retrieved context and parametric memory. We evaluate IGD on three faithful QA benchmarks and three factual-conflict benchmarks across five LLMs, IGD substantially improves factual recovery, achieving gains of up to 65.4 percentage points on factual-conflict benchmarks over Direct RAG, while preserving or improving strict context-following behavior, this findings highlight the importance of balancing factuality and faithfulness in RAG.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 提出 IGD 框架，利用答案级过滤（answer-level filtering）和 token 级校正（token-level correction），在解码阶段根据用户意图在检索上下文与参数记忆之间选择或融合生成轨迹。

Conclusion: 摘要强调在 RAG 中平衡事实性（factuality）与忠实性（faithfulness）的重要性，IGD 通过按意图仲裁检索上下文与参数记忆来实现这一平衡。

papers.title: Matched Outcomes, Divergent Gaze: How Foveated MLLMs Search Compared to Humans
papers.abstract_en: Human visual search is serial: the fovea must land on a candidate to confirm it, and those landings form a scanpath. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs), given the same foveated input, search as humans do bears on their use as models of human vision and on attention-alignment scores. We compare three general-purpose MLLMs with human eye-movement scanpaths on goal-directed search (COCO-Search18), driving each model fixation by fixation through an identical, human-matched foveated view and assessing it along three axes: the decision of target presence, the efficiency of reaching the target, and the gaze process itself. The axes dissociate. On the decision and on target acquisition the models match or exceed humans, detecting present targets near ceiling and reaching them on the first saccade more often than people do. The gaze process is not human. Under the human-matched condition, all three share one signature: low-entropy, large-amplitude, self-consistent scanpaths that agree with themselves far more closely than two humans agree with each other. That is consistent with a single-pass, non-serial architecture rather than a limit of acuity. Matched retinal input reproduces where humans look but not how the looking unfolds in time, and no degradation regime recovers human-like search at human-like success. The gap sits on a process axis that answer-alignment and saliency metrics do not measure. Because they miss it, such metrics cannot certify human-like vision, and zero-shot models suit outcome and spatial questions but not temporal, process-level ones.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了三种通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）与人类在目标导向搜索任务（COCO-Search18）上的眼动扫描路径（scanpath），通过将每个模型逐注视点地驱动通过与人类匹配的中央凹（foveated）输入，并从目标存在性判断、到达目标的效率以及注视过程三个维度进行评估。摘要显示模型在结果性维度上达到或超越人类水平，但注视过程与人类不同：三类模型都表现出低熵、大幅幅、高自一致性的扫描路径。作者据此认为现有的答案对齐和显著性指标无法捕捉这一过程层面的差异。
Motivation: 人类视觉搜索是串行的，中央凹必须落在候选目标上才能确认，而多模态大语言模型在相同中央凹输入下是否像人类一样搜索，关系到它们能否作为人类视觉模型以及注意力对齐分数的有效性。现有的结果对齐或显著性类指标只衡量答案或空间位置，未衡量时间上的过程性差异。
Method: 在 COCO-Search18 上比较三个通用 MLLM 与人类眼动扫描路径，逐注视点地将模型置于相同的人类匹配中央凹视图中，并沿三条轴线评估：目标存在性判断、到达目标的效率、以及注视过程本身。
Result: 在目标存在性判断和目标获取上，模型匹配或超过人类，接近满分的检出率且比人类更常在第一次眼跳就到达目标。但在人类匹配条件下，三个模型的注视过程都不像人类：扫描路径低熵、大振幅、自一致，模型内部一致性远高于两个人之间的一致性；没有任何退化设置能在保持人类水平成功率的同时恢复类似人类的搜索过程。
Conclusion: 匹配的视网膜输入能复现人类看的位置，但无法复现人类看的时序展开方式；差距位于答案对齐和显著性指标测量不到的过程轴上，因此这些指标无法证明类人视觉能力，零样本模型适合结果性和空间性问题，不适合时间性、过程层面的问题。

papers.title: MLLM-Guided Semantic Correction for Text-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion models and Transformer architectures have led to significant progress in text-to-video generation. However, these models often suffer from semantic errors such as missing objects, incorrect attributes, or mismatched actions. Although some semantic correction methods perform optimization before sampling or refinement after sampling, how to detect and correct semantic deviations during the video generation process remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce a training-free, interpretable mid-generation correction framework that integrates multimodal large language model (MLLM) feedback directly into the diffusion sampling loop. Our framework achieves diffusion trajectory correction by injecting semantic evaluation signals during video synthesis, enabling the model to optimize the generated content through continuous self-reflection. We propose two key modules: a Semantic Assessment Supervisor that generates intermediate preview frames for semantic evaluations and deviation diagnostics, and a Semantic Modification Assistant that corrects semantic drift during inference via a controllable latent trajectory intervention. Our method improves semantic alignment, visual fidelity, and temporal consistency without modifying model parameters. We validate the effectiveness of our approach through extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种训练无关、可解释的生成中途语义校正框架，用于文本到视频生成。框架将多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的反馈直接注入扩散采样循环，通过语义评估监督器和语义修改辅助模块，在视频合成过程中检测并修正语义偏差（如缺失对象、属性错误或动作不匹配）。摘要称该方法在不修改模型参数的情况下提升了语义对齐、视觉保真度和时间一致性。
Motivation: 现有文本到视频扩散模型常出现缺失对象、属性错误或动作不匹配等语义错误；已有方法多在采样前优化或采样后精修，对生成过程中的语义偏差检测与校正研究不足。
Method: 提出训练无关的生成中途校正框架：Semantic Assessment Supervisor 生成中间预览帧用于语义评估与偏差诊断，Semantic Modification Assistant 通过可控潜在轨迹干预在推理时修正语义漂移，并将 MLLM 的语义评估信号注入扩散采样循环实现轨迹校正。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多个基准上的大量实验表明，其在不修改模型参数的情况下改善了语义对齐、视觉保真度和时间一致性。
Conclusion: 该方法通过生成过程中的连续自我反思实现扩散轨迹校正，可作为无需训练的语义修正方案；其有效性已在多基准实验中验证。

papers.title: LLMs for Zero-Shot Threat Detection via Structured Risk Indicators
papers.abstract_en: We propose a two-stage large language model (LLM) framework for zero-shot detection of insider threats and advanced persistent threats (APTs) from heterogeneous security logs. The framework models user activity as chronological timelines and incorporates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to provide personalised behavioural context from each user's historical activity. Rather than performing end-to-end classification directly from raw logs, it first generates structured, interpretable sets of threat-specific risk indicators, which are then classified jointly across temporal sequences to capture attack patterns spanning multiple windows.The framework is evaluated on two benchmark datasets, CERT r5.2 for insider threat detection and PicoDomain for APT detection, using four combinations of two open-weight LLMs under both retrieval and non-retrieval settings. All configurations outperform the previous state-of-the-art LLM-based framework (GABM), with the best configuration improving the F1-score by 11.40 percentage points on CERT r5.2 and 31.50 percentage points on PicoDomain. Results further show that retrieval mainly benefits weaker LLMs by generating more discriminative risk indicators, whereas stronger models achieve comparable performance without retrieved context. The most effective assignment of LLMs to the two stages depends on the dataset. These findings show that the quality of the generated risk indicators is the main driver of zero-shot cyber threat detection performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段大语言模型框架，用于对异构安全日志中的内部威胁 (insider threats) 和高级持续性威胁 (APTs) 进行零样本检测。框架将用户活动建模为时间线，并通过检索增强生成 (RAG) 引入每个用户历史活动的个性化行为上下文；先生成结构化的威胁特定风险指标，再跨时间序列联合分类这些指标，以捕捉跨多个窗口的攻击模式。在 CERT r5.2 和 PicoDomain 两个基准上，四种开放权重 LLM 组合均超过此前最优的 LLM 框架 GABM，最佳配置的 F1 分数分别提升 11.40 和 31.50 个百分点。
Motivation: 安全日志中的内部威胁与 APT 检测需要零样本泛化能力，而直接对原始日志做端到端分类难以解释，也难以捕捉跨时间窗口的复杂攻击模式；现有方法在这一任务上的性能仍有提升空间。
Method: 提出两阶段 LLM 框架：第一阶段将用户活动构建为时间线，并通过 RAG 提供个性化历史行为上下文，生成可解释的威胁特定风险指标；第二阶段联合分类这些跨时间序列的风险指标，而非直接从原始日志分类。
Result: 在 CERT r5.2 和 PicoDomain 上，所有配置均优于此前 SOTA 的 GABM；最佳配置 F1 分数分别提升 11.40 和 31.50 个百分点。检索主要提升较弱 LLM 的表现，而较强模型在无检索上下文时也能达到相当性能；两个阶段的最优 LLM 分配因数据集而异。
Conclusion: 摘要强调生成的风险指标质量是零样本网络威胁检测性能的主要驱动因素，且检索增强与模型选择的影响取决于具体数据集。

papers.title: Large language models as synthetic clinical experts to inform longitudinal rare-disease modeling
papers.abstract_en: Due to the limited amount of information, modeling longitudinal rare-disease data can benefit from integrating clinical knowledge. Yet, elicitation of expert knowledge and formalization for model fitting is challenging, in particular due to limited time of clinical experts. To nevertheless make domain knowledge accessible during model fitting, we use large language models (LLMs) as synthetic clinical experts to supervise a variational-autoencoder-based approach that learns low-dimensional latent summaries of visit-level observations. Specifically, LLMs are queried offline on textual descriptions of patient observations to obtain judgments, e.g., the suspected clinical category. To improve the variational autoencoder fit, we train a differentiable surrogate model on these judgments and augment the loss function to encourage reconstructions that preserve the clinical-label distribution of their corresponding input profile. In an application to longitudinal motor-function assessments from children with spinal muscular atrophy, we map visit-level clinical profiles to low-dimensional representations that are linked by a multivariate mixed-effects model. The synthetic expert loss discourages reconstructions that remain numerically close in data space but alter the clinical interpretation of the reconstructed motor function profile, such as by crossing a disease-type boundary. We thus reduced disagreement between original and reconstructed SMA type labels from about 11 to 7 percent. Furthermore, informing the latent representation by the synthetic expert improved prediction of motor function milestones compared with unsupervised latent representations and a data-level baseline. These results suggest that incorporating LLMs into model fitting can make clinical knowledge available to representation learning and improve clinical faithfulness for longitudinal rare-disease data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）作为“合成临床专家”来监督基于变分自编码器（VAE）的纵向罕见病数据建模。LLM 被离线查询以对患者访视的文本描述给出临床判断（如疑似临床类别），作者训练一个可微代理模型并将这些判断加入损失函数，鼓励重建结果保留输入临床标签分布。应用场景是脊髓性肌萎缩症（spinal muscular atrophy，SMA）儿童的纵向运动功能评估，结果显示该方法降低了原始与重建 SMA 类型标签的不一致，并改善了运动功能里程碑预测。
Motivation: 纵向罕见病数据信息量有限，整合临床知识有助于建模，但专家知识的获取与形式化很困难，且临床专家时间有限；因此需要一种在模型拟合过程中让领域知识可用、同时不占用临床专家大量时间的方式。
Method: 使用 LLM 作为合成临床专家，离线查询患者观察的文本描述以获得临床判断；训练一个可微代理模型（differentiable surrogate model）模拟这些判断，并将其用于增强 VAE 的损失函数，促使重建保留对应输入临床标签分布；随后用多元混合效应模型（multivariate mixed-effects model）关联访视级低维表征。
Result: 摘要报告原始与重建 SMA 类型标签的不一致从约 11% 降至约 7%；与无监督潜在表征及数据级基线相比，利用合成专家信息改进潜在表征后，对运动功能里程碑的预测得到了改善。

papers.title: Density-Reweighted Entropic Optimal Transport: Decoupling Geometry from Sampling Density
papers.abstract_en: Dataset alignment is a central step in data analysis across science and engineering, where the goal is to match observations between datasets. Entropic Optimal Transport (EOT) offers a computationally tractable framework for this task by encoding cross-dataset affinities in a transport plan. However, when two datasets are sampled from geometrically similar low-dimensional structures with substantially different sampling densities, the EOT plan may match points by relative sampling density rather than geometric proximity, yielding geometrically misleading correspondences. To address this issue, we propose a density-reweighted EOT framework in which the influence of sampling density on the transport plan can be discounted to a desired degree, ranging from standard EOT to alignment driven purely by underlying geometry. Under suitable regularity conditions, we establish convergence of the reweighted EOT plan to a family of population-level plans whose dependence on sampling density is made explicit. Through simulations, we show that our approach recovers geometrically faithful correspondences, improving over related EOT-based frameworks when datasets exhibit substantial sampling density disparity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出密度重加权熵正则最优传输 (density-reweighted EOT) 框架，用于数据集对齐。当两个数据集来自几何相似的低维结构但采样密度差异显著时，标准 EOT 计划会按相对采样密度而非几何邻近度匹配点；作者引入可调的密度折扣程度，使对齐从标准 EOT 过渡到纯几何驱动。在合适的正则条件下，文章证明重加权 EOT 计划收敛到一族人口级计划，并通过模拟实验显示其能恢复几何上忠实的对应关系。
Motivation: 标准 EOT 在采样密度差异大的数据集间会产生几何误导的对应关系，因为传输计划被相对采样密度而非几何邻近度主导。这会影响数据集对齐这一数据科学核心步骤的可靠性。
Method: 提出密度重加权 EOT 框架，通过参数化权重对采样密度在传输计划中的影响进行折扣，覆盖从标准 EOT 到纯几何对齐的连续范围；并在正则条件下建立重加权 EOT 计划向一族人口级计划的收敛性，显式刻画其对采样密度的依赖。
Result: 模拟实验表明，在数据集存在显著采样密度差异时，该方法能恢复几何上忠实的对应关系，并优于相关的基于 EOT 的对齐框架。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架可在采样密度异质的情况下改善基于 EOT 的数据集对齐，并指出收敛性结果依赖适当的正则条件；未涉及真实数据或实际应用的验证。

papers.title: NebulaVLA: A Dual-Frequency Vision-Language-Action Model With Guide Action for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Real-world deployment of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is often bottlenecked by efficiency-performance trade-offs, cross-embodiment generalization, and execution smoothness. We present NebulaVLA, an asynchronous dual-frequency architecture that decouples high-level semantic reasoning from low-level action control, optimizing computational resources and modularity. To bridge semantic gaps across heterogeneous robots, we introduce GESTURE-7, a unified language-grounded action representation. Furthermore, our Guide Action algorithm enforces kinematic continuity via mask-based smoothness constraints. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that NebulaVLA significantly outperforms synchronous baselines, achieving an 85.5\% average success rate on LIBERO-Plus and accelerating action generation by \textasciitilde 2.7$\times$. This asynchronous design enables highly efficient and responsive control for practical robotics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NebulaVLA，一种异步双频视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型，将高层语义推理与低层动作控制解耦，并引入统一语言接地动作表示 GESTURE-7 与 Guide Action 算法以提升跨本体泛化和执行平滑性。在 LIBERO-Plus 上平均成功率达 85.5%，动作生成加速约 2.7 倍。
Motivation: 现实部署 VLA 模型常受限于效率-性能权衡、跨本体泛化能力不足和执行平滑性问题，本文针对这些瓶颈提出异步架构方案。
Method: 采用异步双频架构解耦高层语义推理与低层动作控制；提出面向异构机器人的统一语言接地动作表示 GESTURE-7；设计 Guide Action 算法，通过基于掩码的平滑度约束强制运动学连续性。
Result: 综合评估显示 NebulaVLA 显著优于同步基线，在 LIBERO-Plus 上取得 85.5% 的平均成功率，并将动作生成速度提升约 2.7 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调异步设计可带来高效且响应的实际机器人控制，适用于实用机器人操作场景。

papers.title: When Tool-Backed Skill Retrieval Fails: Source-Style Collapse in Executable Capability Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale agents increasingly rely on retrieval to access external capabilities. We study this retrieval gate in structured tools and APIs, a measurable class of tool-backed executable skills that must be surfaced before an agent can plan, incorporate, or act. In this setting the retrieval layer can silently fail even when the capability corpus is fixed: on ToolRet, a retriever fine-tuned on one source-specific slice collapses on another source-specific slice of the same benchmark, with FT-1100 despite its higher lexical overlap with the gold tools. We call this failure mode source-style collapse. Query-side TF-IDF fingerprints flag source styles on which the fine-tuned retriever is likely to fail better than semantic or length-based proxies, giving a cheap signal for mismatch over a fixed tool corpus. We propose ToolScout, a source-aware routing method that uses this signal as a routing guard: on the mixed 4,996-query stream, TF-IDF-based routing raises coverage from 22.3% to 86.1%, and across five collapsed sources 20 matched examples raise the coverage-weighted global top-1 proxy from 1.3% to 53.9%. The same failure and routing behaviors persist when tools are rerendered as executable skill cards, which rules out raw API-schema format as the sole cause.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大规模智能体依赖检索访问外部工具能力时的静默失败问题。作者在ToolRet基准上发现，针对某一源特定切片微调的检索器会在同一基准的另一源切片上崩溃，即使词法重叠更高（如FT-1100），并将此命名为源风格崩溃（source-style collapse）。查询侧TF-IDF指纹能比语义或长度代理更好地标志易失败的源风格，据此提出源感知路由方法ToolScout，在混合4,996查询流上将覆盖率从22.3%提升到86.1%，在五个崩溃源上以20个匹配示例将覆盖率加权全局top-1代理从1.3%提升到53.9%。工具重渲染为可执行技能卡后失败与路由行为不变，说明原始API模式格式不是唯一原因。
Motivation: 大型智能体依赖检索层获取外部可执行技能，但在结构化工具与API的检索中，即使语料库固定，检索器也可能对某些源风格静默失败，导致智能体无法规划或调用所需能力。现有检索器缺乏对这种跨源泛化失败的检测与缓解手段。
Method: 提出源风格崩溃这一失败模式，利用查询侧TF-IDF指纹作为廉价信号来标记微调检索器可能失效的源风格，并在此基础上设计ToolScout，一种源感知路由方法，将该信号作为路由保护，混合使用匹配示例来改善覆盖。
Result: 在ToolRet的混合4,996查询流上，TF-IDF路由将覆盖率从22.3%提升到86.1%；在五个崩溃源上，20个匹配示例使覆盖率加权全局top-1代理从1.3%提升到53.9%。当工具被重新渲染为可执行技能卡时，同样的失败与路由行为依然存在，排除了原始API模式格式作为唯一原因。
Conclusion: 摘要表明源风格崩溃是固定工具语料库下可检测且可缓解的检索失败模式，TF-IDF指纹是一种经济有效的路由信号，且该问题不单纯由API格式引起。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OccamView: Object-Conditioned View Selection for Frame-Budgeted Active 3D Gaussian Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Active 3D Gaussian reconstruction fundamentally relies on selecting informative next-best views under limited sensing budgets. Existing active 3DGS methods primarily plan viewpoints according to geometric information gain, treating object-induced hidden regions in the same manner as general unexplored space. Under tight frame budgets, such geometry-driven strategies may prioritize global scene coverage while leaving partially observed objects incompletely reconstructed. To address this limitation, we propose OccamView, an object-conditioned view-selection framework for frame-budgeted active 3D Gaussian reconstruction. Rather than predicting unseen object geometry or performing shape completion, OccamView maintains an online object memory from open-vocabulary detections grounded in measured RGB-D observations and represents unresolved local occupancy around detected objects as conservative hidden-region proxies. Candidate viewpoints are then evaluated using an occlusion-aware proxy-coverage score. Furthermore, we introduce a Geo-Floor mechanism that restricts object-conditioned re-ranking to geometrically competitive candidates, allowing object-conditioned cues to guide complementary observations while preserving the geometry-driven exploration behavior of the underlying planner. Experiments on Replica and Matterport3D under a unified frame-budgeted protocol show that OccamView consistently reduces Completion and improves Completion Ratio across five frame budgets, with particularly pronounced gains under limited frame budgets. These results demonstrate that lightweight object-conditioned cues effectively complement geometry-driven active view planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OccamView，一种面向帧预算受限的主动 3D 高斯重建 (active 3D Gaussian reconstruction) 的物体条件视图选择框架。与现有基于几何信息增益的方法不同，OccamView 利用开放词汇检测维护在线物体记忆，将已检测物体周围的未解析局部占用表示为保守的隐藏区域代理，并通过遮挡感知的代理覆盖分数评估候选视角。实验在 Replica 和 Matterport3D 上采用统一的帧预算协议，报告该方法在五个帧预算下一致降低 Completion 并提升 Completion Ratio，尤其在帧预算紧张时收益明显。
Motivation: 现有主动 3DGS 方法主要依据几何信息增益规划视点，将物体引起的隐藏区域与一般未探索空间同等对待；在紧帧预算下，这种几何驱动策略可能偏向全局场景覆盖，导致部分可见物体重建不完整。
Method: OccamView 从 RGB-D 观测中通过开放词汇检测建立在线物体记忆，不预测未见物体几何或做形状补全，而是将检测物体周围未解析的局部占用表示为保守的隐藏区域代理；候选视角使用遮挡感知的代理覆盖分数评估，并引入 Geo-Floor 机制，仅对几何上具有竞争力的候选进行物体条件重排序，从而保留底层规划器的几何驱动探索行为。
Result: 在 Replica 和 Matterport3D 上、五个帧预算下的统一协议实验中，OccamView 一致降低了 Completion 并提升 Completion Ratio，在有限帧预算下提升尤为显著。
Conclusion: 摘要强调轻量级物体条件线索能有效补充几何驱动的主动视图规划，在帧预算受限时改善物体区域的重建完整性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调轻量级物体条件线索能有效补充几何驱动的主动视图规划，在帧预算受限时改善物体区域的重建完整性。

papers.title: Graph Machine Learning: An Opportunity for Power Systems
papers.abstract_en: Modern power systems face growing operational complexity driven by the integration of renewable energy sources, decentralization, and the need for real-time decision-making across a wide range of timescales. Addressing these challenges traditionally relies on model-based methods that, while accurate, can be too slow for operational demands. Machine learning (ML) has therefore emerged as a faster, data-driven alternative. As grid topology plays a central role in power system operation, graph machine learning (GML) methods offer a natural framework for incorporating topological dependencies as an inductive bias. We survey nearly 800 papers at the intersection of GML and power systems, covering forecasting, state estimation, optimization, control, fault diagnosis, and cybersecurity. Power systems constitute an unusually rich benchmark setting for GML, as they combine hard physical constraints, multi-scale dynamics, safety-critical requirements, and scarce labeled data within a single, well-defined domain. Conversely, power systems can benefit from utilizing GML to complement classical solvers, as GML provide scalable, topology-aware approximations with promising generalization and computational efficiency. We identify open challenges, including limited real-world deployment and the need for interpretable models in safety-critical settings. Despite the rapidly growing number of publications, standardized benchmarks and open datasets remain scarce, leaving many results difficult to reproduce and undermining the long-term scientific credibility of the field. We further derive a structured requirements catalog for ML-ready power grid benchmarks, intended to guide future dataset development and improve reproducibility across studies. We call on the community to prioritize dedicated benchmark studies and the release of open datasets and models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统综述了图机器学习 (graph machine learning, GML) 与电力系统交叉领域的近 800 篇论文，覆盖预测、状态估计、优化、控制、故障诊断和网络安全等方向。作者认为电力系统为 GML 提供了兼具物理约束、多尺度动态、安全关键性和稀缺标注的丰富基准场景，而 GML 可作为传统求解器的补充，提供可扩展、拓扑感知的近似。综述同时指出真实部署有限、可解释性不足，以及标准化基准和开放数据稀缺导致可复现性差等问题，并提出面向 ML-ready 电网基准的结构化需求清单。
Motivation: 现代电力系统因可再生能源接入、去中心化和实时决策需求而日益复杂，传统基于模型的方法虽准确但可能无法满足运行时效；电网拓扑在运行中起核心作用，因此 GML 能够以拓扑信息作为归纳偏置 (inductive bias) 提供更快的替代方案。
Method: 对 GML 与电力系统交叉领域的近 800 篇文献进行综述，按预测、状态估计、优化、控制、故障诊断和网络安全等应用方向归类，并进一步推导出用于指导未来数据集开发的 ML-ready 电网基准需求清单。
Result: 综述认为 GML 能提供可扩展且拓扑感知的近似，在泛化性和计算效率方面有前景；但标准化基准与开放数据集仍然稀缺，许多结果难以复现，影响该领域长期科学可信度。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁社区优先开展专门的基准研究并发布开放数据集和模型，同时强调在安全关键场景中需要可解释的模型；论文本身是综述和需求分析，而非提出新方法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Improved Regret Analysis for Parallel Gaussian Process Bandit Optimization
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the regret analysis for parallel Gaussian process (GP) bandit optimization. The known regret upper bounds for the widely used GP batched upper confidence bound and GP batched Thompson sampling (GP-BTS) suffer from a multiplicative factor with respect to the batch size $Q$. To avoid this degradation, existing analyses require a polynomial number of uncertainty sampling (US) for $Q$ at the beginning of optimization. However, this initial US phase is often ineffective in practice. This paper shows that the regret upper bound without the multiplicative factor on $Q$ can be achieved without the initial US phase, using GP-BTS as an example. Furthermore, we show much better regret upper bounds in the noiseless setting than in the noisy setting, as in the sequential GP bandit setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究并行高斯过程 (Gaussian process, GP) 多臂老虎机优化中的遗憾界分析。已知的 GP 批量上置信界 (GP batched UCB) 与 GP 批量汤普森采样 (GP-BTS) 的遗憾上界都含有批量大小 Q 的乘法因子，此前避免该退化的分析需要在优化初期执行多项式规模的若干轮不确定性采样 (uncertainty sampling, US)。本文以 GP-BTS 为例，证明无需初始 US 阶段也能获得不依赖 Q 乘法因子的遗憾上界，并进一步给出无噪声环境下优于噪声环境的遗憾上界。
Motivation: 并行 GP bandit 优化中，现有遗憾上界随批量大小 Q 出现乘法退化；已有的补救方案依赖初期大量不确定性采样，而该初始阶段在实践中常无效。
Method: 以 GP-batched Thompson sampling (GP-BTS) 为对象，重新分析遗憾界，去掉了对初始不确定性采样阶段的需求；并分别在噪声与无噪声设定下推导遗憾上界。
Result: 摘要指出该方法能在没有初始 US 阶段的情况下达到不含批量大小 Q 乘法因子的遗憾上界；在无噪声设定下得到的遗憾上界显著优于噪声设定，与序贯 GP bandit 的情况一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为并行 GP bandit 优化中由批量大小引起的遗憾退化并非不可避免，无需低效的初始不确定性采样也能实现更好的理论保证。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Towards Real-Time and Adaptable LiDAR Scene Completion
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR scene completion is a key component of 3D perception in autonomous driving, where the scene must be completed in real time to be usable in downstream tasks. Existing approaches typically follow an initialize-and-refine paradigm, in which a coarse initialization of the scene is first constructed, then refined into complete 3D geometry. Generative models are slower because they iteratively refine random Gaussian noise into the scene, while non-generative methods perturb the partial scene with a fixed noise scale, which limits coverage of large gaps and occluded regions and requires manual recalibration for each new sensor configuration. We present RapidLiDAR, a LiDAR scene completion method that treats the initialization itself as a learned, data-driven component. We propose an adaptive initialization module that predicts a spatially varying displacement for each partial input point, expanding the partial observations into a coarse scene initialization adapted to the local geometry, without requiring manual noise tuning. To refine this coarse initialization into a complete and coherent scene, we additionally propose a multi-scale reconstruction module that further refines point positions by querying multi-scale 3D voxel and 2D BEV feature maps constructed from the input scan. By replacing point-neighborhood operators such as farthest point sampling and $k$-nearest neighbor search with voxel- and BEV-based feature extraction, our architecture is faster and can handle different input resolutions by design. Experiments on SemanticKITTI and KITTI-360 show that our method achieves completion performance on par with the state of the art while completing a full scene in 0.1 seconds, which is 2.3 times faster than the fastest prior method. This matches the 10 Hz acquisition rate of typical automotive LiDAR sensors, taking a step toward real-time LiDAR scene completion.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCVW 2026, 14 pages, 4 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/AzharSindhi/RapidLiDAR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RapidLiDAR，一种面向自动驾驶的 LiDAR 场景补全方法。其核心在于把初始化本身作为可学习的数据驱动组件：自适应初始化模块为每个部分输入点预测空间变化的位移，把稀疏观测扩展为适配局部几何的粗糙场景初始化；随后多尺度重构模块通过查询多尺度 3D 体素与 2D BEV 特征图进一步细化点位置。实验显示该方法在 SemanticKITTI 与 KITTI-360 上取得与现有最优方法相当的补全性能，同时 0.1 秒完成整个场景，比此前最快方法快 2.3 倍，匹配 10 Hz 的汽车级 LiDAR 采集速率。
Motivation: 现有方法普遍采用 initialize-and-refine 范式：先构造粗糙初始场景再细化为完整 3D 几何。生成式模型通过迭代细化随机高斯噪声，速度较慢；非生成式方法则用固定噪声尺度扰动部分场景，难以覆盖大空洞与遮挡区域，并且每换一套传感器配置都需要手工重新校准噪声参数。
Method: 提出自适应初始化模块，学习预测每个部分输入点的空间变化位移，无需手工噪声调参；并提出多尺度重构模块，通过查询由输入扫描构建的多尺度 3D 体素与 2D BEV 特征图来细化点位置。架构用体素与 BEV 特征提取替代最远点采样（farthest point sampling）和 k 近邻搜索（k-nearest neighbor search），因而更快且天然支持不同输入分辨率。
Result: 在 SemanticKITTI 和 KITTI-360 上，方法取得与当前最优方法相当的场景补全性能，并能在 0.1 秒内完成全场景补全，比此前最快方法快 2.3 倍，对应典型汽车 LiDAR 的 10 Hz 采集率。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法朝实时且可适配的 LiDAR 场景补全迈出了一步，避免了针对不同传感器配置的手工噪声重调；摘要未提及具体局限性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HiFi-BRep: High-Fidelity Latent Representation for Robust B-Rep Generation
papers.abstract_en: Boundary representation (B-Rep) generation is a fundamental task in computer-aided design, yet the direct synthesis of high-fidelity and structurally valid B-Reps remains a major challenge. Existing deep generative methods suffer from two forms of brittleness: representation brittleness, caused by padding noise and feature contamination in the latent space, and generation brittleness, stemming from sequential error propagation and a train-inference mismatch due to non-differentiable validity enforcement. We propose HiFi-BRep, a novel framework that addresses these limitations through two synergistic contributions. First, a topology-aware encoder constructs a high-fidelity latent representation by eliminating padding via learnable queries and preventing feature contamination with topology-guided attention. Second, a single-stage decoder jointly predicts geometry and topology in parallel, embedding core manifold constraints as a differentiable learning objective. This design ensures mutual guidance between geometry and topology while avoiding cascaded errors. Extensive experiments show that HiFi-BRep significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both structural validity and geometric fidelity, providing a robust solution for high-quality B-Rep synthesis. Code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/1nnoh/HiFi-BRep.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiFi-BRep，一种面向边界表示 (B-Rep) 生成的高保真潜在表示框架。作者指出现有深度生成方法存在两类脆弱性：由 padding 噪声和潜在空间特征污染导致的表示脆弱性，以及由序列误差传播和不可微有效性约束引起的训练-推理不匹配导致的生成脆弱性。框架包含拓扑感知编码器和单阶段解码器，通过可学习查询消除 padding、拓扑引导注意力防止特征污染，并将核心流形约束嵌入为可微学习目标。实验表明其在结构有效性和几何保真度上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: B-Rep 生成是计算机辅助设计中的基础任务，但直接合成高保真且结构有效的 B-Rep 仍具挑战。现有深度生成方法受制于潜在空间中的 padding 噪声与特征污染，以及顺序误差传播和不可微有效性约束造成的训练-推理不匹配。
Method: 提出 HiFi-BRep 框架，包含两个协同部分：一是拓扑感知编码器，利用可学习查询消除 padding，并通过拓扑引导注意力防止特征污染；二是单阶段解码器，并行联合预测几何和拓扑，将核心流形约束作为可微学习目标嵌入，实现几何与拓扑的相互引导并避免级联误差。
Result: 大量实验表明 HiFi-BRep 在结构有效性和几何保真度两方面均显著优于现有最先进方法，为高质量 B-Rep 合成提供了稳健方案。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过拓扑感知的潜在表示和单阶段并行解码可以有效解决表示脆弱性和生成脆弱性，实现稳健的 B-Rep 生成。代码和模型已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Remote-Sensing City Layout Extraction with MLLM
papers.abstract_en: Remote-sensing systems usually describe urban content with detection boxes, semantic masks, or vector boundaries. Such outputs locate classes and support image-plane scoring, yet they do not by themselves constitute an executable layout that retains object identities, typed relations, topology, and regeneration rules. Code-as-City instead casts urban-layout extraction from a single top-down image as constrained code generation with a multimodal large language model (MLLM). An image model first produces an aligned five-class semantic layout prior. Three ordered MLLM passes use the image and this prior to recover roads, land-cover regions and relations, and buildings. Deterministic normalization converts the accumulated records into a city graph and a restricted layout program. Executing the program creates a renderable 3D city layout and an orthographic semantic projection over shared geometry. The projection admits pixel-level comparison with remote-sensing masks, while named objects, relations, and editing operations remain available for synchronized regeneration of both views. Evaluated on the 100 scenes of CityLayout-100, the complete framework obtains 41.1% mean intersection-over-union and 48.3% global intersection-over-union. This result provides quantitative evidence that visual observations can be translated into inspectable, editable city code with coupled planar and 3D outputs.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Code-as-City 方法，利用多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 将单张俯视遥感图像转化为可执行的城市布局代码。图像模型先产生对齐的五类语义布局先验，三次有序 MLLM 传递结合图像和先验恢复道路、土地覆盖区域及关系、建筑物，确定性归一化生成城市图和受限布局程序；执行程序可得到可渲染的 3D 城市布局和正射语义投影。在 CityLayout-100 的 100 个场景上，完整框架获得 41.1% 平均 IoU 和 48.3% 全局 IoU。
Motivation: 现有遥感系统通常输出检测框、语义掩码或矢量边界，能定位类别并支持图像平面评分，但无法构成保留对象身份、类型化关系、拓扑和再生规则的可执行布局。
Method: 提出三阶段流程：图像模型生成对齐的五类语义布局先验；三次有序 MLLM 传递基于图像和先验依次恢复道路、土地覆盖区域及关系、建筑物；确定性归一化将累积记录转换为城市图和受限布局程序，执行该程序可同步生成可渲染的 3D 城市布局与共享几何上的正射语义投影。
Result: 在 CityLayout-100 的 100 个场景上，完整框架取得 41.1% 平均 IoU 和 48.3% 全局 IoU。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该结果提供了定量证据，表明视觉观测可被翻译为可检查、可编辑的城市代码，并耦合平面与 3D 输出。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning for Hemodynamic Management of Sepsis in the ICU: a MIMIC-IV Study with Dual Off-Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: The dosing of intravenous fluids and vasopressors in sepsis is a sequential decision made under uncertainty and guided largely by clinical judgment, which makes it a natural target for reinforcement learning from historical care. Because a learned policy cannot be trialed on patients, its value must be estimated off-policy, and such estimates can be fragile and optimistic. This work advances the reliable evaluation of sepsis treatment policies by combining off-policy estimation, reliability diagnostics, and clinician-agreement analyses in a transparent validation framework. We modeled fluid and vasopressor dosing on a cohort of 36,872 septic ICU stays drawn from the MIMIC-IV critical-care database, as a discretized Markov decision process with 1,000 states and 25 actions, defined by a five-by-five grid of fluid and vasopressor levels and solved by policy iteration. The clinicians' behavior policy was estimated with a random forest, which mitigated the collapse of the Effective Sample Size (ESS 50.1 against 4.0 with smoothed counts) that otherwise destabilizes the importance-sampling estimate. The learned policy was evaluated with two estimators, weighted importance sampling (WIS) and fitted Q evaluation (FQE), with the ESS and clinician agreement as reliability checks. An empirical variable selection found that the composition of the state matters more than its size. Both estimators place the learned policy above the clinicians' return (WIS 50.8 and FQE 46.8 against 38.2, ESS 50.1), yet it departs only modestly from observed practice (total variation 0.18), favoring less intravenous fluid. These retrospective single-center off-policy results support the learned policy as a clinically plausible refinement of observed practice and motivate its further evaluation as a discordance-based clinical decision-support approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了重症监护室内脓毒症液体与血管加压药给药的离线强化学习策略，并在 MIMIC-IV 的 36,872 次脓毒症 ICU 住院记录上建模。作者将给药决策离散化为含 1,000 个状态、25 个动作的马尔可夫决策过程，用策略迭代求解，并以随机森林估计临床医生行为策略。双估计器评估（WIS 与 FQE）显示学习策略的回报高于临床实践（WIS 50.8、FQE 46.8 对 38.2），但该策略仅温和偏离观测实践（total variation 0.18），倾向于减少静脉输液量。
Motivation: 脓毒症中静脉输液与血管加压药的剂量是临床判断主导的序贯决策，适合用历史数据做强化学习；但学习到的策略不能直接在患者身上试验，只能在策略外（off-policy）估计其价值，而这类估计往往脆弱且偏乐观。因此需要一套结合离线估计、可靠性诊断与临床一致性分析的透明验证框架。
Method: 将液体与血管加压药剂量建模为离散马尔可夫决策过程，状态与动作由五乘五的液体/血管加压药水平网格构成，并用策略迭代求解；临床医生的行为策略用随机森林估计，以缓解有效样本量（ESS）的坍塌（ESS 50.1 对比平滑计数法的 4.0）。评估采用加权重要性采样（WIS）与拟合 Q 评估（FQE），并以 ESS 和临床医生一致性作为可靠性检验，同时做了经验性变量选择。
Result: 两种估计器均将学习策略的回报置于临床医生之上（WIS 50.8、FQE 46.8，对照 38.2，ESS 50.1）；策略与观测实践的偏差较小（total variation 0.18），且偏好更少的静脉输液。经验性变量选择发现状态的构成比其规模更重要。
Conclusion: 这些回顾性单中心离线结果支持将该学习策略视为对观测实践的一种临床合理的精化，并推动其作为基于分歧（discordance）的临床决策支持方法进一步评估；摘要同时强调结果依赖回顾性与单中心离线估计的范畴。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RISE: Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding across 3D Tracking and Structured Vision-Language Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We present RISE (Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding and Evaluation), a framework spanning metric 3D tracking and structured vision-language reasoning in roadside sequences. For metric tracking, our image-only method combines SAM3 video identities with calibration-guided mask agreement for multi-view identity association, recovering persistent 3D tracks without LiDAR or task-specific 3D training. Its calibration-conditioned geometry allows the procedure to be instantiated at different calibrated multi-camera intersections without layout-specific retraining. On 20 human-reviewed clips from six intersections, the generated tracks achieve 66.9 MOTA within the defined multi-view evaluation scope. For structured vision-language reasoning, a human-reviewed MLLM pipeline mines high-value clips and uses a constrained full-context Oracle to construct bbox-grounded predictive QA without exposing future evidence to evaluated models. The resulting RISE-VQA dataset contains 33,910 QA pairs from 557 clips across 16 intersections and 61 roadside views. Its intersection-held-out RISE-Bench evaluates semantic choices, coordinates, future boxes, and interaction sets with deterministic task-specific metrics. Experiments show consistent benefits from domain adaptation and generally from temporal context, while revealing persistent challenges in spatial grounding, future localization, and interaction reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RISE，一个面向路边基础设施序列的统一框架，涵盖度量 3D 跟踪与结构化视觉-语言推理。跟踪部分仅用图像，结合 SAM3 视频身份与标定引导的掩膜一致性，在无 LiDAR 或任务特定 3D 训练下恢复持久 3D 轨迹；推理部分用人工审核的 MLLM 流程构建带 bbox 锚定的预测型 QA，形成 RISE-VQA 数据集与 RISE-Bench 基准。实验显示领域自适应和时间上下文的收益，同时暴露空间定位、未来位置和交互推理方面的持续挑战。
Motivation: 路边基础设施场景需要在不依赖 LiDAR 和特定布局重训练的情况下实现跨视角的持久 3D 跟踪，并需要结构化的视觉-语言推理能力来评测模型对场景序列的理解；现有方法在此类任务上缺少统一框架与严格评测。
Method: 跟踪侧采用仅图像方法，将 SAM3 视频身份与标定引导的掩膜一致性结合，进行多视角身份关联；标定条件化的几何使该方法可在不同标定多相机路口直接实例化。推理侧采用人工审核的 MLLM 流水线挖掘高价值片段，并用受限全上下文 Oracle 构造带 bbox 锚定的预测型 QA，避免向被评测模型泄露未来证据。
Result: 在来自六个路口的 20 个人工审核片段上，生成轨迹在定义的多视角评测范围内达到 66.9 MOTA。RISE-VQA 数据集包含来自 16 个路口、61 个路边视角、557 个片段的 33,910 个 QA 对；路口留出式 RISE-Bench 使用确定性的任务特定指标评测语义选择、坐标、未来框和交互集合。实验显示领域自适应普遍有效、时间上下文大体有益，但空间定位、未来定位和交互推理仍具挑战。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架在路边序列上统一了 3D 跟踪与视觉-语言推理，并指出空间锚定和未来推理仍是主要难点；评测范围限于多视角定义下的指标与人工审核子集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pallas: A Proactive KV Cache Migration Framework for LLM Inference in AI-RAN
papers.abstract_en: AI-RAN brings large language model (LLM) serving close to mobile users, but cellular handover can separate an active request from its inference state: the user attaches to a target base station (gNB) while the large and growing key-value (KV) cache remains at the source. Retaining inference at the source preserves service continuity but persistently increases inter-token latency (ITL), whereas recovering the state at the target restores serving locality but requires KV-cache transfer, recomputation, or a combination of both only after handover, directly prolonging service interruption time (SIT). This work presents Pallas, a \textit{proactive} KV-cache migration framework that prepares the inference state at the predicted target before handover, in parallel with ongoing source-side inference and token delivery. At the preparation trigger, Pallas partitions the token sequence into a stable historical prefix and an evolving suffix. The target reconstructs the prefix through local prefill, while the source streams the KV blocks generated for the suffix. At handover, the target assembles both portions into an up-to-date KV cache and resumes decoding locally, leaving only unfinished preparation to contribute to SIT. An online scheduler selects the \textit{prefetching window}, which determines how early preparation begins before handover, based on mobility predictions and runtime telemetry. Across three LLMs and $100$--$500~\mathrm{Mbps}$ inter-gNB links, our vLLM-based prototype reduces average SIT by factors of $2.28$--$89.68$ over target-side recovery approaches and lowers average ITL by $16.0\%$--$50.0\%$ compared with source-side forwarding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pallas，一个面向 AI-RAN 场景中 LLM 推理的主动式 KV 缓存迁移框架。针对蜂窝切换会使用户请求与推理状态分离的问题，Pallas 在预测的目标基站上于切换前并行准备推理状态：将 token 序列划分为稳定历史前缀与动态后缀，目标基站本地 prefill 前缀，源基站流式传输后缀对应的 KV 块，切换时目标组装出最新 KV 缓存并本地恢复解码。基于 vLLM 的原型在三个 LLM 和 100–500 Mbps 的 inter-gNB 链路上，将平均服务中断时间 (SIT) 相比目标侧恢复方法降低 2.28–89.68 倍，并将平均 token 间延迟 (ITL) 相比源侧转发降低 16.0%–50.0%。
Motivation: AI-RAN 将 LLM 服务部署到靠近移动用户的位置，但蜂窝切换可能使活跃请求与其推理状态分离：用户附着到目标 gNB，而大且不断增长的 KV cache 仍留在源侧。在源侧继续推理能维持服务连续性但持续增加 ITL，在目标侧恢复状态则需在切换后传输 KV cache 或重算，直接延长 SIT，因此需要一种在切换前主动准备状态的方案。
Method: Pallas 在切换前主动将推理状态准备到预测的目标节点，并与源侧解码和 token 下发并行执行。触发准备时，它将 token 序列切分为稳定历史前缀和动态后缀；目标通过本地 prefill 重建前缀，源侧流式发送后缀产生的 KV 块；切换时目标将两部分组装为最新 KV cache 并恢复本地解码。此外，在线调度器基于移动性预测和运行时遥测选择 prefetching window，决定切换前多早开始准备。
Result: 在三个 LLM 与 100–500 Mbps 的 inter-gNB 链路下，基于 vLLM 的原型相比目标侧恢复方法将平均 SIT 降低 2.28–89.68 倍，相比源侧转发将平均 ITL 降低 16.0%–50.0%。
Conclusion: Pallas 通过把未完成的准备部分计入 SIT，并在切换前并行预取 KV 状态，在服务连续性与服务局部性之间取得更好平衡，显著减少服务中断时间与 token 间延迟。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 在三个 LLM 与 100–500 Mbps 的 inter-gNB 链路下，基于 vLLM 的原型相比目标侧恢复方法将平均 SIT 降低 2.28–89.68 倍，相比源侧转发将平均 ITL 降低 16.0%–50.0%。
summary_sections.conclusion: Pallas 通过把未完成的准备部分计入 SIT，并在切换前并行预取 KV 状态，在服务连续性与服务局部性之间取得更好平衡，显著减少服务中断时间与 token 间延迟。

papers.title: A Two-Stage Learning PINN Approach for Solving the Inverse Problem of the 1D Porous Medium Equation
papers.abstract_en: The Porous Medium Equation (PME), given by $u_t = Δ(u^m)$ for $m > 1$, is a degenerate nonlinear parabolic partial differential equation that arises in various physical applications such as fluid flow in porous media, heat transfer in plasmas, and population dynamics. It is known for its nonlinear diffusion and finite propagation speed. In this paper, we study numerical solutions of the one-dimensional direct and inverse PME using Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), and compare them with classical numerical methods and available analytical and manufactured solutions. While PINNs provide a flexible framework for solving both forward and inverse problems, we show that the standard inverse formulation suffers from a strong sensitivity to the initial guess, leading to only local convergence. To address this issue, we propose a novel two-stage PINN training framework for the inverse problem, which significantly improves convergence stability and allows reliable recovery of the unknown parameter even for poor initial guesses. Overall, the proposed approach demonstrates that PINNs are a flexible and accurate alternative to classical methods for the 1D PME, and the introduced two-stage training strategy substantially improves their robustness in inverse problems, providing a solid basis for extensions to more complex geometries and higher-dimensional cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一维多孔介质方程 (Porous Medium Equation, PME) 的正问题和逆问题的物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 数值求解。作者指出标准逆问题 PINN 公式对初始猜测非常敏感、只能局部收敛，为此提出一种两阶段 PINN 训练框架，显著提升收敛稳定性并在较差初始猜测下可靠恢复未知参数。与经典数值方法及解析/制造解比较后，PINN 被认为是 1D PME 的灵活且准确的替代工具。
Motivation: PME 是退化的非线性抛物方程，其逆问题在标准 PINN 框架下对初始猜测敏感，容易陷入局部收敛，导致未知参数难以可靠恢复。
Method: 提出一种针对 1D PME 逆问题的两阶段 PINN 训练框架，通过分阶段训练改善收敛行为，使模型在较差的初始猜测下也能稳定恢复未知参数。
Result: 摘要报告该两阶段策略显著提高逆问题收敛稳定性，并能在较差初始猜测下可靠恢复未知参数；同时 PINN 在 1D PME 上与经典数值方法和解析/制造解相比表现出灵活性和准确性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 PINN 是经典方法在 1D PME 上的灵活准确替代，提出的两阶段训练策略增强了逆问题求解的鲁棒性，并为扩展到更复杂几何和高维情形提供了基础。

papers.title: Reference-free logged energy-oracle recovery for neural approximations of symmetric coercive variational problems: conforming Riesz reconstruction and archive-level selection
papers.abstract_en: Neural PDE training yields a finite checkpoint archive, yet its logged energy errors are inaccessible without the exact solution, while loss-based selection does not necessarily recover the logged energy oracle. For admissible neural approximations of symmetric coercive variational problems, we introduce a reference-free selection rule based on minimizing a computable conforming Riesz monitor. The exact residual-energy identity and conforming projection make the monitor an unconditional lower bound converging monotonically to each logged energy error under nested conforming refinement; under saturation, hierarchical enrichment yields a computable upper estimate and hence a lower-upper bracket. A key finding is that archive selection is order-sensitive: unresolved checkpoint-dependent components can reverse the oracle-non-oracle ranking at finite resolution, so checkpointwise recovery alone is insufficient. For finite archives, we prove uniform recovery, yielding convergence to the logged-oracle error and, without saturation, logged-oracle selection at sufficiently fine auxiliary resolution. Under saturation, the bracket gives a computable near-oracle bound and certifies unique logged-oracle selection upon interval separation. We also bound logging-resolution loss and certify oracle inclusion over prescribed comparison trajectories. The resulting criterion replaces inaccessible exact-error minimization by computable, training-independent post-training selection on the intrinsic energy-error scale, requiring only the computed candidates and the variational problem. Experiments on diffusion and elasticity, including a non-manufactured perforated plate, demonstrate energy-scale calibration, oracle-level selection, and modest post-processing cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经 PDE 训练过程中产生的有限 checkpoint 档案（archive），提出一种无需参考解（reference-free）的能量误差恢复与选择准则。作者利用对称强制变分问题的共形 Riesz 监控器（conforming Riesz monitor），使其成为可计算的无条件下界，并在饱和条件下通过分层加密得到可计算的上界，从而形成下-上界包围。理论证明在有限档案下可实现 uniform recovery，并收敛到登录的 oracle 误差；实验在扩散、弹性以及非制造穿孔板问题上展示了能量尺度校准与 oracle 级选择。
Motivation: 神经 PDE 训练会得到有限 checkpoint 档案，但其登录的能量误差在缺乏精确解时无法获取，而基于损失的档案选择不一定恢复登录能量 oracle。因此需要一种不依赖精确解、仅依赖候选解与变分问题的后训练选择规则。
Method: 引入基于最小化可计算共形 Riesz 监控器的无参考选择规则。精确残差-能量恒等式与共形投影使该监控器成为无条件下界，并在嵌套共形细化下单调收敛到每个登录能量误差；饱和情况下通过分层加密得到可计算上估计，形成下-上界括弧。还证明档案选择存在顺序敏感性，并提出 checkpointwise 恢复之外的档案级选择。
Result: 对有限档案证明了 uniform recovery，即收敛到登录 oracle 误差，并在无饱和时于足够细的辅助分辨率下实现登录 oracle 选择；饱和时括弧给出可计算近 oracle 界，并在区间分离时认证唯一登录 oracle 选择。扩散与弹性实验（含非制造穿孔板）展示了能量尺度校准、oracle 级选择与适度的后处理成本。
Conclusion: 该准则将不可访问的精确误差最小化替换为可计算、训练无关、位于内在能量误差尺度上的后训练选择，仅需已计算的候选解与变分问题本身。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Regulatory Placebo? The Systemic Failure of Mandatory GenAI Labeling
papers.abstract_en: We examine the worldwide trend of mandatory labeling of generative artificial intelligence(GenAI) as a reactive, symbolic form of legislation triggered by technological panic and institutional responses. From a technical perspective, this study demonstrates that current mandatory labeling not only creates implementation dilemmas but also risks hindering the evolutionary trajectory of AI technology. We then systematically analyze the three dominant theoretical strands of this regime, the value dilution theory, the information authenticity theory, and the proactive regulation theory, and find that they are products of regulators' cognitive limitations in understanding the logic of modern technology. Not only do such formalistic compliance requirements become a regulatory placebo, but they also obscure the genuine legal demands of the technological era. This challenges the current governance paradigm and suggests a shift from identity-label governance to content governance, with an urgent need to address the complex problems associated with GenAI.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Technology and Society
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察全球强制性生成式人工智能（GenAI）标签立法的趋势，认为这是一种由技术恐慌和制度反应驱动的象征性立法。作者从技术角度论证现行强制标签既造成实施困境，又可能阻碍 AI 技术演进，并系统分析价值稀释理论、信息真实性理论和主动监管理论三种主流理论支柱，指出它们是监管者认知局限的产物。文章认为此类形式化合规要求沦为“监管安慰剂”（regulatory placebo），并主张从身份标签治理转向内容治理。
Motivation: 作者针对各国普遍推行的 GenAI 强制标签制度，指出其作为技术恐慌下的象征性立法既缺乏实施可行性，也可能妨碍技术发展，且现有理论依据建立在监管者对现代技术逻辑的认知局限之上。
Method: 论文从技术视角分析强制标签的实施困境，并对三种主流理论支柱（价值稀释理论、信息真实性理论、主动监管理论）进行系统性理论批判，进而提出从身份标签治理转向内容治理的框架性建议。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验或实证数据，其主要结论是强制标签作为形式化合规要求会沦为监管安慰剂，同时遮蔽技术时代真正的法律需求。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前以身份标签为核心的 GenAI 治理范式需要改变，应转向内容治理，并亟需处理与生成式人工智能相关的复杂问题。

papers.title: Sterilizable Scene Graph Generation for Operating Rooms
papers.abstract_en: Scene graph generation from surgical video enables a holistic and structured understanding of surgical scenes by modeling objects and their semantic relationships. Despite recent advances, state-of-the-art approaches rely on large, parameter-heavy deep learning models that are impractical for deployment in the operating room (OR) due to hardware footprint, hygiene constraints, latency, and data privacy concerns. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first scene graph generation method built on NCAs and the first NCA framework capable of learning structured representations. We introduce SG-NCA, a lightweight scene graph generation framework based on Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), designed for inference in fanless devices critical for OR hygiene protocols. SG-NCA is the first scene graph generation combining NCA-based multiclass segmentation for efficient object detection and feature extraction with a lightweight relation predictor. We evaluate SG-NCA on videos of cataract surgery and cholecystectomy, demonstrating performance comparable to established baselines while requiring 55x fewer parameters. We showcase deployment on fanless edge devices better suited for the OR and demonstrate downstream applications such as surgical video captioning, highlighting SG-NCA's potential for affordable, privacy-preserving, and OR-ready intraoperative scene understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SG-NCA，首个基于神经细胞自动机 (Neural Cellular Automata, NCA) 的手术视频场景图生成框架，面向手术室 (OR) 中无风扇边缘设备的低延迟、隐私保护推理。作者称该方法在白内障手术和胆囊切除术视频上达到与既有基线相当的性能，同时参数量减少 55 倍，并展示了在无风扇设备上的部署及手术视频字幕等下游应用。
Motivation: 现有场景图生成方法依赖参数规模大、计算量高的深度学习模型，难以在手术室部署，受到硬件占用、卫生约束、延迟和数据隐私问题的限制。
Method: SG-NCA 将基于 NCA 的多类分割用于高效目标检测与特征提取，并结合一个轻量级关系预测器来生成场景图；据作者所述，这是首个基于 NCA 的场景图生成方法，也是首个能学习结构化表示的 NCA 框架。
Result: 在白内障手术和胆囊切除术视频上，SG-NCA 的性能与既有基线相当，但参数量减少 55 倍，并能在符合手术室卫生协议的无风扇边缘设备上运行。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SG-NCA 展示了面向手术室的低成本、隐私保护且可部署的术中场景理解的潜力，并给出了手术视频字幕等下游应用示例。

papers.title: Deep adaptive design with an evidential bias criterion
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimal experimental design (BOED) aims to collect informative data by optimizing an expected utility reflecting the goals of an experiment. However, this optimization is computationally challenging for common utilities and complex models. This is especially so for sequential or adaptive designs, where design and data collection alternate, so that feedback from already observed data must be taken into account. Most existing BOED research employs information gain as the utility, leading to the expected information gain (EIG) criterion. While EIG is widely useful, it may not always adequately reflect experimental goals. EIG can be viewed as rewarding experiments that produce large positive evidence for the truth on average, but it does not directly control the risk of an experiment producing misleading evidence. Here we consider an alternative criterion, which we call bias against (BA), that prioritizes such control. To address computational challenges when applying this criterion for adaptive design, we consider a policy-based deep adaptive design framework, which has previously been used for the EIG criterion. Minimizing a tractable upper bound on the BA objective is equivalent to maximizing a variance-penalized EIG criterion, and we optimize the latter by approximating it by Monte Carlo and learning design policies using stochastic gradient methods. The differences between BA and EIG designs are demonstrated in several examples including the adaptive design of a complex discrete choice experiment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对贝叶斯最优实验设计 (BOED) 提出一种新的准则 bias against (BA)，目标不是像期望信息增益 (EIG) 那样平均地奖励产生大正面证据的实验，而是优先控制实验产生误导性证据的风险。为解决自适应设计中的计算困难，作者采用基于策略的深度自适应设计框架，并证明最小化 BA 目标的一个可处理上界等价于最大化带方差惩罚的 EIG；随后用蒙特卡洛近似并用随机梯度方法学习设计策略。多个例子（包括复杂离散选择实验的自适应设计）展示了 BA 与 EIG 设计的差异。
Motivation: 现有 BOED 研究大多使用 EIG 作为效用，它平均奖励产生大正面证据的实验，但不能直接控制实验产生误导性证据的风险；同时自适应设计中设计轮次与数据收集交替进行，给常见效用和复杂模型带来显著计算挑战。
Method: 提出 BA 准则，并采用此前用于 EIG 的基于策略的深度自适应设计框架；通过最小化 BA 目标的可处理上界，将问题转化为最大化方差惩罚的 EIG (variance-penalized EIG)，再用蒙特卡洛近似该目标并用随机梯度方法学习设计策略。
Result: 摘要未给出定量数值结果，仅在包括复杂离散选择实验在内的多个例子中演示了 BA 设计与 EIG 设计的差异。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 BA 准则能够在自适应设计中更多地控制误导性证据的风险，且基于策略的深度设计框架使其可计算；示例表明 BA 与 EIG 设计在实践中会给出不同的设计选择。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: JailbreakSkill: Scaling Automated Red-Teaming with Reusable and Ever-Evolving Skills
papers.abstract_en: Automated red-teaming has produced a growing collection of attack strategies, yet they typically remain scattered across prompts and workflows, making them difficult to systematically integrate, reuse, and improve at scale. We introduce \textsc{JailbreakSkill}, a skill-centric framework for scaling automated red-teaming through reusable and continuously evolving attack capabilities. \textsc{JailbreakSkill} packages existing attack strategies into modular, agent-ready skills that can be directly reused and adaptively selected across tasks and target models. Beyond reuse, it closes the loop between attacking and learning: attack experience is used to diagnose, refine, combine, and discover new skills, which are added back to an ever-growing skill library. This evolution lifts macro-average ASR by 17.5 percentage points on AdvBench and 13.4 points on HarmBench, including a 48.6-point gain against GPT-5.4 on AdvBench, while yielding novel attack strategies such as reframing a direct request as an unfinished document-completion task. Several evolved skills also generalize to unseen prompts and target models without further adaptation. Our code is available at https://github.com/BattleWen/JailbreakSkill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JailbreakSkill，一个以技能为中心的自动化红队（red-teaming）框架，将攻击策略打包为模块化、智能体可复用的技能，支持跨任务和跨目标模型的自适应选择，并通过攻击-学习闭环不断诊断、精炼、组合和发现新技能，回填到持续扩大的技能库。摘要报告该方法在 AdvBench 上宏观平均攻击成功率（ASR）提升 17.5 个百分点，在 HarmBench 上提升 13.4 个百分点，其中针对 GPT-5.4 在 AdvBench 上提升 48.6 个百分点，并产生如将直接请求重构为未完成文档补全任务的新型攻击策略。
Motivation: 现有自动化红队产生的攻击策略分散在各种提示词和工作流中，难以系统性整合、复用和大规模改进，限制了攻击能力的规模化演进。
Method: 提出 JailbreakSkill 框架，把已有攻击策略封装为模块化、智能体可用的技能，可跨任务和模型复用并自适应选择；同时闭环攻击与学习，用攻击经验诊断、精炼、组合和发现新技能，将演化结果加入持续增长的技能库。
Result: 摘要报告宏观平均 ASR 在 AdvBench 上提升 17.5 个百分点、在 HarmBench 上提升 13.4 个百分点，其中对抗 GPT-5.4 在 AdvBench 上提升 48.6 个百分点；部分演化出的技能无需进一步适配即可泛化到未见提示词和目标模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可复用且持续演化的技能库能够规模化自动化红队攻击，且若干演化技能具备跨提示与模型的泛化能力；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Shared-Structure 4D Spectral Gaussian Representation for Sparse-View Spectral CT Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view spectral computed tomography (CT) reconstructs energy-resolved attenuation volumes from limited projection views, requiring simultaneous handling of angular undersampling and spectral coupling. We propose a SharedStructure 4D Spectral Gaussian Representation (4D-SG) that learns shared Gaussian geometry from full spectrum structural projections and uses a Gaussian-wise Spectral Density Curve Network (GSC-Net) to predict Gaussian raw density transformations. This factorization separates shared spatial structure from spectral attenuation variation, avoids independent channel geometry optimization, and establishes a continuous 4D-SG representation from discrete spectral measurements for unobserved spectral channel queries. Experiments on six synthesized, simulated projection, and real projection datasets with 50 views demonstrate the best average performance. Compared with the strongest Gaussian baseline, 4D-SG improves PSNR from 35.56 dB to 36.61 dB, increases SSIM from 0.909 to 0.914, and reduces LPIPS from 0.208 to 0.194, demonstrating its effectiveness for sparse-view spectral CT reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏视角光谱CT重建，提出共享结构4D光谱高斯表示（4D-SG），从全光谱结构投影学习共享高斯几何，并用高斯级光谱密度曲线网络（GSC-Net）预测高斯原始密度变换。在六个50视图的合成、模拟投影和真实投影数据集上取得最佳平均性能，相比最强高斯基线将PSNR从35.56 dB提升至36.61 dB、SSIM从0.909提升至0.914、LPIPS从0.208降至0.194。
Motivation: 稀疏视角光谱CT需从有限投影视角重建能量分辨衰减体积，同时处理角度欠采样与光谱耦合；现有方法需要对每个光谱通道独立优化几何，效率与一致性受限。
Method: 提出4D-SG表示，将共享空间结构（shared Gaussian geometry）与光谱衰减变化分解开，避免逐通道几何独立优化；通过GSC-Net预测高斯原始密度变换，并从离散光谱测量建立连续的4D-SG表示，支持未观测光谱通道的查询。
Result: 在六个数据集（含50个投影视角）上平均性能最优；相比最强高斯基线，PSNR从35.56 dB提高到36.61 dB，SSIM从0.909增至0.914，LPIPS从0.208降至0.194。
Conclusion: 摘要认为所提出的分解式4D-SG表示能有效处理稀疏视角光谱CT重建中的角度欠采样与光谱耦合问题，并在多类数据集上验证了其有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Human-LLM Teaming Framework for Privacy Risk Analysis: An Illustration with CBDC-Based Welfare Schemes
papers.abstract_en: Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC)-based welfare schemes may be potentially privacy invasive as they process significant volumes of beneficiary personal data and lead to privacy harms such as surveillance, discrimination and stigmatization. Such welfare delivery schemes involve complex digital ecosystems and large number of stakeholders. Consequently, to examine their privacy risks, privacy risk assessments require extensive information gathering and synthesis, complex reasoning, scenario explorations, contextual evaluation and human judgement. Thus, they present ideal scenarios for human-LLM teaming, where effective integration of complementary human and LLM capabilities can yield an outcome far superior to either human-only or LLM-only assessments. In this paper, we propose a first human-LLM teaming framework for the systematic privacy risk analysis methodology called PRIAM. The framework specifies an iterative collaborative process in which the LLM processes large-scale documentary evidence to produce initial outputs, which are then interpreted and evaluated by human experts who direct their further refinement by the LLM and exercise their judgement to finalize the output. We illustrate the framework on the data characterization activity of PRIAM using a CBDC-based welfare scheme use case. The illustration demonstrates that while LLMs generate the initial data categories and assign initial values to data attributes, human experts evaluate and provide feedback to refine them, distinguishing documented evidence from inferences, identifying information gaps, and flagging unsupported or ambiguous outputs. This framework serves as a foundational contribution towards human-AI teaming for privacy risk assessments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个面向隐私风险分析方法 PRIAM 的人类-LLM 协作框架，并以 CBDC 福利计划中的数据类型刻画活动为例进行说明。框架规定迭代协作流程：LLM 处理大规模文档证据生成初始输出，人类专家对其进行解释和评估，再指导 LLM 精炼并最终定稿。作者称其属于人机协作隐私风险评估的基础性贡献。
Motivation: 基于 CBDC 的福利计划处理大量受益人个人数据，可能造成监视、歧视和污名化等隐私伤害；此类风险评估涉及复杂数字生态与众多利益相关方，需要大量信息收集、复杂推理与人类判断，因而适合引入人类-LLM 协作。
Method: 提出一个迭代协作式人类-LLM 团队框架：LLM 先从大规模文档证据生成初始输出，人类专家评估反馈并决定 LLM 的进一步精炼方向；在数据类型刻画活动中，LLM 负责生成初始数据类别并给数据属性赋初值，人类专家负责区分文档证据与推断、识别信息缺口并标记不支持或模糊的输出。
Result: 在 CBDC 福利计划用例上的示例表明，LLM 可生成初始数据类型和属性值，而人类专家的反馈能改进这些输出；该框架尚未给出量化评估结果。
Conclusion: 作者将该框架定位为人类-AI 协作进行隐私风险评估的奠基性贡献，目前以 PRIAM 的数据类型刻画活动为说明场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Contrastive Energy Fields for Inference-Time Procedure Planning in Instructional Videos
papers.abstract_en: Procedure planning seeks to estimate a sequence of actions to transition from an observed initial state to a given goal state. Current procedure planning approaches directly predict action sequences from latent representations using feed-forward neural networks or diffusion-based inference. These paradigms treat every action as plausible, lacking the ability to enforce task-specific logical constraints that render certain actions irrelevant or not plausible. We propose CEFITO, a procedure planning approach that learns a predictor to express an action-conditioned representation space. Based on this representation space, we formulate procedure planning as a task-constrained optimization problem. Unlike prior methods, CEFITO explicitly reasons over the action space by omitting irrelevant actions during inference-time planning. This reformulation enables effective procedure planning and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on two established procedure planning benchmarks.
papers.comment: To appear at GCPR 2026 (oral paper). Project page: https://visinf.github.io/cefito
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CEFITO，一种面向教学视频中程序规划 (procedure planning) 的推理时优化方法。与直接前馈预测或扩散式推理不同，CEFITO 学习一个动作条件表示空间，并将规划建模为任务约束优化问题，在推理时省略无关动作。摘要报告该方法在两个既有程序规划基准上达到最先进准确率。
Motivation: 现有程序规划方法从潜在表示直接预测动作序列，把每个动作都视为同样可信，缺乏施加任务特定逻辑约束的能力，因而可能输出与目标无关或不可用的动作。
Method: CEFITO 学习一个预测器来表达动作条件表示空间，并基于该表示空间把程序规划形式化为任务约束优化问题；与先前方法不同，它在推理时显式地省略无关动作，从而在动作空间上进行推理。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在两个已建立的程序规划基准上取得最先进准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将程序规划重构为任务约束优化、并在推理时对动作空间进行显式筛选可以带来有效的规划性能；未在摘要中说明局限。
Relevance: 0
