papers.title: RadioVIL: Anomaly-Aware Diffusion Models for Radio Map Inpainting and Zero-Shot Vehicle Localization
papers.abstract_en: High-precision radio map construction is essential for emerging 6G Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) applications, including digital twins and intelligent transportation. However, existing deep learning methods predominantly treat this as a pure image completion task, resulting in over-smoothed reconstructions that fundamentally erase high-frequency scattering signatures of dynamic physical entities such as hidden vehicles. To overcome this, we propose RadioVIL, an efficient two-stage framework that reformulates joint radio map inpainting and zero-shot vehicle localization as a prior-guided physical inverse problem. Specifically, we first train a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) to capture the structural generative prior of the environment. During inference from highly sparse measurements, we employ a Diffusion-based Mediating Intermediate Layer Optimization (DMILO) algorithm. By optimizing an L1-regularized sparse deviation term, DMILO mathematically isolates vehicle scattering anomalies layer-by-layer without unfolding the entire denoising chain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while conventional reconstruction baselines fail to detect hidden vehicles, and the zero-shot diffusion baseline achieves only limited detection ability due to forced semantic harmonization, RadioVIL preserves authentic physical textures, yielding the best LPIPS of 0.0587 in our evaluation. Uniquely, it unlocks accurate zero-shot vehicle localization directly from sparse radio maps, securing a 75.20% Recall and a 3.31-meter average error, paving a robust way for ISAC at the 6G edge.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to IEEE GLOBECOM 2026, Wireless Communications Symposium
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RadioVIL，一个两阶段框架，将无线电台图修复与零样本车辆定位统一为带先验的物理逆问题。作者先训练 DDPM 捕获环境的结构性生成先验，推理时采用 Diffusion-based Mediating Intermediate Layer Optimization (DMILO)，通过优化 L1 正则化的稀疏偏差项逐层分离车辆散射异常，而无需展开整个去噪链。实验表明，相比常规重建基线和零样本扩散基线，RadioVIL 保留真实物理纹理，取得最优 LPIPS 0.0587，并实现 75.20% Recall 与 3.31 米平均误差的零样本车辆定位。论文被 IEEE GLOBECOM 2026 Wireless Communications Symposium 接收。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法将电台图构建视为纯图像补全任务，导致重建过度平滑，从根本上抹除了隐藏车辆等动态物理物体的高频散射特征，难以支撑 6G ISAC 中的数字孪生与智能交通应用。
Method: 提出 RadioVIL 两阶段框架：先训练 DDPM 捕捉环境的结构生成先验；在高稀疏测量下推理时，使用 DMILO 算法，通过优化 L1 正则化的稀疏偏差项逐层数学隔离车辆散射异常，避免展开完整去噪链。
Result: 摘要报告 RadioVIL 获得最佳 LPIPS 0.0587；常规重建基线无法检测隐藏车辆，零样本扩散基线因强制语义协调而检测能力有限，而 RadioVIL 能从稀疏电台图直接实现零样本车辆定位，取得 75.20% Recall 和 3.31 米平均误差。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将电台图修复与零样本定位表述为先验引导的物理逆问题，能够保留真实物理纹理，为 6G 边缘的 ISAC 提供稳健路径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Trajectory-Level Automatic Curriculum Learning for Legged Locomotion on Unstructured Terrain
papers.abstract_en: Training locomotion policies for complex unstructured terrain requires a curriculum to avoid early exploration failures. However, since unstructured terrain lacks explicit difficulty ordering for curriculum design, existing methods resort to heuristic curricula over parameterized terrains. This abstraction limits generalization, as policies can overadapt to near-fixed perceptual patterns. To address this, we propose \textbf{\ourname{}}, an \textbf{T}rajectory-level \textbf{A}utomatic \textbf{C}urriculum \textbf{L}earning framework that generates training tasks directly from unstructured terrain maps. At each curriculum update, the evaluator learns a difficulty function for the current policy that maps a given trajectory task to a difficulty score. The sampler then proposes new trajectories guided by the learned evaluator as the curriculum for the next policy update. This forms a closed loop in which the curriculum is iteratively matched to the evolving policy. Quantitative and qualitative experiments show that \ourname{} continuously provides effective curricula on unstructured terrain, improving trajectory success rate by \(56.3\%\) over direct training without curriculum. Compared with handcrafted curriculum learning, our method improves success rate by \(18.5\%\) on the hardest terrain tasks and by up to \(39.74\%\) when evaluating traversal from diverse approach directions on the same obstacle type.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非结构化地形上腿部运动 (legged locomotion) 策略训练需要课程学习但缺乏显式难度排序的问题，提出轨迹级自动课程学习框架 (Trajectory-level Automatic Curriculum Learning)。该方法让评估器学习当前策略的难度函数，采样器据此从非结构化地形图中直接生成新轨迹任务，形成与策略同步演化的闭环课程。实验显示相对无课程直接训练，轨迹成功率提升 56.3%。
Motivation: 非结构化地形缺乏显式难度排序，现有方法依赖参数化地形上的启发式课程，导致策略过度适应近固定的感知模式，泛化受限。
Method: 提出轨迹级自动课程学习框架：每个课程更新阶段，评估器学习当前策略的难度函数，把给定轨迹任务映射为难度分数；采样器依据该评估器提出新轨迹作为下一轮策略更新的课程，形成课程与演化策略迭代匹配的闭环。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在非结构化地形上持续提供有效课程，相对直接训练将轨迹成功率提升 56.3%；与手工课程学习相比，在最难地形任务上成功率提升 18.5%，在同一障碍类型的不同接近方向评估穿越任务时提升最高达 39.74%。
Conclusion: 作者认为直接从非结构化地形图生成训练任务、并以闭环方式匹配演化策略，能够持续提供有效课程并改善泛化。

papers.title: Domain-Specific Text Embedding Models for Entity Resolution
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose text embedding models are designed to capture semantic similarity but are not optimised for distinguishing entity records that represent the same real-world business or person. This limitation affects applications such as entity resolution and duplicate record retrieval, where small textual differences may either preserve or change identity. This paper investigates whether domain-specific triplet fine-tuning can adapt pretrained embedding models for identity-sensitive retrieval. A synthetic dataset of business and person records was created with identity-preserving variations and challenging non-matching examples. Two widely used embedding models were evaluated before and after fine-tuning using a margin-based similarity evaluation. The results show substantial improvements in separating true matches from highly similar non-matches, demonstrating that domain-specific triplet training can effectively reshape general-purpose embedding spaces for entity retrieval. These findings suggest that targeted fine-tuning provides a practical approach for improving embedding models in data quality management and information retrieval applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否通过领域特定的三元组微调 (triplet fine-tuning) 将预训练文本嵌入模型适配到实体解析场景。作者构造了包含身份保持变体和困难非匹配样本的企业与个人记录合成数据集，并用基于边际的相似度评估比较两个常用嵌入模型在微调前后的表现。摘要报告微调后模型在区分真实匹配与高度相似的非匹配记录上取得了显著改进。
Motivation: 通用文本嵌入模型擅长捕捉语义相似性，但并未针对区分代表同一真实世界企业或个人的记录进行优化。这种局限影响实体解析和重复记录检索，因为微小的文本差异可能保留或改变身份。
Method: 作者构建了企业与个人记录的合成数据集，纳入身份保持型变体和具有挑战性的非匹配样本；对两个广泛使用的嵌入模型进行三元组微调，并使用基于边际的相似度评估 (margin-based similarity evaluation) 比较微调前后的效果。
Result: 摘要显示，微调后在区分真实匹配与高度相似的非匹配记录方面取得了实质性改进，说明领域特定的三元组训练能够重塑通用嵌入空间以服务于实体检索。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，针对性的微调为提高数据质量管理和信息检索应用中的嵌入模型提供了一种实用途径。

papers.title: Digital Twin Degradation: Detecting Cyber Physical Attacks via Temporal Inconsistencies
papers.abstract_en: Digital Twins (DTs) are increasingly used to monitor and analyze Cyber Physical Systems (CPS). However, in adversarial environments, the fidelity of a DT cannot be assumed. Communication delays, data manipulation, sensor degradation, or partial information loss may cause the DT state to diverge from the physical process it represents. Such divergence creates temporal inconsistencies that may reveal cyber physical attacks. This paper proposes a detection framework that monitors temporal consistency between the physical system and a potentially degraded DT view. A DT predictor is trained exclusively on normal system behavior to model short-term system dynamics. During operation, discrepancies between predicted and observed states are transformed into multi-horizon temporal features capturing the magnitude, persistence, and evolution of prediction residuals. An unsupervised density model characterizes normal consistency patterns, while a sequential change detection mechanism identifies sustained deviations indicative of attacks. The approach is evaluated on three widely used Industrial Control System (ICS) datasets, SWaT, HAI, and BATADAL, under multiple DT degradation scenarios, including time desynchronization and partial observability loss. Results show that temporal inconsistency patterns enable reliable event-level attack detection with bounded false alarm rates and low detection latency. The proposed method achieves up to 98% detection reliability on SWaT and false alarm rates below 2%. Unlike conventional anomaly detection methods, the proposed framework does not require attack signatures or labeled attack data and remains effective even when the DT view is degraded. These results suggest that DT degradation, often treated as a limitation, can instead serve as a useful signal for cyber physical security monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对网络物理系统（CPS）中数字孪生（DT）在对抗环境下可能发生状态退化的问题，提出一种基于时间一致性（temporal consistency）的攻击检测框架。框架训练一个仅基于正常行为的DT预测器，将预测与观测之间的残差转化为多时间跨度特征，并用无监督密度模型与序列变化检测识别持续偏差。在SWaT、HAI和BATADAL三个ICS数据集上，该方法在多种DT退化场景下实现了事件级攻击检测。
Motivation: 数字孪生被广泛用于监控CPS，但对抗环境中通信延迟、数据篡改、传感器退化或部分信息丢失会使DT状态偏离物理过程，这种时间不一致可能暴露网络物理攻击。现有方法通常假设DT保真度，本文则把DT退化本身当作可用的检测信号。
Method: 提出一个检测框架：DT预测器仅在正常系统行为上训练以建模短期动态；运行中预测与观测的残差被转换为多时间跨度（multi-horizon）特征，刻画残差的大小、持续性和演化；无监督密度模型刻画正常一致性模式，再由序列变化检测机制识别持续偏离。
Result: 在SWaT、HAI和BATADAL数据集上，针对时间失同步和部分可观测性损失等DT退化场景，方法实现了可靠的事件级攻击检测，在SWaT上检测可靠性最高达98%，误报率低于2%，并具有低检测延迟。
Conclusion: 该框架不依赖攻击签名或标注攻击数据，在DT视图退化时仍然有效。作者认为DT退化通常被视为局限性，但可以成为网络物理安全监控的有用信号。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对网络物理系统（CPS）中数字孪生（DT）在对抗环境下可能发生状态退化的问题，提出一种基于时间一致性（temporal consistency）的攻击检测框架。框架训练一个仅基于正常行为的DT预测器，将预测与观测之间的残差转化为多时间跨度特征，并用无监督密度模型与序列变化检测识别持续偏差。在SWaT、HAI和BATADAL三个ICS数据集上，该方法在多种DT退化场景下实现了事件级攻击检测。
summary_sections.motivation: 数字孪生被广泛用于监控CPS，但对抗环境中通信延迟、数据篡改、传感器退化或部分信息丢失会使DT状态偏离物理过程，这种时间不一致可能暴露网络物理攻击。现有方法通常假设DT保真度，本文则把DT退化本身当作可用的检测信号。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架不依赖攻击签名或标注攻击数据，在DT视图退化时仍然有效。作者认为DT退化通常被视为局限性，但可以成为网络物理安全监控的有用信号。

papers.title: A Tree-Structured Approach for Phishing Template and Attacker Attribution Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Phishing remains a persistent and evolving cybersecurity threat, with attack volumes reaching record levels. This growth is driven by the industrialization of phishing through widely available phishing kits and reusable templates, which enable cybercriminals to rapidly generate and deploy large numbers of fraudulent webpages. Although surface-level attributes may differ across these websites, their underlying structures often exhibit significant similarities. However, most existing defenses rely on reactive blocklists or supervised classification models that focus on individual phishing instances, limiting their ability to identify structural reuse and detect coordinated phishing campaigns. To address this limitation, this study investigates whether HTML structure can serve as a robust fingerprint for identifying phishing template reuse. We model webpages as Document Object Model (DOM) trees and extract structural features, optionally enriched with HTML tag-based content information. These representations are then clustered using unsupervised learning methods to group structurally similar webpages. Three clustering algorithms are evaluated and compared, while also analyzing how the depth of the extracted DOM-tree affects cluster formation and overall clustering performance. Finally, cluster quality is also evaluated both quantitatively and qualitatively, including a novel level-wise Jaccard Distance Score and manual inspection supported by visualization tools. Results demonstrate that structural representations of webpages can effectively reveal hidden similarities across phishing sites, enabling the detection of emerging and zero-day templates and supporting the analysis of coordinated phishing threats
papers.comment: Paper accepted and presented @ eCrime 2026 conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出以网页 DOM 树结构作为识别钓鱼模板复用的鲁棒指纹，提取结构特征（可选加入 HTML 标签内容信息），并用无监督聚类方法对结构相似的网页分组。研究比较了三种聚类算法，分析 DOM 树深度对聚类的影响，并提出逐层 Jaccard Distance Score 等指标评估聚类质量。结果显示结构表示能有效揭示钓鱼站点间的隐藏相似性，支持发现新兴与零日模板以及协同钓鱼活动分析。
Motivation: 现有防御大多依赖反应式黑名单或针对单个钓鱼实例的监督分类，难以识别结构复用和协调性钓鱼活动；钓鱼套件和可复用模板使攻击规模化，需要在实例层面之外通过页面结构发现相似性。
Method: 将网页建模为 DOM 树，提取结构特征并可选结合 HTML 标签内容信息；随后使用无监督学习进行聚类以归组结构相似的网页，评估三种聚类算法，并分析 DOM 树深度对聚类结果的影响；聚类质量通过定量与定性方式评估，包括新的逐层 Jaccard Distance Score 和可视化人工检查。
Result: 摘要报告结构表示能够揭示钓鱼站点间隐藏的相似性，从而检测新兴和零日模板，并支持对协调式钓鱼威胁的分析。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为网页 DOM 树结构可以作为钓鱼模板复用的有效指纹，适用于检测模板重用与协调攻击场景。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TRCA: Transition-wise Rubric Credit Assignment for Long-horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents are typically optimized with sparse terminal outcomes, making fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step interactions difficult. Existing approaches either rely on process evaluators, which incur annotation and inference costs, or derive step-level credit from successful trajectories. However, successful trajectories are extremely scarce during early-stage reinforcement learning, substantially weakening anchor-based methods. We propose Transition-wise Rubric Credit Assignment (TRCA), which derives step-level supervision directly from action-induced transitions without learned evaluators or successful anchors. TRCA evaluates each transition using Evidence, Execution, and Invalidity rubrics to capture task-relevant information acquisition, valid task execution, and invalid or regressive behavior. From these judgments, Foundational Rubric Reward measures local transition quality, while Breakthrough Rubric Reward tracks newly covered Evidence and Execution conditions to reward incremental task progress. Combined with terminal outcomes, these signals produce fine-grained step-level advantages for policy optimization. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and seven search-augmented question-answering benchmarks show consistent improvements over the evaluated baselines. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, TRCA improves the WebShop score by 6.0%-12.6%; with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, it improves the average SearchQA score by 1.9%-18.3%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of transition-wise rubric credit assignment for long-horizon tasks with sparse successful anchors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长视野 LLM agent 中稀疏终端结果导致的多步交互信用分配困难，提出 Transition-wise Rubric Credit Assignment (TRCA) 方法。TRCA 不依赖学习的评估器或成功轨迹锚，直接根据动作引起的转移 (transition) 生成步骤级监督，并用 Evidence、Execution、Invalidity 三个规则 (rubric) 评估每步。实验在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和七个搜索增强问答基准上相比基线取得一致提升。
Motivation: 长视野 LLM agent 通常只有稀疏的终端奖励，难以进行细粒度信用分配。现有方法要么依赖过程评估器，带来标注和推理成本；要么从成功轨迹中推导步骤级信用，但早期强化学习阶段成功轨迹极少，严重削弱了这类基于锚的方法。
Method: 提出 TRCA，直接从行动诱导的转移中推导步骤级监督，无需学习评估器或成功锚。它对每个转移用 Evidence、Execution 和 Invalidity 三种规则评估，分别捕捉任务相关信息获取、有效任务执行以及无效或倒退行为；并在此基础上定义 Foundational Rubric Reward 衡量局部转移质量，Breakthrough Rubric Reward 追踪新覆盖的 Evidence 和 Execution 条件以奖励增量进展，最后与终端结果结合生成细粒度步骤级优势用于策略优化。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和七个搜索增强问答基准上，TRCA 相比评估基线实现一致提升。具体地，使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 时 WebShop 分数提升 6.0%-12.6%；使用 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 时平均 SearchQA 分数提升 1.9%-18.3%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在成功锚稀疏的长视野任务中，转移级规则信用分配 (transition-wise rubric credit assignment) 是有效的，并展示了 TRCA 在这些任务上的实际收益。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: REFLEX: Reflexive Equilibrium Fixed-point Learning for Endogenous eXchanges
papers.abstract_en: In over-the-counter corporate bond markets, dealers compete for client trades by quoting bid and ask prices. Tighter quotes attract more business, but also informed customers more likely to trade ahead of adverse price moves, leaving the dealer holding the risk. As dealers increasingly use machine learning to set quotes, they retrain these models on the trades their own quotes attract, creating a feedback loop in which each model reshapes the market that generates its next training data. The question is therefore not only whether a quoting model performs well, but whether the market it creates stays stable as the model learns from it. Existing performative prediction theory gives a sharp stability condition, yet expresses it through abstract properties of the learning objective a trading desk cannot measure before deployment. We introduce REFLEX, a framework that replaces those unobservable quantities with three measurable features of dealer behavior: how strongly trading volume responds to tighter quotes, how sharply the dealer's objective bends around its optimum, and how quickly informed flow increases as spreads narrow. REFLEX combines these into a single retraining modulus, a pre-deployment stability margin estimated from a desk's own quote and execution history that predicts whether repeated retraining will converge or amplify itself. In simulation, predicted and measured stability agree within 8%, and competing dealers increase instability by 1.74x with two and 3.16x with three, as predicted. Where ordinary retraining becomes unstable at modulus 1.21, a structurally anchored correction converges as blind retraining collapses. Calibrated over 36 years of public market data, stability headroom falls roughly 4.4x for investment grade and 4.3x for high yield from calm to crisis regimes. Ultimately, REFLEX turns an abstract convergence theorem into a market-level safety margin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 OTC 公司债市场中做市商报价模型的再训练反馈回路，提出 REFLEX 框架，用三个可测的交易行为特征构建重训练模量 (retraining modulus)，在部署前估计市场是否会因模型反复再训练而失稳。仿真显示稳定性预测与实测误差在 8% 以内，竞争做市商数量增加会使不稳定性按预测放大；基于 36 年公开市场数据的校准显示，从平静期到危机期，投资级与高收益级债券的稳定裕度分别下降约 4.4 倍和 4.3 倍。
Motivation: 现有 performative prediction 理论给出了稳定性条件，但该条件依赖学习目标的抽象性质，交易台在部署前无法测量；需要一个可从报价与成交历史直接估计的稳定性判据。
Method: REFLEX 用三个可测特征替代不可观测量：交易量对收紧迫价的响应强度、做市商目标函数在最优值附近的弯曲程度、以及价差收窄时知情交易流增加的快慢，并将它们组合成单一重训练模量作为部署前稳定裕度。
Result: 仿真中预测与实测稳定性在 8% 以内一致；两个竞争做市商使不稳定性放大 1.74 倍、三个放大 3.16 倍，与预测一致。普通再训练在模量 1.21 处失稳，而结构锚定修正（structurally anchored correction）在盲再训练崩溃时仍收敛；36 年市场数据校准显示危机期稳定裕度在投资级和高收益级分别下降约 4.4 倍和 4.3 倍。
Conclusion: REFLEX 将抽象收敛定理转化为做市商可预先估算的市场级安全裕度，适用于 OTC 公司债市场的报价再训练稳定性评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: KeyID: Decoupled Drafting and Keyframe Editing for Identity-Preserving Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Identity-preserving video generation (IPVG) requires synthesizing videos that are faithful to both reference subjects and text prompts. Existing methods are often hindered by high tuning costs or limited input-level enhancements, struggling to maintain rigid identity consistency during complex, long-sequence actions. To address these limitations, we propose KeyID, a training-free IPVG framework that decouples the synthesis of video dynamics from the injection of identity. Specifically, KeyID comprises two components: (1) Reference-Aware Video Generation, which produces an identity-agnostic video draft aligned with multiple references, and (2) Identity-Preserved Keyframe Editing, which integrates the target identity via sparse keyframe correction and subsequent motion interpolation. By shifting from dense frame-level supervision to sparse keyframe-level refinement, KeyID effectively resolves the capacity conflict between prompt adherence and identity fidelity. Crucially, our modular design allows seamless extension to multi-subject references and complex sequential action generation without additional training. KeyID outperforms prior works and is validated by automatic and human evaluations on the official challenge benchmark, ultimately securing the runner-up position in the Track 2 (Sequential Action) of the ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG Grand Challenge. Source code is available at https://github.com/WISLab-GDUT/KeyID.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KeyID，一个免训练的身份保持视频生成（identity-preserving video generation, IPVG）框架，将视频动态合成与身份注入解耦。KeyID 由参考感知视频生成和身份保持关键帧编辑两部分组成，通过稀疏关键帧校正和运动插值来注入目标身份，在 ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG Grand Challenge Track 2（Sequential Action）中取得亚军。
Motivation: 现有 IPVG 方法要么调优成本高，要么只做有限的输入级增强，在复杂长序列动作中难以维持刚性的身份一致性。
Method: KeyID 先由 Reference-Aware Video Generation 生成对齐多个参考的身份无关视频草稿，再由 Identity-Preserved Keyframe Editing 通过稀疏关键帧校正和后续运动插值注入目标身份；模块化设计使其无需额外训练即可扩展到多主体参考和复杂顺序动作生成。
Result: 自动评测和人工评测均表明 KeyID 优于此前方法，并在 ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG Grand Challenge 的 Track 2（Sequential Action）中获得亚军。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将密集帧级监督转变为稀疏关键帧级细化，可以解决提示遵循与身份保真之间的容量冲突。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Asymptotics-guided learning and symbolic regression for dispersive resonances
papers.abstract_en: We study resonance prediction in dispersive media, formulated as nonlinear spectral problems for volume integral operators. The main idea is to use asymptotic analysis not only as a baseline approximation, but also as a guide for constructing predictive correction models. We learn the residual between asymptotic and reference resonances using features suggested by the subwavelength expansion, including the logarithmic scales specific to two dimensions. The resulting corrections substantially improve single-resonator and dimer predictions, and symbolic regression produces compact formulas for the learned residual. The results show that asymptotic analysis can be used not only to approximate resonances, but also to design the feature space in which data-driven corrections become accurate, low-dimensional, and interpretable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究色散介质中的共振预测，将其表述为体积积分算子的非线性谱问题。作者不再把渐近分析仅当作基线近似，而是用它指导构建预测修正模型：利用亚波长展开（subwavelength expansion）所提示的特征（包括二维特有的对数尺度）学习渐近共振与参考共振之间的残差。摘要报告该方法显著改善单谐振器与二聚体（dimer）预测，且符号回归（symbolic regression）可将学习到的残差压缩为紧凑公式。
Motivation: 渐近分析通常只作为基线近似使用，其内部结构未被用于提升数据驱动修正的精度与可解释性；需要一种能利用物理渐近结构设计特征空间、从而获得低维可解释修正模型的方法。
Method: 以渐近分析为指导设计特征空间，根据亚波长展开提示的特征（含二维特有的对数尺度）学习渐近解与参考共振之间的残差；再用符号回归将残差表示为紧凑公式。
Result: 摘要报告该修正方法显著改进单谐振器和二聚体的共振预测，并声称符号回归能生成学习残差的紧凑公式。
Conclusion: 结果表明渐近分析不仅可以作为近似的工具，还能用于设计特征空间，使数据驱动修正在该空间中变得准确、低维且可解释。

papers.title: FeatureHospital: A Skill-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Algorithm Customization in Multi-View Multi-Label Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view multi-label feature selection aims to identify a compact and informative feature subset from heterogeneous views while preserving discriminative information for multiple labels. Existing methods are generally developed from specific modeling perspectives and incorporate mechanisms tailored to particular data characteristics. Designing suitable feature selection algorithms across datasets with diverse and heterogeneous characteristics still relies heavily on expert knowledge and substantial manual effort, imposing considerable time and labor costs that severely hinder the practical adoption of feature selection. To address this problem, we propose FeatureHospital, a Skill-driven multi-agent framework for automated multi-view multi-label feature selection algorithm design. FeatureHospital first diagnoses the target dataset to identify its feature selection issues. Based on the diagnosis, specialist agents equipped with domain Skills then prescribe corresponding optimization strategies and Loss terms for different issues. After that, the resulting prescriptions are reconciled to remove overlaps and resolve conflicts before being integrated into a compact dataset-specific objective. Finally, the constructed objective is optimized to select the final feature subset. Experimental results demonstrate that FeatureHospital can construct effective feature selection algorithms for different datasets based on their individual characteristics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FeatureHospital，一个以技能驱动的多智能体框架，用于自动化设计多视图多标签特征选择算法。框架先诊断数据集的特征选择问题，再由具备领域技能的专业智能体针对不同问题给出优化策略和损失项，经协调去重后整合为紧凑的目标函数，最后优化该目标以选出最终特征子集。实验表明该方法能根据数据集个体特征构造有效的特征选择算法。
Motivation: 现有多视图多标签特征选择方法通常针对特定数据特性设计，跨数据集设计合适算法仍高度依赖专家知识和大量人工，耗时且限制特征选择的实际采用。
Method: 提出 FeatureHospital 框架：先对目标数据集进行诊断以识别特征选择问题，然后由配备领域技能（Skills）的专业智能体（specialist agents）为不同问题开具相应的优化策略和损失项（Loss terms），再将处方进行协调以去除重叠和解决冲突，整合成紧凑的数据集特定目标函数，最后优化该目标以选择最终特征子集。
Result: 实验结果表明 FeatureHospital 能够根据不同数据集的个体特征构造有效的特征选择算法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架可以基于数据集自身特点自动化构造特征选择算法，从而减少对专家知识的依赖。

papers.title: When Single-Dataset Conclusions Fail: A 45-Task Study of Threshold Tuning and Resampling for Imbalanced Classification
papers.abstract_en: Class-imbalance handling is routinely evaluated on a single benchmark dataset, and the resulting conclusions are reported as if they were properties of the method. We show this practice is unsafe. On the public Kaggle credit-card fraud dataset, under a leakage-free nested cross-validation protocol in which the decision threshold is selected on a held-out inner validation fold, a plain Random Forest at the default 0.5 threshold attains F1 = 0.861 +/- 0.021, and threshold tuning yields it no benefit (delta-F1 = -0.002). Read alone, this supports an appealing conclusion: for a well-calibrated ensemble, imbalance handling is unnecessary. We then apply the identical protocol to 45 binary tasks spanning imbalance ratios from 1:1.5 to 1:178 (2,025 model fits, four model families). The conclusion reverses. Random Forest benefits most from threshold tuning across the suite (delta-F1 = +0.101 +/- 0.134), not least, while three other families replicate their fraud-dataset behaviour almost exactly. SMOTE likewise harms the fraud dataset but helps across the suite (mean delta-F1 = +0.076; 138 wins, 39 losses; Wilcoxon p = 2.7e-17). Two further results. Threshold-tuning benefit is non-monotonic in the imbalance ratio: near zero below 1:5, peaking at +0.120 in the 1:15-1:40 band, declining to +0.045 beyond 1:100 - explaining why the fraud dataset, at 1:577, is an unrepresentative place to study the question. And we reject an intuitive heuristic: validation-set calibration error does not predict tuning benefit (expected calibration error r = -0.087; Brier r = +0.137), so calibration diagnostics cannot tell a practitioner whether tuning is worthwhile. We release the protocol, the 45-task harness, and all per-run metrics.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code and per-run metrics released
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出在单一基准数据集上评估类别不平衡处理方法会得出不可靠的结论。作者在Kaggle信用卡欺诈数据集上发现，默认0.5阈值的普通随机森林已达到F1=0.861，阈值调优无收益（delta-F1=-0.002），看似说明不平衡处理不必要；但将相同协议扩展到45个二分类任务后结论逆转，随机森林从阈值调优中获益最多（delta-F1=+0.101），SMOTE在欺诈数据上有害但在整套任务中有帮助（平均delta-F1=+0.076）。阈值调优收益随不平衡率呈非单调变化，且校准误差不能预测调优收益。
Motivation: 类别不平衡方法通常在单一基准数据集上评估，所得结论被当作方法本身的属性，这种实践不安全，可能导致误导性的方法选择。
Method: 采用无泄漏的嵌套交叉验证协议，在内部验证折上选择决策阈值，对45个二分类任务（不平衡率1:1.5到1:178）进行2,025次模型拟合，覆盖四个模型族，并发布协议、任务框架和每次运行的指标。
Result: 欺诈数据集上阈值调优对随机森林无益（delta-F1=-0.002），但在45任务套件中随机森林获益最大（delta-F1=+0.101±0.134）；SMOTE在欺诈数据上有害但在套件中总体有益（平均delta-F1=+0.076，138胜39负，Wilcoxon p=2.7e-17）。调优收益随不平衡率非单调变化：低于1:5时接近零，1:15-1:40区间达峰值+0.120，超过1:100后降至+0.045；校准误差不能预测调优收益（ECE相关系数r=-0.087，Brier r=+0.137）。
Conclusion: 单一数据集结论不可推广，欺诈数据集（不平衡率1:577）是研究该问题的不具代表性场所；校准诊断无法告知从业者阈值调优是否值得。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Right Prior for the Right Deformation: Rethinking Continuous Deformable Image Registration
papers.abstract_en: Deformable image registration models implicitly encode deformation priors through their parametrization and optimization. In this work, we conduct a validation study on continuous registration methods to examine how these implicit priors affect performance across different registration tasks. Classic B-Spline transformations impose locality, smoothness, and scale through their control-point structure, whereas recent INR-based methods impose different priors through neural parameterization and optimization. We compare INR-Dense (IDIR), which directly models a dense displacement field using a SIREN-based INR; INR-BSCP (SINR), which predicts B-Spline control points with an INR; D-BSCP, which directly optimizes single-scale B-Spline control points; and MR-D-BSCP, which adds a multiresolution coarse-to-fine scheme. Experiments on inter-subject brain MR registration (OASIS) and intra-subject exhale-to-inhale lung CT registration (DIR-LAB 4DCT) reveal different behavior across deformation regimes. On OASIS, where deformations are moderate but locally complex, D-BSCP matches or slightly outperforms INR-BSCP, suggesting that the B-Spline parameterization accounts for much of INR-BSCP's effectiveness. On DIR-LAB 4DCT, where respiratory motion is larger and more coherent, single-scale B-Spline methods (D-BSCP and INR-BSCP) are less suitable, while INR-Dense and MR-D-BSCP are more effective. Across both tasks, MR-D-BSCP achieves the best performance among the tested continuous parameterizations. These findings highlight that registration accuracy depends strongly on matching the induced deformation prior to the target motion pattern, and support prior-deformation matching as a practical design principle for medical image registration. Our code will be available at https://github.com/HengjieLiu/RightPriorDIR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对连续可变形图像配准方法进行验证研究，考察不同参数化方式所隐含的形变先验（deformation prior）如何影响跨任务配准性能。作者比较了基于 SIREN 的稠密位移场 INR（INR-Dense/IDIR）、预测 B-Spline 控制点的 INR（INR-BSCP/SINR）、直接优化单尺度 B-Spline 控制点的 D-BSCP，以及加入多分辨率粗到细方案的 MR-D-BSCP，并在 OASIS 脑 MR 和 DIR-LAB 4DCT 肺 CT 上实验。结果显示配准精度强烈依赖形变先验与目标运动模式的匹配，其中 MR-D-BSCP 在两类任务中综合表现最好。
Motivation: 可变形图像配准模型透过参数化和优化隐式编码形变先验，但不同连续参数化方法所引入的先验在不同配准任务中的影响缺乏系统性验证。作者希望通过对比研究揭示先验与任务运动模式的匹配关系，为医学图像配准中的方法选择提供依据。
Method: 在跨被试脑 MR（OASIS）和同被试呼气到吸气肺 CT（DIR-LAB 4DCT）两个任务上，系统比较四种连续参数化配准方法：INR-Dense（IDIR）用 SIREN 直接建模稠密位移场，INR-BSCP（SINR）用 INR 预测 B-Spline 控制点，D-BSCP 直接优化单尺度 B-Spline 控制点，MR-D-BSCP 增加多分辨率粗到细优化方案。
Result: 在 OASIS 上，D-BSCP 与 INR-BSCP 相当或略优，提示 B-Spline 参数化本身承担了 INR-BSCP 的大部分有效性；在运动更大且更连贯的 DIR-LAB 4DCT 上，单尺度 B-Spline 方法（D-BSCP 和 INR-BSCP）不太适用，而 INR-Dense 与 MR-D-BSCP 更有效；两个任务中 MR-D-BSCP 均取得最佳性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调配准精度在很大程度上取决于将诱导形变先验与目标运动模式相匹配，并把先验-形变匹配（prior-deformation matching）作为医学图像配准的实用设计原则；代码将在 GitHub 上公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AnyTalk: Speech Animation for Arbitrary Characters Leveraging a Video Generation Model
papers.abstract_en: We present AnyTalk, a novel method for generating 3D speech animations for arbitrary characters without requiring any animation data. While existing audio-driven 3D speech animation methods rely on character-specific training data or laborious rigging/re-meshing, AnyTalk circumvents these limitations by leveraging recent video diffusion models trained on extensive video datasets. We first adapt a pre-trained video diffusion model to a target character through our Character-specific Fine-tuning (\textit{CsF}) technique. By fine-tuning on rendered images of the 3D character paired with zeroed-out audio embeddings (representing "no motion"), we eliminate the need for animation data while preserving the motion prior of large-scale video diffusion model. We then uplift the resulting talking-head video into a 3D speech animation by estimating blendshape parameters through a proposed optimization process. AnyTalk enables lip-synced animations across diverse face meshes and blendshape configurations, significantly reducing manual effort and data requirements. We further enhance usability by distilling AnyTalk into a streamlined network, $\text{AnyTalk}_{RT}$, thereby enabling real-time performance. By leveraging talking-head video generation, our method broadens access to audio-driven speech animation technology for arbitrary characters. The code is publicly available at https://serin-yoon.github.io/projects/anytalk/.
papers.comment: accepted to TVCG, Project page at https://serin-yoon.github.io/projects/anytalk/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnyTalk 提出一种无需动画数据即可为任意 3D 角色生成语音动画的方法。它通过 Character-specific Fine-tuning (CsF) 技术微调预训练视频扩散模型，利用渲染图像与零化音频嵌入（表示“无运动”）保留运动先验，再通过优化 blendshape 参数将生成的说话头视频提升为 3D 语音动画。作者还提供了精简网络 AnyTalk_RT 以实现实时性能。
Motivation: 现有音频驱动的 3D 语音动画方法依赖角色特定训练数据或繁琐的绑定/重网格化流程，限制了任意角色上的应用。
Method: 提出 CsF 微调策略，仅使用目标 3D 角色的渲染图像和零化音频嵌入来适配预训练视频扩散模型，从而避免动画数据需求；随后设计一个优化过程估计 blendshape 参数，将说话头视频转化为 3D 语音动画，并蒸馏出实时版本 AnyTalk_RT。
Result: 摘要报告该方法支持多种人脸网格和 blendshape 配置下的唇形同步动画，显著减少人工与数据需求，且 AnyTalk_RT 可实现实时性能。

papers.title: Graph Neural Assisted Actor-Critic for Latency-Efficient Edge Vision System
papers.abstract_en: UAV on-board vision systems are widely used for different activities, including monitoring in no-fly zones. In this case, the vision-equipped UAV streams a video to a ground server where an operator assists its activities. The latency of video transmission has a profound impact on the effectiveness of the operator assistance. However, most techniques available for video transmission still incur significant latency costs. In this paper, we propose a graph convolutional neural network-assisted (GCN-Assisted A2C) deep reinforcement learning (DRL) system model to find the optimal pixel-correlated area of a suspicious object. We combine the Lagrangian dual form with gradient descent to prevent lack of convergence and over- and under-penalization constraint violation during latency optimization. The proposed system model sends a sub-group pixel-correlated area of the frame from the UAV to the server rather than the transmission of the whole video frame. The proposed framework utilizes the GCN model to explore hidden representations of feature-correlated groups of pixels. Moreover, the GCN supervises the A2C model, which selects a subgroup to enhance transmission latency, thus supervising the training of UAV actions in A2C. Experimental results show that GCN-assisted A2C reduces video frame transmission latency together with false detection rate in UAV vision systems over other DRL and state-of-the-art models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图卷积网络辅助的 Actor-Critic（GCN-Assisted A2C）深度强化学习模型，用于降低无人机（UAV）机载视觉系统向地面服务器传输视频的延迟。系统不再传输整帧视频，而是只传输与可疑目标像素相关的子区域；GCN 用于学习像素特征相关组的隐藏表示，并监督 A2C 选择子区域以优化传输延迟。结合拉格朗日对偶形式与梯度下降，以处理约束违反以及惩罚过重/不足导致的收敛问题。实验表明该方法相比其他 DRL 和 SOTA 模型同时降低帧传输延迟和误检率。
Motivation: 无人机视觉系统将视频流传输到地面服务器以辅助操作员监控，视频传输延迟严重影响操作有效性，而现有视频传输技术延迟成本仍然较高。
Method: 提出 GCN-Assisted A2C 深度强化学习系统模型：由 GCN 探索像素特征相关组的隐藏表示并监督 A2C 训练，A2C 选择要传输的帧内像素相关子区域而非整帧；同时将拉格朗日对偶形式与梯度下降结合，防止无法收敛以及约束惩罚过度或不足。
Result: 实验结果表明，GCN-Assisted A2C 相比其他 DRL 和最新模型，在无人机视觉系统中降低了视频帧传输延迟和误检率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提框架通过只传输像素相关子区域并在 GCN 监督下训练 A2C，能够在降低延迟的同时控制误检率，适用于边缘视觉系统。

papers.title: Multi-Feature Riemannian Hypergraph for Online Test-Time Adaptation of Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interface
authors: (5) Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College)
papers.abstract_en: In clinical motor imagery brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) decoding, cross-day transferability and online operation remain two critical challenges. Hypergraphs can improve transferability by capturing higher-order sample relationships, yet existing hypergraph-based methods for online emotion recognition neglect the cross-day benefits of Riemannian geometry widely adopted in EEG transfer learning. To bridge this gap, we propose the Multi-feature Riemannian Hypergraph (MRieHy), a framework tailored for online test-time adaptation in MI-BCI decoding that leverages Riemannian geometry to strengthen cross-day transferability. MRieHy first computes Riemannian means of covariance matrices from cross-day training data to align multi-day distributions. It then constructs a hypergraph over covariance matrices using Riemannian distance, complemented by a second hypergraph over deep features built with cosine similarity. The two hypergraphs are fused via adaptively learned combination weights, jointly optimized with the label projection matrices. During online testing, MRieHy maintains a first-in-first-out buffer of recent samples, performs Riemannian alignment on the buffered data, and decodes with the learned hypergraph. Extensive experiments on a private four-class ECoG dataset and two public four-class EEG datasets validate that MRieHy achieves notable performance gains over state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multi-feature Riemannian Hypergraph (MRieHy)，一个面向运动想象脑机接口（MI-BCI）解码的在线测试时自适应（test-time adaptation）框架。它利用黎曼几何对齐跨天训练数据的协方差矩阵分布，并融合基于黎曼距离的协方差超图和基于余弦相似度的深度特征超图进行解码。在私有四类 ECoG 数据集和两个公开四类 EEG 数据集上，MRieHy 相对现有最先进基线取得显著性能提升。
Motivation: 临床 MI-BCI 解码面临跨天可迁移性与在线运行两大挑战。现有基于超图的方法多用于在线情绪识别，未利用 EEG 迁移学习中广泛采用的黎曼几何所带来的跨天收益。
Method: MRieHy 先计算跨天训练数据协方差矩阵的黎曼均值以对齐多天分布；然后基于黎曼距离在协方差矩阵上构建一个超图，并基于余弦相似度在深度特征上构建第二个超图。两个超图通过自适应学习的组合权重融合，并与标签投影矩阵联合优化。在线测试时，维护先进先出（FIFO）缓冲区保存最近样本，对缓冲数据进行黎曼对齐并用学习到的超图解码头。
Result: 在私有四类 ECoG 数据集和两个公开四类 EEG 数据集上的大量实验表明，MRieHy 相比最先进基线获得了显著性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法能提升 MI-BCI 解码的跨天可迁移性与在线运行能力，未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: Coded Hankel Polynomial Chaos: Spectral Identification of Dominant Polynomial-Chaos Modes
papers.abstract_en: Identification of dominant polynomial-chaos modes is usually formulated as a sparse-regression problem on a sampled multivariate polynomial dictionary. We develop coded Hankel polynomial chaos (CH-PC), a complementary spectral formulation for dominant-mode identification. A finite generating transform converts PCE coefficients into a coefficient-generating polynomial, and evaluation along a geometric phase orbit produces a finite exponential sum. Its model order and spectral nodes are encoded by low-rank Hankel matrices, while coordinate phase shifts attach root-of-unity labels from which the full polynomial multi-indices are recovered. Coordinate-shifted probes are combined as common-node snapshots, and independent phase encodings provide redundant representations when a single spectral encoding is poorly conditioned. For finite observations, population, finite-data, and observed probes are kept distinct: sampling or quadrature error and observation error enter as separate Hankel perturbations, which are then connected to spectral stability, discrete decoding, and phase voting. For tensor-product candidate sets, the generating kernel factorizes into one-dimensional sums and can be evaluated without assembling the full multivariate PCE design matrix. Numerical experiments on sparse Legendre benchmarks and a stochastic Darcy problem illustrate exact recovery, noise stabilization, unknown-order identification by phase persistence, and dominant-mode recovery for a PDE-generated quantity of interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 coded Hankel polynomial chaos (CH-PC)，一种用于主导多项式混沌 (polynomial chaos) 模态识别的谱方法。它通过有限生成变换将 PCE 系数转为系数生成多项式，并沿几何相位轨道求值得到有限指数和，再利用低秩 Hankel 矩阵编码模型阶数与谱节点，以坐标相位平移上的单位根标签恢复多指标。
Motivation: 主导多项式混沌模态识别通常被建模为采样多元多项式字典上的稀疏回归问题，本文旨在补充一种谱域 (spectral) 的识别框架，绕过稀疏回归的常规设定。
Method: 将坐标平移探针组合为公共节点快照，并用独立相位编码提供冗余表示以应对病态谱编码；对有限观测数据，分别处理采样/求积误差与观测误差为独立的 Hankel 扰动，并将其联系到谱稳定性、离散解码与相位投票。对张量积候选集，生成核可分解为一维和，无需组装完整多元 PCE 设计矩阵。
Result: 在稀疏 Legendre 基准和随机 Darcy 问题上的数值实验表明，该方法能实现精确恢复、噪声稳定化、通过相位持续性 (phase persistence) 进行未知阶数识别，以及对 PDE 生成的目标量进行主导模态恢复。
Conclusion: CH-PC 为多项式混沌主导模态识别提供了一种不依赖完整多元设计矩阵的谱域替代方案，并显式区分了总体、有限数据与观测探针下的误差来源。

papers.title: TokenSTFormer: A Tokenized Spatial-temporal Attention Model for Holistic Motion Analysis in Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis Screening
papers.abstract_en: Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis (AIS) is a prevalent spinal deformity in adolescents that, if left untreated, can result in severe health outcomes. Traditional screening methods are limited by subjective interpretation, reliance on professional expertise and low scalability. To address these challenges, we present ScoliGait dataset, which comprises 1,516 gait video clips paired with corresponding X-ray records. We also introduce TokenSTFormer, a novel model that tokenizes spatial and temporal semantics to enhance feature representation and convergence. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing vanilla Vision Transformer encoder across key metrics, including accuracy of 0.79. This study highlights the potential of leveraging holistic motion features derived from gait video and attention-based models for scalable, cost-effective AIS screening, paving the way for future clinical applications in scoliosis detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ScoliGait 数据集（1,516 段步态视频片段配对 X 光记录）和 TokenSTFormer 模型，将空间与时间语义进行 tokenization 以增强特征表示和收敛性。模型在 AIS 筛查任务上达到 state-of-the-art，准确率为 0.79，超越 vanilla Vision Transformer encoder。作者认为基于步态视频的整体运动特征与注意力模型可用于可扩展、低成本的脊柱侧弯筛查。
Motivation: 青少年特发性脊柱侧弯（AIS）是常见的青少年脊柱畸形，传统筛查方法受主观判读、依赖专业经验且可扩展性低的限制，需要更自动化的筛查手段。
Method: 构建包含 1,516 个步态视频片段及对应 X 光记录的 ScoliGait 数据集，并提出 TokenSTFormer 模型，通过对时空语义进行 tokenization 来提升特征表示和模型收敛。
Result: 摘要报告模型在关键指标上超越 vanilla Vision Transformer encoder，实现 0.79 的准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用步态视频中的整体运动特征和基于注意力的模型有望实现可扩展、低成本的 AIS 筛查，为未来临床应用奠定基础。

papers.title: Assessing LLMs' mathematical abilities requires understanding the various mechanisms of mathematical creativity
papers.abstract_en: How should we assess whether large language models can perform mathematical invention? I argue that this question is currently underspecified: mathematical creativity is not one capacity but several mechanistically distinct modes of meaning-making - reflexive introspection on mathematical practice, analogical import from the sciences, problem-driven construction, and the bridging of distant domains - together with a further, cross-cutting distinction between meaning pursued because a pattern was observed and meaning pursued because it is strategically wanted, a distinction I develop through the case of conjecture-formation. These mechanisms are likely non-substitutable, so that competence in one does not transfer to the others. Grounding each in a historical case study and in an architecture-level account of current transformer-based systems, I suggest that today's models concentrate their competence in modes shaped by recombination and search over existing building blocks; if that description holds, the remaining modes are out of reach in principle, not just slower - though whether it holds is itself the open, empirical part. Because proof is getting cheaper as AI improves at generating it - a shift the field's own leading voices are now diagnosing - mathematical value is migrating toward the modes current systems cannot yet perform, and evaluations of AI mathematical ability should be organized around this taxonomy rather than around aggregate benchmarks that conflate it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于如何评估大语言模型数学发明能力的立场性论文。作者认为“数学创造力”并非单一能力，而是包含多种机制上不同的意义建构模式，并提出应围绕这些模式而非聚合基准来组织评估；文中还区分了因观察到模式而追求意义与因策略需要而追求意义两种情形，以猜想形成为例。作者借助历史案例研究和当前 Transformer 系统的架构层面分析论证，现有模型的能力集中于重组与搜索既有构建块的模式，其余模式若该判断成立则原则上不可及。
Motivation: 现有对 LLM 数学能力的评估因把数学创造力视为单一能力而欠定义，聚合基准混淆了机制上不同的能力；同时，随着 AI 生成证明的成本下降，数学价值正在向当前系统尚无法完成的模式迁移，因此需要更恰当的评估框架。
Method: 提出数学创造力的机制分类，包括对数学实践的反思性内省、从科学中类比引入、问题驱动的构造、跨远域桥接，并补充“观察驱动”与“策略驱动”的意义追求之区分；通过历史案例研究与基于当前 Transformer 系统的架构层面分析来支撑该分类。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数据。核心论断是当今模型的能力集中在由重组与搜索既有构建块塑造的模式上；若该描述成立，其余模式在原则上（而非仅仅在速度上）超出当前系统可达范围，但其是否成立本身是开放的经验问题。
Conclusion: 作者主张证明生成正因 AI 进步而变便宜，数学价值正在向当前系统尚不能完成的模式迁移，评估 AI 数学能力应围绕该分类法组织，而非依赖混淆各类能力的聚合基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RetroMPA: A Molecular Property-Aware Auxiliary Framework for Enhancing Retrosynthesis Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Retrosynthesis is a cornerstone of drug discovery and organic synthesis. While data-driven deep learning models have shown remarkable progress, they autonomously learn reaction patterns from extensive datasets with limited integration of established chemical knowledge as priors. To address this limitation, we introduce RetroMPA, a molecular property-aware, post-hoc enhancement module that injects chemical knowledge into the retrosynthesis pipeline. Rather than functioning as an independent SMILES sequence generator, RetroMPA is a broadly applicable, model-agnostic chemical filter designed to recalibrate and optimize the predictive pathways of existing algorithms. This plug-and-play framework integrates seamlessly with a range of data-driven retrosynthesis methods, enhancing outputs without modifying model architecture or requiring resource-intensive retraining. By leveraging a property-aware latent embedding space, RetroMPA consistently improves top-1 accuracy across eight representative retrosynthesis models by an average of 5.50% on USPTO-50K. Furthermore, we validate its scalability on the large-scale USPTO-Full dataset, achieving an average improvement of about 2.03% across both template-based and template-free architectures. Wet-lab experiments provide preliminary support for the practical utility of the framework. These syntheses confirmed viable, previously unreported substrate combinations for classic reaction paradigms---specifically, Suzuki-Miyaura coupling, Bucherer reaction, and Friedel-Crafts acylation---suggesting that RetroMPA can operate beyond mere data fitting. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/MengzhouLu/RetroMPA.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RetroMPA，一种分子性质感知（molecular property-aware）的即插即用后处理增强模块，用于提升现有逆合成预测模型的性能。它不是独立的 SMILES 生成器，而是作为模型无关的化学过滤器，在潜在嵌入空间中重新校准已有算法的预测路径，无需修改架构或重新训练。摘要报告在 USPTO-50K 上对八个代表性逆合成模型平均提升 top-1 准确率 5.50%，在 USPTO-Full 上平均提升约 2.03%，并给出初步湿实验支持。
Motivation: 数据驱动的逆合成深度学习模型主要从大规模数据集中自动学习反应模式，对既有化学知识作为先验的集成有限，本文针对这一局限引入化学知识。
Method: RetroMPA 是一个 post-hoc 增强模块，通过性质感知的潜在嵌入空间重新校准和优化现有逆合成算法的预测路径，以即插即用方式与多种数据驱动方法集成，不改变底层模型架构，也不要求高成本重训练。
Result: 在 USPTO-50K 上，RetroMPA 对八种代表性逆合成模型平均提升 top-1 准确率 5.50%；在大型 USPTO-Full 数据集上，对模板化与非模板化架构平均提升约 2.03%。湿实验验证了 Suzuki-Miyaura 偶联、Bucherer 反应和 Friedel-Crafts 酰化等经典反应范式下可行且此前未报道的底物组合。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RetroMPA 可作为广泛的、模型无关的化学过滤器，在不重训练的情况下增强现有逆合成方法，并能扩展到大规模数据集和不同架构，代码已开源。

papers.title: SUGFW+: An Uncertainty-guided Feature Weighting Framework for Cold Start Active Adaptation of SAM in Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Cold Start Active Learning (CSAL) is important in improving the performance of a medical image segmentation model with low annotation budget by querying a small subset for annotation from an unlabeled training set. Existing CSAL methods typically rely on inefficient dataset-specific Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) to map the unlabeled images into a feature space for sample selection. Recently, the advent of foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) offer a promising alternative as the pre-trained model can provide strong generalizable feature embeddings, and allow high performance in downstream tasks after fine-tuning (adaptation). However, how to systematically exploit SAM's inherent embeddings for cold-start sample selection during adaptation with low annotation budget remains underexplored. To address this, we propose an extended SAM-based Uncertainty-guided Feature Weighting (SUGFW+) framework for CSAL and adaptation of SAM. Specifically, it leverages the SAM for Patch-level Feature and Uncertainty Calculation (PFUC), and introduces a Patch-based Global Distinct Representation (PGDR) module that aggregates patch-level embeddings into highly discriminative, uncertainty-aware image-level features. These features are then utilized by a Greedy Selection with Cluster and Uncertainty (GSCU) strategy to combine diversity and uncertainty during sample selection. Unlike prior CSAL methods that decouple sample selection from model training, SUGFW+ tightly integrates these two stages via an Uncertainty-Prompted Fine-Tuning (UPFT) process of SAM in model training. Extensive experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that SUGFW+ achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing CSAL methods. Code is available at https://github.com/HiLab-git/SUGFW-plus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SUGFW+，一个基于 SAM 的不确定性引导特征加权框架，用于医学图像分割中的冷启动主动学习（CSAL）。方法利用 SAM 进行 patch 级特征与不确定性计算，通过 PGDR 模块聚合为图像级特征，并用 GSCU 策略结合多样性与不确定性进行样本选择，同时通过 UPFT 将样本选择与 SAM 微调紧密耦合。在四个公共数据集上达到现有 CSAL 方法中的 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 现有 CSAL 方法通常依赖数据集特定的自监督学习（SSL）来映射特征空间，效率较低；SAM 等基础模型可提供强泛化特征嵌入，但如何在低标注预算下系统利用 SAM 的固有嵌入进行冷启动样本选择仍未得到充分探索。
Method: 提出 SUGFW+ 框架：利用 SAM 进行 Patch 级特征与不确定性计算（PFUC），引入 Patch-based Global Distinct Representation (PGDR) 模块，将 patch 级嵌入聚合为高度判别性、不确定性感知的图像级特征；再通过 Greedy Selection with Cluster and Uncertainty (GSCU) 策略在样本选择中结合多样性与不确定性，并用 Uncertainty-Prompted Fine-Tuning (UPFT) 将样本选择与模型训练紧密集成。
Result: 在四个公共数据集上的大量实验表明，SUGFW+ 相比现有 CSAL 方法取得了 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，系统利用 SAM 的固有嵌入进行冷启动样本选择，并将样本选择与微调阶段耦合，能够在低标注预算下提升医学图像分割性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Nexus: Structured Synergy for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation using Rectified Flow Model
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow matching models have made significant progress in text-to-image generation, yet high computation, quadratic complexity, and large memory footprint hinder high-resolution synthesis and edge deployment. We propose Nexus, which integrates sparse architecture, linear complexity, and low-bit quantization. It combines MoE feed-forward layers, gated DeltaNet attention, and per-expert low-bit training to reduce computation and memory. Their joint optimization allows Nexus to achieve generation quality comparable to mainstream models such as SDXL and SD3 while delivering markedly higher inference efficiency. Experiments on COCO and LAION validate its effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Nexus，一种面向文本到图像生成的高效流匹配框架，通过稀疏架构、线性复杂度与低比特量化三者的联合设计来降低计算与内存开销。方法结合 MoE 前馈层、gated DeltaNet 注意力和 per-expert 低比特训练，在 COCO 与 LAION 上的实验表明其生成质量可与 SDXL、SD3 等主流模型相当，同时推理效率显著更高。
Motivation: 扩散模型与流匹配模型在文本到图像生成上进展显著，但高计算量、二次复杂度和较大的内存占用限制了高分辨率合成与边缘端部署。
Method: 提出 Nexus，整合稀疏架构（MoE 前馈层）、线性复杂度机制（gated DeltaNet 注意力）与低比特量化（per-expert 低比特训练），并通过联合优化（joint optimization）在减少计算和内存的同时维持生成质量。
Result: 摘要报告 Nexus 在 COCO 和 LAION 上取得与 SDXL、SD3 等主流模型相当的生成质量，同时带来明显更高的推理效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调稀疏结构、线性注意力与低比特训练的协同设计可以在不牺牲生成质量的前提下大幅提升推理效率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Similarity Matching: Structured Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Referring Segmentation in 3DGS
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary referring segmentation in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) requires a neural model to select Gaussian primitives according to free-form language expressions. Existing 3DGS-based methods usually rely on global text-region similarity, which is weak for queries involving attributes, reference objects, spatial relations, and fine-grained parts. This often causes target-reference confusion, granularity mismatch, part-whole leakage, and relation violations. We propose QAGaussian, a query-adaptive neural reasoning framework for language-guided Gaussian primitive selection. QAGaussian first learns query-conditioned multi-scale Gaussian slots as differentiable candidates whose receptive fields are shaped by the input expression. It then builds a relation-aware slot graph with language-conditioned edge weighting to propagate target-reference, attribute, part-whole, and contextual evidence. A granularity-adaptive router softly combines region-level, object-level, part-level, attribute-aware, and relation-aware mask branches, followed by relation-constrained refinement for spatial, part-whole, attribute, and geometric consistency. QAGaussian is pretrained only on Mosaic3D-5.6M for Gaussian-text alignment and evaluated on independent benchmarks without target-dataset fine-tuning. It achieves 47.2 Avg. mIoU and 63.2 Avg. F1, outperforming the strongest 3DGS referring baseline by 2.7 mIoU points and 2.9 F1 points. It also improves Part-mIoU from 38.6 to 43.4, Rel-mIoU from 44.4 to 50.8, and reduces target-reference confusion from 10.8 to 7.4. These results demonstrate that query-conditioned slot learning, relation-aware graph reasoning, and adaptive routing provide an effective neural modeling strategy for open-vocabulary referring segmentation in 3DGS. The code is available at https://github.com/zqeslwyz/QAGaussian.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 中的开放词汇 referring segmentation 任务，提出 QAGaussian 查询自适应神经推理框架。该方法用查询条件下的多尺度高斯槽 (Gaussian slots) 构建关系感知槽图，并通过粒度自适应路由组合多种掩码分支，然后进行关系约束细化。摘要报告其在独立基准上达到 47.2 Avg. mIoU 和 63.2 Avg. F1，超越现有最强 3DGS referring 基线。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 方法通常依赖全局文本-区域相似度，难以处理涉及属性、参照对象、空间关系和细粒度部件的自由形式查询，导致目标-参照混淆、粒度不匹配、部分-整体泄漏和关系违规等问题。
Method: 提出 QAGaussian：先学习查询条件化的多尺度高斯槽作为可微候选，其感受野由输入表达塑造；再构建带语言条件边权的关系感知槽图来传播目标-参照、属性、部分-整体和上下文证据；最后用粒度自适应路由器软组合区域级、对象级、部件级、属性感知和关系感知掩码分支，并辅以关系约束细化。
Result: 仅在 Mosaic3D-5.6M 上预训练并在独立基准上零样本评测，取得 47.2 Avg. mIoU 和 63.2 Avg. F1，较最强 3DGS referring 基线提升 2.7 mIoU 和 2.9 F1；Part-mIoU 从 38.6 提升到 43.4，Rel-mIoU 从 44.4 提升到 50.8，目标-参照混淆从 10.8 降到 7.4。
Conclusion: 摘要认为查询条件化槽学习、关系感知图推理和自适应路由为 3DGS 开放词汇 referring segmentation 提供了有效的神经建模策略，并公开了代码。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出 QAGaussian：先学习查询条件化的多尺度高斯槽作为可微候选，其感受野由输入表达塑造；再构建带语言条件边权的关系感知槽图来传播目标-参照、属性、部分-整体和上下文证据；最后用粒度自适应路由器软组合区域级、对象级、部件级、属性感知和关系感知掩码分支，并辅以关系约束细化。
summary_sections.result: 仅在 Mosaic3D-5.6M 上预训练并在独立基准上零样本评测，取得 47.2 Avg. mIoU 和 63.2 Avg. F1，较最强 3DGS referring 基线提升 2.7 mIoU 和 2.9 F1；Part-mIoU 从 38.6 提升到 43.4，Rel-mIoU 从 44.4 提升到 50.8，目标-参照混淆从 10.8 降到 7.4。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为查询条件化槽学习、关系感知图推理和自适应路由为 3DGS 开放词汇 referring segmentation 提供了有效的神经建模策略，并公开了代码。

papers.title: EMS Coreset: An Efficient Expectation-Maximization Algorithm for Sinkhorn Coreset
papers.abstract_en: Coresets distill large datasets into small, representative subsets for efficient downstream learning. Yet Optimal Transport (OT)-based selection typically requires intensive computation of transport plans, limiting scalability. We introduce a scalable Sinkhorn coreset method that permits closed-form updates of the entropically regularized OT coupling by allowing non-uniform coreset weights. This produces centroids that generalize k-means via soft assignments. We establish asymptotic consistency of the selected measure and Lipschitz stability to data perturbations, providing accuracy and robustness guarantees. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, the proposed method achieves competitive or improved approximation quality while substantially reducing runtime compared to Wasserstein- and standard Sinkhorn-based coreset selection, especially at large scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Sinkhorn 距离的 coreset 构造方法，通过允许非均匀 coreset 权重，使熵正则化最优传输 (OT) 耦合可以闭式更新，从而避免昂贵传输计划的密集计算。得到的聚类中心可视为 k-means 的软分配推广，并在理论上给出所选测度的渐近一致性与对数据扰动的 Lipschitz 稳定性。实验表明，在合成与真实基准上，该方法相比 Wasserstein 和标准 Sinkhorn coreset 选择，能在保持有竞争力或更好的近似质量的同时显著降低运行时间，尤其在大规模场景。
Motivation: 现有基于最优传输 (OT) 的 coreset 选择通常需要大量计算传输计划，可扩展性受限，难以用于大规模数据集的高效下游学习。
Method: 引入可扩展的 Sinkhorn coreset 方法，允许非均匀 coreset 权重，从而对熵正则化 OT 耦合进行闭式更新；该方法产生的聚类中心通过软分配推广了 k-means。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在合成和真实基准上达到有竞争力或更好的近似质量，并相比 Wasserstein 及标准 Sinkhorn coreset 选择大幅降低运行时间，尤其在大规模数据上；同时建立了所选测度的渐近一致性和 Lipschitz 稳定性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法为 OT 驱动的 coreset 选择提供了可扩展且具有鲁棒性保证的替代方案，但其表述未涉及降水、临近预报或气象数据的具体应用。

papers.title: TISC: A Text-Driven Image Semantic Communication System for Faithful Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Generative image semantic communication converts an image into a text description and then performs text-to-image reconstruction at the receiver via diffusion-based generative models. This paradigm has attracted broad attention due to its extremely low bandwidth cost. However, existing methods still face two critical bottlenecks across image-to-text (I2T) semantic extraction at the transmitter and text-to-image (T2I) semantic reconstruction at the receiver: (i) semantic loss and distortion in I2T, where holistic image descriptions may omit fine-grained object attributes and spatial-position information, causing the generated text to deviate from the original image semantics; and (ii) insufficient semantic faithfulness in T2I, where even with the same semantically faithful text description, different initial noise settings may lead diffusion-based reconstruction to produce images with different levels of semantic consistency with the original image. These issues jointly limit the semantic faithfulness of image reconstruction. To address them, we propose TISC, a text-driven image semantic communication framework tailored for faithful reconstruction. TISC incorporates two key designs: (1) Tree-Structured Attribute Semantic Extraction (TSASE), which decomposes semantic extraction into global scene, background, and object-level attribute descriptions, covering spatial position, shape/pose, color, material, and other physical attributes for each detected object; and (2) an Initial Noise Optimization (INO) mechanism, which selects an initial noise seed at the transmitter according to a comprehensive similarity score that jointly considers visual and semantic consistency. Experiments on multiple datasets show that TSASE improves object-position recovery and semantic description faithfulness, while the INO parameter study supports the adopted configuration for noise selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TISC，一个面向忠实图像重建的文本驱动图像语义通信框架，针对生成式图像语义通信中 I2T 语义提取与 T2I 语义重建的两个瓶颈。框架包含树状结构属性语义提取（TSASE）和初始噪声优化（INO）两个关键设计，并在多个数据集上验证了其在物体位置恢复和语义描述忠实度上的改进。
Motivation: 现有生成式图像语义通信虽然带宽成本极低，但存在两处关键瓶颈：I2T 端整体图像描述容易丢失细粒度物体属性和空间位置信息，导致生成文本偏离原图语义；T2I 端即使使用同一语义文本，不同初始噪声设置也会使扩散重建结果与原始图像的语义一致性不稳定。这些问题共同限制了图像重建的语义忠实度。
Method: 提出 TISC 框架，包含两项设计：一是树状结构属性语义提取（TSASE），将语义提取分解为全局场景、背景和物体级属性描述，覆盖每个检测物体的空间位置、形状/姿态、颜色、材质等物理属性；二是初始噪声优化（INO）机制，在发射端根据综合相似度得分（同时考虑视觉与语义一致性）选择初始噪声种子。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，TSASE 改善了物体位置恢复和语义描述忠实度；INO 的参数研究支持了所采用的噪声选择配置。
Conclusion: 摘要认为通过树状属性提取与发射端噪声种子优化可以共同提升图像语义通信的重建忠实度，但未提及其他限制或更广的适用性范围。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: AsyTO: Asymmetric Temporal Operator for Parameter-Efficient Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time-series forecasting faces a structural dilemma: sharing one temporal predictor across variables is parameter-efficient but forces heterogeneous variables through an identical history-to-future map, whereas learning an independent predictor per variable restores flexibility at a cost that grows with the product of variable count, context length, and horizon. We argue that this dilemma dissolves once the object being compressed is the forecasting operator rather than the observed series. Auditing per-variable linear history-to-future maps across standard benchmarks, we find that a phase-locked seasonal component paired with a compact residual operator outperforms a dense phase-blind reference in most audited settings. The residual transport is also directional: lag-invariant alternatives consistently underperform asymmetric history-to-future maps. Guided by this structure, we propose AsyTO, an Asymmetric Temporal Operator that factorizes the tensor of per-variable operators into shared but distinct history-reading and future-writing temporal modes with per-variable mode-wise gains, complemented by a low-rank periodic prototype and a cycle-separable factorization of the temporal modes. Each forecast reads only its own variable's history, so parameters and compute grow linearly in the number of variables. Across eleven benchmarks and multiple forecast horizons, AsyTO attains the best lightweight error in 30 of 44 dataset-horizon settings, locating at the accuracy-compute Pareto frontier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多元时间序列预测中共享与独立预测器的结构困境，提出非对称时间算子 AsyTO。通过审计逐变量线性历史到未来映射，发现相位锁定的季节分量配合紧凑残差算子优于密集相位无关基线，且非对称历史到未来映射优于滞后不变替代。AsyTO 将逐变量算子张量分解为共享但分离的历史读取与未来写入时间模式，并引入低秩周期原型和循环可分离分解，参数与计算随变量数线性增长。在 11 个基准和多个预测尺度上，AsyTO 在 44 个数据集-尺度设置中取得 30 个最佳轻量误差，位于精度-计算帕累托前沿。
Motivation: 现有方法在参数效率与灵活性之间面临两难：共享时间预测器强制异构变量经历相同映射，而逐变量独立预测器的成本随变量数、上下文长度和预测尺度的乘积增长。作者认为压缩对象应当是预测算子而非观测序列，以此化解该困境。
Method: 先审计逐变量线性历史到未来映射，发现相位锁定季节分量加紧凑残差算子优于密集相位无关基线，且非对称映射优于滞后不变映射。据此提出 AsyTO，将逐变量算子张量分解为共享但分离的历史读取与未来写入时间模式，辅以逐变量模式增益、低秩周期原型和循环可分离分解；每个预测只读取自身变量的历史。
Result: 在 11 个基准和多个预测尺度上，AsyTO 在 44 个数据集-尺度设置中取得 30 个最佳轻量误差，并处于精度-计算帕累托前沿。
Conclusion: 摘要主张将压缩对象从观测序列转向预测算子，借助非对称时间模式可实现参数高效且灵活的多元时间序列预测。摘要未提及明确限制。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Unifying Graph Neural Networks Through a Common Layer Equation
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks are commonly described through family-specific equations whose notation obscures shared computations and structural differences. We introduce a common layer equation that represents covered architectures through seven components: an update domain, channel set, propagation bank, per-channel message maps, channel-fusion operator, ego/residual map, and update map. The central factorization separates where information moves, encoded by the propagation bank, from what moves, encoded by the message maps. Function-valued fillings extend the same equation across local message passing, attention, spectral filtering, global communication, relation-specific channels, higher-order domains, and geometric messages. We make this unification explicit and checkable through worked reductions of canonical layers and component assignments spanning seven nonexclusive architectural families. A fixed slot discipline assigns operations by computational role and defines the framework's coverage boundary. The decomposition also yields component-level theoretical insights: under endpoint-local messages and node-local updates, operator support bounds one-layer dependencies, and one-layer global mixing requires a full effective operator row under the stated hypotheses. The resulting framework organizes more than 200 architectures in a common design space, enables component-wise comparison and generation of structurally consistent architectures, and connects propagation choices to oversmoothing, oversquashing, heterophily, and expressivity. It further exposes the empirical inverse problem of mapping measurable graph and task properties to validated component choices.
papers.comment: 133 pages, including appendix; includes figures and tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的图神经网络层方程，将覆盖的架构表示为七个组件：更新域、通道集、传播库、逐通道消息映射、通道融合算子、自我/残差映射和更新映射。核心分解将信息移动的位置（传播库）与移动的内容（消息映射）分离，并通过函数值填充统一局部消息传递、注意力、谱滤波、全局通信等范式。作者给出规范层的化简和跨七个非互斥架构族的组件分配，并用固定槽位纪律定义覆盖边界。该框架组织了超过200种架构，支持组件级比较与生成，并将传播选择与过平滑、过挤压、异质性及表达能力联系起来。
Motivation: 现有图神经网络通常用族特定的方程描述，符号差异掩盖了共享计算和结构差异，阻碍跨架构比较与系统化设计。
Method: 引入公共层方程，以七个组件刻画架构；分解分离传播库（信息去向）与消息映射（信息内容）。通过函数值填充将同一方程扩展到局部消息、注意力、谱滤波、全局通信、关系特定通道、高阶域和几何消息。采用固定槽位纪律按计算角色分配操作，并据此界定框架覆盖范围。
Result: 摘要报告了组件级理论见解：在端点局部消息和节点局部更新下，算子支持限制单层依赖；在这些假设下单层全局混合需要满有效算子行。框架统一组织超过200种架构，并将传播选择与过平滑、过挤压、异质性和表达能力联系起来。
Conclusion: 该框架实现了架构的组件级比较和结构一致生成，并揭示了一个经验逆问题：如何将可测量的图和任务属性映射到实证有效的组件选择。

papers.title: Protein Structure Prediction: From Evolutionary Constraints to Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Accurate protein structure prediction is fundamental to structural biology because protein structure underlies molecular function and provides a basis for mechanistic interpretation. Recent advances in deep learning have transformed the field from multiple sequence alignment (MSA)-driven monomer folding into broader frameworks capable of modeling protein complexes and increasingly heterogeneous molecular systems. Existing reviews have summarized this progress from the perspectives of representative models, application domains, and protein design. Building on these efforts, this review focuses on the methodological evolution of the field itself. It examines recent developments through three closely related dimensions: representations and data, architectures and learning strategies, and confidence and evaluation. Within this perspective, the field is organized into four methodological phases and three cross-cutting transitions: from explicit evolutionary coupling features and early contact prediction to learned sequence representations in AlphaFold2, RoseTTAFold, and ESMFold; from protein-only monomer folding to increasingly integrated modeling of heterogeneous molecular systems in AlphaFold-Multimer, RoseTTAFoldNA, and AlphaFold3; and, more recently, from prediction-oriented structure inference to design-oriented generative modeling in RFdiffusion and related frameworks. This framework provides a clearer understanding of how methodological shifts have shaped the capabilities, limitations, and practical roles of recent models.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Preprint submitted to Elsevier
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于蛋白质结构预测方法演进的综述，聚焦于领域本身的范式变迁，而非具体模型或应用。作者从表示与数据、架构与学习策略、置信度与评估三个维度，将领域归纳为四个方法学阶段和三条交叉转型：从显式进化耦合特征与早期接触预测，到 AlphaFold2、RoseTTAFold、ESMFold 的学习式序列表示；从纯蛋白质单体折叠到 AlphaFold-Multimer、RoseTTAFoldNA、AlphaFold3 等异质分子系统的整合建模；以及从预测导向的结构推断转向 RFdiffusion 等设计导向的生成式建模。
Motivation: 蛋白质结构预测已从 MSA 驱动的单体折叠发展为可建模复合物和异质分子系统的更广泛框架，而既有综述多从代表性模型、应用领域和蛋白质设计的角度总结，缺少对领域自身方法学演进的系统梳理。
Method: 提出一个综述性分析框架，沿表示与数据、架构与学习策略、置信度与评估三个相互关联的维度审视近期进展，并将领域组织为四个方法学阶段与三条跨阶段转型，用于解释不同模型在能力、局限和实际角色上的变化。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数据或基准结果，主要贡献是给出了一个理解方法学转变如何塑造 AlphaFold 系列和 RFdiffusion 等模型能力与角色的结构化视角。
Conclusion: 该框架有助于更清晰地理解蛋白质结构预测领域的方法学转型，以及这些转变对近期模型能力、局限和实际用途的影响。

papers.title: Representation Is Not Enough: Body-Localized Thermal Evidence for Contactless Stress and Craving Sensing in Opioid Use Disorder
papers.abstract_en: Removing wearables from physiological monitoring also removes their supervision: the signal indicating where and when a stress response occurred. Contactless stress sensing therefore becomes a weakly supervised evidence-localization problem, where a clip-level label must be traced to the body regions and moments that produced it. We address this with FABLE-Therm, a weakly supervised architecture that preserves localized evidence across body regions, time, and encoder-specific representations until the final decision. FABLE-Therm fuses frozen foundation-model encoders at the embedding level, with theory explaining why localized fusion can outperform feature concatenation and prediction averaging. We study this problem in opioid use disorder (OUD), where stress is a major relapse trigger and sustained wearable use can be difficult during early recovery. Using fixed thermal video, FABLE-Therm achieves 0.938 AUROC on held-out participants, and its learned representation transfers to self-reported craving, providing, to our knowledge, the first evidence that craving can be recovered from contactless thermal video. Localized evidence also enables participant-level analysis of deployment failure. We find that improving representation alone is insufficient for equitable deployment: additional data from the underserved group would recover only about half of the cohort gap, while the remainder reflects person-to-person heterogeneity. This modality-agnostic decomposition applies to models with identifiable subpopulations. Together with the first cohort-structured contactless thermal OUD benchmark, our results show that preserving localized evidence supports both accurate sensing and principled analysis of who a model fails and why.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无接触生理监测中缺乏监督信号的问题，提出弱监督架构 FABLE-Therm，在阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）场景下利用固定热视频进行压力和渴望感知。该方法保留身体区域、时间和编码器特定表示的局部证据直到最终决策，在留出参与者上达到 0.938 AUROC，并首次证明渴望可从无接触热视频中恢复。参与者级失败分析表明，仅改进表示不足以实现公平部署，额外数据只能恢复约一半的队列差距，其余来自个体间异质性。
Motivation: 移除可穿戴设备后，生理监测失去了指示压力反应位置和时间的监督信号，无接触压力感知因此成为弱监督证据定位问题。在 OUD 中压力是复发的主要诱因，而早期恢复期间持续佩戴可穿戴设备可能困难，故需要无接触且能定位证据的感知方法。
Method: 提出 FABLE-Therm，一种弱监督架构，在整个决策过程中跨身体区域、时间和编码器特定表示保留局部证据，并在嵌入层融合冻结的 foundation-model 编码器。论文还给出理论说明，解释为何局部融合优于特征拼接和预测平均。
Result: 在留出参与者上达到 0.938 AUROC，学到的表示可迁移到自我报告的渴望，据作者所知这是首次从无接触热视频中恢复渴望的证据。参与者级分析显示，仅改进表示不够：为弱势群体增加数据仅能恢复约一半的队列差距，其余差距反映个体间异质性。
Conclusion: 保留局部证据既能支持准确的感知，也能支持对模型失败对象和原因的规范性分析；这一与模态无关的分解适用于具有可识别子群体的模型。论文同时提供了第一个面向队列结构的无接触热 OUD 基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Behaviour Is an Incomplete Measure of Reasoning Development: Cross-surface pre-arrival accessibility and the limits of developmental inference in a recurrent-depth reasoner
papers.abstract_en: Capability development is routinely inferred from behavioural thresholds, from final checkpoints, or from what a decoder can read out of a hidden state. These quantities need not identify the same event. We study a 30M-parameter recurrent-depth relational reasoner in a closed, oracle-defined world, using dense behavioural trajectories, two training surfaces, preregistered pre-arrival hidden-state probes, prospectively checked evaluability, and explicit untrained and negative controls, holding the training-time and inference-time axes separate throughout. Behaviour first: under one frozen acquisition criterion, three-hop competence cost 70 logical epochs on the symbolic surface and 13,055 on the verbal surface, a 186.5-fold contrast, after which verbal four-hop competence cleared in 8 logical epochs. Across the 13,055-epoch grind, four-hop held-out behaviour never exceeded 3/40 and ended at 0/40. Internal measurement next: on the verbal surface a linear probe recovered future-answer identity before behavioural arrival at 0.056159 against uniform chance 0.025, an untrained control of 0.024758 and a population frequency baseline of 0.048309 (p = 0.012987; 16/40 answer classes contributing). Analogous pre-arrival accessibility survived the surface change, reaching 0.1020 against a zero-step control of 0.0460 (p = 0.000999) at the upstream structural position and 0.0618 at the readout comparator (p = 0.004), with 21/40 classes contributing. Finally, the natural attempt to track that accessibility across training was not cleanly evaluable: probe eligibility is defined by behavioural arrival, so the measured population changes with the measurand. Behavioural competence, internal accessibility, and training-time development are distinct observables, and neither behaviour nor decoder accessibility identifies the computation training acquired; causal intervention is the necessary next step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从行为阈值、最终检查点或隐藏状态读出推断能力发展的可靠性。作者在30M参数的递归深度关系推理器上，使用密集行为轨迹、两个训练表面、预注册的到达前隐藏状态探针及多种对照，发现三跳能力在符号表面需70逻辑epoch、在语言表面需13,055逻辑epoch，相差186.5倍；而语言表面的线性探针能在行为到达前恢复未来答案身份。结论是行为能力、内部可访问性与训练时间发展是不同可观察量，行为测量不足以识别训练获得的计算。
Motivation: 能力发展通常从行为阈值、最终检查点或解码器对隐藏状态的读出中推断，但这些量不必识别同一事件；论文针对这一缺口，论证行为测量本身不足以推断推理发展。
Method: 在封闭的oracle定义世界中训练30M参数递归深度关系推理器，采用两个训练表面（符号表面与语言表面）、预注册的到达前隐藏状态探针、前瞻性检查的可评估性，以及显式未训练和负对照，并全程分离训练时与推理时轴。
Result: 在固定获取准则下，三跳能力在符号表面耗时70逻辑epoch、在语言表面耗时13,055逻辑epoch，呈186.5倍对比；之后语言表面四跳能力在8逻辑epoch内通过。在13,055 epoch的漫长训练中，四跳保持行为从未超过3/40并最终为0/40。语言表面上线性探针在行为到达前恢复未来答案身份，得分0.056159，对比均匀概率0.025、未训练对照0.024758和群体频率基线0.048309（p=0.012987；16/40个答案类贡献）。类似的到达前可访问性在表面切换后仍存在，上游结构位置达0.1020（对照0.0460，p=0.000999），读出比较器处为0.0618（p=0.004），21/40个类贡献。
Conclusion: 行为胜任力、内部可访问性与训练时间发展是各不相同的可观测量，行为表现和decoder可访问性都无法识别训练实际获得的计算；跨训练追踪该可访问性的自然尝试因探针资格由行为到达定义而无法干净评估。摘要强调因果干预是必要的下一步。

papers.title: Eigenanalysis framework for autoregressive neural emulators of multi-scale chaotic dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Neural autoregressive models have rapidly emerged as powerful emulators of high-dimensional chaotic systems, yet their long-term instability and error growth remain poorly understood, leading to ad-hoc solutions. Here, we develop an eigenanalysis framework that reveals the dynamical origin of this error growth. By analyzing the Jacobian of the learned one-step update map with respect to the state, we show how inference-time error growth, and thus model stability, is governed by its spectral radius. Direct-step architectures (models that predict the next state from the previous one) generically admit unstable eigenvalues with magnitudes exceeding one, explaining the rapid divergence of these widely used models. In contrast, integration-constrained models (where the time derivative is estimated and integrated with a higher-order integrator) collapse their eigenspectrum onto the unit circle, yielding neutral stability and a universal linear error-scaling law. The largest eigenvalue of this Jacobian provides an architecture-agnostic, a priori diagnostic of short-term skill, long-term stability, and spectral bias, without requiring an expensive rollout. Leveraging this theory, we introduce a stability-promoting loss that explicitly regularizes Jacobian-driven error amplification, improving both forecast accuracy and dynamical robustness. Demonstrated across $29$ models spanning two architectures, several explicit and implicit integrators, and multiple loss functions on the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky system, our results establish a theoretical foundation for the design and evaluation of neural emulators of chaotic multi-scale dynamics. More broadly, our framework is a step toward the kind of a priori stability analysis that numerical analysis provides for discretizations of differential equations and that scientific machine learning currently lacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种特征分析 (eigenanalysis) 框架，通过分析神经自回归仿真器单步更新映射关于状态的 Jacobian，揭示其长期不稳定与误差增长的动力来源。作者发现直接步进 (direct-step) 架构普遍存在模大于 1 的不稳定特征值，而受积分约束 (integration-constrained) 的模型将特征谱折叠到单位圆上，呈现中性稳定与通用线性误差缩放律。基于最大特征值可得到与架构无关的先验诊断，并据此引入促进稳定性的损失函数。研究在 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 系统上的 29 个模型上验证了该理论。
Motivation: 神经自回归模型作为高维混沌系统的仿真器已被广泛使用，但其长期不稳定性和误差增长机制仍缺乏理解，现有解决方案多为临时性的 (ad-hoc)，需要理论基础来解释和预测模型失效。
Method: 提出特征分析框架，考察学习到的一步更新映射关于状态的 Jacobian，用其谱半径解释推理时误差增长；并引入一个显式正则化 Jacobian 驱动误差放大的稳定性促进损失 (stability-promoting loss)。
Result: 直接步进架构的特征值模普遍超过 1，导致快速发散；积分约束模型的谱收缩到单位圆，获得中性稳定和通用线性误差缩放律。最大特征值可无需昂贵 rollout 地作为短期技巧、长期稳定性和谱偏差的先验诊断；该方法在 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 系统上覆盖 2 种架构、多种显式和隐式积分器及损失函数的 29 个模型中得以验证。
Conclusion: 该框架为混沌多尺度动力系统的神经仿真器设计与评估提供了理论依据，是迈向科学机器学习中类似数值分析对微分方程离散化所做的那种先验稳定性分析的一步。

summary_sections.motivation: 神经自回归模型作为高维混沌系统的仿真器已被广泛使用，但其长期不稳定性和误差增长机制仍缺乏理解，现有解决方案多为临时性的 (ad-hoc)，需要理论基础来解释和预测模型失效。
summary_sections.method: 提出特征分析框架，考察学习到的一步更新映射关于状态的 Jacobian，用其谱半径解释推理时误差增长；并引入一个显式正则化 Jacobian 驱动误差放大的稳定性促进损失 (stability-promoting loss)。
summary_sections.result: 直接步进架构的特征值模普遍超过 1，导致快速发散；积分约束模型的谱收缩到单位圆，获得中性稳定和通用线性误差缩放律。最大特征值可无需昂贵 rollout 地作为短期技巧、长期稳定性和谱偏差的先验诊断；该方法在 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 系统上覆盖 2 种架构、多种显式和隐式积分器及损失函数的 29 个模型中得以验证。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为混沌多尺度动力系统的神经仿真器设计与评估提供了理论依据，是迈向科学机器学习中类似数值分析对微分方程离散化所做的那种先验稳定性分析的一步。

papers.title: Towards Reasonable Molecular Structure Elucidation from Infrared Spectroscopy with Chemical Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Infrared (IR) spectra provide characteristic signals of molecular structure, which are often interpreted by experts via functional-group identification or library matching, making the process time-consuming and ambiguous. Recent machine learning methods have made progress in molecular structure elucidation using molecular formulas and IR spectra. However, these models often infer unreasonable candidate molecular structures, including top-ranked predictions. More specifically, the molecular formula implied by a candidate structure often fails to match the input molecular formula, and the candidate's theoretical IR spectrum is often inconsistent with the observed IR spectrum. To address these issues, we propose Formula- and IR-Matched Preference Optimization (FIRMPO), a general and plug-and-play chemical feedback-driven preference optimization framework for molecular structure elucidation. FIRMPO incorporates chemical feedback as preference signals based on exact molecular formula matching and IR spectral consistency to guide reasonable structure predictions. Unlike generic preference optimization methods, FIRMPO is tailored to molecular structure elucidation while remaining model-agnostic, enabling it to be readily integrated with different structure prediction models in this class. This encourages models to prioritize structures that satisfy the chemical feedback, leading to a substantial improvement in the accuracy of top-ranked predictions. Extensive experiments on three widely used IR datasets show that FIRMPO significantly improves molecular structure elucidation accuracy over existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Formula- and IR-Matched Preference Optimization (FIRMPO)，一种用于红外光谱分子结构解析的化学反馈偏好优化框架。FIRMPO 将精确分子式匹配与红外光谱一致性作为化学反馈偏好信号，引导模型优先输出合理候选结构。在三个常用红外数据集上的实验表明，该框架显著提升了现有基线的分子结构解析准确率。
Motivation: 现有基于机器学习的分子结构解析方法即使对 top-ranked 预测也会产生不合理的候选结构，具体表现为候选结构隐含的分子式与输入分子式不匹配，或候选结构的理论红外光谱与观测光谱不一致。
Method: 提出 FIRMPO，一个通用且即插即用的化学反馈驱动的偏好优化框架。与通用的偏好优化方法不同，FIRMPO 针对分子结构解析定制，且保持模型无关（model-agnostic），可方便地集成到同类不同结构预测模型中，通过化学反馈作为偏好信号来优化 top-ranked 预测的合理性。
Result: 在三个广泛使用的红外数据集上的大规模实验表明，FIRMPO 相对现有基线显著提高了分子结构解析准确率。
Conclusion: FIRMPO 能够引导模型优先选择满足化学反馈（分子式匹配与红外光谱一致性）的结构，从而提升 top-ranked 预测的准确性，且由于模型无关性可灵活适配不同结构预测模型。摘要未提及明显局限。

papers.title: SafeGesture: Evaluating Fine-Grained Hand Gesture Understanding in Vision-Language Models through Scenario-Conditioned Safety Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight and frontier vision-language models (VLMs) perform well on general image understanding, but their ability to interpret fine-grained hand gestures in safety-critical operational contexts remains largely unexamined. We introduce SafeGesture, a benchmark that evaluates whether a model can infer scenario-appropriate safety actions from hand gestures. It pairs six HaGRID gestures with eight operational scenarios for 4,800 items and evaluates Qwen2.5-VL-7B, LLaVA-NeXT-7B, InternVL2-8B, Phi-3.5-Vision, and GPT-4o. Results reveal a perception-reasoning decoupling: GPT-4o achieves 98.4% gesture accuracy but 53.3% safety accuracy, while Qwen2.5-VL reaches 84.9% and 39.5%, yielding gaps of 45.0 and 45.4 percentage points. Four of five models rarely or never use the uncertainty label, and failure directions differ substantially across models. Accuracy also obscures label bias: a scenario-majority policy with no visual input reaches 58.3%, above every evaluated model, while only GPT-4o exceeds this prior under macro-F1. Visual input improves safety accuracy by 11.2 to 30.2 percentage points, but providing the ground-truth gesture as text improves performance by only 0.4 to 3.2 points, and no model exceeds 56.2%. These results indicate that the main bottleneck is scenario-conditioned safety reasoning rather than gesture recognition.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 22 tables, 2 figures. Code and benchmark resources available at https://github.com/The-Responsible-AI-Initiative/SafeGesture
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SafeGesture 基准，用于评估视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在安全关键操作情境下对手势的细粒度理解与情境化安全推理。基准将 HaGRID 的六种手势与八种操作场景配对，共 4,800 项测试，评测 Qwen2.5-VL-7B、LLaVA-NeXT-7B、InternVL2-8B、Phi-3.5-Vision 和 GPT-4o。结果显示感知与推理解耦：GPT-4o 手势准确率达 98.4% 但安全准确率仅 53.3%，Qwen2.5-VL 分别为 84.9% 和 39.5%，差距约为 45 个百分点。
Motivation: 开放权重与前沿 VLM 在通用图像理解上表现良好，但在安全关键操作情境下对手势进行全面细致的解释能力几乎未被检验；同时现有准确率指标掩盖了标签偏置问题。
Method: 构建 SafeGesture 基准，将六种 HaGRID 手势与八种操作场景配对生成 4,800 项测试，要求模型推断情境相适应的安全动作；实验还比较了无视觉输入的场景多数策略、提供真实手势文本等条件，以及不确定性标签的使用情况。
Result: GPT-4o 手势准确率 98.4% 但安全准确率 53.3%，Qwen2.5-VL 为 84.9% 与 39.5%，五个模型中有四个很少或从不使用不确定性标签。无视觉输入的场景多数策略达到 58.3%，超过所有被评测模型，仅 GPT-4o 在 macro-F1 上超过该先验；视觉输入使安全准确率提升 11.2 到 30.2 个百分点，而给定真实手势文本仅提升 0.4 到 3.2 个百分点，且没有模型超过 56.2%。
Conclusion: 主要瓶颈是情境条件的安全推理而非手势识别；作者强调准确率会掩盖标签偏置，且各模型的失败方向差异显著，需要更严谨的评估方式。

papers.title: DeepOHeat-v2: Self-Improving Operator Learning for Fast and Trustworthy Thermal Optimization in 3D-IC Design
papers.abstract_en: Thermal-aware optimization of multi-die 3D integrated circuits evaluates many designs, each a costly heat-equation solve. Operator-learning surrogates replace this solve with a fast forward pass, ideally trained from physics alone, without labeled data. DeepOHeat-v1 made such surrogates fast and trustworthy, but only on low-contrast geometries. High-contrast multi-die stacks break it in two ways: discontinuous conductivities make the continuous physics loss ill-defined at material interfaces, and ill-conditioning ($κ_2(A_h) \approx 6 \times 10^4$) puts the discretized strong-form loss beyond first-order optimization. We propose DeepOHeat-v2 to overcome both. First, we train on a discretized physics loss that handles the discontinuities natively; its energy form reduces the prediction-space loss-Hessian conditioning from $κ^2$ to $κ$, and a matrix-preconditioned optimizer cuts the mean peak temperature error from over 30 K to 0.55 K. Second, because optimization leaves the training distribution, we propose a self-improving framework: a hotspot trust gate sends flagged placements to a reference solver, and the surrogate incrementally retrains on the refined solutions, keeping an update only when it improves held-out validation error. On a multi-die benchmark, the surrogate-true peak gap on the returned design falls from 1.12 K to 0.11 K, matching a solve-at-every-step optimizer while running $56\times$ faster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepOHeat-v2，一个面向多 die 3D-IC 热感知优化的算子学习代理模型，解决高对比度几何下连续物理损失在材料界面处不适定以及离散化强形式损失病态（κ₂(A_h)≈6×10⁴）的问题。它采用离散化物理损失、能量形式降条件数和矩阵预处理优化器，并引入自改进框架：热点信任门将可疑布局交给参考求解器，代理模型增量重训，仅当提升留出验证误差时保留更新。在多 die 基准上，返回设计的代理-真实峰值温度差距从 1.12 K 降至 0.11 K，匹配逐步求解优化器的精度且快 56 倍。
Motivation: 3D-IC 热感知优化需评估大量设计，每次都需要昂贵的热方程求解；算子学习代理模型可将其替换为快速前向传播，理想情况下仅由物理驱动、无需标签数据。但 DeepOHeat-v1 只适用于低对比度几何，高对比度多 die 堆叠因材料界面不连续和离散化损失病态而失效。
Method: DeepOHeat-v2 首先在离散化物理损失上训练，原生处理不连续性；其能量形式将预测空间损失 Hessian 的条件数从 κ² 降至 κ，并用矩阵预处理优化器将平均峰值温度误差从超过 30 K 降至 0.55 K。其次提出自改进框架：热点信任门将标记的布局送至参考求解器，代理模型在精化解上增量重训，仅采纳能降低留出验证误差的更新。
Result: 摘要报告在多 die 基准上，返回设计的代理-真实峰值温度差距从 1.12 K 降至 0.11 K，精度匹配逐步求解优化器，同时运行速度快 56 倍；预处理优化器使平均峰值温度误差降至 0.55 K。
Conclusion: 本文表明结合离散化物理损失、能量形式与矩阵预处理可以克服高对比度热优化中算子学习的病态问题，自改进框架使代理模型在优化分布外仍保持可信。
Relevance: 5
