papers.title: US-VLA: An Ultrasound Vision-Language-Action Model for Embodied Abdomina
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence-assisted ultrasound scanning enhances diagnostic reliability and efficiency by providing real-time guidance for standardized image acquisition and reducing operator dependence. However, existing reinforcement learning and learning-assisted ultrasound scanning methods typically rely on carefully designed reward functions or extensive interaction data, which limits their generalization ability and stability across different devices, patient populations, and complex clinical scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose an ultrasound vision-language-action model (US-VLA) for automated ultrasound scanning that explicitly encodes clinical semantic goals and generates sequential probe manipulation actions under real-time ultrasound feedback. In particular, we first design an ultrasound-aware expert fusion module to jointly integrate ultrasound observations with auxiliary contextual information, enabling semantic ultrasound feedback to effectively guide the scanning process. Then, we construct US-VLA-Data, a real-world dataset covering liver and kidney examinations, which includes five clinically defined standard planes and comprises 320 expert scanning trajectories with approximately 80,000 synchronized timesteps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that US-VLA achieves competitive performance in ultrasound probe manipulation tasks, indicating its effectiveness and promising generalization within the evaluated abdominal ultrasound setting. The source code is available at https://github.com/VMVLab/US-VLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 US-VLA，一个用于自动化超声扫描的视觉-语言-动作模型 (vision-language-action model)，显式编码临床语义目标并在实时超声反馈下生成探针顺序操作动作。作者设计了超声感知专家融合模块以联合整合超声观测与辅助上下文信息，并构建了覆盖肝脏和肾脏检查的真实数据集 US-VLA-Data，包含 5 个临床标准切面、320 条专家扫描轨迹和约 80,000 个同步时间步。实验表明 US-VLA 在超声探针操作任务上表现有竞争力，并在所评估的腹部超声设置中显示出泛化潜力。
Motivation: 现有强化学习和学习辅助的超声扫描方法通常依赖精心设计的奖励函数或大量交互数据，导致跨设备、患者群体和复杂临床场景的泛化能力与稳定性受限。
Method: 提出超声视觉-语言-动作模型 US-VLA，将临床语义目标显式编码并为探针操作生成动作；其中的超声感知专家融合模块用于联合整合超声观测和辅助上下文信息。作者还构建了包含肝脏与肾脏真实扫描轨迹的数据集 US-VLA-Data 以支持训练。
Result: 摘要报告 US-VLA 在超声探针操作任务上取得有竞争力的性能，并在所评估的腹部超声设置中表现出有效性和泛化能力；摘要未给出与其他方法的定量对比数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 US-VLA 在腹部超声扫描评估设置中的有效性与泛化潜力，并开源了源代码；其验证范围限于文中定义的腹部超声场景。

papers.title: GOD: Enhancing Generalization via Deep Grafting for Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Sequential recommenders often struggle with sparse and noisy histories, limiting generalization to unseen interactions. Knowledge distillation mitigates this by transferring dense supervision from a teacher to a student. However, most distillation methods run teacher and student independently, then match student outputs or representations to the teacher. Such supervision entangles student-component effects, blurring whether weak generalization stems from unreliable embeddings, overfitted encoding, or co-adaptation to sparse histories. In this paper, we propose Graft-Oriented Distillation (GOD), a component-level distillation framework for improved generalization through grafting. Grafting denotes replacing selected frozen-teacher components with trainable student counterparts to build hybrid source models. GOD uses these hybrid models to evaluate student embeddings with the teacher encoder and the student encoder with teacher embeddings, providing component-level feedback. At inference, GOD uses only the student, incurring no additional cost. Across three real-world datasets, GOD outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by up to 13.92%.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Graft-Oriented Distillation (GOD)，一种用于序列推荐的组件级知识蒸馏框架。GOD 通过嫁接 (grafting) 操作，将冻结的教师组件与可训练的学生组件组合成混合源模型，从而对学生嵌入和编码器分别提供组件级反馈，以改善对稀疏交互历史的泛化。推理时仅使用学生模型，不引入额外成本；在三个真实数据集上，GOD 相较最先进的基线最高提升 13.92%。
Motivation: 序列推荐常受稀疏和有噪声的历史影响，限制了对未见交互的泛化。现有蒸馏方法通常独立训练教师和学生，再匹配输出或表示，但这种监督纠缠了学生各组件的影响，难以判断弱泛化究竟是来自不可靠的嵌入、过拟合的编码，还是对稀疏历史的共适应。
Method: 提出组件级蒸馏框架 GOD。嫁接 (grafting) 指用可训练的学生组件替换选定的冻结教师组件，构建混合源模型；GOD 利用这些混合模型，一方面用教师编码器评估学生嵌入，另一方面用学生编码器评估教师嵌入，从而提供组件级反馈。推理阶段仅使用学生模型，无额外推理成本。
Result: 在三个真实数据集上，GOD 优于现有最先进基线，最高提升 13.92%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调组件级反馈的蒸馏框架能够有效改进序列推荐的泛化能力，且推理时无需教师模型参与，不产生额外开销。

papers.title: Learn What's Left, Not What's Mastered: Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) with group-relative advantages has become the de facto standard for post-training language model reasoners. However, when optimizing multiple reward objectives, existing methods typically scalarize the reward vector with a fixed weighted sum before group-wise standardization. We show that this design leads to two fundamental problems: rollouts with distinct reward profiles can receive identical advantages, and all objectives are optimized with fixed relative weights regardless of their current level of saturation. As a result, training continues to allocate gradient budget to already-solved objectives instead of focusing on those with greater remaining headroom. We introduce \textbf{Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization} (SA-MRPO), which standardizes each reward objective independently and adaptively discounts its contribution according to a batch-level estimate of objective saturation. This dynamically reallocates optimization effort toward under-optimized objectives while empirically maintaining performance on those that are already well satisfied. We further show that saturation-aware reweighting can reverse the sign of an update, rather than merely rescale its magnitude. Across mathematical reasoning with two- and three-objective reward combinations, SA-MRPO improves the harder correctness objective over GDPO in 12 of 15 benchmark comparisons, with gains of up to $5\%$ on AIME24. On adaptive reasoning it improves accuracy on all five benchmarks, by $3.8\%$ on average and up to $9.2 \%$ on AMC23, and on coding benchmarks it improves pass rate by up to $2.3\%$, while in all settings maintaining the easier objectives near their already satisfied levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多奖励策略优化中固定加权标量化导致的问题，提出饱和感知优势重加权方法 SA-MRPO。其做法是对每个奖励目标独立标准化，并根据批次级饱和估计自适应折扣该目标的贡献，从而把梯度预算动态转移到尚未饱和的目标。摘要报告该方法在数学推理、自适应推理和编码基准上比 GDPO 更优，同时保持易目标性能。
Motivation: 现有方法在组内标准化前用固定权重把奖励向量标量化，导致两类问题：奖励轮廓不同的 rollout 可能获得相同优势；所有目标按固定相对权重优化，而不考虑各自当前的饱和程度，已解决的目标仍持续占用梯度预算。
Method: SA-MRPO 对每个奖励目标独立标准化，按批次级目标饱和估计自适应折扣其贡献，从而动态重新分配优化努力；作者还证明饱和感知重加权可以反转更新的符号，而不仅仅是缩放其幅度。
Result: 数学推理的两目标与三目标组合中，SA-MRPO 在 15 个基准对比中的 12 个上优于 GDPO 的更难正确性目标，AIME24 上增益最高达 5%；自适应推理在全部五个基准上提升准确率，平均 3.8%、AMC23 最高 9.2%；编码基准的 pass rate 最高提升 2.3%，同时各设定下较容易目标保持接近已满足水平。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是，按饱和程度动态重分配优化努力能在改善未充分优化目标的同时维持已满足目标的性能；摘要未提及明显局限。

papers.title: OceanLight: Efficient Global Ocean Forecasting via Geometry-Adaptive Unstructured Mesh Representation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable global ocean forecasting is critical for climate monitoring, marine navigation, and extreme event early warning. Physics-based ocean forecasting models impose prohibitive computational costs, while existing deep learning approaches predominantly rely on structured-grid architectures, incurring unnecessary computation on masked land cells and enforcing uniform resolution across dynamically heterogeneous ocean regions regardless of local flow complexity. Here we present OceanLight, an efficient global ocean forecasting framework innovatively combining geometry-adaptive unstructured mesh tokenization with a graph neural network (GNN) backbone. OceanLight achieves pointwise forecast accuracy and kinetic energy spectral fidelity exceeding both operational numerical analyses and state-of-the-art AI-based models, while surpassing all AI-based ocean models in geostrophic balance consistency. Furthermore, OceanLight demonstrates reliable mesoscale eddy representation, capturing coherent ocean structures beyond pointwise statistical optimization. These capabilities are delivered with a 62% reduction in GPU memory consumption and 70\% reduction in FLOPs relative to structured-grid baselines. Our unstructured mesh representation establishes a generalizable paradigm for scalable data-driven oceanography.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OceanLight，一个面向全球海洋预报的高效框架，核心是将几何自适应非结构化网格 tokenization 与图神经网络 (GNN) 主干结合。摘要称其在逐点预报精度和动能谱保真度上超过业务化数值分析与现有最优 AI 模型，并在地转平衡一致性上超过所有 AI 海洋模型；相较结构化网格基线，GPU 内存消耗降低 62%，FLOPs 降低 70%。作者认为该非结构化网格表示可为可扩展的数据驱动海洋学提供通用范式。
Motivation: 基于物理的海洋预报模型计算成本过高，而现有深度学习方法大多依赖结构化网格架构，会在被掩码的陆地单元上产生不必要的计算，并对动态异质的海洋区域强制使用统一分辨率，忽略了局地流动复杂度。
Method: 提出几何自适应非结构化网格 tokenization 与 GNN 骨干相结合，以替代结构化网格上的均匀 tokenization，从而按海洋局地动力学复杂度分配计算资源。
Result: 摘要报告 OceanLight 的逐点预报精度和动能谱 (kinetic energy spectrum) 保真度同时超过业务化数值分析和现有最优 AI 模型，且在地转平衡一致性上优于所有 AI 海洋模型；相对结构化网格基线实现 GPU 内存减少 62%、FLOPs 减少 70%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能可靠刻画中尺度涡旋等连贯海洋结构，而不仅是逐点统计优化，并指出非结构化网格表示为可扩展的数据驱动海洋预报提供了通用范式。

papers.title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that rely on system prompts to use tools and complete tasks. Such deployments impose distinct operational requirements, including appropriate tool use, concise prompts and solution paths, and compliance with safety and formatting policies. For many practitioners, however, assembling domain-specific supervised data to post-train models to meet these requirements is infeasible. We introduce CAPO (Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization), a primal-dual method that combines pool-based rewrites with adaptive constraint weighting to optimize system prompts under explicit operational constraints. Across agentic benchmarks, CAPO more reliably reaches empirically feasible operating points while improving task performance. CAPO also generalizes beyond agentic settings, achieving strong results on assistant-style evaluations with output-format and safety/privacy constraints. We further introduce DCAPO (Dynamically Trained CAPO), which trains a feedback- and dual-conditioned rewriter with pool-based GRPO while keeping the task agent frozen. Across task agents of different sizes, DCAPO produces a feasible prompt in every evaluated domain and matches or improves the task accuracy achieved by the evaluated baselines. A surrogate analysis characterizes how finite-pool and discrete-rewrite errors enter the inexact primal-dual procedure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAPO（Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization），一种基于原始-对偶（primal-dual）方法的系统提示词优化框架，用于在显式操作约束（如工具使用正确性、提示词简洁性、安全与格式策略符合性）下优化 LLM agent 的 system prompt。方法结合池式重写与自适应约束加权，在 agentic 基准和助手式评估上取得可行操作点与任务性能提升；进一步引入 DCAPO，用池式 GRPO 训练反馈与对偶条件化的重写器，在多种规模任务 agent 上均产生可行提示并匹配或超过基线准确率。
Motivation: LLM agent 部署要求系统提示词满足工具使用、简洁性和政策合规等操作约束，但许多从业者无法构建领域监督数据进行后训练，因此需要无需额外监督数据的提示词优化方法。
Method: CAPO 采用原始-对偶方法，结合基于池（pool-based）的提示词重写和自适应约束权重，在显式操作约束下优化系统提示词；DCAPO 则在保持任务 agent 冻结的前提下，使用池式 GRPO 训练一个反馈与对偶条件化的重写器。
Result: 在 agentic 基准上，CAPO 更可靠地达到经验可行操作点并提升任务性能；在输出格式和安全/隐私约束的助手式评估上也取得强结果。DCAPO 在不同规模任务 agent 的每个评估领域均产生可行提示，并匹配或改进基线任务准确率。摘要还通过代理分析刻画了有限池与离散重写误差如何进入不精确的原始-对偶过程。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CAPO 能在无领域监督数据条件下优化受约束的 LLM agent 提示词，且方法可泛化到非 agentic 设置；DCAPO 通过动态训练重写器实现跨领域可行性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Governance at the Boundary: How Agent Decomposition Degrades Policy Compliance
papers.abstract_en: Existing agent benchmarks ask whether the agent finished the task. We ask whether it finished it within policy. We introduce Fiducia-bench, a benchmark for the governability of financial agents---whether they escalate when obligated, abstain when required, and leave an auditable trail---and use it to study a question no prior benchmark addresses: does decomposing an agent into components degrade its governance? It does, and the mechanism is specific. Policy-relevant facts discovered by one component are attenuated at the handoff boundary before reaching the component that must act on them. In a 626-episode experiment across 100 KYC/AML task variants, two models, and three architectures, a 32B open-weights model attenuated 0% of discovered facts under a single-loop baseline, 56% under a fixed pipeline, and 85% under an orchestrator-subagent architecture (all at constraint distance 2). A stronger model (gpt-4.1-mini) attenuated 3-6% under the same conditions, suggesting the governance cost of decomposition is partly a function of model capability. Critically, the same mechanism produces both under-escalation and over-escalation, depending on whether the dropped fact was a risk signal or an exculpating one. The benchmark, all tasks, and the verification harness are open-source
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fiducia-bench，一个衡量金融智能体可治理性（governability）的基准，关注智能体是否在应升级时升级、在应放弃时放弃，并留下可审计轨迹，而非仅仅是否完成任务。作者用该基准研究一个此前基准未涉及的问题：将智能体分解为多个组件是否会损害其策略合规性。在 626 个回合、100 个 KYC/AML 任务变体、两个模型和三种架构的实验中，32B 开源模型在单循环基线（single-loop baseline）下衰减 0% 的已发现事实，在固定流水线（fixed pipeline）下衰减 56%，在编排器-子代理（orchestrator-subagent）架构下衰减 85%；更强的 gpt-4.1-mini 在相同条件下衰减 3-6%。
Motivation: 现有智能体基准只问智能体是否完成了任务，而没有问它是否在策略范围内完成任务。此前也没有基准研究智能体分解是否降低治理能力，而这正是本文填补的空白。
Method: 引入 Fiducia-bench 基准，专门评估金融智能体的可治理性，包括应升级时升级、应弃权时弃权以及留下可审计轨迹。实验比较了单循环基线、固定流水线和编排器-子代理三种架构，并设置约束距离（constraint distance）等条件来量化策略相关事实在组件交接（handoff boundary）处的衰减。
Result: 32B 开源模型在不同架构下对已发现策略相关事实的衰减率分别为 0%（单循环）、56%（固定流水线）和 85%（编排器-子代理），而较强的 gpt-4.1-mini 在相同条件下只衰减 3-6%。这种衰减机制同时导致升级不足（under-escalation）和过度升级（over-escalation），取决于被丢弃的事实是风险信号还是免责信号。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将智能体分解为组件会降低其策略合规性，具体机制是一个组件发现的策略相关事实在移交给必须采取行动的组件之前被衰减；治理成本部分取决于模型能力。基准、任务和验证框架均已开源。

papers.title: Structured Prediction for Scalable Spreadsheet Table Understanding: From Cell Types to Table Ranges (Extended Version)
papers.abstract_en: Spreadsheets are a primary medium for publishing tabular data, yet automatically extracting structured content from them remains difficult due to heterogeneous layouts, diverse file formats, and inconsistent organizational conventions. We address two core tasks in spreadsheet understanding: Cell-Type Classification (CTC), which assigns roles to cells, and Table Detection (TD), which identifies table bounding boxes within sheets. We propose an efficient two-stage pipeline in which a learned CTC model feeds a deterministic TD algorithm. For CTC, we use a LightGBM classifier over 65 structured features together with a pairwise CRF enforcing spatial consistency across the cell grid. Our TD method extracts table ranges from predicted cell types by a deterministic five-stage procedure. For evaluation, we built and share StatSheets, a multilingual benchmark of 737 manually annotated sheets from 14 public data providers across multiple countries and file formats. Under 5-fold cross-validation, our CRF-LightGBM system achieves a Mean File-Macro F1 score of 0.937 on CTC, within 0.6 percentage points of the GPU-based TUTA Transformer, while requiring substantially fewer computational resources. For TD, our deterministic approach outperforms region-based baselines and remains competitive with recent LLM-based systems such as SpreadsheetLLM. These results demonstrate that combining non-linear structured prediction with deterministic range extraction provides a competitive, scalable, and computationally efficient approach to spreadsheet table understanding.
papers.comment: Extended version of a paper published at CIKM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电子表格表格理解中的两个核心任务——单元格类型分类 (CTC) 与表格检测 (TD)——提出一个高效两阶段流水线：先由学习模型做 CTC，再用确定性算法做 TD。CTC 采用基于 65 个结构化特征的 LightGBM 分类器，并配合成对 CRF 在单元格网格上施加空间一致性；TD 则通过确定的五阶段流程从预测的单元格类型中提取表格范围。作者构建并公开了多语言基准 StatSheets（737 个手工标注表格，来自 14 个公共数据提供方），实验显示该方法在 CTC 上达到 0.937 的 Mean File-Macro F1，接近 GPU 版 TUTA Transformer，而计算开销显著更低；TD 上优于基于区域的基线，并与 SpreadsheetLLM 等基于 LLM 的系统相当。
Motivation: 电子表格是发布表格数据的主要媒介，但异构布局、多样文件格式和不一致的组织惯例使自动提取结构化内容仍然困难，需要可扩展且计算高效的表格理解方法。
Method: 提出两阶段流水线：CTC 阶段使用带 65 个结构化特征的 LightGBM 分类器，并结合成对 CRF 在单元格网格上强制空间一致性；TD 阶段通过确定的五阶段流程从预测的单元格类型中提取表格边界范围。
Result: 在 5 折交叉验证下，CRF-LightGBM 系统在 CTC 上取得 0.937 的 Mean File-Macro F1，与基于 GPU 的 TUTA Transformer 相差 0.6 个百分点以内，但所需计算资源大幅减少；TD 方法优于基于区域的基线，并与近期基于 LLM 的 SpreadsheetLLM 系统保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将非线性结构化预测与确定性范围提取相结合，为电子表格表格理解提供了一种具有竞争力、可扩展且计算高效的方案。

papers.title: Walk Before You Run: The Importance of Data Exploration for Data Analysis Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based data-analysis tools are increasingly used to help users analyze messy spreadsheets and workbooks, from answering questions over uploaded files to generating code, summaries, and visualizations. These systems are often evaluated by the correctness of their final downstream answers. However, reliable data analysis also depends on an earlier step: understanding what the dataset contains before solving the requested task. For complex workbooks, this Data Exploration step includes identifying the logical tables behind physical sheets, interpreting column semantics, recovering keys and relationships, and detecting quality issues. In current tools and benchmarks, this step is usually left implicit, creating a gap between downstream task performance and the dataset understanding needed for reliable, human-checkable analysis. Our key contribution is to identify this overlooked gap, make Data Exploration a first-class evaluation target, and show through downstream experiments that stronger Data Exploration support improves task performance. To evaluate dataset understanding directly, we introduce two benchmark settings: a real multi-sheet workbook benchmark based on a Vitamin D study dataset, and an extension of DSBench with schema-fixed Data Exploration artifacts. In both settings, systems are evaluated by the quality of a structured artifact capturing tables, columns, semantic roles, relationships, and profiling signals. Our results show that strong LLMs and data-analysis agents still miss important logical structure even when they read spreadsheet content. Furthermore, explicit Data Exploration support often improves downstream correctness, suggesting it should be treated as a first-class, inspectable stage in LLM data-analysis workflows and a natural human-in-the-loop checkpoint where domain experts can review and correct the artifact before downstream analysis proceeds.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to VLDB 2026 Workshop: DASHSys: Systems for Data-centric Agents with Human-in-the-loop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出LLM数据分析工具通常只按最终答案的正确性来评估，忽略了更早的数据探索步骤，即理解数据集包含什么：识别物理工作表背后的逻辑表、解释列语义、恢复键与关系、检测数据质量问题。作者提出把Data Exploration作为一等评估目标，引入两个基准设置（基于Vitamin D研究数据的真实多表工作簿基准，以及带schema固定数据探索工件的DSBench扩展），并实验表明强LLM和数据分析代理在读取电子表格内容时仍会遗漏重要逻辑结构，显式数据探索支持通常能改善下游任务正确性。
Motivation: 现有工具和基准把数据探索步骤隐式化，导致下游任务性能与可靠、可人工核查分析所需的数据集理解之间存在缺口；复杂工作簿的分析必须先理解数据内容。
Method: 将Data Exploration作为一等评估目标，提出两个基准设置：一个基于Vitamin D研究数据集的真实多表工作簿基准，另一个是带有schema固定数据探索工件的DSBench扩展；系统按捕捉表、列、语义角色、关系和profiling信号的结构化工件质量进行评估。
Result: 摘要报告强LLM和数据分析代理即使读取了电子表格内容，仍会遗漏重要的逻辑结构；显式加入数据探索支持往往能提升下游任务的正确性。
Conclusion: 作者主张数据探索应被作为LLM数据分析工作流中一等、可检查的阶段，并作为天然的人机交互检查点，让领域专家在下游分析前审查和修正工件。

papers.title: TR-GS: High-Fidelity Sparse-View CT Volumetric Rendering via t-Distribution Gaussian Splatting and Ray-Confidence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity 3D medical visualization supports applications such as clinical assessment and surgical planning. Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) can reduce projection requirements and associated radiation exposure, but limited observations may introduce structural artifacts and reconstruction uncertainty. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient explicit representation for volumetric rendering, existing CT methods based on standard Gaussian primitives may be sensitive to unreliable observations under sparse-view acquisition. We present TR-GS, a Gaussian-splatting framework for sparse view CT volumetric rendering. TR-GS replaces standard Gaussian primitives with projectable Student's t-distribution primitives and introduces a ray-confidence model that regulates their degrees of freedom according to local ray observability. Confidence-guided 3D wavelet regularization is further used to balance high-frequency detail preservation and noise suppression. This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that TR-GS improves over representative baselines in most evaluated settings and remains competitive in the remaining cases. The resulting volumetric representations may support downstream medical multimedia applications, including XR-based visualization and interactive clinical rendering.
papers.journal_ref: ACM Multimedia 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TR-GS，一个面向稀疏视图 CT 体积渲染的高斯泼溅框架。作者用可投影的 Student's t 分布基元替换标准高斯基元，并引入射线置信模型 (ray-confidence model) 根据局部射线可观测性调节其自由度，再配合置信引导的 3D 小波正则化，在保留高频细节的同时抑制噪声。实验在合成和真实数据集上的多数设置下优于代表性基线，在其余设置下保持竞争力。
Motivation: 稀疏视图 CT 能减少投影数量和辐射暴露，但有限观测会引入结构伪影与重建不确定性；基于标准高斯基元的现有 CT 方法在稀疏采集下对不可靠观测较为敏感。
Method: TR-GS 使用 Student's t 分布基元替代标准高斯基元，并设计射线置信模型按局部可观测性调控基元自由度；同时采用置信引导的 3D 小波正则化，平衡高频细节保留与噪声抑制。
Result: 在合成与真实数据集上的实验表明，TR-GS 在大多数评测设置中优于代表性基线，并在其余设置中保持有竞争力的表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法生成的体积表示可支撑下游医学多媒体应用，如基于 XR 的可视化和交互式临床渲染。

papers.title: Decoupling Parcellation from Classification: Systematic Benchmark of Fast Brain Segmentation Methods for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
papers.abstract_en: Brain parcellation and classification are typically evaluated in isolation, yet downstream AD detection performance depends on their interaction. We decouple these components and systematically benchmark fast deep learning parcellation methods (SynthSeg+, OpenMAP-T1) against the FreeSurfer (FS-HV) clinical baseline through down- stream AD classification on OASIS-1. Our factorial design evaluates three parcellation methods, two volumetry strategies (hard vs. soft), and four classifier paradigms (clinical thresholds, supervised feedforward networks, ensemble methods, and foundation models with zero/few-shot prompting), with all results quantified using BCa Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将脑区分割 (parcellation) 与 AD 分类解耦，并在 OASIS-1 上系统基准测试快速深度学习分割方法 SynthSeg+、OpenMAP-T1 与 FreeSurfer (FS-HV) 临床基线对下游阿尔茨海默病检测的影响。实验采用析因设计，覆盖三种分割方法、两种体积策略（硬/软）和四种分类范式，所有结果以 BCa Bootstrap 95% 置信区间量化。
Motivation: 脑区分割与分类通常被孤立评估，但下游 AD 检测性能取决于两者的交互；现有研究缺乏对这一交互的系统性基准测试。
Method: 采用析因设计评估三种分割方法、两种体积策略（hard vs. soft）和四种分类器范式（临床阈值、有监督前馈网络、集成方法、带零样本/少样本提示的基础模型），并以 BCa Bootstrap 95% 置信区间量化全部结果。
Result: 摘要未给出具体性能数字，仅报告了在 OASIS-1 上的系统基准测试框架以及上述因素组合所构成的结果矩阵。
Conclusion: 摘要强调解耦评估分割与分类的必要性，认为两者的相互作用决定下游 AD 检测性能；具体最终结论与局限性未在摘要中呈现。

summary_sections.result: 摘要未给出具体性能数字，仅报告了在 OASIS-1 上的系统基准测试框架以及上述因素组合所构成的结果矩阵。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调解耦评估分割与分类的必要性，认为两者的相互作用决定下游 AD 检测性能；具体最终结论与局限性未在摘要中呈现。

papers.title: NICE: Scale-Stable Perturbations for Graph Neural Network Explanations via Noise Corruption
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc Graph Neural Network (GNN) explainers commonly follow a Perturb-Query paradigm, inferring the importance of graph elements based on queried predictions to perturbed inputs. However, such perturbations often introduce substantial distribution shift, undermining the reliability of the queried predictions used to derive explanations. While existing efforts mainly improve perturbed graphs or stabilize model predictions on them, we revisit the perturbation mechanism itself. We show that the widely used Element-wise Masking(EM) suppresses edge-induced messages toward zero, causing deterministic scale contraction that accumulates across message-passing layers, a phenomenon we term Scale Drift. Consequently, prediction changes under EM may conflate information corruption with deviations in propagation scale. As a scale-stable alternative to EM, we introduce Noise Corruption (NC), which perturbs each message through matched-norm random-direction corruption while preserving the expected squared message norm. Building on NC, we propose NICE, a Noise Corruption-based explanation framework, which learns a Stochastic Restoration Boundary (SRB) under NC-induced uncertainty, balancing target-prediction restoration against compactness. Furthermore, Boundary-Integrated Gradient (BIG) converts this boundary into edge attributions by accumulating each edge's contribution to reducing restoration risk along the restoration path. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate stronger explanation performance and model faithfulness while confirming that NC substantially reduces the Scale Drift induced by masking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视图神经网络（GNN）后验解释器中的扰动机制，指出常用的逐元素掩蔽（Element-wise Masking, EM）会把边消息压向零，导致跨消息传递层累积的确定性尺度收缩，作者称之为 Scale Drift；作为尺度稳定的替代，提出噪声腐蚀（Noise Corruption, NC），并基于它构建 NICE 解释框架，配合随机恢复边界（SRB）与边界积分梯度（BIG）生成边属性。实验显示该方法在多个基准上取得更强的解释性能和模型忠实度，且 NC 能显著降低掩蔽带来的 Scale Drift。
Motivation: 现有多数 GNN 解释器遵循 Perturb-Query 范式，但扰动常造成明显分布偏移，损害查询预测的可靠性；已有工作多从改进扰动图或稳定模型预测入手，本文则直接回到扰动机制本身，指出 EM 的尺度收缩问题会混淆信息破坏与传播尺度变化。
Method: 提出 Noise Corruption 作为 EM 的尺度稳定替代：对每条消息施加匹配范数的随机方向腐蚀，同时保持期望平方消息范数不变；在此基础上构建 NICE 框架，学习受 NC 不确定性影响的 Stochastic Restoration Boundary（SRB），以平衡目标预测恢复与解释紧凑性，并用 Boundary-Integrated Gradient（BIG）沿恢复路径累积各边对降低恢复风险的贡献，从而得到边属性。
Result: 在多个基准实验上，NICE 相比现有方法获得更强的解释性能与模型忠实度，并验证 NC 大幅减少了掩蔽所产生的 Scale Drift。
Conclusion: 作者认为重新设计扰动机制本身（而非仅改善扰动图或稳定预测）是提升 GNN 解释可靠性的有效路径，NC 可作为 EM 的尺度稳定替代方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AdROD: HyperNetwork-based Adversarially Robust Object Detection for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Camera-based object detectors are vulnerable to physical adversarial attacks designed to suppress detections. While adversarial training and input purification offer some protection, they often overfit to specific attack distributions and fail on adaptive adversaries. This paper presents AdROD, an embedded, stochastic ensemble defense software designed for autonomous driving. AdROD employs {\em low-rank HyperNetworks}, which require only 1.6\% of the parameter footprint of standard HyperNetworks, to generate diverse detectors at a per-frame rate, making it impractical for attackers to obtain the deployed detectors in time. To further improve adversarial robustness, AdROD incorporates a novel \emph{functional diversity} mechanism, which couples stochastic weight updates with unique input-space transformations. We design two serving modes of AdROD that strike different trade-offs between robustness and runtime overhead: AdROD-I, a continuous protection mode for maximum resilience that leverages inter-detector disagreement to recover compromised detections, and AdROD-II, an on-demand mode triggered by kinematic discontinuities in object tracking. Through comprehensive evaluation with synthetic benchmarks, physically deployed adversarial patches, and end-to-end safety tests in the OpenCDA co-simulator, AdROD outperforms five baseline defenses and exhibits superior generalizability compared with the evaluated adversarial-training baselines, while maintaining real-time performance for safely stopping the vehicle at a stop sign instrumented with adversarial patches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdROD，一种面向自动驾驶的嵌入式随机集成防御软件，用于抵御针对相机目标检测器的物理对抗攻击。AdROD 使用仅占标准 HyperNetwork 参数 1.6% 的低秩 HyperNetwork（low-rank HyperNetwork）逐帧生成多样化的检测器，并引入功能多样性（functional diversity）机制，将随机权重更新与输入空间变换耦合。设计了两种服务模式：AdROD-I 连续保护模式利用检测器间分歧恢复被攻击的检测结果，AdROD-II 按需模式由目标跟踪中的运动学不连续触发。在合成基准、物理部署的对抗补丁以及 OpenCDA 协同仿真中的端到端安全测试中，AdROD 优于五种基线防御。
Motivation: 基于相机的目标检测器容易受到旨在抑制检测的物理对抗攻击；对抗训练与输入净化虽然提供一定保护，但往往过拟合特定攻击分布，难以应对自适应攻击者。
Method: AdROD 采用低秩 HyperNetwork 以极小的参数开销逐帧生成多样检测器，使攻击者难以实时获取当前部署的检测器；同时通过功能多样性机制将随机权重更新与输入空间变换耦合以提升鲁棒性，并提供 AdROD-I 与 AdROD-II 两种在鲁棒性和运行时开销之间权衡的服务模式。
Result: 在合成基准、物理对抗补丁和 OpenCDA 协同仿真评估中，AdROD 优于五种基线防御，且相比所评估的对抗训练基线具有更好的泛化性；同时保持实时性能，能够在带有对抗补丁的停车标志处安全停车。
Conclusion: 摘要强调嵌入式随机集成结合低秩 HyperNetwork 与功能多样性，能在自动驾驶场景中实现对自适应物理对抗攻击的更强鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Group ICA 2.0: Closing the Gap Between Subjects and Group Latent Decomposition with Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA)
papers.abstract_en: Group Independent Component Analysis (gICA) is widely used to decompose high-dimensional functional MRI data into interpretable brain networks. However, conventional gICA primarily identifies components shared across subjects. This group-level assumption can limit the recovery of networks present only in individuals or subject subsets, reducing sensitivity to intersubject heterogeneity in clinical neuroimaging datasets. We introduce Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA), an algorithm in the Group ICA 2.0 framework that jointly estimates template-linked, cohort-only, and subject-only brain networks within a unified model. CoLiG-ICA combines ICA-based spatial decomposition, copula-based dependence modeling, and deep learning optimization to preserve the consistency and interpretability of template-constrained ICA while enabling free components beyond the reference networks. By linking subject decompositions to shared templates and jointly estimating cohort-only and subject-only sources, CoLiG-ICA represents individual variability not captured by conventional group priors. We evaluate CoLiG-ICA using resting-state fMRI data from the UCLA-CNP dataset and compare it with conventional constrained ICA in estimating template-linked components, discovering additional free components, improving component independence, and capturing subject-level variability beyond the shared group prior. Compared with MOO-ICAR, CoLiG-ICA showed significantly lower intercomponent spatial dependence, indicating improved subject-level component independence, and significantly reduced motion-related variance in the template-linked components. Additionally, in a schizophrenia-only group analysis, CoLiG-ICA identified three additional resting-state networks beyond the 53 template-linked NeuroMark components: one sensorimotor and two visual networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA)，将 Group ICA 扩展为同时估计模板关联、群体独有和个体独有脑网络的统一模型，以解决传统 gICA 只能识别跨被试共享成分、对个体异质性不敏感的问题。该方法结合 ICA 空间分解、copula 依赖建模和深度学习优化，在 UCLA-CNP 静息态 fMRI 数据上，与 MOO-ICAR 相比显著降低成分间空间依赖，并在精神分裂症群体分析中发现三个额外静息态网络。
Motivation: 传统 Group ICA 主要识别被试间共享的成分，可能无法恢复仅存在于个体或部分被试中的网络，从而降低临床神经影像数据中对被试间异质性的敏感性。
Method: CoLiG-ICA 在 Group ICA 2.0 框架下联合估计模板关联、群体独有和个体独有脑网络，融合 ICA 空间分解、copula 依赖建模与深度学习优化，在保持模板约束 ICA 的一致性和可解释性的同时允许超出参考网络的自由成分。
Result: 在 UCLA-CNP 静息态 fMRI 数据上，CoLiG-ICA 相比 MOO-ICAR 显著降低成分间空间依赖，提升个体水平成分独立性，并显著减少模板关联成分中的运动相关方差；在精神分裂症群体分析中，CoLiG-ICA 在 53 个模板关联 NeuroMark 成分之外识别出三个额外静息态网络（一个感觉运动网络和两个视觉网络）。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 CoLiG-ICA 能够捕获传统群体先验未涵盖的个体变异，并提升成分独立性；其评估局限于 UCLA-CNP 数据集和特定模板约束设置。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RagGAD: Rationale-Aware Conditional Gaussian Mixture Normalizing Flow for Unsupervised Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Graph anomaly detection aims to identify nodes that deviate from normal behavioral patterns within graphs. However, existing methods largely rely on the homophily assumption, which makes it difficult to distinguish spurious affinities and to capture the diverse behaviors of normal nodes,limiting their robustness in complex real-world scenarios. To address this problem, we propose RagGAD, an unsupervised graph anomaly detection framework based on rationale-aware conditional Gaussian mixture normalizing flow. RagGAD introduces an adaptive rationale disentangler to disentangle stable rationales from spurious correlations within node interrelationships, and further decomposes stable rationales into robust and fragile components. The learned rationales capture underlying interaction patterns that characterize normal behaviors under varying conditions, while anomalies emerge as deviations associated with unstable or spurious correlations. To model the intricate distributions of normal and abnormal nodes, RagGAD integrates rationale-non-rationale Gaussian mixture modeling with a robust-fragile rationale mixture learning strategy. By mitigating spurious homophilic correlations and embracing the heterogeneity of normal patterns, RagGAD identifies anomalies as low-density regions within a structure-aware distribution space. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that RagGAD outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RagGAD，一种基于理由感知的条件高斯混合归一化流 (rationale-aware conditional Gaussian mixture normalizing flow) 的无监督图异常检测框架。它通过自适应理由解耦器分离稳定理由与虚假相关，并将稳定理由分解为鲁棒与脆弱成分，最终将异常识别为结构感知分布空间中的低密度区域。摘要报告在多个基准数据集上优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有图异常检测方法大多依赖同质性假设，难以区分虚假亲和性并捕捉正常节点的多样行为，在复杂真实场景下鲁棒性不足。
Method: RagGAD 引入自适应理由解耦器 (adaptive rationale disentangler)，从节点相互关系中解耦稳定理由与虚假相关，再将稳定理由分解为鲁棒与脆弱成分；并整合理由-非理由高斯混合建模与鲁棒-脆弱理由混合学习策略，以刻画正常与异常节点的复杂分布。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，RagGAD 的检测性能超过现有最先进方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过缓解虚假同质相关并接纳正常模式的异质性，RagGAD 能够将异常检测为结构感知分布空间中的低密度区域，从而提升无监督图异常检测的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dynamic Evidence Collection Ecosystem for Assessment Integrity and Authentic Competence
papers.abstract_en: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) can produce high-quality essays, code, and design artefacts, challenging the validity of conventional assessments that rely on single-point submissions and product-only grading. This paper proposes a design framework called "Dynamic Evidence Collection Ecosystem" that shifts assessment toward continuous, authentic, multi-source evidence of student learning over time. The framework collects process evidence through iterative artefacts, design logs, activity rounds, self-reflection, and peer collaboration, supported by an AI-enabled layer for learning analytics, formative feedback, and transparency. The approach is grounded in recent assessment-redesign scholarship in AI-rich contexts and aligned with contemporary views of authenticity in assessment. This paper builds on the hypothesis that academic integrity is strengthened when it is treated as an assessment design rather than as an AI detection problem. The tools have limitations and risks of use that carry academic penalties. This paper presents an implementation scenario to support institutional adoption.

papers.title: Multi-scale Decomposed Convolution Refinement Network for Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) suffers from cross-modal discrepancies and limited discriminative capabilities, leading to suboptimal recognition performance. Current approaches exhibit limitations in semantic mining, cross-modal fusion and feature constraints. To tackle these challenges, we propose MDCRNet, a Multi-scale Decomposed Convolution Refinement Network that enhances cross-modal feature learning and discriminative metric learning. Specifically, we introduce a Hierarchical Learning Module (HLM) containing four Hierarchical Decomposed Convolution Attention (HDCA) modules, each equipped with lightweight channel attention and multi-scale spatial perception blocks to capture multi-scale spatial dependencies. Moreover, we develop a Joint Discriminative Metric Loss (JDML) incorporating a novel Granularity Discriminative Loss (GDL) that simultaneously optimizes intra-identity compactness and inter-identity separability across modalities. Extensive experiments on SYSU-MM01 and RegDB datasets demonstrate that MDCRNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on both benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Kevin-zms/MDCRNet.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication in the LNCS proceedings of ICONIP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可见光-红外行人重识别（VI-ReID）中的跨模态差异与判别能力不足问题，提出 MDCRNet（Multi-scale Decomposed Convolution Refinement Network）。网络通过 Hierarchical Learning Module（HLM）中的四个 Hierarchical Decomposed Convolution Attention（HDCA）模块捕捉多尺度空间依赖，并引入联合判别度量损失（JDML）及其中的 Granularity Discriminative Loss（GDL）来同时优化类内紧凑性与类间可分性。在 SYSU-MM01 和 RegDB 两个基准上，摘要称该方法取得了当前最优性能。
Motivation: VI-ReID 面临跨模态差异和有限判别能力导致的识别性能欠佳问题，现有方法在语义挖掘、跨模态融合和特征约束方面存在局限。
Method: 提出 MDCRNet，其核心是包含四个 HDCA 模块的 HLM，每个模块采用轻量级通道注意力和多尺度空间感知块；同时提出联合判别度量损失 JDML，其中 GDL 跨模态同时优化类内紧凑性与类间可分性。
Result: 在 SYSU-MM01 和 RegDB 数据集上的大量实验表明，MDCRNet 在两个基准上均达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MDCRNet 增强了跨模态特征学习与判别度量学习，并公开了代码；论文已被 ICONIP 2026 录用，将发表于 LNCS 会议论文集。

papers.title: Depth-guided Multi-view Exposure Bracketing for HDR Robot Vision
papers.abstract_en: Achieving reliable single-shot high dynamic range (HDR) imaging under extreme illumination conditions remains a long-standing challenge, yet no comprehensive benchmark exist for evaluating HDR perception in multi-sensor robotic systems. To fill this gap, we introduce a large-scale dataset collected via a custom robotic vision platform and an iPhone 13 Pro: 121 real-world scenes spanning modest and ultra-high dynamic range conditions, alongside 20 synthetic video sequences from the CARLA simulator. As a reference pipeline for this dataset, we propose Depth-guided Multi-view Exposure Bracketing (DMEB), a single-shot HDR method that distributes drastically different exposures across multi-view low-bit-depth cameras and fuses them via depth-guided confidence-aware fusion. Evaluations on our dataset show that DMEB establishes a strong reference point and highlight the promise of this sensor configuration for robust HDR perception in diverse multi-camera and depth sensor system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对极端光照下的单次高动态范围 (HDR) 成像问题，指出多传感器机器人系统中缺乏 HDR 感知评估基准，因此构建了一个大规模数据集：用定制机器人视觉平台和 iPhone 13 Pro 采集 121 个真实场景，覆盖中等与超高动态范围条件，并包含 20 条来自 CARLA 模拟器的合成视频序列。作为该数据集的参考流程，作者提出 Depth-guided Multi-view Exposure Bracketing (DMEB)，一种单次 HDR 方法，将差异极大的曝光分配到多视角低比特深度相机，并通过深度引导的置信度感知融合进行合成。实验表明 DMEB 建立了强参考点，并展示了该传感器配置在多样多相机与深度传感器系统中的 HDR 感知潜力。
Motivation: 在极端光照条件下实现可靠的单次高动态范围成像长期具有挑战性，且目前缺少针对多传感器机器人系统 HDR 感知的全面评估基准。
Method: 提出 DMEB：将差异极大的曝光分配给多视角低比特深度相机，并通过深度引导的置信度感知融合 (depth-guided confidence-aware fusion) 合成 HDR 结果；同时构建包含真实场景与 CARLA 合成序列的数据集。
Result: 在自建数据集上的评估显示，DMEB 建立了强参考点，并验证了多相机与深度传感器配置对鲁棒 HDR 感知的潜力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该数据集和参考流程填补了多传感器机器人 HDR 感知评估的空白，但未讨论方法在真实机器人部署中的具体局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ReRef-3D: A Benchmark for Spatial Referring Expression-Guided 3D Scene Rearrangement
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ReRef-3D, a benchmark for language-guided placement in 3D scenes. It contains 33,826 instructions across 998 CLEVR-derived scenes, spanning 16 placement families and direct, one-hop, and two-hop references. Each instruction must be resolved into a valid new placement position. Given that an instruction defines a region of acceptable placements rather than one coordinate, our evaluation inserts a prediction into the scene, recomputes relations, and tests relation satisfaction and physical validity. Each instruction also includes a verified naturalized rewrite. After fine-tuning, LLaVA-3D, 3D-LLM, and PlaceIt3D produce valid placements for 68.3%, 31.6%, and 22.4% of instructions, respectively. Across models, relation satisfaction surpasses physical validity, relations such as nearest and between are the most difficult, and phrasing has minimal effect on performance.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (ARR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReRef-3D，一个用于语言引导的 3D 场景放置 (placement) 的基准，包含 998 个 CLEVR 衍生场景中的 33,826 条指令，覆盖 16 种放置族以及直接、一跳和两跳引用。评估时把预测位置插入场景并重新计算关系，检验关系满足度与物理有效性，每条指令还带有经过验证的自然化改写。微调后 LLaVA-3D、3D-LLM 和 PlaceIt3D 分别对 68.3%、31.6% 和 22.4% 的指令产生有效放置。
Motivation: 语言引导的 3D 场景放置缺乏合适的基准，且一条指令定义的是一块可接受放置区域而非单一坐标，现有评估方式可能不匹配这种语义；需要一个能检验关系与物理约束的评估协议。
Method: 构建 ReRef-3D 基准，并提供基于关系重计算 (recompute relations) 的评估方法：将模型预测插入场景后重新检查关系是否满足以及物理有效性；同时为每条指令提供验证过的自然化改写 (naturalized rewrite) 以研究措辞影响。
Result: 在微调设置下，LLaVA-3D、3D-LLM 和 PlaceIt3D 的有效放置率分别为 68.3%、31.6% 和 22.4%；各模型的关系满足度均高于物理有效性，nearest 与 between 这类关系最难，而措辞变化对性能影响很小。
Conclusion: ReRef-3D 为语言引导的 3D 场景重排提供了新的基准与评估协议，并显示当前模型在该任务上仍有明显提升空间，尤其是物理有效性与困难关系的处理。

papers.title: Breaking the Compression Barrier: Cross-Architecture Compression Boundary Learning via Reverse Regrowth
papers.abstract_en: Model compression is critical for deploying networks on resource-constrained edge devices. While pruning-based methods can significantly reduce model size, they often suffer from abrupt performance collapse beyond a sparsity thresh-old, making it difficult to identify the feasible compression limit of the model. To address this challenge, we propose a boundary-Learning reverse regrowth framework, BRIDGE, that reformulates compression as a constructive boundary-search problem. Unlike forward pruning, our method first drives the model to an extremely sparse state to expose the collapse region, and then selectively regenerates the critical structure to restore performance. The proposed framework employs a hierarchical regeneration strategy, including coarse-grained layer selection and fine-grained regeneration parameter selection, to accurately identify which parameters require recovery. Experiments show that our method can recover models from the brink of collapse on both CNNs and Transformer architectures, demonstrating its architecture in-dependence. BRIDGE achieves a performance improvement of up to 1.49% in unstructured pruning and up to 4.77% in structured pruning. These results demonstrate that reverse regeneration can effectively extend the compression limit while maintaining stable performance. The source code is available at https://github.com/EnumaCaliber/BRIDGE.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code available at https://github.com/EnumaCaliber/BRIDGE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BRIDGE，一个边界学习反向再生长框架，将模型压缩重新表述为构造性边界搜索问题：先把模型驱动到极度稀疏状态以暴露性能崩塌区域，再有选择地再生长关键结构来恢复性能。框架采用分层再生长策略，包括粗粒度层选择和细粒度再生长参数选择。实验表明该方法在 CNN 和 Transformer 架构上均能从崩塌边缘恢复模型，非结构化剪枝最高提升 1.49%，结构化剪枝最高提升 4.77%。
Motivation: 基于剪枝的压缩方法在超过一定稀疏度阈值后常出现突然的性能崩塌，导致难以确定模型可行的压缩极限，这限制了网络在资源受限边缘设备上的部署。
Method: 提出 BRIDGE 反向再生长框架，与正向剪枝相反，先让模型进入极度稀疏状态以暴露崩塌区，再通过分层再生策略（粗粒度层选择加细粒度再生长参数选择）精准识别并恢复需要重建的参数。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 CNN 和 Transformer 架构上都能从崩塌边缘恢复模型，非结构化剪枝性能最高提升 1.49%，结构化剪枝最高提升 4.77%，并体现出架构无关性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调反向再生长可以有效扩展压缩极限并保持稳定性能，且源代码已公开。

papers.title: Spatial Temporal Synergy: Balancing Change and Invariance in Text Driven 3D Human Motion Editing
papers.abstract_en: Text-driven human motion editing aims to modify existing motion sequences according to natural language instructions while maintaining the structural consistency of the original motion. Existing diffusion-based approaches struggle to balance text-responsive "change" and inertial "invariance". They often rely on coarse spatial constraints and rigid uniform time assumptions, leading to spatial motion distortions and the destruction of intrinsic physical rhythms during variable-length editing. To handle these challenges, we propose Change and Invariance Motion Editing (CIME), a unified framework that comprehensively decouples change and invariance into spatial pose and temporal rhythm dimensions. For spatial poses, our method integrates an omni-supervised positive-negative learning mechanism comprising hierarchical retrospective feature supervision, subtle motion preservation, and triplet-based semantic alignment. For temporal rhythms, we introduce the Riemannian Non-uniform Integral Manifold Mapping (RNIMM) module, which achieves high-fidelity reproduction of physical beats in the edited text via kinematics-aware non-uniform timestamps. Extensive experiments on the MotionFix and STANCE Adjustment datasets demonstrate that CIME achieves state-of-the-art performance in editing alignment and structural fidelity, validating the effectiveness of our unified architecture. Our source codes and models have been released at: github.com/ZhenwuShi/CIME.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本驱动 3D 人体动作编辑中“变化”与“不变性”的平衡问题，提出统一框架 CIME（Change and Invariance Motion Editing），将变化与不变性解耦到空间姿态和时序节奏两个维度。空间上采用全监督的正负学习机制，时序上提出黎曼非均匀积分流形映射（RNIMM）模块，以保真地复现编辑文本中的物理节拍。实验在 MotionFix 和 STANCE Adjustment 数据集上达到编辑对齐与结构保真方面的最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的方法难以在文本响应性的“变化”与惯性“不变性”之间取得平衡，常依赖粗糙的空间约束和刚性均匀时间假设，导致空间动作畸变并破坏变长编辑中固有的物理节奏。
Method: 提出 CIME 框架，将变化与不变性全面解耦为空间姿态与时间节奏两维。空间姿态上整合包含层次回溯特征监督、细微运动保持和三元组语义对齐的全监督正负学习机制；时间节奏上引入 RNIMM 模块，通过运动学感知的非均匀时间戳实现编辑文本中物理节拍的高保真复现。
Result: 在 MotionFix 和 STANCE Adjustment 两个数据集上的大量实验表明，CIME 在编辑对齐和结构保真方面取得了当前最佳（state-of-the-art）性能。
Conclusion: 摘要认为统一架构有效，并已公开源代码与模型（github.com/ZhenwuShi/CIME.git）。该工作面向人体动作编辑，与给定的气象降水、临近预报等关键词无直接关联。

papers.title: Retrieval-guided Twin Fusion with Similarity-aware Contrast for Molecule-Text Alignment
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the problem of molecule-text alignment, which aims to project molecules and their textual descriptions into a joint latent space for downstream tasks including molecule search and molecular property prediction. Previous approaches typically combine graph structure mining with contrastive learning to enhance joint representation learning. However, they typically neglect fine-grained semantic relationships between substructures and texts, leading to suboptimal performance on downstream tasks. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Retrieval-guided Twin Fusion with Similarity-aware Contrast (RISEN) for molecule-text alignment. The core idea of RISEN is to construct a latent twin molecule for each substructure with cross-modal retrieval for semantic enhancement. In particular, for each substructure query, we retrieve relevant textual descriptions and sample several molecules that share similar descriptions of substructures. Then, we aggregate their representations via attention pooling for a twin latent representation, which would be further fused with the original substructure for representation enrichment. In addition, we measure the similarity across substructures and texts, which would further guide cross-modal contrastive learning with soft thresholding. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets validate the superiority of the proposed RISEN in comparison with existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分子-文本对齐 (molecule-text alignment)，提出名为 RISEN 的方法，核心是为每个子结构通过跨模态检索构造潜在孪生分子表示，并与原始子结构融合以丰富语义；同时用子结构与文本间的相似度指导带软阈值的跨模态对比学习。摘要在基准数据集上报告了相对现有基线更优的性能。
Motivation: 已有方法通常将图结构挖掘与对比学习结合来学习联合表示，但忽视了子结构与文本之间的细粒度语义关系，导致下游任务性能次优。
Method: 提出 RISEN：对每个子结构查询检索相关文本描述并采样共享相似子结构描述的分子，通过注意力池化聚合得到孪生潜在表示，再与原始子结构融合；此外度量子结构与文本的相似度，用于以软阈值方式指导跨模态对比学习。
Result: 摘要在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，RISEN 相较于现有基线具有优越性，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为通过检索增强的孪生融合和相似度感知对比能够改进分子-文本对齐，适用于分子搜索和分子性质预测等下游任务；未提及明显局限。

papers.title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency
papers.abstract_en: Automated checking pipelines increasingly place one language model as the checker and another (or the same one) as the fixer. We ask whether that wiring changes what the checker reports. Measuring false alarms on human-verified-correct ProcessBench traces with the present task held byte-identical, we find that a completed audit -> repair episode already in the model's context lowers false alarms in 15 of 15 model x wording combinations, by 2.8 to 11.5 percentage points against a length-matched non-audit control, a 9 to 25% reduction relative to that control. The direction contradicts what the accumulated-message literature predicts: an episode whose audit reported an error lowers false alarms further still, at all five wordings on the model where that manipulation lands cleanly, though a negativity asymmetry predicts more flagging. Decomposing the episode finds repair content and audit verdict complementary: different components carry the effect on different model families. Signal-detection analysis locates the change in the threshold rather than in discrimination -- the criterion moves in 15 of 15 combinations and survives correction in 13 while d' survives in none, though the d' test is half as sensitive by construction -- and a hand audit of 50 false alarms finds 82% simply wrong, so at this operating point the shift need not be harmful. With reasoning enabled the effect keeps its relative size on both models tested, and the threshold reading holds there too.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code and analysis artefacts: https://github.com/parsa-mz/crtitxer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将语言模型用作检查者、另一个（或同一个）模型用作修复者的自动化检查流水线，考察上下文中已有的审计-修复情节是否会改变检查者报告行为。在人工验证正确的 ProcessBench 轨迹上，以字节相同的当前任务衡量误报，发现已完成的审计→修复情节在 15/15 的模型×措辞组合中降低误报 2.8 到 11.5 个百分点，相对长度匹配的非审计对照减少 9% 到 25%。信号检测分析表明变化主要发生在判断阈值而非判别能力上，且手工审查 50 个误报发现 82% 确实判错。
Motivation: 自动化检查流水线日益普遍地让一个 LLM 充当检查者、另一个充当修复者，但这种接线本身可能影响检查者报告的内容；作者希望系统验证先前的审计-修复情节是否改变检查者的误报率。
Method: 通过控制实验比较长度匹配的非审计对照与已完成的审计→修复情节在上下文中的效果，覆盖多种模型和措辞组合；并将情节分解为修复内容与审计裁决，使用信号检测分析（signal-detection analysis）区分判断阈值变化与判别能力变化。
Result: 误报降低在 15/15 个模型×措辞组合中出现，降幅为 2.8 至 11.5 个百分点（相对对照降低 9% 至 25%）；报告错误的审计情节进一步降低误报（在测试模型的全部 5 种措辞下均如此）。阈值测量（criterion）在 15/15 组合中移动，并在 13 个组合中通过校正检验，而 d' 没有显著变化；50 个误报的手工审计中有 82% 是纯粹判错。启用推理后效果在相对大小上保持不变。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，上下文中已有的审计-修复情节会把 LLM 验证者的判断阈值移向宽容方向，方向与累积式消息（accumulated-message）文献的预测相反；修复内容与审计裁决的作用互补，变化定位于阈值而非判别能力。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: From Sequence to Structure: Relational Uncertainty Propagation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying large language model (LLM) agents in complex interactive environments. Existing UQ methods largely rely on local signals, such as token probabilities, predictive entropy, or per-step confidence, and therefore overlook the long-range dependencies through which errors accumulate across an execution trajectory. As a result, they may fail to identify agent failures whose causes originate several reasoning or interaction steps before the final answer. We propose RUPA (Relational Uncertainty Propagation for Agents), a trajectory-level UQ framework for LLM agents. RUPA represents an execution history as a directed trajectory graph in which reasoning states, tool interactions, and environment feedback are nodes connected by temporal and semantic dependency edges. It then propagates uncertainty over this graph to capture how execution risk accumulates and transfers across interaction steps. The propagated signal is combined with trajectory-level behavioral features and goal-alignment information to produce a confidence estimate for the full agent trajectory. We evaluate RUPA on representative agent benchmarks, including $τ$-2, Terminal-Bench-2, and GAIA, using 6 open-source LLMs spanning multiple model families. Experimental results show that RUPA consistently outperforms existing UQ methods by providing more accurate uncertainty estimates, enabling earlier failure detection, and improving uncertainty-guided agent execution across diverse agent tasks. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling relational dependency is crucial to reliable UQ for long-horizon LLM agents, providing a practical foundation for trustworthy agent execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RUPA（Relational Uncertainty Propagation for Agents），一种面向 LLM agent 的轨迹级不确定性量化框架。RUPA 将执行历史建模为有向轨迹图，在图上传播不确定性以捕获长程依赖，并结合轨迹级行为特征与目标对齐信息估计整条轨迹的置信度。作者在 τ-2、Terminal-Bench-2 和 GAIA 等基准上、使用 6 个开源 LLM 进行评测，结果显示 RUPA 在不确定性估计准确性、早期失败检测和不确定性引导执行上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有不确定性量化（UQ）方法主要依赖局部信号，如 token 概率、预测熵或逐步置信度，忽略了错误沿执行轨迹积累的长程依赖，因此难以识别根因发生在最终答案之前若干推理或交互步骤的 agent 失败。
Method: RUPA 将执行历史表示为有向轨迹图，节点为推理状态、工具交互和环境反馈，边为时间与语义依赖关系；随后在此图上传播不确定性，并将传播信号与轨迹级行为特征及目标对齐信息结合，生成整条 agent 轨迹的置信度估计。
Result: 在 τ-2、Terminal-Bench-2 和 GAIA 上使用 6 个来自多个模型家族的开源 LLM 进行实验，RUPA 一致优于现有 UQ 方法，提供更准确的不确定性估计、更早的失败检测，并改进不确定性引导的 agent 执行。
Conclusion: 作者强调，显式建模关系依赖对长程 LLM agent 的可靠 UQ 至关重要，这项工作为可信 agent 执行提供了实用基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MUPA$^{2}$E: Multimodal Unified Perception with Asymmetric Attention for Emotion Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Automatic emotion assessment can benefit from combining neural and behavioral signals, but many multimodal approaches rely on separate, modality-specific feature-extraction pipelines before fusion. This paper presents MUPA\textsuperscript{2}E, a unified perception framework that processes facial video and electroencephalography (EEG) through a single shared asymmetric-attention backbone. Facial video is represented through axis-folded frame tokens, while EEG is processed either as a raw multichannel waveform or projected into the spatial domain for multimodal fusion. The framework is evaluated on the DMER dataset under a stratified subject-independent protocol, comparing unimodal video, unimodal EEG, and fused video--EEG configurations with per-channel and merged EEG projections. Using the original recordings, with shorter trials zero-padded to match the longest duration, merged fusion at stride~$30$ achieves the highest validation performance and a test accuracy of $70.07\%$. Further analysis revealed that recording duration is unevenly distributed across the affective classes, making the padding pattern a potential classification cue. Controlling for this factor by cropping all recordings to a common duration of $20$ seconds yielded a test accuracy of $62.71\%$, providing a stricter duration-controlled assessment of the framework in which differences in recording length are removed as a potential classification cue. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of processing structurally different neural and visual signals within a compact unified architecture while highlighting the importance of controlling duration-related cues in affective datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MUPA$^{2}$E，一种统一感知框架，通过单个共享的非对称注意力骨干 (asymmetric-attention backbone) 同时处理面部视频和脑电 (EEG) 信号用于自动情感评估。面部视频用轴折叠帧令牌表示，EEG 既可以原始多通道波形输入，也可投影到空间域进行多模态融合。在 DMER 数据集上采用分层 subject-independent 协议评估，原始录音下合并融合 (merged fusion) 在 stride 30 时取得最高验证性能和 70.07% 的测试准确率；将全部录音裁剪为统一 20 秒时长以控制录音时长的潜在分类线索后，测试准确率为 62.71%。
Motivation: 自动情感评估可受益于神经与行为信号的结合，但现有许多多模态方法在融合前依赖各自的、模态特定的特征提取流水线，缺乏紧凑统一的处理框架。
Method: 提出 MUPA$^{2}$E，将面部视频与 EEG 输入同一个共享的非对称注意力骨干；视频用轴折叠帧令牌表示，EEG 可作原始多通道波形或投影到空间域，支持视频、EEG 单模态及融合配置，并对比逐通道与合并式 EEG 投影。
Result: 在 DMER 数据集上，原始录音中 stride 30 的合并融合达到最高验证性能与 70.07% 测试准确率；将全部试次裁剪到统一 20 秒时长后测试准确率为 62.71%，说明录音时长分布不均会作为潜在分类线索影响结果。
Conclusion: 结果表明结构不同的神经与视觉信号可在紧凑统一架构中处理，但情感数据集中时长相关线索需要被控制，否则会污染评估。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 MUPA$^{2}$E，一种统一感知框架，通过单个共享的非对称注意力骨干 (asymmetric-attention backbone) 同时处理面部视频和脑电 (EEG) 信号用于自动情感评估。面部视频用轴折叠帧令牌表示，EEG 既可以原始多通道波形输入，也可投影到空间域进行多模态融合。在 DMER 数据集上采用分层 subject-independent 协议评估，原始录音下合并融合 (merged fusion) 在 stride 30 时取得最高验证性能和 70.07% 的测试准确率；将全部录音裁剪为统一 20 秒时长以控制录音时长的潜在分类线索后，测试准确率为 62.71%。

summary_sections.method: 提出 MUPA$^{2}$E，将面部视频与 EEG 输入同一个共享的非对称注意力骨干；视频用轴折叠帧令牌表示，EEG 可作原始多通道波形或投影到空间域，支持视频、EEG 单模态及融合配置，并对比逐通道与合并式 EEG 投影。

papers.title: Toward Optimal Second-Order Path-Length Guarantee for Adversarial Multi-Armed Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study second-order path-length regret in adversarial $K$-armed bandits against oblivious loss sequences. Bubeck et al. [2019] designed an algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K+\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,1}})$ regret, where $Q_{\infty,1}$ is the first-order path length, and left open whether $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\text{poly}(K)\sqrt{1+Q_{\infty,2}})$ regret is achievable under bandit feedback, where $Q_{\infty,2}$ is the second-order path length. Somewhat surprisingly, we resolve this question positively by showing that with a more involved analysis, the exact same algorithm of Bubeck et al. [2019] achieves $\mathcal{O}\left(K\log(KT)+\sqrt{K\log(KT)\bigl(1+Q_{\infty,2}\bigr)}\right)$ expected regret when $Q_{\infty,2}$ is known, where $T$ is the horizon. This matches the $Ω(\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,2}})$ lower bound up to logarithmic factors and additive terms. We further remove the knowledge of $Q_{\infty,2}$ using an adaptive restart scheme whose path-length estimator has uniformly bounded increments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究对抗性 K 臂老虎机在 oblivious 损失序列下的二阶路径长度 (second-order path-length) regret。作者令人意外地证明，Bubeck 等人 [2019] 的同一算法经过更精细的分析即可达到近似最优的二阶路径长度 regret：在 Q∞,2 已知时得到 O(K log(KT)+√(K log(KT)(1+Q∞,2))) 期望 regret，匹配 Ω(√(KQ∞,2)) 下界（差对数与加性项）；随后用自适应重启方案去掉对 Q∞,2 的依赖，其路径长度估计量具有一致有界增量。
Motivation: 此前 Bubeck 等人 [2019] 的算法只给出依赖一阶路径长度 Q∞,1 的 regret 界，并在 bandit 反馈下留下一个开放问题：能否实现 Õ(poly(K)√(1+Q∞,2)) 这种依赖二阶路径长度的最优 bound。
Method: 沿用 Bubeck 等人 [2019] 的原始算法，仅通过更复杂的分析来证明其二阶路径长度性质；对于未知的 Q∞,2，则设计一个自适应重启方案，其路径长度估计量具有一致有界的增量，从而消除对 Q∞,2 的事先知晓。
Result: 当 Q∞,2 已知时，同一算法达到 O(K log(KT)+√(K log(KT)(1+Q∞,2))) 的期望 regret，与 Ω(√(KQ∞,2)) 下界在 log 因子和加性项内匹配；摘要还报告自适应重启方案能在未知 Q∞,2 时继续成立。
Conclusion: 摘要明确肯定地回答了二阶路径长度 regret 在 bandit 反馈下是否可达的开放问题，且无需更换算法即可获得最优界；自适应重启方案进一步去掉了对路径长度的先验知识。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Varying Physical Therapist-Patient Interactions for Robot-mediated Upper Limb Task-Specific Training
authors: The University of Melbourne (2) Melbourne School of Health Sciences
papers.abstract_en: Upper extremity motor function recovery is positively linked to Task-Specific Training (TST) and sufficient therapy dosage. Rehabilitation robots can increase TST dosage via controlled, repetitive treatment and free therapists to simultaneously manage other patients, but it has yet to demonstrate significant benefits over conventional treatment. This is potentially linked to inaccurate robotic representation of personalised physical therapist-patient interaction and lack of practice variability during TST. Hence, we advocate for robotic interventions that preserve the personalised physical therapist-patient interactions when delivering TST for patients across varying practise conditions. We propose a Learning-from-Demonstration framework using Task-Parameterised Gaussian Mixture Models (TPGMM) to learn personalised physical therapist-patient interaction in Task-Specific exercises, mapping patient joint kinematics to therapist-applied torques using few demonstrations. The model is generalised to reconstruct therapist torques in new task variations. The framework was evaluated on physical interactions from 14 mock "therapist-patient" pairs over three tasks of increasing complexity, each with six variations. A benchmark comparison against a Look-Up Table was conducted. The results show both methods reproducing interactions in unseen task variations that deviate slightly from the actual interaction, with TPGMM slightly outperforming LUT. Both methods reproduced interactions that gets increasingly closer to the actual interaction as task complexity increases.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables Submitted to:IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于学习示范 (Learning-from-Demonstration) 的框架，使用任务参数化高斯混合模型 (TPGMM) 学习康复机器人中个性化的物理治疗师-患者交互，将患者关节运动学映射到治疗师施加的扭矩，并仅用少量示范泛化到新的任务变体。研究在 14 对模拟“治疗师-患者”、三个复杂度递增的任务（各含六种变体）上评估，并与查表法 (Look-Up Table) 进行对比。结果显示两种方法都能在未见任务变体上重建交互，但与实际交互略有偏差，TPGMM 略优于 LUT，且任务复杂度越高，重建结果越接近实际交互。
Motivation: 上肢运动功能恢复与任务专项训练 (TST) 及足够的训练剂量正相关，康复机器人可增加 TST 剂量，但相比传统治疗尚未展现显著优势，可能原因是机器人未能准确表征个性化的治疗师-患者交互，且 TST 缺乏练习变异性 (practice variability)。
Method: 提出基于 TPGMM 的 Learning-from-Demonstration 框架，用少量示范学习个性化物理治疗师-患者交互，建立从患者关节运动学到治疗师施加扭矩的映射，并将模型泛化到新的任务变体以重建治疗师扭矩。
Result: 在 14 对模拟“治疗师-患者”配对、三个复杂度递增的任务（每个任务六种变体）上，TPGMM 与 Look-Up Table 均能在未见任务变体上复现交互，偏差较小；TPGMM 略优于 LUT，且当任务复杂度增加时，两种方法重建的交互都越来越接近实际交互。
Conclusion: 作者主张在提供 TST 时保留个性化的物理治疗师-患者交互，所提框架验证了用少量示范学习并在新任务变体中重建这种交互的可行性，但重建结果仍与实际交互存在轻微偏差。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Plug-and-Play 2D Motion Interface for Real-World Motion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Motion Language Models (MoLMs) typically understand human motions by tokenizing 3D motion and processing the resulting tokens using a language model. However, obtaining accurate 3D motions from monocular videos is challenging, limiting their real-world applicability. To address this issue, we introduce a plug-and-play 2D Motion Interface that enables 3D-pretrained MoLMs to accept 2D motion inputs without modifying or fine-tuning the original models. Experiments on public datasets show that our method achieves performance comparable to 3D motion inputs across multiple MoLMs and outperforms training MoLMs from scratch on 2D motions. We further construct a monocular real-world video motion evaluation dataset and introduce a real-video adapter, demonstrating the usefulness of 2D motions over 3D motions under the evaluated monocular pose-estimation setting. These results suggest that 2D motion provides a practical interface for deploying MoLMs in real-world motion understanding settings. Code is available at https://github.com/irajisamurai/2D-Motion-Interface.
papers.comment: Accepted to HCMIW at ECCV 2026 (Oral Presentation). Code and demo: https://github.com/irajisamurai/2D-Motion-Interface
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种即插即用的 2D Motion Interface，使 3D 预训练的运动语言模型（MoLM）无需修改或微调即可直接接受 2D 运动输入。公共数据集实验显示，该方法在多种 MoLM 上达到与 3D 运动输入相当的性能，并优于从头在 2D 运动上训练的 MoLM。作者还构建了单目真实视频评估数据集并引入真实视频适配器，表明在评估的单目姿态估计设置下 2D 运动比 3D 运动更实用。
Motivation: MoLM 通常通过将 3D 运动 token 化并交给语言模型处理来理解动作，但从单目视频获取准确的 3D 运动非常困难，这限制了 MoLM 在真实场景中的可用性。
Method: 提出一个即插即用的 2D Motion Interface，不改动也不微调原有 3D 预训练 MoLM，即可让其接受 2D 运动输入；此外构建了单目真实世界视频运动评估数据集，并提出一个真实视频适配器（real-video adapter）。
Result: 在公开数据集上，该方法与 3D 运动输入的性能相当，且优于从零开始在 2D 运动上训练的 MoLM；在所评估的单目姿态估计设定下，2D 运动展现出优于 3D 运动的效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 2D 运动为在真实世界运动理解场景中部署 MoLM 提供了一种实用接口。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Operator-Theoretic Generalization Bounds for Multitask Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: We develop operator-theoretic generalization bounds for deep multi-output function classes by representing network layers as Koopman composition operators on vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. In vector-valued Sobolev RKHSs, we derive Rademacher complexity bounds for invertible and width-expanding injective architectures. The estimates separate the output-coupling contribution, represented by the trace of the task matrix, from the layerwise operator norms, Sobolev symbol ratios, determinant factors, and restriction constants generated by the linear maps. We then analyze a distinct one-dimensional Brownian/Cameron--Martin regime. Using the exact anchored derivative-norm characterization of the vector-valued Brownian RKHS, we obtain layerwise bounds for domain-preserving scalar linear maps and anchored diffeomorphic activations; the corresponding factors scale as $|W_l|^{1/2}$ and $\|σ_l'\|_\infty^{1/2}$, respectively, and do not involve Sobolev smoothness exponents. Because the Sobolev and Brownian results concern different hypothesis spaces, neither is asserted to dominate the other uniformly. We additionally formulate shared operator learning across tasks, prove a finite-rank representer theorem, derive the exact finite-dimensional problem for squared loss, and establish a target-transfer bound when the learned operator is obtained independently of the target sample. Synthetic and MNIST studies examine stabilized Sobolev-inspired and Brownian-inspired complexity proxies; these empirical proxies are not evaluations of the proved bounds for rank-deficient architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发展了一套面向深度多输出函数类的算子理论泛化界：将网络层表示为向量值再生核希尔伯特空间 (vector-valued RKHS) 上的 Koopman 复合算子。作者在向量值 Sobolev RKHS 中推导了可逆与宽度扩张单射架构的 Rademacher 复杂度界，并在独立的 Brownian/Cameron–Martin 情形下给出逐层界；此外还提出共享算子学习、有限秩表示定理与目标迁移界。合成数据与 MNIST 实验仅考察了经稳定化的复杂度代理，并非对所证界在亏秩架构上的直接评估。
Motivation: 现有深度学习泛化界很少从算子理论角度刻画多任务/多输出架构中输出耦合与逐层结构的作用，论文旨在填补这一理论缺口。
Method: 将网络层表示为向量值 RKHS 上的 Koopman 复合算子；在 Sobolev 与 Brownian 两种假设空间下分别推导 Rademacher 复杂度界。Sobolev 界将输出耦合贡献（任务矩阵的迹）与逐层算子范数、Sobolev 符号比、行列式因子和限制常数分离；Brownian 情形则利用向量值 Brownian RKHS 的精确锚定导数范数刻画，得到作用于保域标量线性映射与锚定微分同胚激活的逐层界。论文还形式化了跨任务共享算子学习，证明有限秩表示定理，导出平方损失下的精确有限维问题，并在学习算子独立于目标样本时建立目标迁移界。
Result: Sobolev 框架下得到分离输出耦合项与逐层项的 Rademacher 界；Brownian 框架下对应因子分别按 |W_l|^{1/2} 和 ‖σ_l'‖_∞^{1/2} 缩放，且不涉及 Sobolev 光滑性指数。合成与 MNIST 研究考察了 Sobolev 启发与 Brownian 启发的稳定性复杂度代理，但这些代理不是对亏秩架构所证界的直接评估。
Conclusion: 作者明确指出 Sobolev 与 Brownian 结果针对不同的假设空间，因此不主张其中任何一个在一切情形下一致占优；实证部分仅提供经稳定化的复杂度代理，而非对所证界本身的验证。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.result: Sobolev 框架下得到分离输出耦合项与逐层项的 Rademacher 界；Brownian 框架下对应因子分别按 |W_l|^{1/2} 和 ‖σ_l'‖_∞^{1/2} 缩放，且不涉及 Sobolev 光滑性指数。合成与 MNIST 研究考察了 Sobolev 启发与 Brownian 启发的稳定性复杂度代理，但这些代理不是对亏秩架构所证界的直接评估。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者明确指出 Sobolev 与 Brownian 结果针对不同的假设空间，因此不主张其中任何一个在一切情形下一致占优；实证部分仅提供经稳定化的复杂度代理，而非对所证界本身的验证。

papers.title: Whose Gold? Annotator-Pool Disagreement Is Large at the Item Level, and Hidden by Small Leaderboards
papers.abstract_en: Preference benchmarks are built by hiring annotators, and the identity of those annotators is treated as an implementation detail. We measure what that detail buys. On the 2,885 MultiPref items where both pools are internally unanimous, so no tie-breaking convention is consulted at all, expert and crowd annotators assign a different majority label to 23.6% and name the opposite winner on 9.2%; on the 246 comparably unanimous MT-Bench cells, benchmark authors and recruited experts differ on 30.5% and reverse on 8.5%. Yet on both corpora the resulting model leaderboards are bit-identical: Kendall tau = 1.00 with zero of six models displaced. That invariance is far weaker evidence than it looks, and we quantify how weak. Switching pools moves a model's win rate by 1.9pp (SD), one adjacent pair in our own leaderboard sits 0.8pp apart and had a 38% chance of swapping, and an item-level bootstrap displaces at least one model in 28% of resamples. The observed zero is the common outcome, not a property of aggregation: on the same measured perturbation, a ten-model leaderboard is displaced with probability 0.86 and a twenty-model leaderboard with probability 0.9997. Reporting a six-model leaderboard is safe; the safety does not generalise, and everything that consumes labels per item is not safe at any size. We make the distinction precise, show that a widely used dataset's stated assumption of no intra-group annotator variability is false, and show that an LLM judge tracks the crowd pool over the expert pool on all three models we test, including one from a different vendor. All code, per-call outputs, and pre-registered decision rules will be released upon acceptance.
papers.comment: Submitted to the HAIC workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究偏好基准中标注者池身份对标注结果的影响，基于 MultiPref 和 MT-Bench 数据测量专家与大众标注者在项目层面的一致性。摘要报告两组标注者在内部一致的子集上仍有 23.6% 和 30.5% 的多数标签分歧、9.2% 和 8.5% 的胜者反转，但六模型排行榜完全不变（Kendall tau = 1.00）。作者指出这种排行榜不变性是弱证据，池切换会使模型胜率变化约 1.9pp，且十模型和二十模型排行榜被置换的概率分别为 0.86 和 0.9997。
Motivation: 偏好基准通过雇佣标注者构建，但标注者身份被视为实现细节；论文旨在量化这一细节对标注一致性和模型排行榜稳健性的影响，并指出仅报告小规模排行榜会掩盖项目层面的分歧。
Method: 作者在 MultiPref 和 MT-Bench 上选取两个池内部达成一致的条目，比较专家与大众标注者的多数标签和胜者；通过池切换、项目级 bootstrap 以及不同规模排行榜的置换概率来量化影响；还测试了 LLM 评判者对两个池的跟随倾向。
Result: 在内部一致的 MultiPref 条目上，专家与大众标注者分歧 23.6%、胜者反转 9.2%；MT-Bench 上分别为 30.5% 和 8.5%。六模型排行榜位序完全相同，但切换池使模型胜率移动 1.9pp，item-level bootstrap 在 28% 的重采样中至少置换一个模型；十模型排行榜置换概率 0.86，二十模型为 0.9997。LLM 评判者在所有三个测试模型上更跟随大众池而非专家池。
Conclusion: 报告小规模六模型排行榜的不变性是常见结果而非聚合性质的保证，安全性不能推广到更大排行榜或任何逐项消费标签的场景；论文还反驳了某常用数据集关于组内标注者无变异的假设。

papers.title: ALPS: Measuring Valid Creativity in Large Language Models with Mathematical Construction
papers.abstract_en: Large language models produce outputs presented as discoveries - new proofs, conjectures, or molecules. Whether such an output that appears creative is truly original and effective is hard to establish: open-ended outputs require subjective judgment, the output may replicate something seen in training, or the task may be too simple to need creativity. We present ALPS (Austin-Law Proof-Synthesis), a benchmark that designs a task to measure valid creativity: producing a solution that is original and can be proven correct. Each instance is a single equational law, certified to require either the construction of an infinite mathematical structure satisfying the law, or a proof that no such structure exists. Submissions are verified by automated proof checking with no human involvement, and a public generator produces new instances without limit, so LLMs are never evaluated on problems they may have seen. A portfolio of eight configurations of leading automated provers resolves 2.2% of the 4,141-law evaluation pool, and a twentyfold budget increase adds 0.6%: the obstacle is not compute, but the absence of any method that produces the tailored structure each law requires. Under a fixed protocol, the strongest reasoning model we test succeeds in 14% of instances on the proof side, but none on the construction side. The remaining 97.2% of the pool is unresolved at every configuration and budget we test. We release ALPS in full: the corpus, the generator, and the automated judge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ALPS (Austin-Law Proof-Synthesis) 基准，用于衡量大语言模型的“有效创造性”：要求为单个等式定律构造满足该定律的无限数学结构，或证明不存在这样的结构。提交通过自动证明检查验证，无人工参与；公共生成器可无限生成新实例，避免训练数据污染。在 4141 条定律的评估池中，八种主流自动证明器配置仅解决 2.2%，二十倍预算增加仅提升 0.6%；最强推理模型在证明侧成功 14%，构造侧为 0，其余 97.2% 未解决。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 创造性评估依赖主观判断，且输出可能复现训练数据或任务过于简单，难以判定“真正原创且有效”的输出。
Method: 设计 ALPS 基准，每个实例是一个等式定律，要求构造满足该定律的无限数学结构或证明不存在；用自动证明检查器验证，并发布公共生成器持续生成新实例。
Result: 在 4141 条定律池中，八种自动证明器配置解决 2.2%，二十倍预算增加仅加 0.6%；最强推理模型在证明侧成功 14%，构造侧 0，97.2% 未解决。
Conclusion: 摘要强调障碍不是算力，而是缺少能生成每一定律所需定制结构的方法；ALPS 全部开源（语料、生成器、自动裁判）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fiber Fingerprints of Hidden Learning-State Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: A learning system can occupy execution states that are indistinguishable under every declared present-behavior readout yet respond differently to future training. We formalize this through fiber fingerprints: controlled future-learning response laws restricted to present-behavior equivalence classes. Prefix-compatible finite probes induce a predictive quotient functor, a Nerode-type minimal recursively sufficient representation, and a canonical set-level predictive fiber without assuming smoothness, reversibility, finite rank, or a manifold. Under an explicit finite-dimensional Hilbert realization, response decomposes into visible, visible-mode-reuse, and irreducible-new sectors; a history-reachability bridge retains only distinctions generated by natural training histories. Conditional mechanism results then identify a graph-Hodge chronology decomposition, a regular switching class with root-mean-square scale $\sqrt{p}η^{3/2}$ and finite-scale corrections, and an exact Adam moment section whose immediate adaptive field is constant while common future gradients can reveal hidden moment differences. Frozen Transformer--LoRA--AdamW studies with Qwen2.5-7B and Mistral-7B-v0.3 support a local action backbone, longer-horizon first-return non-closure, and fresh visible-relative completion with output-range reuse and a low-rank irreducible sector. Stronger claims remain bounded by preregistered negative or mixed results: re-anchored transport is unresolved above its measurement floor; the strict finite-grid Hodge--$3/2$ conjunction is unmet despite prospective contraction; Qwen accessibility is not established in the frozen raw moment chart; and Mistral revelation is future-context dependent rather than bank invariant. Within these support-, scale-, metric-, and context-resolved boundaries, present behavior is not a sufficient statistic for declared future learning.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Ancillary files include figure-reproducibility code and frozen plot-level data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“纤维指纹”(fiber fingerprints) 来刻画学习系统中在一切声明的当前行为读取下不可区分、但对未来训练响应不同的执行状态。作者建立了前缀兼容有限探测诱导的预测商函子 (predictive quotient functor)、Nerode 型最小递归充分表示，以及不依赖光滑性、可逆性、有限秩或流形假设的规范集合层预测纤维。在显式有限维 Hilbert 实现下，响应被分解为可见、可见模态复用和不可约新三个扇区；条件机制结果进一步给出图-Hodge 时间序列分解、均方根尺度为 sqrt(p)η^{3/2} 的正则切换类以及精确 Adam 矩截面。实验基于 Qwen2.5-7B 和 Mistral-7B-v0.3 的冻结 Transformer–LoRA–AdamW 设置，支持局部作用骨架、长时首次返回非闭合等结论，同时受限于预注册的负面或混合结果。
Motivation: 现有学习系统即使在所有声明的当前行为读取下状态不可区分，仍可能对未来训练产生不同响应，意味着当前行为不足以作为未来学习的充分统计量。作者希望形式化这一隐藏学习状态动态，并给出不需要光滑性、可逆性或有限秩等强假设的严格框架。
Method: 通过纤维指纹形式化“当前行为等价类上受控的未来学习响应律”；引入前缀兼容有限探测诱导的预测商函子、Nerode 型最小递归充分表示和规范集合层预测纤维。在有限维 Hilbert 实现下将响应分解为可见、可见模态复用和不可约新扇区，并借历史可达性桥保留仅由自然训练历史产生的区分。条件机制层面得到图-Hodge 时间序列分解、正则切换类的尺度行为以及精确 Adam 矩截面。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B 和 Mistral-7B-v0.3 的冻结 Transformer–LoRA–AdamW 实验中，摘要报告支持局部作用骨架、更长时域的首次返回非闭合，以及带输出范围复用和低秩不可约扇区的新可见相对补全。同时预注册的负面或混合结果显示：重新锚定传输未超过测量下限、严格有限网格 Hodge–3/2 联合条件未满足、Qwen 可获得性在冻结原始矩图中未确立、Mistral 的揭示依赖未来上下文而非银行不变性。
Conclusion: 作者强调，在支持、尺度、度量和上下文均已解析的边界内，当前行为不是所声明未来学习的充分统计量；更强的结论被预注册的负面或混合结果所约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Scalable Pipeline for LLM-Teacher Distillation Labeling: Work-Stealing Job Scheduling and Memory-Aware GPU Concurrency
papers.abstract_en: Labeling large text corpora with LLM teachers has become a practical route to training data at scale. At millions of items, hand-labeling every batch is not feasible, and two questions dominate: what label quality a teacher buys per dollar, and how to keep a fleet of GPU workers busy under skewed, failure-prone workloads. We present a simple, reproducible pipeline that addresses both. First, a work-stealing ring pool: each worker owns a queue, drains it first, and then steals from ring successors, with exactly-once task claims via atomic conditional writes and crash tolerance via stale-claim sweeping. The claim protocol requires only a compare-and-set primitive from its storage layer; we implement it on a single SQLite file, which makes the reference implementation dependency-free and the experiments reproducible on one machine. Second, a memory-aware concurrency rule that sizes per-node parallelism by how many model copies fit on the GPU, so the same code runs safely across device sizes. Third, a relabeling benchmark methodology in which the teacher relabels a public dataset that already has gold labels, so quality reduces to an agreement measurement and cost follows from measured throughput. Under skewed load the pool sustains up to 3.4 times the throughput of static sharding while matching it at zero skew, loses 0 of 2,000 tasks when half the workers are killed mid-run (static sharding loses 953), and yields measured quality and cost points for an instruction-tuned teacher on irony and sentiment tasks. All experiments run on public data and commodity hardware; code, tests, and run logs are released.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Code, tests, and all run artifacts: https://github.com/rsdpyenugula/hybrid-labeling-training
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于 LLM 教师模型蒸馏标注的可复现流水线，包含工作窃取环形队列 (work-stealing ring pool)、内存感知的 GPU 并发规则和重标注基准方法。在偏斜负载下，该池相比静态分片最多提升 3.4 倍吞吐量，在零偏斜时持平；杀掉一半 worker 后 2,000 个任务零丢失，而静态分片丢失 953 个。所有实验基于公开数据和单机 SQLite 存储运行，代码与运行日志已发布。
Motivation: 面对百万级文本语料，人工标注不可行，需要低成本、可靠且可扩展的教师模型标注流程；同时要在偏斜且易失败的工作负载下保持 GPU worker 群忙碌，并量化标签质量与成本。
Method: 提出三部分方案：每个 worker 先耗尽自己队列再从环形后继窃取任务，并通过原子条件写入实现 exactly-once 认领、陈旧认领扫描实现崩溃容错，仅依赖 compare-and-set 原语（用单个 SQLite 文件实现）；按 GPU 可容纳的模型副本数决定节点内并行度，使同一代码适配不同设备；重标注基准法让教师重标已有 gold label 的公开数据集，以一致性度量质量、按实测吞吐度量成本。
Result: 在偏斜负载下，该池吞吐量达到静态分片的 3.4 倍，零偏斜时与静态分片持平；杀掉一半 worker 时 2,000 个任务丢失为 0（静态分片丢失 953 个）；摘要还给出指令微调教师模型在 irony 和 sentiment 任务上的质量与成本实测点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该流水线简单、可复现，依赖单一 SQLite 文件且在单机上即可重复实验，并使用公开数据和 commodity hardware 验证；发布代码、测试和运行日志以支持复现。

papers.title: Academic League of Artificial Intelligence - An Integrative Perspective of Teaching, Research, and Extension
papers.abstract_en: Academic leagues have become important mechanisms for promoting extracurricular education and strengthening the integration between universities and society. This paper presents the organizational framework adopted by the Academic League of Artificial Intelligence (LIA) at the Federal University of Santa Catarina (UFSC), designed to integrate teaching, research, and university extension through a student-centered, project-based approach. The framework combines democratic governance, collaborative learning, and dynamic project organization to foster both technical and transversal competencies. The framework is illustrated through representative initiatives, including competition teams, study groups, open lectures, knowledge repositories, and AI-powered applications with social impact. These projects demonstrate how diverse educational, scientific, and extension activities can be developed within a common organizational structure while promoting leadership, scientific production, community engagement, and knowledge preservation. The reported experience indicates that the proposed framework provides a flexible and replicable model for integrating the three university pillars into engineering and computing education, offering practical guidance for academic leagues and similar student organizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍巴西圣卡塔琳娜联邦大学（UFSC）人工智能学术联盟（LIA）的组织框架，该框架以学生为中心、基于项目，旨在整合大学的教学、科研与社会延伸三大支柱。框架结合民主治理、协作学习和动态项目组织，并通过竞赛团队、学习小组、公开讲座、知识库以及具有社会影响的 AI 应用等代表性项目加以说明。摘要称该经验表明这是一个灵活且可复制的模型，可为学术联盟及类似学生组织提供实践指导。
Motivation: 学术联盟已成为促进课外教育与加强大学和社会联系的重要机制，但缺少将教学、科研和大学延伸系统性整合到工程与计算教育中的可复制组织框架。
Method: 提出一个结合民主治理、协作学习与动态项目组织的学生中心化框架，并以竞赛团队、学习小组、公开讲座、知识库和具有社会影响的 AI 应用等多样化项目作为实施载体。
Result: 摘要未给出量化实验数据，而是报告了实践经验，表明该框架能够灵活地在一个共同组织结构中承载教育、科学和延伸活动，并促进领导力、科学产出、社区参与和知识保存。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架作为可复制的灵活模型，可为学术联盟和类似学生组织提供实践指导，将其视为整合大学三大支柱的有效方案。

papers.title: Sign Language Video Synthesis via Loss-Guided Multi-Expert GANs
papers.abstract_en: This preliminary technical report presents a framework for sign language video synthesis using a loss-guided multi-expert Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to enhance communication for individuals with hearing impairments. Three specialized discriminators -- global, hand, and head -- each guide a corresponding expert branch in the generator toward a distinct visual region, enabling implicit feature specialization without explicit diversity losses. To stabilize this multi-discriminator system, whose early-phase training otherwise exhibits chaotic dynamics, we introduce a United Loss consensus mechanism that regularizes each discriminator toward the ensemble average at a 10% weight. Each branch further adopts a dual-pathway convolutional-transformer design with learnable AdaptiveFeatureFusion, balancing the stability of convolutions against the detail of windowed self-attention. The generator is trained using an alternating three-mode schedule (discriminator, holistic generation, branch-specialized generation). On a custom 156GB dataset with a filtered test set that removes easy and repetitive samples, our 0.2B-parameter variant achieves 29.8 PSNR (0.959 SSIM) and the 1.3B-parameter variant achieves 30.7 PSNR (0.965 SSIM), with inference VRAM footprints of 1.5 GB and 8 GB respectively, enabling deployment on consumer-grade hardware. Full ablation studies remain ongoing due to the 2-3 month training cycle on a single GPU. The system was showcased at the 2025 Hong Kong Frontier Technology Summit.
papers.comment: Preliminary technical report. 19 pages, 8 figures, 4 algorithms
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一份初步技术报告，提出用损失引导的多专家生成对抗网络（loss-guided multi-expert GAN）进行手语视频合成，以改善听障人群的沟通体验。三个专门判别器（全局、手、头）分别引导生成器中对应专家分支关注不同视觉区域，实现隐式特征特化；并引入 United Loss 共识机制按 10% 权重将各判别器向集成平均正则化，以稳定早期训练。在自建 156GB 数据集上，0.2B 参数变体达到 29.8 PSNR（0.959 SSIM），1.3B 变体达到 30.7 PSNR（0.965 SSIM），推理显存占用分别为 1.5GB 和 8GB。
Motivation: 手语视频合成对帮助听障人士沟通有意义，但手部、头部等局部细节的高质量生成困难；此外，多判别器系统在训练早期呈现混沌动力学，需要额外的稳定机制。
Method: 提出三个专家判别器（global、hand、head）与生成器中对应专家分支配对的结构，不依赖显式多样性损失而实现隐式特化；引入 United Loss 共识机制，以 10% 权重把每个判别器向整体平均正则化。每个分支采用双路径卷积-Transformer 设计，并用可学习的 AdaptiveFeatureFusion 在卷积稳定性与窗口自注意力细节之间取平衡；生成器按判别器、整体生成、分支特化生成三种模式交替训练。
Result: 在自建 156GB 数据集及过滤掉简单重复样本的测试集上，0.2B 变体取得 29.8 PSNR（0.959 SSIM），1.3B 变体取得 30.7 PSNR（0.965 SSIM），推理显存分别为 1.5GB 和 8GB，可部署于消费级硬件。
Conclusion: 作者指出完整消融研究仍在进行，原因是单 GPU 训练周期长达 2-3 个月；该系统已在 2025 香港前沿技术峰会展示。
