papers.title: Represent, Then Generate: Multimodal-Conditioned Time-Series Generation under Irregular Missingness
papers.abstract_en: Continuous physiological time series underpin modern clinical monitoring, yet many of the most informative signals are invasive, expensive, or simply unavailable for a given patient. Conditional generation offers a remedy: an absent signal can be synthesized from co-recorded signals and routine clinical variables. Existing generators, however, are built around a single conditioning modality and degrade when forced to handle the heterogeneous, irregularly missing mix of time-variant signals and static covariates seen in practice. We propose ReCoGen (Represent Conditions, then Generate), a two-stage framework that decouples multimodal condition representation from target generation. Stage I trains one masked autoencoder per modality, distilling each time-variant condition into a compact and missingness-tolerant token sequence. Stage II trains a flow-matching generator that fuses these tokens with static conditions to synthesize the target signal. Across three physiological benchmarks, including continuous glucose monitoring on AI-READI and arterial blood pressure generation on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, ReCoGen attains the best downstream utility on all sixteen (dataset, task, metric) settings, surpassing six representative conditional generators; on thirteen of them its utility also reaches or exceeds the utility measured on the real signal, a reference we read as an approximate anchor rather than a ceiling. Ablations trace the gains to the conditioning path: learnable cross-attention over the frozen per-modality encoders, and a dual token-plus-AdaLN route for the static conditions. ReCoGen thus turns routinely collected signals into informative surrogates for invasive or unavailable ones, a step toward less invasive, lower-cost continuous clinical monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCoGen (Represent Conditions, then Generate)，一个面向不规则缺失场景下多模态条件生理时间序列生成的两阶段框架。第一阶段为每个模态训练掩码自编码器 (masked autoencoder)，将时变条件压缩为对缺失鲁棒的 token 序列；第二阶段用流匹配 (flow-matching) 生成器融合这些 token 与静态条件来合成目标信号。在 AI-READI 的连续血糖监测和 MIMIC-III/MIMIC-IV 的动脉血压生成上，该方法在全部十六个 (数据集、任务、指标) 设置中取得最佳下游效用，并在十三个设置中达到或超过真实信号对应的效用。
Motivation: 现有条件生成器通常围绕单一条件模态设计，面对实际中时变信号与静态协变量混合、且不规则缺失的多模态条件时会退化。作者希望利用共记录信号和常规临床变量合成缺失信号，以降低侵入式或高成本监测的依赖。
Method: 提出两阶段框架 ReCoGen：阶段一按模态分别训练掩码自编码器，把每个时变条件提取为紧凑且容忍缺失的 token 序列；阶段二训练流匹配生成器，将这些 token 与静态条件融合以生成目标信号。消融显示增益主要来自条件路径，包括对冻结的逐模态编码器做可学习交叉注意力 (cross-attention)，以及针对静态条件的 token-plus-AdaLN 双路径。
Result: 在三个生理基准（AI-READI 连续血糖监测、MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV 动脉血压生成）上，ReCoGen 在全部十六个设置中超过六种代表性条件生成器，取得最佳下游效用；其中十三个设置的下游效用达到或超过真实信号测得的效用，作者将后者视为近似锚点而非上限。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ReCoGen 能把常规采集的信号转化为侵入式或不可得信号的有效替代，向更少侵入、更低成本的连续临床监测迈进。

papers.title: One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning for human-AI interaction typically relies on a single large language model to simulate user behavior. We show that this approach systematically fails to generalize, and trace the failure to simulator collapse: because the simulator LLM is mode-collapsed, an LLM policy trained against it overfits to narrow strategies that exploit the simulator's dominant mode, and such a policy transfers poorly to unseen simulators and real users. We formalize this collapse theoretically and propose two complementary solutions, one at inference time and one at training time. The inference-time solution, Verbalized Sampling, broadens the simulator's behavior by sampling from a verbalized response distribution, reducing mode collapse. The training-time solution, Co-Training, jointly optimizes the policy against a population of trainable simulators, preventing it from overfitting to any single simulator's mode. We validate both solutions on three multi-turn benchmarks: Persuasion for Good, $τ^2$-bench, and CooperBench. Verbalized Sampling improves held-out success by up to 9% over single-simulator RL, and Co-Training pushes gains further to 14%; the human study shows similar gain on real users. Both solutions preserve the policy diversity that collapses under single-simulator RL. To support further work in this direction, we release SCOPE, an open-source framework for Population Co-Training multi-agent RL. More broadly, our results suggest that the diversity of the training environment, not only the policy, is critical to the generalization of multi-turn RL to real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人机交互多智能体强化学习中用单个大语言模型模拟用户行为导致泛化失败的问题，提出“模拟器坍缩”(simulator collapse)概念：由于模拟器 LLM 存在模式坍缩，策略会过拟合到模拟器的主导模式，从而难以迁移到未见模拟器和真实用户。作者给出理论形式化，并提出推理时的 Verbalized Sampling 与训练时的 Co-Training 两种互补方案，在多个多轮基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有方法通常依赖单一 LLM 模拟用户行为来训练人机交互策略，但这种方式系统性泛化失败；其根源在于模拟器本身模式坍缩，使策略过拟合于狭窄策略并难以迁移到真实部署。
Method: 理论上形式化模拟器坍缩；推理侧提出 Verbalized Sampling，通过从言语化响应分布中采样来拓宽模拟器行为、减轻模式坍缩；训练侧提出 Co-Training，联合优化策略与一组可训练的模拟器，避免策略过拟合到任何单一模拟器的模式。
Result: 在 Persuasion for Good、τ²-bench 和 CooperBench 三个多轮基准上，Verbalized Sampling 相比单模拟器 RL 将 held-out 成功率提升最高 9%，Co-Training 进一步将增益提升到 14%；人类研究显示对真实用户也有类似增益，并且两种方案都保留了单模拟器 RL 下会坍缩的策略多样性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调训练环境的多样性（而不仅是策略本身的多样性）对多轮 RL 向真实世界部署的泛化至关重要；作者发布 SCOPE 开源框架以支持 Population Co-Training 多智能体 RL 的后续研究。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对人机交互多智能体强化学习中用单个大语言模型模拟用户行为导致泛化失败的问题，提出“模拟器坍缩”(simulator collapse)概念：由于模拟器 LLM 存在模式坍缩，策略会过拟合到模拟器的主导模式，从而难以迁移到未见模拟器和真实用户。作者给出理论形式化，并提出推理时的 Verbalized Sampling 与训练时的 Co-Training 两种互补方案，在多个多轮基准上验证了有效性。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有方法通常依赖单一 LLM 模拟用户行为来训练人机交互策略，但这种方式系统性泛化失败；其根源在于模拟器本身模式坍缩，使策略过拟合于狭窄策略并难以迁移到真实部署。

papers.title: JAPE: Joint Anomaly Prediction and Intrinsic Explanation in Multivariate Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time-series anomaly prediction aims to identify whether and when anomalies will occur over a future horizon from historical observations. Existing methods primarily characterize anomalies as deviations in future numerical values, which may overlook subtle dependency changes induced by weak anomaly precursors and provide no native variable-level explanation together with the alert. To bridge these gaps, we propose JAPE, a Joint Anomaly Prediction and Explanation framework that lifts anomaly prediction from numerical-deviation modeling to dependency-structure modeling. JAPE is the first anomaly prediction framework to explicitly model evolving dependency structures for both point-wise alerting and native variable-level explanation. Specifically, JAPE (i) proposes a Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Representation (DSTR) backbone that decouples temporal and spatial modeling and captures lag-aware dependencies via learnable lag aggregation, thereby perceiving structural precursors before numerical deviations emerge; (ii) designs a dual-view alerting mechanism that fuses numerical forecasts with evolving dependency graphs for point-wise anomaly prediction, capturing structural evidence even under subtle numerical deviations; and (iii) presents Native Predictive Explanation (NPE), which directly reuses the predicted dependency graphs to rank variables by structural deviations without additional models or training. Extensive experiments on five real-world benchmarks across three prediction horizons demonstrate that JAPE improves average F1 and AUC-PR by 19.7% and 41.3%, respectively, while improving explainability with 26.6% gain in MRR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JAPE，一个面向多元时间序列异常预测与内在解释的联合框架，将异常预测从数值偏差建模提升到依赖结构建模。JAPE 提出 DSTR 骨干网络解耦时空建模并捕获滞后感知依赖，设计双视图告警机制融合数值预测与演化依赖图，并提出 NPE 原生预测解释直接复用预测依赖图进行变量排序。在五个真实基准和三个预测时域上，JAPE 平均 F1 提升 19.7%、AUC-PR 提升 41.3%，解释性 MRR 提升 26.6%。
Motivation: 现有多元时间序列异常预测方法主要把异常刻画为未来数值上的偏差，容易忽略由弱异常前兆引发的细微依赖变化，且无法在告警同时原生给出变量级解释。
Method: JAPE 包含三部分：(i) 解耦时空表示 (DSTR) 骨干，通过可学习的滞后聚合捕获滞后感知依赖，从而在数值偏差出现前感知结构前兆；(ii) 双视图告警机制，融合数值预测与演化依赖图进行逐点异常预测；(iii) 原生预测解释 (NPE)，直接复用预测依赖图按结构偏差对变量排序，无需额外模型或训练。
Result: 在五个真实世界基准和三个预测时域上的实验表明，JAPE 平均 F1 提升 19.7%，AUC-PR 提升 41.3%，并在解释性上获得 26.6% 的 MRR 提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调将异常预测从数值偏差建模转向依赖结构建模可以同时改善点级告警和原生变量级解释，尤其适用于弱前兆导致的细微依赖变化场景。

papers.title: Semantic Lenia: Emergence of Homeostatic Solitons within the Semantic Space of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Semantic Lenia, an artificial life framework that transforms Large Language Model (LLM) inference from a static optimization problem into a continuous, closed-loop dynamical system. By establishing a non-linear homeostatic feedback loop to dynamically balance semantic attraction and syntactic repulsion, we demonstrate the emergence of ``Homeostatic Solitons''-metastable semantic structures that actively resist repetitive crystallization. Our exhaustive parameter sweeps map a critical ``Habitable Ridge'' where applied steering forces balance the model's intrinsic syntactic inertia. This approach successfully maintains generative trajectories in a numerically sensitive critical regime, triggering profound abductive leaps without structural collapse, and reveals a capacity-dependent scaling trend in the syntactic inertia across different model sizes.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Code, datasets, and interactive phase diagrams are available at https://y-kayama.github.io/semantic-lenia/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Semantic Lenia，一个将 LLM 推理从静态优化问题转变为连续闭环动力学系统的人工生命框架。通过建立非线性稳态反馈环来动态平衡语义吸引与句法排斥，演示了“稳态孤子”(Homeostatic Solitons) 的涌现——一种抵抗重复结晶的亚稳态语义结构。参数扫描绘制出“可居住脊”(Habitable Ridge)，在该临界区上生成轨迹得以维持并触发深刻的溯因跳跃而不发生结构崩溃，同时揭示句法惯性随模型规模呈容量依赖的缩放趋势。
Motivation: 作者认为把 LLM 推理当作静态优化问题会掩盖生成过程中的连续动态与自组织特性，因此从人工生命视角将推理建模为连续闭环动力系统，以研究稳态语义结构如何涌现。
Method: 提出 Semantic Lenia 框架，构建非线性稳态反馈环以动态平衡语义吸引与句法排斥，并通过穷举参数扫描定位“可居住脊”，使施加的引导力与模型内在句法惯性达到平衡，从而把生成轨迹维持在数值敏感的临界区。
Result: 摘要报告观察到稳态孤子的涌现，生成轨迹在临界区保持稳定并产生深刻溯因跳跃而无结构崩溃，且句法惯性在不同模型规模下呈现容量依赖的缩放趋势。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能成功维持生成轨迹于临界动态区间并支持持续的溯因跳跃，还揭示了模型规模的句法惯性缩放规律；但摘要未给出具体评测基准或定量指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Recoverability to Functional Use: Auditing Temporal Reports in Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time-series forecasters increasingly accompany numerical predictions with explicit temporal reports, such as delays or selected history, but a correct report need not describe the information actually used by the forecast. We separate this problem into three questions: whether the target temporal structure is recoverable from the observed trajectory, whether the model reports it correctly, and whether the forecast functionally depends on the reported history. For point delays, we show that accurate prediction does not imply correct temporal use: two candidate delays can become statistically distinguishable as the trajectory grows even when substituting one for the other incurs little per-step prediction error. On controlled time-series tasks, learned forecasters can remain primarily dependent on history outside the reported structure even when the target is recoverable, the report is correct, and the forecast is accurate. Finally, report-controlled routing substantially improves report--forecast alignment without an observed loss in predictive accuracy. These results motivate separate statistical and functional validation of temporal reports.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时间序列预测中伴随数值预测给出的显式时间报告（如延迟或选取的历史）是否真正描述模型实际使用的信息。作者把问题拆分为可恢复性、报告正确性与功能依赖性三个方面，并指出准确的预测并不能保证正确的时间使用。通过受控任务实验，他们发现学习型预测器即使目标可恢复、报告正确且预测准确，仍可能主要依赖报告结构之外的历史；而报告控制路由能在不明显损失预测精度的前提下显著改善报告与预测的对齐。
Motivation: 时间序列预测器经常附带时间报告（如延迟或选中的历史），但一份正确的报告不一定描述预测实际使用的信息，现有验证通常只关注预测精度而忽略这一点。
Method: 将问题拆为三个问题：目标时间结构能否从观测轨迹中恢复、模型是否正确报告、预测是否在功能上依赖所报告的历史；针对点延迟给出理论区分性分析，并在受控时间序列任务上验证学习预测器的依赖行为，最后提出报告控制路由（report-controlled routing）来对齐报告与预测。
Result: 摘要表明准确预测不蕴含正确的时间使用：两条候选延迟在轨迹增长时可在统计上区分，即使替换一条为另一条只带来很小的每步预测误差；受控任务中预测器可主要依赖报告结构之外的历史；报告控制路由在不出现预测精度损失的观察下提升了报告-预测对齐。
Conclusion: 这些结果说明时间报告需要分别进行统计验证与功能验证，而不能仅以预测精度作为唯一依据。

papers.title: A Probabilistic Circuit-Induced Pseudo-Metric for Out-of-Distribution Detection
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) are tractable generative models whose internal nodes encode a hierarchy of probabilistic summaries over different variable scopes. Existing PC-based out-of-distribution (OOD) detection methods ignore this hierarchy, reducing the entire circuit to the scalar likelihood (or its uncertainty) computed at the root. We introduce Hierarchical Likelihood Vector (HLV), a representation whose entries are the likelihoods associated with selected PC nodes and define the Hierarchical Likelihood Distance (HLD), a PC-induced pseudo-metric that compares the probability distributions through the expectations of their HLVs. We show that HLD is an integral probability metric over a function class naturally induced by the PC and develop a principled goodness-of-fit hypothesis test for unsupervised OOD detection. Unlike existing approaches, the trained PC alone serves as the representation of the in-distribution: no held-out in-distribution data are required at deployment. We further show that the quantities required by the hypothesis test can be computed exactly, directly from the trained circuit, yielding an approximate analytic decision threshold. Experiments on tabular and MNIST datasets demonstrate that exploiting the hierarchical probabilistic summaries encoded through the PC improve OOD detection over root-likelihood, uncertainty-, typicality- and kernel-based baselines, while naturally localizing distribution shifts to the PC nodes responsible for the shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hierarchical Likelihood Vector (HLV)，其分量为所选概率电路 (Probabilistic Circuits, PC) 节点的似然，并据此定义 Hierarchical Likelihood Distance (HLD)，一种由 PC 诱导的伪度量，用于无监督 OOD 检测。作者证明 HLD 是某个由 PC 自然诱导函数类上的积分概率度量 (integral probability metric)，并据此构造 goodness-of-fit 假设检验；检验所需量可直接从训练后的电路精确求得，从而得到近似解析决策阈值。在 tabular 和 MNIST 数据集上，该方法优于 root-likelihood、不确定性、典型性和基于 kernel 的基线，并能将分布偏移定位到相关 PC 节点。
Motivation: 现有基于 PC 的 OOD 检测方法忽略电路的内部层次结构，把整个电路约简为根节点的标量似然或其不确定性，从而丢失了不同变量作用域上的层次化概率摘要。本文旨在利用这种层次结构来提升 OOD 检测，并提供有原则的统计检验框架。
Method: 提出 HLV 表示与 HLD 伪度量，通过 HLV 的期望比较概率分布；证明 HLD 是 PC 诱导函数类上的积分概率度量，并据此开发无监督 OOD 检测的 goodness-of-fit 假设检验。检验所需的量可由训练好的电路精确计算，部署时无需 held-out 分布内数据，且可获得近似解析决策阈值。
Result: 在 tabular 和 MNIST 数据集上的实验表明，利用 PC 层次概率摘要的方法在 OOD 检测上优于 root-likelihood、不确定性、typicality 和 kernel 基线，并能自然地将分布偏移定位到导致偏移的 PC 节点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调训练好的 PC 单独即可作为分布内表示，部署时不需要 held-out 分布内数据；假设检验所需量可精确计算并给出近似解析阈值。验证范围限于 tabular 和 MNIST 数据集。

papers.title: Context Is Not Authority: Structured Runtime Governance for Financial Market Agents
papers.abstract_en: Financial agents can turn correct context into an unauthorized effect: a customer-facing commitment, trade, or deployed policy. We present SAGE-Fin, a finance-specific authority-handoff contract that makes the proposed effect, not merely its text, the object of runtime control. SAGE-Fin compiles proposals into typed, adapter-bound candidates; records missing or stale institutional obligations as coverage debt; contracts authority under current market, account, policy, and dialogue state; and requires an exact-artifact receipt whose nominal type matches the consuming response, execution, or policy adapter. Evidence and workflow progress cannot substitute for effect authority, and prior authorization is rechecked after state changes. Across an authored 616-case catalog, five deterministic specifications yield 3,080 outputs; a label-isolated harness obtains 616/616 binary reference-prototype parity, including 3/3 named response-gate fixtures, while 22 tests cover selected paths. These results establish executable conformance, not independent safety accuracy. Separately, SAGE-Fin's response gate processed real customer-facing production requests at a confidential digital-asset platform. An operational team independent of the implementation team reached a strongly positive post-deployment conclusion on practical usefulness and workflow fit, and end-user feedback was also strongly positive. Disclosure permits only the review's independence, stakeholder classes, assessed dimensions, and directional conclusion, so this is qualitative field corroboration rather than an aggregate effect estimate. Three distinct de-identified predecessor failures, with independently confirmed 0/3 interception, ground repeated-emission drift, stale account evidence, and missing escalation state without estimating prevalence or treatment effect.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables. Qiangqiang Liu and Yichi Zhang are corresponding authors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGE-Fin，一个面向金融市场的权限移交合约 (authority-handoff contract)，将代理提议的效果（而非文本）作为运行时控制对象。SAGE-Fin 将提案编译为类型化、适配器绑定的候选，把缺失或过期的机构义务记为覆盖债务 (coverage debt)，并在状态变化后重新检查先前授权。在作者构建的 616 用例目录上，五种确定性规范产生 3,080 个输出，标签隔离的测试装置实现 616/616 的二进制参考原型一致性；另在数字资产平台完成真实生产请求的定性验证。
Motivation: 金融代理可能把正确的上下文转化为未经授权的效果（如客户承诺、交易或部署策略），现有做法缺少对提议效果而非文本的运行时控制机制。
Method: SAGE-Fin 将提案编译为类型化、适配器绑定的候选；把缺失或过期的机构义务记录为覆盖债务；依据当前市场、账户、政策和对话状态收缩权限；并要求名义类型与消费方响应、执行或策略适配器匹配的精确工件收据。证据和工作流进度不能替代效果权限，授权在状态变化后被重新检查。
Result: 在 616 用例目录上得到 3,080 个输出，标签隔离测试装置实现 616/616 二进制参考原型一致性（含 3/3 命名响应门夹具），22 个测试覆盖选定路径；响应门还在数字资产平台处理了真实客户生产请求，独立运营团队与终端用户均给出强烈正面反馈。作者明确这些结果确立的是可执行一致性 (executable conformance) 而非独立的安全性准确率。
Conclusion: 生产环境的积极反馈属于定性现场佐证而非总体效果估计；三个去标识化的历史失败案例被独立确认为 0/3 拦截，但未估计发生率或处理效应。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: World models have recently achieved impressive progress in visual prediction and interactive generation, but extending them to multi-agent environments introduces a fundamental scalability challenge. Existing methods generally assume a fixed number of agents during training and inference, which ties the model to a pre-determined agent population and limits inference-time scalability. Our key insight is that cross-view consistency should arise from a shared world state whose evolution does not assume a predefined number of agents, while agent-specific observations should be generated by querying this state through a unified rendering interface. Based on this insight, we propose Khora, a scalable multi-agent world model that supports inference-time expansion to arbitrary numbers of agents without retraining. Our framework decouples world-state evolution from visual rendering and introduces a population-agnostic rendering mechanism for incorporating other agent information. This design maintains cross-view consistency through the shared world state rather than through dense interactions among observation streams inside the expensive video generator, enabling approximately linear practical scaling with the number of queried views. Qualitative experiments demonstrate that our approach generalizes to unseen numbers of agents while maintaining visual quality and multi-agent consistency. We further implement a real-time interactive system to demonstrate scalable open-world simulation.
papers.comment: Technical report. Project page: https://rhos.ai/research/khora. Online demo: https://ophilus.ai/khora
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Khora，一个面向多智能体环境、可在推理时扩展到任意智能体数量的世界模型。核心思路是将世界状态演化与视觉渲染解耦，让跨视图一致性来源于共享世界状态，而非视频生成器内部的观测流密集交互。摘要报告定性实验表明该方法能泛化到未见过的智能体数量，并保持视觉质量与多智能体一致性。
Motivation: 现有世界模型在训练和推理时通常假设固定数量的智能体，导致模型被绑定到预设群体规模，无法在推理时扩展。多智能体环境下的可扩展性成为基础性挑战。
Method: Khora 将世界状态演化与视觉渲染解耦，引入群体无关的渲染机制来整合其他智能体信息。智能体特定观测通过统一渲染接口查询共享世界状态，从而避免在昂贵的视频生成器内进行密集的观测流交互，实现与查询视图数量近似线性的扩展。
Result: 定性实验显示该方法能泛化到未见过的智能体数量，同时维持视觉质量和多智能体一致性；作者还实现了实时交互系统以演示可扩展的开放世界模拟。
Conclusion: 作者认为共享世界状态而非智能体间的密集交互是保持跨视图一致性的关键，这一设计使推理时群体扩展成为可能。

papers.title: SimWAM: A Simple World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve end-to-end autonomous driving by transferring video dynamics priors to action prediction, but existing methods incur costly test-time future imagination. We present SimWAM, a simple yet effective WAM that leverages future-video prediction as a training-time supervision signal. It co-trains a pretrained video expert and a lightweight action expert with joint flow matching. An isolated attention mask keeps action prediction independent of future frames, allowing trajectory prediction without explicit future-frame generation at inference. Since the two experts share no parameters and interact only through a unified attention interface, the video backbone could be replaced and the action expert scaled independently without modifying the learning objective or inference pipeline. We further apply reinforcement learning to optimize a compositional driving reward beyond trajectory imitation. Our SimWAM achieves 91.5 PDMS on NAVSIM, surpasses state-of-the-art WAM-based planners with substantially lower latency, and transfers zero-shot to nuScenes. These results position SimWAM as a simple yet solid baseline that could readily benefit from advances in video generation for efficient autonomous driving. The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/SimWAM/.
papers.comment: The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/SimWAM/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SimWAM，一个简单有效的世界动作模型（World-Action Model）用于端到端自动驾驶。SimWAM 将未来视频预测作为训练时的监督信号，联合训练预训练视频专家与轻量动作专家，并通过隔离注意力掩码使推理时不依赖未来帧生成。摘要报告其在 NAVSIM 上达到 91.5 PDMS，超过基于 WAM 的现有先进规划器且延迟更低，并零样本迁移到 nuScenes。
Motivation: 现有 WAM 通过将视频动力学先验迁移到动作预测来提升端到端自动驾驶，但测试时需要昂贵的未来想象（future imagination）。本文旨在用训练时视频预测监督替代测试时生成，从而降低推理开销。
Method: SimWAM 以联合 flow matching 共同训练预训练视频专家和轻量动作专家；隔离注意力掩码（isolated attention mask）使动作预测独立于未来帧，因此推理时无需显式生成未来帧。两个专家不共享参数，仅通过统一注意力接口交互，视频骨干可替换、动作专家可独立缩放；此外用强化学习优化组合式驾驶奖励，超越纯轨迹模仿。
Result: 在 NAVSIM 上取得 91.5 PDMS，超过基于 WAM 的现有最优规划器，且延迟显著更低；同时零样本迁移到 nuScenes。
Conclusion: 摘要将 SimWAM 定位为简单而坚实的 WAM 基线，能够直接受益于视频生成技术的进步，用于高效率的自动驾驶。

papers.title: Estimating and Testing Kinks in Panel Data Models
papers.abstract_en: Many economic and financial relationships may change gradually rather than abruptly. We study panel data models in which the coefficient vector is continuous and piecewise linear in calendar time, with a finite number of unknown kink dates at which its slope changes. We propose a penalised least squares estimator that applies adaptive weighted group penalties to the second differences of the coefficient path, and develop asymptotic theory showing that it recovers both the number and the locations of the kinks with probability approaching one. To our knowledge, this is the first panel framework to estimate an unknown number of common kink dates in a time-varying coefficient path under fixed effects. We establish that endpoint slopes converge at the usual cubic regime-length rate and interior slopes at rates determined by their own and adjacent regime lengths. We also develop a coefficient-by-coefficient extension allowing individual regressors to kink at different dates. Monte Carlo evidence supports the good finite sample properties, and we illustrate the method through an application in macro-finance, specifically the relationship between debt and growth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究面板数据模型中系数向量随日历时间连续、分段线性变化的情形，并关注斜率发生变化的未知扭结日期 (kink dates)。作者提出一种对系数路径二阶差分施加自适应加权组惩罚的惩罚最小二乘估计量，并建立渐近理论，证明该方法能以趋于一的概率恢复扭结的数量和位置。据作者所述，这是首个在固定效应下估计时变系数路径中未知数量共同扭结日期的面板框架。
Motivation: 许多经济与金融关系可能是渐进而非突变地变化，现有面板模型难以估计未知数量的共同扭结日期。该方法填补了固定效应面板框架下同时估计扭结数量和位置的空白。
Method: 提出惩罚最小二乘估计量，对系数路径的二阶差分应用自适应加权组惩罚 (adaptive weighted group penalties)，并开发系数级扩展，允许不同解释变量在不同日期发生扭结。
Result: 渐近理论表明该方法能以趋于一的概率恢复扭结的数量与位置；端点斜率以通常的立方式区间长度速率收敛，内部斜率则以由自身及相邻区间长度决定的速率收敛。Monte Carlo 证据支持良好的有限样本性质，并通过对债务与增长关系的宏观金融应用进行说明。
Conclusion: 这是首个在固定效应面板模型中估计未知数量共同扭结日期的方法，并支持系数级异质扭结；作者通过债务-增长应用展示了其实用性。

papers.title: Energy-Guided Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Pixel-space generative models bypass lossy latent compression, yet necessitate joint learning of global structure and fine-grained details in a high-dimensional space. Standard flow matching interpolates noise toward a fixed clean-image endpoint, leaving the spectral evolution to be learned implicitly. In this paper, we introduce Energy-Guided Flow Matching(EG-FM) that explicitly models a coarse-to-fine generative trajectory by moving endpoint. Specifically, EG-FM replaces the fixed endpoint with a heat-kernel-filtered endpoint that evolves smoothly from low-frequency image to clean image. The fraction of high-frequency signal in moving endpoint is released by an image-specific energy-guided scheduling, leading to the re-targeting of velocity in flow matching. Our framework requires no adaptation of the backbone and training data, bringing negligible cost on the training and inference stages. In our experiment, EG-FM consistently achieves lower FID on the ImageNet class-conditional image generation task at $256 \times 256$ with fewer epochs, reaching an FID of 1.55 at 200 epochs and 1.45 at 600 epochs. We continue training the generation task on the setting of $512 \times 512$ resolution, yielding a FID of 1.58 after only 40 high-resolution adaptation epochs. Furthermore, we transfer EG-FM on text-to-image generation and achieve 0.85 on GenEval score and 83.9 on DPG-Bench. Code is available at https://github.com/ysng123/EG-FM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Energy-Guided Flow Matching（EG-FM），在像素空间生成模型中用随训练演化的热核滤波端点替换固定清洁图像端点，显式建模从低频到高频的粗到细生成轨迹，并通过图像特异的能量引导调度释放高频信号、重定向流匹配的速度场。该方法无需改动骨干网络和训练数据，训练与推理开销可忽略。实验表明在 ImageNet 256×256 类别条件生成上以更少 epoch 取得更低 FID（200 epochs 为 1.55，600 epochs 为 1.45），512×512 上仅用 40 epochs 高分辨率适配即达 1.58，并迁移至文生图任务（GenEval 0.85，DPG-Bench 83.9）。
Motivation: 像素空间生成模型绕开了有损潜压缩，但需要在高维空间中同时学习全局结构与细粒度细节。标准流匹配把噪声向固定清洁图像端点插值，频谱演化只能隐式学习，缺乏对粗到细生成过程的显式建模。
Method: EG-FM 将固定端点替换为热核滤波端点，使其从低频图像平滑演化到干净图像；通过图像特异性的能量引导调度（energy-guided scheduling）逐步释放端点中的高频信号，从而重新定向流匹配中的速度场。框架无需调整骨干网络和训练数据，训练与推理几乎无额外成本。
Result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 类别条件图像生成上，EG-FM 以更少 epoch 取得更低的 FID，200 epochs 为 1.55、600 epochs 为 1.45；在 512×512 分辨率继续训练仅需 40 个高分辨率适配 epochs，FID 为 1.58。文生图迁移任务上得到 GenEval 0.85 与 DPG-Bench 83.9。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 EG-FM 通过在流匹配中显式建模粗到细的谱演化并移动端点，可以一致地提升生成质量，同时保持对现有骨干和数据的零适配要求以及可忽略的成本。

papers.title: SPOT: Sparse Probing and Outcome Calibration for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but standard reverse-KL training can assign insufficient probability to other plausible continuations. Teacher entropy alone does not reveal whether uncertainty is concentrated among a few plausible next tokens or dispersed over a long probability tail, nor whether the student already represents those candidates well. Moreover, local teacher probabilities may not predict downstream success. We introduce Sparse Probing and Outcome-calibrated Targets OPD (SPOT), which addresses two coupled decisions, where to probe and what to distill, through an acquisition--exploration--exploitation procedure. During acquisition, a position-level score combines normalized teacher entropy, the probability mass captured by a small top-$k$ candidate set, and student--teacher mismatch to allocate a limited probing budget. During exploration, SPOT evaluates teacher-proposed candidates through verifier-scored student continuations. During exploitation, these outcomes produce a closed-form, KL-regularized target that favors candidates with better downstream outcomes while remaining anchored to the teacher distribution. Extensive experiments across multiple student models and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of SPOT in improving reasoning performance while balancing solution quality and coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation, OPD）中标准反KL训练可能给其他合理延续分配过低概率的问题，提出 SPOT 方法，通过采集-探索-利用（acquisition–exploration–exploitation）流程耦合处理“在哪里探测”和“蒸馏什么”两个决策，并利用封闭形式的 KL 正则化目标校准教师分布。实验表明 SPOT 在多个学生模型和推理基准上提升了推理性能，并平衡了解质量和覆盖度。
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏提供密集的教师监督，但标准反KL训练可能忽略其他合理延续；仅靠教师熵无法区分不确定性集中于少数候选还是分散在长尾，也无法判断学生是否已能表示这些候选，且局部教师概率不能预测下游成功。
Method: SPOT 包括三个步骤：采集阶段用一个位置级分数（综合归一化教师熵、top-k 候选集覆盖的概率质量以及师生不匹配）分配有限的探测预算；探索阶段通过验证器（verifier）打分的延续来评估教师提出的候选；利用阶段据此生成闭式的 KL 正则化目标，偏好具有更好下游结果的候选，同时保持与教师分布锚定。
Result: 摘要报告多个学生模型和推理基准上的广泛实验显示，SPOT 改善了推理性能，并在解质量和覆盖度之间取得了平衡。
Conclusion: SPOT 通过采集-探索-利用过程联合解决探测位置选择与蒸馏目标构建的问题，为在线策略蒸馏中教师不确定性利用提供了可行方案。

papers.title: DiffImaginE: Imagine to Verify Entity Types with Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal named entity recognition (MNER) determines whether each candidate span and entity-type hypothesis is supported by joint textual and visual evidence. Existing imagine-and-compare verifiers map each (span, type) pair to one predicted visual feature, compressing diverse visual realisations into a single prototype and providing a compatibility score without explicit probabilistic semantics. We introduce DiffImaginE, which formulates MNER type verification as conditional latent diffusion inference. Given span-localised visual evidence, a type-conditioned denoiser predicts noise injected into its standardised latent. The resulting denoising error provides an ELBO-consistent surrogate for type-conditional negative log-likelihood, allowing competing type hypotheses to be ranked by how well they explain the observation. DiffImaginE retains a standard multimodal encoder stack and replaces the deterministic verifier with a classifier-free-guided diffusion scorer trained using Min-SNR weighting. We directly supervise per-type diffusion scores as classification logits, learn aggregation across noise levels, and use antithetic sampling to reduce Monte Carlo comparison variance. Our analysis shows that classifier-free guidance sharpens the induced type posterior and characterises when antithetic pairing reduces variance at equal denoiser cost. Experiments on Twitter-2015 and Twitter-2017 show consistent gains over a matched deterministic ImaginE control under the same encoder, auxiliary objectives, and evaluation protocol, supported by ablations and paired significance tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiffImaginE，将多模态命名实体识别 (MNER) 的类型验证建模为条件潜扩散推理。给定跨度和类型假设，类型条件去噪器预测注入标准化潜变量的噪声，去噪误差作为类型条件负对数似然的 ELBO 一致代理，从而对竞争类型假设排序。模型保留标准多模态编码器，用分类器无关引导的扩散评分器替换确定性验证器，并采用 Min-SNR 加权、按类型扩散分数直接监督、噪声水平聚合和 antithetic 采样降低比较方差。
Motivation: 现有 imagine-and-compare 验证器将每个 (span, type) 对映射到单一预测视觉特征，把多样的视觉实现压缩成单一原型，只给出兼容性分数而缺乏显式概率语义，限制了类型验证的判别能力。
Method: 将 MNER 类型验证形式化为条件潜扩散推理：使用类型条件去噪器预测注入标准化潜变量的噪声，并用去噪误差作为类型条件负对数似然的 ELBO 一致代理来排序类型假设；训练采用 Min-SNR 加权，将每类型扩散分数直接作为分类 logits 监督，学习跨噪声水平聚合，并使用 antithetic 采样降低蒙特卡洛比较方差。
Result: 在 Twitter-2015 和 Twitter-2017 上，DiffImaginE 在相同编码器、辅助目标和评估协议下持续优于匹配的确定性 ImaginE 对照，并有消融和配对显著性检验支持；分析还表明分类器无关引导锐化类型后验，并刻画了 antithetic 配对在相同去噪器成本下降低方差的条件。
Conclusion: 摘要强调用扩散去噪误差替代确定性兼容性分数可为多模态实体类型验证提供更明确的概率语义，并在基准上带来一致性改进；其适用场景限定为图文联合的 MNER 类型验证任务。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator for Transient Magnetization Prediction in Power Magnetics
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic components in high-frequency, high-power-density converters are increasingly driven by non-sinusoidal flux-density waveforms with fast transitions, minor-loop operation, dc bias, and temperature variation. Under these conditions, steady-state core-loss formulas and single-valued material curves cannot fully capture transient magnetization responses. This work proposes the Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator (PI-HNO), a compact material-specific neural model with B-H energy-consistency regularization for core-loss-oriented transient magnetization prediction. Given the measured B(t)-H(t) history, the input B(t) series over the prediction interval and operating-condition information, PI-HNO predicts the H(t) series and the corresponding reconstructed B-H trajectory. The model integrates a local recurrent branch for boundary-state representation and rate-dependent response evolution with a Preisach-inspired global branch that extracts waveform-level hysteresis context. Evaluation on the MagNetX transient database using material-specific models for 14 ferrite materials demonstrates that PI-HNO achieves a compact trade-off between sequence accuracy and B(t)-H(t) energy consistency, with the mean and 95th percentile B(t)-H(t) energy consistency errors of 1.92% and 7.60%, respectively, using only 4777 trainable parameters per model. Ablation studies further demonstrate that the local, global, and energy-aware regularized components provide distinct contributions to transient magnetization prediction.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Preprint prepared for possible submission to IEEE Transactions on Power Electronics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator (PI-HNO)，一个紧凑的材料特定神经模型，用于高频高功率密度变换器中磁性元件的瞬态磁化预测。模型以测量的 B(t)-H(t) 历史、预测区间 B(t) 序列和运行条件为输入，预测 H(t) 序列并重构 B-H 轨迹，并通过 B-H 能量一致性正则化控制物理一致性。在 MagNetX 瞬态数据库上对 14 种铁氧体材料训练的材料特定模型，平均和 95 分位 B(t)-H(t) 能量一致性误差分别为 1.92% 和 7.60%，每模型仅 4777 个可训练参数。
Motivation: 高频高功率密度变换器中磁性元件常受非正弦磁通密度波形、快速过渡、小回环运行、直流偏置和温度变化影响，稳态磁芯损耗公式和单值材料曲线无法充分捕捉瞬态磁化响应，因此需要面向磁芯损耗的瞬态磁化预测模型。
Method: PI-HNO 采用混合结构：一个局部循环分支 (local recurrent branch) 负责边界状态表示和率相关响应演化，另一个 Preisach 启发的全局分支 (global branch) 提取波形级滞回上下文；模型结合 B-H 能量一致性正则化 (B-H energy-consistency regularization) 进行训练，在给定历史与运行条件下预测 H(t) 序列并重构 B-H 轨迹。
Result: 在 MagNetX 瞬态数据库上，基于 14 种铁氧体材料的材料特定模型实现了紧凑的序列精度与 B(t)-H(t) 能量一致性权衡，平均和 95 分位能量一致性误差分别为 1.92% 和 7.60%，每模型仅 4777 个可训练参数；消融研究显示局部、全局和能量感知正则化组件各自有独立贡献。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PI-HNO 能以极少参数量在序列精度与 B-H 能量一致性之间取得紧凑平衡，并验证了局部、全局与能量正则化各部分对瞬态磁化预测的贡献。

papers.title: EchoCache: Energy-Guided Cross-Modal Caching for Efficient Audio-Driven Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Audio-driven video generation (A2V) has achieved promising progress in synthesizing temporally coherent and audio-visually aligned videos, yet its inference remains expensive due to the iterative denoising process of diffusion models. Existing caching methods mainly exploit temporal redundancy in visual features while overlooking the cross-modal alignment of A2V, where audio drives visual generation with highly non-uniform temporal importance. In this paper, we identify two levels of misalignment in existing A2V caching methods: temporal-semantic and computation-storage misalignment. To address them, we propose EchoCache, an energy-guided cross-modal caching framework for efficient A2V generation. EchoCache leverages audio time-frequency energy as a saliency anchor to guide latent-level cache updates and further introduces a dynamic timestep-latent caching mechanism with quantized cache management for joint efficiency and memory optimization. Extensive experiments on mainstream A2V models show that EchoCache consistently improves the latency-quality trade-off while preserving generation quality and audio-visual consistency. In particular, on Wan2.2-S2V over the EMTD benchmark, EchoCache achieves a 2.46x speedup with the best overall performance. Code is available at https://github.com/IF-LAB-PKU/EchoCache.
papers.comment: EchoCache is honored to be accepted by ACM MM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EchoCache，一个面向音频驱动视频生成（A2V）的跨模态缓存框架，利用音频时频能量作为显著性锚点指导潜在特征缓存更新，并引入动态 timestep-latent 缓存机制与量化缓存管理，以降低扩散模型迭代去噪的推理开销。在 Wan2.2-S2V 和 EMTD 基准上，EchoCache 实现 2.46x 加速且保持生成质量与音视频一致性。
Motivation: 音频驱动的视频生成推理代价高，现有缓存方法主要利用视觉特征的时间冗余，忽略了音频对视觉生成的非均匀时间重要性，存在时间-语义与计算-存储两层面的错配。
Method: 提出能量引导的跨模态缓存框架，以音频时频能量作为显著性锚点指导 latent 级缓存更新，并结合动态 timestep-latent 缓存机制与量化缓存管理，同时优化效率与内存。
Result: 在主流的 A2V 模型上，EchoCache 一致改善延迟-质量权衡；在 Wan2.2-S2V 上、EMTD 基准中取得 2.46x 加速，并保持最佳整体性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明利用音频能量引导缓存更新能有效兼顾 A2V 生成的效率与质量，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Douyin Multimodal Embedding Model Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal representation learning is a cornerstone of modern AI. By encoding multimodal queries and targets into vectors, it powers industrial search and recommendation and underpins modern agents. Real-world platforms with complex modalities and massive-scale content, such as Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and YouTube, demand both efficiency under billion-scale indexing and fine-grained discrimination for hard matching. Existing MLLM embedding models rarely satisfy both. Contrastive models are efficient but rely on pair-level supervision too coarse for fine-grained distinctions, while CoT-based models improve discrimination through explicit generation impractical to serve online. We present Douyin Multimodal Embedding (DME), a model trained in two stages to combine both strengths. Stage 1 performs large-scale contrastive pre-training that establishes a unified multimodal embedding space with broad modality and task coverage. Stage 2 supplements semantic sufficiency, the property that an embedding is grounded in retrieval-relevant evidence and preserves fine-grained counterpart-side semantics, via two mechanisms. Evidence-Grounded Typed Latent Reasoning organizes retrieval evidence through hidden-space latent reasoning, and Cross-Conditional Reconstruction enforces counterpart-side semantics through cross-directional autoregressive reconstruction. Both act only during training and add only marginal query-side overhead, so DME serves as efficiently as a standard contrastive encoder. On MMEB-v2, DME reaches state-of-the-art results at comparable scales for its 2B and 9B variants (74.8 and 78.4), with especially strong video and visual-document tasks. In production, DME delivers a 2.92% relative gain on Douyin's in-house offline evaluation set, is deployed across Douyin scenarios such as generative, image, and AI search, and yields a 0.1% Lifetime (LT) gain in online A/B testing on Douyin search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍抖音提出的多模态嵌入模型 DME，采用两阶段训练来兼顾十亿级索引下的效率与细粒度判别能力。阶段一进行大规模对比预训练以建立统一嵌入空间，阶段二通过证据接地类型化潜在推理和跨条件重构两种仅训练时的机制补充语义充分性。在 MMEB-v2 上 2B 与 9B 变体分别达到 74.8 和 78.4，并在抖音搜索在线 A/B 测试中获得 0.1% LT 提升。
Motivation: 现有多模态嵌入模型难以同时满足大规模平台的效率与细粒度匹配需求：对比模型高效但依赖过粗的成对监督，CoT 模型通过显式生成提升判别力却无法在线服务。
Method: 采用两阶段训练：先做大尺度对比预训练覆盖模态与任务，再用证据接地类型化潜在推理（Evidence-Grounded Typed Latent Reasoning）和跨条件自回归重构（Cross-Conditional Reconstruction）两种仅训练时机制强化嵌入的检索相关证据与对端语义。推理时仅增加少量查询端开销。
Result: 在 MMEB-v2 上，2B 和 9B 变体分别取得 74.8 与 78.4 的 SOTA 结果，视频和视觉文档任务尤为突出。生产中在抖音内部离线评测集上相对提升 2.92%，部署于生成式、图像和 AI 搜索等场景，在线 A/B 测试中搜索 LT 提升 0.1%。
Conclusion: DME 表明通过训练时的潜在推理与重构机制，可以在保持标准对比编码器效率的同时获得细粒度判别能力，并在真实平台场景中取得可量化收益。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Non-KKT Accumulation in Entropic Mirror Descent
papers.abstract_en: For mirror descent generated by a Legendre kernel, perhaps one of the most basic question in optimization is this: must every accumulation point of a bounded mirror descent sequence be Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) stationary under proper stepsizes? We show that the answer is no. A longstanding obstacle to resolving this question is the boundary blow-up of the Legendre gradient: it keeps every mirror step in the interior, while at a boundary limit, the inverse entropy metric vanishes on active coordinates and can erase the dual-feasibility in the KKT system. We construct $C^\infty$ objectives and bounded sequences generated by the Shannon-entropic mirror descent on the nonnegative orthant $\R_+^n$, for every $n\geq 3$, and on the probability simplex $Δ_n$, for every $n\geq 4$, such that, in each case, the set of accumulation points is a smooth boundary circle containing a nonempty relatively open arc of non-KKT points. The steps satisfy $α_k\asymp k^{-β}$ with $β\in(1/2,1)$, the objective values are nonincreasing, and the objectives are entropy-relatively smooth. Hence the pathology stems from the degeneracy of the Bregman geometry at the boundary, rather than from failure of descent, or improper stepsizes. To the best of our knowledge, these provide the first counterexamples to KKT accumulation for bounded mirror descent sequences with nonincreasing objective values.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究镜像下降 (mirror descent) 的基本问题：在合适的步长下，有界镜像下降序列的每个聚点是否都必须是 KKT 稳定点。作者证明答案是否定的，并针对非负象限 R_+^n（n≥3）和概率单纯形 Δ_n（n≥4）构造了 C^∞ 目标函数以及由 Shannon 熵镜像下降生成的有界序列，其聚点集合是一条光滑边界圆，包含一段非空相对开弧的非 KKT 点。这是首次给出目标值非增条件下有界镜像下降序列不满足 KKT 聚点性质的例子。
Motivation: 该问题长期悬而未决的障碍在于 Legendre 梯度在边界处的爆炸：它使每一步镜像步长都停留在内部，而边界极限处逆熵度量在活跃坐标上退化，可能抹去 KKT 系统中的对偶可行性。作者希望澄清这种退化是否会导致非 KKT 聚点。
Method: 构造显式的 C^∞ 目标函数和步长满足 α_k ≍ k^{-β}（β∈(1/2,1)）的 Shannon 熵镜像下降序列，设定目标值非增且目标函数为熵相对光滑 (entropy-relatively smooth)，并分析边界处 Bregman 几何的退化行为。
Result: 对每个 n≥3（非负象限）和每个 n≥4（概率单纯形），都存在这样的反例：有界序列的聚点集合是边界上的光滑圆，其中包含非空相对开弧的非 KKT 点。作者称这是首批具有非增目标值的有界镜像下降序列违背 KKT 聚点性质的构造。
Conclusion: 该病态行为源于 Bregman 几何在边界处的退化，而非下降失败或步长选择不当；这揭示了熵镜像下降在接近边界时对偶可行性可能丢失的固有局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rolling Shutter Camera Self-Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Rolling shutter (RS) cameras are widely used in consumer devices, but their row-wise exposure causes distortions under motion, making geometric 3D vision problems dependent on both camera intrinsics and readout time ratio. Existing RS calibration methods rely on calibration targets or specialised hardware, limiting their use in unconstrained settings. We present the first self-calibration method for RS cameras that directly estimates camera intrinsics and the readout time ratio from image sequences, without requiring calibration targets. The method is implemented as a self-calibrating bundle adjustment (BA), which critically depends on the RS imaging model. We combine two known complementary models. The first formulates RS imaging as continuous-time trajectory estimation under a row-wise pose representation. The second interprets RS images as temporally distorted global shutter (GS) images and requires to estimate correction fields. The combination is non-trivial and results in a unified dual-projection model, in which each 3D point is simultaneously constrained at both row-dependent and reference timestamps along a shared continuous trajectory, enforcing stronger geometric and temporal consistency. Extensive simulations analyse the applicability of several implementations under varying conditions, and real data experiments demonstrate the accuracy, robustness, and practical effectiveness of the proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个无需标定靶的卷帘快门 (rolling shutter) 相机自标定方法，通过自标定光束法平差 (self-calibrating bundle adjustment) 直接从图像序列估计相机内参和读出时间比 (readout time ratio)。方法组合两种互补的 RS 成像模型，统一为双投影模型 (dual-projection model)，使每个 3D 点在行相关时间戳与参考时间戳上沿共享连续轨迹同时受约束。摘要报告了大量仿真和真实数据实验，验证了方法的准确性、鲁棒性和实际有效性。
Motivation: 现有 RS 相机标定方法依赖标定靶或专用硬件，限制了在无约束场景下的使用；RS 行曝光造成的运动畸变使得几何三维视觉问题同时依赖于内参和读出时间比，因此需要一种无需标定靶的自标定方案。
Method: 将 RS 成像分别建模为基于行位姿的连续时间轨迹估计，以及将 RS 图像视为时间畸变的全局快门 (GS) 图像并估计校正场，并把这两种互补模型组合成统一的双投影模型。该方法实现为自标定 BA，联合估计相机内参和读出时间比。
Result: 摘要报告了大规模仿真实验，分析多种实现在不同条件下的适用性，并通过真实数据实验展示所提方法的准确性、鲁棒性和实际有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法是首个无需标定靶的 RS 相机自标定方法，能够直接从图像序列完成标定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decode-Branch Transformers: Decoupling the Primary Prefill Path from Additional Decode Computation
papers.abstract_en: As large language models serve ever more requests, cumulative inference cost is growing relative to the one-time cost of training. In typical serving, prompt prefill runs in parallel and is compute-bound, whereas autoregressive decode is sequential and memory-traffic-bound. Conventional width or depth scaling raises both costs together, since every added layer is evaluated in both phases and enlarges the weights read at each decode step. We instead ask whether additional learned computation can be allocated to continuation prediction while preserving prompt-wide primary computation and a single KV cache. We realize this with the Decode-Branch Transformer. Its primary path alone processes the prompt and writes the KV cache; the decode branch is omitted during prefill and activated only from the final prompt position onward, adding continuation computation without writing state or affecting the primary path. The paths share attention, MLP, and output matrices, using separate token embeddings with lightweight coupling. Grouped decode reuses loaded weight tiles and the primary KV cache across both paths, so the added arithmetic does not proportionally increase dominant memory traffic or decode latency. Across matched-token comparisons, Decode-Branch achieves lower validation loss across architectures and data settings. In MoE models, the primary and branch expert fan-outs become independent knobs for trading prompt cost, decode cost, and predictive quality. We study two expert-allocation regimes, holding prefill or decode computation fixed, and expose a prefill-decode-quality trade-off enabled by phase-specific expert allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Decode-Branch Transformer，将预填充 (prefill) 主路径与追加的解码计算解耦：主路径单独处理 prompt 并写入 KV cache，decode branch 在预填充阶段被省略、仅在最后 prompt 位置之后激活，从而在不写状态、不影响主路径的情况下增加续写计算。两路径共享 attention、MLP 和输出矩阵，仅用带轻量耦合的独立 token embedding。摘要报告在匹配 token 数对比下，该方法在多种架构和数据设置上取得更低的验证损失。
Motivation: LLM 推理的累计成本随请求量增长而上升；常规宽度或深度扩展会同时抬高预填充和自回归解码的成本，因为每个新增层在两个阶段都被计算，且扩大了解码每步读取的权重。
Method: 提出 Decode-Branch Transformer：主路径单独处理 prompt 并写入 KV cache，decode branch 在预填充阶段被省略、仅从最终 prompt 位置起在解码阶段激活。分组解码 (grouped decode) 在两个路径间复用已加载的权重块和主 KV cache，使新增算术运算不会成比例增加主导显存流量或解码延迟；两路径共享 attention、MLP 和输出矩阵，使用带轻量耦合的独立 token embedding。在 MoE 模型中，primary 与 branch 的 expert fan-out 成为独立调节旋钮，用于权衡 prompt 成本、解码成本与预测质量。
Result: 摘要报告在匹配 token 数的对比中，Decode-Branch 在多种架构和数据设置下取得更低的验证损失；在 MoE 模型上研究了两种专家分配机制（固定预填充或固定解码计算），并展示了由阶段特定专家分配带来的 prefill-decode-quality 权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调：把额外学习计算分配到续写预测、同时保留 prompt 级主计算和单一 KV cache，可以在不按比例增加主导显存流量或解码延迟的情况下改善预测质量；MoE 下阶段特定的专家分配可在 prompt 成本、解码成本与预测质量之间进行权衡。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出 Decode-Branch Transformer：主路径单独处理 prompt 并写入 KV cache，decode branch 在预填充阶段被省略、仅从最终 prompt 位置起在解码阶段激活。分组解码 (grouped decode) 在两个路径间复用已加载的权重块和主 KV cache，使新增算术运算不会成比例增加主导显存流量或解码延迟；两路径共享 attention、MLP 和输出矩阵，使用带轻量耦合的独立 token embedding。在 MoE 模型中，primary 与 branch 的 expert fan-out 成为独立调节旋钮，用于权衡 prompt 成本、解码成本与预测质量。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在匹配 token 数的对比中，Decode-Branch 在多种架构和数据设置下取得更低的验证损失；在 MoE 模型上研究了两种专家分配机制（固定预填充或固定解码计算），并展示了由阶段特定专家分配带来的 prefill-decode-quality 权衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调：把额外学习计算分配到续写预测、同时保留 prompt 级主计算和单一 KV cache，可以在不按比例增加主导显存流量或解码延迟的情况下改善预测质量；MoE 下阶段特定的专家分配可在 prompt 成本、解码成本与预测质量之间进行权衡。

papers.title: Geometric Self-Supervised Pre-training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) techniques have emerged as a highly efficient alternative to traditional exact algorithms for solving routing problems such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). However, the generalization capabilities of these Reinforcement Learning-based models are severely hindered when scaling to high-dimensional instances. This issue has been mitigated in other domains, like computer vision and natural language processing, by adopting a self-supervised pre-training strategy. Nevertheless, its application to routing graphs, which lack complex topological attributes beyond 2D spatial coordinates, remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose a geometric self-supervised pre-training framework specifically designed to capture spatial invariance and global relative distance distributions. By applying isometric transformations, such as rotations and axial reflections, the model learns robust structural representations prior to the policy optimization phase. Empirical results demonstrate that this strategy consistently outperforms models trained from scratch (baselines), achieving a 7.23\% improvement in tour length for massive zero-shot extrapolation scenarios (TSP1,000). Furthermore, the proposed model exhibits remarkable computational efficiency, delivering speedups of up to two orders of magnitude over the exact solver Concorde at massive scales. The source code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/davidaguadocosano/TSP-GeoPretrain.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向神经组合优化（NCO）的几何自监督预训练框架，通过在 TSP 等路由图上施加旋转和轴向反射等保距变换，使模型在策略优化前学习空间不变性与全局相对距离分布。摘要报告该方法在 TSP1,000 大规模零样本外推场景中比从头训练基线改善 7.23% 的 tour length，并在大规模实例上相对精确求解器 Concorde 实现最高两个数量级的加速。
Motivation: 基于强化学习的 NCO 模型在扩展到高维实例时泛化能力严重受限；自监督预训练在 CV 和 NLP 中有效，但路由图仅含 2D 空间坐标、缺乏复杂拓扑属性，难以直接迁移该策略。
Method: 提出几何自监督预训练框架，利用旋转和轴向反射等保距变换（isometric transformations）构造预训练目标，使模型在策略优化前学习鲁棒的结构表征，捕获空间不变性和全局相对距离分布。
Result: 实验中该策略一致优于从零训练的基线，在 TSP1,000 大规模零样本外推场景下 tour length 改进 7.23%；同时计算效率显著，在更大规模上相对精确求解器 Concorde 的加速最高达两个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要认为几何自监督预训练能改善 NCO 模型在高维路由实例上的泛化与计算效率，并公开了源代码与预训练模型。

papers.title: Benchmarking Foundation and Large Language Models for Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot medical image segmentation (FS-MIS) aims to segment novel regions of interest (ROIs) from a few annotated support examples. Despite rapid progress, existing FS-MIS solutions span diverse paradigms but are evaluated under inconsistent settings, leaving their relative effectiveness unclear. We introduce FAME, a unified benchmark for evaluating FS-MIS solutions, covering specialists, SAM-based methods, CLIP-based methods, and MLLM-based methods. FAME contains 14,958 test samples across 7 anatomical sites, 9 imaging modalities, and 14 ROI categories, and evaluates models under zero-shot and ten-shot settings with additional assessment of target-absence recognition and generalization under covariate and semantic shifts. Our evaluation reveals several findings. First, effective few-shot segmentation depends on how models exploit support examples: direct visual adaptation generally outperforms prompt-based strategies. Second, increasing support examples improves performance only when models can effectively utilize them. Third, semantic transfer remains substantially more challenging than imaging-domain adaptation, and strong localization ability does not necessarily imply reliable target-absence recognition. We hope FAME provides a comprehensive understanding of current FS-MIS solutions and facilitates the development of more effective and reliable few-shot medical segmentation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FAME，一个用于评估少样本医学图像分割（FS-MIS）方法的统一基准，覆盖专家模型、基于 SAM 的方法、基于 CLIP 的方法和基于 MLLM 的方法。基准包含 7 个解剖部位、9 种成像模态、14 个 ROI 类别下的 14,958 个测试样本，并在零样本与十样本设置下评估，同时加入目标缺失识别以及协变量和语义漂移下的泛化测试。评估发现：直接视觉适配通常优于基于提示的策略；增加支持样本仅在模型能有效利用时才有帮助；语义迁移比成像域适配困难得多，且强定位能力并不必然意味着可靠的目标缺失识别。
Motivation: 现有少样本医学图像分割解决方案采用多种范式，但评测设置不一致，导致其相对有效性不明确，缺少统一的比较框架。
Method: 构建 FAME 统一基准，纳入多类 FS-MIS 方法，规范零样本与十样本评估协议，并补充目标缺失识别和协变量/语义漂移泛化评估。
Result: 评估显示直接视觉适配优于提示式策略；更多支持样本仅在能被有效利用时提升性能；语义迁移明显难于成像域适配，且定位能力强不代表目标缺失识别可靠。
Conclusion: 作者希望 FAME 能提供对当前 FS-MIS 方案的全面理解，并促进更有效、更可靠的少样本医学分割方法发展。

papers.title: Visko Orbis 1.0: A Live Model for Real-Time Interactive Long Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present Visko Orbis 1.0, a Live Model for real-time, interactive long-video generation. Users can change the prompt at any moment during generation, and the update becomes visible in real time. Visko Orbis 1.0 supports long-form text-to-video, image-to-video, and video continuation, with multilingual prompts and prompt switching while generation is in progress. A bounded multi-scale memory preserves subjects, scenes, and style across chunks, sustaining hour-scale rollouts without evident quality or color drift. Built on a distilled chunk-wise streaming generator and a streaming video upscaler, Visko Orbis 1.0 delivers real-time 4K video generation at 24 FPS using an optimized GPU serving engine. In long-form Arena comparisons, Visko Orbis 1.0 obtains the highest overall-preference and temporal-stability ratings among state-of-the-art real-time interactive video-generation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Visko Orbis 1.0 是一个面向实时交互式长视频生成的 Live Model，允许用户在生成过程中随时修改提示词并立即看到更新。该系统支持长文本到视频、图像到视频和视频延续，支持多语言提示与生成中的提示切换，并引入有界多尺度记忆以跨块保持主体、场景和风格一致，实现小时级生成而不出现明显质量或色彩漂移。系统基于蒸馏的分块流式生成器和流式视频超分辨率器，在优化 GPU 服务引擎上实现 24 FPS 的实时 4K 视频生成。在长视频 Arena 对比中，Visko Orbis 1.0 在实时交互式视频生成系统中获得最高整体偏好和时间稳定性评分。
Motivation: 现有长视频生成系统难以兼顾实时交互性、长时间一致性和高分辨率，用户无法在生成过程中动态调整提示，且长时间生成容易出现质量或色彩漂移。
Method: 提出基于蒸馏的分块流式生成器与流式视频超分辨率器的系统架构，并设计有界多尺度记忆（bounded multi-scale memory）来跨块记忆主体、场景与风格，配合优化 GPU 服务引擎实现实时生成和提示切换。
Result: 在长视频 Arena 对比中，Visko Orbis 1.0 获得最高的整体偏好和时间稳定性评分，并支持 24 FPS 的实时 4K 视频生成。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作展示了实时交互式长视频生成在长时间一致性和分辨率上的可行性，但摘要未提及具体局限。

papers.title: Neurai-VN Benchmark: Standardized Machine Learning Models for Multimodal Digital Phenotyping in Mental Health Classification
papers.abstract_en: Digital phenotyping (DP) using smartphones and wearable devices has emerged as a promising approach for assessing mental health, particularly depression and anxiety. However, progress remains difficult to evaluate because of heterogeneity across datasets and inconsistencies in preprocessing pipelines. In this work, we introduce a reproducible machine learning benchmark using the Neurai-VN dataset, a multimodal digital phenotyping dataset collected from 100 Vietnamese adults over two weeks. We define four binary classification tasks evaluated using standardized subject-wise cross-validation. Representative linear, tree-based, and neural baseline models are evaluated systematically across predefined feature-group configurations. Mean subject-level F1 scores across five cross-validation folds reached 0.71 for Healthy Control vs. Depression and Healthy Control vs. Clinical, while Healthy Control vs. Anxiety and Depression vs. Anxiety achieved 0.69 and 0.56, respectively. These baseline results provide reproducible baselines for future research on multimodal DP for mental health classification tasks. The code to reproduce the benchmark is available at https://github.com/neurai-vn/Neurai-VN-benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Neurai-VN 数据集的可复现机器学习基准，用于多模态数字表型 (digital phenotyping) 的心理健康分类。数据集来自 100 名越南成年人的两周智能手机与可穿戴设备数据，定义了四个二分类任务，并用标准化的受试者级交叉验证评估线性、树模型和神经网络基线。平均 subject-level F1 在 Healthy Control vs. Depression 和 Healthy Control vs. Clinical 上为 0.71，在 Healthy Control vs. Anxiety 上为 0.69，在 Depression vs. Anxiety 上为 0.56。
Motivation: 数字表型用于抑郁和焦虑评估有前景，但数据集异质性和预处理流程不一致导致进展难以比较，缺少可复现的基准。
Method: 使用 Neurai-VN 多模态数字表型数据集，定义四个二分类任务，采用 subject-wise 交叉验证，系统评估线性模型、树模型和神经网络基线在预定义特征组配置上的表现，并公开复现代码。
Result: 五个交叉验证折的 mean subject-level F1 得分：Healthy Control vs. Depression 和 Healthy Control vs. Clinical 均达到 0.71，Healthy Control vs. Anxiety 为 0.69，Depression vs. Anxiety 为 0.56。
Conclusion: 该基准为未来多模态数字表型心理健康分类研究提供了可复现的基线，代码已在 GitHub 上公开。

papers.title: Fast Trainable Multilinear Bases for Image Compression
papers.abstract_en: The Discrete Fourier Transform, the Discrete Cosine Transform, and their block-wise variants underpin most deployed image and video codecs. Their effectiveness rests on three properties: they run in near-linear time (linear up to a polylogarithmic factor), they are exactly invertible, and they carry few to no parameters. In this work, we generalize these bases to isometric multilinear bases, allowing a small number of extra parameters, polylogarithmic in the image size, while preserving all three properties. Given an image dataset, we develop a systematic framework that searches this family for the basis compressing the dataset most effectively: the basis is parameterized as an isometric tensor network, inspired by quantum many-body theory, and trained with Riemannian optimization on the manifold of unitary matrices. Across natural photographs and line drawings, the trained bases consistently improve on their fixed, non-parametric counterparts. On Quick Draw line-drawing compression, they store images in roughly $20\%$ fewer bytes than JPEG's $8 \times 8$ block cosine transform at the same reconstruction quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类可训练的等距多线性基（isometric multilinear bases）用于图像压缩，将 DFT、DCT 等固定基推广为仅带 polylog 数量级额外参数、仍保持近线性时间与精确可逆性的基族。基被参数化为受量子多体理论启发的等距张量网络，并在酉矩阵流形上用黎曼优化训练。摘要报告在自然照片和线条画上训练基一致优于固定无参数基，在 Quick Draw 线条画压缩上，相同重建质量下比 JPEG 的 8×8 分块余弦变换节省约 20% 字节。
Motivation: 主流图像与视频编解码器依赖 DFT、DCT 等固定基，这些基具备近线性时间、精确可逆、几乎无参数等优点，但不针对特定数据集自适应。本文希望推广这些基到带少量参数但仍保持上述三条性质的族，从而提升给定数据集上的压缩效率。
Method: 将基参数化为等距张量网络（isometric tensor network），参数数量随图像大小呈 polylog 增长；提出一个系统性框架在给定图像数据集上搜索该族中压缩效果最好的基，训练采用酉矩阵流形上的黎曼优化（Riemannian optimization）。
Result: 摘要报告在自然照片和线条画数据上，训练基一致胜过对应固定无参数基；在 Quick Draw 线条画压缩中，同等重建质量下比 JPEG 的 8×8 分块余弦变换少约 20% 的字节数。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是在保持近线性运行时间和精确可逆性的前提下，引入少量可学习参数可以提升图像压缩的数据集自适应能力；该方法借鉴量子多体理论，但摘要未讨论其局限性或适用范围。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一类可训练的等距多线性基（isometric multilinear bases）用于图像压缩，将 DFT、DCT 等固定基推广为仅带 polylog 数量级额外参数、仍保持近线性时间与精确可逆性的基族。基被参数化为受量子多体理论启发的等距张量网络，并在酉矩阵流形上用黎曼优化训练。摘要报告在自然照片和线条画上训练基一致优于固定无参数基，在 Quick Draw 线条画压缩上，相同重建质量下比 JPEG 的 8×8 分块余弦变换节省约 20% 字节。
summary_sections.motivation: 主流图像与视频编解码器依赖 DFT、DCT 等固定基，这些基具备近线性时间、精确可逆、几乎无参数等优点，但不针对特定数据集自适应。本文希望推广这些基到带少量参数但仍保持上述三条性质的族，从而提升给定数据集上的压缩效率。
summary_sections.method: 将基参数化为等距张量网络（isometric tensor network），参数数量随图像大小呈 polylog 增长；提出一个系统性框架在给定图像数据集上搜索该族中压缩效果最好的基，训练采用酉矩阵流形上的黎曼优化（Riemannian optimization）。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在自然照片和线条画数据上，训练基一致胜过对应固定无参数基；在 Quick Draw 线条画压缩中，同等重建质量下比 JPEG 的 8×8 分块余弦变换少约 20% 的字节数。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要的结论是在保持近线性运行时间和精确可逆性的前提下，引入少量可学习参数可以提升图像压缩的数据集自适应能力；该方法借鉴量子多体理论，但摘要未讨论其局限性或适用范围。

papers.title: Hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-K Routing: Two-Sided Dependence Control for Frozen Mixture-of-Experts at Fixed Per-Token Routing Laws
papers.abstract_en: A stochastic Gumbel-Top-K router defines, for every token of a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, a routing law: a distribution over ordered expert lists and mixture weights. We ask which joint distributions over the routing choices of different tokens are reachable while every individual token's complete routing law is held exactly fixed. We give a two-sided construction, Hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-K (CGA). Within a group of related tokens, an exchangeable Gaussian copula positively correlates the Gumbel perturbations at each expert coordinate, which can increase within-group expert-set coherence. Across disjoint pairs of groups, a tunable antithetic construction introduces a selectable amount of negative dependence. We prove that both operations leave each token's ordered Top-K sample, mixture weights, and inclusion probabilities identical in distribution to independent routing at a routing layer conditioned on its pre-routing logits; conditional expected expert traffic is preserved as a consequence. We characterize the resulting trade-off: positive within-group coupling can only inflate the variance of realized expert loads relative to independent routing, while nonnegative cross-group opposition can only reduce it relative to flat coupling at the same within-group strength. Coherence and load dispersion are thus controlled by two complementary dependence dials on the invariance constraint surface. Because the base model is untouched, the dials can be driven by a small controller over frozen features, trainable with a score-function estimator: the frozen network is evaluated only in the forward direction, and gradients are confined to the controller. An initial small-scale pilot validates the mechanism and the training route, but does not establish task-level fine-tuning gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机 Gumbel-Top-K 路由器中,每个 token 的完整路由律(ordered expert lists 与 mixture weights 的分布)被精确固定的前提下,不同 token 路由选择的联合分布有哪些可达。作者提出 Hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-K (CGA) 构造:组内用可交换高斯 copula 正向关联专家坐标上的 Gumbel 扰动,组间用可调的 antithetic 构造引入负依赖。论文证明这两种操作都保持每个 token 的 ordered Top-K 样本、mixture weights 与 inclusion probabilities 在分布上等价于独立路由,并刻画了专家负载方差随两类依赖旋钮的变化;小规模 pilot 验证了机制与训练路径,但未建立任务级微调收益。
Motivation: 现有 MoE 路由研究大多关注单个 token 的路由分布,而不同 token 路由选择之间可达到的联合依赖结构尚不清楚。作者希望在不改变任何 token 边际路由律的前提下,通过控制联合依赖来调节组内专家一致性 (coherence) 与负载离散度。
Method: 提出 Hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-K (CGA) 两面对称构造:在相关 token 组内,可交换高斯 copula 在各专家坐标上正向关联 Gumbel 扰动;在不同组之间,可调 antithetic 构造引入指定程度的负依赖。由于基础模型保持不变,依赖旋钮由基于冻结特征的小型控制器驱动,并使用 score-function estimator 训练,梯度只作用于控制器。
Result: 论文证明该构造保持每个 token 的 ordered Top-K 样本、mixture weights、inclusion probabilities 与以 pre-routing logits 为条件的独立路由在分布上一致,并因此保持条件期望专家流量。理论上,组内正向耦合只会抬高实现负载方差,而非负的跨组对抗依赖相对同强度下的平耦合可降低该方差;初步小规模 pilot 验证了机制与训练路径,但未报告任务级微调收益。
Conclusion: 作者认为一致性与负载离散度可由不变约束曲面上的两个互补依赖旋钮分别控制;由于冻结模型只前向求值、梯度限于控制器,该方法有训练轻量的优点。同时摘要明确限定:pilot 仅验证机制,尚不能证明任务级 fine-tuning 增益。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Layering Virtual Try-On
papers.abstract_en: In the real world, fashion is about layering: adding a jacket over a shirt, or a sequence of adding and removing layers, rather than just a single-layer swap. This fundamental real-world task remains a challenge in existing Virtual Try-On (VTON) methods, which excel at single-layer replacement but are not designed to layer or de-layer an existing outfit. This paper proposes Layering Virtual Try-On (LVTON), a layering benchmark and method that preserves an existing outfit while enabling sequential layering. We find that current VTON paradigms are fundamentally ill-equipped for LVTON, as their reliance on cloth-agnostic representations and single-item datasets discards essential layering context. Our key insight is that the LVTON challenge must be disentangled into two distinct competencies: (1) General VTON Priors (e.g., deformation, identity preservation) and (2) Specific Layering Knowledge (e.g., layering order and occlusion reasoning). First, our model obtains general VTON priors by being trained on data produced by an automatic data generation pipeline that synthesizes samples from fashion videos via segmentation and inpainting. Second, the model is fine-tuned on a small, dedicated LVTON dataset to learn the layering logic. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on our LVTON benchmark and demonstrates superior generalizability on traditional VTON benchmarks, setting new state-of-the-art results when fine-tuned and exhibiting zero-shot capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Layering Virtual Try-On (LVTON)，一个面向分层次虚拟试穿（layering virtual try-on）的基准和方法，目标是保留现有穿搭的同时支持逐层添加或移除衣物，而现有 VTON 方法只擅长单件替换。作者认为 LVTON 需要解耦为两类能力：通用 VTON 先验（如变形、身份保持）与特定分层知识（如层叠顺序和遮挡推理）。模型先通过自动数据生成管道（从时尚视频经分割和 inpainting 合成样本）训练获取通用 VTON 先验，再在小型专用 LVTON 数据集上微调学习分层逻辑。
Motivation: 现实世界的时尚以分层为核心，例如在外套上叠加衬衫或反复添加/移除衣物，但现有 VTON 方法仅支持单件替换，无法处理分层或去层。现有范式依赖 cloth-agnostic 表示和单品类数据集，会丢弃分层的上下文信息，因此本质上无法胜任该任务。
Method: 将 LVTON 挑战拆分为两个独立能力：一是通用的 VTON 先验（变形、身份保持等），二是特定的分层知识（分层顺序与遮挡推理）。模型首先在一个自动数据生成管道产生的数据上训练，该管道利用分割和 inpainting 从时尚视频合成分层样本，从而获得通用先验；随后在小型专用 LVTON 数据集上微调以学习分层逻辑。
Result: 该方法在提出的 LVTON 基准上取得最优结果（state-of-the-art），并在传统 VTON 基准上表现出更强的泛化能力；微调后刷新传统基准的最优结果，同时还具备 zero-shot 能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调现实世界的穿衣本质上是分层操作，而现有 VTON 范式因依赖 cloth-agnostic 表示和单品类数据而无法处理分层；将通用 VTON 先验与特定分层知识解耦是解决 LVTON 的关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Do Cheap Probes Predict Expensive Training? Probing 3D-CT Encoders for Text Generation
papers.abstract_en: Building a 3D CT vision language model begins with a choice of which image encoder to build on. Today that choice is made by fine-tuning every candidate through the full language model and comparing downstream scores, an enormously expensive search. A cheap probe on the encoder's representation promises a way out, but whether it forecasts the expensive outcome has never been tested. We test this with CheapCT on report generation and on MeasureVQA, a new VQA dataset we build. MeasureVQA scores the outcome one capability at a time, its answers measured from segmentation masks and Hounsfield units. Report generation scores the whole report at once and reflects mostly disease. The probe forecasts expensive training across every capability. The rank agreement between probe and fine-tuning stays high throughout, from $ρ=0.90$ to $1.00$. Used to choose an encoder, CheapCT picks one nearly as good as the best while fine-tuning a single candidate, at orders of magnitude less compute. We release the code and MeasureVQA at https://github.com/renjie-liang/CheapCT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一个实际问题：在构建 3D CT 视觉语言模型时，能否用编码器表示上的廉价探针（cheap probe）预测昂贵全量微调后的下游性能。作者提出 CheapCT，在报告生成任务和新构建的 VQA 数据集 MeasureVQA 上进行验证，发现探针在所有能力维度上都能预测微调结果，排名一致性 ρ=0.90 到 1.00；用探针选择编码器时，只需微调单个候选即可获得接近最优的性能，且计算量低若干个数量级。代码和 MeasureVQA 已开源。
Motivation: 3D CT 视觉语言模型的第一步是选择图像编码器，但现有做法需要对每个候选编码器完整微调语言模型再比较下游分数，搜索成本极高；廉价探针能否预报这一昂贵结果此前从未被检验。
Method: 提出 CheapCT 探针方法，直接在编码器表示上评估其潜力；同时构建 MeasureVQA 数据集，按单项能力（从分割掩码和亨氏单位测量答案）评分，并用报告生成任务对整体报告进行评分，以此验证探针预报能力。
Result: 摘要报告探针与全量微调之间的排名一致性在各类能力上保持在 ρ=0.90 到 1.00；用它选择编码器时，仅微调一个候选即可选到接近最优的编码器，计算开销降低若干数量级。
Conclusion: 作者认为廉价探针能够可靠预测昂贵的 3D CT 编码器微调效果，并公开了代码与 MeasureVQA 数据集；验证范围限于 CT 影像的报告生成和 VQA 能力评估。

papers.title: Multimodal Language Models Benchmarked Against the NRC Reactor Operator Licensing Examination: Fine-Tuning and Retrieval Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Competence claims for a language model in a safety-critical domain are credible when measured against a standard the domain already enforces. We evaluate an open-weight 31-billion-parameter multimodal model (Gemma 4 31B-IT) on the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission Reactor Operator Generic Fundamentals Examination (GFE), scoring it paper by paper against the 80% criterion applied to every human candidate, with no rounding up. The evaluation set is a census of every GFE administered at the March sitting from 2015 to 2021, giving seven pressurized water reactor (PWR) and seven boiling water reactor (BWR) papers and 697 scored items. Eight configurations cross three model states, the base model, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on distilled chain-of-thought rationales and retrieval-augmented fine-tuning (RAFT), with three retrieval conditions, none and BM25 retrieval over the Department of Energy Fundamentals Handbooks under fixed-size and structure-aware chunking. Out of the box it answers 51.94% correctly and passes no paper. SFT with fixed-size chunking retrieval passes 8 of 14, reaching 80.23% on PWR items and 79.77% pooled, with a Wilson interval spanning the threshold. The preferred chunking granularity reverses with training state, structure-aware before fine-tuning and fixed-size after, so chunking optimized against a base model cannot be inherited by its fine-tuned descendant. RAFT trails SFT by 2.2 to 2.3 percentage points overall, and the deficit holds in all four reactor-type and chunking strata. The pipeline runs on one workstation with no network access at run time, and the result approaches operator-level command of engineering fundamentals without reliably achieving it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以美国核管理委员会反应堆操作员通用基础考试（GFE）为基准，评估开放权重 310 亿参数多模态模型 Gemma 4 31B-IT。评估集为 2015 至 2021 年每年三月考期的全部 14 份试卷（7 份压水堆、7 份沸水堆），共 697 道计分题，并按 80% 及格线逐份对照。基座模型未微调时正确率 51.94%，未通过任何试卷；经蒸馏思维链监督微调（SFT）并配合固定大小分块的 BM25 检索后，通过 14 份中的 8 份。
Motivation: 安全关键领域中语言模型的能力宣称需要有领域自身强制执行的客观标准来检验；作者选取核反应堆操作员执照考试作为这一标准，检验开源多模态模型是否达到人类候选人所必须满足的 80% 通过线。
Method: 在三种模型状态（基座模型、基于蒸馏思维链推理的 SFT、检索增强微调 RAFT）和三种检索条件（无检索、对 DOE Fundamentals Handbooks 采用固定大小分块和结构感知分块的 BM25 检索）下构建共八种配置，对全部 GFE 试题逐项评分，并以 Wilson 区间评估阈值跨越情况。
Result: 基座模型无检索时正确率 51.94%，未通过任何试卷；SFT 加固定大小分块检索通过 14 份中的 8 份，压水堆题目达 80.23%，合并后为 79.77%，Wilson 区间跨越及格线。最佳分块粒度随训练状态反转（微调前为结构感知、微调后为固定大小）；RAFT 整体落后 SFT 2.2 至 2.3 个百分点，且在四个反应堆类型和分块分层中均保持该差距。

papers.title: The Many Senses of Visual Similarity: A Text-Prompted Image Perceptual Metric
papers.abstract_en: Human visual similarity judgments are context-dependent. For example, two images may be similar in shape but distinct in color. Existing perceptual similarity metrics, however, collapse these nuances into a single scalar value, offering no mechanism to condition on specific aspects. To bridge this gap, we introduce a large-scale dataset of human similarity judgments over image triplets, where each triplet is annotated across multiple, free-form semantic aspects of similarity. Benchmarking a broad range of frontier vision-language models (VLMs) reveals a considerable performance gap compared to human annotators' consensus. Leveraging our data, we fine-tune a VLM to produce our Text-Prompted Image Perceptual Similarity (TPIPS) metric, capturing multiple senses of visual similarity depending on the specified text prompt. We demonstrate that TPIPS aligns more closely with human perception and generalizes reliably beyond the training distribution. Finally, we show that TPIPS unlocks new capabilities in text-guided retrieval, compositional search, and the fine-grained evaluation of generative models. Our code, data, and trained models are at https://peterwang512.github.io/TPIPS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出由文本提示驱动的图像感知相似度度量 TPIPS。作者构建了大规模图像三元组人类相似度判断数据集，每条三元组按多个自由形式的语义方面标注；评测发现前沿视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 与人类共识存在明显差距。通过在该数据上微调 VLM，TPIPS 能依据文本提示捕捉不同语义的相似度，并泛化到训练分布之外，还可用于文本引导检索、组合搜索和生成模型的细粒度评估。
Motivation: 人类视觉相似性判断依赖上下文，例如两幅图可能形状相似但颜色不同；现有感知相似度指标将这类多维差异压缩成单一标量，无法按特定方面进行条件化。
Method: 收集大规模三元组图像的人类相似度判断，并为每个三元组标注多个自由形式的语义相似度方面；随后利用这些数据微调一个 VLM，得到 TPIPS，通过文本提示控制所关注的相似度语义。
Result: 摘要报告对多种前沿 VLM 的基准测试显示其与人类标注者共识差距显著；TPIPS 与人类感知对齐更好，且能可靠地泛化到训练分布之外，并在文本引导检索、组合搜索以及生成模型细粒度评估中展现新能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为，利用多语义方面的人类判断数据微调 VLM 可得到更符合人类感知、且可条件化的相似度度量；并公开了代码、数据与训练模型。

papers.title: Does generative AI supersede supervised XMLC? A Benchmark Study on Automated Subject Indexing with German Scientific Literature
papers.abstract_en: With a large controlled vocabulary as the label set, the task of automated subject indexing in a library can be understood as a multi-label classification task. If the set of subject terms is large, the problem fits the Extreme Multi-Label Classification (XMLC) objective. In this study, we apply a selection of specialised supervised XMLC methods to the test case of subject indexing contemporary German scientific literature, collected at the German National Library (DNB). We contrast these results by including a classical lexical matching baseline and three of our own recently developed LLM-based methods into the benchmark. Algorithms are evaluated and compared in several metrics. This includes binary relevance comparisons with previously indexed material, as well as graded relevance ratings by professional subject librarians. A challenge for all methods is to reliably make suggestions from the long tail of the subject vocabulary. We find that supervised XMLC algorithms relying on transformer-based dense features give best results in terms of overall binary relevance metrics. However, focusing on graded relevance and performance in the long tail of our subject vocabulary, the LLM-based generative methods give better results, making them a promising alternative for future productive use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以德国国家图书馆（DNB）的当代德语科学文献自动主题标引为测试用例，将多种监督式极端多标签分类（XMLC）方法、经典词法匹配基线与三种自研的基于LLM的生成式方法纳入统一基准比较。作者发现，基于transformer稠密特征的监督XMLC方法在整体二元相关性指标上最优；但聚焦分级相关性与词表长尾表现时，LLM生成式方法更好，被认为是未来实际应用的有前景替代方案。
Motivation: 图书馆自动主题标引在大规模受控词表下可建模为多标签分类问题，词表规模大时对应极端多标签分类（XMLC）目标；但监督式XMLC与新兴LLM生成式方法在该任务上的系统对比仍然缺乏。
Method: 将一组专门的监督XMLC方法、经典词法匹配基线和三种自研的基于LLM的方法应用于DNB当代德语科学文献的主题标引基准，并使用二元相关性比较和图书馆专业标引员的分级相关性评分等多种指标进行评估。
Result: 基于transformer稠密特征的监督XMLC算法在整体二元相关性指标上取得最佳结果；而LLM生成式方法在分级相关性和主题词表长尾（long tail）表现上更优。
Conclusion: 所有方法都难以从词表长尾中可靠地给出建议；摘要强调LLM生成式方法在分级相关性和长尾场景下更有优势，是未来生产使用的有前景方向。

papers.title: LLMs as a Jury: Cross-Model Consensus Can Outperform Process Reward Models for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Selecting the correct answer from a pool of candidate reasoning chains is the engine of test-time scaling, yet the standard selectors each carry a cost: self-consistency inherits the errors of the single model it resamples, and trained reward models need labeled data and transfer poorly off-distribution. We study a third signal, free at inference time: cross-model consensus, the degree to which independently trained models, each solving the problem once, agree on a final answer. We treat the panel as an LLM-jury, in which the verification signal is the structure of agreement itself, with no model scoring another's work. Across seven benchmarks it selects correct answers better than self-consistency and far better than a model scoring its own candidates: on competition math it closes the entire gap to an oracle selector, while self-scoring closes almost none. The mechanism is error decorrelation: independently trained models err differently, so their wrong answers scatter while the correct one accumulates agreement. We make this precise with a parameter-free law, derived in closed form, that predicts consensus accuracy from three measured panel statistics to a mean absolute error of $0.03$ and exposes the method's ceiling: a shared-error floor where models share a misconception, near zero on math but non-trivial on science. Against four trained verifiers spanning discriminative, outcome, and generative reward models, the free LLM-jury matches the strongest inside their math training domain and is the top selector outside it. Cross-model consensus is thus a verifier we can characterize in advance: a law that says when to trust it, and a floor that marks where it cannot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究测试时扩展中如何从候选推理链中选出正确答案，提出将多个独立训练模型各自求解一次的最终答案一致性作为验证信号，构成所谓"LLM 陪审团"（LLM-jury），无需奖励模型或额外标注。在七个基准上，该方法的选答表现优于 self-consistency 和模型自我评分，在竞赛数学上几乎完全追平 oracle 选择器。作者还推导了一个无参数的闭式定律，仅用三个面板统计量预测共识准确率，平均绝对误差为 0.03，并指出共享错误地板（shared-error floor）构成该方法的固有上限。
Motivation: 现有答案选择器各有代价：self-consistency 继承单一模型重采样的误差，训练类奖励模型需要标注数据且分布外迁移差。作者希望利用推理时可免费获得的第三种信号，即多个独立训练模型之间的跨模型共识，来改进推理链选择。
Method: 提出 cross-model consensus 方法，将若干独立训练的模型视为陪审团，以它们对同一问题最终答案的一致性结构作为验证信号，模型之间互不评分；并给出一个无参数的闭式定律，用三个可测量的面板统计量预测共识准确率并刻画方法上限。
Result: 摘要在七个基准上报告该方法优于 self-consistency 且远优于模型自评分；在竞赛数学上几乎完全弥合了与 oracle 选择器的差距。共识准确率预测的均值绝对误差为 0.03，共享错误地板在数学任务上接近零、在科学任务上不可忽略；与四种训练验证器相比，该方法在其数学训练域内追平最强验证器、在域外成为最优选择器。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是跨模型共识是一种可以预先刻画的验证器：有定律说明何时可信、有地板标明其失效边界；错误去相关是机制，独立模型的错误分散而正确共识累积。

papers.title: PolyWorkBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Cross-Lingual Long-Horizon Workflows
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents excel at monolingual long-horizon planning and tool use, enterprise workflows inherently require processing multilingual resources across extended trajectories. The interaction between multilinguality and long-horizon execution, however, remains underexplored. We introduce PolyWorkBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate LLM agents on multilingual, long-horizon workplace workflows. PolyWorkBench features 67 tasks across five core domains: commerce, knowledge work, legal analysis, localization, and manufacturing. Tasks are authored by the paper's authors from real-world data seeds and independently verified through a second-author audit. Agents must integrate heterogeneous multilingual inputs, execute iterative tool-use trajectories, and produce structured domain artifacts. To rigorously assess performance, we adopt Grade, a task-specific structural scoring rubric, as our primary ranking metric, and complement it with Pytest for executable state verification and LLM-as-Judge for semantic quality diagnostics. Benchmark evaluations reveal that agent performance varies substantially across languages and drops sharply on the harder cross-lingual tasks, and our analysis shows that multilingual execution exposes systematic failure modes across planning, tool interaction, and decision-making in long-horizon agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolyWorkBench，一个用于评估 LLM 智能体在多语言、长周期工作流（long-horizon workflows）上表现的基准。基准包含 67 个任务，覆盖商务、知识工作、法律分析、本地化和制造五个领域，任务由作者基于真实数据种子编写并经第二作者审计。评估采用 Grade 结构化评分作为主要指标，并辅以 Pytest 和 LLM-as-Judge 进行状态与语义质量验证。实验显示智能体性能在不同语言间差异显著，在更难的多语言交叉任务上明显下降。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体研究集中于单语言的长周期规划与工具使用，但企业工作流本质上需要跨语言资源与长轨迹处理，多语言性与长周期执行之间的交互尚未被充分探索。
Method: 构建 PolyWorkBench 基准，包含 5 个核心领域的 67 个任务；要求智能体整合异构多语言输入、执行迭代工具调用轨迹并产出结构化领域产物。评估上以任务特定结构化评分标准 Grade 为主排名指标，并用 Pytest 验证可执行状态、LLM-as-Judge 做语义质量诊断。
Result: 基准评估表明智能体性能在不同语言间波动较大，在更难的跨语言任务上显著下降；多语言执行会暴露长周期智能体在规划、工具交互和决策方面的系统性失败模式。
Conclusion: 作者认为多语言与长周期执行的交叉是评估 LLM 智能体的重要维度，PolyWorkBench 提供了相应评测资源并揭示了现有智能体在该场景下的弱点。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 构建 PolyWorkBench 基准，包含 5 个核心领域的 67 个任务；要求智能体整合异构多语言输入、执行迭代工具调用轨迹并产出结构化领域产物。评估上以任务特定结构化评分标准 Grade 为主排名指标，并用 Pytest 验证可执行状态、LLM-as-Judge 做语义质量诊断。
summary_sections.result: 基准评估表明智能体性能在不同语言间波动较大，在更难的跨语言任务上显著下降；多语言执行会暴露长周期智能体在规划、工具交互和决策方面的系统性失败模式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为多语言与长周期执行的交叉是评估 LLM 智能体的重要维度，PolyWorkBench 提供了相应评测资源并揭示了现有智能体在该场景下的弱点。

papers.title: Statistical Adversaries: Natural Backdoor-like Adversarial Features in Clean Vision Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Model-specific adversarial attacks have been extensively studied. We study a different failure mode: naturally occurring statistical signals in vision data that can behave as backdoor-like triggers without being maliciously inserted. We call these signals statistical adversaries. We analyse ImageNet to find patterns that are strongly linked to certain labels. We then use statistical controls to remove random correlations from our candidate signals. Finally, we demonstrate that these signals directly and predictably alter model predictions. These statistical adversaries are more targeted than generic corruptions and transfer across different model architectures. This suggests that some vulnerabilities are driven by dataset structure and distribution rather than a single model's idiosyncrasies. We conclude that ordinary datasets can contain exploitable adversarial surfaces even in the absence of poisoning, and suggest that dataset audits should treat spurious structure not only as a source of bias or interpretability failure, but also as a latent attack surface for vision models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“统计对手”(statistical adversaries)概念：无需恶意投毒，干净视觉数据集中自然存在的统计信号即可像后门触发器一样影响模型预测。作者在 ImageNet 上寻找与特定标签强相关的模式，用统计控制剔除随机相关，并证明这些信号能直接且可预测地改变预测，且可跨模型架构迁移。结论认为普通数据集本身也可能包含可利用的对抗面。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注模型特异的对抗攻击；本文转向另一种失效模式——视觉数据中天然存在、未被人为插入却可充当后门式触发器的统计信号。
Method: 在 ImageNet 上分析并筛选与特定标签强相关的候选信号；使用统计控制(random correlations removal)去除随机相关性；随后通过实验展示这些信号直接且可预测地改变模型预测。
Result: 摘要报告这些统计信号比通用损坏(generic corruptions)更具针对性，并能跨不同模型架构迁移；这表明部分脆弱性源于数据集结构与分布，而非单一模型的特异性。
Conclusion: 干净数据集也可能包含可利用的对抗面；作者建议数据集审计应将虚假结构(spurious structure)不仅视为偏差或可解释性失败的来源，也视为视觉模型的潜在攻击面。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: TrustCLIP: Learning Private Visual Features via Adversarial Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Vision and vision-language models rely on high-level visual representations that are increasingly used across recognition, retrieval, and multimodal reasoning pipelines. However, recent advances in generative modeling have shown that such features can often be inverted, enabling realistic reconstructions of the underlying image and raising significant privacy risks. We revisit this problem through the lens of reconstruction and propose TrustCLIP, a reconstruction-driven framework that treats a feature-conditioned generator as an explicit privacy adversary. TrustCLIP learns a projection between encoder features and downstream modules that is explicitly optimized to degrade the reconstructions produced by generative attackers while retaining the necessary signals for downstream tasks. Unlike prior defenses that rely on discriminative privacy metrics, TrustCLIP directly optimizes against a generative reconstruction attacker, targeting a threat not captured by standard evaluation protocols. We demonstrate its effectiveness in both conventional classification and multimodal large language model pipelines. Across these settings, TrustCLIP consistently reduces the fidelity of generative inversions while maintaining downstream task performance. Project page: https://atnikos.github.io/trustclip/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TrustCLIP，一个重建驱动的隐私防御框架，针对视觉编码器特征可被生成模型反演出原始图像的风险。TrustCLIP 将特征条件生成器视为显式隐私对手，学习编码器特征与下游模块间的投影，在降低生成重建保真度的同时保留下游任务所需信号。作者在常规分类与多模态大语言模型流程中验证，该方法能一致降低生成反转的保真度并维持下游性能。
Motivation: 视觉与视觉语言模型的高层特征可被生成模型逆转，导致原始图像被重建并带来隐私风险。现有防御通常依赖判别式隐私度量，未覆盖生成式重建攻击这一威胁模式。
Method: 提出 TrustCLIP，一种重建驱动的学习框架：显式地将特征条件生成器作为隐私对手，并优化编码器特征与下游模块之间的投影，使该投影在对抗生成重建的同时保留下游任务信号。
Result: 在常规分类和多模态大语言模型两类流程中，TrustCLIP 均一致降低生成式反转（generative inversion）的重建保真度，同时保持下游任务性能。摘要未报告具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为直接针对生成式重建攻击者进行优化是一种有效的隐私防御思路，可弥补标准评估协议未覆盖的威胁。
Relevance: 0
