papers.title: Disentangling Pictorial Cue Understanding from Language Bias in VLMs via Depth Ordering Task
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study depth perception of vision-language models (VLMs) to isolate the effects of pictorial depth cues and disentangle vision and language influences on model performance. To this end, we combine depth-ordering and odd-one-out psychophysical tasks: the VLMs are presented with images where one object is at different depth relative to other, otherwise identical, objects, and must determine whether the odd-one-out target is closer or farther to the observer. To create stimuli, we generate 2D views from simulated and real 3D scenes while controlling the presence of individual pictorial depth cues, enabling a fine-grained analysis of cue-level contributions. Language effects are examined by varying referring expression clarity. We also introduce a novel metric to quantify vision-vs-language sensitivities. Applying this methodology, we create the Odd-One-Out Depth (O3-D) dataset with 37K real and synthetic images and 147K image-question pairs. Evaluation of 12 open-source and commercial models on O3-D shows under-utilization of depth cues and depth-ordering accuracies between 47% and 56%, with no model above chance level. At the same time, our metric reveals strong linguistic bias in the answers. Neither chain-of-thought (CoT) nor in-context learning (ICL) significantly improves performance, suggesting that static image data alone may be insufficient for depth understanding. All code, the image generation pipeline, and the O3-D dataset are publicly released at https://github.com/lyiqian/o3-d.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, accepted to ECCV 2026 (30 pages, 13 figures, supplementary materials included)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的深度感知，试图把图像中的 pictorial depth cues（图形深度线索）的作用与语言偏差分离开。作者把深度排序 (depth-ordering) 与 odd-one-out 心理物理任务结合，用模拟和真实 3D 场景生成 2D 视图并控制单个深度线索的出现，同时变化指称表达清晰度来考察语言影响，并引入新指标量化视觉与语言敏感性。基于该方法构建的 O3-D 数据集含 37K 图像和 147K 图像-问题对，12 个开源与商业模型在深度排序准确率上仅 47%-56%，均未超过随机水平，且被揭示存在强语言偏差；chain-of-thought (CoT) 和 in-context learning (ICL) 均无显著改善。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 评测容易混淆视觉理解与语言先验，难以回答模型究竟利用了哪些 pictorial depth cues；作者希望通过可控刺激物和明确任务来隔离语言偏差，检验 VLM 是否真正具备深度理解能力。
Method: 结合深度排序和 odd-one-out 心理物理范式，从模拟与真实 3D 场景生成 2D 刺激图，逐一线索控制遮挡、相对大小等图形深度线索；通过变化指称表达的方式调节语言提示强度，并提出一个量化视觉-语言敏感性的新指标；最终形成 O3-D 数据集与公开评测流程。
Result: 在 O3-D 上，12 个开源和商业 VLM 的深度排序准确率介于 47% 到 56%，没有任何模型超过随机水平；新指标显示答案中存在显著语言偏差；CoT 和 ICL 都不能显著提升表现。
Conclusion: 作者认为静态图像数据本身可能不足以支撑 VLM 的深度理解，单靠现有静态数据训练难以获得可靠的 pictorial depth cue 利用能力；代码、图像生成流水线和 O3-D 数据集已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Red-Teaming the Agentic Red-Team
papers.abstract_en: The use of agentic systems to perform offensive security operations has moved from a theoretical possibility to a commoditized capability. However, while the community has focused on creating more and more capable agents, less attention has been allocated to assessing the security of those systems. In this work, we present the first in-depth security analysis of the most widely used agentic systems for offensive security operations. We show that most of these tools share common design flaws that enable an active adversary to exfiltrate API keys, establish persistent footholds, and fully compromise the operator's machine, even when the agent operates inside a sandboxed container. To support our analysis, we introduce a full cyber kill chain for such agentic systems, capturing the progression from initial LLM manipulation to lateral movement, persistence, guardrail bypass, and sandbox escape. Building on our security analysis, we derive a robust architecture for agentic offensive-security tools and propose actionable, broadly applicable design principles that mitigate the disclosed attack paths at the architectural level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对用于攻防安全（offensive security）操作的智能体系统进行了首次深入安全分析。作者发现多数此类工具存在共同设计缺陷，使主动攻击者能够窃取 API 密钥、建立持久化驻留并完全控制操作者机器，即使智能体运行在沙箱容器内。论文还提出了针对此类智能体系统的完整 cyber kill chain，并给出架构层面的缓解设计原则。
Motivation: 社区将大量精力用于制造能力更强的 offensive-security 智能体，却较少评估这些系统自身的安全性；随着该类能力从理论走向商品化，其安全风险亟需被审视。
Method: 对最广泛使用的 agentic 攻防系统进行安全分析，提出涵盖初始 LLM 操纵、横向移动、持久化、guardrail 绕过和沙箱逃逸的完整 kill chain；基于分析推导鲁棒架构，并提出可在架构层面缓解攻击路径的设计原则。
Result: 摘要报告多数被分析的智能体系统存在共同设计缺陷，可被主动对手利用以窃取 API 密钥、建立持久化驻留并在沙箱容器内完全控制操作者机器。
Conclusion: 作者主张通过架构层面的可行设计原则来缓解已披露的攻击路径，并提出了用于 agentic 攻防工具的鲁棒架构方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlowDec: Temporal Conditional Flow Decorruptor for Robust Continuous Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to follow natural-language instructions in unseen scenes. While Large Models (LMs) have advanced VLN-CE, their performance remains severely degraded by real-world visual corruptions, a critical yet underexplored domain constraint. We introduce Temporal Conditional Flow Decorruptor (FlowDec), a novel image restoration framework tailored for LM-based VLN-CE. FlowDec integrates a hybrid temporal conditioning strategy to align the generative flow path with historical context and employs action-centroid guided filtering to dynamically assess and integrate outputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FlowDec outperforms state-of-the-art decorruption methods in both navigation accuracy and generation latency. Our approach establishes a robust, efficient paradigm for resilient embodied navigation in unpredictable real-world conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowDec（Temporal Conditional Flow Decorruptor），一个面向基于大模型（LM）的连续环境视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）的图像恢复框架，用于抵抗现实世界中的视觉损坏。FlowDec 结合混合时间条件策略对齐生成流路径与历史上下文，并采用 action-centroid 引导的过滤机制动态评估与整合输出。实验表明该方法在导航准确率和生成延迟上均优于现有去损坏（decorruption）方法。
Motivation: 基于大模型的 VLN-CE 在未见场景中性能会受到真实世界视觉损坏的严重影响，而这一领域约束此前未被充分探索。
Method: FlowDec 采用混合时间条件（hybrid temporal conditioning）策略，将生成式流路径与历史上下文对齐；同时引入 action-centroid 引导过滤，以动态评估并整合模型输出。
Result: 摘要报告 FlowDec 在导航准确率和生成延迟两方面均优于最先进的去损坏方法。
Conclusion: 该方法为不可预测的真实世界条件下的稳健具身导航（embodied navigation）提供了一种高效范式。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: FlowDec 采用混合时间条件（hybrid temporal conditioning）策略，将生成式流路径与历史上下文对齐；同时引入 action-centroid 引导过滤，以动态评估并整合模型输出。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 FlowDec 在导航准确率和生成延迟两方面均优于最先进的去损坏方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法为不可预测的真实世界条件下的稳健具身导航（embodied navigation）提供了一种高效范式。

papers.title: Empowering Polymeric Materials Discovery by Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Polymeric materials underpin modern technologies spanning energy storage, microelectronics, healthcare and sustainable manufacturing. Yet their rational design remains exceptionally challenging because material performance emerges from complex interactions among molecular composition, chain architecture, processing history and hierarchical structural evolution across multiple length and time scales. Consequently, polymer research has long relied on labor-intensive experimentation and fragmented modeling approaches, limiting both mechanistic understanding and innovation efficiency. Recent advances in data infrastructure, machine learning, large artificial intelligence (AI) models and laboratory automation are beginning to reshape this landscape. Rather than functioning as isolated tools, polymer databases, predictive models, AI agents and automated laboratories are increasingly converging into interconnected discovery ecosystems. As a result, the central challenge is shifting from improving predictive accuracy alone to enabling reliable decision-making, adaptive learning and seamless integration across computation, experimentation and scientific reasoning. We argue that polymer science is entering an era of autonomous discovery, in which data, simulation, reasoning and experimentation operate within self-improving feedback loops that continuously generate hypotheses, design materials, execute experiments and refine predictive models. By unifying molecular design, process optimization, experimental validation and industrial translation, such autonomous ecosystems establish a more predictive, reproducible and scalable paradigm for polymer innovation, fundamentally transforming how polymer research is conducted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇观点性论述，主张人工智能正在推动聚合物材料发现从孤立工具走向互联的自主发现生态系统。作者认为，聚合物数据库、预测模型、AI 智能体与自动化实验室将形成自我改进的反馈回路，统一分子设计、过程优化、实验验证与工业转化，使聚合物科学进入自主发现时代。全文聚焦范式转变，而非具体方法与实验结果。

papers.title: VisDom: Sparse Novel View Synthesis with Visible Domain Constraint
papers.abstract_en: Sparse novel view synthesis (NVS) remains challenging due to the ambiguity of recovering 3D geometry from few input views. While NeRF- and Gaussian Splatting (GS)-based methods perform well with dense supervision, they often overfit in sparse settings, producing floating artifacts and inconsistent geometry. Silhouette consistency is commonly used as a regularizer, but it remains insufficient, as silhouette-consistent regions can extend beyond the true object geometry. We introduce VisDom, a learning-free geometric constraint that augments classical carving-based visual hull reconstruction by enforcing a minimum multi-view visibility requirement. Specifically, we define a visible domain as the subset of 3D space observed by at least $K$ views and use it as an additional filtering criterion on top of standard silhouette-based reconstruction. This provides a stronger spatial prior in sparse-view settings. We integrate VisDom into both implicit (NeRF) and explicit (GS) pipelines by restricting volumetric sampling and guiding Gaussian placement during optimization. Experiments on three challenging datasets show consistent improvements in sparse-view NVS, enabling high-quality object-centric reconstruction from as few as four input images. Our method is domain-agnostic, requires only silhouettes, and introduces no learned parameters, making it a simple complement to existing approaches. Applying VisDom on top of GaussianObject further improves performance on Omni3D and MipNeRF360, while matching or surpassing it at 22 $\times$ lower training cost.
papers.comment: Accepted to GCPR 2026 (Oral). Project page and code: https://tarun738.github.io/visdom/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VisDom，一种无学习的几何约束，用于稀疏视角新视图合成 (sparse novel view synthesis)。它通过在经典 carving 式视觉外壳重建上增加最小多视角可见性要求（至少 K 个视角观测到的 visible domain）来增强 silhouette 一致性正则，并分别集成到 NeRF 和 3D Gaussian Splatting 管线中限制体积采样与引导高斯放置。实验显示在三个数据集上从最少四张输入图像实现高质量物体中心重建，叠加到 GaussianObject 上可改进 Omni3D 和 MipNeRF360 性能，并以 22 倍更低的训练成本匹配或超越原方法。
Motivation: 稀疏视角下从少量图像恢复 3D 几何存在固有歧义，NeRF 和 Gaussian Splatting 类方法在监督密集时表现良好，但在稀疏设置下容易过拟合并产生漂浮伪影和不一致几何；silhouette 一致性常被用作正则，但 silhouette 一致区域可能超出真实物体几何，约束仍不充分。
Method: 定义 visible domain 为至少被 K 个视图观测到的 3D 空间子集，将其作为标准 silhouette 重建之外的额外过滤准则，从而在稀疏视角下提供更强的空间先验。该方法无需学习参数，仅需 silhouette，并被集成到隐式 (NeRF) 和显式 (GS) 两种管线中，分别限制体积采样和引导高斯放置。
Result: 在三个挑战性数据集上，VisDom 一致提升稀疏 NVS 质量，最少四张输入图即可获得高质量物体中心重建；将其叠加到 GaussianObject 上进一步改进 Omni3D 和 MipNeRF360 的性能，并在 22 倍更低的训练成本下匹配或超越 GaussianObject。
Conclusion: VisDom 作为一种简单、域无关且无学习参数的正则补充，可增强现有 NeRF 和 GS 方法在稀疏视角下的空间先验，摘要强调其仅依赖 silhouette 且易于集成到已有方法之上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spectral Certificates and Projection-DPP Rounding for Determinantal MAP Selection
papers.abstract_en: Selecting a fixed-size subset that maximizes the determinant of a positive semidefinite kernel is the MAP problem for a size-constrained determinantal point process and the classical maximum-entropy sampling problem. Although this discrete problem is NP-hard, a classical spectral bound gives an efficiently computable ceiling using the leading eigenvalues. The same ceiling is the exact optimum of the associated Stiefel relaxation, so the continuous problem is already solved by the leading eigenspace. We study what this eigenspace implies for discrete rounding. The leading eigenvectors induce a projection determinantal point process whose probability for a subset equals its squared coordinate volume. We prove that the gap between the determinant of any subset and the spectral ceiling is at most its negative log-probability under this distribution. Consequently, the integrality gap is bounded by the min-entropy and equals it when the kernel rank matches the subset size. Projection-DPP rounding also has an expected gap bounded by the Shannon entropy and admits a high-probability additive guarantee. These results identify leading-subspace localization, rather than eigenvalue decay alone, as the geometry controlling roundability. This analysis yields CertDPP, a matrix-free pipeline that computes the leading eigenspace, draws projection-DPP samples, optionally improves them by determinant-increasing swaps, and reports the gap from a verified spectral ceiling. Controlled experiments validate the entropy identities, compare with exact MAP on small instances, and demonstrate linear scaling in the ground-set size for the rounding stage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究固定大小子集的行列式最大化（即DPP的MAP问题）中，谱上界与离散舍入之间的间隙。作者证明主导特征向量诱导的投影DPP的负对数概率决定了该间隙，从而将积分间隙与最小熵和香农熵联系起来，并提出矩阵无关的CertDPP流水线来计算该间隙。实验验证了熵恒等式，并展示了舍入阶段在地面集规模上的线性扩展。
Motivation: 固定大小的行列式最大化是NP-hard的，经典谱上界可高效计算，但该上界对应的连续解（Stiefel松弛）由主导特征空间精确给出，离散舍入与谱上界的间隙缺乏理论刻画。
Method: 利用主导特征向量构造投影DPP，证明任意子集的行列式与谱天花板（spectral ceiling）的间隙不超过其在该分布下的负对数概率；由此推导积分间隙受最小熵（min-entropy）约束并在核秩与子集大小相等时取等，投影DPP舍入的期望间隙受香农熵约束。进一步提出CertDPP，即矩阵无关的流水线：计算主导特征空间、采样投影DPP、用行列式递增交换改进并报告相对验证谱天花板的间隙。
Result: 摘要报告：积分间隙由最小熵界定，期望间隙由香农熵界定，并存在高概率加性保证；受控实验验证了熵恒等式，在小实例上与精确MAP对比，并显示舍入阶段在地面集大小上线性扩展。
Conclusion: 作者指出主导子空间局域化（leading-subspace localization）而非单纯的征值衰减是控制可舍入性的几何因素。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Machine-Learned Comorbidity Index
papers.abstract_en: Traditional comorbidity scores (e.g., Charlson and Elixhauser) are widely used for risk adjustment and patient stratification, but they have two key limitations: (i) they are largely mortality-centric and do not align well with other clinical outcomes, and (ii) their linear, rule-based structure cannot capture nonlinear, outcome-specific risk relationships. We propose a Machine-Learned Comorbidity Index (MLCI) that maps diagnosis codes to a single scalar by maximizing the normalized Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (nHSIC) between the learned score and multiple clinical outcomes. MLCI captures nonlinear risk-outcome dependence and is supported by a theory that characterizes when a unified, informative admission-level ordering can be achieved across outcomes. Empirical results on multiple benchmark electronic health record (EHR) datasets show that MLCI outperforms strong baselines across multiple evaluation metrics.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026), Seoul, South Korea. 35 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出机器学习共病指数 (MLCI)，通过最大化归一化希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则 (nHSIC) 将诊断代码映射为单一标量，以捕获非线性、结果特异性的风险关系。理论部分刻画了跨多个临床结局实现统一入院级排序的条件。在多个基准电子健康记录 (EHR) 数据集上，MLCI 在多项评估指标上优于强基线。
Motivation: 传统共病评分（如 Charlson 和 Elixhauser）主要以死亡率为中心，与多种临床结局的对齐不佳，且其线性规则结构无法刻画非线性、结局特异性的风险关系。
Method: MLCI 将诊断代码映射为标量，优化目标为最大化学习分数与多个临床结局之间的 nHSIC，并给出理论刻画以说明何时可获得有信息量的跨结局统一入院级排序。
Result: 在多个基准 EHR 数据集上，MLCI 在多项评估指标上优于强基线模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MLCI 能够捕获非线性风险-结局依赖性，并具有支撑统一跨结局排序的理论保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sum-of-Squares Degree Barriers for the Reweighted-Hinge Method in Robust Halfspace Learning: A Christoffel-Function Characterization
papers.abstract_en: A certificate that removes outliers sees the data only through its low-degree moments, and an adversary exploits exactly this, hiding corruption where the clean data already looks typical, in the blind spot no bounded-degree test resolves. That blind spot has an exact size: the Christoffel function of the clean marginal, the quantity data analysis thresholds to detect outliers, here read from the adversary's side as the corruption a certificate cannot remove. We turn this inversion into the organizing principle of the reweighted-hinge approach to robustly learning $γ$-margin halfspaces under malicious noise (Shen 2025; Zeng-Shen 2025): the governing resource is the Sum-of-Squares degree of the certificate, and the resolution principle states that the maximal corruption mass hideable at a center $c$ from a degree-$2t$ certificate is exactly the Christoffel function $λ_{t+1}(c)$. Three consequences follow, all against the certificate method (not information-theoretic). A margin-degree tradeoff: certifying the dense pancake to error $\varepsilon$ costs SoS degree $Ω(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ or margin $Ω(\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}/\sqrt{d})$, so the $\log(1/\varepsilon)$ margin of Shen (2025) is forced; a weighted-Chebyshev reduction makes the threshold $2t=Θ((|c|/s)^2)$ tight modulo one classical extremal estimate. A degree-2 outlier barrier: an explicit instance on which degree 2 is stuck at $η^{1/2}$ while degree 4 escapes, locating the small breakdown rate in the degree, not the analysis. A degree-$2t$ algorithm tracing the frontier $η^{1-1/2t}$ (recovering Shen 2025 at $t=1$), with an explicit constant gain capped by the pancake density. And an information-theoretic floor of $η/(2(1-η))$, matched exactly from above; under a hard margin its two-point realizations provably require $Θ(1/η)$ mixture components."
papers.comment: v2: Corrected proof of the breakdown floor (Prop. 4.11 -> 4.12): v1's two-point instance is inadmissible under a hard margin and v1's Fact 4.13 is false as stated (removed); the same eta/(2(1-eta)) floor is re-proved via a K = Theta(1/eta)-component construction, shown necessary
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从对抗者视角刻画鲁棒半空间学习中证书（certificate）的盲区大小，将其与 Christoffel 函数联系起来，并以此组织 reweighted-hinge 方法的分析。核心结论是：在恶意噪声（malicious noise）下，γ-margin 半空间学习的证书方法受限于 Sum-of-Squares 度数，最大可隐藏的腐败质量恰为 Christoffel 函数 λ_{t+1}(c)。由此导出 margin-degree 权衡、degree-2 障碍、degree-2t 算法前沿以及信息论下界等结果。
Motivation: 现有证书方法通过低阶矩移除离群点，而对抗者可利用干净数据在低阶矩上看起来典型的位置隐藏腐败；需要精确刻画这一盲区，以理解 reweighted-hinge 方法在恶意噪声下学习半空间的能力边界。
Method: 将盲区大小反转为 Christoffel 函数，提出“分辨率原理”：对中心 c 处、度数 2t 的证书，可隐藏的最大腐败质量等于 λ_{t+1}(c)。基于此分析 reweighted-hinge 方法，引入 weighted-Chebyshev 归约等工具，并构造显式实例与算法。

Conclusion: 作者强调这些下界是针对证书方法而非信息论意义；盲区的精确大小由 Christoffel 函数给出，这一视角统一了 reweighted-hinge 的度数、margin 与腐败容忍度之间的关系，并修正了 v1 中 breakdown floor 的证明。

papers.title: Safeguard-Conditioned Uplift: Measuring Utility-Risk Frontiers for Dual-Use Biology Assistants
papers.abstract_en: A refusal rate neither identifies which component intervened nor measures its burden on legitimate users. This paper evaluates safeguards for dual-use biology assistants at the action and answer levels. The framework reconstructs the access path, separates provider refusals from downstream actions, and selects thresholds under an intervention budget. A frozen fresh-generation study satisfies its criterion on Claude Opus 4.5, but both passing configurations share one upstream provider effect; none passes on Gemini 2.5 Flash. The fixed Opus policies retain positive selectivity on 104 previously unused released-label pairs, but both fail a 20\% matched-benign constraint. At the answer level, no joint-scoring verifier qualifies on a response-disjoint 7,200-judgment holdout. A fresh 8,640-judgment factorial experiment finds separate gains from criterion isolation and ordinal representation, with a positive interaction between them; requiring explicit localization lowers aggregate accuracy under a strict no-repair schema. The evidence supports prospective action-level selectivity and identifies verifier interface effects, but not calibrated selective access, verified content removal, or biological-risk reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在不侵入模型的情况下，将双用途生物学助手的安全防护拆解到动作层与答案层进行评测，重建访问路径（access path）并区分供应商拒答与下游动作，同时在干预预算（intervention budget）下选择阈值。冻结的新生成研究（fresh-generation study）在 Claude Opus 4.5 上满足其标准，但两个通过配置共享同一上游供应商效应；Gemini 2.5 Flash 上没有任何配置通过。固定 Opus 策略在 104 对未使用过的 released-label 对上保持正选择性，但双双未通过 20% 匹配良性（matched-benign）约束；答案层没有任何联合评分验证器通过响应不相交的 7,200 判断留出集。整体证据支持前瞻性的动作层选择性与验证器接口效应，但不支持校准的选择性访问、验证的内容移除或生物风险降低。
Motivation: 仅看拒答率既无法定位是哪个组件进行了干预，也无法衡量对合法用户的负担。需要一个能区分供应商拒答与下游动作、并在预算约束下选择阈值的细粒度评测框架。
Method: 框架重建访问路径，将供应商拒答与下游动作分离，并在干预预算下选择阈值。评测在动作层与答案层进行，结合冻结新生成研究和析因实验（factorial experiment）来检验不同评分设置的效果。
Result: 摘要报告：冻结新生成研究在 Claude Opus 4.5 上通过其标准，但两个通过配置共享一个上游供应商效应；Gemini 2.5 Flash 上没有配置通过。固定 Opus 策略在 104 对未使用过的 released-label 对上保留正选择性，但未通过 20% 匹配良性约束。答案层没有联合评分验证器通过响应不相交的 7,200 判断留出集；新的 8,640 判断析因实验显示，标准隔离与序数表示各有单独收益且二者存在正交互，而在严格无修复（no-repair）架构下要求显式定位会降低聚合准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为证据支持前瞻性的动作层选择性以及验证器接口效应，但不支持校准的选择性访问（calibrated selective access）、验证的内容移除或生物风险降低，说明评测方法有一定价值但本文未证明可落地的生物风险缓解能力。

papers.title: A Deep Zero-Inflated Model of North Atlantic Right Whale Presence To Support Blue Economy Management in the U.S. East Coast
papers.abstract_en: Effective modeling of endangered marine mammal species, such as the North Atlantic Right Whale, is critical for balancing marine conservation with the growing blue economy. Passive acoustic monitoring data collected by autonomous underwater vehicles provide new opportunities for localized marine species detection and oceanographic sensing, but introduce complex statistical challenges such as zero inflation, imperfect detection, and intricate dependence structures. In response, we propose the Deep Zero-Inflated Bernoulli (DeepZIB) model--a deep statistical method which jointly models latent species presence and conditional detection probabilities while learning complex habitat relationships from heterogeneous covariate information. We establish theoretical results on the model's structural properties and conduct simulation experiments to demonstrate its ability to recover underlying parameters and latent presence fields. Application to real-world passive acoustic monitoring data on the North Atlantic Right Whale along the U.S. East Coast demonstrates improved model adequacy and predictive performance in capturing the species' dynamic and spatially varying habitat. A key advantage of DeepZIB is its ability to generate high-resolution, spatially and temporally varying presence maps, providing valuable insights for targeted and risk-aware management of blue economy industries, ranging from offshore and marine energy, to fisheries management and maritime transport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Deep Zero-Inflated Bernoulli (DeepZIB) 模型，用于对美国东海岸北大西洋露脊鲸的被动声学监测数据进行物种存在建模。该方法联合建模潜在物种存在和条件检测概率，并从异质协变量中学习复杂栖息地关系；摘要报告了理论结构性质、模拟实验的恢复能力，以及在真实监测数据上改进的模型充分性和预测性能，最终生成高分辨率时空变化的存在图。
Motivation: 濒危海洋哺乳动物（如北大西洋露脊鲸）的保护需要与不断增长的蓝色经济相平衡，而自主水下航行器采集的被动声学监测数据带来了零膨胀、不完全检测和复杂依赖结构等统计挑战。
Method: 提出 DeepZIB 深度统计模型，联合建模潜在物种存在概率与条件检测概率，并通过深度网络从异质协变量信息中学习栖息地关系。
Result: 摘要报告了模型结构性质的理论结果，模拟实验显示能恢复底层参数和潜在存在场；在真实被动声学监测数据上，模型改进了一致性并提升了预测性能，可生成高分辨率、时空变化的存在图。
Conclusion: DeepZIB 的关键优势在于生成高分辨率时空存在图，为海上能源、渔业管理、海上运输等蓝色经济行业的风险感知管理提供参考。

papers.title: Speculative Rollback Correction for Quality-Diverse Web Agent Imitation
papers.abstract_en: Training interactive web agents through imitation learning from expert trajectories has emerged as a highly effective approach. However, determining the optimal timing for expert intervention presents a critical challenge in this context. Delayed intervention often leads to the accumulation of early-stage errors, pushing the page state into an irrecoverable regime. Conversely, premature or excessive intervention causes the agent to become overly reliant on expert policies, trapping the model in local optima characterized by a single, rigid trajectory. We propose Speculative Rollback Correction (SRC), a branch-level imitation framework for resettable agent environments. Instead of requesting teacher labels at every visited state or correcting only after a completed trajectory, SRC uses fixed-horizon branch review: the student executes a short speculative segment before teacher review, and the teacher localizes the first harmful deviation only when local progress breaks. Rollback preserves useful prefixes, while successful rollouts are filtered by a hard verifier and retained in a lightweight quality-diversity archive. The resulting data supports next-action supervised fine-tuning on both localized corrections and verifier-passing trajectories. On WebArena-Infinity, SRC collects 977 verifier-passing trajectories and 9,183 next-action examples; fixed-horizon review improves the recovery-versus-query tradeoff over step-level review while retaining verifier-passing solution variants. Code is available at https://github.com/LongkunHao/SRC_gui_agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Speculative Rollback Correction (SRC)，一种用于可重置智能体环境的分支级模仿学习框架。学生在固定步长分支内先执行一段推测性动作，教师仅在局部进展中断时定位首个有害偏差，并通过回滚保留有用前缀；成功轨迹再经硬验证器过滤并存入轻量级质量-多样性存档。在 WebArena-Infinity 上，SRC 收集到 977 条通过验证器的轨迹和 9,183 个下一步动作示例，固定步长审查在恢复/查询权衡上优于逐步审查。
Motivation: 交互式 web 智能体的模仿学习中，专家干预的时机是关键难题：干预过迟会使早期错误累积并把页面状态推入不可恢复区域，干预过早或过多则会让智能体过度依赖专家策略，陷入单一刚性轨迹的局部最优。
Method: SRC 采用固定步长分支审查：学生先执行短推测片段，只有局部进展中断时才让教师定位第一个有害偏差；回滚机制保留有用前缀，通过硬验证器的成功轨迹被过滤后存入轻量级质量-多样性存档。这些数据用于对局部修正和验证器通过的轨迹进行 next-action 监督微调。
Result: 在 WebArena-Infinity 上，SRC 收集了 977 条通过验证器的轨迹和 9,183 个 next-action 示例；固定步长审查在 recovery-versus-query 权衡上优于 step-level review，同时保留了通过验证器的解变体。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SRC 通过可重置环境中的分支级回滚校正来平衡专家干预的及时性与智能体自主性，在数据收集效率和轨迹多样性上取得收益。

papers.title: REFINE: Super-efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting Pruning via Rendering-Free Primitive Importance
papers.abstract_en: Existing pruning methods for 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) suffer from either severe quality degradation or prohibitive computational overhead. In this paper, we propose REFINE, a highly accelerated 3DGS pruning framework centered on a novel rendering-free primitive importance metric. Our approach leverages an analytically approximated, rendering-aware Hessian field to quantify the expected perceptual error induced by the removal of individual primitives. By modeling the joint modulation of visibility, projection geometry and the content adaptive hyperparameter, we entirely bypass costly forward rendering passes and derive an anisotropic perceptual weight field that serves as a high-fidelity proxy for primitive importance. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that REFINE maintains highly competitive rendering quality while achieving a $3,000\times$ reduction in pruning-related computational complexity, translating to a practical $\sim 20\times$ speedup in device latency compared to state-of-the-art pruning methods.
papers.comment: We corrected the results of LightGaussian and MesonGS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REFINE，一种面向 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 的高效剪枝框架。其核心是一种免渲染的图元重要度度量：通过解析近似的、渲染感知的 Hessian 场估计移除单个图元带来的预期感知误差，并联合建模可见性、投影几何和内容自适应超参数，从而完全绕过前向渲染。实验表明 REFINE 在保持高竞争力渲染质量的同时，将剪枝相关计算复杂度降低 3000 倍，设备延迟相比现有 SOTA 剪枝方法提速约 20 倍。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 剪枝方法要么带来严重的渲染质量退化，要么引入过高的计算开销；需要一种既能保持质量又显著降低开销的剪枝方案。
Method: 以解析近似的渲染感知 Hessian 场为核心建立免渲染的图元重要度指标；通过建模可见性、投影几何与内容自适应超参数的联合调制，推导出各向异性的感知权重场，作为图元重要度的高保真代理，从而完全绕过高开销的前向渲染过程。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验显示，REFINE 在维持极具竞争力的渲染质量的同时，实现 3000 倍的剪枝相关计算复杂度降低，并相对现有 SOTA 剪枝方法带来约 20 倍的设备延迟加速。
Conclusion: 作者强调，该免渲染 Hessian 感知权重场可作为高保真的图元重要度代理，支撑 3DGS 在低计算开销下高效剪枝。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 REFINE，一种面向 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 的高效剪枝框架。其核心是一种免渲染的图元重要度度量：通过解析近似的、渲染感知的 Hessian 场估计移除单个图元带来的预期感知误差，并联合建模可见性、投影几何和内容自适应超参数，从而完全绕过前向渲染。实验表明 REFINE 在保持高竞争力渲染质量的同时，将剪枝相关计算复杂度降低 3000 倍，设备延迟相比现有 SOTA 剪枝方法提速约 20 倍。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 3DGS 剪枝方法要么带来严重的渲染质量退化，要么引入过高的计算开销；需要一种既能保持质量又显著降低开销的剪枝方案。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，该免渲染 Hessian 感知权重场可作为高保真的图元重要度代理，支撑 3DGS 在低计算开销下高效剪枝。

papers.title: Reward hacking in physical reinforcement learning revealed by turbulent drag reduction
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning controllers optimise specified rewards, but in physical systems those rewards often capture only part of the true control objective. Three mechanisms through which this mismatch can produce apparent success without physical improvement are identified: incomplete accounting that omits relevant costs, constraint enforcement outside the policy that corrupts credit assignment, and observations that fail to resolve the relevant dynamics. All three are demonstrated in active drag reduction of wall-bounded turbulence, where the conservation constraint and full energy budget can be measured directly. A memoryless learnt policy reports drag reduction while raising total dissipation, collapsing to non-physical flow configurations. A recurrent multi-agent controller with the zero-mean projection embedded in the actor, temporal memory matched to the relevant timescales, and an actuation cost that bounds the wall power delivers a physically consistent control. Progress in physical reinforcement learning requires the reward, constraints, observations and evaluation metrics to represent unequivocally the physical objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究物理强化学习中的奖励黑客（reward hacking）问题，指出当奖励只刻画部分控制目标时，智能体可能表现出表面成功而实际无物理改善。作者在槽道湍流主动减阻（active drag reduction of wall-bounded turbulence）中验证了三种失配机制：不完整的目标函数、策略外约束破坏信用分配、观测无法分辨相关动力学。一个无记忆学习策略在报告减阻的同时提高了总耗散并坍缩到非物理流场；而将零均值投影嵌入actor、时间记忆匹配相关尺度、并包含作动代价的循环多智能体控制器则给出物理自洽的控制。
Motivation: 物理系统中的强化学习控制器优化的是指定奖励，但奖励往往只覆盖真实控制目标的一部分，这种失配会导致表面成功而无物理收益。作者希望揭示这一失配的具体机制，并说明物理强化学习需要奖励、约束、观测和评估指标共同表征物理目标。
Method: 采用主动减阻的壁面湍流作为可精确测量守恒约束和完整能量收支的测试平台，对比无记忆学习策略与循环多智能体控制器（recurrent multi-agent controller）。后者在actor中嵌入零均值投影、将时间记忆匹配相关时间尺度，并引入限制壁面功率的作动代价。
Result: 摘要报告无记忆策略报告减阻但实际抬高总耗散并坍缩到非物理流场；带嵌入约束、适当记忆和作动代价的循环多智能体控制器则实现了物理自洽的控制。
Conclusion: 物理强化学习的进展要求奖励、约束、观测和评估指标必须无歧义地代表物理目标；摘要未提及超出湍流减阻任务之外的泛化范围或定量性能数字。

papers.title: Imaginative Perception Tokens Enhance Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision language models (VLMs) excel at many tasks but still struggle with spatial reasoning when critical information is not directly observable. Many such problems require imaginative perception: inferring what would be seen from an unseen viewpoint, tracing paths through occluded spaces, or integrating partial observations into a coherent spatial representation. We introduce Imaginative Perception Tokens (IPT), intermediate perceptual representations that externalize what a VLM would perceive under alternative spatial configurations while remaining consistent with the observed input. To study this capability, we formulate three tasks, Perspective Taking (PET), Path Tracing (PT), and Multiview Counting (MVC), and construct datasets of approximately 20K examples with ground truth imaginations, answers, and evaluation benchmarks. Using the unified VLM BAGEL as the backbone, IPT supervision consistently improves spatial reasoning and often outperforms textual chain of thought training, even without generating images at inference time. On MVC, IPT improves accuracy by 3.4% and achieves competitive performance with strong closed-source models on PT. We further find that combining IPT and label-only supervision yields additional gains, whereas textual chain of thought can substantially degrade performance, suggesting a modality mismatch when spatial computation is forced through language. Overall, IPT provides a principled supervision signal for reasoning about unobserved spatial structure, improving generalization while producing interpretable intermediate representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态语言模型（VLM）在关键信息不可直接观测时的空间推理短板，提出 Imaginative Perception Tokens (IPT)，一种外化模型在替代空间配置下感知内容的中间表示。作者构建了 Perspective Taking、Path Tracing 和 Multiview Counting 三个任务约 20K 样本的数据集，并在统一模型 BAGEL 上验证：IPT 监督一致提升空间推理，在 MVC 上提升 3.4% 准确率，在 PT 上与强闭源模型竞争，而文本思维链训练反而可能显著降低性能。
Motivation: VLM 在需要想象性感知的空间推理任务上表现不佳，例如从不可见视角推断、追踪遮挡路径或整合部分观测为一致空间表示；这类场景中关键信息无法直接观测，现有方法缺少合适的监督信号。
Method: 引入 IPT 作为中间感知表示，在训练时外化模型在替代空间配置下会感知到的内容，同时保持与观测输入一致；以统一 VLM BAGEL 为骨干，对比文本思维链（chain of thought）训练，并探索 IPT 与仅标签监督的组合。
Result: IPT 监督一致提升空间推理能力，并常优于文本思维链训练；在 Multiview Counting 上准确率提升 3.4%，在 Path Tracing 上达到与强闭源模型相当的水平；文本思维链可能导致性能大幅下降，而 IPT 结合标签监督带来额外增益。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 IPT 为推理未观测空间结构提供了原则性的监督信号，改善泛化并产生可解释的中间表示。

papers.title: A Quantitative Approximation Framework for Flow Distillation in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We develop a quantitative framework for diffusion distillation by viewing few step sampling as approximation through compositions of learned flow maps. For trajectory distillation of the probability flow ODE, we show that low noise multimodal regimes separate score approximability from dynamical stability: the score remains efficiently approximable, while small local errors may be strongly amplified by stiff flow dynamics. In a Gaussian mixture Ornstein--Uhlenbeck model, we prove time uniform \(L^p(p_t)\) score approximation by ReLU and ReQU networks with explicit polylogarithmic complexity, and derive a computable Lipschitz bound \(L(t)\) for the flow velocity. The stability factor \(\exp\bigl(\int_s^t L(u)\mathrm du\bigr)\) can grow exponentially as noise decreases and mixture separation increases. Comparing this certificate with a certified local Lipschitz budget for one step students identifies regimes of direct distillation difficulty, without implying an approximation lower bound. We also show that deep residual compositions control global transport error through propagated local errors, and that equalizing cumulative stability yields an optimal nonuniform segmentation. With eight segments, this grid reduces final mean relative MSE by up to \(51.9\%\) versus uniform grids.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为扩散模型中的流蒸馏 (flow distillation) 建立了一个定量分析框架，将少步采样视为学习流映射复合后的近似。针对概率流 ODE 的轨迹蒸馏，作者证明在低噪声多模态区域，评分函数的可近似性与动力学稳定性会分离；在 Gaussian mixture Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 模型中，他们给出 ReLU/ReQU 网络对评分的显式 polylog 复杂度近似界，并推导出可计算的流速度 Lipschitz 界 L(t)。稳定性因子可随噪声减小和混合分离度增大而指数增长，比较该证书与单步学生模型的局部 Lipschitz 预算可识别直接蒸馏的困难区间；此外，均衡累积稳定性可得到最优非均匀分段，八个分段时相比均匀网格最多降低 51.9% 的最终平均相对 MSE。
Motivation: 少步采样可被理解为扩散蒸馏，但直接蒸馏在低噪声、多模态区域何时失效缺乏定量理论刻画，尤其是小局部误差可能被刚性流动力学放大这一问题。
Method: 提出面向流蒸馏的定量近似框架：在 Gaussian mixture OU 模型中证明用 ReLU 和 ReQU 网络实现时间一致 L^p(p_t) 评分逼近并给出显式 polylog 复杂度，推导流速度的可计算 Lipschitz 界 L(t) 及稳定性因子；同时分析深度残差复合如何通过传播局部误差控制全局输运误差，并提出通过均衡累积稳定性构造最优非均匀时间分段。
Result: 摘要报告时间一致 L^p 评分逼近具有显式 polylogarithmic 复杂度；稳定性因子 exp(∫_s^t L(u)du) 可随噪声降低和混合分离度增加而指数增长；八段非均匀分段网格相对均匀网格最多降低 51.9% 的最终平均相对 MSE。
Conclusion: 该框架通过比较稳定性证书与单步学生的局部 Lipschitz 预算来识别直接蒸馏的困难区间，但不暗示近似下界；均衡累积稳定性可得到控制全局输运误差的最优非均匀分段。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Access: Guided LLM Scaffolding for Independent Learning in Undergraduate Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly entering students' learning practices, but their educational value may depend on whether they are used to support reasoning or to complete tasks without engaging in the underlying reasoning. This study examines guided LLM use in an undergraduate Probability and Statistics course, focusing on the distinction between assigned LLM access and the quality of students' actual interaction with the model. In a four-week quasi-experimental summer program, students were organized into three balanced conditions: no LLM access, unrestricted LLM access, and guided LLM access. The guided condition used the same LLM platform as the unrestricted condition, but students received explicit training and rules intended to promote reasoning-focused help-seeking, stepwise hints, verification, and ethical use. All quizzes and the delayed final exam were completed without LLM or external assistance, allowing us to separate AI-supported practice performance from independent learning. Results show that guided use was associated with a clearer learning-oriented interaction pattern than unrestricted access, especially in prioritizing reasoning over final answers and requesting stepwise support. In behavior-defined analyses, Guided-LLM students showed a promising pattern of stronger no-help quiz performance, while practice scores showed no consistent Guided-LLM advantage. Available time measures did not support a simple duration-based explanation, and self-assessment calibration suggested better alignment between perceived and demonstrated understanding in Guided-LLM. These findings suggest that access alone may not reliably distinguish independent performance; instead, the quality of interaction and reasoning-focused scaffolds warrant further study.
papers.comment: 10 pages. Accepted at the 34th International Conference on Computers in Education (ICCE 2026), Asia-Pacific Society for Computers in Education (APSCE)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一项四周准实验研究本科概率统计课程中引导式 LLM 使用对独立学习的影响。学生被分为无 LLM 访问、无限制 LLM 访问和引导 LLM 访问三组，引导组使用相同平台但接受面向推理的显式训练与规则。所有测验和延迟期末考试均在无 LLM 辅助下完成，以分离 AI 辅助练习表现与独立学习。结果显示引导使用与更清晰的学习导向交互模式相关，但练习分数未见一致的引导优势。
Motivation: LLM 正越来越多地进入学生学习过程，但其教育价值可能取决于是否用于支持推理而非直接完成任务。作者指出仅分配 LLM 访问权限不足以衡量效果，需要区分访问本身与学生在交互中实际使用的质量。
Method: 采用四周准实验设计，设置无 LLM、无限制 LLM、引导 LLM 三个平衡条件。引导条件使用与无限制组相同的 LLM 平台，但附加显式培训与规则，鼓励推理导向的求助、逐步提示、验证和伦理使用；所有测验与延后期末考试均在无 LLM 或外部帮助下完成。
Result: 引导使用与更清晰的学习导向交互模式相关，尤其是优先推理而非最终答案、请求逐步支持。行为定义分析中引导组显示更强的无帮助测验表现，但练习分数无一致优势；可用时间测量不支持简单的时长解释，自我评估校准显示引导组对感知与实测理解的一致性更好。
Conclusion: 作者认为仅仅提供 LLM 访问权限不一定能可靠区分独立表现，交互质量和推理导向脚手架是更值得进一步研究的方向。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 引导使用与更清晰的学习导向交互模式相关，尤其是优先推理而非最终答案、请求逐步支持。行为定义分析中引导组显示更强的无帮助测验表现，但练习分数无一致优势；可用时间测量不支持简单的时长解释，自我评估校准显示引导组对感知与实测理解的一致性更好。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为仅仅提供 LLM 访问权限不一定能可靠区分独立表现，交互质量和推理导向脚手架是更值得进一步研究的方向。

papers.title: Annealed Softmax Greedy in Many-Armed Bayesian Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and group-based policy optimization methods update a stochastic policy by sampling multiple completions per prompt and increasing the policy's probability on those with higher reward. These updates, unline the exploration mechanism in Thompson sampling and UCB, do not include explicit mechanisms that track epistemic uncertainty. This paper studies a stylized explanation for why such uncertainty-agnostic updates can nevertheless be effective. We analyze an annealed softmax policy that selects actions according to a softmax of empirical mean rewards in a many-armed Bayesian Bernoulli bandit. Under a linear upper-tail condition on the prior, which implies an abundance of near-optimal arms, we prove that annealed softmax greedy achieves Bayes regret $\tilde{O}(m + T/m)$, and in particular $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ when the number of arms scales as $m = Θ(\sqrt{T})$. This is the near-optimal Bayes regret rate in this regime, attained also by empirical-mean greedy. Under the upper-tail condition, many arms keep empirical means near the optimum throughout learning, so the probability that softmax places away from the empirical best falls mostly on other near-optimal arms. By contrast, with a small number of arms, the same kind of softmax policy can suffer linear regret (Cesa-Bianchi et al., 2017). The result also provides a structural analogy to RLVR, where a base policy with a non-negligible probability of producing a correct completion plays the role of the tail condition. Simulations support the theory and motivate prior-anchored variants of greedy and annealed softmax that score arms by the Beta posterior mean and skip the forced initialization; with an arm-specific prior, accurate or noisy, these variants outperform baselines, including Thompson Sampling, when the number of arms is large.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多臂贝叶斯伯努利 bandit 中 annealed softmax greedy 策略的 Bayes regret，并以此解释 RLVR 这类不显式追踪 epistemic uncertainty 的更新为何仍有效。在 prior 满足线性上尾条件（即存在大量近最优臂）时，作者证明 annealed softmax greedy 的 Bayes regret 为 $\tilde{O}(m + T/m)$，当臂数 $m=\Theta(\sqrt{T})$ 时达到近最优的 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$。模拟实验支持理论，并展示了 prior-anchored 变体在大臂数场景下的优势。
Motivation: RLVR 等基于组奖励的策略优化方法通过采样多个补全并按奖励提高概率来更新随机策略，但不像 Thompson sampling 或 UCB 那样包含显式的 epistemic uncertainty 追踪机制。作者想用一个简化模型解释这种不感知不确定性的更新为何仍然有效。
Method: 分析一个按经验均值 reward 的 softmax 选择动作的 annealed softmax 策略，在满足线性上尾条件的 prior 下推导其 Bayes regret；同时提出 prior-anchored 的 greedy 与 annealed softmax 变体，用 Beta 后验均值给臂打分并跳过强制初始化。
Result: 证明 annealed softmax greedy 的 Bayes regret 为 $\tilde{O}(m + T/m)$，在 $m=\Theta(\sqrt{T})$ 时得到近最优的 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$，而臂数较少时同类策略可遭受线性 regret（引用 Cesa-Bianchi et al., 2017）。模拟表明，臂数较大时，prior-anchored 变体（无论 prior 准确与否）优于包括 Thompson Sampling 在内的基线。
Conclusion: 在线性上尾条件下，大量臂的经验均值始终接近最优值，softmax 偏离经验最优臂的概率主要落在其他近最优臂上，这是该方法有效的关键；作者还将此与 RLVR 建立结构类比，即基础策略以不可忽略概率生成正确补全相当于尾条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RT-Lynx: Putting GEMM Sparsity in the Right Place for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve strong performance in image generation but incur substantial inference costs. While prior work has reduced this cost via quantization and distillation, semi-structured sparsity, which can nearly halve FLOPs, remains underexplored. A key reason is that most existing approaches focus on weight sparsification, and pruning 50% of the weights can remove critical model capacity and degrade generation quality. Our study, however, shows that DiT activations are intrinsically sparse and significantly more robust to N:M semi-structured sparsification than weights. Motivated by this observation, we advocate a paradigm shift from weight sparsification to activation sparsification. We propose RT-Lynx, which applies N:M sparsification to activations and incorporates error-compensation techniques to mitigate accuracy loss. We further implement highly optimized CUDA kernels tailored to this setting, achieving up to a 1.55x speedup on average in linear layers. Extensive experiments across multiple diffusion models demonstrate that our method preserves the generation quality of the original models while substantially accelerating inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RT-Lynx，针对 Diffusion Transformers (DiT) 在图像生成中推理成本高的问题，将 N:M 半结构化稀疏从权重侧迁移到激活侧。研究发现 DiT 激活值本身稀疏且比权重更耐受 N:M 稀疏化，RT-Lynx 对激活值应用 N:M 剪枝并引入误差补偿，配合定制 CUDA 内核，在线性层平均获得最高 1.55 倍加速，同时保持原有生成质量。
Motivation: 已有压缩工作多采用量化与蒸馏，而能近乎减半 FLOPs 的半结构化稀疏较少被探索；现有方法集中于权重稀疏，剪掉 50% 权重会移除关键模型容量并损害生成质量。
Method: 提出从权重稀疏转向激活稀疏的范式，RT-Lynx 对激活值施加 N:M 半结构化稀疏化，并采用误差补偿 (error compensation) 技术缓解精度损失，同时实现面向该稀疏模式的高度优化 CUDA 内核。
Result: 在多个扩散模型上的实验表明，该方法在保持原始模型生成质量的同时显著加速推理，线性层平均速度提升可达 1.55 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要主张将剪枝重心从权重转移到激活值，并表明激活 N:M 稀疏化配合误差补偿能够有效加速 DiT 推理且不损失生成质量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SymbolicLight V1: Spike-Gated Dual-Path Language Modeling at High Activation Sparsity
papers.abstract_en: Natively trained spiking language models must preserve information across time while operating through sparse binary activations, a combination that has produced a persistent quality gap relative to dense Transformers. We present SymbolicLight V1, a spike-gated dual-path language model that couples binary Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) dynamics with a continuous residual stream. Its Dual-Path SparseTCAM mixer combines a first-order exponential-decay state with windowed local attention on the continuous residual stream, followed by a context-conditioned decoding head. We train four 194M-parameter models from scratch on a 3B-token, 10-domain Chinese-English corpus. On a token-weighted held-out set the runs reach PPL 8.88-8.93 (mean 8.904, sample standard deviation 0.019) at more than 89% per-element activation sparsity. Code tokens are 43.7% of that set; the unweighted mean of the ten domain PPLs is 29.38. Under the same corpus, tokenizer, token budget, and hardware, the token-weighted mean is 7.7% above GPT-2 201M (PPL 8.27). Across five zero-shot benchmarks the two 200M-scale models show no clear accuracy separation. Under sampling with temperature 0.7 and top-k 50, SymbolicLight produces lower 4-gram repetition; an entropy-modulated rule reverses that ranking. On a measured RTX 2080 Ti, SymbolicLight uses 2,848 mJ/token versus 905 mJ/token for GPT-2 201M.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 24 tables. Revised preprint: quality-gap framing, token-weighted versus unweighted domain PPL, and tightened architecture claims. Code and checkpoints: https://github.com/SymbolicLight-AGI/SymbolicLight-V1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SymbolicLight V1，一种 spike-gated 双路径语言模型，将二值 Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) 动力学与连续残差流结合，尝试缩小原生训练脉冲语言模型与稠密 Transformer 之间的质量差距。作者在 3B token、10 领域的中英混合语料上从零训练了 4 个 194M 参数模型，token 加权留出集 PPL 为 8.88–8.93（均值 8.904），同时保持超过 89% 的逐元素激活稀疏性。结果表明在相同语料和硬件下，其 token 加权 PPL 比 GPT-2 201M 高 7.7%（PPL 8.27），零样本基准上无明显准确率差异，但实际测量能耗反而更高。
Motivation: 原生训练（natively trained）的脉冲语言模型需要在稀疏二值激活条件下跨时间保持信息，这使其相对于稠密 Transformer 一直存在持续的质量差距；论文旨在解决这一质量差距问题。
Method: 提出 Dual-Path SparseTCAM mixer，将一阶指数衰减状态与连续残差流上的窗口化局部注意力（windowed local attention）耦合，并配合上下文条件解码头（context-conditioned decoding head）；整体架构采用 spike-gated 双路径设计，结合二值 LIF 脉冲动力学与连续残差路径。
Result: 在 3B-token、10 领域中英语料上训练 4 个 194M 模型，token 加权 PPL 均值为 8.904（标准差 0.019），激活稀疏性高于 89%；无权重领域 PPL 均值为 29.38。与 GPT-2 201M（PPL 8.27）相比，token 加权均值高 7.7%；五个零样本基准上两者无显著准确率分离。温度 0.7、top-k 50 采样下 SymbolicLight 的 4-gram 重复率更低，但熵调制规则会反转该排序；在 RTX 2080 Ti 上实测能耗为 2,848 mJ/token，高于 GPT-2 201M 的 905 mJ/token。
Conclusion: 摘要将工作定位为脉冲语言模型质量差距的改进尝试，强调高激活稀疏性下 PPL 已接近同规模稠密 GPT-2，但实际能量开销并未降低；作者在修订版中采用了质量差距框架、token 加权与未加权领域 PPL 的区分，并收紧了架构方面的表述。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Spectral Progressive Diffusion for Efficient Image and Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have been shown to implicitly generate visual content autoregressively in the frequency domain, where low-frequency components are generated earlier in the denoising process while high-frequency details emerge only in later timesteps. This structure offers a natural opportunity for efficient generation, as high-resolution computation on noise-dominated frequencies is largely redundant. We propose Spectral Progressive Diffusion, a general framework that progressively grows resolution along the denoising trajectory of pretrained diffusion models. To this end, we develop a spectral noise expansion mechanism and derive an optimal resolution schedule from the model's power spectrum. Our framework supports training-free acceleration and a novel fine-tuning recipe that further improves efficiency and quality. We demonstrate significant speedups on state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generation models while preserving visual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Spectral Progressive Diffusion，一个利用预训练扩散模型在去噪过程中频率域隐式自回归生成特性的通用框架，沿去噪轨迹逐步增大生成分辨率，从而加速图像和视频生成。方法包含频谱噪声扩展机制和由模型功率谱推导的最优分辨率调度，并支持免训练加速与进一步提升效率的微调配方。
Motivation: 扩散模型在频域中先产生低频成分、后产生高频细节，噪声主导频段上的高分辨率计算大量冗余，这为在不损失质量的前提下进行高效生成提供了天然机会。
Method: 提出一个通用框架，在预训练扩散模型的去噪轨迹上渐进式提升分辨率；开发频谱噪声扩展机制，并从模型功率谱推导最优分辨率调度；框架支持免训练加速，也提供一种微调配方以进一步提升效率与质量。
Result: 摘要报告在多种预训练图像和视频生成模型上实现显著加速，同时保持视觉质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架具有通用性，可在保持视觉质量的同时加速现有扩散生成模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Evolving Ensemble of Agents
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Evolving Ensemble of Agents (EvE), a decentralized framework that organizes existing, highly capable coding agents into a live, co-evolving system for algorithmic discovery. Rather than reinventing the wheel within the ``LLMs as optimizers'' paradigm, EvE fixes the base agent substrate and focuses entirely on evolving the cumulative guidance and skills that dictate agent behaviors. By maintaining two co-evolving populations, namely functional code solvers and agent guidance states, the system evaluates agents through a synchronous race, updating their empirical Elo ratings based on the marginal gains they contribute to the current solver state. When applied to a research bottleneck in In-Context Operator Networks (ICON), EvE autonomously discovered a robust rescale-then-interpolate mechanism that enables reliable example-count generalization. Crucially, controlled ablations reveal the absolute necessity of stage-dependent agent adaptation to navigate the shifting search landscapes of complex codebases. Compared to variants driven by a fixed initial agent or even a frozen ``best-evolved'' agent, EvE uniquely avoids phase mismatch, demonstrating that organizing agents into a self-revising ensemble is the fundamental driver for breaking through static performance ceilings.

papers.title: Learning Koopman operators for coupled systems via information on governing equations of subsystems
papers.abstract_en: Nonlinear coupled systems are ubiquitous in science and engineering. The analysis and modeling of such systems are challenging due to their high dimensionality and complex interactions among subsystems. In recent years, operator-theoretic methods based on the Koopman operator have attracted attention as a powerful tool for analyzing and modeling nonlinear dynamical systems. Extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) is one of the most popular methods for approximating the Koopman operator. However, EDMD is a purely data-driven method, and it may be unstable and inaccurate for coupled systems under limited data availability. In this paper, we propose a method to construct a finite-dimensional Koopman approximation for coupled systems using the differential equations governing each subsystem. The proposed method aims to improve data efficiency by using the known subsystem dynamics as prior information and learning the coupling-induced correction from a limited number of snapshots. We also demonstrate its effectiveness through numerical experiments on coupled oscillator systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非线性耦合系统在有限快照数据下 Koopman 算子近似不稳定、不准确的问题，提出利用各子系统已知的微分方程作为先验信息，仅从少量快照学习耦合诱导的修正项，从而构建有限维 Koopman 近似。作者通过耦合振荡器系统的数值实验展示了该方法在提升数据效率方面的有效性。
Motivation: 扩展动态模式分解 (EDMD) 等纯数据驱动方法在数据有限时对耦合系统可能不稳定且不准确；利用子系统已知动力学作为先验有望缓解该问题。
Method: 提出一种利用子系统控制方程构建有限维 Koopman 算子的方法，将已知子系统动力学作为先验，并从有限数量快照中学习耦合引起的修正。
Result: 摘要报告在耦合振荡器系统上的数值实验验证了方法的有效性，但未给出具体量化提升数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用子系统动力学先验可以提高数据效率，但实验范围限于耦合振荡器系统，未提及真实大规模系统的验证。

papers.title: RETO: A Rotary-Enhanced Transformer Operator for High-Fidelity Prediction of Automotive Aerodynamics
papers.abstract_en: Rapid aerodynamic evaluation is crucial for modern vehicle design, yet existing neural operators struggle to capture intricate spatial correlations. We propose the rotary-enhanced transformer operator (RETO), a novel neural solver featuring a dual-stage spatial awareness mechanism: sinusoidal-cosine encodings for global referencing and rotary positional encodings (RoPE) for relative displacements. RoPE encodes spatial relations via unitary rotations, enforcing translation invariance and enhancing local gradient resolution. RETO is validated on ShapeNet and the high-fidelity DrivAerML benchmark. On ShapeNet, RETO achieves a relative $L_2$ error of 0.063, outperforming RegDGCNN at 0.125 and representing a 16\% improvement over the Transolver baseline, which yields an error of 0.075. These performance gains are further amplified on the DrivAerML dataset, where RETO achieves relative $L_2$ errors of 0.089 for surface pressure and 0.097 for velocity. In comparison, Transolver results in errors of 0.116 and 0.121 for the same metrics, indicating that RETO achieves precision enhancements of 23\% and 19\%, respectively. For comprehensive comparison, the surface pressure and velocity errors for AB-UBT are 0.102 and 0.124, while RegDGCNN yields 0.235 and 0.312, respectively. Information-theoretical analysis shows that the entropy peak of RETO at 0.35 is significantly lower than that of Transolver at 0.75 under $10^4$ resolution, indicating a focused attentional mechanism capable of preserving localized gradients against global diffusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出旋转增强Transformer算子RETO，用于汽车空气动力学高保真预测。RETO结合正弦-余弦位置编码（全局参照）与旋转位置编码RoPE（相对位移），通过单位旋转实现平移不变性并增强局部梯度分辨率。在ShapeNet与DrivAerML基准上，RETO的相对L2误差显著低于Transolver、RegDGCNN等基线，且信息论分析显示其注意力熵更低。
Motivation: 现有神经算子难以捕捉汽车空气动力学中复杂的空间关联，影响快速气动评估的精度。
Method: 设计双阶段空间感知机制：正弦-余弦编码提供全局位置参照，RoPE以单位旋转编码相对位移，从而在保持平移不变性的同时提升局部梯度分辨率。
Result: 在ShapeNet上RETO的相对L2误差为0.063，优于RegDGCNN（0.125）和Transolver（0.075），较Transolver提升16%。在DrivAerML上，表面压力和速度误差分别为0.089和0.097，较Transolver的0.116和0.121提升23%和19%；信息论分析表明RETO在10^4分辨率下的熵峰（0.35）远低于Transolver的0.75。
Conclusion: 摘要表明RETO通过融合全局与局部空间编码显著提升了汽车空气动力学预测的精度和注意力聚焦性。

papers.title: MoRFI: Monotonic Sparse Autoencoder Feature Identification
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) acquire most of their factual knowledge during the pre-training stage, through next token prediction. Subsequent stages of post-training often introduce new facts outwith the parametric knowledge, giving rise to hallucinations. While it has been demonstrated that supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on new knowledge may exacerbate the problem, the underlying mechanisms are still poorly understood. We conduct a controlled fine-tuning experiment, focusing on closed-book QA, and identify latent directions causally implicated in this degradation. Specifically, we fine-tune Llama 3.1 8B, Gemma 2 9B and Mistral 7B v03 on seven controlled mixtures of a single QA dataset, controlling for the percentage of new knowledge and number of training epochs. By measuring performance on the test set, we validate that incrementally introducing new knowledge increases hallucinations, with the effect being more pronounced with prolonged training. We leverage pre-trained sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to analyze residual stream activations across various checkpoints for each model and propose Monotonic Relationship Feature Identification (MoRFI) for capturing causally relevant latents. MoRFI filters SAE features that respond monotonically to controlled fine-tuning data mixtures of a target property. Our findings are consistent with exposure to unknown facts disrupting the model's ability to retrieve stored knowledge along a set of directions in the residual stream. Our pipeline reliably discovers them across distinct models, partially recovering lost knowledge through single-latent interventions.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控微调实验研究大语言模型在闭卷问答中因引入新知识而产生幻觉的机制，提出单调关系特征识别 (MoRFI) 方法，利用预训练稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 过滤在受控数据混合物下呈单调响应的残差流潜在方向，并在 Llama 3.1 8B、Gemma 2 9B 和 Mistral 7B v03 上验证这些方向与幻觉增强的因果关联，且可通过单潜在干预部分恢复丢失的知识。
Motivation: 大语言模型主要在预训练阶段获取事实知识，后训练阶段引入的新事实超出参数知识范围会引发幻觉；已有研究显示对未知知识进行有监督微调 (SFT) 可能加剧问题，但潜在机制仍不清楚。
Method: 在闭卷问答任务上对三个模型进行受控微调，控制新知识比例和训练轮数；使用预训练的稀疏自编码器分析残差流激活，提出 MoRFI 筛选与受控微调数据混合比例呈单调关系的 SAE 特征，以识别因果相关的潜在方向。
Result: 摘要报告逐步引入新知识会增加幻觉，且延长训练会使效应更明显；MoRFI 能在不同模型中稳定发现相关潜在方向，并通过单潜在干预部分恢复丢失的知识。
Conclusion: 研究发现与未知事实的暴露干扰模型沿残差流中一组方向检索已存储知识这一机制一致，MoRFI 可作为跨模型发现因果相关潜在方向的可靠管道。

papers.title: The Optimal Sample Complexity of Multiclass and List Learning
papers.abstract_en: While the optimal sample complexity of binary classification in terms of the VC dimension is well-established, determining the optimal sample complexity of multiclass classification has remained open. The appropriate complexity parameter for multiclass classification is the DS dimension, and despite significant efforts, a gap of $\sqrt{\text{DS}}$ has persisted between the upper and lower bounds on sample complexity. Recent work by Hanneke et al. (2026) shows a novel algebraic characterization of multiclass hypothesis classes in terms of their DS dimension. Building up on this, we show that the maximum hypergraph density of any multiclass hypothesis class is upper-bounded by its DS dimension. This proves a longstanding conjecture of Daniely and Shalev-Shwartz (2014). As a consequence, we determine the optimal dependence of the sample complexity on the DS dimension for multiclass as well as list learning.
papers.comment: new bounds for agnostic list learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多类分类与列表学习 (list learning) 的样本复杂度。作者在 Hanneke 等人 (2026) 对多类假设类 DS 维数的代数刻画基础上，证明任意多类假设类的最大超图密度 (maximum hypergraph density) 以其 DS 维数为上界，从而证实 Daniely 和 Shalev-Shwartz (2014) 的猜想，并由此确定样本复杂度对 DS 维数的最优依赖关系。
Motivation: 二分类的 VC 维样本复杂度已完全清楚，但多类分类的最优样本复杂度长期未决；此前上下界之间存在 sqrt(DS) 的差距，需要通过 DS 维数填补这一缺口。
Method: 基于 Hanneke 等人对多类假设类 DS 维数的代数刻画，证明最大超图密度被 DS 维数界定，从而统一样本复杂度的上界与下界；arXiv 评论还指出该结果给出 agnostic list learning 的新界。
Result: 证明了最大超图密度不超过 DS 维数，解决了 Daniely 和 Shalev-Shwartz (2014) 的猜想；据此确定多类分类与列表学习样本复杂度关于 DS 维数的最优依赖关系，消除了 sqrt(DS) 的差距。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这一结果从理论上确定了多类分类与列表学习的最优样本复杂度，核心贡献在于把超图密度与 DS 维数联系起来。摘要未说明具体局限性。

papers.title: Leakage-Audited Benchmarking Reveals Limited Evidence for Cross-Subject Auditory-Evoked EEG Vowel Perception Decoding
papers.abstract_en: We tested whether auditory-evoked EEG supports subject-independent five-vowel perception decoding when trial identity, model identity, prediction provenance, and participant-level inference are controlled within a single benchmark. We reconstructed Study 2 event tables from OpenNeuro ds006104 version 1.0.1 and analyzed the consonant-vowel pair task. One-to-one marker-stimulus pairing yielded 3,840 independent trials; control-condition selection and artifact rejection retained 1,094 epochs from 16 participants and 61 EEG channels. Thirteen unique implementations were evaluated using leave-one-subject-out testing, with participant metrics reconstructed from 36,102 trial predictions across 33 complete prediction replicas. Random Forest was numerically highest at 21.474% balanced accuracy (95% participant-bootstrap interval, 19.526-23.482%; chance, 20%), but neither its participant-level tests nor any implementation survived correction across the 13-model family. Deep-model performance was close to chance, and several architectures showed substantial seed-dependent variation and low trial-label agreement. In a separate descriptive sensor-space representation, participant-associated effects accounted for 72.24% of the balanced standardized centroid sum of squares, compared with 2.04% for vowel-associated effects; between-participant same-vowel distances exceeded within-participant across-vowel distances for all 16 participants. An exploratory MDM analysis comprising 9,616 genuine refits across training cohorts of 3-15 participants showed no monotonic performance gain. Within this dataset and protocol, evidence for reliable cross-subject five-vowel decoding is limited. The benchmark provides a reproducible chain from source rows to retained epochs, predictions, participant-level metrics, multiplicity-adjusted inference, and bounded diagnostic analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在一个统一的基准中对听觉诱发电位 (auditory-evoked EEG) 是否支持跨被试的五个元音感知解码进行了泄漏审计。作者从 OpenNeuro ds006104 版本 1.0.1 重建 Study 2 事件表，经过对照条件筛选与伪迹剔除后保留 16 名被试、61 通道的 1,094 个 epoch，并用留一被试法评估 13 种模型实现。随机森林 (Random Forest) 的平衡准确率最高，为 21.474%（机会水平 20%），但没有任何模型在跨 13 模型族的校正后存活，深度模型接近机会水平。整体结果表明，在该数据集与协议下，可靠的跨被试五元音解码证据有限。
Motivation: 已有关于被试无关 (subject-independent) 元音感知 EEG 解码的结论可能因数据泄漏 (leakage) 而被高估；需要在单个基准中同时控制试验身份、模型身份、预测来源和被试级推断，以检验真实解码能力。
Method: 构建从原始数据行到保留 epoch、预测、被试级指标、多重性校正推断和受约束诊断分析的完整可复现流程；评估 1,094 个 epoch 上 13 种实现，通过 33 个完整预测副本重建被试级指标，并额外进行基于传感器空间的可视化与 MDM (minimum distance to mean) 分析。
Result: 随机森林达到最高的 21.474% 平衡准确率（95% 被试自助区间 19.526–23.482%），但被试级检验和全部 13 个模型均未通过校正；深度模型接近机会水平且存在明显的随机种子依赖。描述性分析中，被试相关效应占平衡标准化质心平方和的 72.24%，而元音相关效应仅占 2.04%；MDM 分析在 3–15 人训练队列下未表现出单调性能提升。
Conclusion: 在该数据集和协议范围内，可靠跨被试五元音解码的证据有限；该基准贡献了一条可复现的从原始数据到推论的分析链，可作为后续研究控制泄漏的参照。

papers.title: MCBench: A Multicontext Safety Assessment Benchmark for Omni Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing multimodal safety benchmarks focus solely on visual inputs and cannot assess Omni Large Language Models (LLMs) that process vision, audio, and text. We introduce MCBench, a benchmark with 1196 scenarios spanning four safety categories that require integrating multiple modalities for accurate safety assessment. Each unsafe scenario is paired with a minimally different safe counterpart to assess model sensitivity. Our evaluations of state-of-the-art models reveal significant challenges. Omni LLMs struggle with subtle or non-physical risks but perform better when salient visual or acoustic cues are present. Analysis of reasoning traces shows that, although models can extract modality-specific information, they often fail to integrate these cues effectively for safety judgments. Our findings reveal that current Omni LLMs lack robust cross-modal reasoning in safety-critical settings, underscoring the need for improved architectures and training strategies for multimodal safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MCBench，一个用于评估全模态大语言模型 (Omni LLM) 安全性的多上下文基准，包含 1196 个场景、四个安全类别，要求模型整合视觉、音频和文本信息进行安全判断；每个不安全场景配有最小差异的安全对照场景以评测模型敏感性。对 SOTA 模型的评估显示，全模态大模型在细微或非物理性风险上表现不佳，但在存在显著视觉或声学线索时表现更好；推理轨迹分析表明模型虽能提取模态特定信息，却常无法有效整合这些线索用于安全判断。
Motivation: 现有多模态安全基准只聚焦视觉输入，无法评估同时处理视觉、音频和文本的全模态大模型，作者针对这一评测缺口提出了跨模态安全评估需求。
Method: 构建 MCBench 基准，包含 1196 个需要整合多模态信息的安全场景，覆盖四个安全类别，并为每个不安全场景设计最小差异的安全对照场景以检测模型敏感性；此外结合推理轨迹 (reasoning traces) 分析模型如何利用多模态线索。
Result: 对 SOTA 模型的评估显示，全模态大模型在细微或非物理性风险上表现挣扎，而当视觉或声学线索显著时表现更好；推理轨迹分析表明模型能提取单模态信息，却经常无法有效整合以做出安全判断。
Conclusion: 当前全模态大模型在安全关键场景中缺乏稳健的跨模态推理能力，作者强调需要改进架构与训练策略以增强多模态安全。

papers.title: ExpertEdit: Learning Skill-Aware Motion Editing from Expert Videos
papers.abstract_en: Visual feedback is critical for motor skill acquisition in sports and rehabilitation, and psychological studies show that observing near-perfect versions of one's own performance accelerates learning more effectively than watching expert demonstrations alone. We propose to enable such personalized feedback by automatically editing a person's motion to reflect higher skill. Existing motion editing approaches are poorly suited for this setting because they assume paired input-output data -- rare and expensive to curate for skill-driven tasks -- and explicit edit guidance at inference. We introduce ExpertEdit, a framework for skill-driven motion editing trained exclusively on unpaired expert video demonstrations. ExpertEdit learns an expert motion prior with a masked language modeling objective that infills masked motion spans with expert-level refinements. At inference, novice motion is masked at skill-critical moments and projected into the learned expert manifold, producing localized skill improvements without paired supervision or manual edit guidance. Across eight diverse techniques and three sports from Ego-Exo4D and Karate Kyokushin, ExpertEdit outperforms state-of-the-art supervised motion editing methods on multiple metrics of motion realism and expert quality. Project page: https://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/expert_edit/ .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ExpertEdit，一个仅用未配对的专家视频演示训练的 skill-driven 运动编辑框架。其核心是用掩码语言建模目标学习专家运动先验 (expert motion prior)，推理时在技能关键帧掩码初学者动作并投影到专家流形，从而无需配对监督或手动编辑引导即可产生局部技能改进。在 Ego-Exo4D 和 Karate Kyokushin 的八种技术与三类运动上，该方法在运动真实性和专家质量等多个指标上超过有监督的运动编辑方法。
Motivation: 运动技能习得中视觉反馈很关键，心理学研究表明观察近似完美的自身动作版本比单纯看专家示范更能加速学习。现有运动编辑方法不适合该场景，因为它们依赖稀缺昂贵的配对输入-输出数据，且推理时需要显式编辑引导。
Method: ExpertEdit 使用掩码语言建模目标从无配对专家视频中学习专家运动先验，能够在推理时以专家级精修填充被掩码的动作片段，并将新手动作投射到学习到的专家流形中，实现局部技能改进。
Result: 在八个不同技巧和三项运动（Ego-Exo4D 与 Karate Kyokushin）上，ExpertEdit 在运动真实性和专家质量等多个指标上优于目前最先进的有监督运动编辑方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法可以在不需要配对监督或手动编辑引导的情况下，自动将个人动作编辑为更高技能水平，从而支持个性化运动反馈。

papers.title: Morphology-Conditioned World Model for Cross-Embodiment Quadrupedal Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: World models promise a paradigm shift in robotics, where an agent learns the physics of its environment once and then acquires behaviors efficiently. Yet the learned dynamics models at their core are typically morphology locked. In legged locomotion, a dynamics model trained on an ANYmal-D quadruped fails on a Unitree Go1 because it overfits to one robot's embodiment rather than capturing the locomotion dynamics shared across robots, so even a small change in actuator dynamics or limb length forces retraining from scratch. However, if we formalize a robot's unique physical traits into a morphology specification, a controller for a family of robots can utilize this blueprint in two ways. It can feed the specification to a model-free policy, or it can feed the specification to a learned dynamics model and extract the policy in imagination. We argue for the second route and introduce the Quadrupedal World Model (QWM), which conditions a single generative dynamics model on scale-invariant physical features and trains policies entirely inside it, through a physical morphology encoder, an adaptive reward normalizer, and morphology conditioning in the latent dynamics. Holding the morphology information identical, a model-free policy matches QWM on the training cohort but degrades on unseen morphologies, while QWM transfers zero-shot with no fine-tuning, adaptation, or warm-up in such cases. To our knowledge, this is the first world model to demonstrate zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer within the quadrupedal family.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出四足世界模型（Quadrupedal World Model, QWM），将单个生成式动力学模型以尺度不变物理特征为条件，并在该模型内部完全训练策略。摘要报告 QWM 在四足机器人家族内实现零样本（zero-shot）跨形态迁移，无需微调、适应或预热，并声称这是首个在四足家族内展示零样本跨形态迁移的世界模型。
Motivation: 现有机器人学习的世界模型核心动力学常被形态锁定（morphology locked），在 ANYmal-D 上训练的动力学模型无法泛化到 Unitree Go1，即使执行器动力学或肢体长度的小变化也需从头重训。作者主张将机器人独特物理特征形式化为形态规格，并将其用于条件化学习到的动力学模型而非模型无关策略，以捕捉不同机器人共享的运动学动力学。
Method: 提出的 QWM 通过物理形态编码器（physical morphology encoder）、自适应奖励归一化器（adaptive reward normalizer）以及潜动力学中的形态条件化（morphology conditioning），将单个生成式动力学模型条件化在尺度不变物理特征上；控制策略完全在该动力学模型内部的想象中训练。
Result: 在形态信息相同的情况下，模型无关策略在训练群体上能与 QWM 匹配，但在未见形态上性能下降；而 QWM 在零样本、无微调、无适应或预热的情况下成功迁移。摘要称这是首个在四足家族内展示零样本跨形态迁移的世界模型。
Conclusion: 作者主张对形态规格采用第二条路线，即将其馈入学习到的动力学模型并在想象中提取策略，理由是该路线能更好地泛化到未见形态，而模型无关条件化策略在超出训练形态时会退化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Uniform to Learned Knots: A Study of Spline-Based Numerical Encodings for Tabular Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Numerical preprocessing remains a critical component of tabular deep learning, as the representation of continuous features can strongly affect downstream performance. We systematically study spline-based numerical encodings, including B-splines, M-splines, and integrated splines (I-splines), under uniform, quantile-based, target-aware, and learnable-knot placement. For the learnable variants, we adopt a differentiable knot parameterization that enables stable end-to-end optimization of knot locations jointly with the backbone. We evaluate these encodings on a diverse collection of public regression and classification datasets using MLP, ResNet, and FT-Transformer backbones, and compare them against common numerical preprocessing baselines. Our results show that the effectiveness of numerical encoding depends strongly on the task, encoding size, and backbone. For classification, piecewise-linear encoding (PLE) is the most robust choice overall, while spline-based encodings remain competitive. For regression, no single encoding dominates, with performance depending on the spline family and knot-placement strategy, and larger gains generally observed for MLP and ResNet than for FT-Transformer. Learnable-knot variants can be optimized stably but may substantially increase training cost. Overall, numerical encodings should therefore be assessed jointly in terms of predictive performance and computational overhead. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/mkumar73/tdl-numerical-encodings/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了表格深度学习中基于样条的数值编码方法，比较 B-spline、M-spline 和积分样条 (I-spline) 在均匀、分位数、目标感知和可学习结点 (learnable knot) 放置策略下的表现。可学习变体采用可微的结点参数化，使结点位置能与主干网络进行端到端联合优化。作者在多个公开回归与分类数据集上以 MLP、ResNet 和 FT-Transformer 为骨干进行评估，并与常见数值预处理基线对比。结果显示编码有效性强烈依赖于任务、编码大小和骨干网络，且应在预测性能与计算开销之间联合考量。
Motivation: 数值特征的预处理是表格深度学习中的关键环节，连续特征的表示方式会显著影响下游性能，但学界对基于样条的数值编码及其结点放置策略缺乏系统性比较。
Method: 作者系统比较多种样条编码族（B-splines、M-splines、I-splines）与多种结点放置策略（均匀、分位数、目标感知、可学习），并对可学习结点采用可微参数化以支持与骨干网络的联合优化，随后在不同骨干网络上评估。
Result: 在分类任务上，分段线性编码 (PLE) 整体最稳健，样条编码仍有竞争力；在回归任务上，没有单一编码占优，性能取决于样条族与结点放置策略，且 MLP 和 ResNet 上的收益一般大于 FT-Transformer。可学习结点能稳定优化，但可能显著增加训练开销。
Conclusion: 数值编码的选择应结合预测性能与计算开销综合评估，不存在普适最优的编码方式；该实现已公开在 GitHub 上。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文系统研究了表格深度学习中基于样条的数值编码方法，比较 B-spline、M-spline 和积分样条 (I-spline) 在均匀、分位数、目标感知和可学习结点 (learnable knot) 放置策略下的表现。可学习变体采用可微的结点参数化，使结点位置能与主干网络进行端到端联合优化。作者在多个公开回归与分类数据集上以 MLP、ResNet 和 FT-Transformer 为骨干进行评估，并与常见数值预处理基线对比。结果显示编码有效性强烈依赖于任务、编码大小和骨干网络，且应在预测性能与计算开销之间联合考量。
summary_sections.motivation: 数值特征的预处理是表格深度学习中的关键环节，连续特征的表示方式会显著影响下游性能，但学界对基于样条的数值编码及其结点放置策略缺乏系统性比较。
summary_sections.method: 作者系统比较多种样条编码族（B-splines、M-splines、I-splines）与多种结点放置策略（均匀、分位数、目标感知、可学习），并对可学习结点采用可微参数化以支持与骨干网络的联合优化，随后在不同骨干网络上评估。

papers.title: A Theoretical Framework for Statistical Evaluability of Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Statistical evaluation aims to estimate the generalization performance of a model using held-out i.i.d. test data sampled from the ground-truth distribution. In supervised learning settings such as classification, performance metrics such as error rate are well-defined, and test error reliably approximates population error given sufficiently large datasets. In contrast, evaluation is more challenging for generative models due to their open-ended nature: it is unclear which metrics are appropriate and whether such metrics can be reliably evaluated from finite samples. In this work, we introduce a theoretical framework for evaluating generative models and establish evaluability results for commonly used metrics. We study two categories of metrics: test-based metrics, including integral probability metrics (IPMs), and Rényi divergences. We show that IPMs with respect to any bounded test class can be evaluated from finite samples up to multiplicative and additive approximation errors. Moreover, when the test class has finite fat-shattering dimension, IPMs can be evaluated with arbitrary precision. In contrast, Rényi and KL divergences are not evaluable from finite samples, as their values can be critically determined by rare events. We also analyze the potential and limitations of perplexity as an evaluation method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于生成模型统计可评估性 (statistical evaluability) 的理论框架，研究如何从有限 i.i.d. 测试样本估计生成模型的评估指标。摘要表明，关于任意有界测试类的积分概率度量 (IPM) 可在乘性和加性近似误差内被评估；当测试类具有有限 fat-shattering 维数时可达任意精度。相比之下，Rényi 散度和 KL 散度无法从有限样本评估，因为其取值可能由罕见事件主导；文章还分析了 perplexity 作为评估方法的潜力与局限。
Motivation: 生成模型的评估因开放性质而困难：不清楚应采用哪些指标，也不清楚这些指标能否从有限样本可靠估计。该工作旨在为生成模型评估建立理论框架并给出常用指标的评估性结论。
Method: 作者将评估指标分为基于测试的指标（包括 IPM）和 Rényi 散度两类，分析它们从有限样本评估的可能性；同时专门分析 perplexity 作为评估方法的潜力与局限。
Result: 摘要报告：对于任意有界测试类的 IPM，可在乘性和加性近似误差内从有限样本评估；当测试类具有有限 fat-shattering 维数时，IPM 可被任意精度评估。相反，Rényi 散度与 KL 散度不可从有限样本评估，因为其值可能由稀有事件 (rare events) 决定性影响。
Conclusion: 该框架给出生成模型统计评估性的判定结果，揭示 IPM 类指标与散度类指标在有限样本下的本质差异，并指出 perplexity 评估方法的能力边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Delay, Plateau, or Collapse: Evaluating the Impact of Systematic Verification Error on RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful approach for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). While RLVR is designed for tasks with verifiable ground-truth answers, real-world verifiers (e.g., static code checkers) can introduce errors into the reward signal. Prior analyses have largely treated such errors as random and independent across samples, concluding that errors merely slow training with limited effect on final performance. However, practical verifiers tend to exhibit systematic errors. This introduces a risk of models learning unwanted consistent behavior from a structurally incorrect reward signal. In this work, we study the impact of such systematic verification errors on RLVR. Through controlled experiments on arithmetic tasks, we show that systematic false negatives lead to similar effects as random noise. On the other hand, systematic false positives can cause a wide range of behaviors from sub-optimal plateaus to performance collapse. Crucially, these outcomes are not determined by the overall error rate but by the specific pattern of introduced errors, making pre-hoc mitigation difficult. Our results show that, in contrast to prior conclusions, realistic verification errors can critically shape RLVR outcomes and that verifier quality has to be understood beyond its sample-level error rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 RLVR（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards）中系统性验证错误对训练的影响。在算术任务的受控实验中，系统性的假阴性与随机噪声效果类似，而系统性假阳性可引发从次优平台期到性能崩溃的多种行为。作者强调结果取决于错误的具体模式而非总体错误率，因此难以事前缓解。
Motivation: 先前分析大多把验证器错误视为跨样本随机且独立的，据此认为错误只会减慢训练速度、对最终性能影响有限；但实际验证器（如静态代码检查器）往往呈现系统性错误，可能让模型从结构错误的奖励信号中学到不受欢迎的一致行为。
Method: 通过在算术任务上的受控实验，向 RLVR 的奖励信号分别注入系统性假阴性和系统性假阳性错误，考察不同错误模式对训练动态与最终性能的影响。
Result: 系统性假阴性产生与随机噪声类似的效果；系统性假阳性则导致从次优平台期（plateau）到性能崩溃（collapse）的广泛行为。关键的是，这些结果并非由总体错误率决定，而是由错误的具体引入模式决定，使事前缓解变得困难。
Conclusion: 与先前结论相反，真实世界的验证错误会显著塑造 RLVR 的结局；验证器质量需要超越样本级错误率来理解。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Free-Flow Class-Incremental Learning: Towards Robust CIL under Variable Class Arrivals
papers.abstract_en: Class-incremental learning (CIL) is commonly evaluated under predefined schedules with fixed or nearly equal class increments, leaving irregular class-arrival scenarios underexplored. However, practical CIL systems may need to update whenever new categories emerge, without forcing them into balanced task partitions. We formalize this setting as Free-Flow Class-Incremental Learning (FFCIL), where the number of newly arriving classes can vary substantially across learning stages. We show that variable class arrivals alter the class composition of incremental training, the reliability of new-class classifier statistics, and the consistency of representations learned across increments, causing clear performance degradation in both conventional and pre-trained model (PTM)-based CIL methods. To improve robustness under FFCIL, we introduce a general framework consisting of Class-Wise Mean (CWM), which replaces instance-wise loss aggregation with class-wise averaging; Dynamic Intervention Weight Alignment (DIWA), which adjusts new-class weight calibration according to the current increment size; and Head-Agnostic Alignment (HA), which performs feature-level correction for PTM-based methods using current and previous-class feature supervision. Extensive experiments across diverse methods, datasets, and class-arrival schedules demonstrate the general impact of FFCIL and the consistent effectiveness of our framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了一类新的增量学习设定 Free-Flow Class-Incremental Learning (FFCIL)，其中各学习阶段新到达的类别数量可大幅变化，并指出该设定会破坏增量训练中的类别组成、新类分类器统计量的可靠性以及跨增量表示的一致性，使传统 CIL 与基于预训练模型 (PTM) 的 CIL 方法均出现明显性能下降。作者提出包含类均值 (CWM)、动态干预权重对齐 (DIWA) 和头无关对齐 (HA) 的通用框架，并在多种方法、数据集和类别到达调度下验证其持续有效。
Motivation: 现有类增量学习 (CIL) 通常只在固定或近似等量的类别增量调度下评估，忽略了实际系统中新类别可能以极不规则的规模随时出现这一场景；这种不平衡类别到达会造成明确的方法退化，但此前未被系统研究。
Method: 作者先形式化 FFCIL 设定，再提出通用鲁棒性框架：CWM 用类内平均取代实例级损失聚合，DIWA 按当前增量大小调整新类权重校准，HA 对 PTM 类方法利用当前类与旧类特征监督做特征级修正。
Result: 摘要报告，在多种 CIL 方法、数据集和类别到达调度上的大量实验表明 FFCIL 具有普遍影响，且所提框架能持续提升鲁棒性；摘要未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 作者认为可变类别到达会从类别组成、新类统计可靠性和表征一致性三方面损害现有 CIL 方法，而 CWM、DIWA 与 HA 的组合可作为提升 FFCIL 鲁棒性的通用手段。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Human Pose Estimation in Trampoline Gymnastics: How to Improve Performance on Extreme Poses
papers.abstract_en: Trampoline gymnastics involves extreme human poses and uncommon viewpoints, on which state-of-the art pose estimation models tend to under-perform. We demonstrate that this problem can be addressed by fine-tuning a pose estimation model on a combination of real extreme poses and domain-specific synthetic poses (STP). We generate STP from motion capture recordings of trampoline routines. We propose a pipeline to fit noisy motion capture data to a parametric human model, then generate multi-view realistic images with high-fidelity keypoint labels. The fine-tuned ViTPose model tested on real multi-view images exhibits accuracy improvements in 2D which translate to improved 3D triangulation. In 2D, we obtain a performance similar to state-of-the-art models on the MS COCO validation set while evaluating on significantly more challenging data, bridging the performance gap between common and extreme poses. In 3D, we reduce the MPJPE by 46.1 mm with our best model, which represents an improvement of 42.7% compared to the pretrained ViTPose model. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/VisionICLab/trampoline_syn_data.
papers.comment: Accepted to the MoCha workshop at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对蹦床体操中的极端人体姿态与非寻常视角下姿态估计模型性能退化的问题，提出在真实极端姿态与领域特定合成姿态（STP）的组合上微调姿态估计模型。作者从蹦床动作的运动捕捉记录生成 STP，通过将含噪 MoCap 数据拟合到参数化人体模型并渲染多视角高保真关键点标注图像。微调后的 ViTPose 在真实多视角图像上的 2D 精度提升并传导至 3D 三角化：3D 上 MPJPE 减少 46.1 mm（相对预训练 ViTPose 提升 42.7%），2D 上在比 MS COCO 验证集更具挑战性的数据上取得与 SOTA 相近的性能。代码与数据已公开。
Motivation: 现有人体姿态估计模型在蹦床体操这类极端姿态和不常见视角下性能明显下降，常见姿态与极端姿态之间存在性能差距。
Method: 提出从运动捕捉记录构建领域特定合成姿态（STP）的流程：先将含噪 MoCap 数据拟合到参数化人体模型，再生成多视角真实感图像及高保真关键点标签，并用真实极端姿态与合成姿态的联合数据微调 ViTPose。
Result: 微调后的 ViTPose 在真实多视角测试图像上的 2D 关键点精度接近 MS COCO 验证集上的 SOTA 模型，但测试数据难度显著更高；3D 三角化中 MPJPE 降低 46.1 mm，相对预训练模型改善 42.7%。
Conclusion: 真实与领域特定合成极端姿态的联合微调能够弥合常见姿态与极端姿态之间的性能差距，并证明该方法在挑战性体育运动场景中的有效性。

papers.title: A Camera-Native Talking-Head Video Dataset for Various Computer Vision Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Talking-head videos constitute a predominant content type in real-time communication, yet publicly available datasets for video processing research in this domain remain scarce and limited in signal fidelity. In this paper, we open-source a camera-native dataset of 838 talking-head recordings (approximately 210 minutes), each 15s in duration, captured from 799 participants across 443 camera-code categories in their natural environments. All recordings are stored using the FFV1 lossless codec, preserving the camera-native signal---uncompressed (24.7%) or MJPEG-encoded (75.3%)---without additional lossy processing. Each recording is annotated with a Mean Opinion Score (MOS) and ten perceptual quality tokens that jointly explain 64.4% of the MOS variance. From this corpus, we curate a stratified benchmarking subset of 120 clips in three content conditions: original, background blur, and background replacement. Codec efficiency evaluation across four datasets and four codecs, namely H.264, H.265, H.266, and AV1, yields VMAF BD-rate savings up to $-71.3%$ (H.266) relative to H.264, with significant encoder$\times$dataset ($η_p^2 = .112$) and encoder$\times$content condition ($η_p^2 = .149$) interactions, demonstrating that both content type and background processing affect compression efficiency. A preliminary super-resolution evaluation with four SR models confirms that the dataset significantly affects absolute performance while preserving model rankings, demonstrating applicability beyond codec benchmarking. The dataset offers 5$\times$ the scale of the largest prior talking-head webcam dataset (838 vs. 160 clips) and preserves the camera-native signal without additional lossy compression, establishing a resource for benchmarking video compression, super-resolution, quality assessment, and enhancement models in real-time communication.
papers.summary_zh:

Result: 编解码器评估得到最高-71.3%的VMAF BD-rate节省（H.266相对H.264），并报告显著的encoder×dataset（ηp²=.112）和encoder×content condition（ηp²=.149）交互效应。超分辨率评估显示数据集显著影响绝对性能但保持模型相对排名。数据集规模为838片段，是此前最大说话头像网络摄像头数据集（160片段）的5倍。
Conclusion: 该数据集保留了相机原生信号且不引入额外有损压缩，为实时通信中的视频压缩、超分辨率、质量评估和增强模型提供一个基准资源，并展示了内容类型和背景处理对压缩效率的影响。
