papers.title: Camera-Agnostic Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splats via Descriptor-Based Beta Evidence
papers.abstract_en: The pruning of 3D Gaussian splats is essential for reducing their complexity to enable efficient storage, transmission, and downstream processing. However, most of the existing pruning strategies depend on camera parameters, rendered images, or view-dependent measures. This dependency becomes a hindrance in emerging camera-agnostic exchange settings, where splats are shared directly as point-based representations (e.g., .ply). In this paper, we propose a camera-agnostic, one-shot, post-training pruning method for 3D Gaussian splats that relies solely on attribute-derived neighbourhood descriptors. As our primary contribution, we introduce a hybrid descriptor framework that captures structural and appearance consistency directly from the splat representation. Building on these descriptors, we formulate pruning as a statistical evidence estimation problem and introduce a Beta evidence model that quantifies per-splat reliability through a probabilistic confidence score. Experiments conducted on standardized test sequences defined by the ISO/IEC MPEG Common Test Conditions (CTC) demonstrate that our approach achieves substantial pruning while preserving reconstruction quality, establishing a practical and generalizable alternative to existing camera-dependent pruning strategies.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种相机无关、一次性后训练的 3D 高斯泼溅 (3D Gaussian splats) 裁剪方法，仅依赖由属性导出的邻域描述符，不依赖相机参数或渲染图像。作者引入混合描述符框架来捕获结构和外观一致性，并把裁剪建模为统计证据估计问题，通过 Beta 证据模型给出每个泼溅的概率置信度。在 ISO/IEC MPEG 通用测试条件 (CTC) 定义的标准测试序列上验证，该方法在显著裁剪的同时保持重建质量。
Motivation: 现有 3D 高斯泼溅裁剪策略大多依赖相机参数、渲染图像或视图相关度量，这阻碍了相机无关的交换场景——即泼溅直接以点云表示（如 .ply）共享时无法使用这些策略。
Method: 提出相机无关的混合描述符框架，直接从泼溅表示捕获结构一致性和外观一致性；在此基础上将裁剪表述为统计证据估计问题，引入 Beta 证据模型，通过概率置信度分数量化每个泼溅的可靠性，实现一种无渲染、无相机的后训练裁剪。
Result: 摘要在 ISO/IEC MPEG CTC 标准测试序列上的实验表明，该方法能实现大量裁剪同时保持重建质量，并称其为对现有相机相关裁剪策略的实用且可泛化的替代方案。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法具有相机无关、一次性后训练的特点，可以推广到直接的泼溅表示交换场景。

papers.title: Can LLMs Reason Like Automated Theorem Provers for Rust Verification? VCoT-Bench: Evaluating via Verification Chain of Thought
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly assist secure software development, their ability to meet the rigorous demands of Rust program verification remains unclear. Existing evaluations treat Rust verification as a black box, assessing models only by binary pass or fail outcomes for proof hints. This obscures whether models truly understand the logical deductions required for verifying nontrivial Rust code. To bridge this gap, we introduce VCoT-Lift, a framework that lifts low-level solver reasoning into high-level, human-readable verification steps. By exposing solver-level reasoning as an explicit Verification Chain-of-Thought, VCoT-Lift provides a concrete ground truth for fine-grained evaluation. Leveraging VCoT-Lift, we introduce VCoT-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark of 1,988 VCoT completion tasks for rigorously evaluating LLMs' understanding of the entire verification process. VCoT-Bench measures performance along three orthogonal dimensions: robustness to varying degrees of missing proofs, competence across different proof types, and sensitivity to the proof locations. Evaluation of ten state-of-the-art models reveals severe fragility, indicating that current LLMs fall well short of the reasoning capabilities exhibited by automated theorem provers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Rust 程序验证中 LLM 评估的黑盒问题，提出 VCoT-Lift 框架，把底层求解器推理转化为高层可读的验证步骤，并据此构建 VCoT-Bench 基准（含 1,988 个 VCoT 补全任务）。该基准沿三个维度评估模型：对缺失证明的鲁棒性、不同证明类型的能力、对证明位置的敏感性。对十个 SOTA 模型的评测显示其推理能力与自动定理证明器仍有显著差距。
Motivation: 现有评估把 Rust 验证视为黑盒，仅以证明提示的二元通过/失败来评判模型，掩盖了模型是否真正理解验证非平凡 Rust 代码所需的逻辑推导。
Method: 提出 VCoT-Lift，将低层求解器推理提升为高层、人类可读的验证推理链，并以此作为细粒度评估的 ground truth；在此基础上构建包含 1,988 个 VCoT 补全任务的 VCoT-Bench 基准，从三个正交维度评测模型。
Result: 对十个 SOTA 模型的评估揭示了严重的脆弱性，表明当前 LLM 远未达到自动定理证明器所展现的推理能力。
Conclusion: 论文强调当前 LLM 在 Rust 验证的完整推理过程理解上仍不足，VCoT-Bench 可作为评估该能力的细粒度基准。

papers.title: Data-knowledge dual-driven intelligent framework for full-chain, experiment-efficient synthesis of 2D dendrites
papers.abstract_en: Exemplified by the chemical vapor deposition growth of two-dimensional dendrites, which has potential applications in catalysis and presents a parameter-intensive, data-scarce and reaction process-complex model problem, we devise a machine intelligence-empowered framework for the full chain support of material synthesis, encompassing rapid process optimization, accurate customized synthesis, and comprehensive mechanism deciphering.First, active learning is integrated into the experimental workflow, identifying an optimal recipe for the growth of highly-branched, electrocatalytically-active ReSe2 dendrites through 60 experiments (4 iterations), which account for less than 1.3% of the numerous possible parameter combinations.Then, a prediction accuracy-guided data augmentation strategy is developed combined with a tree-based machine learning (ML) algorithm, unveiling a non-linear correlation between 5 process variables and fractal dimension (DF) of ReSe2 dendrites with only 9 experiment additions, which guides the synthesis of various user-defined DF. Finally, we construct a data-knowledge dual-driven mechanism model by integration of cross-scale characterizations, interpretable ML models, and domain knowledge in thermodynamics and kinetics, unraveling synergistic contributions of multiple process parameters to the product morphology. This work demonstrates the ML potential to transform the research paradigm and is adaptable to broader material synthesis.
papers.journal_ref: Science Bulletin (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个数据-知识双驱动的智能框架，以化学气相沉积（CVD）生长二维树枝晶为例，覆盖材料合成的全链条：快速工艺优化、按需定制合成与机理解析。摘要报告通过主动学习（active learning）仅用60次实验（4轮迭代）找到高枝化、电催化活性的ReSe2树枝晶最优配方，占可能参数组合的不到1.3%；结合树模型与预测精度引导的数据增强，仅新增9次实验即揭示5个工艺变量与分形维数（DF）的非线性关联。
Motivation: 二维树枝晶的CVD合成具有催化应用潜力，但属于参数密集、数据稀缺且反应过程复杂的模型问题，传统试错方式效率低，需要机器学习赋能的全链条合成支持。
Method: 将主动学习集成到实验流程中进行快速工艺优化；开发预测精度引导的数据增强策略并联合基于树的机器学习算法，建立工艺变量与分形维数的映射；最后整合跨尺度表征、可解释机器学习模型以及热力学和动力学领域知识，构建数据-知识双驱动的机理模型。
Result: 摘要报告60次实验（4次迭代）确定的配方占可能参数组合的不到1.3%；仅9次额外实验即揭示5个过程变量与ReSe2树枝晶分形维数的非线性关系，并可指导合成用户指定DF的产物。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该工作展示了机器学习在改变材料合成研究范式方面的潜力，且方法可推广到更广泛的材料合成场景。

papers.title: Exclusivity-Guided Mask Learning for Semi-Supervised Crowd Instance Segmentation and Counting
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised crowd analysis is a prominent area of research, as unlabeled data are typically abundant and inexpensive to obtain. However, traditional point-based annotations constrain performance because individual regions are inherently ambiguous, and consequently, learning fine-grained structural semantics from sparse anno tations remains an unresolved challenge. In this paper, we first propose an Exclusion-Constrained Dual-Prompt SAM (EDP-SAM), based on our Nearest Neighbor Exclusion Circle (NNEC) constraint, to generate mask supervision for current datasets. With the aim of segmenting individuals in dense scenes, we then propose Exclusivity-Guided Mask Learning (XMask), which enforces spatial separation through a discriminative mask objective. Gaussian smoothing and a differentiable center sampling strategy are utilized to improve feature continuity and training stability. Building on XMask, we present a semi-supervised crowd counting framework that uses instance mask priors as pseudo-labels, which contain richer shape information than traditional point cues. Extensive experiments on the ShanghaiTech A, UCF-QNRF, and JHU++ datasets (using 5%, 10%, and 40% labeled data) verify that our end-to-end model achieves state-of-the-art semi-supervised segmentation and counting performance, effectively bridging the gap between counting and instance segmentation within a unified framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对半监督密集人群场景中基于点的标注难以提供个体结构语义的问题，提出排除约束双提示 SAM（EDP-SAM）与排他性引导的掩码学习（XMask），利用实例掩码先验作为伪标签统一人群计数与实例分割。在 ShanghaiTech A、UCF-QNRF 和 JHU++ 上以 5%、10%、40% 标注数据的实验验证了端到端模型的半监督分割与计数性能达到当前最优。
Motivation: 半监督人群分析中无标注数据丰富，但传统的基于点标注难以刻画个体区域边界，导致从稀疏标注学习细粒度结构语义仍是未解难题。
Method: 提出基于最近邻排除圆约束（NNEC）的 EDP-SAM 以生成掩码监督；进一步提出 XMask，通过判别式掩码目标强制个体间的空间分离，并利用高斯平滑与可微中心采样策略提升特征连续性和训练稳定性；基于 XMask 构建以实例掩码先验为伪标签的半监督计数框架。
Result: 在 ShanghaiTech A、UCF-QNRF 和 JHU++ 数据集上，使用 5%、10% 和 40% 标注数据时，所提出的端到端模型在半监督分割与计数任务上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为实例掩码先验比传统点线索包含更丰富的形状信息，该方法在统一框架内有效弥合了计数与实例分割之间的差距。

summary_sections.method: 提出基于最近邻排除圆约束（NNEC）的 EDP-SAM 以生成掩码监督；进一步提出 XMask，通过判别式掩码目标强制个体间的空间分离，并利用高斯平滑与可微中心采样策略提升特征连续性和训练稳定性；基于 XMask 构建以实例掩码先验为伪标签的半监督计数框架。
summary_sections.result: 在 ShanghaiTech A、UCF-QNRF 和 JHU++ 数据集上，使用 5%、10% 和 40% 标注数据时，所提出的端到端模型在半监督分割与计数任务上达到最先进性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为实例掩码先验比传统点线索包含更丰富的形状信息，该方法在统一框架内有效弥合了计数与实例分割之间的差距。

papers.title: Less Data, Faster Convergence: Goal-Driven Data Optimization for Multimodal Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal instruction tuning is often compute-inefficient because training budgets are spread across large mixed image-video pools whose utility is highly uneven. We present Goal-Driven Data Optimization (GDO), a framework that computes six sample descriptors for each candidate and constructs optimized 1$\times$ training subsets for different goals. Under a fixed one-epoch Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct training and evaluation recipe on 8 H20 GPUs, GDO uses far fewer training samples than the Uni-10x baseline while converging faster and achieving higher accuracy. Relative to the fixed 512k-sample Uni-10x baseline, GDO reaches the Uni-10x reference after 35.4k samples on MVBench, 26.6k on VideoMME, 27.3k on MLVU, and 34.7k on LVBench, while improving Accuracy by +1.38, +1.67, +3.08, and +0.84 percentage points, respectively. The gains are largest on MVBench and MLVU, while LVBench improves more modestly, consistent with its ultra-long-video setting and the mismatch between that benchmark and the short-video/image-dominant training pool. Across MinLoss, Diverse, Temp, and Temp+, stronger temporal emphasis yields steadily better long-video understanding behavior. Overall, GDO provides a goal-driven data optimization framework that enables faster convergence with fewer training samples under a fixed training protocol. Code is available at https://github.com/rujiewu/GDO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Goal-Driven Data Optimization (GDO)，一种面向多模态指令微调的数据优化框架，通过为每个候选样本计算六种样本描述符，为不同目标构建优化的 1× 训练子集。在固定的 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 单轮训练与评估协议下，GDO 用远少于 Uni-10x 基线的样本量达到参考精度并进一步超过基线，在 MVBench、VideoMME、MLVU、LVBench 上分别以 35.4k、26.6k、27.3k、34.7k 样本达到 Uni-10x 参考水平，并提升 Accuracy 各 +1.38、+1.67、+3.08、+0.84 个百分点。
Motivation: 多模态指令微调常因训练预算分散在效用极不均匀的大规模混合图像-视频数据池上而计算效率低下，需要一种按目标选择少量高价值训练样本的方法。
Method: 提出 GDO 框架，为每个候选样本计算六种样本描述符，并据此为不同下游目标构建优化的 1× 训练子集，在固定的一轮训练与评估协议下与 Uni-10x 基线对比。
Result: 相对于固定的 512k 样本 Uni-10x 基线，GDO 在 MVBench、VideoMME、MLVU、LVBench 上分别用 35.4k、26.6k、27.3k、34.7k 样本达到参考水平，并提升 Accuracy 各 +1.38、+1.67、+3.08、+0.84 个百分点；MVBench 与 MLVU 提升最大，LVBench 提升较小，且更强的时序强调（Temp 与 Temp+）带来更稳定的长视频理解行为。
Conclusion: GDO 提供了一种目标驱动的数据优化框架，在固定训练协议下用更少的训练样本实现更快收敛与更高精度；LVBench 增益较小被归因于其超长视频设定与以短视频/图像为主的训练池之间的不匹配。

papers.title: HiAP: A Multi-Granular Stochastic Auto-Pruning Framework for Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers require significant computational resources and memory bandwidth, severely limiting their deployment on resource-constraint hardware. Most structured pruning methods reduce theoretical cost effectively, yet they typically operate at a single structural granularity and depend on multi-stage pipelines with importance ranking, auxiliary solvers or post-hoc magnitude thresholding, followed by a separate fine-tuning phase to recover accuracy. We propose Hierarchical Auto-Pruning (HiAP), which casts ViT pruning as a single budget-aware learning problem and jointly allocates sparsity across four granularities in one end-to-end phase. HiAP introduces stochastic Gumbel-Sigmoid gates at macro level (attention heads and FFN blocks) and micro level (intra-head dimensions and FFN neurons), and trains them against the task loss together with an analytical MAC cost term. The budget coefficient steers the network to a target compute level while the gates gradually harden into a dense, smaller sub-network at convergence. It does not require importance heuristics, ranking metrics, auxiliary solvers or secondary fine-tuning. On ImageNet, HiAP compresses DeiT-Base to 7.4G MACs at 80.88% top-1 and DeiT-Small to 3.1G at 79.33%, competitive with substantially more complex pipelines at matched compute. The structurally pruned network can be accelerated natively on stock kernels, and more than 90% of the theoretical MAC reduction is realized as measured throughput on an A100.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hierarchical Auto-Pruning (HiAP)，将 ViT 剪枝建模为单一预算感知学习问题，在端到端阶段联合分配四个粒度的稀疏性。HiAP 在宏级别（注意力头和 FFN 块）和微级别（头内维度和 FFN 神经元）引入随机 Gumbel-Sigmoid 门，并连同解析 MAC 成本项一起与任务损失训练；预算系数引导目标计算水平，门在收敛时逐步硬化成密集小子网络。该方法不需要重要性启发式、排名指标、辅助求解器或二次微调。在 ImageNet 上，HiAP 将 DeiT-Base 压缩到 7.4G MACs（80.88% top-1），DeiT-Small 压缩到 3.1G（79.33%），与匹配计算量下更复杂的 pipeline 相比具有竞争力。
Motivation: 视觉 Transformer 需要大量计算资源和内存带宽，严重限制其在资源受限硬件上的部署。现有结构化剪枝方法通常只在单一结构粒度上操作，并依赖多阶段流程（如重要性排序、辅助求解器或事后阈值），随后还需单独微调阶段恢复精度。
Method: HiAP 将剪枝视为单一预算感知学习问题，在一个端到端阶段内联合分配四个粒度的稀疏性。它引入宏级别（注意力头和 FFN 块）与微级别（头内维度和 FFN 神经元）的随机 Gumbel-Sigmoid 门，与任务损失和一个解析 MAC 成本项共同训练；预算系数将网络引导至目标计算水平，门在收敛时逐渐硬化为密集的更小子网络。该方法不依赖重要性启发式、排序指标、辅助求解器或二次微调。
Result: 在 ImageNet 上，HiAP 将 DeiT-Base 压缩到 7.4G MACs，top-1 准确率 80.88%；DeiT-Small 压缩到 3.1G MACs，top-1 79.33%，与复杂度明显更高、计算量匹配的 pipeline 相比具有竞争力。结构剪枝后的网络可在标准内核上原生加速，在 A100 上实测吞吐量实现了超过 90% 的理论 MAC 缩减。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将剪枝作为端到端的预算感知学习问题能够同时覆盖多个结构粒度，并消除多阶段流程与二次微调；所得子网络可直接由现有内核加速。摘要未明确提及方法局限。

papers.title: SimulCost: A Cost-Aware Benchmark and Toolkit for Automating Physics Simulations with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating LLM agents for scientific tasks has focused on token costs while ignoring tool-use costs like simulation time and experimental resources. As a result, metrics like pass@k become impractical under realistic budget constraints. To address this gap, we introduce SimulCost, the first benchmark targeting cost-sensitive parameter tuning in physics simulations. SimulCost compares LLM tuning cost-sensitive parameters against traditional scanning approach in both accuracy and computational cost, spanning 2,643 single-round (initial guess) and 2,304 multi-round (adjustment by trial-and-error) tasks across 11 simulators from fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, and plasma physics, whose costs are analytically defined and platform-independent. A twelfth simulator, a production plasma code measurable only by wall clock, is reported separately. Frontier LLMs achieve 45-62% success rates in single-round mode, dropping to 34-50% under high accuracy requirements, rendering their initial guesses unreliable especially for high accuracy tasks. Multi-round mode improves rates to 66-81%, but LLMs are 1.5-2.7x slower than traditional scanning, making them uneconomical choices. We also investigate parameter group correlations for knowledge transfer potential, and the impact of in-context examples and reasoning effort, providing practical implications for deployment and fine-tuning. We open-source SimulCost as a static benchmark and extensible toolkit to facilitate research on improving cost-aware agentic designs for physics simulations, and for expanding new simulation environments. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Rose-STL-Lab/SimulCost-Bench

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SimulCost，第一个面向物理仿真中成本敏感参数调优 (cost-sensitive parameter tuning) 的基准与工具包，系统比较 LLM 调参与传统扫描 (scanning) 方法在精度和计算成本上的表现。基准覆盖流体力学、固体力学和等离子体物理的 11 个仿真器，共 2,643 个单轮初始猜测任务和 2,304 个多轮试错调整任务，成本以解析方式定义且平台无关；另有一个只能用墙钟时间测量的生产级等离子体代码单独报告。结果显示前沿 LLM 在单轮模式成功率 45-62%，多轮模式提升至 66-81%，但多轮模式下比传统扫描慢 1.5-2.7 倍。
Motivation: 现有对科学任务 LLM 代理的评估只关注 token 成本，忽略了仿真时间、实验资源等工具使用成本，导致 pass@k 这类指标在真实预算约束下不切实际。
Method: 提出 SimulCost 基准，用解析定义且平台无关的成本度量，在多个物理仿真器上对比 LLM 与传统的参数扫描方法；同时考察参数组间相关性以探索知识迁移潜力，并分析上下文示例 (in-context examples) 与推理努力 (reasoning effort) 的影响。
Result: 前沿 LLM 在单轮模式下成功率为 45-62%，高精度要求下降至 34-50%，初始猜测尤其不可靠；多轮模式将成功率提升至 66-81%，但 LLM 比传统扫描慢 1.5-2.7 倍，成本上不具经济性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LLM 初始猜测在高精度任务中不可靠，多轮模式虽提升成功率却在计算成本上不如传统扫描；作者以静态基准与可扩展工具包形式开源 SimulCost，旨在促进成本感知的代理设计研究并支持扩展新仿真环境。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Differentiable Thermodynamic Phase-Equilibria for Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of phase equilibria remains a central challenge in chemical engineering. Physics-consistent machine learning methods that incorporate thermodynamic structure into neural networks have recently shown strong performance for activity-coefficient modeling. However, extending such approaches to equilibrium data arising from an extremum principle, such as liquid-liquid equilibria, remains difficult. Here we present DISCOMAX, a differentiable algorithm for phase-equilibrium calculation that guarantees thermodynamic consistency at both training and inference, only subject to a user-specified discretization. The method combines discrete enumeration of feasible phase states with masked softmax aggregation in the backward pass, with the propagation of the true equilibrium state in the forward pass, using a straight-through gradient estimator to enable physics-consistent end-to-end learning of neural \gls{gE}-models. We show that this approach bears analogy to statistical thermodynamics, and we evaluate it on binary liquid-liquid equilibrium data where it outperforms existing surrogate-based methods, while offering a general framework for learning from different kinds of equilibrium data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DISCOMAX，一种可微的相平衡计算算法，用于神经网络热力学 gE-model（过量吉布斯能模型）的端到端学习。方法在前向传播中传播真实平衡态，在反向传播中通过离散枚举可行相态与掩码 softmax 聚合，并借助直通梯度估计器 (straight-through gradient estimator) 保证训练和推理时的热力学一致性。在二元液液平衡数据上，该方法优于现有的代理模型 (surrogate-based) 方法，并可作为学习多种平衡数据的通用框架。
Motivation: 化学工程中相平衡的准确预测仍是核心挑战；虽然将热力学结构嵌入神经网络的物理一致方法在活度系数 (activity coefficient) 建模上表现出色，但将这类方法扩展到由极值原理 (extremum principle) 产生的平衡数据（如液液平衡）仍很困难。
Method: 提出 DISCOMAX 可微算法：前向传播传播真实平衡态，反向传播中离散枚举可行相态并用掩码 softmax 聚合，配合直通梯度估计器，实现神经 gE-model 的物理一致端到端学习。作者指出该方法与统计热力学存在类比关系，且热力学一致性只受用户指定的离散化约束。
Result: 在二元液液平衡数据上，DISCOMAX 优于现有的代理模型方法，并提供一个可学习不同类型平衡数据的通用框架。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在训练和推理阶段均保证热力学一致性，并可能推广到其他由极值原理导出的平衡数据；其通用性以用户指定离散化为前提。

summary_sections.motivation: 化学工程中相平衡的准确预测仍是核心挑战；虽然将热力学结构嵌入神经网络的物理一致方法在活度系数 (activity coefficient) 建模上表现出色，但将这类方法扩展到由极值原理 (extremum principle) 产生的平衡数据（如液液平衡）仍很困难。
summary_sections.method: 提出 DISCOMAX 可微算法：前向传播传播真实平衡态，反向传播中离散枚举可行相态并用掩码 softmax 聚合，配合直通梯度估计器，实现神经 gE-model 的物理一致端到端学习。作者指出该方法与统计热力学存在类比关系，且热力学一致性只受用户指定的离散化约束。
summary_sections.result: 在二元液液平衡数据上，DISCOMAX 优于现有的代理模型方法，并提供一个可学习不同类型平衡数据的通用框架。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在训练和推理阶段均保证热力学一致性，并可能推广到其他由极值原理导出的平衡数据；其通用性以用户指定离散化为前提。

papers.title: Deep Learning for BioImaging: What Are We Really Learning?
papers.abstract_en: Representation learning has driven major advances in natural image analysis by enabling models to acquire high-level semantic features. In microscopy imaging, however, it remains unclear what current representation learning methods really learn. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of representation learning for the two most widely used and broadly available microscopy data types, representing critical scales in biology: cell culture and tissue imaging. We investigate whether, in contrast to natural images, existing models fail to consistently acquire high-level, biologically meaningful features. To this end, we introduce a set of simple yet revealing baselines on curated benchmarks, including untrained models and structural representations of cellular tissue. Our results show that, surprisingly, for a considerable subset of evaluation settings, the baselines are comparable to state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating that many commonly used benchmark metrics are insufficient to assess representation quality and often mask a lack of relevant high-level abstractions. In addition, we investigate how detailed comparisons with these baselines provide ways to interpret the strengths and weaknesses of models for further improvements. Together, our results suggest that progress in representation learning for microscopy requires not only stronger models, but also benchmarks that are more indicative of what is actually learned.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对显微镜成像中的表示学习（representation learning）进行系统研究，聚焦细胞培养（cell culture）和组织成像（tissue imaging）两类广泛使用的显微数据。作者引入未训练模型和细胞组织结构表征等简单但具有揭示性的基线，发现约相当一部分评测设置下这些基线与 SOTA 方法表现相当，说明常用基准指标不足以评估表示质量，常常掩盖模型缺乏生物意义上高层抽象的问题。
Motivation: 自然图像分析中表示学习能够获得高层语义特征，但在显微成像中，现有表示学习方法究竟学到了什么仍不明确，现有基准也可能无法反映生物上真正有意义的特征。
Method: 针对两类代表性显微数据开展系统性研究，构建未训练模型与组织结构表征等简单基线，在精选基准上对比 SOTA 方法，并利用与基线的详细比较来解释模型的优缺点。
Result: 相当一部分评测设置下，简单基线的表现与 SOTA 方法相当，表明许多常用基准指标不足以评估表示质量，并掩盖了相关高层抽象特征的缺失。
Conclusion: 作者认为显微成像领域的表示学习进展不仅需要更强的模型，也需要更能反映模型实际所学内容的基准。

papers.title: Mixture of experts architectures for machine learning interatomic potentials
papers.abstract_en: Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials (MLIPs) enable accurate large-scale atomistic simulations, yet improving their expressive capacity efficiently remains challenging. Here we systematically investigate Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and Mixture-of-Linear-Experts (MoLE) architectures within the DPA3 framework for MLIPs and analyze the effects of routing strategies and expert designs. We show that sparse activation combined with shared experts yields substantial performance gains, and that nonlinear MoE formulations outperform MoLE when shared experts are present, underscoring the importance of nonlinear expert specialization. Furthermore, element-wise routing consistently surpasses configuration-level routing, while global MoE routing often leads to numerical instability. The resulting element-wise MoE model consistently outperforms all DPA3-based baselines across the OMol25, OMat24, and OC20M benchmarks. Analysis of routing patterns reveals chemically interpretable expert specialization aligned with periodic-table trends, indicating that the model effectively captures element-specific chemical characteristics for precise interatomic modeling.
papers.journal_ref: npj Artificial Intelligence (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 DPA3 框架内系统研究用于机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 的 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 与 Mixture-of-Linear-Experts (MoLE) 架构，分析路由策略和专家设计的影响。摘要表明，稀疏激活结合共享专家能带来显著性能提升，非线性 MoE 在存在共享专家时优于 MoLE，且元素级路由一致优于构型级路由，而全局 MoE 路由常导致数值不稳定。最终的元素级 MoE 模型在 OMol25、OMat24 和 OC20M 基准上超过所有 DPA3 基线，路由模式呈现与元素周期表趋势一致的化学可解释专家特化。
Motivation: 提高机器学习原子间势的表达能力且保持计算高效仍是挑战；现有工作缺乏对 MoE/MoLE 架构中路由策略与专家设计影响的系统理解。
Method: 在 DPA3 框架中系统比较 MoE 与 MoLE 架构，考察稀疏激活、共享专家、非线性 vs 线性专家、元素级 vs 构型级 vs 全局路由等因素对模型性能与稳定性的影响。
Result: 摘要报告稀疏激活加共享专家带来显著性能提升；非线性 MoE 在含共享专家时优于 MoLE；元素级路由持续优于构型级路由，全局路由常不稳定；最终模型在 OMol25、OMat24、OC20M 上胜过所有 DPA3 基线。
Conclusion: 作者强调非线性专家特化与元素级路由对精确原子间建模的重要性，并指出路由模式可按元素周期表趋势解释，显示模型能捕获元素特异的化学特征。

papers.title: Not All Neighbors Matter: Understanding the Impact of Graph Sparsification on GNN Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: As graphs scale to billions of nodes and edges, graph Machine Learning workloads are constrained by the cost of multi-hop traversals over exponentially growing neighborhoods. While various system-level and algorithmic optimizations have been proposed to accelerate Graph Neural Network (GNN) pipelines, data management and movement remain the primary bottlenecks at scale. In this paper, we explore whether graph sparsification, a well-established technique that reduces edges to create sparser neighborhoods, can serve as a lightweight pre-processing step to address these bottlenecks while preserving accuracy on node classification tasks. We develop an extensible experimental framework that enables systematic evaluation of how different sparsification methods affect the performance and accuracy of GNN models. We conduct the first comprehensive study of GNN training and inference on sparsified graphs, revealing several key findings. First, sparsification often preserves or even improves predictive performance. As an example, random sparsification raises the accuracy of the GAT model by 6.8% on the PubMed graph. Second, benefits increase with scale, substantially accelerating both training and inference. Our results show that the K-Neighbor sparsifier improves model serving performance on the Products graph by 11.7x with only a 0.7% accuracy drop. Importantly, we find that the computational overhead of sparsification is quickly amortized, making it practical for very large graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究图稀疏化（graph sparsification）作为轻量级预处理步骤，能否在保持节点分类任务准确性的同时缓解GNN管线在大规模图上的数据移动瓶颈。作者开发了可扩展实验框架，系统比较多种稀疏化方法对GNN训练与推理的影响，发现稀疏化通常能保持甚至提升预测性能，且收益随图规模增大而增加，计算开销可快速摊销。
Motivation: 图规模可达数十亿节点和边，多跳遍历导致邻域指数增长，系统级和算法级优化仍受限于数据管理和移动成本；需要一种轻量预处理手段来减少边数、加速GNN管线而不牺牲准确性。
Method: 构建可扩展的实验框架，对多种图稀疏化方法下的GNN训练和推理进行系统评估，并比较不同稀疏化方法对模型性能与准确性的影响。
Result: 摘要报告随机稀疏化在PubMed图上使GAT模型准确率提升6.8%；K-Neighbor稀疏化在Products图上将模型服务性能提升11.7倍，仅带来0.7%的准确率下降；稀疏化的计算开销能快速摊销，收益随图规模增加而增大。
Conclusion: 图稀疏化可作为大规模GNN管线的实用预处理步骤，在保持或提升预测准确性的同时显著加速训练与推理，尤其适用于超大规模图。

papers.title: Random Quadratic Form on a Sphere: Synchronization by Common Noise
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Random Quadratic Form (RQF): a stochastic differential equation which formally corresponds to the gradient flow of a random quadratic functional on a sphere. While the one-point dynamics of the system is a Brownian motion and thus has no preferred direction, the two-point motion exhibits nontrivial synchronizing behaviour. In this work we study synchronization of the RQF, namely we give both distributional and path-wise characterizations of the solutions by studying invariant measures and random attractors of the system. The RQF model is motivated by the study of the role of linear layers in transformers and illustrates the synchronization by common noise phenomena arising in the simplified models of transformers. In particular, we provide an alternative (independent of self-attention) explanation of the clustering behaviour in deep transformers and show that tokens cluster even in the absence of the self-attention mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出随机二次型 (Random Quadratic Form, RQF)，即球面上随机二次泛函的梯度流所对应的随机微分方程。系统单点动力学是布朗运动、没有偏好方向，但两点运动呈现非平凡的同步行为；作者通过不变测度和随机吸引子给出解的分布意义与路径意义刻画。该模型受 Transformer 中线性层作用的启发，用于说明共同噪声 (common noise) 引起的同步现象，并给出与自注意力无关的深层 Transformer 中 token 聚类解释。
Motivation: 作者希望理解简化 Transformer 模型中共同噪声导致的同步机制，特别是线性层在其中扮演的角色，并解释即使没有自注意力机制 token 仍会出现聚类这一现象。
Method: 引入 RQF 这一随机微分方程，研究其两点运动，利用不变测度 (invariant measures) 与随机吸引子 (random attractors) 对系统进行分布意义和路径意义下的同步刻画。
Result: 摘要报告单点动力学虽是布朗运动，但两点运动具有非平凡同步行为；在深层 Transformer 的简化模型中，即使不存在自注意力机制，token 也会发生聚类。
Conclusion: 作者强调该结果提供了一种独立于自注意力机制之外、关于深层 Transformer 中聚类行为的替代解释，其结论建立在 RQF 这一简化模型之上。

papers.title: Understanding Sources of Demographic Predictability in Brain MRI via Disentangling Anatomy and Contrast
authors: Jorge Cardoso (and for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
papers.abstract_en: Demographic attributes can be predicted from medical images, raising concerns about bias in clinical AI systems. In X-ray imaging, acquisition characteristics have been shown to contribute substantially to this predictability. Whether the same holds in brain MRI remains unclear, as anatomical variation and acquisition-dependent contrast are deeply entangled in the image formation process, obscuring the origins of demographic signal. To address this, we propose a controlled framework based on disentangled representation learning, decomposing brain MRI into anatomy-focused representations that suppress acquisition influence and contrast embeddings that capture acquisition-dependent characteristics. Training predictive models for age, sex, and race on full images, anatomical representations, and contrast embeddings allows us to quantify the relative contributions of structure and acquisition to the demographic signal. Across three datasets and multiple MRI sequences, demographic predictability is found to be driven primarily by anatomical variation, with anatomy-focused representations largely preserving the performance of models trained on raw images. Contrast embeddings retain a weaker signal that is dataset-specific and does not generalize across sites. These findings suggest that effective mitigation must explicitly account for the primarily anatomical and secondarily acquisition-dependent origins of demographic signal, ensuring that any bias reduction generalizes robustly across domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究脑磁共振成像（brain MRI）中人口统计学属性的可预测性来源，提出基于解耦表示学习（disentangled representation learning）的受控框架，将MRI分解为抑制采集影响的解剖表征和捕获采集依赖特征的对比嵌入（contrast embedding）。在三个数据集和多种MRI序列上，年龄、性别和种族的可预测性主要由解剖变异驱动，解剖表征能大体保留原始图像训练模型的性能，而对比嵌入仅保留较弱的、数据集特异的信号。
Motivation: 医学影像可以预测人口统计学属性，引发对临床AI系统偏见的担忧；X射线成像中采集特征已被证明对此贡献显著，但脑MRI中解剖变异与采集依赖的对比度在成像过程中深度纠缠，人口统计学信号的来源尚不明确。
Method: 提出一个基于解耦表示学习的受控框架，将脑MRI分解为抑制采集影响的解剖表征和捕获采集依赖特性的对比嵌入；随后分别在全图、解剖表征和对比嵌入上训练年龄、性别和种族预测模型，以量化解剖结构与采集因素对人口统计学信号的相对贡献。
Result: 在三个数据集和多种MRI序列上，人口统计学可预测性主要由解剖变异驱动；解剖表征基本保持了基于原始图像训练模型的性能，而对比嵌入保留的信号较弱、具有数据集特异性，且无法跨站点泛化。
Conclusion: 有效的偏见缓解必须明确考虑人口统计学信号以解剖为主、采集为辅的来源，从而保证偏差削减能够在不同域间稳健泛化。

summary_sections.motivation: 医学影像可以预测人口统计学属性，引发对临床AI系统偏见的担忧；X射线成像中采集特征已被证明对此贡献显著，但脑MRI中解剖变异与采集依赖的对比度在成像过程中深度纠缠，人口统计学信号的来源尚不明确。

papers.title: Decentralized Federated Learning by Partial Message Exchange
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) has emerged as a transformative server-free paradigm that enables collaborative learning over large-scale heterogeneous networks. However, it continues to face fundamental challenges, including data heterogeneity, restrictive assumptions for theoretical analysis, and degraded convergence when standard communication- or privacyenhancing techniques are applied. To overcome these drawbacks, this paper develops a novel algorithm, PaME (DFL by Partial Message Exchange). The central principle is to allow only randomly selected sparse coordinates to be exchanged between two neighbor nodes. Consequently, PaME achieves substantial reductions in communication costs while still preserving a high level of privacy, without sacrificing accuracy. Moreover, grounded in rigorous analysis, the algorithm is shown to converge at a linear rate under the gradient to be locally Lipschitz continuous and the communication matrix to be doubly stochastic. These two mild assumptions not only dispense with many restrictive conditions commonly imposed by existing DFL methods but also enables PaME to effectively address data heterogeneity. Furthermore, comprehensive numerical experiments demonstrate its superior performance compared with several representative decentralized learning algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种去中心化联邦学习算法 PaME（DFL by Partial Message Exchange），其核心是相邻节点间只交换随机选取的稀疏坐标。摘要称该方法能在不牺牲精度的前提下显著降低通信成本并保持较高隐私水平，并在梯度局部 Lipschitz 连续、通信矩阵双重随机这两个温和假设下以线性速率收敛。数值实验显示其优于若干有代表性的去中心化学习算法。
Motivation: 去中心化联邦学习虽然避免了中心服务器，但仍面临数据异构性、理论分析假设过强，以及标准通信或隐私增强技术导致收敛退化等基本挑战。
Method: 提出 PaME 算法，核心思想是允许两个相邻节点之间仅交换随机选取的稀疏坐标（partial message exchange），从而降低通信开销并增强隐私。
Result: 在梯度局部 Lipschitz 连续且通信矩阵为双重随机（doubly stochastic）的温和假设下，PaME 以线性速率收敛；同时大幅降低通信成本、保持较高隐私，且综合数值实验表明其性能优于多种代表性去中心化学习算法。
Conclusion: 作者强调，PaME 所依赖的两个温和假设摆脱了现有 DFL 方法常用的许多限制性条件，并使其能够有效应对数据异构性。

papers.title: VesselBridge3D: A Foundation Model Adaptation Framework for Label-Efficient 3D Vessel Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art vessel segmentation methods typically require large-scale annotated datasets and suffer from severe performance degradation under domain shifts. In clinical practice, however, acquiring extensive annotations for every new scanner or protocol is unfeasible. To address this, we propose VesselBridge3D, a foundation model adaptation framework that bridges frozen vision foundation models and volumetric vessel segmentation through lightweight 3D adaptation modules. The framework combines a lightweight 3D Adapter, a multi-scale 3D Aggregator, and Z-channel embedding for efficient adaptation to volumetric medical images. We instantiate VesselBridge3D with three frozen foundation encoders (DINOv3, MedSAM, and MedGemma) and evaluate it on the TopCoW (ID) and Lausanne (OOD) datasets. In the extreme low-data regime with 5 training samples, our method achieved a Dice score of 43.42%, marking a 30% relative improvement over the state-of-the-art nnU-Net (33.41%) and outperforming other Transformer-based baselines by up to 45%. The proposed framework was effective across all evaluated frozen foundation encoders, with DINOv3 yielding the best performance in the most label-efficient settings. Furthermore, in the out-of-distribution setting, our model demonstrated superior robustness, achieving a 50% relative improvement over nnU-Net (21.37% vs. 14.22%), which suffered from severe domain overfitting. Ablation studies confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed 3D adaptation modules. Our results demonstrate that VesselBridge3D is an effective framework for label-efficient 3D vessel segmentation under data scarcity and domain shifts.
papers.comment: Accepted at SWITCH+ MICCAI 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/pfnet-research/vesselbridge3d

TL;DR: VesselBridge3D 是一个面向标签高效 3D 血管分割的基础模型适配框架，通过轻量级 3D 适配模块将冻结的视觉基础模型与体积分割任务桥接起来。框架由轻量级 3D Adapter、多尺度 3D Aggregator 和 Z-channel embedding 组成，并在 TopCoW (ID) 与 Lausanne (OOD) 数据集上验证。在仅 5 个训练样本的极端低数据场景下，方法取得 43.42% 的 Dice，相对 nnU-Net（33.41%）提升 30%；在 OOD 场景下相对 nnU-Net 提升 50%。三种冻结编码器均有效，其中 DINOv3 在标签最稀缺的设置下表现最佳。
Motivation: 现有最先进的血管分割方法依赖大规模标注数据集，且在域偏移下性能大幅下降；而临床实践中为每种新扫描仪或采集协议获取大量标注不可行。

Result: 在 5 个训练样本下达到 43.42% Dice，相对 nnU-Net（33.41%）提升 30%，并优于其他 Transformer 基线最多 45%；OOD 设置下达 21.37% vs 14.22%，相对提升 50%，而 nnU-Net 出现严重域过拟合；消融实验确认了 3D 适配模块的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架是数据稀缺和域偏移条件下标签高效 3D 血管分割的有效方案，但未在摘要中提及明显局限。

papers.title: SemVideo: Reconstructs What You Watch from Brain Activity via Hierarchical Semantic Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic visual experiences from brain activity provides a compelling avenue for exploring the neural mechanisms of human visual perception. While recent progress in fMRI-based image reconstruction has been notable, extending this success to video reconstruction remains a significant challenge. Current fMRI-to-video reconstruction approaches consistently encounter two major shortcomings: (i) inconsistent visual representations of salient objects across frames, leading to appearance mismatches; (ii) poor temporal coherence, resulting in motion misalignment or abrupt frame transitions. To address these limitations, we introduce SemVideo, a novel fMRI-to-video reconstruction framework guided by hierarchical semantic information. At the core of SemVideo is SemMiner, a hierarchical guidance module that constructs three levels of semantic cues from the original video stimulus: static anchor descriptions, motion-oriented narratives, and holistic summaries. Leveraging this semantic guidance, SemVideo comprises three key components: a Semantic Alignment Decoder that aligns fMRI signals with CLIP-style embeddings derived from SemMiner, a Motion Adaptation Decoder that reconstructs dynamic motion patterns using a novel tripartite attention fusion architecture, and a Conditional Video Render that leverages hierarchical semantic guidance for video reconstruction. Experiments conducted on the CC2017 and HCP datasets demonstrate that SemVideo achieves superior performance in both semantic alignment and temporal consistency, setting a new state-of-the-art in fMRI-to-video reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SemVideo，一种基于层级语义信息的 fMRI 到视频重建框架。针对现有方法在帧间显著物体外观不一致和时间连贯性差的问题，SemVideo 引入 SemMiner 模块，从原始视频刺激中提取静态锚定描述、运动导向叙述和整体摘要三类语义线索，并配合语义对齐解码器、运动适应解码器和条件视频渲染器完成视频重建。在 CC2017 和 HCP 数据集上的实验显示，该方法在语义对齐和时间一致性上取得更优性能，刷新了 fMRI 到视频重建的最优结果。
Motivation: fMRI 图像重建已有进展，但将该思路扩展到视频重建仍面临两个主要缺陷：显著物体在不同帧中的视觉表征不一致导致外观错配，以及时间连贯性差导致运动错位或帧间突变。
Method: SemVideo 的核心是 SemMiner 层级引导模块，构建静态锚定描述、运动导向叙述和整体摘要三级语义线索；随后由 Semantic Alignment Decoder 将 fMRI 信号与 CLIP 风格嵌入对齐，Motion Adaptation Decoder 采用三分注意力融合架构重建动态运动模式，Conditional Video Render 利用层级语义引导进行视频重建。
Result: 在 CC2017 和 HCP 数据集上的实验表明，SemVideo 在语义对齐和时间一致性两方面均优于现有方法，成为 fMRI 到视频重建的新最优方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为层级语义引导能够同时缓解跨帧外观不一致和运动时间连贯性问题，为 fMRI 视频重建提供了有效的新框架。

papers.title: Training-Free Multi-Concept Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Training-free image editing with diffusion models is highly desirable yet is complex and remains a significant challenge. While recent optimisation-based methods achieve strong zero-shot edits from text, they still struggle to preserve identity and capture intricate details, such as facial structure, surface texture, or object-specific geometry, that exist below the level of linguistic abstraction. To address this fundamental gap, we propose Concept Distillation Sampling (CDS). To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to introduce a unified, training-free framework for target-less, multi-concept image editing. CDS overcomes this linguistic bottleneck of previous methods by anchoring the editing process in the certainty of pretrained LoRA adapters. We integrate a highly stable distillation backbone (featuring ordered timesteps, regularisation, and negative-prompt guidance) with a novel dynamic weighting mechanism. This approach enables the composition and control of multiple visual concepts directly within the diffusion process, utilising spatially-aware priors from pretrained LoRA adapters without causing concept clashing. Our method preserves instance concept identity without requiring reference samples of the desired edit. Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that CDS establishes a new state-of-the-art over existing training-free editing and multi-LoRA composition methods on the InstructPix2Pix and ComposLoRA benchmarks. Project Page: https://nickyfot.github.io/cds/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Concept Distillation Sampling (CDS)，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的统一框架，用于无目标 (target-less) 的多概念图像编辑。CDS 将编辑过程锚定在预训练 LoRA 适配器的确定性先验上，结合带有有序时间步、正则化和负向提示引导的蒸馏主干与动态加权机制，在扩散过程中直接组合多个视觉概念。作者在 InstructPix2Pix 和 ComposLoRA 基准上报告了超越现有 training-free 编辑与多 LoRA 组合方法的性能。
Motivation: 现有一类基于优化的零样本文本编辑方法难以保持实例身份，也无法捕捉语言抽象层面之下的细节，如面部结构、表面纹理或物体特定几何；同时，统一且无需参考样本的多概念、无目标编辑仍缺乏 training-free 框架。
Method: 提出 Concept Distillation Sampling (CDS)，利用预训练 LoRA 适配器提供空间感知先验，集成一个高稳定性的蒸馏主干（包括有序时间步、正则化与负向提示指导），并引入动态加权机制，在扩散过程中实现多个视觉概念的组合与控制，避免概念冲突，且无需期望编辑的参考样本。
Result: 在 InstructPix2Pix 和 ComposLoRA 基准上的定量与定性评估显示，CDS 相较现有 training-free 编辑及多 LoRA 组合方法取得新的最优性能 (state-of-the-art)；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 作者将收益归结为把编辑锚定在预训练 LoRA 适配器的确定性上，从而克服语言抽象瓶颈并在不受限设置下保持实例概念身份；摘要同时指出该训练-free、统一框架可推广到多概念编辑场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exact Attention Sensitivity and the Geometry of Transformer Stability
papers.abstract_en: We develop a sensitivity analysis for transformer attention in a geometry aligned with tokenwise computation. Our main result is the exact identity $\|J_τ(u)\|_{\infty\to1}=θ(p)/τ$ for the Jacobian $J_τ(u)$ of the tempered softmax $u\mapsto\mathrm{softmax}(u/τ)$, where $θ(p)=4\max_{S\subseteq[L]}p(S)(1-p(S))$ measures how evenly the attention distribution can be bisected rather than how concentrated it is. We combine this identity with a block-$\infty$/RMS norm under which row-stochastic attention mixing is nonexpansive. This yields a distribution-aware local Jacobian bound for multi-head attention and a sequence-length-independent Lipschitz bound on bounded input sets, with explicit dependence on width, input magnitude, temperature, and projection norms. We also identify a structural distinction between normalization placements: a pre-LN residual-sublayer Jacobian contains an additive identity term, whereas a post-LN residual-sublayer Jacobian does not. A LayerNorm projection lemma gives a sufficient condition under which the LayerNorm-only term in the post-LN expansion contracts geometrically; the condition is not tested by our experiments. Across three Pre-LN early-training runs of $774$M-parameter models, attention becomes substantially more concentrated while the median lower-bound certificate for $θ(p)$ remains near one at every sampled layer and checkpoint. This certifies near-maximal exact sensitivity for at least half of the sampled rows within each layer. A minority of rows enters a dominant-atom regime with lower exact sensitivity, consistent with the deterministic relationship between $p_{\max}$ and $θ(p)$.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 4 figures. v2: Major revision. Exact softmax sensitivity theorem unchanged. Removed an unsupported path-length scaling theorem and its DeepNorm derivation; corrected the uniform-attention parity case and the loss normalization/update accounting; reran the headline experiments; clarified the local vs. bounded-domain bounds and the conditional pre-LN/post-LN analysis

TL;DR: 本文从与逐 token 计算对齐的几何视角，对 Transformer 注意力机制做精确灵敏度分析。主要结果是带温度 softmax (tempered softmax) 的 Jacobian 满足精确恒等式 ||J_τ(u)||_{∞→1}=θ(p)/τ，其中 θ(p) 度量注意力分布可被二等分的程度而非集中程度；结合块无穷范数/RMS 范数下的非扩张性，得到多头注意力的分布感知局部 Jacobian 界以及有界输入集上不依赖序列长度的 Lipschitz 界。作者还给出 pre-LN 与 post-LN 残差子层 Jacobian 的结构性差异，并在 7.74 亿参数的 pre-LN 早期训练实验中观察到注意力显著集中而 θ(p) 的中位下界证书接近 1。
Motivation: 现有 Transformer 稳定性分析缺乏与逐 token 计算对齐的几何刻画，注意力灵敏度没有被精确量化；从分布二等分能力而非集中度出发，可以更准确地描述 softmax 对扰动的响应。
Method: 推导 tempered softmax 的精确 Jacobian 恒等式，构造使行随机注意力混合为非扩张的块-∞/RMS 范数，并由此导出多头注意力的局部 Jacobian 界和序列长度无关的 Lipschitz 界；同时用 LayerNorm 投影引理分析 pre-LN/post-LN 残差子层的收缩行为。
Result: 理论部分给出精确恒等式与显式依赖宽度、输入幅度、温度和投影范数的边界；实验部分在三个 774M 参数 pre-LN 早期训练 run 中显示注意力显著集中，且 θ(p) 的中位下界证书在采样的每层和 checkpoint 都接近 1，表明至少一半采样行的精确灵敏度接近最大，少数行进入低灵敏度的主导原子 (dominant-atom) 区域。
Conclusion: 作者强调精确 softmax 灵敏度定理在 v2 中保持不变，并删除了一个不受支持的路经长度缩放定理及其 DeepNorm 推导；LayerNorm 投影引理给出的收缩充分条件未被实验检验，属于未验证的理论结果。

papers.title: Measuring the Prevalence of Policy Violating Content with ML Assisted Sampling and LLM Labeling
papers.abstract_en: Content safety teams need metrics that reflect what users actually experience, not only what is reported. We study prevalence: the fraction of user views (impressions) that went to content violating a given policy on a given day. Accurate prevalence measurement is challenging because violations are often rare and human labeling is costly, making frequent, platform-representative studies slow. We present a design-based measurement system that (i) draws daily probability samples from the impression stream using ML-assisted weights to concentrate label budget on high-exposure and high-risk content while preserving unbiasedness, (ii) labels sampled items with a multimodal LLM governed by policy prompts and gold-set validation, and (iii) produces design-consistent prevalence estimates with confidence intervals and dashboard drilldowns. A key design goal is one global sample with many pivots: the same daily sample supports prevalence by surface, viewer geography, content age, and other segments through post-stratified estimation. We describe the statistical estimators, variance and confidence interval construction, label-quality monitoring, and an engineering workflow that makes the system configurable across policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套基于设计的测量系统，用于估计平台上政策违规内容在用户曝光流中的流行率（prevalence），即某一天用户浏览曝光（impressions）中违反指定政策内容的比例。系统每天从曝光流抽取概率样本，用 ML 辅助权重集中标注预算于高曝光、高危内容并保持无偏性，再用受政策提示词和黄金集验证约束的多模态 LLM 标注样本，最终给出设计一致的估计、置信区间和仪表盘下钻。摘要还强调“一个全局样本、多种透视”的设计目标，同一日样本可通过事后分层估计支持按界面、用户地域、内容年龄等维度分解。
Motivation: 内容安全团队需要反映用户真实体验的指标，而不仅是用户举报数据；由于违规内容通常稀少且人工标注昂贵，频繁且平台代表性的流行率研究难以开展。
Method: 提出设计型测量系统：从曝光流每日抽取概率样本，采用 ML 辅助权重在保持无偏性的前提下集中标注预算；用受政策提示词和黄金集验证约束的多模态 LLM 标注抽样内容；通过设计一致的估计量、方差与置信区间构造，以及事后分层估计支持多维度下钻。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，主要贡献在于描述统计估计量、方差与置信区间构造、标签质量监控，以及使系统可跨政策配置的工程工作流。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该系统能以每日频率、平台代表性的方式测量政策违规内容流行率，并通过“一个全局样本、多种透视”和可配置工程流程支持不同政策与细分维度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlexAM: Flexible Appearance-Motion Decomposition for Versatile Video Generation Control
papers.abstract_en: Effective and generalizable control in video generation remains a significant challenge. While many methods rely on ambiguous or task-specific signals, we argue that a fundamental disentanglement of "appearance" and "motion" provides a more robust and scalable pathway. We propose FlexAM, a unified framework built upon a novel 3D control signal. This signal represents video dynamics as a point cloud, introducing three key enhancements: multi-frequency positional encoding to distinguish fine-grained motion, depth-aware encoding, and a flexible control signal for balancing precision and generalization. This representation allows FlexAM to effectively disentangle appearance and motion, enabling a wide range of tasks including I2V/V2V editing, camera control, and spatial object editing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FlexAM achieves superior performance across all evaluated tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlexAM，一个基于 3D 控制信号的视频生成统一框架，通过将视频动态表示为点云并引入多频位置编码、深度感知编码和灵活控制信号，实现外观与运动的解耦。该方法支持 I2V/V2V 编辑、相机控制和空间物体编辑等任务，并在所有评估任务上取得优于基线的结果。
Motivation: 视频生成中有效且可泛化的控制仍是难题，现有方法常依赖模糊或任务特定的信号；作者认为外观和运动的基本解耦是更稳健、可扩展的路径。
Method: 将视频动态建模为点云形式的 3D 控制信号，包含多频位置编码以区分细粒度运动、深度感知编码以及用于平衡精度与泛化能力的灵活控制信号，从而统一解耦外观与运动。
Result: 摘要声称在 I2V/V2V 编辑、相机控制和空间物体编辑等所有评估任务上均取得优于现有方法的性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调外观-运动解耦的 3D 点云控制信号是一个通用且可扩展的视频生成控制方向，但摘要未讨论该方法在极端动态或高分辨率场景下的局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Closing the Loop: A Control-Theoretic Framework for Provably Stable Time Series Forecasting with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown exceptional potential in time series forecasting (TSF), leveraging their inherent sequential reasoning capabilities to model complex temporal dynamics. Existing approaches typically employ an autoregressive generation strategy to adapt LLMs for TSF. However, we identify a theoretical flaw in this paradigm: during inference, the model operates in an open-loop manner, recursively consuming its own generated outputs. This leads to error accumulation, where minor early deviations cascade into significant rollout drift over long horizons. In this paper, we reformulate autoregressive forecasting through the lens of control theory, proposing Feedback-driven LLM (F-LLM), a novel closed-loop framework. Unlike standard methods that passively propagate errors, F-LLM actively stabilizes the trajectory via a learnable residual estimator functioning as a system observer. Furthermore, we provide a mathematical proof that, under explicit contraction assumptions, this closed-loop mechanism guarantees a uniformly bounded step-wise error sequence within the local surrogate dynamics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that F-LLM significantly mitigates error propagation, achieving good performance on time series benchmarks. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zh-XY22/F-LLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出将 LLM 用于时间序列预测（TSF）的典型自回归生成范式在推理时是开环的，模型递归消费自身输出，导致误差累积与长程漂移。作者从控制理论出发提出 F-LLM，一种带反馈的闭环框架，用可学习残差估计器作为系统观测器（observer）主动稳定轨迹。摘要给出收缩假设下的误差有界证明，并在时间序列基准上取得良好性能，代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 时间序列预测通常采用自回归生成，推理时模型以开环方式消费自己生成的输出，早期微小误差会在长地平线上级联放大；本文将该缺陷识别为理论上的开环控制问题。
Method: F-LLM 将自回归预测重构成闭环控制问题，引入可学习的残差估计器充当系统观测器，在推理时主动稳定轨迹，而非被动传播误差；论文还在显式收缩假设下给出步进误差序列在局部代理动力学内一致有界的数学证明。
Result: 实验表明 F-LLM 显著缓解误差传播，在时间序列基准上取得良好性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为闭环反馈机制能够在收缩假设下保证误差一致有界，并展示其在常见时间序列基准上的有效性；代码公开。摘要未讨论具体局限性。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: PRO-Bid: Pareto-Prioritized Regret Optimization for Constraint-Aware Generative Auto-Bidding
papers.abstract_en: Auto-bidding systems strive to maximize marketing value while maintaining high compliance with efficiency constraints, such as Target Cost-Per-Action (CPA). While Decision Transformers offer powerful sequence modeling capabilities, their application to this setting faces two challenges: 1) standard Return-to-Go conditioning causes state aliasing by ignoring the cost dimension, preventing precise resource pacing; and 2) standard regression constrains the policy to mimic historical averages, limiting its capacity to optimize performance near the high-efficiency boundary. To tackle these challenges, we propose PRO-Bid, a constraint-aware generative auto-bidding framework featuring systematic redesigns across data, architecture, and training via two synergistic mechanisms: 1) Constraint-Decoupled Pareto Representation (CDPR) separates global constraints into recursive cost and value contexts to restore resource perception, while reweighting trajectories based on the empirical Pareto frontier to prioritize high-efficiency data; and 2) Counterfactual Regret Optimization (CRO) employs a global predictor to evaluate alternative actions and identify promising local adjustments. By utilizing these high-utility outcomes as weighted regression targets, the model overcomes mean regression and approaches the empirical high-efficiency boundary. Extensive experiments on two public benchmarks and online A/B tests show that PRO-Bid achieves better constraint satisfaction and value acquisition than state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted to CIKM2026 Full Research Paper Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRO-Bid，一个约束感知的生成式自动出价 (generative auto-bidding) 框架，针对决策 Transformer 在该场景中的两个问题：Return-to-Go 条件化忽略成本维度造成状态混叠，以及标准回归迫使策略模仿历史均值。框架通过约束解耦 Pareto 表示 (CDPR) 与反事实遗憾优化 (CRO) 两个协同机制，在数据、架构与训练层面进行系统性重设计。实验在两个公共基准和在线 A/B 测试中表明其约束满足与价值获取优于 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: 自动出价系统需要在目标每次行动成本 (Target CPA) 等效率约束下最大化营销价值，但标准决策 Transformer 因忽略成本维度导致状态混叠，且均值回归限制了在高效边界附近的性能优化。
Method: 提出 PRO-Bid，包含两个机制：CDPR 将全局约束分解为递归成本与价值上下文以恢复资源感知，并基于经验 Pareto 前沿对轨迹重加权以优先高效数据；CRO 使用全局预测器评估替代动作，以高效用结果作为加权回归目标，突破均值回归并逼近经验高效边界。
Result: 在两个公共基准和在线 A/B 测试中，PRO-Bid 相比现有最强基线实现了更好的约束满足和价值获取。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过数据、架构与训练的系统性重设计，约束感知生成式自动出价能够逼近经验高效边界，并同时改善约束满足与价值获取。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调通过数据、架构与训练的系统性重设计，约束感知生成式自动出价能够逼近经验高效边界，并同时改善约束满足与价值获取。

papers.title: DECO: Decoupled Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation with a Plugin Tactile Adapter
papers.abstract_en: Bimanual dexterous manipulation relies on integrating multimodal inputs to perform complex real-world tasks. To address the challenges of effectively combining these modalities, we propose DECO, a decoupled multimodal diffusion transformer that disentangles vision, proprioception, and tactile signals through specialized conditioning pathways, enabling structured and controllable integration of multimodal inputs, with a lightweight adapter for parameter-efficient injection of additional signals. Alongside DECO, we release DECO-50 dataset for bimanual dexterous manipulation with tactile sensing, consisting of 50 hours of data and over 5M frames, collected via teleoperation on real dual-arm robots. We train DECO on DECO-50 and conduct extensive real-world evaluation with over 2,000 robot rollouts. Experimental results show that DECO achieves the best performance across all tasks, with a 72.25% average success rate and a 21% improvement over the baseline. Moreover, the tactile adapter brings an additional 10.25% average success rate across all tasks and a 20% gain on complex contact-rich tasks while tuning less than 10% of the model parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DECO，一种解耦多模态扩散 Transformer（decoupled multimodal diffusion transformer），用于双手灵巧操作（bimanual dexterous manipulation）。它通过专门的条件路径分离视觉、本体感觉和触觉信号，并用轻量适配器（plugin tactile adapter）以参数高效方式注入额外信号。作者同时发布 DECO-50 数据集（50 小时、超过 5M 帧，由真实双臂机器人遥操作采集），并在超过 2,000 次真实机器人 rollout 中评估。结果显示 DECO 在所有任务上取得最佳性能，平均成功率达 72.25%，较基线提升 21%；触觉适配器在全部任务上额外带来 10.25% 的平均成功率提升，在复杂接触密集任务上提升 20%，且只微调不到 10% 的模型参数。
Motivation: 双手灵巧操作依赖整合多种模态输入（视觉、本体感觉、触觉）以完成复杂真实世界任务，而现有方法难以有效组合这些模态，构成关键挑战。
Method: 提出解耦多模态扩散 Transformer，通过专门化的条件路径（specialized conditioning pathways）分离视觉、本体感觉和触觉信号，实现结构化、可控的多模态整合，并引入轻量适配器用于参数高效的额外信号注入。
Result: 在 DECO-50 数据集上训练并在真实机器人上开展超过 2,000 次 rollout，平均成功率达 72.25%，较基线提升 21%；触觉适配器额外带来 10.25% 平均成功率提升，在复杂接触密集任务上提升 20%，且仅微调不到 10% 的模型参数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调解耦多模态整合与轻量触觉适配器可显著改善双手灵巧操作性能，但未明确讨论方法的局限或泛化边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MedMCP-Calc: Benchmarking LLMs for Realistic Medical Calculator Scenarios via MCP Integration
papers.abstract_en: Medical calculators are fundamental to quantitative, evidence-based clinical practice. However, their real-world use is an adaptive, multi-stage process, requiring proactive EHR data acquisition, scenario-dependent calculator selection, and multi-step computation, whereas current benchmarks focus only on static single-step calculations with explicit instructions. To address these limitations, we introduce MedMCP-Calc, the first benchmark for evaluating LLMs in realistic medical calculator scenarios through Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration. MedMCP-Calc comprises 118 scenario tasks across 4 clinical domains, featuring fuzzy task descriptions mimicking natural queries, structured EHR database interaction, external reference retrieval, and process-level evaluation. Our evaluation of 23 leading models reveals critical limitations: even top performers like Claude Opus 4.5 exhibit substantial gaps, including difficulty selecting appropriate calculators for end-to-end workflows given fuzzy queries, poor performance in iterative SQL-based database interactions, and marked reluctance to leverage external tools for numerical computation. Performance also varies considerably across clinical domains. Building on these findings, we develop CalcMate, a fine-tuned model incorporating scenario planning and tool augmentation, achieving state-of-the-art performance among open-source models. Benchmark and Codes are available in https://github.com/SPIRAL-MED/MedMCP-Calc.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ACL 2026 Main Conference as an Oral Presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedMCP-Calc，据称是首个通过 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 集成来评估 LLM 在真实医疗计算器场景中表现的基准，包含 118 个场景任务、4 个临床领域，覆盖模糊任务描述、结构化 EHR 数据库交互、外部参考检索与过程级评估。对 23 个领先模型的评估显示，即使 Claude Opus 4.5 等顶尖模型也存在计算器选择、迭代 SQL 交互以及主动调用外部工具方面的明显不足。基于这些发现，作者微调出 CalcMate，加入场景规划与工具增强，据称在开源模型中达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 现实中医疗计算器的使用是一个自适应、多阶段的流程，需要主动获取 EHR 数据、根据场景选择计算器并进行多步计算，而现有基准只关注带有显式指令的静态单步计算，无法反映真实临床场景。
Method: 通过 MCP 集成构建 MedMCP-Calc 基准，用模糊描述模拟自然查询，并引入结构化 EHR 数据库交互、外部参考检索和过程级评估；随后基于基准结果微调 CalcMate，加入场景规划与工具增强。
Result: 评估 23 个模型后发现，顶尖模型如 Claude Opus 4.5 在端到端工作流中仍难以根据模糊查询选择合适计算器，在迭代 SQL 数据库交互上表现差，且明显不愿借助外部工具进行数值计算；性能在不同临床领域间差异较大。CalcMate 在开源模型中取得最佳性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调真实医疗计算器场景暴露出现有 LLM 的关键能力缺口，并认为结合场景规划与工具增强的微调是有效改进方向；基准与代码已在 GitHub 公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Evaluating the trustworthiness of the Fréchet Inception Distance with stochastic embedding representations
papers.abstract_en: Feature embeddings acquired from pretrained models are widely used in medical applications of deep learning to assess the characteristics of datasets; e.g. to determine the quality of synthetic, generated medical images. The Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) is one popular synthetic image quality metric that relies on the assumption that the characteristic features of the data can be detected and encoded by an InceptionV3 model pretrained on ImageNet1K (natural images). While it is widely known that this makes it less effective for applications involving medical images, the extent to which the metric fails to capture meaningful differences in image characteristics is not obviously known. Here, we use Monte Carlo dropout to compute the predictive variance in the FID as well as a supplemental estimate of the predictive variance in the feature embedding model's latent representations. We show that the magnitudes of the predictive variances considered exhibit varying degrees of correlation with the extent to which test inputs (ImageNet1K validation set augmented at various strengths, and other external datasets) are out-of-distribution relative to its training data, providing some insight into the effectiveness of their use as indicators of the trustworthiness of the FID.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 Monte Carlo dropout 估计 Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) 及其特征嵌入模型潜在表示的预测方差，以评估 FID 在输入分布外（out-of-distribution）数据上的可信度。作者在 ImageNet1K 验证集的多种增强强度及若干外部数据集上检验这些预测方差的大小与输入偏离训练分布程度的相关性。摘要结论是这种相关性可为 FID 作为合成图像质量指标的可信度提供参考。
Motivation: FID 依赖在 ImageNet1K（自然图像）上预训练的 InceptionV3 提取特征，因此对医学图像等领域的合成图像质量评估效果较差，但该指标失效的严重程度此前并不明确。
Method: 使用 Monte Carlo dropout 计算 FID 的预测方差，并补充估计特征嵌入模型潜在表示的预测方差；通过在 ImageNet1K 验证集上施加不同强度的增强以及使用其他外部数据集来考察分布外程度。
Result: 摘要报告这些预测方差的大小与测试输入相对训练数据的分布外程度表现出不同程度的相关性，从而为其作为 FID 可信度指标的有效性提供了一些见解。
Conclusion: 作者建议所评估的预测方差可用于指示 FID 在特定输入上的可信度，但其相关性因情况而异。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Robust Privacy: Inference-Stage Privacy through Certified Robustness
papers.abstract_en: An adversary observing a model's released prediction can infer sensitive attributes of the queried input, or even reconstruct representatives of the model's training data. The inference interface thus acts as a side channel for privacy leakage. We introduce Robust Privacy (RP), an inference-stage privacy notion inspired by certified robustness: if a model's prediction is provably invariant within a radius-$R$ neighborhood around an input $x$ with confidence at least $1-α$, then $x$ enjoys $(R,α)$-Robust Privacy, under which we prove that any adversary observing the released prediction has at most $α/2$ advantage in distinguishing $x$ from any input within distance $R$ of $x$. Building on RP, we formalize Robust Attribute Privacy (RAP), an attribute-level privacy notion that characterizes the set of sensitive-attribute values that remain compatible with a released prediction. On a classification task, RP increases the median length of the RAP-compatible inference interval from $23.50$ to $29.96$, reducing attribute-inference precision. Model inversion attacks, often treated as a training-stage threat, in fact rely on fine-grained input-output dependence signals leaked through the inference interface; RP masks these signals at the inference stage, reducing attack success rate (ASR) from $73\%$ to $4\%$ on a black-box inversion attack. This direct targeting of the leakage channel enables RP to dominate DP-SGD and randomized response in the privacy-utility tradeoff space: RP retains $98.4\%$ accuracy at $21\%$ ASR, whereas DP-SGD must drop accuracy to $61.7\%$ to reach a comparable ASR. Across both experiments, increasing the smoothing sample size $N$ at fixed noise scale strengthens privacy and improves utility together. Finally, we examine model distillation as a scope boundary and show that RP mitigates attribute-level and instance-level inference-stage privacy leakage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向推理阶段的隐私概念 Robust Privacy (RP)，其灵感来自认证鲁棒性 (certified robustness)：若模型预测在输入 x 的半径 R 邻域内以至少 1-α 置信度可证明不变，则 x 享有 (R,α)-Robust Privacy，并证明观测预测的敌手区分 x 与其距离 R 内任意输入的优势至多为 α/2。作者进一步形式化属性级隐私概念 Robust Attribute Privacy (RAP)，并通过分类任务与模型反演攻击实验展示其在隐私-效用权衡上的优势。
Motivation: 现有隐私研究多关注训练阶段（如 DP-SGD），但模型推理接口本身可作为侧信道泄露输入敏感属性或训练数据代表，而这一推理阶段的泄露通道缺乏系统性的隐私形式化。
Method: 引入基于认证鲁棒性的推理阶段隐私定义 RP，并扩展出属性级隐私定义 RAP，用于刻画与发布预测相容的敏感属性值集合；通过在推理阶段掩蔽输入-输出细粒度依赖信号来抵御攻击。
Result: 在分类任务上，RP 将 RAP 相容推理区间中位数长度从 23.50 提升到 29.96，降低属性推断精度；黑盒模型反演攻击成功率从 73% 降至 4%。与 DP-SGD 和随机响应相比，RP 在隐私-效用权衡上占优：在 21% 攻击成功率下保持 98.4% 准确率，而 DP-SGD 需将准确率降至 61.7% 才能达到类似攻击成功率。固定噪声尺度下增大平滑样本量 N 可同时增强隐私并提升效用。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RP 能直接针对推理阶段的泄露通道提供隐私保护，并优于训练阶段方法；同时通过模型蒸馏实验界定其适用范围，表明 RP 可缓解属性级与实例级的推理阶段隐私泄露。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Aletheia: What Makes RLVR For Code Verifiers Tick?
papers.abstract_en: Multi-domain thinking verifiers trained via Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) are a cornerstone of modern post-training. However, their adoption in code generation has lagged behind that of execution feedback due to the prohibitive costs of the full RLVR pipeline. In this work, we ablate three primary choices along the performance-cost trade-off in RLVR: intermediate thinking traces, learning from negative samples, and on-policy training. We introduce Aletheia, a controlled, execution-grounded testbed to facilitate a decontaminated analysis of code verifier training recipes across disparate model sizes and covariate shifts across two common verifier application scenarios. Our analysis reveals that the optimal training recipe is scale-dependent: on-policy learning is the primary performance driver for small verifiers, whereas the thinking budget becomes the most vital factor at larger scales. Negative samples play a key role in stabilizing training at large sizes. They have a constant impact on top-1 selection, but are increasingly important for ranking performance as size increases. Our Pareto optimality analysis demonstrates that eliminating on-policy training at larger model scales could yield a verifier that performs comparably to the full RLVR recipe. Furthermore, we find that eschewing thinking traces is a compute-efficient strategy at lower budgets, offering a strong trade-off between training cost and verifier accuracy. We validate our findings across a Best-of-N deployment setting and two external reward model benchmarks, demonstrating that our findings generalize beyond the controlled testbed. Ultimately, our work offers empirical guidance toward training cost-efficient code verifiers and takes a step toward their wider adoption in post-training pipelines for code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Aletheia，一个受控的、基于执行结果 (execution-grounded) 的测试平台，用于消融代码验证器 RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards) 训练中的三个主要选择：中间思维痕迹 (intermediate thinking traces)、负样本学习 (learning from negative samples) 和 on-policy 训练。研究发现最优训练配方依赖于模型规模：小型验证器中 on-policy 学习是主要性能驱动，而大规模下思考预算 (thinking budget) 变得最关键；负样本在稳定大规模训练中起关键作用。Pareto 最优性分析显示，在大规模下消除 on-policy 训练仍可获得与完整 RLVR 配方相当的验证器，并在 Best-of-N 部署和两个外部奖励模型基准上验证了结论的泛化性。
Motivation: 多领域思维验证器是当代后训练 (post-training) 的基石，但 RLVR 在代码生成中的采用落后于执行反馈，原因是完整 RLVR 流程成本过高。本文针对这一性能-成本权衡，系统消融影响训练效率的关键设计选择。
Method: 引入 Aletheia，一个消除污染的 (decontaminated) 受控测试平台，跨不同模型规模和协变量偏移 (covariate shifts) 对代码验证器训练配方进行消融分析，覆盖中间思维痕迹、负样本学习和 on-policy 训练三个维度。
Result: 摘要报告：最优训练配方是规模依赖的——小规模下 on-policy 学习是主要性能驱动，大规模下思考预算成为最关键因素；负样本在大规模下稳定训练，对 top-1 选择影响恒定，但对排序性能的重要性随规模增加。Pareto 分析表明大规模下可省略 on-policy 训练且性能与完整 RLVR 相当，且低预算下省略思维痕迹是计算高效策略。
Conclusion: 本文为训练成本高效的代码验证器提供经验指导，并促进 RLVR 验证器在代码后训练管道中的更广泛采用。

papers.title: Sequential LLM Release Facilitates Manipulation in Regulated Markets
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly mediate bargaining, negotiation and persuasion for people and firms. Such markets extend software-mediated commerce, but add a governance problem: independent model releases change delegates available to participants. Game theory shows that expanding a strategy set can harm equilibrium outcomes, but mostly through constructed examples. Deployed AI-agent logs are scarce, proprietary and privacy-sensitive, and lack counterfactuals and payoff labels. We therefore use GLEE, an independently collected benchmark of 587K strategic decisions by 13 large language models across 1,320 matched bargaining, negotiation and persuasion configurations, to study model release as strategy expansion. Across more than 50{,}000 release comparisons, many releases move payoffs in opposite directions: one agent gains while the other loses. We identify the Poisoned Apple effect: a released model that no agent adopts in equilibrium nevertheless shifts payoffs in opposite directions and changes the regulator's market design. Up to roughly three in ten opposing shifts arise this way, and technology restrictions can amplify the effect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究受监管市场中大语言模型（LLM）按顺序发布如何影响以 AI 智能体为中介的议价、谈判与说服类市场。作者将模型发布建模为策略集合扩张，并借助独立收集的 GLEE 基准（13 个 LLM 在 1,320 个配置下的 587K 个战略决策）进行超过 50,000 次发布比较。研究发现许多发布会使双方收益朝相反方向移动，并识别出 Poisoned Apple 效应：一个均衡中无人采纳的已发布模型仍会反向改变收益并影响监管者的市场设计。
Motivation: AI 智能体日益介入个人和企业的议价、谈判与说服，而独立模型发布会改变参与者可用的代理人集合，构成治理问题。博弈论虽预测策略集合扩张可能损害均衡结果，但主要依赖构造性例子；真实智能体日志稀缺、专有且涉及隐私，缺乏反事实与收益标签。
Method: 利用独立收集的 GLEE 基准，包含 13 个 LLM 在 1,320 个匹配的谈判、议价与说服配置中的 587K 个战略决策；将模型发布视为策略扩张，并在超过 50,000 个发布比较中分析收益变化方向和均衡采纳行为。
Result: 摘要报告许多发布使双方收益向相反方向移动（一方获益、另一方受损）；约每十个相反方向的收益位移中至多三个由 Poisoned Apple 效应引起，且技术限制（technology restrictions）会放大该效应。
Conclusion: 研究表明顺序发布可能使受监管市场被操纵，即使新模型在均衡中无人采纳，也可能改变收益分配与监管者的市场设计；这对模型发布治理与市场规制具有政策含义。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: In-Context Source and Channel Coding
papers.abstract_en: Separate Source-Channel Coding (SSCC) remains attractive for text transmission due to its modularity and compatibility with mature entropy coders and powerful channel codes. However, SSCC often suffers from a pronounced cliff effect in low Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) regimes, where residual bit errors after channel decoding can catastrophically break lossless source decoding, especially for Arithmetic Coding (AC) driven by Large Language Models (LLMs). This paper proposes a receiver-side In-Context Decoding (ICD) framework that enhances SSCC robustness without modifying the transmitter. ICD leverages an Error Correction Code Transformer (ECCT) to obtain bit-wise reliability for the decoded information bits. Based on the context-consistent bitstream, ICD constructs a confidence-ranked candidate pool via reliability-guided bit flipping, samples a compact yet diverse subset of candidates, and applies an LLM-based arithmetic decoder to obtain both reconstructions and sequence-level log-likelihoods. A reliability-likelihood fusion rule then selects the final output. We further provide theoretical guarantees on the stability and convergence of the proposed sampling procedure. Extensive experiments over Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) and Rayleigh fading channels demonstrate consistent gains compared with conventional SSCC baselines and representative Joint Source-Channel Coding (JSCC) schemes.
papers.comment: Published in SCIENCE CHINA Information Sciences
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本传输中分离式信源信道编码（SSCC）在低信噪比（SNR）下的悬崖效应，提出接收端 In-Context Decoding（ICD）框架，在不修改发射端的前提下增强稳健性。ICD 利用 Error Correction Code Transformer（ECCT）获得信息比特的比特级可靠性，基于可靠性引导的比特翻转构造置信度排序候选池，采样紧凑且多样化的子集，并使用基于 LLM 的算术解码器得到重建结果与序列级对数似然，最后通过可靠性-似然融合规则选择最终输出。论文还给出采样过程的稳定性与收敛性理论保证，并在 AWGN 与 Rayleigh 衰落信道上报告了相对传统 SSCC 基线和代表性 JSCC 方案的一致增益。
Motivation: SSCC 因模块化且兼容成熟熵编码与强信道编码而仍具吸引力，但在低 SNR 区域常出现明显悬崖效应：信道解码后的残余比特错误会灾难性破坏无损信源解码，尤其对由 LLM 驱动的算术编码（Arithmetic Coding）。
Method: 提出接收端 ICD 框架，无需修改发射端。先用 ECCT 获取解码信息比特的比特级可靠性，构建上下文一致的比特流；再通过可靠性引导的比特翻转产生候选池，从中采样紧凑但多样的子集；随后用基于 LLM 的算术解码器获得候选的重建与序列级对数似然，并以可靠性-似然融合规则选出最终输出。同时提供采样过程稳定性和收敛性的理论保证。
Result: 在 AWGN 与 Rayleigh 衰落信道上的大量实验中，该方法相比传统 SSCC 基线和代表性联合信源信道编码（JSCC）方案取得一致的性能增益。
Conclusion: 论文强调 ICD 能增强 SSCC 对低 SNR 的鲁棒性且不改变发射端，并同时具备理论上的稳定性和收敛性保证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Highly Efficient Diversity-based Input Selection for DNN Improvement Using VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Maintaining or improving the performance of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) through fine-tuning requires labeling newly collected inputs, a process that is often costly and time-consuming. To alleviate this problem, input selection approaches have been developed in recent years to identify small, yet highly informative subsets for labeling. Diversity-based selection is one of the most effective approaches for this purpose. However, they are often computationally intensive and lack scalability for large input sets, limiting their practical applicability. To address this challenge, we introduce Concept-Based Diversity (CBD), a novel and highly efficient diversity metric for image inputs that leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Our results show that CBD exhibits a strong correlation with Geometric Diversity (GD), an established diversity metric, while requiring only a fraction of its computation time. Building on this finding, we propose a hybrid input selection approach that combines CBD with Margin, a simple uncertainty metric. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation across a diverse set of DNN models, input sets, selection budgets, and six most effective state-of-the-art selection baselines. The results demonstrate that the CBD-based selection consistently outperforms all baselines at guiding input selection to improve the DNN model. Furthermore, the CBD-based selection approach remains highly efficient, requiring selection times close to those of simple uncertainty-based methods such as Margin, even on larger input sets like ImageNet. These results confirm not only the effectiveness and computational advantage of the CBD-based approach, particularly compared to hybrid baselines, but also its scalability in repetitive and extensive input selection scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出概念多样性 (Concept-Based Diversity, CBD)，一种基于视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的高效图像输入多样性度量，用于 DNN 微调前的样本选择。作者发现 CBD 与已有几何多样性 (Geometric Diversity, GD) 高度相关，但计算开销大幅降低，并将其与 Margin 不确定性度量结合成混合选择方法。实验表明 CBD 基选择在提升 DNN 性能上优于六个 SOTA 基线，且耗时接近 Margin 等简单不确定性方法，在 ImageNet 等大规模输入集上仍保持可扩展性。
Motivation: DNN 微调需要标注新采集的输入，成本高且耗时；现有多样化选择方法虽有效但计算密集、难以扩展到大输入集，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出 CBD 度量，利用 VLM 对图像输入的语义概念进行编码以衡量多样性；在此基础上结合 Margin 不确定性度量形成混合输入选择方法，并在多个 DNN 模型、输入集、选择预算和六个 SOTA 基线上进行综合评估。
Result: CBD 与 GD 强相关且所需计算时间仅为其一小部分；CBD 基选择在引导 DNN 改进方面持续优于所有基线，选择时间接近 Margin 等简单不确定性方法，即使在 ImageNet 等更大输入集上依然高效。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果确认了 CBD 基方法在有效性和计算优势上尤其优于混合基线，并证明其在重复性、大规模输入选择场景中的可扩展性。

papers.title: Backpropagation-Free Test-Time Adaptation for Lightweight EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) face significant deployment challenges due to inter-subject variability, signal non-stationarity, and computational constraints. While test-time adaptation (TTA) mitigates distribution shifts under online data streams without per-use calibration sessions, existing TTA approaches heavily rely on explicitly defined loss objectives that require backpropagation for updating model parameters, which incurs computational overhead, privacy risks, and sensitivity to noisy data streams. This paper proposes Backpropagation-Free Transformations (BFT), a TTA approach for EEG decoding that avoids these issues. BFT applies multiple sample-wise transformations, based on knowledge-guided augmentations or structured feature masking, to each test trial, producing multiple predictions for a single test sample using only forward passes. A learning-to-rank module, trained on source data, estimates the reliability of each transformed prediction, so that a weighted aggregation suppresses prediction uncertainty during online inference, with theoretical justification. Extensive experiments on five EEG datasets, covering motor imagery classification and driver drowsiness regression, demonstrate the effectiveness, versatility, robustness, and efficiency of BFT. This research enables lightweight plug-and-play BCIs on resource-constrained devices, broadening the real-world deployment of EEG-based BCIs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Backpropagation-Free Transformations (BFT)，一种面向 EEG 解码的无反向传播测试时自适应 (test-time adaptation, TTA) 方法。BFT 仅用前向传播对单个测试样本施加多种逐样本变换，并通过基于源数据训练的 learning-to-rank 模块对变换预测加权聚合，以抑制在线推理中的预测不确定性。作者在五个 EEG 数据集上验证了该方法在运动想象分类和驾驶员困倦回归任务上的有效性、鲁棒性与效率。
Motivation: EEG 脑机接口部署面临个体差异、信号非平稳性和计算资源受限等挑战。现有 TTA 方法依赖显式损失函数并通过反向传播更新模型参数，带来计算开销、隐私风险和对噪声数据流的敏感性，难以用于轻量级设备。
Method: 提出 BFT：对每个测试试验应用多种基于知识引导增强或结构化特征掩码的逐样本变换，仅用前向传播生成多个预测；利用在源数据上训练的 learning-to-rank 模块估计各变换预测的可靠性，通过加权聚合抑制不确定性，并给出理论依据。
Result: 在五个 EEG 数据集上的大量实验（涵盖运动想象分类和驾驶员困倦回归）表明 BFT 具有有效性、通用性、鲁棒性和计算效率。
Conclusion: 该研究使基于 EEG 的 BCI 可以在资源受限设备上以轻量级即插即用的方式部署，扩大其实际应用范围。

papers.title: Detector-Augmented SAMURAI for Long-Duration Drone Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Robust long-term tracking of drone is a critical requirement for modern surveillance systems, given their increasing threat potential. While detector-based approaches typically achieve strong frame-level accuracy, they often suffer from temporal inconsistencies caused by frequent detection dropouts. Despite its practical relevance, research on RGB-based drone tracking is still limited and largely reliant on conventional motion models. Meanwhile, foundation models like SAMURAI have established their effectiveness across other domains, exhibiting strong category-agnostic tracking performance. However, their applicability in drone-specific scenarios has not been investigated yet. Motivated by this gap, we present the first systematic evaluation of SAMURAI's potential for robust drone tracking in urban surveillance settings. Furthermore, we introduce a detector-augmented extension of SAMURAI to mitigate sensitivity to bounding-box initialization and sequence length. Our findings demonstrate that the proposed extension significantly improves robustness in complex urban environments, with pronounced benefits in long-duration sequences - especially under drone exit-re-entry events. The incorporation of detector cues yields consistent gains over SAMURAI's zero-shot performance across datasets and metrics, with success rate improvements of up to +0.393 and FNR reductions of up to -0.475.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision Workshops (WACVW)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统评估基础模型 SAMURAI 在城市监控场景下的无人机长时间跟踪表现，并提出检测器增强扩展 (detector-augmented extension) 以缓解其对边界框初始化与序列长度的敏感性。实验表明，该扩展在复杂城市环境与长时序列中相比 SAMURAI 零样本性能取得一致增益，成功率最高提升 +0.393，FNR 最高降低 -0.475。
Motivation: 无人机跟踪对现代监控系统至关重要，但基于检测器的方法虽有较强帧级精度，却常因检测中断产生时间不一致；同时 RGB 无人机跟踪研究有限且多依赖传统运动模型，SAMURAI 这类基础模型在无人机特定场景下的适用性尚未被研究。
Method: 对 SAMURAI 在城市监控无人机跟踪任务上进行系统评估，并提出检测器增强扩展，将检测器线索 (detector cues) 集成到跟踪流程中，以降低对边界框初始化和序列长度的敏感性。
Result: 摘要报告该扩展在复杂城市环境和长时序列中显著提升鲁棒性，尤其在无人机退出-重入 (exit-re-entry) 事件下收益明显；在所有数据集和指标上相比 SAMURAI 零样本性能一致提升，成功率最高 +0.393，FNR 最多 -0.475。
Conclusion: 作者认为检测器增强是提升基础模型在长时间无人机跟踪中鲁棒性的有效途径，尤其有利于长时序列与退出-重入场景；该评估限定于 RGB 城市场景。

papers.title: QA-Merging: Query-Adaptive Reasoning via Layer Selective Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Recent large reasoning models (LRMs) have achieved strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by generating a long chain-of-thought (Long-CoT). However, such lengthy reasoning is often unnecessary for simple queries, leading to additional computation and latency. Existing approaches to adaptive reasoning typically rely on retraining the model or designing sophisticated prompting, which are either prohibitively expensive or highly sensitive to the prompt formulation. Model merging provides a more balanced alternative for adaptive reasoning by avoiding expensive training and integrating Long-CoT and Short-CoT behaviors. However, existing merging methods are often static and input-agnostic, or rely on costly all-layer calibration, which limits their effectiveness for query-adaptive reasoning. To tackle these challenges, we propose Query-adaptive Layer Selective Merging (QA-Merging), an activation-based merging framework that integrates a Long-CoT model and a Short-CoT model to obtain a query-adaptive reasoner without training from scratch or requiring large-scale additional data. QA-Merging first constructs a small pattern-labeled calibration set that assigns each query an appropriate reasoning pattern. Motivated by our empirical analysis that Long-CoT and Short-CoT behaviors diverge unevenly across transformer layers, QA-Merging identifies layers with high reasoning pattern divergence and calibrates only these layers through feature alignment and contrastive shaping, while applying closed-form hidden-state correction to the remaining layers. Experiments on seven widely used reasoning benchmarks across two model scales demonstrate that QA-Merging reduces inference cost and maintains strong performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QA-Merging（Query-adaptive Layer Selective Merging），一种基于激活的模型合并框架，将 Long-CoT 模型与 Short-CoT 模型融合为查询自适应的推理器，无需从头训练或大规模额外数据。方法先构造带推理模式标注的小型校准集，并依据 Long-CoT 与 Short-CoT 行为在 Transformer 各层分布不均匀的实证观察，仅对高发散层做特征对齐与对比塑造校准，其余层使用闭式隐状态修正。在七个常用推理基准、两种模型规模上的实验表明，该方法能降低推理成本并保持较强性能。
Motivation: 大型推理模型（LRM）常对简单查询也生成冗长的 Long-CoT，带来额外计算和延迟；现有自适应推理方法要么依赖重训练，要么依赖对提示词敏感的复杂 prompting，代价高或稳定性差。模型合并可避免昂贵训练，但已有合并方法多为静态、与输入无关，或需要昂贵的全层校准，限制了查询自适应推理的效果。
Method: QA-Merging 首先构建一个带推理模式标签的小型校准集，为每个查询分配合适的推理模式。基于 Long-CoT 与 Short-CoT 行为在不同 Transformer 层上非均匀发散的实证分析，方法识别出高推理模式发散层，仅对这些层通过特征对齐和对比塑造（contrastive shaping）进行校准，对剩余层采用闭式隐状态修正。
Result: 在七个广泛使用的推理基准和两种模型规模上的实验显示，QA-Merging 减少了推理成本，同时保持了较强性能。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过激活驱动的层选择性合并与只校准高发散层，可以在不从头训练或依赖大规模额外数据的情况下获得查询自适应的推理模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Gradient descent reliably finds depth- and gate-optimal circuits for generic unitaries
papers.abstract_en: When the gate set has continuous parameters, synthesizing a unitary operator as a quantum circuit is, in principle, always possible using exact methods. However, efficiently finding depth- and gate-minimal circuits remains a major challenge. The landscape is very different for compiled unitaries, which arise from programming and typically have short circuits, as compared with generic unitaries, which use all parameters and typically require circuits of maximal size. Previous approaches based on random combinatorial search indicate a low success rate even when the circuit ansatz is nominally adequately parameterized, motivating the use of heavily overparameterized circuits. In this work, we present a gradient-based optimization framework that enables the synthesis of depth- and gate-optimal circuits for generic unitaries without overparameterization, even under restricted hardware connectivity. We prescribe parameter-optimal circuit skeletons and eliminate the need for random combinatorial search. We further show that the poor performance of earlier random-search approaches can be attributed to the inadvertent selection of parameter-deficient circuit topologies. By systematically avoiding such skeletons, our approach achieves reliable convergence while maintaining parameter efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于梯度的优化框架，用于在无过参数化的情况下合成通用酉矩阵（generic unitaries）的深度和门最优量子电路，并能在受限硬件连接下工作。作者指出早期随机组合搜索方法表现差的原因是无意中选择了参数不足的电路拓扑，系统避免这类骨架后即可实现可靠收敛。
Motivation: 通用酉矩阵的电路合成中，高效找到深度和门最少的电路仍是主要挑战；现有随机组合搜索即使电路 ansatz 名义上参数足够，成功率也低，因而被迫使用严重过参数化的电路。
Method: 提出梯度优化的合成框架，预先指定参数最优的电路骨架（circuit skeletons），消除随机组合搜索；通过系统规避参数不足的电路拓扑来保证收敛性与参数效率。
Result: 摘要称该方法无需过参数化即可为通用酉矩阵合成深度和门最优电路，且在受限硬件连接下也能可靠收敛。
Conclusion: 先前随机搜索方法的低性能被归因于无意中选择了参数不足的电路拓扑；避免此类骨架后可以实现可靠收敛并保持参数效率。
Relevance: 0
