papers.title: On Fibonacci Ensembles: An Alternative Approach to Ensemble Learning Inspired by the Timeless Architecture of the Golden Ratio
papers.abstract_en: Nature rarely reveals her secrets bluntly, yet in the Fibonacci sequence she grants us a glimpse of her quiet architecture of growth, harmony, and recursive stability \citep{Koshy2001Fibonacci, Livio2002GoldenRatio}. From spiral galaxies to the unfolding of leaves, this humble sequence reflects a universal grammar of balance. In this work, we introduce \emph{Fibonacci Ensembles}, a mathematically principled yet philosophically inspired framework for ensemble learning that complements and extends classical aggregation schemes such as bagging, boosting, and random forests \citep{Breiman1996Bagging, Breiman2001RandomForests, Friedman2001GBM, Zhou2012Ensemble, HastieTibshiraniFriedman2009ESL}. Two intertwined formulations unfold: (1) the use of normalized Fibonacci weights -- tempered through orthogonalization and Rao--Blackwell optimization -- to achieve systematic variance reduction among base learners, and (2) a second-order recursive ensemble dynamic that mirrors the Fibonacci flow itself, enriching representational depth beyond classical boosting. The resulting methodology is at once rigorous and poetic: a reminder that learning systems flourish when guided by the same intrinsic harmonies that shape the natural world. Through controlled one-dimensional regression experiments using both random Fourier feature ensembles \citep{RahimiRecht2007RFF} and polynomial ensembles, we exhibit regimes in which Fibonacci weighting matches or improves upon uniform averaging and interacts in a principled way with orthogonal Rao--Blackwellization. These findings suggest that Fibonacci ensembles form a natural and interpretable design point within the broader theory of ensemble learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fibonacci Ensembles，一种受斐波那契数列启发的集成学习框架，包含两种相互关联的构造：基于正交化与 Rao-Blackwell 优化调制的归一化斐波那契权重，以及模仿斐波那契流动的二阶递归集成动态。作者在一维回归实验中用随机傅里叶特征集成和多项式集成验证，发现在某些情形下斐波那契权重匹配或优于均匀平均，并与正交 Rao-Blackwell 化产生有原则的交互。
Motivation: 经典的集成方法如 bagging、boosting 和随机森林已有成熟理论，但作者希望利用斐波那契数列所体现的平衡与递归结构，提出一个既数学严谨又具哲学启发的集成学习框架，以补充和扩展传统聚合方案。
Method: 提出两种公式化构造：一是归一化斐波那契权重，通过正交化 (orthogonalization) 和 Rao-Blackwell 优化实现基学习器间的系统性方差降低；二是二阶递归集成动态，类比斐波那契数列本身的流动，以在经典 boosting 之外丰富表示深度。
Result: 在受控的一维回归实验中，使用随机傅里叶特征集成 (random Fourier feature ensembles) 和多项式集成，展示出斐波那契权重匹配或改善均匀平均的区间，并且与正交 Rao-Blackwell 化产生有原则的相互作用。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Fibonacci Ensembles 在集成学习理论中构成一个自然且可解释的设计点，兼具严谨性与启发性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: From Lab to Reality: A Practical Evaluation of Deep Learning Models and LLMs for Vulnerability Detection
papers.abstract_en: Vulnerability detection methods based on deep learning (DL) have shown strong performance on benchmark datasets, yet their real-world effectiveness remains underexplored. Recent work suggests that graph neural network-based and transformer-based models, including large language models (LLMs), yield promising results when evaluated on curated benchmark datasets. These datasets are typically characterized by similar data distributions and may contain synthetic samples, heuristic labels, or labeling noise. In this study, we systematically evaluate four representative DL models---Devign, ReVeal, LineVul, and VulBERTa---across four representative datasets: Juliet, Devign, BigVul, and ICVul. Each model is trained independently on each dataset, and the graph-based and CodeBERT representations adopted by these models are analyzed using t-SNE and centroid distance to examine vulnerability-related patterns. To assess realistic applicability, we further evaluate trained ReVeal and LineVul models, along with four open-weight LLMs, on VentiVul, our newly constructed temporally separated out-of-distribution (OOD) dataset comprising 200 recent vulnerabilities from Linux and Chromium. Our experiments reveal that current representation methods struggle to distinguish vulnerable from non-vulnerable code and that trained models generalize poorly across datasets with differing distributions and characteristics. When evaluated on VentiVul, performance drops sharply, with most models failing to detect vulnerabilities reliably or distinguish vulnerable functions from their patched counterparts. These results expose a persistent gap between academic benchmarks and real-world deployment, emphasizing the value of our deployment-oriented evaluation framework and the need for more robust code representations, higher-quality datasets, and evaluation methods that account for vulnerability-fixing changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估Devign、ReVeal、LineVul和VulBERTa四种深度学习漏洞检测模型在Juliet、Devign、BigVul、ICVul四个基准数据集上的表现，并构建时间隔离的分布外数据集VentiVul（含Linux和Chromium的200个近期漏洞）检验真实部署效果。结果显示现有表示方法难以区分易受攻击与非易受攻击代码，跨数据集泛化差，在VentiVul上性能大幅下降。
Motivation: 基于深度学习的漏洞检测在基准数据集上表现良好，但真实世界有效性很少被探索；基准数据往往分布相似且可能包含合成样本、启发式标签或标签噪声，学术基准与实际部署之间存在明显的未检验差距。
Method: 对四个模型在每个数据集上独立训练，使用t-SNE和质心距离分析图神经网络与CodeBERT表示中的漏洞相关模式；随后在新建的时间隔离OOD数据集VentiVul上评估训练好的ReVeal、LineVul以及四个开源权重LLM。
Result: 实验表明当前表示方法难以区分脆弱与非脆弱代码，训练模型在不同分布和特性的数据集间泛化差；在VentiVul上性能急剧下降，多数模型无法可靠检测漏洞或区分漏洞函数与修复后版本。
Conclusion: 结果凸显学术基准与真实世界部署之间的持久差距，强调需要更稳健的代码表示、更高质量的数据集，以及能考虑漏洞修复变化的评估方法。

papers.title: jina-vlm: Small Multilingual Vision Language Model
papers.abstract_en: We present jina-vlm, a token-efficient 2.4B parameter vision-language model that achieves state-of-the-art multilingual VQA performance among open 2B-scale VLMs. The model couples a SigLIP2 vision encoder with a Qwen3 language decoder and makes use of image tiling and attention-pooling for token-efficient processing of arbitrary-resolution images. To understand the contribution of different training data categories, we conduct a leave-one-out data mixture ablation study-systematically removing task, domain, modality, and language categories-to diagnose which data types are necessary versus redundant and whether task benefits transfer across domains. Model weights and code are publicly released at https://huggingface.co/jinaai/jina-vlm.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 1-10 main content, 11-23 references and appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 jina-vlm，一个参数规模为 2.4B 的 token 高效视觉语言模型，据称在开放 2B 级 VLM 中取得领先的多语言 VQA 表现。模型组合 SigLIP2 视觉编码器与 Qwen3 语言解码器，并采用图像平铺（image tiling）与注意力池化（attention-pooling）来高效处理任意分辨率图像。作者还通过 leave-one-out 数据混合消融实验，系统移除任务、领域、模态和语言类别，以诊断哪些数据是必要或冗余的。
Motivation: 作者旨在构建一个参数规模小、token 使用高效且具备多语言能力的视觉语言模型，并希望厘清不同训练数据类别对模型能力的贡献，从而判断任务收益能否跨领域迁移。
Method: 模型采用 SigLIP2 视觉编码器加 Qwen3 语言解码器的架构，使用图像平铺和注意力池化来降低任意分辨率图像处理的 token 开销；训练分析上采用 leave-one-out 数据混合消融，系统性地移除任务、领域、模态和语言类别进行对照。
Result: 摘要报告 jina-vlm 在开放 2B 规模 VLM 中达到领先的多语言 VQA 性能，并具有 token 高效的特性。
Conclusion: 作者公开了模型权重与代码，并强调数据混合消融实验对理解各训练数据类别必要性及冗余性的诊断价值。

papers.title: HTTM: Head-wise Temporal Token Merging for Faster VGGT
papers.abstract_en: The Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) marks a significant leap forward in 3D scene reconstruction, as it is the first model that directly infers all key 3D attributes (camera poses, depths, and dense geometry) jointly in one pass. However, this joint inference mechanism requires global attention layers that perform all-to-all attention computation on tokens from all views. For reconstruction of large scenes with long-sequence inputs, this causes a significant latency bottleneck. In this paper, we propose head-wise temporal merging (HTTM), a training-free 3D token merging method for accelerating VGGT. Existing merging techniques merge tokens uniformly across different attention heads, resulting in identical tokens in the layers' output, which hinders the model's representational ability. HTTM tackles this problem by merging tokens in multi-head granularity, which preserves the uniqueness of feature tokens after head concatenation. Additionally, this enables HTTM to leverage the spatial locality and temporal correspondence observed at the head level to achieve higher merging ratios with lower merging costs compared to existing methods. Thus, HTTM achieves up to $7\times$ acceleration over the original VGGT with negligible performance drops in a GPU-based inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 head-wise temporal token merging（HTTM），一种无需训练的 3D token 合并方法，用于加速 Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer（VGGT）。VGGT 是首个单次前向联合推断相机位姿、深度和稠密几何的 3D 重建模型，但其全局注意力需要跨所有视图的 token 做全对全计算，在长序列大场景输入下形成严重延迟瓶颈。HTTM 在多头粒度上合并 token，保留注意力头拼接后特征 token 的独特性，并利用头层面的空间局部性与时间对应性实现更高的合并比率和更低的合并成本。在 GPU 推理上，相对原始 VGGT 最高可实现 7 倍加速，性能下降可忽略。
Motivation: VGGT 的联合 3D 推理机制依赖跨所有视图 token 的全局注意力，使得长序列大场景重建的延迟成为显著瓶颈；现有 token 合并方法在各注意力头间均匀合并，导致层输出中的 token 趋同，损害模型表示能力。
Method: 提出 HTTM，一种训练无关（training-free）的 3D token 合并方法，在多头粒度（head-wise）执行 token 合并，以在头拼接后保留特征 token 的独特性；同时利用头层面观察到的空间局部性与时间对应性，比现有方法实现更高合并比率并降低合并成本。
Result: 在 GPU 推理中，HTTM 相对原始 VGGT 达到最高 7 倍加速，且性能下降可忽略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，多头粒度的 token 合并既能避免均匀合并对表示能力的损害，又能利用头级时空对应性提升 VGGT 的推理效率，是一种有效的无训练加速方案。

papers.title: UrbanWorld2.0: A Multimodal Agentic Framework for Reality-Aligned 3D World Generation at City-Scale
papers.abstract_en: The automated generation of high-fidelity, city-scale 3D environments remains a formidable challenge with profound academic and industrial implications. However, existing methods struggle to achieve the necessary quality, fidelity, and scalability. To address this, we propose \textsc{UrbanWorld2.0}, a reality-aligned intelligent multimodal synthesis engine that creates detailed, city-scale 3D worlds of high fidelity. We introduce an agentic framework that leverages diverse multimodal foundation tools to acquire real-world knowledge, maintain robust intermediate representations, and construct complex 3D scenes.This agentic design, featuring dynamic data processing, iterative self-reflection and refinement, and the invocation of advanced multimodal tools, minimizes cumulative errors and enhances overall performance. Extensive quantitative experiments and qualitative analyzes validate the superior performance of \textsc{UrbanWorld2.0} in real-world alignment, shape precision, texture fidelity, and aesthetics level, achieving a win rate of over 86\% against existing baselines for overall perceptual quality. This combination of 3D quality, reality alignment, scalability, and seamless compatibility with computer graphics pipelines makes \textsc{UrbanWorld2.0} a promising foundation for applications in immersive media, embodied intelligence, and world models.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACM MM 2026, the code is available at: https://github.com/tsinghua-fib-lab/UrbanWorld2.0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UrbanWorld2.0，一个面向城市尺度、与现实对齐的高保真 3D 世界生成的多模态智能体框架。该框架利用多种多模态基础工具获取真实世界知识，维护稳健的中间表示，并通过动态数据处理、迭代自省与精炼来构建复杂 3D 场景，以减少累积误差。定量与定性实验表明其在真实世界对齐、形状精度、纹理保真度和美学水平上优于现有基线，整体感知质量胜率超过 86%。
Motivation: 自动生成高保真、城市尺度的 3D 环境仍具挑战，现有方法在质量、保真度和可扩展性上难以满足要求，这限制了其在沉浸式媒体、具身智能和世界模型等应用中的潜力。
Method: 提出 UrbanWorld2.0，一种多模态智能体框架，通过动态数据处理、迭代自省与精炼，以及调用先进多模态工具来获取真实世界知识并构建复杂 3D 城市场景，同时维护稳健的中间表示以最小化累积误差。
Result: 摘要报告 UrbanWorld2.0 在真实世界对齐、形状精度、纹理保真度和美学水平上表现更优，针对现有基线的整体感知质量胜率超过 86%，且与计算机图形学流水线兼容。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架在 3D 质量、现实对齐、可扩展性以及与图形管线的兼容性方面的结合，使其成为沉浸式媒体、具身智能和世界模型等应用的潜在基础。

papers.title: Budget-Aware Tool Use Enables Effective Agent Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Scaling test-time computation has been extended from language model reasoning to tool-augmented agents, where scaling involves not only thinking in tokens but also acting via tool calls that directly constrain environmental interaction. However, we found that simply increasing the tool-call budget fails to improve performance, as agents lack "budget awareness" and quickly hit a performance ceiling. We study how to scale such agents effectively under explicit tool-call budgets, focusing on web search agents. We first introduce the Budget Tracker, a lightweight plug-in that provides the agent with continuous budget awareness, enabling simple yet effective scaling. We further develop BATS (Budget-Aware Test-time Scaling), an advanced framework that leverages this awareness to dynamically adapt its planning and verification strategy. To analyze cost-performance scaling in a controlled manner, we formalize a unified cost metric that jointly accounts for token and tool consumption. We provide the first systematic study on budget-constrained agents, showing that budget-aware methods produce more favorable scaling curves and push the cost-performance Pareto frontier. Our work offers empirical insights toward a more transparent and principled understanding of scaling in tool-augmented agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/google-research/budget-aware-agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究工具增强智能体（tool-augmented agents）在显式工具调用预算下的测试时扩展问题，聚焦网络搜索智能体。作者发现简单增加工具调用预算无法提升性能，提出 Budget Tracker 轻量插件以提供持续预算感知，并进一步开发 BATS（Budget-Aware Test-time Scaling）框架动态调整规划与验证策略。文章还形式化统一成本度量，同时计入 token 与工具消耗，并给出预算约束下智能体扩展的首个系统研究。
Motivation: 测试时计算的扩展已从语言模型推理延伸到工具调用，但智能体缺乏“预算意识”，增加工具调用预算会迅速触及性能天花板，因此需要研究在显式工具调用预算下如何有效扩展智能体。
Method: 提出 Budget Tracker，一种轻量即插即用组件，为智能体提供持续的预算感知；在此之上构建 BATS 框架，利用预算感知动态调整规划与验证策略。同时形式化统一成本度量，联合计算 token 与工具消耗，用于受控地分析成本-性能扩展。
Result: 摘要报告预算感知方法能产生更有利的扩展曲线（scaling curves），并推动成本-性能帕累托前沿（Pareto frontier）；这是对预算约束智能体扩展的首次系统性研究。
Conclusion: 工作为工具增强智能体的扩展提供了更透明且基于原则的实证理解，并已开源代码。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PickStyle: Video-to-Video Style Transfer with Context-Style Adapters
papers.abstract_en: We address the task of video style transfer with diffusion models, where the goal is to preserve the context of an input video while rendering it in a target style specified by a text prompt. A major challenge is the lack of paired video data for supervision. We propose PickStyle, a video-to-video style transfer framework that augments pretrained video diffusion backbones with style adapters and benefits from paired still image data with source-style correspondences for training. PickStyle inserts low-rank adapters into the self-attention layers of conditioning modules, enabling efficient specialization for motion-style transfer while maintaining strong alignment between video content and style. To bridge the gap between static image supervision and dynamic video, we construct synthetic training clips from paired images by applying shared augmentations that simulate camera motion, ensuring temporal priors are preserved. In addition, we introduce Context-Style Classifier-Free Guidance (CS-CFG), a novel factorization of classifier-free guidance into independent text (style) and video (context) directions. CS-CFG ensures that context is preserved in generated video while the style is effectively transferred. Experiments across benchmarks show that our approach achieves temporally coherent, style-faithful, and content-preserving video translations, outperforming existing baselines both qualitatively and quantitatively.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PickStyle，一个基于扩散模型的视频到视频风格迁移框架。它向预训练视频扩散主干的条件模块自注意力层插入低秩适配器 (low-rank adapters)，并利用带源风格对应关系的静态配对图像训练，以缓解视频配对数据缺乏的问题。为弥合静态监督与动态视频的差距，作者从配对图像构造模拟相机运动的合成视频片段；还提出 Context-Style Classifier-Free Guidance (CS-CFG)，将无分类器引导分解为独立的文本（风格）和视频（上下文）方向。实验显示该方法在时间一致性、风格保真度和内容保持上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 视频风格迁移缺少成对的视频监督数据，是训练扩散模型的主要障碍。需要一种只用配对静态图像监督、同时保持视频时序上下文与风格对齐的方法。
Method: 在预训练视频扩散主干的条件模块自注意力层中插入低秩适配器，实现运动-风格迁移的高效特化；从配对图像通过共享增强模拟相机运动构造合成训练片段以保留时序先验；提出 CS-CFG，把 classifier-free guidance 分解为独立的文本（风格）和视频（上下文）两个方向，在迁移风格的同时保持上下文。
Result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，该方法能生成时间上连贯、风格忠实且内容保持的视频翻译，并在定性与定量比较中超过现有基线。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将低秩风格适配器与 CS-CFG 结合，可以在没有配对视频监督的情况下实现有效的视频风格迁移，同时保持内容与风格的强对齐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OpenGPT-4o-Image: A Comprehensive Dataset for Advanced Image Generation and Editing
papers.abstract_en: The performance of unified multimodal models for image generation and editing is fundamentally constrained by the quality and comprehensiveness of their training data. While existing datasets have covered basic tasks like style transfer and simple object manipulation, they often lack the systematic structure and challenging scenarios required for real-world applications. To address this bottleneck, we introduce OpenGPT-4o-Image, a large-scale dataset constructed using a novel methodology that combines hierarchical task taxonomy with automated data generation. Our taxonomy not only includes fundamental capabilities such as text rendering and style control but also introduces highly practical yet challenging categories like scientific imagery for chemistry illustrations and complex instruction editing requiring simultaneous execution of multiple operations. Through an automated pipeline leveraging structured resource pools and GPT-4o, we generate 80k high-quality instruction-image pairs with controlled diversity, covering 11 major domains and 51 subtasks. Extensive experiments show that fine-tuning leading models on our dataset achieves significant performance gains across multiple benchmarks, with improvements of up to 18\% on editing tasks (UniWorld-V1 on ImgEdit-Bench) and 13% on generation tasks (Harmon on GenEval). Our work demonstrates that systematic data construction is key to advancing multimodal AI capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenGPT-4o-Image，一个面向统一多模态图像生成与编辑训练的大规模数据集，采用分层任务分类法（hierarchical task taxonomy）与自动化数据生成管道构建，覆盖 11 个主要领域和 51 个子任务，共 80k 条高质量指令-图像对。摘要报告在多个基准上微调领先模型后获得显著性能提升，其中编辑任务最高提升 18%（UniWorld-V1 在 ImgEdit-Bench），生成任务提升 13%（Harmon 在 GenEval）。
Motivation: 统一多模态模型的图像生成与编辑能力受限于训练数据的质量和全面性；现有数据集多覆盖风格迁移、简单物体操作等基础任务，缺乏系统结构以及真实应用所需的挑战性场景。
Method: 提出将分层任务分类法与自动化数据生成相结合的数据构建方法；分类法既包含文本渲染、风格控制等基础能力，也引入化学插图等科学图像以及需要同时执行多个操作的复杂指令编辑；通过基于结构化资源池和 GPT-4o 的自动管道生成 80k 张具有受控多样性的指令-图像对。
Result: 摘要报告在多个基准上取得显著性能提升：编辑任务上 UniWorld-V1 在 ImgEdit-Bench 上的提升最高达 18%，生成任务上 Harmon 在 GenEval 上的提升为 13%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调系统性数据构建是推进多模态 AI 能力的关键，并指出所提出的任务分类法与自动生成管道能够提供真实应用所需的系统结构和挑战性场景。

papers.title: Sleeping Kelly
papers.abstract_en: The Sleeping Beauty problem is a problem of imperfect recall that has received considerable attention. One approach to solving the Sleeping Beauty problem is to allow Sleeping Beauty to make decisions based on her beliefs, and then characterize what it takes for her decisions to be "rational". In particular, she can be allowed to make monetary bets based on her beliefs, with the assumption that she wants to gain wealth rather than lose it. However, this approach is often coupled with the erroneous assumption that Sleeping Beauty should maximize the expected value of her bets. Here, we infer probabilities when Sleeping Beauty maximizes the expected growth rate of her wealth using the Kelly Criterion, to show that Sleeping Kelly is an ex ante Halfer and de se Thirder and impervious diachronic Dutch Books.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究睡美人问题（Sleeping Beauty problem）这一不完美记忆问题，指出此前基于决策论的做法常错误地假设睡美人应最大化赌注的期望值。作者转而假设她使用凯利准则（Kelly Criterion）最大化财富的期望增长率，由此推断概率，并证明这种“Sleeping Kelly”在事前意义上是 Halfer、在 de se 意义上是 Thirder，并且不受历时荷兰赌（diachronic Dutch Book）的影响。
Motivation: 决策论方法允许睡美人基于信念下注，但通常附加了“应最大化赌注期望值”这一错误假设，需要更合理的理性准则来刻画她的选择。
Method: 放弃期望值最大化，转而假设睡美人以凯利准则最大化财富期望增长率，并基于该目标反推她应持有的概率信念。
Result: 摘要表明，凯利准则下的 Sleeping Kelly 在事前（ex ante）是 Halfer，在自我定位（de se）意义上是 Thirder，并且对历时荷兰赌免疫。
Conclusion: 摘要强调期望值最大化假设是导致睡美人问题结论混乱的原因之一，改用凯利准则能给出不同于标准决策论的概率推断结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CSMoE: An Efficient Remote Sensing Foundation Model with Soft Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) through masked autoencoders (MAEs) has recently attracted great attention for remote sensing (RS) foundation model (FM) development, enabling improved representation learning across diverse sensors and downstream tasks. However, existing RS FMs often either suffer from substantial computational complexity during both training and inference or exhibit limited representational capacity. In addition, their pretraining datasets can contain redundant images, which increases training cost without improving the learned representations. These issues restrict their practical applicability in RS. To address these limitations, we improve the computational efficiency of RS FMs along two axes: i) model efficiency; and ii) training-data efficiency. Model efficiency is achieved by integrating the Soft mixture-of-experts (MoE) mechanism into the FM, which allows modality-specific expert processing alongside shared cross-sensor representation learning while reducing computational complexity at both training and inference time. We apply this adaptation to the Cross-Sensor Masked Autoencoder (CSMAE) model, which serves as our main baseline, resulting in the Cross-Sensor Mixture-of-Experts (CSMoE) model. Training-data efficiency is achieved by a thematic-climatic descriptor-driven sampling strategy, which constructs a reduced training set from a large-scale image archive while retaining its geographic and thematic-climatic diversity, and thus reduces pretraining cost. Extensive experiments on scene classification, semantic segmentation, and content-based image retrieval (CBIR) show that CSMoE remains competitive with state-of-the-art RS FMs while requiring substantially fewer floating-point operations (FLOPs). The associated code for the model and the training set creation, as well as the pretrained model weights, will be available at https://git.tu-berlin.de/rsim/csmoe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种高效的遥感基础模型 CSMoE，在 Cross-Sensor Masked Autoencoder (CSMAE) 的基础上引入 Soft mixture-of-experts (MoE) 机制，以降低训练和推理时的计算复杂度并保留跨传感器表示学习能力。同时设计了一个基于主题-气候描述符的采样策略，从大规模影像档案中构建较小的预训练集，在保持地理与主题-气候多样性的同时降低预训练成本。实验表明 CSMoE 在场景分类、语义分割和基于内容的图像检索 (CBIR) 上能与现有 SOTA 遥感基础模型保持竞争力，同时所需浮点运算量 (FLOPs) 显著更少。
Motivation: 现有遥感基础模型要么训练和推理计算复杂度高，要么表示容量有限；此外预训练数据常含冗余图像，增加训练成本却不改善表示。这些问题限制了遥感基础模型的实际可用性。
Method: 从模型效率和训练数据效率两个方向改进：将 Soft MoE 机制集成到 CSMAE 基线中形成 CSMoE，实现模态特定专家处理与共享跨传感器表示学习的结合；并用主题-气候描述符驱动的采样策略从大规模影像档案构造缩减训练集，保留地理与主题-气候多样性。
Result: 在场景分类、语义分割和 CBIR 等下游任务上的大量实验表明，CSMoE 与现有 SOTA 遥感基础模型竞争力相当，同时大幅减少 FLOPs。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过 Soft MoE 与数据采样策略可同时提升遥感基础模型的模型效率和训练数据效率；相关代码、训练集构建流程及预训练权重将公开。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Geometrically Constrained and Token-Based Probabilistic Spatial Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Spatial transformations such as rotation and scale obscure the morphological cues needed for accurate image classification. Careful consideration is required for reliable use in high stakes settings. A model should stay robust under such transformations, expose why a correction was applied, and signal when its input is ambiguous. While geometrically equivariant architectures provide a mathematically grounded solution, they often limit model flexibility through strict symmetry constraints and incur significant computational overhead. Spatial Transformer Networks (STNs) offer a data-driven, flexible alternative for learning pseudo-equivariances to affine transformations. However, STNs have historically been restricted to convolutional architectures and suffer from training instability. To address this, we introduce a novel STN framework. It leverages the global modeling capabilities of transformers to regress the affine transformation acting on the input. For this, we decompose affine transformations into interpretable primitives, regressed under adaptable geometric constraints, thereby preventing the training instability typically caused by degenerate transformations. By sharing weights between the localization network and the classification backbone, the framework requires minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on challenging insect biodiversity and medical imaging benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves superior predictive performance under diverse spatial transformations while maintaining high efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/johSchm/TokenSTN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Transformer 的几何约束概率空间变换网络（spatial transformer network，STN），用于在仿射变换下保持图像分类的鲁棒性并提供可解释的校正。该方法将仿射变换分解为可解释的基元，在可适应的几何约束下回归，并通过与分类骨干共享权重降低计算开销。在昆虫生物多样性和医学影像基准上的实验表明，该方法在多种空间变换下取得较好的预测性能与高效率。
Motivation: 空间变换（如旋转、缩放）会破坏图像形态线索，给高风险场景下的分类带来挑战；现有等变架构受严格对称约束且计算开销大，而传统 STN 局限于卷积架构并存在训练不稳定问题。
Method: 提出一种新的 STN 框架：利用 Transformer 的全局建模能力回归作用于输入的仿射变换，将仿射变换分解为可解释基元并在可适应的几何约束下回归，以避免退化变换导致的训练不稳定；定位网络与分类骨干共享权重以最小化额外开销。
Result: 在昆虫生物多样性数据集和医学影像基准上的广泛实验表明，该方法在多种空间变换下取得优于对比方法的预测性能，同时保持高计算效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调几何约束与 token 级全局建模的结合可提升 STN 的稳定性与灵活性，并为空间变换提供可解释的校正机制；代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Focusing by Contrastive Attention: Enhancing VLMs' Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success across diverse visual tasks, yet their performance degrades in complex visual environments. While existing enhancement approaches require additional training, rely on external segmentation tools, or operate at coarse-grained levels, they overlook the innate ability within VLMs. To bridge this gap, we investigate VLMs' attention patterns and discover that: (1) visual complexity strongly correlates with attention entropy, negatively impacting reasoning performance; (2) attention progressively refines from global scanning in shallow layers to focused convergence in deeper layers, with convergence degree determined by visual complexity. (3) Theoretically, we prove that the contrast of attention maps between general queries and task-specific queries enables the decomposition of visual signal into semantic signals and visual noise components. Building on these insights, we propose Contrastive Attention Refinement for Visual Enhancement (CARVE), a training-free method that extracts task-relevant visual signals through attention contrasting at the pixel level. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CARVE consistently enhances performance, achieving up to 75% improvement on open-source models. Our work provides critical insights into the interplay between visual complexity and attention mechanisms, offering an efficient pathway for improving visual reasoning with contrasting attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在复杂视觉环境中的推理退化问题，通过分析注意力模式发现视觉复杂度与注意力熵强相关，且注意力从浅层全局扫描向深层聚焦收敛。作者从理论上证明通用查询与任务特定查询的注意力图对比可将视觉信号分解为语义信号与视觉噪声，并提出无需训练的像素级对比注意力细化方法 CARVE（Contrastive Attention Refinement for Visual Enhancement）。实验表明 CARVE 能持续提升开放源码模型性能，最高提升 75%。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 增强方法要么需要额外训练、要么依赖外部分割工具、要么只在粗粒度层面操作，忽视了 VLM 自身已有的注意力能力；在复杂视觉环境下这些方法难以高效改善推理性能。
Method: 提出 CARVE，一种无需训练、在像素级别通过对比通用查询与任务特定查询的注意力图来提取任务相关视觉信号的方法，并给出注意力图对比可将视觉信号分解为语义成分与视觉噪声的理论证明。
Result: 大量实验表明 CARVE 能一致提升 VLM 的视觉推理性能，在开放源码模型上最高取得 75% 的提升。
Conclusion: 工作揭示了视觉复杂度与注意力机制之间的关联，并验证了对比注意力可作为提升视觉推理的高效路径；摘要未提及方法在闭源模型或更多任务上的局限性。

papers.title: Encoding of musical structures in hidden units of restricted Boltzmann machines
papers.abstract_en: Restricted Boltzmann machines (RBMs) are energy-based models originating from statistical physics, in which hidden units mediate the probability distribution of high-dimensional visible configurations. In this study, we use symbolic music as a structured non-physical dataset and investigate how musical regularities are encoded in the hidden layer of a Bernoulli-Bernoulli RBM. Musical scores by J.~S.~Bach are converted into binary piano-roll representations and used to train the model in an unsupervised manner. We then analyze the visible-layer patterns induced by individual hidden units by activating hidden units separately and computing the corresponding expected visible configurations. The trained RBM reconstructs piano-roll-like inputs and assigns lower energies to piano-roll configurations than to most non-musical binary images, indicating that the learned energy function captures statistical features of the piano-roll dataset. The hidden units mainly encode local temporal and pitch-statistical structures, such as sparse piano-roll-like textures, rather than directly separable musical concepts such as melodies, chords, or keys. We also analyze hidden-layer representations using t-SNE and find that transposed versions of the same musical pieces are not necessarily mapped to nearby regions in the hidden space. This behavior indicates that the trained RBM does not robustly capture transposition equivalence, which is naturally explained by the lack of translational invariance in standard RBM architectures. Samples from the trained RBM show local pitch organization, whereas iterative continuation reveals limited long-range coherence. These results provide a statistical-physics case study of how a simple spin model represents structured creative data and clarify both the usefulness and limitations of standard RBMs as interpretable models of musical structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以巴赫乐谱转换成的二进制钢琴卷 (piano-roll) 作为结构化数据集，用伯努利-伯努利受限玻尔兹曼机 (Bernoulli-Bernoulli RBM) 进行无监督训练，并分析隐藏单元如何编码音乐规律。结果发现隐藏单元主要编码稀疏钢琴卷样的局部时间与音高统计结构，而非旋律、和弦或调性等可直接分离的音乐概念；t-SNE 分析显示移调版本的同一乐曲不必然映射到隐藏空间的邻近区域，表明训练得到的 RBM 未稳健捕捉移调等价性。采样结果显示局部音高组织存在，但迭代续写缺乏长程连贯性。
Motivation: 作者希望从统计物理视角考察一个简单自旋模型如何表示结构化的创意数据，并厘清标准 RBM 作为可解释音乐结构模型的用处与局限。
Method: 将 J. S. Bach 的乐谱转换为二进制钢琴卷表示，以无监督方式训练 Bernoulli-Bernoulli RBM；随后单独激活各隐藏单元并计算对应的期望可见配置来观察诱导模式，并使用 t-SNE 分析隐藏层表示。
Result: 训练后的 RBM 能重构类钢琴卷输入，并对钢琴卷配置赋予比大多数非音乐二元图像更低的能量；隐藏单元主要编码局部时间与音高统计特征而非直接可分的音乐概念；t-SNE 显示移调版本不一定在隐藏空间中邻近，样本具有局部音高组织但长程连贯性有限。
Conclusion: 作者总结，标准 RBM 因缺乏平移不变性而无法稳健表征移调等价性，同时对音乐结构的可解释建模既有价值也有明显局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Efficient Code Embeddings from Code Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: jina-code-embeddings is a novel code embedding model suite designed to retrieve code from natural language queries, perform technical question-answering, and identify semantically similar code snippets across programming languages. It makes innovative use of an autoregressive backbone pre-trained on both text and code, generating embeddings via last-token pooling. We outline the training recipe and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance despite the relatively small size of the models, validating this approach to code embedding model construction.
papers.comment: 9 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Deep Learning for Code (DL4CODE)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: jina-code-embeddings 是一套新的代码嵌入模型套件，面向自然语言查询检索代码、技术问答以及跨编程语言的语义相似代码识别。该工作使用同时以文本和代码预训练的自回归骨干，并通过最后 token 池化 (last-token pooling) 生成嵌入，文章概述了训练配方；摘要声称在模型规模相对较小的情况下仍取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 本文的目标是为代码检索、技术问答和跨语言相似代码识别提供高效的嵌入模型，并验证从代码生成模型构建嵌入表示这一路径的可行性。
Method: 提出 jina-code-embeddings 模型套件，采用在文本和代码上预训练的自回归骨干，以最后 token 池化方式生成嵌入，并给出相应的训练配方 (training recipe)。
Result: 摘要报告该模型套件在规模相对较小的情况下仍达到 state-of-the-art 性能，但未给出具体数据集或量化数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为这一结果验证了利用预训练自回归代码生成模型构建代码嵌入模型的有效性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: PEER: Unified Process-Outcome Reinforcement Learning for Structured Empathetic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Emotional support conversations require more than fluent responses. Supporters need to understand the seeker's situation and emotions, adopt an appropriate strategy, and respond in a natural, human-like manner. Despite advances in large language models, current systems often lack structured, psychology-informed reasoning. Additionally, it is challenging to enhance these systems through reinforcement learning because of unreliable reward signals. Moreover, reinforcement fine-tuning can amplify repetitive response patterns. We propose structured empathetic reasoning, which breaks support into three steps: conversation history analysis, multimodal emotional state inference, and strategy selection, prior to generating the final reply. To implement this, we introduce SER, a fine-grained dataset with step-level correctness labels and pairwise response preferences. We then present PEER, which uses GRPO with UnifiReward, a unified process-outcome reward model for evaluating both reasoning steps and final responses in multi-turn interactions. To reduce repetition, we enhance data with personality-based rewriting and down-weight redundant outputs. Comprehensive experiments show improved empathy, strategy alignment, and human-likeness without sacrificing diversity. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Yunxiao-Wang/PEER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对情感支持对话提出结构化共情推理 (structured empathetic reasoning)，将支持过程拆解为对话历史分析、多模态情绪状态推断与策略选择三步，再生成最终回复。作者构建了带步骤级正确性标签和成对回复偏好的 SER 数据集，并提出 PEER 框架，采用 GRPO 与统一过程-结果奖励模型 UnifiReward 对多轮交互中的推理步骤和最终回复进行强化学习。摘要报告该方法在共情性、策略对齐和人性化程度上有提升，且不牺牲回复多样性。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型在情感支持对话中缺乏结构化、基于心理学的推理；同时强化学习因奖励信号不可靠而难以应用，且强化微调容易放大重复回复模式。
Method: 提出三步式结构化共情推理流程，并引入 SER 细粒度数据集（含步骤级正确性标签与成对回复偏好）；在此基础上提出 PEER，使用 GRPO 和统一的奖励模型 UnifiReward 同时评估多轮对话中的推理步骤与最终回复，并通过基于人格的改写与降权冗余输出减少重复。
Result: 综合实验表明，该方法提升了共情性、策略对齐度和回复人性化程度，同时保持了回复多样性；摘要未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调结构化推理步骤与统一过程-结果奖励信号相结合可以改善情感支持对话的质量，并公开了代码和数据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SMA: Who Said That? Auditing Membership Leakage in Semi-Black-box RAG Controlling
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and its Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) significantly improve the knowledge coverage and contextual understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) by introducing external knowledge sources. However, retrieval and multimodal fusion obscure content provenance, rendering existing membership inference methods unable to reliably attribute generated outputs to pre-training, external retrieval, or user input, thus undermining privacy leakage accountability To address these challenges, we propose the first Source-aware Membership Audit (SMA) that enables fine-grained source attribution of generated content in a semi-black-box setting with retrieval control capabilities. To address the environmental constraints of semi-black-box auditing, we further design an attribution estimation mechanism based on zero-order optimization, which robustly approximates the true influence of input tokens on the output through large-scale perturbation sampling and ridge regression modeling. In addition, SMA introduces a cross-modal attribution technique that projects image inputs into textual descriptions via MLLMs, enabling token-level attribution in the text modality, which for the first time facilitates membership inference on image retrieval traces in MRAG systems. This work shifts the focus of membership inference from 'whether the data has been memorized' to 'where the content is sourced from', offering a novel perspective for auditing data provenance in complex generative systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个源感知成员审计 (Source-aware Membership Audit, SMA)，面向具备检索控制能力的半黑盒 RAG 系统，对生成内容进行细粒度来源归因，区分输出来自预训练、外部检索还是用户输入。方法基于零阶优化 (zero-order optimization) 的归因估计，并引入跨模态归因将图像输入通过 MLLM 投影为文本描述，首次支持 MRAG 系统中图像检索痕迹的成员推断。
Motivation: 检索与多模态融合掩盖了内容来源，导致现有成员推断方法无法可靠地将生成输出归因到预训练、外部检索或用户输入，从而削弱隐私泄露问责能力。
Method: SMA 在半黑盒设置下利用检索控制能力，设计基于零阶优化的归因估计机制，通过大规模扰动采样和岭回归 (ridge regression) 建模来近似输入 token 对输出的真实影响；同时使用 MLLM 将图像输入转换为文本描述，从而在文本模态实现 token 级归因。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能实现生成内容的细粒度来源归因，并首次在 MRAG 系统中支持对图像检索痕迹的成员推断；摘要未给出定量实验数据。
Conclusion: 该工作将成员推断的关注点从“数据是否被记忆”转向“内容来自哪里”，为复杂生成系统中的数据来源审计提供了新视角。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning Multi-Timescale Interventions under Safety and Resource Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Many sequential decision problems offer qualitatively different ways of influencing the environment: some interventions act immediately, whereas others induce persistent effects that continue to shape future states long after the decision that initiated them. An agent must then decide jointly when to intervene, which temporal mode to use and how strongly, while accounting for residual effects and limited intervention resources. We introduce MINT: Multi-timescale Intervention Network Training. Persistent effects are carried by an augmented intervention state that accumulates and decays, while a structured policy separates intervention-mode selection from conditional control. Unlike temporal abstractions that extend policy execution, persistent-effect interventions remain part of the environment dynamics and may overlap with later interventions. We show that the augmented state is a sufficient statistic for the intervention history, preserving the Markov property, and establish Bellman contraction and almost-sure convergence of a tabular Q-learning instance. Across persistent-control MuJoCo locomotion, stochastic inventory management, and a physiologically grounded Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (T1DM) simulator, MINT attains the best mean primary metric on two of three benchmarks while using fewer intervention activations than an identically augmented flat policy. Its return advantage is present at every binding intervention budget and narrows to parity in the unconstrained reference setting. In T1DM it achieves $90.9\pm0.9\%$ time in range with zero time below range, improving on the strongest baseline by $21.5\%$ points. Code, benchmarks and the configuration for every reported run are available at https://github.com/heywanrong/mint-rl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MINT（Multi-timescale Intervention Network Training），一种用于多时间尺度干预的强化学习方法。其核心是用一个累积并衰减的增强干预状态来携带干预的持续效应，并把干预模式选择与条件控制用结构化策略分离。作者证明该增强状态是干预历史的充分统计量、保持 Markov 性质，并给出表格型 Q-learning 的 Bellman 收缩与几乎必然收敛结果。在持续控制的 MuJoCo 运动、随机库存管理和 Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (T1DM) 模拟器上，MINT 在三个基准中的两个上取得最佳平均主指标，且使用的干预激活少于同增强的扁平策略。
Motivation: 许多顺序决策问题中，不同干预的作用时间尺度不同：有些立即生效，有些会产生长期持续影响，并可能叠加到后续干预上。智能体需要同时决定何时干预、采用哪种时间模式以及干预强度，同时考虑残余效应和有限的干预资源，现有方法对此缺乏系统处理。
Method: MINT 通过引入一个随时间累积和衰减的增强干预状态来承载持久效应，并使用一种结构化策略将干预模式选择（何时采用何种时间尺度）与条件控制分离。与延拓策略执行时长的时序抽象不同，持久效应干预保留在环境动态中并允许与后续干预重叠。作者证明该增强状态是干预历史的充分统计量，维持了 Markov 性质，并为一种表格型 Q-learning 实例建立了 Bellman 收缩和几乎必然收敛。
Result: 在持续控制 MuJoCo 运动、随机库存管理和生理学基础的 T1DM 模拟器上，MINT 在三个基准中的两个取得最佳平均主指标，并且比同增强的扁平策略使用更少的干预激活。其回报优势在每个受限干预预算下都存在，并在无约束参考设定下缩小至持平；在 T1DM 中达到 90.9±0.9% 的时间在范围内（time in range）且零时间低于范围，较最强基线提升 21.5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过增强干预状态建模持久效应能够保持 Markov 性质，并在资源约束下实现更优的干预效率与性能，模拟器上的结果展示了其在连续控制、库存管理和医疗等实际场景中的潜力。

papers.title: RingMo-Agent: A Unified Remote Sensing Foundation Model for Multi-Platform and Multi-Modal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing (RS) images from multiple modalities and platforms exhibit diverse details due to differences in sensor characteristics and imaging perspectives. Existing vision-language research in RS largely relies on relatively homogeneous data sources. Moreover, they still remain limited to conventional visual perception tasks such as classification or captioning. As a result, these methods fail to serve as a unified and standalone framework capable of effectively handling RS imagery from diverse sources in real-world applications. To address these issues, we propose RingMo-Agent, a model designed to handle multi-modal and multi-platform data that performs perception and reasoning tasks based on user textual instructions. Compared with existing models, RingMo-Agent 1) is supported by a large-scale vision-language dataset named RS-VL3M, comprising over 3 million image-text pairs, spanning optical, SAR, and infrared (IR) modalities collected from both satellite and UAV platforms, covering perception and challenging reasoning tasks; 2) learns modality adaptive representations by incorporating separated embedding layers to construct isolated features for heterogeneous modalities and reduce cross-modal interference; 3) unifies task modeling by introducing task-specific tokens and employing a token-based high-dimensional hidden state decoding mechanism designed for long-horizon spatial tasks. Extensive experiments on various RS vision-language tasks demonstrate that RingMo-Agent not only proves effective in both visual understanding and sophisticated analytical tasks, but also exhibits strong generalizability across different platforms and sensing modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RingMo-Agent，一个面向遥感（RS）多平台、多模态数据的统一视觉-语言基础模型，可依据用户文本指令执行感知与推理任务。支撑该模型的是包含超过 300 万图像-文本对的 RS-VL3M 数据集，覆盖光学、SAR 与红外模态以及卫星和无人机平台。模型通过分离嵌入层缓解跨模态干扰，并采用任务特定 token 与基于 token 的高维隐藏状态解码机制统一任务建模。实验表明其在多种遥感视觉-语言任务上有效且具备跨平台、跨模态泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有遥感视觉-语言研究大多依赖相对同质的数据源，且局限于分类、captioning 等常规感知任务，难以作为统一、独立的框架处理真实场景中来自不同平台与传感器的遥感影像。
Method: 提出 RingMo-Agent 模型：(1) 构建大型视觉-语言数据集 RS-VL3M（超 300 万图像-文本对，覆盖光学、SAR、红外，来自卫星与无人机平台）；(2) 使用分离嵌入层为异构模态构建隔离特征，降低跨模态干扰；(3) 引入任务特定 token，并采用基于 token 的高维隐藏状态解码机制处理长程空间任务。
Result: 在多种遥感视觉-语言任务上的大量实验表明，RingMo-Agent 在视觉理解与复杂分析任务上均有效，并表现出跨平台、跨传感模态的强泛化能力。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为多平台、多模态遥感数据提供了一种统一的感知-推理框架，弥补了现有方法在数据异构性与任务范围上的不足。摘要未讨论明确局限。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: ROC-n-reroll: How verifier imperfection affects test-time scaling
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling aims to improve language model performance by leveraging additional compute during inference. Many works have empirically studied techniques such as Best-of-N (BoN) and Rejection Sampling (RS) that make use of a verifier to enable test-time scaling. However, to date there is little theoretical understanding of how verifier imperfection affects performance -- a gap we address in this work. Specifically, we prove that the instance-level accuracy of these methods is precisely characterized by the geometry of the verifier's ROC curve. Our theory has two important takeaways, confirmed by experiments with Qwen and LLama models on GSM8K and MATH500. First, RS outperforms BoN for fixed compute, while both methods converge to the same accuracy in the infinite-compute limit. Second, it is generally impossible to predict the high-compute performance of either method based on observations in the low-compute regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上分析验证器 (verifier) 不完美性对测试时扩展 (test-time scaling) 方法的影响，研究对象为 Best-of-N (BoN) 与拒绝采样 (Rejection Sampling, RS)。作者证明这两种方法的实例级准确率完全由验证器 ROC 曲线的几何性质决定，并通过 GSM8K 与 MATH500 上的 Qwen 和 LLaMA 实验加以验证。理论给出两个要点：固定计算量下 RS 优于 BoN，且两者在无限计算极限下收敛到相同准确率；同时，通常无法根据低计算量区间的观测预测高计算量性能。
Motivation: 现有工作大量实证研究 BoN 与 RS 等利用验证器进行测试时扩展的技术，但缺乏对验证器不完美性如何影响性能的理论理解，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出一个理论框架，证明 BoN 与 RS 的实例级准确率可由验证器 ROC 曲线的几何特征精确刻画，并基于该理论推导两个可检验的结论。
Result: 在 GSM8K 和 MATH500 上使用 Qwen 与 LLaMA 模型的实验证实：固定计算量下 RS 优于 BoN，两者在无限计算极限下收敛到相同准确率；且一般无法从低计算量区间表现推断高计算量区间表现。
Conclusion: 作者强调验证器 ROC 曲线几何是理解测试时扩展方法性能的关键，并指出高计算量性能难以由低计算量观测外推这一固有困难。

papers.title: Towards Conditional Feature Alignment for Cross-Domain Counting
papers.abstract_en: Object counting models often degrade under cross-domain deployment because density composition varies across domains and is itself task-relevant. Standard feature alignment methods tend to suppress such variation by encouraging global domain invariance, which can be harmful when source and target domains contain different proportions of background, sparse foreground, and dense foreground. We propose Conditional Feature Alignment (CFA), a cross-domain counting framework that aligns representations within label-induced conditions rather than across full marginal feature distributions. Given density annotations or pseudo-density predictions, CFA constructs foreground/background or density-level conditions and aligns only features belonging to matching conditions. We formalise this idea through a conditional divergence perspective, characterising an ideal conditionally aligned state with no within-condition discrepancy while preserving condition-marginal density shift. For unsupervised domain adaptation, CFA estimates source conditions from annotations and target conditions from detached pseudo-density maps, then performs condition-wise adversarial alignment with full-image consistency regularisation. For source-domain generalisation, we instantiate the same principle with MPCount by enforcing condition-wise memory-consistency between generated source-domain views. Experiments on crowd and cell counting benchmarks show competitive or improved performance across diverse UDA and DG settings. For example, on JHU-CROWD++ FH->SN, CFA-DG reduces MAE/RMSE from MPCount's 216.3/421.4 to 90.5/169.9, showing a marked improvement on this large weather- and density-induced shift. These results suggest that condition-wise alignment is a promising design principle for domain-adaptive counting.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted by The 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出条件特征对齐（Conditional Feature Alignment, CFA），用于跨域目标计数任务。核心思想是避免标准的全局域不变对齐，而是依据标签诱导的条件（前景/背景或密度水平）只对齐匹配条件下的特征，从而保留跨域的密度组成差异。作者在无监督域自适应（UDA）和源域泛化（DG）两种设定下实例化该方法，并在人群与细胞计数基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
Motivation: 目标计数模型在跨域部署时性能下降，因为不同域之间的密度组成不同且密度组成本身与任务相关。标准特征对齐方法通过鼓励全局域不变性来抑制这种差异，在源域与目标域的前景/背景比例或稀疏/密集前景比例不同时反而有害。
Method: CFA 从条件散度视角出发，定义理想条件对齐状态为条件内无差异、而条件边缘密度偏移被保留。UDA 场景下从标注构造源域条件、从分离的伪密度图（pseudo-density maps）估计目标域条件，执行逐条件对抗对齐并加入整图一致性正则化；DG 场景下以 MPCount 为基础，对生成的源域视图施加逐条件记忆一致性约束。
Result: 实验在人群与细胞计数基准的多种 UDA 和 DG 设置下显示有竞争力或更优的性能。例如在 JHU-CROWD++ 的 FH->SN 设置中，CFA-DG 将 MAE/RMSE 从 MPCount 的 216.3/421.4 降至 90.5/169.9，显著改善了天气与密度引起的较大域偏移。
Conclusion: 作者认为逐条件对齐是领域自适应计数中一个有前景的设计原则，既能保留任务相关的密度分布差异，又能实现条件内部的特征不变性。

papers.title: Feature-Aware (Hyper)graph Generation via Next-Scale Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Graph generative models perform well on small-scale structured data but struggle to scale to large, complex structures. Hierarchical approaches improve scalability but often ignore node and edge features, which are critical in real-world applications. In this paper, we propose FAHNES (feature-aware (hyper)graph generation via next-scale prediction), a hierarchical framework that jointly generates topology and features for graphs and hypergraphs. FAHNES progressively constructs the final sample through localized expansion and refinement, guided by a novel node budget controlling granularity and ensuring cross-scale consistency. Experiments on synthetic, 3D mesh, and graph point cloud datasets demonstrate competitive or state-of-the-art performance while uniquely scaling to large-scale graphs and hypergraphs with features. Our code is open source.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FAHNES (feature-aware (hyper)graph generation via next-scale prediction)，一个层次化生成框架，在生成图/超图拓扑的同时联合生成节点与边特征。FAHNES 通过局部扩展与细化 (localized expansion and refinement) 逐步构造最终样本，并用节点预算 (node budget) 控制粒度、保证跨尺度一致性。摘要报告其在合成、3D mesh 与图点云数据集上取得有竞争力或最先进性能，并能扩展到带特征的大规模图与超图。
Motivation: 现有图生成模型在小规模结构化数据上表现良好，但难以扩展到大规模复杂结构；层次化方法改善了可扩展性，却常忽略真实应用中关键的节点和边特征。
Method: 提出 FAHNES 层次化框架，通过下一尺度预测 (next-scale prediction) 的方式，以局部扩展和细化逐步构造图或超图样本；引入节点预算来调节生成粒度并维持跨尺度一致性，从而实现拓扑与特征的联合生成。
Result: 在合成数据集、3D mesh 数据集和图点云数据集上的实验表明，该方法达到有竞争力或 state-of-the-art 的性能；摘要特别强调其是唯一能扩展到带特征的大规模图与超图的生成方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为联合生成拓扑与特征并显式控制粒度，是让层次化图生成扩展到大规模带特征结构的关键；代码已开源。

papers.title: PhyxMamba: Chaotic System Reconstruction from Short Context Observations with Generative State-Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Understanding chaotic dynamics is a fundamental problem across scientific disciplines, including climate science, neuroscience, and fluid dynamics, yet direct experimentation and intervention in such systems are often infeasible. Chaotic system reconstruction aims to identify a surrogate dynamical model that preserves a system's invariant geometric and long-term temporal signatures from observed time series, thereby providing a controllable foundation for probing its mechanisms through systematic perturbation and analysis. However, faithful system reconstruction is hampered by high observational costs, which often restrict data to short, discontinuous sequences spanning only limited timescales. Conventional approaches such as reservoir computing struggle in this data-scarce regime since they typically require long-term synchronization windows to localize states on the attractor. Similarly, while deep learning-based time-series forecasting models effectively fit local trajectories, they often fail to capture global invariants, leading to a collapse of long-term dynamical integrity. Here, we propose PhyxMamba, a framework that synergizes Mamba-based state-space models with physics-informed principles. By leveraging time-delay embeddings to reconstruct the attractor manifold and employing a generative training scheme with geometry-aware regularization, PhyxMamba effectively captures both fine-grained local evolution and global physical constraints. Extensive experiments on simulated and real-world chaotic systems demonstrate that PhyxMamba achieves superior reconstruction performance, outperforming the strongest baseline by over 44% in prediction accuracy and 8% in topological fidelity on the Lorenz96 system, while exhibiting strong robustness against partial observations and noise. Codes are available at https://github.com/changliu01/PhyxMamba.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhyxMamba，一个结合 Mamba 状态空间模型与物理信息原则的混沌系统重建框架。针对观测成本高导致数据为短而断续序列的场景，该方法用时延嵌入 (time-delay embedding) 重建吸引子流形，并通过带几何感知正则化的生成式训练同时捕捉局部演化与全局物理约束。在 Lorenz96 等模拟及真实混沌系统上，相比最强基线在预测精度上提升超过 44%，在拓扑保真度上提升 8%，并对部分观测和噪声具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 混沌系统重建在气候、神经科学与流体动力学等领域具有重要意义，但直接实验干预往往不可行；而高观测成本使数据通常局限于短且不连续的序列。现有方法如储层计算在数据稀缺时难以定位吸引子上的状态，深度学习时序预测模型虽能拟合局部轨迹，却常丢失全局不变量，导致长期动力学完整性崩溃。
Method: PhyxMamba 将基于 Mamba 的状态空间模型与物理信息原则结合：利用时延嵌入重建吸引子流形，并采用带几何感知正则化的生成式训练方案，以同时捕获细粒度局部演化与全局物理约束。
Result: 在模拟与真实混沌系统上的实验表明，PhyxMamba 在 Lorenz96 系统上相比最强基线将预测精度提升超过 44%、拓扑保真度提升 8%，并对部分观测和噪声展现出较强的稳健性。
Conclusion: 作者认为融合状态空间模型与物理信息正则化能够有效应对短时序观测下的混沌系统重建问题，并已开源代码；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。

papers.title: Multilook Coherent Imaging: Theoretical Guarantees and Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Multilook coherent imaging is a widely used technique in applications such as digital holography, ultrasound imaging, and synthetic aperture radar. A central challenge in these systems is the presence of multiplicative noise, commonly known as speckle, which degrades image quality. Despite the widespread use of coherent imaging systems, their theoretical foundations remain relatively underexplored. In this paper, we study both the theoretical and algorithmic aspects of likelihood-based approaches for multilook coherent imaging, providing a rigorous framework for analysis and method development. Our theoretical contributions include establishing the first theoretical upper bound on the Mean Squared Error (MSE) of the maximum likelihood estimator under the deep image prior hypothesis. Our results capture the dependence of MSE on the number of parameters in the deep image prior, the number of looks, the signal dimension, and the number of measurements per look. On the algorithmic side, we employ projected gradient descent (PGD) as an efficient method for computing the maximum likelihood solution. Furthermore, we introduce two key ideas to enhance the practical performance of PGD. First, we incorporate the Newton-Schulz algorithm to compute matrix inverses within the PGD iterations, significantly reducing computational complexity. Second, we develop a bagging strategy to mitigate projection errors introduced during PGD updates. We demonstrate that combining these techniques with PGD yields state-of-the-art performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/Computational-Imaging-RU/Bagged-DIP-Speckle.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2402.15635. Version accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Information Theory
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多视相干成像 (multilook coherent imaging) 中基于似然的方法，并在深度图像先验 (deep image prior) 假设下建立了最大似然估计器均方误差 (MSE) 的首个理论上界。摘要给出的结果表明该上界依赖于深度图像先验的参数数量、视数 (number of looks)、信号维度和每视测量数。算法方面采用投影梯度下降 (PGD) 求解最大似然，并引入 Newton-Schulz 算法计算矩阵逆以降低复杂度，以及 bagging 策略缓解投影误差，组合后达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: 多视相干成像广泛用于数字全息、超声成像和合成孔径雷达，但受乘性噪声 (speckle) 影响且理论基础相对薄弱；现有方法缺乏严格的误差分析框架，因此需要为似然类方法建立严谨的理论保证与高效算法。
Method: 理论上分析深度图像先验假设下最大似然估计的 MSE 上界；算法上使用投影梯度下降 (PGD) 求解，并引入两个增强手段：用 Newton-Schulz 算法计算 PGD 迭代中的矩阵逆以显著降低计算复杂度，以及设计 bagging 策略来抑制 PGD 更新中引入的投影误差。
Result: 摘要报告了深度图像先验假设下 MLE 的 MSE 首个理论上界，并刻画其对深度图像先验参数数、视数、信号维度和每视测量数的依赖；将上述技巧与 PGD 结合可获得 state-of-the-art 表现。
Conclusion: 该论文为多视相干成像的似然方法提供了理论框架和高效算法，并公开代码；摘要未明确讨论应用范围或局限性。

papers.title: MME-VideoOCR: Evaluating OCR-Based Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs in Video Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved considerable accuracy in Optical Character Recognition (OCR) from static images. However, their efficacy in video OCR is significantly diminished due to factors such as motion blur, temporal variations, and visual effects inherent in video content. To provide clearer guidance for training practical MLLMs, we introduce the MME-VideoOCR benchmark, which encompasses a comprehensive range of video OCR application scenarios. MME-VideoOCR features 10 task categories comprising 25 individual tasks and spans 44 diverse scenarios. These tasks extend beyond text recognition to incorporate deeper comprehension and reasoning of textual content within videos. The benchmark consists of 1,464 videos with varying resolutions, aspect ratios, and durations, along with 2,000 meticulously curated, manually annotated question-answer pairs. We evaluate 18 state-of-the-art MLLMs on MME-VideoOCR, revealing that even the best-performing model (Gemini-2.5 Pro) achieves an accuracy of only 73.7%. Fine-grained analysis indicates that while existing MLLMs demonstrate strong performance on tasks where relevant texts are contained within a single or few frames, they exhibit limited capability in effectively handling tasks that demand holistic video comprehension. These limitations are especially evident in scenarios that require spatio-temporal reasoning, cross-frame information integration, or resistance to language prior bias. Our findings also highlight the importance of high-resolution visual input and sufficient temporal coverage for reliable OCR in dynamic video scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MME-VideoOCR 基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 在视频场景中的 OCR 能力。基准包含 10 个任务类别、25 个独立任务和 44 个场景，由 1,464 个视频和 2,000 个手工标注问答对构成，任务涵盖文本识别以及更深层的文本理解与推理。作者评估了 18 个 SOTA MLLM，最佳模型 Gemini-2.5 Pro 准确率仅 73.7%，并发现模型在单帧或少数帧文本任务上表现强，但在整体视频理解、时空推理和跨帧信息整合方面能力有限。
Motivation: MLLMs 在静态图像 OCR 上已达到较高准确率，但视频 OCR 因运动模糊、时间变化和视频固有视觉效果而性能显著下降；现有模型在动态视频场景中缺乏可靠的 OCR 能力，需要更清晰的基准来指导实用 MLLM 的训练。
Method: 构建 MME-VideoOCR 基准，覆盖广泛的视频 OCR 应用场景，任务设计超越简单文本识别，纳入对视频中文字内容的深度理解与推理。基准包含 10 个任务类别、25 个任务和 44 个场景，视频在分辨率、宽高比和时长上多样化，并配有 2,000 个精心整理的人工标注问答对。
Result: 在 MME-VideoOCR 上评估 18 个 SOTA MLLM，最佳模型 Gemini-2.5 Pro 的准确率仅为 73.7%。细粒度分析显示，现有模型在相关文本集中于单帧或少数帧的任务上表现良好，但在需要整体视频理解的任务上能力有限，尤其在时空推理、跨帧信息整合或抵抗语言先验偏差的场景中缺陷明显；结果还表明，高分辨率视觉输入和足够的时间覆盖对可靠视频 OCR 至关重要。
Conclusion: 现有 MLLM 在视频 OCR 的整体视频理解方面存在明显不足，尤其是在时空推理和跨帧信息整合场景，改善高分辨率视觉输入和时间覆盖能力是提升可靠性的关键；MME-VideoOCR 可作为训练实用 MLLM 的指导性基准。

papers.title: One-shot Robust Federated Learning of Independent Component Analysis
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies robust one-shot aggregation for distributed and federated Independent Component Analysis (ICA). In this setting, each client computes a local ICA estimator, while the server aims to recover a common global mixing matrix without accessing raw data. The main difficulty is that local ICA estimators are identifiable only up to signed permutations and may have highly heterogeneous estimation quality. We propose Spectral-Robust-Federated ICA (SRF-ICA), a one-shot aggregation method that constructs a sign-invariant affinity matrix from all local atoms, performs spectral k-means to resolve the permutation ambiguity, aligns signs within each estimated cluster, and then applies the geometric median for robust aggregation. We prove that the spectral clustering step controls the cluster-wise misclustering rate, and that the final estimator remains accurate even when a substantial fraction of local atoms are produced from low-quality clients, as long as each cluster contains a majority of reliable atoms. The analysis combines spectral perturbation bounds, k-means misclustering guarantees, and quantile-based robustness of the geometric median. Due to space constraints, simulation studies demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed approach under heterogeneous sample sizes and corruption levels are deferred to the appendix.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布式/联邦独立成分分析 (ICA) 的鲁棒一次性聚合问题。每个客户端计算局部 ICA 估计量，服务器在不访问原始数据的情况下恢复全局混合矩阵；难点在于局部估计量仅可识别到符号排列，且质量高度异质。作者提出 Spectral-Robust-Federated ICA (SRF-ICA)，用符号不变亲和矩阵与谱 k-means 解决排列歧义，再通过几何中位数 (geometric median) 进行鲁棒聚合，并给出簇误分类率与最终估计误差的理论保证。
Motivation: 联邦 ICA 中，服务器需要从多个局部估计量聚合出共同全局混合矩阵，但无法访问原始数据；局部估计量只可识别到符号排列，且不同客户端的估计质量差异很大，这使得聚合既需要解决排列对齐又需要抵抗低质量客户端的影响。
Method: 提出 SRF-ICA：由所有局部原子 (atoms) 构建符号不变的亲和矩阵，执行谱 k-means 以解决排列歧义，在每个估计簇内对齐符号，最后应用几何中位数进行鲁棒聚合。
Result: 理论分析证明谱聚类步骤能够控制簇级误分类率，且只要每个簇内多数原子来自可靠客户端，即使有相当比例的局部原子由低质量客户端产生，最终估计器仍保持准确。模拟研究因篇幅限制被放在附录中，摘要未给出具体数值。

papers.title: Weak Physics Informed Neural Networks for Geometry Compatible Hyperbolic Conservation Laws on Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a mesh-free approach to solving high-dimensional PDEs on complex geometries, but their theoretical foundations on manifolds remain limited. Moreover, conventional PINN analyses typically rely on solution smoothness, while PINNs may perform poorly for low-regularity solutions arising from nonlinear hyperbolic equations. In this paper, we develop a weak PINN (wPINN) framework for approximating entropy solutions of geometry-compatible hyperbolic conservation laws on Riemannian manifolds $\mathcal{M}^d$. Building on the well-posedness theory, we establish a localized $L_1$-stability estimate that converts localized entropy residuals into terminal error bounds and leads to a rigorous convergence analysis of the proposed method. We then derive approximation guarantees for time-dependent entropy solutions on manifolds, revealing how approximation errors accumulate over long time horizons. For the quadrature error, we develop a problem-adapted localization complexity analysis and show that, for a fixed adversarial test-network architecture, the solution-network contribution achieves the fast rate $\mathrm{VC}_{\mathcal F}/n$, up to logarithmic factors. The resulting algebraic network-complexity exponent depends only on the intrinsic dimension $d$, rather than the ambient dimension. For fixed localization scales, and up to logarithmic factors and the localization bias, the solution-network statistical exponent matches the corresponding minimax exponent in $d$-dimensional Euclidean Sobolev approximation. Numerical experiments illustrate that the proposed wPINN framework accurately approximates entropy solutions on manifold geometries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在黎曼流形上为几何相容的守恒律方程提出弱物理信息神经网络 (weak PINN, wPINN) 框架，用于逼近熵解 (entropy solutions)。作者基于适定性理论建立局部化 L1 稳定性估计，将局部熵残差转化为终端误差界，并给出流形上时变熵解的逼近保证与积分误差的局部化复杂度分析。数值实验表明该框架能在流形几何上准确逼近熵解。
Motivation: PINN 提供无网格方法求解复杂几何上的高维 PDE，但其在流形上的理论基础有限；同时常规 PINN 分析依赖解的充分光滑性，而非线性双曲方程的低正则解会使 PINN 表现不佳。
Method: 提出弱 PINN 框架，基于黎曼流形上的几何相容双曲守恒律，利用局部熵残差的 L1 稳定性估计建立终端误差界，并推导时变熵解的逼近误差在长时间上的累积规律；对积分误差给出问题自适应的局部化复杂度分析，并研究固定对抗测试网络结构下解网络项的收敛速率。
Result: 摘要报告，对于固定的对抗测试网络架构，解网络贡献达到快速率 VC_F/n（至多差对数因子）；所得的代数网络复杂度指数只依赖内蕴维数 d 而非环境维数；在固定局部化尺度下，解网络统计指数与 d 维欧氏 Sobolev 逼近的对应极小极大指数匹配（至多差对数因子和局部化偏差）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，所提出的 wPINN 框架在流形几何上能够准确逼近熵解，并建立了从局部化熵残差到最终误差的严格收敛性分析。

papers.title: DiagnosisArena: Benchmarking Diagnostic Reasoning for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of groundbreaking large language models capable of performing complex reasoning tasks holds significant promise for addressing various scientific challenges, including those arising in complex clinical scenarios. To enable their safe and effective deployment in real-world healthcare settings, it is urgently necessary to benchmark the diagnostic capabilities of current models systematically. Given the limitations of existing medical benchmarks in evaluating advanced diagnostic reasoning, we present DiagnosisArena, a comprehensive and challenging benchmark designed to rigorously assess professional-level diagnostic competence. DiagnosisArena consists of 1,113 pairs of segmented patient cases and corresponding diagnoses, spanning 28 medical specialties, deriving from clinical case reports published in 10 top-tier medical journals. The benchmark is developed through a meticulous construction pipeline, involving multiple rounds of screening and review by both AI systems and human experts, with thorough checks conducted to prevent data leakage. Our study reveals that even the most advanced reasoning models, o3, o1, and DeepSeek-R1, achieve only 51.12%, 31.09%, and 17.79% accuracy, respectively. This finding highlights a significant generalization bottleneck in current large language models when faced with clinical diagnostic reasoning challenges. Through DiagnosisArena, we aim to drive further advancements in AI's diagnostic reasoning capabilities, enabling more effective solutions for real-world clinical diagnostic challenges. We provide the benchmark and evaluation tools for further research and development https://github.com/SPIRAL-MED/DiagnosisArena.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiagnosisArena，一个用于评估大语言模型专业级诊断推理能力的新型基准，包含来自 10 种顶级医学期刊临床病例报告的 1,113 对分段患者病例与对应诊断，覆盖 28 个医学专科。基准通过 AI 与人类专家多轮筛选审阅构建，并做了数据泄漏检查。评测显示最强的推理模型 o3、o1 与 DeepSeek-R1 准确率分别仅为 51.12%、31.09% 和 17.79%，表明当前 LLM 在临床诊断推理上存在明显的泛化瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有医学基准在评估高级诊断推理方面存在不足，而大语言模型在复杂临床场景中的安全有效部署需要对其诊断能力进行系统化基准测试。
Method: 构建 DiagnosisArena：从 10 本顶级医学期刊的临床病例报告中提取分段患者病例与对应诊断，经多轮 AI 系统与人类专家筛选和审阅，并进行严格的数据泄漏检查后形成 1,113 对样本。
Result: 摘要报告 o3、o1 和 DeepSeek-R1 在基准上的准确率分别为 51.12%、31.09% 和 17.79%，显示当前最先进推理模型在临床诊断推理任务上仍表现有限。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果表明当前大语言模型在临床诊断推理中存在显著的泛化瓶颈，并希望通过该基准推动 AI 诊断推理能力的进一步进步；同时公开了基准与评测工具供后续研究使用。

papers.title: Hybrid quantum recurrent neural network for remaining useful life prediction of turbofan engines
papers.abstract_en: Accurate remaining useful life (RUL) estimation underpins safe operation and cost-effective maintenance of aerospace propulsion systems. We propose a Hybrid Quantum Recurrent Neural Network (HQRNN) for jet-engine RUL forecasting on the NASA C-MAPSS FD001 benchmark. The HQRNN stacks Quantum Long Short-Term Memory (QLSTM) layers, replacing each LSTM gate's linear transformation with a Quantum Depth-Infused (QDI) circuit; this is followed by classical dense layers. Quantum and hybrid quantum-classical methods for turbofan RUL prediction are still at an early stage. Our study is therefore among the first to evaluate a gate-based QLSTM hybrid at matched parameter counts, comparing it against classical and joint state-of-the-art models on this benchmark and complementing that comparison with a circuit-level analysis of the quantum layer. Encoding the gate signals in a quantum feature space is intended to help the network represent high-frequency degradation patterns with fewer trainable parameters than a matched classical counterpart. The HQRNN improves mean RMSE and mean MAE by about 5% over matched-parameter stacked-LSTM RNNs across 10 random seeds, and attains a test RMSE of 15.46, outperforming Random Forest, CNN, and MLP baselines. ZX calculus, Fisher information, and Fourier analyses indicate that the QDI circuit is compact, trainable, and expressive. Advanced joint deep-learning models still outperform the stand-alone HQRNN, indicating that quantum-enhanced recurrent modules are best deployed as components within composite prognostics pipelines rather than stand-alone predictors.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合量子循环神经网络 (HQRNN) 用于涡扇发动机剩余使用寿命 (RUL) 预测，并在 NASA C-MAPSS FD001 基准上评估。HQRNN 堆叠量子长短期记忆 (QLSTM) 层，将每个 LSTM 门的线性变换替换为量子深度注入 (QDI) 电路，后接经典稠密层。摘要在 10 个随机种子下报告平均 RMSE 和 MAE 比参数匹配的堆叠 LSTM RNN 提升约 5%，测试 RMSE 为 15.46，优于 Random Forest、CNN 和 MLP 基线；但先进联合深度学习模型仍优于独立 HQRNN。
Motivation: 准确的 RUL 估计对航空推进系统的安全运行和低成本维护至关重要，而量子与混合量子-经典方法在涡扇 RUL 预测中仍处于早期阶段，缺乏在参数匹配条件下与经典模型的系统对比。
Method: 提出 HQRNN，将 QLSTM 层堆叠起来，并用 QDI 电路替换每个 LSTM 门的线性变换，在量子特征空间中编码门信号，随后接入经典稠密层；同时结合 ZX calculus、Fisher 信息和 Fourier 分析对量子层进行电路级评估。
Result: 在 C-MAPSS FD001 上，HQRNN 相对参数匹配的堆叠 LSTM RNN 将平均 RMSE 和 MAE 提升约 5%，测试 RMSE 为 15.46，优于 Random Forest、CNN 和 MLP 基线；ZX calculus、Fisher 信息与 Fourier 分析表明 QDI 电路紧凑、可训练且具有表达力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调先进联合深度模型仍优于独立 HQRNN，因此量子增强循环模块更适合作为复合预测流水线中的组件，而非作为独立预测器使用。

papers.title: On Stopping Times of Power-one Sequential Tests: Tight Lower and Upper Bounds
papers.abstract_en: We present two general lower bounds for stopping times of sequential tests between arbitrary composite nulls $\mathcal P$ and alternatives $\mathcal Q$. The first lower bound is for the ``Wald setting'' where the type-1 error level $α$ approaches zero for a fixed alternative $Q \in \mathcal Q$, and equals $\log(1/α)$ divided by a certain infimum KL divergence between $\mathcal P$ and $Q$, termed $\operatorname{KL_{inf}}$. The second lower bound applies to the ``Farrell setting'', where $α$ is fixed and $\operatorname{KL_{inf}}$ approaches $0$ along a sequence of alternatives such that the required expected sample size along that sequence is of order at least $\operatorname{KL^{-1}_{inf}} \log \log \operatorname{KL^{-1}_{inf}}$. Our main contribution is the generality of these bounds, which hold in non-parametric, composite settings, without requiring a dominating reference measure, substantially generalizing the known parametric results. We also provide sufficient conditions for matching upper bounds and show that these are met in several nontrivial non-parametric cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究序贯检验（sequential tests）中停止时间的一般下界，针对任意复合原假设与备择假设。作者给出两个下界：在 Wald 设定下，当显著性水平 α 趋于 0 时，期望样本量至少为 log(1/α) 除以一个特定的 infimum KL 散度；在 Farrell 设定下，当 α 固定而该 KL 散度趋于 0 时，期望样本量至少为 KL_inf^{-1} log log KL_inf^{-1} 的量级。主要贡献是这些结果不要求支配参考测度，适用于非参数复合设定，显著推广了已知参数结果。
Motivation: 经典的序贯检验停止时间下界通常局限于参数或简单假设设定，本文旨在将这些结果推广到一般的非参数、复合假设，并去掉支配参考测度等限制。
Method: 提出两个一般性的停止时间下界定理，分别处理 Wald 设定与 Farrell 设定；同时给出匹配上界成立的充分条件，并证明若干非平凡非参数情形满足这些条件。
Result: 摘要报告两个下界：Wald 设定下的 log(1/α)/KL_inf，以及 Farrell 设定下的至少 KL_inf^{-1} log log KL_inf^{-1} 量级；作者还展示了在多个非参数情形下这些下界可被匹配。
Conclusion: 作者强调其主要贡献是下界的一般性，即适用于非参数、复合设定且无需支配参考测度，从而推广了已知的参数结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Generative Deep Learning Workflow for Inverse Molecular Design of Fuels
papers.abstract_en: In the present work, a generative deep learning framework combining a Co-optimized Variational Autoencoder (Co-VAE) with quantitative structure-property relationship (QSPR) techniques is developed to enable inverse molecular design of fuels. The Co-VAE approach integrates an auxiliary fuel property prediction regression head with the VAE latent space, enhancing molecular reconstruction and accurate property estimation (Research Octane Number (RON) chosen as the fuel property of interest for demonstration studies). A subset of the GDB-13 database, combined with a curated RON database, is used for the Co-VAE training. Hyperparameter tuning is further utilized to optimize the balance among reconstruction fidelity, chemical validity, and RON prediction. Subsequently, an independent regression model is trained to further improve RON prediction accuracy, and a differential evolution algorithm is employed to efficiently navigate the Co-VAE latent space and identify promising fuel molecule candidates with RON greater than a chosen threshold. The overall generative deep learning framework captures complex structure-property relationships within a latent representation, and can be readily extended to different or multiple fuel properties, allowing exploration of large chemical spaces relevant to fuel design. Furthermore, the framework can be further augmented by incorporating additional synthesizability criteria to improve applicability and reliability for de novo design of novel high-performance fuels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个生成式深度学习工作流，用于燃料分子的逆向设计，核心是把 Co-优化的变分自编码器 (Co-VAE) 与定量结构-性质关系 (QSPR) 技术结合。Co-VAE 在 VAE 隐空间上加入辅助燃料性质预测回归头，演示中以研究法辛烷值 (RON) 为目标性质，使用 GDB-13 数据库子集与精选 RON 数据库训练，并通过超参数调优平衡重建保真度、化学有效性与 RON 预测。之后用独立的回归模型进一步提升 RON 预测精度，再用差分进化算法在潜在空间中搜索 RON 高于设定阈值的候选燃料分子。
Motivation: 燃料分子设计需要在广阔化学空间中高效找到具有理想性质（如高 RON）的候选分子，而传统方法难以直接捕获复杂的结构-性质关系。该工作旨在利用深度学习潜在表示实现逆向分子设计，绕过昂贵的物理模拟或经验规则。
Method: 方法由三部分组成：一是 Co-VAE，将辅助燃料性质回归头与 VAE 隐空间结合，以增强分子重建与性质估计；二是独立训练的回归模型用于进一步改善 RON 预测精度；三是差分进化算法，用于高效导航 Co-VAE 潜在空间并筛选 RON 高于阈值的候选分子。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但指出该框架能捕获潜在表示中的复杂结构-性质关系，并在演示中识别出 RON 超过设定阈值的候选燃料分子。
Conclusion: 该框架可方便地扩展至不同或多个燃料性质，并可进一步加入额外的可合成性判据，从而提高 de novo 设计新型高性能燃料的适用性与可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Thinking Outside the (Gray) Box: A Context-Based Score for Assessing Value and Originality in Neural Text Generation
papers.abstract_en: Despite the increasing use of large language models for creative tasks, their outputs often lack diversity. Common solutions, such as sampling at higher temperatures, can compromise the quality of the results. Dealing with this trade-off is still an open challenge in designing AI systems for creativity. Drawing on information theory, we propose a context-based score to quantitatively evaluate value and originality. This score incentivizes accuracy and adherence to the request while fostering divergence from the learned distribution. We show that our score can be used as a reward in a reinforcement learning framework to fine-tune large language models for maximum performance. We validate our strategy through experiments considering a variety of creative tasks, such as poetry generation and math problem solving, demonstrating that it enhances the value and originality of the generated solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在创意生成任务中输出多样性不足的问题，提出一个基于信息论的上下文分数 (context-based score)，用于定量评估生成内容的价值 (value) 与原创性 (originality)。该分数在奖励对用户请求的准确性遵循的同时，鼓励模型偏离学习到的分布；作者将其作为强化学习框架中的奖励信号来微调大语言模型。实验涵盖诗歌生成和数学问题求解等创意任务，结果显示该方法提升了生成解的价值与原创性。
Motivation: 大语言模型日益用于创意任务，但其输出往往缺乏多样性；常见的提高采样温度等方案可能损害生成质量，如何平衡多样性与质量仍是设计人工智能创意系统时未解决的挑战。
Method: 提出一个基于信息论的上下文分数，用于激励生成结果既准确、符合请求，又促进与已学习分布产生分歧；该分数被用作强化学习 (reinforcement learning) 框架中的奖励来微调大语言模型。
Result: 摘要报告在包含诗歌生成和数学问题求解等多种创意任务的实验中，该方法增强了生成解决方案的价值和原创性。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的分数能够定量评估并改善神经文本生成中的价值与原创性，强调了准确性和多样性之间权衡的可优化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DR.GAP: Mitigating Bias in Large Language Models using Gender-Aware Prompting with Decoupled Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong natural language understanding capabilities but also inherit and amplify societal biases, particularly gender bias, raising fairness concerns. Existing prompt-based debiasing strategies share a key limitation: they fail to disentangle gender information from task semantics. Bias steering compels models to overemphasize gender cues, while reasoning-based prompting induces gender-biased reasoning chains. To address these challenges, we propose DR.GAP (Decoupled Reasoning for Gender-Aware Prompting), an automated and model-agnostic pipeline that mitigates gender bias while preserving model performance. DR.GAP generates gender-neutral reasoning traces and applies them as in-context demonstrations during inference, effectively decoupling gender attributes from task semantics without modifying model parameters. Extensive experiments on coreference resolution and question-answering tasks across six LLMs demonstrate DR.GAP's effectiveness, generalizability, and robustness, supported by detailed mechanism analyses. Moreover, DR.GAP can be extended to vision-language models (VLMs), achieving substantial bias reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DR.GAP（Decoupled Reasoning for Gender-Aware Prompting），一种自动化、模型无关的提示管道，通过生成性别中立的推理轨迹并在推理时作为上下文示例使用，将性别属性与任务语义解耦，从而在不修改模型参数的情况下缓解大语言模型（LLM）的性别偏见。在六个 LLM 的指代消解（coreference resolution）和问答（question-answering）任务上的实验表明其有效、可泛化且稳健，并带有机制分析；该方法还可扩展到视觉语言模型（VLM）。
Motivation: 现有基于提示的去偏策略存在关键缺陷：无法将性别信息与任务语义分离。偏见引导会使模型过度强调性别线索，而推理式提示则会产生带有性别偏见的推理链，导致去偏效果受限。
Method: DR.GAP 是一个自动化且模型无关的管道，首先生成性别中立的推理轨迹，再在推理阶段将其作为上下文示例（in-context demonstrations）应用，从而实现性别属性与任务语义的解耦，且不需要修改模型参数。
Result: 摘要报告 DR.GAP 在六个 LLM 的指代消解和问答任务上展现出有效性、泛化性和稳健性，并通过详细的机制分析加以支撑；此外，该方法可扩展至视觉语言模型（VLM），实现显著的偏见减少。
Conclusion: 作者认为 DR.GAP 能够在保持模型性能的同时有效缓解性别偏见，并且无需参数调整即可推广到不同模型，还可延伸至视觉语言模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving Influence-based Instruction Tuning Data Selection for Balanced Learning of Diverse Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: Selecting appropriate training data is crucial for instruction fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), which aims to (1) elicit strong capabilities, and (2) achieve balanced performance across different tasks. Influence-based methods show promise in achieving (1), by estimating the contribution of each training example to the model's predictions, but often struggle with (2). Our systematic investigation reveals that this underperformance can be attributed to an inherent bias, where some tasks intrinsically have greater influence than others. As a result, data selection is often biased towards these tasks, not only hurting the model's performance on others but also, counterintuitively, harming performance on these high-influence tasks themselves. To address this, we propose BIDS, a Balanced and Influential Data Selection algorithm. BIDS first normalizes influence scores of the training data, and then iteratively chooses the training example with the highest influence on the most underrepresented task. Experiments with both Llama-3 and Mistral-v0.3 on seven benchmarks spanning five diverse capabilities show that BIDS consistently outperforms both state-of-the-art influence-based algorithms and other non-influence-based frameworks. Surprisingly, training on a 15% subset selected by BIDS can even outperform full-dataset training with a much more balanced performance. Our analysis highlights the importance of both instance-level normalization and iterative optimization of selected data for balanced learning of diverse capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究指令微调中基于影响力的数据选择方法为何在跨任务均衡学习上表现不佳，并指出其根源是不同任务天然存在影响力差异，导致选择偏向高影响力任务，反而损害包括这些高影响力任务在内的整体性能。作者提出 BIDS（Balanced and Influential Data Selection）算法，先对训练数据的影响力分数做归一化，再迭代地选择对最未充分表示任务影响力最高的样本。基于 Llama-3 和 Mistral-v0.3 在覆盖五种能力的七个基准上的实验表明，BIDS 一致优于现有基于影响力的方法及其他非影响力框架，且仅用 15% 子集即可超过全量训练并获得更均衡的性能。
Motivation: 指令微调的数据选择需要同时实现强能力激发与跨任务均衡表现，而基于影响力的方法虽擅长前者却在均衡性上经常失败；系统调查发现这种失败源于任务间内在影响力偏差，选择偏向高影响力任务会同时伤害其他任务和高影响力任务自身。
Method: 提出 BIDS 算法，首先对训练数据的影响力分数进行实例级归一化，然后通过迭代方式挑选对当前最未充分表示任务影响力最高的训练样本，以兼顾数据影响力与任务均衡。
Result: 在 Llama-3 和 Mistral-v0.3 上、跨越五种能力的七个基准实验中，BIDS 一致超过当前最优的基于影响力的算法及其他非影响力数据选择框架；由 BIDS 选出的 15% 子集甚至可以超越全量数据训练，并带来更均衡的性能。
Conclusion: 分析强调实例级归一化和对已选数据的迭代优化对于多样能力的均衡学习至关重要，指出了基于影响力数据选择在指令微调中实现均衡能力的可行路径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Bactrainus: Optimizing Large Language Models for Multi-hop Complex Question Answering Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop question answering requires a system to identify and integrate evidence distributed across documents, yet large language models remain vulnerable to irrelevant context. We investigate this evidence bottleneck in the English HotpotQA distractor setting and introduce Bactrainus, a modular selector-reader framework that separates paragraph selection, supporting-sentence identification, and answer generation. Optional question decomposition and teacher-generated rationale supervision make it possible to test where additional reasoning structure is useful. The evaluation combines foundation-model screening, controlled context and prompting ablations, parameter-efficient adaptation of Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and Llama 3.1 70B Instruct readers, and integrated selector-reader experiments. Supplying the full candidate context instead of gold supporting facts reduces answer token-overlap F1 by 17-21 points, showing that scale alone does not remove context sensitivity. The largest observed differences are associated with reader adaptation and sentence-level evidence control. The strongest reported configuration obtains 89.01 answer F1 and 79.70 joint F1, whereas decomposition and rationale-supervision variants yield smaller, recipe-dependent changes. These findings support auditable, explicitly supervised evidence interfaces for fixed-candidate multi-hop QA and motivate blind, matched, multi-seed evaluation of the remaining small differences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多跳问答中 LLM 易受无关上下文干扰的证据瓶颈问题，提出 Bactrainus，一种将段落选择、支持句识别与答案生成分离的模块化 selector-reader 框架。在英文 HotpotQA distractor 设置下，以 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 和 70B Instruct 读者为主进行参数高效适配与集成实验。实验显示，提供完整候选上下文而非黄金支持事实会使答案 token 重叠 F1 下降 17-21 点，最强的配置达到 89.01 答案 F1 和 79.70 joint F1。
Motivation: 多跳问答需要跨文档识别并整合证据，但大语言模型对无关上下文仍然敏感；作者在 HotpotQA distractor 设置下系统考察这一证据瓶颈，并检验规模是否足以消除上下文敏感性。
Method: 提出模块化 selector-reader 框架，分别处理段落选择、支持句识别和答案生成，并加入可选的问句分解与教师生成的 rationale 监督；评估包括基础模型筛选、受控上下文与提示消融、对 Llama 3.1 8B/70B Instruct 读者的参数高效适配，以及集成式 selector-reader 实验。
Result: 用完整候选上下文替代黄金支持事实使答案 token 重叠 F1 下降 17-21 点；最大的差异来自读者适配和句子级证据控制。最强配置获得 89.01 答案 F1 与 79.70 joint F1，而分解与 rationale 监督变体只带来较小且依赖配方的变化。
Conclusion: 作者认为固定候选集的多跳 QA 应使用可审计、显式监督的证据接口；对于剩余的小差异，需要盲法、匹配、多次种子的评估来确认。

summary_sections.motivation: 多跳问答需要跨文档识别并整合证据，但大语言模型对无关上下文仍然敏感；作者在 HotpotQA distractor 设置下系统考察这一证据瓶颈，并检验规模是否足以消除上下文敏感性。
summary_sections.method: 提出模块化 selector-reader 框架，分别处理段落选择、支持句识别和答案生成，并加入可选的问句分解与教师生成的 rationale 监督；评估包括基础模型筛选、受控上下文与提示消融、对 Llama 3.1 8B/70B Instruct 读者的参数高效适配，以及集成式 selector-reader 实验。
summary_sections.result: 用完整候选上下文替代黄金支持事实使答案 token 重叠 F1 下降 17-21 点；最大的差异来自读者适配和句子级证据控制。最强配置获得 89.01 答案 F1 与 79.70 joint F1，而分解与 rationale 监督变体只带来较小且依赖配方的变化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为固定候选集的多跳 QA 应使用可审计、显式监督的证据接口；对于剩余的小差异，需要盲法、匹配、多次种子的评估来确认。

papers.title: Multi-Bin Batching for Increasing LLM Inference Throughput
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) grow in popularity for their diverse capabilities, improving the efficiency of their inference systems has become increasingly critical. Batching LLM requests is a critical step in scheduling the inference jobs on servers (e.g. GPUs), enabling the system to maximize throughput by allowing multiple requests to be processed in parallel. However, requests often have varying generation lengths, causing resource underutilization, as hardware must wait for the longest-running request in the batch to complete before moving to the next batch. We formalize this problem from a queueing-theoretic perspective, and aim to design a control policy which is throughput-optimal under a static-batching framework. We propose Multi-Bin Batching, a simple yet effective method that can provably improve LLM inference throughput under this framework by grouping requests with similar (predicted) execution times into predetermined bins. Through a combination of theoretical analysis and experiments, including real-world LLM inference scenarios with static and continuous-batching baselines, we demonstrate that multi-bin batching substantially improves throughput over static batching and quantify the remaining gap to native continuous batching under both oracle and estimated length information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从排队论 (queueing theory) 视角形式化大语言模型 (LLM) 推理中的请求批处理问题，提出 Multi-Bin Batching：将预测执行时间相近的请求分入预设的多个 bin 中，以缓解批内最长请求拖慢整体吞吐的问题。作者结合理论分析和实验，在静态批处理 (static batching) 与连续批处理 (continuous batching) 基线下验证该方法可证明地提升吞吐量。
Motivation: LLM 请求的生成长度往往差异很大，静态批处理中硬件必须等待批内最慢请求完成才能进入下一批，导致资源利用率不足。作者希望设计一种在静态批处理框架下吞吐最优 (throughput-optimal) 的控制策略。
Method: 先将批处理问题建模为排队论问题，再提出 Multi-Bin Batching：把具有相似（预测）执行时间的请求分组到预先设定的 bin 中，从而减少批内执行时间差异。
Result: 理论分析与实验均表明，Multi-Bin Batching 相比静态批处理显著提升吞吐量；在 oracle 长度信息和估计长度信息两种设定下，作者量化了其与原生连续批处理之间的剩余差距。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法是简单且可证明有效的吞吐提升手段，但尚不能完全达到连续批处理的性能，剩余差距与长度预测信息质量相关。
