papers.title: Breaking and Defending LLM-Powered Social Media Bot Detection Systems
papers.abstract_en: The rise of social media bots poses a persistent threat, enabling misinformation, opinion manipulation, and the erosion of trust in online platforms. To combat this, machine learning systems have been developed to detect and limit bot activity, but attackers continuously adapt through techniques such as adversarial learning and behavior imitation, fueling an ongoing arms race between bots and detection tools. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have significantly improved bot detection by enabling deeper semantic and contextual analysis of accounts and their content. However, this shift also introduces new attack surfaces, allowing adversaries to craft exploits that directly target the reasoning and generation mechanisms of LLM-based classifiers. Industry tools such as Anthropic's Claude Code Security similarly leverage LLMs for security-critical decisions, further motivating a careful study of their attack surfaces. In this work, we investigate both the offensive and defensive aspects of LLM-powered, threat-specific cybersecurity applications. While centered on the challenge of social media bot detection, our methodology and insights generalize to a broad class of LLM-powered cybersecurity systems, including phishing detection, email classification, and fraud analysis. We introduce two novel adversarial attack strategies that systematically exploit the semantic and contextual weaknesses of LLM-based classifiers, degrading their detection accuracy by up to 48%. To counter these threats, we propose a robust multi-LLM defense architecture designed to preserve detection reliability under adaptive adversarial conditions. Our solution, LSABRE (LLM-powered Social Adversarial Bot Recognition Ensemble), is a multi-LLM framework that substantially improves robustness across a range of attacks, maintaining 86% detection accuracy even under strong, adaptive adversarial pressure.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACISP 2026 (Australasian Conference on Information Security and Privacy). Also accepted as a poster at IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (S&P) 2026. Published in Pragmatic Cybersecurity 2026, 1(2), 10, https://doi.org/10.53941/pc.2026.100010. 19 pages, 11 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 驱动的社交媒体机器人检测系统的攻防两侧。作者提出两种新的对抗攻击策略，利用 LLM 分类器的语义和上下文弱点，将检测精度降低最多 48%；为抵御此类攻击，提出多 LLM 集成框架 LSABRE，在强自适应对抗压力下保持 86% 的检测精度。
Motivation: 社交媒体机器人持续构成威胁，LLM 虽能通过语义和上下文分析改善检测，但也引入新的攻击面，攻击者可针对 LLM 分类器的推理与生成机制直接构造利用。作者认为该问题可推广到更广泛的 LLM 驱动网络安全应用，如钓鱼检测、邮件分类和欺诈分析。
Method: 提出两种系统性的对抗攻击策略，针对 LLM 分类器的语义和上下文弱点进行利用。防御方面提出 LSABRE（LLM-powered Social Adversarial Bot Recognition Ensemble），一种多 LLM 防御架构，旨在自适应对抗条件下保持检测可靠性。
Result: 摘要报告两种攻击策略可将检测精度降低最多 48%；LSABRE 在强自适应对抗压力下维持 86% 的检测精度，显著提升跨攻击场景的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 论文强调其方法论和洞见可泛化到一类 LLM 驱动的网络安全系统，并指出对 LLM 在安全关键决策中的攻击面进行严谨研究是必要的。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Resource-Efficient QUBO Formulation for Anchored Currency Arbitrage
papers.abstract_en: Currency arbitrage (CA) involves trading currencies in cycles to exploit discrepancies in market valuations. Quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) involves minimizing a quadratic cost (energy) function of binary variables. Previous works have explored the use of QUBO to solve CA problems. We build on these previous works by introducing realistic constraints such as beginning cycles from a held currency and accounting for per-transaction trading fees. We show that this formulation requires fewer logical variables (qubits) than previous QUBO encodings in the literature. We derive provably sufficient penalty weights for its constraint terms. We also introduce an exact anchor-gauge reweighting of the exchange rates that compresses the QUBO coefficient range from the rate scale to the arbitrage scale, addressing the finite analog precision of annealing hardware. We demonstrate the efficacy of this formulation using classical simulated annealing against an exact Held-Karp baseline on the same CPU and show that it can effectively find profitable cycles and account for trading fees. Finally, we benchmark faithful implementations of five prior QUBO encodings at matched sampler budgets and show that the proposed encoding is the only one to recover the exact fee-adjusted optimum.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种资源高效的 QUBO 编码用于含锚定约束的货币套利 (anchored currency arbitrage)，在模型中加入了从持有货币出发开始交易循环以及每笔交易手续费等现实约束。作者证明该编码所需的逻辑变量（qubit）少于文献中已有的 QUBO 编码，并推导出约束项惩罚权重的充分上界；还引入精确的锚定标度重加权 (anchor-gauge reweighting)，将 QUBO 系数范围从汇率量级压缩到套利量级，以应对退火硬件的有限模拟精度。实验使用经典模拟退火与精确的 Held-Karp 基线对比，并对五种已有 QUBO 编码在相同采样预算下进行基准测试。
Motivation: 以往工作已将 QUBO 用于货币套利问题，但缺少现实约束（如从已持有货币开始、每笔交易手续费），且已有编码在变量数和硬件精度方面存在不足。
Method: 提出带锚定约束与手续费的 QUBO 公式化，给出可证明充分的惩罚权重，并引入精确的锚定标度重加权来压缩系数范围；通过与 Held-Karp 精确解的对比及对五种先前 QUBO 编码的公平基准测试来验证。
Result: 摘要报告新编码比文献中已有 QUBO 编码使用更少的逻辑变量；在匹配的采样预算下，该编码是唯一能恢复精确费用调整后最优解的方案；模拟退火能有效发现盈利循环并计入交易费用。
Conclusion: 作者认为该公式化在资源效率和求解有效性上均优于先前编码，其标度重加权方法还能缓解退火硬件有限精度带来的问题。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Bounded Agents: Delegation Security for Multi-Agent AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents can act on behalf of a user to access cloud services, call tools, or invoke agents. At session start, the agent's permissions are set but remain static, and each request is evaluated independently, without considering prior actions. Within its permissions, an agent may act contrary to the delegated task, combine individually permitted actions into a prohibited outcome, or delegate authority to a sub-agent without limiting it. A prompt injection poses a risk only if the agent has authority to perform such actions; this is therefore a problem of authorization architecture, not just the model. The Agentic Principal Chain (APC) tracks delegated authority from one principal to the next. APC evaluates each request against the accumulated session state using six authorization checks. APC carries forward and restricts delegated scope and budgets. Using composition closure, APC checks requests against prior actions to prevent prohibited combinations and enforces the decision outside the model. We prove Blast Radius Monotonicity and Composition Soundness for APC implementations; Composition Soundness is limited to prohibited combinations under a complete restriction set and serialized admission. We evaluated 3,154 instances including InjecAgent, AgentDojo, and ASB. Our compromised-model evaluation tests APC independently of model behavior by inserting the ground-truth attack call after the first legitimate tool call. AgentDojo exfiltration fell from 75-100% to 0% across all four domains; APC blocked all 544 InjecAgent data-stealing cases. Intent binding reduced destruction from 38.6% to 4.0% and manipulation from 90.5% to 12.1%. Authorization latency was 0.24 ms at the 99th percentile on an idle host; across 949 AgentDojo task-injection pairs, utility was 8.6 and 13.9 percentage points lower in the two settings. Implementation, evaluation tools, and data are publicly available.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/xmuruaga/bounded-agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向多智能体系统的授权架构 Agentic Principal Chain (APC)，用于解决 LLM 智能体在会话中可能违背委托任务、将单独合法操作组合成禁止结果或向下级智能体无限制委托权限的问题。APC 对每个请求基于累积会话状态执行六种授权检查，通过组合闭包 (composition closure) 限制委托范围与预算，并在模型外部强制执行决策。作者证明了 Blast Radius Monotonicity 与 Composition Soundness 两个性质，并在 InjecAgent、AgentDojo 和 ASB 共 3,154 个实例上进行了评估。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在会话开始时设定权限后保持静态，每个请求被独立评估，不参考先前动作；因此智能体在权限范围内可能违背委托任务、组合出被禁止的结果，或未加限制地向子智能体授权。提示注入只有在智能体拥有相应授权时才构成风险，所以这本质上是授权架构问题而非单纯模型问题。
Method: 提出 Agentic Principal Chain (APC)，追踪从一个委托主体到下一个主体的授权链；APC 针对请求结合累积会话状态执行六种授权检查，携带并限制委托范围与预算，利用组合闭包将请求与先前动作对比以防止被禁止的组合，并在模型外部执行决策。作者还引入 intent binding 来绑定意图，并通过 compromised-model 评估将 ground-truth 攻击调用插入首个合法工具调用之后，以独立于模型行为测试 APC。
Result: 在 AgentDojo 上，四个域的数据外泄 (exfiltration) 从 75-100% 降至 0%；APC 阻止了 InjecAgent 全部 544 个数据窃取案例。Intent binding 将破坏 (destruction) 从 38.6% 降至 4.0%，操纵 (manipulation) 从 90.5% 降至 12.1%。授权延迟在空闲主机上第 99 百分位为 0.24 ms；在 949 对 AgentDojo 任务-注入对中，两种设置下 utility 分别降低 8.6 和 13.9 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者强调 APC 是一种在模型外强制执行的授权架构，能够有效阻止多智能体系统中的越权与组合攻击；同时指出 Composition Soundness 的性质证明仅限于完整限制集和串行准入下的被禁止组合，存在范围限制。实现、评估工具与数据均已公开。

papers.title: Deploying Frontier Agentic Technology in MOOSEnger, a Multiphysics-Capable AI Assistant
papers.abstract_en: The Multiphysics Object-Oriented Simulation Environment (MOOSE) is an open-source finite-element framework for building multiphysics simulation applications. Using a multiphysics environment effectively demands specialized expertise, creating a barrier for many domain scientists and engineers. MOOSEnger, developed at Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is a domain-specific, tool-enabled AI agent built for the MOOSE Framework. This work extends MOOSEnger with a harness focused on locally-hosted models. The harness gives the agent a full pipeline: it retrieves contextual knowledge from the MOOSE repository, validates and diagnoses the resulting input through interaction with the simulation executable environment, and extracts and stores lessons in a persistent memory. The resulting framework is demonstrated on an engineering problem from the National Reactor Innovation Center Virtual Test Bed (VTB), illustrating its potential to support realistic multiphysics simulation workflows. Additionally, the agent performance is evaluated on different categories including diffusion, Navier--Stokes, phase field, plasticity, porous media flow, solid mechanics, transient heat transfer, and reactor mesh generation. Each category consists of 25 prompts/cases. We compare MOOSEnger-Gemma4 against MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2, alongside baseline Gemma4 and GPT-5.2 without agentic capabilities. MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2 shows a slight edge, achieving a 90\% success rate versus 76.5\% for MOOSEnger-Gemma4. The baseline models perform far worse, at just 5\% (GPT-5.2) and 0\% (Gemma4), underscoring the impact of the agentic harness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 MOOSEnger，一个在爱达荷国家实验室（INL）为 MOOSE 框架开发的领域专用、支持工具的 AI 代理，并将其扩展为支持本地托管模型的 harness。该 harness 为代理提供完整流程：从 MOOSE 仓库检索上下文知识、通过与仿真可执行环境交互来验证和诊断输入，并将经验提取并存储到持久记忆中。作者在 8 类共 200 个 prompt 上评估代理性能，发现带代理能力的模型成功率远高于无代理基线。
Motivation: 使用多物理场仿真环境（如 MOOSE）需要专业知识，这对许多领域科学家和工程师构成使用障碍。本文旨在通过一个领域专用的 AI 代理 harness 降低该门槛。
Method: 扩展 MOOSEnger，构建一个面向本地托管模型的 harness，形成完整 pipeline：从 MOOSE 仓库检索上下文知识、通过与仿真可执行环境交互验证和诊断输入、提取并存储经验到持久记忆。
Result: 在 National Reactor Innovation Center Virtual Test Bed（VTB）工程问题上演示，并在 diffusion、Navier–Stokes、phase field、plasticity、porous media flow、solid mechanics、transient heat transfer、reactor mesh generation 这 8 类（每类 25 个 prompt）上评估。MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2 达到 90% 成功率，MOOSEnger-Gemma4 为 76.5%；无代理基线 GPT-5.2 和 Gemma4 分别只有 5% 和 0%。
Conclusion: 代理化 harness 对成功率影响显著，说明结合本地模型的完整检索-验证-记忆流程有可能支持现实多物理场仿真工作流。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dear Algo: A Precision-First Agentic Intent Layer for Unified Search and Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Search and recommendation serve a shared discovery objective but encode intent differently. We study this boundary through Dear Algo on Threads, a deployed product where open-ended requests such as \emph{more NBA news} or \emph{less politics} steer subsequent feed recommendations rather than return a one-shot result list. Its agentic intent layer compiles explicit, inferred, negative, and compound intent into a grounded executable plan, then invokes conventional retrieval and optional semantic or multimodal reranking. The layer shares an intent-to-retrieval contract without requiring one model or serving path across search-like and recommendation-like modes. We evaluate Dear Algo under a precision-first objective. In a blinded audit of 300 public request-item pairs (296 evaluable), a strict categorical LLM-as-a-judge gate achieved 94.4\% exact-Relevant precision [88.8\%, 98.9\%]. Across 72 normalized request clusters, the full configuration produced 7.73 judge-qualified candidates per 20 slots versus 6.61 for an LLM-derived-query baseline, a gain of 1.11 [0.12, 2.12]. In a candidate-randomized serving-path study restricted to the reranker path's first 72 eligible hours, the user-weighted judge-Irrelevant share among judged admissions was 2.80\% versus 4.78\% off (-1.97 points [-3.02, -0.94]), while Exact-Relevant share was 2.24 points higher [0.08, 4.41]. Together, these studies show how explicit natural-language intent can be carried into feed recommendation under a precision-first evaluation framework
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Threads 上部署的 Dear Algo 系统，一个“精度优先”的智能体意图层，用于统一搜索与推荐。它将开放式的自然语言请求（如“更多 NBA 新闻”“更少政治”）编译成可执行的落地计划，再调用传统检索与可选语义或多模态重排序。在盲审 300 对公开请求-条目对（296 份可评估）中，严格分类的 LLM-as-a-judge 门控达到 94.4% 的 exact-Relevant 精确率；在 72 个归一化请求簇中，完整配置比 LLM 派生查询基线多产生 1.11 个合格候选；随机化服务路径实验显示用户加权 judge-Irrelevant 份额下降 1.97 个百分点。
Motivation: 搜索和推荐虽有共同的发现目标，但以不同方式编码意图。现有系统通常分别处理两种模式，缺少把显式自然语言意图带入后续 feed 推荐、而非一次性结果列表的通用机制，且往往依赖统一模型或统一服务路径。
Method: 提出 agentic intent layer，将显式、推断、负向和复合意图编译为一个可执行的落地计划，然后调用常规检索以及可选的语义或多模态重排序。该层通过共享的 intent-to-retrieval 契约工作，不需要在搜索式和推荐式模式间共用单一模型或服务路径。
Result: 盲审中精确率 94.4% [88.8%, 98.9%]；72 个请求簇上完整配置每 20 个槽位产生 7.73 个 judge-qualified 候选，对比 LLM-derived-query 基线的 6.61，增益 1.11 [0.12, 2.12]；在只限重排序路径前 72 小时的候选随机化服务路径研究中，judge-Irrelevant 占比为 2.80% 对比关闭该路径时的 4.78%（差 -1.97 点 [-3.02, -0.94]），exact-Relevant 占比高 2.24 点 [0.08, 4.41]。
Conclusion: 这些研究表明，在精度优先的评估框架下，显式自然语言意图可以被有效地引入 feed 推荐，并通过意图层实现搜索与推荐模式下更统一的意图编码与执行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Large Language Models as Implicit Sociological Models: Reconstructing Voting Behaviour from Sociodemographic Profiles
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) trained on large-scale internet corpora encode extensive statistical regularities about social identities, attitudes, and political behaviour. This paper introduces and evaluates a methodological framework that leverages these latent representations to reconstruct aggregate voting behaviour from individual-level sociodemographic profiles. We operationalize LLMs as implicit sociological models by conditioning them on demographic descriptions, eliciting probabilistic turnout and party preferences, and aggregating individual outputs via a soft voting procedure. Using the 2021 Czech parliamentary election as a validation case, we demonstrate that contemporary LLMs reproduce official election outcomes with low mean absolute error, recover known political bloc structures, and align with independently established sociodemographic gradients. The contribution of this work is methodological rather than predictive: we show how LLMs can be systematically interrogated as compressed representations of social reality, offering a novel exploratory instrument for computational social science while clearly delineating its epistemic and ethical limits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个方法论框架，将大语言模型（LLM）当作隐式社会学模型，通过输入社会人口统计描述来询问其概率性投票倾向和党派偏好，再用软投票聚合个体输出，以重建总体投票行为。以2021年捷克议会选举为验证案例，该方法能以较低的平均绝对误差复现官方选举结果，并恢复已知的政治阵营结构与社会人口梯度。作者强调该工作的贡献是方法论而非预测导向，并讨论了其认识论与伦理边界。
Motivation: 现有计算社会学方法通常依赖显式调查或结构化数据，而大规模互联网语料训练的LLM编码了关于社会身份、态度与政治行为的统计规律，本文希望系统性地利用这些潜在表征来重建聚合投票行为。
Method: 将LLM作为隐式社会学模型使用：用人口统计描述作为条件，获取概率性的投票参与度与政党偏好，然后通过软投票（soft voting）过程聚合个体输出，并与官方选举结果进行比对验证。
Result: 以2021年捷克议会选举为案例，当代LLM能以低平均绝对误差复现官方选举结果，能够恢复已知的政治阵营结构，并与独立建立的社会人口梯度保持一致。
Conclusion: 该研究定位为计算方法论贡献，表明LLM可以作为社会现实的压缩表征被系统性地询问，为计算社会科学提供探索性工具，同时作者明确指出其认识论与伦理上的局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Visual CoT: Internalized Visual Thinking for Proactive Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models increasingly use visual chain-of-thought (Visual CoT) to reason about spatial, temporal, and embodied environments. By generating intermediate reasoning images, Visual CoT provides an intuitive mechanism for visual foresight but introduces substantial inference overhead, which is particularly problematic for proactive video reasoning. We ask whether models can learn to think visually during training while reasoning directly at inference. We introduce Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT), a post-training framework that jointly optimizes textual prediction and next-embedding prediction over unlabeled videos. Given a partially observed video, IVT predicts latent representations of future frames together with the target textual answer, encouraging the model to capture motion, object transitions, interactions, and latent intent. At inference, IVT generates the answer directly without synthesizing or re-encoding future frames. We conduct controlled studies across target representations, decoder designs, prediction horizons, data mixtures, training curricula, and predictive objectives. IVT improves over direct-answer fine-tuning on all six evaluation settings while retaining the same inference pathway. Compared with explicit Visual CoT, IVT achieves comparable or better performance and reduces average end-to-end latency by more than 5x. Together, our findings suggest that explicit pixel-space generation at inference time, as used in visual chain-of-thought, may not be necessary for effective proactive video reasoning. Predictive world modeling can be internalized during training to produce multimodal reasoners that are both more accurate and substantially more efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT)，一种面向主动视频推理的后训练框架，在未标注视频上联合优化文本预测与下一嵌入预测，使模型在训练时内化视觉推理，而在推理时不再生成或重编码未来帧。作者在六种评估设置上与直接答案微调相比均取得改进，并在保持相同推理路径的前提下，相较显式 Visual CoT 实现了超过 5 倍的平均端到端延迟降低。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型常用视觉思维链 (Visual CoT) 进行空间、时间与具身环境推理，但显式生成中间推理图像会带来大量推理开销，尤其不利于主动视频推理。作者希望探究模型能否在训练时学会视觉思考，而在推理时直接给出答案。
Method: 提出 IVT 后训练框架，在未标注视频上同时优化文本预测和下一嵌入预测 (next-embedding prediction)。给定部分观测视频，IVT 预测未来帧的潜在表征及目标文本答案，使模型捕捉运动、物体转换、交互和潜在意图；推理时直接生成答案，不生成或重编码未来帧。
Result: 控制实验覆盖目标表征、解码器设计、预测时长、数据混合、训练课程和预测目标。IVT 在所有六种评估设置上均优于直接答案微调，且推理路径不变；相比显式 Visual CoT，性能相当或更好，平均端到端延迟降低超过 5 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为，显式像素空间生成（如 Visual CoT 所用）对有效的主动视频推理可能并非必要；预测性世界建模可以在训练阶段内化，从而得到更准确且显著更高效的多模态推理模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CoupVisor: Strategy Optimization by Round and Challenge Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents CoupVisor, a decision-support system for the hidden-information card game Coup. It addresses two questions: what a player should do on each turn, and when a player should challenge an opponent's claim. The system is built around a single description of game events, which is shared across manual play, replay of recorded games, simulation, belief tracking, advisor recommendations, and learning-based policies. CoupVisor estimates the chance that a claim is truthful by combining how likely each role is with how many cards the claimant still holds, which corrects a case where the very first claim of a game was flagged as suspicious despite no evidence. We compare a rule-following advisor and several learned and heuristic players across many simulated games and different opponent styles. Our main finding is that the choice of reward, whether it rewards short-term gains or ultimately winning the game, decides which learning approach performs best, and that a win-oriented reward produces a policy that outperforms all baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 CoupVisor，一个用于隐藏信息卡牌游戏 Coup 的决策支持系统，回答每回合行动和何时质疑对手声明两个问题。系统围绕单一游戏事件描述构建，统一支持手动游戏、回放、模拟、信念跟踪、顾问建议和学习策略。通过结合角色概率与剩余卡牌数来估计声明为真的概率，修正了首回合声明被无证据误判为可疑的问题。对比规则跟随顾问和多种学习/启发式玩家后发现，奖励选择决定学习方法的表现，以获胜为导向的奖励产生的策略优于所有基线。
Motivation: 隐藏信息博弈中需要同时决策行动与挑战时机，现有方法缺乏统一的事件框架，且简单的信念估计会在无证据时将首个声明误判为可疑。
Method: 构建单一游戏事件描述，统一支持手动游玩、回放、模拟、信念跟踪、顾问推荐和学习策略。用角色似然与剩余卡牌数结合估计声明真实性，并比较规则型顾问与多种学习/启发式玩家在不同对手风格下的表现。
Result: 主要发现是奖励函数的选择决定学习方法的优劣；以获胜为导向的奖励产生的策略超过所有基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在 Coup 这类隐藏信息游戏中，获胜导向奖励比短期收益导向奖励更有效，且统一事件描述系统能支持多种决策功能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Feasible and Novel Synthetic Population Generation with Tabular and Sequential Travel Attributes
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic populations are critical inputs for activity-based travel demand models, yet generating realistic populations from limited survey data remains challenging. Small samples miss valid attribute combinations, known as sampling zeros, and generative models may also produce infeasible structural zeros. Moreover, realistic synthetic populations must capture both static socio-demographic attributes and sequential travel behaviour, such as trip chains. This paper proposes a regularized two-stage generative framework to address these challenges, where regularization refers to additional loss terms that guide the generator toward broader valid coverage and fewer infeasible samples. In Stage 1, a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty is augmented with three regularization terms, IGP, LDR, and CLAP, to improve feasibility, diversity, and novelty in tabular population synthesis. In Stage 2, Transformer and LSTM-Attention models generate sequential travel attributes, including departure time, trip purpose, and travel mode, conditioned on the synthesized tabular profiles. We also introduce novelty and count-aware metrics to evaluate whether valid unseen combinations are recovered and generated in realistic proportions. Results show that regularized models outperform the vanilla WGAN-GP across feasibility, diversity, and novelty. Regularization increases feasibility by 2.1 to 3.7 percentage points and novelty by 6.6 to 10.0 percentage points, improving sampling-zero recovery without sacrificing feasibility. The F1 score improves by 6.3 to 8.6 percentage points. For sequential attributes, LSTM-Attention best matches the trip-length distribution, while Transformer achieves higher overall sequential F1, 90.6\% versus 89.1\%. Cross-stage validation confirms strong consistency between generated mobility status and generated trip chains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个正则化的两阶段生成框架，用于从有限调查数据生成兼具可行性与新颖性的合成人口，包括表格型社会人口属性和序列出行行为（如出行链）。第一阶段用带梯度惩罚的 Wasserstein GAN（WGAN-GP）并加入 IGP、LDR、CLAP 三个正则项来生成表格属性；第二阶段用 Transformer 和 LSTM-Attention 模型生成出发时间、出行目的、出行方式等序列属性。结果显示正则化模型在可行性、多样性和新颖性上优于 vanilla WGAN-GP，并引入新颖性和计数感知指标来评估有效未见组合的恢复与生成比例。
Motivation: 小样本调查数据会产生采样零（sampling zeros）导致缺少有效的属性组合，生成模型也可能产生不可行的结构零（structural zeros）；同时合成人口需要同时刻画静态社会人口属性和序列出行行为，现有方法难以同时满足可行性与新颖性。
Method: 提出两阶段生成框架：第一阶段在 WGAN-GP 基础上增加 IGP、LDR、CLAP 三个正则损失项，引导生成器覆盖更广的有效组合并减少不可行样本；第二阶段以合成的表格档案为条件，用 Transformer 与 LSTM-Attention 生成出发时间、出行目的、出行模式等序列出行属性；并提出新颖性和计数感知（count-aware）指标来评估有效未见组合的恢复情况和生成比例。
Result: 摘要报告正则化模型在可行性上提升 2.1 至 3.7 个百分点，新颖性提升 6.6 至 10.0 个百分点，F1 分数提升 6.3 至 8.6 个百分点。序列属性方面，LSTM-Attention 最好地匹配出行长度分布，而 Transformer 取得更高的总体序列 F1（90.6% 对 89.1%）；跨阶段验证确认生成的移动状态与生成的出行链之间存在强一致性。
Conclusion: 作者认为正则化可以同时改善合成人口的可行性和采样零恢复，在序列出行属性生成上两种模型各有优势，跨阶段验证支持整体框架的一致性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Scaling Manual-Grounded Appliance Manipulation with Data Synthesis and Unified Planning
papers.abstract_en: Operating household appliances requires long-horizon planning that is state-dependent and robust to disturbances, yet existing large models fall short, as no sufficiently diverse, task-oriented dataset exists to support such planning. To bridge this gap, we propose MAGE, a scalable data synthesis pipeline that introduces a novel Hierarchical Appliance Graph (HAG) to automatically generate part grounding, long-horizon planning, and closed-loop recovery data from appliance manuals. With MAGE, we build UseAppliance, the first large-scale dataset for manual-grounded appliance manipulation planning, spanning 22 appliance categories with 89K+ part annotations, 53K+ manipulation tasks, and 33K+ closed-loop adjustment steps. Built on UseAppliance, we develop AppliancePlan, an end-to-end model for manual-grounded appliance manipulation planning. On RealAppliance-Bench, AppliancePlan with only 7B parameters achieves over 10x the best baseline on open-loop planning and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models across all tasks. Real-robot experiments on six household appliances further confirm effective sim-to-real transfer, marking an important step toward general-purpose household robotics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对家庭电器操作中的长时程规划问题，提出 MAGE 数据合成流水线，利用新的层级电器图 (Hierarchical Appliance Graph, HAG) 从说明书自动生成部件接地 (part grounding)、长时程规划和闭环恢复数据。基于此构建了首个大规模手册接地电器操作规划数据集 UseAppliance，涵盖 22 个电器类别、89K+ 部件标注、53K+ 操作任务和 33K+ 闭环调整步骤，并训练了端到端规划模型 AppliancePlan。在 RealAppliance-Bench 上，仅 7B 参数的 AppliancePlan 在开环规划上超过最佳基线 10 倍以上，并通过六种家用电器的真实机器人实验验证了 sim-to-real 迁移。
Motivation: 现有大模型在操作家用电器时表现不足，原因是缺乏足够多样、面向任务的数据集来支撑这种依赖状态且对扰动鲁棒的长时程规划。
Method: 提出 MAGE 可扩展数据合成流水线，通过层级电器图 (HAG) 从手册自动生成部件接地、长时程规划与闭环恢复数据；在此基础上构建 UseAppliance 数据集，并开发端到端规划模型 AppliancePlan。
Result: UseAppliance 包含 22 个电器类别、89K+ 部件标注、53K+ 操作任务和 33K+ 闭环调整步骤；7B 参数的 AppliancePlan 在 RealAppliance-Bench 开环规划上达到最佳基线的 10 倍以上，并在所有任务上持续优于现有模型；六种家用电器的真实机器人实验验证了有效的 sim-to-real 迁移。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可扩展的数据合成方法能够支撑手册接地的电器操作规划，是迈向通用家庭机器人的重要一步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TransfHAR: Self-Supervised Wrist Representations for On-Demand Activity Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained wrist activity recognition can support applications such as procedural step guidance and context-aware assistance, yet acquiring labeled data for every new task, user, and activity granularity remains a bottleneck. We present TransfHAR, a self-supervised wrist IMU framework for on-demand, fine-grained activity recognition by learning transferable motion priors from global, unlabeled activities. We show that self-supervised pretraining on coarse wrist IMU activities (e.g., sitting, walking, exercise) learns motion structure rich enough to transfer to fine-grained manipulative, gestural, and procedural activities (e.g., snapping, stirring, waving) that are absent from pretraining. We implement TransfHAR as a real-time smartwatch application that lets users define and expand their own activity set for personalized recognition from only a few demonstrations. Across three offline cross-dataset evaluations, TransfHAR matches or exceeds fully supervised baselines that use complete label sets with equal or additional sensor channels, by 6.2 balanced-accuracy points on average. In an in-lab study with 10 participants each performing seven novel wrist activities, TransfHAR reaches 86.7% balanced accuracy across participants with five examples per class and 90.4% when updated from a single one-minute recording per class. These results indicate that broad self-supervised wrist pretraining provides an effective foundation for on-demand fine-grained activity recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TransfHAR，一个用于按需细粒度手腕活动识别的自监督 IMU 框架。作者利用未标注的粗粒度手腕活动（如坐、走、锻炼）进行自监督预训练，学习可迁移的运动先验，再迁移到预训练中未出现的细粒度活动（如弹指、搅拌、挥手）。系统被实现为实时智能手表应用，用户只需少量演示即可定义并扩展自己的活动集合。跨三个离线跨数据集评测中，TransfHAR 平均超过完全监督基线 6.2 个 balanced-accuracy 点；10 名参与者的实验室研究中，每类 5 个示例时达到 86.7%，每类一个一分钟录音更新后达到 90.4%。
Motivation: 细粒度手腕活动识别可支持程序步骤引导和情境感知辅助，但为每个新任务、新用户和新活动粒度获取标注数据仍然是瓶颈。作者希望用无标注的全局活动学习可迁移的运动先验，从而支持按需、少样本的活动识别。
Method: 提出 TransfHAR，一种自监督手腕 IMU 框架：先在粗粒度手腕活动上进行自监督预训练以学习运动结构，再迁移到细粒度操作性、手势性和程序性活动。同时实现为实时智能手表应用，允许用户从少量演示中定义和扩展个性化活动集。
Result: 在三个离线跨数据集评测中，TransfHAR 在相等或更少传感器通道下匹配或超过使用完整标签集的完全监督基线，平均提升 6.2 个 balanced-accuracy 点。实验室研究中，10 名参与者每人执行七种新活动，每类五个示例时跨参与者 balanced accuracy 为 86.7%，每类用一个一分钟录音更新后达到 90.4%。
Conclusion: 作者认为广泛的自监督手腕预训练为按需细粒度活动识别提供了有效基础。摘要未讨论明确的局限性，场景限定于手腕 IMU 与智能手表应用。

papers.title: RAGas: Retrieval-Augmented Gas Optimization for Smart Contracts with Continuous Knowledge Integration
papers.abstract_en: Ethereum is now integral to mission-critical sectors, including finance, healthcare, and supply chain management. Execution fees, commonly referred to as Gas, scale with the computational complexity of their functions. Smart contracts on Ethereum incur execution fees, known as Gas, which increase with computational complexity. Thus, optimizing Gas-intensive code while preserving functional equivalence significantly lowers deployment costs. No existing system continuously exploits evolving Gas usage patterns. We systematically analyze syntactic and semantic constructs that drive excessive Gas use. This yields six high-level categories covering twelve fine-grained antipatterns underpinning a curated knowledge base. We operationalize these insights with RAGas, a three-stage retrieval-augmented generation framework that uses a large language model to pinpoint and automatically fix Gas inefficiencies. Experiments on deployed contracts demonstrate that RAGas reduces Gas usage by up to 11% and achieves high precision and recall in detecting code snippets exhibiting Gas wastage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAGas，一个面向智能合约 Gas 优化的检索增强生成框架，利用大语言模型定位并自动修复 Gas 低效代码。作者系统分析了导致高 Gas 消耗的语法与语义构造，归纳出六大类共十二种细粒度反模式，并构建知识库支持持续知识集成。在已部署合约上的实验表明，RAGas 最高可降低 11% 的 Gas 用量，并在检测 Gas 浪费代码片段方面取得较高的精确率与召回率。
Motivation: 以太坊智能合约的执行费用 Gas 随计算复杂度增长，优化高 Gas 消耗代码可显著降低部署成本，但现有系统未能持续利用不断演变的 Gas 使用模式。
Method: 提出三阶段检索增强生成（retrieval-augmented generation）框架 RAGas，结合大语言模型自动定位和修复 Gas 低效问题，并基于六类反模式、十二条细粒度规则构建可更新的知识库以支持持续知识集成。
Result: 在已部署合约上的实验显示，RAGas 最高可减少 11% 的 Gas 用量，并在检测 Gas 浪费代码片段时实现高精确率与召回率。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过持续利用 Gas 使用模式并结合检索增强生成，可以有效降低智能合约的 Gas 消耗，同时保持功能等价性。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为通过持续利用 Gas 使用模式并结合检索增强生成，可以有效降低智能合约的 Gas 消耗，同时保持功能等价性。

papers.title: Geometry of Forgetting: Representation Flux in Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Catastrophic forgetting remains a fundamental obstacle to continual learning, where neural networks lose previously acquired knowledge while learning new tasks. Existing methods primarily mitigate forgetting through parameter regularization or experience replay, while the representation-space dynamics associated with forgetting remain less understood. We investigate latent representation evolution during sequential learning and introduce representation flux, a geometric measure of sample-level representation displacement across training. We show that representation flux is strongly associated with catastrophic forgetting across multiple benchmarks, with temporal analyses indicating that elevated flux can precede subsequent performance degradation. Representation displacement is also associated with confidence degradation, while complementary geometric properties provide additional information about sample-level forgetting. Motivated by these observations, we propose FlowLess-R, a representation-space regularization method that constrains replay representations relative to stored references while allowing continued learning. FlowLess-R is architecture-agnostic and integrates into replay-based methods through a representation-matching term. Experiments on SplitMNIST, SplitFashionMNIST, SplitCIFAR10, and SplitTinyImageNet show improved final average accuracy and reduced forgetting with ER, DER++, and ER-ACE. Our results identify representation flux as an informative geometric marker of forgetting and show that stabilizing latent representations provides a simple strategy for mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究持续学习（continual learning）中灾难性遗忘与表示空间动态的关系，提出表示通量（representation flux）这一几何度量，用于刻画样本级表示在训练过程中的位移。作者发现表示通量与遗忘强相关，且提升的通量可能先于后续性能退化，并提出架构无关的正则化方法 FlowLess-R，通过在重放方法中加入表示匹配项来约束重放表示。实验在 SplitMNIST、SplitFashionMNIST、SplitCIFAR10 和 SplitTinyImageNet 上与 ER、DER++、ER-ACE 结合，报告了更高的最终平均准确率和更低的遗忘。
Motivation: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习的基本障碍，现有方法主要通过参数正则化或经验重放（experience replay）缓解遗忘，而遗忘相关的表示空间动态仍缺乏理解。
Method: 提出表示通量（representation flux）作为样本级表示位移的几何度量，并据此提出 FlowLess-R，一种基于表示空间的回归方法，通过表示匹配项将重放表示约束到存储参考附近，同时允许继续学习新任务。
Result: 在 SplitMNIST、SplitFashionMNIST、SplitCIFAR10 和 SplitTinyImageNet 上，FlowLess-R 与 ER、DER++ 和 ER-ACE 结合时均提升了最终平均准确率并减少了遗忘；时间分析还显示升高的表示通量可先于性能退化，且表示位移与置信度退化相关。
Conclusion: 结果表明表示通量是遗忘的有效几何标记，稳定潜在表示（latent representation）是缓解灾难性遗忘的一种简单且架构无关的策略。

papers.title: Generalized Linear Bandits with Memory
papers.abstract_en: We study generalized linear bandits with memory, an endogenous non-stationary setting in which rewards depend on past actions through a finite memory matrix. Building on prior work for linear models (Clerici et al., 2024), we show that the previously known $\tilde{O}(T^{3/4})$ regret bound stems from a loose analysis, and we provide a sharpened analysis that recovers a $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret rate in the linear case. We then extend this improvement to generalized linear models and propose a block-wise algorithm based on shrunken confidence bounds. Our algorithm achieves a regret bound of $\tilde{O}\left(\sqrt{mT} + d\sqrt{T} + \sqrtκ\, d^{2} m^{1/4} T^{1/4} + κd^{2} \right)$, where $d$ denotes the feature dimension, $m$ the memory length, and $κ$ a curvature parameter of the link function. This attains a $\sqrt{T}$-type rate despite nonlinear rewards and memory effects. To the best of our knowledge, this analysis provides a unified treatment of memory-induced non-stationarity and nonlinear link functions, while ensuring that the leading regret term is independent of the curvature of the link function. We conduct numerical experiments that are consistent with our theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带记忆的广义线性 bandits（generalized linear bandits with memory），其中奖励通过有限记忆矩阵依赖过去的动作，属于内生非平稳设定。作者指出此前线性情形下已知的 $\tilde{O}(T^{3/4})$ 遗憾界源于松散分析，给出锐化分析后在线性情形恢复 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ 速率，并将改进推广到广义线性模型。他们提出基于收缩置信界（shrunken confidence bounds）的块状算法，得到 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{mT} + d\sqrt{T} + \sqrt{\kappa}\,d^{2}m^{1/4}T^{1/4} + \kappa d^{2})$ 遗憾界，其中 $d$ 为特征维数，$m$ 为记忆长度，$\kappa$ 为 link 函数的曲率参数。数值实验与理论结果一致。
Motivation: 已有的带记忆线性 bandits 分析给出 $\tilde{O}(T^{3/4})$ 遗憾界，且缺少对非线性 link 函数与记忆效应统一处理的分析框架。本文目标是收紧该界限并在广义线性模型下获得 $\sqrt{T}$ 型速率。
Method: 作者先在线性模型下修正先前分析中的松散步骤，证明可恢复 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾界；随后将该改进推广到广义线性模型，提出基于收缩置信界（shrunken confidence bounds）的块状（block-wise）算法，并从理论上保证遗憾上界。
Result: 算法达到 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{mT} + d\sqrt{T} + \sqrt{\kappa}\,d^{2}m^{1/4}T^{1/4} + \kappa d^{2})$ 的遗憾界，在非线性奖励和记忆效应下仍获得 $\sqrt{T}$ 型速率，且主导项不依赖于 link 函数的曲率参数 $\kappa$。
Conclusion: 该分析统一处理了记忆导致的内生非平稳性与非线性 link 函数，同时保证 leading regret term 与曲率无关；作者声称这是首次给出此类统一处理，并通过数值实验验证理论结果。

papers.title: Characterising cardiac tissue properties with graph neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Characterising electrophysiological properties of cardiac tissue efficiently and accurately from spatially sparse intracardiac measurements is clinically important for localising ablation targets and improving arrhythmia treatment. We developed a graph neural network-based framework trained on synthetic electrogram signals on 2D flat surfaces to identify areas of interest in the context of cardiac ablation for premature ventricular complexes (PVCs). Our method achieved an average precision of 0.96, 0.97, and 0.95 for the detection of single-patch fibrosis, rapid depolarisation and high excitability, respectively. The trained model can then be applied to 2D curved surfaces with few-shot fine-tuning, demonstrating its generalisation capability. Future work will develop this framework further for clinical use in PVC ablation.
papers.comment: Accepted at The Statistical Atlases and Computational Modeling of the Heart (STACOM) workshop 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于图神经网络 (GNN) 的框架，从空间稀疏的心腔内电信号 (intracardiac electrogram) 中高效、准确地刻画心脏组织的电生理特性，用于室性早搏 (PVC) 消融场景下的靶点定位。模型在二维平面上的合成心电信号上训练，可检测单斑块纤维化、快速去极化和高兴奋性区域，平均精确率分别为 0.96、0.97 和 0.95。作者还展示了模型经少样本微调后可泛化到二维弯曲表面。
Motivation: 从空间稀疏的心腔内测量中高效准确地刻画心脏组织电生理特性，对定位消融靶点和改善心律失常治疗具有临床重要性。
Method: 开发了一种基于图神经网络的框架，在二维平面上的合成心电信号 (synthetic electrogram signals) 上训练，用于识别与心脏消融相关的感兴趣区域，并通过少样本微调 (few-shot fine-tuning) 将其应用于二维弯曲表面。
Result: 在合成数据上，单斑块纤维化、快速去极化和高兴奋性检测的平均精确率分别为 0.96、0.97 和 0.95；模型能够泛化到二维弯曲表面。
Conclusion: 作者指出该框架尚需进一步开发以用于 PVC 消融的临床应用。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Auxiliary Task Discovery for Stable Reinforcement Learning in Stock Trading
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has gained increasing attention as a data-driven approach for stock trading. However, learning a policy that is both profitable and stable remains challenging due to non-stationary market behaviour and noisy reward signals. Auxiliary tasks are often used to improve representation learning and stabilize training, yet they are usually designed manually and depend heavily on prior assumptions about targets and prediction horizons. Such fixed designs may not remain suitable across changing market regimes. In this work, we propose a self-supervised framework that automatically discovers auxiliary tasks to support reinforcement learning for stock trading. The auxiliary tasks are formulated as General Value Functions so that their predictions enrich the learned state representation and assist policy optimization. The framework consists of two networks. The main network learns the trading policy along with the auxiliary predictions, while the secondary network generates the definitions of auxiliary tasks through learned cumulants and discount factors. These tasks are updated using a meta gradient mechanism that accounts for their long-term impact on trading performance and improves training stability. We evaluate the proposed approach across four major equity indices: DJI, FTSE, Sensex, and TAIEX. The empirical results demonstrate that automatically discovered auxiliary tasks lead to more robust learning and improved trading performance compared to existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自监督辅助任务发现框架，用于股票交易中的强化学习。辅助任务被建模为一般价值函数 (General Value Functions)，由次级网络通过学习的 cumulant 和折扣因子自动生成，并用元梯度 (meta gradient) 机制更新以提升训练稳定性。在 DJI、FTSE、Sensex 和 TAIEX 四个主要股指上的实验表明，自动发现的辅助任务相比基线能带来更稳健的学习和更好的交易表现。
Motivation: 强化学习用于股票交易时面临非平稳市场行为和噪声奖励信号，难以学习既盈利又稳定的策略。现有辅助任务通常手工设计，依赖对目标和预测时域的先验假设，难以适应变化的市场机制。
Method: 提出双网络框架：主网络学习交易策略并输出辅助预测，次级网络通过可学习的 cumulant 和折扣因子生成辅助任务定义；辅助任务以 General Value Functions 形式表达，并用元梯度机制更新，以考虑其对交易表现的长期影响并改善训练稳定性。
Result: 在 DJI、FTSE、Sensex 和 TAIEX 四个主要股指上的实证结果显示，自动发现的辅助任务带来更稳健的学习，并相对现有基线提升了交易表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自动发现辅助任务比手工设计更适合股票交易强化学习，能够提升稳健性和交易性能；摘要未报告具体数值或消融细节。

papers.title: How Many Samples Are Needed to Determine Causal Direction? Sharp Minimax Bounds for Bivariate LiNGAM
papers.abstract_en: We study how many observations are needed to determine the causal direction between two linearly related variables. Classical LiNGAM theory shows that independent non-Gaussian disturbances identify the direction, but does not quantify the difficulty when the causal effect is weak or the disturbances are nearly Gaussian. Let $β$ bound the absolute structural coefficient from below, let $ν$ measure each standardized disturbance's distance from Gaussianity, and let the disturbance scales lie in $[\underlineσ,\overlineσ]$. We prove the sharp local minimax law \[ N_2^\star(β,ν,δ) \asymp \frac{\log(1/δ)} {d_β^2+β^2ν^2}, \qquad d_β= \left[β^2- \left(1-\frac{\underlineσ^2}{\overlineσ^2}\right)\right]_+. \] Previous theory established population identifiability or assumed a fixed separation between the two directions. By contrast, we establish the sharp sample complexity as a joint function of edge strength, distance from Gaussianity, and scale uncertainty, and characterize when identification comes from non-Gaussian dependence or from covariance alone. The proof was independently generated with GPT-5.6 Sol in Codex's Ultra mode during a two-hour session. The human author supplied the prompt and was responsible only forchecking the proof and revising and polishing the manuscript.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在双变量线性关系中，需要多少观测样本才能确定因果方向。经典 LiNGAM 理论保证独立非高斯扰动可识别方向，但没有量化因果效应较弱或扰动接近高斯时的困难程度。作者证明了一个尖锐的局部极小极大样本复杂度定律 N_2^*(β,ν,δ) ≍ log(1/δ)/(d_β^2+β^2ν^2)，其中样本复杂度同时依赖于结构系数下界、与高斯性的距离以及扰动尺度不确定性。摘要还说明该证明由 GPT-5.6 Sol 在 Codex Ultra 模式中独立生成，人类作者负责提出提示、检查证明并修改文稿。
Motivation: 经典 LiNGAM 理论只建立总体可识别性，或假设两个方向之间存在固定分离，未回答当因果效应弱或扰动接近高斯时样本需求量如何变化。该问题对实际因果发现中的可靠性与实验成本估计至关重要。
Method: 定义 β 为结构系数绝对值下界、ν 为每个标准化扰动与高斯性的距离、扰动尺度位于 [σ̲,σ̄]，并刻画 d_β = [β^2 - (1 - σ̲^2/σ̄^2)]_+。在此基础上证明双变量 LiNGAM 因果方向判断的尖锐局部极小极大样本复杂度，并区分识别来自非高斯依赖性还是仅仅来自协方差信息。
Result: 摘要给出精确的样本复杂度标度 N_2^*(β,ν,δ) ≍ log(1/δ)/(d_β^2+β^2ν^2)，说明所需样本量随置信度 1-δ、边强度 β、非高斯程度 ν 和尺度比 σ̲/σ̄ 的联合变化规律。
Conclusion: 该结果为双变量线性因果方向识别提供了联合依赖边强度、非高斯距离和尺度不确定性的尖锐样本复杂度刻画。作者特别声明证明由 GPT-5.6 Sol 独立生成，人类作者仅负责提示设计、证明检查与稿件修订。

papers.title: Schema-Agnostic Graph Reasoning Agent for Hybrid Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Tool-calling LLM agents navigate unfamiliar codebases with a handful of generic primitives for listing, reading and searching files (ls, cat, grep). A knowledge graph admits the same interface: listing neighbours, reading node content and searching descriptions are the same operations on a different substrate. Building on this correspondence, we present GRA, a Graph Reasoning Agent that explores hybrid knowledge graphs, whose nodes are either textual concepts or relational tables, with seven generic tools, discovering everything domain-specific at run time. On UFK-M (Unified Factory Knowledge Model), an industrial benchmark of 258 analytical questions whose gold answers are produced by executing validated SQL programs, GRA beats a full-context agent by 5.1 pp (88.4% vs. 83.3%), while reading under a third of its input tokens. A graph-free control shows the gain comes chiefly from selective agentic access rather than graph topology, and that the effect depends on a model able to drive tools reliably. Seeing less, the agent answers better: selective navigation over a structured substrate beats exhaustive context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GRA (Graph Reasoning Agent)，一个以七个通用工具探索混合知识图谱 (hybrid knowledge graphs) 的智能体；图谱节点既可以是文本概念也可以是关系表，所有领域特定信息都在运行时发现。在 UFK-M 工业基准（258 个分析性问题，金标答案由执行验证过的 SQL 程序生成）上，GRA 以 88.4% 对 83.3% 超越全上下文智能体 5.1 个百分点，且只读取不到三分之一的输入 token。去除图结构的对照实验表明收益主要来自选择性的智能体访问而非图拓扑，并且依赖模型可靠驱动工具的能力。
Motivation: 工具调用的 LLM 智能体可以用少量通用原语（ls, cat, grep）导航陌生代码库；知识图谱也提供相同的接口——列出邻居、读取节点内容、搜索描述是同一组操作。作者希望基于这种对应关系构建一个无需预先了解图模式、在运行时发现领域信息的图谱推理智能体。
Method: 提出 GRA，用七个通用工具实现对混合知识图谱的选择性导航：列出邻居、读取节点内容与搜索描述等操作，节点类型包括文本概念和关系表，领域特定的一切都在运行时发现，而不是静态注入或全量上下文。
Result: 在 UFK-M 基准上，GRA 达到 88.4%，比全上下文智能体的 83.3% 高 5.1 个百分点，同时输入 token 阅读量不足后者的三分之一。图无关控制实验显示收益主要来自选择性智能体访问而非图谱拓扑，且该效果依赖一个能可靠驱动工具的模型。
Conclusion: 作者总结为“看得更少，回答得更好”：在结构化基板上的选择性导航优于穷举式上下文，支持用轻量通用工具而非全量图上下文来驱动知识图谱问答。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: The Authority Resolution Framework: A Five-Domain Ontology for Governing Who and What Decides, at Scale
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems become increasingly capable of autonomous action, determining whether an agent is technically capable of performing an action is insufficient: the system must also determine whether the action is authorised in its context. This paper introduces the Authority Resolution Framework (ARF), a five-domain ontology for representing and resolving authority across organisational roles and informal influence, business concepts, codified processes, machine-readable permissions and executable systems, and external real-world context. ARF defines the Authority Relation (AR) as a cross-domain primitive binding an actor, action, object, bounded context, justification chain, and a calibration measure termed the DNA-Coefficient, which captures divergence between documented authority structures and authority as practiced. The framework provides a machine-interpretable representation of authority provenance and scope, with JSON-LD representations and knowledge-graph query patterns for authority resolution. ARF is designed to support AI agents in determining the provenance, scope and contextual validity of authority before executing consequential actions. The framework positions authority resolution as a knowledge-representation and reasoning problem at the intersection of ontology engineering, semantic AI, agentic AI and AI governance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出权威解析框架（Authority Resolution Framework, ARF），一个五域本体，用于表示和解析组织角色与非正式影响、业务概念、编码流程、机器可读权限与可执行系统、以及外部现实世界语境中的权威。框架定义权威关系（Authority Relation, AR）作为跨域原语，绑定行动者、行动、对象、有界上下文（bounded context）、理由链（justification chain）和称为DNA-Coefficient的校准度量。ARF提供JSON-LD表示和知识图谱查询模式，目标是让AI智能体在执行关键行动前判断权威的来源、范围与上下文有效性。
Motivation: 随着AI系统自主行动能力增强，仅判断一个智能体在技术上能否执行某行动并不够，系统还必须判断该行动在其语境中是否被授权。这促使作者将权威解析建模为知识表示与推理问题，而不是单纯的能力判定问题。
Method: 提出ARF五域本体，并定义Authority Relation作为跨域原语，包含actor、action、object、bounded context、justification chain以及度量文档化权威结构与实际运行中权威差异的DNA-Coefficient。框架给出机器可解释（machine-interpretable）的权威来源与范围表示，包括JSON-LD表示和知识图谱查询模式。
Result: 摘要未报告实验评估或定量结果；本文的成果主要是概念框架、本体定义及表示模式本身，以及将其定位为语义AI与智能体AI交叉问题的理论贡献。
Conclusion: 作者将权威解析定位为知识表示与推理问题，处于本体工程、语义AI、agentic AI与AI治理的交叉点，强调AI智能体在执行有后果的行动前应校验权威的provenance、scope与contextual validity。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CardiacMamba: Fair and Robust RGB-RF Fusion for Remote Heart Rate Estimation via State Space Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact heart rate (HR) monitoring from facial videos, but RGB-only methods are vulnerable to illumination changes, motion artifacts, and skin-tone-dependent optical reflectance. We propose CardiacMamba, a fair and robust RGB-RF fusion framework that integrates optical facial cues and radio-frequency cardiac motion cues through state space modeling. CardiacMamba introduces a Temporal Difference Mamba Module (TDMM) to enhance subtle RF temporal variations, a bidirectional SSM-based interaction mechanism to align heterogeneous RGB-RF dynamics, and a Channel-wise Fast Fourier Transform (CFFT) module for channel-domain spectral refinement. On the EquiPleth dataset, CardiacMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance with 0.96 bpm MAE, 3.06 bpm RMSE, and 0.97 Pearson correlation, while reducing the observed light-dark skin-tone MAE gap to 0.26 bpm and maintaining robustness under RGB degradation and RF-missing conditions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CardiacMamba，一个基于状态空间建模 (state space modeling) 的 RGB-RF 融合框架，用于从面部视频进行远程心率估计。该方法通过 Temporal Difference Mamba Module (TDMM) 增强 RF 信号的细微时间变化，以双向 SSM 交互机制对齐异构的 RGB 与 RF 动态，并用 Channel-wise Fast Fourier Transform (CFFT) 进行通道域频谱精炼。在 EquiPleth 数据集上，CardiacMamba 以 0.96 bpm 的 MAE、3.06 bpm 的 RMSE 和 0.97 的 Pearson 相关系数达到最先进水平，并将深浅肤色的 MAE 差距缩小到 0.26 bpm。
Motivation: 仅依赖 RGB 的远程光电容积描记 (rPPG) 方法易受光照变化、运动伪影以及肤色依赖的光学反射影响，导致心率估计在公平性和鲁棒性上不足。本文希望通过融合射频 (RF) 心脏运动线索来解决这一问题。
Method: 提出 CardiacMamba 融合框架，包含 Temporal Difference Mamba Module (TDMM) 以增强 RF 时间变化，双向 SSM 交互机制以对齐 RGB-RF 异构动态，以及 Channel-wise Fast Fourier Transform (CFFT) 模块进行通道域频谱精炼。
Result: 在 EquiPleth 数据集上，该方法取得 0.96 bpm 的 MAE、3.06 bpm 的 RMSE 和 0.97 的 Pearson 相关系数；深浅肤色 MAE 差距降至 0.26 bpm，并在 RGB 退化与 RF 缺失条件下保持良好的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过状态空间建模融合 RGB 与 RF 信号，可以在远程心率估计中同时改进准确性、肤色公平性以及对输入模态缺失的鲁棒性。

papers.title: MITE-Net: SWaP-Optimized 4K Video Tiny Target Perception for Embodied Edge SAR
papers.abstract_en: Real-time tiny target perception in high-resolution imagery is critical for embodied Search-and-Rescue (SAR) missions. However, strict Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) constraints on edge devices like UAVs create a bottleneck: traditional image downsampling causes severe feature loss, while slice-based processing incurs prohibitive latency. To address this gap, this paper introduces a comprehensive framework encompassing a novel architecture, specialized datasets, and hardware-level benchmarks. First, we propose MITE-Net, a SWaP-optimized cascaded architecture, which couples a bio-inspired, learning-free Tiny Target Motion-Based Region Proposal Network (TTM-RPN) with a sub-0.14M-parameter R-CNN-like head. Second, to standardize 4K tiny target evaluation, we construct the SAR-Tiny Datasets by relabeling two challenging UAV datasets: SeaDroneSee-Tiny (dynamic maritime scenes, tiny targets predominantly of 64-256 pixels ) and UAVID-Tiny (cluttered urban scenes, extremely tiny targets, less than 64 pixels). Third, we benchmark against state-of-the-art YOLO models on an edge device, NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier, where MITE-Net directly processes 4K maritime imagery, achieving a 100\% search success rate at 30.33 FPS. Consuming merely 3.19 W (9.51 FPS/W), MITE-Net vastly outperforms YOLO baselines in target recall and energy efficiency. Conversely, UAVID-Tiny evaluations expose a compound structural limitation: the learning-free bionic front-end struggles against urban backgrounds, while the ultra-lightweight head lacks representational capacity for complex features. Ultimately, this work delivers an efficient onboard perception paradigm and a rigorous baseline guiding future end-to-end SAR architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向具身搜救 (SAR) 场景中的边缘设备，提出 SWaP 优化的级联架构 MITE-Net，用于 4K 视频下的微小目标感知。该架构将无学习的仿生微小目标运动区域提议网络 (TTM-RPN) 与参数量低于 0.14M 的 R-CNN-like 头部耦合；同时构建了 SAR-Tiny Datasets（由 SeaDroneSee-Tiny 与 UAVID-Tiny 重标注而成）并在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier 上给出硬件级基准。摘要报告在海事 4K 图像上达到 100% 搜索成功率、30.33 FPS、3.19 W 功耗（9.51 FPS/W），明显优于 YOLO 基线；但在 UAVID-Tiny 上暴露出结构性的局限。
Motivation: 高分辨率图像中的实时微小目标感知对具身搜救任务至关重要，但边缘设备（如 UAV）严格的尺寸、重量与功耗 (SWaP) 约束形成瓶颈：传统下采样造成严重特征损失，而基于切片 (slice-based) 的处理则带来难以接受的延迟。
Method: 提出一个包含架构、数据集与硬件基准的综合框架：一是 MITE-Net 级联架构，耦合无学习的仿生 TTM-RPN 与超轻量 R-CNN-like 检测头；二是通过重标注 SeaDroneSee-Tiny 和 UAVID-Tiny 两个 UAV 数据集得到 SAR-Tiny Datasets，用于标准化 4K 微小目标评测；三是在边缘设备上对 SOTA YOLO 模型进行对比基准测试。
Result: 在海事场景的 SeaDroneSee-Tiny 上，MITE-Net 直接处理 4K 图像，实现 100% 搜索成功率、30.33 FPS，功耗仅 3.19 W（9.51 FPS/W），在目标召回率与能效上大幅优于 YOLO 基线；而在城市场景的 UAVID-Tiny 上，无学习仿生前端难以应对城市背景，超轻量头部也缺乏表达复杂特征的能力。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种高效的机载感知范式，并为未来端到端 SAR 架构建立了严格的基准；同时摘要明确指出了其复合结构性局限，即仿生无学习前端在城市场景中表现不佳，且轻量头部表达能力有限。

summary_sections.motivation: 高分辨率图像中的实时微小目标感知对具身搜救任务至关重要，但边缘设备（如 UAV）严格的尺寸、重量与功耗 (SWaP) 约束形成瓶颈：传统下采样造成严重特征损失，而基于切片 (slice-based) 的处理则带来难以接受的延迟。
summary_sections.method: 提出一个包含架构、数据集与硬件基准的综合框架：一是 MITE-Net 级联架构，耦合无学习的仿生 TTM-RPN 与超轻量 R-CNN-like 检测头；二是通过重标注 SeaDroneSee-Tiny 和 UAVID-Tiny 两个 UAV 数据集得到 SAR-Tiny Datasets，用于标准化 4K 微小目标评测；三是在边缘设备上对 SOTA YOLO 模型进行对比基准测试。
summary_sections.result: 在海事场景的 SeaDroneSee-Tiny 上，MITE-Net 直接处理 4K 图像，实现 100% 搜索成功率、30.33 FPS，功耗仅 3.19 W（9.51 FPS/W），在目标召回率与能效上大幅优于 YOLO 基线；而在城市场景的 UAVID-Tiny 上，无学习仿生前端难以应对城市背景，超轻量头部也缺乏表达复杂特征的能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种高效的机载感知范式，并为未来端到端 SAR 架构建立了严格的基准；同时摘要明确指出了其复合结构性局限，即仿生无学习前端在城市场景中表现不佳，且轻量头部表达能力有限。

papers.title: A Cognitively Motivated Multidimensional Framework for Evaluating Metaphor Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Current evaluation of metaphor explanations relies mainly on holistic quality ratings, revealing little about how explanation quality is structured or where human judgments agree and diverge. We introduce a cognitively motivated framework that decomposes metaphor explanation quality into six theoretically grounded dimensions. In a dense annotation study (11,200 ratings), we find that: {\bfseries(i)} explanation quality is genuinely multidimensional; {\bfseries(ii)} annotator disagreement is systematic rather than random; and {\bfseries(iii)} the six dimensions collapse into a shared cluster and two independent axes of judgment. An exploratory feasibility study further shows that a standard automatic evaluation pipeline can recover parts of this structure, predicting the most discriminative dimensions well while its errors correlate human (dis)agreement. Together, these results suggest that multidimensional evaluation offers richer diagnostic insight than holistic ratings, and that automatic evaluators for open-ended generation tasks should be judged on how well they preserve the structure of human judgment.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个认知动机的多维框架，将隐喻解释质量分解为六个有理论依据的维度，并通过密集标注研究（11,200 条评分）发现解释质量真正多维、标注者分歧是系统性而非随机的，且六个维度可坍缩为一个共享聚类和两个独立判断轴。探索性可行性研究表明，标准自动评估管线能部分恢复该结构，能较好预测最具判别力的维度，同时其预测误差与人类的（不）一致相关。
Motivation: 现有隐喻解释评估主要依靠整体质量评分，难以揭示解释质量的结构，也无法说明人类判断在何处一致或分歧。
Method: 引入一个认知动机的多维评估框架，将隐喻解释质量分解为六个理论维度，并设计密集标注研究（11,200 条评分）来检验其结构；随后用探索性可行性研究考察标准自动评估管线能否恢复该多维结构。
Result: 标注研究表明解释质量是多维的，标注者分歧具有系统性；六个维度可以归为一个共享聚类和两个独立判断轴。自动评估实验显示标准管线能较好预测最具判别力的维度，且其错误模式与人类判断的（不）一致相关。
Conclusion: 作者认为多维评估比整体评分提供更丰富的诊断信息，并主张对开放式生成任务的自动评估器应依据其保留人类判断结构的程度来评判。

papers.title: Second-Moment Memory in Coordinatewise Adam
papers.abstract_en: Adam retains a moving average of past squared gradients in its denominator, but the optimization cost of this memory is not well understood. We show that second-moment memory can itself suppress progress toward the optimum even under finite-variance stochastic gradients. For a simple two-point oracle, the expected positive normalized update is $O(M_2^{-1/2})$ after an initialization transient, where $M_2=(1-β_2)^{-1}$ is the second-moment memory length. We convert this directional bound, under the stated memory and stepsize scaling, into an average-stationarity lower bound of the same order on a smooth convex problem with normalized gap, smoothness, and variance. Long second-moment memory can slow optimization even when the gradient noise has finite variance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Adam 优化器中二阶矩记忆（second-moment memory）对收敛速度的影响，指出即使梯度噪声具有有限方差，较长的二阶矩记忆本身也可能阻碍向最优点的进展。对简单两点预言机（two-point oracle），作者证明初始化暂态后期望正归一化更新量为 O(M_2^{-1/2})，其中 M_2=(1-β_2)^{-1}；并在指定的记忆与步长缩放下把该方向性界转换为光滑凸问题上同阶的平均驻点（average-stationarity）下界。
Motivation: Adam 在分母中保留过去平方梯度的移动平均，但这种记忆的优化代价尚不清楚；本文要回答即使在有限方差随机梯度下，二阶矩记忆是否也会拖慢收敛。
Method: 采用简单两点预言机模型，刻画二阶矩记忆长度 M_2 对期望正归一化更新量的影响；随后将该方向性下界在给定记忆与步长缩放下转化为光滑凸问题（含归一化间隙、光滑度和方差）的平均驻点下界。
Result: 得到期望正归一化更新量与平均驻点指标均为 O(M_2^{-1/2}) 的低界，表明长二阶矩记忆即使面对有限方差梯度噪声也会减缓优化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调长二阶矩记忆可以独立于梯度噪声方差而拖慢优化进程；论文为 10 页的理论结果，结论限定在所给的记忆与步长缩放及问题设定下。

papers.title: QuantumPhaseNet: A Gauge-Covariant Geometric and Quantum-Spectral Theory of Semantic Concept Hierarchies with Prototype Validation of a Classical Quantum-Inspired Model
papers.abstract_en: We present QuantumPhaseNet, a gauge-covariant geometric and quantum-spectral extension of Transformer representations. Context-dependent semantic states are modeled as complex amplitudes; a covariant phase rate induces a semantic wavelength used as a proxy for conceptual scale; and low-frequency graph modes define a document-level discourse direction. The theoretical part establishes local gauge invariance, unitarity of the quantum block, boundedness and conditional stability of WavePhase Attention, and a calibratable hallucination-risk formulation. We also implemented a fully offline Validation Studio for the classical quantum-inspired pipeline in Section 14.1 and evaluated the five research questions in Section 16.1 on its built-in synthetic setting (n=240, observation noise 0.22, circuit noise 0.08, five seeds). RQ1 yielded a wavelength-hierarchy Spearman correlation of 0.852 versus 0.707 for the baseline, 87.3% direction accuracy, and AUC 0.953. RQ2 achieved discourse alignment 0.933 versus 0.589 and 41.2 versus 16.2 paragraphs before drift. RQ3 achieved AUROC 0.881 versus cosine 0.765 and phase-shuffle 0.536. RQ4 achieved error-detection AUROC 0.854 versus entropy 0.634, with Brier 0.150 and ECE 0.098. RQ5 did not show quantum advantage: target probability and end-to-end cost efficiency were 25.5% and 0.107, compared with 70.7% and 0.707 for the Chebyshev classical approximation. These results provide initial synthetic evidence for the classical quantum-inspired components, but not external validity or unconditional quantum speedup.
papers.comment: [PAGES] pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Extends arXiv:2602.14419 (WavePhaseNet). Includes prototype validation with an offline Validation Studio; RQ5 reports a negative result for quantum advantage
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QuantumPhaseNet，一种将 Transformer 表示扩展为规范协变 (gauge-covariant) 几何与量子谱理论的方法。上下文相关的语义状态被建模为复振幅，协变相位率诱导语义波长作为概念尺度代理，低频图模态定义文档级话语方向。理论部分建立了局部规范不变性、量子块的幺正性、WavePhase Attention 的有界性与条件稳定性，以及可标定的幻觉风险公式。作者用离线 Validation Studio 在合成设置 (n=240) 上评估五个研究问题，给出经典量子启发组件的初步合成证据，但 RQ5 未显示量子优势。
Motivation: 现有 Transformer 表示缺少对语义概念层级的结构化几何描述，量子启发模型也缺乏理论保证与可复现验证。作者希望用规范协变几何和量子谱框架统一语义层级、概念尺度与文档级话语结构，并明确检验是否存在量子优势。
Method: 提出 QuantumPhaseNet：将语义状态编码为复振幅，用协变相位率定义语义波长作为概念尺度代理，用低频图模态定义文档级话语方向；理论上证明局部规范不变性、量子块幺正性与 WavePhase Attention 的稳定性。实现完全离线的 Validation Studio，在合成数据 (n=240, 观测噪声 0.22, 电路噪声 0.08, 五个种子) 上评估五个研究问题。
Result: RQ1 的波长层级 Spearman 相关为 0.852 (基线 0.707)，方向准确率 87.3%，AUC 0.953；RQ2 话语对齐 0.933 对 0.589，漂移前段落数 41.2 对 16.2；RQ3 AUROC 0.881，优于余弦 0.765 与相位打乱 0.536；RQ4 错误检测 AUROC 0.854 (熵基线 0.634)，Brier 0.150，ECE 0.098；RQ5 未显示量子优势：目标概率 25.5% 对 Chebyshev 经典近似的 70.7%，端到端成本效率 0.107 对 0.707。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结果为经典量子启发组件的初步合成证据，不提供外部效度 (external validity) 或无条件量子加速；量子优势在 RQ5 中被报告为负结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlowDance: Music-Driven Dance Video Generation with Parallel Pose and RGB Streams
papers.abstract_en: Music-driven dance video synthesis aims to animate a reference person according to a given music clip. The task is challenging because it requires a model to jointly learn music-to-motion correspondence, identity-preserving human animation, temporal coherence, and visually realistic video generation. We present FlowDance, a music-driven dance video generation framework that integrates explicit motion modeling with reference-preserving visual synthesis through parallel pose and RGB streams. We further introduce timestep-aware pose injection to adapt structural guidance across denoising steps and persistent identity injection to preserve the reference appearance over long video. To support this task, we further build a popularity-curated, high-resolution in-the-wild dance video dataset with synchronized music, RGB videos, 3D body motion, camera parameters, and projected 2D pose annotations. Extensive experiments show that FlowDance achieves strong performance in both dance motion generation and music-driven dance video synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowDance，一个音乐驱动的舞蹈视频生成框架，通过并行姿态流 (pose stream) 和 RGB 流 (RGB stream) 整合显式运动建模与参考人物保持的视觉合成。方法引入时间步感知的姿态注入 (timestep-aware pose injection) 和持久身份注入 (persistent identity injection)，并构建了一个带同步音乐、RGB 视频、3D 人体运动、相机参数和 2D 姿态标注的高分辨率野外舞蹈视频数据集。实验表明其在舞蹈动作生成和音乐驱动的舞蹈视频合成上均表现良好。
Motivation: 音乐驱动的舞蹈视频合成需要同时学习音乐到动作的对应、保持人物身份的人体动画、时间一致性和视觉真实感，现有模型难以在长视频中兼顾这些需求。
Method: 提出双流架构 FlowDance，并行处理姿态流与 RGB 流，分别负责显式运动建模和参考保持的视觉合成；并设计时间步感知的姿态注入以在不同去噪步骤中调整结构引导，以及持久身份注入以在长视频中保持参考外观。同时构建一个经过流行度筛选的高分辨率野外舞蹈视频数据集，包含多模态标注。
Result: 摘要报告 FlowDance 在舞蹈动作生成和音乐驱动的舞蹈视频合成任务上均取得强性能，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为并行姿态与 RGB 流结合两种注入机制能够同时提升运动质量与视觉合成效果，并提供了配套数据集以支持该任务。

papers.title: RLCascadeRouter: Quality-Estimator-Free Cascade Routing via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: The growing ecosystem of large language models (LLMs) offers huge potential to optimize performance-cost trade-offs. However, their heterogeneous capabilities and inference costs make efficiently routing queries a significant challenge. Existing paradigms are inflexible: one-shot routers commit before observing responses, whereas conventional cascades stop adaptively but follow a fixed model order. Cascade routing removes both restrictions by reconsidering whether to stop or invoke another model after each response. Current methods use a predict-then-optimize pipeline estimating response quality and future model utility. However, prediction loss for quality or utility is not equivalent to routing-decision loss. A lower prediction error does not necessarily yield a better action; a small boundary-crossing error can reverse a ``stop'' or model-selection decision. Therefore, we propose RLCascadeRouter, a quality-estimator-free framework that formulates cascade routing as a Markov decision process with actions comprising ``stop'' and model selection. It uses trajectory returns and advantages to directly optimize the performance-cost objective. Its Cascade Policy Network models candidate complementarity for model selection and remaining-action value for stopping, eliminating independent post-hoc response-quality estimators. Evaluated across ten LLMRouterBench benchmarks with thirteen LLMs, RLCascadeRouter outperforms strong baselines and achieves superior performance-cost trade-offs. It incorporates unseen models without retraining, and ablation studies validate both policy components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RLCascadeRouter，一种无需质量估计器 (quality-estimator-free) 的级联路由框架，将级联路由建模为马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP)，动作包含“停止”和“选择下一个模型”。它利用轨迹回报和优势函数直接优化性能-成本目标，并通过 Cascade Policy Network 同时建模候选模型互补性和剩余动作价值。在十个 LLMRouterBench 基准和十三个 LLM 上的评估显示其优于强基线，且无需重新训练即可纳入未见过的模型。
Motivation: 现有级联路由方法采用 predict-then-optimize 流程，先估计响应质量和未来模型效用，但预测损失并不等同于路由决策损失：预测误差小不一定带来更好动作，边界附近的微小误差就可能反转“停止”或模型选择决策。此外，一次性路由器在选择前提交、固定顺序级联又缺乏自适应性，难以灵活权衡性能与成本。
Method: 提出无质量估计器的强化学习框架，将级联路由形式化为包含“停止”和模型选择两类动作的 MDP，直接以轨迹回报和优势函数优化性能-成本目标。其 Cascade Policy Network 对模型选择建模候选模型互补性，对停止决策建模剩余动作价值，从而消除独立的事后响应质量估计器。
Result: 在十个 LLMRouterBench 基准、十三个 LLM 的评估中，RLCascadeRouter 优于强基线，取得更好的性能-成本权衡；消融实验验证了两个策略组件的有效性，并且能够在不重新训练的情况下纳入未见过的模型。
Conclusion: 作者强调直接针对路由决策损失进行优化、去除独立质量估计器可以改善级联路由的性能-成本平衡；方法在 LLMRouterBench 上验证，并支持对未见模型的零重训练扩展。

papers.title: KOALA: Koopman Operator Learning for WiFi-Based Anticipatory Hum
papers.abstract_en: WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) has emerged as a privacy-preserving alternative to cameras for human pose estimation. However, existing approaches treat pose inference as an instantaneous regression problem and do not model temporal dynamics, making future motion prediction infeasible. Naively applying vision-based prediction methods compounds the estimation noise already present in CSI-derived poses, as autoregressive rollouts amplify errors at every step. We propose KOALA, the framework for human motion prediction directly from WiFi CSI, by lifting noisy CSI-derived pose sequences into a learned Koopman latent space where nonlinear dynamics become linear, enabling multi-horizon prediction via simple matrix-vector products without autoregressive iteration or error accumulation. A residual CSI-conditioned operator resolves the identity attractor problem inherent from Koopman formulations, and an anchor-delta prediction head eliminates the degenerate shortcut of copying the current pose across all horizons. To regularise the lifting and operator jointly, we introduce a Koopman Anchored Latent (KAL) loss that operates in the temporal-encoder feature space, enforcing dynamical consistency across prediction horizons without requiring contrastive, spectral, or auxiliary losses. Experiments on MM-Fi and WiPose show that KOALA achieves robust, consistent performance across both short- and long-term prediction horizons, outperforming all baselines by a substantial margin.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KOALA，一个直接从 WiFi CSI 进行人体运动预测的框架。该方法将含噪的 CSI 姿态序列提升到学习得到的 Koopman 潜空间，使非线性动态在该空间中线性化，从而通过简单的矩阵-向量积实现多时域预测，无需自回归迭代或误差累积。在 MM-Fi 和 WiPose 上的实验表明，KOALA 在短期和长期预测时域上均超越所有基线。
Motivation: 现有基于 WiFi CSI 的姿态估计将推理视为瞬时回归问题，未建模时间动态，因而无法预测未来运动；而直接套用基于视觉的预测方法会放大 CSI 姿态中的估计噪声，自回归滚动传播会在每一步累积误差。
Method: KOALA 将含噪的 CSI 姿态序列提升到学习得到的 Koopman 潜空间，使非线性动态近似线性，并通过矩阵-向量积完成多时域预测。为避免 Koopman 公式固有的恒等吸引子问题，引入残差 CSI 条件算子；为消除跨时域复制当前姿态的退化捷径，设计 anchor-delta 预测头；并提出 Koopman Anchored Latent (KAL) 损失在时间编码器特征空间联合正则化提升与算子。
Result: 在 MM-Fi 和 WiPose 数据集上，KOALA 在短期和长期预测时域上均表现稳健一致，大幅优于所有基线。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，学习 CSI 姿态序列的 Koopman 潜表示能够在不依赖自回归迭代的情况下实现稳定的多时域人体运动预测，并避免误差累积。

papers.title: From Generation to Matching: A Development Report on Personalized Chinese Handwriting
papers.abstract_en: This paper documents a frozen engineering project on personalized Chinese handwriting. The project started from approximately 200 real handwriting images from one user, covering 197 unique Chinese characters, and was initially formulated as few-shot generation of unseen characters. A sequence of canonical-centered personalization routes repeatedly exposed the same conflict: increasing structural pressure made outputs more canonical, while increasing personalization could damage identity-defining strokes. The project was therefore reset around real-human character equivalence classes. A multi-writer CASIA candidate pool showed that a USER-compatible realization often already existed among valid human samples. The task consequently changed from synthesis to character-wise matching, followed by cross-writer composition into a virtual writer. The frozen system uses real-ink features, character-specific human population percentiles, top-20 candidate pruning, and greedy hardest-first whole-row selection. On the covered target set, all 197 USER characters had real-human candidates, and the 100-character evaluation subset was covered 100/100. Knowncharacter held-out comparisons included a row judged visually almost indistinguishable from genuine USER handwriting. A 60- episode stability audit placed every episode in a predefined A-like machine-proxy region, but these were not independent human A-level judgments. The final evidence supports stable practical B-level quality, with many outputs approaching A-level under the USER-defined criterion. The report records why generation became unnecessary for this case without claiming unrestricted or universal handwriting synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一份关于个性化中文手写工程的冻结项目报告，记录了任务从少样本生成 (few-shot generation) 转向字符级匹配 (character-wise matching) 的过程。项目以约 200 张真实手写图像、197 个独特汉字为起点，尝试多条以标准字形为中心 (canonical-centered) 的个性化路线，但反复遇到结构压力与个性笔画保真之间的冲突，于是改用真实人类字符等价类方案。冻结系统利用真实墨迹特征、字符级人群百分位、top-20 候选剪枝以及贪心 hardest-first 整行选择，最终在覆盖的目标集上实现全部 197 个字符都有真实人类候选。
Motivation: 个性化手写生成中，增强结构规范性会使输出更接近标准字形，而增强个性化则可能破坏具有身份特征的笔画，两种目标长期冲突；作者因此重新审视任务设定，质疑生成在真实人类样本池存在时是否必要。
Method: 将生成问题重构为字符级匹配：在多书写者 CASIA 候选池中寻找与目标用户等价的真实人类样本，再通过跨书写者组合 (cross-writer composition) 构建虚拟书写者；系统采用真实墨迹特征、字符特定人群百分位数、top-20 候选剪枝和贪心 hardest-first 整行选择。
Result: 在覆盖的目标集上，197 个 USER 字符全部找到真实人类候选，100 字符评估子集覆盖 100/100；已知字符保留对比中有一行被人工评判为与真实 USER 手写几乎无法区分；60 集稳定性审计均落在预定义的类 A 机器代理区域，但并非独立人工 A 级判定。
Conclusion: 作者强调最终证据支持稳定的实际 B 级质量，许多输出在 USER 定义标准下接近 A 级；本报告只记录对该案例而言生成不再必要，不声称通用或无条件的手写合成能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pricing the Risk of Runtime Compression: Anytime-Valid Admission and a Served-Output Law for Compressed Serving State
papers.abstract_en: Runtime compression of serving state trades quality for capacity with no priced guarantee: systems adapt precision on load signals with no soundness statement, and certified approaches budget request-level risk by a union bound over a pre-declared event count. We show the union budget exhausts on every long request in a production serving stack (100% of requests), and replace it with an anytime-valid, physically accounted ledger whose bound holds at every one of 352,333 admission calls on live traffic and which, in a pre-registered held-out confirmatory round, halves the exact-fallback rate at matched risk (0.30 -> 0.14) -- coverage is bought at a price the account states. We then price the remaining distance from the certified witness to what a user experiences: a machine-checked design law (TV <= tanh(a_q w_thr)) turns the served-TV target into a threshold knob, and a three-layer audit of its instantiation -- an operator-norm query envelope measured 1.5x from tight, a measured-ellipsoid replacement for the Cauchy-Schwarz ball that buys nothing (0.89x, held-out sound), and the gate's operating point (~700x) -- localizes the entire 1064x gap to the operating point, a price the law now states rather than an unknown. A priced bound is worth nothing on a request one has not seen, so the third link is the quantifier: exchangeable extrapolation across 80 serving histories replaces binary conformal prediction's vacuous certificates with order-statistic bounds that discriminate (0.41 against 0.51 calibration risk). All probabilistic kernels are Lean 4-checked (228 exported theorems, no sorry); which object deserves this machinery at all is settled empirically in a companion paper that adjudicates -- and rejects -- the natural alternative of certifying routing. What ships is an account: risk you can spend, a gap you can read off a law, and a bound that survives the request you have not seen.
papers.comment: 29 pages (20 pages main text plus appendices), 8 figures, 10 tables. Companion paper: "What to Protect When You Quantize a Mixture of Experts", submitted concurrently. Lean 4 development (228 exported theorems, no sorry) and all artifacts released
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究运行时压缩（runtime compression）服务状态的代价问题，指出传统基于预先声明事件数的联合界（union bound）预算会在生产服务栈的每个长请求上耗尽（100%），并提出一种随时有效（anytime-valid）且物理计账的替代方案，其界在 35 万多次准入调用上均成立，并在预注册的留出确认轮中将精确回退率在匹配风险下减半（0.30 到 0.14）。随后论文用一个机器验证的设计律 TV ≤ tanh(a_q w_thr) 将已认证证明到用户实际体验之间的差距定价为阈值旋钮，并用可交换外推（exchangeable extrapolation）取代二元共形预测的空洞证书。全部概率核经 Lean 4 验证（228 条导出定理，无 sorry）。
Motivation: 运行时压缩以质量换取容量，但系统通常根据负载信号自适应调整精度，缺乏带定价的保证；既有认证方法通过预先声明事件数的联合界来预算请求级风险，而该预算在实际生产栈的每个长请求上都会耗尽，因此需要一种在任何时刻都成立、物理可核算的边界。
Method: 用随时有效的物理计账账本替代联合界预算，保证在实时流量上的每一次准入调用都成立；提出机器验证的设计律 TV ≤ tanh(a_q w_thr) 将 served-TV 目标转为阈值旋钮，并通过三层审计（算子范数查询包络、实测椭球替代 Cauchy-Schwarz 球、门控工作点）将整个 1064 倍差距定位到工作点；第三环是用 80 条服务历史上的可交换外推给出顺序统计量界。
Result: 联合界预算在长请求上 100% 耗尽；新账本在 352,333 次准入调用上均成立，预注册留出轮中精确回退率在匹配风险下从 0.30 降到 0.14。算子范数查询包络距离紧致界 1.5 倍，实测椭球替代仅 0.89 倍且留出验证可靠，门控工作点贡献约 700 倍，从而把 1064 倍差距全部归因于工作点；可交换外推的校准风险为 0.41，优于二元共形预测的 0.51。
Conclusion: 论文强调最终交付的是一个账本：可支出的风险、可从律中读出的差距，以及能覆盖未见请求的边界；全部概率核经 Lean 4 机器检查，而针对路由进行认证这一替代方案在伴随论文中被实证裁决并否定。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 联合界预算在长请求上 100% 耗尽；新账本在 352,333 次准入调用上均成立，预注册留出轮中精确回退率在匹配风险下从 0.30 降到 0.14。算子范数查询包络距离紧致界 1.5 倍，实测椭球替代仅 0.89 倍且留出验证可靠，门控工作点贡献约 700 倍，从而把 1064 倍差距全部归因于工作点；可交换外推的校准风险为 0.41，优于二元共形预测的 0.51。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文强调最终交付的是一个账本：可支出的风险、可从律中读出的差距，以及能覆盖未见请求的边界；全部概率核经 Lean 4 机器检查，而针对路由进行认证这一替代方案在伴随论文中被实证裁决并否定。

papers.title: A Pre-Specified Construction-Confirmation Test of Operation-Level Causal Transfer Across Finite Isomorphic Symbolic Domains
papers.abstract_en: Behavioral accuracy, linear decodability, and successful activation interventions do not by themselves show that a model carries an operation-level structure from one symbolic domain to another. We ask a narrower question in finite isomorphic state spaces: if the hidden-state difference between two operations is estimated separately for each source input, does adding that difference to a mapped recipient input move the model toward the corresponding recipient answer? The design compares this input-specific intervention with wrong-operation, norm-matched random, and no-op controls, and separates candidate construction from an independently isolated confirmation split. On a frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model at layers 20--21, one route--domain--operation candidate from a family pre-specified and frozen before confirmation access, transparent | integer_mod16--letters16 | successor->predecessor, passed both PyVene splits; its confirmation intersection--union p-value was 0.000198 and its 36-family Holm-adjusted p-value was 0.006943. A subsequent NNsight 0.7.0 experiment, pre-specified and frozen before its confirmation access, tested only this selected prompt route, without candidate or layer reselection. It reproduced all 12 confirmation effect estimates, confidence intervals, and exact sign-flip p-values numerically; its 36-family Holm-adjusted p-value was 0.007141. The result is therefore limited to one prompt route and one candidate, replicated across two intervention implementations on one model revision and one layer interval. It does not establish cross-model generalization, full-family backend independence, domain-general transfer, or algebraic invariance.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, and 4 ancillary CSV files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对有限同构符号域上的操作级因果迁移提出一种预指定 (pre-specified) 的 construction-confirmation 检验设计：分别对每个源输入估计两个操作间的隐状态差值，再将该差值加到映射后的目标输入上，考察模型是否朝对应答案移动。在冻结的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 第 20--21 层上，预指定候选 transparent | integer_mod16--letters16 | successor->predecessor 通过两个 PyVene 分割，并在 NNsight 0.7.0 的独立复现实验中数值复现全部 12 个效应估计和 p 值。作者明确将结论限定为单一提示路径、单一候选、单一模型版本和单一层区间。
Motivation: 行为准确率、线性可解码性和激活干预成功都不能证明模型在不同符号域间携带操作级结构；论文希望回答一个更窄的问题，即操作差值干预能否在有限同构状态空间内产生目标答案方向的因果移动。
Method: 对每个源输入单独估计两操作间的隐状态差值，将其加到经过映射的目标输入上，并与错误操作、范数匹配随机干预及无操作对照进行比较；同时把候选构建与独立隔离的确认分割分开，并在接触确认数据前冻结候选族。
Result: 预指定候选在 PyVene 两个分割上均通过，确认 intersection--union p 值为 0.000198，经 36 族 Holm 校正后为 0.006943；随后 NNsight 0.7.0 复现实验在数值上复现全部 12 个效应估计、置信区间和精确 sign-flip p 值，36 族 Holm 校正 p 值为 0.007141。
Conclusion: 结果仅覆盖一个提示路径和一个候选，并在两个干预实现、一个模型版本和一个层区间上得到复现；论文明确不声称跨模型泛化、全族后端无关性、领域一般性迁移或代数不变性。

papers.title: PWLR: Pairwise Witness Local Rejection for Boundary-Aware Out-of-Distribution Detection
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging for image classifiers, especially when near-OOD samples lie close to in-distribution (ID) class boundaries. Recent vision-language detectors improve OOD detection through class semantics, local prompting, or LLM-generated outlier concepts, but seldom use language as explicit boundary evidence between confusing ID classes. We propose Pairwise Witness Local Rejection (PWLR), which uses an MLLM offline to describe visible local cues that favor one ID class over a specific rival class. These cue phrases are then screened with ID-only data under a frozen vision-language backbone, so that only reliable local verifiers are kept. At inference, PWLR first retains a small set of globally plausible classes, then checks whether any of them is locally supported against its most relevant rivals, and finally combines this pairwise local evidence with the global class score through calibration. Experiments on ImageNet-100 far-OOD, cleaner/challenging OOD and near-OOD benchmarks show that PWLR consistently improves strong vision-language baselines across multiple backbones. Source code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pairwise Witness Local Rejection (PWLR)，一种边界感知的 OOD 检测方法，利用多模态大模型 (MLLM) 离线生成与具体混淆类别相关的局部视觉线索描述，并在冻结的视觉-语言骨干上仅用 ID 数据筛选可靠验证器。推理时先保留全局可能的类别，再用成对局部证据对抗最相关竞争类别，最后通过校准融合局部证据与全局类别分数。实验在 ImageNet-100 far-OOD、cleaner/challenging OOD 和 near-OOD 基准上稳定提升多种视觉-语言基线。
Motivation: 现有基于视觉-语言模型的 OOD 检测器虽然利用类别语义、局部提示或 LLM 生成的概念，但很少将语言作为区分易混淆 ID 类别之间的显式边界证据，导致 near-OOD 检测仍具挑战。
Method: PWLR 使用 MLLM 离线生成偏向某一 ID 类而非其竞争类的可见局部线索短语，接着在冻结的视觉-语言骨干上仅用 ID 数据筛选这些线索，只保留可靠的局部验证器；推理时先保留少量全局可行的类别，再检查每个类别是否得到其最相关竞争类的局部支持，并通过校准将成对局部证据与全局类别分数结合。
Result: 摘要报告在 ImageNet-100 far-OOD、cleaner/challenging OOD 和 near-OOD 基准上，PWLR 在多个骨干上一致改进强视觉-语言基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将语言作为成对类别边界的局部证据可以有效提升近分布 OOD 检测，代码将开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cross-Entropy Risk Estimation for Language Models: Inconsistency Must Be Dense, and the Holdout Method Is No Exception
papers.abstract_en: Language models are compared by their held-out per-token cross-entropy risk---the quantity scaling laws are fitted to. We show that it cannot be consistently estimated. Consistency, or convergence to the estimand, is defined relative to a \emph{possible state of the world}: a pair consisting of a data-generating distribution and a model we turn out to train. Quantifying over models as well as data-generating mechanisms is essential, because what decides whether a model's risk is estimable is a tail property of the distribution its weights induce, which no sample reveals. The per-token cross-entropy risk is hard to estimate because of a topological fact: among the possible states, finite risk and infinite risk each lie arbitrarily close to every instance of the other. Consequently no estimator---not merely the holdout average---is consistent at every state at which the risk is defined. Worse, inconsistent estimation persists under both bounding the expected sequence length and restricting to full-support models; and in that restricted setting the states at which inconsistency occurs are even dense. Two interesting ways out are identified, and neither is free. Way out 1: using a bounded context window, we can floor a model's next-token probabilities, making its risk finite exactly when the data-generating distribution has finite expected sequence length---a new, statistical rationale for a choice that was made on computational grounds, though the assumption it substitutes is itself beyond the reach of any test. Way out 2: reporting the risk only when it falls below a threshold fixed in advance restores consistency, at no cost to what model selection actually requires---but we need to recognize that the goal of estimation is revised.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型逐 token 交叉熵风险（held-out per-token cross-entropy risk）的可估计性问题，证明该风险无法被一致估计。作者将一致性定义为相对于可能的‘世界状态’（数据生成分布与最终训练得到的模型的配对）的收敛，并指出风险可估与否取决于模型权重所诱导分布的一个尾部性质，而样本无法揭示该性质。文中还说明，即使限定期望序列长度有界并限制为全支撑模型，不一致估计仍然存在，且不一致状态在该受限集合中甚至是稠密的。
Motivation: 语言模型通常通过留出集上的逐 token 交叉熵风险进行比较，这也是 scaling laws 所拟合的量；然而该风险是否可被一致估计这一基础问题尚未得到严格回答。作者希望澄清这一估计困难背后的拓扑与统计原因。
Method: 论文采用形式化的统计一致性框架，将估计目标定义为相对于可能世界状态（数据生成分布加训练所得模型）的收敛，并借助拓扑论证（有限风险与无限风险状态彼此任意接近）证明不存在对每个风险有定义的状态都一致的估计量。文中同时考察了两种限制场景，并提出两条‘出路’：有界上下文窗口下对 next-token 概率设置下限，以及仅当风险低于预先设定的阈值时才报告风险。
Result: 摘要给出否定性结论：没有任何估计量（包括 holdout 平均）能在每个风险有定义的状态下一致估计逐 token 交叉熵风险；即使限制期望序列长度有界并限制为全支撑模型，不一致估计依然存在，且在这些受限状态下不一致状态是稠密的。两条出路各有代价：前者引入的假设本身也无法被任何检验证实，后者则改变了对估计目标的理解。
Conclusion: 作者认为逐 token 交叉熵风险的估计困难是本质性的，而非单纯方法问题；要恢复一致性，要么修改模型设定（如有界上下文与概率下限），要么修订估计目标（仅报告低于固定阈值的风险），但两者都不是免费的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KV-Rescue: Recovering Reasoning Language Model KV Eviction Loss via Stepwise Interleaving
papers.abstract_en: KV-cache eviction caps the memory cost of long reasoning traces but is inherently lossy because the model decodes from a partial view of its history. Under aggressive budgets, this not only lowers accuracy but can also cause runaway degeneration, where the model produces incoherent or repetitive tokens until reaching the length limit. We characterize much of this loss as an information gapf caused by missing context, rather than a capability gap caused by limited model capacity. An evicted 7B model and a full-context 1.5B model make complementary errors, and an oracle choice between their answers recovers 79% of the accuracy gap to the full-KV 7B model. Based on this observation, we propose KV-Rescue, a training-free inference framework that bridges the information gap introduced by KV eviction using a lightweight full-context helper. KV-Rescue interleaves reasoning steps from the two models into a shared trajectory. An online detector uses entropy and compressibility to terminate the generation of incoherent or repetitive base-model candidates early. Across five math benchmarks with Qwen2.5-Math 7B and 72B, KV-Rescue recovers an average of 87% of the accuracy lost to eviction at eviction budget B=64. A decode-cost analysis further shows that preventing runaway degeneration cuts base-model token generation by 43% on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对KV缓存驱逐（KV-cache eviction）带来的信息损失问题，提出KV-Rescue，一种无需训练的推理框架，用轻量级全上下文辅助模型与主模型交错推理步骤，以恢复被驱逐的历史上下文。在五个数学基准、Qwen2.5-Math 7B和72B上，平均恢复87%的驱逐准确率损失（预算B=64）。
Motivation: KV缓存驱逐虽能降低长推理轨迹的内存开销，但本质上是有损的，模型只能从历史的部分视图解码；在激进预算下不仅降低准确率，还可能引发失控退化，即生成不连贯或重复的token直到达到长度限制。作者将大部分损失刻画为缺失上下文导致的信息差，而不是模型能力不足造成的能力差。
Method: 提出KV-Rescue，一个无需训练的推理框架，借助轻量级全上下文辅助模型（full-context helper）弥合KV驱逐带来的信息差。KV-Rescue将两个模型的推理步骤交错进共享轨迹，并用在线检测器基于熵和可压缩性（compressibility）提前终止主模型候选生成中不连贯或重复的部分。
Result: 在五个数学基准上，使用Qwen2.5-Math 7B和72B时，KV-Rescue在驱逐预算B=64下平均恢复87%因驱逐损失的准确率。解码成本分析显示，阻止失控退化使主模型token生成平均减少43%。此外，被驱逐的7B模型与全上下文1.5B模型产生互补性错误，oracle选择可将与全KV 7B模型的准确率差距恢复79%。
Conclusion: 作者认为KV驱逐造成的大部分损失源于信息缺口而非模型能力缺口，并通过训练无关的轻量级辅助模型交错推理思路来弥补该缺口，避免额外训练或修改模型。

summary_sections.motivation: KV缓存驱逐虽能降低长推理轨迹的内存开销，但本质上是有损的，模型只能从历史的部分视图解码；在激进预算下不仅降低准确率，还可能引发失控退化，即生成不连贯或重复的token直到达到长度限制。作者将大部分损失刻画为缺失上下文导致的信息差，而不是模型能力不足造成的能力差。
