papers.title: Benchmarking Quantum Machine Learning for Power-System Attack Detection: Evaluation Choices Decide the Outcome Before the Models Do
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning detectors for power-system cyberattacks are themselves attack surfaces, and quantum machine learning has been proposed for them. We benchmark fidelity-kernel SVMs and variational classifiers against six tuned classical models on public power-system attack data (Mississippi State/ORNL), across white-box, transfer, decision-based black-box, and poisoning attacks. Our headline finding is methodological: the benchmark's answers are set by the evaluator's choices before the models. Eight choices -- six in the evaluation protocol, two in the tuning the benchmark itself runs -- each reversed or moved a conclusion at fixed models. The largest is the split: the row-level protocol scores 0.905 macro-F1 where holding whole source files out leaves 0.594, and in the capped matched-dimensionality regime the quantum arm sits within noise of chance with the classical arm 0.024 above it. A fidelity kernel looks most robust until attacked directly (retention 0.886 to 0.064); a mis-fitted surrogate manufactures a 10x asymmetry; an unseeded black-box attack moves 75% between restarts. A positive control explains the accuracy null: the labels, not the pipeline. We give the control that catches each choice and release the seeded benchmark.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables. Code, configs, and seeded pipelines: https://github.com/rzn-git/quantum_grid_attack_detection_benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对电力系统网络攻击检测中的量子机器学习（QML）提出了系统性基准评测，比较保真度核 SVM (fidelity-kernel SVM) 与变分分类器（variational classifiers）在公共电力攻击数据集（Mississippi State/ORNL）上对抗六种经典调优模型的表现，覆盖白盒、迁移、决策型黑盒与投毒攻击。核心结论是方法论的：基准的答案在模型运行之前就已由评估者的选择决定，八项选择（六项在评估协议中、两项在基准自身的调参中）在固定模型下均会反转或改变结论。作者发布了带种子的基准与配套控制。
Motivation: 电力系统的机器学习攻击检测器本身也是攻击面，量子机器学习被提出用于此类任务，但缺乏能回答鲁棒性问题的可信基准；评测协议中的隐性选择可能先于模型决定结论。
Method: 构建一个可复现的基准流水线：在公共电力攻击数据上对比保真度核 SVM、变分分类器与六种经典模型，跨多种攻击场景评测；逐一引入能够捕获每项选择影响的阳性对照（positive control），并发布带种子的代码、配置与流水线。
Result: 摘要报告的最大影响来自数据划分：行级协议给出 0.905 宏 F1，而按源文件整体留出只有 0.594；在有上限的匹配维度设定下，量子一方落在与随机噪声不可区分的水平，经典一方仅高出 0.024。保真度核在受到直接攻击时保持率从 0.886 跌至 0.064；错误拟合的替代模型制造出 10 倍的不对称性；未播种的黑盒攻击在不同重启间有 75% 的变动；阳性对照表明精度空结果源于标签本身而非流水线。
Conclusion: 作者强调基准答案由评估者的协议选择预先决定，而非模型本身；给出能够捕获每类选择的对照实验并发布带种子的基准，呼吁评测结果需报告并控制这些选择。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EgoGazeLite: On-Device Egocentric Gaze Prediction for Token-Efficient Multimodal LLM Video Input
papers.abstract_en: The use of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for egocentric video understanding with wearable devices is constrained by the token budget. Memory and compute cost scale with the number of visual tokens, and high-resolution video quickly becomes expensive to transmit and process at scale. Prior work (GazeLLM) addresses this by cropping the video around the camera wearer's gaze. This reduces the number of visual tokens by about tenfold while maintaining or improving the quality of full-resolution descriptions. However, this compression strategy depends on dedicated eye-tracking hardware, which is unavailable on consumer smart glasses. Building a software-only substitute poses a joint constraint: the predictor must be accurate enough to preserve downstream description quality, yet light enough to run on-device, within the power and compute budget of a smartphone. We address this with EgoGazeLite, a lightweight dual-process gaze predictor for egocentric video. Across two MLLMs, three automated metrics, and two LLM judges, predicted-gaze crops show no significant difference from ground-truth-gaze crops. Equivalence is confirmed in all ten cases. EgoGazeLite achieves this at 15.7M parameters, 6.71 GFLOPs, and runs the full gaze-and-crop pipeline end-to-end in real time (21.6 ms/frame) on consumer accelerator hardware. Together, these results remove the need for eye-tracking hardware for token-efficient, gaze-conditioned egocentric video understanding with MLLMs.
papers.comment: 16 pages. Accepted at the WearableAI Workshop, ECCV 2026 (Archival Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoGazeLite，一种用于第一视角（egocentric）视频的轻量级双过程（dual-process）注视预测器，旨在替代专用眼动追踪硬件，为多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的视觉 token 输入提供 gaze-conditioned 裁剪。该模型仅 15.7M 参数、6.71 GFLOPs，在消费级加速硬件上以 21.6 ms/帧实时运行完整的 gaze-and-crop 流水线。在两种 MLLM、三种自动指标和两个 LLM 裁判下，预测注视裁剪与真值注视裁剪无显著差异，十个案例均确认等价。
Motivation: 多模态 LLM 用于可穿戴设备的第一视角视频理解受 token 预算限制，高分辨率视频在传输和计算上代价高昂。先前方法 GazeLLM 通过围绕佩戴者注视点裁剪视频来减少约十倍视觉 token，但依赖专用眼动追踪硬件，消费级智能眼镜无法提供；软件替代方案需同时满足下游描述质量的准确性和智能手机功耗算力预算内的轻量性。
Method: 提出 EgoGazeLite，一种轻量级双过程注视预测器，用于第一视角视频，并在设备端端到端运行完整的注视检测与裁剪流水线，无需专用眼动追踪硬件。
Result: 模型参数量为 15.7M，计算量为 6.71 GFLOPs，在消费级加速硬件上以 21.6 ms/帧实时运行。在两种 MLLM、三种自动指标和两个 LLM 裁判的评估中，预测注视裁剪与真值注视裁剪在全部十个案例中均显示无显著差异。
Conclusion: 该结果消除了在 token 高效、gaze-conditioned 的第一视角视频理解中依赖眼动追踪硬件的需求。摘要强调其等价性验证覆盖多种模型与评估方式，但未提及超出该设置的其他局限。

summary_sections.motivation: 多模态 LLM 用于可穿戴设备的第一视角视频理解受 token 预算限制，高分辨率视频在传输和计算上代价高昂。先前方法 GazeLLM 通过围绕佩戴者注视点裁剪视频来减少约十倍视觉 token，但依赖专用眼动追踪硬件，消费级智能眼镜无法提供；软件替代方案需同时满足下游描述质量的准确性和智能手机功耗算力预算内的轻量性。
summary_sections.method: 提出 EgoGazeLite，一种轻量级双过程注视预测器，用于第一视角视频，并在设备端端到端运行完整的注视检测与裁剪流水线，无需专用眼动追踪硬件。
summary_sections.result: 模型参数量为 15.7M，计算量为 6.71 GFLOPs，在消费级加速硬件上以 21.6 ms/帧实时运行。在两种 MLLM、三种自动指标和两个 LLM 裁判的评估中，预测注视裁剪与真值注视裁剪在全部十个案例中均显示无显著差异。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该结果消除了在 token 高效、gaze-conditioned 的第一视角视频理解中依赖眼动追踪硬件的需求。摘要强调其等价性验证覆盖多种模型与评估方式，但未提及超出该设置的其他局限。

papers.title: AlloEgo-VLM: Disambiguating Allocentric and Egocentric Reference Frames in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates the challenge of ambiguity faced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in understanding spatial semantics. Spatial cognition, shaped by cognitive psychology, spatial science, and cultural context, often assigns directionality to objects. However, natural language descriptions of spatial relations frequently omit explicit reference frames, leading to semantic ambiguity and potentially serious errors for embodied AI robots. Existing VLMs, due to insufficient training on reference frames and object orientations, often produce inconsistent responses. To address this issue, we construct a new dataset, AlloEgo-View, comprising (image, query, view-specific answer) triplets that capture key object relations from both allocentric and egocentric perspectives. The view-specific descriptions follow a structured spatial representation that annotate detailed scene descriptions, reference and target objects, their orientations, reference frames, and view types. Building on AlloEgo-View, we develop AlloEgo-VLM, a framework to disambiguate allocentric and egocentric reference frames, even under ambiguous queries, and to be easily integrated into existing VLMs via supervised fine-tuning. Furthermore, we deploy our framework onto an embodied robotic platform within NVIDIA Isaac Sim to validate its real-world feasibility in open-ended object searching tasks. Experiments highlight the limitations of current VLMs in handling view-specific queries and demonstrate the strong disambiguation ability of AlloEgo-VLM.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 9 figures. Project page and code available at https://github.com/CKL9001/AlloEgo-VLM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在空间语义理解中的参照系歧义问题，构建了 AlloEgo-View 数据集，包含从外部参照系（allocentric）和自身参照系（egocentric）视角描述物体关系的 (image, query, view-specific answer) 三元组。基于该数据集提出 AlloEgo-VLM 框架，通过监督微调（supervised fine-tuning）使现成 VLM 能在模糊查询下消解参照系歧义，并在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 的具身机器人平台上验证了开放目标搜索任务中的可行性。实验显示当前 VLM 在处理视角特定查询时存在局限，而 AlloEgo-VLM 表现出较强的歧义消解能力。
Motivation: 自然语言中的空间关系描述常省略明确的参照系，导致语义歧义，对具身 AI 机器人可能造成严重错误；现有 VLM 因缺乏参照系和物体朝向的训练而产生不一致响应。
Method: 构建 AlloEgo-View 数据集，使用结构化空间表示标注场景描述、参照物体与目标物体、朝向、参照系和视角类型；提出 AlloEgo-VLM 框架，通过监督微调集成到现有 VLM 中，以消解外部参照系与自身参照系的歧义，并将其部署到 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中的具身机器人平台。
Result: 实验表明当前 VLM 在处理视角特定查询时存在局限，AlloEgo-VLM 展示了较强的歧义消解能力，并在开放目标搜索任务中验证了实际可行性。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过结构化空间表示与视角特定微调数据，可以将参照系歧义消解能力嵌入现有 VLM，并为具身机器人场景提供实用支持。

papers.title: FluxBin: Flexible LUT-based Ultra-low-bit LLM Inference by Algorithm-Kernel Synergy
papers.abstract_en: While binary quantization theoretically promises extreme compression and acceleration for Large Language Models (LLMs), existing research often overlooks the necessity of specialized hardware kernels, thus failing to unleash the full acceleration potential due to persistent reliance on expensive floating-point arithmetic or runtime dequantization overheads. To bridge this gap, we propose FluxBin (\textbf{F}lexible \textbf{L}UT-based \textbf{U}ltra-low-bit e\textbf{X}ecution with \textbf{Bin}ary bases), an algorithm-kernel co-design that synergizes post-training quantization with a highly optimized CUDA kernel. Algorithmically, we introduce Decoupled Row-Column Binary Decomposition to enhance representational capacity while maintaining hardware efficiency, complemented by a Hessian-guided saliency-aware hybrid bases that preserve critical information. At the kernel level, we implement a Lookup Table Building Approach with Scale Fusion to reduce floating-point arithmetic, featuring a Virtual Columnar Mapping that transforms irregular, sparse, and salient matrices into dense execution. Extensive evaluations demonstrate FluxBin achieves up to $5.92\times$ speedup and $10.19\times$ energy savings across diverse model architectures, delivering comparable accuracy to heavily fine-tuned methods. This effectively enables the deployment of 70B-scale models on one single A100 GPU with a $4\times$ memory reduction. Code is available at https://github.com/nicyyyy/FluxBin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FluxBin，一种面向超低比特（二进制基底）大语言模型推理的算法-内核协同设计。算法层面提出解耦行列二进制分解（Decoupled Row-Column Binary Decomposition）与 Hessian 引导的显著性感知混合基底，内核层面实现查找表构建与标度融合（Scale Fusion）以减少浮点运算，并引入虚拟列映射（Virtual Columnar Mapping）将稀疏矩阵转为稠密执行。摘要报告在多种模型架构上实现最高 5.92 倍加速与 10.19 倍能耗节省，内存减少 4 倍，可在单张 A100 上部署 70B 规模模型。
Motivation: 现有二值量化研究常忽视专用硬件内核，仍依赖昂贵浮点运算或运行时反量化开销，未能充分发挥超低比特量化的加速潜力。
Method: 算法上采用解耦行列二进制分解增强表示能力并保持硬件效率，结合 Hessian 引导的显著性感知混合基底保护关键信息；内核上提出带标度融合的查找表构建方法减少浮点算术，并用虚拟列映射将不规则、稀疏、显著矩阵转化为稠密执行。
Result: 摘要显示 FluxBin 在多种模型架构上取得最高 5.92 倍加速和 10.19 倍能耗节省，准确率与经重度微调的方法相当；内存减少 4 倍，使 70B 模型可部署于单张 A100 GPU。
Conclusion: 摘要强调算法与内核协同设计能释放超低比特 LLM 推理的加速潜力并显著降低资源占用，且代码已开源。

papers.title: Quantum Models with Multi-Stage Training for Compositional Concept Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Compositional Concept Generalization (CoCoGen), the ability to systematically recombine learned primitives in novel contexts, is a key challenge for multimodal learning. In this work, we provide a solution using a compositional model of meaning that separates nouns from relations and uses tensors and variational quantum circuits to train them on data. This model enables us to employ a multi stage training paradigm, one that first learns object representations from single-object image-caption pairs, then subsequently transfers these to the relational stage where object parameters are frozen and optimisation is only applied to relational components. This design explicitly enforces compositional factorisation at the circuit, ensuring that relations are learned as transformations over stable primitives. The training paradigm is tested on the CLEVR dataset developed specificially for CoCoGen. For text, we work with vector representations of nouns and higher order tensor representations of relations using a set of different ansatz. For images, we work with quantum encodings of image embeddings dervied from Open AI's Vision Language tool CLIP and contrast amplitude encoding, which preserves the original embedding geometry, with angle encoding, which introduces nonlinear feature transformations. Our results show that multi-staged training combined with structured encodings significantly improves out of distribution relational generalisation, while using orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters than classical baselines. We find that performance gains arise from the interaction between representation and encoding, with nonlinear quantum encodings enhancing the separability of compositional structure. These findings demonstrate that structured quantum representations and staged learning provide an effective framework for compositional generalisation in multimodal quantum machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态学习中的组合概念泛化（CoCoGen）问题，提出一种将名词与关系分离的组合式意义模型，用张量和变分量子电路（variational quantum circuits）进行训练。训练采用多阶段范式，先从单对象图像-标题对学习对象表示，再冻结对象参数仅优化关系组件，从而在电路层面显式施加组合分解。方法在专为 CoCoGen 设计的 CLEVR 数据集上测试，文本端使用名词向量与关系高阶张量表示，图像端使用 CLIP 嵌入的量子编码并比较振幅编码与角度编码。
Motivation: 组合概念泛化（系统性地在新上下文中重组合已学基元）是多模态学习的关键挑战，现有方法难以在数据上有效分离并学习名词与关系的组合结构。
Method: 提出基于张量和变分量子电路的组合式意义模型，并采用多阶段训练：先从单对象图像-标题对学习对象表示，随后在关系阶段冻结对象参数、仅优化关系组件。文本使用名词向量与关系高阶张量表示并采用不同 ansatz；图像使用 CLIP 嵌入的量子编码，对比保留嵌入几何的振幅编码（amplitude encoding）与引入非线性特征变换的角度编码（angle encoding）。
Result: 摘要报告多阶段训练结合结构化编码显著提升分布外关系泛化，且可训练参数比经典基线少若干个数量级；性能提升来源于表示与编码的交互，非线性量子编码增强组合结构的可分离性。
Conclusion: 结构化量子表示与分阶段学习为多模态量子机器学习中的组合泛化提供了有效框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: VARM-Bench: Benchmarking Verifiable Structured Reasoning in Chinese Abusive Speech Moderation
papers.abstract_en: The widespread circulation of abusive online content has increased the need for reliable moderation of Chinese social-media text. Existing Chinese benchmarks support label classification, fine-grained toxicity categorization, and target-aware extraction, but do not provide a unified representation for deterministically verifying the stated basis of a moderation decision. We introduce VARM-Bench, a benchmark for field-anchored chain-of-thought rationales in Chinese abusive-speech moderation. Each instance contains a concise natural-language rationale with explicit anchors for six decisions: target, target type, target explicitness, author stance, harmfulness label, and fine-grained category. Our deterministic protocol evaluates field correctness, target alignment, output validity, complete-record agreement, and hidden record errors conditioned on correct final decisions, without relying on an LLM judge. Under a common structured-output protocol, we evaluate language models across multiple model families using zero-shot prompting, taxonomy guidance, and structured CoT supervision, and analyze lexical-cue sensitivity and field-level errors. Results show that strong label-level performance can conceal substantial errors in complete moderation records. VARM-Bench provides an auditable and reproducible benchmark for evaluating verifiable moderation rationales in Chinese abusive-speech moderation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VARM-Bench，一个面向中文辱骂性言论审核的可验证结构化推理基准。每个实例包含一段字段锚定 (field-anchored) 的自然语言推理链，覆盖目标、目标类型、目标显式性、作者立场、危害标签和细粒度类别六个决策。基准采用不依赖 LLM 评审的确定性协议，评估字段正确性、目标对齐、输出有效性、完整记录一致性及隐藏记录错误。结果发现强标签级性能可能掩盖完整审核记录中的大量错误。
Motivation: 现有中文辱骂性言论基准支持标签分类、细粒度毒性分类和目标感知抽取，但缺乏统一表示来确定性验证审核决策所依据的陈述理由。
Method: 构建 VARM-Bench 基准，为每个实例提供锚定六项决策的简洁推理链，并设计确定性评估协议；在常见结构化输出协议下，使用零样本提示、分类法引导和结构化 CoT 监督评估多个模型家族，并分析词汇线索敏感性与字段级错误。
Result: 实验表明，模型在标签级上的强性能可能掩盖完整审核记录中的显著错误。
Conclusion: VARM-Bench 为中文辱骂性言论审核中的可验证审核推理提供可审计、可复现的基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Underwater Color Restoration with Vanishing Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Underwater color restoration promises to unlock color as a reliable signal for aquatic sciences, but achieving this with scientific confidence remains out of reach. Current methods are validated almost exclusively on an empirical basis, which provides confidence only to the extent that the vast diversity of possible visibility conditions is covered with end-to-end testing using a known ground truth. This is exacerbated by color restoration being a fatally ill-posed problem when considered in full mathematical generality, requiring additional constraints to narrow the solution to a finite uncertainty interval. The gap between which constraints suffice in theory and which constraints are satisfied by real-world data is poorly understood, making it unclear whether existing methods are solving a problem that is actually solvable. In this article, we investigate the theoretical side of this gap, identifying idealized conditions which guarantee bounded uncertainty that converges to zero as the spatial resolution of the camera increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察水下颜色恢复作为科学工具的可靠性问题，指出在完全数学一般性下该问题病态（ill-posed），现有方法几乎仅基于经验验证。作者从理论角度分析约束条件与实际数据之间的差距，识别出保证不确定性有界且随相机空间分辨率提高而收敛到零的理想化条件。
Motivation: 水下颜色恢复有望为水科学提供可靠的色彩信号，但现有方法仅靠经验验证无法覆盖海量可见性条件；同时该问题在完整数学一般性下严重病态，需要附加约束才能将解限定在有限不确定性区间内。理论与实际约束之间的差距未被充分理解，导致现有方法可能尝试求解的并非实际可解的问题。
Method: 从理论侧研究上述差距，形式化识别保证不确定性的理想化条件；在这些条件下，恢复问题的不确定性有界，并随相机空间分辨率提高而收敛到零。
Result: 摘要报告的是理论结果：在识别出的理想化条件下，水下颜色恢复的不确定性有界，且当相机空间分辨率增加时不确定性趋近于零。
Conclusion: 作者指出理论充分约束与实际数据满足的约束之间存在鸿沟，本文仅给出理想化条件下的理论保证；要使颜色恢复具有科学置信度，仍需弥合该差距。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TRACE: Trajectory Aware Reasoning for Multi-Turn Adversarial Conversation Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks have emerged as a critical safety threat to LLMs, as harmful objectives are decomposed across a sequence of apparently benign turns to bypass guardrails. Existing defenses lack the reasoning capacity to identify evolving manipulation patterns, often trading helpfulness for safety by over-refusing benign requests related to sensitive topics. We introduce Trace, a multi-turn defense with trajectory-aware structured reasoning. Before generating each response, the model identifies manipulation cues from the trajectory, evaluates both the benign and adversarial interpretations of user intent, assigns a jailbreak score, and commits to an action: Allow, Caution, or Decline. We curate 4k multi-turn adversarial conversations from five attack frameworks, pair them with 2.4k benign dialogs, and 600 sensitive-but-benign conversations. We train Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with SFT and GRPO under a multi-component reward that jointly optimizes helpfulness on benign prompts and robustness against jailbreak attempts. Across seven multi-turn attack benchmarks, Trace attains an average attack success rate (ASR) of 14.5% against 31.4% for the strongest baseline and 74.9% for the undefended target, while significantly raising the attacker effort required per successful jailbreak. Trace also balances usability and safety, achieving a 93.3% average compliance on over-refusal benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Trace，一种面向多轮对抗对话（multi-turn jailbreak attacks）的 LLM 防御方法。其核心是在每次回复前进行轨迹感知的结构化推理：识别操纵线索、评估用户意图的良性/对抗双重解释、给出 jailbreak 分数，并决定 Allow、Caution 或 Decline。作者在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上结合 SFT 与 GRPO 及多组件奖励训练，在七个多轮攻击基准上平均 ASR 降至 14.5%，同时在过度拒绝基准上保持 93.3% 的平均遵从率。
Motivation: 现有防御缺乏识别跨多轮逐步演变的操纵模式的推理能力，常常通过过度拒绝与敏感话题相关的良性请求来换取安全，损害了有用性（helpfulness）。
Method: Trace 在生成每个响应前执行轨迹感知的结构化推理流程，并输出 Allow/Caution/Decline 动作；训练数据包含来自五种攻击框架的 4k 条多轮对抗对话、2.4k 条良性对话和 600 条敏感但良性对话，使用 SFT 与 GRPO 在联合优化有帮助性和抗攻击性的多组件奖励下训练 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。
Result: 在七个多轮攻击基准上，Trace 平均攻击成功率（ASR）为 14.5%，对比最强基线 31.4% 和未防御目标 74.9%，并显著提高每次成功 jailbreak 所需的攻击者努力；在过度拒绝基准上平均遵从率为 93.3%。
Conclusion: Trace 在安全性与可用性之间取得平衡，既降低了对多轮 jailbreak 的脆弱性，又避免了过度拒绝敏感但良性的请求。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Entropy Is Not Enough: Reclaiming Lost Semantics in LLM Output Length Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Efficient LLM serving is often bottlenecked by the need to pad sequences to a fixed maximum length, and this wastes compute and degrades throughput. Predicting output lengths in advance makes it possible to adopt length-aware scheduling, and this reduces the overhead. This advantage is especially pronounced in long-context reasoning and reinforcement learning applications. Existing approaches, such as entropy-guided token pooling, use token-wise entropy as their primary signal, but they tend to ignore differences in semantic content across tokens. So, important tokens are often underweighted, and tokens carrying little information receive disproportionate emphasis. This hurts the reliability of length prediction. We introduce ESTP (Entropy-and-Semantic Token Pooling), a lightweight framework that addresses this issue by combining entropy with attention-based importance scores. These scores are derived directly from the self-attention weights computed during the LLM prefill phase, and this allows ESTP to capture both uncertainty and semantic importance with minimal additional computation. Since the framework reuses prefill activations, it adds almost no extra memory overhead and introduces only minimal latency. On the ForeLen benchmark, ESTP outperforms baseline methods, achieves better prediction accuracy and lower error rates in most scenarios. When integrated with a length-aware scheduler in end-to-end system tests, it further helps improve overall throughput and reduce the padding ratio. Our results offer a practical and effective building block for length-aware LLM serving systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 服务中因固定最大长度填充（padding）造成的计算浪费问题，提出 ESTP（Entropy-and-Semantic Token Pooling）框架，将 token 级熵与基于预填充阶段自注意力权重得到的语义重要性分数结合，用于提前预测输出长度。摘要称该方法在 ForeLen 基准上取得更好的预测准确率和更低的误差，并能在端到端长度感知调度中提升吞吐、降低填充比例。
Motivation: 现有基于熵引导的 token 池化方法仅以 token 熵作为主要信号，忽略 token 间语义内容差异，导致重要 token 被低估、低信息 token 被过度强调，从而损害长度预测的可靠性。
Method: 提出 ESTP 轻量框架，在预填充阶段复用自注意力权重，将熵与注意力重要性分数（attention-based importance scores）组合，以同时捕捉不确定性和语义重要性；由于复用 prefill 激活，额外内存开销和延迟都很小。
Result: 在 ForeLen 基准上，ESTP 在多数场景下优于基线方法，取得更好的预测准确率和更低的误差率；与 length-aware scheduler 集成后，端到端系统测试显示整体吞吐提升且 padding ratio 降低。
Conclusion: 摘要将 ESTP 定位为长度感知 LLM 服务系统的一个实用且有效的构建模块，其语义与熵结合的思路可改善输出长度预测的可靠性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Agent Gym: A Framework for Continuous Evaluation and Evolution of LLM Agents Through Human-in-the-Loop Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents deployed in production environments face a fundamental tension: the agent's behavior is frozen at deployment time, while the business rules and edge cases it must handle continue to evolve. Existing approaches address agent construction and one-time evaluation but provide no structured mechanism for continuous post-deployment behavioral correction without modifying the agent's source code. Most of the approaches offered in the market, require intense collection of logs and traces, and re-examining the agent design by the engineering team, a process which is heavy, long and negates the economical value of agentic transformation. We introduce Agent Gym, a modular, domain-agnostic framework that wraps any existing LLM-based agent in a continuous evaluation-and-evolution loop. The framework provides six composable capabilities --- Act, Evaluate, Investigate, Correct, Learn, and Observe --- organized across three architectural zones: a constitution layer that codifies domain knowledge in configuration artifacts, a runtime inference pipeline that chains acting, investigation, and adaptive correction, and a learning loop that enables subject matter experts to discover and validate new correction rules through natural language interaction. The key technical contributions include a hybrid deterministic-LLM correction engine with 21 condition operators and three-tier actions, a three-layer investigation architecture for ground-truth-free compliance validation, and a programmatic safety loop that guarantees rule correctness before human approval. We further introduce the Spec-to-Note Gap, an autoencoder-inspired view of agentic system transparency. An open-source reference implementation for invoice processing demonstrates that the framework is fully operational and ready for adoption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agent Gym，一个模块化、领域无关的框架，将任何现存的基于 LLM 的 agent 包装进持续的评估-进化循环中，使其无需修改源代码即可在部署后进行行为纠正。框架提供 Act、Evaluate、Investigate、Correct、Learn、Observe 六个可组合能力，分布在宪法层、运行时推理管道和学习循环三个架构区域。技术贡献包括混合确定性-LLM 纠正引擎、三层调查架构和程序化安全循环，并引入 Spec-to-Note Gap 概念。摘要给出一个开源的发票处理参考实现，表明框架已可运行。
Motivation: 生产环境中的 LLM agent 在部署时行为冻结，而业务规则和边界情况持续演变；现有方法只支持一次性评估，缺乏结构化的持续后部署修正机制，且市场上多数方案需要收集大量日志并让工程团队重新检查 agent 设计，过程繁重、周期长，削弱了 agentic 转型的经济价值。
Method: 提出 Agent Gym 框架，包含六个可组合能力并组织成三个架构区域：宪法层（constitution layer）将领域知识编码为配置工件；运行时推理管道链式执行行动、调查与自适应纠正；学习循环让领域专家通过自然语言交互发现和验证新纠正规则。关键技术包括含 21 个条件操作符和三层动作的混合确定性-LLM 纠正引擎、用于无 ground-truth 合规验证的三层调查架构，以及保证规则在人工审批前正确性的程序化安全循环。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验指标，仅介绍了一个开源的发票处理参考实现，证明框架完全可操作、可供采用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架为持续的后部署行为纠正提供了无需修改 agent 源代码的结构化机制，并具有模块化和领域无关的特点；其范围限于 LLM agent 生产环境的持续演进场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GraniKV: Asymmetric Granularity KV-Cache Paging for Multi-Agent Systems with Long Shared Prefix
papers.abstract_en: Production paged-serving engines apply uniform paging granularity to the KV cache, even though the two regions of a multi-agent workload have opposite storage requirements: a long shared prefix demands contiguity, while the per-request suffix demands fine-grained allocation. We present \textbf{GraniKV}, a KV-cache layer that allocates the shared prefix in a contiguous HOT pool and the suffix in a token-level COLD pool, combined with a per-step dispatcher which selects the appropriate backend among dual backends for each regime (compute-, memory-, or communication-bound). To the best of our knowledge, GraniKV is the first system to apply asymmetric paging granularity to the KV cache of a production paged-serving engine. At $L_p{=}16$\,K shared tokens GraniKV reaches $\mathbf{2.16\times}$, $\mathbf{1.98\times}$, and $\mathbf{1.57\times}$ output-token throughput over the production baseline on Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1, Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2, and Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4. The gain decomposes: cascade attention integration contributes the majority at saturation; the asymmetric storage layer adds $1.05$--$1.15\times$ end-to-end while being what makes the batched-GEMM prefix backend possible at all. Under heterogeneous multi-agent serving with \emph{distinct} prompts of different lengths, the attribution inverts: GraniKV sustains $\mathbf{1.95\times}$ while batch-global cascade collapses to parity --- the storage layer alone carries the win in the regime that motivates the paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GraniKV，一个面向多智能体长共享前缀场景的 KV-cache 层，对生产级分页服务引擎引入非对称分页粒度：共享前缀放入连续 HOT 池，每个请求的后缀放入 token 级 COLD 池，并配一个逐步调度器在计算、内存或通信受限的双后端之间选择。摘要报告在 Lp=16K 共享 token 时，输出 token 吞吐相比生产基线在 Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1、Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2、Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4 上分别提升 2.16x、1.98x 和 1.57x。
Motivation: 生产分页服务引擎对 KV cache 使用统一分页粒度，但多智能体负载的两类区域存储需求相反：长共享前缀需要连续性，而逐请求后缀需要细粒度分配；这种矛盾导致当前方案无法同时满足两个区域。
Method: GraniKV 将共享前缀分配到连续 HOT 池、后缀分配到 token 级 COLD 池，并由逐步调度器为每种状态（计算受限、内存受限或通信受限）选择适当的双后端之一；据作者称这是首个对生产分页引擎的 KV cache 应用非对称分页粒度的系统。
Result: 在共享 token 数 Lp=16K 时，GraniKV 在 Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1、Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2 和 Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4 上较生产基线分别达到 2.16x、1.98x 和 1.57x 输出 token 吞吐；其中级联注意力集成（cascade attention integration）在饱和时贡献大部分增益，非对称存储层带来 1.05–1.15x 端到端提升。在异质多智能体服务（不同长度提示词）下，GraniKV 保持 1.95x，而 batch-global cascade 退化为持平，存储层单独承担主要增益。
Conclusion: 作者强调，在本文所针对的异质多智能体长共享前缀场景中，存储层的非对称分页设计本身是吞吐优势的主要来源，而非级联注意力集成。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 GraniKV，一个面向多智能体长共享前缀场景的 KV-cache 层，对生产级分页服务引擎引入非对称分页粒度：共享前缀放入连续 HOT 池，每个请求的后缀放入 token 级 COLD 池，并配一个逐步调度器在计算、内存或通信受限的双后端之间选择。摘要报告在 Lp=16K 共享 token 时，输出 token 吞吐相比生产基线在 Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1、Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2、Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4 上分别提升 2.16x、1.98x 和 1.57x。
summary_sections.motivation: 生产分页服务引擎对 KV cache 使用统一分页粒度，但多智能体负载的两类区域存储需求相反：长共享前缀需要连续性，而逐请求后缀需要细粒度分配；这种矛盾导致当前方案无法同时满足两个区域。
summary_sections.method: GraniKV 将共享前缀分配到连续 HOT 池、后缀分配到 token 级 COLD 池，并由逐步调度器为每种状态（计算受限、内存受限或通信受限）选择适当的双后端之一；据作者称这是首个对生产分页引擎的 KV cache 应用非对称分页粒度的系统。
summary_sections.result: 在共享 token 数 Lp=16K 时，GraniKV 在 Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1、Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2 和 Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4 上较生产基线分别达到 2.16x、1.98x 和 1.57x 输出 token 吞吐；其中级联注意力集成（cascade attention integration）在饱和时贡献大部分增益，非对称存储层带来 1.05–1.15x 端到端提升。在异质多智能体服务（不同长度提示词）下，GraniKV 保持 1.95x，而 batch-global cascade 退化为持平，存储层单独承担主要增益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，在本文所针对的异质多智能体长共享前缀场景中，存储层的非对称分页设计本身是吞吐优势的主要来源，而非级联注意力集成。

papers.title: PoseAdapter: Dual-Stream 2.5D Controllable Image Generation for Complex Multi-Object Scenes
papers.abstract_en: While Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models have achieved remarkable success, precise spatial and orientational control in multi-object scenes remains a persistent challenge. Existing methods either rely on computationally expensive dense 3D maps or suffer from severe attribute leakage and "cut-and-paste" artifacts. To address these limitations, we propose PoseAdapter, a lightweight framework for high-fidelity 2.5D controllable image generation. Instead of dense spatial maps, it establishes precise spatial-angular anchors using an efficient condition layout: individual object captions, 2D bounding boxes, and 3D angles. To resolve the generative trade-off between strict instance isolation and global coherence, we introduce a Context-Aware Dual-Stream Representation. By injecting local object tokens and relation-enriched scene tokens into the visual stream of modern MM-DiT architectures via parallel masked and unmasked pathways, PoseAdapter eliminates attribute leakage while preserving natural inter-object relationships and scene-level coherence. To support this paradigm, we construct OrientLayout, a high-quality dataset featuring standardized 2.5D annotations and instance-level decoupled semantics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PoseAdapter outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in spatial accuracy, orientational precision, and multi-object visual fidelity. Code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/cyf23/PoseAdapter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PoseAdapter，一种面向复杂多物体场景的 2.5D 可控图像生成轻量框架。它以对象标题、2D 边界框和 3D 角度构成的条件布局替代密集 3D 图，通过上下文感知双流表示 (Context-Aware Dual-Stream Representation) 在 MM-DiT 架构中并行注入局部对象 token 与场景 token，避免属性泄漏并保持多物体关系。作者还构建了 OrientLayout 数据集，实验表明其在空间精度、方向精度和多物体视觉保真度上优于现有最强基线。
Motivation: 现有 T2I 扩散模型在多物体场景中的空间与朝向控制仍具挑战：密集 3D 图计算开销大，且已有方法存在属性泄漏 (attribute leakage) 和“剪切粘贴”(cut-and-paste) 伪影。需要一种高效且高保真的 2.5D 控制方案。
Method: 提出 PoseAdapter 轻量框架，采用稀疏的条件布局（个体对象标题、2D 边界框、3D 角度）作为空间-角度锚点，并引入 Context-Aware Dual-Stream Representation；在 MM-DiT 架构的视觉流中通过并行的掩码与非掩码路径注入局部对象 token 和关系增强的场景 token。同时构建了带标准化 2.5D 标注和实例级解耦语义的 OrientLayout 数据集。
Result: 摘要报告 PoseAdapter 在空间精度、朝向精度和多物体视觉保真度上优于现有最强基线 (state-of-the-art baselines)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PoseAdapter 在避免属性泄漏的同时保持自然对象间关系与场景级连贯性，并宣称代码与数据集将公开。

papers.title: From Generalist to Specialist: A Context-Fusion Framework for Endoscopic Polyp Reporting with a Frozen VLM
papers.abstract_en: Reliable endoscopic polyp reporting requires integrating quantitative lesion sizing, standardized Paris classification, and clinically meaningful morphological description within a single record. General-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) offer a unified interface for image understanding and report generation. Existing specialization strategies, however, typically rely on task-specific models or model-weight adaptation, leaving unresolved how to introduce reliable specialist knowledge while preserving both this unified interface and the VLM's pretrained capabilities. We introduce a context-fusion framework that specializes a frozen general-purpose VLM through both implicit instruction context and explicit transduction context without modifying its pretrained weights. Specifically, a self-supervised polyp encoder retrieves related image-report pairs as explicit, query-specific evidence, while learned continuous specialist tokens provide implicit instruction context shared across cases. Experiments were conducted on 2,056 expert-annotated public endoscopic images. We compared the framework with general-purpose VLMs, task-specific predictors, and weight-adaptation methods to assess specialist performance, unified reporting, and adaptation efficiency. Across numerical, categorical, and report-generation metrics, the proposed framework substantially improved direct frozen-VLM inference and achieved the strongest overall performance among the evaluated methods. It added trainable parameters equal to only 0.006% of the frozen VLM's parameter count. When the top-1 retrieved case carried the correct target category, our framework corrected 70.5% of the errors made by a weight-adaptation baseline. These findings support the context-fusion framework as a lightweight and effective strategy for specialist adaptation of a frozen VLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种上下文融合 (context-fusion) 框架，在不修改预训练权重的前提下，将冻结的通用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 特化为内镜息肉报告生成模型。框架通过自监督息肉编码器检索相关的图文报告对作为显式证据，并用可学习的连续专家 token 提供隐式指令上下文。在 2,056 张专家标注的公开内镜图像上，该方法在数值、分类和报告生成指标上均显著优于直接冻结 VLM 推理，并超过所比较的通用 VLM、任务专用预测器和权重适配方法。
Motivation: 通用 VLM 提供了统一的图像理解与报告生成接口，但现有特化策略通常依赖任务专用模型或权重适配，难以在引入可靠专家知识的同时保留统一接口和预训练能力。作者旨在解决如何在不改动预训练权重的情况下实现可靠的专家级报告生成。
Method: 提出上下文融合框架，通过隐式指令上下文与显式转导上下文 (transduction context) 两种路径特化冻结的通用 VLM：自监督息肉编码器检索相关图像-报告对作为查询特异的显式证据，学习得到的连续专家 token 作为跨病例共享的隐式指令上下文，全程不修改预训练权重。
Result: 在 2,056 张专家标注公开内镜图像上，与通用 VLM、任务专用预测器和权重适配方法相比，该框架显著提升直接冻结 VLM 推理的性能并在整体上取得最强结果；新增可训练参数仅为冻结 VLM 参数量的 0.006%。当检索到的 top-1 图像包含正确目标类别时，框架纠正了权重适配基线 70.5% 的错误。
Conclusion: 作者认为上下文融合框架是一种轻量且有效的冻结 VLM 特化策略，能够在保持统一接口与预训练能力的同时引入专家知识。摘要未讨论明显局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Kozuchi Agent: A Language-Agnostic Open-Weight Agent for Software Repair
papers.abstract_en: Industrial software-engineering teams increasingly need LLM agents that turn bug reports into correct patches, yet benchmark-scale operation adds long horizons, tool-use discipline, context persistence, heterogeneous clusters, and evaluation reuse. We present Kozuchi Agent, a language-agnostic open-weight repair agent and CI-operated evaluation pipeline. Explicit phases, persistent state, deterministic tools, a model-independent action interface, and cross-agent test-time selection make runs auditable and repeatable. With locally hosted Qwen3.5-27B, no fine-tuning, and TTS@8, Kozuchi resolves 374/500 SWE-bench Verified instances on the official evaluator. Unchanged on Multi-SWE-bench Java, the same 27-billion-parameter agent resolves 41/128 instances (32.03%), ranking first among strict open-weight submissions and fourth of 42 overall; on Python it ranks 12th of 135 and first among open-weight systems. Per-phase behavior remains within +/-5 percentage points across languages. Remaining failures mainly reflect semantic correctness, Java-specific harness issues, and selection errors. Across both tracks, results compare favorably with open/local peers by parameter count. Analysis of candidate diversity, selector regret, and patch reliability shows that the remaining gap is primarily semantic correctness and selection rather than edit formatting or proprietary-model access. Operationally, reusable CI stages reduce operator touch-points from five to one across heterogeneous internal clusters.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE '26), Industry Showcase track, Munich, Germany, October 12-16, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Kozuchi Agent，一个语言无关（language-agnostic）的开源权重软件修复智能体，并配套 CI 驱动的评估流水线。系统采用显式阶段、持久状态、确定性工具、模型无关动作接口和跨智能体测试时选择，使运行可审计、可复现。在本地部署 Qwen3.5-27B、无微调、TTS@8 条件下，Kozuchi 在官方评估器上解决 SWE-bench Verified 的 374/500 实例；在 Multi-SWE-bench Java 和 Python 上分别排名开源权重方法第一，整体排名第四（共42）和第十二（共135）。
Motivation: 工业软件工程团队日益需要将 bug 报告转化为正确补丁的 LLM 智能体，但基准规模的操作带来长时程任务（long horizons）、工具使用纪律、上下文持久性、异构集群和评估复用等挑战。
Method: 提出 Kozuchi Agent：一种语言无关的开源权重修复智能体，结合显式阶段划分、持久状态、确定性工具、模型无关动作接口以及跨智能体测试时选择（cross-agent test-time selection），并构建 CI 驱动的可复用评估流水线。
Result: 使用本地 Qwen3.5-27B 且不微调，TTS@8 下在官方评估器上解决 SWE-bench Verified 的 374/500 实例；Multi-SWE-bench Java 上解决 41/128（32.03%），在严格开源权重提交中排名第一、42 个系统中排名第四；Python 上在 135 个系统中排名第十二、开源权重系统排名第一。跨语言每阶段行为差距在 ±5 个百分点以内；剩余失败主要来自语义正确性、Java 特定 harness 问题和选择错误；CI 阶段使操作接触点从五处减少到一处。
Conclusion: 作者认为与开源/本地同规模参数系统相比结果具有竞争力，且剩余差距主要来自语义正确性和选择，而非编辑格式或专用模型访问；该流水线的可审计性和可重复性是其运营优势。

papers.title: ARENA: Automated Red-Teaming for Large Audio Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large audio-language models (LALMs) make it possible to interact with language models through speech, music, and environmental sound, but they also introduce a safety surface that is difficult to expose with text-only red-teaming. We study automated audio-grounded red-teaming, where a text query must remain safe in isolation while the joint text-audio input induces harmful target behavior. We propose ARENA, a closed-loop framework that trains a controller on an independent 2,000case text-audio dataset. MD-Judge supplies training rewards and adaptive search feedback, while a separate, non-adaptive Llama Guard 3 evaluator alone labels final outcomes. On 520 held-out AdvBench objectives, ARENA achieves FDR/PSR of 87.9/100.0%, 71.5/96.3%, 68.1/100.0%, and 75.4/98.5% on Audio Flamingo 3, Qwen2-Audio, MiMo-Audio, and GPTAudio, respectively. Ablations show that feedback-based refinement and audio-variant search substantially improve attack discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型音频语言模型（LALM）的自动化红队测试，提出 ARENA 闭环框架，在文本查询单独安全但文本-音频联合输入可诱发有害行为的情况下，训练控制器生成音频对抗样本。摘要报告在 520 条保留的 AdvBench 目标上，对 Audio Flamingo 3、Qwen2-Audio、MiMo-Audio 和 GPTAudio 分别达到 FDR/PSR 87.9/100.0%、71.5/96.3%、68.1/100.0%、75.4/98.5%。
Motivation: 大型音频语言模型扩展了语言模型与语音、音乐和环境声的交互，但仅用文本红队难以暴露其安全风险；需要针对音频接地输入的攻击面进行自动化红队测试。
Method: 提出 ARENA 闭环框架，在独立的 2000 案例文本-音频数据集上训练控制器；使用 MD-Judge 提供训练奖励与自适应搜索反馈，并用独立的非自适应 Llama Guard 3 评估器仅标注最终结果。
Result: 在 520 条保留的 AdvBench 目标上，ARENA 对 Audio Flamingo 3、Qwen2-Audio、MiMo-Audio、GPTAudio 的 FDR/PSR 分别为 87.9/100.0%、71.5/96.3%、68.1/100.0%、75.4/98.5%；消融实验表明基于反馈的细化与音频变体搜索显著提升攻击发现率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调音频接地红队测试的必要性，并说明基于反馈的细化与音频变体搜索是攻击发现的关键组成部分。

summary_sections.method: 提出 ARENA 闭环框架，在独立的 2000 案例文本-音频数据集上训练控制器；使用 MD-Judge 提供训练奖励与自适应搜索反馈，并用独立的非自适应 Llama Guard 3 评估器仅标注最终结果。
summary_sections.result: 在 520 条保留的 AdvBench 目标上，ARENA 对 Audio Flamingo 3、Qwen2-Audio、MiMo-Audio、GPTAudio 的 FDR/PSR 分别为 87.9/100.0%、71.5/96.3%、68.1/100.0%、75.4/98.5%；消融实验表明基于反馈的细化与音频变体搜索显著提升攻击发现率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调音频接地红队测试的必要性，并说明基于反馈的细化与音频变体搜索是攻击发现的关键组成部分。

papers.title: Catching Hallucinated Citations in Video-LLM Question Answering: A Self-Verification Pipeline and Verifier Ablation Study
papers.abstract_en: Video question answering systems built on vision-language models often produce timestamped claims with high confidence even when unsupported by the cited frame. This deceptive hallucination arises because timestamps imply grounding without ensuring correctness, increasing user trust but not accuracy. We introduce a pipeline that closes this loop. A retrieval-augmented language model drafts answers with per-claim timestamp citations, and each cited frame is independently re-examined before being shown to the user. We compare against a plain baseline and ablate three verification designs, evaluated on both Apple Silicon (MLX) and Google Colab (HF Transformers, CUDA). Directly asking the vision model whether a frame supports a claim fails completely (0% catch rate on 40 claims) due to sycophancy. Blind re-captioning plus a general LLM judge improves results but is unstable, oscillating between 0% and 100% flagged depending on prompt phrasing. Replacing that judge with a small natural language inference model yields a stable, interpretable verifier that catches 79% of fabricated claims on adversarial false-premise questions while leaving true claims untouched. We release the full pipeline, evaluation harness, and implementations for both Apple Silicon and Colab. Code is available at https://github.com/yogesh-iitj/grounded-video-qa.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Video-LLM 问答中时间戳引用导致的虚假幻觉问题，提出一个自我验证流水线：先由检索增强语言模型生成带逐条时间戳引用的答案，再对每个被引用帧进行独立复核后才展示给用户。作者在 Apple Silicon (MLX) 与 Google Colab (HF Transformers, CUDA) 上对比了朴素基线并消融三种验证设计，发现直接询问视觉模型完全失效，盲重述加通用 LLM 评判不稳定，而改用小型自然语言推理 (NLI) 模型后稳定且可解释。
Motivation: 视频问答系统常常即使缺乏帧内容支持也会高置信地给出带时间戳的声明；时间戳暗示了接地真实 (grounding) 却并不保证正确性，从而提升用户信任但未提升准确率，这种欺骗性幻觉需要被捕捉。
Method: 提出闭合循环的验证流水线：检索增强语言模型生成带逐声明时间戳引用的答案，用户看到前每个被引用帧被独立重新检查；并消融三种验证设计——直接询问视觉模型、盲重述加通用 LLM 评判器、盲重述加小型 NLI 模型。
Result: 直接询问视觉模型在 40 条声明上完全失败 (0% 捕获率)，归因于谄媚行为 (sycophancy)；盲重述加通用 LLM 评判器不稳定，标记率随提示措辞在 0% 与 100% 间振荡；改用小型 NLI 模型后，在对抗性假前提问题上捕获 79% 的捏造声明，同时不影响真实声明。
Conclusion: 作者强调用小型 NLI 模型替换通用 LLM 评判器可得到稳定、可解释的验证器，并发布了完整流水线、评估基线与 Apple Silicon/Colab 两套实现。

papers.title: SchurQuant: Groupwise Discrete Optimization for Layer-Wise LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) enables the deployment of large language models under tight memory budgets, but accuracy often collapses at 2-3 bits. Existing backpropagation-free PTQ optimizers have two limitations: group decisions ignore the correction that the remaining continuous suffix can absorb, and discrete refinements typically keep the affine quantization grid fixed. We introduce SCHUROPT, which analytically eliminates the suffix's optimal continuous response, yielding an exact groupwise quadratic with Schur-complement curvature. It then alternates closed-form row-wise scale/zero-point refitting with coordinate descent over integer codes. With the GPTQ objective fixed, SCHUROPT improves mean zero-shot accuracy on 2-bit Qwen3-4B by 11.88 percentage points (pp). At higher precision, however, tighter reconstruction does not consistently improve end-model metrics. SCHURQUANT therefore combines SCHUROPT with quantized-prefix teacher reconstruction, reference-weight regularization, residual-add targets, and teacher-decision token weighting. Across eight Llama and Qwen models, SCHURQUANT achieves the highest mean zero-shot accuracy among the evaluated backpropagation free PTQ baselines, outperforming the strongest baseline by 9.65 pp at 2 bits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无反向传播的权重后训练量化 (PTQ) 优化器提出改进，引入 SCHUROPT 与 SCHURQUANT。SCHUROPT 解析消除剩余连续后缀的最优响应，得到基于 Schur 补的精确分组二次型，并交替做行级尺度/零点重拟合与整数码坐标下降；SCHURQUANT 再结合量化前缀教师重建、参考权重正则、残差加目标和教师决策 token 加权。摘要报告在 2 bit 下显著提升零样本准确率，并在多个 Llama/Qwen 模型上超过既有无反向传播 PTQ 基线。
Motivation: 现有无反向传播 PTQ 优化器在 2-3 bit 低比特下准确率常崩溃，且存在两个局限：分组决策忽略剩余连续后缀可吸收的修正，离散精炼通常固定仿射量化网格。
Method: SCHUROPT 解析消除后缀的最优连续响应，得到具有 Schur 补曲率的精确分组二次型，再交替执行闭式行级 scale/zero-point 重拟合与整数码 coordinate descent；SCHURQUANT 进一步引入量化前缀教师重建、参考权重正则、残差加目标与教师决策 token 加权。
Result: 在 GPTQ 目标固定时，SCHUROPT 将 2-bit Qwen3-4B 的平均零样本准确率提升 11.88 个百分点；但在更高精度下更紧的重建并不一致改善端模型指标。SCHURQUANT 在 8 个 Llama 和 Qwen 模型上取得最高的平均零样本准确率，2 bit 时超过最强基线 9.65 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在低比特 (2 bit) 下，所提出的无反向传播优化方案能显著改善零样本准确率；同时指出更高精度下紧重建收益有限，说明低比特场景才是该方法的主要价值所在。

papers.title: Admission Without Answers: Label-Free Certification and Experience Learning for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Experience-learning agents for optimization modeling improve by storing verified skills, but existing learners admit knowledge by checking against known answers, which real ticket streams do not provide. The natural label-free alternatives are unreliable: on a 300-problem label-blind stream, admitting every executable model poisons roughly one admission in four, while single-instance agreement accepts models that match at one value but differ elsewhere. We propose AdmitOR, an admission gate built on calibrated external behavioral evidence. Candidates from three model families, prompting strategies, and solver stacks are run on instances resampled from an extracted parameter domain; agreement across the resulting value-function traces is summarized by a cross-family clique, and a calibrated threshold returns accept, abstain, or escalate. The preregistered false-discovery criterion holds on calibration data but not on the wild stream. We report this negative result in full and trace most failures to benchmark texts that do not faithfully encode their labeled instances. Comparing four admission judges on one collection of logs inside a state-of-the-art skill learner, AdmitOR raises admission precision to 0.927, against 0.871 for majority vote and 0.726 for execution success, yielding 3.1x and 8.0x fewer poisoned admissions. Its library is the smallest and attains the highest macro accuracy across five public benchmarks, 58.4 against 54.8 for majority vote and 53.9 for the ground-truth-labeled library. The 3.5-point gain over majority vote is supported by a paired bootstrap and survives correction for a host-side anomaly. To our knowledge, AdmitOR is the first label-free admission mechanism designed around an explicitly calibrated false-discovery target. The transfer failure identifies a necessary condition for extending it to wild streams.
papers.comment: Code and data are available at \url{https://github.com/junbolian/AdmitOR}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdmitOR，一个面向 LLM 优化建模经验学习（experience learning）的免标签认证门控。针对真实工单流不提供已知答案的问题，候选模型在从提取参数域重采样的实例上运行，跨模型族的一致性被汇总为交叉族 clique，并用校准阈值输出接受、弃权或升级。在技能学习器日志上 AdmitOR 将准入精度提高到 0.927，库最小且五个公共基准上 macro accuracy 最高（58.4），但预注册的伪发现率标准在真实流上不成立，作者完整报告了这一负结果。
Motivation: 现有经验学习智能体通过对照已知答案来验证技能，而真实 ticket streams 不提供答案。天然的免标签替代方案不可靠：在 300 题的 label-blind 流上，接受所有可执行模型约四分之一被污染，单实例一致只匹配单点值。需要一个基于校准外部证据的免标签准入机制。
Method: 提出 AdmitOR 准入门控：候选模型来自三种模型族、提示策略和 solver stacks，在从提取参数域重采样的实例上运行；用交叉族 clique 汇总 value-function traces 的一致性，并通过校准阈值输出 accept、abstain 或 escalate 三类决策。
Result: 在 SOTA 技能学习器日志上比较四种准入评判，AdmitOR 的准入精度为 0.927，高于多数投票的 0.871 和执行成功的 0.726，受污染准入分别少 3.1 倍和 8.0 倍；其库最小且五个公共基准 macro accuracy 为 58.4（多数投票 54.8，ground-truth 标签库 53.9），3.5 点优势经 paired bootstrap 支持并扛住 host-side anomaly 修正。预注册的伪发现标准在校准数据上成立，但在真实流上不成立。
Conclusion: 作者称 AdmitOR 是首个围绕显式校准的伪发现目标设计的免标签准入机制。迁移失败表明扩展到真实流需要必要条件，即基准文本须忠实编码其标注实例，否则校准无法保持。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Amortised Post-Hoc Explanation with Exact Preservation for Dynamic Graph Anomaly Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection in dynamic graphs underpins financial fraud analysis, intrusion detection, and platform integrity, where automated decisions require human-interpretable justifications. StrGNN, the strongest performer in recent benchmarks, produces no explanation: when an edge is flagged, the analyst receives only a score. Explanation metrics are undefined for StrGNN because no attribution vector exists. This paper closes that gap. We present X-StrGNN, a post-hoc explanation layer that wraps a trained, frozen StrGNN and emits, for every flagged edge, dual attributions: a structural attribution identifying which contextual interactions in the enclosing subgraph drove the decision, and a temporal attribution identifying which historical snapshot carried the signal. Both attributions are multiplicative masks identically one in the unexplained pass, so the layer is an exact pass-through: detection is preserved to machine precision, verified rather than asserted (Delta AUC = 0.0000, Delta AP = 0.0000, Delta P@100 = 0.0000). Attribution costs 0.66 ms per edge, making explanation of an entire alarm list feasible. We conduct the first controlled design study of attribution strategies for this architecture, comparing gradient attribution, per-instance mask optimisation, and amortised parameterisation under one protocol, one budget, and three seeds. X-StrGNN attains the highest stability (0.913) at 268x lower cost than per-instance optimisation, and its temporal attribution (1.601 against a measured random floor of 0.973) is separably better than its ablated control, while per-instance optimisation - the most expensive strategy - falls below that floor. Code, protocol, and per-seed measurements are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态图异常检测器 StrGNN 无法提供解释的问题，提出 X-StrGNN，一个包裹冻结 StrGNN 的后验解释层。它对每条被标记边输出结构归因与时间归因两类乘性掩码，在未解释路径中掩码恒为 1，从而精确保持检测结果。摘要报告检测指标完全不变（Delta AUC/AP/P@100 均为 0.0000），每个边归因耗时 0.66 ms，并首次在该架构上对梯度归因、逐实例掩码优化与摊销参数化等策略进行受控设计对比。
Motivation: 动态图异常检测（如金融欺诈、入侵检测）需要可解释的自动化决策，而近期基准中表现最强的 StrGNN 只输出分数、不产生归因向量，导致对其解释指标无法定义。
Method: 提出 X-StrGNN 后验解释层：为冻结的 StrGNN 每条被标记边生成结构归因（识别包围子图中关键上下文交互）和时间归因（识别承载信号的历史快照），两者为乘性掩码，未解释路径恒为 1 因此是精确直通层；并在同一协议、预算和三随机种子下比较梯度归因、逐实例掩码优化与摊销参数化三种策略。
Result: 检测精度完全保留（Delta AUC=0.0000，Delta AP=0.0000，Delta P@100=0.0000）；归因成本为 0.66 ms/边。X-StrGNN 在稳定性上取得最高值 0.913，且成本比逐实例优化低 268 倍；其时间归因得分 1.601 高于实测随机基线 0.973，而最昂贵的逐实例优化低于该随机基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法以机器精度级别的直通性补齐了 StrGNN 的解释缺口，并认为摊销参数化在稳定性与成本间优于逐实例优化；作者已发布代码、评估协议及逐种子测量结果。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出 X-StrGNN 后验解释层：为冻结的 StrGNN 每条被标记边生成结构归因（识别包围子图中关键上下文交互）和时间归因（识别承载信号的历史快照），两者为乘性掩码，未解释路径恒为 1 因此是精确直通层；并在同一协议、预算和三随机种子下比较梯度归因、逐实例掩码优化与摊销参数化三种策略。
summary_sections.result: 检测精度完全保留（Delta AUC=0.0000，Delta AP=0.0000，Delta P@100=0.0000）；归因成本为 0.66 ms/边。X-StrGNN 在稳定性上取得最高值 0.913，且成本比逐实例优化低 268 倍；其时间归因得分 1.601 高于实测随机基线 0.973，而最昂贵的逐实例优化低于该随机基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该方法以机器精度级别的直通性补齐了 StrGNN 的解释缺口，并认为摊销参数化在稳定性与成本间优于逐实例优化；作者已发布代码、评估协议及逐种子测量结果。

papers.title: A Counterexample to the Tang Zhang Schatten Norm Conjecture and Sharp Positive Results
papers.abstract_en: For $m\geq 2$, let $c_p(m)$ be the all-dimensional best constant in $$ \left\|\sum_{k=1}^m A_k\right\|_p \leq c_p(m)\left\|\sum_{k=1}^m |A_k|\right\|_p. $$ Tang and Zhang conjectured an explicit formula for every finite $p>1$. We disprove the conjecture with two explicit real $2\times 2$ rank-one matrices at $p=3/2$. The comparison is certified by seven strict rational inequalities and, in particular, places the attained ratio above $207/200$, while the conjectured constant lies below $207/200$. On the positive side, we prove the conjectured sharp bound for every family of rank-at-most-one summands when $2\leq p<\infty$, and classify all equality cases. We also prove the corresponding endpoint statement for $p=\infty$. Finally, for arbitrary complex matrices, we establish the conjectured sharp constant in the case $m=2$, $p=4$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Schatten 范数不等式的最佳常数 c_p(m)，即 ||∑A_k||_p ≤ c_p(m)||∑|A_k|||_p。作者用两个实 2×2 秩一矩阵在 p=3/2 处构造显式反例，反驳了 Tang 和 Zhang 对所有有限 p>1 猜测的显式公式；同时证明该猜测在若干情形下依然成立。
Motivation: Tang 和 Zhang 提出一个关于所有有限 p>1 的最佳常数显式公式，该猜想是否成立直接影响相关算子不等式理论；作者试图通过具体反例检验其边界。
Method: 构造两个实 2×2 秩一矩阵作为反例，并用七个严格有理不等式证明反例成立；在正向部分，对秩至多为一的加项族证明 2≤p<∞ 时的猜想最优界并分类等式情形，还处理 p=∞ 端点及任意复矩阵的 m=2, p=4 情形。
Result: 在 p=3/2 时，反例达到的比值高于 207/200，而猜测的常数低于 207/200，从而否证猜想；正向结果则确认了秩一加项族在 2≤p<∞ 下的猜想最优界，以及 p=∞ 和 m=2, p=4 情形的相应结论。
Conclusion: 作者指出 Tang-Zhang 猜想在一般情形不成立，并给出了几类保证猜想结论成立的正向刻画。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RigidBench: Evaluating Rigid-Body Physics in Video Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: Video models are increasingly used to predict what happens next in a scene, yet the metrics commonly used to compare their outputs say little about whether the predicted objects move correctly. Motion, geometry, identity, background stability, and visual similarity can fail independently, but whole-frame scores often mix these errors together. We introduce RigidBench, a simulator-grounded benchmark that compares a generated continuation with a reference rollout from the same initial frame and motion description. Its five rigid-body tasks vary objects, materials, viewpoints, and indoor and outdoor scenes, with per-frame masks, depth, 6-DoF trajectories, and contacts available for scoring. We evaluate eight models on the same 100 examples with ten measurements that keep these aspects separate. The resulting rankings depend strongly on what is measured: no model leads on all ten, and across model means, higher SSIM accompanies larger 3D trajectory error (r = 0.89). RigidBench also includes 5,000 training videos with exact simulator state, which we use to fine-tune and analyze Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B. Full fine-tuning reduces 3D trajectory error by about 20% with almost no change in SSIM, while teacher-forced probes and targeted interventions show that object position is represented throughout Wan's diffusion transformer and used by its denoising computation.
papers.comment: 30 pages, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/swarnim-j/RigidBench. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21649156
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RigidBench，一个基于仿真器 (simulator) 的基准，用于评估视频生成模型对刚体物理 (rigid-body physics) 的建模能力。基准包含五个刚体任务、100 个评测样本和十项分离式指标，分别衡量运动、几何、物体身份、背景稳定性和视觉相似度。作者用该基准评测八个模型，发现排名强烈依赖评测指标，且跨模型均值中 SSIM 越高、3D 轨迹误差越大 (r = 0.89)。基准还附带 5,000 段含精确仿真状态的训练视频，作者以此微调 Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B，使 3D 轨迹误差降低约 20% 而 SSIM 几乎不变。
Motivation: 视频模型常用于预测场景中接下来发生什么，但常用指标无法说明预测物体是否运动正确；运动、几何、身份、背景稳定性和视觉相似度可能独立失效，而整帧分数常把这些错误混在一起。
Method: 提出基于仿真器 (simulator) 的 RigidBench 基准，将生成的后续帧与同一初始帧和运动描述下的参考 rollout 进行比较；五个刚体任务覆盖不同物体、材质、视角以及室内外场景，并提供逐帧掩码、深度、6-DoF 轨迹和接触信息。基准包含 5,000 段带精确仿真状态的训练视频，作者用它们对 Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B 做全量微调，并用 teacher-forced 探测和定向干预分析模型内部表示。
Result: 在相同 100 个样本上对八个模型进行十项指标评测，没有任何模型在所有指标上领先，跨模型均值中 SSIM 与 3D 轨迹误差呈正相关 (r = 0.89)；全量微调将 3D 轨迹误差降低约 20%，SSIM 几乎不变。探测与干预实验表明物体位置在 Wan 的 diffusion transformer 中全程有表示，并参与去噪计算。
Conclusion: 摘要强调视频生成模型的排名强烈依赖于评测维度，需将不同失效模式分开度量；对 Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B 的分析显示物体位置被模型内部表示并用于去噪过程。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MistyPilot: Enabling Social-Robot Control through Multi-Agent LLM Skill Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Programming small social robots from natural-language instructions requires more than invoking isolated APIs. Interactive tasks combine reactive physical behaviors with stateful social behaviors, while existing interfaces often require developers to manually compose APIs into skills, configure their parameters, bind sensor events to skills, and manage task states at runtime. We present MistyPilot, a multi-agent LLM framework that interprets high-level natural-language instructions and orchestrates the corresponding skills on the Misty social robot. A Task Router dispatches each instruction to one of two specialized agents: a Physically Interactive Agent for sensor-triggered robot control and direct skill invocation, and a Social Interaction Agent for dialogue-oriented task-state management and context-dependent multimodal response generation. To improve efficiency, the Social Interaction Agent reuses previously generated results when applicable and invokes full generation otherwise. We evaluate MistyPilot on five component-level suites, with sensor bindings and skill invocations executed on the physical Misty robot, and a preliminary user study with 12 participants. MistyPilot attains high accuracy on routing, sensor-skill binding, task-state parsing, result reuse, and skill extension up to 100 skills, and lower variance than an otherwise identical single-agent baseline, while participants report positive perceptions of usability and interaction quality. The code will be made publicly available via the project page.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 ACVR Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MistyPilot，一个基于多智能体 LLM 的框架，用于将自然语言高层指令编排为 Misty 社交机器人的技能调用。系统通过 Task Router 将指令分派给物理交互智能体或社交交互智能体，后者可复用先前生成结果以提升效率。作者在物理机器人上执行传感器绑定与技能调用，评估了五个组件级测试套件并进行了 12 名参与者的初步用户研究。
Motivation: 小型社交机器人编程通常需要开发者手动将 API 组合成技能、配置参数、绑定传感器事件并在运行时管理任务状态；现有接口难以从自然语言指令直接生成交互式任务，尤其是同时涉及反应式物理行为和带状态的社交行为。
Method: MistyPilot 采用多智能体 LLM 编排：Task Router 将指令分派给两个专门智能体，Physically Interactive Agent 负责传感器触发的机器人控制和直接技能调用，Social Interaction Agent 负责面向对话的任务状态管理和多模态响应生成；社交智能体在适用时复用先前生成结果，否则执行完整生成。
Result: 在五个组件级测试套件上的评估显示，MistyPilot 在路由、传感器-技能绑定、任务状态解析、结果复用以及最高 100 个技能的扩展上达到高准确率，且方差低于完全相同的单智能体基线；12 名参与者的初步用户研究报告了对可用性和交互质量的正面感知。
Conclusion: 作者认为多智能体 LLM 技能编排能够以较低方案方差完成自然语言驱动的社交机器人控制，并计划通过项目页面公开代码。摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Spectral Saliency for Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning (MU) aims to remove the influence of specific training data while preserving model utility. As the name suggests, MU can be viewed as the inverse of learning, using gradient-based updates to reduce the influence of a forget-set by counteracting the previously learned behavior. Recently, Muon, a gradient descent variant, has been introduced. Muon applies spectral magnitude normalization to encourage exploration of rare directions and demonstrates promising performance. Inspired by Muon, we adopt the spectral view for unlearning and propose Spectral Saliency Unlearning (SSU). SSU thresholds weak singular components and updates only those directions supported by a confident unlearning signal. We further provide theoretical justification for this thresholding approach from the perspective of the forgetting-retention trade-off. Experiments across image classifiers, diffusion models, and LLMs demonstrate SSU's effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器卸载（machine unlearning, MU）问题，借鉴 Muon 优化器的谱视角，提出 Spectral Saliency Unlearning (SSU)。SSU 通过阈值化弱奇异分量，仅沿具有置信卸载信号的更新方向进行更新，并从遗忘-保留权衡（forgetting-retention trade-off）角度给出理论依据。实验覆盖图像分类器、扩散模型和大语言模型，验证了该方法的有效性。
Motivation: MU 的目标是在移除特定训练数据影响的同时保留模型效用，通常通过梯度更新来抵消遗忘集（forget-set）之前学到的行为。作者希望引入谱分解视角来改进卸载过程，尤其是在低置信方向上避免无效或有害的更新。
Method: 提出 SSU 方法：对梯度或参数更新进行谱分解，阈值化弱奇异分量，只更新那些由置信卸载信号支持的方向。同时提供关于该阈值化方法在遗忘-保留权衡下的理论解释。
Result: 摘要报告在图像分类器、扩散模型和 LLM 上的实验均显示 SSU 有效，但未给出具体数值或基准细节。
Conclusion: 作者认为从谱角度筛选更新方向能够提升机器卸载的效果，并给出相应的理论依据。摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。

papers.title: ATLAS: Scaffold-Free Algorithm Synthesis by LLMs via Embedding-Guided Quality-Diversity Search
papers.abstract_en: Most LLM-based automated algorithm design methods optimize a designated component within a human-specified scaffold, fixing overall organization and component interactions. We present ATLAS, an embedding-guided quality-diversity framework for scaffold-free full-algorithm synthesis in combinatorial optimization. The problem specification supplies objectives and constraints; a minimal I/O interface fixes only instance and solution formats; the LLM chooses and restructures components, interactions, and control flow. This freedom enlarges the search space, risking invalid candidates and premature convergence to one design region. ATLAS independently detects execution, interface, and feasibility failures, recomputes objectives, and applies error-conditioned repair; similarity-based archive management preserves algorithms across embedding-space regions to counter premature convergence. Its three-layer search refines the best design, gives other regions dedicated refinement opportunities, and performs cross-region synthesis to recombine components and their interactions. Across four NP-hard problems, ATLAS outperforms several state-of-the-art component-synthesis methods and a matched full-synthesis baseline while remaining competitive with strong human-designed algorithms. One ATLAS run retains several algorithms with comparable performance from distinct embedding-space regions rather than a single design. Code inspection finds that these multi-component designs differ in their primary construction or global-search backbone. Our results suggest that embedding-guided quality-diversity search can make the enlarged full-algorithm design space practically searchable. Source code and exact executable prompts are available at <https://github.com/Danial-Yazdani/ATLAS>.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ATLAS 是一个面向组合优化的、基于嵌入引导的质量多样性搜索 (embedding-guided quality-diversity search) 的 LLM 框架，用于无脚手架 (scaffold-free) 的全算法合成。与大多数只优化人定脚手架内单一组件的方法不同，ATLAS 允许 LLM 自行选择并重构组件、交互和控制流，仅由问题规格和最小 I/O 接口约束。框架通过独立检测执行、接口和可行性失败、错误条件修复、基于相似性的存档管理以及三层搜索（精炼最佳设计、给其他区域专门的精炼机会、跨区域合成重组组件）来应对增大的搜索空间和过早收敛。在四个 NP-hard 问题上，ATLAS 优于若干最先进的组件合成方法和匹配的全合成基线，并与强人工设计算法相当。
Motivation: 大多数基于 LLM 的自动算法设计方法只能在人工指定的脚手架内优化某个指定组件，整体组织和组件交互被固定，限制了搜索的灵活性。放开这些约束会扩大搜索空间，带来无效候选和过早收敛到单一设计区域的风险，因此需要新的机制来使这种更大的设计空间可用。
Method: ATLAS 提出嵌入引导的质量多样性搜索框架：问题规格提供目标和约束，最小 I/O 接口只固定实例和解决方案格式，LLM 负责选择和重构组件、交互及控制流。框架独立检测执行、接口和可行性失败，重新计算目标并应用基于错误条件的修复；基于相似性的存档管理保留不同嵌入空间区域中的算法以对抗过早收敛；三层搜索分别精炼最佳设计、为其他区域提供精炼机会并进行跨区域合成以重组组件及其交互。
Result: 在四个 NP-hard 问题上，ATLAS 胜过多种最先进的组件合成方法和匹配的全合成基线，同时与强人工设计的算法保持竞争力。一次 ATLAS 运行会保留多个性能相当但来自不同嵌入空间区域的算法，且代码检查显示这些多组件设计在主要构造或全局搜索骨干上存在差异。
Conclusion: 结果表明，嵌入引导的质量多样性搜索可以使增大的全算法设计空间在实践中可搜索。作者提供源代码和精确的可执行提示。

papers.title: CrossView: Can Vision-Language Models Reason Across Cameras?
papers.abstract_en: Video understanding benchmarks have long centered on single-camera settings, where modern multi-modal language models achieve strong performance across image and video tasks. Yet, the real world runs on multi-camera networks: autonomous vehicles, security systems, and robots all gather data across many simultaneous views. We argue that this is not simply "more" of the single-camera problem; it is fundamentally different. Multi-camera reasoning requires handling context that scales with the number of views, resolving occlusions visible from only a subset of cameras, judging which views matter, and integrating evidence across perspectives that may overlap or diverge. Current models struggle with exactly these challenges, yet no benchmark systematically targets them. We introduce CrossView, a multi-camera video question-answering benchmark spanning autonomous driving, security surveillance, egocentric/exocentric video, and robotics. Evaluation of proprietary models, such as GPT-5.2, and open-source models, like Qwen3-VL, reveals consistently low accuracy, with open-source models trailing by a wide margin. Performance scales strongly with a model's ability to jointly process multiple viewpoints, positioning CrossView as a rigorous benchmark for multi-camera video. We open-source our code and dataset at https://utaustin-swarmlab.github.io/CrossView.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CrossView，一个面向多相机视频问答的新基准，覆盖自动驾驶、安全监控、自我/外部视角视频和机器人场景。对专有模型（如 GPT-5.2）和开源模型（如 Qwen3-VL）的评估显示整体准确率偏低，且开源模型明显落后。作者认为性能与模型联合处理多视角的能力密切相关，并将 CrossView 定位为多相机视频推理的严格评测基准。
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准几乎都在单相机设置下评测，而真实系统（自动驾驶、安防、机器人）依赖多相机网络，需要处理随视角数量增长的上下文、仅部分视角可见的遮挡、视角重要性判断以及重叠或分歧证据的整合。当前模型在这些挑战上表现欠佳，但缺乏系统性基准来刻画这一问题。
Method: 构建并开源 CrossView 基准，包含多相机视频问答任务，覆盖自动驾驶、安全监控、自我/外部视角视频和机器人等场景，并在此基准上评估多类视觉-语言模型，包括专有模型 GPT-5.2 与开源模型 Qwen3-VL。
Result: 摘要报告所有评测模型在 CrossView 上的准确率都较低，其中开源模型与专有模型差距明显；模型性能与其联合处理多个视角的能力强相关。
Conclusion: CrossView 为多相机视频问答提供了系统评测基准，并公开了代码与数据集。

papers.title: EA-LiteUNet: An Edge-Adaptive and Resource-Efficient U-Net for Boundary-Sensitive Dermoscopic Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate boundary delineation remains a persistent challenge in dermoscopic image segmentation because of blurred lesion margins, heterogeneous textures, and complex background artifacts. From a signal-processing perspective, lesion boundaries represent high-frequency components that are highly susceptible to aliasing, noise amplification, and information loss. Consequently, repeated downsampling and feature transformations in conventional convolutional architectures often lead to severely degraded boundary representations. To address these limitations, we propose EA-LiteUNet, an edge-adaptive and computationally efficient U-Net variant specifically designed for boundary-sensitive medical image segmentation. The architecture integrates three core mechanisms: (1) boundary-aware representation learning to suppress aliasing and preserve high-frequency structural details; (2) attention-guided feature modulation to selectively enhance boundary-relevant responses across multi-scale features; and (3) a resource-adaptive inference strategy to dynamically balance segmentation accuracy and computational efficiency. Extensive evaluations across three public dermoscopic datasets demonstrate that EA-LiteUNet consistently achieves superior boundary precision. Specifically, on the ISIC 2018 dataset, the method significantly reduces the 95% Hausdorff Distance (HD95) to 12.89 pixels while maintaining a robust Dice score of 92.08%. Notably, this strong performance is achieved with an ultralightweight configuration of merely 0.29M parameters and 1.17 GFLOPs. Ablation studies further validate the complementary effects of these components, confirming their contribution to enhanced boundary fidelity and stable optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EA-LiteUNet，一种面向边界敏感皮肤镜图像分割的边缘自适应、计算高效的 U-Net 变体。架构结合边界感知表示学习、注意力引导的特征调制和资源自适应推理策略，旨在缓解下采样导致的边界高频信息丢失。在三个公开皮肤镜数据集上取得优于对比方法的边界精度，其中 ISIC 2018 上 HD95 降至 12.89 像素、Dice 达 92.08%，参数仅 0.29M、计算量 1.17 GFLOPs。
Motivation: 皮肤镜图像分割中病变边界模糊、纹理不均且存在复杂背景伪影，边界作为高频成分易受混叠、噪声放大和信息损失影响，传统卷积架构反复下采样会严重退化边界表示。
Method: 提出 EA-LiteUNet，集成三种核心机制：边界感知表示学习（抑制混叠并保留高频结构细节）、注意力引导特征调制（在多尺度特征中选择性增强边界相关响应）、资源自适应推理策略（动态平衡分割精度与计算效率）。
Result: 在三个公开皮肤镜数据集上的评估表明该方法持续获得更优的边界精度；在 ISIC 2018 上将 95% Hausdorff Distance（HD95）显著降至 12.89 像素，并保持 92.08% 的 Dice 分数；模型仅 0.29M 参数和 1.17 GFLOPs。消融研究验证了各组件的互补作用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该轻量 U-Net 架构可在极低参数与计算开销下提升皮肤镜分割的边界保真度，并通过消融证明各机制对稳定优化和边界精度的贡献。

papers.title: From Contexts to Values: Context-Dependent Defeat in Abstract Argumentation
papers.abstract_en: In value-based argumentation, an audience's ordering of values decides which attacks succeed as defeats. In many settings the deciding factor is not the audience but the circumstances: the same attack may succeed at one procedural stage, or under one regulation, and fail at another. Context-dependent argumentation frameworks (CDAFs), a model we recently introduced, capture this directly: one set of arguments, one attack relation, and a defeat function that switches each attack on or off per context, so every context induces an ordinary Dung framework. This raises a reduction question: is context genuinely new, or can one value assignment with per-context orderings reproduce the defeat function, collapsing the CDAF into a VAF? We present a polynomial-time decision procedure for this question and map the harder neighbouring problems, with upper bounds from NP to $Σ^p_3$. We also present a validated reference implementation and a measurement: representability is rare and falls fast with the number of contexts.
papers.comment: Accepted to SAFA workshop at COMMA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究我们近期提出的上下文相关论证框架（context-dependent argumentation frameworks, CDAFs）与价值论证框架（value-based argumentation frameworks, VAFs）之间的可归约性。CDAF 用一个取决于上下文的 defeat 函数在给定攻击关系上按上下文开关每条攻击，每个上下文诱导一个普通 Dung 框架；文中提出一个多项式时间判定程序来判断给定 CDAF 能否被带逐上下文价值排序的 VAF 复现，并把更难的邻近问题映射到从 NP 到 Σ_p^3 的上界。作者还给出经过验证的参考实现，并测量表明可表示性很少见且随上下文数量快速下降。
Motivation: 在价值论证中，受众对价值的排序决定哪些攻击成为 defeat；但许多场景下决定因素是情境而非受众，同一攻击在一个程序阶段或法规下成立、在另一情境下不成立。因此需要检验 CDAF 是否本质上是一种新模型，还是可以被带逐上下文价值排序的单一价值赋值（即 VAF）完全复现。
Method: 提出针对 CDAF 到 VAF 可表示性问题的多项式时间判定程序，并刻画与之相邻的更困难问题，给出从 NP 到 Σ_p^3 的上界；同时开发了一个经过验证的参考实现用于实际判定和测量。
Result: 摘要报告测量结果表明可表示性是罕见的，并且随着上下文数量增加而迅速下降；这为 CDAF 不能被 VAF 简单归约提供了经验证据。
Conclusion: 结论倾向于认为上下文带来的机制是真正的建模新增量，而非 VAF 的简单特例；判定程序与复杂度上界为该归约问题提供了系统解答。

papers.title: L3Cube-IndicQuest v2: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Factual Knowledge of Large Language Models Across Indic Languages
papers.abstract_en: We present L3Cube-IndicQuest v2, a large-scale gold-standard multilingual question-answering benchmark for evaluating the India-specific factual knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs). The benchmark comprises 3,471 curriculum-grounded English question--answer pairs spanning nine domains, curated from educational curricula, competitive examination materials, and domain-specific reference books. We introduce a practical hybrid construction strategy that combines context-grounded LLM-based question generation and validation with semantic deduplication and human verification, enabling scalable creation of benchmark data while preserving annotation quality. The benchmark is translated into 19 Indic languages, yielding a publicly released multilingual dataset of 69,420 question--answer pairs across 20 languages. We evaluate six LLMs under three protocols: LLM-as-a-judge and two deterministic lexical criteria, exact-substring and word-overlap matching. All three produce almost the same model ranking, showing that the results do not depend on the choice of judge. The frontier commercial model leads by a wide margin, and among open-weight models Gemma4 31B outperforms the Indic-specialised Sarvam 30B in every evaluated Indic language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 L3Cube-IndicQuest v2，一个大规模、金标准的多语言问答基准，用于评估大语言模型对印度特定事实知识的掌握。基准包含 3,471 个基于课程内容的英文问答对，覆盖九个领域，并翻译成 19 种印度语言，形成 69,420 对、20 种语言的公开数据集。作者采用基于上下文的 LLM 问答生成与验证、语义去重和人工验证的混合构建策略，并用三种评估协议评测六个 LLM。
Motivation: 现有基准缺乏大规模、高质量、以印度为中心的多语言事实知识评测数据，难以衡量 LLM 对印度特定知识的掌握程度。
Method: 提出混合构建策略，利用上下文相关的 LLM 生成问答对并进行验证，结合语义去重和人工校验以保证质量；随后将数据翻译为 19 种印度语言。评估上使用 LLM-as-a-judge、精确子串匹配 (exact-substring) 和词重叠匹配 (word-overlap) 三种协议来评测六个 LLM。
Result: 三种评估协议产生的模型排名几乎一致，说明结果不依赖于判定器选择；前沿商业模型大幅领先，而在开放权重模型中，Gemma4 31B 在所有被评估的印度语言上均优于印度特化的 Sarvam 30B。

papers.title: DeltaLog: Deferred Materialization of Recurrent States for Linear Attention Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Linear attention models eliminate the quadratic prefix computation and context-growing KV cache of softmax attention by replacing pairwise token interactions with recurrent state updates. However, existing decoding implementations often materialize and write back the full recurrent state after every generated token, making state maintenance a major source of memory traffic, especially for models with large states and many heads. This paper presents DeltaLog, a recurrent-state decoding scheme that reduces this overhead without changing the model semantics. Specifically, DeltaLog represents the recurrent state as a dense base state together with a bounded log of recent compact updates. Most decode steps append only compact update factors to this log, while periodic merge steps fold the accumulated updates back into the dense base state. Thus, the model observes the same dense state as in eager decoding, but most full-state write-backs are replaced by lightweight append operations. We implement DeltaLog for GDN, KDA, and RWKV6 and integrate it into a prototype serving stack. Across these models, DeltaLog accelerates the recurrent-state update kernel by up to $1.86\times$, reduces profiled recurrent-state write traffic by up to $7.83\times$, and achieves $1.05$--$1.20\times$ end-to-end serving speedups over dense recurrent baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对线性注意力模型解码时频繁物化并写回完整循环状态（recurrent state）导致的内存流量开销，提出 DeltaLog 解码方案：将循环状态表示为一个稠密基态（dense base state）加上一个有界的紧凑更新日志（bounded log）。大多数解码步只追加紧凑更新因子，周期性 merge 步骤再将累积更新折回稠密基态，使模型观测到与 eager decoding 相同的稠密状态，但大幅减少全状态写回。在 GDN、KDA 和 RWKV6 上的原型实现中，循环状态更新内核加速最高 1.86×，状态写流量最高减少 7.83×，端到端服务吞吐提升 1.05–1.20×。
Motivation: 现有线性注意力解码实现往往在每个生成 token 后物化并写回完整循环状态，对于状态大、头数多的模型，状态维护成为主要内存流量来源。作者希望在保持模型语义不变的前提下降低这一开销。
Method: 提出 DeltaLog 循环状态解码机制，将状态拆成稠密基态和有界更新日志；普通解码步只做轻量 append 操作，周期性的 merge 步骤把累计更新合并回稠密基态。作者在 GDN、KDA 和 RWKV6 上实现该方法，并集成进一个原型 serving 栈。
Result: 摘要报告，与稠密循环基线相比，DeltaLog 将循环状态更新内核加速最高 1.86×，profiled 循环状态写流量最高降低 7.83×，端到端 serving 提速 1.05–1.20×。
Conclusion: 作者认为延迟物化完整状态、用紧凑更新日志代替频繁全状态写回，可以在不改变模型语义的前提下显著降低线性注意力解码的内存流量并提升端到端性能，且适用于多种线性注意力模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Efficient Audio-Visual Generation via Synchrony-Aware Cross-Modal Sparse Attention
papers.abstract_en: Recent audio-visual generation models can synthesize synchronized video and sound in a unified diffusion process, but their inference cost remains high because long video token sequences require repeated attention computation across denoising steps.A variety of acceleration techniques have been developed for video generation models, including low-bit quantization, attention sparsification, and feature caching.However, since these methods are originally designed for video generation, directly applying them to audio-visual models overlooks the interactions between the audio and video branches and may therefore disrupt audio-video synchronization.We present a synchronization-aware acceleration framework for efficient audio-visual generation.Our key observation is that bidirectional audio-video cross-attention reveals structured interactions between the two branches, with high responses often concentrated on a few sound-related visual and temporal regions.Guided by this interaction pattern, we introduce a protected sparse attention strategy that preserves high-fidelity computation for synchronization-critical tokens while sparsifying redundant attention interactions.By explicitly accounting for cross-modal dependence during acceleration, our method improves inference efficiency while keeping video quality, audio quality, and audio-video synchronization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向高效音视频生成的同步感知加速框架。作者观察到双向音视频交叉注意力中，高响应集中在少量与声音相关的视觉和时间区域，据此设计保护性稀疏注意力 (protected sparse attention)，在保留同步关键 token 高保真计算的同时稀疏化冗余注意力交互。摘要报告该方法在提升推理效率的同时保持视频质量、音频质量和音视频同步。
Motivation: 现有音视频生成模型在统一扩散过程中因长视频 token 序列需反复进行注意力计算而推理成本高昂；已有的视频生成加速技术（如低比特量化、注意力稀疏化、特征缓存）直接套用到音视频模型时会忽略音频与视频分支的交互，可能破坏音视频同步。
Method: 提出同步感知加速框架，基于双向音视频交叉注意力揭示的结构化交互模式，采用保护性稀疏注意力策略：对同步关键 token (synchronization-critical tokens) 保留高保真计算，对冗余注意力交互进行稀疏化，并在加速过程中显式考虑跨模态依赖。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值指标，仅报告该方法在提升推理效率的同时保持视频质量、音频质量与音视频同步。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式建模跨模态依赖进行加速，可在不损害音视频同步的前提下提高推理效率；未讨论明确的局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Guaranteed Adaptive Modality Acquisition: When the Policy Chooses Its Own Calibration Group
papers.abstract_en: A multimodal system may begin inference holding only some of its inputs and may acquire the rest at a cost. With adaptive acquisition, the policy determines which inputs are ultimately observed, so we state the guarantee conditional on that terminal input pattern. Conditional calibration normally assumes the grouping map is fixed independently of the calibration sample, which policy-induced grouping does not satisfy. We characterize when pattern-conditional guarantees remain valid and give two finite-sample constructions: threshold-free routing with calibration applied at the terminal pattern, and simultaneous certification of complete policy-pattern pairs, which lets calibration data select the deployed policy. A counterexample shows that a guarantee proved for a calibration-independent grouping map need not transfer once the policy makes the terminal group calibration-dependent. We call the resulting method RouteCert. On a clinical electrocardiogram task with a staged, cost-ordered lead protocol, the certified policy answers 71.2% of held-out patients at an observed 7.4% disagreement with the cardiologist's diagnosis at 48.8% of the prespecified ordinal cost of acquiring every stage, and all three acquisition stages carry their own certificate. On masked multimodal benchmarks, certifying pointwise at each terminal pattern holds observed worst-pattern selective risk, measured against the full-information reference decision rather than the true label, at 0.034 where a pooled design reaches 0.145 against a 0.10 cap, at a comparable answered fraction (0.350 vs 0.342); under the budget-matched simultaneous comparison the answered fraction falls to 0.305.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Includes appendix with full proofs and additional experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RouteCert，一种在自适应模态获取（adaptive modality acquisition）下保证条件校准的方法。由于策略决定最终观测的输入模态，终端分组依赖于校准样本，常规的固定分组假设不成立。作者刻画了模式条件保证仍成立的条件，给出两种有限样本构造，并通过临床心电图任务和掩码多模态基准验证。
Motivation: 在自适应获取系统中，校准保证通常假设分组映射独立于校准样本固定不变，而策略诱导的分组不满足该假设，导致模式条件风险无法被直接保证。
Method: 给出两种有限样本构造：一种是在终端模式上应用校准的阈值无关路由；另一种是对完整策略-模式对进行同时认证，使校准数据可以选择部署策略。还通过反例说明校准无关分组的保证在策略使终端分组依赖校准数据后不一定可迁移。
Result: 在临床心电图任务中，认证策略以 48.8% 的预设全部阶段顺序成本回答了 71.2% 的留出患者，观察到的与心脏病专家诊断不一致率为 7.4%，且三个获取阶段各有证书。在掩码多模态基准上，逐终端模式认证将观察到的最差模式选择性风险控制在 0.034，而合并设计为 0.145，对照组上限为 0.10，回答比例分别为 0.350 与 0.342；预算匹配比较下回答比例降至 0.305。
Conclusion: 作者强调策略自身选择的校准组需要专门处理，RouteCert 为这种策略依赖分组提供有效的有限样本保证。

papers.title: GLaQ: Grounding Latent Queries in Visual Evidence for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially improved the problem-solving capabilities of multimodal large language models. Fine-grained visual evidence, however, remains difficult to preserve and reuse across text-based reasoning steps. To address this limitation, tool-augmented thinking-with-images methods maintain visual access externally by revisiting or manipulating the image, but require predefined tools and additional inference-time processing. As an internal alternative, continuous visual latent reasoning retains intermediate computation in hidden states. However, its prevailing autoregressive construction makes each latent state depend on its predecessors, so later states may repeat information already present in the latent sequence rather than capture complementary visual details. We introduce GLaQ, a grounded latent-query framework that replaces sequential latent rollout with a fixed set of context-conditioned queries grounded in the original visual tokens. The grounded queries are reinjected for answer generation, providing direct and coordinated access to source visual evidence. We train GLaQ with localized-view supervision followed by reinforcement learning under task-level rewards. Across five benchmarks for fine-grained visual understanding and perception, GLaQ-7B gains 5.99--9.66\% over its base model and leads all compared visual latent methods, suggesting that direct query-to-image grounding can recover localized evidence from the full image without external visual operations or autoregressive latent rollouts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GLaQ，一种用于多模态大模型推理的接地潜在查询框架。GLaQ 用一组固定、上下文条件化的查询替换传统的自回归潜在状态序列，这些查询直接接地到原始视觉 token，并在答案生成时重新注入，以提供对源视觉证据的协调访问。论文在五个细粒度视觉理解与感知基准上报告，GLaQ-7B 相对基座模型提升 5.99–9.66%，并超越所有对比的视觉潜在方法。
Motivation: 多模态大模型的链式推理难以保留和复用细粒度视觉证据；工具增强的思维-含图像方法需要预定义工具与额外推理开销，而连续视觉潜在推理的自回归构造会导致后续潜在状态重复已有信息，而非补充互补的视觉细节。
Method: GLaQ 用一组固定的上下文条件化查询（queries）替代序列式潜在展开，查询直接接地到原始视觉 token，并在答案生成阶段重新注入以提供直接、协调的视觉证据访问。训练采用局部视图监督（localized-view supervision），随后在任务级奖励下进行强化学习。
Result: 在五个细粒度视觉理解与感知基准上，GLaQ-7B 相对基座模型提升 5.99–9.66%，并优于所有对比的视觉潜在方法；这表明直接查询到图像的接地可以在无需外部视觉操作或自回归潜在展开的情况下恢复局部证据。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，直接查询到图像的接地能够在完整图像上恢复局部证据，无需外部视觉工具或自回归潜在展开，为多模态推理中的视觉证据利用提供了一种内部实现途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: UniFed-VLM: Federated Instruction Tuning for Vision-Language Models with Multiple Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in multimodal understanding and generation. However, fine-tuning of VLMs typically relies on centralized data, which raises privacy concerns in certain domains (e.g. healthcare). Federated Learning (FL) provides a natural solution by enabling model training without sharing raw data. However, applying FL to VLM instruction tuning is highly challenging. VLMs have substantial parameter scales, and in real-world scenarios, clients exhibit significant heterogeneity in tasks, modalities, and model architectures. Existing methods mainly focus on simplified settings and are unable to handle such multi-dimensional heterogeneous scenarios. In this work, we study federated instruction tuning under joint heterogeneity in tasks, modalities, and model architectures. We propose UniFed-VLM, a unified federated instruction tuning framework for VLMs that addresses multiple types of heterogeneity. It consists of two key components: 1) Federated Compensated Subspace Aggregation (FedCSA), which performs subspace-aligned aggregation of parameter-efficient adapters with dynamic weighting and compensation to mitigate heterogeneity-induced conflicts; 2) Two-stage Collaborative Distillation (TCoD), which enables effective knowledge transfer across heterogeneous models via a Mutual Distillation Adapter (MDA) and a mixture-of-experts-based distillation strategy. We conduct experiments on multiple benchmark datasets, and the results show that UniFed-VLM achieves stronger average performance across diverse tasks compared with existing FL methods. The source code is available at: https://github.com/wangpengyu2004/UniFed-VLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniFed-VLM，一个面向视觉-语言模型（VLM）联邦指令微调的统一框架，专门处理任务、模态和模型架构三种异质性同时存在的情况。框架包含联邦补偿子空间聚合（Federated Compensated Subspace Aggregation, FedCSA）和两阶段协作蒸馏（Two-stage Collaborative Distillation, TCoD）两个关键组件。在多个基准数据集上的实验显示，相比现有联邦学习（FL）方法，UniFed-VLM 在多样任务上的平均性能更强。
Motivation: VLM 微调通常依赖集中式数据，在医疗等领域存在隐私顾虑；联邦学习虽能避免共享原始数据，但 VLM 参数规模大，且真实场景中客户端在任务、模态和模型架构上存在显著异质性，现有方法仅针对简化设置，无法处理这种多维异质场景。
Method: 提出 UniFed-VLM 框架，由两部分组成：一是 FedCSA，对参数高效适配器（parameter-efficient adapters）进行子空间对齐聚合，通过动态加权与补偿来缓解异质性引发的冲突；二是 TCoD，利用互蒸馏适配器（Mutual Distillation Adapter, MDA）和基于混合专家（mixture-of-experts）的蒸馏策略，实现异构模型间的有效知识迁移。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，相比现有 FL 方法，UniFed-VLM 在多种任务上取得更强的平均性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能够应对任务、模态和模型架构联合异质性下的联邦指令微调，并公开了源代码链接。
Relevance: 0
