papers.title: Who Leads Now? Token-Level Modality Arbitration for Chart-to-Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Chart-to-code generation requires a model to read the fine-grained visual details of a chart and write executable code that reproduces it. Existing chart-to-code methods either train visual and coding abilities separately, or fine-tune on chart-to-code data with the two abilities entangled. Neither strategy accounts for the distinct nature of the two abilities or the interference that arises when they are optimized together. We propose MoCA (Mixture of Cross-modal Arbitration), which separates the two abilities rather than blending them. MoCA is built on Cross-modal Arbitration Block (CAB), which maintains a visual branch and a code branch as two distinct pathways, and a lightweight arbiter that arbitrates their relative contributions at every layer and generated token. We train MoCA in two stages: a supervised warm-up on self-distilled reasoning trajectories that decomposes visual understanding into explicit steps, followed by reinforcement learning with rewards on both the reasoning process and the final code. Analysis shows that the arbiter learns structured rather than arbitrary allocations, with expert contributions varying systematically across tokens, layers, and instances. Across three benchmarks, MoCA delivers competitive performance against general-domain and chart-specialized models. Ablation results show that the gains cannot be attributed to a larger model size alone, but instead arise from the joint contributions of complementary visual and code branch initialization and input-conditioned arbitration through CAB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 chart-to-code 生成任务，提出 MoCA（Mixture of Cross-modal Arbitration）方法，将视觉理解与代码生成作为两条独立路径，并通过轻量仲裁器在每一层和每个生成 token 上动态分配两者贡献。训练分两阶段：先在自蒸馏的推理轨迹上做监督热身，再用强化学习同时优化推理过程和最终代码。摘要报告 MoCA 在三个基准上取得与通用及图表专用模型相当的竞争力，且消融表明收益来自互补分支初始化与输入条件化仲裁，而非单纯模型规模扩大。
Motivation: 现有 chart-to-code 方法要么分开训练视觉和编码能力，要么在 chart-to-code 数据上微调但将两种能力纠缠在一起，都未考虑两种能力的本质差异以及联合优化时产生的干扰。
Method: 提出 MoCA，基于跨模态仲裁块（Cross-modal Arbitration Block, CAB）构建两个独立通路（视觉分支和代码分支），并用轻量仲裁器逐层、逐生成 token 仲裁两者相对贡献；训练采用两阶段：自蒸馏推理轨迹的监督热身，以及同时对推理过程和最终代码给予奖励的强化学习。
Result: 在三个基准上，MoCA 取得与通用域和图表专用模型相当的竞争力；分析显示仲裁器学到结构化而非任意的分配，专家贡献随 token、层和实例变化；消融表明增益不能仅归于更大模型规模，而来自互补分支初始化和经由 CAB 的输入条件化仲裁的共同作用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将视觉与代码能力分离并以输入条件化的 token 级仲裁结合起来，可以有效提升 chart-to-code 生成，且该方法的效果并非来自参数量的增加。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Temporal Logic Guided Universal Task Representations for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Task guided agents demonstrate strong performance in a wide range of complex tasks. However, most existing task representation algorithms are tailored to specific contexts and struggle to generalize across diverse scenarios. Moreover, they typically depend on gradient signals from reinforcement learning controllers to update their weights, which can degrade both representation quality and learning efficiency. To overcome these limitations, we propose LOTUS, a temporal logic inspired universal task representation framework that can be seamlessly integrated into any RL algorithm to enhance agent performance across diverse task settings. Specifically, we design a novel task representation architecture capable of modeling relationships and extracting task semantics from LTL formulas. We further introduce a more effective update mechanism that treats the LTL encoder as a policy, thereby improving representation capacity. To enhance stability and robustness, LOTUS leverages the bisimulation metric, which provides theoretical guarantees for LTL representation, including behavioral equivalence, optimality fidelity, and trajectory robustness. Experimental results show that LOTUS outperforms most existing methods in learning efficiency, generalization capability, and representation quality. Specifically, LOTUS accelerates convergence over 20% in single-task scenarios, achieves a 15%-45% higher success rate in unseen manipulation tasks, and improves generalization performance over 25% in complex multi-task environments with increased sub-goal depth or conjunctions. The corresponding code, videos, and appendix are available at: https://lotus-website.github.io/.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (Early Access). Project page: https://lotus-website.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LOTUS，一种受时序逻辑（LTL）启发的通用任务表示框架，可无缝集成到任意强化学习（RL）算法中。框架设计了一种能从 LTL 公式中建模关系并提取任务语义的表示架构，并引入将 LTL 编码器视为策略的新更新机制，同时利用双模拟度量（bisimulation metric）提供理论保证。实验表明 LOTUS 在单任务、未见过的操作任务以及复杂多任务环境中均优于大多数现有方法。
Motivation: 现有任务表示算法多针对特定场景，难以跨场景泛化，且通常依赖 RL 控制器的梯度信号更新权重，这会损害表示质量和学习效率。
Method: 提出 LOTUS 框架：设计新的任务表示架构以从 LTL 公式中提取任务语义；将 LTL 编码器当作策略进行更新以提升表示能力；采用双模拟度量提供 LTL 表示的理论保障，涵盖行为等价、最优保真和轨迹鲁棒性。
Result: 实验显示 LOTUS 在多数现有方法上表现更好：单任务场景收敛速度提升超过 20%，未见过的操作任务成功率提高 15% 至 45%，在子目标深度或合取增加的复杂多任务环境中泛化性能提升超过 25%。
Conclusion: LOTUS 可作为通用任务表示框架集成进任意 RL 算法并提升性能，摘要强调其理论保证和实验层面的收益，未提及明显局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Language Models Consistently Encode the Current Year?
papers.abstract_en: A consistent concept of the current time is important for temporal reasoning, yet how language models represent the current time is not well understood. We contribute two tasks that probe the current year in conceptually distinct ways: an associative task, which infers the current year from verb tense, and a declarative task, which directly queries for the current year. Both tasks estimate current years within one year of the post-training data cutoff of instruction-tuned language models. For base models, predictions on the associative task serve as a strong proxy for the pre-training data cutoff, with an average error of only 10 months across 13 models. However, their internal mechanisms diverge: the associative task uses mechanisms similar to factual recall, while the declarative task lacks consistent causal pathways. This divergence poses a challenge for updating the current year in language models. None of prompting, SFT, or weight editing succeed in shifting the associative and declarative years simultaneously. Prompting updates the declarative year (94.6% success across 351 target years) but leaves the associative year nearly unchanged (1.7% success). Year-shifted SFT also fails to shift the associative year, matching the target year in only one of eight models. Weight editing, while effective for both tasks individually, does not generalize across both. Overall, our results show that the current year is not consistently encoded in language models: The associative notion, deeply ingrained in linguistic structures learned in pre-training, uses different causal mechanisms and resists the same modifications that easily shift the declarative notion learned in post-training.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两个概念上不同的探测任务来研究语言模型如何表示当前年份：关联任务（从动词时态推断当前年份）和陈述任务（直接询问当前年份）。研究发现指令微调模型对当前年份的估计在数据截止后一年内，基础模型在关联任务上的预测可作为预训练数据截止时间的强代理，但两个任务的内在机制不同，提示、SFT 和权重编辑等方法均无法同时更新两个任务的年份。
Motivation: 一致的时间概念对时间推理很重要，但语言模型如何表示当前时间并不清楚，缺乏针对性的探测和更新方法研究。
Method: 设计关联式（associative）与陈述式（declarative）两类任务探测当前年份，并在指令微调和基础模型上评估提示（prompting）、SFT 和权重编辑（weight editing）对年份更新的跨任务泛化效果。
Result: 基础模型在关联任务上的平均误差约为10个月（13个模型）；提示能更新陈述式年份（351个目标年中成功率94.6%）却几乎不影响关联式年份（1.7%）；年平移SFT在8个模型中仅1个匹配目标年；权重编辑对单个任务有效但无法跨任务泛化。
Conclusion: 当前年份并未在语言模型中被一致编码：关联式概念深植于预训练语言结构，使用不同于陈述式的因果机制，且抗拒那些能轻易改变陈述式概念的修改。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PERO: Efficient Robust Post-Training Foundation Models for Encrypted Traffic Classification
papers.abstract_en: Encrypted traffic classification is vital for network security, yet real-world deployments are inherently sensitive to rare but high-loss errors such as misclassification of malicious traffic. The encrypted traffic foundation model, as a promising general-purpose technique, can achieve impressive overall performance. However, employing standard objectives such as empirical risk minimization often overlooks high-risk tail events, and commonly used performance metrics hardly reflect robustness limitations in risk-sensitive scenarios. Directly applying robust optimization objectives, such as conditional value-at-risk, to post-training is computationally prohibitive for large models, as identifying high-loss samples exhausts substantial computation. To this end, we propose Pre-Evaluation Robust Optimization (PERO), an efficient robust post-training framework for encrypted traffic foundation models. PERO employs a lightweight proxy to estimate sample-wise risk and selects a subset of high-risk samples to update the foundation model, decoupling risk estimation from expensive large-model optimization. Extensive experiments on typical encrypted traffic datasets show that PERO achieves competitive or superior robustness and average performance compared to outstanding robust post-training methods, while significantly reducing computational and memory costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PERO（Pre-Evaluation Robust Optimization），面向加密流量分类基础模型的高效鲁棒后训练框架。核心是用轻量代理模型估计样本级风险，仅选择高风险样本子集更新基础模型，从而把风险估计与大模型优化解耦，避免条件风险价值（CVaR）等鲁棒优化目标在大模型上的高昂计算。在典型加密流量数据集上，PERO 在鲁棒性和平均性能上与先进鲁棒后训练方法相当或更优，同时显著降低计算和内存开销。
Motivation: 加密流量分类部署中，恶意流量误分类等罕见但高损失的错误十分关键，而常见的经验风险最小化和平均性能指标会忽视高风险尾部事件。直接使用 CVaR 等鲁棒优化目标对大型基础模型进行后训练在计算上不可行，因为识别高损失样本本身消耗大量计算。
Method: 提出 PERO 框架，采用轻量代理（lightweight proxy）估计样本级风险，选出高风险样本子集对基础模型进行更新，将风险估计与昂贵的大模型优化过程解耦。该方法针对加密流量基础模型的后训练场景设计。
Result: 在典型加密流量数据集上的大量实验显示，PERO 相比先进鲁棒后训练方法能够达到有竞争力或更优的鲁棒性与平均性能，同时显著降低计算和内存成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PERO 为加密流量基础模型提供了一条高效鲁棒后训练的途径，缓解了鲁棒优化在大模型上计算不可行的问题；摘要未展开具体算法局限。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 PERO（Pre-Evaluation Robust Optimization），面向加密流量分类基础模型的高效鲁棒后训练框架。核心是用轻量代理模型估计样本级风险，仅选择高风险样本子集更新基础模型，从而把风险估计与大模型优化解耦，避免条件风险价值（CVaR）等鲁棒优化目标在大模型上的高昂计算。在典型加密流量数据集上，PERO 在鲁棒性和平均性能上与先进鲁棒后训练方法相当或更优，同时显著降低计算和内存开销。
summary_sections.motivation: 加密流量分类部署中，恶意流量误分类等罕见但高损失的错误十分关键，而常见的经验风险最小化和平均性能指标会忽视高风险尾部事件。直接使用 CVaR 等鲁棒优化目标对大型基础模型进行后训练在计算上不可行，因为识别高损失样本本身消耗大量计算。
summary_sections.method: 提出 PERO 框架，采用轻量代理（lightweight proxy）估计样本级风险，选出高风险样本子集对基础模型进行更新，将风险估计与昂贵的大模型优化过程解耦。该方法针对加密流量基础模型的后训练场景设计。
summary_sections.result: 在典型加密流量数据集上的大量实验显示，PERO 相比先进鲁棒后训练方法能够达到有竞争力或更优的鲁棒性与平均性能，同时显著降低计算和内存成本。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 PERO 为加密流量基础模型提供了一条高效鲁棒后训练的途径，缓解了鲁棒优化在大模型上计算不可行的问题；摘要未展开具体算法局限。

papers.title: EcoVLA: Energy-Efficient Device-Edge Co-Inference for Vision-Language-Action Models under Real-Time Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising foundation for Embodied AI, but their high inference cost poses significant challenges for deployment in robotic systems. In practice, on-device inference is constrained by limited compute capacity and energy budgets, struggling to simultaneously satisfy real-time control and energy efficiency requirements. Alternatively, offloading the inference workload to an edge server is susceptible to fluctuations in system conditions, introducing unpredictable latency risks. Device-edge co-inference offers a promising solution, but systematic research tailored to VLA models remains scarce, particularly a unified co-inference framework that jointly addresses real-time constraints and system-level energy efficiency. Thus, we propose EcoVLA, an adaptive device-edge co-inference framework for VLA models that maximizes system energy efficiency under real-time constraints. EcoVLA first introduces a unified stage-level abstraction over different VLA paradigms, establishing an architecture-agnostic co-inference design space. It then formulates a joint device-edge-network latency and energy prediction model to enable rapid runtime evaluation of candidate co-inference schemes. Building on this, EcoVLA continuously selects the energy-optimal scheme satisfying real-time constraints with millisecond-level overhead, adapting to runtime variations in network and system states. Furthermore, EcoVLA incorporates a lightweight transmission mechanism for inter-stage intermediate tensors to reduce the communication overhead incurred by cross-device collaboration. Experimental results across VLA models show that EcoVLA improves system energy efficiency by up to 236% over existing co-inference approaches under a 20 Hz action output frequency constraint, while consistently maintaining SLO satisfaction under dynamic network and edge workload conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EcoVLA，一个面向视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的设备-边缘协同推理 (device-edge co-inference) 框架，目标是在实时约束下最大化系统能效。框架建立了统一的阶段级抽象、联合设备-边缘-网络延迟与能量预测模型，并引入轻量级中间张量传输机制。实验表明在 20 Hz 动作输出频率约束下，EcoVLA 相对现有协同推理方法最多提升 236% 的系统能量效率，并在动态网络和边缘负载下持续满足 SLO。
Motivation: VLA 模型推理成本高，端侧推理受限于算力和能量预算，难以同时满足实时控制与能效要求；将推理卸载到边缘服务器又受系统条件波动影响，带来不确定的延迟风险。现有研究缺乏面向 VLA 模型、同时处理实时约束与系统级能效的统一协同推理框架。
Method: EcoVLA 先对不同 VLA 范式建立统一的阶段级抽象，形成架构无关的协同推理设计空间；随后构建联合设备-边缘-网络延迟和能量预测模型，以便快速评估候选协同推理方案；运行时以毫秒级开销持续选择满足实时约束的能耗最优方案，并采用轻量级传输机制压缩跨设备协作的中间张量通信开销。
Result: 在多种 VLA 模型上的实验显示，在 20 Hz 动作输出频率约束下，EcoVLA 相比现有协同推理方法将系统能量效率提升最高 236%，并在动态网络和边缘工作负载条件下保持 SLO 满足。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过架构无关的阶段级抽象、延迟与能量建模以及运行时方案选择，可以在满足实时约束的同时改善 VLA 协同推理的系统级能效，并适应网络与边缘负载的动态变化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Generalized Hierarchical Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Many prediction problems arise with data collected in groups. In this setting, hierarchical conformal prediction (HCP) (Lee et al., 2026) provides distribution-free prediction sets for a new observation from a previously unseen group under hierarchical exchangeability. In many applications, however, prediction is conducted only after a few observations from the group of interest have already been collected. Standard HCP cannot leverage these observations, as its required symmetry conditions do not hold in this setting. At the same time, the initial sample may still be too small for standard conformal prediction applied within the test group to be informative. We develop predictive inference methods for this setting. Our proposed method, Generalized HCP (GHCP), restores the relevant symmetry needed for conformal inference by assigning the test group a randomly "donated" reference group size. GHCP further leverages the initial test group observations to improve the quality of the nonconformity scores for prediction within that group. To improve efficiency, we introduce a variant that restricts the set of eligible donors. We demonstrate the performance of the proposed method through simulations and an illustration on the American Community Survey dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分层数据中预测问题提出广义分层共形预测 (Generalized HCP, GHCP)。标准分层共形预测 (HCP) 假设在观察到感兴趣组的新观测之前进行预测，而 GHCP 允许利用该组已收集的少量观测，通过随机分配一个“捐赠”的参考组大小来恢复共形推断所需的对称性，并改进组内非一致性分数。模拟实验和美国社区调查 (American Community Survey) 数据集上的示例展示了所提方法的性能。
Motivation: 在许多应用中，预测是在已收集到感兴趣组的少量观测之后进行的，而标准 HCP 的对称性条件在此设置下不成立；同时，测试组内样本量又太小，不足以直接使用标准共形预测。
Method: 提出 Generalized HCP (GHCP)，通过为测试组随机分配一个“捐赠”的参考组大小来恢复共形推断所需的对称性；GHCP 还利用测试组已观测数据改进组内非一致性分数，并引入一个限制合格捐赠者集合的变体以提高效率。
Result: 摘要通过模拟研究和 American Community Survey 数据集的示例展示了所提方法的性能，未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: GHCP 适用于分层可交换性下、测试组已有少量观测但不足以直接进行标准共形预测的预测推断场景。

papers.title: QSMP: finding representative time series subsequences through Quick Shift+Matrix Profile
papers.abstract_en: Finding representative waveforms in long time series has scientific and practical value in many domains, as it enables summarization and visualization of large time series datasets, and downstream tasks like classification and forecasting. We present here QSMP, a method to find representative waveforms in long time series through a density-guided clustering of time series subsequences. Our method makes a novel connection between Quick Shift, a mode-seeking algorithm, and the Matrix Profile, a time series similarity-search data structure, to adapt Quick Shift to the clustering of subsequences in long time series, with a space complexity that is superior to the state-of-the-art method. Our experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that QSMP can be a valuable tool to summarize and visualize long time series by finding representative waveforms.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QSMP，一种在长时间序列中寻找代表性波形的方法，通过密度引导的子序列聚类实现。该方法将 Quick Shift 模式搜索算法与 Matrix Profile 时间序列相似性搜索结构结合，使 Quick Shift 适用于长时间序列的子序列聚类，并声称空间复杂度优于现有方法。在合成与真实数据集上的实验表明，QSMP 可用于总结和可视化长时间序列。
Motivation: 在长时间序列中提取代表性波形对数据总结、可视化和下游任务（如分类与预测）有价值，但现有方法在空间复杂度或聚类适应性上存在不足。
Method: 提出 QSMP：利用 Matrix Profile 作为时间序列相似性搜索结构，将 Quick Shift 这一 mode-seeking 算法适配到长时间序列的子序列聚类，实现密度引导的代表性波形发现。
Result: 摘要报告 QSMP 在合成与真实数据集上的实验表明其能有效找到代表性波形，且空间复杂度优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为 QSMP 是总结和可视化长时间序列的有用工具，但摘要未给出具体数值或局限性讨论。

papers.title: A Network-driven Framework for Public Event Forecasting via Dynamic Interaction Network Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Effective public event forecasting is essential for intelligent service systems, enabling proactive risk management, adaptive resource allocation, and timely decision-making. In many real-world scenarios, the evolution of public events is driven by dynamic interactions among participants. Motivated by this observation, this paper proposes auto-ibDLM, a network-driven deep learning framework that represents events as dynamic interaction networks and predicts public event evolution through participant growth forecasting. The proposed framework adopts a hybrid representation learning strategy that first represents network evolution using network science-informed structural metrics and subsequently transforms the resulting structural feature vectors into compact and robust latent representations through an auto-learning layer. A GRU-based temporal forecasting module is then employed to capture temporal dependencies and predict future participant growth. Extensive experiments on 13 real-world public event datasets and two publicly available dynamic network datasets demonstrate that auto-ibDLM consistently outperforms representative state-of-the-art methods in both forecasting accuracy and generalization capability, achieving over 97% accuracy in public event forecasting. Comprehensive experimental analyses further validate the effectiveness of the proposed hybrid representation learning strategy and demonstrate its representation-level interpretability. These results indicate that auto-ibDLM provides an effective and practical solution for intelligent public event forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 auto-ibDLM，一种网络驱动的深度学习框架，将公共事件建模为动态交互网络，并通过预测参与者增长来实现事件演化预测。框架采用混合表示学习策略：先用网络科学结构指标描述网络演化，再通过自学习层将结构特征向量转化为紧凑的潜在表示，最后用 GRU 时序预测模块捕捉时序依赖。在 13 个真实公共事件数据集和两个公开动态网络数据集上，auto-ibDLM 在预测准确率和泛化能力上均优于代表性基线，公共事件预测准确率超过 97%。
Motivation: 公共事件的演化在许多真实场景中由参与者之间的动态交互驱动，现有预测方法未能充分利用这种交互网络的演化信息，从而限制了预测效果。
Method: 提出 auto-ibDLM 框架，采用混合表示学习策略，先利用网络科学启发的结构指标表示网络演化，再通过自学习层将结构特征向量转换为紧凑、鲁棒的潜在表示；随后使用基于 GRU 的时序预测模块建模时间依赖，预测未来的参与者增长。
Result: 在 13 个真实公共事件数据集和两个公开动态网络数据集上的实验表明，auto-ibDLM 在预测准确率和泛化能力上持续优于代表性 SOTA 方法，公共事件预测准确率超过 97%；综合分析验证了混合表示学习策略的有效性及其表示层面的可解释性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 auto-ibDLM 为智能公共事件预测提供了有效且实用的解决方案，并强调混合表示学习策略和表示层可解释性是其关键优势。

papers.title: Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep networks are trained through long update trajectories, yet their temporal organization remains less systematically characterized than architectures, losses, or optimizers. We study short-horizon predictability as a measure of temporal redundancy: where, when, and under which training conditions recent updates contain information about near-future parameter motion. We combine three complementary probe families, displacement-direction, subspace-residual, and predictor-based probes, with convention-aware, null-calibrated group-level readouts, and apply them to multi-pass vision training on CIFAR and public Pythia pretraining checkpoints. Across both regimes, vector-like tensors such as normalization parameters and biases (auxiliary parameters) exhibit simpler short-horizon dynamics than matrix-like feature-transforming weights (bulk parameters), whose predictable behavior concentrates in localized, time-varying pockets. Agreement within and across probe families, and with independent trajectory diagnostics, indicates that these measurements capture intrinsic trajectory structure, while probe differences distinguish complementary forms of temporal organization. Controlled CIFAR comparisons further show that architecture and training recipe systematically modulate the measured structure. A Pythia-70M case study further exposes a sequence of role-, depth-, and scale-dependent events, including bulk ESA falling below the random sign-agreement level and the emergence and redistribution of predictable qkv pockets across layers. These results position short-horizon predictability as a retrospective, parameter-resolved diagnostic of training dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究训练轨迹的短视界可预测性 (short-horizon predictability)，将其作为衡量时间冗余的指标，并用三类探针（位移方向、子空间残差、基于预测器）加空校准的组级读数，对 CIFAR 视觉训练和多轮 Pythia 预训练检查点进行跨训练体制分析。结果显示向量型参数（归一化参数、偏置等辅助参数）的动力学比矩阵型特征变换权重（主体参数）更简单，而主体参数的可预测行为集中在局部、时变的时间窗中。作者将该指标定位为一种回顾性的、参数解析的训练动力学诊断工具。
Motivation: 深度网络的架构、损失函数和优化器已被系统研究，但长时间更新轨迹的时间组织方式仍缺乏刻画；论文希望回答近期更新在哪些位置、何时以及何种训练条件下包含关于近期未来参数运动的信息。
Method: 组合三类互补探针（displacement-direction、subspace-residual、predictor-based），采用考虑约定、经零模型校准的组级读数；在 CIFAR 多轮视觉训练与公开 Pythia 预训练检查点上进行测量，并加入受控 CIFAR 比较来考察架构与训练策略的影响。
Result: 跨两类训练体制，辅助参数显示更简单的短视界动力学，主体参数的可预测性集中在局部时变区间；探针族内及族间的一致性与独立轨迹诊断相符，表明测量捕捉到内在轨迹结构。受控比较显示架构和训练配方会系统性调节该结构；Pythia-70M 案例还揭示主体 ESA 降至随机符号一致水平以下、以及可预测 qkv 区间在不同层的出现与再分布等事件。
Conclusion: 作者认为短视界可预测性可作为一种回顾性、参数解析的训练动力学诊断方法，适用于不同训练体制。

papers.title: Bit-Flip Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models: Action-Decoding Architecture Shapes the Vulnerability
papers.abstract_en: Quantized Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models expose a weight-fault surface: Rowhammer-style faults can corrupt deployed INT8 bits. We present the first bit-flip attack on a VLA: a few gradient-selected flips reduce closed-loop success to $0\%$, while hundreds of random flips are harmless. Across four model variants spanning three action-head families, damaging bits concentrate in a few action-generating layers, but the empirical budget depends sharply on the head: direct regression and token policies fall in $1$--$5$ flips, whereas the evaluated flow-matching policies require ${\sim}100$--$300$. Our fixed-direction manifold-escape loss cuts \pizero{}'s budget from ${\sim}1000$ to ${\sim}100$ flips, and a matched five-direction sweep shows that the attack is not specific to an all-positive direction. On a direct head, protecting $3.1\%$ of weights preserves $60\%$ success at $K{=}100$, and protecting $5.3\%$ moves the open-loop break threshold from 3 to 100 flips. Finally, task-calibrated emulated $K{=}100$ flips yield $0/20$ real-robot successes, versus $14/20$ clean and $16/20$ global-random. Weight integrity is therefore a security boundary for embodied foundation models. Code is included as ancillary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出针对量化视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA) 的首个比特翻转攻击 (bit-flip attack)。摘要显示，少量经梯度选择的比特翻转即可将闭环成功率降至 0%，而数百次随机翻转几乎无害；在覆盖三种动作头家族的四个模型变体上，破坏性比特集中于少数动作生成层，且攻击预算强烈依赖动作头类型。作者还提出固定方向流形逃逸损失 (manifold-escape loss) 来降低攻击成本，并验证保护少量权重即可显著提升鲁棒性。
Motivation: 量化 VLA 模型暴露了权重故障面：Rowhammer 式故障可破坏部署后的 INT8 比特，而此前尚无针对 VLA 的比特翻转攻击研究。该工作旨在揭示动作解码架构如何决定此类模型对权重损坏的脆弱性。
Method: 提出首个针对 VLA 的比特翻转攻击，使用梯度选位确定少量关键比特；引入固定方向流形逃逸损失以降低特定模型 (π0) 的攻击预算，并做五方向对照实验排除方向特异性；最后通过保护部分权重和任务校准的仿真翻转在真实机器人上验证威胁。
Result: 直接回归 (direct regression) 与 token 策略只需 1–5 次翻转即可击溃闭环成功率，而被评估的 flow-matching 策略需要约 100–300 次；manifold-escape 损失把 π0 的预算从约 1000 降到约 100。保护 3.1% 的权重可在 K=100 时维持 60% 成功率，保护 5.3% 可将开环失效阈值从 3 推到 100 次翻转；真实机器人实验中任务校准的仿真 K=100 翻转得到 0/20 成功，而干净条件为 14/20、全局随机为 16/20。
Conclusion: 作者认为权重完整性 (weight integrity) 是具身基础模型 (embodied foundation models) 的安全边界，且动作解码架构显著影响比特翻转攻击的可行预算与防御策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimal Lower Bounds for Networked Information Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: The problem of networked information aggregation, studied in Kearns et al. (2026), involves a group of learners situated on the vertices of a directed acyclic graph $G$, each learning a linear predictor $\widehat Y$ for a fixed random variable $Y$ given access to a local feature, as well as the predictors learnt by its parents. Learning proceeds iteratively, with learners ordered according to a topological sort of $G$. The main quantity of interest is the error incurred by the current learner, constrained to this flow of information, with respect to the best linear predictor using all the features seen so far. When the studied error is the MSE, i.e., $\mathbb{E} (\widehat Y - Y)^2$, Kearns et al. (2026) show that the error is at most $O(1/\sqrt{D})$ along a path of length $D$. They also obtain a hard instance where the MSE is lower bounded by $Ω(1/D)$, leaving the correct order open. In this work, we resolve this central open problem, and obtain a family of worst case problem instances with a MSE lower bound of $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$. By exploiting invariances in the structure of the learnt predictors, our analysis generalizes to all convex loss functions $\ell(\widehat Y, Y)$ satisfying regularity conditions which include strong convexity in a ball around the origin, and that the ideal predictor minimizing the population loss is positively correlated with the label. We show that networked information aggregation on a gaussian instance in our worst case family incurs an $\ell$-error lower bounded by $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$ with respect to this ideal predictor. We demonstrate that a variety of common losses satisfy these regularity conditions. In particular, the logistic loss satisfies them, and hence our analysis also closes the gap between the upper and lower bounds in Bateni et al. (2026).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文解决了网络信息聚合（networked information aggregation）中一个开放的最优下界问题。在Kearns等人所研究的迭代线性预测框架下，作者构造了一族最坏情况实例，证明其均方误差（MSE）下界为 Ω(1/√D)，从而匹配已知上界。分析利用预测器结构的对称性，将结论推广到满足强凸与正相关等正则条件的凸损失函数，并验证逻辑损失等常见损失满足这些条件。
Motivation: Kearns等人（2026）对有向无环图上的网络信息聚合给出MSE上界O(1/√D)和下界Ω(1/D)，二者之间存在阶的差距。这个开放问题对于理解信息在图结构上的传播损失至关重要，而本文旨在确定该误差的真实收敛阶。
Method: 作者构造了一个高斯分布的最坏情况实例族，并利用学习到的线性预测器在结构上的不变性（invariances）进行分析。该分析框架不只针对MSE，而是推广到满足正则条件的任意凸损失函数，条件包括在原点附近强凸以及最小化总体损失的理想预测器与标签正相关。
Result: 对构造的高斯实例，网络信息聚合的ℓ误差相对于理想预测器具有 Ω(1/√D) 的下界，从而闭合了MSE情形的上下界。多种常见损失函数满足所要求的正则条件；特别地，逻辑损失（logistic loss）也满足，因此同时填补了Bateni等人（2026）中上下界之间的差距。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该结果在相当一般的一类凸损失下确定了网络信息聚合误差的最优下界，说明Kearns等人给出的上界在更广范围内是紧的。摘要未讨论该理论结论的具体应用场景或局限。

papers.title: Population Structure Analysis of an Inbred Population using Quantitative Shape Phenotyping from Stereo Retinal Photographs
papers.abstract_en: The population structure of an inbred population of 781 people on Norfolk Island in the Pacific, 318 of which are descendants of the original Mutineers of the Bounty, is analyzed phenotypically using shape from stereo retinal fundus photographs. Three-dimensional optic nerve head (ONH) shape is reconstructed from stereo pairs by a multi-scale stereo matching algorithm. Using deep neural network, the shape of ONH, which is under genetic control, is decomposed into a set of hierarchical features through self-taught learning. Features captured at different levels are selected according to their discriminant power in identifying the two populations. The prediction accuracy is evaluated with stratified cross validation. Given the selected feature set, individuals are grouped into k hierarchical clusters and cluster membership fractions are determined for k=2,3,4,5,6,7. Population structure analysis on the basis of phenotypes through image analysis allows heritability and linkage analysis, including founder effects from English and Polynesian ancestors, potentially leading to new genetic risk factors for glaucoma and other ONH-related eye diseases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 781 名 Norfolk Island 近交人群（其中 318 人为 Bounty 号叛变者后裔）的立体视网膜照片，通过多尺度立体匹配重建三维视神经头（ONH）形状，并用深度神经网络的自学学习（self-taught learning）将形状分解为层次化特征。作者按判别力选择特征以区分两个人群，用分层交叉验证评估预测准确率，并对个体进行 k=2 至 7 的层次聚类，从而从表型层面开展群体结构分析。
Motivation: 该人群具有明确的奠基者效应（英国与波利尼西亚祖先），从表型而非基因型进行群体结构分析，可为遗传力和连锁分析提供基础，并可能发现青光眼及其他视神经相关眼病的新遗传风险因素。
Method: 从立体视网膜照片经多尺度立体匹配算法重建三维 ONH 形状；利用深度神经网络通过自学学习将受遗传控制的 ONH 形状分解为层次化特征；按区分两个人群的判别力选择不同层级的特征，并以分层交叉验证评估预测准确率；随后基于选定特征对个体做层次聚类，计算 k=2 至 7 的聚类成员比例。
Result: 摘要报告采用分层交叉验证评估预测准确率，并给出了 k=2,3,4,5,6,7 时的聚类成员分数；未提供具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于图像分析的表型群体结构分析可以支持遗传力与连锁分析，纳入英国和波利尼西亚祖先的奠基者效应，进而可能导向青光眼等 ONH 相关眼病的新遗传风险因素。

papers.title: High-Dimensional Nonparametric Change-Point Detection via Low-Rank Degree-Three Density Projection
papers.abstract_en: Distributional changes can be invisible to means and covariances yet appear in skewness, asymmetric interactions, or other third-order structure. We develop a nonparametric change-point method that retains every degree-at-most-three coefficient of a density while avoiding direct density estimation. For observations in $[-1,1]^d$, we construct a symmetric order-three Legendre feature tensor $H_3(X)\in\Sym^3(\R^{d+1})$ such that $A(f)=\E_fH_3(X)$ is an exact isometric encoding of the degree-three density projection: $\|A(f)-A(g)\|_{\F}=\|P_3(f-g)\|_{L^2}$. Instead, fixed tensor contractions are degree-three polynomial chaoses with $ψ_{2/3}$ tails. The two terms have the characteristic order-three tensor scaling and match the powers in sharp concentration results for simple random tensors. For a coordinate-orthogonal specialization, the bound improves to $\sqrt{\log d}$ and enables a prefix-sum implementation in hundreds of dimensions. We derive the exact population tent shape and localization margin, introduce a seeded shortest-interval algorithm with a padded local recentering step, and prove exact recovery by induction: null recursive segments remain inactive, every undetected change retains a balanced isolating interval, and the shortest active seed contains exactly one change before recentering. A two-way cross-fitted scalar refinement attains $O_{\Pp}(κ^{-2})$ localization in the small-jump regime, matching a Le Cam lower bound on a pure cubic family whose degree-two projection jump is exactly zero. Reproducible experiments at $d\in\{20,50,100,200\}$ and a three-change $d=100$ sequence demonstrate the intended high-dimensional regime without materializing a $(d+1)^3$ tensor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种非参数变点检测 (change-point detection) 方法，通过低秩三次密度投影保留分布的三阶结构，避免直接密度估计。作者构造对称三阶 Legendre 特征张量 H_3(X)，使得 A(f)=E_fH_3(X) 成为三次密度投影的精确等距编码，并给出固定张量收缩的 ψ_{2/3} 尾概率界。算法采用带填充局部重心的种子最短区间 (seeded shortest-interval) 程序，证明可精确恢复变点；双交叉拟合标量细化在小跳跃 regime 达到 O_P(κ^{-2}) 定位误差，匹配 Le Cam 下界。实验在 d∈{20,50,100,200} 上展开，避免了 (d+1)^3 张量的显式物化。
Motivation: 分布变化可能对均值和协方差不可见，却体现在偏度、非对称交互或其他三阶结构中；现有方法若只检查前两阶矩会漏检，而直接估计密度在高维下困难。
Method: 在 [-1,1]^d 上构造对称三阶 Legendre 特征张量 H_3(X)∈Sym^3(R^{d+1})，使 A(f)=E_fH_3(X) 满足 ||A(f)-A(g)||_F=||P_3(f-g)||_{L^2} 的精确等距性质；固定张量收缩作为三次多项式混沌 (polynomial chaos) 具有 ψ_{2/3} 尾。坐标正交特化下界改进为 √log d，可用前缀和在数百维实现。作者推导总体 tent 形状与定位 margin，提出带填充局部重心步骤的种子最短区间算法，并通过归纳证明精确恢复：空递归段保持非活跃、未检出变点保有平衡隔离区间、重心的最短活跃种子恰含一个变点。
Result: 在摘要所述的小跳跃 regime 中，两路交叉拟合 (two-way cross-fitted) 标量细化达到 O_P(κ^{-2}) 定位误差，与纯三次族 (度二投影跳变为零) 上的 Le Cam 下界匹配。可复现实验覆盖 d=20,50,100,200 及一个三变点 d=100 序列，验证了高维场景且无需物化 (d+1)^3 张量。

papers.title: Maintaining IoT Device Identification under Concept Drift via Budget-Aware Traffic Labeling
papers.abstract_en: Identification of IoT device types from passive traffic is increasingly used for security management in enterprise and ISP networks. However, the performance of machine learning-based classifiers gradually degrades under concept drift as device behavior evolves. Therefore, maintaining classification performance requires periodic retraining with newly labeled deployment traffic. The operational challenge is determining how much and which deployment traffic instances to label for maintaining classification performance. We show that these two decisions should be treated separately. While retraining solely on instances selected by a drift detector is prone to systematically overlooking parts of the emerging behavioral space, uniformly sampled deployment traffic captures more representative behavioral changes. Instead, drift detection is more effective at determining the amount of deployment traffic that should be labeled. We make three contributions. (1) We conduct a two-year longitudinal study of IoT traffic and characterize how behavioral evolution manifests across device classes and how retraining with newly labeled traffic restores classification performance. (2) We develop a conformity-based drift detector that captures class-conditional behavioral models directly from raw traffic features and provides feature-level explanations of behavioral evolution. (3) We demonstrate that adjusting the traffic labeling rate according to the observed behavioral evolution, combined with uniform traffic sampling, maintains classifier performance more effectively than detector-guided sample selection and is beneficial to managing the traffic labeling effort. We further show that this strategy performs comparably to confidence-guided adaptation while providing feature-level explanations. Our evaluation uses 3.8 million IPFIX flow records collected from 21 IoT types over more than 2 years.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究物联网设备类型识别在概念漂移 (concept drift) 下的性能维持问题。作者基于两年多的真实 IoT 流量数据，提出将“标注多少部署流量”和“标注哪些流量实例”这两个决策分开处理：均匀采样用于选择重训练实例，基于一致性 (conformity) 的漂移检测器用于确定标注比例。摘要报告该方法比漂移检测器引导的样本选择更有效，并在保持可解释性的同时与置信度引导的适应策略性能相当。
Motivation: 基于机器学习的 IoT 设备分类器会因设备行为演化而产生概念漂移，导致分类性能逐渐下降；周期性使用新标注的部署流量重训练是必要的，但运营中难以决定应该标注多少流量以及选择哪些流量实例来维持性能。
Method: 作者将标注数量与实例选择两个决策分离：采用均匀采样获取具有代表性的部署流量进行重训练，并开发了一个基于一致性 (conformity) 的漂移检测器，直接从原始流量特征中捕获类条件行为模型并提供特征级解释，用于根据观察到的行为演化调整流量标注速率。
Result: 摘要表明，仅用漂移检测器选择的实例重训练会系统性地遗漏部分新兴行为空间，而均匀采样能更准确地捕获行为变化。根据漂移程度调整标注速率并结合均匀采样，比检测器引导的样本选择更有效地维持分类器性能，且性能与置信度引导的适应策略相当并提供特征级解释；评估基于 21 种 IoT 类型、超过 2 年共 380 万条 IPFIX 流记录。
Conclusion: 作者强调应把标注数量决策与实例选择决策分开处理：漂移检测更适合决定需要标注多少部署流量，而均匀采样更适合决定标注哪些实例，这有助于管理流量标注开销。

papers.title: Not All Attention Is Equal: A Quantitative Survey of the EEI Trade-off
papers.abstract_en: Attention mechanisms have driven machine learning for a decade, from neural machine translation to language models that do general-purpose reasoning. This survey covers four connected threads: their formulation for sequence-to-sequence tasks, adaptation to computer vision, efficiency innovations that address the quadratic bottleneck, and advances in interpretability. We define three criteria: efficiency, expressiveness, and interpretability, and compare twenty-one methods using an EEI scoring framework. Scores come from a single rater with an assumed +/-1-point perturbation range. A deterministic Monte Carlo analysis with 200,000 samples shows that, under this perturbation model, rank changes of more than one position occur in 67-70% of samples on average. A rank-matched null model reproduces a similar stability profile, so the results support coarse tier-level comparisons rather than fine-grained rankings. The survey traces attention from Bahdanau-Luong alignment through the Transformer and into vision architectures. It reviews fixed and learned sparse attention, linear attention, IO-aware exact algorithms including FlashAttention, and state-space alternatives including Mamba. It also covers induction heads, superposition, and the attention-SSM duality. We further provide a structured narrative review, a benchmark synthesis with cross-study caveats, a five-problem research gap analysis, and a 2015-2026 evolution timeline. We conclude by framing attention research as an expansion of the efficiency-expressiveness-interpretability frontier and identifying future directions including unified efficiency benchmarks, learned routing for hybrid architectures, length generalization, and scalable mechanistic interpretability.
papers.comment: 53 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Code and analysis artifacts: https://github.com/Nixon-H/not-all-attention-is-equal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对注意力机制 (attention mechanisms) 的定量综述，提出效率 (efficiency)、表达力 (expressiveness) 与可解释性 (interpretability) 三个评价标准，并以 EEI 评分框架比较 21 种方法。作者通过 200,000 样本的确定性蒙特卡洛分析发现，在假设 ±1 分扰动下，排名变化超过一位的情况平均出现于 67–70% 的样本中，因而结论支持粗粒度层级比较而非细粒度排序。综述还覆盖从 Bahdanau-Luong 对齐到 Transformer、视觉架构、稀疏/线性注意力、FlashAttention、Mamba 以及 attention-SSM 对偶等内容。
Motivation: 注意力机制已成为机器学习近十年的核心驱动组件，但现有研究缺乏对效率、表达力和可解释性三者权衡 (EEI trade-off) 的系统定量比较，方法选择与基准评估缺少统一框架。
Method: 定义三个评价标准并构建 EEI 评分框架，对 21 种方法进行单评分者打分；采用带 ±1 分扰动假设的确定性蒙特卡洛分析 (200,000 样本) 检验排名稳定性，并用 rank-matched null model 对照；同时提供叙述性综述、跨研究基准综合、五问题研究空白分析和 2015–2026 演化时间线。
Result: 在假设的 ±1 分扰动模型下，平均 67–70% 的样本出现超过一位的排名变化，且 null model 呈现相似的稳定性分布，说明细粒度排名不可靠，结果仅支持粗层级比较。摘要未报告各方法的具体 EEI 分值。
Conclusion: 作者将注意力研究框定为扩展效率–表达力–可解释性前沿的过程，并指出未来方向包括统一效率基准、混合架构中的学习路由、长度泛化以及可扩展的机械可解释性 (mechanistic interpretability)。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: AlignJEPA: Predictive Vision-Language Alignment for Remote Sensing Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing (RS) foundation models provide transferable Earth observation representations across sensors, resolutions, and geographies, yet most remain weakly aligned with natural language, limiting natural-language archive search, image-text retrieval, and question-conditioned analysis. We propose AlignJEPA, a JEPA-inspired predictive vision-language alignment framework for remote sensing foundation models. AlignJEPA uses a pretrained AnySat visual encoder and a RemoteCLIP text encoder while training only a lightweight predictive alignment network. Instead of relying on global image--text contrastive alignment alone, the framework predicts remote-sensing text embeddings from masked visual foundation-model tokens. Its mask-aware multi-scale predictive aligner aggregates visible tokens at fine, regional, and global scales, jointly models them with a cross-scale Transformer, and projects the resulting representation into the text space using learned query pooling. Training combines semantic prediction with bidirectional contrastive retrieval. We train and evaluate AlignJEPA on BigEarthNet.txt for natural-language Sentinel retrieval, evaluate cross-dataset adaptation on RSICD, and use RSVQA only as a closed-set representation probe. AlignJEPA provides a parameter-efficient route for aligning Earth observation foundation models with language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AlignJEPA，一种受 JEPA 启发的预测式视觉-语言对齐框架，用于遥感（remote sensing）基础模型。它使用预训练的 AnySat 视觉编码器和 RemoteCLIP 文本编码器，仅训练轻量预测对齐网络，从掩码视觉 token 预测遥感文本嵌入，并在 BigEarthNet.txt、RSICD 和 RSVQA 上评估。摘要称该方法为 Earth observation 基础模型提供参数高效的语言对齐路线。
Motivation: 遥感基础模型虽可迁移到不同传感器、分辨率和地理区域，但大多与自然语言弱对齐，限制了自然语言档案搜索、图像-文本检索和基于问题的分析。
Method: 基于 JEPA 的预测式对齐：保持预训练视觉和文本编码器冻结，仅训练轻量预测对齐网络。掩码感知的多尺度预测器聚合细粒度、区域和全局尺度的可见 token，用跨尺度 Transformer 联合建模，再通过可学习 query pooling 投影到文本空间；训练结合语义预测与双向对比检索（bidirectional contrastive retrieval）。
Result: 在 BigEarthNet.txt 上训练并评估自然语言 Sentinel 检索，在 RSICD 上评估跨数据集适应，在 RSVQA 上作为闭集表征探针使用；摘要未报告具体量化指标。
Conclusion: AlignJEPA 提供了一种参数高效（parameter-efficient）的途径，将 Earth observation 基础模型与语言对齐；摘要未明确说明局限性。

papers.title: Dynamic Multi-Byte Prediction With Hierarchical Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Byte-level hierarchical language models (LMs) have recently emerged as a robust alternative to their popular counterparts that use subword tokenization. However, generating one byte at a time remains a bottleneck for inference speed. To address this, we introduce multi-byte prediction (MBP), which generates multiple bytes in parallel, speeding up inference with minimal performance impact and no additional parameters. MBP builds on the popular multi-token prediction (MTP) paradigm with two crucial innovations. First, we introduce a variable-length prediction window that aligns with the latent tokens, or segments, of a hierarchical LM. Second, we implement a novel attention-masking scheme that enables parallel byte prediction without violating causality. We show that multi-byte prediction strikes a Pareto-optimal trade-off across multiple generative tasks, instruction following, question answering, summarization, and machine translation, achieving the best trade-off between performance and inference throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对字节级层次语言模型逐字节生成导致的推理速度瓶颈，提出多字节预测 (multi-byte prediction, MBP)，在不增加参数的前提下并行生成多个字节。MBP 借鉴多 token 预测 (MTP) 范式，引入与层次 LM 潜在线段对齐的可变长度预测窗口，并设计新的注意力掩码方案以保证并行预测不违反因果性。摘要称该方法在指令跟随、问答、摘要和机器翻译等多个生成任务上取得性能与推理吞吐量之间的 Pareto 最优权衡。
Motivation: 字节级层次 LM 是子词分词模型的一种稳健替代方案，但逐字节生成成为推理速度的瓶颈，限制了实际部署效率。
Method: 在 MTP 范式基础上做两点关键改进：一是使用与层次 LM 潜在线段对齐的可变长度预测窗口；二是实现一种新的注意力掩码机制，使多个字节可以并行预测且不违反因果性，且不引入额外参数。
Result: 摘要报告 MBP 在指令跟随、问答、总结和机器翻译等多种生成任务上实现了性能与推理吞吐量的最佳折中，即 Pareto 最优权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为多字节预测能以很小的性能代价显著加速字节级层次 LM 的推理，为后续字节级模型的高效生成提供了一种无需额外参数的方案。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Spatially-Grounded Flow Matching: Structured Source Distributions for Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Current flow matching models learn to transport the source i.i.d. Gaussian noise into the target distribution of natural images, yet this source distribution carries no notion of spatial structure. Images however are fundamentally local since nearby pixels are strongly correlated. By sampling the noise independently, we hypothesize that models are implicitly encouraged to exploit less noisy neighbors as context during training, partially bypassing the need to properly learn the true local structure of images. The source distribution, in other words, works against the inductive bias of the image domain. To ameliorate this design discrepancy, we propose StructFlow which encodes spatial locality directly into the source by having the pixels within a small region share a common noise component. This structured source produces transport paths that are geometrically aligned with image regions - enabling properties that generic flow matching struggles to provide: fine-grained local editing that naturally respects boundaries, robust structure preservation, and smooth semantic interpolation between images. We show that these benefits also extend to large pre-trained models, demonstrating that StructFlow can even be incorporated through a lightweight post-training phase. Comprehensive experiments on multiple datasets, in unconditional, class and text-conditioned regimes, using different diffusion transformer architectures confirm that StructFlow not only offers competitive image generation quality, but also significantly improves localized controllable re-synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 flow matching 模型使用无空间结构的 i.i.d. 高斯噪声作为源分布与图像局部性先验不匹配的问题，提出 StructFlow，将空间局部性直接编码进源分布：小区域内的像素共享一个公共噪声分量。作者称该结构化源分布使得传输路径与图像区域几何对齐，带来细粒度局部编辑、结构保持和语义插值等能力，并可经轻量 post-training 阶段用于大型预训练模型。在多个数据集、无条件/类别/文本条件下的实验表明，StructFlow 在保持竞争性生成质量的同时显著改善局部可控重合成。
Motivation: 现有 flow matching 模型从 i.i.d. 高斯噪声学习到自然图像的传输，但该源分布不携带空间结构；而图像本质上是局部的，相邻像素强相关。独立采样噪声可能使模型在训练中利用较少噪声的邻域作为上下文，部分绕过对真实局部结构的学习，与图像领域的归纳偏置相悖。
Method: 提出 StructFlow，在源分布中引入空间局部性：让一个小区域内的像素共享一个公共噪声分量，从而生成与图像区域几何对齐的传输路径。该结构化源可嵌入无条件、类别和文本条件下的生成流程，并可通过轻量 post-training 阶段集成到大型预训练模型中。
Result: 摘要报告在多个数据集上、无条件/类别/文本条件以及多种 diffusion transformer 架构下的综合实验表明，StructFlow 提供具有竞争力的图像生成质量，并显著改进局部化的可控重合成（localized controllable re-synthesis）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将空间局部性纳入源分布可缓解 flow matching 设计与图像归纳偏置之间的不匹配，使模型获得更符合图像区域结构的传输路径，并补充了现有方法欠缺的局部编辑与结构保持能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Mental Model Management: An Operator-Based Framework for LLM Memory
papers.abstract_en: Large language models process large amounts of information but usually lack an explicit mechanism for maintaining compact and evolving conceptual representations. We introduce Mental Model Management (3M), a framework in which knowledge is represented as mental models consisting of compact chunks. Rather than accumulating text passages, 3M continuously integrates new information into an existing conceptual representation. A set of operators extracts knowledge, retrieves relevant models, adds and updates chunks, reorganizes representations, detects inconsistencies, and derives new knowledge. We describe the main 3M operators and illustrate each operation using Evolution Strategies as a running example.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mental Model Management (3M)，一个面向大语言模型记忆管理的算子化框架，用紧凑的“心智模型”分块表示知识，并通过一组算子持续整合新信息、更新与重构概念表示。论文以 Evolution Strategies 作为贯穿示例逐一说明各算子的作用，属于概念性框架描述，未报告实验验证。
Motivation: 大语言模型虽能处理大量信息，但缺乏显式机制来维护紧凑且不断演化的概念表示；直接累积文本片段不利于知识的整合与更新。
Method: 提出 3M 框架，将知识表示为由紧凑分块 (chunks) 构成的心智模型，并定义一组算子来抽取知识、检索相关模型、添加和更新分块、重构表示、检测不一致性以及推导新知识。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验结果；主要贡献是对 3M 各算子的形式化描述与运行示例。
Conclusion: 作者认为 3M 提供了一种替代文本累积的记忆管理方式，使 LLM 能持续将新信息融入现有概念表示；论文作为框架性工作，后续需要进一步验证其有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: StreamTTT: Reconciling Real-Time Perception and Long-Term Memory in Streaming VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Humans effortlessly perceive the present while remembering the past, yet streaming VLMs often trade off real-time perception against long-term memory. Prior work shows that shortening the context can sharpen current-scene perception at the expense of long-range recall. To reconcile these abilities, we introduce StreamTTT, which writes long-range history into online-updated fast weights outside the attention context. This leaves a short sliding key-value cache dedicated to recent evidence, mitigating attention dilution. We train StreamTTT jointly on offline long-video QA and a newly constructed real-time QA corpus. On OVO-Bench, under each model's reported input protocol, StreamTTT-4B outperforms the same-scale SimpleStream-4B by 1.4 points in real-time perception and 3.7 points in backward tracing. It also remains competitive with the larger SimpleStream-8B on StreamingBench's Real-Time Visual Understanding (RTVU) subset. Our code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamTTT，一种面向流式视频语言模型 (streaming VLM) 的架构，用以同时保持实时感知与长期记忆。其核心是将长程历史写入注意力上下文之外的在线更新快权重 (fast weights)，并仅保留一个较短的滑动键值缓存来服务近期证据，从而缓解注意力稀释。模型在离线长视频 QA 与新建的实时 QA 语料上联合训练；在 OVO-Bench 上，StreamTTT-4B 相比同规模 SimpleStream-4B 在实时感知上高 1.4 点、在回溯 (backward tracing) 上高 3.7 点，并在 StreamingBench 的 Real-Time Visual Understanding (RTVU) 子集上与更大规模的 SimpleStream-8B 保持竞争力。
Motivation: 流式 VLM 常在实时感知与长期记忆之间取舍；已有工作表明缩短上下文能提升当前场景感知，但会牺牲长程回忆能力，作者希望调和这两种能力。
Method: StreamTTT 将长程历史写入注意力上下文之外、在线更新的快权重中，使短滑动键值缓存专注于近期证据，以缓解注意力稀释；训练时联合使用离线长视频 QA 与新建的实时 QA 语料。
Result: 在 OVO-Bench 上，StreamTTT-4B 相比 SimpleStream-4B 在实时感知上提升 1.4 点、在后向回溯上提升 3.7 点；在 StreamingBench RTVU 子集上与 SimpleStream-8B 表现相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为将长程历史移至上下文外的快权重可以调和实时感知与长期记忆，并计划发布代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Excess Separability: Nuisance-Controlled Residual-Stream Probing for Benchmark Contamination Detection
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark contamination is diagnosed with n-gram overlap, likelihood-based membership inference, or canary strings, and each needs something usually unavailable: the training corpus, a well-chosen test statistic, or foresight at release. A recent alternative reads it off a linear probe on internal activations. We show the natural way to do this does not work, specify one that survives measurement, then find that the correction making it work carries more variance than the null it is tested against. The protocol reports a zero-sum contrast on the depth profile of probe accuracy, recentred on a level-matched placebo baseline, tested against a label-permutation null, with the reference set twice the size of the suspect set. Each choice replaces a simpler alternative we rejected on measurement. Reporting the level of excess separability rather than its shape makes the false positive rate track the size of the analyst's own control set, 0.03 to 0.99 under a true null. Contrasting against a flat depth profile rejects a true null 0.72 of the time when surface decodability rises with depth, and loses all power when it falls. On real transformers the protocol fails a test the simulations did not pose. The recentring subtracts an estimate, and the permutation null holds it fixed. Re-estimated across split seeds on four audits of contaminated checkpoints, its standard deviation is 1.30 to 1.56 times the null's own in every arm: what is subtracted to remove a bias is more variable than what it corrects. The one nominally significant result, p = 0.0075, becomes 0.0745 once that variance is propagated, and no verdict is issued. The simulations missed this because their surface key is the covariate driving item variation; on real text it is a proxy, and degrading key quality in simulation reproduces it. We add a companion measurement and a widened null. No arm shows contamination.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 11 figures, 8 tables. v2: measures the placebo baseline's own sampling variance, finds it exceeds the permutation null's in every audit, propagates it, and withdraws the one nominally significant result. Code and artefacts: https://github.com/mabushi-lab/residual-stream-contamination-probing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用内部激活上的线性探针 (linear probe) 检测基准污染 (benchmark contamination) 的方法。作者表明直接进行该探测在测量上并不成立，提出一种能够经受住测量的协议，随后发现使协议成立的校正项比它所校正的偏差携带更多方差。在真实 Transformer 上协议未通过模拟未考察的检验，传播该方差后原本名义显著的结果不再显著，最终没有给出污染结论。
Motivation: 现有污染检测依赖 n-gram 重叠、基于似然的成员推断或 canary 字符串，这些方法通常需要训练语料、精心选择的检验统计量或发布时的预见性；基于内部激活线性探针的替代方案被认为更可行，但论文指出其自然做法在测量层面不可靠。
Method: 提出一种深度剖面探测协议：对探针准确率的深度剖面取零和对比，围绕水平匹配的安慰剂基线重定中心，并用标签置换零分布进行检验，参考集大小为可疑集的两倍。作者还加入伴随测量并放宽零分布，以处理重定中心项自身方差过大的问题。
Result: 在真实零假设下，报告超额可分性水平而非形状会使假阳性率随分析者自身控制集大小在 0.03 到 0.99 间变化；当表面可解码性随深度上升时，与平坦深度剖面做对比以 0.72 的概率拒绝真实零假设，而随深度下降时则完全失去功效。在四个污染检查点审计中，重定中心项的估计标准差是零分布自身的 1.30 到 1.56 倍；唯一的名义显著结果 p=0.0075 在传播该方差后变为 0.0745，所有实验组均未显示污染。
Conclusion: 论文的结论是，使该协议可用的最近校正项比它要纠正的偏差更具变异性，因此不应据此发布污染判定；模拟之所以遗漏这一点，是因为其表面关键变量是驱动项目变化的协变量，而在真实文本上它只是代理变量，降低代理质量可在模拟中复现该现象。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在真实零假设下，报告超额可分性水平而非形状会使假阳性率随分析者自身控制集大小在 0.03 到 0.99 间变化；当表面可解码性随深度上升时，与平坦深度剖面做对比以 0.72 的概率拒绝真实零假设，而随深度下降时则完全失去功效。在四个污染检查点审计中，重定中心项的估计标准差是零分布自身的 1.30 到 1.56 倍；唯一的名义显著结果 p=0.0075 在传播该方差后变为 0.0745，所有实验组均未显示污染。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文的结论是，使该协议可用的最近校正项比它要纠正的偏差更具变异性，因此不应据此发布污染判定；模拟之所以遗漏这一点，是因为其表面关键变量是驱动项目变化的协变量，而在真实文本上它只是代理变量，降低代理质量可在模拟中复现该现象。

papers.title: No One to Blame: A Framework of Constitutive AI Unaccountability
papers.abstract_en: The increasing deployment of autonomous, agentic AI systems challenges traditional accountability mechanisms. Existing research predominantly frames AI accountability gaps as barriers that can be overcome through better standards, transparency, and institutional reform. We argue that this framing is insufficient: certain configurations of actors, systems, and institutions render AI accountability conceptually unachievable regardless of effort. We introduce the concept of constitutive AI unaccountability to capture these configurations. Through a three-stage qualitative study comprising a concept-centric literature analysis, a secondary analysis of 27 expert interviews with AI professionals from technical, legal, and sociotechnical backgrounds, and an illustrative framework application to the open-source agentic AI system OpenClaw, we identify nine categories and 20 themes of constitutive AI unaccountability. These are organized across structural, technological, and normative clusters and reinforce one another through eight directed interdependencies. Our framework is operationalized as a diagnostic instrument of 20 questions, which detected 17 of 20 conditions when applied to OpenClaw, including an inverted anthropomorphism configuration in which the AI agent was the only identifiable actor. We contribute a reframing of AI unaccountability as a constitutive property of sociotechnical systems, an extension of the four barriers to accountability, and a practical instrument for identifying accountability voids in specific AI deployments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出构成性 AI 不可问责性（constitutive AI unaccountability）概念，认为某些行动者、系统与制度组合会使 AI 问责在概念上不可实现，而非仅靠标准、透明度和制度改进就能克服。通过三阶段定性研究（概念导向文献分析、27 位 AI 专家访谈的二次分析、对开源智能体系统 OpenClaw 的框架应用），作者识别出 9 个类别和 20 个主题，并将其组织为结构、技术与规范三个集群，以及 8 个有向相互依赖关系。最终形成包含 20 个问题的诊断工具，在 OpenClaw 案例中检出 20 个条件中的 17 个。
Motivation: 现有研究多把 AI 问责缺口视为可通过更好标准、透明度和制度改革克服的障碍，本文认为这一框架不充分，因为在特定行动者、系统与制度配置下，AI 问责在概念上无法实现。
Method: 采用三阶段定性研究：概念中心文献分析、对来自技术、法律和社会技术背景的 27 位 AI 专家访谈的二次分析，以及将框架示例应用于开源智能体系统 OpenClaw；并将框架操作化为包含 20 个问题的诊断工具。
Result: 识别出构成性 AI 不可问责性的 9 个类别和 20 个主题，分布在结构、技术和规范集群中，并通过 8 个有向相互依赖关系相互强化；应用于 OpenClaw 时检测到 20 个条件中的 17 个，包括 AI 智能体成为唯一可识别行动者的反向拟人化（inverted anthropomorphism）配置。
Conclusion: 作者将 AI 不可问责性重新框定为社会技术系统的构成性属性，扩展了问责的四个障碍，并提供一个实用诊断工具来识别具体 AI 部署中的问责空洞。

papers.title: Benchmark-Based Comparative Assessment of Publicly Benchmarked Indian Foundation Models: A Capability and Evaluation-Maturity Framework
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: Governments increasingly fund indigenous foundation models to strengthen national AI capability, digital sovereignty, and multilingual computing. This paper assesses India's foundation-model ecosystem and examines whether apparent capability gaps in public benchmark evidence may also reflect gaps in evaluation maturity. Approach: The paper presents a structured, benchmark-based comparative assessment of Indian foundation models against global frontier and comparable-scale models across eight capability domains: general-purpose reasoning, coding and software engineering, agentic AI and computer use, cybersecurity, vision and image understanding, video and multimodal understanding, scientific research, and Indic language capability. Using only publicly reported results, it proposes an exploratory four-dimension Benchmark Maturity Index (BMI), scoring each domain on standardization, participation, independent verification, and national Findings: Indian models achieve strong scores on established benchmarks such as MMLU and MATH-500. However, these are now widely regarded as saturated, and frontier developers no longer report them. Indian models participate far less frequently in newer, agentic, and domain-specialized evaluations, and participation is highly uneven across organizations. Sarvam AI reports the broadest coverage by a substantial margin. The BMI refines, and in some cases revises, the maturity judgments a purely descriptive review would produce. Practical implications: Many apparent capability gaps cannot be distinguished, on available evidence, from evaluation-ecosystem gaps, with direct implications for how national AI programs should design monitoring and funding criteria. Originality: The paper proposes BMI as a reusable instrument for scoring evaluation-ecosystem maturity at the domain level and demonstrates its application to the Indian foundation-model ecosystem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对印度基础模型生态进行基于公开基准的结构化比较评估，覆盖通用推理、编码、智能体 AI、网络安全、视觉、视频与多模态、科学研究以及印度语言能力八个领域。作者提出探索性的四维基准成熟度指数 (Benchmark Maturity Index, BMI)，从标准化、参与度、独立验证和国家相关性对各领域打分，并用该工具审视所谓能力差距在多大程度上其实是评估生态差距。
Motivation: 各国政府日益资助本土基础模型以增强国家 AI 能力、数字主权和多语言计算，但公开基准证据中表现出的能力差距可能部分来自评估成熟度的不足，而非模型真实能力。
Method: 仅使用公开报告结果，对印度基础模型与全球前沿及同等规模模型进行跨八个能力领域的基准比较；提出由标准化、参与度、独立验证和国家相关性四个维度构成的 BMI，用于按领域量化评估生态成熟度。
Result: 印度模型在 MMLU 和 MATH-500 等已趋饱和的既有基准上得分较高，但前沿开发者已不再报告这些基准；印度模型在新兴的智能体和领域专用评估中参与度明显较低，且不同机构间参与极不均衡，其中 Sarvam AI 的覆盖面显著最广。BMI 完善并在某些情况下修正了纯描述性综述所得的成熟度判断。
Conclusion: 在现有证据下，许多表面上的能力差距无法与评估生态差距区分开来，这对国家 AI 项目如何设计监控与资助标准有直接启示；论文将 BMI 定位为可在领域层面复用的评估生态成熟度工具。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SkillZip: Evaluation-Free Skill Compression for Self-Evolving Agents by Discovering Reusable Structure
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents accumulate reusable skills by appending successful procedures and failure fixes. Over time, the same requirement is often restated in several branches, examples, and warnings, while common action sequences are copied rather than reused. The resulting skill becomes expensive to inject and difficult to maintain. Generic prompt compression is ill-suited to this setting because a skill is not a flat passage: its name and description define when it applies, its workflow controls execution, its tool and output contracts constrain validity, and rare exceptions may remain essential even when no sampled task activates them. Evaluation-guided compression can test these behaviors, but it introduces rollouts, cost, and dependence on the compression-time evaluation set. We present SkillZip, an evaluation-free method that compresses a skill by finding its shortest faithful structural explanation. The intuition is explain once, reference many: state a repeated rule once at the scope where it applies, factor a repeated action sequence into a shared procedure, and keep only the differences as explicit exceptions. We formalize this intuition as a typed minimum description-length objective over a skill contract and a residual, subject to a hard coverage constraint for every extracted trigger, workflow edge, tool requirement, obligation, and output field. The formulation provides simple sharing thresholds, preserves unique rare rules by construction, and supports efficient local updates. SkillZip has a one-shot mode with one structured extraction call and deterministic optimization, and a continual Zip-on-Write mode that integrates each self-evolution patch without replaying tasks or reparsing the full history. Through comprehensive experimental evaluations, we demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of SkillZip in compression performance, generalizability, and cost overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillZip，一种面向自进化智能体 (self-evolving agents) 的无评估技能压缩方法，通过发现技能中的可复用结构来生成最短的忠实结构解释。方法将技能压缩形式化为带类型的极小描述长度 (minimum description length) 目标，并施加硬覆盖约束，支持一次性压缩与持续 Zip-on-Write 两种模式。实验显示其在压缩性能、泛化性和开销方面优于既有方案。
Motivation: 自进化智能体通过追加成功流程和失败修复不断积累技能，导致同一需求在多个分支、示例和警告中重复表述，公共动作序列被复制而非复用，技能注入成本高且难以维护。通用提示压缩不适用，因为技能不是扁平文本；基于评估的压缩又引入 rollout、成本和压缩时评估集的依赖。
Method: SkillZip 将技能表示为技能契约 (skill contract) 与残差 (residual)，并定义带类型的极小描述长度目标，对每个触发的触发器、工作流边、工具需求、义务和输出字段施加硬覆盖约束，从而只保留差异作为显式异常。该方法提供简单的共享阈值，按构造保留稀有唯一规则，并支持高效局部更新；包含一次性模式与无需重放任务或重解析历史的 Zip-on-Write 持续模式。
Result: 综合实验表明 SkillZip 在压缩性能、泛化性和成本开销方面相对基线具有有效性和优越性。
Conclusion: 作者认为无评估、可证明保留稀有异常并支持增量更新的结构压缩路径，能有效缓解自进化智能体技能库的冗余维护难题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: VibeLifeBench: Can Your Life Agent Be Proactive and Persistent in a Living World?
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as personal assistants. Existing evaluations, however, mostly use short, self-contained requests in static environments. Everyday life assistance is different. A task runs for weeks rather than minutes. The world keeps changing while the agent is not being prompted. Many constraints are never stated outright. An agent that merely answers the request in front of it will fail at such a task. What is needed instead is an agent that stays proactive and consistent. It decides on its own when to act, when to ask, and when to stay silent. It notices changes that nobody announced. It keeps one plan coherent from the first day to the last. No current benchmark measures this. We introduce VibeLifeBench, a benchmark of 200 long-horizon tasks across ten everyday-life domains. Each task is a scripted multi-week timeline in a simulated world of 22 mock services. The world advances on its own clock, and many of its changes are silent, so only an agent that re-inspects the world discovers them. Every task is graded by fine-grained, weighted checks that read only what the agent actually left behind, covering the end state, the timeliness of its actions, and whether it upheld the implicit constraints. We evaluate seven frontier models. All of them score low, which shows how far current agents are from assisting with real life. We will open-source all tasks, environments, and the evaluation framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VibeLifeBench，一个面向 LLM 智能体 (agent) 的长时程日常生活任务评测基准，包含 200 个跨十个生活领域的多周任务。任务在由 22 个模拟服务构成的动态世界中运行，世界按自身时钟推进且大量变化是静默的，只有主动重新检查世界的智能体才能发现。每个任务通过细粒度加权检查评分，仅依据智能体实际留下的行为记录，覆盖最终状态、行动及时性与隐性约束遵守情况。作者评测了七个前沿模型，全部得分偏低，并计划开源全部任务、环境与评测框架。
Motivation: 现有智能体评测大多使用静态环境中的短时、自包含请求，而现实生活辅助任务往往持续数周、世界不断变化、许多约束从未被明确说明；仅回答眼前请求的智能体会失败，但目前没有任何基准衡量这种长期主动性与一致性能力。
Method: 构建一个基准，其中每个任务是在模拟世界中按照脚本运行的多周时间线；世界拥有自己的时钟并产生无人告知的静默变化。评测通过只读取智能体实际留下的行为产物进行细粒度、加权的检查，涵盖最终状态、行动是否及时以及是否维持隐性约束。
Result: 论文评测了七个前沿模型，所有模型在该基准上得分都很低，说明当前智能体距离应对真实生活协助还很远。
Conclusion: 作者认为智能体需要自主决定何时行动、何时询问、何时保持沉默，并能从第一天到最后一天维持连贯计划；VibeLifeBench 及其环境与评测框架将开源，以推动该方向的研究。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 论文评测了七个前沿模型，所有模型在该基准上得分都很低，说明当前智能体距离应对真实生活协助还很远。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为智能体需要自主决定何时行动、何时询问、何时保持沉默，并能从第一天到最后一天维持连贯计划；VibeLifeBench 及其环境与评测框架将开源，以推动该方向的研究。

papers.title: MMArt: A Multi-Perspective Multimodal Dataset for Visual Art Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent vision-language models demonstrate impressive general visual understanding, yet their art interpretation remains shallow: they describe surface content but struggle with formal analysis, grounded historical interpretation, or affective characterization. We argue this is not only a model but also a dataset limitation. Existing art datasets are single perspective resources, where no dataset provides narrative, formal, emotional, and historical perspectives simultaneously for the same artworks. We introduce MMArt, a large-scale dataset of 74,234 WikiArt paintings, each annotated with four independently annotated perspectives plus a harmonized unified caption, produced by specialized vision-language models or human annotation and validated through complementary quality evaluations. Two complementarity analyses establish that perspectives encode genuinely distinct information. A generative analysis shows that formal analysis descriptions best preserve compositional style, and historical descriptions carry strong affective signal in reconstructed images. A discriminative retrieval analysis reveals task-asymmetry: narrative descriptions drive retrieval (R@1 = 44.0%), while formal descriptions, strongest for reconstruction, are nearly nondiscriminative at retrieval scale (R@1 = 7.8%). Leave-one-out analysis further confirms that historical descriptions are the least replaceable perspective across both tasks. Together, the two analyses establish that no single perspective suffices for all tasks, directly motivating MMArt multi-perspective design. The dataset, code, and additional information are available at https://shuaiwang97.github.io/MMArt/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMArt，一个大规模多视角视觉艺术理解数据集，包含 74,234 幅 WikiArt 画作，每幅画同时带有叙事、形式、情感和历史四种独立标注视角以及一个统一标题。作者通过互补性分析表明各视角编码了真正不同的信息，并发现叙事描述在检索任务中最有效，而形式描述最适合重建，历史描述是最不可替代的视角。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型对艺术的解读仍然浅层，只能描述表面内容，难以进行形式分析、有依据的历史解读或情感刻画。作者认为这不仅是模型问题，也是数据集问题：现有艺术数据集都是单一视角资源，没有数据集能同时为同一批艺术作品提供叙事、形式、情感和历史视角。
Method: 构建 MMArt 数据集，使用专门的视觉语言模型或人工标注为每幅画生成四种独立标注视角和一个统一标题，并通过互补性质量评估进行验证。还进行了生成式分析和判别式检索分析，以及留一法 (leave-one-out) 分析来评估各视角的独特价值。
Result: 生成分析显示形式描述最能保留构图风格，历史描述在重建图像中带有强烈的情感信号；判别式检索分析显示任务不对称性：叙事描述驱动检索 (R@1 = 44.0%)，而形式描述虽最适合重建，在检索尺度上几乎无判别力 (R@1 = 7.8%)；留一法分析确认历史描述是两种任务中最不可替代的视角。
Conclusion: 没有单一视角能胜任所有任务，这直接支持了 MMArt 多视角设计的必要性。数据集、代码和附加信息已在项目页面公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Persistent Recursive Worlds Enable Autonomous Software Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Complex software systems develop over timescales that exceed the lifespan of any individual coding agent. Most agentic software systems preserve continuity through persistent sessions, memories, managers or shared context. We introduce EvoX Genesis (hereafter, Genesis), which instead makes the software project persistent while allowing local agents to remain finite-lived. Genesis represents software as a persistent recursive world: each local world is situated by an accepted version and a repository path, finite-lived agents propose local changes, recursive delegation moves work across paths, and only accepted consequences advance the persistent version history. We evaluate this organization across formation, continuation and redevelopment. Starting from a repository with no compiler implementation, Genesis used DeepSeek V4 Flash to build a Rust-based C compiler with about 250k tracked lines; the run lasted over 120 hours, archived over 1,000 agent episodes and incurred only US\$44 in model-token charges. The compiler passed the complete c-testsuite and most LLVM and Csmith tests. In a separate compiler world generated with GLM 5.2, development continued after repeated agent replacement while retaining full test performance. Genesis also reimplemented 13 MESA modules with over 100k Fortran lines as a Rust workspace with nearly 90k Rust lines; across six numerical workloads, it achieved median speedups of 1.55--6.87x. These results show that long-horizon software development can be organized around a persistent project rather than a persistent agent. Project Website: https://genesis.evox.group/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvoX Genesis（简称 Genesis），将软件项目表示为持久递归世界 (persistent recursive world)，使有限寿命的编码代理在持久项目上协作完成跨时间尺度的软件演化。摘要报告从零构建 Rust 版 C 编译器、在多次代理替换后持续维护编译器开发，并将 13 个 MESA 模块改写为 Rust 工作区，取得 1.55–6.87 倍的中位加速。
Motivation: 复杂软件系统的开发周期超过任何单个编码代理的寿命，现有 agentic 系统依赖持久会话、记忆、管理器或共享上下文来保持连续性；作者提出另一种组织方式：让软件项目持久化，而局部代理保持有限寿命。
Method: Genesis 将软件表示为持久递归世界：每个局部世界由已接受版本和仓库路径定位，有限寿命代理提出局部修改，递归委托 (recursive delegation) 跨路径传递工作，只有被接受的后果才会推进持久版本历史。
Result: 摘要报告使用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 从无编译器实现的仓库开始构建 Rust 版 C 编译器（约 25 万行跟踪代码），运行超过 120 小时，归档 1,000 多个 agent episodes，token 费用仅 44 美元，并完整通过 c-testsuite 及大部分 LLVM 和 Csmith 测试。另一个由 GLM 5.2 生成的编译器世界在反复更换代理后仍保持完整测试性能；此外，Genesis 将 13 个 MESA 模块（超过 10 万行 Fortran）重写为约 9 万行 Rust 工作区，在六个数值负载上取得 1.55–6.87 倍的中位加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果表明，长时程软件开发可以围绕持久项目而非持久代理来组织。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Degraded Infrared Small Object Detection via Degradation-Adapted Physics-Guided Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small object detection has made significant progress in recent years. However, degradations such as fog and nonuniformity can suppress target-background contrast, substantially increasing detection difficulty. Existing methods mainly rely on image restoration as preprocessing, but they are typically designed for specific degradation types and fail to generalize to varying degradations. To alleviate this, we propose DAISOD, a degradation-adapted infrared small object detection framework for robust detection under different degradations. DAISOD first identifies the type and severity of degradations, then adapts the processing via dedicated branches, and finally fuses the results for subsequent detection. Moreover, a physics-guided restoration mechanism is incorporated to explicitly estimate degradation parameters and remove degradation effects through physical models, avoiding excessive restoration that may erase small targets. Moreover, we construct a degraded infrared small object detection dataset covering diverse degradation types and levels. Extensive experiments show that DAISOD outperforms state-of-the-art methods under various degradation conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DAISOD，一个退化自适应的红外小目标检测框架，用于在雾、非均匀性等退化条件下保持鲁棒检测。框架先识别退化类型与严重程度，再通过专用分支适配处理并融合结果，同时引入物理引导的恢复机制显式估计退化参数并通过物理模型去除退化，避免过度恢复抹除小目标。作者还构建了涵盖多种退化类型与等级的红外退化小目标检测数据集，实验表明该方法在多种退化条件下优于现有方法。
Motivation: 红外小目标检测在雾、非均匀性等退化下目标-背景对比度被抑制，检测难度显著增加。现有方法主要将图像恢复作为预处理，但通常针对特定退化类型设计，难以泛化到不同退化情况。
Method: 提出 DAISOD 框架，包含退化识别模块（判断退化类型与严重程度）、专用恢复/适配分支、结果融合模块，以及物理引导的恢复机制，通过物理模型显式估计退化参数并去除退化效应，以防止过度恢复导致小目标被擦除。
Result: 摘要报告在自建的多类型、多等级退化红外小目标检测数据集上，DAISOD 在多种退化条件下的检测性能优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 退化自适应与物理引导恢复相结合能提升红外小目标检测在多种退化下的鲁棒性；本文还贡献了一个覆盖多样退化类型与等级的评测数据集。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Unaccountable Delegation, Fading Skills: Mapping the Risks of Workplace AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: To anticipate socio-technical risks from AI agents, organizations need taxonomies to classify them. However, existing AI risk taxonomies focus on broad risks and do not capture job-specific risks introduced by agents. To address this gap, we make three main contributions. First, we developed a multi-layer framework from a literature review of AI agents. The framework models three core components and their interactions: agents, goals, and environment. Second, we embedded this framework in a structured prompt and applied it to descriptions of 2,078 job tasks from the O*NET database, producing 8,356 risk scenarios labeled by severity and deployment mode (automation or augmentation). We validated these scenarios with 45 workers across 10 job roles and an independent LLM judge, confirming their plausibility and alignment with job tasks. Finally, we extended an existing taxonomy to create a 15-category taxonomy of workplace AI agent risks that covers all our risk scenarios. Our analysis highlights four findings. First, augmentation is not inherently safe because overreliance on agents can gradually erode workers' skills and oversight. Second, Erroneous Agent Actions accounts for the largest share of risk scenarios and has the highest concentration of severe risks. Many arise at the human-agent boundary. Third, automation is associated mainly with organizational risks, while augmentation is associated mainly with risks to workers. Fourth, workers found our taxonomy easier to use for a risk classification task than two other taxonomies and preferred it in 64% of non-tied comparisons with a recent generative AI risk taxonomy. These findings show that workplace AI agent risks do not arise from agents alone; they also depend on how people work with agents and how agents are deployed. Safer workplaces require not only safer agents but also carefully designed human-AI agent collaboration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有AI风险分类法难以覆盖工作场所中AI代理（AI agents）引入的岗位特定风险这一缺口，提出一个多层框架并应用于O*NET数据库的2078个工作任务描述，生成8356个按严重度和部署模式（自动化/增强）标注的风险场景。作者扩展出15类工作场所AI代理风险分类法，并用45名工人和独立LLM裁判验证。主要发现包括：增强（augmentation）并非天然安全，过度依赖会侵蚀工人技能与监督；错误代理行为（Erroneous Agent Actions）占总风险场景最多且严重风险最集中；自动化主要关联组织风险，增强主要关联工人风险。
Motivation: 现有AI风险分类法聚焦于宽泛风险，未捕获AI代理在具体工作岗位中带来的风险，而组织需要能够提前预判这类社会技术风险的分类工具。
Method: 基于AI代理文献综述构建多层框架，建模代理、目标、环境三个核心组件及其交互；将该框架嵌入结构化提示并应用于O*NET的2078项工作任务描述，产出按严重度和部署模式标注的风险场景；再扩展已有分类法形成15类工作场所AI代理风险分类法。
Result: 验证表明生成的风险场景合理且与工作任务一致；增强模式与工人技能消退和监管弱化相关；错误代理行为类别拥有最大占比和最高严重度集中度，许多风险发生在人机边界；自动化主要对应组织风险，增强主要对应工人风险；在风险分类任务中，工人认为该分类法比另外两种分类法更易用，并在64%的非平局比较中偏好它。
Conclusion: 工作场所AI代理风险不仅源于代理本身，还取决于人们如何与代理协作以及代理如何被部署；更安全的工作场所既需要更安全的代理，也需要精心设计的人机协作。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Spectral Neuron
papers.abstract_en: As machine learned models increase in complexity and expressive power, features of simpler models, such as intrinsic coefficient transparency and control over the shape of the modeled function are lost. On the one edge of the spectrum we have simple linear models that possess coefficient transparency, but have a limited expressive power. On the other edge we have neural networks, that have expressive power that improves with scaling, but are mostly opaque. In this work we develop the \emph{spectral neuron} concept: a scalar model given by $f(x)=λ_k (A_0 + A_1 x + ... + A_n x_n)$, with learned real symmetric matrices $A_0, ..., A_n$. The input enters the model through an affine matrix function, but the prediction is obtained by reading one of its eigenvalues. Thus, the model is nonlinear, but the source of nonlinearity is still mathematically explicit. This gives us a useful middle ground: the model can become more expressive as the matrix dimension grows, while retaining coefficient transparency through the learned matrices. For example, extremal eigenvalues yield convex or concave functions, semidefinite constraints on the coefficient matrices impose monotonicity, and the associated eigenspaces characterize local feature influence. We study coefficient transparency, feature-influence bounds, and shape-control properties of this model family, and then test whether it can be learned and scaled in practice. We develop a systematic study of this model family, bringing together spectral results from several mathematical literatures to characterize its expressivity, coefficient transparency, feature influence, and shape-control properties. Code available at https://github.com/alexshtf/spectral_neuron_paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种称为谱神经元 (spectral neuron) 的标量模型，形式为 f(x)=λ_k(A_0 + Σ A_i x_i)，其中 A_i 是实对称矩阵，预测通过读取矩阵函数的一个特征值获得。该模型兼具非线性表达力与系数透明性：极端特征值给出凸或凹函数，半定约束可施加单调性，特征空间刻画局部特征影响。作者系统研究了该模型族的表达能力、系数透明性、特征影响界与形状控制性质，并测试其是否可在实践中学习与扩展。
Motivation: 简单线性模型具有系数透明性但表达力有限，而神经网络随规模扩大表达力强但大多不透明。作者希望填补两者之间的空白，构造一个非线性但非线性来源在数学上显式的模型族。
Method: 提出谱神经元模型，通过仿射矩阵函数将输入映射为对称矩阵，再读取其某个特征值作为预测；利用矩阵特征值相关数学理论刻画模型性质，并给出实现在实践中测试可学习性与可扩展性。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅说明作者进行了系统的理论刻画并测试了模型能否在实践中被学习和扩展。
Conclusion: 谱神经元族为表达力与系数透明性提供了折中，其特征值结构可显式控制函数形状，如凸性、凹性、单调性，并可通过特征空间解释局部特征影响。

papers.title: GSBF: Gaussian Splatting for Environment-Aware Beamforming
papers.abstract_en: Beamforming plays a key role in multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) communication systems. However, conventional beamforming design normally requires accurate instantaneous channel state information (CSI) and iterative optimization, which incur substantial pilot overhead and computational complexity. Recognizing that radio propagation is intrinsically governed by the physical geometry, we develop a 3D Gaussian splatting for environment-aware beamforming (GSBF) pipeline based on multi-modal data, which characterizes the environment through a persistent 3D Gaussian representation. Specifically, GSBF models the environmental scattering response with reciprocity-preserving bidirectional spherical Gaussian (Bi-SG) kernels and performs two-sided electromagnetic rasterization to render an angular propagator map. The rendered map is then aggregated through an over-complete array-manifold dictionary and projected to the constant-modulus beamformers, thereby synthesizing beams directly from the access point (AP) pose and user position without online instantaneous CSI. Simulations demonstrate that GSBF consistently outperforms baselines such as exhaustive beam alignment (EBA) with lower latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GSBF（Gaussian Splatting for Environment-Aware Beamforming）管线，用 3D 高斯溅射（3D Gaussian splatting）表征无线传播环境，基于多模态数据训练后，可直接从接入点（AP）位姿和用户位置合成恒模波束，无需在线瞬时 CSI。摘要称其在仿真中稳定优于穷举波束对齐（EBA）等基线，且延迟更低。
Motivation: 传统波束成形依赖精确瞬时信道状态信息（CSI）和迭代优化，导致大量导频开销和计算复杂度；本文利用无线电传播受物理几何支配这一事实，希望绕过在线 CSI 直接进行环境感知的波束合成。
Method: GSBF 用保持互易性的双向球面高斯（Bi-SG）核建模环境散射响应，执行双侧电磁光栅化（two-sided electromagnetic rasterization）渲染角传播子图，再通过过完备阵列流形字典聚合，并投影到恒模波束成形器。
Result: 仿真表明 GSBF 在性能上持续优于穷举波束对齐（EBA）等基线，并具有更低延迟。
Conclusion: 摘要强调持久化的 3D 高斯环境表征可以替代在线瞬时 CSI，实现低延迟的环境感知波束成形；具体泛化边界和实测效果未在摘要中展开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Runtime Observability for Heterogeneous Attention Memory
papers.abstract_en: Modern models no longer keep a plain KV cache: latent caches, learned sparse selectors and recurrent states each carry the model's memory in a different form, and each fails differently under compression. We give a runtime observability contract that covers all four memory classes with three operators, instantiate it on six model configurations across five architecture families, and compose the per-stage bounds into an executable request-level risk ledger. Contracts carry their error metric as a type -- composition is only defined when metrics match, and this check rejected our own first composed chain; the repaired chain crosses metrics through two proved bridges, and whatever no formal system can certify is measured instead, dropping the composed tier to empirical automatically: every claim is certified, partially certified, or empirical, composition inherits the weakest tier, and the tier is decided by the machine. Replayed over $12.4$M entry reads and run under eight-way concurrency with per-request budgets and fail-closed identity attribution, the ledger quantifies the honest trade-off on today's witness and holds its risk budget with zero violations. A fused always-on probe observes a declared one-layer subset under CUDA graphs inside the serving noise floor. Applied to a served DeepSeek-V4 stack with a packed compressed-KV prototype, the same machinery localizes a silent corruption to a precise structural boundary -- exact in the eviction-free, identity-isolated regime, with every observed failure in an eviction or slot-reuse regime -- through a machine-adjudicated discrimination campaign whose calculus rejected two of our own confounded inferences along the way. All artifacts, guards, and the Lean development are released at https://github.com/metask-ai/witprobe-attention-memory; every number in this paper regenerates from the shipped artifacts by one command.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 5 figures. Code, artifacts, and Lean 4 development: https://github.com/metask-ai/witprobe-attention-memory
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套面向异构注意力内存 (heterogeneous attention memory) 的运行时可观测性契约，用三个运算符覆盖四种内存类别：普通 KV cache、潜变量缓存 (latent caches)、学习式稀疏选择器 (learned sparse selectors) 和循环状态 (recurrent states)。契约把误差度量作为类型携带，仅在度量匹配时允许组合，并通过 Lean 4 形式化验证与机器裁决的层级分类来保证每个声明可被认证、部分认证或标记为经验性结论。作者在六个模型配置、五个架构家族上实例化该方法，并在 1240 万条读取记录和八路并发下验证风险账本零违规。
Motivation: 现代模型不再只维护单一的 KV cache，不同的内存形式在压缩下会有不同的失效模式，而现有手段缺乏跨内存类别的统一运行时可观测性，难以在请求级定位和解释压缩带来的风险。
Method: 提出一种运行时可观测性契约，配有三个运算符并覆盖四种内存类别；将每阶段误差界组合成可执行的请求级风险账本 (request-level risk ledger)。契约将误差度量编码进类型，组合仅在度量匹配时被允许，并用 Lean 4 形式化开发证明两条跨度量桥；无法被形式系统证明的部分自动降级为经验性 (empirical) 层级。
Result: 摘要报告在 1240 万次条目读取、八路并发、每请求预算和 fail-closed 身份归因下，该风险账本保持零违规；融合的常开探针在 CUDA graphs 下可观测声明的一层子集且保持在服务噪声底线内。应用于 DeepSeek-V4 堆栈的压缩 KV 原型时，该方法将一次静默损坏 (silent corruption) 定位到精确的结构边界。
Conclusion: 所有声明都被机器判定为已认证、部分认证或经验性三个层级之一，组合继承最弱层级；作者强调全部工件、守卫和 Lean 4 开发已开源，论文中每个数字都可通过一条命令从工件重新生成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wiring Beats Blending: What Transfers Between Transformer Sizes -- and What Doesn't
papers.abstract_en: Model families are typically trained size by size, each from scratch. Can a pretrained large model instead be converted into a smaller sibling? We characterize the 1.4B->410M conversion in Pythia end to end. Representations align strongly across sizes (ridge R^2=0.84) while parameters align weakly. Dense weight projection is functionally destructive, and a bit-exact control shows this is not an assembly artifact: basis mixing breaks rotary, per-head, GELU, and LayerNorm structure. After the best-fit linear operator, weight residuals are statistically indistinguishable from noise under shuffle controls. Conversion value therefore lives in initialization. In matched-budget continued pre-training we decompose conversion into two independent levers: least-squares compensation (function lever, best zero-shot) and variance-preserving rescale (dynamics lever, best endpoints). Compensation is a token-efficient, low-budget win rather than a universal one. At 30M tokens it beats the strongest subcloning variant on both a width-reduced pair (84.0 +/- 1.8 vs. 89.7 +/- 3.7, 3/3 seeds) and a held-out depth-reduced pair (109.3 vs. 117.9, 3/3 seeds), reaching a given quality with fewer tokens. At a 33x larger budget the two converge to parity (40.0 vs. 40.0), both far ahead of from-scratch, which transfer initialization always beats: by up to 18x at low budget, with the margin narrowing at convergence and at the largest scale. We also map the method's boundary. At about 5x the donor scale (6.9B->1.4B) stacking both levers over-corrects, consistent with ill-conditioning of the compensation solve at large width, which points to dimension-aware regularization as a fix. At matched budget our initialization also beats structured pruning with distillation, the standard pipeline, and improves further combined with it. Code, checkpoints, and the frozen evaluation corpus are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究是否可以把一个预训练大模型直接转化为更小的同族模型，并以 Pythia 1.4B->410M 为例做了端到端刻画。研究发现表示层跨尺寸高度对齐（ridge R^2=0.84），但参数层对齐很弱，稠密权重投影在功能上是破坏性的；转换价值主要体现在初始化上。匹配预算的持续预训练下，最小二乘补偿（function lever）与方差保持重缩放（dynamics lever）是两个独立的杠杆，前者在小预算下更省 token，而大预算下两者收敛到持平。
Motivation: 现有模型族通常逐尺寸从头训练，作者想回答预训练大模型能否被转换为更小的兄弟模型，从而省去大量重复训练成本。
Method: 提出将转换分解为两个独立杠杆：最小二乘补偿（least-squares compensation，功能杠杆，零样本最优）和方差保持重缩放（variance-preserving rescale，动力学杠杆，端点最优），并与从零训练、结构化剪枝加蒸馏等基线进行匹配预算比较。
Result: 在 30M token 预算下，补偿在宽度缩减对上以 84.0±1.8 vs. 89.7±3.7、在留出的深度缩减对上以 109.3 vs. 117.9（3/3 seeds）胜过最强子克隆变体；在 33 倍预算下两者收敛到持平（40.0 vs. 40.0）。初始化转移在低预算下最多领先从零训练 18 倍。在约 5 倍捐赠者规模（6.9B->1.4B）下叠加两个杠杆会过度修正，且匹配预算下该初始化也优于结构化剪枝加蒸馏，并可与其进一步结合。
Conclusion: 摘要强调转换价值存在于初始化而非权重本身，最佳拟合线性算子后的权重残差在置乱控制下与噪声不可区分；方法边界在大宽度下受补偿求解的病态性限制，指向维度感知正则化作为修复方向。
Relevance: 2
