papers.title: Where did the ambiguity go? Examining how multimodal models interpret polysemous words
papers.abstract_en: Human language is highly polysemous. Many common words (e.g., "bank" or "palm") carry several distinct meanings that shape what humans communicate and imagine. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to understand this multiplicity of meaning, but much less is known about how polysemy surfaces in other modalities such as images. We study this across 17 text-to-image and 15 text-generation models by giving each a polysemous word with no context to fix its meaning and measuring which senses are produced over many samples. We find a clear multimodal gap, where within every model family, generated images settle on far fewer senses than generated sentences (normalized entropy 0.10 vs. 0.25), and both are far less varied than what people imagine for the same words (normalized entropy 0.47). However, when we instead ask a model to list how often it would generate outputs corresponding to each possible meaning of a word, it predicts distributions that are more diverse than the actual space of outputs. These results reveal a multimodal gap in how foundation models express meaning, and how their understanding may not transfer faithfully nor equally across modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态基础模型如何处理多义词（polysemy），比较了17个文生图模型和15个文本生成模型在无上下文条件下生成多义词的语义分布。结果显示多模态差距：图像模型生成的语义多样性远低于文本模型（归一化熵0.10 vs 0.25），而两者都低于人类想象的多样性（0.47）；但当模型被要求列出各义项的输出频率时，预测分布又比实际输出空间更多样。
Motivation: 人类语言高度多义，LLM已能理解多种含义，但多义词在其他模态（如图像）中的表现研究不足。
Method: 给多个文生图和文本生成模型提供无上下文的歧义词，多次采样测量生成的语义分布，并与人类想象分布对比；另让模型自行预测各义项的输出频率。
Result: 所有模型族中图像生成比文本生成收敛到更少的义项（归一化熵0.10 vs 0.25），二者均远低于人类0.47；模型自我预测的义项分布比实际输出分布更多样。

papers.title: WitCert: Sound Runtime Risk Observability and Gating for KV-Cache Quantization
papers.abstract_en: KV-cache quantization is validated today by offline benchmark averages; a deployed system cannot tell whether compression is damaging the request it is serving right now. We give it a provably sound runtime meter -- a "DTrace for KV quantization": a per-(layer, head, step) upper bound on the total variation between exact and compressed attention. The meter has two tiers: a deterministic band-norm-witness bound, sound for any cache-preserving black-box quantizer and for any query (adaptive-safe, worst-case Cauchy--Schwarz plus RoPE band-unitarity), and a tighter probabilistic certificate for a controlled subtractively-dithered INT8 quantizer under an explicit request-level failure budget (stated for non-adaptive queries; core theorems machine-checked in Lean 4). Three results. Observability: the meter enters SGLang through an env-guarded patch, and any scheme registered as one tensor function is measured in live serving. Repair: meter-driven gating -- risk-ranked where the witness is saturated, certified where it is informative -- empirically restores the quality floor at benchmark scale, e.g. raw-cast fp8 from 22.8 back to 79.7 on hard RULER tasks with the difference from uncompressed bounded at $[+0.0,+0.8]$ by a paired test. Analysis: aggressive schemes survive on cross-layer error cancellation, not per-step fidelity -- in a 28-layer sweep, no single layer's pollution alone loses anything (0/28) -- and the certified int8 cache serves $1.88\times$ more KV tokens at the same memory in SGLang. All artifacts, guards, and the Lean development are released at https://github.com/metask-ai/witcert-kv-certificates; every number regenerates from the shipped artifacts by one command.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 7 figures. Code, artifacts, and Lean proofs: https://github.com/metask-ai/witcert-kv-certificates
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WitCert，一个为 KV-cache 量化提供可证明可靠运行时风险观测与门控（gating）的系统。其核心是给出每个 (layer, head, step) 上精确注意力与压缩注意力之间全变差（total variation）的上界，分两层：对任意保持缓存的 black-box 量化器和任意 query 均成立的确定性 band-norm-witness 界，以及对受控 subtractively-dithered INT8 量化器在请求级失败预算下的概率性证书（核心定理在 Lean 4 中机器验证）。作者报告了三项结果：通过 env-guarded patch 在 SGLang 中对任意单张量函数进行在线测量；基于测量驱动的门控在基准规模上恢复质量下限；以及分析表明激进方案依赖跨层误差抵消而非单步保真度。
Motivation: 现有 KV-cache 量化仅用离线基准平均值验证，部署中的系统无法判断压缩是否正在损害当前服务的请求，缺少一个可证明可靠的运行时度量手段。
Method: 提出一个类似“DTrace for KV quantization”的运行时计量器：为每个 (layer, head, step) 给出精确与压缩注意力之间的全变差上界。包含两层证书：对任意 cache-preserving black-box 量化器及任意 query 都 sound 的确定性 band-norm-witness 界（最坏情形 Cauchy–Schwarz 加 RoPE band-unitarity），以及针对 subtractively-dithered INT8 量化器、在显式请求级失败预算下成立的更紧概率性证书（针对非自适应 query，核心定理由 Lean 4 机器检查）。在此基础上实现 meter 驱动、风险排序/证书化的门控，并集成到 SGLang。
Result: 摘要报告：raw-cast fp8 在困难 RULER 任务上从 22.8 恢复到 79.7，且与未压缩的差异由配对检验限制在 [+0.0, +0.8]；在 28 层扫描中没有任何单层污染单独造成损失（0/28）；certified int8 cache 在 SGLang 中以相同内存服务 1.88 倍以上的 KV tokens。
Conclusion: 作者的结论是，激进量化方案之所以在基准上存活，靠的是跨层误差抵消（cross-layer error cancellation）而非每步保真度；概率性证书的适用范围限于非自适应查询。所有工件、guards 和 Lean 证明均已开源，摘要称每个数字都可由随附工件用一条命令重新生成。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Technological Advances in Detecting and Managing Cognitive Impairment in Older Adults: Trends, Challenges, and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: As populations age, cognitive decline from mild cognitive impairment (MCI) to dementia is a defining health challenge of the coming decades, yet routine assessment often misses its earliest signs. This article critically synthesizes recent technological advances for detecting and managing cognitive impairment in older adults, spanning neurophysiological signals (chiefly electroencephalography, EEG), structural and molecular neuroimaging (MRI and amyloid/tau PET), blood-based biomarkers, and digital markers, integrated through artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and deep learning (DL). Beyond summarizing, it contributes a cross-disciplinary taxonomy, a methodological-rigor lens foregrounding subject- and site-independent validation, an integrative early-detection framework linking tiered screening to intervention, and comparison tables of detection methods, interventions, and risk and protective factors. EEG markers (alpha/theta changes, P300 latency) and deep models (CNNs, LSTM/BiLSTM, transformers, self-supervised EEG foundation models) report strong accuracy, yet many rest on small, single-site datasets unlikely to survive rigorous external validation. Elsewhere, gains are tangible: plasma p-tau217 has reached clinical utility, with the first blood test cleared to aid Alzheimer's diagnosis in 2025; anti-amyloid therapies (lecanemab, donanemab) are approved despite modest, contested benefits; and multidomain lifestyle prevention has matured. Wearable, remote, speech, and virtual-reality tools enable continuous, ecologically valid monitoring, and multimodal fusion improves sensitivity and specificity. Barriers remain: standardization, explainability, data privacy, and equitable, externally validated deployment. The field's near-term promise lies in trustworthy, multimodal, longitudinally validated systems linking early detection to actionable, personalized care.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于老年人认知障碍检测与管理的技术综述（该论文已从 arXiv 撤回，撤回原因是作者署名资格争议未解决）。它综合了神经生理信号（主要是 EEG）、结构与分子神经影像（MRI、淀粉样蛋白/tau PET）、血液生物标志物和数字标记，并以 AI/ML/DL 进行整合；还提出了跨学科分类法、强调受试者与站点无关验证的方法学严谨性视角、连接分层筛查与干预的早期检测框架，以及检测方法、干预措施和风险/保护因素的比较表。
Motivation: 随着人口老龄化，从轻度认知障碍（MCI）到痴呆的认知衰退是未来数十年的关键健康挑战，而常规评估常常错过其最早期的信号。
Method: 作者对近期技术进展进行批判性综合，覆盖 EEG、MRI/PET、血液标志物和数字标记，并经由 AI、机器学习与深度学习整合；在此基础上贡献了跨学科分类法、方法学严谨性视角、整合式早期检测框架和比较表。
Result: 摘要指出 EEG 标志物（alpha/theta 变化、P300 潜伏期）和深度模型（CNN、LSTM/BiLSTM、Transformer、自监督 EEG 基础模型）报告了较高的准确率，但多基于小型单站点数据集，难以通过严格的外部验证；同时血浆 p-tau217 已达到临床可用水平，2025 年首个血液检测获批辅助阿尔茨海默病诊断；抗淀粉样蛋白疗法（lecanemab、donanemab）已获批但收益有限且有争议；多领域生活方式干预已成熟；可穿戴、远程、语音和虚拟现实工具支持连续生态化监测，多模态融合提升了敏感性和特异性。
Conclusion: 主要障碍仍包括标准化、可解释性、数据隐私以及公平且经外部验证的部署；该领域近期前景在于可信、多模态、纵向验证的系统，将早期检测与可操作、个性化的照护相连接。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models commonly adopt an LLM-centric $V \to L \to A$ pathway, where visual observations are projected into the representation space of a large language model before being decoded into robot actions. Although effective, this design incurs substantial computation and memory overhead at every policy invocation. In this work, we introduce TurboVLA, a new VLA paradigm that reformulates the conventional $V \to L \to A$ pathway as a direct $V + L \to A$ mapping. Instead of using a large language model as the central interface between perception and action, TurboVLA independently encodes visual observations and language instructions, directly exchanges information between them through lightweight bidirectional vision-language interaction, and predicts continuous action chunks with a compact decoder. This simple design constructs task-conditioned representations directly from visual and linguistic features, significantly reducing the computational and memory costs of VLA inference. On LIBERO, TurboVLA achieves 97.7% average success with only 0.2B parameters, 31.2 ms inference latency, and 0.9 GB inference VRAM on a consumer-grade RTX 4090, matching or outperforming substantially larger VLA policies. These results establish TurboVLA as a simple and effective alternative to the prevailing LLM-centric VLA paradigm, offering a new perspective on how vision, language, and action can be connected for efficient robotic manipulation. Code is available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/TurboVLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TurboVLA，一种新的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 范式，将传统 LLM 中心的 V→L→A 路径改为直接的 V+L→A 映射：独立编码视觉与语言指令，通过轻量双向视觉-语言交互交换信息，并用紧凑解码器预测连续动作块。在 LIBERO 上以 0.2B 参数取得 97.7% 平均成功率，在 RTX 4090 上推理延迟 31.2 ms、显存 0.9 GB，匹配或超越显著更大的 VLA 策略。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型普遍采用以 LLM 为中心的 V→L→A 路径，视觉观测需先投影到大语言模型表示空间再解码为动作，导致每次策略调用产生大量计算与内存开销。作者希望消除 LLM 作为感知与动作中枢的必要性，降低 VLA 推理成本。
Method: 提出直接 V+L→A 映射的 TurboVLA：不使用大语言模型作为中心接口，而是独立编码视觉观测和语言指令，通过轻量双向视觉-语言交互直接交换信息，并用紧凑解码器预测连续动作块，从视觉与语言特征直接构造任务条件化表示。
Result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，TurboVLA 以 0.2B 参数达到 97.7% 平均成功率，在消费级 RTX 4090 上推理延迟为 31.2 ms、推理显存为 0.9 GB，匹配或优于显著更大的 VLA 策略。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TurboVLA 是主流 LLM 中心 VLA 范式的简单有效替代，为机器人操作中视觉、语言与动作的高效连接提供了新视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Global Convergence of DGM and PINN Algorithms for Solving Nonlinear PDEs
papers.abstract_en: The Deep Galerkin Method (DGM) and Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have become widely-used methods for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) in the rapidly growing field of scientific machine learning. In these methods, a neural network is trained to approximate the PDE solution by using (stochastic) gradient descent to minimize the PDE residual of the neural network. Due to the non-convexity of the PDE residual objective function, the trained neural network may, in principle, only converge to a local minimizer of the objective function (which would not be a solution of the PDE). Therefore, there is a longstanding question regarding the mathematical foundations of these algorithms, and it is highly valuable to establish that the trained neural network will converge to the PDE solution. In this paper, we consider a class of semilinear PDEs with nonlinearities in the solution and its first derivative. For this class of PDEs, we prove that neural networks trained with gradient descent to minimize the PDE residual objective function will converge to the PDE solution as the network width and training time $\rightarrow \infty$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Deep Galerkin Method (DGM) 和 PINNs 这两类求解非线性 PDE 的神经网络方法，针对其 PDE residual 目标函数非凸导致只能收敛到局部极小值的问题，给出全局收敛性证明。作者针对解及其一阶导数具有非线性的半线性 PDE 类，证明当网络宽度和训练时间趋于无穷时，用梯度下降最小化 PDE residual 训练的神经网络会收敛到 PDE 的真实解。
Motivation: DGM 与 PINNs 在科学机器学习中被广泛用于求解 PDE，但其训练目标是非凸的 PDE residual，理论上可能只收敛到局部极小值而非 PDE 解，因此这些算法缺乏严格的数学基础，收敛性保证具有很高价值。
Method: 考虑一类在半线性 PDE 的解及其一阶导数中含有非线性项的问题，分析用梯度下降最小化 PDE residual 的训练过程，并证明在网络宽度和训练时间同时趋于无穷时网络输出收敛到 PDE 解。
Result: 摘要报告了对该类半线性 PDE 的全局收敛性证明：随着网络宽度和训练时间趋于无穷，训练后的神经网络收敛到 PDE 解。

papers.title: Moral Hazard in Multi-Agent Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Cooperation can fail when socially valuable effort is costly, hard to observe, and benefits mainly someone else. Building on Holmström's model of moral hazard in teams, we introduce the Dialogue Moral Hazard Game, a theory-grounded controlled experimental paradigm that instantiates this hidden-action structure as a textual environment for language agents. In each episode, an agent chooses between keeping an immediate local reward and paying a query cost to reveal a hidden safety fact that primarily helps another agent's downstream decision. We evaluate thirteen open-weight and four frontier models with stage-level mechanism metrics. In matched 3,015-decision-per-model experiments, GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 4.8 track the Holmström-derived private-share boundary across nine query costs (mean absolute errors 0.013 and 0.030); Muse Spark 1.1 responds directionally, whereas Fable 5 remains query-saturated. Diagnostic SFT, RLOO, SFT+RLOO, and GEPA updates are heterogeneous: SmolLM3-3B and OLMo-7B show the clearest weight-level mechanism gains, while GEPA raises Muse team success from $22.2\pm3.8\%$ to $100.0\pm0.0\%$ as query use falls from $51.1\pm5.1\%$ to $0.3\pm0.5\%$. Freezing the three Muse prompts and intervening on the rank--label mapping changes team success from $100.0\%$ to $12.5\%$ and then $0.0\%$, with validity fixed at $100\%$. Opus supplies a within-model contrast: its query-mediated prompt remains perfect across mappings, while two near-zero-query prompts follow the same trajectory. Optimization can therefore reach the same aggregate outcome through direct revelation or a learned effective information structure, motivating mechanism-level evaluation rather than team success alone.
papers.comment: New frontier baselines, new open weight inference baselines
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于 Holmström 的团队道德风险模型，提出对话道德风险博弈 (Dialogue Moral Hazard Game)，把隐藏行动 (hidden-action) 结构实例化为语言智能体的文本环境，用于检验智能体是否会在“付出查询代价揭示安全事实”与“保留即时本地奖励”之间选择合作。作者对 13 个开源权重模型和 4 个前沿模型做了机制层面的对照实验，并用心理学意义上的干预实验说明只看团队成功率会掩盖不同的信息结构。
Motivation: 合作可能失败于昂贵的、难以观察的且主要惠及他人的社会性努力，而现有评估多只关注团队级结果，缺少对机制层面的刻画。作者希望用理论支撑的受控实验来研究多智能体语言模型中的道德风险问题。
Method: 提出 Dialogue Moral Hazard Game，一个受 Holmström 团队道德风险模型启发的文本环境，每回合智能体在本地奖励与查询成本之间选择；评估采用阶段级机制指标 (stage-level mechanism metrics)，并加入诊断性 SFT、RLOO、SFT+RLOO、GEPA 更新以及冻结提示后干预“秩-标签映射”的实验设计。
Result: 在每模型 3,015 次决策的匹配实验中，GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Claude Opus 4.8 在 9 个查询成本上贴近 Holmström 私有份额边界，平均绝对误差分别为 0.013 和 0.030；GEPA 将 Muse 团队成功率从 22.2±3.8% 提升至 100.0±0.0%，同时查询使用率从 51.1±5.1% 降至 0.3±0.5%；冻结三个 Muse 提示并干预秩-标签映射后，团队成功率从 100.0% 依次降到 12.5% 和 0.0%，有效性保持 100%。
Conclusion: 优化既可以通过直接揭示 (direct revelation) 也可以通过习得的有效信息结构达到相同的团队级结果，因此作者主张应进行机制级评估而不是只看团队成功率。

papers.title: AutoWorldModel-Bench: A State-Centric Benchmark for Automated World-Model Research
papers.abstract_en: World modeling is an unsettled field: architectures, training objectives, and state representations interact in complex ways, and no single recipe dominates across environments. This makes it an ideal testbed for AI coding agents acting as autonomous researchers--a setting in which the improvement direction is not specified in advance, unlike the engineering-to-spec tasks that dominate current agent benchmarks. We introduce AutoWorldModel-Bench, a closed-loop benchmark in which frontier coding agents autonomously improve a provided base world model under a fixed compute budget. The benchmark spans eight game environments under a unified structured-state representation--ground-truth entity state extracted from each game and consumed through a shared tensor format--which isolates dynamics modeling from perception and enables minutes-per-run iteration. Across 64 sessions, Codex-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 improve their base on a held-out test split in all but one session, with about half (33 of 64) a substantial gain ($Δ\geq +0.10$) and the remaining improvements smaller but positive; in 91% of sessions the winning edit is a substantive change to the model or training rather than a hyperparameter tweak. Our benchmark offers a setting in which frontier coding agents can be evaluated on open-ended research rather than engineering-to-spec problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoWorldModel-Bench，一个闭环基准测试，用于评估前沿编码智能体 (frontier coding agents) 在固定计算预算下自主改进给定基础世界模型 (world model) 的能力。基准覆盖八个游戏环境，使用从游戏中提取的真值实体状态组成的统一结构化状态表示（共享张量格式），将动力学建模与感知隔离，从而支持分钟级的迭代。在 64 次会话中，Codex-5.4 与 Claude Opus 4.6 在除一次外的所有会话中均提升了留出测试集上的基础性能，其中 33 次为显著提升 (Δ≥+0.10)。
Motivation: 世界建模领域尚无统一方案，架构、训练目标与状态表示之间的交互复杂，且改进方向无法预先指定，因此非常适合作为开放式研究的测试场；而现有智能体基准多偏向按规格实现任务的工程设置，缺少此类开放研究场景。
Method: 提出闭环基准 AutoWorldModel-Bench：向编码智能体提供基础世界模型并限定计算预算，让智能体自主迭代改进；基准通过从八个游戏环境提取的结构化真值实体状态（统一张量格式）隔离感知与动力学建模，使每次迭代可在数分钟内完成。
Result: 摘要报告在 64 次会话中，Codex-5.4 和 Claude Opus 4.6 除一次外均提升了基础模型在留出测试集上的表现，其中 33 次 (约一半) 获得 Δ≥+0.10 的显著提升，其余为较小但正向的提升；91% 的会话中获胜改动是对模型或训练的实质性修改，而非超参数微调。
Conclusion: 摘要将该基准定位为对开放研究型任务（而非工程按规格任务）的智能体评估设置，为衡量前沿编码智能体在开放式世界模型改进中的能力提供可复现的评估平台。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Governing Well in the Algorithmic Age: The Foundations of Digital Statecraft
authors: David Uriel Socol de la Osa
papers.abstract_en: The digital substrate - data, algorithms, infrastructure, platforms, applications - is being governed without adequate conceptual foundations. The ability and legitimacy required to govern this substrate, and to govern with it, are simultaneously misaligned, contested, and structurally absent. We introduce digital statecraft as the organising concept for this emerging field, arguing that 'digital' reconstitutes the statecraft question rather than merely extending its domain. The concept operates on two dimensions - statecraft over digital systems, concerning the authority and capacity of the state in relation to the digital substrate itself, and statecraft with digital systems, concerning the deployment of algorithmic tools as instruments of governing authority. And it rests on two foundational requirements, technical coherence and legitimate authority, that are genuinely in tension. We derive ten principles of digital statecraft from these foundations, each naming a condition whose absence produces an identifiable and structural governance failure: public interest first, human-machine complementarity, governability by design, systemic coherence, hybrid institutions, adaptive governance, human centricity and civic agency, accountable and traceable authority, judgment across time, and the non-delegable core. This article takes the state as the starting point, the institutional form that developed historically in response to the problem of effective and legitimate public governance, and the only current candidate for which the full set of legitimacy conditions is institutionally available. But the digital statecraft programme holds open a deeper question than just whether states can reform themselves: governing well in the algorithmic age may require rethinking the boundaries, scale, and affiliative basis of statehood itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“数字治国术”(digital statecraft) 作为治理数字底层结构（数据、算法、基础设施、平台、应用）的组织性概念。作者认为“数字”重构了治国术问题而非仅扩展其领域，并从两个维度（对数字系统的治国术与以数字系统施行的治国术）和两个相互冲突的基础要求（技术连贯性与合法权威）推导出十条治理原则。文章以国家为出发点，但开放了重新思考国家自身边界、规模与归属基础的问题。
Motivation: 数字底层结构正在缺乏充分概念基础的情况下被治理；治理该底层结构所需的能力与合法性同时存在错位、争议和结构性缺失。这促使作者提出一个系统性的概念框架。
Method: 提出数字治国术概念，构建两个维度（statecraft over digital systems 与 statecraft with digital systems）和两个基础要求（技术连贯性与合法权威），并从中推导出十条原则，每条原则对应一种可识别的结构性治理失败。
Result: 摘要层面的核心产出是十条数字治国术原则，包括公共利益优先、人机互补、可设计性治理、系统连贯性、混合制度、适应性治理、以人为中心与公民能动性、可问责可追溯的权威、跨时间的判断以及不可委托的核心。
Conclusion: 作者强调该纲领以国家为起点，因为国家是当前唯一在制度上具备完整合法性条件的候选形式；但算法时代善治可能要求重新思考国家本身的边界、规模与归属基础。

papers.title: Lesioned Multimodal Language Models Reproduce Aphasic Picture-Naming Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Aphasia following stroke commonly produces systematic naming errors with characteristic profiles, but whether general-purpose language models not designed for clinical simulation can reproduce these patterns remains untested. We investigated (1) whether lesions or controlled perturbations to a multimodal language model can reproduce different types of errors in picture naming, and (2) whether the framework can reproduce the complete error profile of individual persons with aphasia (PWAs). Using LLaVA 1.6, we evaluated perturbation configurations that varied the layer, proportion, and amount of noise applied to model units. We examined 278 PWAs on the Philadelphia Naming Test, classifying responses into seven categories using a validated neural classifier. Six of seven response categories (correct, semantic, mixed, unrelated, neologism, no response errors) emerged at clinically-comparable proportions across distinct parameter space regions, with formal paraphasia being the exception. Searching the perturbation space revealed configurations that reproduced the individual error profile in at least six of seven categories for 97.8% of PWAs and in all seven categories for 79.5% of PWAs. Monte Carlo baselines confirmed that this matching reflects joint inter-category structure rather than marginal overlap. These results establish a quantitative framework for reproducing individual aphasic error patterns in picture naming. They suggest the potential for language models to serve as digital twins of individuals with post-stroke aphasia.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 8 figures; supplementary materials (18 pages, 6 sections) included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究通用多模态语言模型在受控扰动下能否复现卒中后失语症患者的图片命名错误模式。作者使用 LLaVA 1.6，在 278 名失语症患者的 Philadelphia Naming Test 反应上评估不同层、比例和噪声量的扰动配置，发现除形式性错语外其余六类反应以临床可比比例出现，并可对绝大多数患者复现个体层面的完整错误轮廓。
Motivation: 失语症通常产生带有特征性分布的系统性命名错误，但面向一般用途、并非为临床模拟设计的语言模型能否复现这些模式尚未得到检验。
Method: 采用多模态语言模型 LLaVA 1.6，对模型单元施加改变层、比例和噪声量的受控扰动；使用经过验证的神经分类器将 278 名失语症患者的图片命名反应分为七个类别，并通过搜索扰动空间来匹配每个患者的个体错误轮廓。
Result: 七类反应中六类（正确、语义、混合、无关、新词、无反应）在参数空间不同区域以临床可比比例出现，形式性错语是例外；搜索扰动空间后，97.8% 的患者在至少六个类别、79.5% 的患者在全部七个类别上被复现，Monte Carlo 基线表明匹配源于类别间的联合结构而非边缘重叠。
Conclusion: 该框架为在图片命名任务上定量复现个体失语错误模式建立了基础，并提示语言模型可能充当卒中后失语症个体的数字孪生。

summary_sections.method: 采用多模态语言模型 LLaVA 1.6，对模型单元施加改变层、比例和噪声量的受控扰动；使用经过验证的神经分类器将 278 名失语症患者的图片命名反应分为七个类别，并通过搜索扰动空间来匹配每个患者的个体错误轮廓。
summary_sections.result: 七类反应中六类（正确、语义、混合、无关、新词、无反应）在参数空间不同区域以临床可比比例出现，形式性错语是例外；搜索扰动空间后，97.8% 的患者在至少六个类别、79.5% 的患者在全部七个类别上被复现，Monte Carlo 基线表明匹配源于类别间的联合结构而非边缘重叠。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为在图片命名任务上定量复现个体失语错误模式建立了基础，并提示语言模型可能充当卒中后失语症个体的数字孪生。

papers.title: EEG Emotion Recognition From AI-Generated Biodigital Architecture Images
papers.abstract_en: Emotional responses to biodigital architecture were examined using electroencephalographic (EEG) data from AI-generated images. A pre-experiment involving 336 participants identified 60 images, selected from an initial pool of 600, that elicited strong emotional responses categorized as awe, disgust, or content. These images were used for EEG recordings of 52 volunteers, with channel selection and sample size estimation based on the analysis of an existing dataset. Gamma and delta bands yielded the highest classification accuracy, with the gamma band achieving an accuracy of 77.07 percent +/- 13.8 percent for the awe emotion. Key factors such as greenery and non-uniform granularity were linked to positive emotions, while dampness triggered negative reactions. These results emphasize the significance of incorporating natural elements and varied textures in biodigital architecture to enhance aesthetic appeal and acceptance. The study demonstrates EEG's capability to objectively assess architectural preferences, providing valuable insights for architects to design engaging and sustainable environments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 AI 生成的生物数字建筑图像，通过脑电图（EEG）数据考察情绪反应。预实验由 336 名参与者从 600 张图像中选出 60 张能诱发敬畏、厌恶或满足等强烈情绪的图像，随后对 52 名志愿者进行 EEG 记录，并基于现有数据集进行通道选择与样本量估计。摘要报告伽马（gamma）和德尔塔（delta）频带分类准确率最高，其中敬畏情绪的伽马频带准确率达 77.07% ± 13.8%。研究还发现绿色植物和非均匀颗粒感与积极情绪相关，而潮湿感引发消极反应。
Motivation: 建筑偏好通常依赖主观问卷，缺乏客观度量；作者希望验证 EEG 能否客观评估人们对生物数字建筑的审美反应，从而为建筑师提供可量化的设计反馈。
Method: 采用两阶段实验设计：先用 336 名参与者的预实验从 600 张 AI 生成图像中筛选 60 张高情绪诱发图像；再用 52 名志愿者进行 EEG 记录，基于已有数据集的通道选择和样本量估计，并对 EEG 频带进行分类分析。
Result: 伽马（gamma）与德尔塔（delta）频带达到最高分类准确率，伽马频带对敬畏情绪的分类准确率为 77.07% ± 13.8%；绿色植物与非均匀颗粒感与积极情绪相关，潮湿感与消极反应相关。
Conclusion: 作者强调在生物数字建筑中融入自然元素和多样化纹理可提升美学吸引力与接受度，并认为 EEG 具备客观评估建筑偏好的能力，为设计可持续且吸引人的环境提供参考。

papers.title: Directional Curvature from Armijo Backtracking: A Low-Cost Sharpness Probe and a Calibration-Free Learning-Rate Safeguard for Adam
papers.abstract_en: The local sharpness of the loss, the top Hessian eigenvalue $λ_1$, determines the largest stable gradient step, but measuring it normally requires Lanczos or Hessian-vector products. A single Armijo backtracking line search already carries this information at the cost of a few forward passes: the accepted step $α$ brackets the directional curvature along the probed direction within the multiplicative band set by the backtracking factor: exactly the curvature averaged over the tested step, and empirically $q = g^\top H g/\|g\|^2$ to within that band. Across CIFAR-10, Fashion-MNIST and Imagenette, $\logα$ tracks $\logλ_1$ at Pearson $-0.91$ to $-0.95$, and the relation survives a per-run detrending check at $-0.60$ to $-0.70$, a low-cost online Edge-of-Stability reading of the slow sharpness component. Used as a safeguard rather than a faster optimiser, the reading caps a too-large initial learning rate. A single fixed protocol, probing along Adam's own update direction at initialisation and over the first fifty optimiser steps and capping the rate at twice the smallest reading, removes every divergence across learning-rate grids spanning $10^{-3}$ to $3.0$ and at GPT-2 pretraining scale, and all but one marginal case across the further architectures we test, at about $1\%$ overhead, and it leaves training bit-identical whenever the cap does not bind. No constant in the protocol is tuned per architecture; this is the sense in which the safeguard is calibration-free. The guarantee is divergence, not accuracy: where the productive range is narrow the capped run survives at strongly reduced accuracy (chance level on AG News at aggressive rates), and our measurements show why any cap frozen at initialisation must fail at pretraining scale: the loss surface sharpens within the first five optimiser steps, the gap warmup has always filled by convention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用单次 Armijo backtracking 线搜索中接受的步长 α 来低成本估计损失沿探测方向的方向曲率，并将其作为 top Hessian eigenvalue λ1 的在线代理，进而构造一个无需逐架构调参的 Adam 学习率安全保护机制。摘要报告在 CIFAR-10、Fashion-MNIST 和 Imagenette 上 logα 与 logλ1 的 Pearson 相关为 -0.91 至 -0.95；在从 10^-3 到 3.0 的学习率网格及 GPT-2 预训练规模下，固定协议消除了所有发散，且开销约 1%。
Motivation: 测量损失锐度通常需要 Lanczos 或 Hessian-vector products，成本较高；同时在大规模预训练中损失面会在最初几步内迅速变尖锐，任何在初始化时冻结的学习率上限都会失效。本文希望提供低成本的锐度探针，并构造一个校准-free 的 Adam 发散保护。
Method: 利用 Armijo backtracking 线搜索中接受的步长 α 来界定探测方向上的方向曲率，并采用 Adam 自身的更新方向作为探测方向；在初始化及前五十个优化步内探测，将学习率上限设为最小读数的两倍。协议中没有任何逐架构调参的常数，开销约为 1%。
Result: 摘要报告 logα 与 logλ1 的 Pearson 相关为 -0.91 至 -0.95，逐运行去趋势后为 -0.60 至 -0.70；该协议在覆盖 10^-3 至 3.0 的学习率网格和 GPT-2 预训练规模上消除所有发散，其它测试架构中仅剩一个边缘案例；当上限不生效时训练保持 bit-identical。
Conclusion: 作者强调该保护的保证是避免发散而非保证精度：在有效学习率范围很窄时，被限制的运行会以显著降低的精度存活（如 AG News 在激进学习率下接近随机水平）。测量还表明任何在初始化时固定的学习率上限在预训练规模下必然失效，因为损失面在前五个优化步内就会变尖锐。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On the Role of Directionality in Structural Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Several SLOG test categories explicitly involve directional distinctions (modifier position shifts, argument extraction positions), yet AM-Parser, the previous SOTA, uses an AM algebra whose operations do not encode direction. We redesign the symbolic backend around CCG directed types (deterministic CKY + single linear decoder, 30K learnable parameters). Under the same BERT-base encoder, the system achieves 75.9$\pm$6.4% LF exact match, surpassing AM-Parser (70.8$\pm$4.3%). Per SLOG's own category groupings, gains are highly directional: the CCG system outperforms AM-Parser on all 5 position-shift categories (+29.9pp), while AM-Parser outperforms on all 6 recursive-depth categories. Replacing the encoder with DeBERTa-v3-large yields 90.7$\pm$4.9%, with the largest encoder gains in recursive-depth categories, complementary to directionality's gains. Directional representations shift the bottleneck from the symbolic layer (AM-Parser's 0% category ceiling) to the neural layer, which improves with encoder upgrades.
papers.comment: We have identified an evaluation-metric mismatch in this preprint (reported LF exact match was computed against a final-state proxy, not against predicted LF edges). We withdraw the claims in this version. A corrected approach with true LF evaluation is in preparation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究方向性表示在结构泛化中的作用，针对 SLOG 基准中显式包含方向性区分的测试类别，提出用 CCG 有向类型 (directed types) 重设计符号后端，替代此前 SOTA 的 AM-Parser 所使用的 AM 代数。摘要报告在 BERT-base 编码器下达到 75.9±6.4% 的 LF exact match，超过 AM-Parser 的 70.8±4.3%，且收益集中在位置移动类别的测试上。但 arXiv comment 明确指出本预印本存在评估指标不匹配问题（LF exact match 是对最终状态代理而非预测 LF 边计算），作者因此撤回该版本中的全部结论，并正在准备使用真实 LF 评估的修正版本。
Motivation: SLOG 的多个测试类别明确涉及方向性区分（修饰语位置移动、论元抽取位置），而之前的 SOTA AM-Parser 使用不编码方向的 AM 代数，这一不匹配可能限制了其在方向性类别上的泛化能力。
Method: 作者将符号后端重新设计为 CCG 有向类型，采用确定性 CKY 解析加单一线性解码器，仅含约 30K 可学习参数，并与相同的 BERT-base 编码器搭配使用。
Result: 摘要报告该系统 LF exact match 达到 75.9±6.4%，优于 AM-Parser 的 70.8±4.3%；按 SLOG 类别分组，CCG 系统在全部 5 个位置移动类别上平均领先 29.9 个百分点，而 AM-Parser 在全部 6 个递归深度类别上更优；换用 DeBERTa-v3-large 编码器可达到 90.7±4.9%，且编码器提升主要集中在递归深度类别。但由于评估指标不匹配，这些数字对应的结论已被作者撤回。
Conclusion: 作者明确撤回本版本中的全部结论，指出报告中的 LF exact match 是对最终状态代理而非预测 LF 边计算的产物；他们正在准备以真实 LF 评估的修正方法后再重新呈现方向性作用的结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interpreting "Interpretability" and Explaining "Explainability" in Machine Learning in Physics
papers.abstract_en: We review the concepts of interpretability and explainability as they apply to machine learning in physics. We define interpretability as concerning the structural transparency of a model (the ability to understand or approximate its inner workings) and explainability as concerning the scientific content of a model (the ability to map it onto domain knowledge). We discuss the trade-offs each entails (interpretability vs. expressivity; explainability vs. adaptability), the contexts in which each is needed, and the intrinsic and post-hoc tools available for achieving them. Throughout, we emphasize that machine-learned models are subject to the same scientific questions as classical models, differing only in scale, and that interpretability and explainability are best understood as deliberate modeling choices rather than inherent properties. We also emphasize the importance of task specification and intervention plans as a core aspect of model design.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 3 figures, Part of the VERaiPHY Initiative; v2: Minor revisions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向物理学中机器学习应用的综述，系统梳理了可解释性 (interpretability) 与可解释性/解释性 (explainability) 两个概念的区别与联系。作者将前者定义为模型的结构透明性，即理解或近似其内部运作的能力；将后者定义为模型的科学内容性，即将其映射到领域知识的能力。文章讨论了二者各自的权衡、适用场景以及内在 (intrinsic) 与事后 (post-hoc) 工具，并强调机器学习模型与经典模型面对相同的科学问题，只是规模不同。
Motivation: 物理学界在使用 interpretability 和 explainability 时常常混用，缺乏清晰的概念框架，这阻碍了模型设计中对科学内容与结构透明性的明确区分。
Method: 给出形式化定义并区分两类概念，讨论 interpretability 与 expressivity、explainability 与 adaptability 之间的权衡，梳理内在工具与事后工具，并强调任务说明 (task specification) 与干预计划 (intervention plans) 应作为模型设计的核心部分。
Result: 该文为综述性质，摘要未报告具体实验或量化结果，主要贡献是概念厘清与框架构建。
Conclusion: 作者认为 interpretability 和 explainability 应被视为有意的建模选择而非模型的固有属性，且 ML 模型在科学上应接受与经典模型相同的审查标准。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Multi-Agent Embodied Autonomous Driving (MAEAD): From V2X Information Exchange to Shared World Models
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving is shifting from isolated vehicle intelligence toward multi-agent embodied systems that share perception, infer intent, and coordinate action under uncertainty. This survey examines this transition through the lens of Shared World Models (SWMs): predictive cross-agent representations maintained across vehicles, infrastructure, and other traffic participants. We review approximately 400 publications covering vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication, collaborative perception, inter-agent cognition, cooperative planning, end-to-end cooperative driving, and simulation and data engines for closed-loop validation. The organizing question is how exchanged observations become aligned state, intent-aware interaction, and coordinated downstream action. Across the surveyed literature, evaluation remains concentrated in simulation, curated benchmarks, and offline protocols. Foundation-model-based coordination also lacks verifiable real-time safety guarantees in open traffic. These gaps motivate key research priorities for multi-agent embodied autonomous driving (MAEAD): verifiable shared-state maintenance, robust intent and plan alignment, and safe coordinated action under communication and computing constraints in real-world deployment. We maintain an open-source project to continuously track the latest developments at https://github.com/dl-m9/Multi-Agent-Embodied-Autonomous-Driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇综述以共享世界模型 (Shared World Models, SWMs) 为主线，审视自动驾驶从单车智能向多智能体具身系统的转变。作者回顾约400篇文献，涵盖V2X通信、协同感知、智能体间认知、协同规划、端到端协同驾驶以及闭环验证的仿真与数据引擎，核心问题是交换的观测如何转化为对齐状态、意图感知交互和协调的下游动作。摘要指出当前评估仍集中于仿真、精选基准和离线协议，且基于基础模型的协同缺乏开放交通中可验证的实时安全保证。
Motivation: 自动驾驶正从孤立车载智能转向多智能体具身系统，需要在不确定性下共享感知、推断意图并协调行动。现有文献缺乏以共享世界模型为组织视角的系统梳理，同时评估与安全验证仍存在明显缺口。
Method: 本文是综述性研究，以'交换的观测如何变成对齐状态、意图感知交互和协调动作'为组织问题，对约400篇文献进行系统梳理，覆盖V2X通信、协同感知、智能体间认知、协同规划、端到端协同驾驶以及仿真与数据引擎。作者还维护开源项目以持续跟踪该领域的最新进展。
Result: 摘要未提供量化实验指标，但指出文献中的评估集中在仿真、精选基准和离线协议，而基础模型驱动的协调在开放交通下缺乏可验证的实时安全保证。
Conclusion: 摘要提出多智能体具身自动驾驶 (MAEAD) 的关键研究优先级：可验证的共享状态维护、鲁棒的意图与计划对齐，以及通信和计算约束下真实部署中的安全协调行动。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: E2LLM: Towards Efficient LLM Serving in Heterogeneous Edge/Fog Environments
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become integral to modern applications, yet their deployment remains challenging. Beyond executing the models themselves, practical deployment must address cost efficiency, low latency, and optimal resource utilization. Conventional approaches typically assume that an entire model can be hosted on a single device, which does not hold in many real-world scenarios, particularly in Edge and Fog environments where device resources are constrained. In this paper, we introduce E2LLM, a framework designed to enable efficient LLM deployment in such resource limited settings. Rather than simply partitioning a single model across all available devices, E2LLM replicates the full model across multiple groups of devices (replicas) and applies model parallelism within each replica. Each replica is assigned a specialized role PREFILL or DECODER based on its efficiency in handling input and output tokens. This separation leverages the inherent differences between these two phases of LLM inference. To effectively organize devices, we utilize a Genetic Algorithm to form clusters that maximize system performance. Within each cluster, we apply Dynamic Programming to determine an optimal partitioning strategy that minimizes bottlenecks in model-parallel execution. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach adapts robustly to varying workloads, including scenarios with significant variation in input and output token lengths. Compared to the Splitwise baseline, E2LLM reduces average waiting time by over 50% under high-demand conditions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: E2LLM 是一个面向资源受限的边缘/雾计算环境的大语言模型（LLM）部署框架，旨在解决单设备无法承载完整模型的部署难题。该框架将模型复制到多组设备（replicas）中，并在每个副本内部采用模型并行；副本按其在输入和输出 token 上的处理效率被分配 PREFILL 或 DECODER 角色，以利用 LLM 推理两个阶段的差异。实验表明，在高负载条件下，与 Splitwise 基线相比，E2LLM 将平均等待时间降低了超过 50%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 部署方法通常假设整个模型可以托管在单个设备上，但在边缘和雾计算环境中设备资源受限，这一假设往往不成立。论文希望解决这些场景下部署的成本效率、低延迟与资源利用率优化问题。
Method: E2LLM 提出将完整模型复制到多组设备上，并在每个副本内应用模型并行；使用遗传算法（Genetic Algorithm）对设备进行聚类以最大化系统性能，并在每个聚类内用动态规划（Dynamic Programming）确定最优的模型分区策略，以最小化模型并行执行中的瓶颈。
Result: 实验表明，E2LLM 能稳健适应输入和输出 token 长度差异较大的多变工作负载；与 Splitwise 基线相比，在高需求条件下平均等待时间减少超过 50%。
Conclusion: 论文强调，通过副本间的角色分离（PREFILL 与 DECODER）以及两级优化（遗传算法聚类与动态规划分区），E2LLM 可在资源受限的边缘/雾环境中实现高效的 LLM 部署。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SUPREME: A Multi-GPU Framework for Reproducible Image Unlearning Method Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning removes the influence of specific training data from a trained model without retraining it from scratch. Evaluating an unlearning method requires repeating training, unlearning, and evaluation across multiple seeds, which is computationally expensive. To our knowledge, existing image classification unlearning frameworks run on a single GPU, which limits how many seeds can be evaluated in reasonable time. We introduce SUPREME, an open-source framework that distributes these stages across multiple GPUs. SUPREME makes three contributions: a registry-based design for adding new methods, metrics, models, and scenarios; a multi-GPU architecture supporting multiple accelerators and precision modes; and a demonstration on Pins Face Recognition using ResNet18 and ViT under full-class and random-sample unlearning across ten seeds. The framework is available at https://github.com/pedroandreou/supreme-unlearning.
papers.comment: Accepted at WIPE-OUT 2026, the 2nd Workshop on Machine Unlearning and Privacy Preservation, co-located with ECML-PKDD 2026, Naples, Italy. Camera-ready version. 16 pages. Code available at https://github.com/pedroandreou/supreme-unlearning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SUPREME，一个用于可复现图像遗忘（machine unlearning）方法评估的多 GPU 开源框架。它将训练、遗忘和评估阶段分布到多个 GPU 上，以支持更多随机种子（seeds）的评估，并在 Pins Face Recognition 数据集上用 ResNet18 和 ViT 在全类与随机样本遗忘场景下做了演示。框架代码已开源。
Motivation: 评估一个遗忘方法需要在多个随机种子下重复训练、遗忘和评估，计算开销很大；现有图像分类遗忘框架仅在单 GPU 上运行，限制了合理时间内可评估的种子数量。
Method: SUPREME 提供三种核心设计：基于注册表（registry-based）的架构以方便加入新方法、指标、模型和场景；支持多种加速器和精度模式的多 GPU 架构；以及在 Pins Face Recognition 上的完整演示流程。
Result: 摘要报告了在 Pins Face Recognition 上使用 ResNet18 和 ViT 的演示，涵盖全类和随机样本遗忘，横跨十个随机种子，但未给出具体的性能或加速数字。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架是开源的，旨在提升遗忘方法评估的可复现性，并支持多 GPU 扩展以应对计算瓶颈。

papers.title: Periodic Topological Deep Learning for Polymer Design and Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Polymers underpin applications across energy, healthcare, and materials science, yet their vast chemical space makes systematic discovery challenging. Most machine learning approaches represent polymers as molecular graphs of a single repeating unit, thereby missing both the periodicity of polymer chains and many-body interactions beyond pairwise bonds. We introduce Periodic-TDL, a deep learning framework built on periodic Vietoris-Rips complexes that capture many-body interactions across multiple spatial scales, followed by a hierarchical simplicial message-passing (HSMP) encoder that propagates information from long-range interactions to covalent bonds, yielding representations enriched by higher-order topological features. Periodic-TDL outperforms all state-of-the-art models across polymer property prediction tasks spanning electronic, optical, physical, and thermal targets. Furthermore, we quantitatively validate how ester-to-amide substitution and $α$-methylation enhance thermal stability. Using a computationally synthesized dataset of 48,208 structures-generated via systematic substitution of acrylate and acrylamide polymers-we observed a mean $T_g$ increase of $\sim 55^\circ$C for ester-to-amide substitutions and $\sim 14^\circ$C for backbone $α$-methylation across matched polymer pairs. To verify these predicted trends, we use our Periodic-TDL model to analyze six novel polymer pairs from independent experimental measurements, including three newly synthesized polymers previously unreported in the literature. The experimental data successfully confirmed the model's predictions. Ultimately, these findings demonstrate that Periodic-TDL captures the underlying physical effects of specific functional group modifications, rather than merely optimizing predictive performance on benchmark datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Periodic-TDL，一个基于周期 Vietoris-Rips 复形 (periodic Vietoris-Rips complexes) 的聚合物深度学习框架，用层级单纯消息传递 (HSMP) 编码器把长程多体相互作用传播到共价键，从而得到带有高阶拓扑特征的表示。摘要称该方法在电子、光学、物理和热学等聚合物性质预测任务上超越现有 SOTA 模型，并定量验证了酯基到酰胺基取代及 α-甲基化对热稳定性的提升（平均 Tg 分别升高约 55°C 和 14°C），独立实验数据证实了模型预测。
Motivation: 现有机器学习方法大多把聚合物表示为单一重复单元的分子图，既丢失了聚合物链的周期性，也忽略了成对键之外的多体相互作用，限制了聚合物性质预测与系统性发现。
Method: 构造周期 Vietoris-Rips 复形以捕获跨多个空间尺度的多体相互作用，再使用层级单纯消息传递 (hierarchical simplicial message-passing, HSMP) 编码器，将长程相互作用的信息传播到共价键，最终得到由高阶拓扑特征增强的表示。
Result: 摘要报告 Periodic-TDL 在电子、光学、物理和热学性质预测任务上优于所有现有 SOTA 模型。在 48,208 个通过丙烯酸酯和丙烯酰胺聚合物系统取代生成的结构上，酯基到酰胺基取代使匹配聚合物对的平均 Tg 提高约 55°C，骨架 α-甲基化提高约 14°C；用包含三个文献未见新合成聚合物的六个新型聚合物对的独立实验测量验证了这些预测趋势。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果表明 Periodic-TDL 学到的是特定官能团修饰背后的物理效应，而不仅仅是优化基准数据集上的预测性能；工作范围聚焦于聚合物设计、性质预测与发现。

papers.title: BrickAnything: Geometry-Conditioned Buildable Brick Generation with Structure-Aware Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Generating physically buildable brick structures from 3D shapes requires more than geometric reconstruction: the output must also satisfy discrete part constraints and structural stability. Existing brick generation methods either rely on heuristic optimization, which can break down when the target 3D shape does not admit a feasible structure under predefined constraints, or generate brick sequences without explicitly modeling the underlying 3D geometry and assembly relations. In this work, we present BrickAnything, a geometry-conditioned autoregressive framework for generating buildable brick structures from diverse 3D representations. BrickAnything uses point clouds as a unified geometric interface and predicts brick sequences that reconstruct the target shape under assembly constraints. To model structural dependencies among bricks, we introduce a structure-aware tree tokenization, which represents brick structures through local attachment relations. This formulation makes sequence generation more consistent with the physical construction process, and reduces invalid intermediate states. We further introduce preference-based alignment post-training, validity-constrained decoding and adaptive rollback to improve buildability objectives such as stability and geometric fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BrickAnything produces geometrically faithful and physically realizable brick structures, and that the proposed tokenization effectively reduces rollback and regeneration compared with conventional ordering strategies.
papers.comment: Revised version with updated Code: https://github.com/xjtunzy/BrickAnything
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BrickAnything，一个几何条件自回归框架，用于从不同 3D 表示生成可物理搭建的积木结构。它使用点云作为统一几何接口，并引入结构感知树分词（structure-aware tree tokenization）来表示积木间的局部连接关系，使序列生成更接近物理搭建过程。此外还加入基于偏好的对齐后训练、有效性约束解码和自适应回滚，以改善稳定性和几何保真度。实验表明该方法能生成几何保真且物理可实现的积木结构，所提分词相比常规排序策略能减少回滚和重生成。
Motivation: 现有积木生成方法要么依赖启发式优化，在目标形状不满足预定义约束时可能失效，要么生成积木序列时没有显式建模底层 3D 几何和装配关系，导致输出难以同时满足离散部件约束与结构稳定性。
Method: 以点云作为统一几何接口，提出几何条件自回归框架预测积木序列；引入结构感知树分词，通过局部连接关系表示结构；并结合偏好对齐后训练、有效性约束解码与自适应回滚来提升可搭建性目标。
Result: 实验表明该方法能生成几何保真且物理可实现的积木结构，所提出的结构感知树分词相比常规排序策略有效减少回滚和重生成次数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过显式建模装配关系的分词和约束解码，可以改善从任意 3D 形状生成可搭建积木结构的鲁棒性与保真度。

papers.title: Specifying AI-SDLC Processes: A Protocol Language for Human-Agent Boundaries
papers.abstract_en: AI agents now act as first-class members of the software development lifecycle, but the instruments teams use to direct them enforce nothing: process encoded in prompts is flexible but unenforceable, while workflow formalisms are enforceable but do not model autonomous agents. We propose a domain-specific language for specifying AI-SDLC processes as protocols, with formal abstract syntax, well-formedness conditions, operational semantics, and enforcement invariants, organised around a separation of policy (declared intent) from mechanism (structural enforcement). We prove that any well-formed protocol maintains its invariants on every execution trace, closed under Kleene composition of orchestration loops: protocol steps cannot be skipped, by construction. A failure-rate analysis derives two consequences: structural enforcement bounds silent failure while converting the remainder into visible, audited stalls, and the benefit carries a capability floor. We validate the design in simulation and end-to-end on SWE-bench Verified, where an identical bug-fix methodology yields no improvement delivered as prose instructions, but a significant, replicated 14-22 point gain when executed as a validated, self-correcting process; an ablation attributes the gain to the executed process itself, and the capability floor appears where the model predicts it. As foundation models converge, the durable engineering asset is the formally specified, executable process.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种领域特定语言，用于把 AI 参与的软件开发生命周期 (AI-SDLC) 过程规范化为协议，并以策略 (policy) 与机制 (mechanism) 分离为核心，给出形式化抽象语法、良构条件、操作语义与执行不变量。作者证明良构协议的每一步在任意执行轨迹上都不可跳过，并通过失败率分析说明结构性强制能将静默失败转化为可见、可审计的停滞，同时存在能力下限 (capability floor)。端到端实验在 SWE-bench Verified 上显示，同一缺陷修复方法以文字指令交付时无提升，而作为可验证、自纠正过程执行时带来可复现的 14–22 点增益。
Motivation: 现有团队用来指挥 AI agent 的工具缺乏强制力：编码在提示词 (prompt) 中的流程灵活但不可强制执行，而工作流形式化方法可强制却不建模自主 agent，因此缺少能真正约束 AI-SDLC 流程的规范手段。
Method: 提出一种用于说明 AI-SDLC 协议的领域特定语言，包含形式化抽象语法、良构条件、操作语义和执行不变量，并围绕策略与机制的分离来组织；同时给出不变量保持定理的 Lean 4 机械化证明，并用模拟与端到端实验验证设计。
Result: 摘要证明任何良构协议在每种执行轨迹上都保持其不变量，且在编排循环的 Kleene 复合下封闭；失败率分析表明结构性强制界定了静默失败并将其余部分转为可见停滞。端到端实验中，同一 bug 修复方法以提示词形式交付无改进，而执行为验证过的自纠正协议时在 SWE-bench Verified 上获得显著且可复现的 14–22 点增益；消融实验把增益归因于被执行的过程本身。
Conclusion: 作者认为，随着基础模型趋同，真正持久的工程资产是形式上被规定、可执行的过程本身；该方法面向 AI-SDLC，其收益存在能力下限的边界条件。

papers.title: Efficient Table QA via TableGrid Navigation and Progressive Inference Prompting
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promising results on NLP tasks, however, their performance on tabular data still needs research attention, because Table Question-Answering (TQA) requires precise cell retrieval and multi-step structured reasoning. Existing work improves TQA either by fine-tuning or training LLMs on task-specific tabular data, but often lacks verifiable control over how the model navigates tables and derives answers. In this work, we propose a training-free TQA approach with two structured prompting frameworks: TableGrid Navigation (TGN), which iteratively navigates rows and columns via a three-module loop to locate evidence and refine answers, and Progressive Inference Prompting (PIP), which enforces columns identification for explicit progressive row selection constraint according to the query. We evaluate 17 LLMs against 6 baselines on TableBench and FeTaQa dataset. On TableBench, TGN improves over the strongest baseline by 3.8 points, and on FeTaQa, PIP achieves SOTA performance over ReAct and Chain-of-Thought. Beyond inference-time gains, PIP and TGN can also serve as supervision templates to fine-tune small models, narrowing the performance gap to much larger architectures in resource-constrained settings, offering versatile and cost-efficient solution for TQA.
papers.comment: Accepted for Presentation in ICDAR 2026, Vienna, Austria
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的表格问答 (Table QA) 方法，包含两个结构化提示框架：TableGrid Navigation (TGN) 通过三模块循环迭代导航行和列以定位证据并细化答案，Progressive Inference Prompting (PIP) 按查询强制列识别和渐进式行选择约束。作者在 TableBench 和 FeTaQa 上评估了 17 个 LLM 与 6 个基线，TGN 在 TableBench 上比最强基线提升 3.8 分，PIP 在 FeTaQa 上达到 SOTA，且两个框架还可作为监督模板微调小模型，缩小与更大架构的性能差距。
Motivation: LLM 在表格数据上的表现仍需研究，因为表格问答需要精确的单元格检索和多步结构化推理，而现有方法多依赖微调或任务特定训练，缺乏对模型表格导航和答案推导过程的可验证控制。
Method: 提出训练免费的 TQA 方法，使用两个结构化提示框架：TGN 通过三模块循环迭代导航行列来定位证据并改进答案，PIP 根据查询强制执行列识别与渐进式行选择约束。
Result: 在 TableBench 上，TGN 相比最强基线提升 3.8 分；在 FeTaQa 上，PIP 超过 ReAct 和 Chain-of-Thought 取得 SOTA。此外，PIP 和 TGN 可作为监督模板微调小模型，在资源受限场景下缩小与更大架构的差距。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种无需训练且成本效益高的 TQA 方案，既能用于推理阶段提升性能，也能作为训练模板增强小模型能力，适用于资源受限环境。

papers.title: AgentMV: A State-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Budget-Aware Music Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating a complete music video from a song requires more than synthesizing visually plausible clips for individual lyric prompts. A practical system must maintain long-range visual consistency, coordinate recurring motifs, synchronize edits with musical structure, and manage the cumulative cost of video generation. Existing approaches typically generate segments independently or adopt fixed generation strategies, limiting their ability to perform global planning over an entire song. We present AgentMV, a state-guided multi-agent framework for budget-aware music video generation. AgentMV decomposes the production process into specialized agents for music perception, script planning, visual asset provision, segment realization, and final assembly, coordinated through a Structured Persistent State that enables information exchange and state tracking throughout the generation process. To optimize generation resources, we formulate motif-aware segment realization as a group-level Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problem solved via dynamic programming, considering segment importance, generation quality, cost, and motif reuse under a global budget constraint. Experiments on song benchmarks demonstrate that AgentMV improves quality-cost trade-offs over existing MV generation frameworks, highlighting the potential of state-guided multi-agent coordination and budget-aware planning for long-form music video generation with improved quality and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentMV，一个面向预算感知音乐视频生成的状态引导多智能体框架。它将生成流程拆分为音乐感知、脚本规划、视觉素材提供、片段实现和最终合成等专用智能体，并通过结构化持久状态（Structured Persistent State）协调信息交换与状态追踪。片段实现被建模为组级多重选择背包问题（group-level Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problem），用动态规划在全局预算约束下权衡片段重要性、生成质量、成本与主题复用。摘要报告在歌曲基准上相比现有 MV 生成框架改善了质量-成本权衡。
Motivation: 现有音乐视频生成方法通常独立生成片段或采用固定生成策略，难以对整首歌进行全局规划，因而无法维持长程视觉一致性、协调重复主题、让剪辑与音乐结构同步，并控制累计生成成本。
Method: AgentMV 将生产过程分解为音乐感知、脚本规划、视觉素材提供、片段实现和最终合成等专用智能体，由结构化持久状态统一协调。预算优化方面，将主题感知的片段实现建模为组级多重选择背包问题，使用动态规划在全局预算约束下综合片段重要性、生成质量、成本与主题复用进行求解。
Result: 在歌曲基准上的实验表明，AgentMV 相比现有 MV 生成框架实现了更好的质量-成本权衡，展示了状态引导多智能体协调与预算感知规划对长格式音乐视频生成的潜力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调状态引导的多智能体协调与预算感知规划能够提升长格式音乐视频生成的质量与效率。

papers.title: Learning to Bid with Unknown Private Values in Budget-Constrained First-Price Auctions
papers.abstract_en: We study the operational problem of automated bidding in repeated first-price auctions under budget and return-on-spend (RoS) constraints. In this setting, an auto-bidder must translate advertiser goals and constraints into real-time bids while learning two latent objects: the causal uplift value of each ad impression and the highest competing bid (HoB) needed to win it. We model uplift values and HoBs through a shared-context Linear Treatment Effect (LTE) structure and analyze both full-information and binary HoB feedback. We develop Dual-LTE, a dual-aware online learning framework that coordinates value estimation, HoB estimation, and budget/RoS control through confidence-guided exploration. We prove regret and constraint-violation guarantees that scale as $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ under full-information HoB feedback and $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ under binary win/loss feedback, where $\widetilde{O}(\cdot)$ hides problem-dependent and logarithmic factors. Semi-synthetic experiments using real auction covariates show that Dual-LTE achieves lower regret than the baselines across budget and RoS settings, while illustrating the tradeoff between regret and constraint violation. Our results provide operational guidance for DSPs and platform auto-bidders that manage advertiser budgets or seek to meet ROAS targets. When impression values must be learned, value estimation should be coordinated with budget or ROAS control: the auto-bidder should follow the Lagrangian bidding rule only when value estimates are sufficiently accurate given the current constraint pressure and should otherwise use controlled exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究预算和投资回报率 (RoS) 约束下的重复一价拍卖 (first-price auctions) 自动出价问题。作者提出 Dual-LTE，一个双感知在线学习框架，通过置信度引导探索来协调因果提升值估计、最高竞争出价 (HoB) 估计和预算/RoS 控制。摘要证明在全信息 HoB 反馈下遗憾和约束违反为 O~(√T)，在二元输赢反馈下为 O~(T^(2/3))，半合成实验显示其遗憾低于基线。
Motivation: 自动出价器需要将广告主目标与约束转化为实时出价，同时学习两个潜在对象：每个广告曝光的因果提升值和赢得曝光所需的最高竞争出价；现有方法缺乏对价值估计与预算/ROAS 控制的协调。
Method: 提出 Dual-LTE 框架，使用共享上下文的线性处理效应 (Linear Treatment Effect, LTE) 结构建模提升值和 HoB，并通过置信度引导探索 (confidence-guided exploration) 联合执行价值估计、HoB 估计和预算/RoS 控制，同时分析全信息和二元 HoB 反馈两种设置。
Result: 摘要证明全信息 HoB 反馈下遗憾和约束违反保证为 O~(√T)，二元输赢反馈下为 O~(T^(2/3))；半合成实验使用真实拍卖协变量，显示 Dual-LTE 在预算和 RoS 设置下比基线实现更低遗憾，并展示遗憾与约束违反之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 当印象价值需要学习时，价值估计应与预算或 ROAS 控制协调：仅在价值估计对当前约束压力足够准确时才遵循拉格朗日出价规则，否则使用受控探索；该结果为 DSP 和平台自动出价器提供操作指导。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要证明全信息 HoB 反馈下遗憾和约束违反保证为 O~(√T)，二元输赢反馈下为 O~(T^(2/3))；半合成实验使用真实拍卖协变量，显示 Dual-LTE 在预算和 RoS 设置下比基线实现更低遗憾，并展示遗憾与约束违反之间的权衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当印象价值需要学习时，价值估计应与预算或 ROAS 控制协调：仅在价值估计对当前约束压力足够准确时才遵循拉格朗日出价规则，否则使用受控探索；该结果为 DSP 和平台自动出价器提供操作指导。

papers.title: Period spacings and global seismic parameters for K2 red giants using deep learning
papers.abstract_en: Gravity-mode period spacings (DPi_1) of red giants probe the stellar core directly, constraining its structure, mass and evolutionary state. Their measurement requires resolving narrow, densely spaced mixed modes and has so far relied on the four-year baseline of Kepler. Recovering DPi_1 from the much shorter (~80-day) baselines typical of K2 remains largely unexplored at the ensemble scale. We develop an automated machine-learning technique to measure global asteroseismic parameters and gravity-mode period spacings for red giants from single-campaign K2 photometry. Two deep residual neural networks take the full-resolution power spectrum of an ~80-day light curve as input, without background fitting or mode identification, and return a probability distribution for each parameter, yielding a point estimate and asymmetric uncertainties. They are trained on ~8 million synthetic spectra and evaluated on held-out synthetics, on Kepler data degraded to K2-like resolution, and on K2 observations. On Kepler data at K2-like resolution, numax and Dnu are recovered for 96% and 91% of stars with robust dispersions of 3.6% and 1.2%; DPi_1 for 22%, with a dispersion of 0.9%. Applied to 18,704 K2 red giants, the inferred numax and Dnu agree with catalogue values to 5.8% and 1.9%, the additional scatter arising from known K2 artefacts. Among the 2,059 young red giants we obtain DPi_1 for 232 stars with a median fractional uncertainty of 1.3%, following the same Dnu-DPi_1 sequence as the Kepler sample although the training set carries no imprint of that relation. We show that numax, Dnu and - for a subset of young red giants - DPi_1 can be recovered from a single ~80-day K2 campaign within an automated, probabilistic machine-learning framework. This approach can also be extended to short-baseline samples from TESS and, in future, Roman and PLATO.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 13 figures. Substantially revised. TESS analysis will be presented separately
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自动化深度学习方法来从单次 K2 巡天约 80 天的测光中测量红巨星的全球星震学参数以及重力模周期间隔 DPi_1。两个深度残差神经网络直接把约 80 天光变的全分辨率功率谱作为输入，无需背景拟合或模式认证，输出每个参数的概率分布并给出点估计与非对称不确定度。模型在约 800 万个合成谱上训练，并在保持合成谱、降质到 K2 分辨率的 Kepler 数据以及真实 K2 观测上验证。
Motivation: 红巨星的 DPi_1 能直接探测恒星核心，但其测量一直依赖 Kepler 四年的长基线数据；K2 约 80 天的短基线在星团尺度上能否恢复 DPi_1 此前基本未被探索。
Method: 使用两个深度残差神经网络，输入为单次 K2 光变的全分辨率功率谱，跳过背景拟合与模式识别，直接给出 numax、Dnu 和 DPi_1 等参数的概率分布，从而得到点估计和非对称不确定度；训练数据为约 800 万个合成功率谱。
Result: 在 K2 分辨率的 Kepler 数据上，numax 和 Dnu 可对 96% 和 91% 的恒星恢复，离散度分别为 3.6% 和 1.2%；DPi_1 可对 22% 的恒星恢复，离散度为 0.9%。应用于 18,704 颗 K2 红巨星时，numax 与 Dnu 与星表值分别吻合到 5.8% 和 1.9%；在 2,059 颗年轻红巨星中，有 232 颗获得了 DPi_1，中位分数不确定度为 1.3%，并且它们遵循与 Kepler 样本相同的 Dnu-DPi_1 序列，尽管训练集并未隐含有该关系。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，在自动化的概率机器学习框架下，单次约 80 天的 K2 巡天足以恢复 numax、Dnu 以及部分年轻红巨星的 DPi_1；该方法还可推广到 TESS 的短基线样本，以及未来的 Roman 和 PLATO 任务。

papers.title: Convex Optimization with Nested Evolving Feasible Sets
papers.abstract_en: \emph{Convex Optimization with Nested Evolving Feasible Sets (CONES)} is considered where the objective function \(f\) remains fixed but the feasible region evolves over time as a nested sequence \(S_1 \supseteq S_2 \supseteq \cdots \supseteq S_T\). The goal of an online algorithm is to simultaneously minimize the regret with respect to hindsight static optimal benchmark and the total movement cost $M_\cA(T)$ while ensuring feasibility at all times. CONES is an optimization-oriented generalization of the well-known \emph{nested convex body chasing} (NCBC). When the loss function is convex, we propose a lazy-algorithm and show that it achieves $O(T^{1-β}), O(T^β)$ simultaneous regret and movement cost for any $β\in (0,1]$, over a time horizon of $T$. When the loss function is strongly convex, we propose a \textsc{Frugal} algorithm that simultaneously achieves zero regret and a movement cost of $O(\log T)$. To complement this, we show that any online algorithm with $o(T)$ regret has a movement cost of $Ω\left(\sqrt{\frac{\log{T}}{\log \log T}}\right)$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究嵌套演化可行集上的凸优化问题（CONES）：目标函数固定，但可行区域随时间按嵌套序列 S_1 ⊇ S_2 ⊇ ⋯ ⊇ S_T 演化，在线算法需在保证可行性的同时，同时最小化相对事后静态最优基准的 regret 和总移动成本 M_A(T)。作者针对凸损失提出 lazy 算法，针对强凸损失提出 Frugal 算法，并给出相应的 regret 与移动成本上界以及一个下界结果。
Motivation: CONES 是嵌套凸体追逐（NCBC）问题的优化导向推广，旨在处理可行集随时间变化的在线凸优化场景，现有工作缺少对同时最小化 regret 与移动成本的系统刻画。
Method: 对凸损失函数提出一种 lazy 算法，对强凸损失函数提出 Frugal 算法；两者都保证在任何时刻满足可行性约束，并联合控制累计后悔与移动成本。
Result: 对凸损失，lazy 算法对任意 β∈(0,1] 同时达到 O(T^{1-β}) 的 regret 和 O(T^β) 的移动成本；对强凸损失，Frugal 算法同时达到零 regret 和 O(log T) 的移动成本；此外证明了任何 regret 为 o(T) 的在线算法其移动成本至少为 Ω(√(log T / log log T))。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该工作给出了嵌套演化可行集下在线凸优化的 regret-移动成本权衡，并指出强凸情形下可同时实现零 regret 与对数级移动成本，同时以匹配的下界说明了这一权衡的紧性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structural Generalization on SLOG without Hand-Written Rules
papers.abstract_en: Structural generalization in semantic parsing requires systems to apply learned compositional rules to novel structural combinations. Existing approaches either rely on hand-written algebraic rules (AM-Parser) or fail to generalize structurally (Transformer-based models). We present an alternative requiring no hand-written compositional rules, based on a neural cellular automaton (NCA) with a discrete bottleneck: all compositional rules are learned from data through local iteration. On the SLOG benchmark, the system achieves an overall accuracy of $67.3 \pm 0.2\%$ across 10 seeds (AM-Parser: $70.8 \pm 4.3\%$), with 11 of 17 structural generalization categories at $100\%$ type-exact match, including three where AM-Parser scores $0$--$74\%$. Analysis reveals that all 5,539 failure instances reduce to exactly two mechanisms: novel combinations of wh-extraction context with reduced verb types, and modifiers appearing on the subject side of verbs. When we decompose results by CCG structural features, each sub-pattern either succeeds on all instances or fails on all. Intermediate scores (e.g., $41.4\%$) are mixtures of structurally distinct CCG patterns, not partial generalization. These results suggest that CCG directed types provide higher resolution than SLOG's phenomenon-level categories for characterizing structural generalization, and that the success/failure boundary is determined by the coverage of directed operations in the training data.
papers.comment: We have identified an evaluation-metric mismatch in this preprint (reported LF exact match was computed against a final-state proxy, not against predicted LF edges). We withdraw the claims in this version. A corrected approach with true LF evaluation is in preparation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种不需要手工编写组合规则的结构泛化语义解析方法，基于带离散瓶颈的神经细胞自动机 (neural cellular automaton, NCA)，通过局部迭代从数据中学习组合规则。在 SLOG 基准上报告了 10 个种子的整体准确率 67.3±0.2%（AM-Parser 为 70.8±4.3%），17 个结构泛化类别中有 11 类达到 100% 类型精确匹配；失败分析表明 5,539 个失败实例可归因于两种机制。需要特别注意的是，作者在 arXiv 评论中指出该预印本存在评估指标错配（LF 精确匹配实际是用最终状态代理而非预测 LF 边计算），因此撤回本版本的全部主张。
Motivation: 结构泛化要求系统把已学组合规则应用到新颖的结构组合上；现有方法要么依赖手工编写的代数规则（如 AM-Parser），要么基于 Transformer 的模型难以实现结构泛化。
Method: 提出基于神经细胞自动机 (NCA) 并引入离散瓶颈的替代方案，不依赖任何手工组合规则，所有组合规则均通过局部迭代从数据中学习。
Result: 摘要报告 SLOG 整体准确率 67.3±0.2%（10 seeds，AM-Parser 为 70.8±4.3%），17 个结构泛化类别中 11 类达到 100% 类型精确匹配，其中 3 类是 AM-Parser 得分仅 0–74% 的类别；全部 5,539 个失败实例可归结为两类机制，且按 CCG 结构特征分解后，每个子模式要么全部成功要么全部失败。然而 arXiv 评论说明该结果因评估指标错配而被撤回。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CCG 有向类型在刻画结构泛化上比 SLOG 的现象级类别分辨率更高，成功/失败边界由训练数据中有向操作的覆盖范围决定；但当前版本因评估指标问题已撤回相关主张，修正后的方法尚在准备中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GeoRect4D: Geometry-Compatible Generative Rectification for Dynamic Sparse-View 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes from sparse multi-view videos is highly ill-posed, often leading to geometric collapse, trajectory drift, and floating artifacts. Recent attempts introduce generative priors to hallucinate missing content, yet naive integration frequently causes structural drift and temporal inconsistency due to the mismatch between stochastic 2D generation and deterministic 3D geometry. In this paper, we propose GeoRect4D, a novel unified framework for sparse-view dynamic reconstruction that couples explicit 3D consistency with generative refinement via a closed-loop optimization process. Specifically, GeoRect4D introduces a degradation-aware feedback mechanism that incorporates a robust anchor-based dynamic 3DGS substrate with a single-step diffusion rectifier to hallucinate high-fidelity details. This rectifier utilizes a structural locking mechanism and spatiotemporal coordinated attention, effectively preserving physical plausibility while restoring missing content. Furthermore, we present a progressive optimization strategy that employs stochastic geometric purification to eliminate floaters and generative distillation to infuse texture details into the explicit representation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GeoRect4D achieves state-of-the-art performance in reconstruction fidelity, perceptual quality, and spatiotemporal consistency across multiple datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoRect4D，一个用于动态稀疏视角 3D 重建的统一框架，通过闭环优化将显式 3D 一致性与生成式精修耦合。该方法引入退化感知反馈机制，结合基于锚点的动态 3DGS 基底与单步扩散整流器，并采用结构锁定机制和时空协调注意力来恢复缺失内容。实验表明其在重建保真度、感知质量和时空一致性上达到多个数据集的最先进水平。
Motivation: 从稀疏多视角视频重建动态 3D 场景是高度病态问题，容易出现几何坍缩、轨迹漂移和漂浮伪影。现有方法引入生成先验来补全缺失内容，但随机 2D 生成与确定性 3D 几何的不匹配常导致结构漂移和时间不一致。
Method: 提出 GeoRect4D 框架，包含退化感知反馈机制、基于锚点的动态 3DGS 基底、单步扩散整流器（带结构锁定机制和时空协调注意力），以及渐进优化策略：用随机几何净化消除漂浮物，用生成蒸馏向显式表示注入纹理细节。
Result: 摘要报告在多个数据集上，GeoRect4D 在重建保真度、感知质量和时空一致性方面均达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式 3D 一致性与生成式精修的闭环耦合能够有效解决稀疏视角动态重建中的结构漂移和时间不一致问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lost in Adaptation: Layer-Selective Recovery of Temporal Reasoning in Video-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal adaptation can erode temporal reasoning (TR) in video-language models (VLMs), leaving models able to perceive salient events yet unable to infer their temporal and causal structure. We introduce MERIT, a gradient-free framework that repairs this capability through layer-selective model merging. MERIT assigns each self-attention layer a VLM-dominant or LLM-dominant interpolation and uses the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) to search the resulting combinatorial space under an objective that rewards TR gains while penalizing temporal perception (TP) degradation. Across three VLM families and five video benchmarks, MERIT consistently improves TR while preserving TP; recipes selected on a compact diagnostic set transfer to four unseen benchmarks, with relative gains of up to 27.8%. Interventional masking and frame-level attribution further show that the selected layers are functionally important for reasoning and that MERIT shifts decisions toward temporally distributed, causally relevant evidence. These results establish layer-selective merging as a practical post-hoc mechanism for repairing video temporal reasoning degraded during multimodal adaptation, without learning new parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MERIT，一种无需梯度的层选择性模型合并 (layer-selective model merging) 框架，用于修复视频语言模型 (VLM) 在多模态适应中退化的时序推理 (temporal reasoning, TR) 能力。MERIT 对每个自注意力层选择 VLM 主导或 LLM 主导的插值，并用 CMA-ES 在奖励 TR 提升、惩罚时序感知 (temporal perception, TP) 下降的目标下搜索组合空间。在三个 VLM 家族和五个视频基准上，MERIT 一致提升 TR 并保持 TP；在紧凑诊断集上选出的配方可迁移到四个未见基准，相对增益最高达 27.8%。
Motivation: 多模态适应 (multimodal adaptation) 会侵蚀 VLM 的时序推理能力，使模型虽能感知显著事件，却无法推断其时间与因果结构。作者将此作为核心问题，目标是修复这种在适应过程中丢失的推理能力。
Method: MERIT 将每个自注意力层分配为 VLM 主导或 LLM 主导的插值，借助 CMA-ES 搜索组合空间；目标函数同时奖励时序推理增益并惩罚时序感知退化，整个过程无需梯度训练或学习新参数。
Result: 在三个 VLM 家族和五个视频基准上，MERIT 一致提升 TR 并保持 TP；在紧凑诊断集上选择的配方迁移到四个未见基准，相对增益最高达 27.8%。干预掩蔽 (interventional masking) 与帧级归因显示所选层对推理功能重要，且决策转向时间分布、因果相关的证据。
Conclusion: 作者将层选择性合并确立为一种实用的、无需学习新参数的后处理 (post-hoc) 机制，用于修复多模态适应中退化的视频时序推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deterministic Adam-Inspired Methods with Accelerated Convergence Rate
papers.abstract_en: Adam is widely used, but its convergence theory remains incomplete even in the deterministic full-batch setting because momentum and adaptive preconditioning are tightly coupled. For smooth convex objectives, we split the momentum variable through variable-and-operator splitting, which reveals the acceleration mechanism. We then combine a Hessian-driven correction with Adam-style feedback based on the gradient magnitude. The resulting Adam-HNAG (Hessian-driven Nesterov accelerated gradient with Adam-style adaptive preconditioning) flow admits a nonnegative energy that decays exponentially. Its discretization yields two methods, Adam-HNAG and the synchronous variant Adam-HNAG-s. Under the stated trajectory-bound and consistency conditions, both methods satisfy a discrete Lyapunov contraction. If the exact adaptive steps are accepted, this contraction gives an $O(k^{-2})$ objective-value bound. Numerical experiments illustrate their behavior. These results apply to the proposed methods, not to the original Adam recursion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究确定性全批量（full-batch）设定下 Adam 的收敛理论。作者通过变量与算子分裂（variable-and-operator splitting）拆分动量变量，结合 Hessian 驱动修正与基于梯度幅度的 Adam 式反馈，提出 Adam-HNAG 流及其离散化方法 Adam-HNAG 与同步变体 Adam-HNAG-s。摘要证明该流存在指数衰减的非负能量，并在轨迹有界与一致性条件下给出离散 Lyapunov 收缩，进而得到 O(k^{-2}) 目标值界。作者强调这些结论仅针对所提方法，而非原始 Adam 递归。
Motivation: Adam 虽然被广泛使用，但即使在确定性全批量设定下，由于动量与自适应预处理（adaptive preconditioning）紧密耦合，其收敛理论仍不完整。
Method: 通过变量与算子分裂将动量变量解耦以揭示加速机制；随后将 Hessian 驱动修正与基于梯度幅度的 Adam 式反馈结合，得到连续流 Adam-HNAG（Hessian-driven Nesterov accelerated gradient with Adam-style adaptive preconditioning），并对其离散化得到 Adam-HNAG 与同步变体 Adam-HNAG-s。
Result: 摘要报告 Adam-HNAG 流具有指数衰减的非负能量；两种离散方法在所述轨迹有界与一致性条件下满足离散 Lyapunov 收缩，若接受精确自适应步长则可得到 O(k^{-2}) 的目标值界，数值实验展示了其行为。
Conclusion: 作者明确强调这些结果适用于所提方法，而不适用于原始 Adam 递归；理论针对光滑凸目标建立，并依赖额外假设条件才能得到加速收敛界。

papers.title: FactReview: Evidence-Grounded Peer Review with Execution-Based Claim Verification
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based reviewing systems typically assess manuscripts in isolation, leaving literature- and code-dependent claims difficult to verify. We present FactReview, an audit pipeline that extracts review-relevant claims, grounds them in related work and reference checks, and, when code is available, executes released artifacts under a fixed repair budget. On 26 paper-disjoint test papers with 354 human-verified claims, FactReview achieves 84.3\% F1 for claim recovery. In a same-backend, evidence-matched comparison, FactReview scores 4.72/5 overall, outperforming a direct LLM reviewer by 0.74 points. Removing execution evidence changes 17.0\% of claim statuses, more than removing any other single evidence source. In a reviewer-assistance study, FactReview reduces mean review time by 58\% while increasing benchmark-claim coverage from 87\% to 99\%. FactReview supports evidence-based claim auditing, with acceptance decisions reserved for human reviewers. The code is public at https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/FactReview.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FactReview 是一个面向 LLM 审稿的审计管道：先提取与评审相关的声明，再在相关工作与引用核查中进行证据 grounding，若有代码则在固定修复预算内执行发布产物来验证声明。在 26 篇论文、354 条人工核验声明上，声明恢复 F1 达到 84.3%；在同后端、证据匹配的对比中总评 4.72/5，比直接 LLM 审稿高 0.74 分。去除执行证据会改变 17.0% 的声明状态，比例高于去除任何单一证据来源；在评审辅助实验中，平均审稿时间降低 58%，基准声明覆盖率从 87% 提升到 99%。最终接受决定仍留给人类评审员。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的评审系统通常孤立地评估稿件，导致依赖文献与代码的声明难以验证；本文针对这一缺口提出可审计的声明核查流程。
Method: 构建 FactReview 管道，包括提取评审相关声明、将其 grounding 到相关工作和参考文献核查中，并在代码可得时于固定修复预算下执行已发布代码产物，从而形成多种证据来源的联合验证。
Result: 在 26 篇论文、354 条人工核验声明上取得 84.3% 的声明恢复 F1；证据匹配对比中总评 4.72/5，较直接 LLM 审稿高 0.74 分；移除执行证据改变 17.0% 的声明状态；评审辅助研究将平均审稿时间降低 58%，基准声明覆盖率从 87% 提至 99%。
Conclusion: FactReview 支持基于证据的声明审计，但接受决定仍保留给人类评审员；作者已公开代码。

papers.title: FusionBERT: Multi-View Image--3D Retrieval via Cross-Attention Visual Fusion and Normal-Aware 3D Encoder
papers.abstract_en: We propose FusionBERT, a novel multi-view visual fusion framework for image--3D multimodal retrieval. Existing image--3D representation learning methods predominantly focus on feature alignment of a single object image and its 3D model, limiting their applicability in realistic scenarios where an object is typically observed and captured from multiple viewpoints. Although multi-view observations naturally provide complementary geometric and appearance cues, existing multimodal large models rarely explore how to effectively fuse such multi-view visual information for better cross-modal retrieval. To address this limitation, we introduce a multi-view image--3D retrieval framework named FusionBERT, which innovatively utilizes a cross-attention-based multi-view visual aggregator to adaptively integrate features from multi-view images of an object. The proposed multi-view visual encoder fuses inter-view complementary relationships and selectively emphasizes informative visual cues across multiple views to get a more robustly fused visual feature for better 3D model matching. Furthermore, FusionBERT proposes a normal-aware 3D model encoder that can further enhance the 3D geometric feature of an object model by jointly encoding point normals and 3D positions, enabling a more robust representation learning for textureless or color-degraded 3D models. Extensive image--3D retrieval experiments on both synthetic 3D models and real-world industrial mechanical objects demonstrate that FusionBERT achieves significantly higher retrieval accuracy than SOTA multimodal large models under both single-view and multi-view settings, establishing a strong baseline for multi-view multimodal retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FusionBERT，一个面向图像-3D 多模态检索的多视图视觉融合框架。其核心是利用基于交叉注意力 (cross-attention) 的多视图视觉聚合器，自适应整合物体多视角图像中的互补信息，并设计法线感知的 3D 编码器，联合编码点法线与 3D 位置以增强无纹理或颜色退化 3D 模型的几何特征。在合成 3D 模型和真实工业机械物体上的图像-3D 检索实验中，该方法在单视图与多视图设置下均显著优于 SOTA 多模态大模型。
Motivation: 现有图像-3D 表示学习方法主要聚焦于单个物体图像与 3D 模型的特征对齐，难以适用于物体通常从多个视角被观测和捕获的现实场景。尽管多视角观测能提供互补的几何与外观线索，现有多模态大模型很少探索如何有效融合这些多视角视觉信息以改善跨模态检索。
Method: 提出 FusionBERT 框架，包含基于交叉注意力的多视图视觉聚合器，用于融合视图间互补关系并选择性强调跨视图的重要视觉线索；同时提出法线感知的 3D 模型编码器，通过联合编码点法线和 3D 位置来增强 3D 几何特征，提升对无纹理或颜色退化 3D 模型的表示鲁棒性。
Result: 在合成 3D 模型和真实工业机械物体上的广泛图像-3D 检索实验中，FusionBERT 在单视图和多视图设置下均取得了比 SOTA 多模态大模型显著更高的检索准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FusionBERT 为多视图多模态检索建立了一个强基线，表明交叉注意力的多视图融合与法线感知的 3D 编码可以有效提升图像-3D 跨模态检索性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VFIG: Vectorizing Complex Figures in SVG with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) are essential for technical illustration and digital design, offering resolution independence and semantic editability. In practice, original vector files are frequently lost, leaving only rasterized versions (e.g., PNG, JPEG) that resist modification, while manual reconstruction is prohibitively expensive. Progress on automating raster-to-SVG conversion has been bottlenecked by two gaps: existing SVG datasets are dominated by icons and decorative graphics that lack the complexity of professional diagrams, and existing benchmarks rely on pixel- or embedding-level similarity that fails to capture structural correctness (e.g., broken connectivity, misplaced arrows). We close both gaps with paired contributions targeting diagram-centric figures (e.g., model architectures, flowcharts, schematics). For training, we introduce VFIG-Data, the largest figure-to-SVG dataset of its kind at 66K pairs, combining real paper figures converted via a describe-and-generate pipeline with programmatic diagrams that supply noise-free supervision over arrow styles, fonts, and geometry. For evaluation, we introduce VFIG-Bench, a structure-aware evaluation suite, paired with VFIG-Bench-OOD, an out-of-distribution set of figures manually curated from highly cited arXiv papers. Beyond pixel and embedding similarity, our protocol reports rubric-based VLM-Judge scores and Elo ratings from pairwise human preference evaluation. Built on these contributions, VFIG is a VLM family trained with a simple-to-complex SFT curriculum followed by RL with rendering-aware rewards. VFIG achieves state-of-the-art open-source performance, outperforming the best open-source VLM baseline by over 30%, and matches Claude Sonnet 4.6 on VFIG-BENCH: Gemini-Judge 78.2% vs. 76.7% and GPT-Judge 87.5% vs. 87.4%. It remains slightly behind the strongest proprietary models GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VFIG，一个面向图表类图形（如模型结构图、流程图、示意图）的栅格图像到 SVG 向量化方法，并配套两个贡献：VFIG-Data（66K 图像-SVG 对，迄今最大的同类数据集，混合真实论文图片与程序化图形）与结构感知评测套件 VFIG-Bench 及其 OOD 版本 VFIG-Bench-OOD。方法上采用从简到繁的 SFT 课程学习再加渲染感知奖励的 RL 训练；摘要报告其在开源 VLM 中达到最优，超过最佳开源基线 30% 以上，并在 VFIG-Bench 上匹配 Claude Sonnet 4.6，但仍略逊于 GPT-5.2 与 Gemini-3。
Motivation: 实际场景中原始矢量文件常丢失，只剩难以编辑的栅格版本，手动重建成本过高；而现有 SVG 数据集以图标和装饰图形为主，缺少专业图表复杂度，现有评测又依赖像素或嵌入相似度，无法捕获结构性正确性（如连接断裂、箭头错位）。
Method: 训练侧提出 VFIG-Data，通过描述-生成 (describe-and-generate) 流程转换真实论文图片，并用程序化图形提供无噪声的箭头样式、字体和几何监督；评测侧提出 VFIG-Bench 与人工筛选自高被引 arXiv 论文的 VFIG-Bench-OOD，除像素与嵌入相似度外，还报告基于规则的 VLM-Judge 分数与成对人类偏好 Elo 评分。VFIG 模型采用从简到繁的 SFT 课程，随后以渲染感知奖励进行 RL。

papers.title: EdgeCrafter: Compact ViTs for Edge Dense Prediction via Task-Specialized Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Deploying high-performance dense prediction models on resource-constrained edge devices remains challenging due to strict computation and memory budgets. In practice, lightweight systems for object detection, instance segmentation, and pose estimation are still dominated by CNN-based architectures such as YOLO, while compact Vision Transformers (ViTs) often struggle to achieve comparable accuracy-efficiency trade-offs, even with large-scale pretraining. We argue that this gap arises primarily from insufficient task-specific representation learning in small-scale ViTs, rather than from an inherent mismatch between ViTs and edge dense prediction. To address this issue, we introduce EdgeCrafter, a unified compact ViT framework for edge dense prediction centered on ECDet, a detection model built on a distilled compact backbone and an edge-friendly encoder-decoder design. The resulting detection-distilled representation transfers directly to instance segmentation and human pose estimation through lightweight task-specific prediction modules. Without using task annotations beyond COCO, ECDet-S achieves 51.7 box AP with fewer than 10M parameters, while ECInsSeg-X and ECPose-X reach 48.4 mask AP and 74.8 keypoint AP, respectively. As a complementary but more compute-intensive setting, Objects365 detection pretraining consistently improves performance across all scales, with the X variants reaching 59.9 box AP, 49.8 mask AP, and 75.9 keypoint AP. These results show that compact ViTs, when combined with task-specialized distillation and edge-aware design, can be a practical and competitive solution for edge dense prediction. Code is available at: https://intellindust-ai-lab.github.io/projects/EdgeCrafter
papers.comment: Accepted by TMLR 2026. The Objects365 pre-training results have also been updated. Code is available at: https://intellindust-ai-lab.github.io/projects/EdgeCrafter
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EdgeCrafter，一个面向边缘设备稠密预测 (dense prediction) 的统一紧凑 ViT 框架，核心检测模型为 ECDet。作者认为紧凑 ViT 在边缘稠密预测上落后于 CNN 的主要原因在于小规模 ViT 缺乏任务特化表示学习，而非架构本身不匹配。通过任务特化蒸馏 (task-specialized distillation) 和边缘友好的编码器-解码器设计，检测蒸馏表示可直接迁移到实例分割与人体姿态估计。摘要报告 ECDet-S 以不到 10M 参数在 COCO 上达到 51.7 box AP，ECInsSeg-X 和 ECPose-X 分别达到 48.4 mask AP 与 74.8 keypoint AP。
Motivation: 资源受限的边缘设备上，高精度稠密预测模型的部署受严格计算与内存预算制约；目前检测、实例分割和姿态估计的轻量系统仍以 YOLO 等 CNN 架构为主，紧凑 ViT 即使经过大规模预训练也难以取得相当的精度-效率权衡。
Method: 提出 EdgeCrafter 统一框架，以 ECDet 检测模型为核心，包含蒸馏得到的紧凑骨干 (distilled compact backbone) 与边缘友好的编码器-解码器设计；所得检测蒸馏表示通过轻量任务特化预测模块直接迁移到实例分割和姿态估计，并考虑 Objects365 检测预训练作为补充的算力密集型设置。
Result: 仅使用 COCO 任务标注时，ECDet-S 以少于 10M 参数达到 51.7 box AP，ECInsSeg-X 与 ECPose-X 分别达到 48.4 mask AP 和 74.8 keypoint AP；加入 Objects365 预训练后，X 变体进一步达到 59.9 box AP、49.8 mask AP 与 75.9 keypoint AP。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将紧凑 ViT 与任务特化蒸馏及边缘感知设计结合，可以使紧凑 ViT 成为边缘稠密预测中实用且有竞争力的方案；代码已公开。

papers.title: ML-AutoResearch: Training Machine Learning Research Agents with Automatically Generated Environments
papers.abstract_en: With the advent of AI agents, automated scientific discovery is becoming an increasingly plausible goal. However, training agents to autonomously execute the engineering-heavy labor of machine learning (ML) research requires massive, process-level supervision. Existing static benchmarks omit critical intermediate steps such as debugging and incremental reasoning, and manual data collection is prohibitively expensive. To overcome this data bottleneck, we introduce ML-AutoResearch (ML-AR), a scalable pipeline for automatically generating synthetic, end-to-end ML research tasks. Each task defines a complete research cycle, including problem specification, dataset selection, baseline implementation, and iterative improvement. To ensure realism and executability, tasks are grounded in real-world datasets and refined via an automated self-debugging procedure without requiring human supervision. We construct a large-scale dataset of teacher trajectories on these synthetic tasks to train student agents via supervised fine-tuning. We evaluate the resulting agents across 3 diverse ML research benchmarks. Our comprehensive experiments across 2 distinct model families and 3 model sizes demonstrate that training on ML-AR trajectories yields consistent and significant capability gains. Fine-tuning improves the Aggregation Under the Performance (AUP) by up to 9\% and substantially boosts overall pass rates, highlighting robust out-of-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ML-AutoResearch (ML-AR)，一种自动生成合成、端到端机器学习研究任务的流水线，用于缓解训练自动化 ML 研究智能体所需的过程级监督数据瓶颈。每个任务覆盖问题定义、数据集选择、基线实现和迭代改进，并基于真实数据集通过自动自我调试流程确保可执行性。作者利用这些任务生成的教师轨迹对学生智能体进行监督微调，在 3 个 ML 研究基准、2 种模型家族和 3 种模型规模上评估，显示能力一致且显著提升，AUP 最高提高 9% 并提升整体通过率。
Motivation: 现有静态基准缺少调试和增量推理等关键中间步骤，而人工收集过程级监督数据成本过高，限制了训练能自主完成 ML 研究中工程密集工作的智能体。
Method: 提出 ML-AR 流水线，自动生成合成端到端研究任务，每个任务包含问题规范、数据集选择、基线实现和迭代改进；任务基于真实数据集构建，并通过无需人工干预的自动自我调试过程进行精炼以保证真实性和可执行性。基于这些任务构造大规模教师轨迹，用于对学生智能体进行监督微调。
Result: 在 3 个多样化 ML 研究基准上，使用 2 种模型家族和 3 种模型规模进行评估，微调使 AUP 最高提升 9%，并显著提高总体通过率，显示出稳健的域外泛化 (out-of-domain generalization) 能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，基于自动生成的合成研究轨迹进行监督微调，可以给 ML 研究智能体带来一致且显著的能力提升，为绕过昂贵的人工数据收集提供了一条可行路径。
Relevance: 8
