papers.title: Informative Perturbation Selection for Uncertainty-Aware Post-hoc Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Trust and ethical concerns due to the widespread deployment of opaque machine learning (ML) models motivating the need for reliable model explanations. Post-hoc model-agnostic explanation methods addresses this challenge by learning a surrogate model that approximates the behavior of the deployed black-box ML model in the locality of a sample of interest. In post-hoc scenarios, neither the underlying model parameters nor the training are available, and hence, this local neighborhood must be constructed by generating perturbed inputs in the neighborhood of the sample of interest, and its corresponding model predictions. We propose \emph{Expected Active Gain for Local Explanations} (\texttt{EAGLE}), a post-hoc model-agnostic explanation framework that formulates perturbation selection as an information-theoretic active learning problem. By adaptively sampling perturbations that maximize the expected information gain, \texttt{EAGLE} efficiently learns a linear surrogate explainable model while producing feature importance scores along with the uncertainty/confidence estimates. Theoretically, we establish that cumulative information gain scales as $\mathcal{O}(d \log t)$, where $d$ is the feature dimension and $t$ represents the number of samples, and that the sample complexity grows linearly with $d$ and logarithmically with the confidence parameter $1/δ$. Empirical results on tabular and image datasets corroborate our theoretical findings and demonstrate that \texttt{EAGLE} improves explanation reproducibility across runs, achieves higher neighborhood stability, and improves perturbation sample quality as compared to state-of-the-art baselines such as Tilia, US-LIME, GLIME and BayesLIME.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EAGLE（Expected Active Gain for Local Explanations），一个面向黑盒模型事后解释（post-hoc model-agnostic explanation）的扰动样本选择框架。EAGLE 将局部邻域扰动采样建模为信息论主动学习问题，通过最大化期望信息增益来高效训练线性替代模型，同时输出特征重要性与不确定性估计。理论上给出累积信息增益与样本复杂度的界，并在表格与图像数据上验证了其相比 Tilia、US-LIME、GLIME、BayesLIME 等基线在解释可复现性、邻域稳定性和扰动样本质量上的提升。
Motivation: 部署不透明 ML 模型引发可信与伦理担忧，而事后模型无关解释方法需要在不访问模型参数与训练数据的情况下，通过在样本邻域生成扰动输入来构建局部替代模型；如何选取信息量高的扰动样本以高效学习可靠解释是一个关键缺口。
Method: 提出 EAGLE 框架，将扰动选择形式化为信息论主动学习问题，自适应地采样能最大化期望信息增益的扰动，并据此学习线性替代解释模型，同时给出特征重要性和不确定性/置信度估计。
Result: 理论上证明累积信息增益以 O(d log t) 增长（d 为特征维数，t 为样本数），且样本复杂度随 d 线性增长、随置信参数 1/δ 对数增长；实验表明 EAGLE 相比 Tilia、US-LIME、GLIME 和 BayesLIME 等基线提高了解释可复现性、邻域稳定性与扰动样本质量。
Conclusion: 作者认为将扰动选择视为信息论主动学习问题，可以在事后解释中获得更高效、更稳定且带不确定度量化的局部解释，并提供了相应的理论保证。

papers.title: Joint MDPs and Reinforcement Learning in Coupled-Dynamics Environments
papers.abstract_en: Many distributional quantities in reinforcement learning are intrinsically joint across actions, including distributions of gaps and probabilities of superiority. However, the classical Markov decision process (MDP) formalism specifies only marginal laws and leaves the joint law of counterfactual one-step outcomes across multiple possible actions at a state unspecified. We study coupled-dynamics environments with a multi-action generative interface which can sample counterfactual one-step outcomes for multiple actions under shared exogenous randomness. We propose joint MDPs (JMDPs) as a formalism for such environments by augmenting an MDP with a multi-action sample transition model which specifies a coupling of one-step counterfactual outcomes, while preserving standard MDP interaction as marginal observations. We adopt and formalize a one-step coupling regime where dependence across actions is confined to immediate counterfactual outcomes at the queried state. In this regime, we derive Bellman operators for $n$th-order return moments, providing dynamic programming and incremental algorithms with convergence guarantees.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 7 figures. To be presented at UAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出联合 MDP (JMDP) 形式化框架，用于刻画在共享外生随机性下多动作一步反事实结果的耦合分布。传统 MDP 只指定边际转移律，无法描述跨动作的联合分布，而 JMDP 通过多动作生成接口补充一步联合转移模型，同时保持标准 MDP 交互为边际观测。作者在一步耦合框架下推导了 n 阶回报矩的 Bellman 算子，并给出带收敛保证的动态规划与增量算法。
Motivation: 强化学习中许多分布量（如 gap 分布、优势概率）本质上是跨动作联合的，但经典 MDP 形式只规定边际律，未指定同一状态下多个可能动作的一步反事实结果之间的联合律。为此需要一种能显式建模跨动作依赖的新形式化，以支持这类联合分布量的计算与学习。
Method: 定义耦合动力学环境，其多动作生成接口可在共享外生随机性下对多个动作的一步反事实结果进行采样；在此基础上提出 JMDP，即在 MDP 上增广一个多动作采样转移模型，既指定一步反事实结果的耦合，又将标准 MDP 交互保留为边际观测。作者限定一步耦合机制，使跨动作依赖只存在于查询状态的即时反事实结果中，并在该机制下推导 n 阶回报矩的 Bellman 算子及相应动态规划与增量算法，给出收敛性保证。
Result: 摘要报告的主要理论结果是：在一步耦合机制下，为 n 阶回报矩导出了 Bellman 算子，并提供了具有收敛保证的动态规划算法和增量算法。摘要未给出实验数据或基准比较。
Conclusion: 作者认为 JMDP 为耦合动力学环境提供了可以将联合反事实分布纳入回报矩计算的形式化框架，并明确了依赖范围限制为一步耦合。摘要未讨论该方法在更长时间尺度耦合或多步依赖下的适用范围与局限性。

papers.title: A multi-center analysis of deep learning methods for video polyp detection and segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Colonic polyps are well-recognized precursors to colorectal cancer (CRC), typically detected during colonoscopy. However, the variability in appearance, location, and size of these polyps complicates their detection and removal, leading to challenges in effective surveillance, intervention, and subsequently CRC prevention. The processes of colonoscopy surveillance and polyp removal are highly reliant on the expertise of gastroenterologists and occur within the complexities of the colonic structure. As a result, there is a high rate of missed detections and incomplete removal of colonic polyps, which can adversely impact patient outcomes. Recently, automated methods that use machine learning have been developed to enhance polyps detection and segmentation, thus helping clinical processes and reducing missed rates. These advancements highlight the potential for improving diagnostic accuracy in real-time applications, which ultimately facilitates more effective patient management. Furthermore, integrating sequence data and temporal information could significantly enhance the precision of these methods by capturing the dynamic nature of polyp growth and the changes that occur over time. To rigorously investigate these challenges, data scientists and experts gastroenterologists collaborated to compile a comprehensive dataset that spans multiple centers and diverse populations. This initiative aims to underscore the critical importance of incorporating sequence data and temporal information in the development of robust automated detection and segmentation methods. This study evaluates the applicability of deep learning techniques developed in real-time clinical colonoscopy tasks using sequence data, highlighting the critical role of temporal relationships between frames in improving diagnostic precision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一项多中心研究，评估深度学习方法在视频结肠镜息肉检测与分割任务中的适用性，重点关注序列数据和时间信息的作用。研究团队与胃肠病专家合作，汇编了跨多个中心和多样人群的综合数据集，并基于该数据集考察实时临床结肠镜任务中帧间时间关系对诊断精度的影响。
Motivation: 结肠息肉是结直肠癌的已知前兆，但息肉的外观、位置和大小差异大，导致检测和切除困难，漏检和不完全切除率较高，影响患者预后。现有自动化方法虽能辅助检测，但尚未充分利用序列数据和时间信息来提高精度。
Method: 数据科学家与胃肠病专家协作，构建覆盖多个中心和多样人群的综合数据集，并在此数据集上评估面向实时临床结肠镜任务的深度学习检测和分割方法，特别强调帧间时间关系对提升诊断精度的作用。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的定量结果或基准数值；其核心发现是帧间时间关系对于提高息肉检测和分割的诊断精度具有关键作用。
Conclusion: 作者强调在开发鲁棒的自动化检测与分割方法时，纳入序列数据和时间信息至关重要，本研究旨在通过多中心数据验证这一观点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Synthetic Web: Adversarially-Curated Mini-Internets for Diagnosing Epistemic Weaknesses of Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language agents increasingly act as web-enabled systems that search, browse, and synthesize information from diverse sources. However, these sources can include unreliable or adversarial content, and the robustness of agents to adversarial ranking - where misleading information appears prominently in search results - remains poorly understood. Existing benchmarks evaluate functional navigation or static factuality but cannot causally isolate this vulnerability, and current mitigation strategies for retrieval-augmented generation remain largely untested under such conditions. We introduce Synthetic Web Benchmark, a procedurally generated environment comprising thousands of hyperlinked articles with ground-truth labels for credibility and factuality, process-level interaction traces, and contamination filtering to eliminate training-data leakage. By injecting a single high-plausibility misinformation article into a controllable search rank, we measure the causal effect of adversarial exposure in six frontier models. The results reveal catastrophic failures: accuracy collapses despite unlimited access to truthful sources, with minimal search escalation and severe miscalibration. These findings expose fundamental limitations in how current frontier models handle conflicting information, with immediate implications for deployment in high-stakes domains. Our benchmark enables systematic analysis of these failure modes and provides a controlled testbed for evaluating mitigation strategies under adversarial ranking - a gap in current research. This work establishes a reproducible baseline for developing search-robust and epistemically humble agents capable of resisting manipulation in high-stakes domains.
papers.comment: This version includes a revised manuscript presentation and formatting, expanded methodological and experimental details, enhanced reproducibility documentation, and improved benchmark framing and evaluation descriptions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出合成网络基准（Synthetic Web Benchmark），一个程序化生成、包含数千篇带可信度与事实性真值标签的超链接文章的环境，并提供过程级交互轨迹与污染过滤以消除训练数据泄漏。通过在可控搜索结果排名中注入一篇高似真实误信息文章，作者在六个前沿模型中测量对抗性曝露（adversarial exposure）的因果效应，发现准确率在可无限访问真实来源的情况下仍然崩溃、搜索升级极少且校准严重失误。该基准为诊断语言智能体在对抗性排名下的认识弱点提供了可复现的测试平台。
Motivation: 语言智能体越来越多地作为网页系统搜索、浏览并综合分布来源的信息，但对对抗性排名（误导信息在搜索结果中显著靠前）的鲁棒性仍不清楚。现有基准只能评估功能性导航或静态事实性，无法因果地隔离这一脆弱性，而针对检索增强生成（RAG）的现有缓解策略在此类条件下也基本未经检验。
Method: 构建一个程序化生成的合成网络环境，文章带真实标签，配过程级交互轨迹和污染过滤；通过在可调控的搜索排名中注入单篇高似真实误信息文章，以测量对抗性曝露的因果效应。
Result: 作者在六个前沿模型上的实验显示灾难性失效：尽管可无限访问真实来源，准确率仍大幅下降，搜索升级极少且校准严重失准。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了用于对抗性排名条件下系统分析失败模式与评估缓解策略的可复现基线，并指出当前前沿模型处理冲突信息方面存在根本局限，对高风险领域部署有直接影响。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OODBench: Out-of-Distribution Benchmark for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing Visual-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved significant progress by being trained on massive-scale datasets, typically under the assumption that data are independent and identically distributed (IID). However, in real-world scenarios, it is often impractical to expect that all data processed by an AI system satisfy this assumption. Furthermore, failure to appropriately handle out-of-distribution (OOD) objects may introduce safety risks in real-world applications (e.g., autonomous driving or medical assistance). Unfortunately, current research has not yet provided valid benchmarks that can comprehensively assess the performance of VLMs in response to OOD data. Therefore, we propose OODBench, a predominantly automated method with minimal human verification, for constructing new benchmarks and evaluating the ability of VLMs to process OOD data. OODBench contains 40K instance-level OOD instance-category pairs, and we show that current VLMs still exhibit notable performance degradation on OODBench, even when the underlying image categories are common. In addition, we propose a reliable automated assessment metric that employs a Basic-to-Advanced Progression of prompted questions to assess the impact of OOD data on questions of varying difficulty more fully. Lastly, we summarize substantial findings and insights to facilitate future research in the acquisition and evaluation of OOD data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OODBench，一个以自动化构建为主、仅需少量人工验证的基准，用于评估大型视觉语言模型（VLM）在分布外（OOD）数据上的表现。OODBench 包含 40K 个实例级 OOD 实例-类别对，实验显示现有 VLM 在其上性能显著下降，即使底层图像类别很常见。作者还提出一种基于由基础到高级的递进式提示问题的自动评估指标，并总结了若干发现以支持后续 OOD 数据的获取与评估研究。
Motivation: 现实场景中 AI 系统处理的数据往往不满足独立同分布（IID）假设，而 VLM 无法妥善处理 OOD 对象可能带来安全风险（如自动驾驶、医疗辅助）。现有研究缺乏能够全面评估 VLM 在 OOD 数据上表现的基准。
Method: 提出 OODBench，一种以自动化为主、仅需最小人工验证的基准构建方法，并配套一个可靠的自动评估指标，该指标通过基础到高级的递进式提示问题（Basic-to-Advanced Progression of prompted questions）来评估 OOD 数据对不同难度问题的影响。
Result: OODBench 包含 40K 个实例级 OOD 实例-类别对；摘要表明当前 VLM 在 OODBench 上仍表现出显著性能下降，即使底层图像类别是常见的。
Conclusion: 作者总结了若干实质性的发现与见解，旨在促进未来在 OOD 数据获取与评估方面的研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MDP Planning as Policy Inference
papers.abstract_en: We formulate episodic Markov decision process (MDP) planning as Bayesian inference over policies. The primary contribution is conceptual: the policy itself is treated as the latent variable, and expected return defines an unnormalized posterior density over policies. This preserves the standard expected-return objective, in contrast to trajectory-centric planning-as-inference formulations that introduce auxiliary optimality variables and to entropy-regularized policy optimization methods that solve a different objective. In the exact formulation, the posterior over deterministic policies induces what we define here as an optimal stochastic policy under preference uncertainty, namely the stochastic policy induced by that posterior. For discrete MDPs with stochastic transitions, we study variational sequential Monte Carlo (VSMC) as one approximate inference method for this posterior, introducing policy consistency under state revisitation and coupled transition randomness across particles. Experiments on grid worlds, Blackjack, Triangle Tireworld, and Academic Advising examine the consequences of inference over policies and compare its induced behavior with entropy-regularized policy optimization. The results support the view that MDP planning can be naturally cast as Bayesian inference over policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将 episodic Markov decision process (MDP) 规划直接表述为对策略的贝叶斯推断：策略本身作为潜在变量，期望回报定义策略空间上的未归一化后验密度，从而保持标准期望回报目标。精确形式下，确定性策略的后验诱导出一个在偏好不确定性意义下的最优随机策略。对具有随机转移的离散 MDP，作者研究变分序列蒙特卡洛 (VSMC) 近似推断，并提出状态重访下的策略一致性以及跨粒子的耦合转移随机性。实验在 grid worlds、Blackjack、Triangle Tireworld 和 Academic Advising 上进行，结果支持规划可自然表述为策略上的贝叶斯推断这一观点。
Motivation: 现有 planning-as-inference 表述多以轨迹为中心并引入辅助最优性变量，而熵正则化策略优化则求解不同目标；本文希望在不改变期望回报目标的前提下，把规划问题本身看作对策略的后验推断。
Method: 将策略作为隐变量，用期望回报构造未归一化后验密度；在该贝叶斯框架下定义由后验诱导的最优随机策略。针对离散随机转移 MDP，采用 VSMC 作为近似推断方法，并引入状态重访下的策略一致性以及粒子间耦合的转移随机性。
Result: 摘要报告在 grid worlds、Blackjack、Triangle Tireworld 和 Academic Advising 等任务上的实验，将其诱导行为与熵正则化策略优化进行比较，结果支持 MDP 规划可表述为策略上的贝叶斯推断。
Conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是概念性的，主张 MDP 规划可以自然地纳入贝叶斯推断框架；实验在若干离散 MDP 任务上验证了这一表述的可行性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 将策略作为隐变量，用期望回报构造未归一化后验密度；在该贝叶斯框架下定义由后验诱导的最优随机策略。针对离散随机转移 MDP，采用 VSMC 作为近似推断方法，并引入状态重访下的策略一致性以及粒子间耦合的转移随机性。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在 grid worlds、Blackjack、Triangle Tireworld 和 Academic Advising 等任务上的实验，将其诱导行为与熵正则化策略优化进行比较，结果支持 MDP 规划可表述为策略上的贝叶斯推断。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是概念性的，主张 MDP 规划可以自然地纳入贝叶斯推断框架；实验在若干离散 MDP 任务上验证了这一表述的可行性。

papers.title: ReLoop: Structured Modeling and Behavioral Verification for Reliable LLM-Based Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can translate natural language into optimization code, but silent failures pose a critical risk: code that executes and returns solver-feasible solutions may encode semantically incorrect formulations---a feasibility--correctness gap reaching 90 percentage points on compositional problems. We introduce ReLoop, which addresses this gap through two complementary mechanisms. Structured generation decomposes code production into a four-stage reasoning chain (understand, formalize, synthesize, verify), preventing formulation errors at their source. Behavioral verification detects errors that survive generation by testing whether the formulation responds correctly to solver-based parameter perturbation---an external semantic signal that bypasses LLM self-review and requires no ground truth. The two mechanisms are complementary by error structure: structured generation drives the largest gains on compositional problems (+8.5pp accuracy on RetailOpt-190 with Claude Opus 4.6), while behavioral verification dominates on localized defects +4.4pp on MAMO-ComplexLP, its largest contribution across benchmarks). Combined with diagnostic execution recovery, ReLoop reaches 100% executable code on Claude Opus 4.6 and consistently improves accuracy on chat-tuned foundation models across three benchmarks; we further identify a known limitation of narrowly-tuned SFT models, whose learned output formats are brittle to chain-of-thought prompts---an interaction we document and analyze. We release RetailOpt-190, 190 compositional retail optimization scenarios targeting the multi-constraint interactions where LLMs most frequently fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）将自然语言翻译为优化代码时出现的静默失败问题，提出 ReLoop 框架。该框架通过结构化生成（structured generation）将代码生成拆分为理解、形式化、综合、验证四阶段推理链，并结合基于求解器的参数扰动进行行为验证（behavioral verification），以弥合可行性与正确性之间的差距。摘要报告其在多个基准上提升准确率，在 Claude Opus 4.6 上实现 100% 可执行代码，并发布 RetailOpt-190 基准。
Motivation: LLM 生成的优化代码即使能执行并返回求解器可行解，也可能编码语义上错误的公式化问题，形成可行性-正确性差距（feasibility-correctness gap），在组合式问题上该差距可达 90 个百分点。
Method: ReLoop 包含两个互补机制：结构化生成将代码产出分解为四阶段推理链（understand, formalize, synthesize, verify），从源头防止公式化错误；行为验证通过测试公式化结果对求解器参数扰动的响应来检测残余错误，该外部语义信号绕开 LLM 自审且不需要 ground truth；此外还结合了诊断性执行恢复（diagnostic execution recovery）。
Result: 结构化生成在组合式问题上带来最大提升，Claude Opus 4.6 在 RetailOpt-190 上准确率提高 8.5 个百分点；行为验证在局部缺陷上贡献最大，在 MAMO-ComplexLP 上提高 4.4 个百分点。两者结合诊断性执行恢复后，Claude Opus 4.6 达到 100% 可执行代码，并在三个基准上持续提升聊天微调基础模型的准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调两种机制按错误结构互补，并指出窄调优 SFT 模型的一个已知局限：其学习到的输出格式对链式思维提示（chain-of-thought prompts）较脆弱。作者还发布包含 190 个组合式零售优化场景的 RetailOpt-190 基准，聚焦 LLM 最常出错的多约束交互。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Instruction Following in RL via Structured LTL Representations
papers.abstract_en: We study instruction following in multi-task reinforcement learning, where an agent must zero-shot execute novel tasks not seen during training. In this setting, linear temporal logic (LTL) has recently been adopted as a powerful framework for specifying structured, temporally extended tasks. While existing approaches successfully train generalist policies, they often struggle to effectively capture the rich logical and temporal structure inherent in LTL specifications. In this work, we address these concerns with a novel approach to learn structured task representations that facilitate training and generalisation. Our method conditions the policy on sequences of Boolean formulae constructed from a finite automaton of the task. We propose a hierarchical neural architecture to encode the logical structure of these formulae, and introduce an attention mechanism that enables the policy to reason about future subgoals. Experiments in a variety of complex environments demonstrate the strong generalisation capabilities and superior performance of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多任务强化学习中的零样本指令跟随 (zero-shot instruction following) 问题，以线性时序逻辑 (LTL) 作为结构化、时间延展任务的规范框架。作者提出将策略条件化在由任务有限自动机构造的布尔公式序列上，用分层神经网络编码公式的逻辑结构，并引入注意力机制使策略能推理未来子目标。在多种复杂环境的实验中，该方法展现出较强的泛化能力和更优性能。
Motivation: 现有方法虽能训练通用策略，但难以有效捕获 LTL 规范中内在的丰富逻辑与时间结构，限制了训练效率和泛化能力。
Method: 提出一种学习结构化任务表示的新方法：策略以任务有限自动机 (finite automaton) 生成的布尔公式序列为条件；采用分层神经架构编码这些公式的逻辑结构，并加入注意力机制 (attention mechanism) 使策略能够对未来的子目标 (subgoals) 进行推理。
Result: 在多种复杂环境中的实验表明，该方法相比现有方法具有更强的泛化能力和更优的性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构化任务表示与未来子目标推理能有效促进零样本泛化；更详细的消融与局限未在摘要中提及。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MiDAS: A Multimodal Data Acquisition System and Dataset for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery
papers.abstract_en: Background: Robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RMIS) research increasingly relies on multimodal data, yet access to proprietary robot telemetry remains a major barrier. We introduce MiDAS, an open-source, platform-agnostic system enabling time-synchronized, non-invasive multimodal data acquisition across surgical robotic platforms. Methods: MiDAS integrates electromagnetic and RGB-D hand tracking, foot pedal sensing, and surgical video capturing without requiring proprietary robot interfaces. We validated MiDAS on the open-source Raven-II and the clinical da Vinci Xi by collecting multimodal datasets of peg transfer and hernia repair suturing tasks performed by surgical residents. Correlation analysis and downstream gesture recognition experiments were conducted. Results: External hand and foot sensing closely approximated internal robot kinematics and non-invasive motion signals achieved gesture recognition performance comparable to proprietary telemetry. Conclusion: MiDAS enables reproducible multimodal RMIS data collection and is released with annotated datasets, including the first multimodal dataset capturing hernia repair suturing on high-fidelity simulation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MiDAS，一个开源且平台无关 (platform-agnostic) 的多模态数据采集系统，用于机器人辅助微创手术 (RMIS)，可在不依赖专有机器人接口的情况下完成时间同步的数据采集，集成电磁与 RGB-D 手部追踪、脚踏板传感和手术视频录制。系统在开源 Raven-II 和临床 da Vinci Xi 上验证，采集了外科住院医生执行的 peg transfer 和疝修补缝合任务数据。结果显示外部手部与脚部传感信号接近内部机器人运动学，且基于非侵入性运动信号的手势识别性能可与专有遥测数据相媲美。
Motivation: RMIS 研究越来越依赖多模态数据，但专有机器人遥测数据的获取是主要障碍，限制了研究的可复现性和跨平台推广。
Method: MiDAS 集成电磁和 RGB-D 手部追踪、脚踏板传感及手术视频采集，无需专有机器人接口；在 Raven-II 与 da Vinci Xi 上采集住院医生的 peg transfer 和疝修补缝合任务数据，并进行相关性分析与下游手势识别实验。
Result: 外部手部和脚踏传感信号与内部机器人运动学高度接近，非侵入性运动信号在手势识别任务上达到与专有遥测相当的性能。
Conclusion: MiDAS 支持可复现的多模态 RMIS 数据采集，并随论文发布带标注的数据集，包括首个在高保真模拟模型上捕获疝修补缝合的多模态数据集。

papers.title: Grounding LTL Tasks in Sub-Symbolic RL Environments for Zero-Shot Generalization
papers.abstract_en: In this work we address the problem of training a Reinforcement Learning agent to follow multiple temporally-extended instructions expressed in Linear Temporal Logic in sub-symbolic environments. Previous multi-task work has mostly relied on knowledge of the mapping between raw observations and symbols appearing in the formulae. We drop this unrealistic assumption by jointly training a multi-task policy and a symbol grounder with the same experience. The symbol grounder is trained only from raw observations and sparse rewards via Neural Reward Machines in a semi-supervised fashion. Experiments on vision-based environments show that our method achieves performance comparable to using the true symbol grounding and significantly outperforms the only other previous method for multi-task learning that does not assume knowledge of the true symbol grounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在亚符号 (sub-symbolic) 环境中训练强化学习 (RL) 智能体遵循多条以线性时序逻辑 (Linear Temporal Logic, LTL) 表达的时序扩展指令，并实现零样本泛化。现有多任务工作大多假设已知原始观测与公式中符号之间的映射关系，本文放弃这一假设，通过共享经验联合训练多任务策略和符号接地器 (symbol grounder)。符号接地器仅依赖原始观测和稀疏奖励，以半监督方式借助 Neural Reward Machines 训练。在基于视觉的环境中，该方法取得了与使用真实符号接地相当的性能，并显著优于此前唯一不假设真实符号接地的多任务学习方法。
Motivation: 先前多任务 LTL 相关工作通常依赖已知的原始观测到公式符号的映射，这一假设在亚符号环境中并不现实，限制了方法的实用性。
Method: 提出联合训练多任务策略与符号接地器，二者使用同一份经验；符号接地器仅从原始观测和稀疏奖励中通过 Neural Reward Machines 以半监督方式学习符号映射。
Result: 在基于视觉的环境中，所提方法性能与使用真实符号接地相当，并显著超过此前唯一不假设真实符号接地的多任务学习方法。
Conclusion: 摘要表明放弃已知符号接地假设是可行的，半监督 Neural Reward Machines 能从原始观测和稀疏奖励中学会符号接地，从而支持 LTL 任务的零样本泛化。

papers.title: SLUM-i: Semi-supervised Learning for Urban Mapping of Informal Settlements and Data Quality Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: Very-high-resolution remote-sensing imagery provides a scalable basis for delineating informal settlements, but sparse annotations, severe imbalance between informal-settlement and background pixels, and cross-city heterogeneity in urban morphology and image--mask correspondence complicate model development. We present SLUM-i, a semi-supervised semantic segmentation framework together with a geographically diverse seven-city Earth observation benchmark spanning three continents. The benchmark combines a newly annotated Lahore dataset and companion Karachi and Mumbai datasets with four publicly released city datasets, totaling 14,458 RGB image--mask tiles. We quantify cross-city heterogeneity using class composition, boundary morphology, grayscale separability, correspondence between mask boundaries and image edges, and divergence between measured feature distributions. For label-efficient mapping, SLUM-i combines representation-guided unlabeled-pool curation, using embeddings from a vision foundation model (DINOv2-Small) to remove the least-similar tiles, and Class-Aware Adaptive Thresholding, which adapts pseudo-label acceptance by class through global mean-confidence and per-class mean-softmax exponential moving averages. Experiments at 10%, 20%, and 30% label budgets, using convolutional and vision-transformer backbones and five random seeds, demonstrate improvements over the corresponding UniMatch baselines in multiple city--budget settings, reaching +5.9 percentage points in mean intersection-over-union. At the 30% budget, the ResNet-101 configuration matches or exceeds its corresponding fully labeled supervised baseline in four of seven cities. Both components operate only during training and add no inference overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SLUM-i，一个面向非正规聚落（informal settlements）制图的半监督语义分割框架，并构建了覆盖三大洲七个城市、共 14,458 张 RGB 图像-掩膜切片的地球观测基准。SLUM-i 结合基于 DINOv2-Small 嵌入的表示引导未标注池筛选（representation-guided unlabeled-pool curation）和类感知自适应阈值（Class-Aware Adaptive Thresholding），在 10%、20%、30% 标签预算下相对 UniMatch 基线在多个城市-预算组合中提升，最高达 +5.9 个百分点 mIoU。两个组件仅在训练时运行，不增加推理开销。
Motivation: 超高分辨率遥感影像可用于划分非正规聚落，但稀疏标注、非正规聚落像素与背景像素的严重不平衡，以及城市形态和图像-掩膜对应关系的跨城市异质性，给模型开发带来困难。
Method: SLUM-i 是一个半监督语义分割框架，包含两个训练阶段组件：一是利用视觉基础模型 DINOv2-Small 的嵌入来筛选并移除最不相似的未标注瓦片，二是类感知自适应阈值，通过全局平均置信度和按类平均 softmax 的指数移动平均来自适应调整各类伪标签的接受阈值。实验使用卷积和 vision-transformer 骨干，并在五个随机种子下进行。
Result: 在 10%、20%、30% 标签预算下，SLUM-i 在多个城市-预算设置中优于相应 UniMatch 基线，最高提升 +5.9 个百分点 mIoU；在 30% 预算下，ResNet-101 配置在七个城市中的四个达到或超过其对应的全标注监督基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调表示引导的未标注池筛选与类感知自适应阈值可以提升标签高效的非正规聚落制图，且不增加推理开销。基准本身量化了跨城市异质性，包括类别组成、边界形态、灰度可分性、掩膜边界与图像边缘对应性以及特征分布散度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Credit Fairness: Online Fairness In Shared Resource Pools
papers.abstract_en: We study repeated allocation of shared resources among agents with time-varying demands and capped linear utilities. In this setting, independently maximizing the minimum endowment-normalized utility in each round satisfies sharing incentives (agents weakly prefer participating in the mechanism to not participating), strategyproofness (agents have no incentive to misreport their demands), and Pareto efficiency. However, this max-min mechanism can lead to large disparities in the total resources received by agents, even when they have the same average demand. We introduce credit fairness, a property that, together with Pareto efficiency, strengthens sharing incentives by giving agents who lend resources in early rounds priority toward recouping those resources in later rounds. Credit fairness can be achieved in conjunction with either Pareto efficiency or strategyproofness individually, but we show that, under anonymity, it cannot be achieved together with both. We propose a mechanism that is credit fair and Pareto efficient, and evaluate it in a computational resource-sharing setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时变需求与封顶线性效用 (capped linear utilities) 下共享资源的重复分配问题。作者指出每轮独立最大化最小 endowment-normalized utility 的 max-min 机制虽然满足分享激励、策略真实性 (strategyproofness) 与帕累托效率，却会导致相同平均需求的主体获得的总资源差距很大；为此提出 credit fairness 性质，并展示其与帕累托效率或策略真实性可分别兼容，但在匿名性下无法三者同时满足。文章最后给出一个同时满足 credit fairness 与帕累托效率的机制，并在计算资源分享场景中评估。
Motivation: 现有 max-min 机制在每轮表现公平，但跨轮次的总资源分配可能出现显著不均，即使各主体平均需求相同；需要一种能随时间强化分享激励的公平性概念。
Method: 引入 credit fairness 性质，使早期出借资源的主体在后续轮次获得优先回收资源的权利；通过公理化刻画其与帕累托效率、策略真实性和匿名性的兼容关系，并提出一个 credit fair 且帕累托有效的机制。
Result: 结果表明 credit fairness 可以分别与帕累托效率或策略真实性同时实现，但在匿名性假设下无法同时与两者兼容；机制在计算资源共享设置中得到评估，摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为 credit fairness 与帕累托效率的结合能以更强方式实现分享激励，但匿名性下无法兼顾策略真实性，这一不可能性刻画了该设置中公平与激励的边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AWED-PIPER: Agents, Web Applications & Expert Detectors for Personally Identifiable Information Protection & Fine-grained Named Entity Recognition across 36 languages for 6.6 Billion Speakers
papers.abstract_en: Named Entity Recognition (NER) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) anonymization are critical tasks in Natural Language Processing (NLP) for information extraction and privacy preservation. We introduce AWED-PIPER, an open-source framework comprising agentic tools, interactive web applications, and 54 state-of-the-art expert detector models that provide unified Fine-grained Named Entity Recognition (FgNER) and reversible synthetic PII pseudonymization across 36 languages spoken by over 6.6 billion people. The system couples fine-grained multilingual sequence labeling with script-aware regex detectors to identify contextual entities (Person, Location, Organization, Medical) as well as structured technical PII (Emails, native-script Phone Numbers, IP Addresses, Credit Cards). AWED-PIPER offers a dual capability: full FgNER entity extraction and privacy-preserving reversible anonymization with persistent placeholders and de-anonymization dictionary mappings. The suite spans global languages to extremely low-resource vulnerable languages like Bodo, Manipuri, Bishnupriya, and Mizo. The resources can be accessed here: PII Protector Agentic Tool: (https://github.com/PrachuryyaKaushik/AWED-PIPER), FgNER Agentic Tool: (https://github.com/PrachuryyaKaushik/AWED-FiNER), PII Web Application: (https://hf.co/spaces/prachuryyaIITG/AWED_PII_Protector), FgNER Web Application: (https://hf.co/spaces/prachuryyaIITG/AWED-FiNER), and Edge-deployable Expert Detector Models: (https://hf.co/collections/prachuryyaIITG/awed-piper).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AWED-PIPER，一个开源框架，包含智能体工具、交互式 Web 应用和 54 个专家检测模型，用于跨 36 种语言的细粒度命名实体识别（FgNER）与可逆的合成 PII 假名化。系统将细粒度多语言序列标注与脚本感知的正则检测器相结合，覆盖上下文体实体（Person、Location、Organization、Medical）和结构化技术 PII（Email、本地文字电话号码、IP 地址、信用卡）。该框架同时支持完整实体抽取和隐私保护的可逆匿名化，并覆盖从全球语言到极低资源语言（如 Bodo、Manipuri、Bishnupriya、Mizo）的语言范围。
Motivation: 命名实体识别和 PII 匿名化是 NLP 中信息抽取与隐私保护的关键任务，现有系统往往在细粒度识别、多语言覆盖和可逆匿名化方面缺乏统一支持，尤其缺少对低资源语言的防护能力。
Method: AWED-PIPER 结合细粒度多语言序列标注模型与脚本感知的正则检测器（regex detectors），并提供 54 个专家检测模型；系统支持全量 FgNER 实体抽取，以及使用持久占位符和去匿名化字典映射的可逆隐私保护匿名化。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数字，主要贡献是覆盖 36 种语言、约 66 亿使用者的开源框架及资源（GitHub 工具、Hugging Face Web 应用和模型集合）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该系统面向多语言细粒度 NER 与可逆 PII 保护，尤其覆盖极低资源脆弱语言，并提供可部署的智能体工具与边缘端模型资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stitch the Fragments: One-Shot Hierarchical Federated Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Federated Clustering (FC) faces a critical bottleneck in real-world scenarios, i.e., global clusters are rarely intact, often fragmenting into incomplete, multi-granular unlabeled ``clusterlets'' distributed across Non-IID clients. Although hierarchical clustering is theoretically well-suited to model such nested distributions, its recursive nature strictly relies on multi-round communication, introducing prohibitive computational overhead and severe privacy vulnerabilities. This paper, therefore, proposes a novel one-shot hierarchical federated clustering framework designed to seamlessly ``stitch'' the fragmented local clusterlets into a holistic global distribution. Our approach enables clients to perform autonomous fine-grained distribution exploration, uploading prototype-level knowledge via a dynamic parameter-interleaving mechanism to scramble transmission trajectories, which effectively prevents the server from tracing individual client data distributions. Subsequently, a multi-granular learning mechanism at the server fuses these granularly inconsistent local clusterlets, reconstructing a coherent global hierarchy for ultimate clustering. Extensive experiments on real benchmark datasets illustrate the superiority of the proposed approach, which effectively bridges the granularity gap among heterogeneous clients while minimizing privacy exposure risks via anonymized informative one-shot communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种单轮 (one-shot) 分层联邦聚类框架，用于解决全局簇在 Non-IID 客户端上碎片化为多粒度无标注 "clusterlets" 的问题。客户端自主进行细粒度分布探索，通过动态参数交织机制上传原型级知识以打乱传输轨迹；服务器端用多粒度学习机制融合粒度不一致的局部簇，重建全局层次结构。在真实基准数据集上的实验表明该方法能弥合异构客户端间的粒度差距，并通过匿名化单轮通信降低隐私暴露风险。
Motivation: 联邦聚类在现实场景中面临全局簇不完整、碎片化为跨 Non-IID 客户端的多粒度 clusterlets 的瓶颈；传统分层聚类因递归特性依赖多轮通信，带来高计算开销和隐私风险。
Method: 提出 one-shot 分层联邦聚类框架：客户端本地进行自主细粒度分布探索，通过动态参数交织 (dynamic parameter-interleaving) 机制上传原型级知识以打乱传输轨迹，防止服务器追踪个体数据分布；服务器端采用多粒度学习机制融合粒度不一致的局部 clusterlets，重建一致的全局层次结构。
Result: 在真实基准数据集上的大量实验表明该方法优于对比方法，能有效弥合异构客户端之间的粒度差距，并通过匿名化的信息性单轮通信最小化隐私暴露风险。摘要未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架能以单轮通信实现分层联邦聚类，兼顾粒度弥合与隐私保护；但摘要未报告具体数值结果或局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Q-Regularized Generative Auto-Bidding: From Suboptimal Trajectories to Optimal Policies
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid development of e-commerce, auto-bidding has become a key asset in optimizing advertising performance under diverse advertiser environments. The current approaches focus on reinforcement learning (RL) and generative models. These efforts imitate offline historical behaviors by utilizing a complex structure with expensive hyperparameter tuning. The suboptimal trajectories further exacerbate the difficulty of policy learning. To address these challenges, we proposes QGA, a novel Q-value regularized Generative Auto-bidding method. In QGA, we propose to plug a Q-value regularization with double Q-learning strategy into the Decision Transformer backbone. This design enables joint optimization of policy imitation and action-value maximization, allowing the learned bidding policy to both leverage experience from the dataset and alleviate the adverse impact of the suboptimal trajectories. Furthermore, to safely explore the policy space beyond the data distribution, we propose a Q-value guided dual-exploration mechanism, in which the DT model is conditioned on multiple return-to-go targets and locally perturbed actions. This entire exploration process is dynamically guided by the aforementioned Q-value module, which provides principled evaluation for each candidate action. Experiments on public benchmarks and simulation environments demonstrate that QGA consistently achieves superior or highly competitive results compared to existing alternatives. Notably, in large-scale real-world A/B testing, QGA achieves a 3.27% increase in Ad GMV and a 2.49% improvement in Ad ROI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QGA，一种基于 Q 值正则化的生成式自动出价 (auto-bidding) 方法。QGA 将带 double Q-learning 的 Q 值正则化嵌入 Decision Transformer 骨干，通过策略模仿与动作价值最大化的联合优化，缓解离线数据中子最优轨迹对策略学习的不利影响。在公开基准与仿真环境上表现优越或有竞争力，并在大规模真实 A/B 测试中实现 Ad GMV +3.27%、Ad ROI +2.49%。
Motivation: 现有自动出价方法依赖强化学习和生成模型，通过复杂结构模仿离线历史行为，超参数调优成本高；离线数据中的次优轨迹进一步加剧策略学习难度。因此需要一种能同时利用数据集经验并降低次优轨迹负面影响的方法。
Method: 提出 QGA：在 Decision Transformer 骨干上引入带 double Q-learning 策略的 Q 值正则化，联合优化策略模仿与动作价值最大化；另设计 Q 值引导的双探索机制，使 DT 模型以多个 return-to-go 目标和局部扰动动作作为条件进行安全探索，由 Q 值模块对候选动作提供原则化评估。
Result: 在公开基准和仿真环境上的实验显示 QGA 一致地优于或与现有方法竞争力相当；大规模真实 A/B 测试中 Ad GMV 提升 3.27%，Ad ROI 提升 2.49%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，Q 值正则化与双探索机制使学习的出价策略既能利用数据集经验，又能减轻次优轨迹的不利影响，并在数据分布之外安全探索策略空间。摘要未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 QGA，一种基于 Q 值正则化的生成式自动出价 (auto-bidding) 方法。QGA 将带 double Q-learning 的 Q 值正则化嵌入 Decision Transformer 骨干，通过策略模仿与动作价值最大化的联合优化，缓解离线数据中子最优轨迹对策略学习的不利影响。在公开基准与仿真环境上表现优越或有竞争力，并在大规模真实 A/B 测试中实现 Ad GMV +3.27%、Ad ROI +2.49%。

papers.title: RoboMirror: Understand Before You Imitate for Video to Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: Humans learn locomotion through visual observation, interpreting visual content first before imitating actions. However, state-of-the-art humanoid locomotion systems rely on either curated motion capture trajectories or sparse text commands, leaving a critical gap between visual understanding and control. Text-to-motion methods suffer from semantic sparsity and staged pipeline errors, while video-based approaches only perform mechanical pose mimicry without genuine visual understanding. We propose RoboMirror, the first retargeting-free video-to-locomotion framework embodying "understand before you imitate". Leveraging VLMs, it distills raw egocentric/third-person videos into visual motion intents, which directly condition a diffusion-based policy to generate physically plausible, semantically aligned locomotion without explicit pose reconstruction or retargeting. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of RoboMirror, it enables telepresence via egocentric videos, drastically reduces third-person control latency by 80%, and achieves a 3.7% higher task success rate than baselines. By reframing humanoid control around video understanding, we bridge the visual understanding and action gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RoboMirror，一个据称首个免重定向（retargeting-free）的视频到人形运动框架，核心思想是“先理解再模仿”。该方法利用视觉语言模型（VLM）将原始第一/第三人称视频蒸馏为视觉运动意图（visual motion intents），直接条件化基于扩散的策略，生成物理上合理且语义对齐的运动，无需显式姿态重建或重定向。摘要报告实验表明其支持基于 ego 视频的远程临场，将第三人称控制延迟降低 80%，并比基线获得 3.7% 更高的任务成功率。
Motivation: 现有人形运动系统依赖精心策划的动作捕捉轨迹或稀疏文本命令，视觉理解与控制之间存在关键缺口；文本到运动方法受语义稀疏和流水线错误困扰，视频方法则只做机械姿态模仿而缺乏真正的视觉理解。
Method: 提出 RoboMirror，利用 VLM 将原始视频蒸馏为视觉运动意图，并以其直接条件化扩散策略来生成运动，避开了显式姿态重建和重定向步骤。
Result: 摘要报告实验验证了 RoboMirror 的有效性：可通过 ego 视频实现远程临场，第三人称控制延迟降低 80%，任务成功率比基线提升 3.7%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过将人形控制重新定位为围绕视频理解，可以弥合视觉理解与行动之间的 gap。

papers.title: A Survey of Body and Face Motion: Datasets, Performance Evaluation Metrics and Generative Techniques
papers.abstract_en: Body and face motion play an integral role in communication. They convey crucial information on the participants. Advances in generative modeling and multi-modal learning have enabled motion generation from signals such as speech, conversational context and visual cues. However, generating expressive and coherent face and body dynamics remains challenging due to the complex interplay of verbal / non-verbal cues and individual personality traits. This survey reviews body and face motion generation, covering core concepts, representations techniques, generative approaches, datasets and evaluation metrics. We highlight future directions to enhance the realism, coherence and expressiveness of avatars in dyadic settings. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first comprehensive review to cover both body and face motion. Detailed resources are listed on https://lownish23csz0010.github.io/mogen/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是首篇同时覆盖人体与面部运动生成的综述，围绕核心概念、表示方法、生成技术、数据集和评估指标进行梳理。摘要指出，尽管生成建模和多模态学习已能由语音、对话语境和视觉线索驱动运动生成，但生成富有表现力且连贯的面部与身体动态仍受言语/非言语线索与个性特征的复杂交互制约。作者还整理了在线资源，并给出提升双人互动场景中虚拟化身真实感、连贯性与表现力的未来方向。
Motivation: 面部和身体运动在交流中传递关键信息，而现有生成方法难以同时保证面部与身体动态的表现力和连贯性。作者指出此前缺少同时涵盖身体与面部运动的综合综述。
Method: 采用综述方法，系统梳理该领域的核心概念、运动表示技术、生成式方法、数据集和性能评估指标，并在项目主页列出详细资源。

Conclusion: 作者强调未来应着重提升双人互动（dyadic settings）场景中虚拟化身的表现力、真实感和连贯性，并提供了配套资源页。

papers.title: Retrofit: Continual Learning with Controlled Forgetting for Binary Security Detection and Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Binary security has increasingly relied on deep learning to reason about malware behavior and program semantics. However, the performance often degrades as threat landscapes evolve and code representations shift. While continual learning (CL) offers a natural solution through sequential updates, most existing approaches rely on data replay or unconstrained updates, limiting their applicability and effectiveness in data-sensitive security environments. We propose RETROFIT, which regulates knowledge retention and adaptation with controlled forgetting at each update, without requiring historical data. Our key idea is to consolidate previously trained and newly fine-tuned models, serving as teachers of legacy and emergent knowledge, through retrospective-free parameter merging. Forgetting control is achieved by 1) constraining parameter changes to low-rank and sparse subspaces for approximate orthogonality, and 2) employing a confidence-guided arbitration mechanism to dynamically aggregate knowledge from both teachers. Our evaluation on two representative applications demonstrates that RETROFIT consistently mitigates forgetting while maintaining adaptability. In malware detection under temporal drift, it substantially improves the retention score, from 20.2% to 38.6% over CL baselines, and exceeds the oracle upper bound on new data. In binary summarization across decompilation levels, where analyzing stripped binaries is especially challenging, RETROFIT achieves over 2x the BLEU score of transfer learning used in prior work and surpasses all baselines in cross-representation generalization.

papers.title: Comprehension of Multilingual Expressions Referring to Target Objects in Visual Inputs
papers.abstract_en: Referring Expression Comprehension (REC) requires models to localize objects in images based on different types of natural language descriptions. Even with significant progress, research on the area remains predominantly English-centric, despite increasing global deployment demands. This work addresses multilingual REC through two main contributions. First, we construct a unified multilingual dataset spanning 10 languages, by systematically expanding 12 existing English REC benchmarks through machine translation and context-based translation enhancement. Second, we introduce an attention-anchored efficient neural architecture that uses a multilingual SigLIP2 encoder. Our attention-based approach generates coarse spatial anchors from attention distributions, which are subsequently refined through learned residuals. Experimental evaluation demonstrates competitive performance on standard benchmarks despite the use of a relatively small model. Multilingual evaluation shows consistent capabilities across languages, establishing the practical feasibility of efficient multilingual visual grounding systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多语言指代表达理解（Referring Expression Comprehension, REC）问题，构建了一个覆盖 10 种语言的统一多语言数据集，该数据集通过对 12 个现有英文 REC 基准进行机器翻译和基于上下文的翻译增强得到。同时提出一种基于注意力锚点的轻量神经架构，使用多语言 SigLIP2 编码器，从注意力分布生成粗略空间锚点，再通过学习残差进行细化。实验显示该模型在标准基准上具有竞争力，且多语言评估中各语言表现一致。
Motivation: 现有 REC 研究虽然进展显著，但主要以英文为中心，与日益增长的全球部署需求不匹配，多语言视觉指代定位尚缺乏统一的数据集与高效模型。
Method: 作者提出两个贡献：一是通过机器翻译与上下文感知的翻译增强，系统化地扩展 12 个英文 REC 基准，构建覆盖 10 种语言的统一多语言数据集；二是提出注意力锚定的高效架构，采用多语言 SigLIP2 编码器，从注意力分布提取粗略空间锚点，并用学习到的残差做精细化回归。
Result: 摘要报告该模型在标准基准上以相对较小的模型规模取得有竞争力的性能；多语言评估显示跨语言能力一致，验证了构建高效多语言视觉定位系统的实际可行性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为高效的多语言视觉基础（visual grounding）系统提供了可行路径，同时强调小模型与多语言数据扩展相结合的潜力。

papers.title: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Co-Speech Motion Generation via Global Rotation Diffusion and Multi-Level Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Reliable long-horizon co-speech gesture generation requires precise motion representation and consistent structural priors across all joints. Existing generative methods typically operate on local joint rotations, which are defined hierarchically based on the skeleton structure. This leads to cumulative errors during generation, manifesting as unstable and implausible motions at end-effectors. In this work, we propose GlobalDiff, a diffusion-based framework that operates directly in the space of global joint rotations for the first time, fundamentally decoupling each joint's prediction from upstream dependencies and alleviating hierarchical error accumulation. To compensate for the absence of structural priors in global rotation space, we introduce a multi-level constraint scheme. Specifically, a joint structure constraint introduces virtual anchor points around each joint to better capture fine-grained orientation. A skeleton structure constraint enforces angular consistency across bones to maintain structural integrity. A temporal structure constraint utilizes a multi-scale variational encoder to align the generated motion with ground-truth temporal patterns. These constraints jointly regularize the global diffusion process and reinforce structural awareness. Extensive evaluations on standard co-speech benchmarks show that GlobalDiff generates smooth and accurate motions, improving the performance by 46.0% compared to the current SOTA under multiple speaker identities.
papers.comment: AAAI 2026. Project page: https://xiangyuezhang.com/GlobalDiff/; code and pretrained models: https://github.com/Xiangyue-Zhang/GlobalDiff
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence, 40(15), 12834-12842, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GlobalDiff，一个基于扩散的共语手势生成框架，首次直接在全关节全局旋转空间 (global joint rotations) 中操作，以解耦各关节预测对上游依赖并缓解层级误差累积。为补偿全局旋转空间缺失的结构先验，作者引入多级约束：关节结构约束通过虚拟锚点捕捉细粒度朝向、骨骼结构约束保持骨间角度一致性、时间结构约束用多尺度变分编码器对齐时间模式。在标准共语手势基准上，GlobalDiff 相对当前 SOTA 在多说话人身份下性能提升 46.0%。
Motivation: 现有生成方法通常基于骨架层级定义的局部关节旋转，导致长时程生成中误差累积，使端效应器 (end-effectors) 出现不稳定和不合理的运动。
Method: 提出直接在全局关节旋转空间进行扩散生成，并设计三种结构约束来补充全局空间缺失的骨架结构先验：关节级虚拟锚点约束、骨骼级角度一致性约束、以及基于多尺度变分编码器的时间结构约束。
Result: 在标准共语手势基准上，GlobalDiff 生成平滑且准确的动作，相对当前 SOTA 在多说话人身份下性能提升 46.0%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，全局旋转扩散配合多级约束可以有效缓解层级误差累积并增强结构感知，从而提升长时程共语手势生成的可靠性。

papers.title: World-in-World: World Models in a Closed-Loop World
papers.abstract_en: Generative world models (WMs) can now simulate worlds with striking visual realism, which naturally raises the question of whether they can endow embodied agents with predictive perception for decision making. Progress on this question has been limited by fragmented evaluation: most existing benchmarks adopt open-loop protocols that emphasize visual quality in isolation, leaving the core issue of embodied utility unresolved, i.e., do WMs actually help agents succeed at embodied tasks? To address this gap, we introduce World-in-World, the first open platform that benchmarks WMs in a closed-loop world that mirrors real agent-environment interactions. World-in-World provides a unified online planning strategy and a standardized action API, enabling heterogeneous WMs for decision making. We curate four closed-loop environments that rigorously evaluate diverse WMs, prioritize task success as the primary metric, and move beyond the common focus on visual quality; we also present the first data scaling law for world models in embodied settings. Our study uncovers three surprises: (1) visual quality alone does not guarantee task success, controllability matters more; (2) scaling post-training with action-observation data is more effective than upgrading the pretrained video generators; and (3) allocating more inference-time compute allows WMs to substantially improve closed-loop performance.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 World-in-World，一个在闭环世界中评测生成式世界模型 (world models) 的开放平台，统一在线规划策略和动作 API，用四个闭环环境以任务成功率为主指标评测异构世界模型，并呈现世界模型在具身场景下的数据缩放律。研究发现视觉质量不等于任务成功，可控性更重要；用动作-观测数据做后训练比升级预训练视频生成器更有效；分配更多推理时计算能显著提升闭环性能。
Motivation: 现有世界模型基准大多采用开环评测，只强调视觉质量，忽略了具身效用这一核心问题：世界模型是否真正帮助智能体在具身任务中成功。作者希望弥补这一评价缺口。
Method: 引入 World-in-World 平台，提供统一的在线规划策略和标准化动作 API，使异构世界模型接入决策；构建四个闭环环境，以任务成功率作为主要评测指标，并首次给出世界模型在具身设置下的数据缩放律。
Result: 摘要报告三个意外发现：(1) 视觉质量不保证任务成功，可控性更重要；(2) 用动作-观测数据缩放后训练比升级预训练视频生成器更有效；(3) 分配更多推理时计算能让世界模型显著改善闭环表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调闭环评测和任务成功率应成为世界模型研究的核心，数据缩放与推理计算投入比单纯提升视觉生成质量更具实际收益。

papers.title: Explainable Heterogeneous Anomaly Detection in Financial Networks via Adaptive Expert Routing
papers.abstract_en: Financial anomalies arise from heterogeneous mechanisms - price shocks, liquidity freezes, contagion cascades, and momentum reversals - yet existing detectors produce uniform anomaly scores without revealing which mechanism is failing or where risks concentrate. This hinders targeted responses: liquidity freezes call for market-making support, whereas price shocks from information asymmetry call for circuit breakers. Three key challenges remain unresolved: (1) static graph structures cannot adapt when correlations shift across regimes; (2) uniform detectors overlook heterogeneous anomaly signatures; and (3) black-box scores provide no actionable guidance on which mechanism drives the anomaly. We address these challenges with an adaptive graph learning framework that embeds interpretability architecturally rather than post hoc. The framework constructs stress-modulated graphs that adaptively interpolate between known sector and geographic relationships and data-driven correlations as market conditions evolve. Anomalies are decomposed via four mechanism-specific experts - Price-Shock, Liquidity, Systemic-Contagion, and Momentum-Reversal - whose routing weights serve as interpretable proxies for mechanism attribution. A hierarchical Market Pressure Index aggregates entity-level anomaly scores into graduated market-wide alerts. On 100 U.S. equities (2017-2024), the framework detects all six major market stress events with a 3.7-day mean lead time, outperforming the strongest baselines by +33 percentage points in detection rate (AUC 0.888, AP 0.626). Case studies on the SVB collapse (March 2023) and Japan carry-trade unwind (August 2024) demonstrate that routing weights automatically distinguish localized sector-specific crises from systemic multi-sector propagation - without labeled supervision.
papers.journal_ref: XAI-FIN: International Joint Workshop on Explainable AI in Finance, ACM ICAIF 2025; IEEE CIFEr 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对金融网络中的异常检测提出一个自适应图学习框架，将可解释性嵌入架构而非事后解释。框架通过压力调节图 (stress-modulated graph) 在已知行业/地理关系与数据驱动相关性之间自适应插值，并利用 Price-Shock、Liquidity、Systemic-Contagion、Momentum-Reversal 四个机制专属专家来分解异常，路由权重作为机制归因的可解释代理。在 2017-2024 年 100 只美股上，该方法以 3.7 天平均提前量检测出全部六次重大市场压力事件，检测率比最强基线高 33 个百分点 (AUC 0.888, AP 0.626)。
Motivation: 现有异常检测器对所有异常给出统一分数，无法揭示是哪种机制失效或风险集中在何处，阻碍了针对性应对；同时静态图结构无法适应市场状态切换，黑盒分数缺乏可操作的归因指导。
Method: 提出一个自适应图学习框架：构造随市场条件演化的压力调节图，在已知关系与数据驱动相关性之间插值；通过四个机制专属专家分解异常，并用专家路由权重作为机制归因；再以分层 Market Pressure Index 将实体级异常分数聚合成分级别的市场预警。
Result: 在 100 只美股 (2017-2024) 上检测出全部六次主要市场压力事件，平均提前 3.7 天，检测率比最强基线高 33 个百分点，AUC 0.888、AP 0.626。SVB 倒闭 (2023 年 3 月) 与日本套息交易平仓 (2024 年 8 月) 的案例研究显示，路由权重无需监督即可区分局部行业危机与系统性跨行业传播。
Conclusion: 作者强调将可解释性架构化 (而非事后解释) 可以同时获得异常检测与机制归因能力。论文范围限定在金融网络，未涉及其他领域的可迁移性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Near-Equilibrium Propagation training in nonlinear wave systems
papers.abstract_en: Backpropagation learning algorithm, the workhorse of modern artificial intelligence, is notoriously difficult to implement in physical neural networks. Equilibrium Propagation (EP) is an alternative with comparable efficiency and strong potential for in-situ training. We extend EP learning to both discrete and continuous complex-valued wave systems. In contrast to previous EP implementations, our scheme is valid in the weakly dissipative regime, and readily applicable to a wide range of physical settings, even without well defined nodes, where trainable inter-node connections can be replaced by trainable local potential. We test the method in driven-dissipative exciton-polariton condensates governed by generalized Gross-Pitaevskii dynamics. Numerical studies on standard benchmarks, including a simple logical task and handwritten-digit recognition, demonstrate stable convergence, establishing a practical route to in-situ learning in physical systems in which system control is restricted to local parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把均衡传播 (Equilibrium Propagation, EP) 训练算法扩展到离散与连续复值波系统，使其适用于弱耗散 (weakly dissipative) 场景，并在没有明确定义节点的物理系统中用可训练局域势 (trainable local potential) 替代节点间连接。作者在由广义 Gross-Pitaevskii 动力学描述的驱动-耗散激子极化激元凝聚体 (exciton-polariton condensates) 中测试该方法，数值实验在简单逻辑任务和手写数字识别等标准基准上显示稳定收敛。
Motivation: 反向传播 (backpropagation) 难以在物理神经网络中原位实现，而 EP 虽在效率和原位训练潜力上接近反向传播，但已有实现约束较多；本文希望将其推广到弱耗散、不必具备显式节点定义的物理系统。
Method: 提出面向离散和连续复值波系统的 EP 扩展方案，通过训练局域势代替可训练节点间连接，使其能用于控制仅限局域参数的物理系统，并以广义 Gross-Pitaevskii 方程建模的驱动-耗散激子极化激元体系为测试平台。
Result: 摘要报告在简单逻辑任务和手写数字识别等基准上的数值研究表明该方法能够稳定收敛，确立了在仅能控制局域参数的物理系统中进行原位学习 (in-situ learning) 的可行路径。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方案为物理系统中受限于局域参数控制的原位学习提供了实用路线；摘要只给出数值验证，未提及实验实现。

papers.title: Time-Correlated Video Bridge Matching
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models excel in noise-to-data generation tasks, providing a mapping from a Gaussian distribution to a more complex data distribution. However, they struggle to model translations between complex distributions, limiting their effectiveness in data-to-data tasks. While Bridge Matching models address this by finding the translation between data distributions, their application to time-correlated data sequences remains unexplored. This is a critical limitation for video generation and manipulation tasks, where maintaining temporal coherence is particularly important. To address this gap, we propose Time-Correlated Video Bridge Matching (TCVBM), a framework that extends Bridge Matching to time-correlated data sequences in the video domain. TCVBM explicitly models inter-sequence dependencies within the diffusion bridge, directly incorporating temporal correlations into the sampling process. We compare our approach to classical methods based on bridge matching and diffusion models for three video-related tasks: frame interpolation, image-to-video generation, and video super-resolution. TCVBM achieves superior performance across multiple quantitative metrics, benchmark datasets and human evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Time-Correlated Video Bridge Matching (TCVBM)，将 Bridge Matching 扩展到时间相关的视频数据序列，在扩散桥 (diffusion bridge) 中显式建模序列间依赖关系，使采样过程直接纳入时间相关性。作者在帧插值、图像到视频生成和视频超分辨率三个视频任务上，与基于桥匹配和扩散模型的经典方法对比，报告 TCVBM 在多个定量指标、基准数据集和人工评估上均取得更优性能。
Motivation: 扩散模型擅长从噪声到数据的生成，但难以建模复杂分布之间的数据到数据翻译；Bridge Matching 虽能处理分布间翻译，却尚未应用于时间相关数据序列，而视频生成与操作任务中保持时间一致性 (temporal coherence) 十分关键。
Method: 提出 TCVBM 框架，将 Bridge Matching 拓展到时间相关的视频数据序列；在扩散桥内部显式建模序列间依赖关系，直接在采样过程中引入时间相关性。
Result: 在帧插值、图像到视频生成和视频超分辨率三项任务上，与基于桥匹配和扩散模型的经典方法比较，TCVBM 在多个定量指标、基准数据集及人工评估上取得更优性能。
Conclusion: 作者将 TCVBM 的收益归因于在扩散桥中显式建模序列间依赖，填补了 Bridge Matching 在时间相关序列应用上的空白；摘要未提及明显局限。

papers.title: The Fragility of Strategic Thinking in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to domains that require reasoning about other agents' behavior, such as negotiation, policy design, and market simulation. However, can we trust LLMs to think strategically in complex situations? Existing research mostly evaluates LLMs' adherence to equilibrium play or their exhibited depth of reasoning, leaving open whether they display strategic thinking meant as the ability to form coherent conjectures about other agents, to evaluate possible actions conditional on those conjectures, and to best respond to them. We develop a framework to identify this ability by disentangling belief formation, evaluation, and choice in static complete-information games across a series of non-cooperative environments. By jointly analyzing models' revealed choices and reasoning traces, and introducing a new context-free game to rule out imitation from memorization, we show that strategic thinking in current frontier LLMs is real but fragile: models execute best responses to exogenous conjectures and form opponent-contingent conjectures when left unconstrained. Yet under increasing complexity explicit recursion gives way to model-specific logic shifts and heuristic rules of choice, both within and outside equilibrium reasoning. Further, these heuristics do not map directly onto the systematic biases typically observed in human strategic behavior. These findings, already emerging in noiseless settings, warrant caution in the application of LLMs as strategic agents in complex environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）在谈判、政策设计、市场模拟等需要推理他人行为的场景中的应用，提出一个框架，通过在静态完全信息博弈（static complete-information games）中分离信念形成、评估与选择三个环节，来识别模型是否具备真正的策略性思维。结合对模型的显式选择与推理轨迹的联合分析，并引入一种新的无上下文博弈以排除记忆模仿，作者发现当前前沿 LLM 的策略性思维真实但脆弱：在无约束时能对给定外生猜想做最优响应并形成针对对手的猜想，但复杂度上升后显式递归会被模型特有的逻辑转换与启发式规则取代，且这些启发式并不对应人类策略行为中的系统性偏差。
Motivation: 现有研究主要评估 LLM 对均衡策略（equilibrium play）的遵循程度或推理深度，未回答模型能否形成关于其他智能体的连贯猜想、基于这些猜想评估可能行动并做出最优响应；这一缺口关系到模型在需要策略交互的真实场景中是否可靠。
Method: 提出一个识别框架，在系列非合作环境下的静态完全信息博弈中把信念形成、评估与选择解耦；通过联合分析模型的被揭示选择（revealed choices）与推理轨迹，并设计一种新的无上下文博弈来排除记忆模仿（imitation from memorization）。
Result: 摘要报告，模型能够对外生猜想执行最优响应（best response），并在不受约束时形成依赖对手的猜想；但在复杂度增加时，显式递归转向模型特有的逻辑转换和启发式选择规则，且这些启发式并不直接对应人类策略行为中常见的系统性偏差，且这些现象在无噪声设定下已出现。
Conclusion: 作者认为，这些发现警示在复杂环境中将 LLM 作为策略性智能体使用时需保持谨慎。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）在谈判、政策设计、市场模拟等需要推理他人行为的场景中的应用，提出一个框架，通过在静态完全信息博弈（static complete-information games）中分离信念形成、评估与选择三个环节，来识别模型是否具备真正的策略性思维。结合对模型的显式选择与推理轨迹的联合分析，并引入一种新的无上下文博弈以排除记忆模仿，作者发现当前前沿 LLM 的策略性思维真实但脆弱：在无约束时能对给定外生猜想做最优响应并形成针对对手的猜想，但复杂度上升后显式递归会被模型特有的逻辑转换与启发式规则取代，且这些启发式并不对应人类策略行为中的系统性偏差。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有研究主要评估 LLM 对均衡策略（equilibrium play）的遵循程度或推理深度，未回答模型能否形成关于其他智能体的连贯猜想、基于这些猜想评估可能行动并做出最优响应；这一缺口关系到模型在需要策略交互的真实场景中是否可靠。
summary_sections.method: 提出一个识别框架，在系列非合作环境下的静态完全信息博弈中把信念形成、评估与选择解耦；通过联合分析模型的被揭示选择（revealed choices）与推理轨迹，并设计一种新的无上下文博弈来排除记忆模仿（imitation from memorization）。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告，模型能够对外生猜想执行最优响应（best response），并在不受约束时形成依赖对手的猜想；但在复杂度增加时，显式递归转向模型特有的逻辑转换和启发式选择规则，且这些启发式并不直接对应人类策略行为中常见的系统性偏差，且这些现象在无噪声设定下已出现。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，这些发现警示在复杂环境中将 LLM 作为策略性智能体使用时需保持谨慎。

papers.title: A Large-Scale Chinese Knowledge Graph-Text Alignment Dataset for Benchmarking Knowledge-Grounded LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Reliable evaluation of knowledge-grounded Large Language Models (LLMs) in Chinese requires resources that explicitly align Chinese-language text with verifiable Knowledge Graph (KG) facts. Yet existing Chinese benchmarks primarily assess general language understanding and offer limited support for structured reasoning under Chinese-specific linguistic phenomena. We introduce the Chinese Data-Text Pair (CDTP), a large-scale Chinese KG-text alignment dataset comprising more than 7 million aligned instances across four broad domains. Each instance pairs a Chinese-language text with one or more textually supported KG triples, totaling 15 million triples. A multi-stage construction pipeline combining alignment filtering, manual verification, and external evidence validation improves semantic consistency and factual reliability. CDTP supports Knowledge Graph Completion (KGC), Question Answering (QA), and Triple-to-Text Generation (T2T). Across all three tasks, the benchmark design accounts for Chinese-specific phenomena, including polysemy, word-segmentation ambiguity, and context-dependent entity interpretation, enabling the evaluation of structured reasoning, ambiguity-aware factual understanding, and knowledge-grounded generation. Experiments with diverse open-source and proprietary LLMs show that model scale alone does not guarantee reliable performance on these Chinese knowledge-intensive tasks, whereas supervised fine-tuning on CDTP consistently improves in-domain performance and out-of-distribution robustness. The publicly accessible dataset, code, and evaluation protocols provide a reusable resource for developing and evaluating knowledge-grounded LLMs in Chinese.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出大规模中文知识图谱-文本对齐数据集 CDTP (Chinese Data-Text Pair)，包含超过 700 万个对齐实例和 1500 万个 KG 三元组，覆盖四个领域，用于评估知识基础的大语言模型。数据集构建采用多阶段流程，结合对齐过滤、人工验证和外部证据校验，并支持知识图谱补全、问答和三元组到文本生成三类任务。实验表明模型规模本身不保证中文知识密集型任务的可靠性，而基于 CDTP 的有监督微调能稳定提升域内与域外表现。
Motivation: 现有中文基准主要评估通用语言理解，缺乏将中文文本与可验证知识图谱事实显式对齐的资源，难以支持中文特有语言现象下的结构化推理评估。
Method: 构建 CDTP 数据集，通过多阶段流程（对齐过滤、人工验证、外部证据验证）提升语义一致性与事实可靠性，并针对多义词、分词歧义、上下文相关实体解释等中文特有现象设计三任务基准。
Result: 摘要报告数据集包含超 700 万实例、1500 万三元组；实验显示不同开源与闭源 LLM 中，模型规模并不能保证在这些知识密集型任务上的可靠表现，而 CDTP 上的有监督微调一致提升域内性能和分布外鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者强调该公开数据集、代码与评估协议为中文知识基础 LLM 的开发与评测提供了可复用资源。

papers.title: Near-Optimal Sample Complexity Bounds for Constrained Average-Reward MDPs
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances have significantly improved our understanding of the sample complexity of learning in average-reward Markov decision processes (AMDPs) under the generative model. However, much less is known about the constrained average-reward MDP (CAMDP), where policies must satisfy long-run average constraints. In this work, we address this gap by studying the sample complexity of learning an $ε$-optimal policy in CAMDPs under a generative model. We propose a model-based algorithm that operates under two settings: (i) relaxed feasibility, which allows small constraint violations, and (ii) strict feasibility, where the output policy satisfies the constraint. We show that our algorithm achieves sample complexities of $\tilde{O}\left(\frac{S A (B+H)}{ ε^2}\right)$ and $\tilde{O} \left(\frac{S A (B+H)}{ε^2 ζ^2} \right)$ under the relaxed and strict feasibility settings, respectively. Here, $ζ$ is the Slater constant indicating the size of the feasible region, $H$ is the span bound of the bias function, and $B$ is the transient time bound. Moreover, a matching lower bound of $\tildeΩ\left(\frac{S A (B+H)}{ ε^2ζ^2}\right)$ for the strict feasibility case is established, thus providing the first minimax-optimal bounds for CAMDPs. Our results close the theoretical gap in understanding the complexity of constrained average-reward MDPs.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成模型 (generative model) 下受约束平均奖励 MDP（constrained average-reward MDP, CAMDP）中学习 ε-最优策略的样本复杂度。作者提出一种基于模型的算法，分别处理允许小约束违反的松弛可行（relaxed feasibility）与要求输出策略严格满足约束的严格可行（strict feasibility）两种设置，并给出相应样本复杂度上界与严格可行性下的匹配下界。
Motivation: 平均奖励 MDP（AMDP）在生成模型下的样本复杂度已被较充分理解，但对策略需满足长期平均约束的 CAMDP 而言，其样本复杂度仍知之甚少，论文旨在填补这一理论空白。
Method: 提出基于模型的算法，利用生成模型采样，在两种设置下学习 ε-最优策略；复杂度刻画依赖 Slater 常数 ζ、偏差函数的 span 界 H 与瞬态时间界 B，并通过下界分析证明严格可行性设置下的极小极大最优性。
Result: 在松弛可行性下达到样本复杂度 Õ(SA(B+H)/ε²)，在严格可行性下达到 Õ(SA(B+H)/(ε²ζ²))；同时建立严格可行性情形的匹配下界 Ω̃(SA(B+H)/(ε²ζ²))，首次给出 CAMDP 的极小极大最优界。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果弥合了受约束平均奖励 MDP 复杂性理解上的理论空白。

papers.title: Recurrent Cross-View Object Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) aims to determine the location of a specific object in high-resolution satellite imagery given a query image with a point prompt. Existing approaches treat CVOGL as a one-shot detection process, directly regressing object locations from cross-view information aggregation, but they are vulnerable to feature noise and lack mechanisms for error correction. In this paper, we propose ReCOT, a Recurrent Cross-view Object geo-localization Transformer, which models CVOGL as a recurrent localization process. ReCOT introduces a set of learnable tokens that encode task-specific intent from the query image and prompt embeddings, and iteratively attend to the reference features to refine the predicted location. To enhance this recurrent process, we incorporate two complementary modules: (1) a SAM-based knowledge distillation strategy that transfers segmentation priors from the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to provide clearer semantic guidance without additional inference cost, and (2) a Reference Feature Enhancement Module (RFEM) that introduces hierarchical attention to emphasize object-relevant regions in the reference features. Extensive experiments on CVOGL benchmarks demonstrate that ReCOT achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance while significantly reducing parameters compared to previous SOTA approaches. Our code is available at https://github.com/Temperature-ai/ReCOT.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCOT，一种循环跨视角目标地理定位 Transformer，将跨视角目标地理定位 (CVOGL) 建模为循环定位过程而非一次性检测。ReCOT 使用可学习 token 编码查询图像与点提示的任务意图，并迭代地关注参考特征以精化预测位置；同时引入 SAM 知识蒸馏与参考特征增强模块。摘要称该方法在 CVOGL 基准上达到 SOTA，同时相比之前 SOTA 方法显著减少参数量，代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有 CVOGL 方法将其视为一次性检测过程，直接从跨视角信息聚合中回归目标位置，对特征噪声敏感，且缺乏错误修正机制。
Method: 提出循环定位框架 ReCOT：一组可学习 token 从查询图像和点提示嵌入中编码任务意图，并在循环中持续关注参考特征以迭代精化位置。为增强循环过程，加入两个互补模块：基于 SAM 的知识蒸馏策略，在不增加推理成本的情况下提供更清晰的语义引导；以及参考特征增强模块 (RFEM)，通过层级注意力突出参考特征中与目标相关的区域。
Result: 在 CVOGL 基准上的大量实验表明，ReCOT 达到 SOTA 性能，同时相比此前 SOTA 方法显著减少了参数量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将跨视图定位建模为循环精化过程并借助语义先验引导，可以在提升定位精度的同时降低模型规模。

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Decentralized Federated Learning via Explainable Adaptive Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized federated learning enables collaborative model training without a central server, but shared model updates can still leak sensitive information through inversion, reconstruction, and membership inference attacks. Differential privacy offers formal protection, yet existing decentralized methods operate without visibility into the noise already injected by previous participants. Each client therefore adds a full, worst-case perturbation at every step, and the accumulated noise degrades accuracy well below what the privacy requirement actually demands. We present PrivateDFL, a decentralized and privacy-preserving framework that pairs hyperdimensional computing with a transparent noise accountant. The accountant tracks the cumulative perturbation present in the shared model and lets each client add only the minimal incremental noise needed to satisfy its privacy budget. We prove that every transmitted model satisfies the target privacy guarantee, and that under this accounting the cumulative noise grows only logarithmically in the number of clients and rounds, rather than the far faster super-linear growth incurred without accounting. This yields a substantially tighter balance between privacy and accuracy than prior approaches. Across image, speech, and wearable-sensor benchmarks, and under both identically and non-identically distributed data, PrivateDFL surpasses centrally trained Transformer-based and deep neural network baselines, improving accuracy by 16 percent on images, 62 percent on speech, and 14 percent on wearable sensing over the strongest baseline in each case, while reducing inference latency by up to 119 times and energy consumption by up to 143 times. These properties make PrivateDFL a practical solution for privacy-preserving collaborative learning in settings where sensitive data cannot be centralized, such as healthcare and human-activity monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PrivateDFL，一个去中心化且隐私保护的联邦学习框架，将超维计算（hyperdimensional computing）与透明噪声会计（transparent noise accountant）结合，用于跟踪共享模型中已注入的累计扰动，使每个客户端只添加满足其隐私预算所需的最小增量噪声。摘要证明该会计方式下累计噪声随客户端数和轮数呈对数增长，并在图像、语音和可穿戴传感器基准上（含 IID 与非 IID 数据）超过集中训练的 Transformer 与深度神经网络基线，同时大幅降低推理延迟和能耗。
Motivation: 去中心化联邦学习虽无需中央服务器，但共享模型更新仍可通过反转、重构和成员推断攻击泄露敏感信息。现有差分隐私方法无法看到之前参与者已注入的噪声，导致每个客户端每步都添加完整的最坏情况扰动，累计噪声使精度远低于隐私需求实际允许的水平。
Method: PrivateDFL 将超维计算与一个透明的噪声会计（noise accountant）配对，会计跟踪共享模型中的累计扰动，让每个客户端只添加满足自身隐私预算的最小增量噪声。作者证明每个传输模型都满足目标隐私保证，且在该会计机制下累计噪声随客户端数和轮数呈对数增长，而非无会计时更快的超线性增长。
Result: 摘要报告在图像、语音和可穿戴传感器基准上，且同时覆盖 IID 与非 IID 数据分布时，PrivateDFL 在各项上超过最强的集中训练 Transformer 和深度神经网络基线：图像准确率提高 16%，语音提高 62%，可穿戴传感提高 14%；同时推理延迟最高降低 119 倍，能耗最高降低 143 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要将 PrivateDFL 定位为隐私保护协作学习的实用方案，特别适用于敏感数据无法集中的场景，如医疗和人类活动监控。

papers.title: Vision-Based Calorie Estimation for Bangladeshi Street Food: A Comparative Study of Detection and Regression Models
papers.abstract_en: With obesity emerging as a major global health concern, accurate calorie estimation systems have become increasingly important for effective dietary management. Current vision-based approaches are inappropriate for Bangladeshi street food, which is widely consumed and culturally significant, because they mostly focus on Western cuisines and often overlook portion size. The purpose of this research is to offer a vision-based calorie estimation methodology that was created especially for street food in Bangladesh. Training, validation and testing splits were created from a proprietary dataset of 3,885 photos from six classes (Singara, Somusa, Puri, Peaju, Beguni, and Coin as a reference). Five detection and segmentation architectures, YOLOv8n, YOLO11n, YOLO12n, YOLO26n and RF-DETR, were methodically compared. Food dimensions were scaled using a Bangladeshi 5 Taka coin as a reference. To predict calories, extracted geometric characteristics were subsequently fed into machine learning regression models such as Random Forest, Gradient Boost and AdaBoost. YOLO11n outperformed other models with the best detection performance, achieving 96.1% mAP@50 and balanced mask metrics. With a mean absolute error (MAE) of 5.68, root mean squared error (RMSE) of 7.23, and an R2 score of 95.0%, Random Forest regression produced the best results for calorie estimation. YOLO11n in conjunction with Random Forest regression offers a precise and effective calorie estimation for street food in Bangladesh, which is useful for dietary monitoring and mobile health apps. The code and dataset are publicly available on https://github.com/hossain-tamim/BD-CAL .

papers.title: CulTrace: Tracing Internal Cultural Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The growing deployment of large language models (LLMs) across diverse cultural contexts necessitates a deeper understanding of models' hidden representations of different cultures. Prior work has evaluated cultural awareness in LLMs by analysing their outputs. This approach overlooks how cultures are represented within the model parameters, missing why models generate incorrect responses. To bridge this gap, we propose CulTrace, a mechanistic interpretability-based method that probes the internal representations of LLMs for cultural knowledge. With CulTrace, we inspect how cultural knowledge is processed across layers and how it is integrated during cultural QA. We find a consistent staged trajectory of cultural reasoning. Models first engage with the question's domain, then resolve the relevant culture, and finally narrow in on an answer. We also demonstrate that models' cultural reasoning is imbalanced, showing delayed relevant culture resolution and more confusion with less-represented cultures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CulTrace，一种基于机制可解释性 (mechanistic interpretability) 的探针方法，用于探测 LLM 内部表示中的文化知识。作者通过分析文化知识在层间的处理及在文化问答中的整合，发现模型的文化推理遵循一致的分阶段轨迹：先理解问题领域，再解析相关文化，最后收窄到答案；同时模型的文化推理存在不平衡，对代表性不足的文化表现出更迟的文化解析和更多混淆。
Motivation: 以往评估 LLM 文化意识主要依赖输出文本分析，忽略了文化在模型参数内部如何表征，因而无法解释模型为何生成错误回答。本文旨在通过内部表示分析弥合这一缺口。
Method: CulTrace 是基于机制可解释性的方法，对 LLM 的内部表示进行探针 (probing) 分析，逐层检查文化知识如何被处理，并观察其在文化问答任务中如何被整合进最终预测。
Result: 摘要报告发现模型的文化推理呈现稳定的阶段性轨迹，依次涉及问题领域、相关文化与答案收敛；且推理过程存在不平衡，代表性不足的文化其相关文化解析更晚、混淆程度更高。
Conclusion: 作者强调应从模型内部表示层面理解文化推理，并指出当前模型对不同文化的推理质量不均，低资源文化的处理更易出错。

papers.title: Adapting LLMs to Time Series Forecasting via Temporal Heterogeneity Modeling and Representation Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances have demonstrated that Large Language Models (LLMs) can be effectively adapted for time series forecasting, revealing strong potential beyond natural language tasks. However, their performance remains constrained by two fundamental challenges: the inherent heterogeneity of temporal patterns and the modality gap between continuous numerical signals and discrete language representations. In this work, we propose \textbf{TALON} (Temporal-heterogeneity And Language-Oriented Network), a unified framework that enhances LLM-based forecasting by modeling temporal heterogeneity and promoting representation alignment. Specifically, we design a Heterogeneous Temporal Encoder that partitions multivariate time series into structurally coherent segments, enabling localized expert modeling across diverse temporal patterns. To bridge the modality gap, we introduce a Representation Alignment Module that projects temporal features toward LLM-compatible representations, making time series more amenable to LLMs and thereby unlocking their modeling potential, while eliminating the need for handcrafted prompts during inference. Extensive experiments on seven real-world benchmarks demonstrate that TALON achieves superior performance across all datasets, with average MSE improvements of up to 11% over recent state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining higher efficiency. These results underscore the effectiveness of incorporating both pattern-aware modeling and representation-level alignment when adapting LLMs for time series forecasting. The code is available at: https://github.com/syrGitHub/TALON.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TALON（Temporal-heterogeneity And Language-Oriented Network），一个将大语言模型适配到时间序列预测的统一框架，针对时间模式异质性和数值信号与离散语言表示之间的模态差距。设计了一个异构时间编码器（Heterogeneous Temporal Encoder），将多元时间序列划分为结构一致的片段以进行局部专家建模，并通过表征对齐模块（Representation Alignment Module）将时间特征投影为 LLM 兼容表示，从而无需推理时手工构造提示。在七个真实世界基准上的实验显示，TALON 在所有数据集上超过近期 SOTA 方法，平均 MSE 最多改善 11%，同时保持更高效率。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 适配时间序列预测的性能受两个根本挑战限制：时序模式固有的异质性，以及连续数值信号与离散语言表示之间的模态差距（modality gap）。
Method: 提出 TALON 框架：Heterogeneous Temporal Encoder 将多元时间序列切分为结构一致的片段，对不同时间模式进行局部专家建模；Representation Alignment Module 将时间特征对齐到 LLM 兼容的表示空间，消除推理阶段对手工提示（handcrafted prompts）的依赖。
Result: 在七个真实世界基准上的广泛实验表明，TALON 在所有数据集上取得更优性能，平均 MSE 较近期 SOTA 方法最多改善 11%，并保持更高效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将模式感知建模（pattern-aware modeling）与表征级对齐相结合，是提升 LLM 在时间序列预测中适配效果的有效途径。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Lightweight Deep Learning-Based Channel Estimation for RIS-Aided Extremely Large-Scale MIMO Systems on Resource-Limited Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Next-generation wireless technologies such as 6G aim to meet demanding requirements such as ultra-high data rates, low latency, and enhanced connectivity. Extremely Large-Scale MIMO (XL-MIMO) and Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) are key enablers, with XL-MIMO boosting spectral and energy efficiency through numerous antennas, and RIS offering dynamic control over the wireless environment via passive reflective elements. However, realizing their full potential depends on accurate Channel State Information (CSI). Recent advances in deep learning have facilitated efficient cascaded channel estimation. However, the scalability and practical deployment of existing estimation models in XL-MIMO systems remain limited. The growing number of antennas and RIS elements introduces a significant barrier to real-time and efficient channel estimation, drastically increasing data volume, escalating computational complexity, requiring advanced hardware, and resulting in substantial energy consumption. To address these challenges, we propose a lightweight deep learning framework for efficient cascaded channel estimation in XL-MIMO systems, designed to minimize computational complexity and make it suitable for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. Using spatial correlations in the channel, we introduce a patch-based training mechanism that reduces the dimensionality of input to patch-level representations while preserving essential information, allowing scalable training for large-scale systems. Simulation results under diverse conditions demonstrate that our framework significantly improves estimation accuracy and reduces computational complexity, regardless of the increasing number of antennas and RIS elements in XL-MIMO systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向 RIS 辅助的超大规模 MIMO（XL-MIMO）系统的轻量级深度学习级联信道估计框架，面向资源受限边缘设备部署。方法利用信道中的空间相关性，通过基于 patch 的训练机制把输入降维到 patch 级表示，从而支持大规模系统的可扩展训练。仿真表明，在阵列天线和 RIS 单元数量增加时，该方法仍能显著提升估计精度并降低计算复杂度。
Motivation: 6G 等下一代无线系统依赖 XL-MIMO 与 RIS 提供高谱效和能效，但准确的信道状态信息（CSI）获取是关键瓶颈；现有深度学习信道估计模型在 XL-MIMO 中可扩展性和实际部署受限，天线与 RIS 单元增多会带来数据量剧增、计算复杂度上升、硬件要求高和能耗大等问题。
Method: 提出一个轻量级深度学习框架用于 XL-MIMO 中级联信道估计，核心是基于空间相关性的 patch 式训练机制，将输入转换为 patch 级表示以降低维度，同时保留关键信息，从而降低计算复杂度并适配资源受限的边缘设备。
Result: 在多种条件下的仿真结果表明，所提框架在 XL-MIMO 天线和 RIS 单元数量不断增加的场景下，仍能显著提高估计精度并降低计算复杂度；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能够解决 XL-MIMO 信道估计的规模化和部署瓶颈，使实时、高效的信道估计在资源受限边缘设备上成为可能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prompt Engineering in Segment Anything Model: Methodologies, Applications, and Emerging Challenges
papers.abstract_en: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) has transformed image segmentation by introducing a prompt-based paradigm that enables strong zero-shot generalization. In this framework, prompts serve as a semantic interface between human intent and machine perception, making prompt engineering a central factor in model performance. Despite its importance, prompt engineering within SAM and its variants has not yet been systematically reviewed in the literature. This survey addresses that gap by providing a structured and comprehensive overview of prompt engineering techniques developed for SAM and its rapidly growing ecosystem. We introduce a hierarchical taxonomy that organizes methods into geometric prompts, textual semantic prompts, and multimodal fusion prompts, and analyze how these categories reflect different design principles and application goals. In addition, we examine the transition from manually crafted prompts to more advanced, automated approaches based on detector outputs, prototype learning, reinforcement learning, and vision-language models. Beyond categorizing existing work, we trace how prompt engineering has enabled SAM to generalize across domains such as medical imaging, remote sensing, industrial inspection, and anomaly detection. We further identify key challenges---including prompt sensitivity, cross-modal misalignment, and computational inefficiency---and highlight promising research directions such as causal prompt reasoning, collaborative multi-agent prompting, and diffusion-based progressive refinement. By consolidating these developments into a unified perspective, our survey provides a timely reference for understanding the role of prompt engineering in segmentation foundation models and lays the groundwork for future advances in this evolving field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于 Segment Anything Model (SAM) 及其变体中提示工程 (prompt engineering) 的系统性综述，填补了该方向缺乏结构化总结的空白。作者提出一个分层分类法，将方法划分为几何提示、文本语义提示和多模态融合提示三类，并考察从手工提示到基于检测器输出、原型学习、强化学习和视觉语言模型的自动化提示方法。综述还梳理了 SAM 在医学影像、遥感、工业检测和异常检测等领域的跨域泛化，并指出提示敏感性、跨模态错位和计算低效等挑战及未来方向。
Motivation: SAM 引入基于提示的分割范式，提示成为连接人类意图与机器感知的语义接口，直接影响模型性能；但提示工程在 SAM 及其变体中尚未被系统综述，本文旨在填补该文献空白。
Method: 提出覆盖几何提示、文本语义提示和多模态融合提示的分层分类法，并分析手工提示向自动化提示（如检测器输出、原型学习、强化学习、视觉语言模型）的演进，同时考察提示工程推动 SAM 跨领域泛化的方式。
Result: 作为综述，本文不报告新的实验数据，而是通过统一视角归纳 SAM 生态中的提示工程技术，识别提示敏感性、跨模态错位、计算低效等关键挑战，并展望因果提示推理、协同多智能体提示和基于扩散的渐进式精化等方向。
Conclusion: 作者强调该综述为理解提示工程在分割基础模型中的作用提供及时参考，并为该领域的未来发展奠定基础；内容面向 SAM 及其相关分割任务，不直接涉及降水或天气预测应用。
Relevance: 25

summary_sections.result: 作为综述，本文不报告新的实验数据，而是通过统一视角归纳 SAM 生态中的提示工程技术，识别提示敏感性、跨模态错位、计算低效等关键挑战，并展望因果提示推理、协同多智能体提示和基于扩散的渐进式精化等方向。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调该综述为理解提示工程在分割基础模型中的作用提供及时参考，并为该领域的未来发展奠定基础；内容面向 SAM 及其相关分割任务，不直接涉及降水或天气预测应用。

papers.title: Leveraging Generative Artificial Intelligence for Causal Inference with Unstructured Data
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GenAI-Powered Inference (GPI), a statistical framework for both causal and predictive inference using unstructured data, including text and images. GPI leverages open-source Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) models---such as large language models and diffusion models---not only to generate unstructured data at scale but also to extract low-dimensional representations that are guaranteed to capture their underlying structure. Applying machine learning to these representations, GPI enables estimation of causal effects while quantifying associated estimation uncertainty. Unlike existing approaches to representation learning, GPI does not require fine-tuning of generative models, making it computationally efficient and broadly accessible. We illustrate the versatility of the GPI framework through three applications: (1) estimating the effects of Chinese social media censorship while adjusting for textual confounders, (2) isolating the impact of specific image features from that of other correlated features in the same image, and (3) assessing the persuasiveness of political rhetoric. An open-source software package is available for implementing GPI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GenAI-Powered Inference (GPI)，一种利用开源生成式 AI 模型（如大语言模型和扩散模型）对非结构化数据（文本与图像）进行因果推断和预测推断的统计框架。GPI 既能按需生成非结构化数据，也能提取低维表示并保证其捕获底层结构，再结合机器学习估计因果效应并量化不确定性，且无需微调生成模型。作者通过三个应用展示其通用性：调整文本混杂因素估计中国社交媒体审查效应、分离同一图像中特定图像特征与其他相关特征的影响、评估政治言论的说服力。
Motivation: 基于非结构化数据的现有表示学习方法通常需要微调生成模型，计算成本高且使用门槛高；GPI 旨在提供一种无需微调、计算高效且广泛可用的方案，用于从文本和图片等非结构化数据中进行因果推断。
Method: GPI 框架利用开源生成式 AI 模型（如大语言模型和扩散模型）生成大规模非结构化数据，并提取能保证捕获底层结构的低维表示；随后对表示应用机器学习，从而估计因果效应并量化估计不确定性。
Result: 摘要未给出量化实验结果，而是通过三个应用展示框架的通用性：估计中国社交媒体审查效应（调整文本混杂因素）、分离图像中特定特征与相关特征的影响、评估政治言论的说服力；并提供开源软件包。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GPI 不需要微调生成模型，因此计算高效且易于获取，可广泛用于基于非结构化数据的因果推断与预测推断。
