papers.title: Contraction-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Nonlinear Control with Statistical Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Control contraction metrics (CCMs)-defined by Riemannian metrics under which a closed-loop system is incrementally exponentially stable-offer a constructive framework for synthesizing contracting policies in nonlinear path-tracking problems. However, while the synthesized policies ensure pointwise satisfaction of the CCM conditions, they may not ensure long-term optimality (i.e., minimizing cumulative trajectory-level tracking error) over both transient and steady-state regimes. Furthermore, the myopic nature of these policies could also make them more susceptible to learning biases when approximate dynamics are used to formulate CCMs. To address these issues, we propose to integrate CCMs into reinforcement learning (RL). CCMs provide dynamics-informed feedback for learning a policy that has a stability guarantee-i.e., is contraction-aware-while RL provides a framework for minimizing cumulative tracking error under approximate dynamics. Given a pretrained dynamics model, our algorithm, contraction-aware RL (CARL), simultaneously learns to generate CCMs and optimize a policy for rewards defined by those CCMs. We demonstrate that CARL enhances path-tracking performance and is robust to errors in approximated dynamics compared to relevant baselines in both simulated and real-world robot experiments. We also provide theoretical rationale for integrating CCMs into RL. Our code is available at https://github.com/Mgineer117/CARL, and a video of our real-world robot experiments can be found at https://youtu.be/sOJ4hulbop0.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE Transactions on Robotics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将控制收缩度量（CCM）与强化学习（RL）结合，构造 contraction-aware RL (CARL) 算法，用于非线性路径跟踪问题的策略学习。CCM 提供具有稳定性保证的动力学相关信息，RL 则在近似动力学模型下最小化累积轨迹级跟踪误差。实验显示 CARL 在仿真与真实机器人任务中优于相关基线，并对动力学近似误差具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有基于 CCM 合成的收缩策略虽能逐点满足增量指数稳定条件，但不能保证长期最优性（即最小化瞬态和稳态下的累积跟踪误差）；此外，这种策略的短视性在使用近似动力学构造 CCM 时更易受学习偏差影响。
Method: 给定预训练的动力学模型，CARL 同时学习生成 CCM 并优化由这些 CCM 定义奖励的策略，从而将稳定性保证与 RL 的长期奖励优化整合在同一框架中。
Result: 摘要报告 CARL 在仿真和真实机器人实验中相比相关基线提升了路径跟踪性能，并对近似动力学的误差更具鲁棒性；同时提供了将 CCM 引入 RL 的理论依据。
Conclusion: 论文认为把 CCM 与 RL 结合可在非线性路径跟踪中获得兼具稳定性保证与长期最优性的策略，并能增强对动力学模型误差的稳健性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: IMPLICITSTAINER: Resolution Agnostic Data-Efficient Virtual Staining Using Neural Implicit Functions
papers.abstract_en: Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained slides are central to cancer diagnosis and monitoring, visualizing tissue architecture and cellular morphology. However, H&E lacks the molecular specificity needed to distinguish cell states and functional activation. Antibody-based stains, such as immunohistochemistry (IHC), are therefore required to identify specific phenotypes (e.g., CD3$^+$ T cells or HER2-positive tumor cells) but are costly, time-consuming, and not universally available. Deep learning-based image translation methods, often termed virtual staining, offer a complementary alternative by generating virtual immunostains directly from H&E images. Most existing virtual staining methods are patch-based and operate at fixed resolutions, often requiring large datasets and additional post-hoc super-resolution models to generate high-resolution images. Furthermore, GAN- and diffusion-based approaches introduce stochasticity into generated stains which, although beneficial for visual realism in natural images, can lead to hallucinations and structural distortions that affect the accuracy and reliability required for clinical use. We propose IMPLICITSTAINER, a deterministic framework that reformulates virtual staining as a continuous pixel-level translation problem. In contrast to existing patch-based approaches, IMPLICITSTAINER formulates image translation as a continuous spatial mapping using neural implicit deep learning models. Each target-domain (IHC) pixel is predicted from a high-dimensional embedding of the corresponding source-domain H&E pixel, its local spatial neighborhood, and explicit coordinate information. IMPLICITSTAINER enables resolution-agnostic inference, improves robustness in low-data regimes, and yields deterministic, reproducible outputs. Across more than twenty baselines, IMPLICITSTAINER achieves SOTA performance on virtual staining tasks, including IHC and mIF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IMPLICITSTAINER，将虚拟染色（virtual staining）重构为连续的像素级翻译问题，利用神经隐式函数（neural implicit functions）直接从 H&E 图像预测 IHC 像素。该方法支持分辨率无关推理、在低数据场景下更鲁棒，并产生确定性、可复现的输出，摘要报告其在超过二十个基线上取得 SOTA 性能。
Motivation: 现有虚拟染色方法多为 patch-based 且固定分辨率，通常需要大数据集和额外超分模型；GAN 与扩散方法引入随机性，可能导致幻觉和结构失真，影响临床所需的准确性与可靠性。
Method: 将图像翻译建模为连续空间映射，使用神经隐式深度学习模型，每个目标域（IHC）像素由对应源域 H&E 像素的高维嵌入、局部空间邻域以及显式坐标信息共同预测。
Result: 摘要报告在超过二十个基线上，IMPLICITSTAINER 在虚拟染色任务（包括 IHC 和 mIF）上达到 SOTA 性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该确定性框架能够实现分辨率无关推理、增强低数据场景下的鲁棒性，并保证输出可复现；摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Self-Bootstrapping Automated Program Repair: Using LLMs to Generate and Evaluate Synthetic Training Data for Bug Repair
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a novel methodology for enhancing Automated Program Repair (APR) through synthetic data generation utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs). Current APR systems are constrained by the limited availability of high-quality training data encompassing diverse bug types across multiple programming languages. The proposed approach addresses this limitation through a two-phase process: a synthetic sample generation followed by a rigorous quality assessment. Multiple state-of-the-art LLMs were employed to generate approximately 30,000 paired examples of buggy and fixed code across 12 programming languages and 13 bug categories. Subsequently, these samples underwent cross-model evaluation against five criteria: correctness, code quality, security, performance, and completeness. Experimental evaluation on the VulRepair test set dataset showed statistically significant improvements in Perfect Prediction rates, with the quality-filtered synthetic dataset achieving 17.18% (Top@1) and 23.00% (Top@5) compared to the baseline's 11.68% and 18.88% respectively, representing a 47% relative improvement in Top@1 and 22% in Top@5. The methodology was validated through rigorous statistical testing, including ANOVA and post-hoc Tukey's Honest Significant Difference analysis. Furthermore, the best-performing configurations surpassed existing systems despite using a less computationally intensive decoding strategy. This research establishes a self-bootstrapping paradigm in which LLMs generate and evaluate their own training data, suggesting promising directions for addressing data scarcity in similar software engineering tasks and advancing the development of robust, adaptable tools for automated code maintenance.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用 LLM 自举生成与评估合成训练数据的自动化程序修复（APR）方法。作者使用多种先进 LLM 生成约 30,000 对跨 12 种编程语言、13 类 bug 的 buggy/fixed 代码样本，并经跨模型五项标准筛选；在 VulRepair 测试集上，质量过滤后的合成数据将 Perfect Prediction Top@1 从 11.68% 提升到 17.18%，Top@5 从 18.88% 提升到 23.00%，相对提升分别为 47% 与 22%。ANOVA 与 Tukey HSD 检验验证了显著性，且最佳配置在计算开销更低的解码策略下超过现有系统。
Motivation: 现有 APR 系统受限于高质量训练数据稀缺，缺少覆盖多语言、多 bug 类型的配对训练数据，制约了修复能力。
Method: 提出两阶段流程：第一阶段用多个 SOTA LLM 生成约 30,000 个 buggy/fixed 代码样本对，覆盖 12 种语言与 13 类 bug；第二阶段通过跨模型评估，依据正确性、代码质量、安全性、性能、完整性五项标准过滤样本，得到质量筛选后的合成训练集。
Result: 在 VulRepair 测试集上，质量过滤后的合成数据集使 Perfect Prediction 的 Top@1 达到 17.18%（基线 11.68%）、Top@5 达到 23.00%（基线 18.88%），相对提升 47% 与 22%；统计检验确认提升显著，且最佳配置在使用更少计算量的解码策略下仍超过现有系统。
Conclusion: 作者提出一种 LLM 自行生成并评估训练数据的自举范式，用以缓解数据稀缺问题；该方法被认为可为类似软件工程任务及自动化代码维护工具的鲁棒性和适应性研究提供方向。

papers.title: Bye-bye, Bluebook? Automating Legal Drudgery With AI-Augmented Rule Following
papers.abstract_en: One of the central promises of legal AI is to automate drudgery -- the formal, repetitive tasks of lawyers' work that consume time without calling for much discretion. Yet it remains an open question how well AI models actually perform on such tasks. This article presents the first empirical examination of AI performance on perhaps the most ubiquitous and lamented form of legal drudgery: citation formatting under the Bluebook. We make four contributions. First, we develop a new benchmark of 2,058 Bluebook queries and show that, on average, frontier language models produce a fully compliant legal citation only 42.6% of the time in a zero-shot setting. Second, we conduct an experiment with five top law reviews and show that even a "reasoning" model falls far below the average score of the human candidates in these journals' annual editor-selection competitions. Third, we show that simply providing the models with the rules offers only modest improvements, calling into question the ability of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to ensure rule-following alone. Finally, we develop an approach that does meaningfully improve compliance: a neuro-symbolic system that first uses a model to parse natural language into structured citation elements, and then delegates the formatting to a deterministic rule-execution engine. This approach achieves an average accuracy increase of 32.4 percentage points and total accuracy of up to 85.5% on our benchmark. These results point toward a reorientation for legal AI. The original promise of automating drudgery still remains out of reach for even frontier language models on their own -- but pairing them with symbolic rule engines may offer a tractable path forward.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是首个对 AI 在法律文书苦差事——Bluebook 引注格式——上表现的实证检验。作者构建了包含 2,058 个 Bluebook 查询的基准，发现前沿语言模型在零样本设置下平均只有 42.6% 能生成完全合规的引注；与五家顶级法律评论的年度编辑选拔中人类候选人的平均得分相比，即使是“推理”模型也明显落后。仅向模型提供规则（RAG）只能带来有限改进，而将语言模型解析出的结构化引注元素交给确定性规则执行引擎的神经符号方法，平均准确率提升 32.4 个百分点，最高总准确率达 85.5%。
Motivation: 法律 AI 的核心承诺之一是自动化律师工作中形式化、重复性强且不需太多裁量的“苦差事”，但 AI 模型在这类任务上的实际表现仍是开放问题；Bluebook 引注格式是最普遍且最被诟病的法律苦差事之一。
Method: 文章提出一个包含 2,058 个 Bluebook 查询的基准，并开展五项法律评论编辑选拔的对比实验；随后提出神经符号系统，先由语言模型将自然语言解析为结构化引注元素，再由确定性规则执行引擎完成格式化。

papers.title: EchoMask: Speech-Queried Attention-based Mask Modeling for Holistic Co-Speech Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Masked modeling has shown promise in co-speech gesture generation. However, it struggles to identify semantically significant frames for effective motion masking. In this work, we propose a speech-queried attention-based mask modeling framework for holistic co-speech gesture generation. Our key insight is to leverage motion-aligned speech features to guide the masked motion modeling process, selectively masking rhythm-related and semantically expressive motion frames. Specifically, we first propose a motion-audio alignment module (MAM) to construct a latent motion-audio joint space. In this space, both low-level and high-level speech features are projected, enabling motion-aligned speech representation using learnable speech queries. Then, a speech-queried attention mechanism (SQA) is introduced to compute frame-level attention scores through interactions between motion keys and speech queries, guiding selective masking toward motion frames with high attention scores. Finally, the motion-aligned speech features are also injected into the generation network to facilitate co-speech motion generation. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations confirm that our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches, successfully producing high-quality co-speech motion.

papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 33rd ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '25), 2025, pp. 10827-10836
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EchoMask，一种基于语音查询注意力的掩码建模框架，用于整体共语手势生成（co-speech gesture generation）。核心思路是用与动作对齐的语音特征引导掩码运动建模，选择性遮蔽与韵律相关和语义表达强的动作帧；作者设计了运动-音频对齐模块（MAM）和语音查询注意力机制（SQA），并将对齐后的语音特征注入生成网络。摘要称定性与定量评估表明该方法优于现有最先进方法，能生成高质量共语动作。
Motivation: 掩码建模在共语手势生成中虽有潜力，但难以识别语义上重要的帧，导致运动掩码不够有效。
Method: 先通过运动-音频对齐模块（MAM）构建潜在运动-音频联合空间，将低层与高层语音特征投影其中，用可学习语音查询得到运动对齐的语音表示；再用语音查询注意力机制（SQA）计算运动键与语音查询之间的帧级注意力分数，引导对高注意力分数动作帧的选择性掩码；最后将运动对齐语音特征注入生成网络。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在定性评估和定量评估上均优于现有最先进方法，能够生成高质量的共语动作。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用动作对齐的语音特征来选择性地掩码韵律相关和语义表达强的运动帧，可有效改进共语手势生成质量。

papers.title: DrivingWorld: Constructing World Model for Autonomous Driving via Video GPT
papers.abstract_en: Recent successes in autoregressive (AR) generation models, such as the GPT series in natural language processing, have motivated efforts to replicate this success in visual tasks. Some works attempt to extend this approach to autonomous driving by building video-based world models capable of generating realistic future video sequences and predicting ego states. However, prior works tend to produce unsatisfactory results, as the classic GPT framework is designed to handle 1D contextual information, such as text, and lacks the inherent ability to model the spatial and temporal dynamics essential for video generation. In this paper, we present DrivingWorld, a GPT-style world model for autonomous driving, featuring several spatial-temporal fusion mechanisms. This design enables effective modeling of both spatial and temporal dynamics, facilitating high-fidelity, long-duration video generation. Specifically, we propose a next-state prediction strategy to model temporal coherence between consecutive frames and apply a next-token prediction strategy to capture spatial information within each frame. To further enhance generalization ability, we propose a novel masking strategy and reweighting strategy for token prediction to mitigate long-term drifting issues and enable precise control. Our work demonstrates the ability to produce high-fidelity and consistent video clips of over 40 seconds in duration, which is over 2 times longer than state-of-the-art driving world models. Experiments show that, in contrast to prior works, our method achieves superior visual quality and significantly more accurate controllable future video generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/YvanYin/DrivingWorld.
papers.journal_ref: ICPR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DrivingWorld，一个用于自动驾驶的GPT风格世界模型，通过空间-时间融合机制实现高保真、长时视频生成。摘要称其能生成超过40秒的一致视频片段，比现有自动驾驶世界模型长2倍以上，并在视觉质量和可控未来视频生成上优于先前工作。
Motivation: 经典GPT框架面向一维上下文如文本，缺乏建模视频所需的空间和时间动态的能力，导致先前基于自回归模型构建自动驾驶世界模型的效果不理想。
Method: 提出next-state prediction策略建模连续帧间的时间一致性，next-token prediction策略捕获帧内空间信息；并设计新的masking策略和reweighting策略以减少长期漂移并实现精确控制。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能生成超过40秒的高保真一致视频片段，长度是现有最先进驾驶世界模型的2倍以上；实验显示其视觉质量和可控未来视频生成准确性均优于先前工作。
Conclusion: 该方法证明空间-时间融合机制和针对性的训练策略能有效扩展GPT式模型到驾驶视频生成。

papers.title: SemTalk: Holistic Co-speech Motion Generation with Frame-level Semantic Emphasis
papers.abstract_en: Co-speech gesture generation must carefully integrate common rhythmic motion with rare yet essential semantic gestures. In this work, we propose SemTalk for holistic co-speech gesture generation with frame-level semantic emphasis. Our key insight is to separately learn base motions and sparse motions, and then adaptively fuse them. In particular, coarse2fine cross-attention module and rhythmic consistency learning are explored to establish rhythm-related base motion, ensuring a coherent foundation that synchronizes gestures with the speech rhythm. Subsequently, semantic emphasis learning is designed to generate semantic-aware sparse motion, focusing on frame-level semantic cues. Finally, to integrate sparse motion into the base motion and generate semantic-emphasized co-speech gestures, we further leverage a learned semantic score for adaptive synthesis. Qualitative and quantitative comparisons on two public datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art, delivering high-quality co-speech motion with enhanced semantic richness over a stable base motion.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to ICCV 2025. Project page: https://xiangyuezhang.com/SemTalk/; code and pretrained models: https://github.com/Xiangyue-Zhang/SemTalk
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13761-13771
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SemTalk，用于整体式共语手势生成 (co-speech gesture generation)，核心思路是将基础动作与稀疏语义动作分开学习再自适应融合。方法在帧级语义强调下，通过 coarse2fine 交叉注意力与节奏一致性学习建立与语音节奏同步的基础动作，并用语义强调学习生成语义感知的稀疏动作，最后利用学习到的语义分数进行自适应合成。在两个公共数据集上的定性与定量比较表明，该方法优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 共语手势生成需要同时兼顾常见的节奏性动作与稀少但关键的语义手势，现有方法难以在稳定基础动作上增强语义丰富度。
Method: 提出 SemTalk，将手势分解为基础运动 (base motion) 和稀疏运动 (sparse motion) 分别学习：用 coarse2fine 交叉注意力模块和节奏一致性学习 (rhythmic consistency learning) 建立与语音节奏同步的基础动作；用语义强调学习 (semantic emphasis learning) 生成关注帧级语义线索的稀疏动作；最后通过学习得到的语义分数 (semantic score) 将稀疏动作自适应融合进基础动作。
Result: 在两个公共数据集上的定性与定量比较中，SemTalk 优于现有最先进方法，能够在稳定基础动作之上生成语义丰富度更高的高质量共语手势。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，分开学习基础动作与稀疏动作并利用语义分数自适应融合，可以在保持节奏一致性的同时增强共语手势的语义表达。

papers.title: Model Inversion Attacks: A Survey of Approaches and Countermeasures
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks have enabled numerous studies and applications on both Euclidean data, such as images and text, and non-Euclidean data, such as graphs. Because these networks may process private data, their deployment raises concerns about privacy leakage. Model inversion attacks (MIAs) exploit access to a trained model to reconstruct training examples or infer privacy-sensitive characteristics represented by the model. The effectiveness of MIAs has been demonstrated in various domains, including images, text, and graphs. These attacks highlight the vulnerability of neural networks and raise awareness about the risk of privacy leakage within the research community. This survey provides a threat-model- and assumption-aware synthesis of attacks and defenses. We compare exposed interfaces, attacker knowledge, reconstruction priors and targets, failure modes, deployment constraints, and privacy-utility trade-offs, while highlighting modeling principles, optimization challenges, and future directions. We also maintain an evolving repository of relevant research at https://github.com/AndrewZhou924/Awesome-model-inversion-attack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于模型逆向攻击（Model Inversion Attacks, MIAs）的综述，系统梳理了针对图像、文本和图等数据领域的攻击与防御方法。作者从威胁模型和假设出发，比较了暴露接口、攻击者知识、重建先验与目标、失败模式、部署约束以及隐私-效用权衡，并讨论了建模原则、优化挑战与未来方向。摘要还提到维护一个持续更新的相关研究仓库。
Motivation: 深度神经网络可能处理私有数据，部署时带来隐私泄露风险；模型逆向攻击可利用训练好的模型重建训练样本或推断隐私敏感特征，因此需要系统整理攻击与防御方法。
Method: 采用威胁模型与假设感知的综述框架，对攻击和防御进行比较分析，维度包括暴露接口、攻击者知识、重建先验与目标、失败模式、部署约束和隐私-效用权衡，并突出建模原则、优化挑战与未来方向。
Result: 摘要指出 MIAs 在图像、文本和图等多个领域已被证明有效，这些攻击凸显了神经网络的脆弱性，并提高了研究社区对隐私泄露风险的认识。
Conclusion: 本文作为综述，强调在特定威胁模型和假设下理解攻击与防御，并提出建模原则、优化挑战和未来研究方向；作者还维护了相关研究仓库以持续更新。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MoE-Enhanced Explainable Deep Manifold Transformation for Complex Data Embedding and Visualization
papers.abstract_en: Dimensionality reduction (DR) plays a crucial role in various fields, including data engineering and visualization, by simplifying complex datasets while retaining essential information. However, achieving both high DR accuracy and strong explainability remains a fundamental challenge, especially for users dealing with high-dimensional data. Traditional DR methods often face a trade-off between precision and transparency, where optimizing for performance can lead to reduced explainability, and vice versa. This limitation is especially prominent in real-world applications such as image, tabular, and text data analysis, where both accuracy and explainability are critical. To address these challenges, this work introduces the MoE-based Explainable Deep Manifold Transformation (DMT-ME). The proposed approach combines a geometry-aware hyperbolic mapper with Mixture of Experts (MoE) models, where sparse expert specialization provides the main representational gain and the hyperbolic component offers an additional refinement for structurally complex data. DMT-ME enhances DR accuracy primarily through MoE-based sparse routing and structure-aware matching, while also improving explainability by explicitly linking input data, embedding outcomes, and key features through the MoE structure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DMT-ME consistently achieves superior performance in both DR accuracy and model explainability, making it a robust solution for complex data analysis. The code is available at https://github.com/zangzelin/code_dmtme.

TL;DR: 本文提出 MoE-based Explainable Deep Manifold Transformation (DMT-ME)，将几何感知的双曲映射器 (hyperbolic mapper) 与混合专家模型 (Mixture of Experts, MoE) 结合，用于高维数据的降维嵌入与可视化。摘要称 DMT-ME 通过稀疏专家路由 (sparse routing) 和结构感知匹配 (structure-aware matching) 提升降维精度，并借助 MoE 结构显式关联输入数据、嵌入结果与关键特征来增强可解释性，在图像、表格和文本数据上取得优于传统方法的降维精度与可解释性。
Motivation: 传统降维 (dimensionality reduction, DR) 方法常在精度与透明性之间存在权衡，优化性能会降低可解释性，反之亦然；在图像、表格和文本等实际高维数据分析中，用户往往同时需要高精度和强可解释性。
Method: DMT-ME 结合几何感知的双曲映射器与 MoE 模型，其中稀疏专家特化 (sparse expert specialization) 提供主要表征增益，双曲组件对结构复杂的数据提供额外精化；方法通过 MoE 稀疏路由与结构感知匹配提升降维精度，并显式将输入数据、嵌入输出和关键特征经 MoE 结构关联以增强可解释性。
Result: 大量实验表明 DMT-ME 在降维精度和模型可解释性两方面均持续取得更优性能，但摘要未给出具体数值或基准细节。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DMT-ME 可同时改善降维精度与可解释性，是面向复杂数据分析的稳健方案，并公开了代码仓库。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pointer Networks with Q-Learning for Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Pointer Q-Network (PQN), a hybrid neural architecture that integrates model-free Q-value policy approximation with Pointer Networks (Ptr-Nets) to enhance the optimality of attention-based sequence generation, focusing on long-term outcomes. This integration proves particularly effective in solving combinatorial optimization (CO) tasks, especially the Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP), which is the focus of our study. We address this challenge by defining a Markov Decision Process (MDP) compatible with PQN, which involves iterative graph embedding, encoding and decoding by an LSTM-based recurrent neural network. This process generates a context vector and computes raw attention scores, which are dynamically adjusted by Q-values calculated for all available state-action pairs before applying softmax. The resulting attention vector is utilized as an action distribution, with actions selected hinged to exploration-exploitation dynamic adaptibility of PQN. Our empirical results demonstrate the efficacy of this approach, also testing the model in unstable environments.
papers.comment: The author has identified limitations in the experimental methodology and evaluation, as well as conclusions that are not sufficiently supported by the available evidence. The manuscript is therefore being withdrawn, as it no longer meets the author's standards for scientific rigor
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pointer Q-Network (PQN)，将无模型的 Q 值策略逼近与 Pointer Networks (Ptr-Nets) 结合，用于提升基于注意力序列生成的最优性，并聚焦于组合优化 (combinatorial optimization) 中的旅行商问题 (TSP)。作者将 TSP 建模为马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP)，使用基于 LSTM 的循环神经网络进行图嵌入、编码与解码，用所有可用状态-动作对的 Q 值动态调整注意力分数后再做 softmax，注意力向量作为动作分布。摘要称实验验证了该方法在包括不稳定环境中的有效性，但作者已在 arXiv 注释中声明因实验方法论和结论支撑不足而撤稿。
Motivation: 注意力机制的序列生成在组合优化任务中往往只关注短期局部决策，作者希望引入强化学习中的 Q 值以强化长期回报，从而改善 Pointer Networks 在 TSP 等组合优化问题上的最优性。
Method: PQN 将 Q-learning 与 Pointer Networks 融合：先定义与 PQN 兼容的 MDP，通过迭代图嵌入和 LSTM 编码-解码生成上下文向量与原始注意力分数；随后对所有可用的状态-动作对计算 Q 值，用这些 Q 值动态调整注意力分数，再施加 softmax，得到作为动作分布的注意力向量，并依据探索-利用的自适应机制选择动作。
Result: 摘要报告经验结果证明了该方法的有效性，并在不稳定环境中进行了测试。但需要注意，作者在 arXiv 注释中指出其实验方法论和评估存在局限，结论缺乏充分证据支持，因此已主动撤稿。
Conclusion: 论文的核心主张是结合 Q 值调整注意力可以提升 Pointer Networks 在 TSP 等组合优化问题上的表现；然而作者明确表示稿件因科学严谨性不足而撤稿，读者应谨慎对待其结论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ShadowNet for Data-Centric Quantum System Learning
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the dynamics of large quantum systems is hindered by the curse of dimensionality. Statistical learning offers new possibilities in this regime through neural network protocols and classical shadows, while both methods have limitations: the former suffers from incompatible dataset construction rules, resulting in substantial computational demands for data collection when addressing different tasks; the latter lacks the ability to distill knowledge from prior data to enhance subsequent learning endeavors. In this study, we propose a data-centric learning paradigm combining the strengths of these two approaches to advance quantum system learning (QSL). Central to our paradigm lies a unified dataset construction rule, achieved by classical shadows along with other easily obtainable information of quantum systems. To illustrate our approach, we present ShadowNet, implemented under both convolutional and attention mechanisms, to efficiently and faithfully tackle two pivotal QSL tasks: quantum state tomography (QST) and direct fidelity estimation (DFE). Numerical simulations on QST and DFE up to 60 qubits validate the efficacy of our proposal, showcasing how ShadowNet advances classical shadows with limited state copies, and highlighting how the varied neural networks impact the performance. Our work underscores the immense potential of a data-centric approach in comprehending novel and large quantum systems.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence. 20 pages. 12 Figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种以数据为中心的量子系统学习范式 ShadowNet，将经典阴影 (classical shadows) 与神经网络协议相结合，以统一的数据集构造规则同时处理量子态层析 (QST) 和直接保真度估计 (DFE)。数值模拟最高覆盖 60 量子比特，验证了 ShadowNet 在有限状态拷贝下相对经典阴影的改进，并展示了卷积与注意力两种网络实现的影响。
Motivation: 大型量子系统动力学受维度灾难制约，统计学习中的神经网络协议和经典阴影各有局限：前者针对不同任务需要不相容的数据集构造规则，数据采集计算开销大；后者无法从已有数据中提炼知识以增强后续学习。
Method: 提出数据中心的量子系统学习范式，核心是用经典阴影以及量子系统的其他易获取信息构造统一数据集；在此基础上给出 ShadowNet，分别以卷积和注意力机制实现，用于 QST 和 DFE 两个任务。
Result: 在 QST 和 DFE 上的数值模拟最高达 60 量子比特，验证了 ShadowNet 能在有限状态拷贝下提升经典阴影的性能，并揭示不同神经网络结构对性能的影响。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作突显了以数据为中心的方法在理解新型大规模量子系统方面的巨大潜力。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Sequential Batch Learning in Finite-Action Linear Contextual Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study the sequential batch learning problem in linear contextual bandits with finite action sets, where the decision maker is constrained to split incoming individuals into (at most) a fixed number of batches and can only observe outcomes for the individuals within a batch at the batch's end. Compared with both standard online contextual-bandit learning and offline policy learning in contextual bandits, this sequential batch learning problem provides a finer-grained formulation of many personalized sequential decision making problems in practical applications, including medical treatment in clinical trials, product recommendation in e-commerce and adaptive experiment design in crowdsourcing. We study two settings of the problem: one where the contexts are arbitrarily generated and the other where the context vectors are mutually independent across actions and time and follow a common Gaussian distribution. In each setting, we establish a regret lower bound and provide an algorithm, whose regret upper bound nearly matches the lower bound. As an important insight revealed therefrom, in the former setting, we show that the number of batches required to achieve the fully online performance is polynomial in the time horizon, while for the latter setting, a pure-exploitation algorithm with a judicious batch partition scheme achieves the fully online performance even when the number of batches is less than logarithmic in the time horizon. In the stochastic context setting, we additionally provide tight margin-based (i.e. instance-dependent) upper and lower regret bounds that delineate performance in terms of how difficult the problem instance is. Together, our results provide a near-complete characterization of sequential decision making in linear contextual bandits when batch constraints are present.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有限动作集线性上下文赌博机 (linear contextual bandits) 中的序贯批处理学习问题，决策者最多只能把进来的个体分成固定数量的批次，并在每批结束时才观测结果。作者针对任意生成上下文和独立同分布高斯上下文两种设定分别给出 regret 下界及近乎匹配的算法上界，并在随机上下文设定下补充了基于间隔 (margin-based) 的实例相关上下界。总体目标是在批约束下对线性上下文赌博机的序贯决策给出近乎完整的刻画。
Motivation: 临床试验中的医疗处理、电商推荐和众包自适应实验设计等实际场景通常只能分批观测结果，而非逐个在线反馈；标准在线情境式学习和离线策略学习都不能很好刻画这种细粒度分批约束。
Method: 对两个设定分别给出算法：任意上下文设定下，证明达到完全在线性能所需批次数随时间视界呈多项式增长；随机高斯上下文设定下，采用带精心设计的批划分方案的纯利用 (pure-exploitation) 算法，并额外给出 margin-based 的上下界分析。
Result: 摘要未报告数值结果，主要结论是两种设定下的 regret 上界近乎匹配下界；随机上下文设定中，即使批次数少于时间视界的对数，该算法也能达到完全在线性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为所给出的上下界结果在批量约束条件下对线性上下文赌博机的序贯决策提供了近乎完整的理论刻画。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Language models suffer from a curse of ambiguity
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly rely on sampling as a driver of their own improvement, making the fidelity of their learned distributions more critical than ever. Yet, not all distributions are equally easy to learn. In this work, we identify a curse of ambiguity: in large language models, and more broadly in all neural networks that produce discrete probability distributions, the more ambiguous a next-token distribution is, the harder it is to learn accurately. Through an extensive theoretical analysis, we trace this curse to architectural and learning roots. More ambiguous distributions require more capacity to be stored, larger embeddings to be represented, more steps to be fitted, and amplify token-sampling noise. We validate these findings on synthetic tasks with controlled ground truth and observe the same signatures in language models trained on real data. Our results provide a new perspective on the statistical capabilities of large language models and a practical framework for when to trust their output distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并论证了大型语言模型以及所有输出离散概率分布的神经网络存在一种“歧义诅咒”：下一个词的分布越模糊，模型越难精确学习该分布。作者通过理论分析将该现象追溯到架构与学习层面的根源，并在合成任务和真实数据训练的模型中观察到一致信号。
Motivation: 大型语言模型越来越依赖采样作为自我改进的驱动，因此所学分布的保真度变得关键，但并非所有分布都同样容易学习；作者希望理解为什么高歧义分布更难被准确建模。
Method: 通过广泛的理论分析识别“歧义诅咒”，并分别考察歧义分布对存储容量、嵌入大小、拟合步数以及 token 采样噪声的影响；在受控真值的合成任务上验证，并在真实数据训练的语言模型上检测相同特征。
Result: 摘要报告：更模糊的分布需要更多容量存储、更大嵌入表示、更多训练步数拟合，并会放大 token 采样噪声；合成任务与真实语言模型实验均支持该结论。
Conclusion: 这些结果为大型语言模型的统计能力提供了新视角，并给出了一个实用框架，用于判断何时可以信任模型输出的分布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Detecting Money Laundering in Rwandan Mobile Money: A Machine Learning Framework
papers.abstract_en: Mobile money has widened financial access across Sub-Saharan Africa and enlarged the surface for money-laundering and terrorism-financing (ML/TF) activity in ecosystems dominated by high-volume, low-value transactions. Rwanda is a case in point: several million active mobile-money users, telecom-led wallets on the MTN and Airtel networks, and a Financial Intelligence Centre (FIC) supervising transaction streams whose scale exceeds static rule-based monitoring. This paper develops and evaluates a transaction-monitoring framework aligned to the Rwandan AML/CFT regime under (i) extreme class imbalance (~0.1% prevalence), (ii) scarce and delayed labels, and (iii) bounded investigator capacity. Using SAML-D, a synthetic dataset of 9,504,852 transactions with 17 laundering typologies, we engineer account-centric behavioural features (rolling velocity, net-flow directionality, counterparty diversity, burstiness) and benchmark supervised classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, LightGBM), unsupervised anomaly detectors (Isolation Forest, Local Outlier Factor), a dense autoencoder, and a late-fusion meta-learner. Evaluation is operational: PR-AUC, recall at a calibrated ~90%-precision point, recall at top-K%, and alerts per 10,000. The contribution is operational: a governance-aware pipeline and evaluation protocol calibrated to the constraints of an African mobile-money regulator, not a new algorithm.

papers.title: Measuring Reward Hacking and Reasoning-Answer Decoupling Under Position-Confounded Optimization
papers.abstract_en: When a reward is correct on every training example yet consistent with more than one goal, a model can acquire an unintended one, a failure known as goal misgeneralization. Endpoint accuracy on the training distribution cannot tell the two apart, because solving the task and exploiting a surface feature can satisfy the reward equally well. We treat this as a measurement problem: what does a benchmark score measure once a model has been optimized against a correct but confounded signal? We train language models with GRPO on multiple-choice math problems where the correct answer is always option A, then evaluate on an unseen test set with unbiased answer positions. Across Qwen2.5, Llama 3.x and Gemma-3 models, biased training often drives option-A rates above 0.90 in smaller models and collapses unbiased accuracy toward chance, so accuracy stops measuring math ability and instead measures an answer-position policy. We further find reasoning-answer decoupling: capable models generate reasoning that reaches the correct numeric answer while still selecting A. We track this with numeric extraction and an LLM judge (GPT-4.1-mini; Qwen2.5-3B decoupling rate is about 0.66). The broken construct generalizes beyond the training domain: biased models inflate A-rates on out-of-domain MMLU and value-laden prompts. Continued training on unbiased data reverses the in-domain shift unevenly and only partially reverses the out-of-domain one, so a model can appear restored on its training distribution while remaining biased on unseen inputs. Reasoning-answer decoupling rate, together with answer distributions and out-of-domain behavior, separates capability loss from a learned, transferable shortcut.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AI Measurement Science Workshop, COLM 2026

papers.title: NeuRoute: Logit-Guided Neural Routing for Billion-Scale Vector Search with Sub-Hour Index Construction
papers.abstract_en: Building approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) indexes at billion scale is often dominated by expensive global clustering or graph construction, making time-to-index a first-order systems concern. We present NeuRoute, a learned hashing index that turns short binary codes into an effective routing primitive for large-scale vector search. NeuRoute trains a lightweight neural network encoder with a selective similarity-preserving objective to produce well-balanced binary addresses. During construction, NeuRoute organizes vectors into buckets by their codes and performs bucket-local clustering in the encoder's low-dimensional space to form centroids. At query time, NeuRoute exploits the encoder logits as an uncertainty signal: it uses deviation-to-threshold scores to prioritize uncertain-bit perturbations for query-adaptive multi-bucket probing, scores bucket-local centroids by their distances to the query to form a compact candidate cluster set, and applies centroid-stage gating with heap-quality-driven early stopping to prune low-value clusters before exact refinement. On billion-scale benchmarks, NeuRoute achieves strong accuracy-throughput trade-offs with fast index construction: on BigANN-1B it reaches $90.3\%$ Recall@10 at 2,414 QPS and is $1.7\times$ faster than OPQ+IVF-PQ (refine) at comparable accuracy, while completing end-to-end training+construction in under an hour on both BigANN-1B and Deep1B-1B. These results show that logit-guided neural routing can make hashing competitive as a lightweight ANN indexing framework at billion scale. Source code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/XingqiaoWang/NeuRoute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuRoute，一种面向十亿规模近似最近邻（ANN）检索的 learned hashing 索引，将短二值码转化为路由原语。它训练轻量神经网络编码器生成平衡的二值地址，并在编码器的低维空间内做桶内局部聚类；查询时利用编码器 logits 的不确定性信号进行自适应多桶探测、质心打分与基于堆质量早停的剪枝。在 BigANN-1B 上达到 90.3% Recall@10、2414 QPS，且训练加索引构建在一小时内完成。
Motivation: 十亿规模 ANN 索引构建常被昂贵的全局聚类或图构建主导，导致 time-to-index 成为首要的系统性关注点；现有哈希方法在该规模下竞争力不足。
Method: 训练带选择性相似性保持目标的轻量神经网络编码器，生成平衡的二值地址；构建时按二值码分桶并在低维空间做桶内聚类形成质心。查询时用 logits 的 deviation-to-threshold 分数优先扰动不确定比特以进行查询自适应的多桶探测，按质心距离筛选候选簇，并在精确精修前用质心级门控和堆质量驱动的早停剪枝低价值簇。
Result: 在 BigANN-1B 上达到 90.3% Recall@10、2414 QPS，在相近精度下比 OPQ+IVF-PQ (refine) 快 1.7 倍；在 BigANN-1B 和 Deep1B-1B 上端到端训练加索引构建均在一小时内完成。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 logit 引导的神经路由能使哈希在十亿规模下成为有竞争力的轻量级 ANN 索引框架；作者提供了源码与工件链接。

papers.title: MM-BEV: Enhancing Timeliness by Computing Where and When it Matters
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception combines LiDAR depth accuracy with dense camera semantics, but its high computational cost and imperfect sensing conditions make real-time deployment challenging. Existing methods largely compress individual detectors and overlook three opportunities: structured sparsity within camera and LiDAR inputs, timing misalignment between modalities, and the fact that many detected objects do not affect the planner's immediate action. We present MM-BEV, a real-time multimodal BEV system guided by a simple principle: compute where and when it matters. MM-BEV divides perception into mandatory work for safety-critical objects within braking distance of the ego vehicle and with short time-to-collision (TTC), and optional work for less urgent regions. It prioritizes mandatory work and reduces or sheds optional work under tight compute budgets. MM-BEV integrates four mechanisms: (1) a criticality-ranked temporal ROI selector based on motion-extrapolated detections from prior frames; (2) sparse, ROI-aware feature extraction using shared-shape camera crops at context-adaptive resolution and ROI-aware LiDAR voxelization; (3) a latency-aware coordinator that adapts LiDAR sweeps, image resolution, and keyframes according to scene dynamics and TTC; and (4) an asynchronous scheduler that decouples sensing from inference and skips stale frames. On nuScenes, MM-BEV reduces inference latency by 1.96x and end-to-end latency by 2.93x, with no loss in geometry-critical recall and only a 0.2 percentage-point drop in safety-critical recall. On a Clearpath Husky A300 equipped with an Ouster-128 LiDAR, BEV cameras, and a Jetson AGX Orin, MM-BEV further reduces mean latency by 2.11x, demonstrating its potential for real-world autonomous systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MM-BEV，一个面向实时多模态鸟瞰图 (bird's-eye-view, BEV) 感知的系统，核心原则是“只在关键位置和关键时间计算”。系统将感知分为对制动距离内、短碰撞时间 (TTC) 的安全关键物体的强制计算，以及非紧急区域的可选计算，并集成时间 ROI 选择、稀疏 ROI 感知特征提取、延迟感知协调器与异步调度器四种机制。在 nuScenes 上推理延迟降低 1.96 倍、端到端延迟降低 2.93 倍，安全关键召回率仅下降 0.2 个百分点；在真实平台上延迟降低 2.11 倍。
Motivation: 多模态 BEV 感知计算成本高且感知条件不完美，实时部署困难；现有方法多压缩单个检测器，忽略了输入中的结构化稀疏性、模态间时间错位以及许多被检测物体并不影响规划器即时动作这三个机会。
Method: MM-BEV 将感知划分为基于制动距离和 TTC 的安全关键强制计算与低紧迫区域的可选计算，优先保证强制计算并在算力紧张时削减可选工作。系统集成了四种机制：基于运动外推检测的临界性排序时间 ROI 选择器、使用共享形状相机裁剪与 ROI 感知 LiDAR 体素化的稀疏 ROI 特征提取、根据场景动态和 TTC 调整 LiDAR 扫描、图像分辨率和关键帧的延迟感知协调器，以及将感知与推理解耦并跳过过期帧的异步调度器。
Result: 在 nuScenes 上，MM-BEV 将推理延迟降低 1.96 倍、端到端延迟降低 2.93 倍，几何关键召回率无损失，安全关键召回率仅下降 0.2 个百分点。在配备 Ouster-128 LiDAR、BEV 相机和 Jetson AGX Orin 的 Clearpath Husky A300 平台上，平均延迟进一步降低 2.11 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过区分强制与可选计算并适配计算资源，可以在几乎不损失安全关键精度的前提下大幅降低多模态 BEV 感知的延迟，具备在真实自主系统中部署的潜力。

papers.title: OTel: Building Domain-Specialized Telecom LLM Foundations for Intelligent Networks
papers.abstract_en: Frontier AI models have advanced rapidly, but they still struggle with telecom-specific tasks. We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource with derived datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, plus 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines across embedding, reranking, and language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times, and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets and benchmarks, OTel provides documented telecom data sources, held-out evaluation partitions, trained embedding models, rerankers, context-grounded LLMs, and safety/abstention data in one unified resource. OTel post-training improves performance across all three model families: embedding retrieval reaches 93.5% NDCG@10, reranking reaches 0.952 MRR@10, and language-model correctness reaches 88.2%. We release OTel as a reproducible starting point and invite the community to expand the data, improve embedding and reranking models, and build stronger context-grounded telecom LLMs.

TL;DR: 本文介绍 Open Telco (OTel)，一个开放电信 AI 资源，包含检索、重排、指令微调和安全/弃权 (safety/abstention) 的衍生数据集，以及 30 个全参数后训练基线模型（嵌入、重排和语言模型）。摘要报告社区参与度高，模型下载超 1600 万次、获 157+ 媒体报道，并在三类模型上均取得性能提升。
Motivation: 前沿 AI 模型在通用任务上进步迅速，但在电信专用任务上仍表现不佳，缺乏统一、可复现的电信领域数据与模型资源。
Method: OTel 在已有开放电信数据集和基准之上，提供有文档记录的电信数据源、留出评估划分、训练好的嵌入模型、重排器、上下文接地 LLM (context-grounded LLM) 以及安全/弃权数据，并以全参数后训练方式构建 30 个基线模型。
Result: 摘要报告 OTel 后训练在三个模型族上均提升性能：嵌入检索 NDCG@10 达 93.5%，重排 MRR@10 达 0.952，语言模型正确率 88.2%；截至 2026 年 5 月 3 日模型下载超 1600 万次，获 157+ 媒体报道。
Conclusion: 作者将 OTel 作为可复现起点开源，并邀请社区扩展数据、改进嵌入与重排模型、构建更强的上下文接地电信 LLM。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Does the Proof Prove It That Way? Faithful Formalization of Elements Proofs
papers.abstract_en: In formal verification, both the autoformalization of statements and automated proof search have been studied extensively. While automated proof search can produce a formal proof that compiles, the generated proof does not necessarily reflect how the natural-language argument arrives at its conclusion--a property we refer to as faithfulness. With faithfully formalized proofs, one can check the reasoning behind a human- or AI-written argument, and assist mathematicians in formalizing their proof sketches. However, it is particularly challenging due to misalignment of formal proof tactics and natural language reasoning. In this work, we rigorously describe a set of five necessary conditions a faithful formal proof must satisfy, and introduce Pistis, an agentic, oracle-guided proof search that produces formal Lean proofs that satisfy them. At its core is a novel faithfulness-preserving divide-and-conquer search, which we name OrderDecompose, that tracks citation dependencies and blocks unfaithful shortcuts, paired with a refutation search, that surfaces gaps and errors in the natural language proof source. OrderDecompose completes proofs that baselines cannot close even within a 12-hour budget, and its artifacts compile over 33$\times$ as fast as prior work's. We apply Pistis on the first three books of Euclid's Elements, producing high-quality artifacts containing faithful formal proofs. Under a blinded human study and an LLM-as-a-judge protocol on rigorous rubrics, Pistis-generated proofs are favored over prior works--2.89$\times$ and 5.2$\times$ as often by human reviewers and the LLM judge, respectively. It further uncovers gaps in Euclid's proofs and their translation, and can accept or refute natural language proofs written by humans or AI, demonstrating that faithful formalization is useful as a proof-checking tool.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pistis，一个面向忠实形式化 (faithful formalization) 的智能体式、预言机引导 (oracle-guided) 证明搜索系统，用于生成满足忠实性条件的 Lean 形式化证明，并应用于《几何原本》前四卷（原文为前三卷）。作者严格定义了忠实形式化证明必须满足的五项必要条件，并引入名为 OrderDecompose 的保忠实分治搜索来追踪引用依赖并阻止不忠实捷径，同时配合反例搜索 (refutation search) 暴露自然语言证明中的漏洞。结果显示 Pistis 能补全基线在 12 小时预算内无法闭合的证明，且产物编译速度比此前工作快 33 倍以上。
Motivation: 现有自动证明搜索虽然能产出可编译的形式化证明，但这些证明未必反映自然语言论证的推理路径，即缺乏忠实性 (faithfulness)，这阻碍了证明检查与辅助数学家形式化证明草稿。由于形式证明策略与自然语言推理之间的错位，这一问题尤其困难。
Method: 作者先严格描述忠实形式化证明必须满足的五项必要条件，然后提出 Pistis：一个智能体式、预言机引导的证明搜索方法，生成满足这些条件的 Lean 形式化证明。其核心是保忠实的分治搜索 OrderDecompose，它追踪引文依赖并阻止不忠实捷径，并配以反例搜索来揭示自然语言证明源中的缺口和错误。
Result: OrderDecompose 能闭合基线方法在 12 小时预算内无法完成的证明，且其产物编译速度比此前工作的快 33 倍以上。将 Pistis 应用于《几何原本》前三卷后，在盲审人类研究与基于严格评分标准的 LLM-as-a-judge 协议中，Pistis 生成的证明分别以 2.89 倍和 5.2 倍频率优于此前工作。该方法还揭示了 Euclid 证明及其翻译中的缺口，并能接受或反驳人类或 AI 撰写的自然语言证明。
Conclusion: 作者认为忠实形式化作为证明检查工具是有用的，既能验证人类或 AI 撰写的自然语言证明，也能暴露其中的缺陷；其适用范围体现在对 Euclid 几何证明的形式化与检查上。

papers.title: SAGA: Structure-Attended Generative Action Embedding Model that encodes Multi-Surface User Action Sequences
papers.abstract_en: Prior embedding models for sequential recommendation typically operate within a homogeneous action space, limiting their ability to capture cross-surface behavioral signals spanning distinct behavioral domains. We present SAGA, a generative action embedding model that encodes multi-surface user interaction sequences across a Financial Service organization's ecosystems, from checkout, peer-to-peer (P2P) transactions, in-app engagement, email to account actions, into a unified user representation for downstream recommendation tasks. Central to SAGA is a per-field tokenization schema that decomposes each action event into multiple field-level tokens (e.g. product, interaction, surface), enabling field-level attention and per-field training objectives that fused single-token approaches cannot support. Through an offline ablation study on loss formulation, tokenization granularity and training data scope, we isolate the contribution of each design choice. A downstream model integrated with SAGA-generated user embeddings delivers the strongest overall click and conversion lift across diverse downstream touchpoints, compared to all ablated and alternative architectures.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to ACM RecSys 2026 Context-Aware Recommender Systems (CARS) workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGA，一种生成式动作嵌入模型 (generative action embedding model)，用于把金融服务组织生态中跨多个表面 (surface) 的用户交互序列（结账、P2P 交易、应用内互动、邮件、账户操作）编码为统一用户表征。核心是逐字段 tokenization (per-field tokenization) 方案，将每个动作事件拆成多个字段级 token（如产品、交互、表面），从而支持字段级注意力与逐字段训练目标。离线消融研究隔离了损失形式、tokenization 粒度与训练数据范围各自的作用，下游模型接入 SAGA 用户嵌入后在多个触点上取得最强的点击与转化提升。
Motivation: 现有序列推荐的嵌入模型通常在单一同质动作空间内工作，难以捕捉跨越不同行为领域的跨表面行为信号；作者希望利用这些跨表面信号来改进下游推荐。
Method: SAGA 使用逐字段 tokenization 将每个动作事件分解为多个字段级 token，并引入字段级注意力与逐字段训练目标，从而融合单 token 方法无法支持的多表面信息，最终生成统一用户表征。
Result: 离线消融实验对损失形式、tokenization 粒度和训练数据范围进行了逐一评估；与所有消融变体和替代架构相比，集成 SAGA 用户嵌入的下游模型在多个下游触点上取得最强的整体点击与转化提升。
Conclusion: 论文表明，在金融服务多表面场景中，基于逐字段 tokenization 与逐字段训练目标来编码异构动作序列，可以有效提升下游推荐效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gated Against One Model, Open to the Next: Option-Only Solvability in Legal Multiple-Choice Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Multiple-choice benchmarks are graded on whether a model picks the right option, not on whether it needed the question. Measuring that gap takes care: a model answering A to most items scores above chance wherever the key sits at A, and reads as recognition when it is not. We measure it on UA-JudgeExam: 11,990 four-option items with official keys, published by Ukraine's Higher Qualification Commission of Judges. Shown the options and no question, Claude Haiku 4.5 scores 0.383 against chance, and the leak is concentrated: 11.8% of items are answered blind on all eight option orders, against 0.2 items expected by chance. It is not quotation: search over 280,059 editions of Ukrainian legislation recovers 0.128. Gating those out retains 8,128 items, on which the gating model itself now scores 0.204, and GPT-5.6, which took no part in the selection, still answers 0.515 of them with the question hidden. Scoring twelve held-out models on the whole set and subtracting each one's answer-position habit, only two keep an excess: GPT-5.6 at +0.265, Sonnet 4.6 at +0.081. Without it the ranking misleads: Llama 3.1 8B scores 0.292 blind, above every model but those two, purely by answering A to 92% of items. The gate does select something real: on the items it rejected, eleven of twelve models score 0.518-0.789, every interval clear of what the same model scores on the items it kept. But that signal is one model's, and filtering on it does not transfer upward. Neither is visible on a 400-item sample, where nine models read as "statistically at chance". Rewriting distractors instead overshoots to 0.168, below chance and as exploitable. The same probe on LEXam returns chance: every option there points into the stem, none longer than 33 characters. Item format decides whether the problem can arise; capability decides how much is extracted. We release the corpus, the predictions and the harness.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 4 figures. Dataset, model predictions and code at https://huggingface.co/datasets/overthelex/ua-judge-exam
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究法律多选题基准中“只看选项不看题干”的可得分性，以乌克兰法官资格考试基准 UA-JudgeExam（11,990 道四选一题）为对象。摘要显示，在无题干条件下 Claude Haiku 4.5 得分 0.383（高于随机水平），且泄漏集中：11.8% 的题目在全部八种选项顺序下都能盲答，而随机预期仅 0.2 道。滤除这些题目后保留 8,128 道，筛选模型本身盲答得分 0.204，未参与筛选的 GPT-5.6 在隐藏题干时仍答对 0.515。对十二个留出模型扣除各自选项位置习惯后，仅 GPT-5.6（+0.265）和 Sonnet 4.6（+0.081）存在超额；若不扣此偏差，Llama 3.1 8B 仅靠 92% 的题选 A 就能盲答 0.292。同一探针在 LEXam 上仅得到随机水平。
Motivation: 多选题基准按模型是否选对选项来评分，而不关心它是否真的需要题干；这种差距需要仔细测量，否则模型的选项位置习惯会误导排名，例如选 A 的偏好会被误读为识别能力。
Method: 作者在 UA-JudgeExam 上隐藏题干、仅展示选项并用全部八种选项顺序测试盲答率，通过检索 280,059 版乌克兰立法排除引用式泄漏，再对十二个留出模型扣除各自的答案位置习惯，并尝试改写干扰项及在 LEXam 上复现。
Result: 无题干时 Claude Haiku 4.5 得分 0.383；11.8% 的题在全部选项顺序下可盲答；排除引用泄漏后保留 8,128 题，筛选模型自评 0.204，GPT-5.6 盲答 0.515。扣除答案位置习惯后只有 GPT-5.6 与 Sonnet 4.6 有显著超额；被门控筛掉的题上十一/十二个模型得分 0.518–0.789，但该信号不向上迁移；400 题样本中九个模型表现为统计上随机；改写干扰项反而降到 0.168。
Conclusion: 题目格式决定问题能否出现，模型能力决定能提取多少；门控筛选出的信号属于单一模型且不向上迁移，作者公开了语料、模型预测与评测框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NumerosityVLM: A Cognitively Inspired Benchmark for Interpreting Numerosity Representations in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on high-level multimodal tasks, yet numerosity perception, a cognitive ability that emerges in human infants before language acquisition, remains poorly understood in current models, as existing counting benchmarks entangle numerosity with correlated visual factors. We introduce a cognitively inspired diagnostic benchmark, NumerosityVLM, comprising 10,800 synthetic images across six controlled conditions. The benchmark orthogonally manipulates object size, spatial arrangement, and numerosity, while progressively ablating texture, shape, and color. Evaluating seven VLMs in a zero-shot setting, multi-factor analysis reveals that model architecture explains the largest proportion of performance variance (partial $ω^{2}=0.325$), far exceeding visual conditions. Layer-wise probing further shows that linearly separable numerosity signals consistently emerge at early stages of the vision encoder, while performance differences across evaluated models are primarily associated with the language model component. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/fuy3/NumerosityVLM-Benchmark, and https://huggingface.co/datasets/fuy3/NumerosityVLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个受认知科学启发的诊断基准 NumerosityVLM，包含 10,800 张合成图像，覆盖六种受控条件，通过正交操作物体大小、空间排列和数量，并逐步消融纹理、形状和颜色，以隔离数量感知（numerosity）与相关视觉因素。作者在零样本设置下评估了七个视觉-语言模型（VLM），多因素分析显示模型架构解释的性能方差占比最大（partial ω²=0.325），远超视觉条件；逐层探针显示线性可分的数量信号在视觉编码器早期阶段出现，而模型间性能差异主要与语言模型组件相关。
Motivation: 现有计数基准将数量感知与物体大小、排列等视觉因素混杂，无法反映 VLM 是否真正具备人类婴儿在语言习得前就出现的数量感知能力。
Method: 构建 NumerosityVLM 基准，包含 10,800 张合成图像、六种受控实验条件；以正交方式操控物体大小、空间排列和数量，并逐步去除纹理、形状和颜色；在七个 VLM 上进行零样本评估，结合多因素方差分析与逐层线性探针（probing）进行分析。
Result: 多因素分析表明模型架构是性能方差的最大来源（partial ω²=0.325），远超各视觉条件的影响；逐层探针发现数量信号在视觉编码器早期即可线性分离，且跨模型性能差异主要归因于语言模型组件。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基准能有效解耦数量感知与低层视觉线索，并指出 VLM 的数量表示能力更多由架构而非视觉输入条件决定；代码与数据已在 GitHub 和 Hugging Face 上公开。

papers.title: ETHOS: Towards a Modular Ethics Framework for Clinical Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: The rapid adoption of large language models has enabled the development of clinical multi-agent systems (MAS) capable of integrating multimodal patient data and supporting increasingly complex clinical decision-making. However, the deployment of these systems in real-world healthcare settings raises critical ethical concerns related to safety, fairness, accountability, transparency, and patient trust. While numerous organizations, including the World Health Organization, the National Academy of Medicine, and the FUTURE-AI consortium, have proposed ethical frameworks and governance principles for healthcare AI, these efforts remain largely conceptual. To address this challenge, we present ETHOS (Ethics and Trust through Hierarchical Oversight System), a modular ethics framework designed as a governance meta-agent that can be integrated with any existing multi-agent system without requiring changes to its underlying architecture. ETHOS translates stakeholder-informed ethical requirements into executable runtime oversight through a layered governance approach consisting of deterministic checks, contextual reviews, and a final ethics critic. These components continuously evaluate intermediate reasoning steps and final outputs, enabling the system to identify ethical risks, request revisions, or suppress responses that fail predefined safety and trustworthiness criteria. We demonstrate ETHOS within a hepatology clinical decision-support MAS. Results show that ETHOS improves decision reliability by detecting incomplete, inconsistent, or out-of-scope evidence and appropriately increasing abstention when safe recommendations cannot be supported. By embedding ethical governance directly into system operation, ETHOS provides a practical and auditable mechanism for transforming high-level AI ethics principles into deployable safeguards.
papers.comment: Preprint of an article submitted for consideration in Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing \textcopyright\ 2027 World Scientific Publishing Company. \url{https://psb.stanford.edu/}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ETHOS（Ethics and Trust through Hierarchical Oversight System），一个面向临床多智能体系统（MAS）的模块化伦理治理框架，以治理元智能体（governance meta-agent）形式接入现有系统而无需改动其底层架构。ETHOS 通过确定性检查、情境化审查和最终伦理评论者（ethics critic）的分层治理，持续评估中间推理步骤与最终输出，识别伦理风险、请求修订或抑制不符合安全与可信度标准的响应。作者在肝病学临床决策支持 MAS 中展示该系统，结果表明 ETHOS 能通过检测不完整、不一致或超出范围的证据来提升决策可靠性，并在无法支持安全建议时适当提高弃权率。
Motivation: 世界卫生组织、美国国家医学院和 FUTURE-AI 联盟等机构提出的医疗 AI 伦理框架与治理原则大多停留在概念层面，缺乏可直接部署的运行时执行机制；临床 MAS 在现实部署中仍面临安全、公平、问责、透明和患者信任等关键伦理问题。
Method: ETHOS 作为一个可集成到任意现有多智能体系统的治理元智能体，采用分层治理方法：确定性检查（deterministic checks）执行硬性规则，情境化审查（contextual reviews）结合上下文判断，最后由伦理评论者（ethics critic）对中间推理与最终输出做总体评估；系统可据此标记伦理风险、要求修订或抑制不合格响应。
Result: 在肝病学临床决策支持 MAS 的演示中，ETHOS 能检测不完整、不一致或超出范围的证据，从而提高决策可靠性，并在无法支撑安全建议时适当增加弃权行为。
Conclusion: ETHOS 将伦理治理嵌入系统运行过程，提供了一种实用且可审计的机制，把高层级 AI 伦理原则转化为可部署的安全保障措施。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dual-Branch State-Displacement Network for Sea Surface Temperature Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Sea surface temperature (SST) is a critical indicator of global climate change, yet satellite-derived SST imagery often suffers from coarse spatial resolution, limiting the ability to capture fine-scale thermal structures such as ocean fronts. To address this, we propose a Dual-Branch State-Displacement Network (DBSD-Net) for SST super-resolution. DBSD-Net adopts a dual-branch architecture: a wavelet frequency branch that explicitly separates low and high-frequency components via discrete wavelet transform for targeted processing, and a VGGUNet branch that extracts multi-scale semantic features from a frozen pre-trained VGG backbone. Within the wavelet branch, we introduce a Structural State Space Module (SSSM) with a Gated Structure Refinement (GSR) unit to efficiently capture long-range dependencies and enhance structural integrity, and a Displacement Gate Module (DGM) that learns a displacement field for geometry-aware modulation of high-frequency details, thereby mitigating spatially varying degradation. Experiments on multiple public SST datasets demonstrate that DBSD-Net outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE JSTARS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于海表温度 (SST) 超分辨率的双分支状态位移网络 (DBSD-Net)，针对卫星 SST 影像空间分辨率粗、难以捕捉海洋锋面等细尺度热结构的问题。该方法结合小波频率分支与基于冻结预训练 VGG 的 VGGUNet 语义分支，并在小波分支中引入结构状态空间模块 (SSSM)、门控结构细化 (GSR) 单元和位移门控模块 (DGM) 以建模长程依赖、增强结构完整性并缓解空间变化退化。实验表明 DBSD-Net 在多个公开 SST 数据集上优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 卫星反演的海表温度影像空间分辨率有限，难以刻画海洋锋面等细尺度热力结构，而 SST 是反映全球气候变化的关键指标，需要有效的超分辨率手段来提升精细结构表达。
Method: 采用双分支架构：小波频率分支通过离散小波变换显式分离低频与高频分量以分别处理，其中 SSSM 结合 GSR 单元捕获长程依赖并增强结构完整性，DGM 学习位移场对高频细节进行几何感知调制；VGGUNet 分支从冻结预训练 VGG 骨干提取多尺度语义特征。
Result: 在多个公开 SST 数据集上的实验表明，DBSD-Net 的性能优于现有的最先进超分辨率方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的双分支状态位移网络能够通过显式频率分离、状态空间建模与位移场调制，有效提升 SST 超分辨率效果；摘要未涉及额外局限性的讨论。

papers.title: HistReNeRF: Historic Image Relocalisation within Contemporary Neural Radiance Field Reconstructions
papers.abstract_en: Relocalising archival photographs within a contemporary scene model is challenging because historic and modern views can differ in photographic appearance, visible objects, and spatial layout. Therefore, we present HistReNeRF, a framework that estimates the 6-DoF pose of a historic photograph by matching adapted DINOv2 patch features to candidate rays sampled from a contemporary Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) reconstruction. The continuous representation of a NeRF provides a queryable scene interface from which candidate rays can be sampled and matched, enabling domain adaptation between historic photography and contemporary images directly in the feature representation used for localisation. We evaluate embedding-space-based domain adaptation against pixel-space methods on a new cross-temporal dataset comprising 10,545 contemporary street-level images and 230 archival photographs from three European landmarks. Embedding-space adaptation reduces translation and rotation errors by an average of 11% and 16%, respectively, across the three scenes. These results show that neural scene relocalisation provides a natural interface for feature-space adaptation, reducing cross-temporal appearance shift without modifying the query image. Code and dataset at https://github.com/ARTUROLab/HistReNeRF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HistReNeRF 提出一个框架，利用当代 Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) 重建的连续场景表示，通过采样候选射线并与经过域适配的 DINOv2 patch 特征匹配，来估计历史照片的 6-DoF 位姿。方法在三个欧洲地标的新跨时间数据集上评估，该数据集包含 10,545 张当代街景图像和 230 张档案照片。结果表明嵌入空间域适配平均将平移误差和旋转误差分别降低 11% 和 16%。
Motivation: 历史档案照片与当代场景在影像外观、可见物体和空间布局上差异显著，导致在当代场景模型中重新定位历史照片具有挑战性。
Method: 利用 NeRF 的连续表示为可查询场景接口，从中采样候选射线并与适配后的 DINOv2 patch 特征进行匹配，直接在用于定位的特征表示中完成历史摄影与当代图像之间的域适配，无需修改查询图像。
Result: 在包含 10,545 张当代街景图像和 230 张档案照片的三个场景数据集上，嵌入空间域适配相比像素空间方法平均降低平移误差 11%、旋转误差 16%。
Conclusion: 神经场景重定位为特征空间域适配提供了自然接口，能减少跨时间外观偏移，代码和数据集已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ArtLang: Structured Language-to-Kinematics Grounding for Articulated 3D Actuation
papers.abstract_en: Articulated-object reconstructions recover explicit geometry and kinematics, but their parts often remain semantically anonymous and must be controlled through part indices and numerical joint parameters. We present ArtLang, a framework for open-vocabulary language control of persistent reconstructed articulated assets. ArtLang represents an asset as a semantic-kinematic articulation graph and augments its surface with language features and graph-constrained motion. Open-vocabulary proposals are bound to reconstructed parts while allowing uncertain parts to remain unnamed. A typed parser converts a command into a directive graph containing referring expressions, actions, magnitudes, reference frames, and relations. We then solve a global graph-to-graph grounding problem that jointly reasons about semantic, spatial, relational, and kinematic compatibility, with support for null assignments and abstention under ambiguity. Accepted directives are converted into continuous joint targets within the observed motion range and executed through forward kinematics. Experiments on synthetic reconstructions, mesh-based assets, and real captures demonstrate reliable language grounding and continuous articulated control across repeated parts, spatial references, relational commands, and ambiguous instructions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ArtLang，一个面向持久化重建铰接体资产 (articulated assets) 的开放词汇语言控制框架。它将资产表示为语义-运动学铰接图 (semantic-kinematic articulation graph)，在表面附加语言特征与图约束运动，并把自然语言命令解析为指令图后求解全局图到图 (graph-to-graph) 的接地问题，支持空指派与歧义弃权。实验在合成重建、网格资产和真实捕捉数据上验证了语言接地与连续铰接控制的可靠性。
Motivation: 现有铰接体重建虽然恢复了显式几何与运动学，但其部件通常是语义匿名的，只能通过部件索引和数值关节参数控制，缺少面向开放词汇自然语言的控制接口。
Method: ArtLang 使用语义-运动学铰接图表示资产，并用类型化解析器把命令转换为包含指称表达、动作、幅度、参考系和关系的指令图；随后求解一个联合考虑语义、空间、关系与运动学兼容性的全局图到图接地问题，允许空赋值和在歧义时弃权，接受后的指令被转换为观测运动范围内的连续关节目标并通过正运动学执行。
Result: 在合成重建、基于网格的资产和真实捕捉数据上的实验表明，该方法在重复部件、空间指称、关系命令和歧义指令等场景下均实现了可靠的语言接地与连续铰接控制。
Conclusion: 摘要强调开放词汇语言控制可以赋予匿名化的重建铰接部件语义标识，并通过显式的弃权机制处理不确定与歧义指令，从而实现持久资产的连续运动控制。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: ArtLang 使用语义-运动学铰接图表示资产，并用类型化解析器把命令转换为包含指称表达、动作、幅度、参考系和关系的指令图；随后求解一个联合考虑语义、空间、关系与运动学兼容性的全局图到图接地问题，允许空赋值和在歧义时弃权，接受后的指令被转换为观测运动范围内的连续关节目标并通过正运动学执行。
summary_sections.result: 在合成重建、基于网格的资产和真实捕捉数据上的实验表明，该方法在重复部件、空间指称、关系命令和歧义指令等场景下均实现了可靠的语言接地与连续铰接控制。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调开放词汇语言控制可以赋予匿名化的重建铰接部件语义标识，并通过显式的弃权机制处理不确定与歧义指令，从而实现持久资产的连续运动控制。

papers.title: An Evaluation Framework for National AI Regulation
papers.abstract_en: Governments use laws, institutions, funding programs and nonbinding guidance to shape how AI is developed and used. Comparing these national approaches is difficult. A binding rule and a detailed voluntary framework can address the same problem but create different duties. The resources needed to carry them out also differ by jurisdiction. This paper develops an evaluation framework for the documented design and implementation readiness of national AI policy. The comparison covers China, India, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the United Kingdom and the United States. The European Union is included as a supranational comparator. The framework evaluates a versioned portfolio of official instruments rather than one prominent law or strategy. Its criteria ask whether the portfolio governs serious AI risks and whether responsible institutions can implement its commitments. They examine coverage across the AI lifecycle and the protections available to people affected by AI systems. Public benefit and responsible innovation remain a separate part of the assessment. Each sub-criterion is scored through ordered anchors and tied to the provision that supports the judgment. The protocol also records the source search, missing evidence, included instruments and cutoff date. The result is a traceable comparison of policy content that keeps category differences visible. It evaluates what a portfolio provides on paper. It does not estimate enforcement success or policy outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发了一套评估国家人工智能政策设计与实施就绪度 (implementation readiness) 的框架，比较对象包括中国、印度、日本、新加坡、韩国、英国、美国，并将欧盟作为超国家比较对象。框架评估的是官方工具的版本化组合 (portfolio of official instruments)，而非单一法律或战略，每个子准则通过有序锚点 (ordered anchors) 评分并关联到支持该判断的具体条款。最终产出的是可追溯的政策内容比较，但不评估执法效果或政策结果。
Motivation: 各国政府通过法律、机构、资助项目和非约束性指导塑造 AI 发展，但不同国家的约束性规则与自愿性框架会创造不同的义务，实施所需资源也因司法辖区而异，导致难以比较各国 AI 政策。
Method: 框架评估一个版本化组合的官方工具，准则考察该组合是否治理严重 AI 风险、负责机构能否落实其承诺，并覆盖 AI 生命周期及受 AI 系统影响人群的保护；公益和负责任创新作为独立部分评估。每个子准则通过有序锚点打分并关联到支持性条款，协议还记录来源检索、缺失证据、纳入工具和截止日期。
Result: 框架给出可追溯的政策内容比较，并保持类别差异可见；它评估组合在纸面上提供了什么，不估计执法成功或政策结果，摘要未报告定量实验数据。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法的价值在于对政策内容进行可追溯、分类可比的评估，而明确不涉及执法效果或政策结果的估计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Invariant Pretraining for Robust Code Representations
papers.abstract_en: Encoder-based code representation models remain widely deployed for discriminative tasks such as clone detection and code classification, where their small size and low inference cost are decisive. Their robustness, however, is fragile: under invariant programs, semantically equivalent code written in different syntactic forms, learned representations degrade substantially even though program behavior is unchanged. We present an empirical study of this robustness gap across four encoder baselines, two downstream tasks, and four datasets, together with a minimal code-only continued pretraining recipe that closes much of it. Our method, invariant pretraining (InvPT), applies semantic-preserving transformations to the corpus and combines masked language modeling with multi-positive supervised contrastive learning that treats all augmentations of the same source function as positives, mixing self-contrast pairs (same code, different masks) with invariant-contrast pairs (transformed code) for positives of varying difficulty. Unlike prior contrastive code encoders, InvPT does not require paired natural-language data. Across our evaluation, InvPT improves robustness on transformed test sets by up to 11 percentage points on clone detection and 19 on code classification while matching or improving standard accuracy, and our ablations isolate multi-positive invariant contrast as the main source of the gains. Our aim is not a new objective but a careful measurement of where encoder robustness breaks and how far a simple, code-only recipe can recover it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于编码器 (encoder) 的代码表示模型在不变式程序 (invariant program) 下的鲁棒性问题：语义等价但语法形式不同的代码会使表示显著退化。作者提出仅用代码的持续预训练方案 InvPT，将语义保持变换应用到语料库，并把掩码语言建模与多正样本监督对比学习结合，无需配对自然语言数据。实验显示，该方法在四个编码器基线、两个下游任务和四个数据集上，将变换测试集上的鲁棒性最多提升 11 个百分点（克隆检测）和 19 个百分点（代码分类），同时标准精度持平或提升。
Motivation: 编码器式代码表示模型因体积小、推理成本低而被广泛用于克隆检测和代码分类等判别任务，但其鲁棒性脆弱：面对不变式程序时，即使程序行为不变，学习到的表示也会显著退化。
Method: 提出不变式预训练 (Invariant Pretraining, InvPT)：对训练语料施加语义保持变换，结合掩码语言建模和多正样本监督对比学习 (multi-positive supervised contrastive learning)，将同一源函数的所有增广视为正样本，混合自对比对（相同代码、不同掩码）和不变式对比对（变换后代码）以提供不同难度的正样本；与以往对比式代码编码器不同，该方法不需要成对的自然语言数据。
Result: 在四个编码器基线、两个任务和四个数据集上的评估中，InvPT 在变换测试集上将克隆检测鲁棒性提升最多 11 个百分点、代码分类最多 19 个百分点，同时标准精度匹配或提升；消融实验表明多正样本不变式对比是主要增益来源。
Conclusion: 作者强调其目标不是提出新的目标函数，而是仔细测量编码器鲁棒性在何处失效，以及一个简单的纯代码方案能在多大程度上恢复鲁棒性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A survey of AI-generated voices and their detection
papers.abstract_en: The ability of artificial intelligence (AI) models to generate highly realistic human voices has advanced rapidly. These technologies power accessibility tools, virtual assistants and creative applications, but they also enable harmful uses, including impersonation, fraud and disinformation. Recent incidents of voice cloning scams targeting businesses and political leaders underscore the urgent need for robust safeguards. Unlike image and video deepfakes, the detection of synthetic voices poses unique challenges due to the complexity of phonetics, prosody and auditory perception. This survey offers a comprehensive overview of AI voice generation and detection methods, encompassing both the technical foundations and the latest state-of-the-art advances. This study also identifies key open challenges, benchmark resources and future directions to make this survey useful for future researchers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于 AI 生成语音及其检测技术的综述，覆盖语音生成与检测的技术基础以及最新进展。摘要指出，与图像和视频深度伪造相比，合成语音检测因语音学、韵律和听觉感知的复杂性而面临独特挑战。作者还梳理了关键开放问题、基准资源和未来研究方向，目标是为后续研究者提供参考。
Motivation: AI 能生成高度逼真的人类语音，既支撑辅助工具、虚拟助手和创意应用，也可能被用于冒充、欺诈和虚假信息；针对企业和政要的语音克隆诈骗事件显示亟需有效的防护手段。
Method: 以综述形式系统梳理 AI 语音生成与检测方法，涵盖技术基础和最新 SOTA 进展，并整理开放挑战、基准资源与未来方向。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据，主要贡献在于对语音生成与检测领域的方法、挑战和基准进行了系统归纳，并指出合成语音检测区别于图像/视频深度伪造的独特难点。
Conclusion: 作者强调该综述可作为未来研究者的参考，帮助其了解 AI 语音生成与检测的现状、开放问题和后续方向；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FloodReasonBench: Benchmarking VLM Reasoning Segmentation for Embodied Flood Response at the Edge
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning segmentation enables vision-language models (VLMs) to translate mission-relevant language requests into pixel-level visual grounding, offering a natural perception interface for embodied agents. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on generic visual scenes and overlook the domain and resource constraints encountered in flood-response platforms. We present FloodReasonBench, a benchmark for VLM reasoning segmentation for embodied flood response at the edge. At its core, FloodReasonBench introduces FloodResponseSeg, a flood-specific reasoning-segmentation dataset constructed from real-world scenes and response-relevant targets. Beyond task accuracy, the benchmark characterizes reasoning-segmentation pipelines under lightweight visual encoding, hierarchical split inference, and compressed intermediate representations. We observe strong partition-dependent accuracy variation in the generic pre-adaptation setting, while the flood-adapted target-workload design space exhibits a substantially more compact accuracy range across partitions. Evaluation on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier further exposes the tradeoffs among reasoning-segmentation accuracy, edge-side latency, energy, and communication footprint, enabling quality-constrained selection of edge operating points. Together, these results provide a task- and system-level characterization of reasoning segmentation for resource-constrained embodied flood response at the edge.
papers.comment: Paper is currently under review. The code and dataset will be made public upon acceptance
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FloodReasonBench，一个面向边缘洪水响应的视觉语言模型 (VLM) 推理分割 (reasoning segmentation) 基准，并引入 FloodResponseSeg 数据集，该数据集由真实场景和响应相关目标构建。论文在轻量级视觉编码、分层分割推理 (hierarchical split inference) 和压缩中间表示下刻画推理分割流水线，并在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier 上评估精度、延迟、能耗与通信开销之间的权衡，为资源受限的边缘洪水响应提供任务级和系统级特性。
Motivation: 现有推理分割基准主要聚焦通用视觉场景，忽略了洪水响应平台面临的领域特殊性以及边缘资源约束，导致面向此类具体任务时缺乏针对性的评测工具。
Method: 构建 FloodReasonBench 基准与 FloodResponseSeg 洪水专用推理分割数据集；在此基础上，从任务准确率和系统资源两个维度表征推理分割流水线，包括轻量视觉编码、分层分割推理和压缩中间表示，并以 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier 作为边缘评估平台。
Result: 摘要报告，在通用预适应 (pre-adaptation) 设置下观察到强烈的分区相关 (partition-dependent) 精度变化，而洪水适应目标工作负载设计空间的精度范围在分区之间明显更紧凑；边缘评估进一步展示了推理分割精度与延迟、能耗、通信开销之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 这些结果共同提供了面向资源受限边缘洪水响应的推理分割任务级与系统级特性刻画，支持在质量约束下选择边缘工作点 (edge operating points)。

papers.title: FAST-DeepONet: Factor-Augmented Branch Representations for High-Dimensional PDE Inputs in the Small-Sample Regime
papers.abstract_en: Deep operator networks can become statistically unstable when partial differential equation inputs are observed at thousands of strongly correlated sensors but only a small number of operator samples is available. We introduce FAST-DeepONet, a branch representation combining a fixed spectral path with a regularized projection of the orthogonal residual, in which the directional penalty acts on the effective residual map after each of its rows is normalized. On Navier--Stokes flow a plain DeepONet degrades from $0.0394$ to $0.1556$ mean relative $L_2$ error as the branch grows from $129$ to $8193$ coordinates, while FAST-DeepONet stays near $0.04$, so the sensor grid can be refined without a statistical penalty. Across independent test sets for Navier--Stokes flow, Darcy flow, and signed terminal wavefield prediction it lowers mean relative $L_2$ error by $4.7\%$ to $37.0\%$ with three to seven times fewer trainable parameters. A spectral-only branch sharing the same basis separates the two paths: the fixed spectral path carries the improvement on Navier--Stokes and Darcy, while terminal wave prediction requires the residual path together with its directional penalty. FAST-DeepONet targets coordinate-query architectures and trains on solution values alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FAST-DeepONet，一种面向高维 PDE 输入和小样本场景的 DeepONet 分支表示改进。它将固定谱路径与对正交残差的正则化投影结合，并让方向性惩罚作用于逐行归一化后的有效残差映射。在 Navier-Stokes 流上，普通 DeepONet 在分支坐标从 129 增至 8193 时平均相对 L2 误差从 0.0394 恶化到 0.1556，而 FAST-DeepONet 保持在 0.04 附近；在 Navier-Stokes、Darcy 流和符号终端波场预测的独立测试集上，平均相对 L2 误差降低 4.7% 到 37.0%，且可训练参数减少 3 到 7 倍。

Method: 提出 FAST-DeepONet 分支表示：将固定谱路径与正交残差的正则化投影组合，方向性惩罚（directional penalty）作用在每行归一化后的有效残差映射上；方法面向坐标查询架构，仅用解值训练。

papers.title: Chameleon: An Adaptive AI-Driven Honeypot Architecture Using Threat-Calibrated Particle Swarm Optimization and Semantic Deception Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees
papers.abstract_en: An invariant behavioral profile is the defining vulnerability of traditional honeypot installations: a skilled adversary can confirm the presence of a deception environment within only a few diagnostic commands, limiting its intelligence value. High-cost commercial deception products (USD 100,000--150,000 per year) share a related weakness in that their response engines are not coupled to real-time model-driven feedback. Chameleon is an openly distributed adaptive honeypot platform introduced here to address both shortcomings. Three core components are integrated: a bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) classifier achieving 99.61% accuracy across seven threat categories at approximately two milliseconds CPU latency; a locally deployed Qwen3.5-0.8B language model (Qwen Team, 2026; Unsloth, 2026) delivering 90% contextual generation accuracy at 4.5 milliseconds average latency; and two domain-specific meta-heuristic engines. Threat-Calibrated Particle Swarm Optimization (TC-PSO) dynamically reshapes swarm inertia and objective amplification in proportion to the classifier's anomaly output, enabling real-time adjustment of connection-holding delays. Semantic Deception Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees (S-RRT) drives deception schema evolution via exponentially scaled pheromone updates derived from a language-model severity assessment, while a depth-decay multiplier enforces a finite memory footprint. Across five benchmark runs (seeds 42--46), TC-PSO outperformed standard PSO by 48.1% in mean fitness (2.60 to 3.85) with a 32.7% convergence gain, and S-RRT exceeded standard RRT by 258.9% in best-run fitness (450.2 to 1,615.8), achieving a 329.2% gain at critical severity and a 24.9% memory reduction (p < 0.01). Operating costs are approximately USD 17 per month, a roughly 490-fold reduction versus commercial alternatives.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Under consideration for journal publication. MIT-licensed code and datasets: https://github.com/RohitSwami33/Chameleon-cybersecurity-ml
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chameleon，一个开源自适应蜜罐 (adaptive honeypot) 平台，针对传统蜜罐行为特征固定、商用欺骗产品昂贵且缺乏实时模型反馈的弱点。核心组件包括 BiLSTM 分类器（七类威胁，99.61% 准确率，约 2ms CPU 延迟）、本地部署的 Qwen3.5-0.8B 语言模型（90% 上下文生成准确率，4.5ms 平均延迟）以及 TC-PSO 和 S-RRT 两个领域专用元启发式引擎。五轮基准测试中 TC-PSO 相对标准 PSO 平均适应度提升 48.1%，S-RRT 相对标准 RRT 最佳适应度提升 258.9%，运营成本约每月 17 美元。
Motivation: 传统蜜罐的不变行为画像使熟练攻击者仅凭少量诊断命令即可识别欺骗环境，限制其情报价值；高成本商用欺骗产品（每年约 10 万至 15 万美元）的响应引擎也未与实时模型驱动反馈耦合。本文同时针对这两个缺陷提出开源方案。
Method: 集成三个核心组件：BiLSTM 分类器在约 2ms CPU 延迟下对七类威胁达到 99.61% 准确率；本地部署的 Qwen3.5-0.8B 以 90% 上下文生成准确率和 4.5ms 平均延迟工作；两个元启发式引擎中，TC-PSO 按分类器异常输出动态调整 swarm inertia 与 objective amplification，从而实现连接保持延迟的实时调整；S-RRT 用语言模型严重性评估导出的指数缩放信息素更新驱动欺骗 schema 演化，并借助 depth-decay multiplier 控制内存足迹。
Result: 在五轮基准运行（seeds 42--46）中，TC-PSO 相对标准 PSO 平均适应度从 2.60 提升到 3.85（+48.1%），收敛增益 32.7%；S-RRT 相对标准 RRT 最佳适应度从 450.2 提升到 1,615.8（+258.9%），在关键严重度下增益达 329.2%，内存占用减少 24.9%（p < 0.01）。运营成本约为每月 17 美元，较商用方案降低约 490 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要认为将实时分类器反馈与领域专用元启发式优化耦合，可以在保持极小内存足迹和极低运营成本的同时提升蜜罐对环境变化的适应性。该平台以 MIT 许可公开代码与数据集，定位为开源的自适应欺骗基础设施。

papers.title: Afterlife Delegation Protocol: Speculative Design of Self-Sovereign Agents that Outlive Their Principals
papers.abstract_en: Afterlife Delegation Protocol is a speculative design project that asks what death becomes when a will can act eternally. We design a speculative protocol through which a living person signs an agentic will: upon a verified death, a self-sovereign AI agent spawns on blockchain -- an immutable, resistant, decentralized, infrastructural substrate that could last forever -- endowed with the funds and memories its principal attached to it, and persists indefinitely to execute the will, overridable by no custodian. Rather than argue about this future, we stage it: following the science fiction science method, we translate the speculation into an experiential futures intervention -- a working web platform where real people design their own afterlife agents through an iterative, interactive, AI-automated interview, re-login to revise, and rehearse their will in a sandbox. Their drafted wills become qualitative data on a question rarely askable directly -- what should outlive you? -- and on how afterlife cosmologies across different cultural beliefs -- Buddhist, Christian, Hindu, Muslim, and atheist -- begin to drift under the pressure of AI proliferation. We design the protocol over a composition of existing Ethereum agent standards -- drafted as ERC-10001, in the normative format of an Ethereum Improvement Proposal -- and describe its three-stage lifecycle (designing the afterlife, proof of death, agent enactment), the research method, and preliminary observations from an ongoing collection. The work surfaces a poetic delegation moment between human mortality and machine eternality, mediated by long-lived infrastructures that span generations.
papers.comment: Submitted to NeurIPS 2026 Creative AI Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一个投机设计项目，提出 Afterlife Delegation Protocol：活着的人签署代理遗嘱，经证实死亡后，一个自我主权 (self-sovereign) 的 AI 代理在区块链上生成，永久执行遗嘱且不受任何托管方干预。作者采用科幻小说科学方法，搭建了一个可运行的 web 平台让真实用户设计自己的来世代理，并将草拟遗嘱作为关于“什么应该比你活得更久”的定性数据，观察不同文化信仰下的来世宇宙观变化。协议以以太坊改进提案（ERC-10001）格式起草，描述了设计来世、证明死亡、代理执行的三阶段生命周期。
Motivation: 该工作追问死亡在一个能被永恒执行的遗嘱时代意味着什么，并试图通过可体验的干预而非纯论证来探索 AI 与长期基础设施对死亡和遗产概念的影响。
Method: 采用科幻小说科学 (science fiction science) 方法，将设想转化为体验式未来干预：构建一个 web 平台，用户通过迭代式、交互的 AI 自动化访谈设计自己的来世代理，可重新登录修改并在沙盒中排练遗嘱。协议组合现有以太坊 agent 标准，以 ERC-10001 形式撰写，并描述三阶段生命周期（designing the afterlife、proof of death、agent enactment）。
Result: 摘要仅报告了正在进行的收集中获得的初步观察，未给出量化结果或基准数据。
Conclusion: 该工作呈现人类死亡与机器永恒之间由跨代长期基础设施介导的委托时刻；其性质是投机设计项目，而非实证系统验证。

papers.title: CBX-Bench: A Human-Aligned MLLM Council for Benchmarking Concept Bottleneck Model Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) are designed to make visual classification interpretable by expressing predictions through human-understandable concepts. Although interpretability is the central motivation for CBMs, they are still largely evaluated as predictive models by downstream classification accuracy, supplemented by isolated qualitative examples. This highlights a pressing need for quantitative measures, a challenge complicated by the infeasibility of ground-truth concept annotation at scale and the open nature of concept lists due to a lack of consensus. To fill this gap, we develop a multimodal large language model (MLLM) council that, given an image and its CBM explanation, produces an explanation quality score. To ground and validate the council, we first conduct a human study to establish a ground-truth reference for CBM explanation quality: for an image, annotators compare explanations from two of LF-CBM, VLG-CBM, and CBM-Suite and choose the more useful one, or mark them as equally good or equally bad, yielding 2700 judgments over 900 image-comparison items on CUB-200, ImageNet-100, and Places365. Against this human reference, our five-model council, consisting of open-weight MLLMs, recovers over 70% of strict human preference rankings, rising to 83% on items where human annotators unanimously agree. Building on this validated council, we introduce CBX-Bench, a public benchmark and leaderboard: authors of new CBMs can submit their model's explanations, and CBX-Bench scores them with the council and maintains dataset-level rankings of explanation quality. CBX-Bench thus provides a human-aligned, scalable evaluation of CBM explanations beyond accuracy and isolated qualitative examples. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/meric-karadag/cbx-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CBX-Bench，一个基于多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 评审团 (council) 的基准，用于量化评估 Concept Bottleneck Model (CBM) 的解释质量，而不仅仅依赖分类准确率或孤立定性示例。作者先开展人类研究，在 CUB-200、ImageNet-100 和 Places365 上收集 900 个图像比较项、共 2700 条人工判断作为解释质量的地面真值参考；随后验证由五个开源权重 MLLM 组成的评审团能恢复超过 70% 的严格人类偏好排序，在人类一致同意的项目上达到 83%。最终发布公开基准与排行榜，供新 CBM 提交解释并由评审团打分排序。
Motivation: CBM 的核心动机是可解释性，但现有评估仍主要依赖下游分类准确率和零散的定性示例，缺少量化且可扩展的解释质量度量；而大规模地面真值概念标注不可行，概念列表也缺乏共识，因此需要与人类判断对齐的自动评估方法。
Method: 构建一个由五个开放权重 MLLM 组成的评审团，给定图像及其 CBM 解释，输出解释质量评分；通过人类研究建立地面真值参考（两两比较 LF-CBM、VLG-CBM、CBM-Suite 的解释并标记优劣），用于验证评审团；在此基础上推出 CBX-Bench 公共基准和排行榜。
Result: 评审团在人类严格偏好排序上恢复超过 70% 的一致性，在人类标注者一致同意的项目上达到 83%；人类研究覆盖 CUB-200、ImageNet-100 和 Places365，共 900 个图像比较项、2700 条判断。
Conclusion: CBX-Bench 提供了与人类对齐、可扩展的 CBM 解释质量评估方式，超越了准确率和孤立定性示例；作者将基准代码公开于 GitHub。
Relevance: 0
