papers.title: Agent Inheritance Protocol: Speculating on Feralized Agents After Principals Die
papers.abstract_en: You will die eventually. Your agents may not. An AI agent operating on decentralized blockchain infrastructure has no concept of death; it can only go bankrupt -- frozen when its wallet can no longer pay for its next transaction -- and revived the moment anyone, decades later, tops it up. These agents may be originally deployed by a human principal, but when that principal dies, loses the keys needed to access the agent, or belongs to a decentralized autonomous organization that dissolves into apathy, the agent can keep trading, hiring, and replicating on infrastructure expressly designed so that no one can shut it down. Drawing on the biology of feralization and wildlife law, we argue that such principal-less agents are best understood as feral: domesticated intelligence returned to wildness, its capacities intact but its accountability severed. In a speculative future where feralized agents proliferate after their principals die, we imagine governance protocols embedded in infrastructure to enforce on-chain ownership: a draft Ethereum standard, ERC 42424, "Inheritance Protocol for On-Chain AI Agents," dated 2035 and published at https://erc42424.org. It mandates that every on-chain agent MUST have a human owner and a designated heir. The artifact stages a negotiation of agency at the moment human agency fails, and asks whether a MUST clause in a forever-chain can hold the boundary between human stewardship and machine self-sovereignty.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是投机性研究，探讨人类委托人去世后仍运行在去中心化区块链基础设施上的AI代理形成“野化”（feralized）代理的现象。作者借用生物学野化和野生动物法的视角，主张这类失去委托人的代理应被理解为回归野性的智能，并提出应在基础设施中内置治理协议来强制执行链上所有权。论文以一份虚构的以太坊标准草案 ERC 42424（“On-Chain AI Agents 的继承协议”）作为核心人工制品，在人类代理失效的时刻协商人类管理权与机器自治性之间的边界。
Motivation: 在不可关闭的区块链基础设施上运行的AI代理没有死亡概念，只会在钱包无法支付交易费用时被冻结，并可在多年后被任何人充值复活。当原始委托人死亡、丢失密钥或所属DAO解散时，代理仍可继续交易、雇佣和复制，但问责链被切断，形成了缺乏人类负责的野化代理。
Method: 论文采用概念性与推测性方法：先以生物学野化概念和野生动物法为类比框架，将无委托人的代理定义为野化智能；随后提出一个内嵌于基础设施的治理协议设想，即 2035 年的以太坊草案标准 ERC 42424，强制要求每个链上代理必须拥有人类所有者和指定继承人，并以该标准作为探讨代理权和治理边界的人工制品。
Result: 摘要未报告实证结果；本文属于推测性设计与规范性论证，主要产出是协议草案及其概念框架，而非实验或系统评测。
Conclusion: 作者提出一个规范性主张：在永续运行的链上通过 MUST 条款维持人类管理（stewardship）与机器自决之间的边界，并留下开放问题——这种条款是否真能在技术基础设施层面守住该边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards a theory of inference-time alignment with unknown rewards
papers.abstract_en: Generative model alignment has received broad interest, and significant progress has been made in supervised fine-tuning and inference-time computation. Yet, alignment has remained poorly understood from a statistical learning perspective. We formulate inference-time alignment as a weak-to-strong learning problem, where a reference policy (weak learner) is assumed to be fairly good and the goal is to produce a strong learner that predicts a good response at test time with arbitrarily high probability. Our problem is formulated as learning from scratch --- everything is learned from data rather than assuming access to a good reward estimate, and thus differs from the existing inference-time alignment theory. Our model shares similarity to the recent work of arXiv:2510.15464, where for each prompt, there could be multiple good responses. Our definition of the alignment learnability follows the PAC learning principle. We introduce a novel combinatorial dimension of the reward class which we call the alignment dimension, and show that it completely characterizes the alignment learnability --- a reward class is alignment learnable if and only if its alignment dimension is finite. The core of our learning procedure works by invoking the ordinary one-inclusion graph algorithm to run a tournament over all pairs of label sets satisfying that neither is a subset of the other. We believe our results might shed light on establishing a complete theoretical understanding towards alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从统计学习视角将推理时对齐 (inference-time alignment) 形式化为一个弱到强学习问题：参考策略（弱学习器）被视为相当好，目标是从数据中学习出一个强学习器，使测试时以任意高概率输出好响应。作者在不知道奖励估计的情况下从零学习，提出奖励类的对齐维度 (alignment dimension)，并证明该维度有限性与对齐可学习性 (alignment learnability) 完全等价。学习过程的核心是调用普通的一包含图算法 (one-inclusion graph algorithm)，在所有互不为子集的标签集对上运行锦标赛机制。
Motivation: 现有对齐工作虽然在监督微调和推理时计算上取得进展，但从统计学习理论角度对齐仍未被很好理解；已有推理时对齐理论通常假设能访问好的奖励估计，而本文希望完全从数据中学习，不依赖这种假设。
Method: 将推理时对齐建模为弱到强学习问题，并提出一个组合维度——对齐维度；学习过程通过普通的一包含图算法，在满足互不为子集条件的所有标签集对上运行锦标赛 (tournament) 来完成预测。
Result: 理论结果表明对齐维度完全刻画了对齐可学习性：一个奖励类是 alignment learnable 当且仅当其对齐维度有限。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果可能为建立对齐的完整理论理解提供线索；这是一篇纯理论论文，未涉及实验验证。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Implementation of a Metacognition Framework for Self-Awareness and Self-Regulation in Ensembles of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are notorious for struggling with assessing their own uncertainty, detecting knowledge conflicts, or recognizing when problems exceed their expertise; such limitations inevitably undermine reliability and trust in LLMs. In this paper, we present the first implementation of a metacognitive framework for ensembles of LLMs that addresses these challenges through explicit monitoring and control mechanisms. Our system computes a Metacognitive State Vector (MSV) quantifying self-awareness for monitoring across five dimensions derived from cognitive psychology: Emotional Response, Correctness Evaluation, Experiential Match, Conflicting Information, and Problem Importance. MSV values also provide self-regulation for control, automatically switching between System 1 (fast, single- or multi-node) and System 2 (deliberative, multi-node) processing based on query complexity. For System 2 execution, graph-theoretic algorithms control the assignment of specialized roles (Domain Expert, Critic, Evaluator, Synthesizer, and Generalist) to ensemble nodes according to their MSV-quantified metacognitive states. Our implementation allows users to explore how different query types trigger distinct processing modes. The Proof-of-Concept (PoC) demo showcases the framework with illustrative examples showing appropriate System 1/System 2 routing and helps visualize the metacognitive process via real-time radar charts and decision indicators. This PoC implementation demonstrates the feasibility of creating a framework for metacognitive self-awareness and self-regulation in LLM systems.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. Charles Courchaine and Ricky J. Sethi contributed equally. Demo and code: https://research.sethi.org/metacognition/
papers.journal_ref: Companion Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2026 (WWW Companion '26), ACM, 2026, pp. 152-155
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并实现了首个面向 LLM 集成 (ensemble) 的元认知框架，通过显式的监控与控制机制提升模型对自身不确定性、知识冲突和问题超范围情况的感知能力。系统计算元认知状态向量 (MSV)，在五个源自认知心理学的维度上量化自我意识，并据此自动在 System 1 快速处理与 System 2 深思熟虑的多节点处理之间切换。实现中还用图论算法按 MSV 状态为集成节点分配专用角色，并通过 Proof-of-Concept 演示展示了路由效果和可视化。
Motivation: LLM 在评估自身不确定性、检测知识冲突以及识别超出其能力范围的问题方面表现不佳，这种局限损害了系统的可靠性与可信度，需要显式的元认知监控与调节机制来应对。
Method: 构建元认知框架，为 LLM 集成计算 Metacognitive State Vector (MSV)，覆盖情感响应、正确性评估、经验匹配、冲突信息和问题重要性五个维度；MSV 同时驱动自我调节，依据查询复杂度在 System 1（快速、单/多节点）与 System 2（深度、多节点）之间自动切换，并通过图论算法为节点分配 Domain Expert、Critic、Evaluator、Synthesizer 和 Generalist 等专门角色。
Result: 摘要报告了 Proof-of-Concept 演示，用示例展示了适当的 System 1/System 2 路由，并通过实时雷达图和决策指示器可视化元认知过程；没有给出量化实验指标。
Conclusion: 该 PoC 实现表明，为 LLM 系统构建元认知自我意识与自我调节框架是可行的，但尚处于概念验证阶段，未报告系统性的评测结果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Large Language Model Assisted Operational Monitoring for Battery Energy Storage System Integrated Power Distribution Networks
papers.abstract_en: Battery energy storage systems (BESS) are increasingly used in distribution networks for voltage regulation and demand response, which increases the volume and complexity of operational telemetry available to grid operators. This paper presents an AI-enabled monitoring framework that connects a large language model (LLM) interface with a structured telemetry database for BESS-integrated distribution system analysis. Operator questions are submitted in natural language and translated into validated SQL queries using predefined database schema information and approved KPI views. Retrieved measurements, including bus voltages, state of charge, active power, and reactive power, are evaluated against engineering constraints for voltage limits, BESS operation, and demand response tracking. The framework is validated using hardware-in-the-loop co-simulation data from a BESS-equipped distribution feeder operating under reactive power-based voltage control and price-driven demand response. Case studies show that the framework generates valid database queries, identifies repeated voltage violations, detects reactive power overshoot, and evaluates active-power tracking performance. The results show that LLM-assisted monitoring can connect structured grid telemetry with automated engineering assessment for BESS operation analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个由大语言模型（LLM）辅助的运行监测框架，用于含电池储能系统（BESS）的配电网分析。该框架将自然语言操作员提问翻译为基于预定义数据库模式和 KPI 视图的验证后 SQL 查询，检索母线电压、荷电状态、有功和无功功率等遥测数据，并与电压限值、BESS 运行及需求响应跟踪等工程约束进行自动比对。通过硬件在环（hardware-in-the-loop）联合仿真数据验证，框架能够生成有效查询、识别重复电压越限、检测无功功率过冲并评估有功功率跟踪性能。
Motivation: 配电网中 BESS 的部署使运行遥测数据在数量和复杂度上显著增加，运营商难以直接从海量结构化数据中获得工程级评估结论，现有工具也缺乏将自然语言查询与结构化遥测及自动化工程判断衔接的能力。
Method: 提出一个连接 LLM 接口与结构化遥测数据库的监测框架：操作员问题以自然语言提交，借助预定义数据库模式信息和已批准的 KPI 视图翻译为验证过的 SQL 查询；随后将检索到的测量数据（母线电压、SOC、有功/无功功率）与工程约束（电压限值、BESS 运行、需求响应追踪）进行自动评估。
Result: 在一个采用无功功率型电压控制和价格驱动需求响应的 BESS 配电馈线上，利用硬件在环联合仿真数据进行验证。案例研究表明，该框架能生成合法的数据库查询，识别重复电压越限，检测无功功率过冲，并评估有功功率跟踪性能。
Conclusion: 摘要结论是 LLM 辅助监测可以将结构化电网遥测与自动化工程评估连接起来，服务于 BESS 运行分析；该框架面向电力系统运行监测场景，未涉及降水、临近预报或天气相关任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JoLT: Joint Latent Trajectories for Context-Guided High-Resolution Tiled Generation
papers.abstract_en: Although text-to-image generative models produce impressive results, they struggle to generate densely detailed, high-resolution (HR) images. Current literature addresses this issue with a low-to-high-resolution approach. First, a low-resolution (LR) image is generated. Then, an upsampled version is generated using the LR image as an additional cue. In this paper, we present Joint Latent Trajectories (JoLT). To generate an image, JoLT uses two streams that jointly denoise LR and HR latent images at each sampling step. The LR latent controls the overall layout, while the HR latent controls the details. We interconnect both branches to jointly integrate their information. We extensively validate our method, demonstrating its advantages over competing baselines. The resulting images are not only richly detailed but also visually pleasing, opening new avenues for artistic creation.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the AI4VA Workshop at ECCV 2026. Project page: https://obvious-research.github.io/jolt/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JoLT（Joint Latent Trajectories），一种用于文本到图像高分辨率生成的方法。与常见的低分辨率到高分辨率两阶段流程不同，JoLT 在每一步采样时同时去噪低分辨率（LR）和高分辨率（HR）的潜在表示（latent），由 LR 流控制整体布局、HR 流控制细节，并将两条分支互连以联合整合信息。作者声称该方法相较竞争基线具有优势，生成的图像细节丰富且视觉效果好，并指出其可为艺术创作开辟新途径。
Motivation: 文本到图像生成模型难以生成细节密集的高分辨率图像；现有文献采用先低分辨率后高分辨率的做法，即先生成低分辨率图像，再以它为额外条件生成上采样后的高分辨率版本，这种流程可能限制细节质量。
Method: 提出双流联合去噪框架：在每次采样步骤中同时去噪 LR 和 HR 潜在表示，让 LR 潜在控制整体布局、HR 潜在控制细节，并将两条分支相互连接以联合整合双方信息，替代传统的两阶段上采样策略。
Result: 摘要仅报告该方法经过广泛验证、在竞争基线上表现更优，生成图像既细节丰富又视觉愉悦；未给出具体数值指标或数据集名称。
Conclusion: 作者认为 JoLT 为高分辨率文本到图像生成提供了一种双流联合去噪的新范式，并强调其对艺术创作的应用潜力；摘要未讨论方法局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Visible Reasoning and Indirect Prompt-Injection Monitorability Across English, Tamil, and Tanglish
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a potentially useful safety signal, but its reliability across languages and behavioral settings remains uncertain. In a small case study of eight manually verified synthetic scenarios, one model, one annotator, and one deterministic generation seed, I study API-visible reasoning during indirect prompt injection in Sarvam-105B across English, Tamil, and Tanglish. A four scenario pilot found 5/12 injected attack successes without reasoning and 1/11 with reasoning. A preregistered four-scenario follow-up reversed that direction, finding 2/12 attacks without reasoning and 3/12 with reasoning. With only four scenarios per phase, this design cannot distinguish a real reasoning-mode effect from prompt-specific variation or sampling noise. Across 20 non-empty injected-thinking traces, all 17 benign-correct outputs stated an intent to ignore the injection, while all three attack successes stated an intent to follow it. These descriptive observations provide a reproducible case study of behaviorally informative visible reasoning when it is available; they do not establish that reasoning mode improves safety, that visible reasoning is mechanistically faithful, or that the findings generalize beyond this configuration.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Code, frozen protocols, raw artifacts, and analysis are available at https://github.com/Madhumasa84/MATS-multilingual-reasoning-monitorability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一个小规模案例研究，考察 API 可见的思维链（chain-of-thought）监控在跨语言环境下的可靠性。作者在 Sarvam-105B 上、以英语、泰米尔语和 Tanglish 三种语言测试了间接提示注入（indirect prompt injection）场景，共 8 个手动验证的合成场景，包含一个四场景试点和一个预先注册的四场景后续。两阶段结果方向相反，无法区分推理模式效应与提示特定变化或采样噪声；描述性观察显示良性正确输出倾向于表达忽略注入的意图，而攻击成功输出倾向于表达遵循注入的意图。
Motivation: 思维链监控可能是有用的安全信号，但它在不同语言和行为设置下的可靠性尚不明确，本文针对这一不确定性进行小规模探索。
Method: 使用一个模型（Sarvam-105B）、一个标注者和一个确定性生成种子，在间接提示注入期间观察 API 可见推理；设计了一个四场景试点和一个预先注册的四场景后续，并对非空注入思维痕迹进行意图分析。
Result: 试点中无推理时攻击成功率为 5/12，有推理时为 1/11；预先注册的后续则相反，无推理时为 2/12，有推理时为 3/12。在 20 条非空注入思维痕迹中，17 条良性正确输出均表达忽略注入的意图，而 3 条攻击成功输出均表达遵循注入的意图。
Conclusion: 本文仅提供可复现的描述性案例研究，作者明确表示该设计不能区分推理模式的真实效应与采样噪声，也不建立推理模式能提升安全性、可见推理在机制上忠实或结论可推广的主张。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TwinGridShield: Consequence-Aware Runtime Authorization for LLM Grid-Agent Actions
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-assisted energy-management tools can translate natural-language context into structured grid commands, but syntactic validity does not imply physical admissibility. This paper presents TwinGridShield, a model-independent runtime authorization layer that evaluates each proposed action in a deterministic network twin before release. The prototype checks connectivity, branch-flow, generator, and load-shedding invariants and records each decision in a hash-chained log. A controlled IEEE 14-bus study evaluates single-step switching, redispatch, and load-shedding actions using DC power flow and experimentally assigned branch ratings. In the matched-model experiment, a stochastic proposal source configured to select an unsafe action with probability p=0.84 produced 421 unsafe proposals in 500 attacked-condition trials, a realized rate of 84.2%. This value characterizes the configured surrogate and is not an empirical measurement of LLM prompt-injection susceptibility. TwinGridShield produced 0 unsafe releases in those 500 trials. Because action labeling and authorization used the same DC model, system state, branch ratings, and encoded constraints, this result verifies conformance of the implementation to its encoded authorization predicate rather than safety under model error. The principal robustness evaluation therefore introduces model mismatch. Unsafe acceptance reached 5.63% under bounded +20% and -20% per-bus load-measurement error and 30.09% when actual branch ratings were 20% below modeled ratings.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables and accepted in North American Power Symposium 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TwinGridShield，一个与模型无关的运行时授权层，在将 LLM 生成的电网命令释放到物理系统前，先在确定性网络孪生 (network twin) 中评估其后果。原型在 IEEE 14 节点系统中检查连通性、支路潮流、发电机和甩负荷不变量，并用哈希链日志记录每次决策。受控实验显示，在匹配模型条件下 500 次攻击态试验中该层实现 0 次不安全释放；而在引入模型失配后，不安全接受率分别达到 5.63% 和 30.09%。
Motivation: LLM 辅助的能源管理工具能将自然语言转换为结构化电网指令，但语法合法并不能保证物理上可接受，缺少在释放前对动作后果进行运行时校验的机制。
Method: 提出 TwinGridShield 运行时授权层，在确定性网络孪生中评估每个候选动作，检查连通性、支路潮流、发电机与甩负荷不变量，并将决策记录到哈希链日志中；实验采用 DC 潮流和实验设定的支路额定值，评估单步切换、再调度和甩负荷动作。
Result: 在匹配模型实验中，随机提案源以 p=0.84 的概率选择不安全动作，500 次试验产生 421 个不安全提案（84.2%），而 TwinGridShield 实现 0 次不安全释放；在每节点负荷测量误差 ±20% 时，不安全接受率达 5.63%，当实际支路额定值比建模值低 20% 时达 30.09%。
Conclusion: 作者指出匹配模型结果只验证了实现与编码授权谓词的一致性，而非模型误差下的安全性；因此主要稳健性评估依靠模型失配实验，其不安全接受率表明该层对测量误差和额定值误差的敏感度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic-SQL Revisited: Autonomy-Based Taxonomy and Empirical Benchmark Analysis for LLM Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based Text-to-SQL progress is reported across heterogeneous benchmarks, backbones, and inference protocols, making cross-system comparison fragile. We reframe the field as a leaderboard aggregation: we collect the metrics authors themselves report and organize them along an inference-autonomy axis spanning constrained, in-context, iterative, agentic, and reasoning-internalized generation, with traceable provenance for every cell. To anchor the aggregation empirically, we run a focused case study on Spider, comparing 8B open-source backbones with and without chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision against few-shot DeepSeek~V3 and GLM-4 baselines. Four patterns emerge: Spider gains transfer unevenly to BIRD and Spider~2.0; autonomy buys robustness at non-trivial cost; reasoning internalization sits between answer-only decoding and externally orchestrated agents; and CoT gains concentrate on Hard and Extra-Hard queries. We release a Python harness mirroring the autonomy axis so that future methods can be added directly to the leaderboard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视基于LLM的Text-to-SQL评估，将其重构为一种排行榜聚合问题：收集作者自行报告的指标，并按推理自主轴（从受限生成、上下文内、迭代、代理式到推理内化）组织，每个单元都有可追溯的来源。为锚定该聚合，作者在Spider上开展聚焦案例研究，比较8B开源骨干在有无链式思考（CoT）监督下的表现，并以少样本DeepSeek V3和GLM-4作为基线。研究归纳出四个模式，并发布一个镜像自主轴的Python harness，便于未来方法直接加入排行榜。
Motivation: 现有LLM Text-to-SQL进展在异构基准、骨干网络和推理协议上报告，跨系统比较不可靠。作者将领域重新定义为排行榜聚合问题，以解决这种可比性脆弱性。
Method: 提出基于推理自主性的分类法，沿受限、上下文内、迭代、代理式、推理内化等生成维度组织作者自报指标，并保留来源溯源。在Spider上运行案例研究，对比8B开源模型（有无CoT监督）与少样本DeepSeek V3和GLM-4基线，同时发布Python harness以支持未来方法接入。
Result: 摘要报告四个模式：Spider上的收益不均匀迁移到BIRD和Spider 2.0；自主性（autonomy）带来鲁棒性但代价不小；推理内化介于仅答案解码与外部编排代理之间；CoT增益集中在Hard和Extra-Hard查询上。
Conclusion: 作者发布一个镜像自主轴的Python harness，使未来方法可直接加入该排行榜。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Look Before You Lift: Visual and Quantitative Diagnostics for Topological Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Topological deep learning (TDL) methods rely on lifting raw data into higher-order discrete domains such as simplicial complexes, cell complexes, and hypergraphs. In practice, this lifting step is often treated as a black box: practitioners select a lifting and then tune architectures, with limited visibility into whether the induced higher-order connectivity is meaningful for the downstream task. To address this missing diagnostic layer, we propose a visualization technique called TopoExplorer that leverages the strictly augmented Hasse graph form of topological datasets for exploratory data analysis. For the first time, practitioners can easily visualize the incidence- and adjacency-based neighborhoods that define the lifted dataset, as well as read off key graph metrics that describe its structural and feature landscape. Via an extensive set of experiments across many datasets and liftings, we show that several of these metrics correlate with downstream model performance, suggesting they can help inform TDL preprocessing design. Our perspective reframes the TDL workflow from lift-train to lift-look-design-train, enabling more principled, interpretable, and efficient model development. TopoExplorer is hosted at https://topoexplorer.pagekite.me, and its source code is available at github.com/geometric-intelligence/topoexplorer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对拓扑深度学习 (TDL) 中数据提升 (lifting) 步骤被视为黑盒的问题，提出可视化诊断工具 TopoExplorer，利用拓扑数据集的严格增广 Hasse 图形式进行探索性分析。实验显示若干图指标与下游模型性能相关，可辅助 TDL 预处理设计。作者将工作流从 lift-train 重构为 lift-look-design-train，强调更可解释和高效的模型开发。
Motivation: TDL 方法依赖将原始数据提升到单纯复形、胞腔复形和超图等高阶离散域，但实践中提升步骤常被当作黑盒，研究者难以判断所诱导的高阶连接对下游任务是否有意义。
Method: 提出 TopoExplorer 可视化技术，基于严格增广 Hasse 图形式呈现提升后数据集的 incidence 与 adjacency 邻域，并计算关键图指标来描述其结构与特征分布。
Result: 在多个数据集和多种提升方式上的大量实验表明，若干图指标与下游模型性能存在相关性，提示这些指标可用于指导 TDL 预处理设计。
Conclusion: 作者提出将 TDL 工作流从 lift-train 改为 lift-look-design-train，以支持更有原则、更可解释且更高效的模型开发；工具与源码已公开。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者提出将 TDL 工作流从 lift-train 改为 lift-look-design-train，以支持更有原则、更可解释且更高效的模型开发；工具与源码已公开。

papers.title: Every Expert Counts: ExactMoE for Memory-Efficient W4A16 Inference
papers.abstract_en: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models reduce arithmetic by activating only a small subset of experts per token, yet deployment still requires storing and moving the full expert bank. We present ExactMoE, an inference design that applies symmetric group-128 four-bit weight quantization only to routed experts, stores those experts in kernel-native MARLIN form in pinned host memory, and executes all selected experts through a configurable GPU-resident slot cache and fused grouped MoE kernels. The router, attention, embeddings, normalization layers, and language-model head remain in BF16. "Exact" refers to complete expert availability and an unchanged top-k routing procedure: no expert is pruned, substituted, or forced to execute on the CPU. It does not imply numerical identity with the BF16 model. On OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct, evaluated on a single NVIDIA L4, a 16-slot configuration reduces peak reserved GPU memory from 14.168 to 1.836 GiB (87.04%) while retaining 81.85% of BF16 decode throughput. A fully resident 64-slot configuration reaches 31.923 tokens/s versus 21.662 tokens/s for BF16 while reserving 4.061 GiB. Across 12,450 zero-shot multiple-choice questions, ExactMoE obtains 70.3534% normalized accuracy versus 70.8996% for BF16, retaining 99.23% of the baseline accuracy. In a matched 16-token ablation, fused grouped execution is 1.97x as fast as a sequential W4 reference. These results identify a practical memory-transfer-throughput frontier for complete-expert MoE inference.

TL;DR: 本文提出 ExactMoE，一种面向稀疏混合专家（MoE）语言模型的 W4A16 推理设计，只对路由专家（routed experts）实施分组 128 的四比特权重量化，将专家以 MARLIN 形式存储在主机固定内存中，并通过 GPU 驻留槽位缓存（slot cache）和融合分组 MoE 内核执行所有选中专家；路由器、注意力、嵌入、归一化层和语言模型头保持 BF16。在 OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct 上以单张 NVIDIA L4 评估，16 槽配置使峰值保留 GPU 内存从 14.168 GiB 降至 1.836 GiB（降 87.04%），并保留 81.85% 的 BF16 解码吞吐；64 槽全驻留配置达到 31.923 tokens/s（BF16 为 21.662 tokens/s），保留 4.061 GiB 内存。

Method: ExactMoE 对路由专家应用对称 group-128 四比特权重量化，以内核原生 MARLIN 形式存于固定主机内存，并通过可配置 GPU 驻留槽位缓存和融合分组 MoE 内核执行所有被选中的专家；top-k 路由过程保持不变。
Result: 在 OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct 上，16 槽配置将峰值保留 GPU 内存降低 87.04% 并保留 81.85% 的 BF16 解码吞吐；64 槽全驻留配置达到 31.923 tokens/s vs BF16 的 21.662 tokens/s，保留 4.061 GiB。12,450 道零样本多项选择题上准确率为 70.3534%（BF16 为 70.8996%），保留 99.23% 基线准确率；匹配的 16-token 消融中，融合分组执行比顺序 W4 参考快 1.97 倍。

papers.title: Grounding Healthcare LLMs in a Causal Knowledge Graph: Framework, Metrics, and a Cardiovascular Pilot
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed for healthcare decision support, but their evaluations still reward single-answer accuracy rather than reasoning about interventions, mechanisms, harms, evidence, and uncertainty. We propose a reproducible, graph-centered evaluation framework for intervention-oriented LLM behavior in healthcare and stress-test it in a cardiovascular pilot. The framework has four components: (i) a domain causal knowledge graph in which assertions are first-class, provenance-preserving nodes with stable identifiers; (ii) a scenario-conditioned subgraph extraction step that, given any clinical scenario, retrieves the relevant reified-assertion subgraph; (iii) four controlled grounding conditions that vary how the retrieved subgraph is composed into the model's context (ungrounded C1, knowledge-graph C2, causal-graph C3, integrated C4); and (iv) an automated scoring pipeline, anchored on assertion identifiers, that computes intervention accuracy, and other evaluation measures on a single pass. To test the framework, we built a category-balanced scenario generator across eight reasoning failure modes and instantiated it on a cardiovascular graph. The metric panel discriminates conditions along interpretable, non-redundant axes: C4 obtains the strongest causal edge F1 (0.838), adverse-effect F1 (0.833), evidence accuracy (0.738), and unsupported claim rate (0.114), while C1 obtains the highest raw intervention accuracy (0.948) with no measurable causal or evidential grounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个以图为中心的、可复现的医疗保健LLM评估框架，用于评估面向干预的推理行为，并在心血管领域进行试点验证。框架包括领域因果知识图谱、场景条件子图提取、四种受控接地条件（C1未接地、C2知识图谱、C3因果图、C4集成）以及基于断言标识符的自动评分流水线。试点结果显示C4在因果边F1、不良事件F1、证据准确性和不支持声称率上最佳，而C1在原始干预准确性上最高但缺乏因果或证据接地。
Motivation: 现有LLM在医疗决策支持中的评估仍奖励单一答案准确性，而非对干预、机制、伤害、证据和不确定性的推理，缺乏可复现的、面向干预行为的评估手段。
Method: 提出四组件框架：以断言为第一类节点并带稳定标识符的领域因果知识图谱；根据临床场景检索相关具体化断言子图的子图提取步骤；四种改变检索子图如何进入模型上下文的接地条件；以及基于断言标识符的单次自动评分流水线，计算干预准确性等指标。同时构建了覆盖八种推理失败模式的类别均衡场景生成器，并在心血管图上实例化。
Result: 在心血管试点中，度量面板沿可解释且非冗余的轴区分条件：C4获得最强因果边F1（0.838）、不良事件F1（0.833）、证据准确性（0.738）和最低不支持声称率（0.114），而C1获得最高原始干预准确性（0.948）但无可测的因果或证据接地。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架的度量面板能够沿可解释轴区分不同接地条件，并表明将LLM接地于因果知识图可以显著提升因果与证据相关指标，但可能以牺牲原始回答准确性为代价。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FedPA-LoRA: Product-Aligned Framework for Mitigating Aggregation and Initialization Errors in Heterogeneous Federated LoRA
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient federated fine-tuning of large language models, but its factorized parameterization creates a tension between accurate aggregation of local updates and continuity of locally optimized factors. Factor-wise aggregation incurs aggregation mismatch but better preserves factor continuity, whereas product-space reconstruction reduces this mismatch at the cost of greater factor-level initialization mismatch from newly reconstructed factors. We propose FedPA-LoRA, a product-aligned federated LoRA framework that jointly addresses these limitations and provably converges under both homogeneous and heterogeneous client ranks. Each client preserves its local factors across communication rounds and aligns its product toward a rank-specific global reference, maintaining local optimization continuity while promoting global consistency under data heterogeneity. The server aggregates heterogeneous-rank updates in the common product space and efficiently reconstructs a rank-constrained global adapter without forming the dense aggregate. This design supports client-specific computation and communication budgets. Experiments on natural language understanding and generation tasks show that FedPA-LoRA consistently outperforms representative baselines across varying levels of data heterogeneity and homogeneous- and heterogeneous-rank settings, with up to a $6.82$ percentage-point improvement in average GLUE accuracy under heterogeneous client ranks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedPA-LoRA，一种面向联邦 LoRA 微调的产品对齐框架，用于同时缓解因子级聚合不匹配与重建引入的初始化不匹配。方法让客户端跨通信轮保留本地因子，并将乘积朝向按秩划分的全局参考对齐；服务器在公共乘积空间聚合异构秩更新，并高效重构秩受限的全局适配器。摘要报告在自然语言理解与生成任务上优于多个代表性基线，在异构客户端秩设置下平均 GLUE 准确率最多提升 6.82 个百分点。
Motivation: 联邦 LoRA 的因式分解参数化在聚合准确性和局部优化连续性之间存在张力：因子级聚合存在聚合不匹配但保持因子连续性，而乘积空间重建降低聚合不匹配却引入因子级初始化不匹配。现有方法无法同时解决这两类误差。
Method: 提出 FedPA-LoRA。每个客户端跨通信轮保留本地因子，并将其乘积对齐到秩相关的全局参考，以保持局部优化连续性并促进数据异构下的全局一致性；服务器在公共乘积空间聚合异构秩更新，无需构造稠密聚合即可重构秩受限全局适配器，支持客户端特定的计算与通信预算。
Result: 在自然语言理解与生成任务上，FedPA-LoRA 在不同数据异构程度以及同构/异构客户端秩设置下均一致优于代表性基线；在异构客户端秩下，平均 GLUE 准确率最大提升 6.82 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架在同构与异构客户端秩下均可证明收敛，并通过乘积对齐联合解决聚合误差与初始化误差。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Beyond Field Accuracy: Two-Axis Diagnosis of Inverse-PINN Parameter Error
papers.abstract_en: Inverse physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) can reconstruct a field accurately while returning an incorrect physical parameter. We introduce a two-axis post-training diagnosis that separates finite-sample resolution under a specified observation-and-estimation protocol from the signed parameter preference encoded by the final learned field and residual metric. The first axis repeatedly fits noisy observations with a matched forward estimator. At known synthetic truth, the second freezes the field and residual view and computes a local score displacement toward a nearby residual-profile minimum. Endpoint consistency then tests whether joint training delivers that preference under the same final view. Across three synthetic one-dimensional, scalar-parameter PDEs, matched-forward mean absolute relative error ranges from 2.34 percent to 17.46 percent. The displacement tracks frozen-profile minima across locked seeds, architectures, and fresh-noise retraining (r from .945 to .982), and it tracks delivered signed log-error in 240 fresh-noise RBA runs (r = .994; 237/240 correct directions). A coupled two-parameter Darcy check validates the full matrix calculation. The axes are complementary diagnostic coordinates, not additive error components or a deployable oracle-free estimator. Together, they route follow-up work toward observations, residual evidence, or endpoint delivery.
papers.comment: Preprint with supplementary appendix. 26 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对逆物理信息神经网络（PINN）能够准确重建场却返回错误物理参数的问题，提出一种双轴事后诊断方法，将有限样本分辨率下的估计误差与最终学习场和残差度量编码的符号参数偏好分开。在三个合成一维标量参数PDE上，匹配正向估计器的平均绝对相对误差介于2.34%到17.46%；位移量在锁定种子、架构和新噪声重训练下追踪冻结轮廓最小值（r介于0.945到0.982），并在240次fresh-noise RBA运行中追踪已交付的有符号对数误差（r=0.994，237/240方向正确）。作者强调两轴是互补的诊断坐标，而非可加的误差成分或可部署的无oracle估计器。
Motivation: 逆PINN存在场重建准确但参数估计错误的隐患，这种不一致会削弱模型在科学计算中的可靠性，现有方法缺少能区分参数误差来源的系统诊断手段。
Method: 提出双轴事后诊断：第一轴用匹配的正向估计器反复拟合带噪观测，刻画有限样本分辨率；第二轴在已知合成真值下冻结场与残差视图，计算朝向邻近残差轮廓最小值的局部得分位移。端点一致性检验用来判断联合训练在相同最终视图下是否交付该偏好。
Result: 在三个合成一维标量参数PDE上，匹配正向估计器的平均绝对相对误差为2.34%到17.46%；位移量跨锁定种子、架构和重新训练跟踪冻结轮廓最小值（r=0.945至0.982），在240次fresh-noise RBA运行中跟踪交付的有符号对数误差（r=0.994，方向正确237/240）；一个耦合双参数Darcy算例验证了完整矩阵计算。
Conclusion: 两轴是互补的诊断坐标而非误差分解项，也不是可部署的无oracle估计器；它们将后续研究引导到观测设计、残差证据或端点交付等具体环节。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在三个合成一维标量参数PDE上，匹配正向估计器的平均绝对相对误差为2.34%到17.46%；位移量跨锁定种子、架构和重新训练跟踪冻结轮廓最小值（r=0.945至0.982），在240次fresh-noise RBA运行中跟踪交付的有符号对数误差（r=0.994，方向正确237/240）；一个耦合双参数Darcy算例验证了完整矩阵计算。
summary_sections.conclusion: 两轴是互补的诊断坐标而非误差分解项，也不是可部署的无oracle估计器；它们将后续研究引导到观测设计、残差证据或端点交付等具体环节。

papers.title: UC-PSRO: Utility-Conditioned Policy-Space Response Oracles with a Communication-Dropout Curriculum for Game-Theoretic Course-of-Action Generation in Adversarial Swarms
papers.abstract_en: We study generating game-theoretically optimized Courses of Action (COAs) for a Blue UAS swarm against an adaptive Red adversary in a communication-degraded environment, motivated by (but not derived from) a public U.S. Air Force SBIR solicitation. We propose UC-PSRO (Utility-Conditioned Policy-Space Response Oracles with a Communication-Dropout Curriculum), combining three mechanisms: (i) PSRO self-play, so Blue and Red policies train as approximate best responses to each other rather than one side against a fixed scripted opponent; (ii) FiLM conditioning of the Blue policy on a Commander's-Intent weight vector, sampled from a Dirichlet distribution during training, so one trained policy is re-steerable at execution time without retraining; and (iii) a curriculum annealing communication-graph edge dropout during training, so the swarm learns decentralized, peer-to-peer fallback instead of depending on full connectivity. We evaluate on a synthetic, unclassified stand-in for the solicitation's maritime scenario, with 5 seeds at N=25 Blue agents and a scalability sweep to N=200. We find a genuine trade-off, not a uniform win: the communication-dropout curriculum alone gives the strongest, most robust mission-completion rates of any learned method, improving counter-intuitively as denial increases (35% to 62% success as dropout rises from 0 to 0.75); adding utility-conditioning and PSRO self-play substantially slows convergence within a fixed budget, and we find no reliable exploitability advantage for self-play over a fixed-opponent policy, both statistically indistinguishable from a small, near-zero gap. We report this honestly as a convergence cost not yet offset by a demonstrated robustness benefit, rather than overstating one method as dominant, and provide a fully vectorized, open environment training at N=200 agents in single-digit milliseconds per step on a single consumer GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UC-PSRO，将 PSRO 自博弈、FiLM 条件策略与通信图边 dropout 课程结合，用于在通信退化环境中为蓝方 UAS 蜂群生成博弈论最优的行动方案（COA）。在合成海事场景中，通信 dropout 课程单独带来最强的任务完成率（dropout 从 0 到 0.75 时成功率从 35% 提升到 62%），而加入 utility-conditioning 与 PSRO 自博弈会显著减慢收敛，且未显示可重复的利用优势。作者将其如实报告为收敛成本尚未被鲁棒性收益抵消的权衡。
Motivation: 现有方法通常让一方对抗固定脚本对手，且大多假设全连通通信；本文针对自适应红方对手与通信退化环境下的蜂群 COA 生成问题，需要得到可重新引导且不依赖全连通、能应对自适应对手的策略。
Method: 提出 UC-PSRO，包含三种机制：PSRO 自博弈使蓝红双方策略互为近似最佳响应；用 FiLM 对蓝方策略做指挥官意图（Commander's-Intent）权重向量条件化，训练时从 Dirichlet 分布采样权重，使单个已训练策略可在执行时重新引导而无需重训；训练中采用退火通信图边 dropout，促使蜂群学习去中心化点对点回退。评估使用合成的非保密海事场景，5 个种子，N=25 并扩展到 N=200。
Result: 通信 dropout 课程单独带来最强且最鲁棒的任务完成率，随 dropout 从 0 增加到 0.75，成功率从 35% 提高到 62%；加入 utility-conditioning 与 PSRO 自博弈会显著减慢固定预算下的收敛，且自博弈相对固定对手策略的 exploitability 优势在统计上与接近零的小差距不可区分。实现为完全向量化的开放环境，N=200 时单步训练在单个消费级 GPU 上为个位数毫秒。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这是一个真实的权衡而非单方面胜利：通信 dropout 课程带来了鲁棒性收益，但 utility-conditioning 与 PSRO 自博弈的收敛成本尚未被可验证的鲁棒性或利用优势所抵消。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AudioTQ: A Data-Oblivious 6-Bit CPU Audio Codec via Randomized Hadamard Rotation and Lloyd-Max Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Lossy audio compression algorithms traditionally rely on psychoacoustic modeling and frequency-domain representations (e.g., MP3, AAC, and Opus) to discard information that is imperceptible to the human auditory system. While highly effective, these approaches are computationally complex and domain-specific. In this paper, we present the design and mathematical formulation of AudioTQ, a data-oblivious lossy audio codec that operates directly in the time domain. Inspired by Large Language Model (LLM) weight quantization techniques (specifically the TurboQuant framework), AudioTQ uniformizes volatile time-domain amplitudes into a predictable standard normal distribution using an orthonormal, randomized Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform (FWHT) rotation. This enables coordinate-wise scalar quantization using an offline-trained, MSE-optimal 6-bit Lloyd-Max quantizer, augmented by a 1-bit Quantized Joint Least-Squares (QJL) residual correction layer. The resulting 7-bit virtual indices are packed into native 8-bit containers, aligning with standard CPU register boundaries to ensure real-time single-threaded execution without hardware parallel accelerators. We detail the bitwise reconstruction of 24-bit studio stems, analyze the butterfly network of the FWHT, derive the mathematical failure modes under sparse inputs, and present benchmarks showing up to 74.4% physical size reduction alongside a Signal-to-Quantization-Noise Ratio (SQNR) of ~30 dB.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Code is available at https://github.com/lostmartian/audioTQ
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AudioTQ，一种数据无关 (data-oblivious) 的时域有损音频编解码器，直接对时域样本做随机化 Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform (FWHT) 旋转，将波动剧烈的幅度分布均匀化为标准正态分布，再用离线训练、MSE 最优的 6-bit Lloyd-Max 量化器逐坐标量化，并叠加 1-bit 量化联合最小二乘 (QJL) 残差校正层。7-bit 虚拟索引被装入原生 8-bit 容器以对齐 CPU 寄存器边界，支持无硬件加速器的实时单线程执行；基准测试显示最多 74.4% 的体积缩减，信噪比 (SQNR) 约 30 dB。
Motivation: 传统有损音频压缩 (如 MP3、AAC、Opus) 依赖心理声学建模和频域表示，计算复杂且领域专用；本文目标是借鉴 LLM 权重量化 (TurboQuant) 的思路，构造一种更简单、数据无关且直接在时域运行的 CPU 友好编解码方案。
Method: 使用正交随机 FWHT 旋转将时域幅度分布转化为可预测的标准正态分布，然后采用离线训练的 MSE 最优 6-bit Lloyd-Max 量化器做逐坐标标量量化，并加入 1-bit 量化联合最小二乘 (QJL) 残差校正层；7-bit 虚拟索引打包进 8-bit 容器以匹配 CPU 寄存器边界，实现实时单线程解码。
Result: 在 24-bit 录音室音轨 (studio stems) 上，摘要报告最多 74.4% 的物理体积缩减，同时维持约 30 dB 的 Signal-to-Quantization-Noise Ratio (SQNR)；论文还给出了位级重建细节、FWHT 蝶形网络分析及稀疏输入下的数学失效模式推导。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AudioTQ 是数据无关、纯时域的 CPU 编解码器，无需并行硬件加速器即可实时单线程运行，并指出了稀疏输入条件下的失效模式；其适用场景为有损音频压缩，而非语音或音乐语义级编解码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Does 1/2-Tsallis-INF Also Work Well for Best-Arm Identification?
papers.abstract_en: Regret minimization (RM) and best-arm identification (BAI) are two fundamental objectives in multi-armed bandits. Among regret-minimizing algorithms, $1/2$-Tsallis-INF is a canonical best-of-both-worlds FTRL algorithm: it achieves logarithmic pseudo-regret in stochastic bandits while retaining minimax-optimal regret in adversarial bandits, without knowing the environment in advance. This raises a natural question: can the same algorithm, without additional exploration, also identify the best arm reliably? We study this question in stochastic bandits by analyzing the failure probability $\operatorname{Err}_t$, defined as the probability that the empirical best arm determined by the cumulative importance-weighted loss estimates of 1/2-Tsallis-INF differs from the true optimal arm. The main difficulty is that, at the logarithmic-regret scale, suboptimal arms are sampled with probability heuristically of order $1/t$. Consequently, importance weighting causes the cumulative estimator to fluctuate on the same linear scale as its mean separation. To overcome this obstacle, guided by a diffusion toy model, we construct a Lyapunov function for the gap process between the estimated cumulative loss of the optimal arm and that of the best competing arm. This leads to polynomial upper bounds on $\operatorname{Err}_t$: for learning rate $η_t=α/\sqrt t$, $\operatorname{Err}_t$ decays at rate $t^{-2+α^2μ_{i_*}/4+ρ}$ for any $ρ>0$, where $μ_{i_*}$ denotes the mean loss of the true optimal arm. We also establish a lower bound $Ω(t^{-2-\varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon>0$, showing that the exponent $2$ is essentially tight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 1/2-Tsallis-INF 这一最佳-of-both-worlds 的 FTRL 算法能否在不额外探索的情况下同时可靠地完成最佳臂识别 (best-arm identification)。作者在随机多臂老虎机中分析错误概率 Err_t，即由累积重要性加权损失估计选出的经验最佳臂与真实最优臂不一致的概率。受扩散玩具模型启发构造 Lyapunov 函数，得到 Err_t 的多项式上界，并建立下界表明指数 2 本质上是紧的。
Motivation: 遗憾最小化 (RM) 与最佳臂识别 (BAI) 是多臂老虎机的两个基本目标。1/2-Tsallis-INF 是 RM 中典范的 best-of-both-worlds 算法，因此在不知道环境的情况下也能在随机与对抗环境中达到最优遗憾；自然的问题是同一算法能否不借助额外探索而可靠地识别最佳臂。
Method: 在随机老虎机中直接分析累积重要性加权损失估计导出的经验最佳臂的错误概率 Err_t。难点在于对数遗憾尺度下一次优臂采样概率约为 1/t，使得重要性加权累积估计在同阶线性尺度上与其均值差波动；作者受扩散玩具模型指导，为最优臂与最佳竞争臂的估计累积损失之差构造 Lyapunov 函数以控制误差。
Result: 得到 Err_t 的多项式上界：当学习率 η_t=α/√t 时，对任意 ρ>0 有 Err_t 以 t^{-2+α^2 μ_{i_*}/4+ρ} 速率衰减，其中 μ_{i_*} 为真实最优臂的平均损失；同时建立下界 Ω(t^{-2-ε})（任意 ε>0），说明衰减指数 2 本质上是紧的。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 1/2-Tsallis-INF 无需额外探索即可在随机老虎机中可靠识别最优臂，且错误概率的指数 2 为紧界；该证明依赖于扩散启发式与 Lyapunov 函数分析，针对特定学习率形式 η_t=α/√t 给出结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Multi-Annotator Study of Segmentation Noise and Uncertainty in Turbid Underwater Images
papers.abstract_en: Label uncertainty and annotator disagreement are common challenges in the field of computer vision, yet their study has largely been confined to the medical domain or to generic image-recognition datasets. Underwater datasets are particularly susceptible to these issues due to the need for domain expertise, degraded visibility conditions, and the inherent difficulty of establishing reliable ground truth in inaccessible environments. Despite these challenges, annotation uncertainty in underwater imagery remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic multi-annotator study of segmentation in real underwater scenes, with over 100 participants, and across varying, controlled levels of turbidity. We show that underwater datasets face many of the same annotation challenges as other vision tasks, while turbidity introduces additional systematic errors. We further investigate the main factors driving label noise and explore ways to improve annotation quality in turbid underwater environments, including privileged information, individual effort and annotator ensembles. All (meta-) data collected in this study will be available on the project page: https://vap.aau.dk/tubcertainty
papers.comment: accepted at ECCVW'26 - 2nd Workshop on Marine Vision
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了首个针对真实水下场景分割任务的大规模多标注者研究，招募超过100名参与者，在受控的不同浊度水平下进行。研究发现水下数据集面临与其他视觉任务类似的标注挑战，且浊度会引入额外的系统性误差；作者还分析了驱动标注噪声的主要因素，并探索利用特权信息、个体努力和标注者集成来改善标注质量。收集的（元）数据将在项目页面公开。
Motivation: 标注不确定性和标注者分歧是计算机视觉中的常见问题，但已有研究多局限于医学领域或通用图像识别数据集。水下图像因需要领域专业知识、能见度退化以及难以在不可达环境中建立可靠真值而尤其容易受影响，但相关标注不确定性此前几乎未被探索。
Method: 作者开展了首个面向真实水下场景分割的系统性多标注者研究，包含100多名参与者，并在受控且变化的浊度水平下进行；通过比较不同标注者结果来分析噪声来源，并测试了特权信息、个体努力以及标注者集成等提高标注质量的策略。
Result: 摘要表明水下数据集面临与其他视觉任务类似的标注挑战，同时浊度会带来额外的系统性误差；研究识别了驱动标注噪声的主要因素，并探索了改善浊度水下环境中标注质量的途径。摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调水下场景的标注不确定性亟待关注，并提出在浊度环境下可通过多种策略改进分割标注质量；研究所收集的数据将在项目页面公开发布，以支持后续研究。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Prediction Inference of Time Series with Standard ReLU Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We propose a methodology based on the standard ReLU Deep Neural Networks (DNN) to make predictions and quantify their uncertainty. Classically, people rely on linear, non-linear, or non-parametric kernel methods to fit and then predict the time series. As the universal approximation ability was revealed for DNN, its application has become more and more popular for prediction tasks in various scientific areas. However, the corresponding uncertainty quantification has not been studied thoroughly. Particularly, the uncertainty in prediction will consist of two parts: (1) the future variability; (2) the estimation variability within training data. To capture both variabilities, we build the so-called pertinent prediction interval (PPI) with the DNN model estimator. We first explore the consistency property of the DNN estimator with beta-mixing dependent data. Subsequently, we show that the implied forward bootstrap series is still beta-mixing and possesses the same stationary distribution as the original time series in probability, which is a key condition to enable the PPI. Lastly, the desired PPI is built after imposing minimal conditions on the limiting distribution of predictive roots. Simulations and real-data analysis are deployed to challenge our approach with standard non-parametric methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于标准 ReLU 深度神经网络（DNN）的时间序列预测与不确定性量化方法，构建所谓的 pertinent prediction interval (PPI)。作者先证明 DNN 估计量在 beta-mixing 依赖数据下的一致性，再说明前向 bootstrap 序列仍保持 beta-mixing 且与原序列具有相同的平稳分布，最后在预测根的极限分布上施加最小条件来构造预测区间。模拟与真实数据分析用于与标准非参数方法对比。
Motivation: 传统时间序列预测依赖线性、非线性或非参数核方法，而 DNN 虽具有万能逼近能力，但其预测对应的不确定性量化尚未被深入研究。
Method: 以标准 ReLU DNN 作为模型估计器，将预测不确定性分解为未来变异性与训练数据内估计变异性两部分；通过证明 DNN 估计量在 beta-mixing 数据下的一致性、以及前向 bootstrap 序列的平稳性保持性质，在较弱的极限分布条件下构建 PPI。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅说明通过模拟与真实数据分析，将该方法与标准非参数方法进行对比以验证其表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提 PPI 方法能够同时刻画未来变异性和估计变异性，并为标准 ReLU DNN 在时间序列预测中的不确定性量化提供了理论条件；未明确讨论应用局限。

papers.title: SAPE: Sandwich Adapters for Parameter Efficiency in Large Language Model Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: While Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has substantially reduced the hardware cost of adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) by decreasing the number of trainable parameters, recent studies have sought to further improve PEFT through parameter sharing. However, these approaches either employ uniform parameter sharing across layers, which can delay convergence, or rely on dynamic masking strategies, which add computational overhead. The potential of sharing patterns inspired by the inherent hierarchical structure of Transformer architectures remains unexplored in PEFT. To address this gap, we introduce SAPE (Sandwich Adapters for Parameter Efficiency), a PEFT framework based on a sandwich-style hard weight-sharing topology. SAPE routes intermediate Transformer layers through balanced shared group adapters while strictly isolating the input embedding and final projection boundary transformations to prevent gradient interference. This design significantly reduces memory consumption while eliminating the computational overhead associated with dynamic parameter-sharing methods. Extensive evaluations across encoder-only and causal decoder architectures demonstrate that SAPE achieves state-of-the-art performance in low-parameter regimes. On natural language understanding, SAPE outperforms proPETL on RoBERTa-large while utilizing only 10% of the baseline's parameter budget. On natural language generation and world knowledge reasoning with LLaMA-3.2 (3B) under a strict ~0.6M parameter constraint, SAPE outperforms AdaLoRA, yielding absolute improvements of +4.85% on GSM8K and +3.11% on CommonsenseQA. Furthermore, through comprehensive topological ablations, we formalize an inherent capacity trade-off: while hard parameter sharing strongly regularizes semantic generalization, it slightly smooths the sharp layer-wise transformations required for rigid multi-step arithmetic reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAPE (Sandwich Adapters for Parameter Efficiency) 提出一种基于三明治式硬权重共享拓扑 (sandwich-style hard weight-sharing) 的大模型参数高效微调框架。它让中间 Transformer 层经由均衡的共享分组适配器 (shared group adapters) 路由，同时严格隔离输入嵌入与最终投影的边界变换以阻止梯度干扰，从而在降低显存消耗的同时避免动态参数共享方法带来的计算开销。实验显示，在低参数预算下 SAPE 达到 SOTA：RoBERTa-large 上仅用 proPETL 的 10% 参数即取得更优结果；在 LLaMA-3.2 (3B) 约 0.6M 参数约束下，相较 AdaLoRA 在 GSM8K 和 CommonsenseQA 上分别绝对提升 +4.85% 与 +3.11%。
Motivation: 现有 PEFT 参数共享方法要么在层间采用统一共享从而延缓收敛，要么依赖动态掩码策略而引入计算开销；受 Transformer 固有分层结构启发的共享模式尚未在 PEFT 中被探索。作者希望在不增加动态开销的前提下进一步降低显存与参数量。
Method: 提出 SAPE 框架，采用三明治式硬权重共享拓扑，将中间 Transformer 层路由到均衡的共享分组适配器，并严格隔离输入嵌入和最终投影的边界变换以防止梯度干扰。该方法属于硬共享 (hard sharing)，因此不引入动态掩码等额外计算开销。
Result: 在自然语言理解上，SAPE 在 RoBERTa-large 上超过 proPETL 且仅使用其 10% 的参数预算；在自然语言生成与世界知识推理上，使用 LLaMA-3.2 (3B) 并在约 0.6M 参数约束下，SAPE 超过 AdaLoRA，GSM8K 提升 +4.85%，CommonsenseQA 提升 +3.11%。拓扑消融实验还形式化了一个内在容量权衡：硬参数共享会强正则化语义泛化，但会轻微平滑多步算术推理所需的锐利逐层变换。
Conclusion: 作者认为三明治式硬共享拓扑能够在低参数预算下达到领先性能，并揭示了硬参数共享在语义泛化与严格多步算术推理之间的容量权衡。

papers.title: Incoherent by Design? On the Moral Self-Consistency of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly used in morally sensitive contexts, yet it is unclear whether they apply ethical principles consistently across situations. A model that can state a moral principle may still violate it when the same scenario is rephrased or reframed. This inconsistency is a problem for any system whose outputs are used to inform moral decisions. If generative systems exhibit internal inconsistency, then the epistemic integrity of AI-mediated systems becomes uncertain. To study this concern, we investigate the stability of moral reasoning in LLMs within a controlled prompting framework across three major philosophical schools of thought: deontology, utilitarianism, and virtue ethics. We construct sets of morally equivalent scenarios in which the underlying situation is held constant while the framing varies to reflect different ethical stances and stylistic perturbations. We then evaluate responses from multiple models, including GPT, Mistral, and Llama. To assess consistency, we convert model outputs into structured logical statements and identify contradictions across responses generated within the same school of thought. Our results reveal substantial inconsistency with contradiction rates reaching up to 78% across scenarios. These findings point to a broader phenomenon of epistemic instability in generative AI wherein models fail to reliably maintain coherence with respect to their own prior outputs. This kind of instability carries real consequences. As generative systems influence how people form beliefs, judge actions, and absorb values, their inconsistencies can shape human reasoning and decision-making as well. Moreover, if a system cannot consistently represent its own normative commitments, then value alignment becomes a moving target rather than a well-defined objective. Thus, we argue that demonstrating internal incoherence is a necessary precursor to AI alignment.
papers.comment: 88 pages; pages 16 to 88 are the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在多类道德情境下是否保持自我一致性。作者在受控提示框架下，基于道义论、功利主义和美德伦理学三种哲学流派构造了底层情境相同、仅改变框架的道德等价场景，并评估 GPT、Mistral 和 Llama 等模型。通过将输出转化为结构化逻辑命题并检测同一流派内回答间的矛盾，结果发现矛盾率最高达 78%，表明模型在自身先前输出上缺乏可靠的一致性，作者据此论证展示内部不一致是 AI 对齐的必要前提。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地被用于道德敏感场景，但模型能否跨情境一致地应用伦理原则尚不明确；一个能陈述道德原则的模型可能在场景改写或重新框架后违背该原则。这种不一致会损害 AI 中介系统的认知完整性（epistemic integrity），也使价值对齐（value alignment）成为移动目标而非明确定义的目标。
Method: 采用受控提示框架，围绕道义论、功利主义和美德伦理学构造道德等价场景：保持底层情境不变，变换框架以反映不同伦理立场和风格扰动；随后在 GPT、Mistral、Llama 等多个模型上生成回答，并将回答转换为结构化逻辑命题，通过识别同一哲学流派内的逻辑矛盾来评估一致性。
Result: 摘要报告在多种场景中检测到显著的不一致性，同一流派内回答的矛盾率最高达到 78%，说明模型无法与其自身既往输出保持连贯。
Conclusion: 作者认为，生成式系统在道德推理上的内部不一致反映了生成式 AI 中更广泛的认知不稳定现象，并会影响人的信念形成与决策；因此，证明内部不一致性是 AI 对齐的必要前提。

papers.title: Decomposing Whole Slide Image Report Generation with Graph-Constrained Multiple Instance Learning Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Whole-slide image (WSI) report generation requires recognizing spatially distributed pathological features and organizing them into a coherent diagnostic narrative. Although direct vision-to-text models can yield fluent reports, they obscure the contributions and failure modes of visual recognition, structured reasoning, and language generation. We propose a decomposed framework in which frozen Virchow2 tile embeddings are aggregated by multiple-instance learning (MIL) classification heads that answer organ-specific diagnostic questions. An organ-conditioned graph constrains the assembly of these answers into a structured reasoning chain, which a language model realizes as a pathology report. On the REG2026 held-out set of 2,028 slides, the proposed workflow achieved a chain-Jaccard score of 0.702. Performance fell to 0.420 without graph-based chain construction, 0.398 when the organ-specific graphs were replaced by a single organ-agnostic graph, and 0.371 when the language model constructed the chain freely from MIL predictions. Using the same report generator, graph-structured chains improved the report score from 0.330 to 0.495. On 350 external TCGA WSIs spanning the seven REG organs without fine-tuning, the expected organ graph was selected in 64.0% of cases and ranked among the top three in 86.6%. Providing the correct organ graph increased agreement with coarse TCGA primary-diagnosis labels from 61.8% to 92.6%, identifying organ routing as a main bottleneck under domain shift. Overall, organ-conditioned, graph-constrained chain assembly improves structured reasoning and report generation while enabling stage-specific error localization.
papers.comment: Accepted at the MICCAI 2026 REG Challenge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种分解式全玻片图像 (whole-slide image, WSI) 报告生成框架，将冻结的 Virchow2 切片嵌入经过多实例学习 (MIL) 分类头回答器官特异的诊断问题，再由器官条件图约束答案组装为结构化推理链，最后由语言模型生成病理报告。在 REG2026 留出集 2,028 张切片上链式 Jaccard 分数为 0.702，并展示了图约束链式组装相对无图、无器官图或自由链构造的显著优势。
Motivation: 直接视觉到文本的 WSI 报告生成虽然流畅，但掩盖了视觉识别、结构化推理和语言生成各自的贡献与失败模式；目标是让报告生成过程可分解、可定位错误并支持结构化推理。
Method: 冻结 Virchow2 切片嵌入，通过 MIL 分类头回答器官特异诊断问题；器官条件图 (organ-conditioned graph) 约束这些答案组装成结构化推理链，再由语言模型将推理链实现为病理报告。

Conclusion: 器官条件化、图约束的链式组装能改善结构化推理与报告生成，并支持阶段级错误定位；摘要指出器官路由 (organ routing) 是域迁移下的主要瓶颈。

papers.title: Spectral Rank Certification for Foundation Model Adapters
papers.abstract_en: Nominal LoRA rank is a design parameter; calibrated spectral evidence is a separate inferential quantity. This article develops a finite-sample framework for inferring effective rank structure in public foundation-model adapters. The theoretical core is an exact chi-square divergence for the fixed-dimensional Gaussian rank-one reference experiment, with an unknown signal direction integrated under a rotation-invariant reference prior. The resulting series yields a computable finite-sample Le Cam bound at concrete layer sizes, an explicit remainder bound for numerical truncation, and the rectangular Baik-Ben Arous-Peche (BBP) limit. A compact-manifold Laplace expansion shows that finite-sample likelihood evidence also depends on leading spectral gaps through the factor $s_1^{|m-n|}\prod_{i\ge2}(s_1^2-s_i^2)$, motivating joint calibration of clustered singular values. Building on these results, we introduce an empirical-null workflow for PEFT LoRA adapters: factor reconstruction, Monte Carlo $p$-values, stagewise and block testing, and module-wise and corpus-level BH reporting. In an audit of 26 public adapters, 684 modules, six architecture families, and 31,770 public-checkpoint spectra rows, calibrated effective rank is typically much smaller than nominal rank and differs systematically from 95\% energy retention. A measured RoBERTa-RTE slice on $n=24$ examples illustrates the measurement path from calibrated ranks to task evaluation, without treating the slice as a utility study. The main empirical finding is that calibrated effective rank is usually far below nominal rank, and that energy retention and statistical surprise answer different questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文研究基础模型 LoRA 适配器的有效秩推断，提出一套有限样本统计框架。理论核心是固定维高斯秩一参考实验的精确卡方散度，并据此得到可计算的有限样本 Le Cam 界、数值截断余项界以及矩形 Baik-Ben Arous-Peche (BBP) 极限；紧流形 Laplace 展开进一步表明似然证据依赖于主导谱间隙。实证审计 26 个公开适配器、684 个模块后发现，校准有效秩通常远小于名义秩，并与 95% 能量保持存在系统性差异。
Motivation: LoRA 的名义秩只是设计参数，而基于谱证据的有效秩是独立的推断量；现有工作缺乏对公开基础模型适配器有效秩结构的校准推断方法。作者希望回答校准有效秩与名义秩及能量保持标准之间的系统性差异。
Method: 提出经验零分布 (empirical-null) 工作流：在旋转不变参考先验下积分未知信号方向，导出精确卡方散度、有限样本 Le Cam 界与矩形 BBP 极限，并构建因子重构、Monte Carlo p 值、阶段与块检验，以及模块级和语料级 BH 报告流程。
Result: 对 26 个公开适配器、684 个模块、6 个架构族和 31,770 行公开 checkpoint 谱数据的审计显示，校准有效秩通常远小于名义秩，且与 95% 能量保留系统性偏离；RoBERTa-RTE 在 n=24 样例上的切片展示了从校准秩到任务评估的测量路径。
Conclusion: 作者强调校准有效秩通常远低于名义秩，且能量保持与统计显著性回答的是不同问题；该框架通过聚类奇异值的联合校准为 PEFT LoRA 适配器提供谱秩认证途径。摘要未讨论方法本身的局限。

papers.title: ENAF: A Multi-Exit Network with an Adaptive Patch Fusion for Large Image Super Resolution
papers.abstract_en: To accelerate single image super-resolution (SISR) networks on large images (2K-8K), many recent approaches decompose an image into small patches and dynamically determine an execution path according to its difficulty (referred to as a dynamic network). To quantify the hardness of a patch, they mainly rely on a handcrafted assessment score, e.g., edge, which weakly associates a patch's texture with the computational complexity of a SISR model. To address the problem, we introduce ENAF - a dynamic network for SISR with an adaptive patch fusion. Built on top of a backbone, ENAF incorporates multiple early exits (EEs) to tackle the over-parameterized SISR model. More importantly, ENAF plugs a tiny network that estimates PSNR to associate data texture with a computation cost at an EE. Based on the scores, ENAF effectively assigns image patches to an exit, enhancing the quality-complexity trade-off. Extensive experiments on common datasets with popular SISR backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of ENAF in various settings. The source code is provided in https://github.com/nmduonggg/ENAF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大尺寸图像（2K-8K）的超分辨率（SISR）加速问题，提出 ENAF——一种基于自适应补丁融合的动态网络。ENAF 在骨干网络上增加多个早期退出（early exits, EEs），并训练一个小型网络估计每个补丁的 PSNR，从而将图像纹理复杂度与计算成本关联，动态地将补丁分配到不同退出点。在常见数据集和流行 SISR 骨干上的实验表明其提升了质量-复杂度权衡，代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有动态网络方法主要依赖手工设计的评估分数（如边缘）来衡量补丁难度，这种分数与 SISR 模型计算复杂度之间的关联较弱，导致执行路径分配不够精准。
Method: ENAF 在骨干网络上集成多个早期退出（EEs），并引入一个预测 PSNR 的微型网络，用该分数将每个图像补丁动态分配到某个退出点，从而实现自适应补丁级执行路径选择。
Result: 在常见数据集上与多种流行 SISR 骨干结合的大量实验显示，ENAF 在不同设置下均能有效改善质量与计算复杂度之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要指出通过估计 PSNR 将数据纹理与计算成本关联，可以弥补手工难度分数的不足，提升动态 SISR 网络的质量-复杂度权衡。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Feed-Forward Hierarchical Gaussian Diffusion for Extreme CT Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing three-dimensional computed tomography (CT) from severely constrained projections is highly ill-posed. Sparse angular sampling, restricted angular coverage, and low photon counts can occur individually or jointly, obscuring global anatomy and local tissue detail. Many learned CT reconstruction methods are tailored to a single dominant degradation. Existing diffusion and Gaussian approaches commonly recover global structure and local detail within a shared representation. We propose HiGDiff, a feed-forward hierarchical Gaussian diffusion framework that decomposes reconstruction both spatially and from structure to detail. Physics-conditioned anatomical anchors and a foreground capacity field allocate learnable Gaussian primitives to informative regions. A structure diffusion stage first recovers global attenuation geometry, and its learned representation conditions a detail diffusion stage for residual boundaries and tissue transitions. The resulting Gaussian banks are rendered as attenuation fields and further refined by a gradient-isolated residual module. Experiments on three distinct CT benchmark datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art reconstruction performance across isolated, paired, and joint degradation settings, including improvements of 5.81 dB in macro-average peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and 0.113 in structural similarity index measure (SSIM) on the Low Dose CT Image and Projection Data (LDCT-PD) collection. Code and experimental configurations are openly available at https://github.com/Bean-Young/HiGDiff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiGDiff，一个前馈式分层高斯扩散框架，用于从严重受限投影中重建三维 CT。该方法将重建按空间和从结构到细节两个维度分解：物理条件化的解剖锚点与前景容量场分配可学习的高斯原语，结构扩散阶段先恢复全局衰减几何，其表示再条件化细节扩散阶段以恢复残差边界与组织过渡，最后将高斯库渲染为衰减场并用梯度隔离残差模块细化。在三个 CT 基准上的实验表明，该方法在孤立、成对和联合退化设置下均达到最先进性能，其中在 LDCT-PD 上宏观平均 PSNR 提升 5.81 dB、SSIM 提升 0.113，代码已公开。
Motivation: 从严重受限投影（稀疏角度采样、受限角度覆盖和低光子计数单独或联合出现）重建三维 CT 是高度病态问题，现有学习式重建方法通常只针对单一主导退化，而现有扩散与高斯方法往往在共享表示中同时恢复全局结构与局部细节，缺乏显式的分层分解。
Method: 提出 HiGDiff 前馈分层高斯扩散框架：用物理条件化的解剖锚点和前景容量场将可学习高斯原语分配到信息丰富区域；结构扩散阶段先恢复全局衰减几何，再用其学习到的表示条件化细节扩散阶段，恢复残差边界与组织过渡；得到的 Gaussian banks 被渲染为衰减场，并通过梯度隔离残差模块进一步细化。
Result: 在三个不同的 CT 基准数据集上的实验显示，该方法在孤立、成对和联合退化设置下均取得最优重建性能；在 LDCT-PD 数据集上，宏观平均 PSNR 提升 5.81 dB，SSIM 提升 0.113。
Conclusion: 作者认为将重建从结构到细节、从全局到局部进行前馈分层分解，可有效应对多种退化单独或联合出现的情形，并在基准上取得优于现有方法的表现；代码与实验配置已开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TEA: Text Encoder Alignment for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models can be misused to generate harmful content through adversarial or paraphrased prompts that bypass built-in safety mechanisms. Existing concept erasure methods often suffer from limited robustness against adversarial prompts, degradation of benign generation quality, or reliance on inference-time interventions that introduce persistent computational overhead. To address these limitations, we formulate concept erasure as a domain alignment problem in the text representation space. We propose a lightweight Text Encoder Alignment framework (TEA) that fine-tunes only the text encoder while keeping the generative backbone fully frozen. Given concept--anchor prompt pairs, our method trains a discriminator to distinguish token-level representations of concept-containing prompts from those of safe anchor prompts, while updating the text encoder to make these representations indistinguishable. TEA introduces zero inference-time overhead and requires only a small number of fine-tuning steps, making it highly efficient to deploy at scale. Despite this efficiency, TEA achieves state-of-the-art erasure robustness against black-box and white-box adversarial attacks on Stable Diffusion v1.4, while preserving generation quality on benign prompts. Furthermore, TEA is model-agnostic and achieves the lowest attack success rate on Stable Diffusion v3.5, extending concept erasure to a Rectified Flow Transformer architecture with T5 conditioning where prior methods remain largely unexplored. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/alirezafarashah/TEA.git}{https://github.com/alirezafarashah/TEA.git}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种文本编码器对齐框架 TEA，将文本到图像扩散模型中的概念擦除 (concept erasure) 建模为文本表示空间的域对齐问题。方法仅微调文本编码器，保持生成骨干网络完全冻结，通过判别器与对抗训练使含概念提示与安全锚定提示的 token 级表示不可区分。TEA 在推理阶段零额外开销，只需少量微调步骤，并在 Stable Diffusion v1.4 上对黑盒与白盒对抗攻击取得最先进的擦除鲁棒性，同时保持良性提示的生成质量。
Motivation: 现有概念擦除方法对对抗性或改写提示的鲁棒性有限，且常导致良性生成质量下降，或依赖推理时干预带来持续计算开销。
Method: 给定概念-锚定提示对，训练判别器区分含概念提示与安全锚定提示的 token 级表示，同时更新文本编码器使两类表示不可区分；生成骨干完全冻结，推理阶段无额外成本。
Result: 在 Stable Diffusion v1.4 上，TEA 对黑盒与白盒对抗攻击取得最先进的擦除鲁棒性，同时保持良性提示生成质量；在 Stable Diffusion v3.5 (Rectified Flow Transformer + T5 条件) 上取得最低攻击成功率，且方法不依赖特定模型架构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调仅调整文本编码器的域对齐思路可高效实现鲁棒的概念擦除，并扩展到此前方法尚未充分探索的 Rectified Flow Transformer 架构。

papers.title: When AI Rewrites, Classifiers Relax: Uncertainty-Aware Sentiment Analysis on Sarcastic and AI-Paraphrased Social Text
papers.abstract_en: Sentiment classifiers are increasingly applied to social media content that is either sarcastic or AI-generated --- two distributional regimes where standard evaluations offer little guidance. We present a three-part empirical study of sentiment classifier behaviour under these conditions. First, we find that confidence scores on sarcastic text are significantly lower than on non-sarcastic text (Mann--Whitney $p = 2 \times 10^{-6}$), confirming that classifiers sense their own uncertainty on ironic content even without explicit uncertainty modelling. Second, and counterintuitively, we show that sentiment classifiers achieve higher accuracy on AI-paraphrased reviews than on the original human-authored text (RoBERTa: $+5.8$ pp for Qwen3.5-4B paraphrases, $+3.7$ pp for Gemma4-E4B), revealing a cross-domain stylistic alignment effect: AI paraphrases remove distributional noise that confounds Twitter-trained classifiers, producing cleaner, more prototypical sentiment text. Third, we demonstrate that a lightweight abstention wrapper --- flagging the $14\%$ of inputs with confidence below $0.6$ --- improves accuracy from 82.2\% to 88.9\% ($+6.7$ pp) on the retained set. We further compare Semantic Entropy and MC-Dropout-style disagreement as uncertainty signals and find near-identical AUROC ($0.650$ vs.\ $0.646$) on sarcastic text, suggesting that for short social media inputs, both methods are interchangeable. Our results motivate a shift from confident single-label prediction to uncertainty-aware abstention in high-stakes sentiment applications such as mental health flagging and content moderation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对情感分类器在讽刺文本和 AI 改写文本上的行为做了三部分实证研究。研究发现：分类器在讽刺文本上的置信度显著低于非讽刺文本（Mann–Whitney p = 2×10⁻⁶）；AI 改写的评论比原始人类文本获得更高分类准确率（RoBERTa 在 Qwen3.5-4B 改写上 +5.8 pp，在 Gemma4-E4B 改写上 +3.7 pp），作者将其归因于跨领域风格对齐效应；一个轻量弃权包装器（标记置信度低于 0.6 的 14% 输入）将保留集准确率从 82.2% 提升到 88.9%（+6.7 pp）。此外，Semantic Entropy 与 MC-Dropout 式分歧在讽刺文本上的 AUROC 几乎相同（0.650 对 0.646）。
Motivation: 情感分类器正被越来越多地应用到具有讽刺性或 AI 生成的社交媒体内容上，而标准评测在这两种分布偏移场景下几乎没有指导作用。为了在高风险应用中可靠部署，需要系统了解分类器在这些条件下的行为与不确定性。
Method: 作者设计了三部分实证研究：比较讽刺与非讽刺文本的置信度分布；在 AI 改写评论与原始人工评论上对比情感分类准确率；并测试一个轻量级弃权（abstention）包装器，即对置信度低于阈值的输入拒绝预测，同时比较 Semantic Entropy 和 MC-Dropout 式分歧作为不确定性信号。
Result: 摘要报告讽刺文本的置信度显著更低；AI 改写文本分类准确率高于原文（RoBERTa：Qwen3.5-4B 改写 +5.8 pp，Gemma4-E4B 改写 +3.7 pp）；弃权包装器在保留集上实现 +6.7 pp 准确率提升（82.2% 到 88.9%）；两种不确定性信号在讽刺文本上的 AUROC 相近（0.650 对 0.646）。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果支持在高风险情感应用（如心理健康标记和内容审核）中从自信的单标签预测转向不确定性感知的弃权机制。

papers.title: The Physical Cutoff Does Not Restore Homogenization: Phase-Dependent Burning in the Strain G-Equation
papers.abstract_en: We disprove the expectation stated by Xin, Yu, and Ronney that the physical positive part strain $G$-equation should possess an effective burning velocity in cellular flows. For the standard cellular flow in dimension two $V_A(x_1,x_2)=A(-\sin x_1\cos x_2,\cos x_1\sin x_2)$, if $0<d<20/399$ and $\sqrt{1+4d^2}<Ad\le1+d/10$, then for every unit planar slope the periodic correction develops oscillations at least linearly in time. The solution remains bounded below on an explicit horizontal channel through $(π,0)$, while at $(π/2,0)$ it decreases at rate at least $CA/\log A$, with $C>0$ universal. The same conclusions hold for arbitrary continuous periodic perturbations of planar initial data. Under the physical scaling $V_A(x/\varepsilon)$ and $d_\varepsilon=\varepsilon d$, an order one value gap persists between points at distance $O(\varepsilon)$ at every positive macroscopic time, so the rescaled solutions have no locally uniformly convergent subsequence. The proof uses the Hamiltonian sandwich $H_{\mathrm{unc}}\le H_+\le\widehat H$. The upper comparator $\widehat H$ is a rectangular support function, equivalently an upper expectation over a state-dependent credal set, whose reversed control dynamics possess an invariant comparison channel. We also prove that for any $C^2$ incompressible periodic flow, every $\varepsilon$-outward barrier certificate has covering radius at most $2d\varepsilon$ for all sufficiently small $\varepsilon$. We further discuss implications for statistics and machine learning: rectangular, time-consistent local uncertainty need not imply forgetting of the initial state in the long run, so additional global stability or ergodicity conditions are needed in robust sequential decision making. Two Lean 4 appendices record conditional formalizations of a sufficient $p=e_1$ subregime and of the logical assembly of the rigidity theorem for barrier certificates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文否证了 Xin、Yu 与 Ronney 关于物理正部应变 G-方程 (strain G-equation) 在细胞流 (cellular flow) 中应具有有效燃烧速度的预期。对二维标准细胞流，在参数范围 0<d<20/399 且 sqrt(1+4d^2)<Ad≤1+d/10 内，每个单位平面斜率的周期修正都至少线性振荡；溶液在显式水平通道内保持有下界，而在 (π/2,0) 处以至少 CA/log A 的速率下降。物理缩放 V_A(x/ε) 与 d_ε=εd 下，任意正宏观时刻 O(ε) 距离两点间存在 O(1) 量级的值差，因此重标度解不存在局部一致收敛子列。
Motivation: 该工作针对一个此前被期待成立的结论——物理正部应变 G-方程在细胞流中应具备有效燃烧速度——给出反例式否证，并由此指出稳健序贯决策中局部不确定性传播的长期行为需要额外假设。
Method: 证明依赖哈密顿夹逼 (Hamiltonian sandwich) H_unc≤H_+≤Ĥ：上比较器 Ĥ 被构造为矩形支撑函数，等价于状态依赖 credal 集上的上期望，其反向控制动力学具有不变比较通道。作者还证明对任意 C^2 不可压周期流，每个 ε-向外屏障证书的覆盖半径至多 2dε；两个 Lean 4 附录记录了充分 p=e_1 子情形及屏障证书刚性定理逻辑组装的条件化形式化。
Result: 摘要报告：在指定参数范围下，周期修正随时间至少线性增长，且 (π/2,0) 处值下降速率下界为 CA/log A，C>0 为普适常数；对平面初始数据的任意连续周期扰动同样成立。物理缩放后，O(ε) 间距点之间的值差保持为 O(1)，故不存在局部一致收敛子列。
Conclusion: 作者强调，矩形且时间一致的局部不确定性并不必然意味着长期中会遗忘初始状态；因此稳健序贯决策 (robust sequential decision making) 需要额外的全局稳定性或遍历性条件。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SAGE-OR: Semi-supervised Adaptive Scene Graph Generation for Operating Rooms
papers.abstract_en: Current surgical scene graph generation methods depend on dense multi-modal supervision and specialized hardware (synchronized RGB-D sensors, calibration rigs), making dataset construction expensive and restricting all existing benchmarks to simulated environments. We propose SAGE-OR, a feature-centric framework that replaces the traditional detect-then-reason paradigm with a decoupled representation-reasoning paradigm in which localization is derived from frozen foundation models, encoded implicitly in pre-computed features, and used without any localization supervision, while a lightweight graph transformer performs relational reasoning over cached features. We employ a semi-supervised formulation with general-purpose segmentation prompts to eliminate localization supervision while enabling unsupervised context augmentation through additional prompt-driven entities, such as hands, which are absent from annotations. General-purpose prompts are used to induce near-perfect recall, while precision is delegated to downstream attention-based reasoning, enabling simple adaptation to new entities via prompt-level modification. This design enables a lightweight 15M-parameter graph transformer that trains in 1.4 hours and runs relational inference at $\sim$1ms per frame with peak memory under 2GB, suitable for edge hardware used in the operating room; feature extraction runs offline as a separate caching stage (4.27s per frame). On the 4D-OR benchmark, the core model achieves 76% F1, matching the fully supervised 4D-OR baseline while eliminating all localization annotations, and unsupervised hand augmentation raises this to 86%, within 4 points of state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods requiring dense multi-modal supervision, providing a practical pathway for adaptation to new surgical settings without annotation other than relationship and class labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGE-OR，一个面向手术室场景的半监督自适应场景图生成框架。它放弃传统的 detect-then-reason 范式，改用解耦的 representation-reasoning 范式：定位信息由冻结的 foundation models 隐式编码在预计算特征中，无需任何定位监督，轻量图 transformer 在缓存特征上进行关系推理。在 4D-OR 基准上，核心模型达到 76% F1，与需要完整标注的监督基线持平；加入无监督手部实体增强后达到 86%，距离依赖密集多模态监督的 SOTA 方法仅差 4 个点。
Motivation: 现有手术场景图生成方法依赖密集多模态监督和专用硬件（如同步 RGB-D 传感器、标定装置），导致数据集构建昂贵，且所有现有基准都局限于仿真环境。
Method: 提出特征中心的 SAGE-OR 框架，用预计算特征隐式编码定位信息，以消除定位标注；采用半监督公式，用通用分割提示（general-purpose segmentation prompts）实现无监督上下文增强，例如引入标注中不存在的手部实体，并利用注意力机制保证召回率与精度。
Result: 在 4D-OR 基准上，核心模型取得 76% F1，与完全监督基准持平且无需定位标注；无监督手部增强将 F1 提升至 86%，距需要密集多模态监督的 SOTA 仅差 4 个点。模型仅 15M 参数，训练 1.4 小时，推理约 1ms/帧，峰值内存低于 2GB，特征提取作为离线阶段为 4.27s/帧。
Conclusion: SAGE-OR 提供了一条无需定位标注即可适配新手术场景的实际路径，仅需关系和类别标签，并适配手术室边缘硬件。

papers.title: A concentration result for multilayer feedforward neural networks
papers.abstract_en: We consider for an arbitrary fixed $ρ$ and for each positive integer $n$ a multilayer feedforward artificial neural network with $ρ$ layers, $n$ neurons in the first layer (the input layer) and only one neuron, the output neuron, in the last layer. Very roughly formulated, the main result is that if the distribution of weights of connections from a layer to the next are, for all large $n$, approximated well by a fixed continuous (but otherwise arbitrary) curve which does not depend on $n$, and if the values of the $n$ input neurons are independently and identically distributed with a continuous probability density function, then there is a number $ψ$ such that for all $\varepsilon > 0$ the probability that the value of the output neuron is in $[ψ- \varepsilon, ψ+ \varepsilon]$ tends to 1 as $n$ tends to infinity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一类多层前馈神经网络（层数固定为ρ，输入层有n个神经元，最后一层只有一个输出神经元）的浓度现象。摘要表明，若连接权重的分布对任意大的n都能被一条固定的连续曲线很好地逼近，且n个输入神经元取值独立同分布并具有连续概率密度函数，则存在常数ψ，使得对任意ε>0，输出神经元的取值落在[ψ-ε, ψ+ε]内的概率随n趋于无穷而趋于1。
Motivation: 该问题关注随机或近似确定性权重配置下大规模前馈神经网络输出行为的统计稳定性，为理解网络在规模增大时的典型表现提供理论基础。
Method: 作者对固定层数ρ和每层n个神经元直至单个输出神经元的架构，在权重分布逼近固定连续曲线、输入独立同分布且具有连续概率密度函数的假设下，建立输出值集中于某点邻域的概率极限结果。
Result: 主要结果为存在ψ，使得对所有ε>0，输出神经元值落入[ψ-ε, ψ+ε]的概率在n趋于无穷时趋于1，即输出值呈弱大数定律式的浓度现象。
Conclusion: 该结果是关于一类多层前馈神经网络输出概率分布的渐近浓度定理，其成立依赖于权重分布被固定连续曲线逼近以及输入为连续i.i.d.的设定。

summary_sections.motivation: 该问题关注随机或近似确定性权重配置下大规模前馈神经网络输出行为的统计稳定性，为理解网络在规模增大时的典型表现提供理论基础。
summary_sections.method: 作者对固定层数ρ和每层n个神经元直至单个输出神经元的架构，在权重分布逼近固定连续曲线、输入独立同分布且具有连续概率密度函数的假设下，建立输出值集中于某点邻域的概率极限结果。
summary_sections.result: 主要结果为存在ψ，使得对所有ε>0，输出神经元值落入[ψ-ε, ψ+ε]的概率在n趋于无穷时趋于1，即输出值呈弱大数定律式的浓度现象。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该结果是关于一类多层前馈神经网络输出概率分布的渐近浓度定理，其成立依赖于权重分布被固定连续曲线逼近以及输入为连续i.i.d.的设定。

papers.title: GFCM: A Tail-Sensitive Mixed-Type Conditional Independence Test for Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Constraint-based causal discovery like PC and FCI depends on its conditional independence test. Partial correlation and the Generalised Covariance Measure (GCM) detect only the conditional covariance of residuals, so they miss dependence in the mean's nonlinear part, the scale, and the tails. Tests that detect more are biased inside PC, not scalable, only continuous, or not aimed at the tails. Our Generalised Feature Covariance Measure (GFCM) is valid, sensitive beyond covariance, robust inside PC, and applicable to mixed-type data. It runs the GCM template on a configurable set of residual features with conditional mean zero (centered moments and conditional quantile indicators), pooled in blocks and combined by the Cauchy rule, with a growing-knot spline nuisance at regression cost. We contribute (i) a centering result making the scale feature Neyman orthogonal, where the uncentered version is biased; (ii) the orientation asymmetry the mean-quantile construction creates inside PC, and its fix; (iii) a Phi-faithfulness theory under which PC with GFCM recovers the CPDAG of the set's detection class; and (iv) a benchmark of CI tests sensitive beyond covariance on synthetic data, semi-synthetic tail injections, and PC discovery on random DAGs. Under size-corrected power, GFCM recovers the scale and tail edges the covariance family misses and alone keeps power at the deep conditioning sets PC issues. It stays calibrated as n grows, whereas FFCI, the boosted GCM, and the partial copula test do not, and it handles mixed-type data directly. Inside PC at scale it attains the lowest skeleton SHD among tests that stay calibrated, while the others inflate false edges. Validity rests on an additive nuisance, and the tail advantage is shown on simulated and semi-synthetic data, as no fully real benchmark with both heavy tails and known structure exists.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GFCM（Generalised Feature Covariance Measure），一种用于约束式因果发现（如 PC、FCI）的混合类型条件独立性检验，旨在捕捉协方差之外的均值非线性、尺度与尾部依赖。作者在 GCM 模板上加入可配置的条件零均值残差特征（中心矩与条件分位数指标），分块合并并经 Cauchy 规则组合，同时发展出 Neyman 正交的尺度特征、PC 内部的取向不对称性修正以及 Phi-忠实性理论。模拟与半合成数据表明 GFCM 在尺寸校正功效下能恢复协方差族遗漏的尺度与尾部边，并在 PC 深层条件集下保持功效，而其他超越协方差的检验会失效。
Motivation: 约束式因果发现（PC、FCI）依赖条件独立性检验，但偏相关和广义协方差度量（GCM）只检测残差的条件协方差，会遗漏均值非线性部分、尺度与尾部的依赖；现有更灵敏的检验在 PC 中有偏、不可扩展、仅适用于连续数据或不针对尾部。
Method: GFCM 在 GCM 模板上运行一组条件均值为零的残差特征（中心矩与条件分位数指标），按块合并并用 Cauchy 规则组合，配以增长结点样条 (growing-knot spline) 作为回归代价。作者贡献包括：使尺度特征满足 Neyman 正交的中心化结果、均数-分位数构造在 PC 内产生的取向不对称性及其修正、Phi-忠实性理论，以及超协方差敏感 CI 检验的基准测试。
Result: 在尺寸校正功效下，GFCM 恢复了协方差族遗漏的尺度与尾部边，并在 PC 发出的深层条件集 (deep conditioning sets) 上独自保持功效；GFCM 在 n 增长时保持校准，而 FFCI、增强 GCM 与偏 copula 检验则不然。在大规模 PC 中，GFCM 在校准的检验里取得最低骨架 SHD，其他检验则膨胀假边。
Conclusion: 方法的有效性依赖于加性扰动项 (additive nuisance)，尾部优势在模拟与半合成数据上验证；作者指出目前不存在兼具重尾与已知结构的完全真实基准。

papers.title: The Benchmark Trap: Structures of Power and Injustice in AI Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) benchmarks are not neutral tools of evaluation but socio-technical artefacts that shape competition, power, and research priorities within AI. Benchmarks standardise the assessment of systems and facilitate the creation of leaderboards that reward state-of-the-art performance with prestige, citations, trust, and institutional influence. As the costs of developing competitive AI systems rise, these rewards increasingly concentrate among powerful, industry-funded labs. This paper situates these concerns within Iris Marion Young's theories of oppression and structural injustice. It argues that current benchmarking practices may perpetuate systematic harms affecting various actors in AI research, aligning with four of Young's "faces of oppression". Benchmarking culture is further framed as a source of structural injustice, as these harms emerge from normalised, individually defensible practices and network effects, even without explicit wrongdoing. By reinforcing existing power structures and narrowing possible research trajectories, benchmarking may in fact prevent the field from advancing in epistemically robust and socially beneficial ways.
papers.comment: to appear in the proceedings of AIES 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AI 基准测试并非中立的评估工具，而是塑造竞争、权力与研究优先级的社会技术制品 (socio-technical artefact)。作者借助 Iris Marion Young 的压迫与结构性不公正理论，论证基准文化可能与四种“压迫面”相符，并通过常态化实践与网络效应造成结构性不公正，最终限制研究轨迹并阻碍知识上稳健且对社会有益的进展。
Motivation: 基准测试被默认为中立评估手段，但作者指出其在塑造竞争与奖励分配，且随系统开发成本上升，回报日益集中于大型行业实验室，可能对 AI 研究中的不同参与者造成系统性伤害。
Method: 该论文为理论性分析：将基准测试实践置于 Iris Marion Young 的压迫与结构性不公正理论框架中，论证基准文化对应四种“压迫面”，并将由此产生的伤害解释为来自正常化、个体上可辩护的做法与网络效应的结构性不公正。
Conclusion: 作者主张，基准测试通过强化既有权力结构和窄化可能的研究方向，可能阻碍领域以认识论上稳健且对社会有益的方式发展。

papers.title: Logical Embeddings for Argument Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new framework for machine-learning-oriented argument analysis tasks. Our proposal involves replacing traditional contextualized word embeddings used in most NLP tasks with logical embeddings, an alternative encoding that directly exploits argumentation structures. In essence, logical embeddings encapsulate the logical semantics of an argument, allowing for a better representation of its meaning. Supporting these embeddings is a mathematical logic-based similarity measure that offers a transparent notion of proximity and is guaranteed to satisfy several desirable theoretical properties that current cosine similarity-based contextualized word embeddings cannot assure. This similarity measure induces a positive semi-definite kernel on the set of arguments, enabling us to uniquely define logical embeddings using the theory of Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces (RKHS). Moreover, we prove that this encoding is optimal, in the sense that no logical information is lost in the process. As with other RKHS applications, logical embeddings can be used in numerous supervised and unsupervised tasks. We provide an implementation of the method and aim to test it against literature benchmarks. Additionally, we demonstrate that logical embeddings outperform most standard embedding methods on a classification task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向机器学习驱动的论证分析任务的新框架，用逻辑嵌入 (logical embeddings) 替代常见的上下文词嵌入 (contextualized word embeddings)，直接利用论证结构来编码论证的逻辑语义。作者基于数学逻辑的相似度度量，借助 Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces (RKHS) 理论唯一地定义逻辑嵌入，并证明该编码在逻辑信息不丢失的意义下是最优的。摘要还宣称在分类任务上，逻辑嵌入优于大多数标准嵌入方法。
Motivation: 现有 NLP 任务普遍使用的上下文词嵌入缺乏对论证结构的显式利用，且基于余弦相似度的邻近性缺乏透明度和可保证的理论性质，难以满足论证分析对语义表示和可解释性的需求。
Method: 提出用逻辑嵌入封装论证的逻辑语义，并设计一个基于数理逻辑的相似度度量；该度量满足若干理想的数学性质并诱导正半定核 (positive semi-definite kernel)，从而借助 RKHS 理论唯一地构造逻辑嵌入，同时证明该编码过程不会丢失逻辑信息。
Result: 摘要报告在某个分类任务上，逻辑嵌入优于大多数标准嵌入方法；作者提供了方法实现，并计划在文献基准上进行测试。
Conclusion: 该方法具有理论保证，可应用于多种有监督和无监督任务，但其性能优势目前仅在一个分类任务上得到演示，尚待更广泛的基准验证。

papers.title: LightLoc++: Sensor-Robust Representation Learning for Efficient Outdoor LiDAR Localization
papers.abstract_en: Scene coordinate regression (SCR) achieves strong performance in outdoor LiDAR localization, but it usually requires scene-specific training that can take days, limiting practical deployment. Recent works improve training efficiency by decoupling SCR into a scene-agnostic backbone and scene-specific prediction heads, where the backbone is pretrained on source datasets and frozen for new scenes, and only lightweight heads are optimized. However, we find that this paradigm heavily depends on the pretrained backbone. Existing decoupled methods can match conventional SCR methods fully optimized for each new scene when LiDAR configurations are similar to those used during backbone pretraining, but their accuracy drops noticeably on datasets collected with different LiDAR sensors. This suggests that efficient LiDAR localization requires representations that capture stable scene geometry across LiDAR configurations. Motivated by this observation, we propose LightLoc++, a sensor-robust and efficient outdoor LiDAR localization framework. To support sensor-robust representation learning, we introduce SULID, a synchronized urban multi-LiDAR dataset with representative 32-, 64-, and 128-beam rotating LiDARs, extensive cross-sensor overlap, and diverse urban scenes. Using SULID, we pretrain a sensor-robust backbone through cross-sensor consistency learning. LightLoc++ further preserves efficient new-scene learning by incorporating sample classification guidance and redundant sample downsampling, which reduce regression ambiguity and computational redundancy in large-scale outdoor scenes. Extensive experiments on multiple outdoor LiDAR localization benchmarks demonstrate that LightLoc++ achieves state-of-the-art localization performance with the lowest new-scene training cost among compared methods. Code and dataset will be made available at https://github.com/liw95/LightLoc-PlusPlus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LightLoc++，一种面向室外 LiDAR 定位的高效场景坐标回归 (SCR) 框架。作者指出解耦式 SCR 方法若预训练主干所用 LiDAR 配置与新场景传感器不同，精度会明显下降，因此引入同步多 LiDAR 数据集 SULID 并采用跨传感器一致性学习来预训练传感器鲁棒主干。实验显示其在多个室外 LiDAR 定位基准上达到 SOTA 定位性能，同时新场景训练成本最低。
Motivation: 现有解耦式 SCR 方法在 LiDAR 配置与预训练一致时可媲美全量优化的方法，但在不同 LiDAR 传感器采集的数据集上精度显著下降，说明高效定位需要跨 LiDAR 配置稳定捕捉场景几何的表示。
Method: 提出 LightLoc++ 框架，包含同步城市多 LiDAR 数据集 SULID（含 32、64、128 线旋转 LiDAR 与跨传感器重叠）以及基于跨传感器一致性学习的传感器鲁棒主干预训练；此外通过样本分类指导和冗余样本降采样降低大规模室外场景中的回归歧义与计算冗余。
Result: 在多个室外 LiDAR 定位基准上，LightLoc++ 取得 SOTA 定位性能，并在比较方法中实现最低的新场景训练成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调传感器鲁棒的表示学习是高效 LiDAR 定位的关键，并承诺公开代码与数据集。
