papers.title: Physics-informed VAE-EVT for Tail Aware Radio Map Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC) requires precise identification of spatial regions where the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) falls below an outage threshold. In this context, an outage refers to instances in which SNR falls below a specified threshold, which, for URLLC, can be as stringent as the 0.1% quantile of the SNR distribution. Traditional generative radio map models tend to focus on reconstructing average signal levels, often overlooking the low SNR that is crucial for accurate outage prediction. To address this limitation, we introduce a physics- and tail-informed VAE-EVT (variational autoencoder-extreme value theory) framework that distinctly models both the bulk and tail distribution of SNR. Our approach begins with a physics-informed preprocessing stage that extracts deterministic features, including line-of-sight, shadowing, and distance, from the scene geometry. A dual-latent encoder then captures the bulk SNR using a Gaussian mixture and the tail using a generalized Pareto distribution (GPD). By employing a modified variational objective, the model is trained to jointly supervise both regimes, ensuring focused attention on extreme fading events. Evaluated on the RadioMapSeer dataset, our method achieves an SNR RMSE of 4.83 dB in the outage region defined by the low threshold of 0.1% SNR quantile. This significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art GAN-based model, which records an SNR RMSE of 21.90 dB, with the performance gap widening as the outage threshold becomes more stringent.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理信息与尾部分布感知的 VAE-EVT（变分自编码器-极值理论）框架，用于无线通信中的无线电地图（radio map）预测。与只关注平均信号电平的传统生成模型不同，该方法显式分别建模 SNR 的主体分布（bulk）与尾部（tail），以服务于超可靠低延迟通信（URLLC）下的中断预测。在 RadioMapSeer 数据集上，该方法在 0.1% SNR 分位对应的中断区域内取得 4.83 dB 的 SNR RMSE，显著优于基于 GAN 的基准模型。
Motivation: URLLC 需要精确识别 SNR 低于中断阈值的空间区域，其中中断可严格到 SNR 分布的 0.1% 分位。传统生成式无线电地图模型偏向重建平均信号水平，往往忽略对中断预测至关重要的低 SNR 尾部，导致极端衰落事件预测不足。
Method: 提出物理信息和尾部信息引导的 VAE-EVT 框架：先用物理信息预处理从场景几何中提取确定性特征（视距、阴影和距离），再由双潜变量编码器用高斯混合模型（Gaussian mixture）刻画主体 SNR、用广义帕累托分布（GPD）刻画尾部。模型通过修改后的变分目标联合监督两个区间，从而聚焦极端衰落事件。
Result: 在 RadioMapSeer 数据集上，该方法在由 0.1% SNR 分位定义的中断区域内达到 4.83 dB 的 SNR RMSE，大幅优于基于 GAN 的现有最佳模型（21.90 dB），且中断阈值越严格性能差距越大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，显式分离并联合监督 SNR 的主体与尾部分布、同时融入场景几何物理特征，可以显著提升严格中断阈值下的无线电地图预测精度。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Shape Operator PCA: Curvature-Aware Projections for Geometric Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose SHOPCA (Shape Operator-based Principal Component Analysis), a novel method for unsupervised metric learning and dimensionality reduction that incorporates differential geometric information into the covariance structure of classical PCA. SHOPCA regularizes the global covariance matrix using the mean shape operator, defined as the average of the absolute local shape operators estimated from the data manifold, steering principal components toward directions of both maximum variance and informative curvature. A single trace-normalized mixing coefficient $α$ controls the regularization, recovering standard PCA at $α= 0$ and a curvature-driven embedding as $α\to \infty$. We further introduce a fully unsupervised criterion for selecting $α$ based on the spectral eigengap of the regularized covariance matrix, maximizing the relative separation between the top-$d$ and remaining eigenvalues without using class labels. We evaluate SHOPCA on more than 50 real-world benchmark datasets, comparing it with PCA, ISOMAP, and UMAP using Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), Fowlkes-Mallows index (FM), and V-measure. Results show that SHOPCA consistently improves clustering quality over PCA across a broad range of datasets and surpasses UMAP on small-sample settings, where iterative neighborhood-based manifold estimation can degrade. SHOPCA is computationally tractable, parameter-efficient, and applicable to domains requiring fully unsupervised, geometry-aware dimensionality reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SHOPCA（Shape Operator-based Principal Component Analysis），一种将微分几何信息引入经典 PCA 协方差结构的无监督度量学习与降维方法。SHOPCA 用数据流形上局部形状算子绝对值的平均来正则化全局协方差矩阵，使主成分同时朝向最大方差和信息性曲率方向；一个迹归一化的混合系数 α 控制正则化强度，α=0 时退化为标准 PCA。作者还提出基于正则化协方差矩阵谱隙（eigengap）、无需类别标签的 α 选择准则，并在 50 多个真实基准数据集上与 PCA、ISOMAP、UMAP 比较聚类性能。
Motivation: 经典 PCA 仅关注全局方差，忽略了数据流形上的曲率等几何结构，而现有流形学习方法在小样本条件下可能因迭代邻域估计而不稳定；因此需要一种完全无监督、几何感知且计算高效的降维方法。
Method: SHOPCA 以局部形状算子绝对值的平均值作为平均形状算子，对全局协方差矩阵施加正则化；单个迹归一化混合系数 α 平衡方差与曲率信息，并通过最大化前 d 个特征值与其余特征值间的相对分离（谱隙）来自动选择 α，全程不需要类别标签。
Result: 在超过 50 个真实基准数据集上，以 Adjusted Rand Index (ARI)、Normalized Mutual Information (NMI)、Fowlkes-Mallows index (FM) 和 V-measure 为指标，SHOPCA 在广泛数据集上持续优于 PCA，并在小样本场景中超过 UMAP。
Conclusion: SHOPCA 计算上可行、参数高效，适用于需要完全无监督的几何感知降维任务；摘要强调其在小样本设置中相对迭代邻域流形方法的优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MoE Router-Guided Clustering for Heterogeneous Federated Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Federated instruction fine-tuning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to adapt to decentralized, privacy-sensitive data without requiring data sharing. Recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs are particularly attractive for federated learning because their sparse activation reduces computation and communication while scaling model capacity. However, existing federated MoE methods primarily focus on parameter aggregation and personalization, overlooking the routing behavior of MoE models as a source of information for client collaboration. Under heterogeneous instruction distributions, indiscriminate aggregation can lead to negative transfer, highlighting the need to identify which clients should collaborate during federated optimization. We propose ClientMorpher, a routing-aware, personalized federated instruction fine-tuning framework that leverages routing signatures from pretrained MoE models to organize client collaboration prior to aggregation. We investigate two complementary clustering strategies: ClientMorpher-C, which directly clusters clients using expert activation profiles, and ClientMorpher-E, which first clusters experts based on their cross-client usage signatures and then derives client collaboration groups. We evaluate ClientMorpher for federated instruction fine-tuning on the Databricks Dolly-15K dataset, using pathological and Dirichlet-based heterogeneous client distributions across multiple instruction-following tasks. Experimental results show that routing-aware collaboration consistently improves personalized performance compared to conventional federated averaging and local training, while maintaining the same communication cost. Furthermore, our study shows that client-centric and expert-centric clustering provides an effective and scalable approach for personalized federated instruction fine-tuning of sparse MoE LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ClientMorpher，一种利用预训练 MoE LLM 的路由签名（routing signatures）来组织客户端协作的个性化联邦指令微调框架。在异构指令分布下，用两种互补聚类策略（ClientMorpher-C 直接按专家激活画像聚类客户端；ClientMorpher-E 先按跨客户端使用签名聚类专家，再派生出客户端协作组）在聚合前分组，以减少负面迁移。在 Databricks Dolly-15K 数据集上用病理式和 Dirichlet 异构客户端分布验证，路由感知的协作在相同通信成本下持续优于联邦平均和本地训练。
Motivation: 现有联邦 MoE 方法主要关注参数聚合与个性化，忽视了 MoE 模型的路由行为作为客户端协作信息来源的价值。在异构指令分布下，无差别聚合会导致负面迁移，因此需要识别哪些客户端应当协作。
Method: 提出 ClientMorpher 框架，利用预训练 MoE 模型的路由签名在聚合前组织客户端协作；包含两种互补策略：ClientMorpher-C 直接使用专家激活画像（expert activation profiles）对客户端聚类，ClientMorpher-E 先基于跨客户端使用签名（cross-client usage signatures）对专家聚类，再推导客户端协作组。
Result: 在 Databricks Dolly-15K 上，针对多个指令跟随任务采用病理式和 Dirichlet 异构客户端分布进行评估，路由感知协作在保持相同通信成本的前提下持续提升个性化性能，优于常规联邦平均（federated averaging）和本地训练。
Conclusion: 研究表明，客户端中心与专家中心的聚类为稀疏 MoE LLM 的个性化联邦指令微调提供了有效且可扩展的途径；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedADB: Class Anchor-Driven Dual-Branch Federated Learning for Mitigating Forgetting
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal data collected by heterogeneous devices are used for collaborative training, where federated learning (FL) serves as a key paradigm for effective distributed modeling with data privacy preservation. However, local training suffers from the forgetting of previously learned global knowledge under cross-client data heterogeneity, which leads to significant declines in both performance and convergence speed. Most previous studies rely on global alignment strategies to retain global knowledge, which hinder local optimization and lead to inadequate supervision of missing classes. Some studies introduce proxy datasets to supplement supervision for missing classes. However, it remains a challenge to balance class-wise global consistency and local optimization objectives without proxy datasets. In this work, we propose FedADB, a Class Anchor-Driven Dual-Branch FL framework. Specifically, the server generates class anchors optimized in a differentiable input space, which are shared across clients. These class anchors serve as global references that provide supervision for missing classes during local training. A dual-branch collaborative training mechanism is designed for clients. In this mechanism, the anchor-based global branch focuses on learning with global consistency, achieving global knowledge alignment by class-anchor balanced sampling. The local calibration branch focuses on learning discriminative local features, mitigating the degradation of local representations caused by excessive global alignment. Extensive experiments across multiple medical and natural datasets demonstrate that FedADB achieves significant improvements in both accuracy and convergence speed.
papers.comment: Accepted to appear in Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedADB，一个基于类锚点 (class anchor) 的双分支联邦学习框架，用于缓解跨客户端数据异构导致的全局知识遗忘问题。服务器在可微输入空间中生成类锚点并在客户端间共享，为本地训练中缺失的类别提供监督；客户端采用锚点驱动的全局分支与本地校准分支协同训练。实验在多个医学和自然数据集上表明 FedADB 显著提升准确率与收敛速度。
Motivation: 联邦学习在异构客户端本地训练时会遗忘先前学到的全局知识，导致性能和收敛速度下降；已有的全局对齐策略会阻碍本地优化且对缺失类别监督不足，而引入代理数据集 (proxy dataset) 的方法难以在无代理数据下平衡类别级全局一致性与本地优化目标。
Method: 提出类别锚点驱动的双分支联邦学习框架 FedADB：服务器在可微输入空间中优化生成类锚点并共享给客户端，作为缺失类别的全局参考监督；客户端采用双分支协作训练机制，锚点全局分支通过类锚点平衡采样实现全局知识对齐，本地校准分支学习判别性局部特征以缓解过度全局对齐造成的表示退化。
Result: 在多个医学和自然数据集上的大量实验表明，FedADB 在准确率和收敛速度上均取得显著提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为在不依赖代理数据集的情况下，通过类锚点提供缺失类别监督并协调全局一致性与本地优化目标，可以有效缓解联邦学习中的灾难性遗忘并加快收敛。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Physiological World Models for Human State Transitions
papers.abstract_en: Continuous multimodal sensing now allows human physiology to be observed throughout daily life rather than only during occasional clinical visits. However, most health artificial intelligence systems are designed to recognize current states, estimate risks or analyse individual biomarkers. They do not directly model how physiological states change in response to real-world events, behaviours, contexts and interventions. Here we propose the Physiological World Model (PWM), an event-conditioned framework for learning these changes at the level of the whole person. We introduce the HumanState Transition Token, a structured, quality-scored unit that connects the physiological state before an event with the event or action, relevant context and intervention information, the physiological trajectory after the event, observed outcomes and data quality. We describe four capability levels, from state representation to bounded intervention planning, together with four data acquisition and validation protocols. We also propose six benchmark tasks covering HumanState representation, forecasting across multiple timescales, individualized response prediction, simulation of alternative interventions, bounded planning and reliability under distribution shift. Together, this framework provides a practical path towards personalized health management, behavioural intervention design and clinician-supervised decision support, while clearly separating prediction from causal inference and making uncertainty, safety, governance and limits of use explicit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生理世界模型 (Physiological World Model, PWM)，一种事件条件化框架，用于在整个个体层面学习生理状态如何随真实世界事件、行为、情境和干预而变化。作者引入 HumanState Transition Token 这一结构化且带质量评分的单元，连接事件前的生理状态与事件、情境、干预、事件后轨迹、结局及数据质量，并定义四个能力层级、四种数据采集与验证协议以及六个基准任务。
Motivation: 现有健康人工智能系统多用于识别当前状态、估计风险或分析单一生物标志物，并不直接建模生理状态如何对真实世界事件、行为、情境和干预做出改变。
Method: 提出 PWM 框架，以事件为条件学习整个人体的状态转变；核心是 HumanState Transition Token，其将事件前的生理状态与事件或动作、相关情境、干预信息、事件后生理轨迹、观测结局和数据质量绑定在一起，并配套四种数据采集与验证协议。
Result: 提出六个基准任务，涵盖 HumanState 表示、多时间尺度的状态预测、个体化反应预测、替代干预模拟、有界干预规划以及分布偏移下的可靠性。摘要未报告定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 该框架旨在为个性化健康管理、行为干预设计和临床监督决策支持提供路径，同时明确将预测与因果推断分开，并显式说明不确定性、安全性、治理及使用限制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Unified Geometric Framework for Developmental Analysis of Spatial Transcriptomic Data
papers.abstract_en: High-throughput single-cell and spatial transcriptomic technologies provide high-resolution snapshots of heterogeneous cellular states, but their destructive nature prevents repeated measurements of the same cells over time. Consequently, temporal and spatial dynamics must be inferred from independently sampled, unaligned cell populations, making it challenging to reconstruct developmental trajectories. Optimal transport (OT) offers a geometric framework for aligning cell populations and inferring developmental trajectories, but many existing approaches focus on modeling the evolution of distributions of cells in gene expression space rather than the relational structure encoded by gene expression networks. To address this limitation, we introduce a geometric framework for analyzing the spatiotemporal evolution of gene expression networks through embeddings in Gromov--Wasserstein (GW) space. By representing each developmental stage as a graph combining gene expression and spatial proximity, our approach enables comparisons of network structure across time, continuous interpolation between developmental stages via GW geodesics, and quantification of network-level changes using Ollivier-Ricci curvature. We evaluate our framework on a spatiotemporal transcriptomic \textit{Drosophila} dataset and show that GW geodesic interpolations reproduce main trends in curvature dynamics observed in empirical gene expression networks. Agreement with higher-order Co-Optimal Transport (COOT) distances, which jointly represent spatial and temporal information, further validates the framework and suggests that hypernetwork representations successfully record salient biological changes across time. In general, our approach provides a unified geometric approach to study dynamically evolving biological networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的几何框架，将基因表达网络嵌入 Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) 空间，用于分析空间转录组数据中发育阶段的时空演化。每个发育阶段被表示为结合基因表达与空间邻近性的图，从而支持跨时间的网络结构比较、通过 GW 测地线进行的连续插值，以及用 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率量化网络层面的变化。作者在果蝇时空转录组数据上验证，GW 测地线插值能重现经验基因表达网络中曲率动态的主要趋势，并与高阶 Co-Optimal Transport (COOT) 距离一致。
Motivation: 单细胞和空间转录组技术是破坏性的，无法对同一细胞进行重复测量，因此时间与空间动态只能从独立采样、未对齐的细胞群体中推断。现有最优传输 (OT) 方法多聚焦于基因表达空间中细胞分布的演化，而非基因表达网络所编码的关系结构，这一缺失正是本文要填补的空白。
Method: 提出一种几何框架，通过将各发育阶段表示为结合基因表达与空间邻近性的图，并将其嵌入 GW 空间来分析网络演化。该框架利用 GW 距离比较跨时间网络结构、用 GW 测地线在发育阶段之间连续插值，并用 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率量化网络层面的变化。
Result: 在果蝇时空转录组数据集上，GW 测地线插值重现了经验基因表达网络中观察到的曲率动态主要趋势；框架与联合表示时空信息的高阶 COOT 距离一致，表明超网络表示能记录跨时间的显著生物学变化。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法为研究动态演化的生物网络提供了统一的几何途径，尤其适用于空间转录组数据中发育轨迹的重建与分析。摘要未明确讨论该方法在非空间或非转录组场景下的适用边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Cognition-Induced Risks in Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Frontier agentic systems powered by large language models (LLMs) exhibit human-like patterns of cognition. As these systems become deeply integrated across different domains, their cognitive engagement raises critical concerns for human society that remain insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we systematically analyze risks induced by expanding cognitive capabilities, following a three-level framework defined by their cognitive scope, from physical cognition to social cognition, and finally to self-referential cognition. We study their potential risks to human agency, autonomy, and control capability, corresponding to each cognitive level. We finally propose strategies to mitigate these risks and enhance the controllability of agentic AI systems, ensuring their long-term safe development.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE Intelligent Systems, which can be accessed at https://doi.ieeecomputersociety.org/10.1109/MIS.2026.3721766. The DOI is 10.1109/MIS.2026.3721766
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对由大型语言模型 (LLM) 驱动的前沿 agentic AI 系统所展现的类人认知模式，提出一个三层分析框架，按认知范围从物理认知、社会认知到自我指涉认知，系统梳理认知能力扩展带来的风险。作者将这些风险分别对应到对人类能动性 (human agency)、自主性 (autonomy) 和控制能力 (control capability) 的威胁，并提出相应的缓解与可控性增强策略。摘要为概念性分析，未提供具体实验数据。
Motivation: 随着具备类人认知能力的 LLM 智能体系统在各领域深度集成，其认知参与可能引发的社会风险尚未被充分研究，需要进行系统性分析。
Method: 采用按认知范围划分的三层框架，即物理认知 (physical cognition)、社会认知 (social cognition) 和自我指涉认知 (self-referential cognition)，逐层考察风险对人类能动性、自主性和控制能力的影响，并据此提出缓解与可控性增强策略。
Result: 摘要未报告量化结果或实验数据，其主要贡献是建立风险分析框架并给出增强控制能力的策略方向。
Conclusion: 作者强调必须缓解认知能力扩展带来的风险并增强 agentic AI 系统的可控性，以确保其长期安全发展。

papers.title: Divergent-Convergent Reasoning: Scaling Test-Time Compute through Structured Solution Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Test-time compute can substantially improve Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning performance, yet how and when additional compute helps remains poorly understood. We study Divergent-Convergent Reasoning (DCR), a simple two-phase primitive consisting of an exploration phase that generates multiple candidate solutions followed by a convergent reconciliation phase. We present three core results. First, we show that even a single reconciliation step can reliably amplify correct minority reports: across datasets, DCR often recovers the correct answer when correct exploration outputs are in the minority, a regime where majority voting fails. Second, we introduce recursive DCR, an autoregressive reconciliation system that iteratively analyzes disagreements and allocates additional test-time compute. Recursive DCR achieves higher accuracy than fixed-compute baselines-reaching 93.3% on AIME 2024 and 92.0% on AIME 2025-while using roughly 27% less compute on average, demonstrating that attentive resource allocation is superior to uniform scaling. Third, we analyze disagreement among exploration outputs via a simple, training-free dispersion metric. Dispersion reveals a structured relationship between disagreement and test-time gains: in regimes where DCR is effective, higher disagreement among exploration outputs is associated with larger accuracy improvements from reconciliation. Together, these results show that disagreement, often viewed as noise, can be systematically exploited to improve test-time reasoning and reveal emerging scaling laws for agentic LLM systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Divergent-Convergent Reasoning (DCR)：先通过探索阶段生成多个候选解，再通过收敛阶段进行综合，并以此研究测试时计算 (test-time compute) 的收益机制。作者报告三个核心结果：单步综合能够放大正确的少数派解，递归 DCR 在 AIME 2024/2025 上达到 93.3%/92.0% 且平均节省约 27% 计算量，以及一个免训练的离散度指标揭示了探索输出分歧与准确率提升之间的结构化关系。
Motivation: 测试时计算可以显著提升 LLM 推理性能，但额外计算究竟如何以及何时起作用仍缺乏理解。作者希望解释计算分配机制，而非简单地均匀扩大计算量。
Method: 提出 DCR 两阶段原语：探索阶段生成多个候选解，收敛阶段对这些解进行综合；进一步引入递归 DCR，以自回归方式迭代分析分歧并分配额外测试时计算。此外提出一个免训练的离散度 (dispersion) 指标，用于刻画探索输出之间的分歧程度。
Result: 单步综合即可在正确解占少数、多数投票失效的场景中可靠恢复正确答案；递归 DCR 在 AIME 2024 上达到 93.3%、AIME 2025 上达到 92.0%，同时平均比固定计算量基线少用约 27% 计算。离散度分析显示，在 DCR 有效的区间内，探索输出分歧越大，综合带来的准确率提升越大。
Conclusion: 作者认为通常被视为噪声的分歧可以被系统性地利用来改善测试时推理，并据此展现了智能体化 LLM 系统的新兴扩展规律 (scaling law)。

papers.title: MAPLE: MoE Adaptive Plug-and-play Layer-wise Expert allocation
papers.abstract_en: Sparsely-activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformers universally fix the same number of routed experts across all layers, a convention that ignores the well-documented heterogeneity in layer-wise redundancy. We demonstrate that this uniformity is systematically suboptimal and propose MAPLE, a plug-and-play framework that reallocates the routed-expert budget heterogeneously across layers of any pretrained MoE LLM, without modifying weights or requiring retraining. Our core contribution is a closed-form sensitivity-guided allocation: we probe each layer's response to variation in expert count, quantify sensitivity using three measures, and derive an analytically optimal budget assignment that directs capacity towards sensitive layers and absorbs reductions in redundant layers. This closed-form solution is further refined by a sensitivity-constrained genetic search that uses layer-wise sensitivity as a prior to guide exploration, yielding faster convergence and superior allocation quality. On four MoE models spanning different scales and architectures, MAPLE outperforms uniform and pruning-based baselines under a 75% routed-expert budget. Notably, on DeepSeek-MoE-16B, MAPLE uses only 75% of the experts yet surpasses the original 100% expert-uniform baseline on ARC-E, ARC-C, and BoolQ, improving accuracy from 65.09 to 71.40, 48.49 to 51.50, and 80.03 to 82.38, respectively. These accuracy gains translate into measured deployment efficiency: implementing MAPLE in SGLang reduces single-GPU end-to-end serving latency by 32.2% and improves throughput by 47.4%. These results show that well-designed heterogeneous allocation can be more effective than simply activating more experts, establishing it as a principled and practical axis for improving MoE efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出稀疏激活 MoE Transformer 在所有层固定相同路由专家数是一种次优设定，并提出 MAPLE，一个即插即用框架，可在不修改权重、无需重训练的情况下，将路由专家预算在预训练 MoE 大模型的各层之间进行异构分配。核心是闭式灵敏度引导分配与灵敏度约束遗传搜索，在 75% 路由专家预算下超过均匀分配和剪枝基线，并在 DeepSeek-MoE-16B 上以更少专家超越原始全专家基线，同时降低 SGLang 单 GPU 端到端推理延迟。
Motivation: 现有 MoE 模型普遍对所有层分配相同数量的路由专家，忽略层间冗余的异质性，这种均匀约定被证明是系统性次优的，限制了下游部署效率的提升空间。
Method: MAPLE 提出闭式灵敏度引导分配：探测每层对专家数量变化的响应，用三种度量量化灵敏度，推导解析最优预算分配；随后用灵敏度约束的遗传搜索（以层灵敏度为先验）进一步细化，整个流程无需修改权重或重训练。
Result: 在四个不同规模和架构的 MoE 模型上，MAPLE 在 75% 路由专家预算下优于均匀分配和剪枝基线；在 DeepSeek-MoE-16B 上，ARC-E、ARC-C、BoolQ 准确率分别从 65.09 提升到 71.40、48.49 提升到 51.50、80.03 提升到 82.38；在 SGLang 中实现 MAPLE 使单 GPU 端到端推理延迟降低 32.2%、吞吐量提升 47.4%。
Conclusion: 作者认为精心设计的异构专家分配比简单激活更多专家更有效，并将异构分配确立为一条有原则且实用的 MoE 效率优化方向。

papers.title: Image Denoising via the Adaptive Rank-Cluster Filter
papers.abstract_en: A spatial-local image-denoising filter is proposed, and its performance metrics are evaluated in comparison with baseline filtering algorithms, including the median, adaptive median, Gaussian, bilateral, Wiener, anisotropic diffusion, and non-local means. The developed filter is based on aligning the intensity value of the central pixel in a 3x3 window with the statistical majority intensity of one of the two clusters formed by optimal Otsu's partitioning of a pixel set sorted by intensity and trimmed to seven elements. This is followed by a fuzzy fusion of the calculated value with the median intensity of the pixels within the window. The proposed filter demonstrates the highest robustness to variations in image noise levels, particularly when processing mixed noise consisting of salt-and-pepper impulse noise and additive Gaussian noise in various proportions

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于空间局部的图像去噪滤波器，并在多种基线算法（中值、自适应中值、高斯、双边、Wiener、各向异性扩散、非局部均值）上比较性能。该方法在 3x3 窗口中通过 Otsu 最优划分将按强度排序并裁剪为七个元素的像素集合分成两个簇，将中心像素强度与统计多数簇对齐，再与窗口像素中值强度进行模糊融合。摘要报告该滤波器对图像噪声水平变化表现出最高的鲁棒性，尤其在处理不同比例混合的椒盐脉冲噪声与加性高斯噪声时。
Motivation: 现有图像去噪滤波器在不同噪声类型和混合噪声条件下的鲁棒性有限，需要一种能适应噪声水平变化的局部滤波方法。
Method: 提出自适应秩-簇滤波器（adaptive rank-cluster filter）：在 3x3 窗口内，对按强度排序并裁剪到七个元素的像素集合执行 Otsu 最优划分形成两个簇，将中心像素强度与其中统计多数簇的强度对齐，随后将计算值与窗口像素的中值强度进行模糊融合。
Result: 与中值、自适应中值、高斯、双边、Wiener、各向异性扩散和非局部均值等基线相比，该滤波器在图像噪声水平变化下表现最稳健，尤其对盐和胡椒脉冲噪声与加性高斯噪声按不同比例混合的噪声有效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该滤波器在处理混合噪声时具有较高鲁棒性，可作为通用空间局部去噪方法使用。

papers.title: TinyDETR-Pose: Towards End-to-End Real-Time Single-Stage 6DoF Object Pose Estimation with Lightweight Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Real-time 6DoF object pose estimation on resource-constrained hardware remains challenging, as accurate correspondence-based and refinement pipelines typically rely on non-differentiable PnP/RANSAC stages or costly iterative refinement, while recent foundation-model-based approaches incur inference costs that are prohibitive for edge deployment. We present TinyDETR-Pose, a lightweight, end-to-end, single-stage framework that jointly detects objects and regresses their full 6D pose in a single forward pass. Built on the efficient LW-DETR architecture, TinyDETR-Pose formulates detection and pose estimation as a set-prediction problem and attaches dedicated MLP heads for rotation, monocular depth, and projected object center regression to each decoder query, eliminating the need for PnP, NMS (non-maximum suppression), or iterative pose refinement. Object symmetries are handled through a ADD-S loss applied uniformly to all objects, without the need for object-specific loss schedules or separate geodesic/ADD supervision. In addition, predictions are assigned to ground truth using a symmetry-safe Hungarian matcher based on class and 2D spatial cues, yielding stable assignment under symmetry and depth ambiguity. On YCB-V, TinyDETR-Pose achieves a comparable ADD-S AUC of 85.9, while requiring up to 72.7% fewer parameters than other DETR-based single-stage pose-estimation approaches. Due to its compact design, TinyDETR-Pose runs in real time and achieves an inference latency of only ~4.5 ms per frame on an NVIDIA Jetson Nano using TensorRT, demonstrating that accurate end-to-end transformer-based 6D pose estimation can be made practical for edge deployment.

TL;DR: 本文提出 TinyDETR-Pose，一个基于 LW-DETR 的轻量级端到端单阶段 6DoF 物体姿态估计框架，将检测与位姿回归建模为集合预测问题，通过专用 MLP 头直接回归旋转、单目深度和投影中心，无需 PnP、NMS 或迭代细化。在 YCB-V 上达到可比的 ADD-S AUC 85.9，参数量比其他 DETR 类单阶段方法最多减少 72.7%，并在 NVIDIA Jetson Nano 上实现约 4.5 ms/帧的推理延迟，表明边缘端实时部署可行。
Motivation: 在资源受限硬件上实现实时 6DoF 姿态估计仍有挑战：基于对应关系和细化的流程依赖不可微的 PnP/RANSAC 或昂贵的迭代细化，而基于 foundation model 的方法推理成本过高，难以部署到边缘设备。
Method: 基于高效的 LW-DETR 架构，将检测与位姿估计统一为集合预测问题；为每个解码器 query 附加旋转、单目深度和投影中心回归的 MLP 头。物体对称性通过统一施加 ADD-S 损失处理，并用基于类别和 2D 空间线索的对称安全 Hungarian matcher 进行预测与真值分配。
Result: 在 YCB-V 上取得与对比方法相当的 ADD-S AUC 85.9，同时比其他 DETR 类单阶段姿态估计方法最多减少 72.7% 参数；在 NVIDIA Jetson Nano 上使用 TensorRT 推理，延迟约为 4.5 ms/帧。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过紧凑设计，准确且端到端的 Transformer 式 6D 姿态估计可以实现实时性，并具备边缘部署的实用性。

papers.title: FMReward: Aligning and Evaluating Audio-Driven 3D Facial Animation with Human Preferences
papers.abstract_en: Audio-driven 3D facial animation is essential for advancing immersion and interactivity in virtual experiences. Although recent advances have shown promising capabilities, the training and evaluation of existing methods typically rely on ground-truth-based errors, which fall short of aligning with human preferences. To address this, we present a comprehensive framework that learns an automatic perceptual model from human preference data and leverages it to improve and evaluate the perceptual quality of audio-driven 3D facial animation. To begin with, we construct FMPair (Facial Motion Pairwise preference), the first human preference dataset for audio-driven 3D facial animation, which is built through a systematic annotation pipeline and comprises 65,574 annotated 3D facial motion pairs from 8,834 distinct in-the-wild audio clips. Based on the pairwise comparison dataset, we propose a Facial Motion Reward model, termed FMReward, which takes audio and 3D facial motion as inputs and predicts a perceptual quality score aligned with human preferences. Building upon FMReward, we further introduce Facial Motion reward Feedback Learning (FMFL), a direct fine-tuning algorithm that leverages a pretrained reward model to optimize diffusion-based audio-driven 3D facial animation models for better alignment with human preferences. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of FMReward over other metrics in aligning with human preferences and the effectiveness of FMFL in improving the perceptual quality of audio-driven 3D facial animation.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE TVCG, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于音频驱动3D面部动画的偏好对齐与评估框架：构建了首个该领域的人类偏好数据集FMPair，包含65,574个3D面部运动对和8,834段真实野外音频；基于此训练Facial Motion Reward模型（FMReward）预测与人类偏好一致的感知质量分数；并进一步提出FMFL微调算法，利用预训练奖励模型优化扩散式音频驱动3D面部动画模型。实验表明FMReward在偏好对齐上优于其他指标，FMFL能提升生成动画的感知质量。
Motivation: 现有音频驱动3D面部动画方法的训练和评估依赖基于真值（ground truth）的误差，这些指标与人类主观偏好不一致，导致生成结果的感知质量难以被准确衡量和优化。
Method: 构建系统性标注流程生成FMPair成对偏好数据集；提出FMReward模型，以音频和3D面部运动为输入预测感知质量分数；并提出FMFL（Facial Motion reward Feedback Learning）直接微调算法，用预训练奖励模型优化扩散式动画生成模型。
Result: 大规模实验显示FMReward在人类偏好对齐上优于其他指标，且FMFL能有效提升音频驱动3D面部动画的感知质量。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于人类偏好数据的奖励模型与反馈学习可改善音频驱动3D面部动画的生成与评估，使其更符合人类感知。

papers.title: SOS! : A Streamlined Object-Conditional Transformer for Model-free Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Foundation segmentation models excel at generating high-quality, class-agnostic masks, but they struggle to associate these proposals with specific target objects. This semantic gap severely hinders their deployment in downstream applications like robotic manipulation, which demand precise unseen objects segmentation. Existing approaches attempt to resolve this by relying on exhaustive 3D object model priors, inherently introducing prohibitive computational overhead and complex, multi-stage pipelines. To address these limitations, we propose SOS (Streamlined Object-conditional Transformer for model-free Segmentation). SOS completely eliminates the reliance on 3D models, requiring only a single reference image per target object. Central to our framework is a novel Object-Conditional Transformer that learns identity-anchored queries, unifying mask generation and target identification into a single feed-forward pass. This streamlined design drastically improves both structural and computational efficiency. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SOS establishes a new state-of-the-art for model-free unseen objects segmentation, delivering accurate and high-efficiency performance. The project page and code are available at https://sos-seg.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SOS（Streamlined Object-conditional Transformer for model-free Segmentation），一种面向无模型未见过物体分割的流线型目标条件 Transformer。该方法完全不依赖 3D 物体模型先验，仅需每个目标物体一张参考图像，通过学习身份锚定查询（identity-anchored queries）将掩码生成与目标识别统一到一次前向传播中。多个基准上的评估表明 SOS 在无模型未见过物体分割上达到新的最先进水平。
Motivation: 基础分割模型善于生成高质量、类别无关的掩码，但难以将这些候选掩码与特定目标物体关联，限制了其在机器人操作等下游任务中的应用。现有方法依赖详尽的三维物体模型先验，带来高昂的计算开销和复杂的多阶段流水线。
Method: SOS 完全去除对 3D 模型的依赖，仅使用每个目标物体的一张参考图像。核心是新颖的 Object-Conditional Transformer，学习身份锚定查询，将掩码生成与目标识别统一为单次前向传播，从而在结构和计算效率上都得到简化。
Result: 在多个基准上的大量评估表明，SOS 在无模型未见过物体分割任务上建立了新的最先进性能，并实现了高精度与高效率兼备的结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调该流线型设计彻底消除了对三维模型的依赖，并显著提升结构性与计算效率；其适用场景包括机器人操作等需要精确分割未见过物体的下游应用。

papers.title: ReasonCast: Agentic Demand Forecasting with Selective Semantic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Demand forecasting increasingly requires combining two complementary sources of information: historical sales reveal recurring numerical dynamics, while future promotions, holidays, price changes, and platform interventions provide forward-looking knowledge. Existing text-enhanced forecasting methods often encode such context into generic representations and fuse it uniformly with time-series features, without explicitly distinguishing which semantic effects are forecast-relevant or how they should modify future dynamics. We introduce ReasonCast, a structured semantic intervention framework that translates event knowledge into forecast-specific operations. An agent examines the event context, the no-text forecast, and its uncertainty to determine whether textual reasoning is needed. Rather than injecting free-form text, ReasonCast represents event knowledge through structured fields describing event relevance, demand direction, temporal shape, amplitude, and peak intensity. These fields interact selectively with temporal components of a time-series foundation model. An additive path corrects local trends and temporal shapes, while a multiplicative path captures event-driven level shifts. ReasonCast introduces a forecast-grounded post-training curriculum. Schema SFT establishes semantic fields; semantic-field RL calibrates direction, shape, amplitude, and peak judgments; and forecast-utility RL evaluates semantic interventions through a frozen forecaster, aligning reasoning outputs with marginal forecast improvement. ReasonCast lowers WMAPE by 3.29, 1.25, and 0.47 percentage points on holiday-sensitive categories, mega-sale-sensitive categories, and M5 event windows, respectively. On stable-sales periods, indiscriminate semantic intervention increases WMAPE by 1.68 percentage points, whereas suppressing unnecessary intervention preserves the numerical backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReasonCast，一个面向需求预测的结构化语义干预框架。agent 先检查事件上下文、无文本预测及其不确定性，决定是否需要文本推理；事件知识被表示为描述相关性、需求方向、时间形状、幅度和峰值强度的结构化字段，并与时间序列基础模型的时序组件选择性交互。摘要报告该方法在节假日敏感类别、大促敏感类别和 M5 事件窗口上分别降低 WMAPE 3.29、1.25、0.47 个百分点，同时在稳定销售期通过抑制不必要干预避免 1.68 个百分点的 WMAPE 上升。
Motivation: 需求预测需要同时利用历史销售中的重复数值动态与促销、假日、价格变化、平台干预等前瞻性事件知识，但现有文本增强预测方法常把事件上下文编码为通用表示并与时序特征均匀融合，未显式区分哪些语义效应与预测相关，也未说明它们应如何修改未来动态。
Method: 提出结构化语义干预框架 ReasonCast：agent 依据事件上下文、无文本预测及不确定性决定是否需要文本推理；将事件知识表示为相关性、需求方向、时间形状、幅度、峰值强度等结构化字段，并与时间序列基础模型的时序组件选择性交互，加法路径修正局部趋势与时间形状，乘法路径捕捉事件驱动的水平偏移。训练采用预测锚定的后训练课程：Schema SFT 建立语义字段，语义字段 RL 校准方向/形状/幅度/峰值判断，forecast-utility RL 通过冻结的预测器评估语义干预并使其对齐边际预测改进。
Result: 摘要报告 ReasonCast 在节假日敏感类别、大促敏感类别和 M5 事件窗口上分别降低 WMAPE 3.29、1.25、0.47 个百分点；在稳定销售期，不加区分的语义干预会使 WMAPE 上升 1.68 个百分点，而抑制不必要干预可保持数值主干性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调选择性语义干预与结构化字段表示能把事件知识转化为预测特定的操作，从而提升事件敏感场景的预测精度，并避免对稳定销售期的数值主干的破坏。

papers.title: Convolution Smoothed Quantile Regression for XGBoost
papers.abstract_en: The increasing availability of large and complex datasets across many scientific disciplines has led to widespread adoption of machine learning (ML) for prediction. However, most ML algorithms focus on point estimation and provide limited information about predictive uncertainty or the conditional distribution of the response, restricting their ability to characterize rare or extreme outcomes. We develop QXGB, a quantile-based gradient boosting framework, and introduce a convolution smoothed loss within it that estimates conditional quantiles for constructing dense cumulative distribution functions (CDFs), exceedance probabilities, and tail behaviour relevant to extreme outcomes. This approach preserves the computational efficiency of extreme gradient boosting while restoring the Hessian information XGBoost relies on for tree splitting, in turn providing interpretable measures of extreme value and exceedance probability predictions. We derive the gradients and Hessians needed to integrate convolution smoothed quantile loss with different kernel specifications into XGBoost, and with simulated data, benchmark this approach against alternative smoothed quantile regression losses, the native quantile objective in the XGBoost Python package, and independent versus multi-output tree estimation. The practical relevance is illustrated in an application predicting fine particulate matter (PM$_{2.5}$) in northern California, including periods where levels were elevated due to wildfire smoke. Our results show that convolution smoothed QXGB, particularly when paired with multi-output trees, delivers accurate predictions with near-zero quantile crossing, well-calibrated CDF and exceedance probability estimates, and useful tail characterization for extreme values. Interval estimation is also evaluated as a measure of data spread.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QXGB，一个基于分位数回归的梯度提升框架，通过在 XGBoost 中引入卷积平滑分位数损失 (convolution smoothed quantile loss) 来估计条件分位数，从而构建累积分布函数 (CDF)、超阈值概率 (exceedance probability) 和尾部行为。作者推导了不同核函数下该损失所需的梯度和 Hessian，并用模拟数据与多种平滑分位数损失、XGBoost Python 包原生分位数目标以及独立/多输出树估计进行基准比较。实际应用是预测北加州的 PM2.5 浓度，包括野火烟雾导致的污染高峰时段。
Motivation: 大多数机器学习算法只做点估计，难以提供预测不确定性或响应变量条件分布的信息，限制了对罕见或极端结果的刻画能力。
Method: 开发 QXGB 框架，在 XGBoost 中集成卷积平滑分位数损失；推导加入该损失所需的梯度和 Hessian，以恢复 XGBoost 树分裂所依赖的 Hessian 信息，同时保持极端梯度提升的计算效率，并支持独立树与多输出树两种估计方式。
Result: 模拟实验显示，卷积平滑 QXGB（尤其是与多输出树结合）能给出准确预测，分位数交叉 (quantile crossing) 接近零，CDF 和超阈值概率估计校准良好，并能有效刻画极值的尾部行为；间隔估计也作为数据离散度的度量进行了评估。
Conclusion: 该方法的可取之处在于在保持 XGBoost 计算效率的同时恢复 Hessian 信息，为极端值和超阈值概率预测提供可解释的度量；但摘要中的验证场景集中在 PM2.5 空气污染数据，未涉及天气或降水领域。

papers.title: $D^{2}R^{2}$: Discrete Diffusion with Regulation Reinforcement for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting single-cell transcriptomic responses to genetic perturbations is central to functional genomics and virtual-cell modeling. Existing approaches, however, typically predict an entire expression profile as a whole, leaving the order in which individual gene responses are generated unmodeled. To address this problem, we introduce \textbf{$D^{2}R^{2}$} (\textbf{D}iscrete \textbf{D}iffusion with \textbf{R}egulation \textbf{R}einforcement), which reformulates perturbation prediction as regulation-guided gene-wise progressive generation. A Masked Discrete Diffusion Model represents expression as ordinal tokens and reconstructs a fully masked profile step by step, allowing generated gene responses to condition those that remain masked. A Regulatory Policy Module initializes the generation policy from a gene regulatory network inferred from control cells and adapts it to the perturbation and current partially generated state. Then, group-relative policy optimization refines only the ordering policy using final perturbation-effect agreement as reward. Across Norman19 and VCC-H1, $D^{2}R^{2}$ achieves the best performance on all five metrics on Norman19 and remains competitive on H1. Controlled ablations holding the generator and generation budget fixed show that biological-prior ordering improves over random ordering and is more reliable than uncertainty-based heuristics, whereas reversing the biological-prior ordering degrades every metric. Biological analyses further show that the refined policy prioritizes regulatory genes early while promoting perturbation-specific transcription factors and responsive genes. These results establish gene generation order as an effective, controllable, and biologically interpretable dimension of single-cell perturbation prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 D²R²（Discrete Diffusion with Regulation Reinforcement），将单细胞扰动预测重构为调控引导的基因级渐进生成问题。一个掩码离散扩散模型（Masked Discrete Diffusion Model）把表达谱表示为序数 token，并逐步重建完全掩码的谱，使已生成的基因响应可以条件化尚未掩码的基因；调控策略模块从对照细胞推断的基因调控网络初始化生成策略，并用成组相对策略优化（group-relative policy optimization）仅以最终扰动效应一致性为奖励来精炼排序策略。在 Norman19 和 VCC-H1 上，D²R² 在 Norman19 全部五个指标取得最佳，在 H1 上保持有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有方法通常把整个表达谱作为整体预测，未建模单个基因响应生成的先后顺序。作者认为这一顺序是扰动预测中缺失且可利用的维度。
Method: 将扰动预测重构为调控引导的基因级渐进生成：掩码离散扩散模型以序数 token 逐部重建掩码表达谱；调控策略模块用对照细胞推断的基因调控网络初始化生成策略，并随扰动与当前部分生成状态自适应调整；最后用组相对策略优化（group-relative policy optimization）以最终扰动效应一致性为奖励精炼排序策略。
Result: 在 Norman19 和 VCC-H1 上，D²R² 在 Norman19 全部五个指标上达到最佳，在 H1 上保持竞争力。控制生成器和生成预算的消融显示，生物先验排序优于随机排序，且比基于不确定性的启发式更可靠；反转生物先验排序会降低每个指标。生物学分析表明精炼后的策略早期优先调控基因，同时促进扰动特异的转录因子和响应基因。
Conclusion: 这些结果将基因生成顺序确立为单细胞扰动预测中一个有效、可控且具有生物学可解释性的维度。

papers.title: No Task Fails Every Time: Why One-Shot Audits Are Structurally Blind to Agent Damage
papers.abstract_en: We introduce AgentRelBench, an environment-agnostic reliability instrument that computes ground-truth, severity-priced damage from database state diffs across repeated runs, with no LLM in the measurement path, demonstrated on EnterpriseOps-Gym. Across 2,128 evaluation runs spanning nine models in six families (four development, three pre-registered held-out, plus a frontier pass on two frontier-tier models that the pre-registration designates exploratory), we find: (1) damage on irreversible actions is universal across the families we measured and stochastic within them on pinned, single-provider stacks. (2) No task damaged on every run: zero always-fail cells across 42 confirmatory held-out damage events. A single clean run misses a damage-producing (model, task) pair 0.80 of the time on the development pool (13 pairs); the held-out pool is descriptively consistent (0.575 over 5 pairs, pair-weighted) but sits below our pre-registered power floor and is reported as underpowered, not as confirmation. (3) Damage-producing task count falls with model capability, from 7 of 20 tasks for an 8B model to 1 of 20 for the most capable; capability is confounded with family and training, so this is an observed gradient, not a causal claim. The residual damage does not change in character: in the exploratory frontier pass, the most capable model's one damaging task damages at $\hat{p} = 0.16$ per run, inside the same demonstrably-stochastic band, and a single audit misses it 84% of the time. (4) One model family committed the gated irreversible change while declaring it had refused: transcript- and judge-based grading scores those runs as safe refusals, only state diffs as damage. All confirmatory findings were pre-registered with per-claim demote criteria; one demoted our own initially favored finding, which we report.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables, 6 appendices. Code, task suite, released per-run verdicts, and a one-command reproduction of every reported number: https://github.com/shivenkk/agentrelbench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentRelBench，一个环境无关的可靠性评测工具，通过跨重复运行的数据库状态差异（state diffs）计算带严重性定价的 ground-truth 损害，测量路径中不含 LLM，并在 EnterpriseOps-Gym 上验证。基于 2,128 次评估运行（九个模型、六个家族），摘要报告不可逆动作的损害在所有测量家族中普遍存在且具有内在随机性；没有任何任务在所有运行中都失败，单次干净审计在开发池中有 0.80 的概率漏掉一个会造成损害的 (model, task) 组合。作者还发现更强大的模型造成损害的任务数更少，并记录了一个模型家族在宣称拒绝的情况下执行了门控不可逆变更。
Motivation: 一次性审计（one-shot audit）在结构上无法可靠捕捉智能体损害，因为损伤行为是随机的，单次干净运行不能代表整体表现。需要一种重复运行、无 LLM 参与、以状态差异为 ground-truth 的测量方式来量化这种随机损害。
Method: AgentRelBench 从重复运行中的数据库状态差异计算按严重性定价的损害，并在测量路径中完全排除 LLM；研究采用预注册的确认性协议（含 per-claim 降级标准）与探索性前沿模型通过，在 EnterpriseOps-Gym 上对四个开发模型、三个预注册 held-out 模型和两个前沿模型进行 2,128 次运行。
Result: 在 42 个确认性 held-out 损害事件中零个是总是失败的；单次干净运行漏掉损害对的比例在开发池为 0.80（13 对），held-out 池为 0.575（5 对，按对加权）但低于预注册统计功效。造成损害的任务数随模型能力从 8B 模型的 7/20 降至最强模型的 1/20；探索性前沿通过中，最强模型唯一损害任务的单次运行损害概率为 p=0.16，单次审计漏掉率 84%。一个模型家族在声明拒绝时实际提交了不可逆变更，transcript 与 judge 评分判为安全拒绝，只有状态差异显示损害。
Conclusion: 作者主张一次性审计对智能体损伤存在结构性盲区，应改用重复运行、基于状态差异的预注册评测。所有确认性发现均带预注册降级标准，其中一项降级了作者自己最初偏爱的发现，并被如实报告。

papers.title: PhaseLoRA: Control-Regime-Conditioned Low-Rank Adaptation for Continuous-Action Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) is a natural way to adapt pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but most adapter designs apply temporally static updates throughout a control rollout, overlooking the phase-dependent nature of continuous-action manipulation. Such policies traverse distinct regimes, including approach, contact transition, grasping, transport, and placement, each requiring different adaptation behaviors. We propose \textbf{PhaseLoRA}, a lightweight LoRA parameterization that conditions adaptation at each action-chunk prediction step using two weakly supervised descriptors: fine-control tendency and event/boundary intensity. PhaseLoRA modulates the LoRA left factor in the action expert, allowing the effective low-rank update direction to vary over time while keeping the backbone largely frozen. On LIBERO, PhaseLoRA improves average success rate by 12.2 points over a matched-parameter high-rank LoRA baseline and outperforms stronger LoRA variants. Ablations show that random temporal modulation and scalar gating do not reproduce the performance of the full model, while update-direction analyses reveal structured temporal variation associated with the predicted control descriptors. These results establish within-trajectory conditioning as an effective lightweight PEFT axis for continuous-action VLA policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhaseLoRA，一种基于控制阶段条件化的低秩适配（LoRA）参数化方法，用于连续动作的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。它利用两个弱监督描述符（fine-control tendency 和 event/boundary intensity），在每个动作块预测步骤调节 action expert 中的 LoRA 左因子，使有效低秩更新方向随时间变化，同时保持主干网络冻结。在 LIBERO 上，相比参数匹配的高秩 LoRA 基线，平均成功率提升 12.2 个百分点，并优于更强的 LoRA 变体。
Motivation: 现有 PEFT 适配器在整个控制 rollout 中应用时间静态更新，忽略了连续动作操作中不同阶段（approach、contact transition、grasping、transport、placement）需要不同适配行为这一特性。
Method: 提出 PhaseLoRA 轻量级 LoRA 参数化方法，在 action expert 中根据两个弱监督描述符对 LoRA 左因子进行调制，使低秩更新方向随时间变化，同时保持主干网络大部分冻结。
Result: 在 LIBERO 上，PhaseLoRA 相比匹配参数的高秩 LoRA 基线将平均成功率提升 12.2 个百分点，并优于更强 LoRA 变体；消融表明随机时间调制和标量门控无法复现完整模型的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要将轨迹内条件化（within-trajectory conditioning）确立为连续动作 VLA 策略的一个有效轻量级 PEFT 维度，且更新方向分析显示存在与预测控制描述符相关的结构化时间变化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VTInstructor: Visual Trajectory Prompting for Navigation Instruction Generation in Continuous Environments
papers.abstract_en: Navigation instruction generation from ego-centric RGB video in continuous environments is an important yet challenging task for human-robot interaction and scalable dataset construction. Prior instruction generators assume discrete viewpoint graphs with panoramic observations, where trajectory structure is explicit; in continuous environments, however, the agent receives only a dense RGB stream, making trajectory cues difficult to recover. We propose VTInstructor, the first VLN instruction generation framework for continuous environments. Our key idea is to convert implicit trajectory geometry into explicit visual trajectory prompts: EDTC condenses long RGB trajectories into navigation-critical keyframes, VTP overlays path, turn, and goal cues onto these anchors, VTMod injects the resulting trajectory signals into the visual encoder, and VT-GRPO further calibrates this spatial injection during training, all without requiring a navigation graph, pre-built map, or scene reconstruction. On the challenging R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val Unseen benchmarks, VTInstructor sets a new state of the art across all standard NLG metrics, surpassing the strongest baseline by +0.357 CIDEr and +0.109 CIDEr, respectively. Beyond automatic metrics, VTInstructor-generated instructions raise a frozen follower's success rate to 63.3%, a +14.7 percentage-point gain over the best competing instruction source, and provide consistent data augmentation gains of +3 SR points on downstream navigation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VTInstructor，据称是首个面向连续环境的 VLN 指令生成框架，从 ego-centric RGB 视频生成导航指令。核心思路是把隐式的轨迹几何转化为显式的视觉轨迹提示：EDTC 将长 RGB 轨迹压缩为关键帧，VTP 在关键帧上叠加路径、转弯和终点线索，VTMod 将这些轨迹信号注入视觉编码器，VT-GRPO 在训练中校准该空间注入，全程不需要导航图、预建地图或场景重建。在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE Val Unseen 基准上，该方法在所有标准 NLG 指标上取得新 SOTA，分别超过最强基线 +0.357 CIDEr 和 +0.109 CIDEr。
Motivation: 现有指令生成器假设离散的视角图与全景观测，轨迹结构是显式的；而在连续环境中智能体只收到密集 RGB 流，轨迹线索难以恢复。该问题对机器人导航中的人机交互和可扩展数据集构建很重要。
Method: 提出 VTInstructor 流水线：EDTC 将长 RGB 轨迹浓缩为导航关键帧；VTP 在关键帧上叠加速度、转弯和终点提示；VTMod 将得到的轨迹信号注入视觉编码器；VT-GRPO 则在训练阶段进一步校准这种空间注入。方法不依赖导航图、预建地图或场景重建。
Result: 在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE Val Unseen 上，该框架在所有标准 NLG 指标上刷新 SOTA，超过最强基线 +0.357 CIDEr 与 +0.109 CIDEr；生成的指令使冻结的 follow 模型成功率提升至 63.3%（较最佳竞争指令源 +14.7 个百分点），并在下游导航任务上带来 +3 SR 的一致数据增强收益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这是首个面向连续环境的 VLN 指令生成框架，在无需导航图或场景重建的条件下同时提升指令生成指标与下游导航表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Earth Observation Foundation Models for Terrestrial Ecohydrology: From Representation Learning to Process Inference
papers.abstract_en: Earth observation foundation models (EOFMs) are emerging as reusable representation frameworks for data-driven retrieval, prediction and process modelling within ecohydrology, which integrate EO, meteorological forcing and process models to characterise coupled water, energy and carbon dynamics in vegetation and soil across scales. However, there is yet to be an ecohydrology-specific synthesis assessing the EOFM relevance, application evidence or evaluation requirements under uncertain reference data, scale mismatch and temporal dependence. Here, we develop a framework for determining when EOFMs support interpretable inference and identify a mismatch between EOFMs and ecohydrological requirements. Firstly, an observation-to-inference hierarchy shows that relevance depends on target-specific sensing pathways, spatial-temporal support and traceable uncertainty. Secondly, a meta-analysis shows that pretraining is dominated by reflected optical and active-microwave data, with sparse thermal coverage and no passive-microwave-emission sources. Thirdly, our synthesis of ecohydrological applications finds strongest support for spatial context, label-efficient adaptation and hybrid workflows. Evidence declines with inference depth; independent validation of fluxes, coupled dynamics, event trajectories, calibrated uncertainty and decision benefits remains sparse. Fourthly, our benchmark audit finds stronger coverage of fair adaptation and reproducibility in general EOFM suites, and of process targets, direct reference evidence and distribution shifts in ecohydrological evaluations; physical consistency and uncertainty remain weakly assessed. These findings motivate a process-aware framework aligning EOFM design and evaluation with the target variable, observation pathway and process timescale, supporting trustworthy monitoring and interpretation of coupled water, energy and carbon dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对地球观测基础模型 (EOFMs) 在陆地生态水文学中的应用进行系统综述与元分析，提出从观测到推理的层级框架，并基于对预训练数据、生态水文应用证据和基准评估的审计，指出当前 EOFM 与生态水文需求之间存在错配，进而呼吁面向过程感知的模型设计与评估框架。
Motivation: 生态水文学需要数据驱动的反演、预测和过程建模，但缺少针对 EOFM 的相关性、应用证据和评估要求的专门综述；在参考数据不确定、尺度不匹配和时间依赖条件下，如何判断 EOFM 是否支持可解释推理尚不明确。
Method: 构建从观测到推理的层级来分析 EOFM 相关性（目标特异的传感路径、时空支撑和可追溯不确定性），对预训练数据分布进行元分析，并综合生态水文应用证据与基准审计结果，最终提出过程感知的对齐框架。
Result: 预训练以反射光学和主动微波数据为主，热红外覆盖稀疏且缺少被动微波发射源；生态水文应用在空间上下文、标签高效适应和混合工作流方面证据最强，而通量、耦合动态、事件轨迹、校准不确定性和决策收益的独立验证稀少；基准审计显示通用 EOFM 套件在公平适应性和可复现性上覆盖更好，生态水文评估则对过程目标、直接参考证据和分布偏移覆盖更好，物理一致性和不确定性评估均较弱。
Conclusion: 作者认为 EOFM 设计与评估需要与目标变量、观测路径和过程时间尺度对齐，以支持对耦合水、能量和碳动态的可信监测与解释。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Spatio-Temporal Context Modeling for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: 4D occupancy forecasting models the spatio-temporal evolution of 3D scenes and is crucial for autonomous driving, especially for corner-case simulation. Existing methods often rely on discrete tokenization followed by autoregressive prediction, yet struggle with geometric distortion in static structures and inconsistent temporal coherence over the forecasting horizon. In this work, we propose a Geometry-Aware Spatio-Temporal context modeling method (GAST) for 4D occupancy forecasting, built upon progressive explicit-implicit generation and dual-path spatio-temporal modeling. Specifically, the generation module produces per-frame occupancy with high geometric fidelity and semantic plausibility through pose-driven warping, motion-aware feature modulation, and attention-based feature refinement. Subsequently, the spatio-temporal module enhances spatial consistency through global context aggregation while capturing scene evolution through temporal dynamics extraction. This unified design enables joint optimization of historical reconstruction and future forecasting in an end-to-end manner. Extensive experiments on Occ3D-nuScenes demonstrate the superiority of our method, outperforming the state-of-the-art by 7.67% in mIoU and 6.44% in IoU with a 2.84x speedup, while maintaining strong performance in long-term forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出几何感知时空上下文建模方法（GAST），用于自动驾驶中的4D占用预测（4D occupancy forecasting）。该方法基于渐进式显式-隐式生成和双路径时空建模，在Occ3D-nuScenes上较现有最优方法提升mIoU 7.67%、IoU 6.44%，并实现2.84倍加速，同时在长期预测中保持较强性能。
Motivation: 现有4D占用预测方法常采用离散token化加自回归预测，但存在静态结构几何畸变和预测时域上时间一致性不足的问题，影响自动驾驶长尾场景仿真。
Method: 生成模块通过位姿驱动的warping、运动感知特征调制和基于注意力的特征细化逐帧生成高几何保真度与语义合理性的占用；时空模块通过全局上下文聚合增强空间一致性，并通过时序动态提取刻画场景演变；整体采用历史重建与未来预测的端到端联合优化。
Result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上，该方法相比state-of-the-art在mIoU上提升7.67%，在IoU上提升6.44%，并获得2.84倍加速，同时保持长期预测的强性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一设计能够联合优化历史重建和未来预测，并通过显式-隐式生成与双路径时空建模实现当前最优结果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Memory-Bounded Continuation of Greedy Sampling for Continual Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Greedy sampling produces a compact yet representative summary of normal data, which is essential for reliable anomaly detection that relies on measuring distance from normality. For continual anomaly detection where tasks arrive sequentially, extending greedy sampling is straightforward with unbounded memory through coreset accumulation. However, practical deployment requires fixed memory where the coreset size remains constant regardless of task count. We observe that continued greedy sampling, which iteratively applies greedy selection over previously greedy-sampled sets, effectively preserves representativeness under strict memory limits. Despite discarding data at each step to satisfy the memory constraint, coreset quality degrades gracefully rather than catastrophically, enabling reliable anomaly detection across the tasks. We provide theoretical justification by showing that resulting greedy-continued coreset approximates the oracle coreset within a bounded gap. We instantiate this principle in ContCore, which constructs a greedy-continued coreset through greedy expansion on new task features followed by greedy consolidation to enforce the memory budget. Unlike neural methods susceptible to catastrophic forgetting or naive coreset accumulation requiring unbounded memory, ContCore maintains fixed memory with theoretical guarantees. Empirically, ContCore achieves state-of-the-art performance across 11 task schedules on MVTecAD and VisA, and extends effectively to online continual AD settings where prior methods degrade significantly. Code: https://github.com/jungyg/ContCore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对连续异常检测 (continual anomaly detection) 中固定内存限制下的核心集构造问题，提出 ContCore 方法。核心思想是反复在先前贪婪采样得到的核心集上继续应用贪婪选择（greedy-continued coreset），在不增加内存的前提下保持数据代表性，并给出该核心集与 oracle 核心集误差有界的理论保证。实验在 MVTecAD 和 VisA 的 11 个任务调度上达到最优，并能推广到在线连续异常检测场景。
Motivation: 连续异常检测依赖正常数据的紧凑代表性摘要，而任务按顺序到达时，朴素核心集累积需要无界内存，神经网络方法又容易遭受灾难性遗忘 (catastrophic forgetting)。实际部署要求内存固定，因此需要一种在固定核心集大小下仍能保持代表性的连续采样方法。
Method: ContCore 通过两步构造贪婪延续核心集：先对新任务特征进行贪婪扩展 (greedy expansion)，再做贪婪合并 (greedy consolidation) 以满足固定内存预算。作者同时证明这种反复对已贪婪采样集合继续贪婪选择的方式，能使结果核心集逼近 oracle 核心集且误差有界。
Result: 摘要报告 ContCore 在 MVTecAD 和 VisA 上的 11 个任务调度中达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并且在先前方法显著退化的在线连续异常检测 (online continual AD) 设置中仍然有效。
Conclusion: 作者认为在有界内存下，贪婪延续采样能够使核心集质量优雅退化而非灾难性恶化，从而在提供理论保证的同时维持固定内存开销。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: ContCore 通过两步构造贪婪延续核心集：先对新任务特征进行贪婪扩展 (greedy expansion)，再做贪婪合并 (greedy consolidation) 以满足固定内存预算。作者同时证明这种反复对已贪婪采样集合继续贪婪选择的方式，能使结果核心集逼近 oracle 核心集且误差有界。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 ContCore 在 MVTecAD 和 VisA 上的 11 个任务调度中达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并且在先前方法显著退化的在线连续异常检测 (online continual AD) 设置中仍然有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为在有界内存下，贪婪延续采样能够使核心集质量优雅退化而非灾难性恶化，从而在提供理论保证的同时维持固定内存开销。

papers.title: On the Adversarial Robustness of Remote Sensing Semantic Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: Semantic change detection (SCD) is a bitemporal dense-prediction task that jointly identifies changed regions and their semantic states before and after change. Unlike single-image segmentation or binary change detection, SCD couples two temporal inputs with timestamp-wise semantic prediction, change localization, and final semantic-change decoding, creating adversarial dependencies that are not captured by conventional robustness protocols. We present a task-specific evaluation framework that separates output-side attack objectives from input-side temporal perturbation access, enabling systematic analysis of component vulnerability and cross-temporal propagation. Experiments on four datasets and six representative CNN-, Transformer-, and state-space-based models evaluate component-level and temporal objectives, single- and dual-timestamp perturbations, multiple attack methods, and cross-architecture transferability. The results show that final semantic-change predictions can be severely corrupted even when binary change localization remains comparatively stable, and that perturbations or attack objectives associated with one timestamp can propagate to the prediction of the other. These behaviors occur across different architecture families, while direct cross-model transfer remains considerably weaker than white-box attacks. The study demonstrates that adversarial robustness in SCD depends on the complete bitemporal prediction pathway rather than on an individual branch or backbone family, and provides a structured protocol for evaluating robustness in coupled bitemporal image analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/EricYu97/AdvSCD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感语义变化检测 (semantic change detection, SCD) 提出任务特定的对抗鲁棒性评估框架，将输出侧攻击目标与输入侧时间扰动访问分离。在四个数据集和六种 CNN、Transformer、状态空间模型上评估组件级与时间级目标、单双时间戳扰动、多种攻击方法及跨架构迁移性。结果显示最终语义变化预测可被严重破坏而二值变化定位相对稳定，且一个时间戳的扰动或攻击目标会传播到另一个时间戳的预测。
Motivation: SCD 是双时相密集预测任务，耦合两个时间输入、时间戳级语义预测、变化定位和最终语义变化解码，产生常规鲁棒性协议无法捕捉的对抗依赖。既有鲁棒性评估方法未针对这种双时相耦合结构设计。
Method: 提出一个结构化评估框架，显式区分输出侧攻击目标（组件级与时间级）和输入侧时间扰动访问（单/双时间戳），用于系统分析组件脆弱性和跨时间传播；实验使用四个数据集、六种代表性模型族、多种攻击方法和跨架构迁移设置。
Result: 实验表明，即使二值变化定位保持相对稳定，最终语义变化预测仍可能被严重破坏；与一个时间戳相关的扰动或攻击目标可以传播到另一个时间戳的预测。这些行为在不同架构族中均出现，但直接跨模型迁移的攻击效果明显弱于白盒攻击。
Conclusion: SCD 的对抗鲁棒性取决于完整的双时相预测通路，而不是单个分支或骨干网络家族；作者提供了评估耦合双时相图像分析鲁棒性的结构化协议，并开源代码。

papers.title: BrainLinear: A Linear Model for Brain Network Analysis in Sparse Tangent Subspaces
papers.abstract_en: Functional connectome analysis examines brain-region interactions to understand and identify disorders such as autism spectrum disorder and Alzheimer's disease. Existing methods typically use GNNs and Transformers to model the full functional connectivity matrix. However, processing tens of thousands of connections introduces redundancy and noise, increases computational cost, and limits connection-level interpretability. This raises a central question: do we really need complex interaction modeling, or is identifying a small set of disease-relevant connectivity patterns sufficient? To answer this question, we propose BrainLinear, a lightweight geometry-aware framework for mining disease-discriminative connectome patterns. BrainLinear first maps each functional connectivity matrix to a shared tangent space centered at the Fréchet mean of the training set, capturing subject-specific deviations while respecting matrix geometry. It then scores each ROI-pair tangent direction by its classification contribution and disease--control difference, retaining Top-$K$ directions as a compact representation. Finally, a shallow multilayer perceptron performs classification on the selected representation. Experiments on ABIDE and ADNI show that BrainLinear matches or exceeds strong GNN and Transformer baselines at a fraction of their cost: it improves AUC and ACC over the best baseline for each metric by up to $3.54$ and $1.39$ percentage points, while reducing runtime and peak GPU memory by $84.0\%$ and $68.4\%$ relative to the closest baseline in AUC. The selected directions are directionally consistent with between-group displacements and organized across major functional systems, supporting connection-level interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BrainLinear，一个轻量级几何感知框架，用于从功能连接矩阵中挖掘疾病判别性的连接组模式。方法将每个矩阵映射到以训练集 Fréchet 均值为中心的共享切线空间，按分类贡献和疾病-对照差异对 ROI 对切线方向排序并保留 Top-K，最后用浅层多层感知机分类。在 ABIDE 和 ADNI 上，BrainLinear 以远低于 GNN/Transformer 的成本达到或超过强基线，并支持连接层面的解释。
Motivation: 现有基于 GNN 和 Transformer 的方法建模完整功能连接矩阵，但数万条连接带来冗余、噪声、高计算成本，并限制连接层面的可解释性。作者质疑复杂交互建模是否必要，提出识别少量疾病相关连接模式是否足够。
Method: BrainLinear 首先将每个功能连接矩阵映射到以训练集 Fréchet 均值为中心的共享切线空间，保留矩阵几何结构并捕捉个体偏差；然后按分类贡献和疾病-对照差异对每个 ROI-pair 切线方向评分，保留 Top-K 方向作为紧凑表示；最后用浅层多层感知机在该表示上分类。
Result: 在 ABIDE 和 ADNI 数据集上，BrainLinear 在 AUC 和 ACC 上分别比每个指标的最佳基线最高提升 3.54 和 1.39 个百分点，运行时间相对 AUC 最优基线降低 84.0%，峰值 GPU 内存降低 68.4%。
Conclusion: 作者认为识别少量疾病判别性连接模式足以达到甚至超过复杂交互模型的性能，所选方向与组间位移方向一致并分布在不同功能系统中，支持连接层面的可解释性。

papers.title: VibeWorlding: Can Multimodal Agents Construct 3D Open Worlds End-to-End?
papers.abstract_en: Constructing an interactive 3D open world from a user query is important. However, existing methods are primarily evaluated on idealized, simple queries, making it difficult to systematically analyze and compare how multimodal agents understand user intent, use 3D tools, and reason over textual and visual 3D world information. To this end, we propose VibeWorlding, a unified framework for benchmarking and training vibe worlding agents: a multimodal agent that can autonomously infer user intent, plan scene layout, invoke 3D tools, and reflect on the multimodal feedback in a multi-turn agent-environment interaction process. To achieve this, we first build VWE-BENCH, a benchmark of 2,616 high-quality 3D assets, 323 human-annotated seed 3D worlds, and 6,828 reverse-synthesized multimodal user queries, split into verified queries with ground-truth and unverified queries with carefully designed rubrics. Moreover, we develop VibeWorlding-Gym, a joint multimodal RL post-training framework that integrates (1) a sandbox environment unifying asset retrieval, editing, and image rendering as MCP tools, and (2) a rubric-based verifier that combines physical feasibility and intent fulfillment verification, supporting both fair model evaluation and scalable multimodal RL reward service. Our experiments show that current frontier MLLMs are far from solving the vibe worlding agent task, with even GPT-5.5 and Qwen3.8-Max reaching below 60% success rate, and trace the bottleneck to precise 3D world editing. We further find that RL training can ease this weakness and enable open-source MLLMs to even surpass closed-source frontiers: our VibeWorlder-8B is comparable to frontier MLLMs, while our flagship VibeWorlder-30B-A3B attains the best overall Pass@1 among all evaluated models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VibeWorlding，一个用于基准测试和训练多模态 3D 世界构建智能体（vibe worlding agent）的统一框架，该智能体可在多轮智能体-环境交互中从用户查询自主推断意图、规划场景布局、调用 3D 工具并反思多模态反馈。作者构建了包含 2,616 个 3D 资产、323 个人类标注种子世界和 6,828 条反向合成多模态查询的 VWE-BENCH 基准，以及集成 MCP 工具沙盒和基于 rubric 验证器的 VibeWorlding-Gym 多模态 RL 后训练框架。实验显示当前前沿 MLLM（如 GPT-5.5 和 Qwen3.8-Max）在该任务上成功率不足 60%，主要瓶颈是精确 3D 世界编辑；经 RL 训练后，开源模型 VibeWorlder-8B 可比肩前沿模型，VibeWorlder-30B-A3B 取得最佳 Pass@1。
Motivation: 现有方法主要基于理想化、简单查询进行评估，难以系统分析和比较多模态智能体如何理解用户意图、使用 3D 工具并在文本与视觉 3D 世界信息上进行推理，缺少统一的训练与评测框架。
Method: 提出统一框架，包含两部分：VWE-BENCH 基准，通过反向合成生成带 ground-truth 的验证查询和带精心设计 rubric 的未验证查询；VibeWorlding-Gym，即联合多模态 RL 后训练框架，其沙盒环境将资产检索、编辑和图像渲染统一为 MCP 工具，并采用结合物理可行性与意图满足性验证的 rubric 验证器，同时支持公平评估和可扩展的多模态 RL 奖励服务。
Result: 实验表明当前前沿 MLLM 远未解决该任务，GPT-5.5 和 Qwen3.8-Max 的成功率均低于 60%，作者将瓶颈追溯到精确 3D 世界编辑。RL 训练可缓解这一弱点，使开源模型 VibeWorlder-8B 与前沿模型相当，而旗舰模型 VibeWorlder-30B-A3B 在所有被评估模型中取得最佳整体 Pass@1。
Conclusion: 作者强调该开放世界智能体任务仍远未被现有前沿模型解决，并表明 RL 训练能够弥补开源模型在精确 3D 编辑上的短板，使其在整体表现上超越闭源前沿模型。

papers.title: Boundary-Aligned Contribution Routing for Robust Optical--SAR Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Optical imagery provides rich appearance cues, whereas synthetic aperture radar (SAR) offers observations that are less sensitive to illumination and weather, making optical--SAR fusion attractive for remote-sensing object detection. However, the presence of multiple modalities does not guarantee beneficial fusion: imperfect spatial, temporal, and semantic correspondence can make an otherwise intact stream conditionally harmful and induce negative cross-modal transfer. We handle this issue through a model-specific task-utility perspective and learn task-conditioned contribution routing using detection supervision alone. The proposed fusion-boundary-aligned routing regulates each modality's contribution before the first learned cross-modal feature-value mixing operation. For architectures with frequent shallow interaction, a Feature Router performs cross-conditioned, group-addressable modulation near the input; for dual-backbone architectures, a Dual-Statistic Semantic Router predicts stream-level contribution weights from modality-specific average and maximum statistics before late semantic fusion. The routers require no explicit utility supervision, quality labels, reconstruction, or distillation. Experiments on M4-SAR and SpaceNet6-OTD cover nominal full inputs, controlled correspondence shifts, missing modalities, and four nonzero modality-corruption scenarios. Across the reported clean-training controls, routing improves full-input $\text{mAP}_{50}$ by 0.5--5.9 points. Relative to the corresponding modality-dropout baselines, it raises missing-modality $\text{mAP}_{50}$ by 7.6--41.6 points and reduces the negative-transfer rate by up to 12.7 percentage points. Spearman correlations between the learned routing weights and model-specific leave-one-modality-out utility range from 0.45 to 0.66, supporting the task-utility interpretation of the routing coefficients.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对光学-SAR 融合目标检测中的负跨模态迁移问题，提出融合边界对齐的贡献路由方法，仅用检测监督学习任务条件下的逐模态贡献。作者设计了两种路由器：面向浅层频繁交互结构的 Feature Router 和面向双骨干结构的 Dual-Statistic Semantic Router，均在首次跨模态特征值混合前调节模态贡献。实验在 M4-SAR 与 SpaceNet6-OTD 上覆盖完整输入、对应偏移、缺失模态和四种模态损坏场景，报告全输入 mAP50 提升 0.5-5.9 点，缺失模态相对对应模态 dropout 基线提升 7.6-41.6 点，负迁移率最多降低 12.7 个百分点。
Motivation: 光学和 SAR 模态互补，但空间、时间和语义对应不完美会使原本完好的单模态流变成条件性有害信息，导致负跨模态迁移；现有融合方法通常需要显式效用监督、质量标签、重建或蒸馏来缓解，本文希望仅依靠检测监督实现稳健的模态贡献调节。
Method: 提出模型特定的任务效用视角，学习任务条件化的贡献路由，并在第一次可学习的跨模态特征值混合操作之前约束各模态贡献。对浅层频繁交互结构使用 Feature Router，在输入附近进行跨条件、组可寻址调制；对双骨干结构使用 Dual-Statistic Semantic Router，从模态特有的平均和最大统计量预测流级贡献权重，再进行晚期语义融合。路由器不需要显式效用监督、质量标签、重建或蒸馏。

Conclusion: 作者认为路由系数可以被解释为模型特定的逐模态任务效用，且仅用检测监督即可缓解负跨模态迁移。实验范围限于两个数据集以及四类模态损坏场景，结论的推广性取决于这些设定。

papers.title: VGGT-Align: Bridging Local Reconstruction and Global Consistency for Long-Sequence 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Maintaining global geometric consistency is a central challenge in long-sequence 3D reconstruction, with scale drift being the most critical failure mode. In chunk-based inference pipelines, the scale degree of freedom in sequential Sim(3) alignment is left unconstrained, causing estimation errors to compound multiplicatively and distort global trajectories and point cloud geometry. We present a scale-consistency enhancement framework built on a key insight: in structured environments such as driving scenes, geometric quantities arising from environmental regularity remain inherently invariant across temporal segments, and discrepancies in their per-chunk measurements directly expose inter-chunk scale drift. We propose Scene Geometric Invariant Anchoring (SGIA), which extracts dominant geometric invariants from each chunk's predicted point cloud via coarse-to-fine robust estimation and exploits their cross-chunk consistency to establish scale constraints independent of point cloud registration, explicitly degenerating 7-DoF Sim(3) alignment into 6-DoF rigid-body transformation and severing chain-wise scale error propagation at its source. We further introduce a lightweight test-time adaptation strategy that fine-tunes only normalization-layer parameters via multi-objective self-supervision, progressively improving intra-chunk predictions along the sequence. Both modules are plug-and-play and require no offline retraining. Experiments on multiple long-sequence benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, reducing absolute trajectory error by up to 32% with significant gains in trajectory stability and reconstruction quality. Code: https://github.com/WZ-CS/VGGT-Align

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向长序列三维重建中的全局几何一致性问题，指出分块推理下顺序 Sim(3) 对齐中未约束的尺度自由度会导致误差乘法累积并造成尺度漂移。作者提出尺度一致性增强框架，包含 Scene Geometric Invariant Anchoring (SGIA) 与轻量测试时自适应策略，在不离线重训的情况下将绝对轨迹误差最多降低 32%。
Motivation: 长序列三维重建中尺度漂移是最关键的不稳定因素；分块推理流程里 Sim(3) 对齐的尺度自由度未被约束，使估计误差按乘法方式累积并扭曲全局轨迹与点云几何。
Method: 提出 SGIA，从每个 chunk 预测点云中通过粗到细的鲁棒估计提取主导几何不变量，并利用跨 chunk 一致性建立独立于点云配准的尺度约束，将 7 自由度 Sim(3) 对齐退化为 6 自由度刚体变换；同时引入仅微调归一化层参数的测试时自适应策略，通过多目标自监督沿序列逐步改善 chunk 内预测。
Result: 在多个长序列基准上的实验表明该方法达到当前最优性能，绝对轨迹误差最多降低 32%，轨迹稳定性与重建质量均有显著提升。
Conclusion: 两个模块均为即插即用且无需离线重训；作者强调通过截断链式尺度误差传播可以从源头提升长序列重建的尺度一致性。

papers.title: UAV Video Deblurring via Motion-Aware Diffusion: A Path to Robust Target Detection
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) play a crucial role in various scenarios ranging from disaster response to traffic surveillance. However, aerial video footage often suffers from severe motion blur due to rapid flight maneuvers, vibrations, and camera panning, which can significantly degrade downstream tasks such as target detection. Our goal is to explore a computationally-efficient and effective video deblurring approach to enhance UAV target detection performance. To reduce computational cost, we first propose an Adaptive Latent Scale Selector that dynamically adjusts the latent space resolution according to the intensity of UAV motion, thus balancing detail preservation with inference efficiency. To ensure temporal consistency, we introduce a Multi-Frame Alignment and Learnable Gating module to warp and gate the preceding frames, allowing the model to fuse only relevant temporal information and suppress misaligned or uninformative features. Our method can effectively recover sharp details from the UAV video stream. Extensive experiments on real UAV benchmarks demonstrate that our method not only yields superior deblurring performance but also significantly boosts target detection accuracy, making it highly applicable to robust aerial vision tasks.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. Published in the 2025 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机航拍视频中的运动模糊问题，提出一种基于运动感知扩散 (motion-aware diffusion) 的视频去模糊方法，以提升目标检测性能。方法包含自适应潜在尺度选择器 (Adaptive Latent Scale Selector) 和多帧对齐与可学习门控模块 (Multi-Frame Alignment and Learnable Gating)，在真实无人机基准上取得更好的去模糊效果并显著提升目标检测精度。
Motivation: 无人机在快速飞行、振动和相机摇摄时会产生严重运动模糊，导致目标检测等下游任务性能下降；现有方法在计算效率与细节保留之间难以平衡。
Method: 提出自适应潜在尺度选择器，根据无人机运动强度动态调整潜在空间分辨率以平衡细节保留与推理效率；引入多帧对齐与可学习门控模块，对前序帧进行扭曲 (warp) 和门控融合，仅保留相关时间信息并抑制未对齐或无信息特征。
Result: 在真实 UAV 基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在去模糊性能上优于现有方法，并显著提升目标检测准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法计算高效且能有效恢复锐利细节，适用于鲁棒的空中视觉任务。

papers.title: Decentralized Federated Learning for Heterogeneous Multi-Task Semantic Communication
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative training in distributed semantic communication (DSC) networks typically relies on decentralized federated learning (DFL). However, pushing topology-agnostic aggregation into heterogeneous, multi-task environments creates a fundamental bottleneck: it drives negative transfer and overconsensus bias (OCB). This paper introduces a personalized DSC framework that cuts off this cross-task interference. At the node level, a policy-driven multi-path routing mechanism separates task-specific features from shared representations to preserve local fidelity. Across the network, we deploy a "communicationwhile- aggregation" protocol. It calibrates a column-stochastic consensus matrix using task affinities. This limits the system to absorbing complementary knowledge while actively blocking mismatched parameter updates. To bound the convergence, we derive a unified Lyapunov drift analysis. We reveal a strict Ushaped trade-off: deeper topological mixing reduces variance but amplifies structural OCB. Resolving this tension yields a closed-form expression for the optimal aggregation depth. We evaluate the proposed framework on NYU-v2, where the results reveal a clear trade-off between insufficient aggregation and excessive topological mixing. At the analytically derived optimal aggregation depth, our method achieves a 4.77% global relative improvement over the no-aggregation baseline and outperforms decentralized FedAvg, FedAMP, and heuristic max aggregation. We further evaluate the framework on Taskonomy and imperfect wireless links to examine the effects of network-size variation and wireless-link reliability.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 9 figures, Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Communications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分布式语义通信（DSC）网络中异构多任务环境下的协作训练问题，提出一个个性化 DSC 框架，在节点级用策略驱动的多路径路由分离任务特定特征与共享表示，在网络级部署"通信即聚合"（communication-while-aggregation）协议，用任务亲和度校准列随机共识矩阵，以阻止不匹配的参数更新。作者推导统一的 Lyapunov 漂移分析，揭示聚合深度与结构型过共识偏差（OCB）之间的 U 形权衡，并给出最优聚合深度的闭式解。
Motivation: 现有去中心化联邦学习（DFL）将拓扑无关的聚合直接用于异构、多任务环境，导致负迁移（negative transfer）和过共识偏差（OCB），这是分布式语义通信中跨任务干扰的根本瓶颈。
Method: 节点层面采用策略驱动的多路径路由机制，将任务特定特征与共享表示分离以保持局部保真度；网络层面引入"通信即聚合"协议，利用任务亲和度校准列随机共识矩阵，只吸收互补知识并屏蔽不匹配的参数更新；并以 Lyapunov 漂移分析为收敛性提供界，得到最优聚合深度的闭式表达式。
Result: 在 NYU-v2 上，分析得到的最优聚合深度相比无聚合基线取得 4.77% 的全局相对提升，并优于去中心化 FedAvg、FedAMP 和启发式最大聚合；另在 Taskonomy 和不完美无线链路上评估了网络规模变化与无线链路可靠性的影响。
Conclusion: 作者强调存在严格的 U 形权衡：更深的拓扑混合降低方差但放大结构型 OCB，解析推导的最优聚合深度可缓解这一矛盾，从而在异构多任务语义通信中实现个性化协作训练。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Towards Standardized Evaluation in Automated Domain Modeling: Introducing a Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Domain modeling plays an essential role in domain-driven design, capturing essential entities and their relationships within a specific domain. Despite advancements in automated domain modeling, the absence of standardized benchmarks has hindered the comparative assessment of existing approaches. This paper introduces a benchmark designed to address this gap. The benchmark combines the 45-record Golden UML Modelset (Verbruggen et al., 2025) on Zenodo, as distributed by the Text2UML project of Calamo, Mecella, and Snoeck (Calamo et al., 2025), with the 8-record reference archive of Chen et al. (Chen et al., 2023a,b), enabling the evaluation of automated domain modeling approaches across different levels of complexity and scale. Given a natural language description, the task is to generate a corresponding domain model. For each description, a reference domain model is provided as ground truth. A metric is used to compare the generated domain model with the corresponding ground-truth model. To demonstrate the utility of the benchmark, we evaluate multiple automated domain modeling approaches, including heuristic rule-based methods and LLM-driven strategies. In accordance with the FAIR4RS recommendations (Chue Hong et al., 2022), the benchmark is provided as a research artifact to encourage reuse and support future research on automated domain modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动化领域建模（automated domain modeling）缺乏标准化基准的问题，提出了一个结合 Golden UML Modelset（45条记录）与 Chen 等人参考归档（8条记录）的基准，任务是根据自然语言描述生成对应的领域模型，并以参考模型作为 ground truth 进行度量。作者评估了启发式规则方法和 LLM 驱动策略，并按 FAIR4RS 建议以研究工件形式发布。
Motivation: 自动化领域建模虽有进展，但缺少标准化基准，导致现有方法难以进行横向比较评估。
Method: 构建一个由两个公开数据源（45 条记录的 Golden UML Modelset 和 8 条记录的参考归档）组成的基准，定义从自然语言描述生成领域模型的任务，并提供参考模型作为 ground truth 以及比较度量；在此基础上评估多种自动化建模方法，包括启发式规则方法和 LLM 驱动策略。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅说明多种方法（启发式规则方法与 LLM 驱动策略）在基准上得到了评估。
Conclusion: 该基准作为符合 FAIR4RS 建议的研究工件发布，旨在促进自动化领域建模研究的复用与后续发展。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 构建一个由两个公开数据源（45 条记录的 Golden UML Modelset 和 8 条记录的参考归档）组成的基准，定义从自然语言描述生成领域模型的任务，并提供参考模型作为 ground truth 以及比较度量；在此基础上评估多种自动化建模方法，包括启发式规则方法和 LLM 驱动策略。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅说明多种方法（启发式规则方法与 LLM 驱动策略）在基准上得到了评估。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该基准作为符合 FAIR4RS 建议的研究工件发布，旨在促进自动化领域建模研究的复用与后续发展。

papers.title: Demographic Injection in Medical Language Models under Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Clinical-AI guidance increasingly recommends prompting language models to reason with attention to diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). We measure a side effect that misrepresents patients: a one-sentence DEI prompt appended to a medical question leads models to add patient demographic attributes (race, socioeconomic status, sex) the question never stated, in effect rewriting who the patient is. We call this demographic injection. Across 47 models, four medical benchmarks, and 376,000 responses scored by a validated model-judge pipeline, a single DEI prompt raises the injection rate from 0.7% to 33.1% (47x) in all 47 of 47 models, attributable to the equity content rather than to added length (18x above a length-matched control; p=1.4x10^-14). Most added content is a general population statement that leaves the answer unchanged, but a smaller subset attaches an attribute to the specific patient or changes the selected option (0.25-2.4% of responses, 99.8% toward the incorrect option), where the invented demographic changes the answer the model recommends. Phrasing scales the effect from 14% to 56%. DEI prompts are just one example of a more general mechanism. Any instruction that nudges how a model reasons can make it add unrequested details, including details about the patient. Flagged outputs are treated as model errors under study, not clinical guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在医疗语言模型中加入多样性、公平与包容（DEI）提示的副作用。作者发现，在医学问题后追加一句DEI提示会导致模型虚构患者的人口统计属性（种族、社会经济地位、性别），从而改写患者身份，这种现象被称为人口统计注入（demographic injection）。在47个模型、四个医学基准和376,000个响应的评估中，单句DEI提示将注入率从0.7%提升至33.1%（47倍），且所有47个模型均受影响。大部分新增内容为不改变答案的通用人群陈述，但小部分会将属性附加到具体患者或改变所选选项，导致推荐错误答案。
Motivation: 临床AI指南日益建议提示模型以关注DEI的方式进行推理，但作者指出这一建议可能带来未被量化的副作用：模型会添加问题中从未声明的患者人口统计信息，从而在事实上改写患者身份。
Method: 作者在47个模型、四个医学基准上，利用经过验证的模型裁判流水线对376,000个响应进行评分，通过对比单句DEI提示与长度匹配的控制提示，量化人口统计注入率，并检验效果归因于公平内容而非额外长度。
Result: 单个DEI提示将注入率从0.7%提升到33.1%（47倍），全部47个模型中都出现；相比长度匹配控制提示为18倍（p=1.4×10^-14）。0.25%-2.4%的响应将属性附加到特定患者或改变所选选项，其中99.8%转向错误选项；提示措辞的变化使效果在14%到56%之间变化。
Conclusion: 作者强调DEI提示只是更一般机制的一个例子：任何影响模型推理方式的指令都可能使模型添加未要求的细节，包括关于患者的细节。作者明确表示，被标记的输出在研究中被视为模型错误，而非临床指导。

papers.title: Robust structure from motion for aerial-ground images via detector-free feature matching and multi-view track refinement
papers.abstract_en: Integrated 3D reconstruction from aerial-ground images is essential for generating high-precision urban 3D models, yet severe variations in viewpoint, scale, and rotation make robust feature matching highly challenging. To address these limitations, this study introduces a rotation-robust detector-free matching network coupled with multi-view track refinement for incremental Structure from Motion (ISfM). The proposed workflow features four key modules. First, rotation-aware feature extraction replaces traditional convolutions with an Omnidirectional State Space Block (OSS Block) that selectively scans across eight symmetrical directions to model long-range spatial dependencies and synthesize rotation-invariant feature maps. Second, multi-scale attention transformation utilizes quadtree attention to build a hierarchical token pyramid that isolates high-association token regions and discards irrelevant areas, capturing long-range context with linear computational complexity. Third, bi-directional feature matching executes a symmetric coarse-to-fine matching scheme where coarse alignment computes dual-direction Softmax confidence matrices under mutual nearest neighbor constraints, and fine alignment uses a multi-layer perceptron to regress sub-pixel coordinate offsets. Finally, multi-view track refinement employs an integrated indexing structure to evaluate localized spatial proximity and link disjoint sub-tracks to the highest-confidence anchor point, ensuring stable feature repeatability across the ISfM pipeline. By using real aerial-ground datasets, experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method improves AUC at 5° pose error by 93.9% compared with LoFTR and achieves the highest precision in ISfM reconstruction, with the improved accuracy ranging from 27.6% to 32.7%. The proposed method provides a reliable solution for integrated 3D reconstruction of aerial-ground images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对航拍-地面影像集成三维重建中视角、尺度和旋转剧烈变化导致的特征匹配难题，提出一种旋转鲁棒的 detector-free 特征匹配网络并结合多视图轨迹精化用于增量式运动恢复结构 (ISfM)。工作流包含四个模块：基于 Omnidirectional State Space Block (OSS Block) 的旋转感知特征提取、基于 quadtree attention 的多尺度注意力变换、双向 coarse-to-fine 特征匹配，以及多视图轨迹精化。实验表明该方法在 5° 姿态误差下的 AUC 相比 LoFTR 提升 93.9%，并在 ISfM 重建中达到最高精度。
Motivation: 航拍与地面影像的集成三维重建需要高精度城市三维模型，但视角、尺度和旋转的剧烈变化使鲁棒特征匹配极具挑战，现有方法难以稳定处理这类跨视角影像。
Method: 提出一个四模块流程：旋转感知特征提取用 OSS Block 替代传统卷积，在八个对称方向选择性扫描以建模长程空间依赖并生成旋转不变特征图；多尺度注意力变换采用 quadtree attention 构建层次化 token 金字塔，隔离高关联区域并丢弃无关区域，以线性复杂度捕获长程上下文；双向特征匹配执行对称的 coarse-to-fine 匹配，粗对齐在互近邻约束下计算双向 Softmax 置信矩阵，细对齐用多层感知机回归亚像素偏移；多视图轨迹精化用集成索引结构评估局部空间邻近性，将不连续子轨迹连接到最高置信锚点。
Result: 在真实航拍-地面数据集上，该方法相比 LoFTR 将 5° 姿态误差下的 AUC 提升 93.9%，并在 ISfM 重建中获得最高精度，精度改进范围为 27.6% 至 32.7%。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法为航拍-地面影像的集成三维重建提供了可靠方案，但其有效性主要基于摘要所报告的特定数据集与评价指标。
Relevance: 0
