papers.title: CG-GLORE: A Conjugate Gradient-Based Global-Local Regularization Network for Sparse-View CT Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) reduces radiation dose by acquiring fewer projection views, but the resulting inverse problem is highly ill-posed and often produces severe streak artifacts. Existing deep reconstruction methods have achieved promising performance, yet many rely on first-order updates or large regularization networks, which can be less effective in ill-conditioned settings. We propose \textbf{CG-GLORE}, a compact deep unrolling framework inspired by second-order optimization for sparse-view CT reconstruction. Each unrolled stage uses a CG-solved linear system based on a structured Hessian surrogate: it retains the physics-induced curvature of the data-fidelity term while using an identity approximation for the learned regularization term. Thus, the method is second-order-inspired rather than an exact Newton method for the full learned objective. To model image priors, we design a Global-Local Regularization Network (GLORE), which combines convolutional local feature extraction with a Long-Range Dependency Representation module based on sparse patchification and Nyström attention. This design captures anatomical details and non-local dependencies while maintaining practical complexity. Experiments on AAPM and DeepLesion under multiple sparse-view and noise settings show that CG-GLORE achieves strong quantitative performance, stable convergence, lower noise power, and improved visual fidelity compared with representative reconstruction methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CG-GLORE，一个受二阶优化启发的紧凑深度展开 (deep unrolling) 框架，用于稀疏视图 CT 重建。每个展开阶段用共轭梯度 (CG) 求解基于结构化 Hessian 近似的线性系统，保留数据保真项的物理曲率，同时用单位矩阵近似学习到的正则项。配对的正则网络 GLORE 结合卷积局部特征与基于稀疏 patchification 和 Nyström attention 的长程依赖模块。在 AAPM 与 DeepLesion 数据集的多种稀疏视图和噪声设置下，该方法的定量性能、收敛稳定性、噪声功率和视觉保真度均优于代表性重建方法。
Motivation: 稀疏视图 CT 通过减少投影视角来降低辐射剂量，但对应的反问题高度病态，容易产生严重条纹伪影。现有深度重建方法多依赖一阶更新或较大的正则网络，在病态条件下效果有限。
Method: 提出紧凑的深度展开框架，每个展开阶段基于结构化 Hessian 近似求解 CG 线性系统：保留数据保真项的物理曲率，对学习正则项使用单位矩阵近似，因此是二阶启发式而非对完整学习目标的精确牛顿法。设计 GLORE 网络，将卷积局部特征提取与基于稀疏分块和 Nyström attention 的长程依赖表示模块结合，以建模解剖细节和非局部依赖同时保持实际复杂度可控。
Result: 在 AAPM 和 DeepLesion 数据集、多种稀疏视图及噪声设置下，CG-GLORE 相比代表性重建方法获得更强的定量性能、更稳定的收敛、更低的噪声功率以及更好的视觉保真度。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将二阶启发式展开与全局-局部正则化结合，可以在实际复杂度可控的前提下改善病态稀疏视图 CT 重建；摘要未报告具体数值指标，也未讨论该方法的局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LongRCA Bench: Diagnosing Responsible Roles and Root Causes in Long-Horizon Agent Failures
papers.abstract_en: When a long-horizon agent execution fails, outcome-level evaluation reveals the unsuccessful result but not where the decisive error entered the trajectory. Developers must then inspect the full execution to identify the responsible role and localize the earliest decisive root-cause step. Existing failure-attribution benchmarks largely focus on shorter traces, leaving diagnosis across hundreds of recorded steps underexplored. We introduce LongRCA Bench, comprising 1,140 failed trajectories across five domains without injected errors. It provides independently scored human labels for the responsible role and earliest decisive root-cause step. The median trajectory contains 145 steps, and the strongest baseline reaches only 13.2% exact root-step accuracy. We further present Root-Cause Trajectory Attribution (RCTA), a training-free method that retrieves candidate error steps from segment summaries and traces them to available earlier handoff instructions. Using the same backbone, benchmark instances, and scoring protocol, RCTA reaches 51.1% responsible-role accuracy and 24.1% exact root-step accuracy. These results highlight the need to evaluate responsible-role attribution and exact root-step localization as separate targets in long-trajectory failure diagnosis.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Yunfei Zhang and Boyu Feng contributed equally. Changhua Pei is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LongRCA Bench，一个包含 1,140 条失败轨迹、跨五个领域且无注入错误的长时程智能体故障归因基准。该基准为每条轨迹独立标注负责任角色（responsible role）与最早决定性根因步骤（root-cause step），中位轨迹含 145 步，最强基线仅达到 13.2% 的精确根因步骤准确率。作者进一步提出无需训练的 RCTA 方法，通过检索候选错误步骤并回溯到更早的指令来定位根因，在相同设定下达到 51.1% 的角色准确率和 24.1% 的根因步骤准确率。
Motivation: 现有结果层面评估只能说明执行失败，无法指出决定性错误是在哪一步、由哪个角色引入的；已有故障归因基准多针对较短轨迹，对数百步的长时程轨迹诊断研究不足。
Method: 构建 LongRCA Bench 数据集，收集五个领域共 1,140 条失败轨迹（无注入错误），并独立打分标注负责任角色与最早决定性根因步骤；同时提出 Root-Cause Trajectory Attribution (RCTA)，一种免训练方法，从分段摘要中检索候选错误步骤并回溯至可用的早期交接指令。
Result: 基准中位轨迹为 145 步，最强基线精确根因步骤准确率仅 13.2%；RCTA 在相同骨干、实例与评分协议下达到负责角色准确率 51.1% 和精确根因步骤准确率 24.1%。
Conclusion: 结果表明应把负责任角色归因与精确根因步骤定位作为长轨迹故障诊断中两个独立的评价目标，现有方法在此任务上仍有明显差距。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 构建 LongRCA Bench 数据集，收集五个领域共 1,140 条失败轨迹（无注入错误），并独立打分标注负责任角色与最早决定性根因步骤；同时提出 Root-Cause Trajectory Attribution (RCTA)，一种免训练方法，从分段摘要中检索候选错误步骤并回溯至可用的早期交接指令。
summary_sections.result: 基准中位轨迹为 145 步，最强基线精确根因步骤准确率仅 13.2%；RCTA 在相同骨干、实例与评分协议下达到负责角色准确率 51.1% 和精确根因步骤准确率 24.1%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果表明应把负责任角色归因与精确根因步骤定位作为长轨迹故障诊断中两个独立的评价目标，现有方法在此任务上仍有明显差距。

papers.title: Learning reshapes power-law anisotropy in internal representations
papers.abstract_en: Power-law anisotropy in internal representations has been observed across a wide range of biological and artificial neural systems, from state-of-the-art language models to the mouse cerebral cortex. This anisotropy is a key geometric property of high-dimensional information processing and underlies a variety of theoretical analyses. However, the mechanism by which it emerges from input structure and task-driven learning has remained unclear. Here, we characterize this formation process by exactly solving the learning dynamics of a wide two-layer linear neural network in a teacher--student setting with power-law input and teacher structures. We show that, in the feature-learning regime, the local power-law exponent of the internal-representation spectrum evolves nonmonotonically over the course of training and exhibits up to four distinct asymptotic regimes across modes and training times. By contrast, in the lazy regime, the exponent remains essentially unchanged. We further demonstrate numerically that similar exponent dynamics arise in more realistic nonlinear networks. Together, these results suggest a general mechanism by which the dynamic interaction between input statistics and task structure gives rise to power-law internal representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 teacher–student 设定下精确求解了宽两层线性神经网络的训练动力学，输入和 teacher 结构均服从幂律 (power-law)。摘要表明：在 feature-learning 区间，内部表征谱的局部幂律指数在训练中非单调演化，并在模式和训练时间上呈现至多四个不同的渐近区间；在 lazy 区间指数基本不变；非线性网络数值实验也出现类似动力学。
Motivation: 幂律各向异性 (power-law anisotropy) 在生物与人工神经系统中普遍存在，但其如何从输入结构和任务驱动学习中涌现的机制尚不清楚。
Method: 对具有幂律输入和 teacher 结构的宽两层线性神经网络，在 teacher–student 设定下对学习动力学进行精确求解，并对比 feature-learning 与 lazy 两种区间；随后用非线性网络做数值验证。
Result: 摘要报告：feature-learning 区间内谱的局部幂律指数随训练非单调演化，跨模式和训练时间呈现至多四个渐近区间；lazy 区间指数基本不变；更真实的非线性网络也表现出类似的指数动力学。
Conclusion: 这些结果说明，输入统计与任务结构的动态交互可能构成幂律内部表征形成的一般机制。

papers.title: UC-VLM: Consistency-Driven Learning for AI-Generated Image Detection with Vision-Language Large Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Large Models (VLLMs) are promising for AI-generated image (AIGI) detection because they can produce both a prediction and a natural-language output. However, most existing VLLM-based detectors primarily fine-tune the language side while giving limited attention to low-level visual forensic cues. They also often depend on manually crafted prompts or human-annotated rationales, which limits scalability.We present UC-VLM, a unified multi-stage framework for AIGI detection that relies solely on binary supervision. UC-VLM first identifies effective instruction variants automatically. It then reuses the same binary label within a multi-stage training framework: (i) a visual discrimination objective that strengthens sensitivity to non-semantic forensic cues, and (ii) a label-conditioned generation objective that uses the binary label to supervise textual outputs. This design turns weak binary supervision into a shared supervision signal for both the visual pathway and the language output. Our key novelty is a unified multi-stage binary-supervised framework that consistently reuses the same authenticity labels for visual adaptation and label-conditioned text generation, while leveraging automatically optimized instructions to reduce prompt sensitivity without requiring human-written rationales or hand-crafted prompts.Experiments show that UC-VLM achieves 96.1% average accuracy on GenImage, exceeding the strongest prior result by 4.6%, and obtains 69.6% / 77.9% accuracy on Chameleon under ProGAN / SDV1.4 training, surpassing the best baseline by 11.2% / 15.3%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UC-VLM，一个仅依赖二进制监督的统一多阶段框架，用于 AI 生成图像（AIGI）检测。框架先自动识别有效指令变体，再复用同一二进制标签，同时训练视觉判别目标与标签条件生成目标，从而将弱监督信号同时用于视觉通道和文本输出，避免了人工提示与人工标注理由。实验显示其在 GenImage 上平均准确率达 96.1%，较最强先前结果提升 4.6%；在 Chameleon 的 ProGAN 与 SDV1.4 训练设置下分别取得 69.6% 与 77.9% 准确率，超过最好基线 11.2% 与 15.3%。
Motivation: 现有基于 VLLM 的 AIGI 检测器主要微调语言侧，对低级视觉取证线索关注不足，且常依赖手工设计的提示或人工标注的理由，限制了可扩展性。
Method: 提出 UC-VLM，一个统一多阶段二进制监督框架：先自动搜索有效的指令变体，再利用同一二进制真实性标签分别监督视觉判别目标（增强对非语义取证线索的敏感度）和标签条件生成目标（约束文本输出），将弱监督转化为视觉与语言两侧共享的监督信号。
Result: 摘要报告 UC-VLM 在 GenImage 上平均准确率 96.1%，比最强先前结果高 4.6%；在 Chameleon 上采用 ProGAN 与 SDV1.4 训练设置时分别达到 69.6% 与 77.9% 准确率，超过最佳基线 11.2% 与 15.3%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调其核心贡献是统一的多阶段二进制监督框架，通过复用真实性标签进行视觉适应与标签条件文本生成，并利用自动优化指令降低对提示的敏感性，无需人工编写的理由或手工提示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Channel Feature Fusion and Monte Carlo Dropout for Uncertainty-Aware Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
papers.abstract_en: Automated five-stage diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading requires more than high accuracy alone. Medical-grade deployment calls for lesion-aware preprocessing, ordinal predictions, calibrated uncertainty, and explainability to support reliable diagnostic systems. We present a unified pipeline that addresses these requirements using a Ben-Graham-green-channel CLAHE feature representation, an EfficientNetV2-L ordinal regressor, and Monte Carlo dropout for uncertainty-driven referral. Grad-CAM provides visual explanations aligned with clinically relevant lesions. The proposed method achieves a QWK of 91.31% on the APTOS-2019 official test split, placing it within the near-perfect agreement band (>80%). At a 20% referral rate, 293 of 366 images are automatically graded with a QWK of 90.40%. More complex cases are referred for specialist assessment, demonstrating a practical trade-off among grading quality, automation, and patient safety in robust, reliable, and deployment-ready medical diagnostic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向糖尿病视网膜病变 (DR) 五级分级的统一流程，结合 Ben-Graham 绿色通道 CLAHE 特征表示、EfficientNetV2-L 序数回归器和 Monte Carlo dropout 不确定性估计，并用 Grad-CAM 提供可解释性。该方法在 APTOS-2019 官方测试集上达到 91.31% 的 QWK，在 20% 转诊率下自动分级 366 张图像中的 293 张，QWK 为 90.40%。
Motivation: 医学级 DR 自动分级不仅需要高准确率，还需要病变感知预处理、序数预测、校准的不确定性和可解释性，才能支持可靠且可部署的诊断系统。
Method: 使用 Ben-Graham-green-channel CLAHE 特征表示，以 EfficientNetV2-L 作为序数回归器，并通过 Monte Carlo dropout 驱动基于不确定性的转诊；Grad-CAM 提供与临床相关病变对齐的视觉解释。
Result: 在 APTOS-2019 官方测试集上 QWK 为 91.31%，落入近完美一致区间 (>80%)；在 20% 转诊率下，366 张图像中有 293 张被自动分级，QWK 为 90.40%，更复杂病例转交专家评估。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法在分级质量、自动化程度和患者安全之间提供了实用权衡，适用于稳健、可靠且部署就绪的医学诊断系统。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PersonaDrive: Controllable Trajectory Prediction with Multi-Dimensional Driving Personas
papers.abstract_en: Although recent trajectory prediction and end-to-end autonomous driving methods improve robustness in urban environments, they still lack meaningful controllability. Existing benchmarks either provide no persona-conditioned annotations or support only a single urgency spectrum (i.e., emergency, normal, relaxed), which cannot distinguish personas that share the same urgency level but require different driving dynamics. To address this, we propose (i) the Persona-Conditioned Trajectory (PCT) dataset, which decomposes driving personas along two axes, Temporal Urgency and Ride Comfort, and combines three levels of each to form a grid of nine personas, each paired with natural-language descriptions and trajectories, and (ii) PersonaDrive, a framework that can learn driving personas from language and can generate persona-specific trajectories. PersonaDrive incorporates Persona-Conditioned Anchor Transform (PCAT), which hierarchically reshapes anchors along both axes, and Persona-Conditioned Multi-Modal Fusion (PCMF) for BEV-level persona fusion. Training is supervised by a Hierarchical Guide Loss enforcing axis-aligned physical orderings and an Axis-Decomposed Diversity Loss preventing diagonal mode collapse. Experimental results show that PersonaDrive consistently improves over the compared baselines across multi-dimensional scenarios. The code and PCT dataset are available at https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/PersonaDrive
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶轨迹预测的可控性问题，提出人格条件化轨迹（PCT）数据集和 PersonaDrive 框架。PCT 将驾驶人格沿时间紧迫性（Temporal Urgency）与乘坐舒适性（Ride Comfort）两个轴各取三个水平，组合成 9 种人格并配以自然语言描述和轨迹。PersonaDrive 通过 Persona-Conditioned Anchor Transform（PCAT）沿两轴分层重塑锚点，并利用 Persona-Conditioned Multi-Modal Fusion（PCMF）进行 BEV 层人格融合，训练时采用层级引导损失（Hierarchical Guide Loss）和轴分解多样性损失（Axis-Decomposed Diversity Loss）。
Motivation: 现有轨迹预测和端到端自动驾驶方法在可控性上不足：已有基准要么缺少人格条件注释，要么只支持单一紧迫性谱（如 emergency、normal、relaxed），无法区分紧迫性相同但驾驶动态不同的人格。
Method: 提出 PCT 数据集，将驾驶人格分解为 Temporal Urgency 和 Ride Comfort 两个轴并组合成 3×3 的九人格网格；提出 PersonaDrive 框架，包含沿两轴分层重塑锚点的 PCAT 模块和用于 BEV 级人格融合的 PCMF 模块，并用 Hierarchical Guide Loss 约束轴对齐的物理排序、用 Axis-Decomposed Diversity Loss 防止对角线模式坍缩。
Result: 实验表明，PersonaDrive 在多维人格场景下一致优于所比较的基线方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为分解式人格建模能改善轨迹预测的可控性，并公开了代码和 PCT 数据集；摘要未报告具体数值或更多局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Structuring Semantic Embeddings for Principle Evaluation: A Prototype-Guided Contrastive Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Reliable post-hoc evaluation asks whether already generated text satisfies a target criterion after generation. In this paper we study a focused frozen-embedding setting using principle-evaluation proxy tasks: toxicity detection, fine-grained emotion categorization, and ordinal review rating. General-purpose text embeddings are widely deployed for such tasks, but broad semantic similarity can place semantically similar yet task-distinct examples in overlapping regions of the representation space. We introduce Prototype-Guided Contrastive Learning (PGCL), a prototype-guided geometric regularization module built on top of frozen text embeddings. The module combines a semantic stream, a prototype-anchor attention stream, supervised contrastive learning, offset-based prototype-margin regularization, and stream regularization to produce a compact task-adapted representation without updating the base encoder. Controlled experiments show that PGCL improves over raw frozen embeddings on all three datasets and gives the clearest direct-baseline margin on AmazonReviews, while remaining competitive with strong direct frozen metric-learning baselines on GoEmotions and ToxicComment. We also add supervised residual-adapter, encoder-LoRA, full fine-tuning, objective ablation, sensitivity, and fully logged few-shot LLM protocol diagnostics to define the boundary of the claim. The theoretical analysis is revised as a sufficient-condition account for prototype-margin behavior under explicit assumptions in the prototype-mapping space, rather than as an unconditional training or final-embedding separation guarantee.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR). 27 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成后（post-hoc）原则评估，在冻结嵌入（frozen embedding）设置下，以毒性检测、细粒度情感分类和序数评论评分三个代理任务为对象，提出原型引导对比学习（Prototype-Guided Contrastive Learning, PGCL）。PGCL 在冻结文本嵌入之上加入原型锚定注意力、监督对比学习、偏移原型间隔正则化等几何正则化模块，在不更新基础编码器的情况下产生任务适配表示。受控实验表明 PGCL 在三个数据集上均优于原始冻结嵌入，并在 AmazonReviews 上取得最清晰的直接基线优势。理论部分被修订为原型映射空间中原型间隔行为在显式假设下的充分条件描述。
Motivation: 通用文本嵌入被广泛用于此类原则评估代理任务，但宽泛的语义相似性会使语义相似而任务区分的样本在表示空间中重叠，影响后验评估的可靠性。
Method: 提出 Prototype-Guided Contrastive Learning (PGCL)，一种构建在冻结文本嵌入之上的原型引导几何正则化模块；模块包含语义流、原型锚注意力流、监督对比学习、基于偏移的原型间隔正则化以及流正则化，目标是生成紧凑的任务适配表示且不更新基础编码器。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Topologically Invariant Manifold Learning for Railway Image Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Existing blind image quality assessment (BIQA) methods typically rely on synthetic distortions and subjective annotations, limiting generalization in real-world domains. To address this, we propose a fully self-supervised BIQA framework based on topologically invariant manifold learning under boundary constraints, which constructs a stable quality reference without manual labels. The framework generates progressive background dilution scales via repeated random cropping around each target; exploiting the monotonic degradation of target information density across these scales, it establishes a self-constrained quality manifold. A linearized spatial moment projection eliminates geometric distortions from random cropping; then a monotonicity divergence filter prunes background-sensitive evaluators, isolating an elite pool \(\mathcal{M}_{\text{elite}}\). A robust M-estimator with a principal component stabilizer fuses the metrics into an asymptotically efficient pseudo-ground truth \(q_{\text{PGT}}\), contracting variance toward the Cramér-Rao lower bound. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that the elite evaluator pool, distilled from 11 baseline metrics, secures superior zero-shot transferability across standard synthetic and wild benchmarks (CSIQ, LIVEC, LIVE-2). Concurrently, deployments on the CQU Railway Rolling Stock Surveillance Dataset (2,797 images) yield a manifold cosine similarity \(>0.999\) and a 100.0\% survival rate under industrial extreme stresses, robustly validating its cross-paradigm decoupling and topological resilience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种完全自监督的盲图像质量评估 (BIQA) 框架，基于边界约束下的拓扑不变流形学习，在无需人工标注的情况下构建稳定质量参考。方法通过重复随机裁剪生成渐进背景稀释尺度，利用目标信息密度单调退化建立自约束质量流形，并结合投影、过滤与鲁棒融合得到伪真值。在 CSIQ、LIVEC、LIVE-2 及铁路车辆监控数据集上验证了零样本迁移性和拓扑鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有 BIQA 方法通常依赖合成失真和主观标注，导致在真实领域泛化能力受限。作者希望构建无需人工标签、能适应真实工业场景的质量评估框架。
Method: 围绕每个目标用重复随机裁剪生成渐进背景稀释尺度，利用目标信息密度单调退化构建自约束质量流形；用线性化空间矩投影消除随机裁剪的几何失真，用单调性散度过滤剪除背景敏感评估器，得到精英评估器池；再用带主成分稳定器的鲁棒 M-估计器将度量融合为渐近有效的伪真值，使方差向 Cramér-Rao 下界收缩。
Result: 从 11 个基线指标蒸馏出的精英评估器池在 CSIQ、LIVEC、LIVE-2 等标准合成与真实基准上取得优越的零样本迁移性能；在 CQU 铁路车辆监控数据集 (2,797 张图像) 上，流形余弦相似度大于 0.999，工业极端应力下存活率为 100.0%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架无需人工标注即可在合成与真实域实现强零样本迁移，并在工业极端条件下保持拓扑稳定性，验证了其跨范式解耦能力和拓扑弹性。

papers.title: The Distributional View of Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Token-level knowledge distillation (KD) matches two conditional distributions per position, yet the standard objectives compare them pointwise: a Kullback-Leibler gradient is blind to which wrong token receives probability mass. We develop a distributional view in which the teacher is represented not by a single softened output but by a family of multi-temperature views - marginals of the annealing path of its logits - and the student is trained against a geometry-aware aggregate of these views under an embedding-based ground cost. We formalize the resulting design space (mixtures, log-linear pooling, entropic Wasserstein barycenters, and a debiased Sinkhorn-divergence flagship in hub and path forms), prove an exact collapse result showing log-linear pooling of tempered views is equivalent to a single temperature, and give a multi-marginal Schrodinger-bridge reading that yields falsifiable predictions. On instruction-tuned Pythia pairs, experiments yield three empirical laws: (i) dispersion law - the benefit of multi-temperature aggregation grows monotonically with the effective temperature dispersion of the views, not with their number; (ii) dispersed views unlock the aggregation operator - the barycenter separates from the arithmetic mixture exactly when transport-based aggregation starts to beat averaging; and (iii) two-regime picture governed by the ceiling gap $Γ=\mathrm{PPL}_{\mathrm{SFT}}-\mathrm{PPL}_{T}$: when the fine-tuned teacher barely beats a supervised student the gentle transport objective is the best KD loss but no KD beats supervised fine-tuning, whereas at a real ceiling the ranking inverts - and the sign of the fidelity-generalization correlation flips. We argue that "which distillation loss is the best" is not a fixed property of the loss but a function of $Γ$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知识蒸馏 (knowledge distillation) 的分布视角：教师不再由单一软化输出表示，而是由一组多温度视图（其 logits 退火路径的边际分布）构成，学生则在一个基于嵌入的地面代价 (ground cost) 下对这些视图的几何感知聚合进行训练。作者形式化了设计空间（混合、log-linear pooling、熵 Wasserstein 重心以及去偏 Sinkhorn 散度的 hub/path 两种形式），证明了 log-linear pooling 的温化视图等价于单一温度的精确坍缩结果，并给出多边际 Schrödinger-bridge 解读。在指令微调 Pythia 对上的实验总结出三条经验规律，最终认为“哪种蒸馏损失最好”并非损失的固定属性，而是天花板间隙 Γ 的函数。
Motivation: Token 级知识蒸馏需要匹配每个位置上的两个条件分布，但标准目标函数是逐点比较：KL 梯度对错误 token 收到的概率质量分配不敏感。作者希望发展一种真正面向分布的视图，以克服这种点态盲区。
Method: 将教师表示为一族多温度视图（tempered views），即其 logits 退火路径的边际分布；学生针对这些视图在嵌入地面代价下的几何感知聚合进行训练。论文形式化了混合、log-linear pooling、熵 Wasserstein 重心以及去偏 Sinkhorn 散度（hub 与 path 形式）构成的设计空间，证明了温化视图的 log-linear pooling 与单一温度等价的精确坍缩结果，并给出多边际 Schrödinger-bridge 解读以产生可证伪的预测。
Result: 在指令微调 Pythia 对上得到三条经验规律：(i) 分散律——多温度聚合的收益随视图有效温度分散度单调增长，而非视图数量；(ii) 分散的视图解锁聚合算子——重心与算术混合分离的时刻恰是基于传输的聚合开始胜过平均的时刻；(iii) 由天花板间隙 Γ=PPL_SFT−PPL_T 支配的两区域图景：当微调教师仅勉强胜过监督学生时，温和的传输目标是最佳 KD 损失但没有 KD 能胜过监督微调；而在真实天花板下排序反转，保真度-泛化相关性的符号也随之翻转。
Conclusion: 作者主张“哪种蒸馏损失最好”不是损失的固定属性，而是 Γ 的函数；这一结论将蒸馏目标的选择与教师/学生性能间隙联系起来。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: DCA-MoE: Spatially Adaptive Cross-Layer Fusion and Density-Routed Experts for Crowd Counting
papers.abstract_en: Crowd counting must recover reliable local density under severe variations in perspective, head scale, occlusion, and background clutter. Although modern counting objectives provide strong spatial supervision, many multi-level decoders still use spatially invariant feature fusion and apply one receptive-field pattern to every location. We propose DCA-MoE, a framework that makes both decisions content dependent while retaining a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Spatially Adaptive Layer Fusion (SALF) predicts position-wise weights over four aligned backbone features, and Density-Routed Multi-Receptive-Field Experts (DR-MoE) assigns each location a soft mixture of local, mid-range, and large-context residual experts. An EBC-style head reconstructs block density, while DMCount supervision and an auxiliary routing-balance term train the decoder without updating the backbone. On the NWPU-Crowd validation split, the strongest paired configuration, based on DINOv3 ViT-L/16, obtains 31.7 MAE and 72.2 RMSE; the matched ViT-B/16 full model obtains a paired 32.2/75.9. Cross-dataset results remain mixed, and several component baselines currently report independently selected minima from a single seed. The evidence therefore supports the feasibility of spatially adaptive fusion and routing, while broader paired and multi-seed evaluation remains necessary for causal attribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DCA-MoE，一种面向人群计数的框架，在冻结 DINOv3 编码器基础上使特征融合和感受野选择都随内容变化。Spatially Adaptive Layer Fusion (SALF) 对四个 backbone 特征预测逐位置权重，Density-Routed Multi-Receptive-Field Experts (DR-MoE) 为每个位置分配局部、中程和大范围残差专家的软混合，配合 EBC 式头部和 DMCount 监督。在 NWPU-Crowd 验证集上，DINOv3 ViT-L/16 配置得到 31.7 MAE 与 72.2 RMSE，ViT-B/16 全模型得到 32.2/75.9；摘要同时指出跨数据集结果不稳定，且部分基线报告的是单种子下的独立最优值。
Motivation: 人群计数需要在透视、头部尺度、遮挡和背景杂乱剧烈变化下恢复可靠的局部密度，但许多多层级解码器仍采用空间不变的特征融合，并对所有位置使用同一种感受野模式，难以适应局部尺度差异。
Method: 提出 DCA-MoE：SALF 预测四个对齐 backbone 特征的逐位置融合权重，DR-MoE 在每位置使用局部、中程、大范围残差专家的软混合，并采用 EBC 式头部重建分块密度；解码器由 DMCount 监督和辅助路由平衡项训练，backbone 保持冻结。
Result: 在 NWPU-Crowd 验证集上，基于 DINOv3 ViT-L/16 的最强配对配置取得 31.7 MAE 和 72.2 RMSE，匹配的 ViT-B/16 全模型取得 32.2/75.9；跨数据集结果仍有波动，部分组件基线报告的是单一种子下的独立最小值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为现有证据支持空间自适应融合与密度路由的可行性，但要进行因果归因，仍需更广泛的配对评测和多种子实验；跨数据集的泛化性也尚不充分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TERRA: A Hierarchical Parallel Training and Memory Orchestration Framework for High-Resolution AI-based Earth Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Training high-resolution AI-based Earth forecasting models is memory-intensive. Window-based Swin Transformers reduce the quadratic cost of global attention, but existing distributed systems such as AERIS primarily target pixel-level models and do not jointly support convolutional sampling modules and shifted-window execution. Long-lead rollout finetuning further increases activation memory. To address these challenges, we present TERRA, a hierarchical parallel training framework for high-resolution Earth forecasting. TERRA introduces Sampling-Aware Window, Sequence, and Tensor Parallelism (SAWSTP), which preserves spatially contiguous layouts for sampling modules and routes tokens into topology-aware ragged window layouts for Transformer execution. For long-lead finetuning, Memory Orchestration (MO) provides rollout-aware checkpoint planning and combines input buffering with budget-constrained activation offloading. Experiments on the $1/12^\circ$ GLORYS-based Wenhai workload show that TERRA supports models with up to 11.4B parameters on 96 H200 GPUs and sustains up to $39.76$ PFLOPS, achieving $65.0\%$ strong-scaling and $94.1\%$ weak-scaling efficiency. Compared with checkpoint-only policies, MO further reduces peak allocated GPU memory by $32.2\%$--$51.8\%$ with at most $20.0\%$ step-time overhead, which makes finetuning with smaller patch sizes and longer rollouts feasible for improved forecasting accuracy.

TL;DR: 本文提出 TERRA，一个面向高分辨率 AI 地球预报模型训练的层次化并行框架，解决窗口式 Swin Transformer 在分布式训练中不支持卷积采样模块与 shifted-window 执行联合的问题，并针对长前置（long-lead）rollout 微调带来的激活显存压力设计内存编排策略。在基于 GLORYS 的 1/12° Wenhai 负载上，TERRA 在 96 张 H200 GPU 上支持最多 11.4B 参数模型，峰值算力 39.76 PFLOPS，强扩展效率 65.0%、弱扩展效率 94.1%；相比纯 checkpoint 策略，内存编排最多降低峰值分配 GPU 显存 32.2%–51.8%，步时开销不超过 20%。
Motivation: 高分辨率 AI 地球预报模型的训练显存占用巨大；现有分布式系统（如 AERIS）主要面向像素级模型，无法同时支持卷积采样模块和 shifted-window 执行，而长前置 rollout 微调进一步增加激活显存。
Method: 提出层次化并行框架 TERRA，包含采样感知的窗口、序列与张量并行（SAWSTP），为采样模块保留空间连续布局，并将 token 路由到拓扑感知的不规则窗口布局供 Transformer 执行；针对长前置微调，Memory Orchestration (MO) 提供 rollout 感知的 checkpoint 规划，并将输入缓冲与预算约束的激活卸载（activation offloading）结合。
Result: 在 1/12° GLORYS 的 Wenhai 负载上，TERRA 支持 96 个 H200 GPU 上 11.4B 参数模型，维持 39.76 PFLOPS，强扩展效率 65.0%、弱扩展效率 94.1%；相比仅 checkpoint 策略，MO 将峰值分配 GPU 显存降低 32.2%–51.8%，步时开销最多 20.0%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TERRA 的并行与内存编排使更小 patch 尺寸和更长 rollout 的微调变得可行，从而有助于提升预报精度；其适用范围是高分辨率地球预报（Earth forecasting）模型训练。

papers.title: Identifying parameter couplings and uncertainties of mixed-noise stochastic systems via full-covariance Gaussian mixture network
papers.abstract_en: Parameter identification of stochastic dynamical systems driven by mixed noises is challenging due to intractable likelihood functions. We propose PENN-GMD, a parameter estimation neural network that maps partially observed trajectories to a Gaussian mixture distribution (GMD) over the system parameters. Unlike conventional uncertainty estimates, the GMD employs full covariance matrices to explicitly reveal parameter couplings and multi-modal likelihood structures. The network is trained by minimizing the negative log-likelihood via a surjective parameterization that hard-encodes all GMD constraints, thereby approximating the true likelihood. We validate the method on five numerical examples with increasing complexity, including systems driven by fractional Gaussian and Lévy noises, oscillators with colored noise, coupled neurons under different observability, and an aeroelastic airfoil with unidentifiable stochastic disturbances. Results demonstrate that PENN-GMD accurately recovers likelihood distributions, captures parameter couplings, and naturally diagnoses non-identifiability through variance broadening or mode splitting. These capabilities establish PENN-GMD as a practical tool for uncertainty-aware parameter identification in complex stochastic systems where conventional likelihood-based methods are infeasible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PENN-GMD，一种用于混合噪声驱动的随机动力学系统参数辨识的神经网络，将部分观测轨迹映射为系统参数上的高斯混合分布 (GMD)，并采用全协方差矩阵显式刻画参数耦合与多峰似然结构。网络通过满射参数化硬编码 GMD 约束并以负对数似然训练，从而逼近真实似然。在分数高斯噪声、Lévy 噪声、色噪声振子、耦合神经元及气动弹性翼型等五个数值例子上验证了方法，表明其能恢复似然分布、捕获参数耦合并诊断不可辨识性。
Motivation: 混合噪声驱动的随机动力系统参数辨识因似然函数难以处理而具有挑战性，传统基于似然的方法在复杂随机系统中往往不可行，需要一种能处理不可解似然并揭示参数不确定性和耦合的实用工具。
Method: 提出参数估计神经网络 PENN-GMD，将部分观测轨迹映射到系统参数上的高斯混合分布，使用全协方差矩阵表达参数耦合与多峰性；通过满射参数化硬编码所有 GMD 约束，并以最小化负对数似然来训练网络以近似真实似然。
Result: 在五个复杂度递增的数值例子（包括分数高斯噪声和 Lévy 噪声驱动的系统、色噪声振子、不同可观测性下的耦合神经元、以及具有不可辨识随机扰动的气动弹性翼型）上，PENN-GMD 能准确恢复似然分布、捕获参数耦合，并通过方差展宽或模式分裂自然诊断不可辨识性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PENN-GMD 为传统似然方法不可行的复杂随机系统提供了一种实用的不确定性感知参数辨识工具，其能力包括似然恢复、耦合捕获和不可辨识性诊断。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Anchor-Regularized Adaptation for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection with DINOv3
papers.abstract_en: Recent works in AI-generated image detection have shown that careful training data alignment can improve generalization by removing spurious correlations. However, linear probes on frozen DINOv3 representations achieve remarkably strong performance even when trained on misaligned datasets. Motivated by this result, we analyze the underlying rationale and the limits of this generalization. We find that frozen DINOv3 performs well because its decisions rely on features that faithfully represent the space of authentic images. At the same time, its final layer is less effective at capturing the subtle pixel-artifact cues that can be emphasized by aligned training data. We further observe that naively mixing aligned and misaligned data during adaptation improves sensitivity to such cues but at the cost of distorting the pre-trained representation, limiting generalization. To address this issue, we propose Anchor-Regularized Adaptation (ARA). We apply Low-Rank Adaptation to capture pixel-level artifacts while leveraging a frozen anchor classifier to avoid deviations from the original representation structure. This allows the model to exploit pixel-artifact cues without sacrificing generalization. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on nine diverse and challenging benchmarks, indicating that ARA enables complementary supervision from misaligned and aligned data for more effective detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于 DINOv3 的 AI 生成图像检测泛化问题，发现冻结 DINOv3 表示的线性探针在错配数据集上仍表现强劲，但其最后一层对像素级伪影线索不敏感，而简单混合对齐与错配数据虽能提升灵敏度却会扭曲预训练表示。作者提出 Anchor-Regularized Adaptation (ARA)，用 Low-Rank Adaptation 捕获像素伪影，同时借助冻结 anchor 分类器保持表示结构，在九个基准上取得当前最优性能。
Motivation: 现有工作通过训练数据对齐提升 AI 生成图像检测的泛化性，但作者发现冻结 DINOv3 表示已很强，主要原因是其决策依赖忠实刻画真实图像空间的特征；然而其最终层对像素伪影线索捕获不足，而朴素混合对齐与错配数据会损害预训练表示，限制泛化。
Method: 提出 Anchor-Regularized Adaptation (ARA)：在 DINOv3 上应用 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 以捕获像素级伪影，同时使用冻结的 anchor 分类器约束微调过程，避免偏离原始表示结构，从而同时利用错配与对齐数据的互补监督。
Result: 摘要报告 ARA 在九个多样且具有挑战性的基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，表明该方法能在利用像素伪影线索的同时保持泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ARA 使得模型可以从错配与对齐数据中获得互补监督，实现更有效的检测且不牺牲泛化性；本文工作聚焦于 AI 生成图像检测领域。

papers.title: Beyond Natural-Image Foundation Models: Benchmarking Satellite Pretraining for Ophthalmic Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) have emerged as a promising approach in medical imaging, producing broadly applicable systems that can be efficiently adapted across diverse imaging modalities, anatomical regions, and clinical tasks. However, VFMs require extensive training data, and their progress in medical image analysis is constrained by limited data availability, privacy concerns, and high development costs. To alleviate these constraints, medical VFMs (MedVFMs) are often built upon weights from generalist models pretrained on vast amounts of publicly available natural images, introducing a substantial distribution shift for medical task adaptation. To address this, we propose satellite imagery as a novel pretraining domain for MedVFM development and benchmarking, motivated by its closer visual alignment with medical data and its freedom from the privacy constraints that limit medical datasets. Across multiple ophthalmic imaging modalities, we compare DINOv3-SAT493m pretrained on 493 million satellite images against DINOv3-LVD1689m pretrained on 1.7 billion natural images, together with two medical specialist baselines: DINOv3-RETFound and MAE-RETFound. Our experiments show that satellite imagery is a stronger pretraining source than natural images for ophthalmic tasks, particularly on en face vascular-rich modalities. On several tasks, satellite pretraining matches or exceeds the medical specialists on high-resolution en face inputs, despite using no medical data.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Medical Foundation Models and Benchmarks (MEDFMB)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将卫星影像作为医学视觉基础模型（MedVFM）的预训练域，并在多种眼科成像模态上做基准评测：对比在 4.93 亿张卫星图像上预训练的 DINOv3-SAT493m 与在 17 亿张自然图像上预训练的 DINOv3-LVD1689m，以及两个医学专家基线 DINOv3-RETFound 和 MAE-RETFound。结果表明，卫星影像预训练在眼科任务上强于自然图像预训练，尤其在富含血管的 en face 模态上；在若干高分辨率 en face 任务上，即使不使用任何医学数据，卫星预训练也能匹配或超过医学专家模型。
Motivation: 医学视觉基础模型通常基于大规模自然图像预训练的通用模型初始化，这会带来显著的分布偏移；同时医学数据受到数据量少、隐私限制和开发成本高的约束。作者提出卫星影像作为替代预训练域，理由是其与医学影像的视觉对齐更接近，且不受医学数据集的隐私限制。
Method: 这是一个基准评测研究，系统比较不同预训练来源的 DINOv3 模型在多种眼科成像模态上的表现：卫星影像预训练（DINOv3-SAT493m）、自然图像预训练（DINOv3-LVD1689m），以及两个医学专科基线（DINOv3-RETFound 和 MAE-RETFound）。
Result: 实验显示卫星影像预训练在眼科任务上优于自然图像预训练，尤其对 en face 富含血管的模态提升明显；在若干高分辨率 en face 输入任务上，卫星预训练模型即使未使用任何医学数据，也能达到或超过医学专科基线模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为卫星影像是 MedVFM 预训练中值得采用和基准化的新数据域，可缓解自然图像到医学任务之间的分布偏移以及医学数据稀缺带来的约束。其评测范围限于眼科影像任务，结论的推广性尚待更广泛医学模态验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Valhalla: A Layered Knowledge-State and Service-Governance Framework for Long-Term Scientific Knowledge Work
papers.abstract_en: As large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly adopted in scientific research, external knowledge bases, knowledge graphs, and long-term memory have improved information retrieval and task continuity. However, most structured knowledge systems remain node-centric, representing files, concepts, results, and judgments as nodes and relations in a graph. While suitable for personal knowledge management, such structures often depend on individual organizational practices, limiting knowledge sharing, integration, and reorganization across users. This paper presents Valhalla, a layered knowledge-state and service-governance framework for long-term scientific knowledge work. Valhalla replaces flat graphs with layered encapsulation and stable semantic boundaries through a five-layer File-Resource-Entity-Relationship-Graph (FREG) model. File and Resource preserve source identity and provenance, Entity represents knowledge objects, Relationship captures semantic judgments, and Graph provides task-oriented knowledge views, enabling knowledge states from different researchers to be exchanged and reorganized under a unified structure. We further introduce a Router-Contract-Workflow service-governance architecture, inspired by the microkernel paradigm, to constrain how language models access, modify, and extend knowledge states while maintaining structural consistency and auditable operational boundaries. We implement a Valhalla prototype and validate knowledge ingestion, cross-member integration, and scientific writing support through an antibody-design review task comprising 26 paper resources, 80 knowledge entities, and 92 semantic relations. Rather than proposing a new knowledge-extraction algorithm, Valhalla offers a paradigm for organizing collaborative scientific knowledge, transforming individualized knowledge structures into transferable and reorganizable shared knowledge states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Valhalla，一个面向长期科学知识工作的分层知识状态与服务治理框架。它用五层 File-Resource-Entity-Relationship-Graph (FREG) 模型替代扁平图，保留来源身份与溯源，并引入 Router-Contract-Workflow 服务治理架构来约束大语言模型对知识状态的访问与修改。原型在抗体设计评审任务（26 篇论文资源、80 个知识实体、92 个语义关系）上验证了知识摄取、跨成员集成与科学写作支持。
Motivation: 现有基于图的知识系统多为节点中心，依赖于个人组织实践，限制不同用户之间的知识共享、整合与重组；同时，LLM 智能体在科学研究中的应用日益普遍，需要统一结构来交换和重组不同研究者的知识状态。
Method: 提出五层 FREG 模型，其中 File 与 Resource 保留来源身份和溯源，Entity 表示知识对象，Relationship 捕捉语义判断，Graph 提供面向任务的知识视图；并借鉴微内核范式提出 Router-Contract-Workflow 服务治理架构，约束语言模型对知识状态的访问、修改和扩展，维持结构一致性与可审计的操作边界。
Result: 实现了 Valhalla 原型，并通过包含 26 篇论文资源、80 个知识实体和 92 个语义关系的抗体设计评审任务，验证了知识摄取、跨成员集成和科学写作支持；摘要未报告量化性能指标。
Conclusion: 该工作不提出新的知识抽取算法，而是提供一种组织协作科学知识的范式，将个人化知识结构转化为可转移、可重组的共享知识状态。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Quality of Claude AI-authored Python Tests Is Not Weaker Than Human-authored Tests
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate the quality of Claude AI-written Python tests against human-written Python tests from two established open-source projects Django and Pandas. Hundreds of tests per corpus are scored under one identical protocol. Using one-sided non-inferiority bounds, we find that the tests written by recent Claude models (Sonnet/Opus 4.6 and later) are no weaker than the two human-written corpora. In this study: (i) the AI-written corpus is tests from real tools, not synthetic tests generated in isolation against a fixed target, the setup used by every other AI-test-generation study we are aware of; (ii) every test is individually scored under three independent fault-injection protocols plus a seven-axis qualitative design rubric, allowing methods to cross-validate each other; (iii) tests are scored individually, rather than suite-level, identifying exactly which specific tests need attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估 Claude 生成的 Python 测试相对于人工编写测试的质量，语料取自 Django 和 Pandas 两个开源项目，并比较数百个测试。作者使用单侧非劣效界 (non-inferiority bound) 发现最近 Claude 模型（Sonnet/Opus 4.6 及以后版本）编写的测试质量不低于两套人工编写的测试语料。与前人研究不同，这里的 AI 测试来自真实工具，而非针对固定目标生成的合成测试，并且每个测试都经过三种独立故障注入协议和七轴定性设计评分。
Motivation: 现有 AI 测试生成研究大多在隔离的合成设定下评估，缺少对真实项目中 AI 与人工测试质量的直接比较；同时套件级评分无法定位具体需要改进的测试。
Method: 采用统一评分协议，对来自 Django 和 Pandas 的 Claude 生成测试与人工测试逐一评分；使用三种独立故障注入协议和七轴定性设计 rubric 交叉验证，并采用单侧非劣效界进行统计比较，测试按个体而非套件打分。
Result: 摘要报告，较新的 Claude 模型（Sonnet/Opus 4.6 及以后）编写的测试在两个真实开源项目语料上均不弱于人工编写测试。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果表明 AI 生成的测试质量可以达到人工水平，且逐测试评分有助于精确识别需要关注的个别测试。

papers.title: MiNO: Cotangent-bundle propagator learning for PDEs
papers.abstract_en: Scientific machine learning for partial differential equations commonly targets solution fields, as in physics-informed neural networks, or solution maps, as in neural operators. We study a third target: the propagator itself, a phase and amplitude in phase space. The motivation is a gap in regularity. A transported discontinuity is nonsmooth in space and time, yet the rule that moves it can be a polynomial phase carrying unit amplitude, so the object that generates an evolution can be far smoother than the field it generates. The microlocal neural operator (MiNO) learns that object, using the eikonal equation for the phase and the transport equation for the amplitude, and recovers the solution by an oscillatory integral. Sharp fronts and caustics then belong to propagation geometry rather than to a field fitted pointwise. Small residuals certify more than the reconstructed field. They place the learned canonical relation, the geometry that carries singularities, close to the exact one, and they separate trainable error from the frequency-truncation tail. On a matched-budget discontinuous-advection benchmark, MiNO stops improving within 10,000 steps at the accuracy limit of its finite reconstruction window, a limit predicted in closed form, whereas a physics-informed neural network with neural-tangent-kernel loss balancing stays near its initial error. On smooth advection, the mean error is $3.84\times10^{-3}$ for MiNO and $3.12\times10^{-2}$ for a supervised Fourier neural operator. Single-branch MiNO is the smallest model compared, and one trained generator serves five unseen initial conditions without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究偏微分方程（PDE）的第三个学习目标：传播子（propagator）本身，即相空间中的相位与振幅，而非解场或解映射。作者提出微局部神经算子（MiNO），用程函方程（eikonal equation）学习相位、用传输方程（transport equation）学习振幅，再通过振荡积分（oscillatory integral）恢复解，从而将尖锐前沿与焦散视为传播几何而非逐点拟合的场。在不连续平流基准上，MiNO 在有限重建窗口的精度极限处停止提升，而带神经正切核（NTK）损失平衡的 PINN 几乎不改进；在光滑平流上，MiNO 平均误差远低于监督 Fourier 神经算子，且单分支 MiNO 是最小的对比模型。
Motivation: 常见科学机器学习方法要么拟合解场（如 PINN），要么学习解映射（如神经算子），但这两类目标都受制于解的 regularity 缺口：传输的不连续在时空上非光滑，而生成该演化的规则（相位与振幅）可以非常光滑。作者希望直接学习这种更光滑的传播子，以使小残差能够对携带奇异性的几何结构给出更强保证。
Method: MiNO 将传播子表示为相空间中的相位与振幅，使用程函方程约束相位、传输方程约束振幅，并用振荡积分从所学传播子重建 PDE 解。该设计将尖锐前沿和焦散的描述从逐点拟合的场转移到传播几何（canonical relation）上，并可分离可训练误差与频率截断尾部。
Result: 在 matched-budget 不连续平流基准上，MiNO 在 10000 步内达到其有限重建窗口的可预测精度极限，而带 NTK 损失平衡的 PINN 停留在初始误差附近；在光滑平流上，MiNO 的平均误差为 3.84×10⁻³，监督 Fourier 神经算子为 3.12×10⁻²。单分支 MiNO 是所比较模型中最小的，且单个训练好的生成器可在不重训的情况下服务五个未见初始条件。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，学习传播子而非场本身是一种可行且有优势的 PDE 学习范式，其小残差不仅保证重建场，还保证学习到的正则关系接近精确几何，并能区分可训练误差与截断误差。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: FinFraudBench: A Heterogeneous Graph Benchmark for Financial Fraud Detection
papers.abstract_en: The increasing complexity of digital financial systems has reshaped financial fraud detection from isolated transaction classification into relational risk reasoning over interconnected financial entities. This shift has motivated graph-based fraud detection, where models identify fraudulent nodes by exploiting dependencies among customers, cards, merchants, categories, and locations. However, despite rapid progress in graph-based methods, existing public benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world financial systems in two important aspects. First, they often simplify financial ecosystems into homogeneous or single-node-type multi-relational graphs, failing to preserve the multi-entity and multi-relational nature of financial data. Second, they rarely provide large-scale heterogeneous financial graph datasets with realistic operating conditions such as extreme class imbalance and limited label availability, making it difficult to assess the practical effectiveness of current methods. To address these gaps, we present FinFraudBench, a heterogeneous graph benchmark for financial fraud detection. FinFraudBench contains two heterogeneous graph datasets (CreditCard-Fraud and BankTrans-Fraud) with up to 8.99M nodes and 89.23M directed typed edges. Each dataset preserves six financial entity types, fourteen directed edge types, and natural fraud rates that mirror deployment constraints. With these datasets, we establish a standardized evaluation protocol covering both ranking and imbalance-sensitive classification metrics, and evaluate representative baselines. Extensive experiments yield empirical insights into current methods' limitations and suggest promising avenues for future research. FinFraudBench is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FinFraudBench-B002.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinFraudBench，一个面向金融欺诈检测的异构图基准（heterogeneous graph benchmark），包含 CreditCard-Fraud 和 BankTrans-Fraud 两个数据集，规模最高达 8.99M 节点与 89.23M 条有向类型化边。基准保留了六种金融实体类型、十四种有向边类型以及接近真实部署条件的自然欺诈率，并建立涵盖排序指标与不平衡敏感分类指标的标准评测协议。摘要还报告了对代表性基线的广泛实验，并总结了现有方法的局限与未来研究方向。
Motivation: 现有基于图的金融欺诈检测基准与现实金融系统不匹配：一方面常把金融生态简化为同质图或单节点类型的多关系图，丢失多实体、多关系的本质；另一方面缺少大规模异构图数据，且未体现极端类别不平衡和有限标签等实际运行条件，难以评估方法的实用效果。
Method: 构建包含两个异构图数据集（CreditCard-Fraud 和 BankTrans-Fraud）的基准 FinFraudBench，保留六种金融实体类型和十四种有向边类型，数据规模达 8.99M 节点与 89.23M 条边；同时设计标准化评测协议，覆盖排序指标和不平衡敏感分类指标，并评估代表性基线方法。
Result: 摘要报告了在 FinFraudBench 上对代表性基线的广泛实验，给出对现有方法局限性的经验性洞察，并提出有前景的未来研究方向；数据集开源地址为 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FinFraudBench-B002。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过提供大规模、多实体、多关系且贴近部署条件的异构金融图数据，FinFraudBench 能更真实地评估图基金融欺诈检测方法，并为后续研究提供标准化评测基础。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LAPF: LLM-Agent-Based Path Finder Using the UAVScenes Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed for autonomous navigation in complex outdoor environments, where dynamic conditions and mission requirements require intelligent adaptive decision-making. Existing optimization-based, Machine Learning (ML), and Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches often rely on predefined models or task-specific training, limiting their generalization and adaptability in uncertain scenarios. Recent Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted approaches offer promising reasoning capabilities but remain constrained by limited agentic functionality, including insufficient memory, planning, and tool interaction mechanisms.This paper proposes an LLM-Agent-Based Path Finder (LAPF) framework for autonomous UAV navigation in town-scale outdoor environments. LAPF extends LLM-assisted navigation by integrating perception, memory, planning, and action modules into a closed-loop cognitive architecture. The proposed agent leverages prior navigation experiences, performs Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, couples each detected hazard to a bounded corrective action, and dynamically refines waypoint decisions based on environmental feedback.The three independent trials per method demonstrate that LAPF achieves mean path lengths of 512.83 m and 506.37 m, compared to the straight-line optimum of 497.33 m, corresponding to path length reductions of 17.2% and 15.6% relative to CoT prompting and absolute path efficiencies of 97.1% and 98.1% in open-field and obstacle-injected scenarios, respectively. Furthermore, LAPF is the only evaluated approach that couples every detected hazard to a bounded, metric-neutral corrective action while maintaining near-goal stability, with zero clamp events in both scenarios, whereas CoT prompting increases from 9.7 to 14.0 events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 LLM 智能体 (LLM-Agent) 的路径规划框架 LAPF，用于镇级室外环境中的无人机 (UAV) 自主导航，并在 UAVScenes 数据集上评估。LAPF 将感知、记忆、规划与动作模块组合成闭环认知架构，利用先前的导航经验、链式思考 (Chain-of-Thought, CoT) 推理，以及对每个检测到的危险关联有界纠正动作的机制来动态优化航路点。摘要报告在开阔场地和注入障碍物场景下均接近直线最优路径长度，并显著优于单纯的 CoT 提示方法。
Motivation: 现有基于优化、机器学习和强化学习的 UAV 导航方法依赖预定义模型或任务特定训练，泛化与适应能力受限；而近期 LLM 辅助方法虽具备推理能力，但缺少足够的记忆、规划和工具交互等智能体功能 (agentic functionality)，难以应对动态不确定环境。
Method: LAPF 在 LLM 辅助导航基础上扩展出包含感知、记忆、规划、动作模块的闭环认知架构；智能体复用先前的导航经验，执行 CoT 推理，将每个检测到的危险 (hazard) 映射到有界且度量中性的纠正动作，并根据环境反馈动态精炼航路点决策。
Result: 每个方法进行三次独立试验；LAPF 的平均路径长度分别为 512.83 m 和 506.37 m，直线最优路径为 497.33 m，相对 CoT 提示分别缩短 17.2% 和 15.6%，在开阔场地和注入障碍物场景中的绝对路径效率分别达到 97.1% 和 98.1%。LAPF 还是唯一能将每个检测到的危险耦合到有界纠正动作同时保持近目标稳定性的方法，两种场景下夹持事件 (clamp events) 均为零，而 CoT 提示从 9.7 增至 14.0。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 LAPF 在镇级室外 UAV 导航中能够以接近直线最优的路径长度运行，同时保持近目标稳定性并避免危险耦合失效；其局限或适用范围未在摘要中详细展开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SkillCommit: Evolving Agent Skills through Behaviorally Validated Scope Expansion
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can continually improve without parameter updates by converting historical experience into reusable procedural knowledge. However, existing methods often consolidate experience based on semantic similarity or LLM judgments, which may merge superficially related but behaviorally incompatible strategies and thereby degrade performance. To address the issue, we propose SkillCommit, an online skill evolution framework that continuously transforms experience into a hierarchical library of reusable skills. Each new experience is initially preserved as an instance-specific patch, retaining the behavior validated in its local context. As related skills accumulate, SkillCommit abstracts those sharing a common behavioral mechanism into higher-level skills. Specifically, for each incoming skill, embedding-based retrieval first identifies candidate related skills. Cross-instance replay and an LLM-based mechanism check determine whether these skills transfer across cases and share a common underlying mechanism. Candidates that pass both checks are abstracted into a higher-level skill and committed only if it preserves the validated behavior of all constituent skills. Experiments on RuleArena, OpenExempt and KOR-Bench demonstrate that SkillCommit consistently improves agent performance across diverse domains. Moreover, the learned skills transfer across model scales and families, enabling cross-model experience transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SkillCommit，一个面向LLM智能体的在线技能演化框架，将历史经验转化为层级化的可复用技能库。其核心是仅当候选技能通过行为机制验证时才将其抽象为更高级技能，避免合并行为不兼容的策略。在RuleArena、OpenExempt和KOR-Bench上的实验显示该方法能持续提升智能体性能，且习得技能可跨模型规模和家族迁移。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体经验巩固方法多依赖语义相似性或LLM判断来合并经验，容易把表面相关但行为不兼容的策略合并到一起，导致性能下降。
Method: SkillCommit将每个新经验先保存为实例特定的补丁(patch)，保留其局部上下文中已验证的行为；随着相关技能积累，通过嵌入检索(embedding-based retrieval)识别候选相关技能，再用跨实例回放(cross-instance replay)和LLM机制检查判断其是否可迁移并共享共同行为机制；通过两项检查的候选才被抽象为更高级技能，且仅当该抽象保留所有组成技能的已验证行为时才提交。
Result: 摘要报告在RuleArena、OpenExempt和KOR-Bench三个基准上，SkillCommit一致提升智能体在不同领域的性能，并且学到的技能可跨模型规模和家族迁移，实现跨模型经验迁移。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，只有经过行为验证的范围扩展才能可靠地抽象技能，避免不兼容合并；同时技能库具备跨模型复用能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From "What-If" to "What-Is": Counterfactual Thinking-Inspired Semantic Alignment for Visual Brain Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Visual brain decoding reconstructs visual content perceived by a person from neural measurements such as fMRI, providing a computational approach to studying how visual information is represented in the brain. Recent multimodal representations and diffusion priors have improved reconstruction realism. However, visually plausible reconstructions may contain incorrect objects, attributes, or relations because a strong generative prior can complete content not sufficiently specified by the decoded representation. Conventional reconstruction metrics mainly assess the final image and may therefore obscure such semantic errors. We propose ConceptAlign, a counterfactual semantic alignment framework for visual brain decoding. ConceptAlign pools decoded visual tokens and projects them into a frozen text-embedding space, aligning the representation with the ground-truth caption while separating it from scene-preserving near-miss alternatives. Generated offline by an LLM, these alternatives modify one critical object, attribute, or relation while retaining the scene. A margin-based objective learns fine-grained semantic boundaries between the observed stimulus and plausible but incorrect interpretations without requiring LLM calls during inference. We introduce a systematic three-level semantic evaluation framework covering foundational discriminability, counterfactual description discrimination, and representational geometry. Experiments on the Natural Scenes Dataset show that ConceptAlign improves reconstruction measures, counterfactual semantic discrimination, and representational alignment over the MindEye2 backbone. Matched negative-source ablations, independent LLM and human-written alternatives, and human evaluation support the effectiveness and robustness of the supervision, with favorable patterns in fine-grained conflicts, limited-data decoding, and cross-subject structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ConceptAlign，一个面向视觉脑解码 (visual brain decoding) 的反事实语义对齐框架。该框架将解码得到的视觉 token 汇聚并投影到冻结的文本嵌入空间，使其与真实描述对齐，同时与由 LLM 离线生成、仅改动一个关键对象/属性/关系的近邻反事实描述相分离。在 Natural Scenes Dataset 上，基于 MindEye2 骨干的方法提升了重建指标、反事实语义判别和表征对齐，并引入三层次语义评估框架。
Motivation: 视觉上合理的脑解码重建可能包含错误的对象、属性或关系，因为强生成先验会补全解码表征中未被充分指定的内容；传统重建指标主要评估最终图像，容易掩盖这类语义错误。
Method: ConceptAlign 将解码的视觉 token 池化并投影到冻结文本嵌入空间，用基于边界的 margin objective 同时拉近与真实描述的表示并推开场景保持的近邻反事实描述；反事实描述由 LLM 离线生成，推理时无需调用 LLM。还提出包含基础可判别性、反事实描述判别和表征几何的三层次语义评估框架。
Result: 在 Natural Scenes Dataset 上，ConceptAlign 相比 MindEye2 骨干改善了重建指标、反事实语义判别和表征对齐；匹配负样本来源的消融、独立的 LLM 与人工编写反事实以及人类评估支持监督的有效性与鲁棒性，并在细粒度冲突、有限数据解码和跨受试者结构上表现良好。
Conclusion: 摘要强调反事实语义监督能提升脑解码重建的语义保真度，并说明需要超越像素级指标的语义评估体系；其适用场景为视觉脑解码，且反事实样本可离线生成以避免推理开销。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Unified Backbone--Expert Framework with Relation-Token and Residual--Classifier Interfaces for Automatic Modulation Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Automatic modulation recognition (AMR) faces distinct representation bottlenecks under varying observation lengths, where a single model architecture often fails to excel. To address this, we propose a unified backbone-expert framework with a common convolutional state-space backbone and two specialized interfaces. For short sequences, we inject explicit lag-aware complex-plane descriptors as relation tokens before encoding to compensate for information loss. For long sequences, we design a gated multi-scale residual refinement module to correct the feature map, combined with a fixed-averaging classifier collaboration to harness complementary evidence. Our framework achieves overall average accuracies of 67.28 \pm 0.14% on RML2016.10b and 87.19 \pm 0.77% on HisarMod2019 (mean \pm sample standard deviation over three runs), respectively. The framework's efficacy is further validated through three-seed ablations, native-length cross-configuration tests, and controlled window studies, confirming the benefit of expert-interface decoupling over one-size-fits-all architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向自动调制识别（Automatic Modulation Recognition, AMR）中不同观测长度下的表征瓶颈，提出一个统一的骨干-专家框架：公共卷积状态空间骨干加两个专用接口。短序列端在编码前注入显式时延感知复平面描述符作为关系令牌，长序列端设计门控多尺度残差精化模块并配合固定平均分类器协同。在RML2016.10b上平均准确率67.28±0.14%，在HisarMod2019上为87.19±0.77%。
Motivation: 单一模型架构在变长的观测序列上很难同时表现优异，AMR在短序列和长序列下存在不同的表征瓶颈，需要一个既能共享骨干又能按长度特化处理的统一框架。
Method: 提出公共卷积状态空间骨干（convolutional state-space backbone）与两种专用接口相结合的统一框架。短序列端将显式时延感知复平面描述符（lag-aware complex-plane descriptors）作为关系令牌（relation tokens）注入；长序列端使用门控多尺度残差精化模块（gated multi-scale residual refinement module）校正特征图，并采用固定平均分类器协作以利用互补证据。
Result: 摘要报告在RML2016.10b上平均准确率为67.28±0.14%，在HisarMod2019上为87.19±0.77%（三次运行的均值±样本标准差）。三种子消融、原生长度跨配置测试和受控窗口研究进一步验证了专家-接口解耦（expert-interface decoupling）相比一刀切架构的优势。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过专家-接口解耦而非一味使用统一架构，可以更好兼顾不同观测长度下的AMR表征需求，框架的有效性得到了多组验证性实验支持。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Low-Rank Dynamics-Effective Latent Carriers for Counterfactual Rollout in Learned World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models may predict the future without making clear which parts of their hidden state actually drive those predictions. We ask whether a small, directly addressable hidden-state change can place a learned world model on the intended counterfactual trajectory and then let the model continue that future on its own. We study a recurrent world model with a 192-dimensional hidden state in a controlled two-object, two-dimensional collision environment. For a bounded family of local velocity edits, we first verify that the model can natively represent and roll out the edited future. We then construct candidate low-rank carriers from training-only factual-to-counterfactual hidden differences and learn a map from the factual state and requested edit to carrier coefficients. On the registered rank grid, rank 4 is the smallest tested rank that satisfies the full development-panel criteria. A single rank-4 patch at the anchor is sufficient to redirect a 12-step autonomous rollout, with no future observations, teacher forcing, or repeated correction. The frozen procedure satisfies the preregistered replication rule across independently trained checkpoints and remains usable across nearby intervention times. Random equal-norm, wrong-object, and wrong-time controls do not explain the effect. A position-edit stress test provides a negative contrast: the intended position patch can pass the raw rollout criteria, but no-patch and random controls can pass the same criteria, and wrong-object specificity is not established. Thus, successful editing alone is not enough. We use dynamics-effective to describe an intervention that changes the model's future computation in a sustained and target-specific way under autonomous rollout. The rank-4 result identifies a compact intervention interface for the tested velocity-edit family, not a closed four-dimensional state or an intrinsic state dimension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究学习式世界模型 (learned world model) 中是否可以用一个小的、可直接寻址的隐状态改动，让模型进入预期的反事实轨迹并自主延续。作者在 192 维隐状态、双物体二维碰撞环境的循环世界模型上，从训练期间的事实-反事实隐状态差异构造低秩载体 (low-rank carriers)，并学习从事实状态与请求编辑到载体系数的映射。摘要报告 rank 4 是满足全部开发面板准则的最小测试秩，单个 rank-4 补丁即可重定向 12 步自主推演，且无需未来观测、teacher forcing 或重复修正。
Motivation: 世界模型可能预测未来，但不明确隐状态的哪些部分真正驱动这些预测；本文要回答一个可寻址的隐状态小改动能否把模型放到预期的反事实轨迹上，并让模型自己继续推演。
Method: 在受控的双物体二维碰撞环境中训练带 192 维隐状态的循环世界模型，先从训练用事实到反事实的隐状态差异构造候选低秩载体，再学习从事实状态和请求速度编辑到载体系数的映射；在预先登记的秩网格上评估，并在锚点处施加单个低秩补丁。
Result: 在测试秩网格中，rank 4 是满足全部开发面板准则的最小秩；单个 rank-4 补丁足以将 12 步自主推演引导到编辑后的未来，冻结流程在独立训练检查点和附近干预时刻均满足预注册复现规则，而随机等范数、错误物体和错误时间对照均不能解释该效应。位置编辑压力测试则呈现负对照：位置补丁能通过原始推演准则，但无补丁与随机对照也能通过，且错误物体特异性未被建立。
Conclusion: 作者强调“成功的编辑本身并不够”，提出用动力学有效 (dynamics-effective) 描述那些在自主推演中以持续且目标特异方式改变模型未来计算的干预；rank-4 结果标识的是所测速度编辑族的一个紧凑干预接口，而非封闭的四维状态或内在状态维度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Effective Sample Size: Effective Number of Proposals for Adaptive Importance Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Population-based adaptive importance sampling (AIS) methods use a set of proposal densities to approximate complex target distributions. Their performance is commonly assessed through effective sample size (ESS) and related weight-based diagnostics, which measure the concentration of normalized importance weights. However, a large ESS only indicates that the normalized sample weights are not strongly concentrated; it does not describe how the proposal components are arranged in the sampling space. In population-based AIS, several proposal components may generate samples in the same region of the target, so the sample weights can appear well balanced even though the effective number of distinct proposal components is small. This letter introduces the effective number of proposals (ENP), a similarity-aware proposal-level diagnostic for population-based AIS. ENP combines the total normalized weight assigned to each proposal with a redundancy measure computed from similarities among target-weighted samples, estimating the number of non-redundant empirical proposal contributions to the approximation. We establish basic effective-number properties and show that ENP detects proposal collapse and duplication missed by standard ESS. We also illustrate its use as a targeted feedback signal for proposal rejuvenation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于种群的自适应重要性采样 (population-based adaptive importance sampling, AIS) 提出一种新的诊断指标——有效提议数 (effective number of proposals, ENP)。ENP 通过结合每个提议的总归一化权重与基于目标加权样本相似性计算的重叠度，估计近似中非冗余经验提议贡献的数量，并建立基本有效数性质。摘要表明 ENP 能检测到标准 ESS 遗漏的提议坍缩与重复现象，并可作为提议更新的反馈信号。
Motivation: 现有性能评估主要依赖有效样本量 (ESS) 等基于权重的诊断，只刻画归一化重要性权重的集中程度，无法反映提议分量在采样空间中的排布；当多个提议分量采样同一目标区域时，权重看似平衡但有效独立提议数很少。
Method: 提出相似性感知的提议级诊断 ENP：将每个提议分配到的总归一化权重与由目标加权样本间相似度计算的重叠度度量相结合，估计对近似有贡献的非冗余提议分量数量，并验证其满足有效数基本性质。
Result: 摘要报告 ENP 能检测出标准 ESS 无法发现的提议坍缩 (proposal collapse) 与重复 (duplication) 现象，并展示其可作为提议更新 (proposal rejuvenation) 的定向反馈信号。
Conclusion: ENP 为种群式 AIS 提供了提议级别的诊断工具，弥补 ESS 在空间冗余评估上的不足，并可用于指导提议的更新过程。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: An Adaptive Gradient Clipping and Noise Injection Mechanism for Differentially Private Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Differentially private federated learning must balance privacy protection against model accuracy and training efficiency. Static gradient clipping applies a fixed threshold throughout training and across model layers, which can cause excessive clipping when the threshold is too small or unnecessarily large noise when it is too large. This paper presents DDP-SA-adaptive, an adaptive gradient clipping and noise adding mechanism for differentially private federated learning with secure aggregation. At each communication round, every client determines a separate clipping threshold for each model layer from the median of its per-sample gradient norms. The resulting layer-wise thresholds adapt to the evolving gradient distributions and calibrate the Laplace noise added before the updates are encoded and secret-shared among intermediate aggregation servers. We evaluate the proposed mechanism on a federated regression task in terms of efficiency, accuracy, privacy, convergence, clipping norm, and noise magnitude. Compared with the static DDP-SA baseline, DDP-SA-adaptive reduces the number of communication rounds by 6.81%, total training time by 19.21%, and average per-round training time by 13.33%, leading to improved training efficiency. It also reduces test loss by 98.74% and increases test R2 by 3.41%, leading to improved model accuracy. To attain R2 = 0.99, the adaptive mechanism operates with a privacy budget of approximately epsilon = 0.1, compared with epsilon = 0.4 for static DDP-SA, thus providing stronger privacy protection and achieving stronger privacy guarantees. These results demonstrate that round-wise, layer-wise adaptation can improve the privacy-accuracy-efficiency trade-off of differentially private federated learning.
papers.comment: Submitted to International Conference on Computing, Networking and Communications (ICNC 2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DDP-SA-adaptive，一种用于带安全聚合 (secure aggregation) 的差分隐私联邦学习 (differentially private federated learning) 的自适应梯度裁剪与噪声注入机制。每个客户端在每轮通信中根据其逐样本梯度范数的中位数，为每个模型层确定独立的裁剪阈值，并在更新被编码和秘密共享给中间聚合服务器之前校准所添加的拉普拉斯噪声。在联邦回归任务上，与静态 DDP-SA 基线相比，该方法减少了通信轮数与训练时间，降低了测试损失，并在更小的隐私预算下达到同等 R2。
Motivation: 静态梯度裁剪在整个训练过程和所有模型层上使用固定阈值：阈值过小会导致过度裁剪，阈值过大则会引入不必要的大噪声，从而难以在隐私保护、模型精度和训练效率之间取得良好平衡。
Method: 提出 DDP-SA-adaptive：每一通信轮中，每个客户端从该客户端逐样本梯度范数的中位数出发，为每个模型层单独确定裁剪阈值；这些逐层阈值随梯度分布演化，并用于校准更新被编码并秘密共享到中间聚合服务器之前添加的拉普拉斯噪声。
Result: 在联邦回归任务上，相比静态 DDP-SA 基线，通信轮数减少 6.81%，总训练时间减少 19.21%，平均每轮训练时间减少 13.33%；测试损失降低 98.74%，测试 R2 提高 3.41%。为达到 R2=0.99，自适应机制只需约 epsilon=0.1 的隐私预算，而静态基线需要 epsilon=0.4。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，逐轮、逐层的自适应机制能够改善差分隐私联邦学习中的隐私-精度-效率权衡，在提供更强隐私保证的同时提升训练效率和模型精度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Constitutive Priors for Machine Intelligence: A Legitimacy Theory of the Artificial Physical World
authors: Qi Shen (1) ((1) Persagy Science and Technology Co.
papers.abstract_en: Machine intelligence has conquered the symbolic world but stalled at the physical one. The stall is structural: physical AI faces a cold-start deadlock -- no intelligence without data, no data without deployed intelligence. Our thesis: the deadlock is real but unevenly distributed, and the exception has a name: the artificial physical world. Buildings, industrial facilities, and infrastructure are intentionally constituted and documented: designed artifacts ship with readable archives that precede and constitute their instances; here, norms are promulgated before instances, not averaged from them. Four contributions. (i) From a four-world ontology we derive a legitimacy criterion for constitutive prior frameworks: prior extraction is legitimate if and only if the object domain is intentionally constituted and has left a readable archive; the criterion is testable through direction of fit -- deviation from a constitutive norm is a violation in the world, not a revision of the model. (ii) We establish a layering lower bound: any such framework has at least four layers -- syntax, concept, knowledge, instance -- because four construction goals pair into mutually incompatible carriers. (iii) We register deployment claims across five industrial domains and a 32-class failure-mode vocabulary. (iv) We stake the framework on five falsifiable predictions, the central one checkable on the public engineering record: if it fails, the framework fails. Semi-formal arguments back these claims (Appendix A): a Gold-type boundary on rule coverage in archiveless worlds, a decidability result for failure reduction over closed concept layers, and a boundary theorem for certificate-anchored calculi. Large language models find an honored place here -- as readers of the archive, not as the archive. First of three companion works; the companions take up the questions deliberately left open.
papers.comment: 55 pages, 3 figures, 75 references. Appendix A contains the semi-formal statements. First of three companion works; the two companions are in preparation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种关于机器智能在物理世界停滞的结构性解释：物理人工智能面临冷启动死锁，但人为构建的物理世界（建筑、工业设施、基础设施）因具有先于实例的规范与可读档案，可作为例外。作者从四世界本体论推导出构成性先验框架的合法性判据，论证此类框架至少包含四个层次，并给出跨五个工业领域的部署主张、32 类失效模式词汇表及五个可证伪预测。
Motivation: 机器智能已征服符号世界但在物理世界停滞，其根源被认为是结构性冷启动死锁：没有数据就没有智能，没有已部署的智能就没有数据。本文主张该死锁在人为构建的物理世界中不均匀分布，并试图为打破该死锁提供理论依据。
Method: 从四世界本体论出发推导构成性先验框架的合法性判据：仅当对象领域是被有意构成且留有可读档案时，先验提取才合法。作者建立一个层次下界（语法、概念、知识、实例四层），提出可检验的符合方向（direction of fit）判据，并给出半形式化的附录论证（Gold 型边界、可判定性结果、证书锚定演算边界定理）。
Result: 摘要报告了部署声明覆盖五个工业领域和 32 类失效模式词汇表，并给出五个可证伪预测，其中核心预测可在公开工程记录上检验；同时包含三个半形式化理论结果（规则覆盖的 Gold 型边界、封闭概念层上失效归约的可判定性、证书锚定演算的边界定理）。
Conclusion: 作者将框架押注于五个可证伪预测，核心预测若失败则框架失败；大语言模型被定位为档案的读者而非档案本身。本文是三篇系列工作的第一篇，系列后续将处理刻意留出的问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PureTD: Reinforcement Learning for Backgammon Money Games with No Evaluation-time Search
papers.abstract_en: We revisit Tesauro's TD-Gammon for backgammon money games in the setting of no evaluation-time search. Both checker play and cube action (use of the doubling cube) are learned from scratch via self-play reinforcement learning (RL), with minimal hand-coded logic and no expert features. In this setting, we demonstrate that pure self-play RL suffices to train models that reach near-state-of-the-art playing strength. Specifically, for cubeful money games, our search-free model evaluates faster and is substantially stronger than the open-source engines GNU Backgammon and Open Sage running a one-move (1-ply) look-ahead search.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: ACTS-SQL: Agentic and Critic-Oriented Tree-Structured SQL Correctness with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly adopted in Text-to-SQL systems, yet SQL errors remain a major obstacle in real-world Text-to-SQL inference pipelines. Existing SQL correction approaches either rely on large-scale, high-quality training data with substantial overhead, or adopt single-path agentic workflows that are brittle to early mistakes and prone to error propagation. To develop a practical SQL correctness system for industrial scenarios, we present a training-free framework that formulates SQL correction as a plan-guided, tree-structured debugging process. By maintaining multiple correction strategies and enabling backtracking, the framework mitigates error accumulation during iterative refinement. We further integrate execution-based verification and clause-level diagnostic tools to support strategy pruning and precise error localization. We evaluate the system on the BIRD-Critic benchmark and observe consistent accuracy gains over strong LLM backbones and representative agent-based baselines, achieving a 9.42% improvement over the previous state-of-the-art method. The framework is also deployed in the Torch Log Service (TLS) of Volcano Engine to support an online Text-to-TLS API. In production, it improves execution accuracy from 36.77% to 53.61% on real user queries with a representative strong LLM backbone (GPT-5). These results demonstrate the effectiveness and stability of our approach in real-world deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ACTS-SQL，一种面向工业场景的免训练 SQL 正确性框架，将 SQL 修正建模为计划引导的树状调试过程，通过维护多条修正策略并支持回溯来减少错误累积。系统在 BIRD-Critic 基准上相对此前最优方法提升 9.42%，并已部署到火山引擎 Torch Log Service (TLS)，在真实用户查询上使用 GPT-5 骨干将执行准确率从 36.77% 提升至 53.61%。
Motivation: 现有 Text-to-SQL 推理流程中 SQL 错误仍是主要障碍；已有修正方法或依赖大规模高质量训练数据、开销大，或采用单路径 agentic 工作流，容易受早期错误影响并产生错误传播。工业场景需要一种实用的 SQL 正确性系统。
Method: 提出免训练框架 ACTS-SQL，把 SQL 修正形式化为计划引导的树状调试过程，同时维护多个修正策略并支持回溯；进一步集成基于执行的验证和子句级诊断工具，用于策略剪枝与精确错误定位。
Result: 在 BIRD-Critic 基准上，该方法相对强 LLM 骨干和代表性基于 agent 的基线获得一致的准确率提升，较此前最优方法提高 9.42%；生产部署中，在火山引擎 TLS 以 GPT-5 为骨干时，真实用户查询的执行准确率从 36.77% 提高到 53.61%。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果证明了该方法在真实部署中的有效性和稳定性，并指出该框架免训练、适用于工业场景的 SQL 正确性需求。

papers.title: Scale-Consistent Posterior Dynamics for Diffusion Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Posterior sampling with a pretrained diffusion prior is governed by a conditional score whose intermediate likelihood component is generally intractable. We begin from an ideal one-parameter posterior SDE family in which a stochasticity parameter controls probability-flow transport and stochastic exploration without changing the posterior marginals. To obtain a tractable model, we express the likelihood in a rescaled clean-image coordinate and use log-SNR to organize the resulting posterior proxies. Projecting the diffusion uncertainty through the forward operator then yields a noise-conditioned covariance path whose targets approach the clean posterior. Because endpoint consistency of these targets does not ensure that a surrogate transport follows them, we interleave the transport with a frozen-target Langevin corrector, producing a continuous surrogate SDE. We discretize this model with an outer Lie--Trotter splitting and a variance-matched split-step IMEX predictor that treats the learned prior explicitly, the linear likelihood implicitly, and the stochastic innovation after the implicit solve. We prove marginal invariance of the ideal family, posterior convergence of the continuous surrogate under mixing and transport-defect conditions, and a first-order weak error bound for the discrete algorithm. Experiments on FFHQ and ImageNet with 100 score evaluations demonstrate competitive reconstruction fidelity for super-resolution and deblurring. A controlled 100-image ablation separates scale consistency from the finite-step effects of stochastic-increment placement, continuation, and corrector allocation. A separate noiseless box-inpainting study shows that large exploration reaches a performance plateau only when the matched innovation is injected after the stiff likelihood solve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散逆问题 (diffusion inverse problems) 中的后验采样。作者从理想的一参数后验 SDE 族出发，在重标定的干净图像坐标中表达似然，并用 log-SNR 组织后验代理；将扩散不确定性通过前向算子投影得到噪声条件协方差路径，再与冻结目标的 Langevin corrector 交替构成连续代理 SDE。离散化采用外 Lie–Trotter 分裂和方差匹配的分步 IMEX 预测器。作者证明了理想族的边缘不变性、连续代理在混合与 transport-defect 条件下的后验收敛以及离散算法的一阶弱误差界，并在 FFHQ 和 ImageNet 上用 100 次分数评估展示了超分辨率和去模糊的性能。
Motivation: 预训练扩散先验下的后验采样受条件分数控制，其中间似然分量通常不可解，现有代理模型难以在计算可行与后验一致性之间取得平衡。
Method: 从理想的一参数后验 SDE 族出发，在重标定的干净图像坐标中表达似然并使用 log-SNR 组织后验代理；通过前向算子投影扩散不确定性，得到逼近干净后验的噪声条件协方差路径。将 transport 与冻结目标 Langevin corrector 交替形成连续代理 SDE，离散化使用外 Lie–Trotter 分裂和方差匹配的分步 IMEX 预测器，其中先验显式处理、线性似然隐式处理、随机 innovation 在隐式求解后注入。
Result: 在 FFHQ 和 ImageNet 上，以 100 次分数评估实现超分辨率和去模糊的竞争性重建保真度；受控 100 图像消融将尺度一致性 (scale consistency) 与随机增量放置、延续和 corrector 分配等有限步效应分离；无噪声 box-inpainting 实验表明，仅当匹配的 innovation 在刚性似然求解后注入时，大规模探索才达到性能平台。
Conclusion: 论文在理论上证明理想 SDE 族保持后验边缘不变、连续代理在混合与 transport-defect 条件下后验收敛、离散算法具有一阶弱误差界，并通过消融强调尺度一致性与有限步效应之间的可分离性。摘要未涉及降水、临近预报或天气数据等应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Translating finite-domain integer constraint models to CP/SMT/ILP/PB/SAT solvers with CPMpy
papers.abstract_en: Constraint solving is a declarative approach for solving combinatorial satisfaction and optimization problems. The user specifies their problem through constraints and decision variables, and a generic solver is used to find a solution. Several constraint-solving technologies exist, and certain solvers perform well on certain problems. Therefore, it is useful to try different solvers given a particular application. However, each solving paradigm supports different types of constraints and decision variables. Our goal is to translate high-level constraint satisfaction and optimization problems into any lower-level formalism, including CP, SMT QF-LIA, ILP, PB and (Max)SAT. This allows for comparing different solving technologies for a particular problem, without requiring a user to manually remodel it for each solving paradigm. We define a high-level language of logical and arithmetic operations, and useful additional functions and constraints, which are known as global constraints in the CP community. We then present a modular framework for transforming our high-level modeling language to CP/SMT/ILP/PB and (Max)SAT solvers. While many transformations are partly described in the literature, we observe that they can be implemented through a modular waterfall of smaller components, where lower-level paradigms reuse the transformations of higher-level paradigms. Two recurring challenges are handling the negation of arbitrary subexpressions and avoiding the introduction of auxiliary variables. Additionally, we take special care linearizing non-linear operators for ILP, PB and SAT-solvers. The transformation waterfall is implemented and evaluated in the open-source CPMpy library. Our results show that constraint models significantly change throughout the transformations, and that optimizations to the linearization of constraints are essential for ILP and PB solvers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍开源的 CPMpy 库及其模块化转换框架，将有限域整数约束模型自动翻译为 CP、SMT QF-LIA、ILP、PB 和 (Max)SAT 等底层求解器形式。作者定义了一个包含逻辑与算术运算及全局约束的高层建模语言，并通过瀑布式（waterfall）组件复用实现逐层降级转换，使同一问题无需为每种求解范式手动重建模型。实验表明约束模型经过转换后变化显著，且对 ILP 和 PB 求解器而言，非线性算子的线性化优化至关重要。
Motivation: 不同约束求解技术在特定问题上表现差异大，用户希望对照不同求解器；然而每种求解范式支持不同约束和变量类型，手动为每种范式重新建模成本高。目标是让用户只需给出高层约束模型，即可自动获得多种低层形式以便比较。
Method: 定义高层建模语言（包括逻辑与算术操作以及 CP 社区所称的全局约束），提出模块化瀑布转换框架，将模型逐级降为 CP/SMT/ILP/PB/(Max)SAT。转换中特别处理任意子表达式的否定和辅助变量引入问题，并对 ILP、PB 与 SAT 求解器重点做非线性算子的线性化。该框架在开源 CPMpy 库中实现。
Result: 摘要报告约束模型在转换过程中显著改变；对 ILP 和 PB 求解器，针对约束线性化的优化是决定性的。摘要未给出具体数值或基准。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过模块化、可复用的瀑布式转换组件可实现多范式求解器翻译；变换过程中的模型差异提示线性化策略对底层求解器性能影响重大。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HOIMask: Towards Generative Masked Modeling for Human Object Interaction Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based methods have dominated the HOI generation, as they enable critical contact fusions or signals to guide the diffusion process. However, they often result in high artifacts and unstable interaction quality due to error accumulation during iterative denoising. In this work, we propose HOIMask, the first generative masked framework for modeling HOI motion in discrete space. HOIMask first encodes both motion sequences and contact-aware signals into discrete 2D human and object token maps via HOI Vector Quantization (VQ), preserving fine-grained spatial-temporal structure beyond conventional 1D representations. On this basis, a generative masked modeling framework is employed to jointly capture human-object interaction dynamics, leveraging a transformer architecture designed to model complex spatial-temporal and interaction dependencies. To generate more coherent and physically plausible motions, we further introduce a novel contact-aware reconstruction guidance in discrete space during inference, which fuses contact signals to optimize HOI tokens that forces the generated motion with higher spatio-temporal consistency. With craftily designed motion interaction tokens, dedicated architecture and guidance strategy, HOIMask outperforms state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods, generating more realistic and semantically aligned HOI motions. Please refer to https://jyhflash.github.io/HOIMask/ for more results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HOIMask，据称是首个在离散空间进行生成式掩码建模的 HOI（人-物交互）运动生成框架。它通过 HOI 向量量化（Vector Quantization）把运动序列和接触感知信号编码为二维 token 图，利用 transformer 联合建模时空与人-物交互依赖，并在推理阶段引入接触感知重建引导以提升生成运动的一致性。摘要称其生成的 HOI 运动比 SOTA 扩散方法更真实、语义对齐更好。
Motivation: 扩散方法在 HOI 生成中占主导，但迭代去噪过程中的误差累积常导致高伪影和交互质量不稳定。
Method: 提出 HOIMask：先用 HOI 向量量化将运动序列与接触感知信号编码为保留细粒度时空结构的离散 2D token 图，再以生成式掩码建模框架配合 transformer 捕捉时空与交互依赖；推理时在离散空间加入接触感知重建引导来优化 HOI token。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在生成更真实且语义对齐的 HOI 运动方面优于 SOTA 扩散方法，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 摘要将性能提升归因于精心设计的运动交互 token、专用架构与引导策略，并附有项目页面供查看结果。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 HOIMask，据称是首个在离散空间进行生成式掩码建模的 HOI（人-物交互）运动生成框架。它通过 HOI 向量量化（Vector Quantization）把运动序列和接触感知信号编码为二维 token 图，利用 transformer 联合建模时空与人-物交互依赖，并在推理阶段引入接触感知重建引导以提升生成运动的一致性。摘要称其生成的 HOI 运动比 SOTA 扩散方法更真实、语义对齐更好。
summary_sections.motivation: 扩散方法在 HOI 生成中占主导，但迭代去噪过程中的误差累积常导致高伪影和交互质量不稳定。
summary_sections.method: 提出 HOIMask：先用 HOI 向量量化将运动序列与接触感知信号编码为保留细粒度时空结构的离散 2D token 图，再以生成式掩码建模框架配合 transformer 捕捉时空与交互依赖；推理时在离散空间加入接触感知重建引导来优化 HOI token。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法在生成更真实且语义对齐的 HOI 运动方面优于 SOTA 扩散方法，但未给出具体量化指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要将性能提升归因于精心设计的运动交互 token、专用架构与引导策略，并附有项目页面供查看结果。

papers.title: ReForge: Keeping ABR Algorithms Never Finished with Verified Large Language Model Edits
papers.abstract_en: Designing an ABR algorithm for one network scenario takes an engineer months, and large language models now do this work in hours, matching or beating hand-built designs. But either way, the design fits only the world visible at its birth, and fails on the world that arrives after. We ask whether an ABR algorithm can keep pace with the world, redesigned in minutes as each scenario arrives, with every change proven harmless to every scenario already served. In this work, we propose ReForge, a continual heuristic learning framework that adapts to continuously changing scenarios. ReForge runs that routine with a large language model (LLM) in the loop. Each round the LLM reads where the current design falls short and proposes one small edit, and a replay over every network served so far decides. Specifically, what it edits is a single page of fuzzy rules that routes every decision to one of a frozen pool of pre-trained policies. The LLM writes the first page from measurements alone, then keeps improving it on its own. Each round it reads where the current rules fall short and proposes one small edit, and a replay over every network served so far decides whether the edit lands. We evaluate ReForge on nine real-world network families arriving one at a time as 3G, 4G, then 5G. A few edits per arrival lift mean QoE from 1.23 to 1.74, past the best single policy at 1.66 and to 94\% of an oracle, and even repair families the loop never saw, one rising from 0.30 to 0.80. All code, data, and experiment records will be open-sourced upon cleanup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReForge，一个以 LLM 为核心、面向持续变化网络场景的自适应启发式学习框架，用于让 ABR 算法随场景不断更新。框架通过 LLM 每次提出一个小编辑，修改一页将决策路由到预训练策略库的模糊规则 (fuzzy rules)，并用对所有历史网络场景的重放 (replay) 验证编辑是否落地。在按 3G、4G、5G 顺序到达的九个真实网络族上，每个场景少量编辑即将平均 QoE 从 1.23 提升到 1.74，超过最优单一策略的 1.66，达到 oracle 的 94%。
Motivation: 无论是人工还是 LLM 设计的 ABR 算法，都只适配其诞生时可见的网络场景，无法适应之后出现的新场景；作者希望让算法在几分钟内随每个新场景重新设计，同时保证每次改动对已服务的全部场景无害。
Method: ReForge 采用 LLM-in-the-loop 的持续启发式学习：每轮 LLM 阅读当前规则在何处不足并提出一个小编辑，针对的是一页将每个决策路由到冻结的预训练策略池的模糊规则；编辑是否保留由对所有已服务网络的重放测试决定。初始规则页由 LLM 仅凭测量数据写出，之后自行迭代改进。
Result: 在九个按 3G、4G、5G 顺序到达的真实网络族上，每个场景只需少量编辑即将平均 QoE 从 1.23 提升到 1.74，超过最佳单一策略的 1.66，达到 oracle 的 94%；框架还能修复训练中从未见过的网络族，其中一个的 QoE 从 0.30 提升到 0.80。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架能让 ABR 设计跟上世界变化，且每次编辑都经过对所有已服务场景的重放验证以保证无害；全部代码、数据和实验记录将在整理后开源。
Relevance: 5
