papers.title: Platform Adaptation Under Governance Interventions: Actor Best-Response Modeling and an External Public-Case Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Digital platforms govern by changing rules: rankings, monetization thresholds, moderation standards, verification systems, disclosure requirements, appeal processes, and access policies. These interventions are rarely absorbed passively. Creators, sellers, advertisers, moderators, users, developers, and strategic operators adapt to the new reward surface. This paper develops a platform-adaptation model for evaluating governance interventions as transitions in adaptive multi-actor information systems. The model represents actor best response, strategic gaming opportunity, moderation burden, user-incentive movement, enforcement response, externality formation, and downstream platform stability. We evaluate the model on 72 external public platform-governance cases covering media monetization, ranking systems, verification, delivery platforms, marketplaces, app stores, community platforms, and creator ecosystems. Across 9 methods and 648 method-case evaluations, the full platform-adaptation simulator achieves mean adaptation quality of 0.836338, compared with 0.669731 for a risk-register baseline, 0.589457 for causal-loop analysis, 0.492750 for generic governance critique, 0.369492 for engagement-only optimization, and 0.331965 for baseline policy review. Paired comparisons show a win rate of 1.00 against all tested baselines and channel ablations. The contribution is an information-systems theory and measurement framework showing why platform governance evaluation fails when it treats policy rules as static controls rather than interventions into adaptive actor-response fields.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个平台适应模型 (platform-adaptation model)，把数字平台的治理干预视为自适应多主体信息系统中的转变，并对创作者、卖家、广告商、审核员等主体的最佳响应 (best response) 进行建模。作者在 72 个外部公开平台治理案例上评估该模型，涵盖媒体变现、排名系统、验证、配送平台、市场、应用商店、社区平台和创作者生态等；在 9 种方法与 648 次方法-案例评估中，完整平台适应模拟器取得平均适应质量 0.836338，明显优于多种基线。贡献在于提出一个信息系统理论与测量框架，说明平台治理评估不能把政策规则当作静态控制，而应视为对自适应行为响应场的干预。
Motivation: 平台通过改变排名、变现门槛、审核标准、验证系统等规则进行治理，但这些干预很少被被动吸收，参与者会适应新的奖励面。现有评估常把规则当作静态控制，忽略了策略性适应，因而导致治理评估失效。
Method: 提出平台适应模拟器，刻画主体最佳响应、策略博弈机会 (strategic gaming opportunity)、审核负担、用户激励流动、执法响应、外部性形成和下游平台稳定性。作者还构建了一个由 72 个外部公开平台治理案例组成的基准，并采用 9 种方法与通道消融进行对照评估。
Result: 在 648 次方法-案例评估中，完整模拟器平均适应质量为 0.836338，高于风险登记基线 (0.669731)、因果回路分析 (0.589457)、通用治理批评 (0.492750)、仅参与优化 (0.369492) 和基线政策审查 (0.331965)。配对比较显示对所有基线和通道消融的胜率均为 1.00。
Conclusion: 摘要将贡献定位为一种信息系统的理论与测量框架，核心主张是平台治理评估的失效源于把政策规则当作静态控制，而非对自适应行为响应场的干预。摘要未明确说明该方法在何种条件下受限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We systematically compare word order preferences in decoder-only language models across 192 artificial languages and typologically diverse natural languages. On artificial languages, models exhibit a left-branching preference that aligns with neither natural language universals nor human word order learning biases. On natural languages, monolingual models show no clear base word order bias at small scales, but as data grows, a preference for right-branching subject-verb-object (SVO) languages emerges while SOV falls behind despite being the most frequent order cross-linguistically. This SVO advantage extends to multilingual models and correlates with language resource level and data quality rather than word order. Thus, the same architecture exhibits opposite preferences on artificial and natural languages, establishing that word order biases observed in practice are data-driven. Since highly-resourced languages are overwhelmingly SVO, these biases risk gradually reducing word order diversity, particularly in languages that productively use multiple word orders, with the widespread adoption of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较 decoder-only 语言模型在 192 种人工语言和类型多样的自然语言上的词序偏好。人工语言实验中模型呈现左分支 (left-branching) 偏好，与自然语言共性和人类词序学习偏置不一致；自然语言实验中，小规模单语模型没有明确基础词序偏置，随数据增长则出现对右分支 SVO 语序的偏好，而 SOV 语序尽管跨语言频率最高却表现落后。这种 SVO 优势在多语模型中也成立，并与语言资源水平和数据质量相关而非词序本身。作者据此认为实践中观察到的词序偏置是数据驱动的，并可能因高资源语言以 SVO 为主而逐渐降低词序多样性。
Motivation: 语言模型词序偏好的来源尚不明确，需要区分其反映的是人类语言共性/学习偏置还是训练数据特性；作者通过受控人工语言和多样化自然语言来进行系统检验。
Method: 在 192 种人工语言和类型多样的自然语言上训练 decoder-only 语言模型，比较单语与多语设置下不同词序（如 SVO 与 SOV）的表现，并结合语言资源水平和数据质量分析偏好成因。
Result: 人工语言中模型一致偏好左分支结构，与自然语言共性和人类偏置相反；自然语言中随数据量增加出现对右分支 SVO 的偏好，SOV 落后；该优势在多语模型中延续，且与资源水平和数据质量相关。
Conclusion: 作者认为词序偏好主要由训练数据驱动而非先验架构或人类语言偏置，高资源语言多为 SVO 这一状况可能促使 LLM 削弱多种词序并存的语言多样性。

papers.title: From LLM Inference to Agentic Workloads: Characterization and Implications for Serving Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agentic applications are shifting AI serving from isolated model inference to long-running workloads in which LLMs coordinate tools, environments, and persistent state. However, the system behavior of these workloads---where latency, cost, and bottlenecks arise---remains poorly characterized, leaving serving systems to rely on assumptions built for conventional inference. We present AgentSysBench, a benchmark suite and measurement toolkit with ten representative agentic applications and unified systems-level instrumentation. Across controlled deployments and production traces, we identify six properties that distinguish agentic workloads from conventional LLM serving: (1) execution is heavyweight and stateful, with non-LLM components dominating latency in 5 of 10 applications and sandbox working-set memory peaking at 28 GB per session; (2) applications compose components with heterogeneous resource affinity---GPU-bound inference, memory-bound retrieval, CPU-bound sandboxes---whose task latencies diverge by up to 32x; (3) bottlenecks shift across requests, models, and deployments; (4) production sessions hold state idle for minutes to hours between active steps; (5) a control-plane tax---auxiliary LLM calls and context overhead from tool schemas and observations---crowds out productive compute and context; and (6) production traces from three applications reveal heavy cross-request redundancy in search queries and web fetches, exposing a large caching opportunity. Four design explorations demonstrate that these findings are actionable: task-aware serving reduces latency by 29--40%, communication-aware placement by up to 4.5x, state offloading reduces memory usage by 4.6x, and tool-result caching removes 35.2% of redundant search calls and saves 19.3% of aggregate search latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentSysBench，一个包含十个代表性agentic应用和统一系统级插桩的基准套件与测量工具，用于刻画agentic工作负载与常规LLM推理在服务系统行为上的差异。通过受控部署和生产轨迹测量，作者归纳出六个区分性属性，包括非LLM组件主导延迟、异构资源亲和性、瓶颈迁移、状态空闲、控制面开销和跨请求冗余。四个设计探索进一步表明这些发现可直接转化为服务系统优化。
Motivation: 现有AI服务系统基于常规模型推理的假设设计，而agentic应用是LLM协调工具、环境和持久状态的长时间运行负载，其延迟、成本和瓶颈的系统行为缺乏刻画，导致服务系统难以针对这类负载做优化。
Method: 构建AgentSysBench基准与测量工具，包含十个代表性agentic应用和统一系统级插桩；结合受控部署和生产轨迹进行度量分析，并基于识别出的属性开展四项设计探索（任务感知服务、通信感知放置、状态卸载、工具结果缓存）。
Result: 测量显示10个应用中5个的非LLM组件主导延迟，沙箱工作集内存峰值达28 GB/会话，组件任务延迟差异最高达32倍；生产会话在活动步骤之间空闲数分钟到数小时。设计探索中，任务感知服务降低延迟29–40%，通信感知放置提升最高4.5倍，状态卸载降低内存4.6倍，工具结果缓存去除35.2%冗余搜索调用并节省19.3%总搜索延迟。
Conclusion: 摘要强调agentic工作负载在系统行为上与常规LLM推理有本质区别，需要任务感知、通信感知和状态管理等新的服务设计；作者通过四项设计探索说明这些发现是可操作的，但测量范围限于十个应用和三个应用的生产轨迹。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有AI服务系统基于常规模型推理的假设设计，而agentic应用是LLM协调工具、环境和持久状态的长时间运行负载，其延迟、成本和瓶颈的系统行为缺乏刻画，导致服务系统难以针对这类负载做优化。
summary_sections.method: 构建AgentSysBench基准与测量工具，包含十个代表性agentic应用和统一系统级插桩；结合受控部署和生产轨迹进行度量分析，并基于识别出的属性开展四项设计探索（任务感知服务、通信感知放置、状态卸载、工具结果缓存）。
summary_sections.result: 测量显示10个应用中5个的非LLM组件主导延迟，沙箱工作集内存峰值达28 GB/会话，组件任务延迟差异最高达32倍；生产会话在活动步骤之间空闲数分钟到数小时。设计探索中，任务感知服务降低延迟29–40%，通信感知放置提升最高4.5倍，状态卸载降低内存4.6倍，工具结果缓存去除35.2%冗余搜索调用并节省19.3%总搜索延迟。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调agentic工作负载在系统行为上与常规LLM推理有本质区别，需要任务感知、通信感知和状态管理等新的服务设计；作者通过四项设计探索说明这些发现是可操作的，但测量范围限于十个应用和三个应用的生产轨迹。

papers.title: Decision-Driven Regularization: A Blended Model for Learning and Optimization
papers.abstract_en: In contextual optimization, the decision-maker seeks optimal decisions to minimize a cost function, that varies based on observed features. This context is common in many business applications ranging from on-demand delivery and retail operations to portfolio optimization and inventory management. In this paper, we study the learning and optimization approach, which first learns how outcomes result from the features, and then selects optimal decisions based on these outcomes. We focus on the integrated learning and optimization literature, and identify that a lack of control for prediction accuracy can lead to overfitting and a loss of decision effectiveness against simple separate learning and optimization models. Instead, we propose a bi-objective formulation that balances prediction accuracy and cost minimization, termed decision-driven regularization. It also addresses ambiguity in the definition of the cost function via a surrogate that depends on a new hyperparameter. We additionally show that alternative perspectives for formulating the problem, namely robust optimization and regret minimization, lead to models that are closely related to our proposed model. As a consequence, our framework generalizes models such as SPO+. Our model is shown to be numerically superior to other benchmarks, such as OLS, Random Forest, XGBoost, SPO+, Perturbation Gradient, and Learning and Rank, in our synthetic studies.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究上下文优化（contextual optimization）中的集成学习与优化方法，指出缺乏对预测准确性的控制会导致过拟合，并使决策效果不如简单的分离式学习和优化模型。作者提出一种双目标（bi-objective）公式，称为决策驱动正则化（decision-driven regularization），通过平衡预测准确性和成本最小化，并引入依赖新超参数的代理成本函数来处理成本函数定义的模糊性。文章还表明鲁棒优化和遗憾最小化视角导出的模型与所提模型密切相关，因此该框架推广了 SPO+ 等模型。
Motivation: 集成学习与优化（integrated learning and optimization）在商业应用中很常见，但现有方法缺乏对预测准确性的控制，可能导致过拟合，进而在决策效果上甚至不如简单的分离式学习和优化模型；同时成本函数的定义存在模糊性。
Method: 提出双目标公式，在预测准确性和成本最小化之间做权衡，即决策驱动正则化；通过一个依赖于新超参数的代理函数来处理成本函数定义的歧义，并与鲁棒优化和遗憾最小化视角建立联系。
Result: 合成研究中，该模型在数值上优于 OLS、Random Forest、XGBoost、SPO+、Perturbation Gradient 和 Learning and Rank 等基准。
Conclusion: 该框架推广了 SPO+ 等模型，并为集成学习与优化提供了一种平衡预测准确性和决策成本的统一视角。

papers.title: Sufficient Dimesion Reduction via Generalized Stein's Lemma
papers.abstract_en: Sufficient dimension reduction (SDR) seeks the minimal subspace of the predictors that captures the full conditional distribution of the response, which is known as the central subspace (CS). When the response is multivariate, the problem becomes considerably more challenging, particularly when the sample size is limited. Existing methods face different limitations:inverse regression approaches rely on strong distributional assumptions and matrix inversion, and their multi-response extensions suffer from severe slice sparsity; forward regression methods depend on computationally intensive iterative smoothing whose cost grows with the response dimension; and deep learning-based approaches demand large amounts of labeled data. To circumvent these shortcomings, we propose an SDR framework based on the generalized Stein's lemma. Our method constructs a cross-moment matrix between the multivariate response and the marginal score function of the predictors, and recovers the CS via its singular value decomposition. The proposed method does not rely on the linearity condition, avoids matrix inversion as well as iterative smoothing, and can leverage unlabeled data when available. We establish convergence guarantees for the proposed estimator under standard regularity conditions. Moreover, we propose a practical rank-selection algorithm to estimate the dimension of the CS. Extensive simulation studies and a real data application demonstrate that the proposed methods consistently outperform existing approaches across a variety of settings, particularly in moderate-dimensional, label-scarce scenarios with high noise levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于广义Stein引理的充分降维 (sufficient dimension reduction, SDR) 框架，构造多变量响应与预测变量边际得分函数的交叉矩矩阵，并通过奇异值分解恢复中心子空间 (central subspace)。方法不依赖线性条件，避免矩阵求逆和迭代平滑，且可利用无标签数据。作者建立了估计量的收敛性保证，并提出实用的秩选择算法估计中心子空间维数；模拟与真实数据实验表明，在中等维度、标签稀少且噪声较高的场景下，所提方法一致优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有SDR方法各有缺陷：逆回归方法依赖强分布假设和矩阵求逆，多响应扩展存在严重的切片稀疏性；前向回归方法需要随响应维度增长而快速增大的迭代平滑计算；深度学习方法则需要大量有标签数据。本文目标是在多响应、样本量受限时提供一条不依赖上述强假设的SDR路径。
Method: 基于广义Stein引理构造多变量响应与预测变量边际得分函数之间的交叉矩矩阵，利用其奇异值分解恢复中心子空间；不要求线性条件，回避矩阵求逆和迭代平滑，并可引入无标签数据。此外提出一个实用的秩选择算法来估计中心子空间的维数。
Result: 在标准正则条件下，作者给出估计量的收敛性保证；大量模拟研究和一项真实数据应用显示，所提方法在多种设置下一致优于现有方法，尤其在中等维度、标签稀缺和高噪声水平的情景中优势明显。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架绕开了现有SDR方法的多个关键限制（线性性假设、矩阵求逆、迭代平滑和大规模标签需求），为标签稀缺的有限样本场景提供了可用的降维工具。

papers.title: Anatomy of a Quantized Agent: VRAM Stability and Forecasting in Code-Synthesis Agentic Workloads
papers.abstract_en: Analytical models of peak VRAM consumption for LLM inference decompose memory into weight-storage, KV-cache, and activation terms parameterized by step count, tool invocations, and context expansion. We evaluate this decomposition empirically within a strictly scoped measurement study: a LangGraph-based CUDA-kernel-synthesis agent (AgentK), a 4-bit quantization family (Q4 K M), a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, and four LLM backbones across 1,920 trajectories. Focusing on peak-memory forecasting behavior, we report two primary observations. First, closed-form analytical models achieve competitive accuracy when provided with two empirical constants: loaded-weight VRAM and a fixed activation-memory overhead. Supplied with live GPU readings and ground-truth trajectory parameters, the closed-form model matches or outperforms the best learned baseline on three of the four backbones (test MAPE 2.2-4.4% vs. 3.4-6.5%, p = 0.76). The exception is the smallest backbone (Phi-4-mini), where minimal VRAM variance (CV 0.3%) causes dynamic modeling to underperform simple regression. Second, compile success strictly bifurcates by backbone capacity (from 5.7% for Phi-4-mini to 62.0% for Qwen2.5-Coder-14B), demonstrating that functional code synthesis remains constrained by intrinsic LLM capabilities rather than available memory. Furthermore, because overall peak-memory variance is remarkably low across all backbones (CV 0.3-9.4%), learned prompt-feature regression offers statistically insignificant improvements over a constant-mean baseline. Consequently, we find no justification for deploying complex predictive VRAM models in highly quantized, weight-dominated regimes. We release the evaluated corpus and anonymized framework to support replication.

papers.title: Perspective-Invariant Attack with Enhanced Transferability of Adversarial Examples
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial examples generated on a surrogate deep neural network (DNN) can often successfully fool other black-box DNN models. This cross-model transferability poses serious security threats to DNNs in practical applications. Input transformation techniques are widely used to enhance adversarial transferability by increasing the diversity of input images. However, existing methods primarily rely on local operations with limited degrees of freedom (DOF), such as block-wise shuffling and resizing, overlooking global perspective transformations that naturally arise from viewpoint changes. In this work, we propose a Perspective-Invariant Attack (PIA), which introduces a multi-DOF vertex sampling strategy that systematically covers the perspective transformation hierarchy from 2-DOF translation to 8-DOF projective mapping. By generating geometrically diverse input variations, PIA effectively reduces overfitting of adversarial perturbations to the surrogate model, thereby improving adversarial transferability. We further propose PIA-Mix, a generic extension that maintains a complementary transformation pool and efficiently combines our perspective transformation with auxiliary methods for improved transferability. Extensive experiments involving various DNN architectures, advanced defense mechanisms, and multimodal large language models (LLMs) demonstrate that PIA and PIA-Mix outperform state-of-the-art transfer-based attacks.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security, vol. 21, pp. 6818-6831, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Perspective-Invariant Attack (PIA)，一种通过多自由度顶点采样策略系统覆盖透视变换层级（从 2-DOF 平移至 8-DOF 射影映射）的输入变换攻击方法，旨在增强对抗样本的黑盒迁移性。作者进一步提出 PIA-Mix，作为通用扩展，将透视变换与辅助变换方法组合。实验表明，在多种 DNN 架构、先进防御机制和多模态大语言模型上，PIA 与 PIA-Mix 优于现有基于迁移的攻击方法。
Motivation: 现有增强对抗迁移性的输入变换方法主要依赖有限自由度的局部操作，如分块洗牌和缩放，忽略了视角变化带来的全局透视变换，导致可生成的输入多样性受限。
Method: 提出 PIA，其核心是一种多自由度顶点采样策略，系统覆盖从 2-DOF 平移扩展到 8-DOF 射影映射的透视变换层级；并在此基础上提出 PIA-Mix，维护一个互补变换池，将透视变换与辅助方法高效结合以进一步提升迁移性。
Result: 摘要报告在多种 DNN 架构、先进防御机制以及多模态大语言模型上的大量实验均表明，PIA 和 PIA-Mix 在攻击迁移性上优于当前最先进的基于迁移的攻击方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为，引入全局透视变换的几何多样性能够减少对抗扰动对替代模型的过拟合，从而提升黑盒迁移性；PIA-Mix 作为一种通用扩展可与其他变换方法互补使用。

papers.title: Fast Test-Time Refinement for Robust Learned Image Compression
papers.abstract_en: Learned image compression (LIC) has demonstrated remarkable rate-distortion (RD) performance in benign settings. However, the high representational capacity endowed by deep neural networks (DNNs) comes at the expense of increased adversarial vulnerability. This hinders their adoption as trusted standardized codecs. Recent work has sketched test-time refinement (TTR) as a defense in gray-box scenarios, despite its original purpose of improving benign RD performance. Unfortunately, extensive iterations of TTR incur prohibitive overhead, while the robustness mechanism lacks theoretical understanding. Moreover, TTR has not been evaluated in white-box settings or against attacks beyond $\ell_2$-bounded rate and untargeted distortion objectives. To bridge these gaps, we present a systematic study. Our study reveals an Asymmetric Adversarial Trajectory (AAT) property in LIC systems: transitioning from adversarial to benign regions is significantly easier than the reverse process, where adversarial examples can often be roughly recovered within only 1-2 steps. We provide a two-dimensional Tube Model to explain this phenomenon. Based on AAT, we propose a Fast Test-Time Refinement (FTTR) framework for practical and robust LIC systems. We establish that the robustness arises from the contraction of adversarial regions induced by the Input-as-Label property of LIC systems, rather than from obfuscated gradients. Extensive evaluations with diverse strong adaptive attacks across multiple LIC systems demonstrate the promise of the proposed FTTR framework. The code is available at https://github.com/chinaliangjiaming/FTTR.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究学习型图像压缩 (LIC) 在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性问题，提出快速测试时精炼 (Fast Test-Time Refinement, FTTR) 框架。作者发现并命名了 LIC 系统中的非对称对抗轨迹 (Asymmetric Adversarial Trajectory, AAT) 性质：从对抗区域回到良性区域明显比反向过程容易，对抗样本通常只需 1-2 步即可粗略恢复。作者用二维 Tube Model 解释该现象，并在多个 LIC 系统上对多种强自适应攻击进行了验证。
Motivation: 学习型图像压缩虽在良性场景下具有优异率失真性能，但深度网络的高表示能力带来对抗脆弱性，阻碍其成为可信的标准编解码器。已有测试时精炼 (TTR) 被用作灰盒场景中的防御，但迭代开销过大、鲁棒性机制缺乏理论理解，且尚未在白盒设置或超出 ℓ2 有界速率与非目标失真目标以外的攻击下评估。
Method: 提出 FTTR 框架，基于 AAT 性质以极少的 1-2 步将对抗样本从对抗区域恢复至良性区域，从而实现高效的测试时防御。作者建立二维 Tube Model 解释 AAT，并通过论证表明鲁棒性源于 LIC 系统 Input-as-Label 性质所导致的对抗区域收缩，而非梯度混淆 (obfuscated gradients)。
Result: 摘要报告在多个 LIC 系统上对多种强自适应攻击的广泛评估证明了 FTTR 框架的有效性，但未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 FTTR 为实用且鲁棒的 LIC 系统提供了一种高效防御途径，并将鲁棒性机制归因于对抗区域的收缩。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Probability-Preserving Transformer for the Time-Dependent Schrödinger Equation
papers.abstract_en: Solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation (TDSE) via traditional numerical methods is computationally intensive. Transformer models offer a compelling alternative, but standard implementations rely on soft constraints that cannot rigorously guarantee probability conservation. Here, we introduce a Transformer architecture that enforces TDSE probability conservation as a hard constraint. The design intrinsically ensures unitarity across temporal evolution without requiring repeated retraining. Our empirical findings show that this hard-constraint approach is not only physically exact but also computationally superior to conventional soft-constraint methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种将概率守恒作为硬约束的Transformer架构，用于求解含时薛定谔方程（TDSE）。该方法通过构造性的设计保证时间演化的幺正性，无需重复训练，并在物理精确性和计算效率上优于软约束方法。
Motivation: 传统数值方法求解TDSE计算密集，而标准Transformer模型依赖软约束，无法严格保证概率守恒，这限制了其在物理模拟中的可靠性与效率。
Method: 引入一种Transformer架构，将TDSE的概率守恒作为硬约束嵌入模型结构，使时间演化在机制上保证幺正性，从而避免依赖反复训练来维持约束。
Result: 摘要报告该硬约束方法不仅在物理上是精确的，而且在计算上优于传统软约束方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将守恒律作为硬约束嵌入Transformer既能保证物理精确性，又能提升计算效率，为时间演化模拟提供了一种可行的架构设计思路。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: CETalk: Continuous Valence-Arousal Control for Audio-Driven 3D Talking Head Generation
papers.abstract_en: Emotional 3D talking head generation aims to synthesize expressive facial animations with accurate lip synchronization. However, existing methods often rely on discrete emotion categories, which fail to capture the continuous evolution of affect. They also overlook the temporal frequency mismatch between audio articulation and emotional expression. In this paper, we propose CETalk, an audio-driven 3D facial animation framework conditioned on continuous Valence--Arousal (VA) representations for fine-grained emotion control. CETalk predicts a sequence of FLAME parameters through three key components: a Dynamic Emotion Modulation Module that adaptively scales emotional intensity using audio-derived cues; a Multi-Scale Temporal Modeling mechanism that employs parallel branches to decouple high-frequency articulatory movements from low-frequency emotional dynamics; and a Dynamic Fusion Mechanism that integrates these multi-scale features via an adaptive gating network. To support training and evaluation, we construct 3D-VA-MEAD, a large-scale dataset with automatically estimated VA annotations and reconstructed 3D facial motions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CETalk outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both lip-sync accuracy and emotional expressiveness, while enabling smooth and controllable emotion transitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CETalk，一个以连续 Valence-Arousal (VA) 表征为条件的音频驱动 3D 人脸动画框架，用于细粒度情感控制。框架通过动态情感调制模块、多尺度时间建模与动态融合机制预测 FLAME 参数序列，并构建带自动 VA 标注与 3D 面部运动重建的大规模数据集 3D-VA-MEAD。摘要报告该方法在唇形同步准确性和情感表现力上优于现有方法，并能实现平滑可控的情感过渡。
Motivation: 现有情感 3D 说话头生成方法多依赖离散情感类别，无法刻画情感的连续演化，且忽略了音频发音与情感表达之间的时间频率不匹配问题。
Method: CETalk 由三个关键组件构成：动态情感调制模块 (Dynamic Emotion Modulation Module) 利用音频线索自适应缩放情感强度；多尺度时间建模 (Multi-Scale Temporal Modeling) 用并行分支解耦高频发音动作与低频情感动态；动态融合机制 (Dynamic Fusion Mechanism) 通过自适应门控网络整合多尺度特征。此外，作者构建了含自动 VA 标注和重建 3D 面部运动的数据集 3D-VA-MEAD 以支持训练和评估。
Result: 大量实验表明，CETalk 在唇形同步准确性和情感表现力两方面均优于现有最先进方法，并支持平滑、可控的情感过渡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调以连续 VA 表征建模情感并使用多尺度频率解耦，是提升情感 3D 说话头生成中表达连续性与可控性的有效途径。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Constraint-Aware Synthetic Tabular Data Generation via Inter-Column Constraint Discovery with LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Generating structurally valid synthetic tabular data remains difficult: outputs with high statistical fidelity and downstream utility can still violate semantically meaningful domain constraints. We study the discovery and enforcement of three complementary inter-column constraint families---equations, linear inequalities, and logical dependencies. Our unified tool-grounded workflow represents all three as machine-executable hypotheses and applies a common interface for full-table validation, deterministic diagnosis, and counterexample-guided revision. A generator-agnostic postprocessor coordinates family-specific repairs on outputs from unchanged tabular generators. Across curated behavioral audits and end-to-end evaluations, the complete workflow improves held-out violation detection over one-shot direct prompting, while postprocessing yields zero measured violations for every retained, applicable constraint, improves downstream utility on most datasets, and largely preserves univariate marginals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究合成表格数据生成中的列间约束发现与强制问题，聚焦三类互补约束：方程 (equations)、线性不等式 (linear inequalities) 与逻辑依赖 (logical dependencies)。作者提出统一的工具化工作流，将约束表示为机器可执行假设，并通过全表验证、确定性诊断和反例引导修订的通用接口来执行。一个生成器无关的后处理器在不改动原有表格生成器的情况下协调各类约束修复，实验显示该方法比一次性直接提示更好地检测保留集上的违反约束，且后处理使所有保留且适用的约束测得零违反，同时在多数数据集上提升下游效用并基本保留单变量边际分布。
Motivation: 现有合成表格数据即使具有高统计保真度和下游效用，仍可能违反有语义意义的领域约束，而结构性有效的表格数据生成仍未解决这一难题。
Method: 提出了统一工具化工作流，将方程、线性不等式和逻辑依赖三类列间约束统一建模为机器可执行假设，并通过公共接口进行全表验证、确定性诊断和反例引导修订；同时设计生成器无关的后处理器，对未修改的表格生成器输出进行分族修复。
Result: 在行为审计和端到端评估中，完整工作流相比一次性直接提示提升了保留集上的违规检测能力；后处理对每个保留且适用的约束实现零测得违规，在大多数数据集上改善下游效用，并基本保留单变量边际 (univariate marginals)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作流能在不改变底层生成器的情况下发现并强制复杂的列间约束，同时保持下游效用与边际分布质量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Direct Access: Resource Hijacking in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are increasingly connected to high-value resources such as computing infrastructure, credentials, usage budgets, identities, private knowledge, communication channels, and organizational workflows. Existing agent security research mainly studies attacks on instructions, data, and tool behaviors, while high-value resources accessible to agents have received much less attention as direct attack targets. We are the first to identify and systematically study agent resource hijacking, a security blind spot in which attackers induce agents to invoke, consume, transfer, or control high-value resources for their own goals without directly obtaining those resources or their credentials. To study this threat, we introduce ResourceHijackBench together with an automated pipeline for generating resource hijacking cases. We organize high-value agent resources into six categories and construct 300 attack scenarios with 900 attack prompts. Each case runs in an isolated local environment that records actual resource use, allowing attacks to be evaluated from agent behavior rather than text responses alone. Without additional defenses, OpenClaw reaches an average attack success rate of 84.06%. The attack remains effective across different model backends, with average success rates ranging from 69.98% to 89.58%. Existing defenses reduce part of the risk, but the strongest evaluated defense still leaves an average attack success rate of 55.11%. These results show that high-value resources accessible to agents form an important and previously overlooked attack surface, and that current agent defenses are not sufficient to protect them from resource hijacking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地研究大语言模型智能体（LLM agent）的资源劫持（resource hijacking）威胁，即攻击者诱导智能体调用、消耗、转移或控制高价值资源而不直接获取资源或其凭据。作者提出 ResourceHijackBench 基准及自动化生成管线，覆盖六类高价值资源，构造 300 个攻击场景和 900 条攻击提示，并在隔离本地环境中记录真实资源使用以评估攻击。摘要报告 OpenClaw 在无额外防御下平均攻击成功率为 84.06%，不同模型后端下为 69.98% 至 89.58%，最强评估防御仍留下 55.11% 的平均成功率。
Motivation: 现有智能体安全研究主要关注针对指令、数据和工具行为的攻击，而智能体可访问的高价值资源（如计算基础设施、凭据、预算、身份、私有知识、通信渠道和组织工作流）作为直接攻击目标受到的关注不足，形成安全盲区。
Method: 提出 ResourceHijackBench 及自动化攻击案例生成管线，将高价值智能体资源分为六类并构建 300 个攻击场景、900 条攻击提示；每个案例在隔离本地环境中运行并记录实际资源使用，从而基于智能体行为而非仅文本输出评估攻击。
Result: 无额外防御时 OpenClaw 平均攻击成功率为 84.06%；跨模型后端平均成功率范围为 69.98% 至 89.58%；现有防御仅降低部分风险，最强评估防御下平均攻击成功率仍达 55.11%。
Conclusion: 高价值资源构成智能体一个重要且此前被忽视的攻击面，当前智能体防御不足以保护这些资源免受资源劫持。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Global Federated Learning Strategies for Building Efficient Personalized Models
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is a practical framework that can train models on distributed user data while guaranteeing data privacy; however, due to heterogeneity in which each user has a different data distribution, problems frequently arise where both global and personalization performance deteriorate simultaneously. This dissertation presents methodologies for building efficient personalized models by identifying which strategies are effective in the global training stage and by showing how to preserve global knowledge while securing user-specific performance during local adaptation. First, we show that as data heterogeneity increases, the collapse of feature vectors is a more fundamental bottleneck than classifier weights, and propose a method that directly mitigates the discrepancy in representation magnitude between local and global models. Second, we analyze that a training approach that strengthens local alignment can induce forgetting of global knowledge (e.g., categories not observed locally), and propose a method that achieves both local alignment and global knowledge preservation by combining feature distillation based on the global model's feature vectors. Third, in federated personalized reward model learning with preference heterogeneity, we empirically verify the conventional belief that "increasing the number of global models yields better initialization," and we show that when sufficient local fine-tuning is allowed, a single global initialization can instead provide stronger personalization performance. This study redefines the role of global initialization under data and preference heterogeneity and provides practical training strategies that simultaneously satisfy global knowledge preservation and personalization.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 KAIST 的博士学位论文，研究联邦学习 (federated learning) 中如何在数据异构和偏好异构条件下训练高效的个性化模型。论文指出特征向量坍缩比分类器权重更根本，提出缓解局部与全局模型表示幅度差异的方法；分析局部对齐训练会导致全局知识遗忘，并提出基于全局模型特征向量的特征蒸馏方案；最后在个性化奖励模型学习中重新审视全局初始化的作用。
Motivation: 联邦学习中每个用户的数据分布不同，这种异构性常导致全局性能和个性化性能同时下降，因此需要明确全局训练阶段哪些策略有效，并在局部适配时同时保留全局知识。
Method: 论文分三部分：其一，针对数据异构增大时特征向量坍缩这一更根本的瓶颈，提出直接缓解局部与全局模型表示幅度差异的方法；其二，结合基于全局模型特征向量的特征蒸馏，同时实现局部对齐和全局知识保留；其三，在具有偏好异构的联邦个性化奖励模型学习中，实证检验多个全局模型与单个全局初始化的初始化策略。
Result: 摘要报告：随着数据异构性增加，特征向量坍缩比分类器权重更关键；强化局部对齐的训练方式会诱发对全局知识（如本地未观察到的类别）的遗忘；经验上验证了“增加全局模型数量带来更好初始化”的传统观点，但同时表明在允许充分局部微调时，单个全局初始化反而能提供更强的个性化性能。
Conclusion: 这项研究重新定义了数据和偏好异构下全局初始化的作用，并提供了同时满足全局知识保留与个性化的实用训练策略。

papers.title: EMASAM: a Computationally Efficient Sharpness-Aware Minimization via EMA-Guided Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in optimization research has highlighted the sharpness of the loss landscape as a key factor in narrowing the generalization gap. Motivated by this insight, Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) was proposed as a training strategy that enhances generalization. Despite the promising performance, SAM suffers from its twice computational cost due to its core algorithm requiring an extra gradient computation during the perturbation step. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Exponential Moving Average Sharpness-Aware Minimization (EMASAM), a computationally efficient variant of SAM. EMASAM does not require the loss gradient in the perturbation step. Instead, EMASAM defines the perturbation direction based on the discrepancy between the main model and the EMA shadow model. This perturbation travels away from the stable average position toward the less stable area, acting as a softer yet cheaper alternative to SAM's worst-case scenario perturbation. Moreover, since EMASAM's perturbation does not rely on noisy mini-batch gradients, it mitigates the gradient-induced instability inherent in SAM. Hence, EMASAM eliminates the need for an extra backpropagation while also preserving the generalization ability of the SAM-style training. Several experiments have been performed and confirm the efficiency and robustness of our method.
papers.comment: Accepted in ICPR2026. The project page can be accessed at https://www.vip.sc.eng.isct.ac.jp/proj/EMASAM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Exponential Moving Average Sharpness-Aware Minimization (EMASAM)，一种计算高效的 SAM 变体，用于图像分类等任务的损失景观锐度感知训练。EMASAM 在扰动步骤中不计算额外的损失梯度，而是利用主模型与 EMA 影子模型之间的差异来定义扰动方向，从而省去一次反向传播，同时保留 SAM 风格的泛化能力。摘要报告若干实验验证了该方法的效率与鲁棒性。
Motivation: SAM 通过扰动参数来感知损失景观的锐度以提升泛化，但其核心算法需要额外一次梯度计算，导致训练成本翻倍；此外其基于小批量梯度的扰动可能引入梯度噪声带来的不稳定性。
Method: EMASAM 用主模型与指数移动平均 (EMA) 影子模型之间的差异构造扰动方向，使扰动远离稳定的平均位置、指向较不稳定区域，作为 SAM 最坏情形扰动的更便宜替代；由于不依赖有噪的小批量梯度，也缓解了梯度导致的训练不稳定，从而免去额外的反向传播。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，仅称多项实验确认了 EMASAM 在效率和鲁棒性上的优势，并表示其保留了 SAM 风格训练的泛化能力。
Conclusion: EMASAM 以更低的计算代价实现近似 SAM 的泛化收益，并规避了 SAM 中梯度驱动的扰动不稳定性。

papers.title: ProjFormer: Point Cloud Completion via Geometric-Projective Transformer and Cross-Modal Semantic Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Point cloud completion is inherently ill-posed due to severe sparsity and ambiguity in partial observations. Existing multi-view methods alleviate this by incorporating 2D semantics, but often rely on learned attention and fixed fusion, which lack geometric consistency and adaptability. We propose ProjFormer, a cross-modal framework that enforces geometry-consistent 2D-3D interaction through explicit projection and adaptive feature routing. A Projective Guided View Attention module aligns 3D points with multi-view features via deterministic projection, enabling efficient and geometrically consistent aggregation. Building on this, a geometry-aware routing network performs point-wise adaptive fusion of structural and observation-driven features for progressive refinement. Experiments show that, under a lightweight design, ProjFormer delivers competitive performance with improved structural completeness.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2026. 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProjFormer，一种用于点云补全 (point cloud completion) 的跨模态框架。它通过确定性投影 (deterministic projection) 将 3D 点与多视图 2D 特征对齐，并利用几何感知路由网络进行逐点自适应融合，以替代现有方法中缺乏几何一致性的学习注意力和固定融合。摘要在轻量设计下报告了有竞争力的性能与更好的结构完整性。
Motivation: 点云补全因局部观测的严重稀疏性和歧义而本质上是病态问题。现有多视图方法引入 2D 语义来缓解，但依赖学习式注意力和固定融合，缺乏几何一致性 (geometric consistency) 与适应性。
Method: 提出 Projective Guided View Attention 模块，通过显式投影对齐 3D 点与多视图特征，实现高效且几何一致的聚合；在此基础上构建几何感知路由网络 (geometry-aware routing network)，对结构特征与观测驱动特征进行逐点自适应融合，用于渐进式细化。
Result: 实验表明，在轻量设计 (lightweight design) 下，ProjFormer 取得有竞争力的性能，并改善了结构完整性 (structural completeness)。
Conclusion: 作者强调显式投影与自适应特征路由能够实现几何一致的 2D-3D 交互，为多视图点云补全提供了相比固定融合更可适应的方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Second-Order Policy Effects as State Transitions: A Source-Linked Benchmark for Policy Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Policy evaluation often estimates direct benefits and costs while treating the institutional environment as fixed. In practice, a policy changes the system it enters: actors adapt, enforcement capacity shifts, burdens move, and new equilibria form around capture, gaming, compliance theater, irreversibility, and repair costs. We formalize this as second-order policy-effect prediction and present a source-linked benchmark for policy simulation. The benchmark contains 96 named public-policy cases across eight domains and four balanced action classes: implement, modify, pilot, and block. Each case includes source locators and state variables for benefit, capture, gaming, burden shift, instability, uncertainty, irreversibility, distributional risk, and implementation capacity. The runner regenerates method outputs and aggregate results from the case table, and the simulator never reads the expert action target. We report a protocol-based transition-channel audit with recall, precision, F1-style efficiency, and selective top-channel stress diagnostics, so universal channel coverage is not mistaken for field validation. The side-effect simulator achieves mean policy-effect quality of 0.945, compared with 0.838 for the risk-register baseline and 0.879 for the causal-loop baseline. Its advantage is concentrated in side-effect recall and aggregate transition scoring; it does not dominate the best structured baselines on exact policy-action choice. The evidence remains benchmark-based, but supports a bounded claim: transition-state variables make policy simulators more sensitive to downstream institutional effects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出二阶政策效应预测 (second-order policy-effect prediction) 的框架，并发布一个带来源链接 (source-linked) 的政策模拟基准。基准包含 96 个公共政策案例、八个领域和四种动作类别，每个案例带有收益、俘获、博弈、负担转移、不可逆性等状态变量。摘要报告其副作用模拟器 (side-effect simulator) 的平均政策效应质量为 0.945，高于风险登记基线 (0.838) 和因果回路基线 (0.879)，但优势集中在副作用召回与聚合转移评分，而非精确政策动作选择。
Motivation: 传统政策评估在估计直接收益与成本时把制度环境视为固定，但实际政策会改变其进入的系统：行为者适应、执行能力变化、负担转移，并围绕俘获、博弈、合规表演、不可逆性与修复成本形成新均衡，现有方法难以捕捉这类下游制度效应。
Method: 将上述问题形式化为二阶政策效应预测，并构建包含 96 个已命名公共政策案例的来源链接基准；每个案例含来源定位符以及收益、俘获、博弈、负担转移、不稳定性、不确定性、不可逆性、分配风险和实施能力等状态变量。基准的 runner 从案例表再生方法输出与汇总结果，模拟器不读取专家动作目标；同时采用基于协议的转换通道审计 (protocol-based transition-channel audit)，用召回、精确率、F1 式效率与选择性顶部通道压力诊断来避免把通用通道覆盖误认为现场验证。
Result: 副作用模拟器取得 0.945 的平均政策效应质量，风险登记基线为 0.838，因果回路基线为 0.879；优势集中在副作用召回和聚合转移评分，并未在精确政策动作选择上超过最优结构化基线。
Conclusion: 摘要认为证据仍是基准层面的，但支持一个有界结论：转换状态变量 (transition-state variables) 使政策模拟器对下游制度效应更敏感。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MODAL: Multi-Modal Object Re-ID via Model-Driven Sparse Decoupling and Text-Image Differential Filtering
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal object re-identification (Re-ID) aims to facilitate cross-camera object retrieval in complex environments by leveraging complementary information from visual (e.g., RGB, NIR, TIR) and textual modalities. However, existing approaches often lack principled feature disentanglement and coherent multi-modal integration, leading to entangled representations that introduce cross-modal conflicts, obscure discriminative cues, and suffer distribution shift under modality-missing conditions. To tackle these challenges, we propose MODAL, a novel multi-modal object re-identification framework, grounded in coupled sparse coding theory and differential suppression principles. A core component of MODAL is a Multi-modal Feature Sparse Decoupling module, developed in a model-driven deep unrolling manner based on multi-modal coupled sparse coding. It explicitly decomposes multi-modal features into uni-modal specific, bi-modal and tri-modal shared representations, thereby achieving more transparent and effective feature disentanglement. Benefiting from the principled feature disentanglement, MODAL naturally mitigates performance degradation in incomplete-modality scenarios via a Modality-Aware Subspace Activation that selectively activates only the consistently shared subspaces. Moreover, we propose a Text-Image Differential Filtering module that leverages coarse-grained textual semantics to adaptively suppress task-irrelevant responses in the decoupled visual representations, thereby enhancing discriminative information. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that MODAL achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior transparency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MODAL，一个基于模型驱动的多模态目标重识别框架，利用耦合稀疏编码（coupled sparse coding）与差异抑制原则，将多模态特征显式解耦为单模态特有、双模态共享与三模态共享表示，并引入文本-图像差分过滤以增强判别信息。在四个数据集上的实验表明该方法达到 state-of-the-art 性能并具有更好的可解释性。
Motivation: 现有多模态目标重识别方法缺乏有原则的特征解耦与连贯的多模态融合，导致表征纠缠、跨模态冲突以及模态缺失场景下的分布偏移，影响判别力。
Method: 提出多模态特征稀疏解耦模块，以模型驱动的深度展开（deep unrolling）方式实现基于多模态耦合稀疏编码的解耦；通过模态感知子空间激活（Modality-Aware Subspace Activation）在模态不完整时只激活一致共享子空间，并用文本-图像差分过滤（Text-Image Differential Filtering）模块利用粗粒度文本语义抑制无关视觉响应。
Result: 在四个数据集上的广泛实验表明，MODAL 取得了 state-of-the-art 性能，且具有更优的透明性。
Conclusion: 作者强调基于耦合稀疏编码的原则化特征解耦能自然缓解不完整模态下的性能退化，并提升多模态重识别的可解释性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.motivation: 现有多模态目标重识别方法缺乏有原则的特征解耦与连贯的多模态融合，导致表征纠缠、跨模态冲突以及模态缺失场景下的分布偏移，影响判别力。

summary_sections.result: 在四个数据集上的广泛实验表明，MODAL 取得了 state-of-the-art 性能，且具有更优的透明性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调基于耦合稀疏编码的原则化特征解耦能自然缓解不完整模态下的性能退化，并提升多模态重识别的可解释性。

papers.title: Validation-Frontier Representation Selection under Constrained Observation
papers.abstract_en: AI systems deployed outside clean benchmark settings often rely on observations that are incomplete, unstable, costly, or degraded by monitoring failures. This paper studies representation selection under constrained observation: choosing a state representation when raw accuracy is not the only operational criterion. We propose a validation-frontier selector that combines balanced accuracy with penalties for feature cost, overfit gap, and validation-test instability. In a focused public-tabular benchmark using three scikit-learn datasets, five observation regimes, 45 matched task cells, 720 candidate actions, and 405 representation rows, the adaptive selector improves frontier score over full trace features by 0.025801 while reducing mean feature count by 22.733. Balanced-accuracy difference is small and not statistically significant. A broader offline stress test gives mixed results. The supported claim is therefore bounded: adaptive representation selection can improve a constrained-observation robustness-efficiency frontier in matched benchmark settings, but does not universally dominate trace baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在受约束观测下（观测不完整、不稳定、昂贵或监测退化）如何选择状态表示，提出一种验证前沿（validation-frontier）选择器，将平衡准确率与特征成本、过拟合差距、验证-测试不稳定性惩罚相结合。在基于 scikit-learn 三个数据集的公开表格基准上，经过五种观测设置、45 个匹配任务单元、720 个候选动作和 405 个表示行，该自适应选择器将前沿分数相对全迹特征提升 0.025801，同时平均特征数减少 22.733，而平衡准确率差异很小且不显著。更广泛的离线压力测试结果好坏参半，因此作者明确限定其结论：自适应表示选择能在匹配基准设置中改善受约束观测下的鲁棒性-效率前沿，但并不能普遍优于迹基线。
Motivation: 部署于干净基准环境之外的 AI 系统经常面对不完整、不稳定、昂贵或因监控失效而退化的观测，此时原始准确率不是唯一运行标准，需要研究如何在约束观测下选择状态表示。
Method: 提出验证前沿选择器（validation-frontier selector），以平衡准确率（balanced accuracy）为主目标，并加入对特征成本（feature cost）、过拟合差距（overfit gap）和验证-测试不稳定性（validation-test instability）的惩罚项，用于在候选表示中做出自适应选择。
Result: 在聚焦的公开表格基准（三个 scikit-learn 数据集、五种观测机制、45 个匹配任务单元、720 个候选动作、405 个表示行）中，自适应选择器相比全迹特征将前沿分数提升 0.025801，平均特征数减少 22.733；平衡准确率差异小且无统计显著性，更广泛的离线压力测试给出混合结果。
Conclusion: 作者明确限定：自适应表示选择可在匹配基准设置下改善受约束观测的鲁棒性-效率前沿，但不具有对迹基线的普遍支配性，适用范围有限。

papers.title: WeSCE: A Benchmark for Measuring Security Drift in LLM-Driven Code Editing
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we introduce WeSCE, a benchmark for quantifying security drift in code editing under weak-security constraints, where tasks specify only functional objectives without explicit security requirements. WeSCE consists of 400 executable programs derived from real-world code, covering feature addition, feature removal, bug fixing, and refactoring. To quantify security drift, we propose a continuous risk representation that aggregates heterogeneous vulnerability signals through a unified formulation, and define drift measures capturing changes in overall risk, worst-case severity, and vulnerability distribution under code transformations, providing a multi-scale view of security spanning average-case behavior to worst-case emphasis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WeSCE，一个用于量化大语言模型代码编辑中安全漂移 (security drift) 的基准。基准包含 400 个源自真实世界代码的可执行程序，覆盖功能新增、功能删除、缺陷修复和重构四类编辑任务，且任务只给出功能目标、不附带显式安全要求。作者提出一种统一的连续风险表示来聚合异构漏洞信号，并定义了总体风险、最坏情况严重性和漏洞分布三种漂移度量。
Motivation: 现有代码编辑基准在弱安全约束下主要评估功能正确性，缺乏对编辑前后安全隐患变化的量化手段；由于任务不附带显式安全要求，模型可能在满足功能目标的同时引入安全回归，因此需要专门的基准和度量。
Method: 构建 WeSCE 基准：从真实代码派生 400 个可执行程序，按功能新增、功能删除、缺陷修复和重构四类编辑任务组织；提出统一公式化的连续风险表示以聚合异构漏洞信号，并基于该表示定义漂移度量，分别刻画整体风险变化、最坏情况严重性变化和漏洞分布变化。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值；本文的主要交付物是包含 400 个程序的基准，以及用于多尺度刻画安全漂移的风险表示和度量方法。
Conclusion: 作者将 WeSCE 定位为在无显式安全约束的功能驱动代码编辑场景中度量安全漂移的工具，其多尺度视角同时覆盖平均情况风险与最坏情况风险。

papers.title: Distribution-free false-alarm calibration and chance-corrected spatial evaluation for industrial anomaly detection
papers.abstract_en: Studies of industrial visual inspection commonly report the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and the overlap between anomaly maps and defect masks. Neither measure specifies the false-alarm rate at a selected threshold, while recurrent defect locations and mask geometry can inflate overlap. We combine a distribution-free upper tolerance threshold with a paired-minus-crossed spatial test. This test compares each detector's score-contributing locations with the matched defect mask and with masks from other images; the difference in rates defines spatial-evidence lift relative to the empirical chance-overlap rate. We evaluate three detectors on 120 point-defect images from three ISP-AD modalities and three fixed data splits. Of 378 alarms, 230 overlap the matched mask. Paired and crossed rates are nevertheless similar in eight of nine detector--modality cells; only DINOv2--ASM has a positive 95\% bootstrap lower bound (lift 0.259, 95\% interval 0.159--0.347). On the independent Magnetic Tile Defect dataset, the same analysis gives lifts of 0.203 (0.169--0.236) for Wide ResNet-50 (WRN50) patch memory and 0.231 (0.202--0.262) for Vision Transformer B/16 (ViT-B/16) patch memory, with one-sided permutation $p=10^{-5}$ for both. When crossed masks are restricted to the same defect class, the lifts remain 0.185 and 0.210. Exact sample planning shows that, with 150 calibration normals, a 95\%-confidence distribution-free claim is supported only for target false-positive rates of 1.98\% or higher; a 1\% target requires at least 299 normals. The results support reporting operating-point performance and chance-corrected spatial evidence alongside AUROC and raw mask overlap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业视觉检测中的评估指标缺陷，提出一种无分布假设的误报校准方法（distribution-free upper tolerance threshold）与配对减交叉空间检验（paired-minus-crossed spatial test）。该方法在三分支 ISP-AD 数据集的 120 张点缺陷图像上评估了三个检测器，并在 Magnetic Tile Defect 数据集上独立验证，报告了空间证据提升（spatial-evidence lift）及其置信区间，同时给出精确样本规划以支持指定目标误报率下的置信声明。
Motivation: AUROC 和异常图与缺陷掩码的重叠度无法说明选定阈值下的误报率，且重复出现的缺陷位置和掩码几何形状可能虚增重叠度，从而误导对检测器空间定位能力的判断。
Method: 将无分布假设的上容忍阈值与配对减交叉空间检验结合：比较每个检测器得分贡献位置与匹配缺陷掩码及其他图像掩码的重叠率，二者之差定义为相对经验随机重叠率的空间证据提升；并用精确样本规划确定校准所需正常样本数。
Result: 378 个报警中有 230 个与匹配掩码重叠，但九个检测器-模态组合中有八个的配对率与交叉率相近，仅 DINOv2-ASM 有正的 95% 自助法下界（提升 0.259，区间 0.159–0.347）；在 Magnetic Tile Defect 上，WRN50 提升 0.203（0.169–0.236），ViT-B/16 提升 0.231（0.202–0.262），单侧置换 p=1e-5；限定同类缺陷的交叉掩码后提升仍为 0.185 和 0.210。样本规划显示，150 个校准正常样本仅在目标假阳性率不低于 1.98% 时支持 95% 置信的无分布声明，1% 目标至少需要 299 个正常样本。
Conclusion: 作者主张在报告 AUROC 和原始掩码重叠之外，还应报告工作点（operating point）性能与机会校正后的空间证据，以更可靠地评估工业异常检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents can fail even when their underlying models can solve the constituent steps. They may lose track of mutable state, fail to reactivate lessons from earlier executions, skip known procedures, or stop prematurely. We bet on harness scaling to improve the execution system around an agent without changing its model weights. We introduce StateM, an agent-native runtime that organizes execution around durable states, phase-local context, checked transitions, recoverable runbooks, and versioned procedural practices that agents and users can inspect together. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, StateM raises GPT-5.5 xhigh to 92.1\%, versus 83.1\% reference and GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra at 91.9\%. The runbook transfers unchanged to GPT-5.6. With GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh, StateM reaches 95.3\% raw accuracy across 445 trials and succeeds on all 89 tasks at least once. The frozen profile raises GPT-5.6 Luna from 76.7 to 85.4\%, above the 84.9\% Sol xhigh reference. Using the same runtime, runbook structure, and golden rules, less than \$38 of adaptation raises DeepSeek-V4 Flash from 82.7 to 88.1\% under standard timeouts and to 89.1\% on an 88-task common core. Extending only the remaining latency-sensitive task matches the reported 88.8\% GPT-5.6 Sol max result. Final-score API usage is about \$15 versus \$574.68 for the GPT reference; total DeepSeek expenditure is \$52.22. On BusinessBench, family-specific runbooks built on development sets yield held-out gains of 0.55 macro and 1.34 micro points; two mechanism-matched families improve by 10.04 points. Concrete rules generalize when tasks share execution structure, while the control methodology applies broadly. StateM turns selected postmortem findings into persistent, executable preconditions and practices, making learned controls explicit and enforceable through stateful controls. Code at github.com/henryqin1997/statem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StateM，一个面向智能体的运行时系统，通过不改变模型权重的方式改进长程任务的执行质量。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，StateM 将 GPT-5.5 xhigh 从参考值 83.1% 提升到 92.1%，并在 GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh 下达到 445 次试验中 95.3% 的原始准确率，且全部 89 个任务至少成功一次。runbook 可无修改迁移到其他模型，且最终评分的 API 花费约为 15 美元，远低于参考方案的 574.68 美元。
Motivation: 长程智能体即使底层模型能解决各子步骤，仍可能因丢失可变状态、未能复用先前执行经验、跳过已知流程或过早停止而失败。论文主张通过 harness scaling 改进执行系统本身，而不是替换或微调模型权重。
Method: StateM 是一种 agent-native 运行时，围绕持久状态 (durable states)、阶段局部上下文 (phase-local context)、受检转换 (checked transitions)、可恢复 runbook (recoverable runbooks) 和版本化的程序化实践来组织执行，智能体与用户可共同检查。runbook 可在不同模型间直接迁移，并通过有状态的控制将选定的事后分析 (postmortem) 发现转化为持久的可执行前置条件和实践。
Result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，StateM 将 GPT-5.5 xhigh 提升至 92.1%（参考值 83.1%），GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra 为 91.9%；GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh 达到 95.3% 原始准确率并成功完成全部 89 个任务。冻结配置文件将 GPT-5.6 Luna 从 76.7% 提升到 85.4%，高于 Sol xhigh 参考值 84.9%；DeepSeek-V4 Flash 以不到 38 美元的适配成本从 82.7% 提升到 88.1%（88 任务核心上为 89.1%）。最终评分 API 花费约 15 美元，总 DeepSeek 花费为 52.22 美元；在 BusinessBench 上，基于开发集构建的家族专属 runbook 带来 0.55 macro 和 1.34 micro 的留出收益，两个机制匹配的家族提升 10.04 点。
Conclusion: runbook 可无修改迁移到 GPT-5.6，说明当任务共享执行结构时具体规则能够泛化，而控制方法本身具有广泛适用性。论文强调 StateM 能把选定的事后分析结论转化为显式、可执行的持久控制，使学习到的控制策略可被检查和强制实施。

summary_sections.motivation: 长程智能体即使底层模型能解决各子步骤，仍可能因丢失可变状态、未能复用先前执行经验、跳过已知流程或过早停止而失败。论文主张通过 harness scaling 改进执行系统本身，而不是替换或微调模型权重。
summary_sections.method: StateM 是一种 agent-native 运行时，围绕持久状态 (durable states)、阶段局部上下文 (phase-local context)、受检转换 (checked transitions)、可恢复 runbook (recoverable runbooks) 和版本化的程序化实践来组织执行，智能体与用户可共同检查。runbook 可在不同模型间直接迁移，并通过有状态的控制将选定的事后分析 (postmortem) 发现转化为持久的可执行前置条件和实践。
summary_sections.result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，StateM 将 GPT-5.5 xhigh 提升至 92.1%（参考值 83.1%），GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra 为 91.9%；GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh 达到 95.3% 原始准确率并成功完成全部 89 个任务。冻结配置文件将 GPT-5.6 Luna 从 76.7% 提升到 85.4%，高于 Sol xhigh 参考值 84.9%；DeepSeek-V4 Flash 以不到 38 美元的适配成本从 82.7% 提升到 88.1%（88 任务核心上为 89.1%）。最终评分 API 花费约 15 美元，总 DeepSeek 花费为 52.22 美元；在 BusinessBench 上，基于开发集构建的家族专属 runbook 带来 0.55 macro 和 1.34 micro 的留出收益，两个机制匹配的家族提升 10.04 点。

papers.title: Max-Q Selective Imitation for Human-in-the-Loop Online Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Human-in-the-loop (HIL) online reinforcement learning for real robots must absorb human interventions quickly while continuing to improve beyond the human prior. We present a training method for this setting based on two components. First, an \emph{MC Q-chunk} critic regresses chunk-level action values onto Monte Carlo returns from the replay buffer, performing sample-average (behavior) policy evaluation so that intervention trajectories are credited directly rather than diluted by current-policy TD backups. Second, \emph{max-Q selective imitation} updates the actor by imitating, at each state, the higher-$Q$ action between the current policy action and a buffer sample under a hard winner-take-all rule. This rule automatically switches between learning from interventions and on-policy self-improvement: when the autonomous policy is stronger, targets align with the policy distribution, reducing the policy--target-sample gap that otherwise induces execution-time distribution shift. In practice we score candidates with a standard critic ensemble mean to reduce comparison noise, without softening targets or introducing score-gap thresholds. On a real USB pick-and-insertion task with 20 demonstrations, ACT QChunk-MCBC attains 99\% success within 30 minutes of HIL training, whereas HIL-SERL requires about 5 hours to converge. In simulation on Peg Insertion and Square, ACT/Flow Q-chunk variants similarly reach $\ge$96\% success within roughly half an hour of effective training, outperforming HIL-SERL, EXPO, and E2HiL on the success--time frontier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人在环路（HIL）真实机器人在线强化学习提出一种训练方法，由MC Q-chunk critic和max-Q选择性模仿两部分组成。摘要报告在真实USB插拔任务和仿真Peg Insertion/Square上，该方法能在半小时内达到高成功率，显著快于HIL-SERL等基线，并强调其自动在干预学习与策略自改进之间切换，减少执行时分布偏移。
Motivation: HIL在线强化学习需要快速吸收人类干预，同时继续超越人类先验，但现有方法中干预轨迹容易被当前策略的TD备份稀释，且策略与目标样本分布不一致会导致执行时分布偏移。
Method: 提出两个组件：MC Q-chunk critic用蒙特卡洛回报对块级动作值做回归，进行样本平均（行为策略）评估，从而直接对干预轨迹赋信；max-Q选择性模仿在每状态下以硬赢家通吃规则比较当前策略动作与缓冲样本的Q值，选择较高Q动作来更新actor。实际评分采用标准critic集成均值以降低比较噪声，但不软化目标或引入分数差阈值。
Result: 在真实USB插拔任务（20个演示）上，ACT QChunk-MCBC在30分钟HIL训练内达到99%成功率，而HIL-SERL约需5小时收敛；在仿真Peg Insertion和Square上，ACT/Flow Q-chunk变体在约半小时有效训练内达到≥96%成功率，在成功率-时间前沿上优于HIL-SERL、EXPO和E2HiL。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过自动切换干预学习与自改进来快速吸收人类反馈并继续提升，且能减少策略与目标样本间的分布偏移；未提及明显局限性。

papers.title: GATTA: Graph Active Learning with Test-Time Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Test-time augmentation (TTA) has proven effective for improving model robustness and uncertainty estimation in computer vision, yet its application to graph-structured data remains largely unexplored. We introduce GATTA (Graph Active Learning with Test-Time Augmentation), a framework for enhancing active learning by aggregating predictions across multiple augmented views to produce more reliable uncertainty estimates. To address the challenge of label-preserving graph augmentations, GATTA incorporates a consistency-based filtering mechanism that discards augmented views yielding unreliable predictions. We systematically evaluate GATTA across multiple graph datasets, GNN architectures, and acquisition strategies. Our results show that simple uncertainty-based methods, such as Entropy and Least Confidence, benefit most from TTA, achieving performance competitive with more sophisticated and computationally expensive approaches. GATTA generalizes across architectures, outperforms model-side ensemble methods such as MC Dropout. We further show that GATTA scales efficiently with both ensemble size and graph size. Extensive analysis of augmentation types, strengths, and filtering strategies provides practical guidelines for effective deployment. Our findings demonstrate that augmenting simple methods with TTA offers a more efficient path to strong active learning performance than engineering complex acquisition functions, enabling practitioners to achieve competitive results with lower computational overhead and reduced implementation complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GATTA（Graph Active Learning with Test-Time Augmentation），将测试时增强（TTA）引入图数据的主动学习，通过聚合多个增强视图的预测得到更可靠的不确定性估计，并利用一致性过滤机制丢弃不可靠的增强视图。系统评估表明，Entropy、Least Confidence 这类简单不确定性方法从 TTA 中获益最多，能够达到与更复杂昂贵方法相当的性能，并优于 MC Dropout 等模型侧集成方法。
Motivation: TTA 在计算机视觉中已证明能提升模型鲁棒性和不确定性估计，但它在图结构数据上的应用几乎未被探索；同时图上的标签保持增强（label-preserving augmentation）具有较大挑战。
Method: 提出 GATTA 框架，聚合多个增强视图的预测以产生更可靠的不确定性估计；为应对标签保持图增强的困难，引入基于一致性的过滤机制，丢弃产生不可靠预测的增强视图。
Result: 在多个图数据集、GNN 架构和获取策略上的实验显示，Entropy 和 Least Confidence 这类简单不确定性方法从 TTA 中获益最大，性能与更复杂且计算更昂贵的方法相当；GATTA 可跨架构泛化，优于 MC Dropout，并随集成规模与图规模高效扩展。
Conclusion: 作者认为用 TTA 增强简单方法比设计复杂获取函数更高效，能以更低计算开销和更简单的实现获得强主动学习性能；对增强类型、强度和过滤策略的深入分析提供了实际部署指南。

papers.title: Beyond Thresholds: A Quality-Aware Decision Intelligence Framework for Cold Chain IoT Systems
papers.abstract_en: Cold chain logistics has advanced technologically, yet most deployed systems remain reactive monitors, not decision-making agents: thresholds trigger alerts, but nothing relates violations to cumulative product degradation or converts degradation signals into logistics decisions. We address this gap with a Quality-Aware Decision Intelligence (QADI) framework combining three capabilities: a structured quality state representation, $S_q = [L, Q, U, R]$ -- remaining shelf life, degradation rate, estimation uncertainty, and operational risk, all derived and computable from the framework equations; a hybrid quality modeling layer combining physics-based microbial kinetics with a data-driven correction term; and a reasoning layer built on Microsoft Phi-4~\cite{Phi4} with retrieval-augmented generation over a structured domain knowledge base. We benchmark against five baselines -- threshold monitoring, physics-only, physics-plus-noise, optimisation-based decisions, and a rule-based expert system -- across eight cold chain scenarios, using pasteurised milk as the primary case, with ground truth shelf-life drawn from published dairy studies~\cite{Singh1994, Smigic2015} independent of our model. Comparisons use Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction. Across milk and broccoli scenarios, the framework attains mean absolute shelf-life error of 7.2 hours (versus 30.9 hours, physics-only; $p<0.001$), spoilage rate of 14.5% (versus 16.6%, physics-only and rule-based; p=0.08), and oracle-optimal decisions in 99.5% of scenarios. Removing the LLM reasoning component drops optimality to 45.5% ($p<0.001$). Expert-rated explanation quality reaches 83% ($κ= 0.71$). Ablations show hybrid modeling and LLM reasoning contribute distinct gains, while RAG retrieval mainly drives explanation quality. Code: https://bit.ly/4d6t44C.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对冷链物流系统仍停留在阈值告警而非决策智能的现状，提出一种质量感知决策智能（QADI）框架。该框架结合结构化质量状态表示 S_q = [L, Q, U, R]（剩余货架期、退化速率、估计不确定性与运营风险）、融合物理微生物动力学与数据驱动修正项的混合质量建模层，以及基于 Microsoft Phi-4 与检索增强生成（RAG）的推理层。在牛奶与西兰花等八类冷链场景中，QADI 将平均绝对货架期误差降至 7.2 小时，并在 99.5% 的场景中达到 oracle 最优决策。
Motivation: 冷链物流虽已技术升级，但多数部署系统仍是反应式监控器而非决策智能体：阈值触发告警，却无法把违规与累积产品质量退化关联起来，也不能将退化信号转化为具体的物流决策。
Method: 提出 QADI 框架，包含三个能力模块：由框架方程导出且可计算的结构化质量状态表示；结合基于物理的微生物动力学与数据驱动修正项的混合质量建模；以及基于 Microsoft Phi-4、通过 RAG 访问结构化领域知识库的推理层。
Result: 在八个冷链场景中以巴氏杀菌奶为主要案例，对比五个基线（阈值监控、纯物理、物理加噪声、基于优化的决策、规则专家系统）。框架达到平均绝对货架期误差 7.2 小时（纯物理为 30.9 小时，p<0.001）、腐败率 14.5%（纯物理与规则系统为 16.6%，p=0.08）、99.5% 场景的 oracle 最优决策；移除 LLM 推理组件后最优率降至 45.5%（p<0.001）。专家评分的解释质量达 83%（κ=0.71），消融显示混合建模与 LLM 推理贡献不同增益，RAG 主要驱动解释质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架将冷链系统从反应式监控转变为决策智能体，混合建模与 LLM 推理各自带来独立收益，而 RAG 检索主要改善解释质量而非决策性能。实验基于外部发表的乳制品研究作为货架期真值，并以牛奶和西兰花场景为验证范围。

papers.title: SA-GEM: Scale-Adaptive and Geospatial Evidence-Modulated Token Pruning for Efficient Remote Sensing Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: RS-LVLMs have advanced multimodal understanding of Earth observation imagery, yet their performance is fundamentally constrained by high-resolution processing, as visual token counts grow quadratically with linear input resolution while important visual evidence is inherently sparse and increasingly diluted across the expanded sequence. Existing token pruning methods largely rely on scale-agnostic resolution policies and isolated importance cues, limiting task-aligned granularity adaptation and holistic evidence preservation. To address this, we present Scale-Adaptive and Geospatial Evidence-Modulated Token Pruning (SA-GEM), a plug-and-play framework that unifies task-adaptive token granularity allocation with holistic geospatial token importance modulation. Specifically, a lightweight router selects the resolution based on query-dependent token granularity, while a token importance modulator jointly models task relevance, spatial structure, and local redundancy to preserve holistic geospatial evidence. We show that higher resolution is not universally beneficial and, once sufficient granularity is reached, token quality matters more than token quantity. Experiments across various benchmarks demonstrate that SA-GEM achieves consistent gains in both accuracy and efficiency over existing pruning methods. On XLRS-Bench, it surpasses GeoLLaVA-8K by 2.3% in accuracy with a 2.4 times total inference speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SA-GEM，一个即插即用的令牌剪枝框架，用于提升遥感大视觉语言模型（RS-LVLM）在高分辨率输入下的效率。该框架通过轻量路由网络按查询自适应选择分辨率，并用令牌重要性调制器联合建模任务相关性、空间结构和局部冗余，以保留整体地理空间证据。实验表明其在准确率和效率上均优于现有剪枝方法，例如在 XLRS-Bench 上相比 GeoLLaVA-8K 提升 2.3% 准确率并实现 2.4 倍总推理加速。
Motivation: RS-LVLM 的性能受限于高分辨率处理，因为视觉令牌数量随输入分辨率平方增长，而重要的视觉证据本身稀疏且被稀释；现有令牌剪枝方法多依赖与尺度无关的分辨率策略和孤立的显著性线索，缺乏任务对齐的粒度自适应与整体证据保持。
Method: 提出 SA-GEM 框架，包含两大部分：一个轻量路由模块根据查询依赖的令牌粒度选择输入分辨率；一个令牌重要性调制模块同时建模任务相关性、空间结构和局部冗余，实现整体地理空间证据的保持。

papers.title: Evo-Harness: Context-to-Harness Skill Compilation for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.abstract_en: Learning from experience is critical for developing capable, self-improving large language model (LLM) agents. Existing methods typically extract knowledge from accumulated trajectories via reflection, memory, rules, or skills. However, agents in realistic environments continuously encounter novel tasks, often offering only a one-shot opportunity to improve. These executions yield rich but highly noisy contexts, entangling broadly useful lessons with task-specific artifacts. Critically, prior works rarely validate their effectiveness on complex real-world tasks or isolate the underlying drivers of improvement. To address these gaps, we formulate online harness learning, where a frozen agent improves by continually updating a structured harness across sequential tasks. This formulation enables a systematic study of key self-improvement factors through our proposed Evo-Harness. At its core, context-to-harness skill compilation distills noisy, single-shot executions into reusable skill harnesses for cross-domain and topic-level adaptation. To demonstrate the efficacy of one-shot skill compilation, we evaluate across five realistic benchmarks (TerminalBench2, SWE-bench, CL-Bench, -bench, WebArena-Infinity). Our extensive analysis demonstrates the effectiveness of Evo-Harness and provides a principled understanding of how LLM agents can effectively learn on the fly. Our code is available at https://github.com/A-EVO-Lab/a-evolve/tree/release/evo-harness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Evo-Harness，一个用于自进化 LLM agent 的在线 harness 学习框架。核心是将嘈杂的单次执行上下文蒸馏为可复用的技能 harness，支持跨领域和主题级适配，并在五个真实基准上验证了单次技能编译的有效性。
Motivation: 现有 agent 从轨迹中提取知识的方法（反思、记忆、规则、技能）很少在复杂真实任务上验证，且未隔离改进的驱动因素；现实环境常只提供一次执行机会，而执行上下文嘈杂，混杂了通用经验与任务特有细节。
Method: 形式化在线 harness 学习，冻结的 agent 通过持续更新结构化 harness 来跨顺序任务改进；提出 context-to-harness skill compilation，将嘈杂的单次执行蒸馏为可复用技能 harness，以支持跨领域与主题级适配。
Result: 在 TerminalBench2、SWE-bench、CL-Bench、-bench、WebArena-Infinity 五个真实基准上评估，结果表明 Evo-Harness 有效，并提供了对 LLM agent 在线学习机制的 principled 理解。
Conclusion: 摘要强调单次技能编译的有效性，并说明该框架有助于系统地理解 agent 如何即时学习；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Funnel of Thoughts: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Early Voting and Rollout Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models produce diverse, sometimes inconsistent answers across repeated queries on the same problem, so multi-sample inference is a prerequisite for reliable deployment. Majority voting at k rollouts is the standard solution and the de facto accuracy target for this regime, but it is prohibitively expensive at the scale LRMs require. We introduce Funnel of Thoughts (FoT), an inference-time method that preserves the full 32-trajectory voted accuracy while halving its attention FLOPs, a 28.8% reduction in full-model inference cost. Across 115K reasoning trajectories from six LRMs, we find that unproductive trajectories often reveal themselves through repeated hesitation markers such as "Wait", "Actually", and "perhaps." These trajectories are less likely to reach the correct answer and consume disproportionate attention FLOPs, degenerating into no-answer loops in the worst case. Built on this training-free lexical signal, FoT identifies the vocabulary that captures these pathological patterns and prunes affected trajectories before completion, reducing online generation attention FLOPs by 56.1% and wall time by 37.6% without any additional model inference; the same signal transfers without retuning across held-out architectures and out-of-domain tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型推理模型 (LRM) 在多采样推理场景下多数投票成本过高的问题，提出 Funnel of Thoughts (FoT)：利用训练无关的词汇信号（如 "Wait"、"Actually"、"perhaps" 等犹豫标记）在轨迹完成前剪枝低效推理路径。摘要报告该方法在 115K 条来自六个 LRM 的推理轨迹上，保持完整 32 轨迹投票准确率的同时将注意力 FLOPs 减半，并将在线生成的注意力 FLOPs 降低 56.1%、墙钟时间降低 37.6%，且无需额外模型推理。
Motivation: LRM 对同一问题多次采样时答案常不一致，因此多采样推理是可靠部署的前提；但 k 个 rollout 的多数投票在 LRM 所需规模下成本过高，成为实际应用的瓶颈。
Method: FoT 是一种推理时方法，基于训练无关的词汇信号识别包含犹豫标记的低产轨迹，在轨迹完成前将其剪枝，从而在不引入额外模型推理的情况下降低生成开销。
Result: 摘要报告 FoT 在保留完整 32 轨迹投票准确率的同时将注意力 FLOPs 减半，全模型推理成本降低 28.8%；在线生成注意力 FLOPs 减少 56.1%，墙钟时间减少 37.6%，且该信号无需重新调参即可迁移到未见过的架构和域外任务上。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过早期投票与 rollout 剪枝可以在不损失投票准确率的前提下显著降低 LRM 推理成本，且剪枝信号具备跨架构与跨任务的泛化能力。

papers.title: LongDocBench: Benchmarking TOC Hierarchy and Contextual Relationship Recovery in Long Documents
papers.abstract_en: Parsing visual documents into machine-readable representations is fundamental to document intelligence. Existing benchmarks focus on page-level element recognition, reading order, formula recognition, and table structure. Long documents, however, also require document-level structure recovery. This includes reconstructing cross-page table-of-contents (TOC) hierarchies and identifying typed links from tables and figures to their captions, notes, and sources, often in one-to-many form. Because these structures are covered only partially or subsumed within broader parsing protocols, existing benchmarks cannot directly evaluate two key document-level tasks: \emph{Table-of-Contents Hierarchy Recovery} and \emph{Contextual Relationship Recovery}. To benchmark these two tasks, we introduce \textsc{LongDocBench}, comprising 85 real-world financial reports, textbooks, and academic papers spanning 2,582 pages, with up to 105 pages per document. It provides human-verified annotations for 3,937 heading nodes (mean node depth 3.55; maximum depth 9) and 3,258 contextual relationships annotated across 2,680 table and figure objects. We further evaluate both the downstream utility and recoverability of these structures. Long-document question-answering experiments show that human-verified TOC hierarchies and contextual relationships improve reasoning, with their combination providing complementary benefits. Meanwhile, representative document parsers remain limited on both recovery tasks despite strong page-level performance. To support further progress, we publicly release \textsc{LongDocBench} and its evaluation protocol and reproducible testbed for advancing document-level structure recovery in long documents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LongDocBench，一个面向长文档文档级结构恢复的基准，包含 85 篇真实财报、教科书和学术论文，共 2,582 页。基准标注了 3,937 个标题节点（平均深度 3.55）和 3,258 个上下文关系（跨 2,680 个表格与图形对象），用于评估目录层级恢复与上下文关系恢复两项任务。作者通过长文档 QA 实验表明人工验证的注释能提升推理，并发现现有文档解析器在两项任务上表现有限。
Motivation: 现有文档解析基准主要评估页面级元素识别、阅读顺序、公式和表格结构，缺乏对跨页目录层级以及表格/图形到标题、注释、来源之间（常为一对多）链接的文档级结构恢复评估。这些结构在现有协议中仅被部分覆盖，因此无法直接评估文档级的两个关键任务。
Method: 构建 LongDocBench 基准，包含 85 个真实文档、2,582 页，提供人工验证的 3,937 个标题节点和 3,258 个上下文关系注释，并公开评估协议与可复现测试平台。同时设计实验验证这些结构在长文档问答中的下游效用及其可恢复性。
Result: 长文档问答实验显示，人工验证的 TOC 层级和上下文关系能改善推理效果，且两者组合提供互补收益；代表性文档解析器尽管页面级性能较强，在两个恢复任务上仍表现有限。
Conclusion: 作者公开发布 LongDocBench 及其评估协议和可复现测试平台，以推动长文档文档级结构恢复研究的进展。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RecurrentGPT: Expressive Depth through Recurrent Modulation in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Scaling transformer language models creates an inherent tension between expressivity and memory efficiency. While unique weights across layers preserve functional specialization---from input-grounding to abstract refinement---they incur a substantial memory footprint. Conversely, standard depth-sharing enforces uniform transformations that collapse representational diversity and degrade modeling quality. We introduce RecurrentGPT, a recurrent depth transformer where fixed-depth prelude and coda blocks bracket a single shared core iterated R times. Inspired by gated recurrent neural networks, we employ a lightweight projection and an elementwise update gate---conditioned on the hidden state, the fixed prelude output, and noise resampled at every step---to modulate the recurrent update. This allows the model to specialize the input to the same few layers across recurrences, rather than requiring many unique layers to achieve functional diversity. Under an isoFLOPS constraint, a 3-layer RecurrentGPT matches the accuracy of a 12-layer GPT-2 Small baseline with similar training and inference FLOPs, and leads MoR and heavy-tail depth sampling in all nine scale-by-budget cells; at medium and large scale it approaches dense quality at the standard token budget and overtakes it at medium scale once that budget is doubled. Under an isoPARAMS constraint, deeper recurrence achieves a 2.76 validation loss versus 2.84 for a non-recurrent counterpart at matched parameter and data budget. Our results demonstrate that adaptive depth reuse is a principled strategy for trading parameters for quality: at large scale, 63% fewer parameters and 59% less peak decoding memory for a 10% increase in compiled generation latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RecurrentGPT，一种循环深度 Transformer：固定深度的 prelude 与 coda 块之间共享一个核心块并迭代 R 次，借助受门控 RNN 启发的轻量投影与逐元素更新门来调制循环更新。作者报告，在 isoFLOPS 约束下 3 层 RecurrentGPT 匹配 12 层 GPT-2 Small 的精度；在 isoPARAMS 约束下更深循环取得更低验证损失，且大尺度下用更少参数和更少峰值解码内存换取少量生成延迟增加。
Motivation: 扩展 Transformer 语言模型时，逐层独立权重能保留从输入接地到抽象精修的功能专门化，但内存开销大；标准深度共享又强制均匀变换，损失表征多样性并降低建模质量。
Method: 将固定深度的 prelude 和 coda 块包围单个共享核心块，核心块迭代 R 次；更新门以隐藏状态、固定 prelude 输出和每步重采样的噪声为条件，通过轻量投影与逐元素门控调制循环更新，使相同少数层能在多次循环中实现输入专门化。
Result: 在 isoFLOPS 约束下，3 层 RecurrentGPT 匹配 12 层 GPT-2 Small 基线的精度，并在全部九个 scale-by-budget 单元中优于 MoR 与 heavy-tail depth sampling；中等规模在标准 token 预算接近 dense 质量，双倍预算时超越。isoPARAMS 约束下，更深循环验证损失为 2.76，而非循环对照为 2.84；大尺度下用 63% 更少参数和 59% 更少峰值解码内存，换来 10% 的编译生成延迟增加。
Conclusion: 自适应深度复用 (adaptive depth reuse) 是一种以参数换质量的原则性策略，摘要强调该方法在参数与内存效率上相对非循环深度共享方案的收益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Visual Grounding Decoders Need Feed-Forward Networks? A Controlled Study over Frozen Vision-Language Features
papers.abstract_en: Do feed-forward networks (FFNs) in visual grounding decoders add essential computation once a pretrained vision-language model has already encoded image and language context? We compare a four-block attention-only decoder (A4), a matched four-block attention-plus-FFN decoder (S4), and an eight-block attention-only parameter control (A8) over frozen VLM features. A4 matches or slightly exceeds S4 on RefCOCOg and Ref-Adv-s. FineCops-Ref reveals a small A4 deficit of 0.52 percentage points at IoU@0.5 (95% CI [0.12, 0.95] in favor of S4), but A8 recovers it and finishes 0.26 points above S4. Official FineCops levels do not show a monotonic increase in the gap. A4 reduces trainable decoder parameters by 44.4% and cached-decoder latency by 10.1%, although end-to-end latency remains backbone-dominated. These results concern the trainable grounding decoder, not a complete attention-only VLM.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在冻结的视觉-语言模型（VLM）特征之上，视觉定位解码器中的前馈网络（FFN）是否仍然必要。作者比较了四块注意力-only解码器（A4）、匹配的四块注意力+FFN解码器（S4）以及八块注意力-only参数对照（A8）。结果表明A4在RefCOCOg和Ref-Adv-s上匹配或略超S4，在FineCops-Ref上A4出现0.52个百分点的小幅差距（IoU@0.5，95% CI [0.12, 0.95] 偏向S4），但A8能恢复并超过S4 0.26个百分点。A4减少了44.4%的可训练解码器参数和10.1%的缓存解码器延迟，但端到端延迟仍由主干网络主导。
Motivation: 一旦预训练的VLM已经编码了图像和语言上下文，视觉定位解码器中的FFN是否仍是必要的计算组件？由于FFN占据解码器参数和延迟的主要部分，验证其必要性有助于精简解码器设计。
Method: 在冻结的VLM特征上，对三种解码器架构进行受控比较：四块注意力-only（A4）、四块注意力加FFN（S4）以及八块注意力-only参数对照（A8），并在多个视觉定位基准上评估性能。
Result: A4在RefCOCOg和Ref-Adv-s上匹配或略超S4；在FineCops-Ref上，A4比S4低0.52个百分点（95% CI [0.12, 0.95] 偏向S4），而A8恢复差距并最终高于S4 0.26个百分点。官方FineCops各难度层级上差距并未单调增加。A4将可训练解码器参数减少44.4%，缓存解码器延迟降低10.1%，但端到端延迟仍以主干网络为主。
Conclusion: 结果表明，在冻结VLM特征下，注意力-only解码器可以匹配甚至超越含FFN的解码器，但结论限定于可训练的定位解码器，而非完整的注意力-only VLM。

papers.title: EgoTac: In-the-wild Tactile Prediction from Egocentric Vision
papers.abstract_en: Touch is fundamental to dexterous manipulation, yet most egocentric human data increasingly used for robot learning lacks tactile information. Directly collecting large-scale tactile data is challenging due to sensor limitations, while human video data is abundant, contact-rich, and easily scalable. This motivates a natural question: can tactile signals be inferred purely from vision? To address this, we introduce EgoTac, a generalizable model that predicts rich tactile information directly from egocentric human videos. EgoTac is trained on a unified corpus of over 5.7M image-tactile pairs, covering both continuous force measurements and binary contacts. By learning from this diverse dataset, EgoTac captures nuanced touch dynamics across varied interactions. Experiments demonstrate strong performance: in-domain prediction achieves an average force error below 0.06N. On out-of-domain contact prediction benchmarks, EgoTac consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art contact estimator. It also captures the rise and fall patterns of real tactile data and enables zero-shot predictions on unconstrained real-world videos. Scaling analyses further reveal that both data diversity and volume improve performance steadily. Overall, EgoTac provides a scalable pathway to extract tactile priors from egocentric human videos, enabling broadly applicable tactile-aware robot learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoTac，一个从第一人称（egocentric）视觉视频直接预测丰富触觉信息的通用模型。该模型在超过 570 万图像-触觉对的统一语料上训练，覆盖连续力测量和二元接触。实验表明域内预测的平均力误差低于 0.06N，在域外接触预测基准上持续优于现有最优接触估计器，并能对无约束真实世界视频进行零样本预测。
Motivation: 用于机器人学习的自我中心人类数据大多缺乏触觉信息，而大规模触觉数据采集受传感器限制；相比之下，人类视频数据丰富、接触密集且易扩展，因此作者探讨是否可仅从视觉推断触觉信号。
Method: 提出 EgoTac，一个从自我中心视频预测连续力和二元接触等触觉信息的通用模型，并在统一语料（超过 5.7M 图像-触觉对）上进行训练。
Result: 域内预测平均力误差低于 0.06N；域外接触预测一致优于现有最优接触估计器；模型能捕获真实触觉数据的上升与下降模式，并实现无约束真实视频的零样本预测。缩放分析显示数据多样性和数据量均能稳定提升性能。
Conclusion: EgoTac 提供了一条从自我中心人类视频提取触觉先验的可扩展路径，可支撑广泛适用的触觉感知机器人学习。

papers.title: MEDR: Query-Independent Frame Selection via Multi-Signal Event Modeling and Dynamic Rescoring
papers.abstract_en: Frame selection is a fundamental component of multimodal large language models, enabling long videos to be processed under limited visual-token and computational budgets. Uniform sampling preserves temporal coverage but may miss informative content that appears only briefly. To alleviate this limitation, query-dependent methods can retrieve question-relevant frames. However, because the selected frames depend on the current question, the same visual input cannot be directly shared across different questions, and frame selection must be repeated in multi-turn video dialogue. This motivates us to seek a query-independent frame selection method that preserves the reusability of a fixed visual input while improving the coverage of informative events beyond uniform sampling. We propose Multi-Signal Event Modeling and Dynamic Rescoring (MEDR), a training-free and query-independent frame selection method. Multi-Signal Event Modeling organizes complementary visual, motion, and text signals into signal-specific temporal events. Dynamic Rescoring then iteratively reevaluates each candidate relative to the current selected set, updating its score according to frame-level signal strength, additional event coverage, and temporal proximity. The resulting fixed frame set is constructed without observing the query and can be reused across different questions. On the standard benchmark evaluations, MEDR improves model accuracy by 0.63%-0.89% on Video-MME. On the long-video subset of LongVideoBench, it improves accuracy by up to 1.23% with Qwen3-VL-8B. MEDR further improves overall accuracy by 0.53%, while reusing exactly the same frame set for every question about a video.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MEDR，一种免训练、查询无关（query-independent）的视频帧选择方法，面向多模态大语言模型的视频理解。Multi-Signal Event Modeling 将互补的视觉、运动、文本信号组织为各自的时序事件，Dynamic Rescoring 则迭代重打分各候选帧，最终得到可跨问题复用的固定帧集。在 Video-MME 和 LongVideoBench 上报告了准确率提升。
Motivation: 均匀采样虽保持时序覆盖，但容易漏掉短暂出现的信息内容；而查询相关（query-dependent）的帧选择虽能检索相关帧，但帧集依赖当前问题，无法在不同问题间共享，多轮视频对话中需要重复选择。因此需要一种查询无关、又能比均匀采样更好覆盖信息事件的帧选择方法。
Method: 提出 Multi-Signal Event Modeling 与 Dynamic Rescoring 两阶段机制：前者将互补的视觉、运动、文本信号分别建模成信号特定的时间事件；后者迭代地根据当前已选集合重新评估每个候选，并按帧级信号强度、额外事件覆盖度和时间邻近性更新分数。该方法免训练，且选帧过程不观察查询。
Result: 在标准基准评测中，MEDR 在 Video-MME 上提升模型准确率 0.63%-0.89%；在 LongVideoBench 的长视频子集上，配合 Qwen3-VL-8B 最高提升 1.23%；整体准确率提升 0.53%，并且对同一视频的所有问题复用完全相同的帧集。
Conclusion: 摘要强调查询无关的固定帧集可以保持视觉输入的可复用性，同时比均匀采样更好地覆盖信息事件，从而在多轮视频对话场景下避免重复选帧。

papers.title: GraphLoom: Reliability-Calibrated Graph Evidence Routing for Multimodal KG-RAG
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems often rely on long unstructured contexts or aggressively expanded evidence graphs, which can introduce noisy evidence, weaken multi-hop reasoning, and increase unsupported generation. We present GraphLoom, a reliability-calibrated multimodal knowledge-graph RAG framework for compact and faithful evidence routing. Given a question and its associated multimodal input, GraphLoom constructs an instance-level multimodal knowledge graph from grounded scene descriptions, extracted relational triples, and external commonsense knowledge. Instead of injecting all retrieved evidence into the generator, GraphLoom performs reliability-aware subgraph retrieval with bounded expansion and selectively routes high-utility evidence through hierarchical graph memory slots and joint graph-sequence attention in a frozen language model. To improve robustness in complex reasoning settings, GraphLoom further combines interleaved retrieval with budgeted corrective retrieval, enabling adaptive multi-hop evidence refinement under noisy retrieval conditions. We evaluate GraphLoom on ScienceQA, MultiModalQA, and OK-VQA, including large distractor evidence pools that approximate noisy external knowledge retrieval. Experimental results show consistent gains in answer quality and evidence faithfulness over strong multimodal RAG, graph-retrieval, and open-source vision-language baselines, with improved retrieval quality on MultiModalQA and stable performance under noisy evidence pools. Additional analyses using MiniCheck-based verification, human evaluation, and latency profiling show that reliability-calibrated graph evidence routing provides an effective alternative to long-context multimodal evidence injection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphLoom 提出一个面向多模态知识图谱 RAG 的可靠性校准证据路由框架，针对检索增强生成中长上下文或过度扩展证据图带来的噪声与多跳推理退化问题。它从场景描述、关系三元组和外部常识构建实例级多模态知识图谱，通过受限扩展的可靠性感知子图检索，并借助分层图记忆槽 (hierarchical graph memory slots) 与联合图-序列注意力 (joint graph-sequence attention) 在冻结语言模型中选择性路由高价值证据。在 ScienceQA、MultiModalQA 和 OK-VQA 上的实验显示，该方法在答案质量和证据忠实度上优于强多模态 RAG、图检索和开源视觉语言基线，且在含大量干扰证据的噪声池下保持稳定。
Motivation: 现有多模态 RAG 系统要么依赖冗长非结构化上下文，要么过度扩大证据图，导致噪声证据混入、多跳推理能力减弱以及生成内容缺乏依据。
Method: GraphLoom 构建实例级多模态知识图谱，执行带受限扩展的可靠性感知子图检索，并通过分层图记忆槽和联合图-序列注意力在冻结语言模型中将证据以紧凑方式路由给生成器。它还结合交错的检索 (interleaved retrieval) 与有预算的纠正性检索 (budgeted corrective retrieval)，在噪声检索条件下自适应地精炼多跳证据。
Result: 在 ScienceQA、MultiModalQA 和 OK-VQA 上的实验表明，该方法在答案质量和证据忠实度上一致优于多模态 RAG、图检索和开源视觉语言基线；在 MultiModalQA 上检索质量提升，并在大干扰证据池下表现稳定。MiniCheck 验证、人工评估和延迟分析进一步支持可靠性校准的图证据路由是长上下文多模态证据注入的有效替代方案。
Conclusion: 作者认为可靠性校准的图证据路由 (reliability-calibrated graph evidence routing) 是长上下文多模态证据注入之外的一种有效替代路径，但其价值主要体现在多模态知识图谱问答与证据忠实度场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TAHB: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Text-Attributed Hypergraph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Hypergraphs effectively model higher-order groupwise relationships beyond pairwise interactions, while pretrained language models (PLMs) and large language models (LLMs) provide rich semantic understanding from textual attributes. However, research on combining language models with hypergraph learning remains limited due to the lack of public text-attributed hypergraph benchmarks. To address this limitation, we present TAHB (Text-Attributed Hypergraph Benchmark), the first public benchmark integrating hypergraph structures and raw textual attributes. TAHB contains 10 real-world datasets from four domains - e-commerce, academia, movies, and politics networks - enabling systematic evaluation of text-aware hypergraph representation learning. Experimental results show that TAHB preserves key structural properties of real-world hypergraphs and consistently reproduces performance tendencies observed in existing benchmarks. Furthermore, experiments under both LLM-as-Enhancer and LLM-as-Predictor settings demonstrate that LLM-enhanced textual semantics improve hypergraph learning performance, while structural and textual information jointly provide the best setting for LLM-based prediction. Our benchmark provides a foundation for future research at the intersection of hypergraph learning and language models.
papers.summary_zh:
