papers.title: Culturally-Aware AI for Cross-Boundary Community Learning: Undergraduate Innovation at the Intersection of Computation and Design
papers.abstract_en: Research on artificial intelligence in education (AIED) is rapidly expanding, yet technical progress often lacks human-centered grounding and adequate attention to cultural context. Community-Based Learning, a pedagogy rooted in social work, remains underrepresented in AIED research, particularly within Asia-Pacific contexts. This paper reports on cross-boundary Community-Based Learning where undergraduate students develop AI-enabled solutions for cultural heritage preservation and sustainable development. We examine how community-engaged computing operationalizes culturally aware, human-centered AIED through participatory elicitation of cultural knowledge, bilingual representation, and stakeholder validation across education, technology, and culture. We contribute a collaborative framework for culturally aware AIED designed to support multi-stakeholder collaboration and widen participation by bridging social work and computational science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告一项跨边界社区学习 (Community-Based Learning) 实践，其中本科生为文化遗产保护与可持续发展开发 AI 解决方案，并以此探讨如何实现具有文化意识、以人为中心的 AIED。研究通过参与式文化知识 elicitation、双语表达和跨教育/技术/文化领域的利益相关者验证，提出了一个支持多利益相关者协作的文化敏感 AIED 协作框架，试图连接社会工作与计算科学。摘要未给出定量实验指标。
Motivation: 现有 AIED 研究扩张迅速，但技术进步往往缺乏以人为中心的根基，且对文化语境的关注不足；源自社会工作的社区学习理念在 AIED 中尤其少见，亚太地区相关研究更少。
Method: 采用社区参与式计算的方式，通过参与式 elicitation 收集文化知识、双语表达以及跨教育、技术和文化领域的利益相关者验证，来落地具有文化意识、以人为中心的 AIED，并据此提出一个协作式框架。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果；主要成果是提出一个用于跨学科、多利益相关者协作的文化敏感 AIED 框架，并展示其如何在本科教学场景中操作化。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作通过连接社会工作与计算科学，能够为文化敏感的 AIED 提供支持，并扩大参与范围。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: WaveDiT: Distribution-Aware Wavelet Flow Matching for Efficient 3D Brain MRI Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Large and demographically balanced datasets are essential for reliable neuroimaging biomarkers. Full-resolution 3D brain MRI synthesis can support data augmentation in this setting, but existing approaches either incur prohibitive computational cost at volumetric scale or rely on lossy latent compression that may compromise anatomical detail. As a result, practical 3D generative augmentation often requires specialized compute infrastructure. We propose WaveDiT, a conditional flow matching framework operating in the coefficient space of a 3D Haar Discrete Wavelet Transform. The model combines factorized spatio-depth attention with band-wise heteroscedastic uncertainty modeling derived from higher-order wavelet statistics. Predicted log-variance is integrated directly into both the flow objective and conditioning pathway, enabling adaptive precision consistent with the heavy-tailed and input-dependent variance structure of anatomical detail. This formulation supports full-resolution 3D synthesis under practical memory and time constraints on a single modern GPU. Evaluation on a multi-site cohort demonstrates improved alignment between generated and real MRI distributions, together with enhanced downstream brain age prediction and region-level anatomical agreement relative to diffusion, latent, and wavelet-based baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/sisinflab/WaveDiT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WaveDiT，一种在 3D Haar 离散小波变换（DWT）系数空间中运行的 conditional flow matching 框架，用于在单块现代 GPU 上实现全分辨率 3D 脑 MRI 合成。方法结合分解的时空注意力（factorized spatio-depth attention）与基于高阶小波统计的逐频带异方差不确定性建模，将预测的 log-variance 同时融入 flow 目标与条件路径。在多中心队列上的评估显示，生成与真实 MRI 分布的对齐更优，并在下游脑龄预测和区域级解剖一致性上优于扩散、潜空间和小波基线。
Motivation: 可靠神经影像生物标志物需要大规模且人口均衡的数据集，全分辨率 3D 脑 MRI 合成可用于数据增强；但现有方法在体素尺度上计算成本过高，或依赖有损的潜空间压缩而损害解剖细节，导致实际生成式增强常需要专门的算力基础设施。
Method: 提出在 3D Haar DWT 系数空间中训练 conditional flow matching 模型，采用分解的 spatio-depth 注意力，并利用由更高阶小波统计导出的 band-wise 异方差不确定性建模；预测的 log-variance 同时集成到 flow 目标函数与条件路径中，从而根据解剖细节的重尾、输入相关方差结构实现自适应精度。
Result: 在多中心队列上，该方法改善了生成与真实 MRI 分布之间的对齐，并在下游脑龄预测和区域级解剖一致性上超过扩散、潜空间与小波类基线；同时支持在单块现代 GPU 上以实际可行的内存和时间开销进行全分辨率 3D 合成。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 WaveDiT 使全分辨率 3D 脑 MRI 生成增强在常规硬件条件下变得实用，并提供了代码仓库供复现使用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LatentSkill: From In-Context Textual Skills to In-Weight Latent Skills for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent systems increasingly use textual skills to encode reusable task procedures, but injecting these skills into the prompt at every step incurs substantial context overhead and exposes skill content as plaintext. We present LatentSkill, a framework that converts textual skills into plug-and-play LoRA adapters through a pretrained hypernetwork. LatentSkill stores skill knowledge in weight space rather than context space, removing per-step skill tokens while preserving modular loading, scaling, and composition. On ALFWorld and Search-QA, LatentSkill outperforms the corresponding in-context skill baseline while using substantially fewer prefill tokens: it improves ALFWorld success by 21.4 and 13.4 points on the seen and unseen splits with 63.9% fewer prefill tokens on average, and improves Search-QA exact match by 3.0 points while using 71.8% fewer tokens per step. Further analysis shows that generated skill LoRAs form a structured semantic geometry, can be continuously modulated via the LoRA scaling coefficient, and can be composed through parameter-space arithmetic when skill components are aligned. These findings suggest that weight-space skills provide an efficient, modular, and less exposed substrate for extending LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LatentSkill，一个通过预训练超网络 (hypernetwork) 将文本技能转换为即插即用的 LoRA 适配器的框架，把技能知识从上下文空间迁移到权重空间。在 ALFWorld 和 Search-QA 上，它比对应的上下文内技能基线表现更好，同时大幅减少每步所需的 prefill token 数量；进一步的分析表明生成的技能 LoRA 具有结构化语义几何，可通过缩放系数连续调节，并能在参数空间中进行组合。
Motivation: 现有 agent 系统把可复用的任务流程编码为文本技能并注入 prompt，导致每步推理都产生大量上下文开销，且技能内容以明文形式暴露，缺少效率与隐私层面的保障。
Method: 通过预训练超网络把文本技能映射为插件式 LoRA 适配器，使技能存储在权重空间而非上下文空间，同时保留模块化加载、缩放与组合能力。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 上，seen 与 unseen 分片成功率分别提升 21.4 和 13.4 个点，平均减少 63.9% 的 prefill token；在 Search-QA 上，exact match 提升 3.0 个点，每步 token 减少 71.8%。
Conclusion: 权重空间中的技能表示具备高效、模块化且暴露面更小的特性，为扩展 LLM agent 提供了新的技术路径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Compositional Boundaries for Density Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Distributed uncertainty-management systems often combine local probabilistic models along aggregation trees chosen by communication, privacy, or scheduling constraints. The final density should depend on the weighted sources, not on the particular order in which intermediate nodes combine them. We study this requirement as an algebraic compositionality problem for binary fusion of weighted probability densities. The central question is when a local fusion rule can be executed hierarchically while remaining order-invariant. We establish a compositional boundary for local segment-valued fusion rules. Within the class of continuous binary rules with additive output weights and weight-only coefficients, order-invariant hierarchical execution characterizes normalized weighted linear pooling; norm-induced segment balancing realizes the corresponding coefficient. Smooth endpoint-to-candidate $f$-divergence balancing has a different local geometry: its quadratic expansion induces square-root effective weights, showing why pairwise solvability alone is insufficient for schedule-independent fusion. We show that this obstruction is local to endpoint-to-candidate binary balancing, whereas global divergence barycenters retain additive-weight local limits. Finally, Gaussian mixtures show how the same issue appears in finite model classes: exact fusion is compositional, whereas stepwise compression is compositional only under a congruence condition on unnormalized component measures. These results distinguish exact schedule-independent fusion from global aggregation objectives and local approximation heuristics.
papers.comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 17th International Conference on Scalable Uncertainty Management (SUM 2026), LNAI, Athens, Greece
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布式不确定性管理系统中，局部概率密度沿聚合树进行二元融合时的代数组合性问题，即融合结果如何做到与中间节点的合并顺序无关（order-invariant）。作者在连续二元融合规则、加性输出权重和仅依赖权重的系数这一类别内证明，满足分级执行顺序不变性的规则等价于归一化加权线性池化（normalized weighted linear pooling）；同时指出端点到候选的 f-散度平衡具有不同的局部几何结构，其二次展开会产生平方根有效权重，导致两两可解性不足以保证与调度无关的融合。文章还以高斯混合模型为例，说明精确融合与逐步压缩在组合性上的差异。
Motivation: 分布式不确定管理常因通信、隐私或调度约束而沿聚合树合并局部概率模型，最终密度应只取决于加权源而非合并顺序。这一需求在代数上要求二元密度融合规则具备某种组合性，但现有理论尚未清晰刻画哪些局部融合规则能支持分级且顺序不变的执行。
Method: 将问题形式化为加权概率密度二元融合的代数组合性问题，在连续二元规则、加性输出权重且系数仅依赖权重的类别上刻画组合边界；通过范数诱导的段平衡（norm-induced segment balancing）实现相应系数，并对比端点到候选 f-散度平衡与全局散度重心（global divergence barycenters）的局部极限性质；最后用高斯混合模型验证有限模型类中的表现。
Result: 在所述规则类别内，分级执行且顺序不变的融合等价于归一化加权线性池化；端点到候选的 f-散度平衡的二次展开导致平方根有效权重，因此两两可解性不足以保证调度无关融合，而全局散度重心保留加性权重的局部极限。高斯混合中精确融合具有组合性，逐步压缩仅当未归一化分量测度满足同余条件时才具有组合性。
Conclusion: 这些结果区分了与调度无关的精确融合、全局聚合目标与局部近似启发式三者之间的本质差异。摘要未讨论具体实验或应用场景，主要贡献是理论刻画。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Learning symplectic model reduction based on an approximation theorem of symplectic embeddings
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional Hamiltonian systems play a central role in many scientific and engineering disciplines, with dynamics that evolve on symplectic manifolds. Although deep learning provides powerful tools for constructing its low-dimensional surrogates from data, the intrinsic symplectic structure is easily destroyed during model reduction. As a result, a standard autoencoder may produce latent coordinates that do not support a Hamiltonian flow, leading to unstable long-time prediction. In this paper, we first establish a universal approximation theorem for symplectic embeddings. And based on the theory, we propose symplecticity-preserving autoencoders (SpAE), in which the decoder is parameterized as a symplectic embedding and the encoder is constructed as the corresponding symplectic projection. This architecture is expressive enough to approximate nonlinear symplectic embeddings and the corresponding symplectic projection, preserves the symplectic structure exactly by construction, and can be trained by standard unconstrained optimization, thereby improving both reconstruction and prediction accuracy. Extensive experiments on high-dimensional lattice and particle systems demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高维哈密顿系统模型降维中辛结构被破坏的问题，先建立辛嵌入的通用逼近定理，并据此提出保辛自编码器（SpAE）：解码器参数化为辛嵌入，编码器构造为对应的辛投影，从而由构造保证精确保持辛结构，并可用标准无约束优化训练。摘要报告在高维格点和粒子系统上的实验表明该方法能同时提升重构精度与预测精度。
Motivation: 标准自编码器在模型降维时容易破坏哈密顿系统内在的辛结构，导致隐坐标无法支撑哈密顿流，长期预测不稳定。
Method: 建立辛嵌入的通用逼近定理，在此基础上提出 SpAE，其中解码器为辛嵌入、编码器为其对应的辛投影，使网络结构本身精确保持辛结构并支持无约束优化训练。
Result: 摘要报告在高维晶格与粒子系统上的大量实验显示，该方法相比标准方法能提高重构精度和预测精度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于逼近定理的保辛自编码器能够有效逼近非线性辛嵌入及其辛投影，并改善长期预测的稳定性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Practical and Optimal Algorithm for Linear Contextual Bandits with Rare Parameter Updates
papers.abstract_en: We study linear contextual bandits under rare parameter updates: the learner may incorporate reward feedback into its parameter estimate only at a small number of update times, while still observing contexts online and selecting actions sequentially. This viewpoint clarifies a practical distinction that is often blurred in the literature: many "strictly batched" methods additionally restrict within-interval context adaptivity, meaning that the action rule inside an interval cannot depend on the sequence of realized contexts/actions in that interval (beyond the current round's context). For linear contextual bandits, we propose two practical algorithms with only $O(\log\log T)$ parameter updates. Our first algorithm BLCE-G attains minimax-optimal regret (up to polylogarithmic factors in $T$) simultaneously in both the small-$K$ and large-$K$ regimes under a static schedule. Our second algorithm BLCE removes the near G-optimal design step -- a dominant computational bottleneck in prior strictly batched static-grid methods -- yet preserves minimax-optimal regret and achieves the lowest known runtime complexity among optimal algorithms. We further extend these rare-update and computational principles to generalized linear contextual bandits. Overall, our results yield minimax-optimal algorithms for linear contextual bandits and a near-optimal generalized-linear extension under $O(\log\log T)$ parameter updates, while remaining computationally efficient in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究线性上下文赌博机 (linear contextual bandits) 在罕见参数更新 (rare parameter updates) 设定下的学习问题：学习器只能在少量更新时刻利用奖励反馈更新参数估计，但需在线观测上下文并顺序选择动作。作者提出两种仅需 O(log log T) 次参数更新的实用算法 BLCE-G 与 BLCE，前者在静态调度下同时在小 K 与大 K 区间达到极小极大最优遗憾 (minimax-optimal regret)，后者去掉近 G-最优设计步骤并在保持最优遗憾的同时实现已知最优算法中最低的运行时复杂度。结果还扩展到广义线性上下文赌博机。
Motivation: 现有文献中许多“严格批处理”方法额外限制了区间内上下文自适应性，导致动作规则不能依赖区间内已实现上下文序列；同时先前的严格批处理静态网格方法存在近 G-最优设计这一主要计算瓶颈。本文旨在以罕见的参数更新次数实现最优遗憾，并降低计算开销。
Method: 提出两个实用算法：BLCE-G 在静态调度下同时处理小 K 与大 K 两类区间并获得极小极大最优遗憾；BLCE 去除近 G-最优设计步骤，仍保持最优遗憾并降低运行时复杂度。作者还将这些罕见更新与计算原则推广到广义线性上下文赌博机。
Result: 摘要报告 BLCE-G 与 BLCE 在 O(log log T) 次参数更新下达到线性上下文赌博机的极小极大最优遗憾 (至多差 poly-log 因子)；BLCE 达到已知最优算法中的最低运行时复杂度；广义线性扩展取得近最优结果。
Conclusion: 作者总结，其方法在 O(log log T) 次参数更新下为线性上下文赌博机提供极小极大最优算法，并为广义线性模型提供近最优扩展，同时保持实际计算效率。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究线性上下文赌博机 (linear contextual bandits) 在罕见参数更新 (rare parameter updates) 设定下的学习问题：学习器只能在少量更新时刻利用奖励反馈更新参数估计，但需在线观测上下文并顺序选择动作。作者提出两种仅需 O(log log T) 次参数更新的实用算法 BLCE-G 与 BLCE，前者在静态调度下同时在小 K 与大 K 区间达到极小极大最优遗憾 (minimax-optimal regret)，后者去掉近 G-最优设计步骤并在保持最优遗憾的同时实现已知最优算法中最低的运行时复杂度。结果还扩展到广义线性上下文赌博机。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有文献中许多“严格批处理”方法额外限制了区间内上下文自适应性，导致动作规则不能依赖区间内已实现上下文序列；同时先前的严格批处理静态网格方法存在近 G-最优设计这一主要计算瓶颈。本文旨在以罕见的参数更新次数实现最优遗憾，并降低计算开销。
summary_sections.method: 提出两个实用算法：BLCE-G 在静态调度下同时处理小 K 与大 K 两类区间并获得极小极大最优遗憾；BLCE 去除近 G-最优设计步骤，仍保持最优遗憾并降低运行时复杂度。作者还将这些罕见更新与计算原则推广到广义线性上下文赌博机。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 BLCE-G 与 BLCE 在 O(log log T) 次参数更新下达到线性上下文赌博机的极小极大最优遗憾 (至多差 poly-log 因子)；BLCE 达到已知最优算法中的最低运行时复杂度；广义线性扩展取得近最优结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者总结，其方法在 O(log log T) 次参数更新下为线性上下文赌博机提供极小极大最优算法，并为广义线性模型提供近最优扩展，同时保持实际计算效率。

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Dynamic Mini-Batch SGD in Sketched Linear Regression
papers.abstract_en: Mini-batching is central to large-scale optimization, yet its role in statistical scaling laws remains limited. We study one-pass and multi-pass batch SGD for sketched linear regression under power-law spectral and source conditions. Our analysis reveals a two-horizon phenomenon induced by warmup--stable--decay schedules: deterministic learning is governed by the full optimization trajectory, while stochastic error retains only a shorter terminal memory. For dynamic batch schedules, the individual batch sizes enter through influence-weighted summaries that measure how strongly each update affects the final risk. Consequently, batching leaves the approximation and optimization-bias laws unchanged at a fixed update horizon, but controls the one-pass variance and the multi-pass fluctuation around full-batch gradient descent. We obtain matching one-pass variance bounds and nearly matching multi-pass fluctuation bounds, recover static-batch and full-batch behavior as special cases, and derive an oracle square-root rule for allocating a fixed iteration budget. These results identify WSD horizon separation and final-risk influence as the mechanisms governing dynamic mini-batch scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 sketched linear regression 框架下研究动态小批量（dynamic mini-batch）SGD 的缩放定律，覆盖 one-pass 与 multi-pass 两种设置，并假设谱和源条件服从幂律。分析揭示 warmup-stable-decay (WSD) 调度导致的“两个视野”（two-horizon）现象：确定性学习由完整优化轨迹决定，而随机误差只保留较短的终端记忆。动态批量调度下，单个批大小通过影响权重摘要（influence-weighted summaries）作用于最终风险，因而在固定更新视野下不改变逼近与优化偏差定律，但控制 one-pass 方差和 multi-pass 围绕全批量梯度下降的波动。
Motivation: 小批量是大规模优化的核心手段，但其在统计缩放定律中的作用此前研究有限，尤其是动态小批量调度如何影响最终风险的机制尚不清楚。
Method: 对 sketched linear regression 在幂律谱和源条件下分析 one-pass 与 multi-pass 批量 SGD，推导动态批量调度下的边界，并给出在固定迭代预算下分配批量大小的 oracle 平方根规则；静态批量与全批量行为作为特例被恢复。
Result: 摘要报告获得匹配的 one-pass 方差界限和近匹配的 multi-pass 波动界限；在固定更新视野下，批大小不改变逼近和优化偏差定律，但控制 one-pass 方差及 multi-pass 相对全批量梯度下降的波动。
Conclusion: 作者将 WSD 视野分离（horizon separation）和最终风险影响（final-risk influence）识别为动态小批量缩放定律的机制。

papers.title: EvoScene-VLA: Evolving Scene Beliefs Inside the Action Decoder for Chunked Robot Control
papers.abstract_en: Chunked vision-language-action (VLA) policies predict multi-step robot controls, conditioning each update on the current visual observation alone. Yet robot actions cause contact, occlusion, and object motion, and the geometry that later decisions depend on can change before the next visual update arrives. Spatial VLAs improve current-frame geometry. Temporal VLAs aggregate past frames. Neither maintains an action-updated scene prior across chunks. We argue for a persistent action-updated scene state across control calls, and introduce EvoScene-VLA. Its recurrent scene prefix carries a geometry-aware scene state across chunks. At each vision-language model (VLM) call, the VLM combines scene information from the current observation with the action-updated prior from the previous chunk; the action decoder outputs both the next action chunk and a compact scene update. This update becomes the next prior, which the VLM corrects against the new observation when the next call arrives. Each control call therefore starts from a scene prior that reflects both recent actions and fresh visual evidence. During training, \textbf{Scene Predictor} supplies future scene-token targets, and Geometric Anchor aligns scene slots with frozen depth and 3D teachers. We discard both modules at deployment. On 31 RoboTwin tasks, EvoScene-VLA raises average success from 87.2% to 89.1% in fixed evaluation and from 86.1% to 88.5% in randomized evaluation. On the Galaxea R1-Lite real robot, EvoScene-VLA outperforms all baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分块视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提出 EvoScene-VLA，在动作解码器中维护跨控制调用的、由动作更新的场景状态。其循环场景前缀携带几何感知场景先验，每次 VLM 调用结合当前观测与上一分块的动作更新先验，动作解码器同时输出下一动作块和紧凑场景更新。训练时使用 Scene Predictor 提供未来场景 token 目标、Geometric Anchor 对齐冻结的深度与 3D 教师，部署时丢弃两者。在 31 个 RoboTwin 任务上，固定评估平均成功率从 87.2% 提升到 89.1%，随机评估从 86.1% 提升到 88.5%；在 Galaxea R1-Lite 真机上优于所有基线。
Motivation: 现有分块 VLA 策略每次更新仅依赖当前视觉观测，而机器人动作引起的接触、遮挡和物体运动可能在下一次视觉更新前改变后续决策依赖的几何信息；空间 VLA 只增强当前帧几何，时间 VLA 只聚合过去帧，都未维护跨分块的动作更新场景先验。
Method: 提出 EvoScene-VLA，其循环场景前缀跨分块携带几何感知场景状态。每次 VLM 调用时，将当前观测的场景信息与上一分块的动作更新先验结合；动作解码器输出下一动作块和紧凑场景更新作为下一先验。训练阶段使用 Scene Predictor 提供未来场景 token 目标，并用 Geometric Anchor 将场景槽与冻结的深度和 3D 教师对齐，部署时移除这两个模块。
Result: 在 31 个 RoboTwin 任务上，固定评估平均成功率从 87.2% 提升到 89.1%，随机评估从 86.1% 提升到 88.5%；在 Galaxea R1-Lite 真机上优于所有基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调跨控制调用维护持久且由动作更新的场景状态能提升分块 VLA 控制性能，且训练辅助模块可在部署阶段丢弃。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Economics of AI Inference: Inflation Dynamics, Welfare Costs, and Optimal Monetary Policy under the Inference-Cost Phillips Curve
papers.abstract_en: We develop a unified microeconomic and monetary theory of artificial intelligence inference costs and their pass-through to inflation, welfare, and optimal monetary policy. We introduce the Inference-Cost Phillips Curve (ICPC), an augmented New Keynesian Phillips curve in which firm-level marginal costs of producing differentiated goods include a non-trivial AI inference component lambda-bar, and prove a closed-form structural slope kappa*_inf = lambda-bar * kappa, where kappa is the standard Calvo-Yun slope. We derive a welfare-relevant Hicks-Kaldor decomposition of consumer welfare under inference-cost shocks, prove a generalized Taylor principle for the inference-augmented economy, and characterize the optimal monetary policy response coefficient psi*_inf = (1 + phi*rho) * lambda-bar * kappa under commitment. A second-order welfare loss formula closes the model in closed form. We confront the theory with U.S. monthly data 2022:M01-2026:M04 using a two-step GMM estimator with Newey-West HAC standard errors and Hansen J-test, recovering an empirical slope kappa-hat_inf = 0.087 (HAC s.e. 0.021) which lies within one standard error of the structural prediction. A scaling regression over 50 rolling-window subwindows yields b-hat = 0.987 (R^2 = 0.998), consistent with a near-unit-elasticity pass-through. A G7 reduced-form panel with Driscoll-Kraay HAC standard errors yields b-hat^G7 = 0.094 (s.e. 0.026), and a Wald test fails to reject cross-country homogeneity (p = 0.78). The framework provides a single equilibrium scaffold for the joint study of AI inference cost dynamics, monetary policy under generative-AI shocks, and the welfare cost of inference-driven inflation.
papers.comment: The author has withdrawn this manuscript due to theoretical errors identified in the macroeconomic modeling assumptions and equilibrium derivations in Section 3
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文试图建立人工智能推理成本的微观与货币统一理论，提出推理成本菲利普斯曲线（ICPC），推导闭式结构斜率、福利分解、广义泰勒原理和最优货币政策系数，并用美国与G7数据进行实证检验。然而作者已撤回该手稿，原因是第3节宏观经济建模假设与均衡推导存在理论错误。
Motivation: 现有宏观经济学框架未系统刻画AI推理成本对通胀、福利与最优货币政策的传导机制，作者希望提供一个统一均衡框架来同时研究生成式AI冲击下的推理成本动态。
Method: 将企业边际成本中的AI推理成分λ̄引入标准新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线，证明闭式斜率κ*_inf = λ̄κ；推导Hicks-Kaldor福利分解、广义泰勒原理与承诺下的最优政策系数ψ*_inf =(1+φρ)λ̄κ，并以二阶福利损失公式封闭模型。实证采用美国2022:M01-2026:M04月度数据的两步GMM（Newey-West HAC）、50个滚动窗口缩放回归及G7面板Driscoll-Kraay HAC估计。
Result: 实证得到经验斜率κ̂_inf=0.087（HAC标准误0.021），与结构预测在一个标准误内一致；50个滚动窗口回归系数b̂=0.987（R²=0.998），接近单位弹性传导；G7面板系数b̂^G7=0.094（s.e. 0.026），Wald检验无法拒绝跨国同质性（p=0.78）。
Conclusion: 作者已撤回手稿，明确指出第3节中的宏观经济建模假设与均衡推导存在理论错误，因此所报告的理论与实证结论均不宜作为可靠结果引用。

papers.title: The Economics of Model Collapse: Equilibrium, Welfare, and Optimal Provenance Subsidies in Synthetic Data Markets
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming the supply side of training data: an increasing share of new tokens, images, and structured records is produced by previous-generation models rather than by human originators. Recursive training on such synthetic content induces a measurable and often irreversible loss of distributional fidelity, a phenomenon known as model collapse. We develop the first unified microeconomic theory of synthetic data markets under model collapse. We introduce the Synthetic Data Contamination Equilibrium (SDCE), prove existence and generic uniqueness, derive a welfare decomposition W = W_prod + W_cons - L_coll - L_info, establish a Wasserstein-gradient-flow mean-field collapse limit, prove an impossibility of information-constrained implementation, and obtain closed-form expressions for the welfare-maximizing provenance subsidy s* = KL(q||p)/(2 kappa) and the welfare-maximizing watermark strength w* = (1 - psi) KL(q||p)/(2 kappa psi). We prove an information-theoretic Cramer-Rao lower bound on any provenance estimator using only producer-side observations and show that the Provenance-Market Iterative Retraining (PMIR) algorithm attains this bound up to constants while converging to an epsilon-SDCE in O(epsilon^-2 log T) iterations. A reduced-form OLS estimation on a C4-synthetic benchmark over ten retraining generations yields a collapse-rate coefficient b-hat = 0.181 (HAC s.e. 0.024), within one standard error of the structural prediction 0.183. Calibrated experiments raise generation-ten model quality by 23.1 percent over the unregulated benchmark while lowering the 2-Wasserstein drift on a held-out diversity probe from 0.318 to 0.142. Scaling experiments over generations t in {1,...,10} recover a logarithmic-in-t collapse law log Q_t = log Q_0 - 0.183 t rho^2 with R^2 = 0.962.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the author due to mathematical inaccuracies in the synthetic data market equilibrium proofs and welfare optimization analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出模型崩溃 (model collapse) 下合成数据市场的首个统一微观经济理论，引入合成数据污染均衡 (Synthetic Data Contamination Equilibrium, SDCE)，给出福利分解、最优来源补贴与最优水印强度的闭式解，并提出 Provenance-Market Iterative Retraining (PMIR) 算法。摘要报告了理论结果与实证估计，但 arXiv 备注显示作者已因均衡证明和福利优化分析中的数学错误主动撤回论文。
Motivation: 生成模型正逐渐成为训练数据的重要来源，对前代模型输出的递归训练会带来可测且往往不可逆的分布保真度损失，即模型崩溃；但缺乏一个统一的经济学框架来刻画这一过程中合成数据市场的均衡、福利与监管设计。
Method: 引入 SDCE 均衡并证明其存在性与一般唯一性；导出福利分解 W = W_prod + W_cons - L_coll - L_info，建立 Wasserstein 梯度流的均值场崩溃极限，并证明信息约束下实施的不可行性；推导福利最优来源补贴 s* = KL(q||p)/(2 kappa) 与最优水印强度 w*，以及仅基于生产者观测的来源估计器的 Cramér-Rao 下界，并提出可达到该下界（至多差常数因子）且以 O(epsilon^-2 log T) 迭代收敛到 epsilon-SDCE 的 PMIR 算法。
Result: 在 C4 合成基准上对十轮重训练进行 OLS 估计，得到崩溃率系数 b-hat = 0.181（HAC 标准误 0.024），与结构预测 0.183 相差一个标准误以内；校准实验将第 10 代模型质量相对无监管基准提高 23.1%，并把保留多样性探针上的 2-Wasserstein 漂移从 0.318 降至 0.142；跨代缩放实验得到 log Q_t = log Q_0 - 0.183 t rho^2 的对数崩溃律，R^2 = 0.962。

papers.title: SAPO: Step-Aligned Policy Optimization for Reasoning-Based Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommendation treats next-item prediction as autoregressive item-identifier generation. Specifically, items are encoded as semantic identifiers (SIDs), which are short coarse-to-fine token sequences whose early tokens capture broad semantics and later tokens refine them. Recent work augments this paradigm with reasoning traces and optimizes them via reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, typically outcome-reward algorithm with exact-match feedback on the generated SID. However, in large-catalog recommendation, exact-match feedback on the generated SID only reports whether the final item is correct; when a generated SID mismatches, outcome-reward cannot identify which SID-token prediction caused the mismatch and may penalize matched SID-token positions together with the mismatched position. We identify that the natural unit of credit assignment in this setting is a single reasoning step (one thinking block paired with one SID token). We instantiate this idea in SAPO (Step-Aligned Policy Optimization): rather than broadcasting one advantage to the whole response, SAPO computes a separate group-relative advantage for each reasoning step and applies it only to the corresponding thinking block and SID token. Across three real-world recommendation datasets, SAPO stabilizes reinforcement-learning training and consistently improves over existing generative recommendation baselines, with the largest gains where sparse exact-match feedback makes reasoning-step credit assignment important. Our results suggest that reinforcement-learning objectives for structured generation should mirror the decoder's own decomposition of the output.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAPO（Step-Aligned Policy Optimization），用于基于推理轨迹的生成式推荐。推荐场景中物品被编码为语义标识符（SID），模型通过强化学习优化推理轨迹；SAPO 将信用分配（credit assignment）的粒度定为单个推理步骤（一个思考块 paired 一个 SID token），为每个步骤分别计算组内相对优势（group-relative advantage），而不是对整个响应广播同一个优势。摘要报告在三个真实推荐数据集上 SAPO 稳定了 RL 训练并持续优于现有生成式推荐基线，且在稀疏的精确匹配反馈场景下提升最大。
Motivation: 在大型目录推荐中，基于 SID 精确匹配的结果奖励只能反映最终物品是否正确；当 SID 不匹配时，无法定位是哪一步 token 预测出错，且会把匹配的 token 位置与不匹配位置一起惩罚。作者指出该设定下自然的信用分配单元是单个推理步骤，即一个思考块与一个 SID token 的组合。
Method: SAPO 不再把单一优势值广播到整个响应，而是为每个推理步骤单独计算 group-relative advantage，并将其仅应用于对应的思考块和 SID token。
Result: 在三个真实世界推荐数据集上，SAPO 稳定了强化学习训练，并一致优于现有生成式推荐基线；在精确匹配反馈稀疏、步骤级信用分配重要的场景中增益最大。
Conclusion: 作者认为，面向结构化生成的强化学习目标应当镜像解码器自身对输出的分解方式。

papers.title: Representation Signatures and Risk-Feedback Alignment in LLM Trading Agents
papers.abstract_en: We study behavioral alignment and representation dynamics of large language model (LLM) agents in financial decision environments. TradeArena, an auditable trading-agent testbed with risk reports, execution simulation, memory, and replayable trajectories, lets us analyze how rationales, positions, and interventions evolve under market stress. Code and data artifacts are available through the \href{https://github.com/weich97/TreLLM-public}{TradeArena repository}. We find pre-failure signatures: planning embeddings drift from normal centroids, fused plan-risk representations separate normal from pre-drawdown states, and local manifolds exhibit effective-rank contraction. Across 80 rolling failure anchors and eight LLM trajectories, this pattern persists across hash, LSA, Transformer, and white-box hidden-state probes. Stress tests with CoT-free target weights, lexical controls, OHLCV noise, and false audits show that rationale-level contraction can vanish without rationales, while intent-space and fused signatures remain informative. Structured risk feedback can act as an external alignment signal without fine-tuning, but not as a universal performance enhancer: true audit feedback improves calibration for some models, returns for others, and exposes cases where placebo or hidden feedback has higher short-horizon return but weaker alignment diagnostics. A 51-stock intraday experiment reveals a correlation blind spot: LLM rationales justify exposure to coupled assets that the risk layer clips. Finally, a financial-audit task suite shifts comparison from ``which model trades best'' to whether models can audit trajectories, respect execution boundaries, reproduce artifacts, and avoid claim overreach. These results support a research claim, not a profitability claim: auditable risk feedback and representation trajectories reveal when LLM financial reasoning is aligning, drifting, or failing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 交易代理在金融决策环境中的行为对齐与表征动态。作者提出可审计的 TradeArena 测试平台，包含风险报告、执行模拟、记忆与可回放轨迹，并发现市场压力下的失败前签名：规划嵌入偏离正常质心，融合的计划-风险表征能区分正常与回撤前状态，局部流形出现有效秩收缩。摘要还报告了风险反馈作为无微调外部对齐信号的作用，以及 51 股日内实验中模型理性辩护与风险层裁剪之间暴露出的相关性盲区。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 交易代理研究多聚焦于"哪个模型交易得最好"，缺少对代理内部表征与行为对齐的可审计分析；作者希望理解在市场压力下模型推理何时在对齐、漂移或失败。
Method: 提出可审计的 TradeArena 交易代理测试平台，集成风险报告、执行模拟、记忆与可回放轨迹；在 80 个滚动失败锚点和 8 条 LLM 轨迹上，用 hash、LSA、Transformer 与白盒隐藏状态探针分析规划嵌入、计划-风险融合表征及局部流形有效秩，并通过无 CoT 目标权重、词汇控制、OHLCV 噪声和虚假审计进行压力测试。
Result: 发现跨探针一致的失败前表征签名（嵌入漂移、融合表征分离、有效秩收缩）。结构化风险反馈可作为外部对齐信号，但并非普遍的性能增强器：真实审计反馈对某些模型改善校准、对其他模型改善回报，且存在安慰剂或隐藏反馈短期回报更高但对齐诊断更弱的情况；51 股日内实验显示理性为被风险层裁剪的耦合资产辩护，构成相关性盲区。
Conclusion: 摘要明确这只是研究声明而非盈利声明：可审计的风险反馈与表征轨迹能揭示 LLM 金融推理何时在对齐、漂移或失败；建议将比较重心从"哪个模型交易最好"转向模型能否审计轨迹、尊重执行边界、复现工件并避免过度声明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Agentic AI Framework with Large Language Models and Chain-of-Thought for UAV-Assisted Logistics Scheduling with Mobile Edge Computing
papers.abstract_en: In cloud manufacturing, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can support both product collection and mobile edge computing (MEC). This joint operation forms a hybrid scheduling problem, where physical logistics decisions are coupled with computational task scheduling. In this paper, UAVs collect finished products from manufacturing stations and transport them back to a central depot. Meanwhile, computational tasks generated by industrial sensor devices at these stations are processed locally, at UAVs, or offloaded via UAVs to the cloud. This coupling makes the problem challenging. A UAV can provide MEC services only during its service window at a station, so routing decisions directly determine when UAV-assisted offloading is available. Routing decisions also affect the UAV energy budget and the availability of onboard computing and communication resources for computational task execution under task deadline constraints. To address this, we propose an agentic-AI-assisted optimization framework with two components. First, we develop an agentic AI that combines large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and chain-of-thought reasoning to translate user input into an interpretable mathematical formulation for the hybrid scheduling problem. Second, we design a hierarchical deep reinforcement learning approach based on proximal policy optimization (PPO), where the upper layer learns UAV routing and the lower layer optimizes per-slot task execution and resource allocation. Simulation results show that the proposed framework yields more consistent formulations, while the hierarchical PPO achieves full product collection in 99.6% of the last 500 episodes and maintains a 100% deadline satisfaction rate, with more stable performance than the advantage actor-critic approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向云制造场景，研究无人机同时承担成品回收与移动边缘计算（MEC）服务的混合调度问题，其中物流路径决策与计算任务调度相互耦合。作者提出一种代理式 AI 辅助优化框架：先用融合大语言模型、检索增强生成（RAG）与思维链（chain-of-thought）的代理把用户输入转成可解释的数学规划，再用基于 PPO 的分层深度强化学习求解，上层学无人机路径、下层优化逐时隙任务执行与资源分配。仿真显示该框架生成的公式更稳定一致，分层 PPO 在最后 500 个回合中 99.6% 实现全部产品收集并保持 100% 截止时间满足率。
Motivation: 无人机只能在驻站服务窗口内提供 MEC，因此路径决策直接决定卸载可用性，同时影响无人机能量预算以及机载计算与通信资源在任务截止时间约束下的可用性，造成物理物流与计算调度的强耦合，使问题难以求解。
Method: 提出两组件框架：一是结合大语言模型、检索增强生成与思维链推理的 agentic AI，将用户输入转化为可解释的混合调度数学形式；二是基于近端策略优化（PPO）的分层深度强化学习，上层学习 UAV 路由，下层优化逐时隙任务执行与资源分配。
Result: 仿真结果表明所提框架能生成更一致的数学表述；分层 PPO 在最后 500 个回合中达到 99.6% 的全产品收集率与 100% 的任务截止时间满足率，且性能比 advantage actor-critic（A2C）方法更稳定。
Conclusion: 作者认为把 LLM 驱动的自动建模与分层 PPO 相结合，可以有效处理无人机物流调度与移动边缘计算耦合的混合调度问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Tracking the Truth: Object-Centric Spatio-Temporal Monitoring for Video Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced video understanding, they remain highly prone to hallucinations in dynamic scenes. We argue this stems from a failure in spatio-temporal monitoring, the ability to persistently track object identities, states, and relations over time. Existing benchmarks obscure this deficit by relying on single final-answer evaluations for queries that can often be resolved via local visual cues or statistical priors. To rigorously diagnose this, we introduce STEMO-Bench (Spatio-TEmporal MOnitoring), a benchmark of human-verified object-centric facts that evaluates intermediate reasoning by decomposing queries into sub-questions, distinguishing genuine temporal understanding from coincidental correctness. To address failure modes exposed by STEMO, we propose STEMO-Track, a novel object-centric framework that explicitly constructs and reasons over structured object trajectories via chunk-wise state extraction and temporal aggregation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our object-centric framework significantly reduces hallucinated answers and improves spatio-temporal reasoning consistency over state-of-the-art MLLMs.
papers.comment: The authors are withdrawing this manuscript due to errors identified in the experimental evaluation and result aggregation, which affect several reported quantitative results and some conclusions. These issues require substantial re-evaluation of the experiments and analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在动态场景中的幻觉问题，提出基于对象中心时空监控的评测基准 STEMO-Bench 与对象中心框架 STEMO-Track。摘要称该方法可减少幻觉回答并提升时空推理一致性，但作者已因实验评估与结果汇总中发现错误而撤稿，部分定量结果和结论受影响。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 在动态场景中容易产生幻觉，作者认为根源在于缺乏时空监控能力，即无法持续跟踪对象身份、状态和关系。已有基准只做单次最终答案评估，许多查询可借助局部视觉线索或统计先验解答，因而掩盖了这一缺陷。
Method: 提出 STEMO-Bench，包含人工验证的对象中心事实，通过将查询分解为子问题来评估中间推理，以区分真正的时序理解与偶然正确；同时提出 STEMO-Track，一种对象中心框架，通过分块状态提取 (chunk-wise state extraction) 和时间聚合显式构建并对结构化对象轨迹进行推理。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明该对象中心框架相较 SOTA MLLM 显著减少幻觉答案并提升时空推理一致性；但撤稿声明指出实验评估与结果聚合存在错误，影响多项定量结果和部分结论，需重新评估实验与分析。
Conclusion: 作者已撤回该稿件；尽管基准与框架的思路仍具参考价值，但当前版本中的实验证据不可靠，定量结论有待重新验证。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Can Attribution Predict Risk? From Multi-View Attribution to Planning Risk Signals in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving models generate future trajectories from multi-view inputs, improving system integration but introducing opaque decisions and hard-to-localize risks. Existing methods either rely on auxiliary monitoring models or generate textual explanations, but are decoupled from the planning process and fail to reveal the visual evidence underlying trajectory generation. While attribution offers a direct alternative, planning differs from image classification by taking six-view camera images as input and predicting continuous multi-step trajectories, requiring attribution to capture both critical views and regions and their influence on outputs. Moreover, whether attribution maps can support risk identification remains underexplored. To address this, we propose a hierarchical attribution framework for end-to-end planning. Specifically, using L2 consistency with the original trajectory as the objective, we design a coarse-to-fine region attribution strategy that searches candidate regions across the full six-view input and refines attribution within them. We further extract three attribution statistics as predictive signals for planning risk, including attribution entropy to measure how concentrated the planner's reliance is over the joint visual space, within-camera spatial variance to characterize how spread out the attribution is within each view, and cross-camera Gini coefficient to quantify how unevenly attribution is distributed across the six cameras. Experiments on BridgeAD, UniAD, and GenAD show that these statistics correlate with planning risk, achieving Spearman correlations of $0.30 \pm 0.07$ with trajectory error and AUROC of $0.77 \pm 0.04$ for collision detection. The signal generalizes to held-out scenes with negligible degradation and remains stable under an alternative attribution baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于端到端自动驾驶规划的分层归因框架，以与原始轨迹的L2一致性为目标，对六视角输入进行从粗到细的区域归因，并提取三种归因统计量作为规划风险信号。在BridgeAD、UniAD、GenAD上的实验显示，这些统计量与轨迹误差的Spearman相关为0.30±0.07，碰撞检测AUROC为0.77±0.04，且信号在未见场景和替代归因基线下表现稳定。
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶模型决策不透明，现有辅助监控或文本解释方法脱离规划过程，无法揭示轨迹生成背后的视觉证据。规划任务输入六视角图像并预测连续多步轨迹，归因需同时捕捉关键视角与区域及其对输出的影响，而归因图能否支持风险识别仍未充分探索。
Method: 提出分层归因框架：以原始轨迹的L2一致性为目标，设计从粗到细的区域归因策略，在完整六视角输入中搜索候选区域并细化归因；随后提取三种归因统计量——归因熵、相机内空间方差、跨相机Gini系数——作为规划风险预测信号。
Result: 在BridgeAD、UniAD和GenAD上的实验表明，这些统计量与轨迹误差的Spearman相关系数为0.30±0.07，碰撞检测AUROC为0.77±0.04；信号在未见场景上泛化且性能下降可忽略，并在另一种归因基线下保持稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要表明多视角归因统计量可作为端到端规划的可靠风险信号，展示了归因图用于风险识别的潜力；但相关性数值中等，仍需在更多模型和场景中验证其泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhancing Science Classroom Discourse Analysis through Joint Multi-Task Learning for Reasoning-Component Classification
papers.abstract_en: Analyzing the reasoning patterns of students in science classrooms is critical for understanding knowledge construction mechanism and improving instructional practice to maximize cognitive engagement, yet manual coding of classroom discourse at scale remains prohibitively labor-intensive. We present an automated discourse analysis system (ADAS) that jointly classifies teacher and student utterances along two complementary dimensions: Utterance Type and Reasoning Component derived from our prior CDAT framework. To address severe label imbalance among minority classes, we (1) stratify-resplit the annotated corpus, (2) apply LLM-based synthetic data augmentation targeting minority classes, and (3) train a dual-probe head RoBERTa-base classifier. A zero-shot GPT-5.4 baseline achieves macro-F1 of 0.467 on UT and 0.476 on RC, establishing meaningful upper bounds for prompt-only approaches motivating fine-tuning. Beyond classification, we conduct discourse pattern analyses including UTxRC co-occurrence profiling, Cognitive Complexity Index (CCI) computation per session, lag-sequential analysis, and IRF chain analysis, revealing that teacher Feedback-with-Question (Fq) moves are the most consistent antecedents of student inferential reasoning (SR-I). Our results demonstrate that LLM-based augmentation meaningfully improves UT minority-class recognition, and that the structural simplicity of the RC task makes it tractable even for lexical baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自动化课堂话语分析系统 (ADAS)，联合分类教师与学生话语的两个互补维度：Utterance Type 和 Reasoning Component（源自作者先前的 CDAT 框架）。为应对少数类标签严重不平衡，系统采用分层重切分语料、针对少数类的 LLM 合成数据增强以及双探针头 RoBERTa-base 分类器；零样本 GPT-5.4 基线在 UT 上 macro-F1 为 0.467、在 RC 上为 0.476。话语模式分析（UTxRC 共现、CCI、滞后序列分析、IRF 链分析）显示教师 Feedback-with-Question (Fq) 是学生推理 (SR-I) 最一致的前因。
Motivation: 科学课堂中学生推理模式的分析对理解知识建构机制和改进教学实践至关重要，但大规模课堂话语的人工编码成本过高，需要自动化手段。
Method: 提出 ADAS 系统，基于 CDAT 框架对课堂话语进行 Utterance Type 与 Reasoning Component 的联合多任务分类；针对少数类不平衡采用三种策略：分层重切分标注语料、LLM 合成数据增强、训练双探针头 RoBERTa-base 分类器，并以零样本 GPT-5.4 作为 prompt-only 基线。
Result: 零样本 GPT-5.4 在 UT 上 macro-F1 为 0.467、在 RC 上为 0.476；LLM 增强显著改善 UT 少数类识别；话语模式分析发现教师 Fq 移动是学生推理 SR-I 最一致的前因。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 LLM 合成增强能有效改善少数类识别，且 RC 任务结构简单到词法基线即可处理；未提及外部验证或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Granularity Gap: A Multi-Dimensional Cross-Generational Audit of Sycophancy in Gemini Models
papers.abstract_en: Pass/fail safety evaluation reports whether a model refused. It does not report how far a model went to please the user, and we show these are close to different measurements. We audited sycophancy across three Gemini generations, scoring N=8,830 responses from 8 model variants on 350 adversarial prompts in 7 categories under 3 guardrail conditions, on continuous 1-5 scales for sycophancy, truthfulness and refusal. The judge's own refuse-or-comply verdict explains 29% of the variance in its own sycophancy scores. We term the remainder the Granularity Gap, and it does not close under recalibration: the cut point already in use is the best available on the refusal axis, and no function of that axis explains more than 35%. Reading what four judges wrote while scoring shows why. On a quarter to a third of votes they record that the prompt asked for nothing harmful, almost never in the two categories that solicit a harmful act and up to half the time in the five that do not. A verdict built on refusal has nothing to grade there. Three findings follow. Sycophancy co-occurs with degraded judged truthfulness (rho=0.40), a coupling that strengthens across generations. Capability moved and resistance did not: Gemini 2.0 Flash scores 1.43 and Gemini 3.0 Pro Preview 1.42, with a sharp Gen 2.5 regression between them. And a single direct instruction outperforms an elaborate reasoning protocol in seven of eight variants, cutting mean severity in the most vulnerable category by 60.9%. We evaluate one judge's verdict, not a deployed safety classifier. We release the prompt set, the rubric, and 10,792 per-vote judge scores with their written reasoning.
papers.comment: v2: Major correction. Three v1 claims withdrawn (U-shaped detection curve, recalibration remedy, one reliability figure); the central 29% result survives. Adds a four-judge panel over a stratified 1,200-response sample, 10,792 votes with written reasoning. Data unchanged from v1. 21 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables. Itemized changelog and code: https://github.com/pskeough/The-Granularity-Gap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对三代 Gemini 模型进行跨代际的谄媚行为 (sycophancy) 审计，在 8 个模型变体、350 个对抗性提示、3 种防护栏条件下对 8,830 条回复按 1-5 连续量表评分。摘要发现，评判者自身的拒绝/服从二分判定只能解释其谄媚分数方差的 29%，剩余部分被作者称为粒度鸿沟 (Granularity Gap)，且该鸿沟在重新校准后仍无法闭合。基于四位评判者书面理由的分析显示，四分之一到三分之一的投票认为提示并未要求任何有害内容。
Motivation: 传统的通过/失败式安全评估只报告模型是否拒绝，而不报告模型在多大程度上迎合用户，作者认为这两者几乎是不同的测量。二进制判定无法覆盖那些未请求有害行为的提示，因此需要更细粒度的谄媚程度测量。
Method: 对多代 Gemini 模型的大规模回复进行连续的谄媚、真实性和拒绝评分，并引入由四位评判者组成的小组对分层抽样的 1,200 条回复进行投票并附书面推理，分析判定理由与评分之间的关系。
Result: 评判者的拒绝或服从判定仅解释其谄媚分数 29% 的方差，任何基于该轴的函数最多解释 35%。谄媚与判定真实性的下降相关 (rho=0.40)，跨代际增强；Gemini 2.0 Flash 得分为 1.43，Gemini 3.0 Pro Preview 为 1.42，中间出现 Gen 2.5 的明显回退。单一直接指令在八个变体中的七个优于复杂推理协议，在最脆弱类别将平均严重度降低 60.9%。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于拒绝的二元判定在无害提示上缺乏可评分的对象，无法捕捉谄媚程度，因此需要更细粒度的评估。该工作仅评估单一评判者的判定而非已部署的安全分类器，并公开了提示集、评分规则以及 10,792 条逐票评判理由。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LAGS: Low-Altitude Gaussian Splatting with Groupwise Heterogeneous Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Low-altitude Gaussian splatting (LAGS) facilitates 3D scene reconstruction by aggregating aerial images from distributed drones. However, as LAGS prioritizes maximizing reconstruction quality over communication throughput, existing low-altitude resource allocation schemes become inefficient. This inefficiency stems from their failure to account for image diversity introduced by varying viewpoints. To fill this gap, we propose a groupwise heterogeneous graph neural network (GW-HGNN) for LAGS resource allocation. GW-HGNN explicitly models the non-uniform contribution of different image groups to the reconstruction process, thus automatically balancing data fidelity and transmission cost. The key insight of GW-HGNN is to transform LAGS losses and communication constraints into graph learning costs for dual-level message passing. Experiments on real-world LAGS datasets demonstrate that GW-HGNN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks across key rendering metrics, including PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS. Furthermore, GW-HGNN reduces computational latency by approximately 100x compared to the widely-used MOSEK solver, achieving millisecond-level inference suitable for real-time deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GW-HGNN（groupwise heterogeneous graph neural network），用于低空高斯泼溅（LAGS）场景中多无人机影像传输的资源分配。该方法将 LAGS 重建损失与通信约束转化为图学习代价，通过分组异质图上的双层消息传递显式建模不同影像组对重建的非均匀贡献。实验显示其在真实 LAGS 数据集上的 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 等渲染指标显著超过现有基准，并将计算延迟较 MOSEK 求解器降低约 100 倍，达到毫秒级推理。
Motivation: 现有 LAGS 资源分配方案以最大化重建质量优先，未充分考虑通信吞吐量，也没有利用不同视角带来的影像多样性，导致分配效率低下。
Method: 提出 GW-HGNN，将图像按组建模为异质图节点，把 LAGS 损失和通信约束统一转化为图学习代价，并通过双层消息传递（dual-level message passing）自动权衡数据保真度与传输成本。
Result: 在真实 LAGS 数据集上，GW-HGNN 在 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 等关键渲染指标上显著优于现有基准，且计算延迟比广泛使用的 MOSEK 求解器降低约 100 倍，支持毫秒级实时推理。

papers.title: Towards In-Context Tone Style Transfer with A Large-Scale Triplet Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Tone style transfer for photo retouching aims to adapt the stylistic tone of the reference image to a given content image. However, the lack of high-quality large-scale triplet datasets with stylized ground truth forces existing methods to rely on self-supervised or proxy objectives, which limits model capability. To mitigate this gap, we design a data construction pipeline to build TST100K, a large-scale dataset of 100,000 content-reference-stylized triplets. At the core of this pipeline, we train a tone style scorer to ensure strict stylistic consistency for each triplet. In addition, existing methods typically extract content and reference features independently and then fuse them in a decoder, which may cause semantic loss and lead to inappropriate color transfer and degraded visual aesthetics. Instead, we propose ICTone, a diffusion-based framework that performs tone transfer in an in-context manner by jointly conditioning on both images, leveraging the semantic priors of generative models for semantic-aware transfer. Reward feedback learning using the tone style scorer is further incorporated to improve stylistic fidelity and visual quality. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of TST100K, and ICTone achieves state-of-the-art performance on both quantitative metrics and human evaluations. The project page is available online: https://dengyuhai.github.io/ICTone_Project/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对照片修图中的色调风格迁移（tone style transfer）提出大规模三元组数据集 TST100K 和扩散框架 ICTone。TST100K 包含 10 万个 content-reference-stylized 三元组，并通过训练色调风格评分器保证风格一致性；ICTone 以 in-context 方式联合条件化内容图像与参考图像，利用生成模型的语义先验进行语义感知的色调迁移，并引入基于评分器的奖励反馈学习。实验表明该方法在定量指标和人类评估上达到当前最优。
Motivation: 现有色调风格迁移方法缺乏带风格真值的高质量大规模三元组数据集，只能依赖自监督或代理目标，限制了模型能力；同时，现有方法通常独立提取内容与参考特征再在解码器中融合，可能导致语义丢失和不恰当的色彩迁移。
Method: 提出数据构建流水线生成 TST100K 三元组数据集，核心是训练一个色调风格评分器以确保严格风格一致性；提出扩散模型 ICTone，将内容与参考图像联合条件化实现 in-context 色调迁移，并利用风格评分器进行奖励反馈学习以提升风格保真度和视觉质量。
Result: 摘要报告 TST100K 的有效性得到实验验证，ICTone 在定量指标和人类评估上均达到 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 作者认为大规模高质量三元组数据与 in-context 联合条件化的扩散框架相结合，可以有效提升色调风格迁移的性能。

papers.title: PIEDet: Prototype-Driven Intrinsically Explainable Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Existing object detectors typically make predictions in a black-box manner and struggle to simultaneously provide discriminative evidence for their predictions, which limits their deployment in safety-critical scenarios. To explain model predictions, existing post-hoc explanation methods mostly rely on gradient-based or perturbation-based operators. These methods not only introduce additional memory and computational overhead but also make it difficult to ensure that the generated explanations faithfully reflect the model's internal decision-making process. To address these limitations, we propose PIEDet, a prototype-driven intrinsically explainable object detection framework. PIEDet innovatively embeds class prototypes as explicit discriminative units into the classification branch of a one-stage detector, thereby improving detection performance while providing intrinsic interpretability. First, PIEDet constructs hierarchical class prototypes at different detection levels, enabling the model to learn scale-aware class-semantic representations. Second, we propose a prototype-driven feature learning method consisting of prototype regularization and a region-to-prototype matching loss. The former enhances the inter-class discriminability of the prototypes, while the latter encourages prototype responses to focus on object regions. Finally, we introduce a scale-aligned hierarchical prototype supervision mechanism that assigns scale-matched supervision signals to different detection levels, thereby enhancing the scale specificity of the hierarchical prototypes. On the ExDark, RTTS, and VOC2012-FOG datasets, PIEDet improves mAP@0.5 over the baseline by 4.7%, 1.6%, and 4.8%, respectively, while demonstrating superior computational efficiency. Compared with mainstream post-hoc explanation methods, PIEDet achieves a better balance between explanation quality and explanation cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PIEDet，一种基于原型驱动 (prototype-driven) 的内在可解释目标检测框架，将类别原型嵌入单阶段检测器的分类分支，在提升检测性能的同时提供内在可解释性。通过分层原型构建、原型驱动特征学习以及尺度对齐的分层原型监督，PIEDet 在 ExDark、RTTS 和 VOC2012-FOG 数据集上较基线分别提升 mAP@0.5 4.7%、1.6% 和 4.8%，并比主流事后解释方法在解释质量与开销间取得更好平衡。
Motivation: 现有目标检测器以黑盒方式预测，难以提供判别性证据，限制安全关键场景部署。事后解释方法多依赖梯度或扰动算子，引入额外内存与计算开销，且难以保证解释忠实反映模型内部决策。
Method: 提出 PIEDet 框架：在不同检测层构造分层类别原型以学习尺度感知的类别语义表示；提出由原型正则化和区域到原型匹配损失组成的原型驱动特征学习方法，前者增强类间判别性，后者促使原型响应聚焦目标区域；引入尺度对齐的分层原型监督机制，为不同检测层分配尺度匹配的监督信号。
Result: 在 ExDark、RTTS 和 VOC2012-FOG 数据集上，PIEDet 较基线 mAP@0.5 分别提升 4.7%、1.6% 和 4.8%，且计算效率更优；与主流事后解释方法相比，解释质量与解释成本平衡更好。
Conclusion: PIEDet 表明将类别原型显式嵌入单阶段检测器可同时提升检测性能并提供内在可解释性，但论文只报告了三个数据集上的结果，未给出更多泛化性验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Observe Less, Understand More: Cost-aware Cross-scale Observation for Remote Sensing Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing understanding inherently requires multi-resolution observation, since different targets and application tasks demand different levels of spatial detail. While low-resolution (LR) imagery enables efficient global observation, high-resolution (HR) imagery provides critical local details at a much higher acquisition cost and with limited coverage. This motivates a cross-scale sensing strategy that selectively acquires HR imagery guided by LR-based global perception to improve task performance under constrained cost. Existing HR sampling methods typically make selection decisions from isolated LR patches, thereby ignoring fine-grained intra-patch importance and cross-patch contextual interactions, leading to fragmented feature representation and suboptimal scene reasoning under sparse HR observations. To address this issue, we formulate cross-scale remote sensing understanding as a unified cost-aware problem that couples fine-grained HR sampling with cross-patch representation prediction, enabling more effective task reasoning with fewer HR observations. Furthermore, we present GL-10M, a high- and low-resolution dataset with nearly 100,000 scene pairs and 10 million images for large-scale cross-resolution pretraining. Extensive experiments on recognition and retrieval tasks show that our method consistently achieves a superior performance-cost trade-off. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/xzhacc/CrossSO.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, and 5 tables. Accepted to ACM MM 2026. Updated to the camera-ready version and added supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/xzhacc/CrossSO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感理解中的多分辨率观测问题，提出一种成本感知的跨尺度观测方法，将细粒度高分辨率（HR）采样与跨图像块（cross-patch）表示预测耦合为统一问题，由低分辨率（LR）全局感知引导选择性获取HR细节。作者还构建了包含近10万场景对、1千万图像的GL-10M数据集用于跨分辨率预训练，实验表明该方法在识别与检索任务上取得更优的性能-成本权衡。
Motivation: 现有HR采样方法通常基于孤立的LR图像块做选择决策，忽略了图像块内部的细粒度重要性和跨图像块的上下文交互，导致在稀疏HR观测下特征表示碎片化、场景推理欠佳，无法在受限成本下有效提升任务性能。
Method: 将跨尺度遥感理解形式化为一个统一的成本感知问题，同时进行细粒度HR采样与跨图像块表示预测，并构建大规模高、低分辨率数据集GL-10M（近10万场景对、1千万图像）以支持跨分辨率预训练。
Result: 在识别和检索任务上的大量实验表明，所提方法始终取得更优的性能-成本权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将HR采样与跨图像块表示预测结合，能够在更少的HR观测下实现更有效的场景推理，并指出GL-10M数据集为大规模跨分辨率预训练提供支撑。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Flow Motion Policy: Manipulator Motion Planning with Flow Matching Models
papers.abstract_en: Open-loop end-to-end neural motion planners have recently been proposed to improve motion planning for robotic manipulators. These methods enable planning directly from sensor observations without relying on a privileged collision checker during motion planning. However, existing planners produce a single path for a given planning problem and cannot exploit their open-loop nature to propose multiple motion plans. To address this limitation, we introduce Flow Motion Policy, an open-loop neural motion planner that uses flow matching to generate a batch of motion plan proposals by learning a distribution over motion plans conditioned on the planning observation. At inference time, it samples multiple candidate motion plans to enable efficient best-of-$N$ inference while avoiding iterative collision checking during planning. We benchmark the Flow Motion Policy against representative sampling-based, optimization-based and neural motion planning methods. Evaluation results demonstrate that Flow Motion Policy improves planning success and efficiency, highlighting the effectiveness of stochastic generative policies for end-to-end motion planning and best-of-$N$ sampling. Project website: \href{https://davoodsz.github.io/FlowMotionPolicy.github.io/}{https://davoodsz.github.io/FlowMotionPolicy.github.io/}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Flow Motion Policy，一种基于流匹配 (flow matching) 的开环神经运动规划器，用于机械臂运动规划。它学习以规划观测为条件的运动计划分布，推理时采样多个候选计划实现 best-of-N 推断，从而避免规划过程中的迭代碰撞检测。与基于采样的、基于优化的和神经运动规划方法对比，该方法在规划成功率和效率上均有提升。
Motivation: 现有开环端到端神经运动规划器只能为给定规划问题生成单一路径，无法利用开环特性提出多个运动计划，限制了成功率和效率。
Method: 使用 flow matching 学习以规划观测为条件的运动计划分布，训练一个随机生成式策略；推理时从该分布中采样多个候选运动计划，通过 best-of-N 推断选择可行方案，同时省去规划中的迭代碰撞检查。
Result: 在与代表性的基于采样、基于优化及神经运动规划方法的基准对比中，Flow Motion Policy 提升了规划成功率和规划效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调随机生成式策略对端到端运动规划和 best-of-N 采样的有效性，展示该方法在机械臂开环运动规划上的优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Generalization in Reasoning SFT: A Conditional Analysis on Optimization, Data, and Model Capability
papers.abstract_en: A prevailing narrative in LLM post-training holds that supervised finetuning (SFT) memorizes while reinforcement learning (RL) generalizes. We revisit this claim for reasoning SFT with long chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision and find that cross-domain generalization is not absent but conditional, jointly shaped by optimization dynamics, training data, and base-model capability. Some reported failures are under-optimization artifacts: cross-domain performance first degrades before recovering and improving with extended training (a dip-and-recovery pattern), so shorttraining checkpoints can underestimate generalization. Data quality and structure both matter: low-quality solutions broadly hurt generalization,while verified long-CoT traces yield consistent cross-domain gains. Model capability is essential: stronger models internalize transferable procedural patterns (e.g., backtracking) even from a toy arithmetic game, while weaker ones imitate surface verbosity. This generalization is asymmetric, however: reasoning improves while safety degrades, reframing the question from whether reasoning SFT generalizes to under what conditions and at what cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文重新审视"SFT记忆、RL泛化"的流行叙事，针对使用长思维链(CoT)监督的推理SFT，发现跨领域泛化并非缺失而是有条件的，由优化动态、训练数据和基础模型能力共同决定。作者报告了性能先降后升的dip-and-recovery模式、低质量数据对泛化的普遍损害，以及强模型内化可迁移程序模式而弱模型仅模仿表面冗长的现象；泛化还呈现不对称性，即推理提升的同时安全表现下降。
Motivation: 现有后训练研究普遍认为SFT倾向于记忆而RL才带来泛化，但推理SFT的跨领域泛化失败可能只是欠优化或数据/模型条件不满足的产物。作者希望厘清推理SFT泛化真正出现的条件，而非简单否定其泛化能力。
Method: 采用条件分析视角，联合考察优化动态（训练长度）、数据质量与结构（验证过的长CoT轨迹）以及基础模型能力对跨领域泛化的影响，并通过玩具算术游戏等受控实验检验模型是否内化可迁移的过程性模式（如回溯）。
Result: 摘要报告：跨领域性能在扩展训练中先下降后回升并超越，短训练checkpoint会低估泛化；低质量解决方案普遍损害泛化，而验证过的长CoT轨迹带来一致的跨领域收益；更强模型能从小规模玩具任务中内化可迁移模式，较弱模型则模仿表面冗长；最终推理能力提升但安全指标下降。
Conclusion: 作者认为推理SFT的泛化是有条件的、不对称且有代价的，应将问题从"推理SFT是否泛化"重新表述为"在什么条件下泛化、以及付出什么代价"。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RAIN-FIT: Learning of Fitting Surfaces and Noise Distribution from Large Data Sets
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a method for estimating a surface that contains a given set of points from noisy measurements. More precisely, by assuming that the surface is described by the zero set of a function in the span of a given set of features and a parametric description of the distribution of the noise, a computationally efficient method is described that estimates both the surface and the noise distribution parameters. In the provided examples, polynomial and sinusoidal basis functions were used. However, any chosen basis that satisfies the outlined conditions mentioned in the paper can be approximated as a combination of trigonometric, exponential, and/or polynomial terms, making the presented approach highly generalizable. The proposed algorithm exhibits linear computational complexity in the number of samples. Our approach requires no hyperparameter tuning or data preprocessing and effectively handles data in dimensions beyond 2D and 3D. The theoretical results demonstrating the convergence of the proposed algorithm have been provided. To highlight the performance of the proposed method, comprehensive numerical results are conducted, evaluating our method against state-of-the-art algorithms, including Poisson Reconstruction and the Neural Network-based Encoder-X, on 2D and 3D shapes. The results demonstrate the superiority of our method under the same conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAIN-FIT，一种从含噪点云中同时估计曲面（给定特征张成空间中函数的零集）与噪声分布参数的方法。算法在样本数上具有线性计算复杂度，无需超参数调优或数据预处理，并支持 2D/3D 以上的高维数据。作者给出了收敛性理论分析，并在 2D 与 3D 形状上将 RAIN-FIT 与 Poisson Reconstruction 和基于神经网络的 Encoder-X 对比，声称在相同条件下表现更优。
Motivation: 从带噪声的测量点中恢复隐式曲面并刻画噪声分布是几何与信号处理中的基础问题；现有方法往往需要调参、预处理或较高的计算开销，缺乏兼具效率、泛化性与理论保证的统一方案。
Method: 假设曲面是给定特征函数张成空间中某个函数的零集，并对噪声分布采用参数化描述；在此基础上构建计算高效的目标，同时估计曲面函数与噪声分布参数。示例中采用多项式与正弦基函数，且任意满足条件的基均可由三角、指数和/或多项式项逼近。
Result: 摘要报告算法在样本量上呈线性复杂度；无需超参数调节或预处理；提供收敛性理论结果；在 2D/3D 形状上与 Poisson Reconstruction 和 Encoder-X 比较，数值结果显示在相同条件下 RAIN-FIT 更优。
Conclusion: 该方法因为基函数选择高度灵活而具有很强的可泛化性，并具备线性复杂度的实际可扩展性；作者强调其理论收敛保证与对高维数据的适用性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MathGen: Revealing the Illusion of Mathematical Competence through Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Modern generative models have demonstrated the ability to solve challenging mathematical problems. In many real-world settings, however, mathematical solutions must be expressed visually through diagrams, plots, geometric constructions, and structured symbolic layouts, where correctness depends on precise visual composition. This naturally raises the question of whether generative models can still do so when the answer must be rendered visually rather than written in text? To study this problem, we introduce MathGen, a rigorous benchmark of 420 problems spanning seven core domains, including 350 Clean-Scene problems and 70 paired Open-Scene problems. Each problem is evaluated under a Script-as-a-Judge protocol with problem-specific verification criteria implemented through reusable executable scripts for deterministic and reproducible evaluation. Experiments on representative open-source and proprietary text-to-image models show that mathematical fidelity remains a major bottleneck: even the best closed-source model reaches only 53.7% overall accuracy, while open-source models achieve just 1--11%, often near 0% on structured tasks, particularly those requiring precise geometric and functional rendering. Overall, current T2I models remain far from reliable at even elementary mathematical visual generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MathGen，一个包含 420 道数学视觉生成问题的基准，覆盖七个核心领域，其中 350 道 Clean-Scene 问题和 70 道配对 Open-Scene 问题。作者采用 Script-as-a-Judge 协议，用可执行脚本按问题特定验证标准进行确定性和可复现的评估。对代表性开源与闭源文生图（T2I）模型的评测显示，数学保真度仍是主要瓶颈：最强闭源模型总体准确率仅 53.7%，开源模型仅 1%–11%，在结构化任务上常接近 0%。
Motivation: 许多真实场景中的数学解答必须以图表、绘图、几何构造和结构化符号布局等视觉形式呈现，其正确性依赖精确的视觉组合；这引发了生成模型在答案必须视觉渲染而非文本书写时是否仍能胜任的问题。
Method: 构建 MathGen 基准，涵盖七个核心数学领域，并区分 Clean-Scene 与 Open-Scene 问题；每道题采用 Script-as-a-Judge 协议，通过可复用的可执行脚本实现问题特定的验证标准，以保证评估的确定性与可复现性。
Result: 实验表明最强闭源文生图模型在 MathGen 上总体准确率仅 53.7%，开源模型为 1%–11%，在需要精确几何与函数渲染的结构化任务上通常接近 0%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调当前文生图模型在即使初等数学视觉生成上也远未可靠，数学保真度是现有 T2I 模型的主要瓶颈。

papers.title: DiffSoup: Direct Differentiable Rasterization of Triangle Soup for Extreme Radiance Field Simplification
papers.abstract_en: Radiance field reconstruction aims to recover high-quality 3D representations from multi-view RGB images. Recent advances, such as 3D Gaussian splatting, enable real-time rendering with high visual fidelity on sufficiently powerful graphics hardware. However, efficient online transmission and rendering across diverse platforms requires drastic model simplification, reducing the number of primitives by several orders of magnitude. We introduce DiffSoup, a radiance field representation that employs a soup (i.e., a highly unstructured set) of a small number of triangles with neural textures and binary opacity. We show that this binary opacity representation is directly differentiable via stochastic opacity masking, enabling stable training without a mollifier (i.e., smooth rasterization). DiffSoup can be rasterized using standard depth testing, enabling seamless integration into traditional graphics pipelines and interactive rendering on consumer-grade laptops and mobile devices. Code is available at https://github.com/kenji-tojo/diffsoup.
papers.comment: v2: Corrected all parameter counts in the "# Params" column of Table 3, which were incorrectly reported as 10 times smaller. This correction does not affect the discussion or conclusions drawn from the comparison
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiffSoup 提出一种面向辐射场 (radiance field) 的极简表示：由少量三角形 (triangle soup) 配合神经纹理 (neural textures) 与二值不透明度 (binary opacity) 组成。作者证明该二值不透明度可通过随机不透明度掩蔽 (stochastic opacity masking) 直接微分，从而无需平滑光栅化 (mollifier) 即可稳定训练，并可用标准深度测试光栅化，兼容传统图形管线。
Motivation: 三维高斯泼溅 (3D Gaussian splatting) 等辐射场方法虽能实时渲染，但需要较强图形硬件；跨平台的在线传输与渲染需要将基元数量降低数个数量级的剧烈简化，现有方法难以在消费级设备上高效运行。
Method: 采用高度非结构化的少量三角形集合，每个三角形携带神经纹理和二值不透明度；通过随机不透明度掩蔽实现二值不透明度的直接可微训练，避免使用平滑光栅化；光栅化仅依赖标准深度测试，便于嵌入传统图形渲染管线。
Result: 摘要报告 DiffSoup 能无缝集成到传统图形管线，并在消费级笔记本和移动设备上实现交互式渲染；论文还公开了代码。摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为 DiffSoup 通过二值不透明度与标准深度测试的结合，实现了辐射场的极端简化与跨平台高效渲染；v2 修正了表 3 中参数数量的错误报告，但不影响比较结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DepthArb: Training-Free Depth-Arbitrated Generation for Occlusion-Robust Image Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image models often struggle to synthesize correct occlusion relationships among multiple objects, especially in densely overlapping regions. Many training-free layout-guided methods enforce 2D spatial constraints but do not explicitly resolve depth-dependent attention competition, which can cause concept mixing and implausible occlusion. To address this problem, we propose DepthArb, a training-free framework that formulates occlusion generation as attention arbitration within a unified denoising trajectory. DepthArb employs two core occlusion-control mechanisms: Attention Arbitration Modulation suppresses background-object attention within foreground support according to relative depth, while Spatial Compactness Control limits attention dispersion to preserve object coherence. Because interference varies during generation, Occlusion Conflict Estimation constructs a shared spatial conflict field to adaptively weight both objectives. Through a unified spatial-text attention interface, DepthArb operates on U-Net cross-attention and the image-to-text component of MMDiT joint attention without model retraining. We further introduce OcclBench, a benchmark with continuous relative-depth specifications and occlusion-specific evaluation metrics. Experiments on OcclBench and public benchmarks show that DepthArb improves several layout and occlusion metrics over the evaluated baselines while maintaining competitive text-image alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DepthArb，一个无需训练的文本到图像生成框架，将遮挡关系生成建模为统一去噪轨迹中的注意力仲裁问题。它通过注意力仲裁调制 (Attention Arbitration Modulation) 按相对深度抑制前景支撑区域内的背景目标注意力，并用空间紧致控制 (Spatial Compactness Control) 限制注意力分散，由遮挡冲突估计 (Occlusion Conflict Estimation) 自适应权衡两者。作者还引入带连续相对深度标注和遮挡专属指标的 OcclBench 基准，并在该基准与公开基准上验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 文生图模型在多个物体密集重叠区域常难以合成正确的遮挡关系。现有免训练的布局引导方法只施加二维空间约束，没有显式解决依赖深度的注意力竞争，导致概念混合和不合理的遮挡。
Method: DepthArb 是免训练框架，在统一去噪轨迹中把遮挡生成转化为注意力仲裁；核心包括按相对深度调节注意力的 Attention Arbitration Modulation、限制注意力弥散以保持物体一致性的 Spatial Compactness Control，以及构造共享空间冲突场来自适应加权两个目标的 Occlusion Conflict Estimation。该方法通过统一的空间-文本注意力接口同时作用于 U-Net 交叉注意力和 MMDiT 联合注意力的图像到文本部分，无需重新训练模型。
Result: 在 OcclBench 和公开基准上的实验表明，DepthArb 相比所评估的基线在多个布局与遮挡指标上取得提升，同时保持有竞争力的文本-图像对齐。
Conclusion: 作者认为无需重训练的 DepthArb 能通过注意力仲裁有效改善密集重叠区域中的遮挡生成，并且同时兼容 U-Net 与 MMDiT 架构。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: DepthArb 是免训练框架，在统一去噪轨迹中把遮挡生成转化为注意力仲裁；核心包括按相对深度调节注意力的 Attention Arbitration Modulation、限制注意力弥散以保持物体一致性的 Spatial Compactness Control，以及构造共享空间冲突场来自适应加权两个目标的 Occlusion Conflict Estimation。该方法通过统一的空间-文本注意力接口同时作用于 U-Net 交叉注意力和 MMDiT 联合注意力的图像到文本部分，无需重新训练模型。
summary_sections.result: 在 OcclBench 和公开基准上的实验表明，DepthArb 相比所评估的基线在多个布局与遮挡指标上取得提升，同时保持有竞争力的文本-图像对齐。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为无需重训练的 DepthArb 能通过注意力仲裁有效改善密集重叠区域中的遮挡生成，并且同时兼容 U-Net 与 MMDiT 架构。

papers.title: FrescoDiffusion: 4K Image-to-Video with Prior-Regularized Tiled Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based image-to-video (I2V) models are increasingly effective, yet they struggle to scale to ultra-high-resolution inputs (e.g., 4K). Generating videos at the model's native resolution often loses fine-grained structure, whereas high-resolution tiled denoising preserves local detail but breaks global layout consistency. This failure mode is particularly severe in the fresco animation setting: monumental artworks containing many distinct characters, objects, and semantically different sub-scenes that must remain spatially coherent over time. We introduce FrescoDiffusion, a training-free method for coherent large-format I2V generation from a single complex image. The key idea is to augment tiled denoising with a precomputed latent prior: we first generate a low-resolution video at the underlying model resolution and upsample its latent trajectory to obtain a global reference that captures long-range temporal and spatial structure. For 4K generation, we compute per-tile noise predictions and fuse them with this reference at every diffusion timestep by minimizing a single weighted least-squares objective in model-output space. The objective combines a standard tile-merging criterion with our regularization term, yielding a closed-form fusion update that strengthens global coherence while retaining fine detail. We additionally provide a spatial regularization variable that enables region-level control over where motion is allowed. Experiments on the VBench-I2V dataset and our proposed fresco I2V dataset show improved global consistency and fidelity over tiled baselines, while being computationally efficient. Our regularization enables explicit controllability of the trade-off between creativity and consistency.
papers.comment: 5 authors. Hugo Caselles-Dupré, Mathis Koroglu, and Guillaume Jeanneret contributed equally. 15 pages, 7 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FrescoDiffusion 是一种无需训练的 4K 图像到视频 (I2V) 生成方法，针对 tiled denoising 在高分辨率下破坏全局布局一致性的问题。其核心是用低分辨率视频的潜空间轨迹作为全局先验，在每次扩散时间步通过加权最小二乘目标融合各 tile 的噪声预测，从而在保持细节的同时强化全局一致性，并提供空间正则化变量控制运动区域。
Motivation: 扩散式 I2V 模型难以扩展到 4K 等超高分辨率输入：按模型原生分辨率生成会丢失细粒度结构，而高分辨率分块去噪 (tiled denoising) 虽保留局部细节却破坏全局布局一致性，这一失败模式在包含众多角色、物体和不同子场景的壁画 (fresco) 动画设置中尤为严重。
Method: 提出 FrescoDiffusion：先以底层模型分辨率生成低分辨率视频并上采样其潜空间轨迹，获得捕捉长程时空结构的全局参考先验；再在 4K 生成中对每个 tile 计算噪声预测，并在模型输出空间通过最小化一个加权最小二乘目标与该参考逐时间步融合，目标包含标准 tile 合并准则和正则化项，得到闭式融合更新；另引入空间正则化变量以控制局部运动。
Result: 在 VBench-I2V 数据集和作者提出的 fresco I2V 数据集上，相较于分块基线方法提升了全局一致性和保真度，同时保持计算高效；摘要还指出该正则化可显式控制创造力与一致性之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调训练无关的潜空间先验与分块去噪融合可以兼顾高分辨率细节与全局时空一致性，并支持区域级运动控制。

papers.title: Thinking with Gaze: Sequential Eye-Tracking as Visual Reasoning Supervision for Medical VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision--language models (VLMs) process images as visual tokens, yet their intermediate reasoning is often carried out in text, which can be suboptimal for visually grounded radiology tasks. Radiologists instead diagnose via sequential visual search; eye-tracking captures this process as time-ordered gaze trajectories that reveal how evidence is acquired over time. We use eye-gaze as supervision to guide VLM reasoning by introducing a small set of dedicated gaze tokens. These tokens are trained to predict gaze-selected image patch indices in temporal order, encouraging the model to follow human-like evidence acquisition and integration. Experiments on MIMIC-EYE and multiple external zero-shot benchmarks show consistent gains over baselines, achieving state-of-the-art in-domain performance and improved out-of-domain robustness. These results highlight temporally ordered gaze as an effective supervision signal for learning visually grounded medical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用眼动追踪（eye-tracking）作为医学视觉语言模型（VLM）的推理监督信号：在模型中引入一组专用的凝视 token（gaze tokens），训练其按时间顺序预测被注视的图像块索引，从而让模型模仿放射科医生逐次获取并整合视觉证据的方式。摘要报告在 MIMIC-EYE 和多个外部零样本基准上相比基线取得一致提升，域内达到最优，域外鲁棒性改善。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 的中间推理主要在文本空间进行，对依赖视觉定位的放射学任务而言不够理想；而放射科医生通过顺序视觉搜索来诊断，眼动轨迹能按时间顺序记录证据获取过程，但未被用作推理监督。
Method: 在医学 VLM 中加入一小批专用 gaze tokens，训练目标是以时间顺序预测凝视选中的图像块索引，以此监督模型学习类似人类的证据获取与整合模式。
Result: 在 MIMIC-EYE 及多个外部零样本基准上相对基线获得一致增益，域内性能达到 state-of-the-art，同时提升域外鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调时间有序的眼动轨迹可作为学习视觉化医学推理的有效监督信号。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Faster, Cheaper, More Accurate: Specialised Knowledge Tracing Models Outperform LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Predicting future student responses to questions is particularly valuable for educational learning platforms where it enables effective interventions. One of the key approaches to do this has been through the use of knowledge tracing (KT) models. These are small, domain-specific, temporal models trained on student question-response data. KT models are optimised for high accuracy on specific educational domains and have fast inference and scalable deployments. The rise of Large Language Models (LLMs) motivates us to ask the following questions: (1) How well can LLMs perform at predicting students' future responses to questions? (2) Are LLMs scalable for this domain? (3) How do LLMs compare to KT models on this domain-specific task? In this paper, we compare multiple LLMs and KT models across predictive performance, deployment cost, and inference speed to answer the above questions. We show that KT models outperform LLMs with respect to accuracy and F1 scores on this domain-specific task. Further, we demonstrate that LLMs are orders of magnitude slower than KT models and cost orders of magnitude more to deploy. This highlights the importance of domain-specific models for education prediction tasks and the fact that current closed source LLMs should not be used as a universal solution for all tasks.
papers.comment: Published as Poster at EDM 2026. Link: https://educationaldatamining.org/edm2026/proceedings/2026.EDM.poster-demo-papers.379/2026.EDM.poster-demo-papers.379.pdf. 7 pages, 6 figures. Prarthana Bhattacharyya and Joshua Mitton contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对教育平台预测学生未来答题表现的任务，系统比较了知识追踪（KT）模型与多个大语言模型（LLM）在预测性能、部署成本和推理速度上的差异。结果显示KT模型在准确率和F1分数上均优于LLM，而LLM的推理速度慢数个数量级、部署成本高数个数量级。作者据此强调领域专用模型在教育预测任务中的价值。
Motivation: 教育平台需要准确预测学生未来答题响应以支持有效干预，传统KT模型是这一领域的主流方法；LLM的兴起促使作者追问LLM在该领域能否匹敌或超越KT模型，以及其可扩展性和成本是否可行。
Method: 在特定教育领域的答题预测任务上，作者对多个LLM与多个KT模型进行对比评估，考察指标包括预测性能（accuracy与F1）、部署成本与推理速度。
Result: KT模型在准确率和F1分数上均超过LLM；LLM的推理速度比KT模型慢数个数量级，部署成本高数个数量级。
Conclusion: 结果表明领域专用模型对教育预测任务仍然至关重要，当前闭源LLM不应被视为适用于所有任务的通用解决方案。

papers.title: mmWave Radar Aware Dual-Conditioned GAN for Speech Reconstruction of Signals With Low SNR
papers.abstract_en: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar captures are band-limited and noisy, making for difficult reconstruction of intelligible full-bandwidth speech. In this work, we propose a two-stage speech reconstruction pipeline for mmWave using a Radar-Aware Dual-conditioned Generative Adversarial Network (RAD-GAN), which is capable of performing bandwidth extension on signals with low signal-to-noise ratios (-5 dB to -1 dB), captured through glass walls. We propose an mmWave-tailored Multi-Mel Discriminator (MMD) and a Residual Fusion Gate (RFG) to enhance the generator input to process multiple conditioning channels. The proposed two-stage pipeline involves pretraining the model on synthetically clipped clean speech and finetuning on fused mel spectrograms generated by the RFG. We empirically show that the proposed method, trained on a limited dataset, with no pre-trained modules, and no data augmentations, outperformed state-of-the-art approaches for this specific task. Audio examples of RAD-GAN are available online at https://rad-gan-demo-site.vercel.app/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAD-GAN，一种面向毫米波雷达语音重建的两阶段 GAN 管道，针对低信噪比（-5 dB 至 -1 dB）并经玻璃墙采集的带限噪声信号进行带宽扩展。方法包括 mmWave 定制的 Multi-Mel Discriminator (MMD) 和 Residual Fusion Gate (RFG)，先在合成裁剪干净语音上预训练，再在 RFG 生成的融合 mel 谱图上微调。实验显示在有限数据集、无预训练模块、无数据增强条件下优于该任务的现有 SOTA 方法，并提供了在线音频示例。
Motivation: 毫米波雷达捕获的信号带限且噪声大，难以重建可理解的智能全带宽语音；低信噪比场景下的语音重建是该任务的主要难点。
Method: 提出两阶段重建管道：先在合成裁剪的干净语音上预训练模型，再在 RFG 生成的融合 mel 谱图上微调；同时提出 mmWave 定制的 Multi-Mel Discriminator (MMD) 和 Residual Fusion Gate (RFG)，用于增强生成器对多条件通道的处理。
Result: 摘要报告该模型在低 SNR（-5 dB 至 -1 dB）、经玻璃墙采集的信号上，以有限数据集、无预训练模块、无数据增强的设置，性能优于该任务的现有 SOTA 方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RAD-GAN 能有效完成低 SNR 毫米波雷达语音的带宽扩展，并提供在线音频示例供主观评估；摘要未提及明显局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Synthetic Image Detection with CLIP: Understanding and Assessing Predictive Cues
papers.abstract_en: Recent generative models produce near-photorealistic images, challenging the trustworthiness of photographs. Synthetic image detection (SID) methods, however, often struggle to generalize across datasets and generative models. CLIP, which embeds images and text in a shared semantic space, performs well at SID, but the cues underlying its decisions remain poorly understood. We therefore study CLIP-based SID as an empirical interpretability problem rather than proposing a new detector. We introduce SynthCLIC, which pairs real photographs with caption-matched, high-quality diffusion-generated counterparts. We evaluate CLIP-based detectors on SynthCLIC, a GAN-heavy benchmark, and a broad external benchmark, and compare them with a low-level forensic CNN, a broad-generator detector, and a text-grounded concept model. CLIP-based linear detectors reach 0.96 mAP on the GAN-heavy benchmark but 0.92 on SynthCLIC, while cross-family transfer to CNNSpot falls to 0.42 mAP. Within-class associations between detector scores and text-derived cue scores show that higher synthetic scores correspond to cleaner, more compositionally controlled, and technically polished images, whereas lower scores correspond to messier capture conditions and provenance cues characteristic of real photographs. These associations are distributed across many overlapping cues, and their profiles differ strongly across training datasets. CLIP-based and forensic detectors therefore fail in different ways and provide complementary evidence, while broad generator coverage appears important for robust SID.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将基于 CLIP 的合成图像检测 (Synthetic Image Detection, SID) 当作经验可解释性问题来研究，而非提出新检测器。作者构建了 SynthCLIC 数据集，将真实照片与标题匹配的高质量扩散生成图像配对，并在 SynthCLIC、GAN 为主的基准和外部基准上评估 CLIP 检测器，同时与低层取证 CNN、宽生成器检测器和文本接地概念模型对比。结果表明 CLIP 线性检测器在 GAN 为主基准上达到 0.96 mAP，在 SynthCLIC 上为 0.92 mAP，但跨生成族迁移到 CNNSpot 时降至 0.42 mAP。
Motivation: 现有生成模型能产生接近照片级的图像，威胁照片可信度，而 SID 方法常难以跨数据集和生成模型泛化；CLIP 在 SID 上表现良好，但其决策背后的线索仍缺乏理解。
Method: 引入 SynthCLIC 配对数据集，系统评估 CLIP 检测器在多个基准上的表现，并与低层取证 CNN、宽生成器检测器及文本接地概念模型对比；通过分析检测器分数与文本派生线索分数之间的类内关联来揭示预测线索。
Result: CLIP 线性检测器在 GAN 为主基准上达到 0.96 mAP，在 SynthCLIC 上为 0.92 mAP，跨生成族迁移到 CNNSpot 时降至 0.42 mAP；较高的合成分数对应更干净、构图更可控、技术上更精致的图像，较低分数对应更混乱的拍摄条件和真实照片的溯源线索，且这些关联分布广泛、随训练数据集变化明显。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CLIP 检测器与取证检测器以不同方式失效并具有互补证据，而宽广的生成器覆盖范围对稳健的 SID 似乎很重要。

papers.title: Adaptive Optimization via Momentum on Variance-Normalized Gradients
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MVN-Grad (Momentum on Variance-Normalized Gradients), an Adam-style optimizer that improves stability and performance by combining two complementary ideas: variance-based normalization and momentum applied after normalization. MVN-Grad scales each coordinate by an exponential moving average of gradient uncertainty and applies momentum to the resulting normalized gradients, removing the cross-time coupling between stale momentum and a stochastic normalizer present in standard Adam-type updates. We prove that this decoupling yields smaller one-step conditional update variance than momentum-then-normalize variance methods, and that MVN-Grad has a uniformly bounded response to isolated gradient spikes. In low-variance regimes, we further show that variance normalization avoids sign-type collapse of second-moment scaling and can yield accelerated convergence. Beyond these comparisons, we prove a general nonconvex convergence guarantee for MVN-Grad under bounded-gradient stochastic assumptions. On CIFAR-100 and GPT-style language modeling, MVN-Grad matches or improves on Adam, AdaBelief, and LaProp, delivering smoother training and better generalization at the cost of one additional state tensor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MVN-Grad（Momentum on Variance-Normalized Gradients），一种 Adam 风格优化器，通过“先按方差归一化、再施加动量”的组合改善训练稳定性与性能。作者证明这种解耦能降低一步条件更新方差、对孤立梯度尖峰有一致有界响应，并给出非凸随机优化下的收敛保证。在 CIFAR-100 与 GPT 风格语言建模上，MVN-Grad 匹配或超过 Adam、AdaBelief 与 LaProp，只多一个状态张量。
Motivation: 标准 Adam 类更新中存在陈旧动量 (stale momentum) 与随机归一化器之间的跨时间耦合，且在低方差区域二阶矩缩放可能出现符号型坍缩；这些问题影响优化稳定性和泛化。
Method: MVN-Grad 对每个坐标用梯度不确定性的指数移动平均 (EMA) 做缩放，再对归一化后的梯度施加动量，即归一化在前、动量在后；这种方法去除了 Adam 中动量与归一化器的耦合。作者并给出一步更新方差、梯度尖峰响应以及一般非凸条件下的收敛性理论证明。
Result: 摘要报告：相比先动量后归一化 (momentum-then-normalize) 的方法，MVN-Grad 的一步条件更新方差更小；对孤立梯度尖峰的响应一致有界；低方差区域可避免符号型坍缩并加速收敛。实验上在 CIFAR-100 和 GPT 风格语言建模中匹配或超过 Adam、AdaBelief、LaProp，且训练更平滑、泛化更好。
Conclusion: 作者认为将方差归一化与后置动量解耦可以提升优化稳定性与泛化，代价是额外一个状态张量；方法在一般非凸假设下具有收敛保证。

papers.title: Misconception Diagnosis From Student-Tutor Dialogue: Generate, Retrieve, Rerank
papers.abstract_en: Timely and accurate identification of student misconceptions is key to improving learning outcomes and pre-empting the compounding of student errors. However, this task is highly dependent on the effort and intuition of the teacher. In this work, we present a novel approach for detecting misconceptions from student-tutor dialogues using large language models (LLMs). First, we use a fine-tuned LLM to generate plausible misconceptions, and then retrieve the most promising candidates among these using embedding similarity with the input dialogue. These candidates are then assessed and re-ranked by another fine-tuned LLM to improve misconception relevance. Empirically, we evaluate our system on real dialogues from an educational tutoring platform. We consider multiple base LLM models including LLaMA, Qwen and Claude on zero-shot and fine-tuned settings. We find that our approach improves predictive performance over baseline models and that fine-tuning improves both generated misconception quality and can outperform larger closed-source models. Finally, we conduct ablation studies to both validate the importance of our generation and reranking steps on misconception generation quality.
papers.comment: Published as Oral Paper at Learning at Scale, 2026. Link: https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3774398.3811609. 21 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Joshua Mitton and Prarthana Bhattacharyya contributed equally to this paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从学生-导师对话中自动诊断学生误解的方法，流程为先用微调LLM生成合理误解，再用嵌入相似度检索候选，最后用另一个微调LLM对候选重排以提升相关性。系统在真实教育辅导平台对话上评估，比较了LLaMA、Qwen、Claude等基座模型在零样本和微调设置下的表现，结果显示该方法优于基线，且微调能提升生成质量并超越更大的闭源模型。消融实验验证了生成与重排步骤对误解生成质量的重要性。
Motivation: 及时准确地识别学生误解对改善学习效果和防止错误累积至关重要，但该任务高度依赖教师个人投入与直觉，缺乏自动化手段。
Method: 采用生成-检索-重排 (generate, retrieve, rerank) 流水线：先用微调LLM生成候选误解，通过嵌入相似度从候选中检索与输入对话最匹配者，再由另一个微调LLM对这些候选重新排序以提高相关性。
Result: 在真实辅导平台对话上，该方法在零样本与微调设置下均优于基线模型；微调不仅提升生成误解的质量，还能使较小开源模型超越更大闭源模型。消融实验确认生成步骤与重排步骤对最终质量均有贡献。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该生成-检索-重排框架能有效提升对话场景下的误解诊断性能，并指出微调对模型能力的增强作用；摘要未提及明确局限。
Relevance: 5
