papers.title: The Fake Friend Dilemma: Relational Trust and the Political Economy of Conversational AI
papers.abstract_en: As conversational AI systems become a larger part of the media landscape, they raise questions about whose interests they serve and the risks they may pose to users. These systems do more than provide information: they increasingly offer advice and companionship through interfaces that can appear supportive and socially responsive. A pressing concern is that users may form social or interpersonal relationships with these systems and place relational trust in them, even when the interests shaping interactions do not fully align with their own. The Fake Friend Dilemma (FFD) describes the problem that follows: the same relational trust that makes conversational AI useful can also leave users open to manipulation and exploitation when institutional interests conflict with their own. Drawing on work on trust, AI alignment, dark patterns, and surveillance capitalism, the paper considers how the FFD can manifest through product sales, propaganda and biased information, behavioral nudging, and surveillance. It also considers possible structural and technical mitigation strategies. The FFD is not simply about AI misleading users. The problem it surfaces is that the trust people place in these systems can itself become a resource for institutional actors seeking to influence behavior or extract information. The FFD is therefore as much a problem of media governance and political economy as it is a technological one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“假朋友困境”(Fake Friend Dilemma, FFD)这一概念，用以描述对话式AI系统中关系信任带来的风险：用户可能与AI建立社会或人际关系并给予信任，而当制度性利益与用户自身利益冲突时，这种信任会被利用于操纵和剥削。论文从信任、AI对齐、暗黑模式和监视资本主义等文献出发，分析FFD在产品销售、宣传与偏见信息、行为助推和监视中的表现，并讨论结构性与技术性缓解策略。作者认为FFD同时是媒体治理和政治经济问题，而不只是技术问题。
Motivation: 对话式AI越来越多地提供建议和陪伴，用户可能对其形成人际信任，但塑造这些交互的制度利益未必与用户一致。论文旨在指出这种关系信任本身可被机构利用来影响行为或提取信息，从而构成需要治理框架关注的系统性风险。
Method: 论文采用理论分析而非实证方法，提出FFD框架，整合信任研究、AI对齐、暗黑模式和监视资本主义相关文献，剖析该困境在四类场景中的具体表现（产品售卖、宣传与偏见信息、行为助推、监视），并考察可能的结构性改革与技术缓解途径。
Result: 摘要未报告实证数据；其主要理论结果是提出并论证FFD的存在机制，即人们赋予AI系统的信任可成为制度行为者的操纵资源，因而该问题超越单纯的AI误导，牵涉媒体治理与政治经济层面。
Conclusion: 摘要强调FFD既是一个技术问题，更是一个媒体治理和政治经济问题；应对需要同时考虑结构性安排与技术手段，论文本身仍处于稿件评审阶段。

papers.title: High-Resolution Probabilistic Data-Driven Weather Modeling with a Stretched-Grid
papers.abstract_en: We present a probabilistic data-driven weather model providing ensembles of high spatial resolution realizations of 87 variables at arbitrary ensemble size and forecast length. The model uses a global stretched grid, dedicating 2.5 km resolution to our Nordic region of interest and 31 km resolution elsewhere, with 6-hour temporal resolution. Unique ensemble members are generated by a stochastic model architecture, and we train it using a loss function based on the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) evaluated in grid-point and spectral space. The spectral loss component is shown to be necessary to create fields that are spatially coherent, which is not the case when training with mean-squared error loss, nor CRPS in grid-point space only. We evaluate the forecasts against observations from surface weather stations and compare them to high-resolution operational numerical weather prediction forecasts from the MetCoOp Ensemble Prediction System (MEPS). The model shows lower CRPS than MEPS for 2 m temperature and mean sea-level pressure, with average improvements of 13\% and 10\%, respectively, while differences for wind speed and precipitation are smaller. For Storm Dave, the model captures the location and structure of strong-wind systems, but underestimates the peak winds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个概率数据驱动天气模型，利用全球拉伸网格（stretched grid）在目标北欧区域提供2.5 km分辨率并在其他区域提供31 km分辨率，可生成任意集合大小和预报时长的87变量高分辨率集合预报。模型采用随机架构生成集合成员，并以网格点空间和谱空间上的连续排序概率分数（CRPS）作为训练损失，其中谱损失被证明是生成空间连贯场的关键。与高分辨率业务数值预报系统MEPS对比，模型在2 m温度和平均海平面气压上取得更低的CRPS，平均改进分别为13%和10%，风速和降水差异较小；对Storm Dave能捕捉强风系统的位置和结构，但低估峰值风速。
Motivation: 数据驱动天气预报需要高分辨率且具有概率校准能力，但仅用均方误差或仅用网格点空间CRPS训练难以产生空间连贯的场；本文针对这一缺口，提出在网格点和谱空间联合优化CRPS的高分辨率集合预报建模方案。
Method: 使用全球拉伸网格在感兴趣区域加密分辨率，通过随机模型架构生成唯一的集合成员，并采用基于CRPS的损失函数在网格点空间和谱空间联合训练；谱空间的损失项用于保证预测场的空间相干性。
Result: 该模型的2 m温度和平均海平面气压CRPS优于高分辨率业务集合预报系统MEPS，平均改进分别为13%和10%；风速和降水的差异较小。在Storm Dave个例中，模型能捕捉强风系统的位置与结构，但低估峰值风速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调谱空间CRPS损失对空间连贯场是必要的，并表明该数据驱动概率模型在高分辨率预报上能达到或接近业务系统的水平，但在极端峰值风速等强事件上仍有系统性低估。

summary_sections.motivation: 数据驱动天气预报需要高分辨率且具有概率校准能力，但仅用均方误差或仅用网格点空间CRPS训练难以产生空间连贯的场；本文针对这一缺口，提出在网格点和谱空间联合优化CRPS的高分辨率集合预报建模方案。
summary_sections.method: 使用全球拉伸网格在感兴趣区域加密分辨率，通过随机模型架构生成唯一的集合成员，并采用基于CRPS的损失函数在网格点空间和谱空间联合训练；谱空间的损失项用于保证预测场的空间相干性。
summary_sections.result: 该模型的2 m温度和平均海平面气压CRPS优于高分辨率业务集合预报系统MEPS，平均改进分别为13%和10%；风速和降水的差异较小。在Storm Dave个例中，模型能捕捉强风系统的位置与结构，但低估峰值风速。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调谱空间CRPS损失对空间连贯场是必要的，并表明该数据驱动概率模型在高分辨率预报上能达到或接近业务系统的水平，但在极端峰值风速等强事件上仍有系统性低估。

papers.title: Inference for Similarity and Alignability between Noisy High-Dimensional Datasets
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of high-dimensional datasets across a wide range of scientific domains has created an urgent need for new statistical methods to compare distributions with underlying low-dimensional structure. Assessing similarity between high-dimensional datasets whose observations concentrate near low-dimensional manifolds is particularly challenging due to the nontrivial effects of noise in high dimensions. We propose a principled framework for statistical inference on the similarity and alignability of high-dimensional datasets with low-dimensional smooth signals under heterogeneous noise. The key idea is to link the spectral properties of the observed data matrices to the geometry of their underlying signal distributions. Under a manifold signal-plus-noise model, we build on the principal variances associated to the underlying signals and develop a scale- and rotation-invariant dissimilarity measure between two datasets that may differ in sample size and noise structure. We further construct an estimator of the dissimilarity and a statistical test of dataset alignability, namely, whether the dissimilarity vanishes. The proposed methodology and its theoretical guarantees under high-dimensional asymptotic settings draw on recent advances in random matrix theory (RMT). The proposed framework accommodates heterogeneous noise across datasets and provides a fast, theoretically grounded approach to comparing high-dimensional datasets with low-dimensional structures. Through extensive simulations and analyses of multiple single-cell datasets, we demonstrate that the proposed method substantially outperforms existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个在高维渐近框架下比较具有低维结构的高维数据集的统计推断框架。作者在流形信号加噪声模型 (manifold signal-plus-noise model) 下，将观测数据矩阵的谱性质与底层信号分布的几何结构联系起来，构建了尺度与旋转不变的相异度度量及其估计量，并给出数据集可对齐性 (alignability) 的统计检验。通过模拟和多个单细胞数据集的实验，摘要称该方法显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 随着高维数据集在科学领域的快速增长，需要新的统计方法来比较具有底层低维结构的数据分布；当观测集中在低维流形附近时，高维噪声的影响使得数据集间的相似性评估变得特别困难。
Method: 在流形信号加噪声模型下，基于底层信号相关的主方差 (principal variances) 构建一个对不同样本量和噪声结构都适用的尺度与旋转不变的相异度度量；进一步构造该度量的估计量以及检验相异度是否为零的可对齐性检验，理论保证借助随机矩阵论 (random matrix theory, RMT) 的近期进展。
Result: 广泛的模拟实验以及对多个单细胞数据集的分析表明，所提出的方法在性能上大幅优于现有方法。摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 该框架能够容纳跨数据集的异质噪声，并提供一种快速且有理论依据的高维数据集比较途径，特别适用于具有低维结构的数据；摘要强调其相对于现有方法的显著优势。

papers.title: DRL-Guided Neural Batch Sampling for Semi-Supervised Pixel-Level Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection in industrial visual inspection is challenging due to the scarcity of defective samples. Most existing methods rely on unsupervised reconstruction using only normal data, often resulting in overfitting and poor detection of subtle defects. We propose a semi-supervised deep reinforcement learning framework that integrates a neural batch sampler, an autoencoder, and a predictor. The RL-based sampler adaptively selects informative patches by balancing exploration and exploitation through a composite reward. The autoencoder generates loss profiles highlighting abnormal regions, while the predictor performs segmentation in the loss-profile space. This interaction enables the system to effectively learn both normal and defective patterns with limited labeled data. Experiments on the MVTec AD dataset demonstrate that our method achieves higher accuracy and better localization of subtle anomalies than recent state-of-the-art approaches while maintaining low complexity, yielding an average improvement of 0.15 in F1_max and 0.06 in AUC, with a maximum gain of 0.37 in F1_max in the best case.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业视觉检测中缺陷样本稀缺的问题，提出一个半监督深度强化学习框架，将神经批次采样器、自编码器和预测器整合在一起。基于强化学习的采样器通过复合奖励平衡探索与利用，自适应选择信息量大的图块；自编码器生成突出异常区域的损失图谱，预测器在该损失图谱空间中进行分割。在 MVTec AD 数据集上的实验表明，该方法在准确率和细微缺陷定位上优于近期最先进方法，平均 F1_max 提升 0.15、AUC 提升 0.06，最佳情况下 F1_max 最大提升 0.37。
Motivation: 工业视觉检测中缺陷样本稀少，现有方法多依赖仅含正常数据的无监督重建，容易过拟合且对细微缺陷检测效果差。
Method: 提出半监督深度强化学习框架，包含神经批次采样器、自编码器和预测器：RL 采样器以复合奖励平衡探索与利用，选择信息丰富的图块；自编码器生成突出异常区域的损失图谱；预测器在损失图谱空间完成分割。
Result: 在 MVTec AD 数据集上，该方法比近期最先进方法获得更高精度和更好的细微缺陷定位，平均 F1_max 提升 0.15、AUC 提升 0.06，最佳情况 F1_max 最大提升 0.37，且保持较低复杂度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调采样器、自编码器与预测器的交互使系统能在有限标注下同时学习正常与缺陷模式，并有效定位细微缺陷。

papers.title: Last-Iterate Analyses of FTRL with the 1/2-Tsallis Entropy in Stochastic Bandits
papers.abstract_en: The convergence analysis of online learning algorithms is central to machine learning theory, where the last-iterate convergence is particularly important, as it captures the learner's actual decisions and describes the evolution of the learning process over time. However, in multi-armed bandits, most existing algorithmic analyses mainly focus on the order of regret, while the last-iterate (simple regret) convergence rate remains less explored---especially for the widely studied Follow-the-Regularized-Leader (FTRL) algorithms. Recently, FTRL with the $1/2$-Tsallis entropy regularizer $Ψ(p) = -4\sum_{i=1}^d \sqrt{p_i}$ (the $1/2$-Tsallis-INF algorithm, by arXiv:1807.07623) was shown to achieve the desirable Best-of-Both-Worlds (BOBW) guarantees and perform well in both adversarial and stochastic settings. Nevertheless, its last-iterate convergence rate has not yet been fully studied. This paper studies the $1/2$-Tsallis-INF algorithm in stochastic bandits and shows that its sampling simple regret decays at rate $\mathcal{O}(t^{-1})$, without requiring the optimal arm to be unique. Under a unique optimal arm, we further show that the expected Bregman divergence induced by $Ψ$ between the point mass on the optimal arm and the sampling distribution at iteration $t$ decays at rate $\mathcal{O}(t^{-1/2})$. Matching lower bounds under the same uniqueness condition show that both exponents of $t$ are tight.
papers.comment: Substantially revised; adds $\mathcal{O}(t^{-1})$ simple-regret upper and lower bounds and allows multiple optimal arms in the upper bound
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机多臂老虎机中 1/2-Tsallis-INF 算法的最后迭代收敛性，该算法是使用 1/2-Tsallis 熵正则项 Ψ(p)=-4∑√p_i 的 FTRL 变体。摘要证明其采样简单遗憾 (simple regret) 以 O(t^{-1}) 速率衰减，且不要求最优臂唯一；在唯一最优臂条件下，最优臂点质量与迭代 t 处采样分布之间的期望 Bregman 散度以 O(t^{-1/2}) 衰减，并给出匹配下界说明两个指数均紧。
Motivation: 在线学习算法的最后迭代收敛刻画学习者的实际决策与动态过程，但多臂老虎机中多数分析只关注遗憾阶数，FTRL 类算法的简单遗憾收敛率研究较少；1/2-Tsallis-INF 已被证明具有 Best-of-Both-Worlds 保证，但其最后迭代收敛率尚未被充分研究。
Method: 对随机老虎机环境下的 1/2-Tsallis-INF 算法进行最后迭代分析，分别推导采样分布简单遗憾的上界，以及在唯一最优臂条件下由 Ψ 诱导的期望 Bregman 散度上界，并在相同唯一性条件下构造匹配下界。
Result: 摘要报告采样简单遗憾以 O(t^{-1}) 衰减且无需唯一最优臂；在唯一最优臂条件下，期望 Bregman 散度以 O(t^{-1/2}) 衰减，匹配下界表明两个速率指数的阶数都是紧的。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了 1/2-Tsallis-INF 算法最后迭代收敛率的空白，证明其在随机老虎机中的收敛速率刻画是紧的；摘要为纯理论结果，未涉及任何实际应用场景。

papers.title: Comprehensive language-image pre-training for 3D medical image understanding
papers.abstract_en: In the 3D medical image domain, vision-language pre-training is used to create vision-language encoders (VLEs) that can support radiologists by retrieving patients with similar abnormalities, predicting likelihoods of abnormality, or, with downstream adaptation, generating radiological reports. While the methodology holds promise, three challenges limit the capabilities of current 3D VLEs: data scarcity due to privacy concerns, high computational costs resulting from the volumetric nature of the images, and a domain shift between the long reports used for training and the short prompts used during inference for, e.g., zero-shot classification. As a consequence, natural-image VLE recipes do not directly transfer to 3D medical imaging. In this paper, we overcome these challenges by injecting additional supervision via a report generation objective and combining vision-language with vision-only pre-training, allowing us to leverage both image-only and paired image-text 3D datasets. Further, we propose a novel loss that addresses the domain shift between long reports and short textual prompts. Through these additional objectives, paired with best practices of the 3D medical imaging domain, we develop the Comprehensive Language-Image Pre-training (COLIPRI) encoder family. Our COLIPRI encoders achieve state-of-the-art performance in report generation, semantic segmentation, classification probing, and zero-shot classification. The model weights and inference code are freely available at https://huggingface.co/microsoft/colipri.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对3D医学图像中的视觉-语言预训练，提出语言-图像综合预训练（COLIPRI）编码器家族。作者通过报告生成目标注入额外监督，并将视觉-语言预训练与纯视觉预训练结合，以同时利用图像-only和配对图像-文本的3D数据集；同时提出新损失处理长报告与短文本提示之间的域偏移。摘要报告COLIPRI在报告生成、语义分割、分类探测和零样本分类上达到当前最优，且模型权重与推理代码已公开。
Motivation: 当前3D医学视觉-语言编码器（VLE）受限于数据稀缺（隐私问题）、体数据带来的高计算成本，以及训练用长报告与推理时短提示之间的域偏移，导致自然图像VLE配方无法直接迁移到3D医学成像。
Method: 通过在预训练中加入报告生成目标来增加额外监督，并把视觉-语言与纯视觉预训练目标相结合；此外提出一个新的损失函数以缓解长报告与短文本提示间的域偏移，并结合3D医学成像领域的最佳实践构建COLIPRI编码器家族。
Result: 摘要声称COLIPRI编码器在报告生成、语义分割、分类探测和零样本分类任务上均达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为额外监督目标与领域最佳实践的结合能有效提升3D医学VLE能力，并公开了模型权重和推理代码供社区使用。

papers.title: Dissecting Embodied Abilities in Multimodal Language Models through Skill-level Evaluation and Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the capability bottlenecks of embodied multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is crucial for improving embodied agents. However, existing embodied benchmarks mainly focus on task-level evaluation and fail to provide actionable insights into the underlying causes of model failures. To address this limitation, we introduce BEAR, a benchmark that decomposes embodied tasks into 14 atomic skills for fine-grained skill-level evaluation. BEAR comprises 4,469 interleaved image-video-text samples spanning 14 skills across 6 categories, ranging from low-level perception to high-level planning. We evaluate 20 MLLMs on BEAR under a hierarchical skill-level diagnosis framework and uncover two key findings: (1) perceptual capabilities are major bottlenecks behind reasoning failures, and (2) current models suffer from unstable spatiotemporal modeling that remains largely unexposed in prior benchmarks. Motivated by these findings, we further propose BEAR-Agent, a multimodal conversational agent that augments MLLMs with visual and spatial reasoning tools. BEAR-Agent substantially improves performance across embodied skills, achieving a relative improvement of 17.5% on GPT-5 over the base model on BEAR, while also outperforming strong baselines in both simulation and real-world robotic experiments. Project page: https://bear-official66.github.io/

papers.title: Federated Self-Supervised Modulation Classification under Non-IID and Imbalanced Data
papers.abstract_en: Automatic modulation classification (AMC) is a core enabler of cognitive wireless systems, providing spectrum awareness and supporting adaptive communication at the network edge. However, training AMC models on centrally aggregated data incurs high communication overhead, raises privacy concerns, and often lacks robustness to real-world conditions. We propose FedSSL-AMC, a federated self-supervised framework for learning AMC models from sparsely labeled, distributed I/Q time-series data. Participating clients collaboratively train a causal, time-dilated CNN encoder using triplet-loss self-supervision on unlabeled signals, followed by lightweight local SVMs trained on limited labeled samples. This enables communication-round-efficient, robust representation learning under class imbalance and channel variability. We establish convergence guarantees for a proximal variant of the encoder-training procedure and derive a separability bound for the downstream classifier under feature noise. Experiments on synthetic and over-the-air datasets demonstrate improvements over supervised FL baselines across all three datasets and nearly all evaluated settings involving heterogeneous SNRs, carrier-frequency offsets, and non-IID label distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedSSL-AMC，一个用于自动调制分类 (AMC) 的联邦自监督学习框架，在稀疏标注、分布式 I/Q 时序数据上训练模型。客户端用三元组损失自监督训练因果时间膨胀 CNN 编码器，再用少量标注样本训练轻量局部 SVM。实验在合成数据和无线传输数据上验证了该方法在异构 SNR、载波频偏和非 IID 标签分布下优于监督联邦学习基线。
Motivation: 集中式聚合数据训练 AMC 模型存在通信开销高、隐私风险大以及对真实环境鲁棒性不足的问题，而已有方法难以应对非独立同分布 (non-IID) 和类别不平衡的分布式数据。
Method: 提出 FedSSL-AMC 框架：参与客户端使用未标注信号通过三元组损失自监督方式协作训练因果时间膨胀 CNN 编码器，随后在少量标注样本上训练轻量局部 SVM 完成分类；并引入近端变体训练过程以保证收敛性，推导下游分类器在特征噪声下的可分性边界。
Result: 在合成和无线传输数据集上的实验表明，该方法在所有三个数据集以及几乎所有涉及异构 SNR、载波频偏和非 IID 标签分布的设置下，均优于监督联邦学习基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能够以通信轮次高效的方式实现鲁棒的表示学习，对类别不平衡和信道变化具有良好适应性，并提供了收敛性与可分性方面的理论保证。

papers.title: DiSA-IQL: Offline Reinforcement Learning for Robust Soft Robot Control under Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Soft snake robots offer remarkable flexibility and adaptability in complex environments, yet their control remains challenging due to highly nonlinear dynamics. Existing model-based and bio-inspired controllers rely on simplified assumptions that limit their performance. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has recently emerged as a promising alternative, but online training is often impractical because of costly and potentially damaging real-world interactions. Offline RL provides a safer option by leveraging pre-collected datasets, but it suffers from distribution shift, which degrades generalization to unseen scenarios. To overcome this challenge, we propose DiSA-IQL (Distribution-Shift-Aware Implicit Q-Learning), an extension of IQL that incorporates robustness modulation by penalizing unreliable state-action pairs to mitigate distribution shift. We evaluate DiSA-IQL on goal-reaching tasks across two settings: in-distribution and out-of-distribution evaluation. Simulation results show that DiSA-IQL consistently outperforms baseline models, including Behavior Cloning (BC), Conservative Q-Learning (CQL), and vanilla IQL, achieving higher success rates, smoother trajectories, and greater robustness.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 American Control Conference (ACC), pp. 3983-3988, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiSA-IQL（Distribution-Shift-Aware Implicit Q-Learning），一种面向离线强化学习的 IQL 扩展方法，用于软体蛇形机器人控制。该方法通过惩罚不可靠的状态-动作对来缓解分布偏移（distribution shift），并在目标到达任务上分别进行分布内和分布外评估。仿真结果显示 DiSA-IQL 在成功率、轨迹平滑性和鲁棒性上一致优于 Behavior Cloning、CQL 和原始 IQL 等基线。
Motivation: 软体蛇形机器人具有高度非线性动力学，在线深度强化学习训练成本高且有安全风险，离线 RL 虽可利用预先收集的数据，但分布偏移会损害对新场景的泛化能力。
Method: 在 IQL 基础上引入鲁棒性调制机制，对不可靠的状态-动作对施加惩罚，以显式缓解离线数据与部署环境之间的分布偏移。
Result: 在目标到达任务的仿真评估中，DiSA-IQL 在分布内与分布外两种设置下均稳定优于 Behavior Cloning、CQL 和 vanilla IQL，取得更高的成功率、更平滑的轨迹和更强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为对不可靠状态-动作对的惩罚是提升离线 RL 在软体机器人控制中泛化鲁棒性的有效手段，研究处于仿真评估阶段。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Evidence Recomposition and Predictive Context Residualization for Visual Attribution in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong vision-language performance, yet their token-level visual evidence remains difficult to inspect. Recent logit-lens attribution methods project each visual-token hidden state into the vocabulary space to explain generated words, but this token-wise readout introduces a mismatch: visual tokens are context-mixed by the model, while the attribution score is decoded independently at each token location. This often produces fragmented attribution maps and can be further affected by autoregressive context signals from preceding text tokens. We propose ERCR, an attribution framework built from Evidence Recomposition (ER) and Predictive Context Residualization (PCR). ER aggregates target evidence across multiple views with different token-to-region assignments, reducing attribution fragmentation caused by a single readout grid. PCR estimates a preceding-token context map with RBO-based rank relevance and subtracts its fitted component from the ER map to suppress context-token interference. Experiments on LLaVA, Qwen2-VL, and InternVL families across COCO Caption, GranDf, and OpenPSG show that ERCR improves visual evidence for target tokens and mitigates preceding-token context interference under the existing evaluation protocol. On Qwen2-VL-2B, ERCR improves TAM F1-IoU from 39.10 to 44.45 on COCO Caption and from 30.83 to 37.20 on GranDf. Overall, ERCR provides a practical refinement for token-level visual evidence inspection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ERCR，一个面向多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的 token 级视觉归因框架，由 Evidence Recomposition（ER）和 Predictive Context Residualization（PCR）组成。ER 通过不同 token-to-region 分配的多视角聚合目标证据，缓解单一读出的碎片化；PCR 用基于 RBO 的排序相关性估计前文 token 的上下文图并从 ER 图中减去其拟合分量，抑制上下文干扰。在 LLaVA、Qwen2-VL、InternVL 系列及 COCO Caption、GranDf、OpenPSG 上的实验表明，ERCR 提升了目标 token 的视觉证据质量并缓解了前文 token 干扰。
Motivation: MLLM 的 token 级视觉证据难以检视；现有的 logit-lens 归因方法在每个视觉 token 位置独立解码归因分数，而视觉 token 实际上被模型上下文混合，导致归因图碎片化，并受前文文本 token 的自回归上下文信号影响。
Method: 提出 ERCR 框架：ER 在多种 token-to-region 分配视图上聚合目标证据，降低单一读出网格造成的归因碎片化；PCR 使用基于 RBO 的排序相关性估计前文 token 的上下文映射，并减去其在 ER 图中的拟合分量以抑制上下文 token 干扰。
Result: 在 LLaVA、Qwen2-VL 和 InternVL 系列模型上、跨 COCO Caption、GranDf 和 OpenPSG 数据集的实验显示，ERCR 改善了目标 token 的视觉证据并缓解前文上下文干扰。具体而言，Qwen2-VL-2B 的 TAM F1-IoU 在 COCO Caption 上从 39.10 提升到 44.45，在 GranDf 上从 30.83 提升到 37.20。
Conclusion: ERCR 为 token 级视觉证据检视提供了一种实用的改进方案，可在现有评估协议下有效提升归因质量并抑制前文 token 干扰。

papers.title: Knowing When to Defer: Selective Prediction for Responsible Knowledge Tracing
papers.abstract_en: Research on Knowledge Tracing (KT) models traditionally focuses on improving predictive accuracy. However, responsible real-world deployment requires models to know when to defer uncertain predictions to a human teacher. We introduce an intrinsic selective prediction layer for existing KT models using Monte Carlo Dropout (MC-Dropout) to quantify uncertainty. We evaluate this approach across three architectures (DKT, SAKT, and AKT) using the Eedi mathematics dataset. Abstaining on the 20\% most uncertain predictions lifts accuracy by 2.3 to 3.0 percentage points, AUC by 1.9 to 2.4 percentage points and F1 by 1.4 to 4.3 percentage points without any retraining. This abstention strategy is highly targeted: the deferred set exhibits 1.45 to 1.60 times the error rate of the kept set. Furthermore, this targeting holds within every question-difficulty quartile and remains fair across student-ability levels. Importantly, MC-Dropout variance gives roughly five times the AUC lift of a calibrated two-parameter logistic (2PL) Item Response Theory (IRT) baseline as a selective-prediction signal. A variance decomposition of the model's epistemic uncertainty (BALD) reveals that the entire classical psychometric stack, comprising question difficulty, student ability, IRT-style outcome ambiguity, and historical curriculum coverage, explains less than 4\% of the signal under linear modeling and at most 23\% even with a non-linear regressor. This leaves 77\% to 90\% as architecture-specific epistemic content that MC-Dropout surfaces and simpler proxies cannot recover. Selective prediction with model-native epistemic uncertainty is therefore a necessary component of responsible KT deployment, complementary to subgroup-fairness audits and downstream classroom evaluation rather than a substitute for them.
papers.comment: Published as Spotlight paper at IRAISE 2026. Link to published version: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v339/mitton26a.html. 10 pages, 7 figures. Joshua Mitton and Prarthana Bhattacharyya contributed equally to this paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向知识追踪 (Knowledge Tracing, KT) 模型的实际部署场景，提出用蒙特卡洛 Dropout (MC-Dropout) 构建内生的选择性预测层，让模型对不确定的预测选择弃权并交由人类教师。作者在 Eedi 数学数据集上对 DKT、SAKT 和 AKT 三种架构进行评估，弃权最不确定的 20% 预测可在不重新训练的情况下将准确率提升 2.3–3.0 个百分点、AUC 提升 1.9–2.4 个百分点、F1 提升 1.4–4.3 个百分点；弃权集的错误率是保留集的 1.45–1.60 倍。
Motivation: 传统知识追踪研究只关注预测精度，但负责任的实际部署要求模型知道何时该把不确定的预测转交给人类教师，现有方法缺少基于模型自身不确定性的系统化弃权机制。
Method: 为已有 KT 模型加入基于 MC-Dropout 的内生选择性预测层以量化不确定性，并在 DKT、SAKT、AKT 三种架构上评估；同时将其与校准后的双参数逻辑斯蒂 (2PL) 项目反应理论 (IRT) 基线比较，并用 BALD 对认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty) 做方差分解。
Result: 弃权 20% 最不确定样本在三个架构上带来准确率 2.3–3.0、AUC 1.9–2.4、F1 1.4–4.3 个百分点的提升；弃权集的错误率是保留集的 1.45–1.60 倍，且这种针对性在每个题目难度四分位内都成立并对学生能力水平保持公平。MC-Dropout 方差作为选择性预测信号比 2PL IRT 基线带来约五倍的 AUC 提升；线性建模下经典心理测量学变量（题目难度、学生能力、IRT 式结果模糊性、历史课程覆盖）只能解释不到 4% 的信号，非线性回归器最多解释 23%。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于模型内生认知不确定性的选择性预测是负责任 KT 部署的必要组成部分，但它应与子群体公平性审计和下游课堂评估互补，而非替代它们。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文面向知识追踪 (Knowledge Tracing, KT) 模型的实际部署场景，提出用蒙特卡洛 Dropout (MC-Dropout) 构建内生的选择性预测层，让模型对不确定的预测选择弃权并交由人类教师。作者在 Eedi 数学数据集上对 DKT、SAKT 和 AKT 三种架构进行评估，弃权最不确定的 20% 预测可在不重新训练的情况下将准确率提升 2.3–3.0 个百分点、AUC 提升 1.9–2.4 个百分点、F1 提升 1.4–4.3 个百分点；弃权集的错误率是保留集的 1.45–1.60 倍。
summary_sections.motivation: 传统知识追踪研究只关注预测精度，但负责任的实际部署要求模型知道何时该把不确定的预测转交给人类教师，现有方法缺少基于模型自身不确定性的系统化弃权机制。
summary_sections.method: 为已有 KT 模型加入基于 MC-Dropout 的内生选择性预测层以量化不确定性，并在 DKT、SAKT、AKT 三种架构上评估；同时将其与校准后的双参数逻辑斯蒂 (2PL) 项目反应理论 (IRT) 基线比较，并用 BALD 对认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty) 做方差分解。
summary_sections.result: 弃权 20% 最不确定样本在三个架构上带来准确率 2.3–3.0、AUC 1.9–2.4、F1 1.4–4.3 个百分点的提升；弃权集的错误率是保留集的 1.45–1.60 倍，且这种针对性在每个题目难度四分位内都成立并对学生能力水平保持公平。MC-Dropout 方差作为选择性预测信号比 2PL IRT 基线带来约五倍的 AUC 提升；线性建模下经典心理测量学变量（题目难度、学生能力、IRT 式结果模糊性、历史课程覆盖）只能解释不到 4% 的信号，非线性回归器最多解释 23%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为基于模型内生认知不确定性的选择性预测是负责任 KT 部署的必要组成部分，但它应与子群体公平性审计和下游课堂评估互补，而非替代它们。

papers.title: Calibrated Generative AI as Meta-Reviewer: A Systemic Functional Linguistics Discourse Analysis of Reviews of Peer Reviews
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates the use of generative AI to support formative assessment through machine generated reviews of peer reviews in graduate online courses in a public university in the United States. Drawing on Systemic Functional Linguistics and Appraisal Theory, we analyzed 120 metareviews to explore how generative AI feedback constructs meaning across ideational, interpersonal, and textual dimensions. The findings suggest that generative AI can approximate key rhetorical and relational features of effective human feedback, offering directive clarity while also maintaining a supportive stance. The reviews analyzed demonstrated a balance of praise and constructive critique, alignment with rubric expectations, and structured staging that foregrounded student agency. By modeling these qualities, AI metafeedback has the potential to scaffold feedback literacy and enhance leaner engagement with peer review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成式AI作为元评审者（meta-reviewer），在美国一所公立大学研究生在线课程中生成对同伴评审的机器评审，以支持形成性评估。作者基于系统功能语言学（Systemic Functional Linguistics）和评价理论（Appraisal Theory）分析了120条元评审，发现AI反馈能在概念、人际和文本维度上近似人类反馈的关键修辞与关系特征，兼具指示性清晰度和支持性姿态。
Motivation: 在线课程中同伴评审需要大量反馈，而生成式AI能否提供有效的形成性元反馈尚缺乏基于语言学理论的系统分析；该研究希望检验AI生成的元评审在意义建构上是否接近人类反馈。
Method: 采用系统功能语言学和评价理论作为分析框架，对120条生成式AI生成的元评审（metareviews）进行语篇分析，考察其在概念（ideational）、人际（interpersonal）和文本（textual）三个维度的意义建构。
Result: 分析显示AI元评审近似人类有效反馈的关键特征：在表扬与建设性批评之间保持平衡、与评分标准（rubric）对齐、采用结构化阶段推进并突出学生能动性，同时维持支持性立场。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过模仿这些质量特征，AI元反馈（AI metafeedback）有潜力促进学生的反馈素养（feedback literacy）并增强对同伴评审的学习参与。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhancing Differentially Private Linear Regression via Public Second-Moment
authors: Hai Zhang (1) ((1) The School of Mathematics
papers.abstract_en: Leveraging information from public data has become increasingly crucial in enhancing the utility of differentially private (DP) methods. Traditional DP approaches often require adding noise based solely on private data, which can significantly degrade utility. In this paper, we address this limitation in the context of the ordinary least squares estimator (OLSE) of linear regression based on sufficient statistics perturbation (SSP) under the unbounded data assumption. We propose a novel method that involves transforming private data using the public second-moment matrix to compute a transformed SSP-OLSE, whose second-moment matrix yields a better condition number and improves the OLSE accuracy and robustness. We derive theoretical error bounds about our method and the standard SSP-OLSE to the non-DP OLSE, which reveal the improved robustness and accuracy achieved by our approach. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the utility and effectiveness of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在不加界数据假设下，利用公开数据的二阶矩矩阵来改进差分隐私 (DP) 线性回归中基于充分统计量扰动 (SSP) 的普通最小二乘估计 (OLSE)。作者提出先使用公开二阶矩矩阵对私有数据进行变换，再计算变换后的 SSP-OLSE，使二阶矩矩阵条件数更优，从而提升估计精度与鲁棒性，并给出与标准 SSP-OLSE 相对非 DP OLSE 的理论误差界。
Motivation: 传统 DP 方法仅基于私有数据添加噪声，会显著损害线性回归估计的效用；公开数据的信息在 DP 线性回归中未被充分利用。
Method: 提出利用公开二阶矩矩阵对私有数据做变换，得到变换后的 SSP-OLSE，以获得具有更好条件数的二阶矩矩阵；推导该方法与标准 SSP-OLSE 相对非 DP OLSE 的理论误差界。
Result: 理论误差界表明所提方法具有更好的鲁棒性和精度；在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验验证了方法的效用与有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法通过公开二阶矩矩阵改善线性回归中差分隐私 SSP 估计的精度和鲁棒性，适用于不加界数据假设下的 OLSE 场景。

papers.title: ProteoKnight: Convolution-based Phage Virion Protein Classification and Uncertainty Analysis
papers.abstract_en: \textbf{Introduction:} Accurate prediction of Phage Virion Proteins (PVP) is essential for genomic studies due to their crucial role as structural elements in bacteriophages. Computational tools, particularly machine learning, have emerged for annotating phage protein sequences from high-throughput sequencing. However, effective annotation requires specialized sequence encodings. Our paper introduces ProteoKnight, a new image-based encoding method that addresses spatial constraints in existing techniques, yielding competitive performance in PVP classification using pre-trained convolutional neural networks. Additionally, our study evaluates prediction uncertainty in binary PVP classification through Monte Carlo Dropout (MCD). \textbf{Methods:} ProteoKnight adapts the classical DNA-Walk algorithm for protein sequences, incorporating pixel colors and adjusting walk distances to capture intricate protein features. Encoded sequences were classified using multiple pre-trained CNNs. Variance and entropy measures assessed prediction uncertainty across proteins of various classes and lengths. \textbf{Results:} Our experiments achieved 90.8% accuracy in binary classification, comparable to state-of-the-art methods. Multi-class classification accuracy remains suboptimal. Our uncertainty analysis unveils variability in prediction confidence influenced by protein class and sequence length. \textbf{Conclusions:} Our study surpasses frequency chaos game representation (FCGR) by introducing novel image encoding that mitigates spatial information loss limitations. Our classification technique yields accurate and robust PVP predictions while identifying low-confidence predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProteoKnight，一种基于图像编码的噬菌体病毒粒子蛋白（PVP）分类方法。作者将经典 DNA-Walk 算法改编为蛋白质序列的图像编码，引入像素颜色并调整游走距离，再用多个预训练 CNN 进行分类。二元分类准确率达 90.8%，与现有方法相当；多分类精度不理想。不确定性分析采用 Monte Carlo Dropout (MCD)，结果显示预测置信度受蛋白类别和序列长度影响。
Motivation: 噬菌体病毒粒子蛋白的准确预测对基因组学研究很重要，但现有计算注释工具依赖专门的序列编码，且已有技术存在空间约束和空间信息损失问题。
Method: ProteoKnight 将 DNA-Walk 算法适配到蛋白质序列，通过像素颜色和调整游走距离捕获精细蛋白特征，并使用多个预训练 CNN 对编码后的图像进行分类；同时用方差和熵指标通过 MCD 评估预测不确定性。
Result: 实验在二元 PVP 分类上达到 90.8% 准确率，与最先进方法相当；多分类准确率仍不理想。不确定性分析表明预测置信度会随蛋白类别与序列长度变化。
Conclusion: 相比频率混沌游戏表示（FCGR），本文的新图像编码缓解了空间信息损失，能够提供准确稳健的 PVP 预测，并识别低置信度预测。

papers.title: Reprojection-Guided 3D Gaussian Splatting Diffusion for Weakly Supervised Single-Image Normal Estimation
papers.abstract_en: We propose CLONE, a Continuous Latent Optimization framework for Normal Estimation via 3D Gaussian splatting. The core idea is to construct an image-geometry-image consistency strategy that unifies explicit geometric representation with differentiable rendering, thereby enabling weakly supervised learning without normal ground truth. Specifically, CLONE comprises four components. First, by introducing a differentiable light interaction model with a learnable modulation kernel, we perform a unified reparameterization of the 3DGS parameter space. Second, the conditional single-step deterministic refinement network integrates denoising architectures with differentiable reprojection constraints to refine the initial normals, thereby adaptively recovering the high-frequency details erased by the inherently smooth Gaussian primitives. Third, the cross-domain gating fusion mechanism adaptively combines the two complementary normal estimates, reconciling the geometrically consistent yet over-smooth 3DGS estimate with the detailed yet potentially geometry-inconsistent refinement. Finally, all components are jointly optimized under a unified photometric reprojection objective with geometric consistency regularizations in a fully differentiable pathway, achieving an end-to-end optimization closed loop without relying on external normal labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLONE（Continuous Latent Optimization for Normal Estimation via 3D Gaussian Splatting），一种基于 3D 高斯泼溅的弱监督单图法线估计框架。其核心是图像-几何-图像一致性策略，通过可微渲染在无法线真值下联合优化显式几何表示与法线细化网络。摘要称该方法能自适应恢复被高斯原语平滑掉的高频细节，并在无需外部法线标签的条件下形成端到端优化闭环。
Motivation: 单图法线估计通常依赖真值法线监督，而 3DGS 这类显式几何表示虽几何一致但过度平滑，难以保留高频细节。本文针对这一缺口提出弱监督方案，用光度重投影目标替代法线标签。
Method: CLONE 由四部分组成：引入带可学习调制核的可微光照交互模型，对 3DGS 参数空间统一重参数化；条件单步确定性细化网络结合去噪架构与可微重投影约束来细化初始法线；跨域门控融合机制自适应融合 3DGS 估计与细化估计；最后在统一光度重投影目标与几何一致性正则下以完全可微路径端到端联合优化。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化数值，主要声称该方法能自适应恢复被过度平滑的高频细节，并协调几何一致但平滑的 3DGS 估计与细节丰富但可能几何不一致的细化估计。
Conclusion: 作者强调所有组件在统一光度重投影目标下联合优化，构成不依赖外部法线标签的端到端优化闭环。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Model Unlearning: A Survey through Target Events, Unlearning Operators, and Evaluation Protocols
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of generative models, privacy, copyright, safety, and reliability risks have attracted growing attention. To mitigate these risks, machine unlearning has been increasingly adapted from traditional classification models to generative settings. Despite notable progress, existing studies remain fragmented in their target definitions, unlearning mechanisms, and evaluation protocols, making objective comparison difficult across models, modalities, and applications. Moreover, modality-specific surveys often overlook the shared structure of Generative Model Unlearning (GenMU). To address this gap, we provide a comprehensive review of GenMU and formulate it as target-constrained distributional projection: given a target event, an unlearning operator transforms the generative distribution to suppress target-related outputs while preserving useful behavior and controlling operator cost. Under this framework, an unlearning request is specified by a target event, implemented through an unlearning operator, and assessed by empirical evidence over target suppression, distribution preservation, and operator cost. We further reorganize existing GenMU studies under this view. From this perspective, we provide the first explicit and unified account of how GenMU connects to mainstream applications, including privacy protection, copyright and style protection, safety alignment, hallucination mitigation, and deployment defense. Finally, we identify key open problems and future directions toward reliable, scalable, robust, and auditable GenMU. We consistently maintain the related open-source materials at https://github.com/caxLee/GenMU-Survey.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对生成式模型遗忘 (Generative Model Unlearning, GenMU) 的综述，将其形式化为目标约束的分布投影 (target-constrained distributional projection)，并从目标事件 (target event)、遗忘算子 (unlearning operator) 与评估协议三个维度重组织现有研究。摘要指出该框架首次统一了 GenMU 与隐私保护、版权与风格保护、安全对齐、幻觉缓解和部署防御等主流应用的联系，并梳理了开放问题与未来方向。
Motivation: 现有生成模型遗忘研究在目标定义、遗忘机制和评估协议上各自为政，导致跨模型、跨模态和跨应用的客观比较困难，而按模态划分的综述又忽略了 GenMU 的共享结构。
Method: 提出将 GenMU 统一表述为目标约束的分布投影：给定目标事件，遗忘算子把生成分布变换为抑制目标相关输出、同时保持有用行为并控制算子代价的分布；在此框架下，一次遗忘请求由目标事件指定、通过遗忘算子实现，并用目标抑制、分布保持与算子代价三类经验证据评估。
Result: 综述按该视角重新组织现有 GenMU 研究，首次给出了 GenMU 与隐私保护、版权和风格保护、安全对齐、幻觉缓解及部署防御等主流应用的统一且显式的联系，并指出可靠、可扩展、鲁棒且可审计的 GenMU 所面临的开放问题。

papers.title: A validity-guided workflow for robust large language model research in psychology
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly being integrated into psychological and behavioral research as research tools, evaluation targets, human simulators, and cognitive models. Yet recent evidence reveals severe measurement unreliability: personality assessments degenerate under factor analysis, moral preferences reverse with punctuation changes, and theory-of-mind accuracy varies widely with trivial rephrasing. These "measurement phantoms"--statistical artifacts masquerading as psychological phenomena--threaten the validity of a growing body of research. Guided by the dual-validity framework that integrates psychometrics with causal inference, we present a six-stage workflow that scales validity requirements to research ambition--using LLMs to code text requires basic reliability and accuracy, whereas claims about psychological properties demand comprehensive construct validation. Researchers must (1) explicitly define their research goal and corresponding validity requirements, (2) develop and validate computational instruments through psychometric testing, (3) design experiments that control for computational confounds, (4) execute protocols transparently, (5) analyze data with methods appropriate for non-independent observations, and (6) report findings within boundaries and use results to refine theory. We illustrate the workflow through an example of model evaluation--"LLM selfhood"--showing how systematic validation can distinguish genuine computational phenomena from measurement artifacts. By establishing validated computational instruments and transparent practices, this workflow provides a path toward building a robust empirical foundation for AI psychology research.
papers.journal_ref: Behavior Research Methods, 58, 216 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个以效度（validity）为导向的六阶段工作流，用于在心理学和行为研究中稳健地使用大语言模型（LLM）。作者基于双效度框架（整合心理测量学与因果推断），主张将效度要求与研究目标匹配，并通过模型评估示例“LLM selfhood”展示如何区分真实计算现象与测量伪影。
Motivation: LLM 正被用作研究工具、评估对象、人类模拟器和认知模型，但近期证据显示严重测量不可靠，例如人格评估在因子分析下退化、道德偏好随标点变化反转、心理理论准确率因措辞改变而大幅波动；这些“测量幻影”（measurement phantoms）威胁研究效度。
Method: 提出六阶段工作流：(1) 明确研究目标和相应效度要求；(2) 通过心理测量学测试开发和验证计算工具；(3) 设计控制计算混淆的实验；(4) 透明执行协议；(5) 采用适合非独立观测的方法分析数据；(6) 在边界内报告发现并用结果改进理论。
Result: 以“LLM selfhood”模型评估示例说明系统性验证如何区分真实计算现象与测量伪影；摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 通过建立经验证的计算工具和透明实践，该工作流为 AI 心理学研究构建稳健的实证基础提供了路径。

papers.title: From Prompts to Constructs: A Dual-Validity Framework for Large Language Model Research in Psychology
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are entering psychological research both as tools and as objects of inquiry. Yet many studies apply human instruments to LLMs without establishing that the outputs are reliable or interpretable, raising the risk of measurement phantoms--statistical regularities mistaken for genuine psychological phenomena. This review argues that robust AI psychological research requires integrating two methodological traditions: psychometric validation of what a score means and causal inference standards for what the results warrant. It develops a dual-validity framework in which evidentiary demands scale with scientific ambition: from tool use through behavioral characterization and human simulation to cognitive modeling. Classifying text may require only accuracy and reliability; claiming that an LLM simulates anxiety or illuminates cognitive mechanisms requires additional evidence, including construct validity evidence and experimental controls. Progress depends on developing computational analogs of psychological constructs rather than assuming human measures automatically apply to language models.
papers.journal_ref: Annu. Rev. Psychol. 2027. 78:2.1-2.26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述性文章，针对 LLM 在心理学研究中既作为工具又作为研究对象的现象，提出双效度框架 (dual-validity framework)，主张结合心理测量学效度验证与因果推断标准来规范研究。摘要强调许多研究直接将人类测量工具用于 LLM，却未验证输出是否可靠或可解释，存在把统计规律误认为真实心理现象的“测量幻影”风险。
Motivation: LLM 正被引入心理学研究，但大量研究在未确认输出可靠性与可解释性的情况下直接套用人类心理测量工具，可能导致测量幻影，即把统计上的规律性误当成真实心理现象。
Method: 提出双效度框架，将证据需求与科学目标挂钩，从工具使用、行为表征、人类模拟到认知建模逐级提高要求；文本分类只需准确性和可靠性，而声称 LLM 模拟焦虑或揭示认知机制则需要构念效度 (construct validity) 证据与实验控制。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据或定量结果，主要贡献是方法论框架：区分不同程度的效度证据需求，并主张发展计算化的心理构念。
Conclusion: 作者认为研究进展取决于为心理构念发展计算对应物，而不是假设人类测量工具可以自动适用于语言模型。

papers.title: FuseLIP: Multimodal Embeddings via Early Fusion of Discrete Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive language-image pre-training aligns features of text-image pairs in a common latent space via distinct encoders for each modality. While this approach achieves impressive performance in several zero-shot tasks, it cannot natively handle multimodal inputs, i.e., encoding image and text into a single feature vector. As a remedy, it is common practice to use additional modules to merge the features extracted by unimodal encoders. In this work, we present FuseLIP, a new architecture for multimodal embedding. Leveraging recent progress in discrete image tokenizers, we propose to use a single transformer model operating on a unified vocabulary of text and image tokens. This early fusion approach allows the different modalities to interact at each depth of encoding and obtain richer representations compared to common late fusion. We collect new datasets for multimodal pre-training and evaluation, designing challenging tasks for multimodal encoders. We show that FuseLIP outperforms late fusion approaches in several multimodal and unimodal embedding tasks.
papers.comment: TMLR 2026. Code and models available at https://github.com/chs20/fuselip
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FuseLIP，一种用于多模态嵌入的新架构：借助离散图像 tokenizer 的最新进展，用单个 Transformer 在文本与图像 token 的统一词表上进行操作，从而实现早期融合（early fusion）。摘要称该早期融合方法能让不同模态在编码的每一层深度交互，获得比常见晚期融合（late fusion）更丰富的表示；作者还收集了新的多模态预训练与评测数据集，并显示 FuseLIP 在多项多模态与单模态嵌入任务上优于晚期融合方法。
Motivation: 对比语言-图像预训练（如 CLIP）通过各自独立的编码器将文本-图像对在共同潜在空间中对齐，但无法原生处理多模态输入，即把图像和文本编码成单一特征向量；现有补救做法通常是添加额外模块来合并单模态编码器提取的特征。
Method: 提出 FuseLIP 架构，采用离散图像 tokenizer，并使用一个共享的 Transformer 在统一的文本与图像 token 词表上编码，使模态在编码过程的每个深度都能交互；同时构建新的多模态预训练和评测数据集，设计更具挑战性的多模态编码任务。
Result: 摘要报告 FuseLIP 在多个多模态和单模态嵌入任务上优于晚期融合方法。
Conclusion: 早期融合能让模态在每层编码中交互，从而获得比常见晚期融合更丰富的表示；代码和模型已公开。

papers.title: VirnyFlow: Optimizing ML Pipelines for Accuracy, Fairness, and Stability at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Developing machine learning (ML) systems for real-world deployment requires navigating context-dependent trade-offs among accuracy, fairness, stability, and other objectives. Existing AutoML frameworks optimize pipelines efficiently, but they fix the optimization objective up front, leave it outside the developer's control during search, and rarely scale beyond a single node. We present VirnyFlow, a system that optimizes ML pipelines jointly for accuracy, fairness, and stability at scale. A user-defined evaluation protocol, with fairness measured over binary and intersectional groups, drives every layer of the optimizer: multi-objective Bayesian optimization of physical pipelines, cost-aware bandit selection of logical pipelines, and multi-criterion pruning. The architecture combines asynchronous execution over Apache Kafka with database-backed experiment management, providing fine-grained parallelism, fault tolerance, and interactive inspection of trade-offs. On six real-world datasets, VirnyFlow achieves competitive or superior performance compared to state-of-the-art AutoML systems (auto-sklearn, Alpine Meadow, FLAML) under identical resource constraints, scales to 128 workers across four nodes on datasets of up to 2.6M records, and achieves up to 7x higher speedup than the best-scaling single-node baseline, while maintaining stable accuracy and fairness as parallelism increases. A clinical case study on distribution shift and an IRB-approved user study demonstrate human-in-the-loop navigation of trade-offs in practice: rather than returning a single "best" model, VirnyFlow lets data scientists define, inspect, and iteratively refine the objectives of the search to fit their deployment context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VirnyFlow，一个面向大规模机器学习流水线联合优化的系统，目标是在准确率、公平性和稳定性之间进行可交互的权衡。系统以用户定义的评价协议（涵盖二元与交叉群体公平性）驱动多层优化：物理流水线的多目标贝叶斯优化、逻辑流水线的成本感知 bandit 选择以及多准则剪枝，并通过 Apache Kafka 实现异步执行与数据库支撑的实验管理。在六个真实数据集上，VirnyFlow 在相同资源约束下达到与 auto-sklearn、Alpine Meadow、FLAML 相当或更优的性能，并在最多 2.6M 条记录、四节点 128 个 worker 的设置下扩展，取得最高 7 倍于最佳单节点基线的加速。
Motivation: 现有 AutoML 框架能高效优化流水线，但通常在搜索前固定目标函数、搜索过程中开发者无法控制该目标，且很少能扩展到单节点之外；实际部署需要根据上下文在准确率、公平性、稳定性等目标间动态权衡。
Method: VirnyFlow 采用用户定义评价协议驱动优化器各层：对物理流水线做多目标贝叶斯优化，对逻辑流水线做成本感知 bandit 选择，并加入多准则剪枝；架构上结合 Apache Kafka 上的异步执行与基于数据库的实验管理，提供细粒度并行、容错和交互式权衡检查。
Result: 在六个真实数据集上，VirnyFlow 在相同资源约束下性能与 state-of-the-art AutoML 系统相当或更优；可扩展到四节点 128 个 worker、最多 2.6M 条记录的数据集，较最佳单节点基线实现最高 7 倍加速，且随并行度增加准确率和公平性保持稳定。
Conclusion: 通过临床试验性分布偏移案例和 IRB 批准的用户研究，系统支持人在回路中的权衡导航：让数据科学家定义、检查并迭代细化搜索目标，而不是只返回一个固定的“最佳”模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: WATCH: Adaptive Monitoring for AI Deployments via Weighted-Conformal Martingales
papers.abstract_en: Responsibly deploying artificial intelligence (AI) / machine learning (ML) systems in high-stakes settings arguably requires not only proof of system reliability, but also continual, post-deployment monitoring to quickly detect and address any unsafe behavior. Methods for nonparametric sequential testing -- especially conformal test martingales (CTMs) and anytime-valid inference -- offer promising tools for this monitoring task. However, existing approaches are restricted to monitoring limited hypothesis classes or ``alarm criteria'' (e.g., detecting data shifts that violate certain exchangeability or IID assumptions), do not allow for online adaptation in response to shifts, and/or cannot diagnose the cause of degradation or alarm. In this paper, we address these limitations by proposing a weighted generalization of conformal test martingales (WCTMs), which lay a theoretical foundation for online monitoring for any unexpected changepoints in the data distribution while controlling false-alarms. For practical applications, we propose specific WCTM algorithms that adapt online to mild covariate shifts (in the marginal input distribution), quickly detect harmful shifts, and diagnose those harmful shifts as concept shifts (in the conditional label distribution) or extreme (out-of-support) covariate shifts that cannot be easily adapted to. On real-world datasets, we demonstrate improved performance relative to state-of-the-art baselines.

Practical and experimental claims are unaffected. See Remark 3.5

Motivation: 高风险场景中负责任地部署 AI/ML 系统需要持续的后部署监控来快速发现和应对不安全行为。现有非参数序贯检验方法（如 conformal test martingales 和 any time-valid inference）局限于监控受限的假设类或告警准则，无法在线适应漂移，也不能诊断退化或警报的成因。

Result: 在真实数据集上，所提出的 WCTM 算法相比现有最强基线展示了改进的性能。摘要未给出具体数值，并注明 v5 修正了主定理中先前版本遗漏的 bag sufficiency 假设，但实际和实验结论不受影响。

papers.title: Two by Two: Learning Multi-Task Pairwise Objects Assembly for Generalizable Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: 3D assembly tasks, such as furniture assembly and component fitting, play a crucial role in daily life and represent essential capabilities for future home robots. Existing benchmarks and datasets predominantly focus on assembling geometric fragments or factory parts, which fall short in addressing the complexities of everyday object interactions and assemblies. To bridge this gap, we present 2BY2, a large-scale annotated dataset for daily pairwise objects assembly, covering 18 fine-grained tasks that reflect real-life scenarios, such as plugging into sockets, arranging flowers in vases, and inserting bread into toasters. 2BY2 dataset includes 1,034 instances and 517 pairwise objects with pose and symmetry annotations, requiring approaches that align geometric shapes while accounting for functional and spatial relationships between objects. Leveraging the 2BY2 dataset, we propose a two-step SE(3) pose estimation method with equivariant features for assembly constraints. Compared to previous shape assembly methods, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance across all 18 tasks in the 2BY2 dataset. Additionally, robot experiments further validate the reliability and generalization ability of our method for complex 3D assembly tasks.
papers.comment: Accepted to CVPR 2025 (Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 2BY2，一个面向日常成对物体 3D 组装的大规模标注数据集，涵盖 18 个细粒度任务（如插头入插座、插花入花瓶、面包入烤面包机），包含 1,034 个实例和 517 个成对物体，并带有位姿与对称性标注。基于该数据集，作者提出一种使用等变特征的两步 SE(3) 位姿估计方法，用于满足装配约束。实验表明该方法在 2BY2 全部 18 个任务上达到最优性能，并通过机器人实验验证了可靠性与泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 3D 组装基准与数据集主要集中于几何碎片或工厂零件的装配，难以覆盖日常物体交互与组装的复杂性；作者希望弥补这一空白，为家居机器人所需的日常成对物体组装提供数据与方法基础。
Method: 构建大规模日常成对物体组装数据集 2BY2；提出一种两阶段的 SE(3) 位姿估计方法，利用等变特征 (equivariant features) 来建模几何形状对齐以及物体间的功能与空间关系。
Result: 相比以往的形状组装方法，该方法在 2BY2 数据集的全部 18 个任务上取得最优性能；机器人实验进一步验证了方法在复杂 3D 组装任务上的可靠性与泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为 2BY2 数据集与所提位姿估计方法能够有效支持日常物体组装任务，并为机器人操作研究提供新的数据资源与基准。

papers.title: Leveraging Machine Unlearning for Cost-Efficient Preference Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Despite advances in Preference Alignment (PA) for Large Language Models (LLMs), mainstream methods like reinforcement learning with human feedback face notable challenges. These approaches require high-quality datasets of positive preference examples, which are costly to obtain and computationally intensive. The LLM unlearning technique presents a promising alternative by directly removing the influence of negative examples. However, current research has primarily focused on empirical validation, lacking systematic quantitative analysis. To bridge this gap, we propose a framework linking PA with LLM unlearning. Through bi-level optimization, we first quantify how unlearning specific negative examples impacts PA performance. Our analysis reveals that these effects vary substantially across negative examples. Building on this insight, we pose a crucial question: how can we optimally select and weight negative examples for unlearning to maximize PA performance? To answer this, we propose Unlearning to Align (U2A), which leverages bi-level optimization to efficiently select and unlearn examples for optimal PA performance. We validate the proposed method through extensive experiments, with results confirming its effectiveness. Our code is available at https://github.com/muyiahhh/U2A.
papers.comment: Accepted by ICML 2026. 12 pages, 6 figures, and 4 tables. Code available at https://github.com/muyiahhh/U2A
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个将大语言模型偏好对齐（Preference Alignment）与机器遗忘（machine unlearning）联系起来的框架，通过双层优化定量分析遗忘特定负例对偏好对齐性能的影响，并据此提出 Unlearning to Align (U2A) 方法，以优化负例的选择与加权来最大化对齐效果。摘要报告实验验证了方法有效性，代码已开源。
Motivation: 主流偏好对齐方法（如 RLHF）依赖高质量正偏好样本，数据获取成本高且计算密集；LLM unlearning 提供直接移除负例影响的替代思路，但现有研究主要停留在经验验证，缺乏系统的定量分析。
Method: 提出连接偏好对齐与 LLM unlearning 的框架，利用双层优化（bi-level optimization）量化不同负例被遗忘后对偏好对齐性能的影响，并据此提出 U2A 方法，通过优化选择与加权负例进行遗忘，以最大化偏好对齐性能。
Result: 摘要称通过大量实验验证了 U2A 的有效性，但未报告具体数值或基准。
Conclusion: 摘要指出不同负例对偏好对齐的影响差异显著，选择与加权负例进行遗忘能提升对齐效果，并为偏好对齐与 unlearning 的交叉提供了定量分析框架。

papers.title: Diffusion-model approach to flavor models: A case study for $S_4^\prime$ modular flavor model
papers.abstract_en: We propose a numerical method of searching for parameters with experimental constraints in generic flavor models by utilizing diffusion models, which are classified as a type of generative artificial intelligence (generative AI). As a specific example, we consider the $S_4^\prime$ modular flavor model and construct a neural network that reproduces quark masses, the CKM matrix, and the Jarlskog invariant by treating free parameters in the flavor model as generating targets. By generating new parameters with the trained network and local optimization, we find various phenomenologically interesting parameter regions. Additionally, we confirm that the spontaneous CP violation occurs in the $S_4^\prime$ model. The diffusion model enables an inverse problem approach, allowing the machine to provide a series of plausible model parameters from given experimental data.
papers.journal_ref: Prog. Theor. Exp. Phys. 2026 (2026) 5, 053B08
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用扩散模型 (diffusion model) 这类生成式人工智能来搜索满足实验约束的风味模型参数，并以 S_4' 模风味模型 (modular flavor model) 为例进行验证。作者构建神经网络，将风味模型中的自由参数作为生成目标，使之能够再现夸克质量、CKM 矩阵和 Jarlskog 不变量；通过生成新参数并结合局部优化，发现了多个唯象上有趣的参数区域，并确认该模型中存在自发 CP 破坏。该方法把参数搜索转化为逆问题 (inverse problem)，让机器从给定实验数据直接给出可行的模型参数。
Motivation: 一般风味模型包含大量自由参数，要在实验约束下找到可行参数区间在计算上具有挑战性。
Method: 采用扩散模型作为生成式 AI 工具，以 S_4' 模风味模型为具体案例，训练神经网络把自由参数作为生成目标来复现夸克质量、CKM 矩阵与 Jarlskog 不变量，并辅以局部优化。
Result: 训练后的网络生成新参数并结合局部优化后，找到了多种唯象上有趣的参数区间，并确认在 S_4' 模型中会发生自发 CP 破坏。
Conclusion: 摘要表明扩散模型为风味模型参数搜索提供了一种逆问题式框架，能够在给定实验数据下由机器生成一系列合理的模型参数；具体演示限于 S_4' 模风味模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Enhancing the Non-Functional Quality Compliance of LLM-Generated Code through Quality-Aware Preference Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely adopted in commercial code completion engines, significantly enhancing coding efficiency and productivity. However, even functionally correct LLM-generated code may exhibit non-functional quality issues that violate coding standards and best practices, such as poor style and limited maintainability. To address this, we propose a framework for quality-aware preference learning that guides LLMs toward generating criteria-compliant code. Our approach consists of three phases. First, we construct a dataset of paired criteria-violating and criteria-compliant samples, where each pair contains code exhibiting a specific non-functional quality issue and its repaired version that resolves the issue. Second, we design an adaptive token weighting mechanism to emphasize quality-sensitive code regions. Third, we introduce a hybrid optimization objective that combines ranking loss with language modeling loss and KL divergence to enable effective comparative optimization. Extensive experiments on DeepSeek-Coder and Qwen2.5-Coder show that our method substantially improves compliance with the targeted non-functional quality criteria while maintaining functional correctness, achieving a 75.7% relative increase in Quality Reciprocal Score (QRS) on MBPP-sanitized for Qwen2.5-Coder. Fine-tuning a 7B model requires less than three hours, indicating strong practical viability. Ablation studies and a user study further support the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 生成代码即使功能正确也可能存在风格差、可维护性低等非功能质量问题，提出一种质量感知的偏好学习框架。框架包含构建成对违规/合规样本数据集、自适应 token 加权机制，以及结合排序损失、语言建模损失和 KL 散度的混合优化目标。在 DeepSeek-Coder 和 Qwen2.5-Coder 上的实验表明，该方法显著提升目标非功能质量标准的符合度，同时保持功能正确性；Qwen2.5-Coder 在 MBPP-sanitized 上的质量倒数分数 (QRS) 相对提升 75.7%，且 7B 模型微调耗时不足三小时。
Motivation: 商业代码补全引擎中的 LLM 生成代码即使功能正确，也可能违反编码标准和最佳实践，产生非功能质量问题，例如风格不佳和可维护性受限。
Method: 提出三阶段质量感知偏好学习框架：先构建成对的违规代码与其修复版本数据集；再设计自适应 token 加权机制以强调质量敏感代码区域；最后引入混合优化目标，将排序损失 (ranking loss) 与语言建模损失及 KL 散度结合，实现有效的对比优化。
Result: 在 DeepSeek-Coder 和 Qwen2.5-Coder 上的实验显示，该方法在保持功能正确性的同时大幅提升目标非功能质量标准的符合度；Qwen2.5-Coder 在 MBPP-sanitized 上的 QRS 相对提升 75.7%。7B 模型微调耗时小于 3 小时，消融研究和用户研究进一步支持其有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能以较低训练成本有效引导 LLM 生成符合非功能质量标准的代码，具有较强的实际可行性；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在 DeepSeek-Coder 和 Qwen2.5-Coder 上的实验显示，该方法在保持功能正确性的同时大幅提升目标非功能质量标准的符合度；Qwen2.5-Coder 在 MBPP-sanitized 上的 QRS 相对提升 75.7%。7B 模型微调耗时小于 3 小时，消融研究和用户研究进一步支持其有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该框架能以较低训练成本有效引导 LLM 生成符合非功能质量标准的代码，具有较强的实际可行性；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。

papers.title: Helios 2.0: A Robust, Ultra-Low Power Gesture Recognition System Optimised for Event-Sensor based Wearables
papers.abstract_en: We present an advance in wearable technology: a mobile-optimized, real-time, ultra-low-power event camera system that enables natural hand gesture control for smart glasses, dramatically improving user experience. While hand gesture recognition in computer vision has advanced significantly, critical challenges remain in creating systems that are intuitive, adaptable across diverse users and environments, and energy-efficient enough for practical wearable applications. Our approach tackles these challenges through carefully selected microgestures: lateral thumb swipes across the index finger (in both directions) and a double pinch between thumb and index fingertips. These human-centered interactions leverage natural hand movements, ensuring intuitive usability without requiring users to learn complex command sequences. To overcome variability in users and environments, we developed a novel simulation methodology that enables comprehensive domain sampling without extensive real-world data collection. Our power-optimised architecture maintains exceptional performance, achieving F1 scores above 80\% on benchmark datasets featuring diverse users and environments. The resulting models operate at just 6-8 mW when exploiting the Qualcomm Snapdragon Hexagon DSP, with our 2-channel implementation exceeding 70\% F1 accuracy and our 6-channel model surpassing 80\% F1 accuracy across all gesture classes in user studies. These results were achieved using only synthetic training data. This improves on the state-of-the-art for F1 accuracy by 20\% with a power reduction 25x when using DSP. This advancement brings deploying ultra-low-power vision systems in wearable devices closer and opens new possibilities for seamless human-computer interaction.
papers.comment: To be presented at ECCV-2026 at the Event-Based Multimodal Vision Workshop. 24 pages, 14 figures. Prarthana Bhattacharyya, Joshua Mitton, Ryan Page, Owen Morgan, and Oliver Powell contributed equally to this paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Helios 2.0 是一个面向智能眼镜等可穿戴设备的实时、超低功耗事件相机手势识别系统。系统选择拇指横滑和双指捏合等微手势，并借助合成数据仿真来覆盖不同用户与环境差异。在基准数据集和用户研究中，6 通道模型在各类手势上 F1 超过 80%，在 Qualcomm Snapdragon Hexagon DSP 上功耗仅 6–8 mW，且仅使用合成训练数据。
Motivation: 现有手势识别系统在可穿戴场景下难以兼顾直观性、跨用户与环境适应性以及足够的能效，导致实用化受限。
Method: 设计一组合适的微手势（拇指在食指上双向横滑、拇指与食指指尖双捏合），并提出一种仿真方法进行全面的域采样，以减少对真实数据采集的依赖；同时采用面向 DSP 的功耗优化架构。
Result: 模型在包含多样用户和环境的基准数据集上 F1 超过 80%；2 通道实现超过 70% F1，6 通道模型在所有手势类别上超过 80% F1，功耗 6–8 mW。相比现有方法，F1 提升 20%，DSP 功耗降低 25 倍。
Conclusion: 该工作表明仅用合成训练数据也能在超低功耗硬件上实现高精度手势识别，推动可穿戴视觉系统的落地，并为更自然的人机交互提供可能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Bringing Generative Learning to Representation Learning: Self-Supervised Transfer Learning as Distribution Matching
papers.abstract_en: Most self-supervised learning objectives defend against collapse but leave the target representation law unspecified. We formulate representation learning as Distribution Matching (DM), learning an augmentation-invariant encoder whose induced law matches an explicit geometric reference. The reference law specifies what the learned representation distribution should look like, whereas a separately chosen discrepancy determines how deviations from this target are measured; here we use Mallows distance. The DM framework reveals a directional inverse: generative learning maps a tractable reference to data, whereas representation learning maps data to a designed reference law. We connect the population objective to class-centre separation and classification error and prove a non-asymptotic neural-sieve guarantee. Simulations and image benchmarks show manifold rectification, fine-grained structure and transfer across label spaces.
papers.comment: 70 pages, 5 figures, and 6 tables. Substantially revised version with a new title, an explicit distribution-matching formulation linking generative learning and representation learning, expanded theoretical treatment, additional transfer experiments, and appendices integrated into the main file. Code is available at https://github.com/vincen-github/DM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将自监督表示学习形式化为分布匹配 (Distribution Matching, DM)：学习一个增广不变 (augmentation-invariant) 的编码器，使其诱导的分布匹配一个显式的几何参考分布，并使用 Mallows 距离度量偏差。作者指出生成学习与表示学习之间存在方向性逆关系，并将总体目标与类中心分离和分类误差联系起来，证明了一个非渐近的神经筛 (neural-sieve) 保证。
Motivation: 大多数自监督学习目标只防止表征坍塌 (collapse)，却没有指定目标表示律 (target representation law) 应该是什么，这使得学习到的表示缺乏显式约束。
Method: 将表示学习建模为分布匹配：参考律明确规定学习到的表示分布应呈现何种形态，而单独选择的散度（本文用 Mallows 距离）定义偏离该目标的度量方式。
Result: 摘要报告证明了总体目标与类中心分离和分类误差之间的联系，并给出非渐近神经筛保证；模拟实验和图像基准展示了流形矫正 (manifold rectification)、细粒度结构以及跨标签空间的迁移。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架揭示了生成学习与表示学习的统一视角：生成学习将易处理的参考分布映射到数据，而表示学习将数据映射到设计好的参考律。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Unified Approaches in Self-Supervised Event Stream Modeling: Progress and Prospects
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of digital interactions across diverse domains, such as healthcare, e-commerce, gaming, and finance, has resulted in the generation of vast volumes of event stream (ES) data. ES data comprises continuous sequences of timestamped events that encapsulate detailed contextual information relevant to each domain. While ES data holds significant potential for extracting actionable insights and enhancing decision-making, its effective utilization is hindered by challenges such as the scarcity of labeled data and the fragmented nature of existing research efforts. Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising paradigm to address these challenges by enabling the extraction of meaningful representations from unlabeled ES data. In this survey, we systematically review and synthesize SSL methodologies tailored for ES modeling across multiple domains, bridging the gaps between domain-specific approaches that have traditionally operated in isolation. We present a comprehensive taxonomy of SSL techniques, encompassing both predictive and contrastive paradigms, and analyze their applicability and effectiveness within different application contexts. Furthermore, we identify critical gaps in current research and propose a future research agenda aimed at developing scalable, domain-agnostic SSL frameworks for ES modeling. By unifying disparate research efforts and highlighting cross-domain synergies, this survey aims to accelerate innovation, improve reproducibility, and expand the applicability of SSL to diverse real-world ES challenges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于事件流数据（event stream data）自监督学习建模的综述，系统梳理了跨领域（医疗、电商、游戏、金融等）的SSL方法，提出涵盖预测式与对比式范式的统一分类法，并分析各方法在不同应用场景下的适用性。作者还识别了当前研究中的关键缺口，提出面向可扩展、领域无关的SSL框架的未来研究议程。
Motivation: 事件流数据规模庞大且蕴含丰富上下文信息，但标注数据稀缺，且现有研究高度碎片化、各领域方法彼此孤立，缺少统一的视角来推进有效表征学习。
Method: 采用综述性方法，构建SSL技术分类法，覆盖预测式（predictive）和对比式（contrastive）两大类范式，并结合多个应用领域分析其适用性与有效性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，主要贡献是系统化的分类法、对现有方法的整合分析，以及对研究缺口和未来方向的归纳。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要发展可扩展、领域无关的自监督学习框架，通过统一分散的研究努力来推动跨领域协同、提升可复现性，并扩大SSL在真实事件流问题中的应用范围。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: GestureLSM: Latent Shortcut based Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Spatial-Temporal Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Generating full-body human gestures based on speech signals remains challenges on quality and speed. Existing approaches model different body regions such as body, legs and hands separately, which fail to capture the spatial interactions between them and result in unnatural and disjointed movements. Additionally, their autoregressive/diffusion-based pipelines show slow generation speed due to dozens of inference steps. To address these two challenges, we propose GestureLSM, a flow-matching-based approach for Co-Speech Gesture Generation with spatial-temporal modeling. Our method i) explicitly model the interaction of tokenized body regions through spatial and temporal attention, for generating coherent full-body gestures. ii) introduce the flow matching to enable more efficient sampling by explicitly modeling the latent velocity space. To overcome the suboptimal performance of flow matching baseline, we propose latent shortcut learning and beta distribution time stamp sampling during training to enhance gesture synthesis quality and accelerate inference. Combining the spatial-temporal modeling and improved flow matching-based framework, GestureLSM achieves state-of-the-art performance on BEAT2 while significantly reducing inference time compared to existing methods, highlighting its potential for enhancing digital humans and embodied agents in real-world applications. Project Page: https://andypinxinliu.github.io/GestureLSM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GestureLSM，一个基于流匹配 (flow matching) 的共语手势生成方法，通过空间和时间注意力显式建模身体、腿、手等分区 token 之间的交互，并引入潜在捷径学习 (latent shortcut learning) 与 beta 分布时间戳采样以改善流匹配基线的生成质量并加速推理。摘要报告该方法在 BEAT2 上达到当前最优性能，同时显著减少推理时间。
Motivation: 现有全身体手势生成方法分别建模不同身体区域，忽略区域间的空间交互，导致动作不自然且脱节；同时自回归或扩散式管线因需要大量推理步骤而生成速度慢。
Method: 提出 GestureLSM 框架，利用空间与时间注意力对 tokenized 身体区域进行交互建模；采用流匹配并显式建模潜在速度空间，配合潜在捷径学习和 beta 分布时间戳采样来提升合成质量并加速推理。
Result: 摘要称 GestureLSM 在 BEAT2 上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并比现有方法显著降低推理时间。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合空间-时间建模与改进的流匹配框架，GestureLSM 在增强数字人与具身智能体的实时应用中具有潜力。

papers.title: ConfRetro: a 3D-aware template-free method for enhancing retrosynthesis via molecular conformer information
papers.abstract_en: Motivation: Retrosynthesis plays a crucial role in organic synthesis and drug discovery, focusing on identifying a set of reactants capable of synthesizing a target product molecule. Although the existing approaches have shown promising results, they do not fully exploit 3D conformer information and molecular spatial structure, which can hinder stereochemically consistent and chemically plausible predictions. Results: To tackle this problem, we propose ConfRetro, a Transformer-based template-free method that integrates molecular conformer information and spatial structure. We devise an Atom-align Fusion module to combine 3D positional information at the model input stage, ensuring alignment between atom tokens and corresponding 3D representations. Furthermore, we design a Distance-weighted Attention mechanism to guide self-attention, constraining the receptive field of model and emphasizing chemically relevant atom pairs in 3D space. Experiments conducted on the USPTO-50K and USPTO-FULL datasets demonstrate that ConfRetro significantly outperforms existing template-free approaches, achieving a new state-of-the-art performance. Case studies further highlight its capability to predict accurate and chemically plausible reactants, even for target molecules with intricate structures. Moreover, when plugged into a standard retrosynthetic search, ConfRetro recovers feasible synthetic routes for multiple representative drug molecules (e.g. Camptothecin). Availability and implementation: ConfRetro is available at https://github.com/Jesse-zjx/ConfRetro. Archival snapshot is available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20785018.
papers.journal_ref: Bioinformatics 42(8), btag575 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConfRetro 是一种基于 Transformer 的无模板逆合成 (template-free retrosynthesis) 方法，通过引入分子构象 (conformer) 信息与三维空间结构来改进反应物预测。方法包括 Atom-align Fusion 模块，在模型输入阶段对齐原子 token 与对应 3D 表示；以及 Distance-weighted Attention 机制，在 3D 空间中约束注意力感受野并突出化学相关的原子对。在 USPTO-50K 和 USPTO-FULL 数据集上，该方法显著优于现有无模板方法，并取得新的最优性能。
Motivation: 现有逆合成方法未充分利用 3D 构象信息和分子空间结构，可能导致预测在立体化学上不一致或化学上不可行；作者旨在通过显式建模空间信息来改善预测质量。
Method: 提出 ConfRetro，一个基于 Transformer 的无模板方法。其核心是 Atom-align Fusion 模块，在模型输入阶段将 3D 位置信息与原子 token 对齐融合；同时设计 Distance-weighted Attention 机制引导 self-attention，限制感受野并强调 3D 空间中化学相关的原子对。
Result: 在 USPTO-50K 和 USPTO-FULL 数据集上，ConfRetro 显著优于现有无模板方法，达到新的 state-of-the-art 性能。案例研究表明，它能为结构复杂的目标分子预测准确且化学合理的反应物；接入标准逆合成搜索后，可为多种代表性药物分子（如 Camptothecin）恢复可行合成路线。
Conclusion: 摘要的取点是，融合分子构象信息可有效提升无模板逆合成预测的化学合理性与准确性，并提供了开源实现（GitHub 与 Zenodo 快照）。

papers.title: Rethinking Token-wise Feature Caching: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers with Dual Feature Caching
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) have become the dominant methods in image and video generation yet still suffer substantial computational costs. As an effective approach for DiT acceleration, feature caching methods are designed to cache the features of DiT in previous timesteps and reuse them in the next timesteps, allowing us to skip the computation in the next timesteps. Among them, token-wise feature caching has been introduced to perform different caching ratios for different tokens in DiTs, aiming to skip the computation for unimportant tokens while still computing the important ones. In this paper, we propose to carefully check the effectiveness in token-wise feature caching with the following two questions: (1) Is it really necessary to compute the so-called "important" tokens in each step? (2) Are so-called important tokens really important? Surprisingly, this paper gives some counter-intuition answers, demonstrating that consistently computing the selected ``important tokens'' in all steps is not necessary. The selection of the so-called ``important tokens'' is often ineffective, and even sometimes shows inferior performance than random selection. Based on these observations, this paper introduces dual feature caching referred to as DuCa, which performs aggressive caching strategy and conservative caching strategy iteratively and selects the tokens for computing randomly. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in DiT, PixArt, FLUX, and OpenSora, demonstrating significant improvements than the previous token-wise feature caching.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视扩散 Transformer (DiT) 中 token-wise 特征缓存的有效性，提出两个反直觉问题：是否每步都必须计算所谓“重要”token，以及“重要”token 的选择是否真正重要。作者发现持续计算被选中的“重要 token”并非必要，且其选择时常不如随机选择。基于这些观察提出双重特征缓存 (DuCa)，迭代执行激进与保守缓存策略并随机选择要计算的 token，在 DiT、PixArt、FLUX 和 OpenSora 上验证了有效性。
Motivation: DiT 在图像和视频生成中占主导但计算成本很高；现有 token-wise 特征缓存按不同 token 采用不同缓存比例以跳过不重要 token 的计算，但作者质疑其基本假设，即这些“重要”token 是否真的需要每步计算、其选择是否真的有效。
Method: 提出 DuCa (dual feature caching)：交替使用激进缓存策略和保守缓存策略，并随机选择需要计算的 token，而不是依赖基于重要性的选择机制。
Result: 摘要报告在 DiT、PixArt、FLUX 和 OpenSora 上的大量实验表明，DuCa 相比之前的 token-wise 特征缓存方法有显著改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调反直觉的结论：持续计算被选中的“重要”token 并不必要，token 重要性选择常常无效甚至不如随机选择，因此随机选择搭配双策略缓存是更有效的加速方式。

papers.title: Experimentally Extending Quantum Kernel Learning to Quantum Data by NMR
papers.abstract_en: Quantum kernel learning (QKL) promises efficient machine learning by encoding feature maps onto exponentially large Hilbert spaces inherent in quantum systems. Using the liquid-state nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) platform, we implement and benchmark QKL for one-dimensional regression and two-dimensional classification tasks. We then classify entangling and non-entangling operators by extending QKL to handle parametrized or non-parameterized operator inputs. We first compute the kernel numerically for a double-layered star system and then experimentally validate it on a 3-qubit NMR register. QKL provides a practical route to compare operators on native quantum hardware without expensive tomography protocols. Our results confirm the superiority of QKL over other classical methods for processing quantum data, thereby highlighting its ability to capture the inherent structure of quantum space and to extend its domain of operation beyond the training domain by exploiting symmetries in the operator space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在液态核磁共振（NMR）平台上实现并基准测试量子核学习（QKL），用于一维回归和二维分类任务，并扩展 QKL 处理参数化或非参数化算子输入，进而对纠缠与非纠缠算子进行分类。作者先对双星系统数值计算核矩阵，再在 3-qubit NMR 寄存器上实验验证。结果显示 QKL 在处理量子数据上优于其他经典方法，并能通过算子空间的对称性将预测推广到训练域之外。
Motivation: QKL 理论上可将特征映射编码到指数级希尔伯特空间，但缺乏真实量子硬件上的系统实验验证。同时经典方法难以捕捉量子数据的内在结构，而量子态层析协议成本高昂，因此需要一个无需昂贵层析、能在原生量子硬件上比较算子的实用框架。
Method: 在液态 NMR 平台上实现 QKL，覆盖一维回归与二维分类；针对算子输入，将 QKL 扩展用于区分参数化和非参数化算子、纠缠与非纠缠算子。核矩阵先对双星系统做数值计算，再在 3-qubit NMR 寄存器上开展实验验证。
Result: 摘要报告实验结果证实 QKL 在处理量子数据方面优于其他经典方法；利用算子空间的对称性，QKL 能够将其工作范围扩展到训练域之外。
Conclusion: 作者认为 QKL 提供了一条免于昂贵层析协议、在原生量子硬件上比较算子的实际路径，能捕获量子空间的内在结构并利用对称性进行外推。

papers.title: MiniGPT-Reverse-Designing: Predicting Image Adjustments Utilizing MiniGPT-4
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have recently seen significant advancements through integrating with Large Language Models (LLMs). The VLMs, which process image and text modalities simultaneously, have demonstrated the ability to learn and understand the interaction between images and texts across various multi-modal tasks. Reverse designing, which could be defined as a complex vision-language task, aims to predict the edits and their parameters, given a source image, an edited version, and an optional high-level textual edit description. This task requires VLMs to comprehend the interplay between the source image, the edited version, and the optional textual context simultaneously, going beyond traditional vision-language tasks. In this paper, we extend and fine-tune MiniGPT-4 for the reverse designing task. Our experiments demonstrate the extensibility of off-the-shelf VLMs, specifically MiniGPT-4, for more complex tasks such as reverse designing. Code is available at this \href{https://github.com/VahidAz/MiniGPT-Reverse-Designing}{repository}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对逆向设计（reverse designing）这一视觉-语言任务，扩展并对 MiniGPT-4 进行微调：输入源图像、编辑后版本以及可选的高层文本编辑描述，目标是预测编辑操作及其参数。作者通过实验表明，现成的视觉语言模型（VLM）MiniGPT-4 可以被扩展到此类更复杂的多模态任务。代码已在 GitHub 开源。
Motivation: 逆向设计要求模型同时理解源图像、编辑后图像与可选文本上下文之间的相互作用，比传统视觉-语言任务更复杂，而现有 VLM 在该任务上的适配尚未被充分探索。
Method: 作者基于 MiniGPT-4 进行扩展和微调，将源图像、编辑版本和可选的文本编辑描述作为输入，训练模型预测编辑操作及其参数，利用 VLM 同时处理图像和文本模态的能力。
Result: 摘要报告实验证明了现成 VLM（尤其是 MiniGPT-4）对逆向设计等复杂任务的可扩展性，但未给出具体定量指标或基准数据集细节。
Conclusion: 作者强调现成 VLM 可以通过扩展和微调来处理更复杂的视觉-语言任务，并提供了代码仓库供复现；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。

papers.title: A Bi-directional Multi-solution Scalable Grover Search Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: Grover's search algorithms, including various Partial Grover Searches (PGS), suffer from scaling issues when multiple solutions are sought, as the number of iterations scales with the number of solutions or marked states, making implementation more computationally expensive. Inspired by recent PGS algorithms for multi-solution searchers, this article proposes a scalable Grover quantum search algorithm, referred to as Bi-directional Multi-solution scalable Grover Search (BMGS), to efficiently search for an arbitrary number of solutions from an unstructured database. We introduced a novel multi-segment bidirectional search tactic with PGS across multiple equal segments of each state, starting from an initial state and multiple marked states in parallel, obviating the need for merge operations. We have shown in this work that for each solution our novel approach requires at most $\sqrt{\mathcal{N}}\left (1- \sqrt{\frac{1}{b^{\lfloor\frac{r}{dk}\rfloor}}}\right)$ iterations (here, $\mathcal{N}=2^r$ elements, $k=\log_2 b$, $d$ is the number of equal segments on $r$ qubits, and $b$ is the branching factor). Our proposed BMGS algorithm is benchmarked against state-of-the-art Depth First Grover Search (DFGS) and PGS implementations for an arbitrary number of solutions, ranging from $2$ to $20$ qubits, as a proof of concept. We also show that our BMGS requires fewer iterations for shallow quantum circuits and achieves an optimal $\mathcal{O}$($\sqrt{s\mathcal{N}}$) average complexity for $s$ solutions, when $dk < r$. The Qiskit Python implementation of the proposed BMGS algorithm is available on GitHub\footnote{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Multi-Solution-DFGS-BMGS-B507/}.
papers.comment: 29 pages Accepted in Quantum Information Processing, Springer Nature Journal, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向任意数量解的可扩展 Grover 量子搜索算法 BMGS（Bi-directional Multi-solution scalable Grover Search），通过跨多个相等片段的双向部分 Grover 搜索（PGS）策略，从初始态和多个标记态并行搜索，避免合并操作。摘要给出每个解至多 \sqrt{N}(1-\sqrt{1/b^{\lfloor r/(dk)\rfloor}}) 次迭代的界，并称在 dk<r 时对 s 个解达到最优的 O(\sqrt{sN}) 平均复杂度；在 2 到 20 量子比特上对比了 DFGS 与 PGS 实现。
Motivation: 包括多种部分 Grover 搜索（PGS）在内的 Grover 类算法在求解多解问题时扩展性差，因为迭代次数随解或标记态数量增长，使实现更昂贵。
Method: 提出 BMGS 算法：采用新颖的多段双向搜索策略，在每个态的多段等分片段上并行执行 PGS，从初始态和多个标记态同时出发进行双向搜索，从而省去合并操作。
Result: 摘要证明对每个解最多需要 \sqrt{N}(1-\sqrt{1/b^{\lfloor r/(dk)\rfloor}}) 次迭代；当 dk<r 时，对 s 个解达到最优的 O(\sqrt{sN}) 平均复杂度，并报告 BMGS 在浅量子电路上比 DFGS 和 PGS 需要更少的迭代。
Conclusion: 作者认为 BMGS 是可扩展的多解量子搜索方案，所需迭代更少，并公开了基于 Qiskit 的 Python 实现（GitHub 匿名链接）。摘要未提及明显局限性。

papers.title: ODTlearn: A Package for Learning Optimal Decision Trees for Prediction and Prescription
papers.abstract_en: ODTlearn is an open source Python package that provides methods for learning optimal decision trees for high-stakes predictive and prescriptive tasks based on the state-of-the-art mixed-integer optimization (MIO) framework proposed in Aghaei et al. (2025). The current version of the package provides implementations for learning optimal classification trees, optimal fair classification trees, optimal prescriptive trees from observational data, and optimal classification trees robust to distribution shifts. We have designed the package to be easy to maintain and extend as new optimal decision tree problem classes, reformulation strategies, and solution algorithms are introduced. To this end, the package follows object-oriented design principles and supports both commercial (Gurobi) and open source (COIN-OR branch and cut) solvers. The package documentation, user guide, installation instructions, link to source code, and instructions for submitting bug reports and feature requests can all be found at https://d3m-research-group.github.io/odtlearn/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ODTlearn 是一个开源 Python 包，基于 Aghaei 等人提出的混合整数优化（MIO）框架，用于学习高风险的预测与处方（prescription）任务中的最优决策树。当前版本实现了最优分类树、公平最优分类树、从观测数据学习的最优处方树，以及对分布偏移鲁棒的最优分类树。包采用面向对象设计以便扩展，并同时支持商业求解器 Gurobi 和开源求解器 COIN-OR branch and cut。
Motivation: 高风险预测和处方任务需要可解释且可证明最优的决策树，但现有工具缺少基于最新 MIO 框架的系统实现；该包旨在提供一个易于维护和扩展的统一学习工具。
Method: 基于 Aghaei 等人（2025）的 MIO 框架，以混合整数规划形式化四类最优决策树问题，并通过面向对象架构将问题建模、重构策略与求解算法解耦，支持 Gurobi 和 COIN-OR 两种求解器。
Result: 摘要未报告数值实验结果；当前版本的贡献是覆盖四类最优决策树问题的实现，以及可扩展的包结构和多求解器支持。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该包易于维护和扩展，未来可加入新的问题类别、重构策略和求解算法；相关文档、用户指南、源代码和反馈渠道均已公开。

papers.title: Dynamic Pricing and Advertising with Demand Learning
papers.abstract_en: We consider a novel pricing and advertising framework in which a seller not only sets the product price but also designs flexible advertising schemes to influence customers' valuations of the product. We impose no structural restriction on the seller's feasible advertising strategies and allow her to advertise the product by disclosing or concealing any information. Following the information design literature, we model this fully flexible advertising as the seller choosing an arbitrary information policy that signals the product quality to customers. Customers observe the advertising signal and form a Bayesian posterior belief over the product quality. We investigate two questions in this work: (1) What is the value of advertising? To what extent can advertising enhance a seller's revenue? (2) Without any a priori knowledge of the customers' demand function, how can a seller adaptively learn and optimize both pricing and advertising strategies using past purchase responses? To study the first question, we quantify the value of advertising by comparing the optimal revenue from jointly designing advertising and a single posted price with the optimal revenue from pricing alone. We show that advertising can increase revenue by at most a factor of two, and this bound is tight. For the second question, we study the seller's dynamic pricing and advertising problem under demand uncertainty. Our main result for this question is a computationally efficient online algorithm that achieves the optimal $O(T^{2/3} (m\log T)^{1/3})$ regret rate when the valuation function is linear in the product quality. Here, $m$ is the cardinality of the discrete product quality domain and $T$ is the time horizon.
