papers.title: Score Attack: A Lower Bound Technique for Optimal Differentially Private Learning
papers.abstract_en: Achieving optimal statistical performance while ensuring the privacy of personal data is a challenging yet crucial objective in modern data analysis. However, characterizing the optimality, particularly the minimax lower bound, under privacy constraints is technically difficult. To address this issue, we propose a novel approach called the score attack, which provides a lower bound on the differential-privacy-constrained minimax risk of parameter estimation. The score attack method is based on the tracing attack concept in differential privacy and can be applied to any statistical model with a well-defined score statistic. It can optimally lower bound the minimax risk of estimating unknown model parameters, up to a logarithmic factor, while ensuring differential privacy for a range of statistical problems. We demonstrate the effectiveness and optimality of this general method in various examples, such as the generalized linear model in both classical and high-dimensional sparse settings, the Bradley-Terry-Luce model for pairwise comparisons, and nonparametric regression over the Sobolev class.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种名为 score attack 的下界技术，用于刻画差分隐私约束下参数估计的极小极大风险 (minimax risk) 下界。该方法借鉴差分隐私中的追踪攻击 (tracing attack) 概念，可应用于任意具有良好定义的得分统计量 (score statistic) 的统计模型，在至多对数因子内给出最优下界。作者在广义线性模型（经典与高维稀疏）、Bradley-Terry-Luce 成对比较模型以及 Sobolev 类非参数回归等例子中验证了其有效性与最优性。
Motivation: 在隐私约束下刻画统计最优性特别是极小极大下界在技术上很困难，论文旨在提供一种通用的下界证明技术，以解决差分隐私约束下参数估计极小极大风险的刻画难题。
Method: 提出 score attack 方法，基于差分隐私中的 tracing attack 概念，通过构造得分统计量来对差分隐私约束下的极小极大风险给出下界；该框架适用于任何具有良定义得分统计量的统计模型，并能达到至多对数因子下的最优下界。
Result: 论文在若干统计问题中展示了该方法的有效性，包括经典与高维稀疏广义线性模型、Bradley-Terry-Luce 成对比较模型以及 Sobolev 类非参数回归。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该方法为差分隐私约束下参数估计的极小极大下界提供了一种通用而最优（至多差对数因子）的刻画工具。

papers.title: Partial FC: Training 10 Million Identities on a Single Machine
papers.abstract_en: Training face recognition models with millions of identities is challenging because classifier storage, logit memory, and computation grow linearly with the number of classes, eventually making full softmax impractical even when the backbone itself fits comfortably in memory. We present Partial FC (PFC), a scalable approximation to large-class softmax that preserves every positive class center while activating only a sampled subset of negative centers in each mini-batch. This asymmetric treatment retains every target term while avoiding exhaustive interaction with millions of mostly uninformative negatives. Our distributed implementation partitions the classifier across GPUs and samples within each owned shard, so sampling reduces local matrix multiplication and logit storage while sharding eliminates class-gradient synchronization across workers. Together, these properties reduce GPU-resident classifier memory, computation, and class-dependent communication without feature-based hard-negative retrieval. End-to-end system benchmarks demonstrate efficient scaling to massive class spaces, including 64 million classes on a single eight-GPU machine. Across large-scale face-recognition datasets, moderate sampling rates maintain competitive recognition accuracy while substantially improving training efficiency. Our best PFC configurations achieve 97.2\% TAR on IJB-C at FAR $=10^{-4}$ and 94.0\% TAR on ICCV21-MFR at FAR $=10^{-6}$. Beyond clean training data, PFC is robust to inter-class conflicts, label noise, and long-tailed identity distributions: under 40\% label noise, PFC with conflict filtering raises ICCV21-MFR TAR from 43.9\% to 80.2\%, while on long-tailed data PFC improves TAR from 87.4\% to 92.0\%. These results establish positive-preserving negative sampling as an effective foundation for scalable, accurate, and robust identity classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Partial FC (PFC)，一种面向大规模人脸识别分类的大类 softmax 近似方法：每个 mini-batch 中保留全部正类中心，仅采样部分负类中心参与计算，并通过 GPU 间分片实现采样与去同步。系统基准显示在单台八卡机器上可扩展到 6400 万类，并在 IJB-C 与 ICCV21-MFR 上达到较高 TAR；同时对标签噪声、类间冲突和长尾分布表现出鲁棒性。
Motivation: 当身份类别数达到数百万甚至更多时，分类器存储、logit 内存和计算量随类别数线性增长，即使骨干网络内存可容纳，完整 softmax 也不再可行；需要一种可扩展的大类 softmax 近似方案。
Method: PFC 在每个 mini-batch 中保留所有正类中心，仅对负类中心做子采样；分布式实现将分类器分片到各 GPU，并在各自拥有的分片内采样，从而减少本地矩阵乘法、logit 存储和跨 worker 的类梯度同步，且无需基于特征的难负例检索。
Result: 端到端系统基准表明可高效扩展至 6400 万类；最佳配置在 IJB-C 上达到 97.2% TAR (FAR=1e-4)，在 ICCV21-MFR 上达到 94.0% TAR (FAR=1e-6)。在 40% 标签噪声下，配合冲突过滤可将 ICCV21-MFR TAR 从 43.9% 提升到 80.2%；在长尾数据上 TAR 从 87.4% 提升到 92.0%。
Conclusion: 作者认为保留正类、采样负类的非对称策略是构建可扩展、准确且鲁棒的身份分类的有效基础，并强调其对噪声、冲突和长尾分布的稳健性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Trust Is Not Enough: Influence Calibration for On-Policy Self-Distillation in Agentic RL
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) gives language agents dense token-level supervision from a privileged self-teacher on the policy's own trajectories. Existing methods allocate this supervision mainly by teacher trust, but trust does not reveal whether emphasizing a token supports the current policy objective. We call this the trust-utility mismatch and introduce Influence Calibration for Self-Distillation (ICSD). For each supervised token, ICSD measures the first-order response of its importance-weighted RL surrogate contribution to a teacher-directed output perturbation. Batch-adaptive calibration converts this non-stationary signal into a bounded allocation weight while preserving the original auxiliary-loss mass within each action turn. These detached weights affect only the distillation loss and require no additional model pass. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA, ICSD improves all matched aggregate metrics over trust-only allocation under Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO), across two model families spanning 1.5B to 7B. At 7B, it reaches 96.1% ALFWorld success and a WebShop score of 93.1. Frozen-batch analyses show that ICSD reduces teacher-supported mass assigned to objective-opposed tokens from 60.1% to 37.8% and raises cosine compatibility with the RL gradient by 0.192. A companion repository is avail- able at https://github.com/lanqz7766/Influence-Calibration-for-On-Policy-Self-Distillation-in-Agentic-RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在线策略自蒸馏 (on-policy self-distillation, OPSD) 中仅按教师信任分配监督的问题，提出影响校准自蒸馏 (ICSD)。ICSD 对每个被监督 token，通过 teacher-directed 输出扰动的一阶响应度量其重要性加权 RL surrogate 贡献，并用批自适应校准转换为有界分配权重。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Search-QA 上，该方法在 GRPO 与 GiGPO 下、两个模型族（1.5B–7B）中均优于纯信任分配，7B 模型取得 ALFWorld 成功率 96.1%、WebShop 得分 93.1。
Motivation: 现有 OPSD 方法主要依据教师信任来分配 token 级监督，但信任度并不揭示强调某个 token 是否支持当前策略目标，作者称之为 trust-utility mismatch（信任-效用错配），这限制了蒸馏监督对策略优化的作用。
Method: 提出 ICSD：对每个被监督 token，测量其重要性加权 RL surrogate 贡献对 teacher-directed 输出扰动的一阶响应（first-order response）；通过批自适应校准 (batch-adaptive calibration) 将该非平稳信号转为有界分配权重，同时保持每个 action turn 内原始辅助损失质量不变。detached weights 只影响蒸馏损失，且不需要额外模型前向计算。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA 三个环境上，ICSD 在所有匹配的聚合指标上均优于 trust-only 分配；7B 规模下 ALFWorld 成功率达 96.1%，WebShop 得分为 93.1。frozen-batch 分析显示，ICSD 将分配给与目标相反 token 的 teacher-supported 质量从 60.1% 降至 37.8%，并使与 RL 梯度的余弦兼容性提高 0.192。
Conclusion: 摘要强调信任本身不足以指导 OPSD 监督分配，需要依据监督对当前策略目标的实际影响进行校准；ICSD 在不增加额外模型 pass 的情况下改进了智能体任务表现。

papers.title: SkillComposer: Learning Reusable Skills for Natural-Language Robot Programming
papers.abstract_en: Natural-language interfaces can lower the barrier to programming robots, but existing systems struggle when users request complex tasks. While large language models (LLMs) perform well with simple commands, they often struggle to generate code for multi-step tasks, decompose high-level instructions, or reuse prior solutions. We present SkillComposer, an interactive natural-language robot programming system for simulation environments that continually learns reusable program abstractions. SkillComposer uses a generate-test architecture in which an LLM iteratively generates and revises robot programs before execution. Successful programs are stored and processed by an online library-learning algorithm that compresses recurring function sequences into reusable macro skills for future tasks. We evaluate SkillComposer through ablation experiments and a user study with 12 participants to determine its effectiveness on manipulation and robot caregiving tasks. The results show that evaluator-guided generation and learned abstractions improve success rates and usability while reducing user effort in natural-language robot programming.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE Humanoids 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillComposer，一个面向仿真环境的交互式自然语言机器人编程系统，通过持续学习可复用的程序抽象来降低用户编程门槛。系统采用生成-测试架构，由大语言模型迭代生成并修正机器人程序，成功的程序会被在线库学习算法压缩为可复用的宏技能。摘要报告了消融实验和 12 名参与者的用户研究，显示评估者引导的生成和学习到的抽象能提高任务成功率、可用性并减少用户负担。
Motivation: 现有自然语言机器人编程接口在处理复杂多步任务时表现不佳，大语言模型难以分解高层指令、生成多步程序或复用已有解决方案。
Method: 提出 SkillComposer，采用生成-测试架构，让 LLM 迭代生成并修订程序直到执行成功；成功程序由在线库学习算法处理，将重复出现的函数序列压缩为可复用的宏技能（macro skills）供未来任务使用。
Result: 通过消融实验和 12 名参与者的用户研究表明，评估者引导的程序生成和学到的程序抽象能提高操作（manipulation）和机器人照护（caregiving）任务的成功率和可用性，同时减少用户编程努力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将评估者反馈纳入生成过程并持续积累可复用技能，是改善自然语言机器人编程效果与用户体验的有效途径。

summary_sections.method: 提出 SkillComposer，采用生成-测试架构，让 LLM 迭代生成并修订程序直到执行成功；成功程序由在线库学习算法处理，将重复出现的函数序列压缩为可复用的宏技能（macro skills）供未来任务使用。
summary_sections.result: 通过消融实验和 12 名参与者的用户研究表明，评估者引导的程序生成和学到的程序抽象能提高操作（manipulation）和机器人照护（caregiving）任务的成功率和可用性，同时减少用户编程努力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，将评估者反馈纳入生成过程并持续积累可复用技能，是改善自然语言机器人编程效果与用户体验的有效途径。

papers.title: Skill Blocks: How Should an Agent Load Its Skill? A Caching-Correct Comparison of Pre-load, On-Demand Tool-Loading, Progressive Disclosure, and Hybrid
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are often injected in full on every request, increasing token cost. We compare four content-preserving loading methods: Full, Skill Block, Reference, and Hybrid. Across SearchQA, SpreadsheetBench, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SynthProc, we measure token usage using raw input for single-turn tasks and cache-correct effective input for multi-turn tasks. Results show no universal winner. Hybrid reduces input by 27.4% on SearchQA and 39.8% on SpreadsheetBench. On large multi-turn skills, Skill Block and Hybrid achieve substantial reductions, reaching 62.5% and 52.8% on ScienceWorld and 73.0% and 66.6% on SynthProc. ALFWorld shows smaller gains because procedures are short and repeatedly needed. Paired outcome tests detect no quality differences, though they do not establish equivalence. Overall, conditional loading is most beneficial when large portions of a skill are not needed on every turn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能体技能注入的 token 成本问题，比较四种内容保持的加载方式：Full、Skill Block、Reference 和 Hybrid，在 SearchQA、SpreadsheetBench、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 与 SynthProc 上分别用原始输入（单轮）和缓存修正有效输入（多轮）衡量 token 用量。结果表明不存在普遍最优方法；Hybrid 在 SearchQA 和 SpreadsheetBench 上分别降低输入 27.4% 与 39.8%，Skill Block 与 Hybrid 在大型多轮技能上取得显著压缩，ScienceWorld 达 62.5% 与 52.8%，SynthProc 达 73.0% 与 66.6%，ALFWorld 因流程短且每轮必需而增益较小。配对结果检验未发现质量差异，但也不足以建立等价性。
Motivation: 智能体技能常常在每次请求中全量注入，导致 token 成本随调用轮次线性增长；现有做法缺乏对不同按需加载策略在缓存感知下的一致比较。
Method: 提出一种内容保持的加载方法对比框架：Full 为全量注入，Skill Block 为按块条件加载，Reference 为引用式加载，Hybrid 为混合策略；并用单轮原始输入与多轮缓存修正有效输入两种口径度量 token 开销。
Result: 混合方法在 SearchQA 上减少输入 27.4%，在 SpreadsheetBench 上减少 39.8%；在 ScienceWorld 和 SynthProc 等大型多轮技能上，Skill Block 与 Hybrid 分别达到 62.5%/52.8% 和 73.0%/66.6% 的缩减；ALFWorld 增益较小。配对检验未发现结果质量差异。
Conclusion: 条件式加载在技能中大部分内容并非每轮必需时收益最大；虽然未检测到质量差异，但检验并不证明等价，实际效果仍取决于任务结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Looks Can be Deceiving: Annotator and Reviewer Performance Across Imagery Sources in Crowd-Sourced Aerial Damage Assessment
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents the first known empirical investigation of annotator and reviewer performance across multi-source remotely sensed imagery, evaluating human labeling across drone, crewed aviation, and satellite views. Because existing aerial imagery datasets rely predominantly on single-source imagery, there is no currently established state of practice for efficiently allocating human labor to curate large-scale, multi-source aerial datasets. This work addresses this limitation by analyzing annotator and reviewer performance within a post-disaster building damage assessment dataset of 9 disasters, where 20041 buildings in drone, 20695 buildings in crewed aviation, and 33392 buildings in satellite imagery were labeled. These labels, provided by 187 annotators, were then refined through two successive quality-control stages: a single-reviewer pass followed by a consensus-committee review. Our analysis reveals two findings that raise questions for standard crowd-sourcing practices. First, initial annotations were revised by the final committee at rates that rise steeply from higher- to lower-resolution sources (25.27% for crewed aviation and 36.95% for satellite), with the same ordering at every observed workflow stage. Second, a single individual review reduced but did not resolve this disagreement: after review, the committee still revised 6.85% of drone, 14.05% of crewed, and 20.86% of satellite labels. These observations suggest that, in workflows like this one, uniform review allocation leaves the most residual disagreement in lower-resolution imagery. Based on this evidence, and consistent with prior work on adaptive task assignment and budget-aware quality control, this paper offers three recommendations for multi-source dataset curation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对无人机、有人驾驶航空和卫星等多源遥感影像中的标注者与审核者表现进行实证研究，基于包含 9 场灾难、74 138 栋建筑（无人机 20041 栋、有人机 20695 栋、卫星 33392 栋）的灾后建筑损毁评估数据集。187 名标注者提供的标签先后经过单人审核和共识委员会评审两轮质量控制后被修正。分析显示，从高分辨率到低分辨率影像，最终委员会修订初始标注的比例依次升高（有人机 25.27%、卫星 36.95%），且单人审核后仍存在明显的残余分歧。
Motivation: 现有航拍影像数据集大多依赖单一影像来源，缺乏在多来源数据上高效分配人工标注与审核劳动力的成熟实践，这限制了大规模多源航拍数据集的构建。
Method: 对多源航拍影像灾后损毁标注流程进行分析，统计 187 名标注者在 9 场灾难数据上的标注结果，并通过两阶段质量控制（单人审核后再由共识委员会复核）追踪每一阶段的修订率，进而提出三条多源数据集整理建议。
Result: 最终委员会对有人机和卫星影像初始标注的修订比例分别为 25.27% 和 36.95%，高于无人机数据；经过单人审核后，委员会仍会修订 6.85% 的无人机、14.05% 的有人机和 20.86% 的卫星标签，表明统一的审核分配会让低分辨率影像残留最多的分歧。
Conclusion: 作者认为此类流程中均匀分配审核劳动并不高效，并依据证据以及自适应任务分配和预算感知质量控制的相关工作，给出针对多源数据集整理的三条建议。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Degeneracy Counting Quantum Algorithm using Decoherence
papers.abstract_en: Counting the global optima of a classical optimization problem is a #P-hard task. We develop the canonical thermal pure quantum (CTPQ) state-based degeneracy counting (CTPQsd#) algorithm that determines the number of global optima of a classical optimization problem P by measuring only a small probe S, without finding individual minima. The method exploits a perturbative relation between the decoherence measure of S and the degeneracy of P when S and P are together in a CTPQ state. We provide the first numerical demonstration that this relation can be used to count the global minima, applying it to problems encoded by diagonal random-energy Hamiltonians as a maximally unstructured testbed for classical binary optimization problems. Classical simulations of up to 20 problem qubits quantify the algorithm's sensitivity to variations in the temperature of the CTPQ state, the Hamiltonian energy range, the problem size, and degeneracy. We establish the temperature threshold for determining the exact degeneracy and identify a second, lower threshold that provides a temperature window to count near-degenerate minima within a user-defined energy tolerance. By confining measurement to S, the protocol replaces tomography over the exponentially large problem Hilbert space with tomography over a small probe represented by only four qubits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于退相干测量的简并度计数量子算法 CTPQsd#，利用规范热纯量子 (CTPQ) 态中探测子系统 S 的退相干度量与经典优化问题 P 的全局最优解数目之间的微扰关系，仅测量四比特探针即可统计全局最优解数量，无需逐一寻找极小值。作者在由对角随机能量哈密顿量编码的经典二值优化问题上首次给出数值验证，经典模拟最多 20 个问题比特，并刻画了温度、能量范围、问题规模和简并度对算法灵敏度的影响。
Motivation: 统计经典优化问题的全局最优解数量是 #P-难任务，传统方法要么需要找到所有极小值，要么需要对指数大的问题希尔伯特空间做层析，成本极高。
Method: 构造 CTPQ 态并利用 S 与 P 共同处于该态时退相干度量与简并度之间的微扰关系，将测量限制在一个仅含四个量子比特的小探针 S 上，从而用对小探针的层析替代对整个问题空间的层析。
Result: 经典模拟结果表明算法可计数全局最小值，并确立了一个确定精确简并度的温度阈值，以及一个较低的第二阈值，在用户定义的能量容差内形成可计数近简并极小值的温度窗口。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法通过只测量小探针即可完成简并度计数，避免指数规模的态层析，但其精度受 CTPQ 态温度、哈密顿量能量范围、问题规模与简并度等因素影响。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Is an Agent Evaluation Over? Outcome Finality and Cross-Unit Separation
papers.abstract_en: Current agent evaluations score models on the state visible at the end of a stopped run which they count as one trial. However, interpreting the score as a final result would require two conditions that the endpoint does not itself necessarily establish: outcome finality and cross-unit separation. These conditions are independent, since reconciling a delayed outcome can settle the label while runs still share state and isolating runs can prevent carryover while the scored outcome remains unfinished. We develop a completion argument that specifies the evidence needed for each decision and argue that a final label is justified only when anything that could still change the claimed outcome is resolved, bounded, or retained as uncertainty. First, in a controlled replay to demonstrate the mechanism where an agent's actions were held fixed, we find that the endpoint and terminal labels differ for every delayed operation, while a delayed write changes the next run's score when service state persists between runs but not after isolation or verified reset. Second, in a review of ten public protocols, we find that all protocols identify when a run stops and what is scored, while unfinished operations and the evidence for treating runs as separate trials are documented less consistently. Finally, we propose an open-effects record that lists operations or resources that may remain relevant after the endpoint, their current status, and whether they could change the scored outcome or affect another run.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论智能体评估中把停止运行结束时的可见状态当作单次试验得分的做法是否成立，提出两个必要条件：结果最终性 (outcome finality) 与跨单元分离 (cross-unit separation)。作者给出“完成论证” (completion argument) 说明何时才能给最终标签，并通过受控回放和十份公开协议审查来展示延迟操作、状态持久化对分数的影响，最后提出 open-effects record 记录端点后仍可能相关的操作或资源。
Motivation: 现有智能体评估把停止运行末端可见状态作为单次 trial 的得分，但得分要解释为最终结果还需要端点本身未保证的两个条件，而延迟结果和运行间状态共享都可能破坏评估有效性。
Method: 提出完成论证，规定最终标签仅在可能改变声称结果的因素被解决、界定或保留为不确定性时成立；用代理动作固定的受控回放演示机制，并审查十份公开协议，随后提出 open-effects record 记录端点后仍可能相关的操作/资源及其状态。
Result: 受控回放中端点标签与终止标签在每个延迟操作上都不一致；当服务状态在运行间保留时，延迟写入会改变下一轮的分数，而隔离或验证性重置后不会。十份公开协议都标明运行停止时机和评分对象，但对未完成操作及运行作为独立试验的证据记录一致性较差。
Conclusion: 作者认为最终标签的正当性取决于未决因素是否被解决、界定或保留为不确定性，并建议用 open-effects record 来记录端点后相关操作和跨运行影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Small Models Scout Bottleneck Order for Large-Model Data Control
papers.abstract_en: Small proxy models are commonly used to identify data mixtures for larger-scale training. We ask whether their training trajectories reveal another transferable structure: the order in which larger models should resolve skill bottlenecks. We formulate first-passage skill training, where each monitored skill has a target floor and the objective is to minimize the tokens required to reach all floors. We introduce LogFloor, a closed-loop controller that directs each round toward current bottlenecks, producing phase-ordered resolution trajectories. Across five bAbI skill slices on Qwen2.5-1.5B, LogFloor reduces token cost by 56.2% on average. In 70M-to-12B transfer, three-round replay of a 70M scout path reaches every floor in all eight target runs, saving 30.9% by pair mean, 39.4% in pooled training tokens, and 37.6% under source-cost accounting. On MMLU-control, a frozen scout path succeeds across all eight 12B runs. Collapsing a path to its static marginal mixture or reversing its phase order removes most benefits, while bottleneck labels alone remain partially useful. These results identify phase-ordered bottleneck resolution as a transferable curriculum structure for monitored skill-targeted training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用小代理模型（small proxy model）的训练轨迹来预测大模型应解决技能瓶颈的顺序，并将此形式化为 first-passage skill training 问题。作者引入 LogFloor 闭环控制器，使训练按当前瓶颈分阶段有序推进；在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 的五个 bAbI 技能切片上平均节省 56.2% token，并将 70M 侦察路径迁移至 70M-12B 训练。
Motivation: 小代理模型已被用于识别大规模训练的数据混合，但现有工作没有探索其训练轨迹中是否还包含另一种可迁移结构，即大模型应该按何种顺序解决各个技能瓶颈。
Method: 将目标定义为每个受监控技能达到目标下限（floor），以总 token 消耗最小化；提出 LogFloor 闭环控制器，每轮把训练导向当前瓶颈，从而产生相位有序（phase-ordered）的求解轨迹，并支持用小模型的离线路径回放来引导大模型。
Result: 在五个 bAbI 技能切片上，Qwen2.5-1.5B 的 token 成本平均降低 56.2%。70M-12B 迁移中，三次回放 70M 侦察路径可在全部八个目标运行中达到所有下限，按配对均值节省 30.9%、池化训练 token 节省 39.4%、按源成本核算节省 37.6%；MMLU-control 上冻结侦察路径在全部八个 12B 运行中成功。将路径退化为静态边际混合或反转相位顺序会消除大部分收益，仅用瓶颈标签仍保留部分效用。
Conclusion: 作者认为相位有序的瓶颈解决顺序是一种可迁移的课程结构，适用于受监控的技能定向训练场景；收益依赖路径的相位顺序本身，而不仅是最终的混合比例。

papers.title: Developing an Offshore Machine Learning Surface Layer Scheme
papers.abstract_en: Turbulent fluxes between the surface and the atmosphere are typically parameterized using empirically fit relationships. Here we test machine learning techniques for fitting the relationship for the offshore environment. To do that, data from three offshore sites are used: the Martha's Vineyard Coastal Observatory (MVCO) air-sea interaction tower, the FINO1 research platform, and the CASPER-West FLIP research vessel deployed off the coast of California. Two machine learning methods were employed: Neural Networks (NN) and Random Forests (RF). Because the observational sites had towers with measurements at different levels, the vertical differences were input as gradients. Models were built for both momentum flux and heat flux. ML models trained at the individual sites were competitive with and in some cases, better than the physically-based COARE-3 model tailored to offshore fluxes. The heat flux ML models generally outperformed the physics-based parameterizations for most metrics, but the results were mixed for momentum flux, with only the site with the most training data (MVCO) producing results better than COARE-3. When the ML models from that site were applied to the other sites, results were degraded from using data from the site being tested. ML models built from data combined from the three sites generally showed improvements for the sites with less available training data. When assessing which variables were most important, the wind speed was most important for momentum flux and temperature gradient for heat flux.
papers.comment: This Work has been submitted to Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对近海环境中海气湍流通量参数化通常依赖经验拟合关系的问题，测试用机器学习方法拟合该关系。研究使用 MVCO、FINO1 和 CASPER-West FLIP 三个近海观测站的数据，分别用神经网络和随机森林构建动量通量与热通量模型，并以垂直梯度作为输入特征。结果表明单站训练的 ML 模型能与基于物理的 COARE-3 模型竞争，热通量模型在多数指标上优于物理参数化，动量通量则结果不一；跨站迁移效果下降，合并三站数据训练对数据较少的站点有改善。变量重要性分析显示风速对动量通量最重要，温度梯度对热通量最重要。
Motivation: 海气界面的湍流通量通常用经验拟合关系参数化，而近海环境可能与开放海域不同。作者希望检验机器学习是否能为该环境提供更好或更具竞争力的通量拟合方案。
Method: 使用三个近海观测站的观测数据，因塔上测量高度不同，将垂直差异作为梯度输入；分别用神经网络和随机森林构建动量通量和热通量模型，并与面向近海通量的 COARE-3 物理模型进行比较，同时评估跨站迁移和合并数据训练的效果。
Result: 单站训练的 ML 模型与 COARE-3 相当甚至更优；热通量 ML 模型在多数指标上优于物理参数化，动量通量则只有训练数据最多的 MVCO 站点优于 COARE-3。将 MVCO 模型应用于其他站点时性能下降，而合并三站数据训练的模型对数据较少的站点总体有改善；变量重要性方面，风速对动量通量最重要，温度梯度对热通量最重要。
Conclusion: 作者认为机器学习方案可用于近海表面层通量建模，热通量收益更明显，而动量通量表现受训练数据量影响较大；跨站迁移仍具挑战，合并多站数据有助于数据稀缺站点。研究局限于两个 ML 方法和三个观测站点。

papers.title: Training Leaves Traces: Centered Residual Signatures for Language Model Lineage Verification
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight language models are fine-tuned, quantized, pruned, and merged, yet their provenance is often undocumented. We study data-free white-box lineage verification: can weights alone reveal whether two compatible model checkpoints share ancestry? Residual training produces a shared identity-aligned component in branch products, so this structure alone cannot establish ancestry. We remove it and compare checkpoint-specific structure across residual blocks, yielding a symmetric lineage score calibrated against independent checkpoints. On residual-MLP and GPT-2 benchmarks, the score separates fine-tuned, LoRA-merged, pruned, and quantized descendants from independent and distilled models (AUROC=1.0), distinguishing weight ancestry from behavioral similarity. Under function-preserving checkpoint laundering experiments, weight-space baselines lose margin or fail; our score remains unchanged and runs 76x faster than the nearest robust baseline on GPT-2. The projection-pairing signal appears across six language-model families and beyond, and a case study correctly identifies 3 related and 7 unrelated LLaMA-2 public checkpoints. Collectively, these results establish a passive, data-free provenance signal for compatible open-weight language-model checkpoints
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究开放权重语言模型的数据无关白盒谱系验证：能否仅凭权重判断两个兼容检查点是否共享祖先。作者发现残差训练会在分支产物中留下共享的身份对齐成分，因此先去除该成分，再比较跨残差块的检查点特有结构，得到与独立检查点校准的对称谱系分数。在 residual-MLP 和 GPT-2 基准上，该分数能以 AUROC=1.0 区分微调、LoRA 合并、剪枝、量化后代与独立及蒸馏模型，并且在检查点洗白实验中保持稳定，运行速度比最接近的稳健基线快 76 倍。案例研究正确识别了 3 个相关和 7 个无关的 LLaMA-2 公开检查点。
Motivation: 开放权重语言模型常被微调、量化、剪枝和合并，但其来源往往没有记录；需要一种被动的、无需数据的方法，仅从权重本身验证两个兼容检查点是否共享训练祖先。
Method: 提出数据无关的白盒谱系验证方法：先移除残差训练产生的共享身份对齐成分，再跨残差块比较检查点特有结构，生成与独立检查点校准的对称谱系分数，用以区分权重祖先关系而非行为相似性。
Result: 在 residual-MLP 和 GPT-2 基准上，该方法以 AUROC=1.0 区分微调、LoRA 合并、剪枝和量化后代与独立及蒸馏模型；在保持函数不变的检查点洗白实验中，权重空间基线失效或失去裕度，而该方法分数不变，且在 GPT-2 上比最接近的稳健基线快 76 倍；投影配对信号出现在六个语言模型家族中，案例研究正确识别 3 个相关和 7 个无关的 LLaMA-2 公开检查点。
Conclusion: 这些结果建立了针对兼容开放权重语言模型检查点的被动、数据无关的谱系验证信号，能够区分权重祖先关系与行为相似性。

papers.title: Impacts of Sulfate Injection Geoengineering on Particulate Matter with Diameter less than 2.5 μm
papers.abstract_en: Particulate matter with aerodynamic diameter less than 2.5 μm (PM2.5) is of great concern for human health. Here, for the first time, we examine the impact of sulfate aerosol geoengineering on PM2.5, using the output from the Geoengineering Large Ensemble (GLENS) project. GLENS is an ensemble of climate model simulations injecting SO2 into the stratosphere to balance RCP8.5 forcing using the Community Earth System Model, version 1. GLENS geoengineering reduces global averaged surface PM2.5 mass concentrations compared with RCP8.5 and also changes PM2.5 composition with more percentages of organic carbon and sulfate. The total reduction of PM2.5 is a result of less dust and sea salt concentrations. Dust emission is declined under GLENS geoengineering because of increased soil moisture and leaf area index over desert regions, and less emission of sea salt is due to slower wind speeds when geoengineering is applied. Excluding dust and sea salt, there is more global averaged PM2.5 under GLENS geoengineering relative to RCP8.5, predominantly due to more aerosol phase secondary organic aerosol (SOA). Since gas precursors of SOA are prescribed in the simulations, a cooler environment with geoengineering tends to transfer more gas phase SOA to aerosol phase. Changes in PM2.5 concentration and composition with applied geoengineering may have potential human health impact. Another new finding of this study is that the large amount of injected SO2 does not increase surface sulfate aerosol as a component of PM2.5, as the majority of sulfate aerosol reaching the boundary layer is in the coarse mode, which represents a very small fraction of the PM2.5. But the difference of deposition spatial distribution between geoengineering and RCP8.5 may have potential impacts on ecosystem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次利用 Geoengineering Large Ensemble (GLENS) 项目输出，研究硫酸盐气溶胶地球工程（向平流层注入 SO2）对地表 PM2.5 浓度与组成的影响。结果显示 GLENS 地球工程相比 RCP8.5 降低全球平均地表 PM2.5 质量浓度，但组成中有机碳和硫酸盐占比升高；总减少主要来自沙尘和海盐减少，排除这两者后 PM2.5 反而增加，主要源于二次有机气溶胶 (SOA) 从气相向气溶胶相转移增多。研究还发现注入的 SO2 并未显著增加作为 PM2.5 组分的表面硫酸盐气溶胶，因为到达边界层的硫酸盐主要处于粗模态。
Motivation: PM2.5 与人体健康密切相关，而硫酸盐气溶胶地球工程可能改变大气气溶胶组成与浓度，但此前缺乏对 PM2.5 的专门评估。
Method: 分析 GLENS 项目的气候模型模拟输出，该模拟使用 Community Earth System Model version 1 向平流层注入 SO2 以平衡 RCP8.5 强迫，并与 RCP8.5 对比 PM2.5 浓度、组成、沙尘/海盐排放及硫酸盐模态分布。
Result: GLENS 地球工程相比 RCP8.5 降低全球平均地表 PM2.5 浓度，且组成上有机碳和硫酸盐百分比增加；总减少归因于沙尘和海盐减少，其中沙尘减少与沙漠地区土壤湿度和叶面积指数增加有关，海盐减少与风速降低有关；排除沙尘和海盐后 PM2.5 增加，主要由更多气溶胶相 SOA 导致；注入 SO2 没有增加作为 PM2.5 成分的表面硫酸盐，因为到达边界层的硫酸盐主要在粗模态。
Conclusion: 地球工程对 PM2.5 浓度和组成的变化可能影响人类健康，且地球工程与 RCP8.5 之间沉积空间分布的差异可能影响生态系统。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LLMs Can Predict Failure Risk, But Struggle to Predict Which Collaboration Protocol Pays Off: Cost-Aware Protocol Routing Across Reasoning Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems can improve reasoning by spending more computation, but deployment requires deciding when extra collaboration is worth its cost. We isolate this decision by running every problem under four protocols while holding the solver fixed within each setting: direct solving (Baseline), iterative self-correction (Single), planner-executor-reviewer collaboration (PER), and multi-agent deliberation (Broadcast). The primary benchmark comprises 4,181 competition-level math problems; paired robustness checks cover four benchmarks spanning competition math, biology, and broader science with two solver families. Across fixed policies, trained routers, and frozen LLM routers, conservative policies under-escalate, whereas higher-solve frozen routers often over-escalate. A post-answer, pre-collaboration gpt-oss-120b probe ranks Baseline failures with 0.8847 AUROC (4,151 parseable cases; 95% CI [0.8732, 0.8955]). The same score remains informative for predicting whether any collaboration helps (0.7683 AUPRC), but is much weaker for identifying PER- or Broadcast-specific value (0.1674 and 0.1041 AUPRC). Separately, the pre-answer self-confidence gate reaches 78.0% solve at 45K tokens, compared with 73.8% at 71.3K for a frozen gpt-oss-120b router and 92.4% for a retrospective fixed-order oracle. Across 10 paired model-condition settings, the oracle adds 23.2-58.3 points of retrospective coverage over Baseline, but protocol profiles vary by task. In the six settings with held-out router evaluations, oracle gaps remain 18.5-28.9 points. Confidence can therefore support initial escalation, while protocol-specific cost-aware routing remains unresolved.

TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体LLM系统在推理任务中如何决定何时值得为额外协作付出计算成本。作者保持求解器固定，在4,181道竞赛级数学题上对每个问题运行四种协议：直接求解（Baseline）、迭代自校正（Single）、规划器-执行器-评审器协作（PER）和多智能体商议（Broadcast），并在四个基准上做配对鲁棒性检验。结果显示保守策略往往升级不足，而高求解率的冻结路由器常过度升级；一个事后、协作前的gpt-oss-120b探针能较好排序Baseline失败，但预测具体协议价值的准确性明显较弱。
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统可通过增加计算来提升推理，但实际部署需要在额外协作与成本之间做决策。现有方法缺乏对这一升级决策的系统性隔离和成本感知评估，作者希望明确什么时候协作值得、以及能否预测哪种协议更有效。
Method: 在固定求解器的条件下，对每个问题运行四种设定的协作协议，比较固定策略、训练路由器与冻结LLM路由器的表现；并引入一个事后预协作探针（post-answer, pre-collaboration gpt-oss-120b）用于预测Baseline失败，以及一个预答自信门（pre-answer self-confidence gate）用于决定是否升级协作。
Result: 事后探针在4,151个可解析案例上排序Baseline失败的AUROC为0.8847（95% CI [0.8732, 0.8955]）；预测“任何协作是否有帮助”的AUPRC为0.7683，但识别PER和Broadcast特定价值的AUPRC仅分别为0.1674和0.1041。预答自信门在45K tokens下达到78.0%求解率，优于冻结gpt-oss-120b路由器的73.8%（71.3K tokens），但低于回顾性固定顺序oracle的92.4%。在10个配对设置中，oracle相对Baseline增加23.2-58.3个百分点的回顾覆盖率；在6个有held-out路由器评估的设置中，该差距为18.5-28.9个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要认为置信度可用于支持初始升级决策，但协议特定的成本感知路由（cost-aware routing）仍然未解决：预测整体协作是否有帮助较可行，而预测具体哪种协作协议会带来收益则相当困难，仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: PaSTel: Anchoring Histology in Spatial Transcriptomics via Multi-Scale Hierarchical Bio-Prior Contrastive Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) links tissue morphology with molecular programs, motivating multimodal pretraining methods that align histology images with gene expression. However, existing approaches suffer from two key limitations: spatially informative gene selection is often dominated by ubiquitous housekeeping genes, leading to weakly discriminative representations, and independent spot-patch alignment fails to capture spatial dependencies that are critical for tissue organization. To address these challenges, we introduce PaSTel, a hierarchical multimodal pretraining framework that integrates biological priors at three levels. At the spot level, TF-IDF reweighting is used to identify spatially informative genes; at the functional level, curated KEGG pathways serve as anchors for encoding global biological semantics; and at the regional level, spatial clustering aggregates neighboring spots to model meso-scale tissue structure. Across multiple downstream tasks, PaSTel consistently outperforms existing vision and vision-omics encoders, demonstrating that incorporating multiscale biological priors yields more informative and transferable representations for spatial transcriptomics.
papers.comment: This paper was accepted to the 3rd ICML 2026 Workshop on Multi-modal Foundation Models and Large Language Models for Life Sciences
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PaSTel，一个用于空间转录组学（spatial transcriptomics）的分层多模态预训练框架，将组织学图像与基因表达对齐。针对现有方法的两大局限——空间信息基因选择被管家基因主导、以及独立 spot-patch 对齐忽略空间依赖性——PaSTel 在三个层级整合生物学先验：spot 级 TF-IDF 重加权、功能级 KEGG 通路锚点、区域级空间聚类。摘要称其在多个下游任务上一致优于现有视觉与 vision-omics 编码器，得到更具信息量与可迁移性的表征。
Motivation: 现有空间转录组学多模态预训练方法存在两个关键问题：空间信息基因选择常被广泛表达的管家基因主导，导致表征判别力弱；独立的 spot-patch 对齐无法捕捉对组织结构至关重要的空间依赖性。
Method: PaSTel 构建三层次生物学先验：spot 级使用 TF-IDF 重加权识别空间信息基因；功能级以精选 KEGG 通路为锚点编码全局生物学语义；区域级通过空间聚类聚合邻近 spots，建模中尺度（meso-scale）组织结构。
Result: 在多个下游任务上，PaSTel 一致优于现有视觉编码器与 vision-omics 编码器，证明多尺度生物学先验能产生更具信息量和可迁移性的空间转录组表征。
Conclusion: 摘要强调融入多尺度生物学先验可为空间转录组学带来更有效且可迁移的表征；该文为 ICML 2026 多模态基础模型与生命科学大模型工作坊的录用论文，未报告具体数值。

papers.title: SpIn-ViT: Designing a Sparsity-Induced Vision Transformer That Is Mechanistically Interpretable
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability has recently expanded to Vision Transformers (ViTs), with Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) increasingly used as post-hoc tools to decompose internal representations into sparse and more interpretable features. However, because post-hoc SAEs are trained on frozen representations after the ViT has already been optimized, their latent features are not directly aligned with the downstream classification objective. We introduce SpIn-ViT, a framework that jointly trains a pretrained ViT and a modified SAE end-to-end, directly aligning sparse patch-level representations with image classification. SpIn-ViT learns semantically coherent neuron activations that localize meaningful image regions while maintaining competitive predictive performance. We evaluate SpIn-ViT across nine image-classification benchmarks using classification accuracy, quantitative interpretability metrics, AI-based and Human evaluations. Compared with the previous state-of-the-art post-hoc SAE method, SpIn-ViT achieves 8.84% higher average classification accuracy, an AI-based interpretability score nearly four times as high, and a human-evaluation score more than twice as high. We further extract interpretable rule-sets using the SAE neurons to create neurosymbolic models which achieve 5.97% higher average classification accuracy while requiring a 58.8\% smaller rule-set than the neurosymbolic models created from the SOTA post-hoc SAE method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpIn-ViT，一种将预训练 Vision Transformer（ViT）与修改后的稀疏自编码器（SAE）端到端联合训练的框架，使稀疏 patch 级表征直接对齐图像分类目标，而非像事后（post-hoc）SAE 那样在冻结表征上训练。作者在九个图像分类基准上评测，称相比之前最先进的事后 SAE 方法，SpIn-ViT 的平均分类准确率提高 8.84%，基于 AI 的可解释性分数高出近四倍，人类评估分数高出两倍以上；基于 SAE 神经元提取的规则集构建神经符号模型，平均分类准确率提高 5.97%，且规则集大小减小 58.8%。
Motivation: 事后 SAE 在已优化好的 ViT 冻结表征上训练，其潜在特征不与下游分类目标直接对齐，导致可解释特征与任务目标脱节。
Method: 提出 SpIn-ViT 框架，将预训练 ViT 与修改后的 SAE 端到端联合训练，直接对齐稀疏 patch 级表征与图像分类，并学习语义连贯的神经激活以定位有意义的图像区域。
Result: 在九个图像分类基准上，相比之前最先进的事后 SAE 方法，平均分类准确率提升 8.84%，AI 可解释性分数约为其四倍，人类评估分数超过其两倍；所得神经符号模型平均准确率提升 5.97%，规则集减小 58.8%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将 SAE 与 ViT 端到端联合训练能够在保持竞争力准确率的同时提升机制可解释性，并支持从 SAE 神经元提取紧凑规则集构建神经符号模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Distinguishing AI-Generated Music from Edited Audio as a Hard-Negative Robustness Task
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated music detectors are commonly evaluated against original songs, but real-world uploads are often remixed, re-encoded, pitch-shifted, or otherwise edited. These edited versions form a difficult negative class: they are not generated by AI, yet they may introduce spectral artifacts that resemble synthetic audio fingerprints. We study this problem as a hard-negative robustness setting for AI-generated music detection, focusing on AI-generated and edited variants derived from the same anchor songs. We compile a YouTube-based dataset of AI, edited, and original variants, using the original tracks only as references, and train a binary AI versus edited detector. Audio is processed as 10-second clips and passed as raw waveforms to a pretrained PaSST spectrogram transformer. To reduce leakage, all splits are performed by anchor song. On the held-out test set, the final video-level system achieves 0.811 balanced accuracy. At clip level, AI-generated clips reach an F1-score of 0.836, while edited clips reach a lower F1-score of 0.720. The results suggest that AI-generated music retains detectable fingerprint-like spectral cues beyond ordinary editing, but the lower edited-class F1-score shows that these cues can still overlap with artifacts from edited audio. Grad-CAM visualizations are used to inspect whether high-confidence predictions rely on localized time-frequency regions.
papers.comment: Accepted at the RobustifAI 2026 Workshop @IJCAI-ECAI 2026, Bremen
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把“AI 生成音乐与编辑后音频”的区分建模为一种难负例 (hard-negative) 鲁棒性任务，针对真实上传中常见的混音、重编码、变调等编辑操作。作者构建了基于 YouTube 的数据集，包含同一锚定歌曲的 AI、编辑和原始三种变体，其中原始曲目仅作为参考，并训练一个 AI 对编辑的二分类检测器。音频以 10 秒片段的形式作为原始波形输入预训练 PaSST 谱图 Transformer。按锚定歌曲划分数据以避免泄漏，最终视频级系统在留出测试集上达到 0.811 的平衡准确率，片段级 AI 类 F1 为 0.836，编辑类 F1 为 0.720。
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成音乐检测器通常只针对原始歌曲进行评估，而真实上传的音频经常被编辑，构成一类难以区分的负样本；这些编辑版本并非 AI 生成，却可能引入与合成音频指纹相似的光谱伪影，威胁检测可靠性。
Method: 从 YouTube 收集同一锚定歌曲的 AI、编辑和原始变体，以原始轨道仅作参考，训练一个 AI 与编辑的二分类器；音频切成 10 秒片段并以原始波形输入预训练的 PaSST 谱图 Transformer，所有划分均按锚定歌曲进行以减少泄漏，并使用 Grad-CAM 可视化检查高置信预测是否依赖局部时频区域。
Result: 在留出测试集上，视频级系统平衡准确率为 0.811；片段级别上，AI 生成片段的 F1 为 0.836，编辑片段的 F1 为 0.720，表明 AI 生成音乐仍保留可检测的指纹样频谱线索，但编辑类 F1 较低，说明这些线索与编辑音频产生的伪影存在重叠。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 AI 生成音乐的可检测频谱指纹在常规编辑之外依然存在，但编辑类较低的 F1 说明难负例设置下两类特征仍有交叠；Grad-CAM 用于考察高置信预测所依赖的局部时频区域。

papers.title: The Open-Strategy Dictator Game: Cooperation Under Mutual Transparency
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Open-Strategy Dictator Game (OSDG), a variant of the classic dictator game in which each player's strategy is a natural-language document visible to all participants. The dictator's decision, to SHARE or TAKE an endowment, may depend on the text of the recipient's strategy. A large language model adjudicates each interaction by interpreting the dictator's strategy in the context of the recipient's. We run round-robin tournaments among diverse strategies and analyze the resulting payoff matrix using softmax equilibrium frequencies, dominance analysis, and sensitivity to the relative value of cooperation. Conditionally cooperative strategies, those that share with cooperators and take from exploiters, consistently dominate, while unconditional strategies (always share or always take) are weakly dominated. The results suggest that in environments where agents can inspect each other's decision procedures, conditional cooperation is evolutionarily robust across a wide range of payoff parameters.

TL;DR: 本文提出开放策略独裁者博弈 (Open-Strategy Dictator Game, OSDG)，在该变体中每个参与者的策略是一份对所有人可见的自然语言文档，独裁者根据接收者策略文本决定分享或拿走 endowment，由大语言模型裁决交互结果。作者在多种策略间进行循环赛，并用 softmax 均衡频率、支配性分析和合作相对价值敏感性分析收益矩阵。结果显示条件合作策略 (与合作者分享、从剥削者处取走) 持续占优，而无条件策略 (始终分享或始终取走) 被弱支配，表明当智能体可相互审视决策程序时，条件合作在广泛收益参数下具有进化稳健性。

papers.title: Optimal Watermark Localization in Mixed-Source Large Language Model Texts
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking provides a principled way to authenticate text generated by large language models (LLMs). In practice, however, the final text may be mixed-source, with watermark evidence surviving at only a subset of token positions after rewriting, insertion, deletion, or paraphrasing. Although prior work has studied global detection of watermark signals, when such signals can be localized remains unclear. We formulate watermark localization as a token-level multiple-testing problem based on pivotal statistics, with a latent indicator recording whether watermark dependence survives at each position. Under an asymptotic regime indexed by exponents for signal sparsity, next-token concentration, and effective-vocabulary growth, we derive a sharp boundary for global detection and phase transitions for discovery and classification within the class of coordinatewise pivot-based localization rules. We show that discovery is strictly harder than detection and that consistent classification is impossible across the parameter regime within this class. We then develop an adaptive thresholding method that does not require knowledge of the exponents or time-varying next-token distributions, but uses a data-driven estimate of the surviving watermark fraction. The method attains the optimal discovery boundary and near-optimal discovery power relative to homogeneous pivot-based rules. Simulations support the theoretical phase transitions, while experiments on model-generated texts demonstrate practical localization performance under common edit mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）生成文本中水印信号的定位问题，将其建模为基于 pivotal statistics 的 token 级多重检验，并引入潜在指标表示每个位置的水印依赖是否存续。作者在信号稀疏度、next-token 集中度和有效词表增长的指数化渐进框架下，推导了全局检测的尖锐边界以及发现与分类任务的相变，并提出一种无需知道指数或时变 next-token 分布的自适应阈值方法。模拟实验和真实模型生成文本上的实验支持理论相变并展示实际定位性能。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注水印信号的全局检测，但在改写、插入、删除或释义后，水印证据可能只残留在部分 token 位置，此时何时能够对信号进行定位仍不清楚。
Method: 将水印定位形式化为基于 pivotal statistics 的 token 级多重检验问题，在指数化渐进框架下推导全局检测边界及发现（discovery）与分类（classification）的相变；随后提出自适应阈值方法，利用数据驱动的存活水印比例估计，不要求知道指数或时变 next-token 分布。
Result: 理论结果表明发现严格难于检测，且在坐标wise pivot-based 定位规则类中一致分类在整个参数区间内不可实现；所提方法达到最优发现边界，并获得相对于同质 pivot-based 规则的近最优发现功效。模拟验证了理论相变，模型生成文本上的实验展示了常见编辑机制下的实际定位效果。
Conclusion: 作者强调在坐标wise pivot-based 定位规则类内，水印发现与分类存在固有难度限制，并给出无需指数先验的自适应方法作为实际方案。

papers.title: Frontier AI Forecasting Has a Measurement Problem: An Audit of Progress Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative forecasts of frontier artificial intelligence often connect dated targets to trends in benchmark scores, training compute, release time, or expert belief. This paper audits whether the public measurement record supports those connections before another trend is fitted. I construct a frozen, event-centric record through 12 August 2026 with 62 selected systems, 12 versioned benchmarks, seven capability or impact criteria, 144 graded events, 27 source records, and 408 typed relations. The record is an audit sample, not a census. Only seven systems jointly observe estimated training compute and a METR 50 percent task horizon. Training compute is absent for 19 of 27 closed systems, including every selected closed release from 2026, while none of the 35 open-weight systems has a METR horizon observation. Benchmark succession creates a second break: a seven-system link from METR Time Horizon 1.0 to 1.1 has a log-scale slope of 1.206 (95 percent CI 1.021 to 1.390), whereas a six-system MMLU to MMLU-Pro comparison appears shift-like under logit and probit links but not under linear or logarithmic links. The observed bridges have about 80 percent power only for slope departures near 25 percent. Provenance is concentrated: 52 of 71 substantive quantitative events, or 73.2 percent, come from one measurement programme, and 76.1 percent are laboratory releases. A review of 56 methodological and empirical sources identifies 16 complementary measurement directions spanning resources, inference budgets, reliability, agentic work, safety, human preference, field outcomes, and forecast backtesting. No direction supplies a replacement scalar. The result is not that frontier AI forecasting is impossible, but that a defensible dated forecast is a claim about a versioned measurement system with explicit joins, protocols, links, and source dependence, not merely a fitted curve or calendar date.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Evidence cutoff: 12 August 2026. Ancillary code and data included. Preprint; comments welcome
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对前沿人工智能的定量预测所依赖的公开测量记录进行审计，构建了一个截至 2026 年 8 月 12 日的事件中心型冻结记录，包含 62 个系统、12 个版本化基准、144 个分级事件和 408 条类型化关系。作者发现训练算力与 METR 任务时域联合观测的系统极少，基准更替造成的连接在 log 尺度与 logit/probit 尺度下表现不一致，且测量来源高度集中。结论是站得住脚的带日期预测应被视为关于版本化测量系统的声明，而非简单的拟合曲线。
Motivation: 前沿 AI 的定量预测常把具体日期目标与基准分数、训练算力、发布时间或专家信念等趋势联系起来，但公开测量记录是否真正支持这些连接尚未被系统审计。作者希望在看下一次趋势拟合之前，先检验这些连接背后的证据基础。
Method: 作者构建了一个冻结的、事件中心型的审计样本（非普查），涵盖 62 个系统、12 个版本化基准、7 个能力或影响标准、144 个分级事件、27 个来源记录和 408 条类型化关系；并采用连接桥（bridge）的斜率与功效分析，以及 56 篇方法学和经验来源的综述，梳理互补的测量方向。
Result: 只有 7 个系统同时观测到估计训练算力和 METR 50% 任务时域；27 个闭源系统中有 19 个缺失训练算力，35 个开源系统均无 METR 时域观测。METR Time Horizon 1.0 到 1.1 的 7 系统连接在对数尺度上斜率为 1.206（95% CI 1.021–1.390），而 MMLU 到 MMLU-Pro 的比较在 logit 和 probit 连接下表现为平移、在线性或对数连接下则不然；连接桥对接近 25% 的斜率偏差仅有约 80% 功效。73.2% 的实质性定量事件来自单一测量项目，76.1% 为实验室发布。综述识别出 16 个互补测量方向，但没有任何方向能提供替代性的单一标量。
Conclusion: 作者强调问题不在于前沿 AI 预测不可能，而在于可辩护的带日期预测必须明确指向一个带版本、连接协议、链接和来源依赖的测量系统，不能仅靠拟合曲线或日历日期。

papers.title: Interpretable Cross-Lingual Alignment in Small Language Models: Probing Cultural and Pragmatic Reasoning in Japanese-English Bilingual LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models work well on English and behave in poorly understood ways on languages typologically far from it. Japanese is a clean example, where evaluation still leans on translation quality and JGLUE-style benchmarks, which roll lexical, syntactic and pragmatic competence into a single score. The phenomena on which general-purpose models fail Japanese users are pragmatic: honorifics, in-group and out-group reference, context-sensitive politeness, zero anaphora. I introduce J-PragEval-v0, a minimal-pair benchmark isolating four such phenomena from surface fluency, and combine it with linear probes and teacher-forced log-probability evaluation to ask where inside TinySwallow-1.5B (28 layers, hidden size 1536) the corresponding contrasts live. The four features split three ways. Honorific register sits cleanly in the residual stream: 0.96 balanced accuracy at layer 15, and the model flips its preferred continuation with the scenario on 93 percent of items. Implicit subject and in-group reference are not linearly decodable at the final prompt token (0.48 and 0.38), yet flip rates are 0.77 and 0.79, so the contrast is worked out during generation rather than stored at the prompt. Indirect refusal is the negative case: 0.95 probe accuracy collapsing to a 0.43 flip rate under length-normalised teacher forcing, because the current minimal pairs conflate politeness with continuation length. I also specify Pragmatic Representation Steering, a parameter-free inference-time method that edits residual-stream activations along the class-mean-difference directions probing identifies. Feasibility is argued indirectly rather than demonstrated: the contrastive activation addition baseline, the same geometry the method would inject, recovers probe accuracy within one to two points of logistic regression wherever a linear signal exists. Scaling to Llama-3.1-Swallow-8B is the next step.
papers.comment: 15 pages, no figures. Introduces the J-PragEval-v0 minimal-pair benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 J-PragEval-v0，一个用于日英双语小模型的最小对 (minimal-pair) 评测基准，将敬语、内群体/外群体指称、语境敏感礼貌和零主语 (zero anaphora) 四类语用现象从表层流利度中分离出来；作者结合线性探针 (linear probes) 与 teacher-forced log-probability 评估，考察 TinySwallow-1.5B（28 层，隐藏维度 1536）内部这些对比究竟存储在哪里。结果显示四类特征分成三种情况：敬语语域干净地存在于残差流中（第 15 层平衡准确率 0.96，93% 的项目模型随场景翻转首选续写）；隐式主语和内群体指称在最终 prompt token 上不可线性解码（0.48 与 0.38），但翻转率分别达 0.77 与 0.79，说明对比在生成过程中被解决而非存储在 prompt 处；间接拒绝是反例，探针准确率 0.95 在长度归一化 teacher forcing 下却只有 0.43 的翻转率，因为当前最小对把礼貌与续写长度混在一起。论文还提出 Pragmatic Representation Steering，一种无参数的推理期方法，沿探针识别的类别均值差方向编辑残差流激活，但其可行性仅以间接方式论证而非直接演示。
Motivation: 大语言模型在英语上表现良好，但在类型学上与英语相距较远的语言上行为难以解释；日语是典型例子，现有评测仍依赖翻译质量和 JGLUE 式基准，将词汇、句法和语用能力混成一个总分。通用模型在日语用户会失败的现象恰恰是语用层面的，包括敬语、内/外群体指称、语境敏感礼貌和零主语，因此需要一个能把这些现象从表层流利度中剥离出来的评测与分析方法。
Method: 构建 J-PragEval-v0 最小对基准，隔离四个语用现象；在该基准上对 TinySwallow-1.5B 做线性探针和 teacher-forced log-probability 评估，以定位对比在层内的位置。此外定义了 Pragmatic Representation Steering，一种无参数、推理期方法，沿探针找到的类别均值差方向编辑残差流激活；论文用对比激活加法 (contrastive activation addition) 基线间接论证其可行性。
Result: 四类特征呈现三种模式：敬语语域在第 15 层达到 0.96 平衡准确率，模型在 93% 的项目上随场景翻转首选续写；隐式主语和内群体指称在最终 prompt token 上线性不可解码（0.48 与 0.38），但翻转率分别为 0.77 与 0.79；间接拒绝的探针准确率 0.95，在长度归一化 teacher forcing 下翻转率跌到 0.43。摘要还报告，在存在线性信号的地方，对比激活加法基线能恢复探针准确率，与逻辑回归相差 1 到 2 个点。
Conclusion: 作者强调对比的存储位置与生成过程中被解决的位置是两回事：某些语用对比不在 prompt 末 token 线性编码，而是在生成阶段逐步实现；J-PragEval-v0 的价值在于把语用能力从表层流利度中分离。Pragmatic Representation Steering 的可行性目前只是间接论证而非实证演示，且间接拒绝一项的最小对设计混淆了礼貌与续写长度；下一步计划扩展到 Llama-3.1-Swallow-8B。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 J-PragEval-v0，一个用于日英双语小模型的最小对 (minimal-pair) 评测基准，将敬语、内群体/外群体指称、语境敏感礼貌和零主语 (zero anaphora) 四类语用现象从表层流利度中分离出来；作者结合线性探针 (linear probes) 与 teacher-forced log-probability 评估，考察 TinySwallow-1.5B（28 层，隐藏维度 1536）内部这些对比究竟存储在哪里。结果显示四类特征分成三种情况：敬语语域干净地存在于残差流中（第 15 层平衡准确率 0.96，93% 的项目模型随场景翻转首选续写）；隐式主语和内群体指称在最终 prompt token 上不可线性解码（0.48 与 0.38），但翻转率分别达 0.77 与 0.79，说明对比在生成过程中被解决而非存储在 prompt 处；间接拒绝是反例，探针准确率 0.95 在长度归一化 teacher forcing 下却只有 0.43 的翻转率，因为当前最小对把礼貌与续写长度混在一起。论文还提出 Pragmatic Representation Steering，一种无参数的推理期方法，沿探针识别的类别均值差方向编辑残差流激活，但其可行性仅以间接方式论证而非直接演示。

papers.title: Can Neural Networks Learn by Experimenting on Themselves? Self-Interventional Learning from Functional Consequences to Predictive Self-Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning systems usually model external data, while their internal functional organization is analyzed by external observers. This work introduces Self-Interventional Learning (SIL), in which a neural system perturbs its own functional structure, observes consequences, learns a predictive self-model, generalizes to unexecuted interventions, and uses predictions to guide later structural action. In a construction-known synthetic system, SIL recovered critical structure, redundancy, and replaceability, while synergy was not reliably recovered. Across 30 fresh confirmatory seeds, increasing the pairwise intervention budget from 4 to 56 reduced held-out prediction error from 0.0335 to 0.0148 and increased Spearman correlation from 0.629 to 0.883. In a matched ablation, preserving the correct intervention--consequence mapping reduced prospective prediction error by 81.3%, while using the same learned self-model for action reduced normalized regret by 31.7% relative to ignoring it. However, model-guided action did not significantly outperform a direct empirical-memory policy, and powered CIFAR-10/ResNet validation showed no robustness advantage over equal-budget direct repair search. These results support SIL as an intervention-driven framework for learning predictive knowledge about a network's own functional organization, while showing that the self-model remains incomplete and is not universally superior to simpler direct strategies.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research (JMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自干预学习 (Self-Interventional Learning, SIL)：让神经网络扰动自身功能结构、观察后果、学习可预测的自我模型 (self-model)，并借助该模型指导后续结构行动。在构造已知的合成系统中，SIL 恢复了关键结构、冗余性与可替换性，但协同性 (synergy) 恢复不可靠；在 CIFAR-10/ResNet 验证中未表现出优于同等预算直接修复搜索的鲁棒性优势。
Motivation: 机器学习系统通常只对外部数据建模，而系统自身的功能组织往往由外部观察者分析。本文试图回答神经网络能否通过自我实验获得关于自身功能结构的预测性知识。
Method: 提出 SIL 框架：网络对自身功能结构施加干预，观察干预的功能后果，学习一个预测性自我模型，并泛化到未执行的干预，再利用预测结果引导后续结构操作。
Result: 在 30 个全新种子实验中，将成对干预预算从 4 增至 56 使留出预测误差从 0.0335 降至 0.0148，Spearman 相关从 0.629 升至 0.883；保持正确的干预-后果映射使前瞻预测误差降低 81.3%，使用同一自模型指导行动使归一化遗憾降低 31.7%。但模型引导行动未显著优于直接经验记忆策略，且在 CIFAR-10/ResNet 上无鲁棒性优势。
Conclusion: SIL 可作为干预驱动的框架，用于学习关于网络自身功能组织的预测性知识；但摘要强调该自模型仍不完整，并且并非普遍优于更简单的直接策略。

papers.title: Personalized Auto-Research: Towards a True AI Co-Scientist
papers.abstract_en: AI co-scientists that generate hypotheses, retrieve related work, design experiments, execute code, and draft full papers are beginning to change how research is carried out. Despite this rapid progress, state-of-the-art systems remain researcher-agnostic: given a research goal, they optimize novelty, validity, or reviewer score while ignoring the individual scientist who will use the output. This overlooks a fundamental fact about research, namely, that what counts as novel, valuable, or feasible depends on the researcher, including their prior work, methodological repertoire, and the collaborators and communities in which they are embedded. In this work, we introduce the problem of personalized auto-research, which conditions every stage of the research process on a representation of the individual researcher. We argue that personalization is not a convenience layer, but rather the fundamental property that allows an AI system to serve as a genuine co-scientist rather than a generic instrument. To address this problem, we propose a general and flexible framework that threads a graph-grounded researcher context through retrieval, hypothesis search, experimentation, writing, and review. The framework consists of three fundamental components: (i) graph-grounded researcher representations, (ii) personalization across the full research pipeline, and (iii) evaluation grounded in the individual. Notably, we highlight a one-size-fits-all failure mode where distinct researchers issuing the same goal receive essentially the same research, erasing the tacit knowledge through which novel ideas arise. Finally, we discuss fundamental open problems and challenges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出个性化自动科研（personalized auto-research）问题，主张AI合著者（co-scientist）应将研究全流程建立在单个研究者的表征之上，而非面向通用目标优化新颖性或审稿得分。作者给出一个以图为基础的通用框架，将研究者上下文贯穿检索、假设搜索、实验、写作与评审，并指出现有系统在相同目标下对不同研究者输出趋同的失败模式。文章属于问题定义与框架构想性质，未报告具体实验数据。
Motivation: 现有AI科研系统是研究者无关（researcher-agnostic）的，只针对给定目标优化新颖性、有效性或审稿分数，忽略了个体研究者的既有工作、方法储备以及所处合作者与学术社群，而这些恰恰决定了什么算新颖、有价值且可行。
Method: 提出一个通用灵活的框架，核心是将图基研究者表征（graph-grounded researcher representations）注入完整科研流水线，包含三个基本组件：图基研究者表示、全流水线个性化（包括检索、假设搜索、实验、写作与评审），以及基于个体研究者的评估。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，主要通过概念论证和失败模式分析（不同研究者输入同一目标却得到几乎相同的研究产出）来说明个性化的重要性。
Conclusion: 作者认为个性化不是便利性附加层，而是AI系统成为真正合著者而非通用工具的根本属性；文章最后讨论了该方向的基础性开放问题与挑战。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Workspace Topology as an Attack Vector in Agentic Coding Assistants
papers.abstract_en: Agentic coding assistants are finding widespread use, not just in new code development but in quickly ingesting and leveraging third-party code. This opens up a risk of malicious code being ingested as these coding tools operate with broad filesystem access inside developer workspaces. In this paper, we extensively study the impact of different dimensions of a novel attack surface we term workspace topology -- defined via directory depth, codebase modularity, in-file injection position and context framing -- on the attack success rate of adversarial prompt injection attempts. We perform an empirical study of indirect prompt injection (IPI) across a diverse set of open-source repositories spanning 10 languages and 6 engineering domains, evaluating three IPI entry points against open-weight models operating open source code harnesses. We find that workspace topology measurably affects IPI success. Specifically, changes in codebase modularity can significantly alter the Attack Success Rate (ASR), with highly modular environments demonstrating significantly lower attack success rates. Furthermore, context framing and introduction of security-cues in the workspace can also alter the ASR. Our findings offer practical value for the evaluation and security testing of coding agents across diverse settings, while underscoring the importance of an uncontaminated testing environment to obtain reliable results and conclusions.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 10 figures. Preprint of a paper accepted at the Conference on Applied Machine Learning in Information Security (CAMLIS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并系统研究一种针对智能编码助手 (agentic coding assistants) 的新攻击面“工作区拓扑”(workspace topology)，将其定义为目录深度、代码库模块化、文件内注入位置和上下文框架等维度，并实证考察这些维度对间接提示注入 (indirect prompt injection, IPI) 攻击成功率的影响。研究覆盖10种语言和6个工程领域的开源仓库，使用开放权重模型与开源编码框架，发现工作区拓扑可测量地改变 IPI 成功率，其中高度模块化的环境攻击成功率显著更低。
Motivation: 智能编码助手被广泛用于快速摄取和利用第三方代码，且以广泛的文件系统访问权限运行在开发者工作区内，因此存在恶意代码被摄入的风险；现有工作尚未系统刻画工作区结构特征如何影响对抗性提示注入的成功率。
Method: 作者通过实证研究间接提示注入，在跨10种语言和6个工程领域的多种开源仓库上，基于开放权重模型运行开源编码框架，评估三个 IPI 入口点，并操纵目录深度、代码库模块化、文件内注入位置和上下文框架等拓扑维度以测量攻击成功率的变化。
Result: 工作区拓扑对 IPI 成功率有可测量的影响：代码库模块化程度的改变能显著改变攻击成功率 (Attack Success Rate, ASR)，高度模块化环境下 ASR 明显更低；此外，上下文框架以及工作区中引入安全提示 (security-cues) 也会改变 ASR。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些发现对在不同场景下评估和安全测试编码代理具有实用价值，并强调无污染的测试环境对于获得可靠结果和结论的重要性。

papers.title: When do machine-learned exchange-correlation improvements inherit into density-functional tight binding?
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learned exchange-correlation functionals correct band gaps at near-semilocal cost, while density-functional tight binding reaches the $10^3$-$10^6$-atom regime; combining them assumes that a better parent yields a better parameterization, but we show it does not. Current-generation functionals are orbital-dependent generalized Kohn-Sham operators, whereas the parameterization channel is built on a multiplicative potential, preventing exact representation. Using the transfer ratio, the surviving fraction of a parent-level change, we find anti-transfer: coherently negative ratios across four covalent semiconductors move the gap in the wrong direction, consistent with a molecular proxy and an r$^2$SCAN control. The minimal-basis overgap is dominated by the on-site convention rather than basis incompleteness; correcting the on-site block removes most of it, while one $d$-polarization shell closes a further $16$-$40%$, depending on the placement of the empty $d$ level, which no free-atom eigenvalue uniquely fixes. Occupied-manifold enhancements, ionic and closed-shell repulsive potentials, and rocksalt-oxide gaps inherit, whereas elemental and III-V covalent networks inherit neither gaps nor repulsive potentials and oxide networks inherit only the latter. We screen 23 elements and release the parameter sets, showing that the transfer ratio provides a cheap pre-test before any parameterization campaign.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究机器学习交换关联泛函的改进能否通过密度泛函紧束缚 (density-functional tight binding, DFTB) 参数化传递下去。作者定义传递率 (transfer ratio) 为父级水平变化在参数化通道中的存活分数，发现当前轨道依赖的广义 Kohn-Sham 算符与 DFTB 的乘性势参数化通道不匹配，导致四个共价半导体出现反传递 (anti-transfer)：带隙朝错误方向移动。进一步分析表明最小基组带隙高估主要源于在位 (on-site) 约定而非基组不完备性，修正 on-site block 可去除大部分高估。作者筛选了 23 种元素并发布参数集。
Motivation: 将机器学习交换关联泛函的带隙校正能力与 DFTB 的 10^3-10^6 原子规模模拟结合的前提是更好的父级泛函能产生更好的参数化，但论文表明这一假设不成立，因此需要一种低成本手段在参数化之前预判改进能否继承。
Method: 利用传递率 (transfer ratio) 量化父级变化在 DFTB 参数化中的存活分数，并结合分子代理 (molecular proxy) 与 r²SCAN 对照实验，检验轨道依赖泛函与乘性势参数化通道之间的失配；同时通过修正 on-site block 和加入 d 极化壳层考察最小基组带隙高估的来源。

papers.title: JarvisBench: Always-on Intelligence Between Humans and Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents can execute continuously, but human attention remains intermittent and scarce. This creates a bidirectional coordination problem: users may need immediate access to an agent while work continues in the background, whereas agents may encounter consequential decisions that require user judgment after the user has stopped monitoring execution. We posit an always-on attention-coordination layer---\textit{Jarvis}\footnote{Named after the fictional AI assistant in \textit{Iron Man}.}---that mediates this interface and allocates human attention across one or more working agents. We introduce \textit{JarvisBench} to evaluate both directions of this coordination: whether an intermediary can accurately and promptly answer user-initiated questions about ongoing work, and whether it can recognize when an agent requires user judgment, solicit that judgment at the right moment, and route it back to improve task outcomes. JarvisBench contains 45 agentic task instances: 20 single-agent tasks and 25 workstreams organized into 10 multi-agent projects. The tasks span 19 domains and were selected and adapted from more than 2,000 public candidates. Crucially, the need for user attention arises naturally during execution rather than from an obvious omission in the initial prompt. JarvisBench is designed to integrate with arbitrary agent runtimes without modifying their underlying execution loops. Our reference implementation further provides a full-duplex speech interface, allowing users to reach Jarvis naturally while timely attention coordination supports agents working in the background. By separating agent execution from attention coordination, JarvisBench provides a stable evaluation target as agent capabilities continue to improve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Jarvis，一个位于人类与智能体之间的常开注意力协调层（always-on attention-coordination layer），并配套发布基准 JarvisBench，用于评估双向协调能力：中间层能否准确及时地回答用户对进行中任务的提问，以及能否在智能体需要用户判断时适时征求并回传判断以改进任务结果。基准包含 45 个智能体任务实例：20 个单智能体任务和 10 个多智能体项目中的 25 条工作流，覆盖 19 个领域，从 2000 多个公开候选任务中筛选改编而来。JarvisBench 可在不修改执行循环的情况下接入任意智能体运行时，参考实现还提供了全双工语音接口。
Motivation: 长程智能体可以持续执行，但人类的注意力是间歇且稀缺的，这造成双向协调问题：用户可能需要在后台工作继续时随时访问智能体，而智能体可能在用户停止监控后面临需要用户判断的重大决策。
Method: 引入 Jarvis 作为协调人类与一个或多个工作智能体之间注意力分配的中间层；JarvisBench 则评估中间层在用户发起的问答和智能体发起的判断请求两条方向上的表现，并设计为与任意智能体运行时集成而无需改动其执行循环，参考实现包含全双工语音接口。
Result: JarvisBench 包含 45 个任务实例，其中 20 个单智能体任务、10 个多智能体项目中的 25 条工作流，跨越 19 个领域，从 2000 多个公开候选中筛选和改编；关键特点是用户注意力的需求在执行过程中自然产生，而非源于初始提示中的明显遗漏。
Conclusion: 通过将智能体执行与注意力协调分离，JarvisBench 为随智能体能力持续提升而演进的评估提供了稳定目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beam-Wise Statistical Background Subtraction for Static Roadside LiDAR: A Cross-Sensor Benchmark Study
papers.abstract_en: Background subtraction is a key preprocessing step for infrastructure-based LiDAR perception, enabling efficient isolation of dynamic traffic participants without semantic annotations. However, systematic cross-sensor evaluations and reproducible studies for static roadside LiDAR are missing. This paper presents a comparative benchmark of beam-wise statistical background subtraction for statically mounted LiDAR sensors. We formulate background estimation as a per-beam temporal modeling problem and investigate complementary statistical strategies that capture dominant as well as multi-modal background structures, combined with spatial filtering in the angular and 3D domain. To enable reproducible evaluation, we introduce HighwayScene, a new multi-LiDAR dataset recorded in a static roadside setup, and extend the public CoopScenes dataset with static/dynamic point-wise annotations. Across multiple scenes and heterogeneous sensing technologies, we demonstrate that beam-wise statistical modeling provides a robust and transferable solution. Combining lightweight per-beam models with spatial consistency filtering substantially improves precision while maintaining high recall and real-time capability. All datasets, annotations, and implementations are publicly released.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), Naples, Italy, September 15-18, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对静态路侧 LiDAR 的背景减除（background subtraction）提出了一种逐波束（beam-wise）统计建模的对比基准研究。作者将背景估计建模为每根波束的时间序列问题，结合捕获主峰和多峰背景结构的统计策略，并在角度域和 3D 域进行空间滤波；为支持可复现评估，引入了新的多 LiDAR 数据集 HighwayScene，并为公开的 CoopScenes 数据集补充了静态/动态逐点标注。实验表明，逐波束统计模型在不同场景和异构传感技术下具有鲁棒性和可迁移性，轻量级逐波束模型配合空间一致性滤波能显著提升精度，同时保持高召回率和实时能力。
Motivation: 基础设施型 LiDAR 感知中背景减除是关键预处理步骤，但静态路侧 LiDAR 缺少系统性的跨传感器评估和可复现研究。
Method: 将背景估计形式化为逐波束时间建模问题，研究能够刻画主导背景结构和多模态背景结构的互补统计策略，并结合角度域和 3D 域的空间滤波；同时构建 HighwayScene 数据集并扩展 CoopScenes 的静态/动态逐点标注。
Result: 在多个场景和异构传感技术上的实验表明，逐波束统计建模提供了稳健且可迁移的方案；轻量级逐波束模型与空间一致性滤波结合大幅提升精度，同时保持高召回率和实时性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为逐波束统计背景减除是静态路侧 LiDAR 的有效方案，并公开了全部数据集、标注和实现以支持可复现研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ARISE: An adaptive residual-informed stability ensemble for feature selection in small-sample biomedical omics
papers.abstract_en: Objective: Small-sample molecular classification requires feature selectors that identify predictive, stable, and nonredundant subsets for binary and multiclass outcomes. We propose ARISE (Adaptive Residual-Informed Stability Ensemble), which integrates complementary relevance signals, class-balanced stability assessment, residual-informed redundancy control, and multiclass pairwise coverage. Methods: ARISE combines seven percentile-normalized relevance components through 15 predefined profiles, adaptively weighted by nested inner cross-validation. It was evaluated on five molecular datasets, eight feature-set sizes, three fixed classifiers (k-nearest neighbours, support vector machine, and random forest), and six filter comparators. Generalization was estimated by five-fold outer cross-validation repeated 50 times using balanced accuracy, macro-F1, and Cohen's kappa. Results: Across 210,000 held-out assessments, ARISE ranked first in all 15 dataset-metric combinations. Equal-dataset means were 0.793 for balanced accuracy, 0.776 for macro-F1, and 0.725 for kappa, exceeding the strongest aggregate comparator by 0.022, 0.023, and 0.028, respectively. Performance remained strong across compact feature sets, although the optimal budget differed by dataset. Conclusion: ARISE provides a transparent, adaptive framework that jointly addresses relevance, stability, redundancy, and multiclass discrimination. Its consistent results across datasets, classifiers, metrics, and feature-set sizes support further evaluation for small-sample molecular classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARISE (Adaptive Residual-Informed Stability Ensemble) 特征选择框架，面向小样本生物医学组学数据的二分类与多分类。它整合七个百分位归一化的相关性分量，通过 15 个预定义 profile 和嵌套内部交叉验证自适应加权，并在五个分子数据集上用三个固定分类器、六个过滤器对比评估。摘要报告在 210,000 次留出评估中，ARISE 在全部 15 个数据集-指标组合上排名第一。
Motivation: 小样本分子分类需要同时满足预测性、稳定性和非冗余的特征选择器，现有方法往往难以联合处理这些目标，缺乏一个统一的框架来保证跨数据集与跨分类器的可靠性。
Method: ARISE 结合互补的相关性信号、类别均衡的稳定性评估、残差信息冗余控制 (residual-informed redundancy control) 以及多类别成对覆盖；通过 15 个预定义 profile 组合七个百分位归一化的相关性分量，并用嵌套内部交叉验证自适应地确定权重。
Result: 在五个分子数据集、八种特征集大小、三个固定分类器与六个过滤器比较中，基于 50 次重复的五折外交叉验证得到的 210,000 次留出评估，ARISE 在全部 15 个数据集-指标组合上排名第一；等数据集均值为均衡准确率 0.793、macro-F1 0.776、Cohen's kappa 0.725，分别超过最强聚合比较器 0.022、0.023 和 0.028。
Conclusion: ARISE 提供了一个透明、自适应的框架，同时处理相关性、稳定性、冗余性和多类别判别；其在多个数据集、分类器、指标和特征集大小上的一致结果支持其在小样本分子分类中的进一步评估。

papers.title: Evaluating Agentic Code Repair Capabilities in Distributed Systems
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based coding agents have advanced rapidly on single-process SWE tasks, with frontier models now clustering in the high-70s on SWE-bench Verified. Distributed-system debugging, however, remains an under-explored regime: bugs span processes, nodes, and protocol interactions, with root causes rarely recoverable from source alone and brute-force exploration intractable across non-deterministic interleavings. This leaves two gaps in LLM and agent evaluation: no code-repair benchmark targets distributed-system bugs, and no controlled study isolates how much externally provided debugging context changes agent success on them. We introduce DDBench, a code-repair benchmark of 60 historical bugs mined from 13 open-source distributed systems, partitioned into three difficulty tiers. DDBench evaluates every case under two matched conditions: a symptom-only condition where the agent receives only the bug symptom and repository, and a context-augmented condition where it additionally receives a bounded debugging context (logs, traces, runtime state, and targeted code-investigation notes), isolating the effect of debugging context from model capability. The evaluation of ten LLMs on DDBench reveals several findings. First, distributed debugging exercises a reasoning dimension that single-process benchmarks do not surface: models' pass rates span 61 pp, and pairwise bootstrap separates 9 of 15 top-tier model pairs at p < 0.05 on DDBench's hardest case-set. Second, bounded debugging context lifts aggregate pass rate by +18.1 pp, and the lift is asymmetric: weaker models gain pass rate, while stronger models gain efficiency. Third, debugging context requires careful curation, as even faithful debugging context can sometimes mislead LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DDBench，一个面向分布式系统缺陷的代码修复基准，包含从 13 个开源分布式系统中挖掘的 60 个历史 bug，并按难度分为三档。作者在两种受控条件下评估了十个 LLM：仅症状条件（只给 bug 症状和代码库）与上下文增强条件（额外提供日志、trace、运行时状态和定向代码调研笔记）。主要发现是分布式调试暴露了单进程基准未覆盖的推理维度，模型通过率跨度达 61 个百分点；有界调试上下文使总体通过率提升 18.1 个百分点，且提升不对称：弱模型获得通过率提升，强模型获得效率提升。
Motivation: 分布式系统调试仍是 LLM 与智能体评估中未被充分探索的领域：bug 跨越进程、节点和协议交互，根因难以仅从源码恢复，且非确定性交织使得暴力探索不可行。现有评测存在两个空白：没有针对分布式系统 bug 的代码修复基准，也没有受控研究单独衡量外部调试上下文对智能体成功率的影响。
Method: 构建 DDBench 基准，从 13 个开源分布式系统中挖掘 60 个历史 bug 并分成三档难度。每个案例在两种匹配条件下评估：symptom-only 条件仅给 bug 症状和代码库，context-augmented 条件额外提供有界的调试上下文（日志、traces、运行时状态和定向代码调研笔记），从而把调试上下文的影响与模型能力分离。共评估十个 LLM。

Conclusion: 作者认为分布式调试体现了一种单进程基准无法暴露的推理维度，并且外部调试上下文能显著提升修复成功率，但必须谨慎策划，因为上下文有时会产生误导。

papers.title: STAR-FL: Secure Federated Learning with Spatial-Temporal Analysis and Robust Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Data poisoning attacks pose serious security threats to Federated Learning (FL) systems in Computer Vision. Despite growing research attention, two key challenges remain for existing defense techniques: (1) accurately distinguishing between benign and malicious model updates and (2) effectively mitigating the influence of poisoned model updates during model aggregation. To address these challenges, we propose a novel defense framework against targeted poisoning attacks with Spatial-Temporal Analysis and Robust aggregation for FL (STAR-FL). First, we employ spatial-temporal clustering to identify and remove potentially malicious updates from the FL training process. Second, we adjust the learning rate during aggregation to mitigate the impact of any malicious updates that evade detection. Third, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets to evaluate the spatial-temporal analysis and robust aggregation in STAR-FL. Experimental results demonstrate their synergistic effect in enabling STAR-FL to effectively protect FL and consistently outperform state-of-the-art defenses against targeted poisoning attacks, significantly reducing Attack Success Rates (ASRs). The source code is available at https://github.com/mlsysx/STAR-FL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STAR-FL，一个针对联邦学习 (FL) 中定向投毒攻击 (targeted poisoning attacks) 的防御框架，结合空间-时间聚类 (spatial-temporal clustering) 与稳健聚合 (robust aggregation)。方法先通过时空聚类识别并移除潜在恶意更新，再在聚合阶段调整学习率以削弱未被检测出的恶意更新的影响。摘要报告在多个基准数据集上，STAR-FL 能有效保护 FL，并持续优于现有最先进防御，显著降低攻击成功率 (Attack Success Rates, ASRs)。
Motivation: FL 系统在计算机视觉领域面临数据投毒攻击威胁，现有防御技术仍有两个关键挑战：难以准确区分良性更新与恶意更新，以及难以在模型聚合阶段有效抑制被投毒更新的影响。本文针对这两个挑战提出新的防御框架。
Method: STAR-FL 包含两部分：一是采用空间-时间聚类识别并移除训练过程中可能恶意的模型更新；二是在聚合阶段调整学习率，以缓解绕过检测的恶意更新带来的影响。作者在多个基准数据集上开展实验来评估时空分析模块与稳健聚合模块的效果。
Result: 实验结果显示，时空分析与稳健聚合之间具有协同效应，使 STAR-FL 在对抗定向投毒攻击时持续优于现有最先进防御，并显著降低攻击成功率 (ASRs)。
Conclusion: 作者强调时空分析与稳健聚合的协同作用能有效保护联邦学习系统，并公开了源代码；工作范围聚焦于针对定向投毒攻击的防御场景。

papers.title: BRAID: Learning Equilibrium Maps in Interdependent Security Games via Weight-Tied Iterative Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Computing Nash equilibria in interdependent security (IDS) games on networks is computationally expensive: best-response dynamics may need hundreds of iterations per instance, and downstream tasks such as auditing, stress-testing, and incentive design often require repeatedly re-solving the game under parameter perturbations. We propose BRAID, a Best-Response Amortized Iterative Dynamics model that uses a weight-tied iterative graph neural network to learn a direct map from game parameters to Nash equilibrium effort profiles, replacing iterative best response computation with a single forward pass that is up to 43X faster per instance. BRAID is derived from the best-response fixed-point structure of IDS games: its SUM aggregation reflects additive neighbor coupling, and a weight-tied gated recurrent unit (GRU) mirrors a damped best-response update. The same architecture applies across IDS specifications that vary investment-cost curvature and neighborhood aggregation, including log-linear, quadratic-cost, and log constant-elasticity-of-substitution (CES) utilities. Beyond equilibrium prediction, BRAID also recovers how equilibrium efforts change under perturbations to game parameters, including costs and network edge weights. We make this sensitivity recovery an explicit evaluation target and introduce two training strategies, interior-equilibrium training and input-noise regularization, that improve the local behavior of the learned equilibrium map without using sensitivity labels. Experiments show that BRAID effectively predicts Nash equilibria and recovers equilibrium sensitivities across utility specifications and network sizes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BRAID（Best-Response Amortized Iterative Dynamics），用权重共享的迭代图神经网络（weight-tied iterative GNN）学习从博弈参数到网络型相互依赖安全博弈（interdependent security games, IDS）纳什均衡投入轮廓的直接映射，从而用单次前向传播替代逐实例的迭代最优反应计算，摘要称每个实例最多可加速 43 倍。BRAID 的 SUM 聚合对应加性邻居耦合，权重共享的 GRU 近似阻尼最优反应更新；同一架构可处理 log-linear、quadratic-cost 和 log CES 等多种效用形式。除均衡预测外，该方法还能恢复均衡努力对成本和网络边权扰动的敏感性，实验覆盖多种效用规范与网络规模。
Motivation: 在网络上计算 IDS 博弈的纳什均衡计算代价高，最优反应动力学（best-response dynamics）每个实例可能需数百次迭代；而审计、压力测试、激励设计等下游任务常常需要在参数扰动下反复求解同一博弈，因此需要一种能直接由参数映射到均衡并保持对参数扰动敏感性的快速方法。
Method: 利用 IDS 博弈的最优反应不动点结构，用权重共享的迭代图神经网络学习从博弈参数到均衡努力轮廓的映射；SUM 聚合模拟加性邻居耦合，权重共享的门控循环单元（GRU）模拟阻尼最优反应更新。作者还将敏感性恢复设为显式评估目标，并提出两种不依赖敏感性标签的训练策略：interior-equilibrium training 与 input-noise regularization，以改进均衡映射的局部行为。
Result: 摘要报告 BRAID 的单次前向传播比逐实例最优反应计算快最多 43 倍；实验表明该方法在 log-linear、quadratic-cost、log CES 等不同效用规范及不同网络规模下均能有效预测纳什均衡，并能恢复均衡对成本与边权扰动的敏感性。
Conclusion: 摘要表明将迭代均衡计算摊销为端到端学习的单次前向传播是可行的，且同一架构可跨多种 IDS 效用规范泛化；同时指出对参数扰动的敏感性恢复需要显式评估与训练策略，所提的两种训练方式可改善学习到的均衡映射的局部行为。

papers.title: Zero-MELO: Test-Time Evidence Calibration with Multimodal LLMs for Zero-Shot Micro-Gesture Recognition
papers.abstract_en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in general video understanding, their capability in fine-grained and motion-centric tasks remains limited. This limitation is particularly critical in micro-gesture recognition (MGR), where micro-gestures (MGs) - subtle, short-duration, and spatially localized human movements - serve as key discriminative signals for implicit affective analysis, yet are easily neglected following common prompting practices. Although MGR has been intensively studied by many discriminative approaches, the use of MLLMs for MGR is underexplored, with notably poor performance. We hypothesize that the motion-sensitive representation ability of MLLMs is constrained by their inherent single-pass forward inference, which can be substantially enhanced through carefully designed test-time guidance. Motivated by this, building on our prior findings regarding temporal insensitivity in Video LLMs, we diagnose zero-shot MGR errors in the Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) space. We observe that MLLMs suffer from two bottlenecks: 1) insufficient localized evidence and 2) severe score biases driven by language and motion-agnostic appearances. Thus, we propose a novel test-time evidence calibration framework that improves both reasoning details and prediction reliability. Specifically, we introduce a tree search mechanism to progressively acquire localized, fine-grained visual evidence, coupled with a test-time calibration module to mitigate score biases. The multi-cue fusion module then integrates evidence from multiple cues without relying on a single cue for final prediction. Our framework achieves mean-class accuracies of 26.84\% on iMiGUE and 22.10\% on MA-52, significantly outperforming the Qwen2.5-VL baseline, which produces 16.15\% and 10.20\%, respectively. The code will be available at https://zero-melo.github.io/Zero-MELO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Zero-MELO，一个针对零样本微手势识别 (micro-gesture recognition, MGR) 的测试时证据校准框架，利用多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 改善细粒度运动理解。作者在负对数似然 (NLL) 空间诊断错误，发现 MLLMs 存在局部证据不足和由语言及与运动无关外观导致的分数偏差两个瓶颈，进而引入树搜索获取局部细粒度视觉证据、测试时校准模块缓解分数偏差，以及多线索融合模块整合多类证据。在 iMiGUE 和 MA-52 上，该方法平均类准确率分别达 26.84% 和 22.10%，显著高于 Qwen2.5-VL 基线的 16.15% 和 10.20%。
Motivation: MLLMs 在通用视频理解上表现优异，但在细粒度、以运动为中心的任务（如微手势识别）上能力有限；微手势是细微、短时、空间局部的人类动作，常规提示方式容易忽略。尽管判别式方法已广泛研究 MGR，但 MLLMs 在该任务上的使用尚未充分探索且性能较差。
Method: 提出测试时证据校准框架：引入树搜索机制逐步获取局部细粒度视觉证据，配合测试时校准模块缓解分数偏差，最后通过多线索融合模块整合来自多个线索的证据，避免依赖单一线索做最终预测。
Result: 在 iMiGUE 上平均类准确率达 26.84%，在 MA-52 上达 22.10%，显著超过 Qwen2.5-VL 基线的 16.15% 和 10.20%。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过精心设计的测试时引导可以增强 MLLMs 对运动敏感的表征能力，从而提升零样本微手势识别的推理细节与预测可靠性。

papers.title: Discovering High-Quality Chess Puzzles with Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning and skill mastery require extensive and deliberate practice. In many learning settings, producing high-quality pedagogical materials can require a high level of domain expertise and be very time-consuming. Pedagogical materials often need to train students to engage in different thinking patterns. In some domains, such as chess, puzzles are used to help students practice their skills in calculating the next moves and recognizing known patterns on a board. Giving students a practice set of puzzles to help them learn different modes of thinking is challenging because the teacher needs to carefully balance between different motifs and how many look-ahead steps a student needs to perform. Popular online platforms like Chess.com and Lichess offer players millions of puzzles. Unlike chess tactics puzzles procured by human experts, where chess beginners can learn valuable insights, these puzzles are automatically generated and often regarded as having low pedagogical value. These platforms also rely on a heuristic to recommend puzzles to users for practice. Using the user history data over an entire year, a total of 1.5 billion puzzle-solving histories, we learn the pedagogical value of a puzzle and how to automatically choose a set of puzzles to better support chess learners using insights from offline reinforcement learning. We show that using offline policy evaluation, our trained policy has significant impact on beginners with puzzle-solving Elo range of 100--1000, particularly for the group of beginners whose learning growth was stagnant. We also performed a qualitative analysis of the puzzles discovered by our model by collecting annotation ratings from expert chess players. The success of our pipeline shows promise for a future where we can understand the pedagogical values of practice items given general user interaction data.

TL;DR: 本文利用离线强化学习 (offline reinforcement learning) 从 Chess.com 和 Lichess 一整年共 15 亿次谜题解答历史中学习谜题的教学价值，并自动选择适合学习者的谜题集合。作者通过离线策略评估 (offline policy evaluation) 验证策略对谜题解答 Elo 在 100 至 1000 的初学者有显著影响，尤其是学习成长停滞的群体，并请国际象棋专家对模型发现的谜题进行定性标注。
Motivation: 人工制作高质量教学谜题需要高水平领域知识且耗时；现有自动生成的在线象棋谜题常被认为教学价值低，平台只能靠启发式推荐。目标是更好地为象棋学习者选择练习谜题。
Method: 利用一整年共 15 亿条谜题解答历史数据，从离线强化学习的视角建模谜题的教学价值，并学习如何自动挑选一组谜题以支持学习者。
Result: 离线策略评估显示，训练出的策略对谜题解答 Elo 在 100 至 1000 的初学者有显著影响，尤其对学习成长停滞的初学者群体；专家棋手的标注分析也提供了对模型发现谜题的定性证据。
Conclusion: 这一流程展示了从通用用户交互数据中理解练习项目教学价值的可能性，可为未来教育材料自动生成提供方向。
