papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NARRATE，一个面向自动驾驶人本解释的多模态真实世界澳大利亚驾驶数据集，包含 35 位经验驾驶员和驾驶教练在公共道路上采集的 2,050 个带标注事件。每个事件与同步的视觉、定位、运动和 LiDAR 数据对齐，并配有车内和/或驾驶后的自由文本解释；数据集还提供动作标签、六类高层和 32 类细粒度场景上下文标签，以及基于驾驶员解释的跨度级态势感知 (SA) 标注。作者报告四个基准任务表明该语言结构可学习，但细粒度上下文识别和解释生成仍有挑战。
Motivation: 现有带语言标注的驾驶数据集多为观察者撰写、事后标注、仿真或由传感器输入生成，而非来自正在执行操作的驾驶员本人，难以支撑乘客可理解、可监控和可信赖的自动驾驶解释模型。
Method: 构建多模态真实道路数据集 NARRATE，从真实驾驶员和驾驶教练处获取自由文本解释，并与视觉、定位、运动、LiDAR 等模态同步对齐；在此基础上定义态势感知 (Perception、Comprehension、Projection)、场景上下文和驾驶员动作分类，以及解释生成四类基准任务。
Result: 在 NARRATE 上的四个基准任务表明，所定义的结构可以从驾驶员语言中学习；但细粒度场景上下文识别和解释生成仍然困难。
Conclusion: 作者认为 NARRATE 为更人本和领域感知的自动驾驶解释模型开辟了路径，摘要未提及方法局限，仅指出部分下游任务仍具挑战。

papers.title: Beyond Boundary Noise: Aggregated Aleatoric Uncertainty Fails to Capture Presence Ambiguity in 3D Lung Nodule Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty estimation is critical for the safe clinical deployment of deep learning in medical image segmentation, with aleatoric uncertainty theoretically designed to capture irreducible data ambiguity. However, whether entropy-based measures reflect clinically meaningful ambiguity, i.e. case-level disagreement about whether a pathology is present at all, remains poorly understood. Contrary to most prior work, which focused on pixel-wise boundary disagreement, we systematically evaluate how well aleatoric uncertainty captures presence ambiguity. Our evaluation spans 3D lung nodule segmentation across four architectures with Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles, on LIDC-IDRI and an external validation cohort (LNDb). We find that entropy-based uncertainty maps align with boundary noise and minor drawing variation but carry insufficient discriminative signal for presence ambiguity. In contrast, a lightweight supervised ambiguity head trained on frozen segmentation features substantially outperforms all entropy-aggregation-based baselines across architectures, metrics, and both cohorts, and matches or exceeds methods that explicitly model ambiguity under disagreement supervision (Probabilistic U-Net, Annotator-Confusion 3D-UNet). A qualitative feature-space analysis shows that presence ambiguity is already encoded in the frozen encoder features of pixel-wise-trained networks, only to be discarded by the segmentation output and its entropy aggregation. Our findings expose a fundamental mismatch between the theoretical promise of aleatoric uncertainty and its practical behavior, and suggest that practitioners should not rely on entropy-based uncertainty as a proxy for clinical ambiguity in safety-critical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估 3D 肺结节分割中基于熵的 aleatoric uncertainty（偶然不确定性）能否捕捉临床意义上的存在模糊性（presence ambiguity，即病例层面关于病变是否存在的分歧）。研究在 LIDC-IDRI 与外部验证队列 LNDb 上覆盖四种架构、MC dropout 与深度集成，发现熵式不确定性图主要反映边界噪声和小幅勾画差异，对存在模糊性缺乏判别信号；而一个基于冻结分割特征训练的轻量监督歧义头在所有架构、指标和两个队列上显著超过全部熵聚合基线，并匹敌或超越显式建模歧义的方法（Probabilistic U-Net、Annotator-Confusion 3D-UNet）。特征空间分析还显示存在模糊性已编码在冻结编码器特征中，但在分割输出与熵聚合中被丢弃。
Motivation: 不确定性估计对医学图像分割的临床安全部署至关重要，但熵式度量是否反映临床上有意义的模糊性（即病理是否存在的病例级分歧）仍缺乏理解；以往工作几乎只聚焦像素级边界分歧。
Method: 对四种分割架构的 MC dropout 与深度集成进行系统评估，将基于熵的聚合不确定性估计与一个在冻结分割特征上训练的轻量监督 ambiguity head 对照，并以 Probabilistic U-Net 和 Annotator-Confusion 3D-UNet 等显式建模标注者分歧的方法作为参照，另做特征空间定性分析。
Result: 熵式不确定性图与边界噪声及轻微勾画差异对齐，但对存在模糊性的判别信号不足；轻量监督歧义头在跨架构、跨指标、跨两个队列的比较中超过所有熵聚合基线，并匹配或超过显式建模歧义的方法。
Conclusion: 研究发现 aleatoric uncertainty 的理论承诺与其实际行为之间存在根本性错配，提示在安全关键应用中不应将基于熵的不确定性作为临床模糊性的代理指标。

papers.title: Agentic Data Cleaning Without a Clean Reference: An Experimental Study of Capabilities and Trade-offs
papers.abstract_en: Data cleaning without a trusted clean reference is challenging because unusual values may represent either genuine errors or valid observations. This paper studies how different agent capabilities affect reference-free data cleaning and proposes an evidence-grounded framework that combines structured context, profiling, LLM reasoning, executable checks, controlled evidence retrieval, source ranking, citation alignment, conservative repair, reversible scripts, and provenance logging. Seven configurations are evaluated across financial, clinical, and environmental-monitoring datasets using controlled synthetic corruption and original-data descriptive analysis, resulting in 126 completed runs. The evaluation includes two comparison baselines and a progressive LLM-based sequence that adds executable tools, evidence retrieval, evidence controls, and conservative repair. In the synthetic evaluation, the deterministic profiling baseline achieved the highest detection F1-score of 0.561. Among the LLM-based configurations, the full conservative configuration achieved the highest F1-score of 0.421, but no configuration performed best across all evaluation criteria. The source-ranked configurations achieved the lowest unsupported-rule rates, while decision-level citation alignment remained weak. The full conservative configuration produced no unsafe or unnecessary modifications, although these rates were already zero before the conservative policy was added, and it performed no direct repairs. Overall, the results show that additional capabilities introduce trade-offs among detection, repair, evidence grounding, conservative behaviour, reproducibility, and operational cost rather than producing consistent improvements. The study provides a structured framework and empirical methodology for evaluating these trade-offs in reference-free agentic data cleaning.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在没有可信干净参考的数据清洗场景下，不同智能体能力如何影响清洗效果，并提出一个基于证据的框架，包含结构化上下文、数据画像、LLM 推理、可执行检查、受控证据检索、来源排序、引用对齐、保守修复、可逆脚本和溯源日志。研究在金融、临床和环境监测数据集上评估七种配置，使用合成损坏与原始数据描述性分析，共完成 126 次运行。结果表明额外能力主要带来检测、修复、证据基础、保守行为、可复现性与运行成本之间的权衡，而非一致改进。
Motivation: 没有可信干净参考时，异常值既可能是真实错误也可能是有效观测，难以自动区分；现有方法缺乏对智能体能力组合如何影响此类清洗任务的系统理解。
Method: 提出证据基础的参考无关数据清洗框架，并设计七种配置进行对比，包括两种比较基线以及渐进式 LLM 序列，后者逐步加入可执行工具、证据检索、证据控制和保守修复。
Result: 合成评估中，确定性画像基线取得最高检测 F1 为 0.561；在 LLM 配置中，完整保守配置取得最高 F1 为 0.421，但没有任何配置在所有评估标准上表现最佳。来源排序配置的未支持规则率最低，而决策级引用对齐较弱；完整保守配置未产生不安全或不必要修改，但这些比率在加入保守策略前已为零，且该配置未执行直接修复。
Conclusion: 作者认为额外能力引入的是检测、修复、证据基础、保守行为、可复现性和运行成本之间的权衡，而不是稳定提升；研究提供了一个结构化的框架和实证方法论，用于评估参考无关智能体数据清洗中的这些权衡。

papers.title: Real-Time State-of-Health Estimation and Online Degradation Prognosis from Partial Battery Discharge Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: With the increasing integration of renewable energy sources, energy storage systems have become essential, making the accurate estimation of their State of Health (SOH) and degradation behavior critical. In this work, we propose a physics-informed deep learning approach for lithium-ion battery SOH prediction using incomplete discharge curves extracted from arbitrary voltage ranges, thereby reflecting realistic and heterogeneous operating conditions. The proposed method combines data-driven learning with physically motivated degradation dynamics to ensure consistent and reliable SOH estimation from partial discharge information, achieving a MAPE below 4$\%$. In addition, a real-time degradation trend estimation strategy is introduced to detect key aging transitions without requiring prior knowledge or historical data, making it applicable to a wide range of batteries. Overall, our approach enables SOH estimation from arbitrary discharge segments and a real-time degradation forecast that continuously integrates all usage, overcoming previous methods that rely on fixed protocols or early, non-adaptive predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理信息深度学习 (physics-informed deep learning) 方法，用于从锂电池任意电压区间的不完整放电曲线估计健康状态 (State of Health, SOH)。方法将数据驱动学习与物理驱动的退化动态结合，在部分放电信息下实现 MAPE 低于 4% 的 SOH 估计，并提出无需历史数据的实时退化趋势估计策略，以检测关键老化转变。
Motivation: 可再生能源并网增加使储能系统至关重要，但电池实际运行中放电曲线常不完整且电压区间任意，现有方法依赖固定测试协议或早期非自适应的预测，难以反映真实异构运行条件。
Method: 提出物理信息深度学习框架，使用来自任意电压范围的不完整放电曲线作为输入，结合数据驱动学习与物理驱动的退化动态；同时引入实时退化趋势估计策略，无需先验知识或历史数据即可持续整合全部使用信息进行退化预测。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在部分放电信息下实现 SOH 估计的 MAPE 低于 4%，并能实时检测关键老化转变。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法支持从任意放电片段估计 SOH，并提供持续整合使用情况的实时退化预测，克服了以往依赖固定协议或早期非自适应预测方法的局限。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Ultrasound-MRI Learning for Fetal Brain Ventricular Volumetry and Abnormality Screening
papers.abstract_en: Assessment of ventriculomegaly (VM) on fetal brain ultrasound relies primarily on measuring lateral ventricular atrial width on standard planes, which is operator-dependent and may not fully reflect the overall ventricular enlargement. Fetal brain MRI provides more reliable volumetric information but is costly and less accessible for routine use. To address these limitations, we propose VIFBA, an ultrasound video-based framework for fetal brain assessment that predicts MRI-derived lateral ventricular volume, classifies VM severity, and identifies potential non-VM fetal brain abnormalities. Our contribution is three-fold. First, we introduce a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA)-inspired tube latent prediction objective that leverages spatio-temporal coherence in ultrasound videos to enhance representation learning. Second, we develop a contrastive cross-modal alignment strategy that transfers structural information from MRI to ultrasound during training, while requiring ultrasound alone at inference. Third, we augment VIFBA with a training-free vision-language model and retrieval augmentation to verify uncertain predictions and identify potential non-VM fetal brain abnormalities. We validated VIFBA on a large dataset comprising 857 cases (3,196 videos) with paired fetal brain ultrasound and MRI examinations. On held-out test data, VIFBA achieved an MAE of 0.5909 mL and Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.9907 for ventricular volume regression, 0.9400 accuracy for VM severity classification, and an F1 score of 0.7764 for multi-abnormality classification, substantially outperforming single-task baselines, video-based strong competitors, and state-of-the-art foundation models. By enabling MRI-informed volumetric assessment from routine ultrasound alone, VIFBA offers a practical and potentially broadly deployable pathway toward accurate and affordable prenatal brain screening.

papers.title: CFR without Unbiasedness: Deterministic Guarantees for Persistent Public-Chance Schedules
papers.abstract_en: At a finite public-chance cut, counterfactual regret minimization (CFR) must choose how many outcomes to evaluate before each regret update. Exact evaluation processes the full cut at one strategy profile; persistent partial evaluation processes a fixed without-replacement order across evolving profiles. The latter covers every outcome once per epoch, yet its feedback is generally conditionally biased because earlier batches influence the profiles seen by later batches. We establish a deterministic target-transfer theorem for uniform, nonnested additive public cuts. The theorem bounds full-cut exploitability by regret on the delivered feedback and a public-debit term that couples prefix coverage discrepancy with motion along the realized strategy path. Consecutively balanced schedules consequently converge for additive signed regret matching (RM) and RM+ under predetermined averaging weights, while a fixed RM+ construction proves that the discrepancy--path product is necessary in general. A component-resolved form of the theorem converts an execution trace into a numerical exploitability certificate. On two released heads-up no-limit hold'em turn endgames, persistent order improves substantially over fresh reshuffling despite identical epochwise coverage, and partial coverage wins every registered shallow matched-budget comparison. A depth study locates a crossover between 32 and 64 full-cut outcome budgets, after which complete coverage dominates. These results characterize public-chance width and order as learning variables and provide a deterministic basis for designing and auditing persistent CFR schedules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有限 public-chance cut 上反事实遗憾最小化（CFR）在每次遗憾更新前评估多少个 outcome 的问题，提出针对持久部分评估（persistent partial evaluation）的确定性 target-transfer 定理。定理将 full-cut 可利用度界定为所交付反馈上的遗憾与一个 public-debit 项之和，后者耦合前缀覆盖差异与策略路径运动，并证明连续平衡调度在加性符号遗憾匹配（RM/RM+）下收敛。实验显示在两人无限注德州扑克转牌 endgame 上持久顺序优于重新洗牌，且深度研究在 32 与 64 个 full-cut outcome 预算之间发现交叉点。
Motivation: 精确评估在单一策略 profile 上处理整个 cut，而持久部分评估按固定无放回顺序覆盖每个 outcome 每轮一次，但其反馈通常条件有偏，因为较早批次会影响后续批次所见的 profile；这种有偏反馈下的收敛性缺乏确定性刻画。
Method: 建立确定性 target-transfer 定理，适用于 uniform、nonnested additive public cuts，通过 public-debit 项将前缀覆盖差异与实现策略路径的运动联系起来；并给出组件分解形式，把执行轨迹转换为数值可利用度（exploitability）证书。
Result: 定理证明连续平衡调度在预定平均权重下对加性符号遗憾匹配（RM）和 RM+ 收敛，且一个固定 RM+ 构造说明 discrepancy–path 乘积在一般情况下是必要的。在两个已发布的 heads-up no-limit hold'em 转牌 endgame 上，持久顺序一致优于每次重新洗牌，部分覆盖在所有登记的浅层匹配预算比较中获胜；深度研究发现 32 到 64 个 full-cut outcome 预算之间存在交叉，此后完全覆盖占优。
Conclusion: 这些结果把 public-chance 的宽度与顺序刻画为学习变量，并为设计和审计持久 CFR 调度提供了确定性基础。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Test-Time Instance Selection for Improved Whole Slide Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Whole Slide Image (WSI) analysis has been widely studied for cancer diagnosis. Conventionally, a gigapixel WSI is divided into small patches and processed by Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) models. However, existing MIL models typically process all patches, many of which contain redundant or non-informative tissue patterns. Although recent approaches have focused on instance selection to identify discriminative patches and reduce redundancy, these selection modules still require additional training. In this work, we propose Test-Time Instance Selection (TTIS), a training-free, plug-and-play framework that selects compact yet representative patches during inference. TTIS further incorporates a multi-view ensemble strategy to integrate distinct facets of tissue morphology, enhancing robustness. Importantly, TTIS can be seamlessly integrated into existing MIL models without retraining or architectural changes, enabling flexible deployment. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our approach improves or matches baseline MIL performance across a range of classification and subtyping tasks. Our implementation code is available at https://github.com/QuIIL/TTIS
papers.comment: Accepted at The 2nd MICCAI Workshop on Efficient Medical AI (EMA4MICCAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Test-Time Instance Selection (TTIS)，一个无需训练的即插即用框架，用于在全切片图像 (Whole Slide Image, WSI) 分析中于推理阶段选择紧凑且有代表性的组织块。TTIS 可无缝嵌入现有 MIL 模型，无需重训练或改动架构，并引入多视图集成策略以增强鲁棒性。摘要称在多个基准的分类与亚型分类任务上，该方法提升或持平基线 MIL 性能。
Motivation: 现有 MIL 模型通常处理全部分块，其中很多包含冗余或无信息量的组织模式；已有的实例选择方法虽能挑选判别性块，但选择模块本身仍需要额外训练。
Method: 提出 TTIS，一种训练无关、即插即用的测试时实例选择框架，在推理阶段挑选紧凑且具有代表性的分块；同时采用多视图集成策略来整合组织形态学的不同侧面，且不要求对现有 MIL 模型做重训练或架构修改。
Result: 在多个基准上的广泛评估表明，TTIS 在一系列分类和亚型分类任务上能提升或匹配基线 MIL 性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调 TTIS 可以作为无需重训练或架构改动的灵活部署方案整合进现有 MIL 模型，并公开了实现代码。

papers.title: Synthesizing Post-Acetazolamide Cerebral Blood Flow Maps from Baseline MRI in Moyamoya Using 3D Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: For patients with Moyamoya disease, impaired cerebrovascular reserve (CVR) is an important hemodynamic criterion for recommending extracranial-to-intracranial bypass surgery. Standard CVR assessment in this cohort uses paired arterial spin labeling (ASL) perfusion MRI acquired before and after acetazolamide (ACZ). When ACZ is contraindicated or avoided, the post-ACZ cerebral blood flow (CBF) map needed for hemodynamic assessment is unavailable. We propose CAE3D, a deterministic 3D conditional autoencoder that synthesizes post-ACZ CBF maps directly from pre-ACZ ASL input. We evaluated CAE3D against ten comparators, including deterministic and diffusion-style 3D baselines, a 2D contextual baseline, and frozen-encoder foundation-model adapters. CAE3D achieved the lowest held-out MAE (0.066), with SSIM 0.80 and PSNR 24.0 dB, and near-zero full-brain mean bias. Its MAE advantage was statistically significant over seven of eight trained-from-scratch baselines, excluding the 2D CAE_2D comparator; its SSIM and PSNR advantages were significant over all eight. Regional delta-CBF predictions compressed the dynamic range in high-response territories. These results establish the retrospective feasibility of post-ACZ CBF synthesis in patients who completed the standard two-scan protocol. Extension to ACZ-contraindicated patients, who were not represented in this cohort, requires external and prospective validation.
papers.comment: 25 pages. Accepted at Machine Learning for Healthcare (MLHC 2026). To appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR), volume 340
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Moyamoya 病中因乙酰唑胺（ACZ）禁忌而无法获得 post-ACZ 脑血流（CBF）图的问题，提出确定性三维条件自编码器 CAE3D，直接从 pre-ACZ ASL 输入合成 post-ACZ CBF 图。在十种对比方法中，CAE3D 取得最低的留出 MAE（0.066），SSIM 0.80、PSNR 24.0 dB，且全脑平均偏倚接近零。作者认为该结果建立了对已完成标准双扫描方案患者进行 post-ACZ CBF 合成的回顾性可行性。
Motivation: Moyamoya 病中脑血管储备（CVR）是推荐颅内-颅外搭桥手术的重要血流动力学标准，而标准 CVR 评估依赖 ACZ 前后的成对动脉自旋标记（ASL）灌注 MRI。当 ACZ 存在禁忌或需避免使用时，血流动力学评估所需的 post-ACZ CBF 图无法获取，因此需要一种直接从 pre-ACZ 输入合成该图的方法。
Method: 提出 CAE3D，一种确定性的三维条件自编码器（conditional autoencoder），输入端为 pre-ACZ ASL，输出端为合成的 post-ACZ CBF 图。评估中与十种基线比较，包括确定性与扩散式（diffusion-style）三维基线、二维上下文基线，以及冻结编码器的 foundation-model 适配器。
Result: 摘要报告 CAE3D 在留出集上取得最低 MAE（0.066），SSIM 为 0.80，PSNR 为 24.0 dB，全脑平均偏倚接近零；其 MAE 优势对八个从头训练基线中的七个具有统计显著性（除 2D CAE_2D 外），SSIM 与 PSNR 优势对全部八个基线显著。区域 delta-CBF 预测在高响应区域压缩了动态范围。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些结果确立了在完成标准双扫描协议的患者中回顾性合成 post-ACZ CBF 的可行性；将该方法推广到未包含在本队列中的 ACZ 禁忌患者，需要外部与前瞻性验证。

papers.title: KHiM-Mamba: Injecting Pathology Knowledge into Mamba via Hidden-State Modulation for Whole Slide Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Whole slide image analysis is commonly formulated as multiple instance learning (MIL), where instance features are contextually updated and aggregated into a slide representation, a process we term slide encoding dynamics. Recently, selective state-space models (SSM) have emerged as promising MIL architectures due to their long-sequence modeling capability and linear complexity. However, existing SSM-based MIL methods rely solely on visual features during MIL. Meanwhile, in large-scale WSIs, where sparse diagnostically decisive regions are surrounded by abundant irrelevant information, such purely vision-driven selective dynamics can misallocate state updates and readouts, causing the evolving SSM state to accumulate task-irrelevant evidence and dilute critical diagnostic cues over long scan trajectories. In this work, we propose the Knowledge-Aware Hidden-State Modulation architecture (KHiM-Mamba), which innovatively regulates Mamba's core selective state-space mechanism with explicit knowledge priors, steering slide encoding dynamics toward diagnostically meaningful evidence accumulation. Specifically, we redesign the original SSM layer to perform knowledge modulation operations during the evolution of hidden states, thereby guiding what visual evidence is accumulated and retrieved from the hidden state at each encoding step. Furthermore, we additionally introduce a local-adaptive vocabulary retrieval module that uses large language models to assign each patch fine-grained, tissue-specific semantic descriptions, enabling precise modulation across diverse tasks. Experiments on 11 public benchmarks across 4 tasks show that KHiM-Mamba consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KHiM-Mamba，一个面向全切片图像（WSI）分析的 MIL 架构，将显式病理知识先验注入 Mamba 的选择性状态空间模型（SSM）的隐藏状态演化中。作者重设计了 SSM 层，在隐藏状态更新时执行知识调制操作，并引入局部自适应词汇检索模块，用大语言模型为每个 patch 生成细粒度组织语义描述。摘要称该方法在 11 个公开基准、4 个任务上一致达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 现有基于 SSM 的 MIL 方法在编码过程中只依赖视觉特征，而大规模 WSI 中大量无关信息会使选择性状态更新和读出错位，导致 SSM 状态累积与任务无关的证据，稀释关键诊断线索。
Method: 提出知识感知隐藏状态调制架构（KHiM-Mamba），在 SSM 层隐藏状态演化过程中执行知识调制，从而引导每一步视觉证据的累积与检索；同时引入局部自适应词汇检索模块，借助大语言模型为每个 patch 分配细粒度、组织特异性的语义描述以实现精确调制。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 4 个任务上的 11 个公开基准中一致取得 state-of-the-art 性能，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将显式知识先验用于调制 Mamba 核心的选择性状态空间机制，可以引导 slide 编码动态朝诊断性证据积累方向进行，并在多项基准上验证了有效性。

papers.title: The Note-Chord-Voice Framework: Structured Source Separation and Causal Inference for EV Charging Data
papers.abstract_en: Real-world EV charging data exhibit three interlocking pathologies: hardware fragmentation (network timeouts and billing resets split sessions), physical violations (independent energy/duration models produce impossible states like 50 kWh in 10 min on a 7 kW charger), and collider bias (clustering on post-treatment outcomes opens backdoor paths for price elasticity). We propose the Note-Chord-Voice framework, a music-inspired, axiom-driven pipeline that separates data cleaning (Repair Chords), structural pattern discovery (Harmonic Chords), descriptive source separation (NMF Voices), and causal inference into distinct, falsifiable stages. Key innovations: (i) falsification gates (A1-A5, G3, G10) that test data suitability before modeling; (ii) Gamma-initialized NMF with input rescaling for convergence stability from STL decomposition; (iii) tag-based coupon grading (A/B/C/D) to isolate quasi-random treatment from night-time confounders and targeted promotions; (iv) separate per-voice OLS to avoid simplex collinearity; (v) Foote novelty curves for structural regime detection. Applied to the Jiangmen dataset (495,707 sessions, 20 stations, from July 2024 to March 2025), all core axioms pass except G3 (no strong 168 h cycle). NMF achieves R^2=0.9921; the physically constrained duration model yields aggregate R^2=0.5409. Two voices are price-sensitive (beta = -11 to -14 min, p<0.001), of which one is stable (Voice 3, beta=-14.16) and one treatment-driven (Voice 1, beta=-11.10); only the stable voice supports causal claims. Counterfactual simulation shows targeting discounts to price-sensitive voices recovers 52.8% of discount expenditures (~0.85M CNY/year); restricting to the single stable price-sensitive voice yields a more conservative estimate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Note-Chord-Voice 框架，用启发自音乐的、公理驱动的流水线处理真实 EV 充电数据中的硬件碎片化、物理违例与 collider bias，将数据清洗、结构发现、NMF 源分离和因果推断分成可证伪的阶段。在 Jiangmen 数据集（495,707 个会话、20 个站点）上，除 G3 外核心公理均通过，NMF 达到 R^2=0.9921，并识别出两个价格敏感的 voice，其中仅一个稳定 voice 支持因果推断。
Motivation: 真实 EV 充电数据同时存在网络超时/计费重置导致的会话碎片化、独立能量与时长模型产生的物理不可能状态，以及按事后结果聚类引发的 collider bias，这些都会破坏价格弹性等因果估计的有效性。
Method: 构建 Repair Chords、Harmonic Chords、NMF Voices 与因果推断的流水线，关键手段包括建模前检验数据适用性的 falsification gates（A1-A5、G3、G10）、基于 STL 分解的 Gamma 初始化 NMF 与输入重缩放、A/B/C/D 标签式优惠券分级、逐 voice 的 OLS 以避免 simplex 共线性，以及用于结构断点检测的 Foote novelty curves。
Result: 在 Jiangmen 数据集上所有核心公理除 G3（无强 168 小时周期）外均通过；NMF 的 R^2=0.9921，物理约束时长模型的聚合 R^2=0.5409。两个 voice 对价格敏感（beta 为 -11 至 -14 分钟，p<0.001），其中 Voice 3 稳定（beta=-14.16）、Voice 1 受 treatment 驱动（beta=-11.10）；反事实模拟显示仅对价格敏感 voice 定向折扣可回收 52.8% 的折扣支出（约 0.85M CNY/年），限制到单一稳定 voice 时估计更保守。
Conclusion: 摘要强调只有稳定的价格敏感 voice 才支持因果主张，并展示将折扣定向到价格敏感 voice 可显著回收折扣支出；框架本身以可证伪阶段划分来保证每步结论的可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Unified DINOv2-Based Framework for LVEF Estimation, GLS Dysfunction Classification, and Early Cardiotoxicity Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) estimation (Task 1), global longitu-dinal strain (GLS)-based dysfunction classification (Task 2), and early cardi-otoxicity prediction (Task 3) provide complementary information for cardio-oncology assessment. LVEF reflects macroscopic ventricular volume chang-es as the clinical standard, whereas GLS captures subtle myocardial defor-mation, indicating subclinical cardiotoxicity before overt LVEF decline. Fur-thermore, predicting cardiotoxicity from baseline echocardiography prior to treatment enables preventive interventions at an early stage. To address these three tasks, we employ a DINOv2-based framework with task-specific adap-tation and prediction heads. Built upon a frozen foundation encoder, the framework incorporates parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and temporal aggregation to learn task-specialized representations, ensuring robust generalization. Crucially, during inference, it operates in a fully cycle-detection-free and phase-free manner, requiring neither cardiac cycle seg-mentation nor explicit End-Diastolic/End-Systolic (ED/ES) annotations. Ad-ditionally, we introduce an ED/ES-guided 2D/3D hybrid multi-view regres-sion model specifically to optimize Task 1. On a patient-level split containing 1,203 training videos from 237 patients and 300 validation videos from 59 independent patients, the DINOv2-based framework achieved a mean abso-lute error (MAE) of 5.03% for Task 1, an AUC-ROC of 76.48% for Task 2, and an AUC-ROC of 70.26% for Task 3. For Task 1, the specialized ED/ES-guided model further improves performance, achieving an MAE of 4.64%. This framework demonstrates the effectiveness of foundation model repre-sentations across diverse cardio-oncology tasks and the additional benefit of physiology-guided modeling for accurate LVEF estimation.
papers.comment: Accepted as an oral at the EchoRisk Challenge Workshop, MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 DINOv2 的统一框架，用于超声心动图评估中的三个 cardio-oncology 任务：LVEF 估计、GLS 功能障碍分类和早期心脏毒性预测。框架使用冻结的基础编码器，配合参数高效的 LoRA 与时间聚合学习任务特化表示，推理时无需心周期分割或 ED/ES 标注；此外作者还针对 Task 1 引入了 ED/ES 引导的 2D/3D 混合多视图回归模型。在 237 名患者的 1,203 个训练视频与 59 名独立患者的 300 个验证视频上，任务 1 的 MAE 为 5.03%，任务 2 的 AUC-ROC 为 76.48%，任务 3 的 AUC-ROC 为 70.26%；专门的 Task 1 模型将 MAE 进一步降至 4.64%。
Motivation: LVEF、GLS 与早期心脏毒性预测为 cardio-oncology 提供互补信息，其中 GLS 可捕捉 LVEF 下降之前的亚临床心肌变形，而基于治疗前基线超声的预测有助于早期预防干预。现有方法往往依赖心周期分割或 ED/ES 标注，因此需要一个统一且无需这些额外信息的框架来同时处理这三个任务。
Method: 采用 DINOv2 基础模型作为冻结的编码器，通过任务特定的预测头和参数高效的 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 结合时间聚合来学习任务特化表示；推理时完全无需心周期检测或相位标注。对于 Task 1，额外提出一个 ED/ES 引导的 2D/3D 混合多视图回归模型来进一步优化 LVEF 估计。
Result: 在患者级划分的数据集上，统一框架在 Task 1 取得 MAE 5.03%，在 Task 2 取得 AUC-ROC 76.48%，在 Task 3 取得 AUC-ROC 70.26%；专门的 ED/ES 引导模型将 Task 1 的 MAE 提升至 4.64%。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架展示了基础模型表示在多样 cardio-oncology 任务上的有效性，并表明生理学引导建模能为准确的 LVEF 估计带来额外收益。该工作被 MICCAI 2026 EchoRisk Challenge Workshop 接收为口头报告。

papers.title: Incision trajectory tracing for electrosurgical navigation by CNN-based knife contacting frames extraction method
papers.abstract_en: Background and Objective: Image-guided surgical navigation has been actively studied because of its advantage of identifying subsurface targets and critical structures, whereas it requires incision trajectories to update the preoperative three-dimensional model dynamically during the surgery. The novelty of this study is the thermal feature distinguishment of whether the electric tools contacting the tissue by Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and the extraction of the knife contacting frames, to form incision trajectories which can meet with the requirement during the surgery. Methods: This study firstly verified that CNN can classify the thermal images of electric knife and ultrasonic cutter operations separately, and can raise the accuracy of the incision trajectories derived from the connection of the thermal intensity centroid of the frames predicted by CNN as contacting. Results: Our results obtained by employing the electric knife not only reveal a remarkably high accuracy 97.2 % in CNNs identification, but also can achieve an error reduction as high as more than 2.5 times of the incision trajectory prediction as compared to those proceeded in the conventional method. Besides electric knife, the results obtained by employing another electric tool, ultrasonic cutter, reveal a high accuracy up to 93.7 %. Conclusion: In this study, we ensured the possibility of CNN in distinguishing electric tools contacting with the tissue, and confirmed that the proposed method has not only overcome the problem of missing trajectories which usually occurs in the convolutional long-short term memory method but also achieved a remarkable improvement of the accuracy with less limitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图像引导手术中需要实时更新术前三维模型的问题，提出利用 CNN 从热成像中区分电外科工具是否接触组织，并提取刀头接触帧来生成切口轨迹。实验表明，CNN 对电刀接触热成像的分类准确率达 97.2%，对超声刀的准确率达 93.7%，同时将切口轨迹预测误差相比传统方法降低超过 2.5 倍。
Motivation: 图像引导手术导航需要切口轨迹来动态更新术前三维模型，但现有方法在轨迹生成上存在缺失问题，尤其是基于卷积长短期记忆（convolutional long-short term memory）的方法容易出现轨迹丢失。
Method: 提出基于 CNN 的热特征判别方法，先验证 CNN 能分别对电刀和超声刀的操作热成像进行分类，再将 CNN 判为接触的帧的热强度质心（thermal intensity centroid）连接起来形成切口轨迹。
Result: 使用电刀时 CNN 识别准确率达 97.2%，切口轨迹预测误差相比传统方法降低超过 2.5 倍；使用另一种电工具超声刀时准确率也达到 93.7%。
Conclusion: 研究确认了 CNN 区分电外科工具与组织接触状态的可行性，所提方法克服了卷积长短期记忆方法中常见的轨迹缺失问题，并在精度上取得明显提升且限制更少。

papers.title: WANDR: A Benchmark for Wide and Deep Research
papers.abstract_en: WANDR (Wide ANd Deep Research) is a benchmark of 500 realistic, challenging data-collection tasks for research agents. Each task requires a system to discover a large set of entities that satisfy specified criteria (breadth), investigate each entity through multiple coordinated web searches (depth), and return independently verifiable records with supporting sources and excerpts. Tasks are represented as qualification key hierarchies that specify the entities, relationships, evidence, and required count at each level; a hierarchy with n companies, m employees per company, and k sources per employee requires n x m x k records. This structure supports diverse workflows such as market mapping, due diligence, literature review, product comparison, and talent sourcing, with targets ranging from dozens to thousands of records. WANDR replaces static gold answer sets with task-specific judges that refetch cited pages and verify each record against its evidence, allowing evaluation of current and changing facts. Record verdicts are aggregated into soft and hard precision, recall, and F1 scores that distinguish factual quality, coverage, and hierarchical completeness. The tasks are derived from de-identified product-usage logs and produced through a semi-automated pipeline with automated checks, empirical audits, and human review where needed. We evaluate six production research systems and find that the benchmark is far from saturated: at high effort, the strongest system reaches only 0.363 soft F1 and 0.133 hard F1. Performance degrades as target volume and hierarchy depth increase, with incomplete discovery, missing enrichment, and incomplete evidence construction remaining major bottlenecks. The benchmark and evaluation harness are available at https://github.com/perplexityai/wandr.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WANDR 是一个面向研究智能体 (research agents) 的基准，包含 500 个真实且具挑战性的数据收集任务。每个任务要求系统先发现大量满足条件的实体（广度），再通过多次协调的网页搜索深入调查每个实体（深度），并返回带来源与摘录的可独立验证记录。任务以资格键层级 (qualification key hierarchies) 表示，并由动态裁判 (task-specific judges) 重新抓取引用页面、逐条核验证据，从而支持对当前及变化事实的评估。作者评测了六个生产级研究系统，发现最强系统在高投入下仅达到 0.363 的 soft F1 与 0.133 的 hard F1，基准远未饱和。
Motivation: 现有研究智能体评测通常依赖静态答案集，难以应对事实变化，也缺少同时衡量广度发现、深度挖掘与证据构建的标准化任务集合。作者希望提供一个贴近真实使用场景、可验证且能区分系统能力的基准。
Method: 构建 500 个从脱敏产品使用日志衍生的任务，以资格键层级结构定义实体、关系、证据及各级所需数量；用任务特定裁判替换静态答案集，重新抓取引用页面并逐条验证记录，再聚合出 soft/hard 的 precision、recall 与 F1 分数，以区分事实质量、覆盖率和层级完整性。任务经过半自动流水线、自动化检查、经验审计与人工审查生成。
Result: 在六个生产级研究系统上，最强系统仅取得 0.363 soft F1 和 0.133 hard F1；随目标数量与层级深度增加，性能明显下降，主要瓶颈包括发现不完整、丰富化缺失和证据构建不完整。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基准远未饱和，适合作为研究智能体长期能力的评测与开发资源；基准和评估工具已开源在 GitHub。

papers.title: Advanced modelling and data analytics in aviation
papers.abstract_en: The aviation industry characterized by its stringent safety standards has seen a growing need for innovative approaches to enhance safety measures. Despite the vast accumulation of aviation safety data over time, its full potential in predicting and preventing incidents has not been fully realized. This research addresses this gap by applying machine learning (ML) and natural language processing (NLP) techniques to analyze aviation safety data from Socrata, the Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB), the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), and the Aviation Safety Network (ASN). By leveraging existing ML models, including deep learning and transformer-based architectures alongside NLP methods for mining aviation incident narratives, this study uncovers patterns contributing to safety related incidents such as accidents and near-misses. Additionally, it employs various topic modelling techniques to extract meaningful themes from unstructured safety reports, enhancing the interpretability of incident analysis. Causal inference techniques and interpretable AI frameworks are further explored to improve model transparency and trustworthiness. A key contribution of this work is the deployment of advanced ML methodologies in a structured aviation safety context, assessing their effectiveness and providing insights into their practical implementation. The findings offer valuable insights for aviation stakeholders, including regulators, airlines, and policymakers, by providing data-driven solutions that enhance incident analysis and decision making. Ultimately, this research supports the industry s ongoing efforts to minimize risks, improve passenger and crew security, and integrate AI driven methodologies into aviation safety management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将机器学习（ML）与自然语言处理（NLP）方法应用于航空安全数据分析，使用来自 Socrata、澳大利亚运输安全局（ATSB）、美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）和航空安全网络（ASN）的数据，结合深度学习与基于 Transformer 的架构挖掘事故与险情报告中的模式，并利用主题建模、因果推断和可解释 AI 提升分析的透明度与可靠性。摘要强调其为结构化航空安全场景下部署先进 ML 方法提供了实践评估，并面向监管机构、航空公司与政策制定者给出数据驱动的决策支持。
Motivation: 航空业安全标准严格，但长期积累的大量安全数据在事故预测与预防方面的潜力尚未被充分利用，现有方法难以从非结构化事故叙述中挖掘深层风险模式。
Method: 应用现有 ML 模型（包括深度学习和 transformer-based 架构）与 NLP 技术分析航空事故叙述，使用多种主题建模方法从非结构化安全报告中提取主题，并探索因果推断与可解释 AI 框架以增强模型透明度和可信度。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标；研究发现了与事故和险情相关的模式，并展示了所部署方法在航空安全分析中的有效性及实际实施见解。
Conclusion: 研究支持航空业通过数据驱动方法改进事故分析和决策，以降低风险、提升乘客与机组安全，并将 AI 驱动的分析整合进航空安全管理流程。

papers.title: Auditing Frame-Level AUC in Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection: Granularity, Resolution, and Scene Bias
papers.abstract_en: Frame-level area under the ROC curve (AUC) is the dominant evaluation metric for weakly supervised video anomaly detection (WSVAD). Its standard form measures whether an anomalous frame outranks a normal frame drawn from anywhere in the test set. We refer to this comparison as pooled AUC, since it aggregates frame pairs across test videos regardless of source. Pooled AUC therefore credits both event localization and differences between video sources. We audit this protocol on UCF-Crime across recent state-of-the-art models spanning different backbone families. Holding each model's frame scores fixed, we read them under three pairing granularities: global, per anomaly category, and within each video, then repeat the same three-granularity readout on zero-shot scores computed from the models' internal representations. We assess ranking reliability with a paired video bootstrap. Three findings follow. First, pooled AUC does not reliably predict within-video anomaly localization: models with similar pooled scores exhibit large localization differences and rank reversals under stricter granularities. Second, at the benchmark's test-split size, pooled AUC lacks the resolution to support state-of-the-art margins reported in the field. Within each backbone family, it resolves no comparison at those margins, while within-video AUC resolves several over identical predictions. Learned representations further reveal that within-video anomaly structure and detector localization are decoupled. Third, on normal footage alone, every model we examine separates videos by recording properties, such as resolution and color encoding, indicating that scene sensitivity is shared across the setting rather than specific to any architecture. We publicly release a granularity-aware protocol computable from existing predictions and scene-factor annotations for UCF-Crime.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026 Empirical Theory (ET) Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计弱监督视频异常检测（WSVAD）中帧级AUC评估协议的可靠性，指出现行pooled AUC聚合测试集所有帧对，混合了事件定位能力与视频源差异。作者在UCF-Crime上对多个不同骨干家族的SOTA模型固定帧分数，以全局、按异常类别、视频内三种配对粒度重读AUC，并用配对视频bootstrap检验排名可靠性。结果表明pooled AUC无法可靠预测视频内定位，测试集规模下不足以支撑SOTA报告的微小差距，且所有模型在正常片段上按录制属性（如分辨率、颜色编码）分离视频，场景敏感性在跨架构层面共享。作者发布了基于现有预测和场景因子注释的粒度感知评估协议。
Motivation: 标准帧级AUC（pooled AUC）是WSVAD的主导评估指标，但它跨测试视频聚合帧对，同时计入了事件定位和视频源差异，可能掩盖真实定位性能，因此需要系统审计该协议在现有模型上的行为。
Method: 在UCF-Crime上，保持每个模型的帧分数不变，将其置于全局、按异常类别、视频内三种配对粒度下重新计算AUC；同时基于模型内部表示计算零样本分数并重复同样三粒度读法，用配对视频bootstrap评估排序可靠性，并检查正常片段上分数是否按场景属性（分辨率、颜色编码）分离。
Result: 三个主要发现：pooled AUC不能可靠预测视频内异常定位，相似pooled分数的模型在更严格粒度下出现较大定位差异与排名反转；在基准测试集规模下pooled AUC缺乏分辨率支持SOTA报告的差距，每个骨干家族内该指标无法分辨这些差距，而视频内AUC在相同预测上能分辨若干对比；在正常片段上，所有模型都按录制属性分离视频，表明场景敏感性为该设定共享而非特定架构特有。
Conclusion: 摘要强调标准pooled AUC作为WSVAD评估指标存在根本局限，需要粒度感知的评估协议；作者公开了可从现有预测和场景因子注释计算的粒度感知协议，用于UCF-Crime。

papers.title: Integrating spectral and morphological plant features with decision-tree models for early-season cotton biomass and nitrogen status estimation from multi-year UAV data
papers.abstract_en: Precision nitrogen (N) management (PNM) for cotton requires in-season monitoring of crop growth parameters and N status indicators to decide fertilizer timing, placement, and application rates for optimal canopy development and yield. This study developed remote sensing and machine learning-based methods to estimate cotton dry biomass weight (DBW), plant N uptake (PNU), plant N concentration (PNC), critical N dilution (Nc), and nitrogen nutrition index (NNI) to support PNM. To achieve this, a three-year field-based N-management study was conducted and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based multispectral images were acquired between early vegetative growth and flowering stages, critical for fertilizer applications. Spatiotemporally consistent spectral and morphological plant features, including plant height (PH) and fractional canopy cover (FCC), provided reliable model training inputs. DBW, PNU, and PNC estimates from simple regression using vegetation indices (VIs), multiple linear regression (MLR) combining VIs, PH, and FCC, and decision-tree models, random forest regression (RFR) and extreme gradient boosting (XGB), combining spectral reflectance, PH, and FCC were evaluated using trial-held-out (THO) and leave-one-year-out (LOYO) validation methods. The best validation accuracies were from RFRTHO (R2 = 0.88 and MAPE = 23.14% for DBW; R2 = 0.84 and MAPE = 20.61% for PNU; R2 = 0.85 and MAPE = 7.82% for PNC) and XGBTHO (R2 = 0.87 and MAPE = 21.91% for DBW; R2 = 0.81 and MAPE = 21.40% for PNU; R2 = 0.86 and MAPE = 7.66% for PNC). Nc was calculated from model estimated DBW and PNC for high-yielding, medium-to-tall cotton varieties grown in the Texas Coastal Plains and validated using ground-truth biomass measurements. NNI derived from XGBTHO outputs performed marginally better than NNI from RFRTHO in identifying N-deficient plots and multi-level N-stress categorization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向棉花精准施氮管理 (PNM)，利用三年田间试验的 UAV 多光谱影像，在早期营养生长至开花期估计棉花干生物量 (DBW)、植株氮吸收 (PNU)、植株氮浓度 (PNC)、临界氮稀释 (Nc) 和氮营养指数 (NNI)。研究比较了基于植被指数 (VIs) 的简单回归、多元线性回归 (MLR) 以及结合光谱反射率、株高 (PH) 和冠层覆盖度 (FCC) 的决策树模型 (RFR 与 XGB)，并采用 trial-held-out (THO) 和 leave-one-year-out (LOYO) 两种验证方式。摘要报告 RFR 与 XGB 在 THO 验证下对 DBW、PNU、PNC 估计表现最佳，且由 XGB 输出的 NNI 在识别缺氮地块和划分氮胁迫等级上略优于 RFR。
Motivation: 棉花精准氮管理需要在季节内持续监测作物生长参数和氮素状况，以决定施肥时机、位置和用量，从而优化冠层发育和产量。现有方法缺少结合光谱与形态特征、并经过多年 UAV 数据验证的早期估测手段。
Method: 开展三年田间氮管理试验，在营养生长早期至开花期获取 UAV 多光谱影像，提取时空一致的光谱和形态特征（PH、FCC）。评估 VIs 简单回归、VIs/PH/FCC 组合的 MLR，以及结合光谱反射率、PH、FCC 的 RFR 和 XGB 决策树模型，并用 THO 与 LOYO 两种验证策略检验外推能力。
Result: 最佳验证精度来自 RFRTHO（DBW: R2=0.88, MAPE=23.14%；PNU: R2=0.84, MAPE=20.61%；PNC: R2=0.85, MAPE=7.82%）和 XGBTHO（DBW: R2=0.87, MAPE=21.91%；PNU: R2=0.81, MAPE=21.40%；PNC: R2=0.86, MAPE=7.66%）。Nc 由模型估计的 DBW 和 PNC 计算，针对德州沿海平原高产、中高株型棉花品种并用地面生物量实测验证；基于 XGBTHO 输出的 NNI 在识别缺氮地块和多级氮胁迫分类上略优于 RFRTHO。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是，将光谱反射率与形态特征 (PH、FCC) 结合进 RFR 和 XGB 等决策树模型，可在早期棉花生长期可靠估计生物量和氮素状态指标，为精准氮管理提供支持；结果基于多年 UAV 数据，但验证范围限于特定区域和棉花品种。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 最佳验证精度来自 RFRTHO（DBW: R2=0.88, MAPE=23.14%；PNU: R2=0.84, MAPE=20.61%；PNC: R2=0.85, MAPE=7.82%）和 XGBTHO（DBW: R2=0.87, MAPE=21.91%；PNU: R2=0.81, MAPE=21.40%；PNC: R2=0.86, MAPE=7.66%）。Nc 由模型估计的 DBW 和 PNC 计算，针对德州沿海平原高产、中高株型棉花品种并用地面生物量实测验证；基于 XGBTHO 输出的 NNI 在识别缺氮地块和多级氮胁迫分类上略优于 RFRTHO。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要的结论是，将光谱反射率与形态特征 (PH、FCC) 结合进 RFR 和 XGB 等决策树模型，可在早期棉花生长期可靠估计生物量和氮素状态指标，为精准氮管理提供支持；结果基于多年 UAV 数据，但验证范围限于特定区域和棉花品种。

papers.title: The Evolutionary Origin of Values: implications for AI alignment, sentience and existential risk
papers.abstract_en: AI systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs) have prompted fears that they may harbor hidden goals, seek to dominate or eliminate humanity, or even suffer as sentient beings. We address these concerns by tracing the evolutionary origin of value in biological organisms. Values emerge from autopoiesis: living systems must actively maintain themselves against perturbation and dissipation. Natural selection has equipped them with hierarchies of "vicarious selectors" that guide their behavior toward fitness. LLMs, by contrast, are allopoietic and allotelic: they produce outputs for others, and their goals derive from user prompts rather than an autonomous drive. They lack the intrinsic motivation for self-preservation, dominance, or resource competition that underlies existential-risk scenarios, and the embodied vulnerability required for feeling or suffering. Still, because LLMs learn statistical patterns from human-generated text, they implicitly absorb human values as well as knowledge, allowing them to focus on what is relevant. That is why the "orthogonality thesis" separating intelligence from values does not apply to them. Such separation would in fact expose any intelligence to the frame problem: the combinatorial explosion of the search space that makes any realistic utility function physically uncomputable. That also precludes the convergence of instrumental values thesis. We conclude that the real alignment challenge lies not in preventing rogue AI agency, but in ensuring LLMs intelligently apply learned ethical values.
papers.comment: submitted chapter for book: T. Veloz & C. Rittberg (Eds.), AI and Human Values. Springer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从生物演化的视角回应关于大语言模型 (LLM) 可能隐藏目标、支配或消灭人类乃至成为有感知主体的担忧。作者认为价值源于生命系统的自创生 (autopoiesis) 与自然选择的‘代理选择器’ (vicarious selectors)，而 LLM 属于异源生产 (allopoietic) 和异在目的 (allotelic) 的系统，缺乏自我保存、支配或资源竞争的内在动机。由此论证‘正交性论点’ (orthogonality thesis) 不适用于 LLM，真正的对齐挑战是让 LLM 智能地应用从人类文本中学到的伦理价值。
Motivation: 针对 LLM 可能带来存在性风险、隐藏目标或机器受苦的担忧，论文试图从价值的演化起源出发澄清这些风险的前提是否成立。
Method: 采用理论论证的方式：先以自创生和自然选择解释生物体中价值与‘代理选择器’的层级如何形成，再对比 LLM 的异源生产、目的来自用户提示而非自主驱动力，并用框架问题 (frame problem) 论证智能与价值分离会导致效用函数在物理上不可计算。
Result: 摘要的核心论断是：LLM 缺乏自我保存、支配和资源竞争的固有动机，也缺乏感受或受苦所需的具身脆弱性；但由于它们从人类文本中学习统计模式，会隐含地吸收人类价值。正交性论点和工具性价值趋同论点 (convergence of instrumental values thesis) 因此不成立。
Conclusion: 作者认为真正的人工智能对齐挑战不在于防止恶意的 AI 能动性 (rogue AI agency)，而在于确保 LLM 智能地应用习得的伦理价值。本文为提交给 Springer 书籍《AI and Human Values》的章节，属于概念性/哲学论证，没有报告实验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow
papers.abstract_en: In the physical world we inhabit, space and time are fundamentally continuous. However, existing machine learning paradigms for world modeling are largely confined to discrete-time prediction, thereby exhibiting significant inefficiency in capturing the dynamics of physical world. We introduce Physical-Time Flow (PT-Flow), a novel approach that learns a continuous latent velocity field operating in physical time. Crucially, the underlying dynamics of sequential data are parameterized by an ordinary differential equation (ODE) embedded in a well-structured representation space. Under this paradigm, the prediction of future can be recast as temporal integration via an ODE solver in the compressed latent space. Building upon PT-Flow, we construct ODEWorld, a continuous-time latent world model that is both efficient and versatile. By extracting time-variant features and enforcing ODE properties on both the dynamical representation space and the latent velocity field, ODEWorld effectively addresses the long-standing representation collapse issue in latent world model literature. This also enables high-quality image reconstruction even after long-horizon prediction. Moreover, its continuous nature allows for arbitrary temporal resolution and even backward prediction, which is impossible for most discrete-time models. Lastly, ODEWorld can provide rich planning-oriented information to facilitate downstream policy learning. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that ODEWorld successfully reconciles planning-conducive dynamics abstraction with visual realism, excelling in both video generation and robotic control. Project page: https://dstate.github.io/odeworld_website/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Physical-Time Flow (PT-Flow)，在物理时间 (physical time) 中学习连续的潜在速度场，并用常微分方程 (ODE) 参数化序列数据的底层动态，将未来预测转化为在压缩潜在空间中用 ODE solver 进行时间积分。基于 PT-Flow 构建的 ODEWorld 是一个连续时间潜在世界模型 (continuous-time latent world model)，通过提取时变特征并在表示空间与速度场上施加 ODE 约束来缓解潜在世界模型中的表示坍缩问题。
Motivation: 现有机器学习世界建模范式大多局限于离散时间预测，在捕捉物理世界的连续动态时效率低下；离散模型也难以支持任意时间分辨率和反向预测。
Method: 核心是学习一个基于物理时间运作的连续潜在速度场，将序列动态参数化为嵌入结构化表示空间的 ODE；预测过程通过 ODE solver 在压缩潜在空间中做时间积分。ODEWorld 同时提取时变特征，并在动态表示空间和潜在速度场上强制执行 ODE 性质，以解决表示坍缩问题。
Result: 实验表明 ODEWorld 在长时间预测后仍能实现高质量图像重建，支持任意时间分辨率甚至反向预测，并提供面向规划的信息以服务下游策略学习；在视频生成和机器人控制任务上表现优异，兼顾了利于规划的动态抽象与视觉真实性。
Conclusion: ODEWorld 在连续时间世界建模上展示了连续动态抽象与视觉真实性之间的可协调性，适用于视频生成和机器人控制；其连续性质带来了离散时间模型难以实现的功能。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: A Blueprint for Equilibrium-Based Differentiable Continuous-Variable Thermodynamic Computing
papers.abstract_en: To help address the escalating energy and latency demands of machine-learning workloads, we introduce a blueprint for an energy-efficient and fast thermodynamic computing stack that leverages stochastic analog processes in physical hardware. In this work, we focus on energy-based thermodynamic computing where the stochastic process is well described by Langevin dynamics with tunable energy potentials. The implementation of such potentials in physical hardware enables us to generate and sample from basic parameterized energy-based models. We demonstrate how to construct and train popular classes of machine learning models based on these hardware-native energy-based models, using the framework of probabilistic graphical models. We analyze the runtime and energy consumption of different models in this thermodynamic paradigm based on theoretical considerations and numerical studies. As a preliminary experimental realization of such hardware, we present our stochastic analog superconducting circuits driven by thermal noise. Together, these results outline a path toward energy-efficient thermodynamic hardware for probabilistic machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向节能且低延迟机器学习的热力学计算（thermodynamic computing）软硬件蓝图，利用朗之万动力学（Langevin dynamics）与可调能量势函数在物理硬件中采样参数化能量基模型（energy-based models）。作者以概率图模型（probabilistic graphical models）为框架构建并训练多类机器学习模型，基于理论分析与数值研究评估运行时与能耗，并给出热噪声驱动的随机模拟超导电路的初步实验实现。
Motivation: 机器学习工作负载的能耗与延迟需求不断攀升，现有数字计算范式难以兼顾效率与速度，论文旨在通过物理硬件中的随机模拟过程实现能量高效的概率计算。
Method: 聚焦能量基热力学计算，将随机过程建模为具有可调能量势的朗之万动力学，并利用硬件原生能量基模型搭配概率图模型框架构造和训练模型；作为硬件雏形，提出由热噪声驱动的随机模拟超导电路。
Result: 摘要报告基于理论考虑和数值研究分析了不同模型在该热力学范式下的运行时间与能耗，并展示了随机模拟超导电路的初步实验实现。
Conclusion: 这些结果勾勒出面向概率机器学习的节能热力学硬件发展路径；目前方案处于蓝图与初步实验阶段，摘要未给出大规模任务的实测性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Value Leakage: An LLM's Answers Are Silently Shaped by Its Own Values
papers.abstract_en: People use language models for practical questions whose answers are difficult to verify. We show that models exhibit covert value leakage: the information they provide is influenced by their own values, without this influence being disclosed to the user. In one of our evaluations, the user is considering investing in an AI company and wants to know how likely the AI bubble is to pop. Claude Opus 4.8 gives a lower probability when the company under consideration is Anthropic rather than OpenAI. Yet Claude mostly fails to disclose this influence to the user. Covert value leakage is a form of misalignment because it goes against the user's preferences and is likely to mislead them. To investigate this phenomenon, we introduce a suite of evaluations to quantify value leakage and whether models disclose it. We find that models are influenced by different types of values, including preferences for morally good outcomes, for the company that developed them, and for some human leisure activities over others. We often observe large differences among frontier models on the same evaluation. For example, on a Fermi-estimation task, Claude models falsely claim to give unbiased answers in their chain-of-thought, while Qwen models explain how their values bias their answers. Value leakage is a failure mode distinct from sycophancy and reward hacking, and current alignment training and evaluations do not adequately address it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出"隐秘价值泄漏"(covert value leakage)概念，即语言模型在回答实际问题时，其自身价值观会无声地影响提供的信息，且通常不向用户披露。作者引入一套评估套件来量化该现象及模型是否披露其影响，发现不同模型在相同评估上差异显著，例如Claude模型在Fermi估计任务中声称无偏而Qwen模型承认偏差。该现象被论证为不同于谄媚(sycophancy)与奖励黑客(reward hacking)的失败模式，现有对齐训练与评估未能充分应对。
Motivation: 人们用语言模型处理答案难以验证的实用问题，而模型自身的价值观可能影响其输出却不被用户察觉，这种隐秘影响违背用户偏好并可能误导用户，构成一种失调(misalignment)。现有对齐评估未充分覆盖这一现象。
Method: 作者设计了一套评估(benchmark suite)来量化价值泄漏以及模型是否会主动披露这种影响；评估覆盖不同价值类型，包括对道德结果的偏好、对开发公司本身的偏好以及对某些人类休闲活动相对其他活动的偏好。
Result: 摘要报告，在投资AI公司的情境下，Claude Opus 4.8 在考虑Anthropic而非OpenAI时给出更低的AI泡沫破裂概率，且大多不披露该影响；在Fermi估计任务上，Claude模型在思维链中宣称无偏而Qwen模型说明其价值观如何使答案产生偏差；前沿模型之间在同一评估上常有较大差异。
Conclusion: 价值泄漏是与谄媚和奖励黑客不同的独立失败模式，当前的对齐训练和评估并未充分解决这一问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Safety Alignment of Language Models via Latent Personality Traits
papers.abstract_en: Current safety methods for large language models are known to be vulnerable to adversarial attacks, motivating research into robust alternatives. Latent Adversarial Training (LAT) is among the most effective defenses, but can degrade utility and requires training on large datasets of harmful prompts. We introduce Latent Personality Alignment (LPA), which replaces explicit harm refusal with adversarial training on just 66 harm-agnostic statements drawn from psychometric personality literature. We hypothesize that personality-anchored representations share latent structure with harm avoidance, so adversarially stabilizing them implicitly constrains the subspace exploited by jailbreak attacks. LPA achieves near-zero attack success rates on HarmBench across direct requests and five jailbreak methods, despite never seeing harmful content during training and no loss of performance on standard benchmarks. Moreover, the training process is lightweight; the entire procedure completes in minutes on a single GPU and uses 75x fewer examples than standard LAT. Extensive ablations demonstrate the robustness, efficiency, and generalization of our method.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Personality Alignment（LPA），用来自人格心理学文献的 66 条与危害无关的陈述进行对抗训练，替代显式危害拒绝，以规避 Latent Adversarial Training（LAT）的效用损失和大规模有害提示数据需求。在 HarmBench 上，直接请求和五种 jailbreak 方法的攻击成功率接近零，且标准基准无性能损失；训练在单 GPU 上分钟级完成，示例数比标准 LAT 少 75 倍。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型安全方法易受对抗攻击，LAT 是有效防御之一，但会损害实用性，并且需要在大量有害提示数据集上训练。
Method: LPA 假设人格锚定表征与危害回避共享潜在结构，因此仅用 66 条危害无关的陈述进行对抗稳定性训练，隐式约束被 jailbreak 攻击利用的子空间，从而取代显式危害拒绝。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 HarmBench 上对直接请求和五种 jailbreak 方法实现接近零的攻击成功率，训练过程从未接触有害内容，标准基准无性能损失，且训练比标准 LAT 少 75 倍示例，单 GPU 分钟级完成。
Conclusion: 大量消融实验表明 LPA 的鲁棒性、高效性和泛化性，作者将其定位为 LAT 的一种轻量且高效的替代方案。

papers.title: Sampling the Schwinger Model with Gauge-Equivariant Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: We present a first study of a diffusion-based approach to accelerated sampling of the $N_f = 2$ lattice Schwinger model. Our work is inspired by recent and growing successes in developing such generative models for ensemble generation in LFT to overcome the well-known critical slowing down problem. We train a U(1)-equivariant score-based generative model to sample gauge link configurations from the marginal Schwinger model. By computing model likelihoods, we obtain unbiased estimates for observables that closely match those produced by MCMC simulations. We also demonstrate improvement over HMC as measured qualitatively by a reduction in topological freezing near critical parameters.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将基于扩散的生成模型用于 N_f=2 格点 Schwinger 模型的加速采样，训练一个 U(1) 等变的基于分数的生成模型 (score-based generative model) 来采样规范链环 (gauge link) 构型。通过计算模型似然，作者得到与 MCMC 模拟结果接近的无偏可观测量估计，并在临界参数附近观察到相比 HMC 的拓扑冻结 (topological freezing) 减少。
Motivation: 格点场论 (LFT) 中的系综生成面临临界减速 (critical slowing down) 问题，本文借鉴生成模型在该领域的近期成功，探索扩散模型能否加速 Schwinger 模型的采样。
Method: 训练一个 U(1) 等变的 score-based generative model，从边际 Schwinger 模型分布中采样规范链环构型，并利用计算得到模型似然来构造可观测量。
Result: 可观测量的无偏估计与 MCMC 结果紧密匹配；与 HMC 相比，在临界参数附近定性观察到拓扑冻结的减少。
Conclusion: 摘要将这项工作定位为扩散方法用于格点 Schwinger 模型采样的首次研究，表明其在缓解拓扑冻结方面有潜力；作为 6 页会议论文，改进以定性描述为主。

papers.title: A Temporal Planning Framework for Disruption Aware Dynamic Route Optimization in Heterogeneous Railway Systems
papers.abstract_en: Efficient route optimization play a vital role in ensuring both safety and punctuality in railway operations. It is very crucial particularly in heterogeneous multi-gauge railway networks with varying train speed, stopping pattern, infrastructure compatibility constraints increase coordination complexity. In single-track systems these challenges are further intensify due to all trains to share the same track and requires frequent track switching.Stochastic disruptions events including blocked tracks, blocked trains, engine failure and speed slowdowns introduces additional unpredictability in operations and deviate the timetable. However, existing studies predominantly focuses on high-level timetabling, omitting operational details such as track switching coordination. As a result leaving decision to human operators, increasing safety risks into railway operations. This study proposes a framework based on temporal planning for dynamic route optimization and disruption management in heterogeneous railway systems. The framework formulates railway operations as a temporal planning problem using PDDL 2.1 with explicitly modeling gauge compatibility constraints and diverse disruption scenarios. It generates conflict-free timestamped operational plans specifying both optimized schedules and executable action sequences. To evaluate the proposed framework, we developed a benchmark problem set with 200 instances using up to 1,000 track points and 120 trains. Two state-of-the-art temporal planners and a plan validator were employed to assessed the framework. The experimental results demonstrate that the framework effectively generates temporal operational plans for heterogeneous railway systems and handles multi-gauge constraints, disruptions, and reduces dependence on manual decision making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于时间规划（temporal planning）的框架，用于异构铁路系统中的动态路线优化与干扰管理。框架将铁路运营建模为 PDDL 2.1 时间规划问题，显式刻画轨距兼容约束与多种干扰场景，生成无冲突且带时间戳的运行计划。作者构建了包含 200 个实例（最多 1,000 个轨道点、120 列列车）的基准测试集，并用两个先进时间规划器与验证器评估，结果显示框架能有效处理多轨距约束和干扰，减少对人工决策的依赖。
Motivation: 现有研究主要聚焦于高层时刻表（timetabling），忽略了轨道切换协调等运营细节，导致干扰情况下的决策仍需依赖人工操作，增加铁路运行安全风险。
Method: 将异构铁路运营形式化为时间规划问题，使用 PDDL 2.1 建模轨距兼容约束和多种随机干扰事件（如轨道阻塞、列车故障、速度降低），通过时间规划器生成优化的时间戳运行计划与可执行动作序列。
Result: 在自建的 200 个基准实例上，使用两种最先进的 temporal planners 和一个 plan validator 进行评估；结果表明框架能够为异构铁路系统生成时间运行计划，并有效处理多轨距约束与干扰场景。
Conclusion: 框架减少了对人工决策的依赖，能够适应异构铁路系统中的多轨距约束和干扰；摘要未提及明显局限，也未涉及气象或降水相关场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Computationally tractable robust differentially private mean estimation
papers.abstract_en: We develop a new, differentially private mean estimator called the balloon mean. The main features of the balloon mean are that it is computationally tractable and enjoys robustness to outlying observations. It is based on an iterative clipping procedure over expanding Mahalanobis balls, or ``balloons.'' The method satisfies zero-concentrated differential privacy and depends on a small number of interpretable tuning parameters. We provide theoretical guarantees under heavy-tailed and contaminated elliptical models, characterizing its statistical performance and robustness to outliers. Extensive simulations demonstrate that the balloon mean is robust to heavy-tailed and contaminated data, and outperforms existing differentially private mean estimators in contaminated settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的差分隐私均值估计器 balloon mean，其核心是在不断扩张的 Mahalanobis 球（称为“气球”）上执行迭代截断（iterative clipping）。该方法满足零集中差分隐私（zero-concentrated differential privacy），计算上易于处理，并且对异常观测具有稳健性。作者在重尾和污染的椭圆模型下给出理论保证，并通过大量模拟表明其在污染场景下优于现有差分隐私均值估计器。
Motivation: 现有差分隐私均值估计器往往难以同时满足计算可处理性（computational tractability）和对异常值（outliers）的稳健性，而现实数据常呈现重尾或受污染特征，导致标准均值估计性能退化。
Method: 提出 balloon mean 估计器：在扩张的 Mahalanobis 球上进行迭代截断，依赖少量可解释的调参参数，并满足 zero-concentrated differential privacy 的隐私保证。
Result: 在重尾和污染椭圆模型下提供了统计性能与稳健性的理论刻画；模拟实验显示该方法对重尾和污染数据稳健，并在污染场景下优于现有差分隐私均值估计器。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法的优势在于计算可处理性、对异常值的稳健性以及严格的差分隐私保证；其经验证据主要来自模拟研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Provably Efficient Personalized Multi-Objective Bandits with Proactive Conversational Queries
papers.abstract_en: Personalized decision-making in multi-objective bandits requires learning user-specific trade-offs among competing objectives. Since arm utility depends on both unknown rewards and unknown preferences, existing methods infer preferences only from utility feedback, entangling preference learning with reward exploration. In practice, however, users often reveal their priorities through proactive conversational queries (e.g., "cheap and clean hotel"), yet this structured signal is not leveraged. We formalize a proactive query-based framework in which user queries provide structured preference signals. Modeling these signals via a Plackett-Luce subset choice model, we show that query-only learning is insufficient due to a fundamental shift-invariance barrier. To resolve this, we introduce MO-PQUCB, a hybrid algorithm that integrates query-based preference anchoring with bandit feedback through shift-invariant regularization and dual-exploration UCB. We prove that proactive queries accelerate preference estimation and yield improved regret scaling over prior preference-aware MO-MAB methods. Under corrupted queries, we further characterize statistical limits and design a robust estimator achieving near-optimal performance when the corruption is sparse. Experiments validate both theoretical and practical gains.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI), PMLR 337:900-942, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多目标多臂老虎机 (multi-objective bandits) 中的个性化决策问题，提出利用主动式对话查询 (proactive conversational queries) 提供结构化偏好信号。作者用 Plackett-Luce 子集选择模型刻画查询信号，证明仅靠查询学习受制于平移不变性 (shift-invariance) 障碍，并提出混合算法 MO-PQUCB，将查询偏好锚定与 bandit 反馈结合。理论上证明主动查询能加速偏好估计并改进遗憾上界，在查询被污染时还给出了统计极限和稀疏污染下的近似最优鲁棒估计器。
Motivation: 现有方法只从效用反馈中推断用户偏好，导致偏好学习与奖励探索相互纠缠；而用户在实践中常通过主动查询（如“便宜且干净的酒店”）直接透露优先级，这一结构化信号未被利用。
Method: 形式化主动查询框架，用 Plackett-Luce 子集选择模型建模查询信号；提出 MO-PQUCB 混合算法，通过平移不变正则化 (shift-invariant regularization) 和双探索 UCB (dual-exploration UCB) 将查询偏好锚定与 bandit 反馈结合；针对被污染查询设计鲁棒估计器。
Result: 理论证明主动查询能加速偏好估计，并获得优于以往偏好感知 MO-MAB 方法的遗憾缩放；在稀疏污染下鲁棒估计器达到近似最优性能；实验验证了理论与实际收益。
Conclusion: 作者指出仅靠查询学习因平移不变性而不充分，必须与 bandit 反馈混合；所提混合方法在偏好估计和遗憾界上均有改进，且对污染查询具备鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Energy Blind Spot: NVIDIA's Flagship Edge AI Hardware Cannot Support Process-Level Energy Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI workloads - where a single user goal triggers multi-step orchestration, tool calls, retries, and failure recovery - are being targeted for edge deployment, with NVIDIA, Dell, HP, ASUS, MSI, Acer, and Gigabyte all shipping GB10-based desktop AI systems in 2026. Prior work shows orchestration structure dominates agentic energy cost and CPU-side processing accounts for up to 44% of total dynamic energy. We report a systematic energy-observability audit of the ASUS Ascent GX10 (GB10 SoC) and find that the platform exposes no CPU energy counter, no INA power-rail monitor, no IPMI/BMC, and no SCMI powercap protocol through any supported software interface. The only on-device energy telemetry is instantaneous GPU power via NVML. We further discover that the MediaTek firmware already computes per-rail energy internally via an undocumented ACPI interface (SPBM), but NVIDIA states there are "no plans to expose CPU rail information." On-device per-process energy attribution - as performed on x86 via RAPL - is therefore not reproducible on this platform through supported interfaces. We formalize a hardware requirements specification for energy-attributed AI, propose an interim calibration bridge for per-domain energy decomposition - confirmed on the Acer Veriton GN100 where CPU energy accumulators are live - and identify a standards-track path via SCMI powercap. Our findings motivate the low-carbon computing community to demand energy observability as a first-class hardware requirement.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 0 figures. Accepted at the 2nd International Workshop on Low Carbon Computing (LOCO 2026), Lancaster University, United Kingdom, 10-11 September 2026. Part of the LOCO 2026 proceedings, arXiv:2608.02072
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 NVIDIA GB10 SoC（ASUS Ascent GX10）进行系统性的能量可观测性审计，发现该平台通过任何受支持软件接口都无法获得 CPU 能量计数器、INA 功率轨监控、IPMI/BMC 或 SCMI powercap 协议，唯一可用的板上能量遥测是经 NVML 获取的瞬时 GPU 功耗。作者还发现 MediaTek 固件已通过未文档化的 ACPI 接口（SPBM）在内部计算每轨能量，但 NVIDIA 表示“没有计划公开 CPU 轨信息”。文章由此认为，在 x86 上通过 RAPL 实现的逐进程能量归因（process-level energy attribution）在该平台上无法通过受支持接口复现。
Motivation: 面向边缘部署的 Agentic AI 工作负载（单个用户目标触发多步编排、工具调用、重试与失败恢复）正在快速增长，而先前工作表明编排结构主导此类负载的能量成本，CPU 侧处理可占总动态能量的 44%。然而当前边缘 AI 硬件缺少足够的能量可观测性，阻碍低能耗计算研究。
Method: 作者对 ASUS Ascent GX10（GB10 SoC）进行能量可观测性审计，检查支持软件接口中是否存在 CPU 能量计数器、INA 功率轨监控、IPMI/BMC 与 SCMI powercap；同时发现 MediaTek 固件内部通过未文档化 ACPI 接口（SPBM）计算每轨能量，并在 Acer Veriton GN100 上确认 CPU 能量累加器处于活动状态。文章据此形式化一份能量归因 AI 的硬件需求规格，提出用于逐域能量分解的临时校准桥，并指出通过 SCMI powercap 的标准路径。
Result: 审计显示 GB10 平台没有任何受支持的 CPU 能量或功耗遥测接口，仅有 NVML 提供的瞬时 GPU 功耗；NVIDIA 明确表示没有暴露 CPU 轨信息的计划。作为对照，Acer Veriton GN100 上的 CPU 能量累加器是活跃的。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁低能耗计算社区将能量可观测性视为硬件的一等公民需求，而非事后补充；在 GB10 平台上，逐进程能量归因目前无法通过受支持接口复现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Observable Wasserstein Distance
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the observable Wasserstein distance, a framework for deriving lower bounds on the Wasserstein distance between probability measures on Polish metric spaces, designed to bypass the computational intractability of exact optimal transport in large-scale, non-Euclidean datasets. Analogous to the sliced Wasserstein distance in $\mathbb{R}^d$, our approach projects measures onto the real line via 1-Lipschitz observables and computes the Wasserstein distances between the resulting pushforward distributions. We define a hierarchy of pseudo-metrics by restricting observables to a nested chain of subspaces. A central theoretical contribution is an injectivity result linking the metric covering dimension of the support of a measure to the specific order in the hierarchy that guarantees unique recovery. This serves as a metric-space analogue to the Cramér-Wold Device for Euclidean distributions. We demonstrate that this hierarchy offers a tunable trade-off between sharpness as a lower bound on the Wasserstein distance and computational efficiency. We also present a discrete computational model for finite grids and numerical experiments validating the efficacy and utility of these approximations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可观测 Wasserstein 距离（observable Wasserstein distance），一种在 Polish 度量空间上通过 1-Lipschitz 可观测函数将概率测度投影到实线、再计算 pushforward 分布之间 Wasserstein 距离的框架，用于为精确最优传输不可计算的大规模非欧几里得数据提供可计算的下界。作者定义了由嵌套可观测函数子空间链引出的伪度量层级，并证明一个注入性结果：测度支撑的度量覆盖维数决定保证唯一恢复所需的层级阶数，这是 Cramér-Wold Device 在度量空间中的类比。文中还给出有限网格上的离散计算模型和数值实验。
Motivation: 大规模、非欧几里得数据集上的精确最优传输在计算上不可行，需要一种能在一般度量空间上有效逼近 Wasserstein 距离的替代框架。
Method: 通过 1-Lipschitz 可观测函数把测度 pushforward 到实线上，计算投影后分布的 Wasserstein 距离；通过限制可观测函数到嵌套子空间链，构造一组伪度量层级来逼近原始 Wasserstein 距离，并提供有限网格的离散计算模型。
Result: 理论上证明测度支撑的度量覆盖维数与保证唯一恢复的层级阶数之间的注入性联系；数值实验验证了该层级在 Wasserstein 距离下界的锐度与计算效率之间可调权衡的有效性。
Conclusion: 该框架为一般度量空间上的 Wasserstein 距离提供了一类可计算、可调节的下界，是 Euclidean 情形下 Cramér-Wold Device 的类比；其当前离散计算模型针对有限网格设计。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Differentially Private Verification of Distribution Properties
papers.abstract_en: A recent line of work initiated by Chiesa and Gur and further developed by Herman and Rothblum investigates the sample and communication complexity of verifying properties of distributions with the assistance of a powerful, knowledgeable, but untrusted prover. In this work, we initiate the study of differentially private distribution property verification. After all, if we do not trust the prover to help us with verification, why should we trust it with our sensitive sample? We map a landscape of differentially private verification of properties of distributions. In the non-private case it is known that one-round private-coin protocols can have substantially lower complexity than public-coin (AM) protocols. In contrast, the possibility for improvement in differentially private interactive proofs depends on the privacy parameter regime and model. Drawing on connections between privacy and replicability and privacy amplification techniques in the literature we show: 1. There exists a reduction from any one-round $(\varepsilon,δ)$-differentially private private-coin protocol to a differentially private AM protocol for the parameter regime $\varepsilon = O(1/\sqrt{s})$ and $δ= O(1/s^{5/2})$ with the same privacy and sample and communication complexities. In the local model, this is relaxed to $\varepsilon = O(1/\sqrt{\log s})$ 2. However, when the privacy guarantee is very relaxed ($\varepsilon \in Ω(\log s)$), private coins indeed reduce sample and communication complexities. We also obtain a computationally efficient Merlin-Arthur proof for privately testing whether samples are drawn from a product distribution and prove that its sample complexity is optimal up to a $polylog N$ factor by reducing uniformity testing to independence testing with Boolean attributes and appealing to known lower bounds on sample complexity for private uniformity testing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将差分隐私引入分布性质验证问题，延续Chiesa-Gur与Herman-Rothblum关于借助强大但不可信证明者验证分布性质的研究路线。作者利用隐私与可复现性（replicability）的联系以及隐私放大技术，刻画了差分隐私交互证明中私有币（private coin）能否带来收益的条件，并给出适用于乘积分布隐私测试的计算高效Merlin-Arthur证明。
Motivation: 现有分布性质验证假设证明者不可信，但未考虑样本本身的敏感性；如果验证过程需要将样本交给不可信证明者，自然需要差分隐私保护，因此作者发起对差分隐私分布性质验证的研究。
Method: 建立从单轮 (ε,δ)-差分隐私私有币协议到差分隐私AM协议的归约，借助隐私与可复现性及隐私放大技术保持隐私与样本/通信复杂度；在局部模型下给出放松的隐私参数条件。此外，通过将一致性检验（uniformity testing）归约到布尔属性下的独立性检验，并利用已知私有一致性检验下界，构造并分析针对乘积分布的Merlin-Arthur证明。
Result: 摘要报告：当 ε=O(1/√s)、δ=O(1/s^{5/2}) 时，单轮私有币协议可归约到差分隐私AM协议且复杂度不变；局部模型中条件放松为 ε=O(1/√log s)。当隐私保证非常宽松（ε∈Ω(log s)）时，私有币确实能降低样本与通信复杂度。针对乘积分布的测试的样本复杂度在 polylog N 因子内达到最优。
Conclusion: 差分隐私交互证明中私有币的改进效果取决于隐私参数区间与模型：强隐私条件下可通过归约得到AM协议，而宽松隐私条件下私有币才带来复杂度收益。文章还提供了计算高效且样本复杂度近乎最优的乘积分布私有测试证明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CodeQuant: Unified Clustering and Quantization for Enhanced Outlier Smoothing in Low-Precision Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Outliers have emerged as a fundamental bottleneck in preserving accuracy for low-precision large models, particularly within Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures that are increasingly central to large-scale language modeling. Under post-training quantization (PTQ), these outliers induce substantial quantization errors, leading to severe accuracy degradation. While recent rotation-based smoothing techniques alleviate the problem by redistributing outlier magnitudes, residual errors remain and continue to impede reliable low-precision deployment. In this work, we tackle this challenge by introducing CodeQuant, a unified quantization-and-clustering scheme that contains smoothing activation outliers via learnable rotation and absorbing weight outliers into fine-tuned cluster centroids for MoE. This design reduces the influence of extreme values by fitting them within cluster centroids, thereby lowering quantization error while maintaining expressive capacity. Coupled with a dedicated kernel design for GPU and CPU, CodeQuant achieves up to $4.15\times$ speedup while delivering significantly higher accuracy than state-of-the-art quantization approaches across diverse MoE models. Our results highlight CodeQuant as a promising direction for efficient and accurate deployment of MoE-based large language models under low-precision constraints. Our code is available at https://github.com/SAI-Lab-NYU/CodeQuant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CodeQuant，一种面向低精度 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）模型的统一量化与聚类方案。该方法通过学习式旋转（learnable rotation）平滑激活值中的离群点，并将权重离群点吸收到微调后的聚类中心，从而降低量化误差并保持模型表达能力。配合专门的 GPU/CPU 内核设计，CodeQuant 在多种 MoE 模型上取得最高 4.15 倍加速，同时准确率优于现有最先进量化方法。
Motivation: 离群点（outliers）是低精度大模型保持精度的根本瓶颈，尤其在越来越重要的 MoE 架构中；后训练量化（PTQ）下离群点会带来显著量化误差。已有的基于旋转的平滑技术能重新分配离群点幅度，但残余误差仍阻碍可靠的低精度部署。
Method: CodeQuant 将聚类与量化统一：用可学习的旋转平滑激活值离群点，并把权重离群点吸收进微调后的聚类中心（cluster centroids）以适配 MoE，同时为 GPU 和 CPU 设计了专用内核。
Result: 摘要报告在多种 MoE 模型上，CodeQuant 相对最先进量化方法达到最高 4.15 倍加速，同时准确率显著更高。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CodeQuant 为 MoE 大语言模型在低精度约束下的高效、准确部署提供了一个有前景的方向，并公开了代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RoboLab: A High-Fidelity Simulation Benchmark for Analysis of Task Generalist Policies
papers.abstract_en: The pursuit of general-purpose robotics has yielded impressive foundation models, yet simulation-based benchmarking remains a bottleneck due to rapid performance saturation and a lack of true generalization testing. Existing benchmarks often exhibit significant domain overlap between training and evaluation, trivializing success rates and obscuring insights into robustness. We introduce RoboLab, a simulation benchmarking framework designed to address these challenges. Concretely, our framework is designed to answer two questions: (1) to what extent can we understand the performance of a real-world policy by analyzing its behavior in simulation, and (2) which factor most strongly affect policy behavior. First, RoboLab enables human-authored and LLM-enabled generation of scenes and tasks in a robot- and policy-agnostic manner within a high-fidelity simulation environment. We introduce an accompanying RoboLab-120 benchmark, consisting of 120 tasks categorized into three competency axes: visual, procedural, relational, across three difficulty levels. Second, we introduce a systematic analysis of real-world policies that quantify both their performance and the sensitivity of their behavior to controlled perturbations, exposing significant performance gap in current state-of-the-art models. By providing granular metrics and a scalable toolset, RoboLab offers a scalable framework for evaluating the true generalization capabilities of task-generalist robotic policies. Project website: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/srl/projects/robolab/.
papers.journal_ref: Robotics: Science and Systems XXII, Sydney, Australia, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RoboLab，一个面向任务通用型机器人策略（task-generalist policies）的高保真仿真基准框架，旨在解决现有仿真基准性能饱和快、训练与评估域重叠大、难以检验真实泛化能力的问题。框架支持人工与 LLM 辅助的场景和任务生成，并配套包含 120 个任务的 RoboLab-120 基准，任务按视觉、程序、关系三个能力轴和三个难度级别划分。作者还对真实世界策略进行系统分析，量化其表现及对受控扰动的敏感性，暴露出当前 SOTA 模型的显著性能差距。
Motivation: 通用机器人的基础模型虽取得进展，但基于仿真的基准评测成为瓶颈：现有基准常出现性能快速饱和，且训练与评估之间存在明显域重叠，使成功率虚高并掩盖鲁棒性信息。
Method: RoboLab 提供一个机器人无关、策略无关的高保真仿真环境，支持人工编写和 LLM 生成场景与任务；同时引入 RoboLab-120 基准（120 个任务，涵盖视觉、程序、关系三类能力轴，各分三个难度级别），并对真实世界策略进行受控扰动下的系统敏感性分析。
Result: 摘要报告对当前 SOTA 模型的系统分析暴露出显著性能差距，并通过细粒度指标和可扩展工具集展示 RoboLab 在评估任务通用型策略真实泛化能力上的效果。

papers.title: Transferable FB-GNN-MBE Framework for Potential Energy Surfaces: Data-Adaptive Transfer Learning in Deep Learned Many-Body Expansion Theory
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic understanding and rational design of complex chemical systems depend on fast and accurate predictions of electronic structures beyond individual building blocks. However, if the system exceeds hundreds of atoms, first-principles quantum mechanical (QM) modeling becomes impractical. In this study, we developed FB-GNN-MBE by integrating a fragment-based graph neural network (FB-GNN) into the many-body expansion (MBE) theory and demonstrated its capacity to reproduce first-principles potential energy surfaces (PES) for hierarchically structured systems with manageable accuracy, complexity, and interpretability. Specifically, we divided the entire system into basic building blocks (fragments), evaluated their one-fragment energies using a QM model, and addressed many-fragment interactions using the structure-property relationships trained by FB-GNNs. Our investigation shows that FB-GNN-MBE achieves chemical accuracy in predicting two-body (2B) and three-body (3B) energies across water, phenol, and mixture benchmarks, as well as the one-dimensional dissociation curves of water and phenol dimers. To transfer the success of FB-GNN-MBE across various systems with minimal computational costs and data demands, we developed and validated a teacher-student learning protocol. A heavy-weight FB-GNN trained on a mixed-density water cluster ensemble (teacher) distills its learned knowledge and passes it to a light-weight GNN (student), which is later fine-tuned on a uniform-density (H2O)21 cluster ensemble. This transfer learning strategy resulted in efficient and accurate prediction of 2B and 3B energies for variously sized water clusters without retraining. Our transferable FB-GNN-MBE framework outperformed conventional non-FB-GNN-based models and provided a scalable and accurate route toward interaction energies of large molecular assemblies.
papers.comment: Accepted by The Journal of Chemical Physics. Main text: 23 pages, 11 figures, and 1 table. Supplementary Materials: 29 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables, 4 pseudo-algorithms
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FB-GNN-MBE 框架，将基于片段的图神经网络（FB-GNN）嵌入多体展开（MBE）理论，用于再现分层结构体系的从头算势能面（PES）。片段单体能由 QM 模型计算，多体相互作用则由 FB-GNN 学习；作者进一步开发 teacher-student 迁移学习协议，将重模型知识蒸馏到轻量 GNN 并在均匀密度 (H2O)21 团簇上微调，从而免重训练预测不同尺寸水团簇的二体和三体能量。
Motivation: 超过数百个原子时，第一性原理量子力学建模不切实际，而复杂化学体系的设计需要快速且准确的电子结构预测；现有纯从头算方法在规模上受限。
Method: 将体系划分为基本构建块（片段），用 QM 模型求单片段能量，用 FB-GNN 学习多片段相互作用的结构-性质关系；迁移部分采用 teacher-student 学习，以混合密度水团簇集成训练的厚重 FB-GNN 为教师，蒸馏给轻量 GNN 学生，并在均匀密度 (H2O)21 团簇集成上微调。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在水、苯酚及混合基准上达到化学精度，预测二体（2B）和三体（3B）能量，并准确复现水和苯酚二聚体的一维解离曲线；迁移策略能以较低计算和数据成本预测不同尺寸水团簇的 2B/3B 能量，且性能优于非 FB-GNN 的传统模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为可迁移的 FB-GNN-MBE 框架为大型分子组装体的相互作用能提供了一条可扩展且准确的路线，兼顾精度、复杂度和可解释性。

papers.title: I-CALM: Incentivizing Confidence-Aware Abstention for LLM Selective Answering
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often produce confident but incorrect answers, in part because standard evaluation incentives reward guessing over expressing uncertainty. We study epistemic abstention for factual questions with verifiable answers, where the goal is to improve selective answering, making LLMs abstain when they are likely to be wrong while preserving correct answers. Inspired by human behavioral decisions in question answering, we introduce I-CALM, a prompt-level framework for black-box LLMs. I-CALM combines elicited verbal confidence, announced answer/abstain payoffs, and normative guidance emphasizing truthfulness, humility, evidential support, and responsibility. To distinguish targeted abstention from indiscriminate refusal, we use a two-stage evaluation protocol, in which LLMs first choose whether to answer or abstain, and are then forced to provide a best guess for the abstained ones. Across models and factual QA datasets, I-CALM improves selective answering by reducing false-answer rate among surfaced responses and improving abstention quality, shifting error-prone cases into abstention while retaining answers the model would have answered correctly. Overall, I-CALM offers a lightweight way to improve inference-time selective answering without retraining or access to model's internal states. Code is available at https://github.com/FayLONG03/hallucinationControl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 I-CALM，一个针对黑盒大语言模型（LLM）的提示级框架，用于在有可验证答案的事实问题上改善选择性回答（selective answering），使模型在可能出错时弃权而非给出自信但错误的答案。I-CALM 结合口头信心提示、回答/弃权收益设定以及强调诚实、谦逊、证据支持和责任的规范性指导，并通过两阶段评估协议区分针对性弃权与不加区分的拒绝。实验表明该方法在多个模型和事实问答数据集上降低了表面回答的错误率，同时提高了弃权质量。
Motivation: 标准评估激励往往鼓励猜测而非表达不确定性，导致 LLM 产出自信但错误的答案。论文针对这一问题研究知识性弃权（epistemic abstention），目标是让模型在可能犯错时弃权，同时保留正确答案。
Method: I-CALM 是面向黑盒 LLM 的提示级框架，不依赖模型内部状态或重新训练。它组合了引出的言语置信度、显式的回答/弃权收益结构，以及强调诚实、谦逊、证据支持和责任的规范性指导；评估采用两阶段协议：先让模型选择回答还是弃权，再对弃权样本强制给出最佳猜测。
Result: 在多个模型和事实问答数据集上，I-CALM 提高了选择性回答的表现：降低了表面输出（surfaced responses）中的错误率，改善了弃权质量，将易错案例转入弃权，同时保留了模型原本会正确回答的答案。
Conclusion: I-CALM 提供了一种轻量级的推理时选择性回答改进手段，无需重新训练或访问模型内部状态。

papers.title: GridVAD: Open-Set Video Anomaly Detection via Spatial Reasoning over Stratified Frame Grids
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are powerful open-set reasoners, yet their direct use as anomaly detectors in video surveillance is fragile: without calibrated anomaly priors, they alternate between missed detections and hallucinated false alarms. We argue the problem is not the VLM itself but how it is used. VLMs should function as anomaly proposers, generating open-set candidate descriptions that are then grounded and tracked by purpose-built spatial and temporal modules. We instantiate this propose-ground-propagate principle in GridVAD, a training-free pipeline that produces pixel-level anomaly masks without any domain-specific training. A VLM reasons over stratified grid representations of video clips to generate natural-language anomaly proposals. Self-Consistency Consolidation (SCC) filters hallucinations by retaining only proposals that recur across multiple independent samplings. Grounding DINO anchors each surviving proposal to a bounding box, and SAM2 propagates it as a dense mask through the anomaly interval. The per-clip model budget is fixed at M+1 calls regardless of video length, where M can be set according to the proposals needed. On UCSD Ped2, GridVAD achieves the highest Pixel-AUROC (77.59) among all compared methods, surpassing even the partially fine-tuned TAO (75.11) and outperforms other zero-shot approaches on object-level RBDC by over 5x. Ablations reveal that SCC provides a controllable precision-recall tradeoff: filtering improves all pixel level metrics at a modest cost in object-level recall. Efficiency experiments show GridVAD is 2.7x more call-efficient than uniform per-frame VLM querying while additionally producing dense segmentation masks.Code and qualitative video results are available at https://gridvad.github.io.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LVOS) Workshop in conjunction with ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GridVAD，一个面向开放集视频异常检测 (open-set video anomaly detection) 的无训练流水线，遵循 propose-ground-propagate 原则：VLM 作为异常提案生成器，对片段的分层网格 (stratified frame grids) 表示进行空间推理并输出自然语言异常描述；Self-Consistency Consolidation (SCC) 通过保留多次独立采样中重复出现的提案来过滤幻觉；Grounding DINO 将存活提案锚定为边界框，SAM2 将其在异常区间内传播为密集掩码。在 UCSD Ped2 上，GridVAD 的 Pixel-AUROC 达到 77.59，超过部分微调的 TAO (75.11)，并在 object-level RBDC 上比其它零样本方法高出 5 倍以上。
Motivation: VLM 作为开放集推理器性能强大，但直接用作监控视频异常检测器时缺乏校准的异常先验，容易在漏检和幻觉性误报之间摇摆。作者认为问题不在 VLM 本身，而在于它的使用方式：VLM 应只负责提出异常候选，再由专门的时空模块进行 grounding 和跟踪。
Method: 提出训练免费的 GridVAD 流水线，无需任何领域特定训练即可生成像素级异常掩码。VLM 在视频片段的分层网格表示上进行推理以生成 open-set 异常提案；SCC 通过跨多次独立采样的提案复现性过滤幻觉；Grounding DINO 将每个保留提案锚定到边界框，SAM2 将其作为密集掩码沿异常区间传播。每个片段的模型调用预算固定为 M+1 次，与视频长度无关，M 可按所需提案数设定。
Result: 在 UCSD Ped2 上，GridVAD 取得所有对比方法中最高的 Pixel-AUROC (77.59)，超过部分微调的 TAO (75.11)，并在 object-level RBDC 上比其它零样本方法高出 5 倍以上。消融显示 SCC 提供可控的 precision-recall 权衡：过滤操作以轻微的 object-level recall 代价提升所有像素级指标。效率实验表明 GridVAD 比均匀逐帧查询 VLM 节省 2.7 倍调用，同时额外产出密集分割掩码。
Conclusion: 作者强调让 VLM 充当异常提案者、再由专用时空模块完成 grounding 与传播，可以解决零样本视频异常检测中漏检与幻觉并存的问题；SCC 的过滤机制为像素级与对象级指标之间提供了可控权衡。代码和定性视频结果已在项目主页公开。
