papers.title: Braided Vision Transformer for Stroke Detection in Multi-view Retinal Fundus Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Stroke remains a leading cause of mortality and morbidity worldwide, emphasizing the importance of its accurate and immediate assessment. Retinal fundus imaging has emerged as a promising modality for stroke assessment, as the retina reflects cerebrovascular and neurological risk factors. Contrary to conventional neuroimaging techniques, retinal fundus imaging offers a non-invasive, cost-effective, and portable alternative for rapid screening. This paper explores the feasibility of retinal fundus imaging for stroke and transient ischemic attack (TIA) detection using macula-centric and optic nerve head-centric views captured from both eyes. Our study introduces, to the best of our knowledge, the first vision transformer model for retinal fundus imaging in stroke assessment, offering a novel approach for capturing retinal patterns. Thereby, we propose the Braided Vision Transformer (BViT) model, which extracts representative features from the given multi-view images while simultaneously capturing inter-view relationships across both eyes, enabling a more informative understanding of retinal biomarkers associated with cerebrovascular events. Experiments conducted on our collected Stroke-Data dataset demonstrate that BViT achieves an AUC score of 0.75 for stroke detection, outperforming regular vision transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨用多视角视网膜眼底影像检测卒中与短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA），提出首个用于卒中评估的眼底影像视觉 Transformer 模型 Braided Vision Transformer (BViT)。BViT 同时提取双眼黄斑中心（macula-centric）和视盘中心（optic nerve head-centric）视图的特征，并建模跨视角关系。在自建 Stroke-Data 数据集上，BViT 的卒中检测 AUC 为 0.75，优于普通视觉 Transformer。
Motivation: 卒中致死致残率高，需要快速准确的评估手段；眼底影像非侵入、低成本、便携，可反映脑血管与神经风险。现有方法未充分利用多视角眼底影像中双眼之间的关联，论文针对这一缺口提出新的建模方案。
Method: 提出 BViT，一种视觉 Transformer 架构，以黄斑中心和视盘中心的多视图眼底图像为输入，在提取各视角代表性特征的同时捕获跨双眼的视角间关系（inter-view relationships）。
Result: 在自收集的 Stroke-Data 数据集上，BViT 对卒中检测取得 AUC 0.75，并优于常规视觉 Transformer。
Conclusion: 摘要表明眼底多视角影像可用于卒中/TIA 检测，BViT 通过跨视角关系建模提升性能；但实验仅基于自建数据集，泛化性仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: AeroGround: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Aerial-Ground Collaborative Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have been widely employed in understanding and reasoning tasks for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Existing UAV benchmarks primarily focus on aerial-view scenarios. However, whether current VLMs can perform well on understanding and reasoning tasks in aerial-ground collaborative scenarios which are practical in real-world applications like rescue and infrastructure inspection remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce AeroGround, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in aerial-ground collaborative reasoning. AeroGround is built upon a simulated aerial-ground dataset containing approximately 29,000 multimodal observation groups from diverse open environments, and provides 2,250 high-quality question-answering instances covering cross-view correspondence, spatial understanding, and reasoning. Experiments on 16 pretrained VLMs, together with two domain-adapted variants, reveal a substantial gap between current models and human performance: the best model achieves an average accuracy of 54.4%, whereas humans reach 93.3%. By systematically revealing the strengths and limitations of existing models in aerial-ground collaborative reasoning, AeroGround provides a foundation for developing more capable aerial-ground collaborative embodied intelligence systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AeroGround，一个用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在空地协同推理能力的基准。它基于模拟空地数据集构建，包含约 29,000 组多模态观测组和 2,250 个高质量问答实例，覆盖跨视角对应、空间理解与推理。在 16 个预训练 VLM 和两个领域自适应变体上的实验显示，最佳模型平均准确率为 54.4%，而人类达到 93.3%。
Motivation: 现有无人机（UAV）基准主要聚焦纯空中视角场景，而空地协同场景在救援和基础设施巡检等实际应用中很普遍，当前 VLM 在该场景下的理解和推理能力尚未被系统评估。
Method: 构建基于模拟环境的空地协同数据集，包含约 29,000 组多模态观测组，设计 2,250 个问答实例，覆盖跨视角对应、空间理解和推理等任务，并用这些数据评估多个预训练 VLM 及其领域自适应变体。
Result: 最佳模型在空地协同推理上的平均准确率为 54.4%，人类表现达 93.3%，说明当前 VLM 与该场景下人类推理能力之间存在显著差距。
Conclusion: 通过系统揭示现有模型在空地协同推理中的优势与局限，AeroGround 为开发更强大的空地协同具身智能系统提供了评估基础。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Closed-Loop Reasoning for Organic Structure Elucidation from Multimodal Spectra
papers.abstract_en: Following the molecular discovery and synthesis revolutions, scalable automated structure elucidation from routine spectroscopic data remains an outstanding challenge. Despite decades of computational efforts, no existing system achieved reliable reasoning over unseen spectra. Here, we propose MACROS, a multi-agent system automating structure elucidation by emulating expert iterative hypothesis-testing. Trained on 100M simulated and 1.6M experimental spectra-molecule pairs, it natively supports arbitrary combinations of routine spectroscopic techniques. It achieves unprecedented zero-shot generalization to diverse real-world samples, correctly identifying synthetic compounds, natural products and metabolites above 500 Da with 1D NMR. Remarkably, MACROS spontaneously recovers textbook spectroscopic correlations from unassigned data and exhibits emergent chemical intuition such as a ring-first parsing preference, learning fundamental chemical principles rather than memorizing database patterns. MACROS augments chemists via collaboration to deliver sixfold faster, 40% more accurate elucidation. MACROS establishes a scalable foundation for fully automated structure elucidation, and catalyzes accelerated molecular discovery toward autonomous laboratories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MACROS，一个通过模拟专家迭代式假设检验来执行有机结构解析的多智能体系统。该系统在 100M 个模拟和 1.6M 个实验光谱-分子对上训练，原生支持常规光谱技术的任意组合，并在未见过的真实样本上实现零样本泛化。摘要报告它能用 1D NMR 正确识别 500 Da 以上的合成化合物、天然产物和代谢物，并自发恢复教科书级的光谱-结构相关性，出现环优先解析等化学直觉行为。与化学家协作时，MACROS 带来六倍加速和 40% 的准确率提升。
Motivation: 分子发现和合成革命之后，从常规光谱数据中实现可扩展的自动化结构解析仍是突出挑战；摘要强调尽管经过数十年计算努力，尚无系统能在未见光谱上实现可靠推理。
Method: MACROS 是多智能体系统，通过模拟专家的迭代假设检验流程实现结构解析，并在大规模模拟与实验光谱-分子对上训练，能够原生支持任意组合的常规光谱技术。

papers.title: DeCo-MIL: Debiased Counterfactual Reasoning for Long-Tailed Whole Slide Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely used for weakly supervised whole slide image (WSI) analysis. However, under long-tailed distributions, MIL-based WSI analysis faces a nested dual long-tail: an inter-slide class long tail and an intra-slide long tail of instance-level discriminative evidence. The two long tails are coupled: tail classes have few training slides, while their limited diagnostic evidence is concentrated in a few patches and obscured by abundant within-bag redundancy. This coupling biases models toward head classes and degrades rare-class recognition. To address this, we propose DeCo-MIL for long-tailed WSI analysis, which jointly alleviates the nested dual long-tail through frequency-debiased counterfactual reasoning. For the inner long tail, DeCo-MIL clusters patches into tissue-morphology anchors, replaces each anchor with its matched normal prototype to perform a counterfactual intervention, and estimates its counterfactual contribution to the ground-truth class using class-frequency-corrected predictions. These contributions guide redundancy masking to preserve scarce discriminative instances. For the outer long tail, DeCo-MIL constructs anchor-stratified pseudo-bags from redundancy-reduced bags and combines tail-aware oversampling with consistency regularization, increasing effective supervision for tail classes while preserving tissue-morphology composition. Extensive experiments on three long-tailed WSI benchmarks demonstrate that DeCo-MIL achieves state-of-the-art performance in both tail-class recognition and overall classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeCo-MIL，用于长尾分布下的全切片图像（WSI）弱监督多示例学习（MIL）分析。针对摘要所称的嵌套双长尾问题——切片间类别长尾与切片内实例级判别证据长尾——该方法通过基于类别频率校正的反事实推理（frequency-debiased counterfactual reasoning）联合缓解内、外两层长尾。摘要在三个长尾 WSI 基准上报告了尾部类识别与总体分类的 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 基于 MIL 的 WSI 分析在长尾分布下面临嵌套双长尾：稀有类别本身训练切片少，其有限判别证据又集中在少数 patch 中并被袋内冗余掩盖，两类长尾相互耦合，使模型偏向头类并损害罕见类识别。
Method: DeCo-MIL 对内长尾将 patch 聚类为组织形态锚点，用匹配的正常原型替换锚点进行反事实干预，并由类别频率校正的预测估计每个锚点的反事实贡献，据此做冗余掩码以保留稀缺判别实例；对外长尾则在冗余削减后的袋上构建锚点分层伪袋（anchor-stratified pseudo-bags），结合尾部感知过采样（tail-aware oversampling）与一致性正则化，在保持组织形态构成的同时增强尾部类的有效监督。
Result: 在三个长尾 WSI 基准上的大量实验表明，DeCo-MIL 在尾部类识别和总体分类上均达到当前最优性能。
Conclusion: 摘要主张嵌套双长尾的耦合可通过反事实干预与伪袋重采样的联合设计得到缓解，并以此提升长尾 WSI 分析的罕见类识别能力。

papers.title: VideoGAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants on Agentic Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Video understanding is a fundamental task for evaluating the capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing leading models have already achieved approximately 90% accuracy on the Video-MME leaderboard, suggesting that conventional single-turn video understanding tasks are becoming increasingly saturated and insufficient for assessing the intelligence of advanced MLLMs. Towards this end, we introduce VideoGAIA, an agentic video understanding benchmark for general artificial intelligence (AI) assistants. Moving beyond one-shot video question answering, VideoGAIA formulates video understanding as a multi-turn, tool-augmented interaction process, where models must iteratively perceive videos, invoke external tools, gather complementary information, and integrate multimodal evidence across turns. VideoGAIA contains 271 model-human co-designed tasks covering diverse and complex real-world scenarios. Each video-question-answer instance is independently verified by three human experts to ensure both correctness and appropriate difficulty. All evaluated MLLMs, including frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Kimi-K3, achieve less than 60% accuracy on VideoGAIA, highlighting its value as a high-quality and timely benchmark for evaluating next-generation MLLMs. We hope that VideoGAIA will facilitate the transition from conventional video understanding toward agentic video understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VideoGAIA，一个面向通用 AI 助手的智能体视频理解基准。与传统的单轮视频问答不同，VideoGAIA 将视频理解建模为多轮、工具增强的交互过程，模型需要迭代感知视频、调用外部工具并整合多模态证据。基准包含 271 个人机协同设计的任务，每个实例经三位人类专家独立验证。实验显示包括 GPT-5.5、Kimi-K3 在内的前沿 MLLM 在 VideoGAIA 上准确率均低于 60%，表明该基准对下一代 MLLM 具有区分度。
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准如 Video-MME 上领先模型已达约 90% 准确率，传统单轮视频理解任务趋于饱和，难以评估高级 MLLM 的智能水平，因此需要更贴近真实助手场景的智能体式视频理解基准。
Method: VideoGAIA 将视频理解设计为多轮、工具增强的交互过程：模型需迭代感知视频、调用外部工具、收集补充信息，并跨轮整合多模态证据。基准包含 271 个人机协同设计的复杂真实世界任务，所有视频-问题-答案实例均由三位人类专家独立验证以确保正确性和难度。
Result: 在 VideoGAIA 上，包括 GPT-5.5 和 Kimi-K3 在内的所有被评估 MLLM 准确率均低于 60%，而现有模型在 Video-MME 上已达约 90% 准确率，说明该基准具备较高难度和时效性。
Conclusion: 作者希望 VideoGAIA 能推动视频理解从传统模式向智能体式理解转变，并强调其作为评估下一代 MLLM 的高质量基准价值。

papers.title: Local Gains and Fixed-Assignment Set Losses in Shared Set Decoders
papers.abstract_en: A query-relation deletion can improve the edited slot while reducing the utility of the prediction set that contains it. We study this tension in two related ResNet-50 DETR-family checkpoints using recorded, selection-conditional evidence from 710 paired image-relation units per checkpoint. The primary comparison subtracts a matched active control, which deletes the same leader source at a different recorded recipient, from the selected target deletion. It is therefore a composite contrast rather than a same-recipient placebo. The target-minus-control contrast is locally positive and fixed-assignment negative in both checkpoints. The opposite-sign pattern occurs within 302/710 DETR units and 460/710 DINO units. After rematching, the corresponding counts are 285/710 and 433/710. Rematching and native selection absorb enough of the mean loss for DETR intervals to cross zero, whereas DINO intervals remain negative, so persistence across readouts differs by checkpoint. A fixed-map comparison between hard deletion and a mass-preserving edit also differs before rematching. That comparison is conditional on the outcome-blind map and does not establish same-dose transport. Local intervention success therefore does not determine the consequence for a jointly decoded set. The supported conclusion is selection-conditional deletion sensitivity whose persistence depends on the readout and intervention operator. We do not identify an intervention-invariant edge mechanism, detector-level degradation, population prevalence, or the value of a training-time regularizer.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. An ancillary analysis-ready package supports exact aggregate reproduction without model inference. Code and reproduction package: https://github.com/yqjyzzz/query-interaction-reproduction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 DETR 系列共享集合解码器中查询关联删除（query-relation deletion）的张力：局部提升被编辑槽位的同时可能降低包含该槽位的预测集合整体效用。作者基于两个 ResNet-50 DETR 家族检查点中 710 对图像-关系单元的 recorded、selection-conditional 证据，使用匹配的主动对照做复合对比，发现目标减对照对比在局部为正、固定分配下为负。DETR 与 DINO 中相反符号模式的比例不同，rematching 后 DETR 区间跨零而 DINO 仍为负，说明这种删除敏感性的持久性依赖于读出方式与干预算子。
Motivation: 共享集合解码器中，针对单个查询的干预可能带来局部收益却损害整体集合预测效用，而现有评估未充分区分局部效应与固定分配下的集合效应。本文旨在用选择条件化的成对证据检验这一张力是否在不同检查点中稳健存在。
Method: 使用两个 ResNet-50 DETR 家族检查点（DETR 与 DINO）的 recorded、selection-conditional 数据，每个检查点含 710 对图像-关系单元。主要对比从目标删除中减去匹配的主动对照，即删除同一 leader source 但在不同 recorded recipient 的对照，构成复合对比；此外进行 rematching 以及固定映射下硬删除与质量保持编辑（mass-preserving edit）的比较。
Result: 目标减对照对比在两个检查点中局部为正、固定分配为负；相反符号模式出现在 DETR 的 302/710 与 DINO 的 460/710 单元中，rematching 后分别为 285/710 与 433/710。DETR 的区间在 rematching 后跨零，而 DINO 区间仍为负；固定映射比较在 rematching 前也存在差异。
Conclusion: 支持的结论是选择条件化的删除敏感性（selection-conditional deletion sensitivity），其持久性取决于读出方式与干预算子。作者明确指出未识别出干预不变的边机制、检测器级退化、总体流行率或训练时正则化器的价值，并强调局部干预成功不能决定联合解码集合的后果。

papers.title: Koopman early warning signals for bifurcation and rate-induced tipping
papers.abstract_en: Abrupt transitions in complex systems are often preceded by early warning signals. However, most indicators rely on the notion of critical slowing down and do not generally extend to rate-induced tipping where transitions can occur without local loss of stability. This is problematic in stochastic, nonautonomous systems where internal variability and time-varying variables interact to shape tipping onset. We use Koopman operator theory to develop a unified early warning framework for both bifurcation and rate-induced tipping in stochastic systems. Our approach builds on residual Koopman mode decomposition that measures discrepancies between dynamics and their finite-dimensional approximation, and extends it to the control setting by augmenting the observable space with time-varying control variables. In idealized examples, the resulting indicators recover expected signatures near bifurcation points and improve detection in rate-induced regimes where classical indicators fail. We further show that learned embeddings through deep learning outperform prescribed dictionaries, especially in a high-dimensional setting. Applied to simulations of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation, our Koopman-based indicators distinguish tipping from non-tipping trajectories and reveal interpretable spectral signatures prior to critical transition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用Koopman算子理论提出一个统一的早期预警框架，同时涵盖随机系统中的分岔型突变与速率诱导翻转 (rate-induced tipping)。方法基于残差Koopman模态分解，并将可观测空间扩充时间变化的控制变量以适配控制场景。在理想化例子和AMOC模拟中，该指标能恢复分岔点附近的预期信号，并在经典指标失效的速率诱导区间改善检测，还能区分翻转与非翻转轨迹。
Motivation: 现有早期预警信号大多依赖临界减速 (critical slowing down)，无法推广到速率诱导翻转这类不伴随局部稳定性丧失的突变。在随机、非自治系统中，内部变率与时间变化变量的相互作用使翻转 onset 难以刻画，需要新的统一框架。
Method: 基于Koopman算子理论构建统一预警框架，使用残差Koopman模态分解度量动力学与其有限维近似之间的差异，并通过向可观测空间加入时变控制变量将其扩展到控制设定。另外，作者使用深度学习学习嵌入，以替代预设字典。
Result: 在理想化例子中，该指标在分岔点附近恢复预期信号，并在经典指标失效的速率诱导区间提升检测能力。深度学习嵌入在高维场景下优于预设字典；在AMOC模拟中，Koopman指标能区分翻转与非翻转轨迹，并揭示临界转变前的可解释谱特征。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架统一了分岔型与速率诱导型突变的早期预警，并提供了可解释的谱特征。摘要未明确讨论方法的适用范围或局限。

papers.title: SpotlessGS: Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting under Dynamic Illumination for Robotic Perception
papers.abstract_en: Robots operating in dark or poorly lit environments rely on onboard lights, which often produce uneven illumination that degrades downstream perception tasks. Prior approaches based on 2D image enhancement lack reliable supervision and fail to preserve multi-view geometric consistency. To address these limitations, we extend Dark Gaussian Splatting (DarkGS) toward a more accurate and flexible relightable 3D reconstruction framework. First, we eliminate the need for explicit light parameter calibration by jointly optimizing lighting parameters within the Gaussian Splatting framework. Second, we introduce a low-frequency illumination model based on spherical harmonics (SH) to capture spatially varying residual and ambient lighting effects. Third, we incorporate an MLP-based Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF) to model non-Lambertian reflectance. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates illumination artifacts while improving rendering quality and quantitative performance over prior approaches. We further validate its benefits for robotic perception through a downstream task.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpotlessGS，面向机器人感知的可在动态光照下重照明的 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架。该方法在 DarkGS 基础上，将光照参数与高斯溅射联合优化以避免显式光校准，用球谐函数 (SH) 建模低频空间变化残差与环境光，并用 MLP 的 BRDF 建模非朗伯反射。实验表明其在合成与真实数据集上减少照明伪影并提升渲染质量。
Motivation: 在黑暗或弱光环境中，机器人依赖机载光源，但光照不均匀会降低下游感知性能。先前的 2D 图像增强方法缺乏可靠监督且不能保持多视图几何一致性。
Method: 扩展 Dark Gaussian Splatting (DarkGS)：联合优化光照参数与 Gaussian Splatting 参数，免去显式光校准；用基于球谐函数 (SH) 的低频光照模型刻画空间变化的残差和环境光；引入 MLP 实现的 BRDF 以建模非朗伯反射。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法能有效缓解照明伪影，并在渲染质量和定量指标上优于先前方法；还通过一个下游机器人感知任务验证了其效益。
Conclusion: 该工作强调无需显式光校准的联合优化、SH 光照建模和 MLP-BRDF 相结合，可提升弱光环境下可重照明三维重建的准确性与灵活性，并惠及机器人感知。

papers.title: Which Question Is Your Attention Metric Answering? Attention Rows as Compositional Data
papers.abstract_en: Each row of a transformer's attention matrix is a probability distribution over tokens, and in trained models most of that probability lands on a single \emph{sink} token, usually the first. Standard tools for comparing attention rows (cosine similarity, Jensen--Shannon divergence, Shannon entropy) therefore hinge on a choice papers rarely report: keep the sink, or drop it and renormalize. This choice can reverse conclusions. On ten pretrained models from five families, 17--47% of verdicts about which of two heads is more similar flip with the convention, and the most prominent structure in a standard BERT head-clustering pipeline is an artifact of it. The reason is that one-number summaries mix two questions: how much attention the sink takes, and how the rest is divided among the content tokens. Treating rows as compositional data separates them exactly: the Aitchison distance splits orthogonally into a sink term and a content term, entropy splits by an exact identity, and the content distance is characterized by invariances the transformer itself possesses. The separation matters in practice: most measured entropy collapse during training is the sink growing, not attention sharpening (30% of the drop at 70M parameters, 95% at 1B, 79% at 1.4B), and pruning heads with the wrong channel can inflate perplexity more than a hundredfold. We map where each convention is safe, test a frozen out-of-sample predictor (one confirmation, one abstention, one failure), and release code regenerating every number.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出 transformer 注意力矩阵每一行是 token 上的概率分布，训练后大部分概率集中在单个 sink token（通常是第一个 token）。常用的注意力行比较工具（余弦相似度、Jensen-Shannon 散度、Shannon 熵）依赖一个很少被报告的约定：保留 sink 还是去掉后重新归一化，而这一选择可以反转结论。作者将注意力行视为成分数据 (compositional data)，用 Aitchison 距离与熵的精确恒等式把 sink 项和内容项正交分离，并显示许多熵塌缩与剪枝效应实际上是 sink 增长造成的。
Motivation: 标准注意力行比较指标对是否保留 sink token 的约定极其敏感：在五个系列的 10 个预训练模型上，17–47% 的“两个头哪个更相似”判定会随约定翻转，标准 BERT 头聚类中最显著的结构也是该约定的伪影。原因在于单数摘要混合了“sink 占多少”与“剩余概率如何在内容 token 间分配”这两个不同问题。
Method: 将注意力行建模为成分数据，利用 Aitchison 距离将行间距离正交分解为 sink 项和内容项，熵则通过精确恒等式进行分解；内容距离由 transformer 本身具有的不变性来刻画。作者还绘制了每种约定在何种情况下安全的图谱，并测试了一个冻结的样本外预测器 (frozen out-of-sample predictor)。
Result: 在五个系列的 10 个预训练模型上，17–47% 的头部相似性判定会随 sink 约定翻转；训练中观测到的大部分熵下降来自 sink 增长而非注意力锐化（70M 参数时占该下降的 30%，1B 时占 95%，1.4B 时占 79%）；用错误的剪枝通道可能使困惑度 (perplexity) 膨胀超过百倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调应当把注意力行当作成分数据，分离 sink 效应与内容效应，否则许多关于注意力行为的结论可能是约定伪影；作者已发布可复现所有数字的代码。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Beyond Pass@k: Measuring Reliability and Security of Agentic Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agent benchmarks rank agents with the Chen et al. (2021) pass@k estimator, but current implementations misapply it: they set n to the number of unit tests in a single submission rather than the number of independent rollout attempts, conflating test-suite size with attempt independence. We diagnose this operationalization error, prove it by counterexample, and propose reliability@k, the same estimator applied correctly, with n = independent rollouts and c = fully-passing rollouts per (task, agent) pair. In a synthetic multi-rollout benchmark, the misapplied metric inflates reported scores by 0.85-0.97 in absolute terms (0.96-0.98 reported vs. 0.00-0.12 corrected), and a cheap single-rollout proxy fails to substitute for repeated runs (Spearman $ρ= 0.417$). Motivated by evidence that functional correctness does not imply security safety, we additionally propose security-adjusted reliability@k, which counts only rollouts that are both functionally correct and free of high-severity insecure patterns. In an initial live-API test with three agents, the adjustment did not change any ranking under our current scanner and threshold, so we present it as a proposed complementary lens whose decisive evaluation requires better-powered future runs. Finally, a preliminary 5-task SWE-bench Verified pilot observes the same core concern in a real repository setting: macro-averaged hidden-test pass rate was 0.80 while strict task resolution was 0.20.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出 AI 编码智能体基准常用的 Chen et al. (2021) pass@k 估计器被误用：实现将 n 设为单个提交中单元测试的数量而非独立 rollout 次数，混淆了测试套件规模与尝试独立性。作者通过反例证明该操作化错误，并提出 reliability@k，即 n=独立 rollout、c=完全通过 rollout 的正确估计器。合成多 rollout 基准显示误用指标使报告分数绝对抬高 0.85–0.97（报告 0.96–0.98 vs 修正 0.00–0.12），单 rollout 代理无法替代重复运行（Spearman ρ=0.417）；论文还提出仅统计功能正确且无高危不安全模式的安全调整版 reliability@k。
Motivation: 现有编码智能体基准依赖 pass@k 排名，但当前实现错误地把单元测试数当作独立尝试次数，导致分数系统性地虚高；同时功能正确性并不等于安全性，需要同时考虑安全维度。
Method: 诊断并证明 pass@k 在智能体评估中的操作化错误，提出按正确语义定义的 reliability@k；进一步提出 security-adjusted reliability@k，只统计功能正确且不含高危不安全模式的 rollout，并在 live-API 与 SWE-bench Verified 上做初步验证。
Result: 合成多 rollout 基准中，误用指标使绝对分数虚高 0.85–0.97；单 rollout 代理与重复运行结果的 Spearman ρ=0.417。三个 agent 的 live-API 测试中安全调整在当前扫描器和阈值下未改变排名；5 任务 SWE-bench Verified 试点中宏平均隐藏测试通过率为 0.80，而严格任务解决率仅 0.20。
Conclusion: 作者将 reliability@k 定位为修正后的核心评估口径，把安全调整视为需要更强统计功效的补充视角，并强调当前试点样本量不足以做决定性判断。

papers.title: Path2ST: Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Grounded Cross-Modal Translation for Spatial Transcriptomics
papers.abstract_en: Predicting spatial gene expression from hematoxylin and eosin (H\&E)-stained images offers a cost-effective alternative to spatial transcriptomics (ST). However, existing methods treat H\&E images as generic visual inputs and ignore their intrinsic biological hierarchy, where spatially organized cell types collectively form functional tissue microenvironments that govern local gene expression programs. To bridge this gap, we formulate H\&E-to-ST prediction as a cross-modal semantic translation task and propose Path2ST, a hierarchically grounded autoregressive framework featuring three key components: (i) a Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Conditioning mechanism that fuses explicit and implicit cellular features with tissue-level semantic representations to construct hierarchical conditioning signals; (ii) a Scale-Adaptive Autoregressive Generation process over a hierarchical semantic vocabulary, enabling coarse-to-fine, biologically consistent expression synthesis; and (iii) SpectraLoss, a full-spectrum objective that jointly enforces ordinal fidelity, models transcriptional bursts, and aligns semantic structures with cell types. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, validating that Path2ST generates highly accurate and spatially coherent transcriptomic profiles. The related code is released at https://github.com/RuochenLiu23/Path2ST.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Path2ST，一个将 H&E 染色图像翻译为空间基因表达的分层自回归框架，把该任务建模为跨模态语义翻译。方法包含层次化细胞-组织条件机制、尺度自适应自回归生成过程以及全频谱损失 SpectraLoss，在三个数据集上取得最优性能。
Motivation: 现有 H&E-to-ST 预测方法把 H&E 图像当作通用视觉输入，忽略了其内在生物学层次结构，即空间组织的细胞类型共同构成功能组织微环境并调控局部基因表达程序。
Method: 提出 Path2ST，包含三个组件：(i) 层次化细胞-组织条件机制，融合显式与隐式细胞特征及组织级语义表示；(ii) 在层次化语义词汇表上进行尺度自适应自回归生成，实现从粗到细、生物学一致的表达合成；(iii) SpectraLoss 全频谱目标，联合约束序数保真、建模转录爆发并对齐语义结构与细胞类型。
Result: 在三个数据集上的大量实验表明，Path2ST 达到最优性能，生成高度准确且空间连贯的转录组图谱。
Conclusion: 作者认为考虑生物学层次结构的跨模态语义翻译能够提升空间转录组学预测的准确性与空间一致性，并已发布代码。

papers.title: Hardware-in-the-Loop Phase-Aware CNN for Real-Time 5G Channel Estimation
papers.abstract_en: This demo presents real-time AI-based uplink channel-estimation inference using data collected from a hardware-in-the-loop 5G platform. The data-collection setup integrates commercial RF signal generation, programmable channel emulation, an O-RAN Radio Unit, DU emulation, and a lightweight phase-aware convolutional neural network (CNN) that estimates the channel response directly from received DMRS signals. Unlike simulation-only evaluations, the hardware-derived dataset exposes the estimator to practical RF and system-level impairments, including calibration mismatches, synchronization imperfections, quantization effects, phase noise, and implementation-specific nonlinearities. During the demo, attendees will observe real-time CNN inference and channel reconstruction using captured hardware-generated DMRS observations and compare the proposed CNN against Least Squares (LS) and frequency-domain LMMSE baselines. The objective is to showcase a practical AI-native physical-layer inference pipeline that combines hardware-derived 5G data with real-time neural channel estimation for future 5G-Advanced and 6G systems.

papers.title: PE-CSNet: An equivariant network architecture with learnable patch-based sparse representation
papers.abstract_en: Compressive sensing (CS) enables accurate signal reconstruction from sparse measurements and is widely applied in medical imaging, remote sensing, and image compression. However, designing an effective, task-specific sparse transform and the corresponding optimization procedure for high-quality CS remains challenging. This process typically requires expert domain knowledge and laborious parameter tuning. To address this issue, we present a Patch-based Equivariant deep unrolling architecture, termed PE-CSNet, for accurate CS recovery. While traditional CS methods generally use predefined patch-based transform sparsity, we generalize this idea by incorporating learnable transform sparsity that adapts to the specific CS task through an optimization-driven process. Specifically, we first establish a generalized patch-based CS model, which we solve via a block coordinate descent (BCD) algorithm. The BCD solver is then unrolled into a deep neural network, where all parameters of both the CS model and solver are learned through end-to-end training. To improve data efficiency, we introduce a stochastic equivariant training strategy that exploits the patch-wise structure of the network, enabling PE-CSNet to learn effectively even from limited data. We further provide a simpler, parameter-shared version of PE-CSNet and briefly discuss its convergence as an iterative solver. For practical applications, the network uses stage-specific (non-shared) parameters to enhance its expressive power and thereby improve its performance. On the tasks of CS magnetic resonance imaging (CS-MRI) and CS coded diffraction patterns (CS-CDP), PE-CSNet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with fast computational speed, outperforming traditional methods and existing deep unrolling methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PE-CSNet，一种基于 patch 的等变深度展开网络用于压缩感知（CS）重建。它将广义 patch 基 CS 模型用块坐标下降（BCD）算法求解，并将求解器展开为可端到端训练的深度网络，引入随机等变训练策略以提升小样本数据效率。作者还给出参数共享的简化版本并讨论其收敛性，而实际使用非共享的 stage-specific 参数以增强表达能力。在 CS-MRI 和 CS-CDP 任务上，PE-CSNet 达到 state-of-the-art 精度且计算速度快。
Motivation: 传统压缩感知方法依赖人工设计的稀疏变换和对应的优化过程，需要领域知识与大量参数调优，难以针对具体任务获得高质量重建。
Method: 建立广义 patch 基 CS 模型并用块坐标下降（BCD）算法求解，再将 BCD 求解器展开为深度神经网络，使模型与求解器参数通过端到端训练学习。利用网络的 patch 结构设计随机等变训练策略以提高数据效率，并提供参数共享的简化版本以及使用非共享 stage-specific 参数的完整版本。
Result: 在 CS 磁共振成像（CS-MRI）和 CS 编码衍射图样（CS-CDP）任务上，PE-CSNet 以较快的计算速度取得 state-of-the-art 精度，优于传统方法和现有深度展开方法。
Conclusion: 摘要表明可学习的 patch 基稀疏变换配合等变深度展开能够在 CS 重建任务上兼顾精度与速度；参数共享版本作为迭代求解器的收敛性也被简要讨论。

papers.title: Semantic Uncertainty-Guided Orchestration in Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: As large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems become increasingly capable, coordinating agents under uncertainty becomes a fundamental challenge. Existing orchestration strategies typically rely on fixed interaction patterns and often lack mechanisms for assessing the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps, allowing errors and hallucinations to propagate through the system. This paper introduces a semantic-uncertainty-guided orchestration approach, HASSUM as a general framework for uncertainty-aware coordination in multi-agent systems. The method estimates uncertainty using semantic entropy and semantic density, which measure trust at the level of answer semantics rather than output probabilities. These signals enable adaptive orchestration decisions, including output verification, selective reprompting, additional deliberation, and confidence-aware response selection. Because the approach operates independently of any particular agent architecture, it can be integrated into a broad range of hierarchical and collaborative multi-agent systems. The evaluations demonstrate an implementation within a hierarchical agent framework and evaluate it on StrategyQA, JailbreakBench, and TruthfulQA benchmarks. Across tasks that require complex reasoning and are prone to ambiguity or hallucinations, uncertainty-guided orchestration yields more reliable outcomes than uncertainty-unaware coordination. Semantic entropy and semantic density in tandem outperformed either metric alone. Ablations testing different thresholds and model sizes demonstrated that both influence the effectiveness of semantic metrics. The results suggest that semantic uncertainty is a practical and general-purpose signal for improving robustness and trustworthiness in agentic AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HASSUM，一种基于语义不确定性引导的通用多智能体协调框架。该方法用语义熵 (semantic entropy) 和语义密度 (semantic density) 在答案语义层面估计信任度，并据此做出自适应编排决策，如输出验证、选择性重提示、额外深思和置信度感知的响应选择。在 StrategyQA、JailbreakBench 和 TruthfulQA 上的层级智能体实现评估显示，与不考虑不确定性的协调相比，该方法在复杂推理与易产生幻觉的任务上更可靠。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的多智能体编排策略通常依赖固定交互模式，缺少评估中间推理步骤可靠性的机制，导致错误和幻觉在系统中传播。
Method: 提出语义不确定性引导的编排方法 HASSUM，用语义熵和语义密度估计答案层面的信任度，并基于这些信号做出输出验证、选择性重提示、额外深思和置信度感知响应选择等自适应决策；该方法与具体智能体架构无关。
Result: 在层级智能体框架中于 StrategyQA、JailbreakBench 和 TruthfulQA 上评估，不确定性引导协调比不确定无知协调更可靠；语义熵与语义密度联合使用优于单独使用任一指标；阈值和模型规模的消融均会影响语义指标的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为语义不确定性是提升智能体 AI 系统鲁棒性和可信度的实用且通用的信号。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Equilibrium Forcing: Adaptive Video Generation Without Noise Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Standard autoregressive video generation algorithms based on Diffusion and Flow Matching rely on rigid training objectives and static sampling schedules, limiting inference procedures from adapting to the data. We introduce Equilibrium Forcing (EqF), a simplified framework for video denoising generative models without noise level conditioning. EqF pioneers modular training- and inference-time designs for noise-unconditional generation that decouple learning the denoising field from sampling. This flexibility allows for inference-time algorithms that operate in a closed loop by adapting to feedback from the sample, improving video quality and consistency on challenging autoregressive video generation benchmarks. Extensive analysis elucidates exactly how removing the noise level conditioning enables EqF's data-dependent inference properties to surpass the performance of standard noise level-conditional denoising video methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Equilibrium Forcing (EqF)，一个不依赖噪声水平条件 (noise level conditioning) 的视频去噪生成模型框架。EqF 将学习去噪场 (denoising field) 与采样过程解耦，支持闭环的推理时算法，根据样本反馈自适应调整。在自回归视频生成基准上，EqF 提升了视频质量和一致性，并超过标准的噪声水平条件去噪视频方法。
Motivation: 基于 Diffusion 和 Flow Matching 的标准自回归视频生成依赖固定训练目标和静态采样调度，限制了推理过程对数据的自适应能力。
Method: EqF 去掉噪声水平条件，通过模块化的训练和推理设计把去噪场学习与采样解耦；推理时算法可以闭环运行，根据来自样本的反馈进行自适应。
Result: 摘要报告 EqF 在具有挑战性的自回归视频生成基准上提升视频质量和一致性，并说明去除噪声水平条件使 EqF 的数据依赖推理性质优于标准噪声水平条件去噪视频方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调去除噪声水平条件这一设计使推理具备数据依赖特性，从而超越传统条件去噪方法；该框架为噪声无条件的视频生成提供了模块化训练与推理设计思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On Cross-Validation for Hyperparameter Optimization of Deep Learning Image Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) can materially affect the performance of deep learning (DL) image classifiers, but there is little empirical guidance on how to derive the validation signal that drives it, especially for the small sample sizes common in fields such as medical imaging. We compared three HPO protocols in terms of {\em absolute performance-estimation error} (AEE; the absolute difference between the winning configuration's validation AUROC and its test AUROC): fixed holdout (F), reshuffled holdout (R), and 5-fold cross-validation (C). The search space, sampler, training procedure, architecture, and test set were held identical across protocols. We evaluated the protocols on three public datasets spanning two regimes: binary medical imaging (RSNA pneumonia radiographs and binarized HAM10000 skin lesions) and 200-class natural imaging (Tiny ImageNet), across a range of development set sizes $n$ and two backbones (ResNet-18 on all datasets, Vision Transformer (ViT-S/16) on RSNA). On the medical datasets, every point estimate favored cross-validation over both holdout protocols, with reductions in AEE largest at small sample sizes and diminishing as $n$ increased. This pattern remained robust under conservative family-wise adjustment. On Tiny ImageNet, AEE was negligible under all three protocols. Test AUROC was generally similar among protocols. Fixed holdout had lower mean AEE than reshuffled holdout in 11 of 12 medical conditions, although this secondary finding was less uniformly supported. For small-sample medical image classification, we recommend cross-validation-based HPO when computational resources permit because it trades additional computation for a more reliable development-time estimate of subsequent test performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度学习图像分类器的超参数优化（HPO），比较了三种验证信号获取协议：固定留出法（F）、重排留出法（R）和5折交叉验证（C），以绝对性能估计误差（AEE，即胜出配置的验证AUROC与测试AUROC之差的绝对值）为指标。在三个公开数据集（RSNA肺炎胸片、二值化HAM10000皮肤病变、Tiny ImageNet）上，保持搜索空间、采样器、训练流程、架构和测试集一致，覆盖不同开发集大小n和两种骨干网络，发现医学影像小样本场景下交叉验证的AEE最低，且在小样本时收益最大。
Motivation: 超参数优化对深度学习图像分类器性能影响显著，但关于如何构造驱动HPO的验证信号缺少经验性指导，尤其缺乏医学影像等常见小样本场景下的系统比较。
Method: 设计了受控比较实验，在搜索空间、采样器、训练流程、架构和测试集完全一致的条件下，对比固定留出、重排留出和5折交叉验证三种HPO协议；数据集涵盖二元医学影像分类（RSNA肺炎和HAM10000）与200类自然图像分类（Tiny ImageNet），并使用ResNet-18及ViT-S/16两种骨干。
Result: 在医学数据集上，所有点估计均显示交叉验证优于两种留出协议，AEE的降低在小样本规模时最大，并随n增大而缩小；该模式在保守的族-wise校正下依然稳健。Tiny ImageNet上三种协议的AEE均可忽略，测试AUROC在各协议间总体相近。次要发现是固定留出在12个医学条件中的11个上平均AEE低于重排留出，但支持证据较弱。
Conclusion: 作者建议在计算资源允许时，对小样本医学图像分类采用基于交叉验证的HPO，因为其以额外计算换取对后续测试性能更可靠的开发期估计。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 在医学数据集上，所有点估计均显示交叉验证优于两种留出协议，AEE的降低在小样本规模时最大，并随n增大而缩小；该模式在保守的族-wise校正下依然稳健。Tiny ImageNet上三种协议的AEE均可忽略，测试AUROC在各协议间总体相近。次要发现是固定留出在12个医学条件中的11个上平均AEE低于重排留出，但支持证据较弱。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者建议在计算资源允许时，对小样本医学图像分类采用基于交叉验证的HPO，因为其以额外计算换取对后续测试性能更可靠的开发期估计。

papers.title: Deep Analog: Open-Set Film Emulation with Reference-Conditioned 3D LUTs
papers.abstract_en: Film emulation reproduces the look of an analog film stock on a new digital photograph. We target its open-set form -- matching any reference film frame from a single example -- with a 3D lookup table (LUT) predicted from that reference. Real-time image enhancement predicts per-image weights over a fixed bank of 3D LUTs and blends them. We show this is a gated mixture of experts and inherits its failure: trained end-to-end against reconstruction, the gate collapses onto a single expert, so a bank of K LUTs delivers the capacity of one. An entropy term, the enhancement-setting analogue of mixture-of-experts load balancing, restores utilization and recovers about 1 dB PSNR. The deeper constraint survives: a fixed LUT basis is closed-set, freezing the achievable looks at training time. We therefore discard the basis and predict a single 3D LUT as a residual from a reference image (StyleLUTNet), trained by self-supervision on procedurally generated color transforms. The conditional design removes the gate and generalizes open-set to unseen film stocks without paired data or retraining. Around this color backbone we build Deep Analog, a film-emulation pipeline that adds histogram-based tone matching and a physics-informed optical renderer -- multi-scale grain and per-channel halation driven by parameters an inverse network regresses from the reference. On 350 self-supervised pairs the color stage reaches 22.05 dB PSNR / 0.925 SSIM and the full pipeline 21.72 dB / 0.923; the color path runs in 5.2 ms at 1080p (192 FPS) and exports a portable .cube LUT for standard editing tools. A second degeneracy in conditional LUT training -- residual-scale collapse -- shares the root cause and yields a general principle: auxiliary regularization must stay subordinate to reconstruction.
papers.comment: Master's thesis, Rochester Institute of Technology, 2026. 24 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Code and demo: https://github.com/EtonMu/deep-analog
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对"开放集胶片模拟"(open-set film emulation)任务，即仅凭一张参考胶片画面匹配任意胶片风格，提出从参考图像预测单个 3D LUT 的 StyleLUTNet。作者先指出固定 LUT 库上的逐图加权本质上是被门控混合专家 (gated mixture of experts)，端到端训练会令门控坍缩到单一专家，加入熵项后恢复利用并提升约 1 dB PSNR；但固定基底的表达空间仍受限于训练时见过的风格。为此他们丢弃基底，改为从参考图回归残差式 3D LUT，并用程序化颜色变换自监督训练，从而无需配对数据即可泛化到未见胶片。基于该颜色主干构建的 Deep Analog 流水线还加入直方图色调匹配与物理启发的光学渲染器（多尺度颗粒与逐通道光晕），整体在 1080p 下以 5.2 ms 运行并可导出 .cube LUT。
Motivation: 现有基于固定 3D LUT 库的实时增强方法本质上是门控混合专家，端到端重建训练会让门控坍缩到单个专家，导致 K 个 LUT 只提供单专家容量；更深层的问题是固定 LUT 基底属于闭集，冻结了训练时可获得的风格范围，无法真正匹配任意参考胶片。
Method: 提出 StyleLUTNet，直接从参考图像预测一个 3D LUT 作为残差，训练采用程序化生成颜色变换的自监督方式，去掉门控并实现开集泛化；在其上构建 Deep Analog 流水线，加入直方图色调匹配以及由逆网络从参考图回归参数的多尺度颗粒、逐通道光晕等物理启发式光学渲染。
Result: 在 350 对自监督测试对上，颜色阶段达到 22.05 dB PSNR / 0.925 SSIM，完整流水线为 21.72 dB / 0.923；颜色路径在 1080p 下耗时 5.2 ms（约 192 FPS），并导出可移植的 .cube LUT。摘要还声称门控坍缩的熵正则恢复约 1 dB PSNR。
Conclusion: 作者指出条件式 LUT 训练中的另一种退化——残差尺度坍缩——与门控坍缩共享根因，并给出一般性原则：辅助正则必须从属于重建目标；该条件式残差设计能零训练地泛化到未见胶片风格。

papers.title: Periocular Soft Biometrics: A Survey and Applications to Multimedia Forensics and Disinformation Detection
papers.abstract_en: Soft-biometric attributes such as gender, age, and ethnicity provide valuable ancillary evidence when full identity recognition is not feasible, supporting applications in forensic investigation, identity verification, surveillance, or detection of synthetic and manipulated media. Among biometric modalities, the periocular region is a robust source of soft-biometric cues, as it often remains visible when other parts of the face are occluded, a frequent condition in forensic evidence and surveillance footage, and can be captured across a wide range of acquisition conditions. In this paper, we provide a survey of demographic attribute estimation from periocular images, covering publicly available datasets, methodological trends from handcrafted descriptors to deep learning architectures, and the state of the art in gender, age, and ethnicity prediction. We discuss use cases relevant to multimedia forensics and disinformation-detection applications, including demographic filtering in surveillance footage, age verification, and the detection of demographic inconsistencies in synthetic data. We also highlight open challenges, including dataset bias, cross-domain generalisation, fairness, ethical aspects, and the lack of forensic-oriented benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at ECCV 2026 Workshop on AI for Multimedia Forensics & Disinformation Detection (AI4MFDD2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了眼周区域（periocular）软生物特征，特别是从眼周图像估计性别、年龄和种族等人口统计属性的研究。摘要覆盖公开数据集、从手工特征到深度学习架构的方法趋势，以及性别/年龄/种族预测的当前技术水平，并讨论其在多媒体取证和虚假信息检测中的应用。文章还指出数据集偏差、跨域泛化、公平性和伦理性等开放挑战。
Motivation: 当完整身份识别不可行时，软生物特征（如性别、年龄、种族）提供有价值的辅助证据，可支撑取证调查、身份验证、监控以及合成与篡改媒体检测；眼周区域在面部其他部分被遮挡时仍常可见，且能在多种采集条件下获取，因此是可靠的软生物特征来源。
Method: 作为调查研究，系统梳理了基于眼周图像的人口统计属性估计，包括公开可用的数据集、从手工描述符到深度学习架构的方法演进，以及性别、年龄和种族预测的现状，并讨论了与多媒体取证和虚假信息检测相关的用例。
Result: 摘要给出了该领域的现状总结（gender/age/ethnicity 预测的技术水平），但未报告具体的量化实验数值；重点在于数据集、方法趋势和应用场景的归纳。
Conclusion: 作者强调眼周软生物特征在监控场景人口统计过滤、年龄验证以及合成数据人口统计不一致检测等方面的潜力，并指出开放挑战包括数据集偏差、跨域泛化、公平性、伦理问题以及缺乏面向取证的基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Xemo-Talker: Unlock Emotions Explicitly for Audio-Driven Talking Portrait Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Precise emotion control in audio-driven talking heads remains a challenge due to the reliance on implicit emotion regulation in existing systems, which often leads to indirect and insufficient control. Additionally, training with explicit emotion-related losses across the entire motion space poses significant difficulties due to the inherent trade-off between accurate lip synchronization and fine-grained emotion control. In this paper, we reveal a key finding: although emotional cues are distributed throughout the motion space, concentrating discriminative supervision on less-principal components achieves a better emotion-lip synchronization balance, as principal components mainly encode high-energy articulation and pose variations. Building on this insight, we propose Xemo-Talker, which first learns a neutral speech-to-motion mapping for stable articulation and lip synchronization, and then introduces a lightweight emotion branch guided by less-principal subspace supervision. To enhance emotion control, we design a Tri-Loss consisting of inter-class separation, intra-class compactness, and less-principal contrastive learning. Given an audio input, a reference image, and an emotion label, Xemo-Talker achieves state-of-the-art emotion classification accuracy while maintaining competitive lip synchronization and high inference efficiency, with performance approaching that measured on real videos.The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/chaolongy/Xemo-Talker.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出音频驱动的说话人肖像合成模型 Xemo-Talker，针对现有系统仅靠隐式情绪调控导致情绪控制不精确的问题，显式建模情绪。核心发现是情绪线索分布于整个运动空间，但对非主成分（less-principal components）施加判别性监督能在情绪与唇形同步之间取得更好平衡。模型先学习中性语音到动作映射以稳定口型，再引入由非主成分子空间监督引导的轻量情绪分支，并设计 Tri-Loss 增强情绪控制。摘要报告其在情绪分类准确率上达到最先进水平，同时保持有竞争力的唇形同步和高推理效率。
Motivation: 现有音频驱动说话人模型的情绪控制依赖隐式情绪调节，导致控制间接且不充分；而在整个运动空间上使用显式情绪损失又会在精确唇形同步与细粒度情绪控制之间存在固有权衡。
Method: 提出 Xemo-Talker：先学习中性的语音到动作映射以稳定发音和唇形同步，再引入由非主成分子空间监督引导的轻量情绪分支；情绪控制通过 Tri-Loss 实现，包含类间分离（inter-class separation）、类内紧凑（intra-class compactness）和非主成分对比学习（less-principal contrastive learning）。输入为音频、参考图像和情绪标签。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在情绪分类准确率上达到最先进水平，同时保持有竞争力的唇形同步和高推理效率，性能接近在真实视频上测得的结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调将判别性监督集中在非主成分上可更好地平衡情绪表达与唇形同步，并公开了源代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Low-Cost IoT Device for Environmental Monitoring and Embedded Solar Forecasting with On-Device Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Hyperlocal meteorological sensing is essential for accurate solar photovoltaic forecasting, yet professional-grade meteorological stations require investments easily exceeding 1000~USD per node, making distributed deployments economically inaccessible. This work presents a modular internet of things (IoT) device based on the ESP32 microcontroller integrating temperature, humidity, luminosity, and solar irradiance sensors in an IP68-rated enclosure at a total hardware costs of about \$65~USD when components are sourced in Germany. A hybrid architecture decouples external model training, performed on a conventional computer using the software Python and the open-source library TensorFlow, from autonomous 24-hour solar voltage forecasting executed on-device via a three-layer feedforward network with 3{,}011 parameters (11.8\,KB). The network is trained offline on site-collected data and deployed on the microcontroller as static weight matrices without cloud connectivity. An on-device incremental gradient descent mechanism enables continuous model adaptation after deployment without external retraining. The system was evaluated through two field deployments: a short period of hardware and firmware validation in Ulm, Germany, and a 115-day deployment in Zapopan, Mexico, comprising 84~days of training and 31~days of autonomous operation with zero missing records. Over a clean 28-day daytime window, the embedded model attained a coefficient of determination of 0.9165 and a mean absolute error of 0.2975~V (4.65\% of the operational range), outperforming a climatology baseline (skill score 0.64) while not surpassing a 24-hour persistence baseline. A frozen-weight ablation confirms that the on-device update mechanism yields a small but statistically robust accuracy gain ($p = 0.001$), demonstrating that autonomous incremental learning is feasible on low-cost hardware without cloud connectivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种基于ESP32的低成本物联网气象监测设备，集成温湿度、光照和太阳辐照度传感器，总硬件成本约65美元，并具备离线训练、设备端部署的太阳能电压预测能力。系统采用混合架构：外部计算机用Python/TensorFlow训练三层前馈网络（3011参数，11.8KB），部署为静态权重矩阵后通过片上增量梯度下降进行持续适应，无需云连接。两个实地部署（德国Ulm短时验证和墨西哥Zapopan 115天运行）中，干净28天日间窗口内模型决定系数0.9165，平均绝对误差0.2975V（量程的4.65%），优于气候学基线（技能得分0.64）但未超过24小时持续性基线。
Motivation: 专业级气象站单节点成本超过1000美元，使得分布式超本地气象感知在经济上不可行，而超本地感知对精确太阳能光伏预测至关重要。
Method: 提出模块化IoT设备，基于ESP32微控制器，IP68外壳，硬件成本约65美元；混合架构将外部模型训练（Python+TensorFlow）与设备端24小时太阳能电压预测解耦，预测由三层前馈网络执行，并部署片上增量梯度下降机制以在无云连接条件下持续更新模型。
Result: 在墨西哥Zapopan的115天部署中（84天训练、31天自主运行），零缺失记录；干净28天日间窗口内决定系数0.9165，MAE 0.2975V（量程4.65%），技能得分相对气候学基线为0.64，未超越24小时持续性基线；冻结权重消融显示片上更新带来微小但统计稳健的精度提升（p=0.001）。
Conclusion: 摘要表明自主增量学习在低成本硬件上无需云连接即可实现，且片上更新机制有统计显著的精度增益，尽管其幅度较小。

papers.title: Synchronized Logit Steering: Real-world Steganography
papers.abstract_en: Steganography in large language models offers a way to embed hidden messages within natural-sounding text. Existing token and logit-level methods typically require the sender and receiver to share an identical prompt context, which is rarely guaranteed in production pipelines that use retrieval-augmented generation or proprietary system instructions. We introduce Synchronized Logit Steering (SLS), a deterministic steganographic scheme that eliminates this dependency by deriving a proxy prompt from the generated output itself, allowing both parties to reconstruct the same logit distribution without access to the original prompt. SLS encodes payload values as token ranks within high-entropy regions of the proxy prompt distribution, and we extend the scheme with periodic recurrence and payload bursts to scale information density. Across ShareGPT, GSM8K, and SWE-bench Verified, we show that the KL divergence between the true and proxy prompt distributions falls below 0.5 nats once the synchronization window reaches 40 tokens, and SLS encoding does not meaningfully disrupt this convergence relative to greedy generation. We also find that the periodic-burst variant achieves 0.20 bits per token, or roughly 10x the capacity of single-payload encoding. Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests further confirm that SLS outputs are statistically difficult to distinguish from greedy generations, demonstrating that covert, prompt-agnostic communication through LLMs is both practical and stealthy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出同步 logit 引导（Synchronized Logit Steering, SLS），一种无需共享提示词上下文的确定性隐写方案。SLS 从生成输出本身推导代理提示词，使收发双方无需原始提示词即可重建相同的 logit 分布，并在高熵区域以 token 秩编码负载。实验显示同步窗口达 40 tokens 后 KL 散度低于 0.5 nats，周期突发变体达到 0.20 bits/token，约为单负载编码的 10 倍，KS 检验表明输出与贪心生成难以区分。
Motivation: 现有 token 级和 logit 级隐写方法通常要求收发双方共享完全相同的提示词上下文，但在使用检索增强生成（RAG）或专有系统指令的生产流水线中这一前提难以保证，限制了隐写方案的实用性。
Method: 提出 SLS，一种确定性隐写方案：从生成输出自身派生代理提示词（proxy prompt），从而无需访问原始提示词即可重建相同 logit 分布；负载值被编码为代理提示词分布高熵区域内的 token 秩，并引入周期性重复（periodic recurrence）和负载突发（payload bursts）以提升信息密度。
Result: 在 ShareGPT、GSM8K 和 SWE-bench Verified 上，当同步窗口达到 40 tokens 时真实与代理提示词分布间的 KL 散度降至 0.5 nats 以下，且 SLS 编码相对贪心生成不明显破坏该收敛；周期突发变体实现 0.20 bits/token，约为单负载编码容量的 10 倍；KS 检验确认 SLS 输出在统计上难以与贪心生成区分。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 SLS 展示了通过 LLM 进行隐蔽、与提示词无关（prompt-agnostic）通信的可行性和隐蔽性，是一种实用且难以察觉的隐写方法。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Survey of Wireless Foundation Models for AI-Native 6G Networks
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are emerging as a transformative paradigm for AI-native sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks by enabling scalable, transferable, and data-efficient intelligence across diverse communication tasks. Unlike conventional deep learning models that are trained for individual applications, wireless foundation models (WFMs) learn generalized representations from large-scale heterogeneous wireless data and can be efficiently adapted to communication, sensing, localization, and network optimization tasks with minimal task-specific supervision. Despite rapid progress, current research remains fragmented across architectures, training paradigms, and application domains, with no unified survey dedicated to the design, learning, and deployment of WFMs. This survey presents a comprehensive and unified review of wireless foundation models. We first establish the fundamental concepts of WFMs and introduce a taxonomy that organizes the field according to model architectures, pre-training paradigms, and applications. We then review representative architectures, self-supervised pre-training strategies, parameter-efficient adaptation methods, datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation methodologies, highlighting their roles in enabling transferable wireless intelligence. Furthermore, we examine emerging applications spanning physical-layer signal processing, network intelligence, and cross-layer optimization, and discuss the key challenges of data availability, generalization, interpretability, efficient edge deployment, and standardization. Finally, we outline future research directions toward scalable, trustworthy, and general-purpose wireless intelligence for AI-native 6G networks. This survey provides a comprehensive reference for researchers and practitioners developing next-generation intelligent wireless systems.
papers.comment: 28 Pages, submitted to IEEE Communications Surveys and Tutorials
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对无线基础模型 (wireless foundation models, WFMs) 的综合性综述，面向 AI-native 第六代 (6G) 无线网络。作者提出按模型架构、预训练范式和应用程序组织该领域的分类体系，并系统回顾代表性架构、自监督预训练策略、参数高效适配方法、数据集、基准与评估方法，同时讨论数据可用性、泛化、可解释性、边缘部署效率和标准化等挑战。论文还展望了面向 AI-native 6G 的可扩展、可信、通用无线智能的未来研究方向。
Motivation: 无线基础模型的研究在架构、训练范式和应用程序域之间仍然碎片化，缺乏一个专门针对 WFM 设计、学习和部署的统一综述，这阻碍了可迁移无线智能的系统化发展。
Method: 建立 WFM 的基本概念并提出按模型架构、预训练范式和应用程序组织的分类体系；随后综述代表性架构、自监督预训练策略、参数高效适配方法、数据集、基准和评估方法，并考察物理层信号处理、网络智能和跨层优化等新兴应用。
Result: 作为综述论文，本文不报告新的实验数值结果，而是整理并统一了现有 WFM 研究的主要技术路线、应用场景与开放挑战。
Conclusion: 作者指出 WFM 有望实现可扩展、可信且通用的无线智能，并强调未来需要解决数据可用性、泛化、可解释性、高效边缘部署和标准化等问题，以支撑 AI-native 6G 网络。

papers.title: Domain Agnostic Text Redaction from Natural Language Rules using Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: With the increasing digitization of personal and corporate communication, the automatic sanitization of textual data has become a crucial component of data privacy and compliance frameworks. Traditional text sanitization solutions are majorly suitable for obscuring sensitive data with standard structure such as Personal Identifiable Information (PII). These solutions do not provide transparent justification for their redaction, which makes it difficult to audit them. This paper introduces an explainable, domain-agnostic text redaction solution that uses natural language rules of redaction, applied via an instruction-tuned language model, to identify and redact sensitive information in unstructured documents. Unlike traditional text sanitization, this method enables a user to conveniently define any sensitive information; which may be structured (e.g.\ PII) or unstructured (e.g.\ legal terms and conditions) in natural language. A general-purpose LLM generates or augments these natural language rules of redaction from the user's definition, which are then used to instruction-fine-tune a smaller language model that reasons the rules step-by-step over any given document to identify and redact the corresponding sensitive content, while providing transparent justifications for each redaction and highlighting the specific rule that triggered the decision. This explanation is generated in natural language to support human reviewers and auditors in understanding why specific content was redacted. A reconstruction-based metric is used to estimate the probability of recovering redacted information from the sanitized document, quantifying redaction coverage. The solution shows high reconstruction error and high redaction precision, making it suitable for automated text sanitization in critical applications such as legal discovery, medical documentation, and corporate information governance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释、领域无关的文本脱敏方案，利用自然语言脱敏规则并通过指令微调（instruction tuning）语言模型来识别和涂除非结构化文档中的敏感信息。通用 LLM 根据用户定义生成或增强脱敏规则，较小的语言模型在微调后逐步推理规则，对每次脱敏给出透明理由并指明触发的规则。摘要报告该方法在高重建误差和高脱敏精度上表现良好，适合法律发现、医疗文档和企业信息治理等关键场景。
Motivation: 传统文本脱敏主要适用于具有标准结构的个人身份信息（PII），且无法为脱敏决策提供透明依据，难以审计。论文针对这一空白，希望让用户能够用自然语言灵活定义任意敏感信息，包括非结构化的法律条款等内容，并给出可审计的解释。
Method: 方法先用通用 LLM 从用户的敏感信息定义中生成或增强自然语言脱敏规则，再用这些规则对较小的语言模型进行指令微调；模型在给定文档上逐步推理规则，识别并涂除敏感内容，同时生成自然语言解释并高亮触发决策的具体规则。脱敏覆盖率通过基于重建的指标（估计从脱敏文档中恢复被涂除信息的概率）来衡量。
Result: 摘要报告该方法达到高重建误差（说明被涂除信息难以恢复）和高脱敏精度，因此适合用于法律发现、医疗文档和企业信息治理等关键应用中的自动化文本脱敏。
Conclusion: 该工作的核心结论是：结合自然语言规则与指令微调可以实现可解释、领域无关的文本脱敏，既支持结构化也支持非结构化敏感信息，并为审计者提供决策依据。摘要未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: Identifying Harm in Personalized, Generative AI Systems Requires User-Centered Auditing at the Interaction Level
papers.abstract_en: Personalized, generative AI systems increasingly adapt their behavior to individual users over time, fundamentally changing model behavior. While existing auditing approaches have been effective at surfacing harms in non-personalized contexts, they often rely on static, simulated evaluations and definitions of harm that aggregate across broad, group categories. In this position paper, we argue that such approaches can fail to capture emergent harms in personalized generative AI systems, where harms surface through interpretations of ongoing interaction and evolve with user history. We identify three presuppositions underlying many harm auditing paradigms: that harms can be (1) specified outside real-world interaction, (2) defined non-pluralistically within groups, and (3) treated as static. One might argue that personalized systems could simply learn definitions of what constitutes harm to individual users through repeated interactions. However, we argue that attempts to surface user harms through deeper personalization risk imposing asymmetric burdens of labor and privacy on marginalized users. Consequently, we propose reframing understandings of harm as adaptive, user- and community-centered processes, and outline design directions that shift auditing from retrospective evaluation toward infrastructures that support ongoing articulation of harm in interaction. Our work highlights the need for auditing and design practices that better reflect the pluralistic and evolving nature of harm understanding in personalized generative AI systems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，针对个性化生成式 AI 系统中的新兴危害提出质疑：现有审计方法依赖静态、模拟的评估和跨群体聚合的危害定义，难以捕捉随用户历史与持续互动演化而浮现的危害。作者识别出危害审计范式的三个预设，并主张将危害重新理解为适应性的、以用户和社群为中心的过程，把审计从回顾式评估转向支持互动中持续表达危害的基础设施。
Motivation: 个性化生成式 AI 会随用户互动不断调整行为，而现有审计方法在非个性化情境下有效，却可能漏掉那些通过持续互动诠释、随用户历史演化的突发危害。作者进一步指出，靠更深个性化来发现用户危害，可能会给边缘化用户带来不对称的劳动和隐私负担。
Method: 作为立场论文，作者通过论证而非实验提出观点：识别出危害审计中三个常见预设，即危害可在真实互动之外被规定、可在群体内被非多元地定义、以及可被视为静态；随后提出将危害理解为动态、用户和社群中心的过程，并勾勒从回顾式评估转向支持互动中持续危害表达的设计方向。
Result: 论文未报告实证结果；其理论贡献在于识别上述三个预设，并提出以适应性、多元的视角重构个性化生成式 AI 中的危害理解与审计实践。
Conclusion: 作者强调，审计与设计实践需要更好地反映个性化生成式 AI 中危害理解的多元性和演化性；该工作属于概念性立场陈述，未提供实验验证。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 作为立场论文，作者通过论证而非实验提出观点：识别出危害审计中三个常见预设，即危害可在真实互动之外被规定、可在群体内被非多元地定义、以及可被视为静态；随后提出将危害理解为动态、用户和社群中心的过程，并勾勒从回顾式评估转向支持互动中持续危害表达的设计方向。
summary_sections.result: 论文未报告实证结果；其理论贡献在于识别上述三个预设，并提出以适应性、多元的视角重构个性化生成式 AI 中的危害理解与审计实践。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，审计与设计实践需要更好地反映个性化生成式 AI 中危害理解的多元性和演化性；该工作属于概念性立场陈述，未提供实验验证。

papers.title: The Quantum Shortcut: Complex Phase-State Dynamics Reduce the Optimization Steps of Sequence Models
papers.abstract_en: Sequence models are conventionally distinguished by their backbone, the mechanism that routes information across positions, such as attention or recurrence. This paper varies a choice that is prior to the backbone and shared by nearly all current models: the \emph{substrate}, the number system in which the hidden state is represented together with the form of the map from state to prediction. The prevailing substrate is a real-valued state with an affine--softmax readout; we study a complex-valued alternative drawn from the mathematics of quantum theory, in which information is carried by the phases of the state and scores are quadratic Born forms. Prior work proved an idealized version of this substrate representationally stronger than any real model with a linear readout; we ask whether it also trains faster. Relaxing the two properties that block deployment, exact unitarity and the Born vocabulary readout, we instantiate it in the Mamba state-space model and an attention-based Transformer. At 253M parameters, matched to within $0.02\%$ and trained under one fixed protocol on three byte-level corpora, the complex models reach every measured validation loss in approximately one third (state-space) and one half (attention) of the optimization steps of their real counterparts. The two backbones then diverge. Once the learning-rate warmup ends, the state-space advantage continues to widen, from $0.321$ to $0.354$ bits per character on OpenWebText and from $0.368$ to $0.396$ on FineWeb, which an artifact of the warmup ramp would not do; the attention advantage instead decays toward zero on every corpus, and is therefore an effect of early training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究序列模型中先于骨干网络（backbone）的一个共同选择：隐藏状态的表示基底（substrate），即状态所用数系以及从状态到预测的映射形式。作者将通常的实数值状态与仿射-softmax 读出替换为来自量子理论的复数值基底，信息由状态相位承载、得分为二次 Born 形式；通过放宽精确酉性和 Born 词汇表读出这两个阻碍部署的性质，将该基底实例化到 Mamba 状态空间模型和基于注意力的 Transformer 中。在 253M 参数、参数匹配误差 0.02% 且使用同一固定训练协议的三个人工智能字节级语料上，复数值模型达到每个测得的验证损失所需的优化步数约为实数值对应模型的 1/3（状态空间）和 1/2（注意力）。
Motivation: 此前工作已证明理想化复数值基底在表示能力上强于任何带线性读出的实数值模型，但尚不清楚它是否也能训练得更快；同时精确酉性和 Born 词汇表读出这两个性质阻碍了实际部署。
Method: 提出在序列模型中采用复数值基底，状态的信息由相位承载、预测得分为二次 Born 形式，并放宽精确酉性和 Born 词汇表读出，使其可实例化到 Mamba 状态空间模型和注意力 Transformer 中；模型在 253M 参数下与实数值对照匹配到 0.02% 以内，在三个字节级语料上采用同一固定训练协议比较。
Result: 摘要报告，复数值模型达到每个测得的验证损失所需的优化步数约为实数值模型的 1/3（状态空间骨干）和 1/2（注意力骨干）；学习率预热结束后，状态空间模型的优势继续扩大，在 OpenWebText 上从 0.321 扩至 0.354 bits per character，在 FineWeb 上从 0.368 扩至 0.396，而注意力模型的优势则在所有语料上衰减至接近零。
Conclusion: 作者认为状态空间骨干的优势不是预热伪影、而是持续存在的训练加速效应，注意力骨干的加速则只是早期训练阶段的效应；复数值相位态基底可以显著减少序列模型的优化步数。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RA-CAD: Learning Post-Execution Critique for State-Aware Text-to-CAD Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-CAD generation translates natural-language design intent into editable and executable parametric computer-aided design (CAD) codes, reducing the expertise and effort required for manual modeling. Existing methods incorporate fixed, externally supplied, prompt-induced, or separately optimized critique mechanisms to optimize the generation process, but they do not necessarily optimize how feedback is interpreted and translated into effective corrective actions throughout the generation process. To bridge this feedback-utilization gap, we present RA-CAD (ReAct Agent for CAD), a state-aware agent that interacts with the CAD environment through a Generate--Execute--Critique--Rewrite loop. At each iteration, RA-CAD executes the current code and observes its outcome. Conditioned on the design instruction, current code, and execution feedback, the agent then generates an explicit post-execution critique as an intermediate policy action. This critique either validates the current result for termination or provides revision-oriented guidance that conditions the next rewrite. CAD Code Bootstrapping (CCB) first establishes fundamental parametric CAD coding capabilities through supervised fine-tuning. Feedback-Driven Agent Optimization (FAO) subsequently applies trajectory-level Group Relative Policy Optimization to both policy-generated code and critique sequences, assigning terminal F1 and Chamfer Distance rewards to the complete interaction trajectory. This formulation makes critique an outcome-aligned, learnable policy decision rather than an unoptimized auxiliary output. Experiments on CADFusion and Text2CAD show that RA-CAD achieves state-of-the-art execution validity and geometric quality compared with existing methods and strong proprietary language models, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed state-aware text-to-CAD agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RA-CAD (ReAct Agent for CAD)，一种状态感知智能体，通过 Generate–Execute–Critique–Rewrite 循环完成文本到 CAD 生成。智能体每轮执行当前代码并观察结果，再生成显式的执行后批评 (post-execution critique) 作为中间策略动作，用于验证终止或指导重写。作者先用 CAD Code Bootstrapping (CCB) 做监督微调建立参数化 CAD 编码能力，再用 Feedback-Driven Agent Optimization (FAO) 以轨迹级 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 同时优化代码与批评序列。实验在 CADFusion 和 Text2CAD 上取得最先进的执行有效性与几何质量。
Motivation: 现有文本到 CAD 方法依赖固定的、外部提供的或单独优化的批评机制，没有针对反馈如何被解释并转化为有效修正动作进行优化，存在反馈利用差距 (feedback-utilization gap)。
Method: 提出 RA-CAD 智能体，采用 Generate–Execute–Critique–Rewrite 循环；CCB 阶段通过监督微调建立参数化 CAD 编码能力，FAO 阶段使用轨迹级 GRPO 对策略生成的代码和批评序列联合优化，并以终端 F1 和 Chamfer Distance 作为整条交互轨迹的奖励。
Result: 在 CADFusion 和 Text2CAD 基准上，RA-CAD 相比现有方法和强专有语言模型取得了最先进的执行有效性和几何质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将批评构建为与结果对齐、可学习的策略决策而非未优化的辅助输出，能够提升状态感知文本到 CAD 生成的效果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Reproducibility Study of Partial Residual Ablations in Pre-LN Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Residual connections are a fundamental component of transformer architectures, yet the roles of the attention and feed-forward residual pathways remain poorly understood when considered independently. This paper presents a reproducibility study of partial residual ablations in Pre-LN GPT-style transformers trained at two scales (10M and 124M parameters). I compare four architectural configurations by selectively removing the attention residual connection, the feed-forward residual connection, or both. Across all experiments, removing the attention residual (FFNOnly) consistently causes deterministic collapse to the No-Residual performance floor. In contrast, removing the feed-forward residual (AttnOnly) exhibits a reproducible recovery effect at 10M scale under a controlled 8-seed deterministic study, while its behavior at 124M remains unresolved because of substantial seed variance. During the investigation, I identified and corrected an experimental measurement confound in runtime gain scaling and document both the failed intermediate reproduction and the subsequent controlled replication. Based on the empirical results, I propose a cross-position routing hypothesis to explain the observed asymmetry while explicitly distinguishing confirmed findings from unresolved questions. To support reproducibility, I release the complete source code, experiment configurations, checkpoints, training logs, and all experimental results, including intermediate non-reproducing runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对 Pre-LN GPT 风格 Transformer 中部分残差连接消融的可复现性研究，在 10M 和 124M 两个参数规模下比较四种架构配置。摘要发现移除注意力残差（FFNOnly）会确定性坍缩到无残差性能下限，而移除前馈残差（AttnOnly）在 10M 规模下表现出可复现的恢复效应，但在 124M 规模下因种子方差过大而结论未决。作者还修正了运行时增益测量中的实验混淆，并提出跨位置路由假说解释注意力与前馈残差路径的不对称性。
Motivation: 残差连接是 Transformer 的基础组件，但注意力残差路径和前馈残差路径各自独立的作用尚不清晰；本研究通过受控消融实验系统检验这两条路径的独立贡献。
Method: 在 Pre-LN GPT 风格 Transformer 上，以 10M 和 124M 参数规模训练，选择性移除注意力残差、前馈残差或两者，比较四种架构配置；采用 8 种子确定性实验设计，并记录失败的中间复现与后续受控复现。
Result: 移除注意力残差（FFNOnly）在所有实验中一致坍缩到 No-Residual 性能下限；移除前馈残差（AttnOnly）在 10M 规模下表现出可复现的恢复效应，但在 124M 规模下因种子方差过大而无法确定。
Conclusion: 作者提出跨位置路由假说以解释注意力与前馈残差路径之间的不对称性，并明确区分已确认发现与未决问题；同时发布完整源代码、配置、检查点、训练日志和所有实验结果以支持可复现性。

papers.title: Rethinking Reverse KL as Adaptive Entropy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) is widely used to transfer the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to smaller students, but existing objectives often struggle to balance faithful imitation and robust generation. In particular, existing methods mainly combine FKL and RKL, overlooking that RKL itself provides a mechanism for adjusting the student's imitation strength. Motivated by this, we revisit on-policy Reverse Kullback-Leibler (RKL) distillation and decompose its objective into a teacher-fitting term and a student-entropy term, without introducing an explicit FKL branch. We show theoretically that the token-level optimal student distribution corresponds to a tempered variant of the teacher distribution, where the adaptive weight controls the trade-off between mode-seeking and uncertainty preservation. Guided by this insight, we propose \textbf{Adaptive Entropy Distillation (AED)}, which uses the teacher's entropy to dynamically calibrate token-level imitation strength. Experiments on instruction-following and mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that AED achieves superior overall performance and generally improves teacher--student distributional and entropy alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视 on-policy 的反向 KL 散度 (RKL) 知识蒸馏，将其目标分解为教师拟合项与学生熵项，且不引入显式的 FKL 分支。作者从理论上证明 token 级最优学生分布是教师分布的 tempered 变体，并据此提出 Adaptive Entropy Distillation (AED)，用教师熵动态校准 token 级的模仿强度。在指令跟随和数学推理基准上，AED 取得更优的综合性能，并普遍改善师生分布与熵的对齐。
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏目标常需在忠实模仿与稳健生成之间权衡，已有方法主要将 FKL 与 RKL 组合，却忽略了 RKL 本身就能提供调节学生模仿强度的机制。
Method: 将 on-policy RKL 蒸馏目标分解为教师拟合项和学生熵项，给出 token 级最优学生分布为教师分布 tempered 变体的理论刻画；据此提出 AED，利用教师熵动态校准 token 级模仿强度。
Result: 在指令跟随与数学推理基准上的实验表明，AED 的综合性能优于现有方法，并通常改善师生分布对齐与熵对齐。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RKL 自带自适应的熵调节机制，AED 在不引入显式 FKL 分支的情况下能够动态控制模仿强度与不确定性保持之间的权衡。

papers.title: Mitigating Rubric Interference in LLM Judges via On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: LLM judges increasingly evaluate responses against fine-grained rubric checklists. When a sample requires multiple rubrics, current methods typically assess each in a separate inference call. Evaluating all rubrics in a single pass is a natural alternative with greater efficiency, but we find that it introduces rubric interference: the verdict on one rubric shifts depending on which other rubrics are co-present. In a preliminary study, only one-third of samples receive fully consistent verdicts when evaluated under rubric sets of varying composition. We develop a measurement framework that probes interference through four controlled operations: rubric set expansion, subsetting, reordering, and noise injection. To mitigate interference without external supervision, we propose Self-Anchored Rubric Alignment (SARA). SARA uses a model's own single-rubric judgments as stable anchors and aligns multi-rubric reasoning with these anchors through on-policy self-distillation. We validate SARA on three datasets (HealthBench, FLASK, ResearchQA) and two model families (Qwen3, Llama-3.1). SARA consistently improves evaluation consistency while maintaining agreement with both base models and GPT-4.1 as a reference judge. Furthermore, the learned consistency transfers across datasets, confirming that SARA teaches a general capability rather than fitting dataset-specific patterns.

TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 裁判（LLM judge）在单次推理中评估多条 rubric 时出现的 rubric 干扰现象，即某条 rubric 的判定会因同批出现的其他 rubric 而偏移。作者提出无外部监督的 Self-Anchored Rubric Alignment (SARA)，用模型自身的单 rubric 判定作稳定锚点，通过 on-policy 自蒸馏对齐多 rubric 推理。在 HealthBench、FLASK、ResearchQA 三个数据集和 Qwen3、Llama-3.1 两个模型族上，SARA 提升了判定一致性，同时保持与基础模型及 GPT-4.1 参考裁判的一致性，且该一致性可跨数据集迁移。
Motivation: LLM 裁判常按细粒度 rubric 清单评估回答；现有方法对多条 rubric 分多次推理调用，而单次评估虽更高效却引入 rubric 干扰。初步研究发现，当 rubric 集合构成变化时，仅三分之一样本的判定完全一致，说明干扰显著影响评估可靠性。

Result: 在 HealthBench、FLASK、ResearchQA 三个数据集上，对 Qwen3 和 Llama-3.1 两个模型族，SARA 持续提升评估一致性，同时保持与基础模型和 GPT-4.1 参考裁判的一致性。所学到的一致性还能跨数据集迁移，表明 SARA 学到的是通用能力而非数据集特定模式。
Conclusion: 作者认为，利用模型自身单 rubric 判定作为锚点的自蒸馏可以有效缓解单次评估中的 rubric 干扰，且该能力具有跨数据集泛化性。摘要未提及明显局限性。

papers.title: One Score, Two Decisions: Selective Prediction on the Rare-Disease Tail
papers.abstract_en: Given a patient's clinical findings, a diagnostic system ranks possible diseases and must decide when to endorse its first prediction or defer it for review. This decision is usually made by thresholding the top score. Selective prediction over ranked outputs begins with two checks. First, the ranker must produce enough correct top-ranked predictions to make the target feasible. Across 2,000 patient records stratified by disease prevalence, eight small open-weight LLMs achieve at most 4.6% Recall@1 on ultra-rare diseases. At 10% coverage, even a perfect confidence ranking of their existing predictions therefore cannot reach 50% selective accuracy. More accurate models pass the same check, showing that the limit is regime-specific. Second, the confidence signal must match the decision being made. For fixed-candidate rankers, the top-two margin cancels components shared across candidates. On phenotype-only Exomiser, it selects 10% of cases at 29.0% accuracy, compared with 13.3% overall, while the top score provides no reliable gate. Yet that cancellation can remove information needed to detect whether the candidate list contains an answer. SciFact retrieval and biomedical entity linking confirm this distinction. Finally, we prove that unlabelled scores alone cannot determine whether switching to the margin will help.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究诊断系统的选择性预测 (selective prediction) 问题，即在给定患者临床表现时，系统何时采纳排名第一的预测、何时转人工复核。作者在按疾病患病率分层的 2,000 份患者记录上检验了两个前提：排序器在超罕见疾病上的 Recall@1 极低（8 个小型开放权重 LLM 最高仅 4.6%），因此即使置信度排序完美，10% 覆盖率下也无法达到 50% 的选择性准确率；并且 top-two margin 作为置信度信号在部分场景有效，但会抵消掉判断候选列表是否包含答案所需的信息。最后给出证明：仅凭无标签分数无法决定是否切换为 margin。
Motivation: 选择性预测通常用 top score 阈值做门控，但在罕见病诊断这类长尾、候选排序场景中该信号可能不可靠；现有工作缺少对两个前提（排序器可行性、置信度与决策是否匹配）的系统性验证。
Method: 使用按患病率分层的患者记录，评估多个小型开放权重 LLM 的 Recall@1；比较 top score 与 top-two margin 作为门控置信度；在表型数据 Exomiser、SciFact 检索和生物医学实体链接任务上验证二者差异；并对无标签分数能否指导信号切换给出理论结论。
Result: 超罕见疾病上 8 个模型 Recall@1 最高为 4.6%；10% 覆盖下即使完美的置信度排序也无法达到 50% 选择性准确率。在表型 Exomiser 上，top-two margin 以 29.0% 的准确率选择 10% 病例（总体准确率 13.3%），而 top score 无法提供可靠门控；但 margin 的抵消操作会移除判断候选列表是否包含答案所需的信息，SciFact 检索和生物医学实体链接佐证了这一区别。
Conclusion: 选择性预测的可行性取决于特定疾病患病率区间（regime-specific），且置信度信号必须与所要做的决策匹配；无标签分数本身无法决定切换为 margin 是否有利。

papers.title: RouteTS: Frequency-Time Routing for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Real-world time series inherently intertwine global periodic structures with localized non-stationary variations. Existing approaches process these heterogeneous dynamics within a single computational domain, incurring fundamental limitations: time-domain models suffer from periodic misalignment over long horizons, while frequency-domain models over-smooth transient spikes. We argue that the optimal computational domain is not a property of the model, but of the data itself. Based on this principle, we propose RouteTS, a unified forecasting framework that partitions the frequency spectrum via amplitude routing and delegates components to their mathematically optimal domains. Dominant frequencies are processed by a complex-valued linear predictor in the frequency domain to preserve periodic structure, while residual spectral energy is reverted to the time domain and modeled by a lightweight MLP for local variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RouteTS achieves competitive prediction accuracy across diverse real-world datasets, with routing decisions guided by the underlying spectral signature. Furthermore, the lightweight design of RouteTS provides significant computational efficiency advantages, offering a principled solution to the longstanding dilemma between global periodicity and local transience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RouteTS 提出一种统一的时序预测框架，认为最优计算域应由数据本身而非模型决定。该方法通过振幅路由划分频谱，将主导频率交给频域的复值线性预测器以保持周期结构，将剩余谱能量回到时域用轻量 MLP 建模局部变化。摘要称其在多个真实数据集上取得有竞争力的预测精度，并凭借轻量设计带来明显的计算效率优势。
Motivation: 现有方法在单一计算域中处理全局周期结构与局部非平稳变化：时域模型在长周期上存在周期对齐问题，频域模型则会过度平滑瞬态尖峰。作者指出这一矛盾源于计算域被固定为模型属性，而非数据本身的属性。
Method: 提出 RouteTS 框架：通过振幅路由 (amplitude routing) 切分频率谱，将主导频率分量交由频域中的复值线性预测器处理，以保留周期结构；残余频谱能量则转回时域，由轻量 MLP 建模局部变化。
Result: 摘要报告 RouteTS 在多种真实数据集上取得有竞争力的预测精度，且路由决策由底层谱特征引导；同时其轻量设计带来显著的计算效率优势。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RouteTS 为全局周期性与局部瞬变性之间的长期权衡提供了一种有原则的解决方案，但摘要未提及具体实验规模或与特定基线的量化对比。

papers.title: Automatic or Controlled? Repetition Priming Reveals Divergent Processing in Base LLMs, Instruct LLMs, and Humans
papers.abstract_en: Words recur constantly in natural language use, yet it remains unclear whether language models reactivate prior representations or re-evaluate repeated words afresh, and whether post-training changes this default behavior. We apply repetition priming (Shiffrin and Schneider, 1977) to 15 models across five model families (1.5B-14B parameters) in two tasks, semantic categorization and cloze completion, with matched human experiments using identical stimuli. We find that base models exhibit automatic processing: they show immediate facilitation that remains stable across lags, partially survives context removal, and correlates with attention to prior occurrences. Instruct models exhibit controlled processing: their facilitation decays with lag, collapses without expected context, and reverses to interference at larger scales. Within the Qwen 2.5 family, this dissociation increases monotonically with model scale, suggesting that post-training progressively alters repetition processing. Humans show a hybrid profile, with lag-sensitive facilitation resembling instruct models but without interference, suggesting that neither model type fully captures human cognition. Our findings reveal a qualitative shift in how language models process repeated information after post-training and provide mechanistic evidence for the divergence between model behaviors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用重复启动范式 (repetition priming) 考察基础 LLM、指令微调 LLM 与人类在处理重复词汇时的加工机制差异。作者在五个模型家族的 15 个模型（1.5B-14B 参数）上进行了语义分类和完形填空两类任务，并用相同刺激开展匹配的人类实验。结果显示基础模型表现出自动加工，指令模型则表现出受控加工，且该分离随模型规模增大而增强；人类的反应模式介于两者之间，但不会出现干扰效应。
Motivation: 自然语言中词汇反复出现，但尚不清楚语言模型是会重新激活先前表征还是重新评估重复词汇，也不清楚后训练 (post-training) 是否改变这一默认行为。
Method: 采用 Shiffrin 和 Schneider (1977) 的重复启动范式，对 15 个模型（覆盖五个模型家族）执行语义分类和完形填空两个任务，并使用相同刺激进行匹配的人类实验，比较不同滞后 (lag)、上下文移除和注意力模式下的反应。
Result: 基础模型呈现自动加工：即时促进效应在不同滞后间保持稳定、部分抵御上下文移除，并与对先前出现的注意力相关；指令模型呈现受控加工：促进效应随滞后衰减、缺少预期上下文时消失，并在更大规模上转为干扰。在 Qwen 2.5 家族中，该分离随模型规模单调增强。人类表现出类似指令模型的滞后敏感促进，但无干扰。
Conclusion: 后训练使语言模型处理重复信息的方式发生质性转变，且两类模型均未完全复现人类认知，说明模型行为与人类之间存在机制性分歧。

papers.title: When Agentic Executions Fail: Detecting and Localizing Runtime Faults from Telemetry
papers.abstract_en: Reliability in LLM-based agentic systems is a property of the whole execution (its tool calls, model calls, guardrails, and inter-agent messages), not of the final answer alone, yet evaluating only task outcomes reveals little about how or why a run fails. We present AGENTCHAOSBENCH, a benchmark for detecting and localizing runtime faults in agentic systems from their execution telemetry. We run five heterogeneous applications that coordinate agents over the Agent-to-Agent protocol and call tools through the Model Context Protocol, and inject ten types of operational fault (unavailable or slow tools, corrupted or oversized responses, and delayed, looped, or misrouted delegations and bypassed guardrails) at their tool, model, guardrail, and inter-agent boundaries, alongside a no-fault control. The resulting dataset contains 275 sanitized traces: 250 faulty executions spanning ten fault types and 25 no-fault controls. Each faulty trace is aligned with the no-fault execution of the same input; fault-type labels and, where applicable, location labels are held out from diagnosis. On structured single-trace inputs, a first set of zero-shot LLM baselines shows the task is far from solved: local detectors up to 14B parameters reach only 13.6-19.2% top-1 fault-type accuracy and the frontier DeepSeek-v4-pro only 24.8%, while jointly identifying the fault type and its location tops out at 22%; reference-dependent faults (above all a bypassed guardrail) stay near-unsolved from a single trace. An aligned reference improves selected relative faults but does not resolve guardrail bypass. The held-out labels and compact prediction format support reproducible comparison of LLM-based and non-LLM diagnosis methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AGENTCHAOSBENCH，一个用于从执行遥测中检测和定位 LLM 智能体系统运行时故障的基准。作者运行五个通过 Agent-to-Agent 协议协调、经 Model Context Protocol 调用工具的异构应用，在工具、模型、guardrail 和智能体间边界注入十种操作故障，得到 275 条脱敏 trace（250 条故障、25 条无故障对照）。零样本 LLM 基线的低准确率表明该诊断任务距解决还很远。
Motivation: LLM 智能体系统的可靠性来自整个执行过程（工具调用、模型调用、guardrails、智能体间消息），而非仅最终答案；只评测任务结果几乎无法揭示运行如何失败及为何失败，因此需要专门针对运行时故障检测与定位的基准。
Method: 构建 AGENTCHAOSBENCH：对同一输入分别生成故障与无故障执行并做对齐，保留 fault-type 标签和位置标签用于诊断评估。故障类型包括工具不可用/变慢、响应损坏/过大、委派延迟/循环/错误路由以及 guardrail 被绕过，注入位置覆盖工具、模型、guardrail 和 inter-agent 边界。
Result: 在结构化单 trace 输入上，零样本 LLM 基线表现有限：本地检测器（最高 14B 参数）的 top-1 故障类型准确率仅为 13.6-19.2%，前沿 DeepSeek-v4-pro 也只有 24.8%；联合识别故障类型和位置的最佳结果约为 22%。对齐参考可改善部分相对型故障，但无法解决 guardrail 绕过这类参考依赖故障。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该任务远未解决，现有 LLM 诊断能力不足；基准的留出标签和紧凑预测格式可支持 LLM 与非 LLM 诊断方法的可复现比较。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Information-Theoretic Causal Modelling of Semiconductor Process Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: With the progress of the semiconductor industry toward increasingly complex compute devices and tighter process tolerances, advanced process control has become crucial. This work explores a novel framework to infer the underlying dynamics of semiconductor processes, directly from raw equipment log-file time-series data. By modelling the tool dynamics as a stochastic dynamical system comprising (a) a deterministic component and (b) a stochastic component, we estimate entropy transfer rates between variables through the Liang-Kleeman and Pires formalism. Preliminary results indicated that 7.5% of the inferred dependencies were known, 36.0% were plausible, 17.5% represented previously uncharacterised relationships, and 39.0% were inconsistent with established process knowledge. These findings demonstrate the framework's capability to uncover novel causal insights, while motivating further improvements to reduce inconsistent findings.
papers.comment: To be presented at the 2026 IEEE 33rd International Conference on Electronics, Circuits and Systems (ICECS), and published by IEEE in the conference proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从半导体设备日志时间序列直接推断工艺动态因果结构的框架，将工具动态建模为含确定性和随机分量的随机动力系统，并通过 Liang-Kleeman 与 Pires 形式论估计变量间的熵传递率。初步结果表明，推断出的依赖关系中 7.5% 为已知、36.0% 为合理、17.5% 为先前未表征的关系、39.0% 与既有工艺知识不一致，显示框架能发现新因果见解但仍需减少不一致结果。
Motivation: 半导体行业向更复杂器件和更紧工艺容差发展，先进过程控制至关重要，但现有方法难以直接从原始设备日志时间序列数据推断工艺动态的潜在因果结构。
Method: 将工具动态建模为包含确定性分量和随机分量的随机动力系统，采用 Liang-Kleeman 和 Pires 形式论估计变量之间的熵转移率，以推断因果依赖关系。
Result: 初步结果中推断依赖的 7.5% 为已知关系、36.0% 为合理关系、17.5% 为以前未表征的关系、39.0% 与既有工艺知识不一致，表明框架能揭示新的因果关系但误报偏多。
Conclusion: 该框架具备从原始日志数据中挖掘半导体工艺因果关系的潜力，作者指出需要进一步改进以减少不一致的推断结果。
Relevance: 2
