papers.title: BDIP-Net: Dual-Interaction Graph Learning for Property Prediction of Bilayer Materials
papers.abstract_en: Stacked bilayer materials exhibit rich stacking-dependent properties driven by the interplay between strong intra-layer bonding and weak inter-layer van der Waals interactions. The computational discovery of such materials is challenging because accurate structure generation typically relies on expensive DFT-based optimization, while existing machine-learning models often fail to explicitly distinguish different interaction types during property prediction. To address these challenges, we propose a machine-learning framework for efficient construction and property prediction of stacked bilayer materials. The framework employs a MatterSim-D3-based structural optimization workflow to generate DFT-quality bilayer structures from monolayer building blocks and stacking configurations at substantially reduced computational cost. For property prediction, we introduce BDIP-Net (Bilayer Dual-Interaction Potential Network), a graph neural network that explicitly models intra-layer and inter-layer interactions through interaction-specific potential representations and adaptive message fusion. We evaluate the proposed framework on BiDB, HetDB, and SAMBA, encompassing homobilayers, heterobilayers, and twisted bilayer systems. Results show that the MatterSim-D3-based workflow closely reproduces DFT-PBE-D3 optimized structures, while BDIP-Net consistently outperforms existing graph neural network and potential-based approaches for bilayer property prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向堆叠双层材料的高效机器学习框架，包含基于 MatterSim-D3 的结构优化流程和新的图神经网络 BDIP-Net。框架从单层构建块与堆叠构型生成 DFT 质量的双层结构，并通过显式建模层内与层间相互作用来进行性质预测。在 BiDB、HetDB 和 SAMBA 等数据集上的实验表明，该工作流能紧密复现 DFT-PBE-D3 优化结构，且 BDIP-Net 在双层材料性质预测上优于现有图神经网络与基于势函数的方法。
Motivation: 堆叠双层材料的性质依赖堆叠方式，由强层内成键与弱层间范德华相互作用的共同作用决定。计算发现这类材料的瓶颈在于：准确的结构生成通常依赖昂贵的 DFT 优化，而现有机器学习模型在性质预测时往往没有显式区分不同相互作用类型。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：先使用 MatterSim-D3 基础的结构优化工作流，从单层和堆叠构型以较低计算成本生成 DFT 质量的双层结构；再引入 BDIP-Net（Bilayer Dual-Interaction Potential Network），通过相互作用特定势表示 (interaction-specific potential representations) 和自适应消息融合 (adaptive message fusion) 显式建模层内与层间相互作用。
Result: 在 BiDB、HetDB 和 SAMBA（分别涵盖同质双层、异质双层和扭转双层体系）上的评估显示，MatterSim-D3 工作流紧密复现 DFT-PBE-D3 优化结构；BDIP-Net 在双层材料性质预测上一致优于现有的图神经网络和基于势函数的方法。
Conclusion: 该框架能够在显著降低计算成本的同时完成高质量双层结构生成与性质预测，摘要强调显式区分层内/层间相互作用对性质预测的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Valid Per-Field Selective Risk Control for Document Extraction: Three Failure Modes, a Validity Ladder, and When Conditioning Pays
papers.abstract_en: Per-field accept/review with selective risk at most alpha -- accept a field only if the error rate among accepted fields is controlled -- is the trust contract document-extraction systems need, and the natural procedure silently violates it on real documents. On 13,859 genuine claude-sonnet-5 fields from 800 CORD receipts (49.0% correct) we diagnose three failure modes: document clustering (design effect 1.84-2.45), score-refit leakage (coverage 0.416 at risk 0.127, violating alpha=0.10 in 95% of splits), and a tie-mass pathology (a degenerate score collapses the threshold grid, 0.030 to 0.001). We organize the fixes as a validity ladder, guarantee form stated per tier. A fit/val split protocol restores expected-selective-risk control for a learned fusion: coverage 0.318 at risk 0.096 at nominal alpha=0.10, no tolerance band (production variant 0.326) -- an on-average point whose realized risk exceeds alpha in 47.5% of resplits, not a certificate. Mondrian Learn-then-Test with exact binomial tails yields per-group PAC certificates: field-iid 0.171 at risk 0.068, cluster-corrected 0.140, doc-iid 0.060 -- the only tier matching documents, honestly near-vacuous today. Support-bin, the pre-specified provenance taxonomy, wins every rigor tier on the sonnet CORD capture (p<1e-4, Bonferroni-corrected) -- a win that does not replicate on the same documents under haiku or qwen -- while on higher-accuracy corpora pooled thresholds win: conditioning helps exactly where pooled cannot certify, subsumed by a learned score elsewhere. A frozen-configuration confirmation on selection-untouched claude-haiku-4-5 held at both risk levels, and a blind three-annotator human-gold audit verifies the practical tier's accepted-set risk at 1.3% against its 10% budget (Fleiss' kappa=0.83; labels err one-sidedly pessimistic). Released Apache-2.0 with seed-pinned, regression-gated procedures.
papers.comment: 14 pages. Seed-pinned, regression-gated harness (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/bhaskargurram-ai/verifydoc . Companion benchmark paper: VerifyDocBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究文档抽取（document extraction）中按字段的接受/复核决策，目标是在被接受字段的错误率不超过 alpha 的选择性风险控制（selective risk control）。摘要基于 13,859 个来自 800 张 CORD 小票的真实 claude-sonnet-5 字段（正确率 49.0%）诊断出三种失败模式：文档聚类、score-refit 泄漏和 tie-mass 病态，并给出按层级组织的“有效性阶梯”（validity ladder）修复方案。结果显示简单的拟合/验证切分只能做到平均意义上的风险控制，而 Mondrian Learn-then-Test 能给出逐组的 PAC 证书，但当前近乎平凡（near-vacuous）。
Motivation: 按字段的选择性接受要求接受的字段中错误率受控，这是文档抽取系统所需的信任契约；但自然过程在真实文档上会静默违反该契约，例如在风险 0.127 时覆盖率 0.416，违反 alpha=0.10 的设定。
Method: 作者诊断出三种失败模式：文档聚类（design effect 1.84-2.45）、score-refit 泄漏（coverage 0.416 at risk 0.127）、以及 tie-mass 病态（退化分数使阈值网格塌缩，0.030 到 0.001）。修复被组织成一个有效性阶梯，每一层给出相应形式的保证：拟合/验证切分协议、带精确二项尾部的 Mondrian Learn-then-Test、以及预指定的 provenance 分类 Support-bin。
Result: 摘要报告：fit/val 协议在名义 alpha=0.10 下恢复期望选择性风险控制，coverage 0.318、risk 0.096（生产变体 0.326），但这是一个平均意义上的点，47.5% 的重新切分中实现风险超过 alpha。Mondrian Learn-then-Test 在 field-iid 上给出 coverage 0.171、risk 0.068 的逐组 PAC 证书，cluster-corrected 为 0.140，doc-iid 为 0.060。Support-bin 在 sonnet 的 CORD 数据上赢得所有严格层级（p<1e-4，Bonferroni 校正），但在 haiku/qwen 上不复制；在更高准确率的语料上 pooled 阈值胜出。
Conclusion: 摘要强调条件化（conditioning）恰好只在 pooled 方法无法提供证书的地方有帮助，在其他地方可被学习到的分数取代；当前唯一匹配文档结构的层级（doc-iid）的证书诚实地说近乎平凡。确认实验在 selection-untouched 的 claude-haiku-4-5 上通过两个风险水平，三标注者盲审显示实际层级被接受集风险为 1.3%，低于 10% 预算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Randomly initialized autoencoders: fixed points and edge-of-chaos
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we study autoencoders, a special class of deep neural nets (DNNs) whose performance can be characterized via their fixed points. This perspective naturally raises questions of existence, stability, and basins of attraction of these fixed points. These questions are addressed via the contractive properties of autoencoders, and are closely related to the notion of edge-of-chaos. Edge-of-chaos (EoC) is an important notion in the theory of DNNs. It describes the critical regime separating ordered and chaotic signal propagation through a randomly initialized network. Initialization at or near this critical regime offers several theoretical and practical advantages, including stability of the network w.r.t. perturbations of the input. EoC was previously introduced for broad classes of neural networks using mean-field averaging methods. In this paper we modify the notion of EoC for the study of autoencoders. Specifically, we introduce local and global EoC for autoencoders that control local (small) and global (arbitrary) perturbations of the input respectively. The study of stability of autoencoders falls within the scope of nonlinear problems in Random Matrix Theory (RMT). Our analysis of local EoC is based on spectral techniques of RMT, whereas global EoC is studied by employing Sudakov-Fernique inequality for Gaussian processes.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Early Cycle Charge Trajectory Generative Prediction and Full Life Cycle Health Management of Iron-Chromium Flow Batteries Based on FlowBD-E1
papers.abstract_en: Long-duration stationary energy storage requires batteries whose degradation can be detected before substantial capacity loss has accumulated. Iron-chromium redox flow batteries are attractive for this role because they use abundant and low-cost active species, yet their operation is shaped by slow chromium kinetics, hydrogen evolution, membrane crossover and electrolyte imbalance. These coupled processes gradually reshape the full charge voltage/current (V/I) trajectory, but most battery prognostic studies either focus on lithium-ion cells or compress ageing into scalar capacity and state-of-health (SOH) labels. Here we study an industrial 33 kW Fe-Cr redox flow battery and introduce FlowBD-E1, an early-cycle generative forecasting framework that predicts complete future charge V/I trajectories from only the first few cycles. The model combines a multi-scale convolutional encoder, a lifecycle Transformer and an age-aware FiLM decoder, and we compare three deployment strategies: single-step latent extrapolation (SLE), recursive latent forecasting (RLF) and teacher-forced updating (TFU). Using the first 9 of 289 cycles, RLF achieved a joint V/I mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 0.731% over the remaining lifecycle and produced SOH estimates below 1% MAPE. Ablation and independent-sequence tests showed that the age-aware generative architecture outperformed LSTM and TCN baselines and retained sub-percent errors under industrial validation. These results suggest that early-cycle trajectory generation can turn a short commissioning record into a long-horizon diagnostic signal for flow-battery management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究工业级 33 kW 铁铬 (Fe-Cr) 液流电池，提出 FlowBD-E1，一种从早期循环生成完整未来充电 V/I 轨迹的生成式预测框架。模型结合多尺度卷积编码器、生命周期 Transformer 和年龄感知 FiLM 解码器，并比较单步隐空间外推 (SLE)、递归隐空间预测 (RLF) 和 teacher-forced 更新 (TFU) 三种部署策略。使用 289 个循环中的前 9 个循环时，RLF 在剩余生命周期上的联合 V/I MAPE 为 0.731%，SOH 估计 MAPE 低于 1%。消融和独立序列测试显示该架构优于 LSTM 和 TCN 基线，并在工业验证中保持亚百分误差。
Motivation: 长时固定式储能需要在容量明显损失前检测退化；铁铬液流电池使用丰度高的低成本活性物质，但受铬动力学缓慢、析氢、膜交叉和电解液失衡等耦合过程影响，这些过程会逐渐重塑完整充放电 V/I 轨迹。现有电池预后研究多聚焦锂离子电池，或将老化压缩为标量容量和 SOH 标签，缺少从早期循环生成完整轨迹的预测框架。
Method: 提出 FlowBD-E1，由多尺度卷积编码器、生命周期 Transformer 和 age-aware FiLM 解码器组成，用于仅凭前几个循环预测未来完整充电 V/I 轨迹；同时对比 SLE、RLF 和 TFU 三种部署策略，并基于生成轨迹估计 SOH。
Result: 在 289 个循环中仅使用前 9 个循环时，RLF 在剩余生命周期上达到联合 V/I MAPE 0.731%，SOH 估计 MAPE 低于 1%；消融和独立序列测试表明该架构优于 LSTM 和 TCN 基线，且在工业验证下保持亚百分误差。
Conclusion: 摘要认为早期循环轨迹生成可以把短暂的调试记录转化为长时程诊断信号，用于液流电池健康管理；该研究基于单个工业电池开展，摘要未讨论跨电池或跨工况的泛化边界。

papers.title: Fractional Optimizers Meet Fractal Activation Functions: An Empirical Study of Multi-Scale Optimization in Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: Fractional optimization methods and fractal activation functions are two independent directions for improving neural network training. Fractional optimizers extend first-order optimization through fractional derivatives and memory effects, whereas fractal activations introduce multi-scale nonlinear representations based on self-similar Weierstrass- and Blancmange-type functions. Here, we investigate their interaction within a unified experimental framework. We evaluate fractional optimizer families on Ackley and Himmelblau benchmark surfaces, in standard form and with additive Weierstrass-type perturbations, and then in feed-forward neural networks with conventional and fractal activations on ten classification datasets. The comparison includes standard methods, regularization-style optimizers, explicit and adaptive memory-based fractional optimizers, and other representative literature methods. Overall, fractional optimization and fractal activations show useful but selective pairings. Regularization-style fractional scaling performs well with selected fractal activations in network training, while Grünwald--Letnikov memory is most relevant on perturbed surfaces. Adaptive memory improves plain memory substitution in several cases, supporting controlled fractional memory as a promising direction rather than a universal replacement.
papers.comment: Quite extensive paper, more than 100 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在同一实验框架下研究分数阶优化器（fractional optimizers）与分形激活函数（fractal activations）在神经网络训练中的交互效应。先在一维基准面 Ackley 和 Himmelblau（含或不含 Weierstrass 型扰动）上评估多种分数阶优化器，再在十个分类数据集上比较常规激活与分形激活的前馈网络训练。整体结论是两者存在有用但选择性的配对，而非普适改进。
Motivation: 分数阶优化与分形激活分别是改进神经网络训练的两条独立方向，但二者如何相互作用此前缺乏系统性考察。
Method: 构建统一实验框架，比较标准方法、正则化风格优化器、显式与自适应记忆型分数阶优化器及其他文献代表性方法；激活函数涵盖常规函数与基于自相似 Weierstrass 型和 Blancmange 型函数的分形激活。
Result: 正则化风格的分数阶缩放与部分分形激活在网络训练中搭配良好；Grünwald–Letnikov 记忆型方法在扰动表面上最重要；自适应记忆在多个场景中优于普通记忆替代，表明受控分数阶记忆是有前景的方向而非通用替代。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分数阶优化与分形激活的配对是选择性的，推荐将其视为受控分数阶记忆的补充手段，而非普遍替代现有训练方法。

papers.title: Belayer: Efficient Fault Tolerance for LLM Agentic RL Training
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly trained with reinforcement learning in long-horizon, sandboxed environments. Unlike conventional RL, agentic RL couples GPU-intensive rollout engines with stateful environment containers whose actions may produce visible side effects, such as file edits, command execution, and dependency installation. A single trajectory can span many rounds of gen- eration and environment interaction, so a component failure can discard completed work or expose the model to an environment state that is inconsistent with its context. However, existing systems lack efficient and correct recovery mechanisms for this distributed execution model. This paper presents Belayer, an efficient fault-tolerant system for LLM agentic RL training. Belayer handles failures in both rollout engines and environment execution while targeting low failure-free overhead. For scoped worker-local rollout failures, Belayer equips each pre-initialized shadow worker with a selective GPU-state reuse protocol that retains independently owned weights and raw KV-arena allocations after owner and GPU health checks, reinitializes worker-local state, and rebuilds request-specific KV contents from logged token prefixes. For environment failures, Belayer introduces full checkpoint and full restore to jointly capture and restore container file-system and runtime state, and coordinates the recovered environment with the LLM context to preserve prefix consistency. An adaptive policy opportunistically overlaps full-state checkpointing with natural LLM inference bubbles when the predicted interval is long enough. Empirical results show low measured overhead during failure-free training, a worker-recovery-time reduction of up to 42 times faster compared with a full engine cold start, and 1.5 to 3.5 times faster recovery from environment failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Belayer，一个面向 LLM agentic RL（智能体强化学习）训练的容错系统，针对 rollout 引擎与有状态环境容器两类故障设计恢复机制。Belayer 通过预初始化的 shadow worker 和选择性 GPU 状态复用处理局部 rollout 故障，通过环境全量检查点与恢复统一捕获容器文件系统和运行时状态，并用自适应策略将检查点与推理气泡重叠。实验显示正常训练开销低，worker 恢复比引擎冷启动快最多 42 倍，环境故障恢复快 1.5 至 3.5 倍。
Motivation: LLM 智能体在长时序、沙箱化环境中进行强化学习训练时，单个轨迹横跨多轮生成与环境交互，组件故障会造成已完成工作丢失或环境状态与模型上下文不一致。现有系统缺少针对这种分布式执行模型的高效且正确的恢复机制。
Method: Belayer 采用选择性 GPU 状态复用协议：每个预初始化的 shadow worker 在所有者与 GPU 健康检查后保留独立权重和原始 KV-arena 分配，重新初始化 worker 本地状态，并从记录的 token 前缀重建请求相关 KV 内容。对环境故障，引入全量检查点与全量恢复来联合捕获并恢复容器文件系统与运行时状态，使恢复后的环境与 LLM 上下文保持前缀一致；自适应策略在预测间隔足够长时将全状态检查点与 LLM 推理气泡重叠。
Result: 摘要报告正常训练期间测量开销较低，worker 恢复时间比完整引擎冷启动最多缩短 42 倍，环境故障恢复速度提升 1.5 至 3.5 倍。
Conclusion: Belayer 证明了通过对 rollout 引擎采用选择性 GPU 状态复用、对环境采用联合状态检查与恢复，可以同时实现低失败开销与快速恢复。摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Metaplasticity as adaptive gradient preconditioning for incremental learning
papers.abstract_en: Biological intelligence naturally prevents catastrophic forgetting through Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory, a macroscopic consolidation process driven at the local level by synaptic metaplasticity: the continuous, history-dependent neuromodulation of individual synapses. While artificial neural networks struggle with the stability-plasticity dilemma in non-stationary environments, existing solutions often require task labels or incur massive memory overhead, diverging from biological reality. Re-framing this localized neuromodulation as an optimization-driven process, we introduce $\textbf{SynGAP}$: $\textbf{Syn}$aptic $\textbf{G}$eometric $\textbf{A}$daptive $\textbf{P}$reconditioning. SynGAP is a task-free continual learning framework based on adaptive gradient preconditioning. Rather than relying on explicit episodic triggers, SynGAP simulates real-time metaplasticity by maintaining an exponential moving average of the Fisher Information Matrix over a continuous data stream. During the optimization step, these dynamic metaplastic states are translated into a bounded multiplicative mask that preconditions raw gradients, selectively attenuating updates to critical historical parameters. Empirical evaluations demonstrate SynGAP's superior ability to mitigate catastrophic forgetting compared to established baselines. On the Split CIFAR-100 benchmark, SynGAP delivers a $4\times$ increase in accuracy compared to EWC++ and outperforms Experience Replay (ER) by almost $10\%$, while reducing the forgetting measure by over $10\%$ against both methods. Furthermore, on the CORe50 benchmark, SynGAP achieves about $68\%$, a $10\%$ improvement over optimizer baselines. By mathematically formalizing continuous biological metaplasticity as stable gradient-based regularization, SynGAP offers a highly robust and memory-efficient solution for adaptive intelligence at the edge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SynGAP（Synaptic Geometric Adaptive Preconditioning），一个基于自适应梯度预条件（adaptive gradient preconditioning）的免任务（task-free）持续学习框架。SynGAP 通过对连续数据流维护 Fisher Information Matrix 的指数移动平均来模拟突触元可塑性（metaplasticity），并在优化时把动态元可塑状态转化为有界乘性掩码，对原始梯度做预条件，选择性衰减对关键历史参数的更新。实验显示其在缓解灾难性遗忘上优于多个基线。
Motivation: 生物智能通过互补学习系统（CLS）和突触元可塑性自然避免灾难性遗忘，而人工神经网络在非平稳环境中面临稳定性-可塑性困境；现有解决方案往往需要任务标签或带来巨大内存开销，偏离生物现实。作者希望把局部的生物神经调制重新表述为优化驱动过程，以填补这一空白。
Method: SynGAP 是一种免任务的持续学习框架，不依赖显式的回合触发（episodic triggers）。它维护 Fisher Information Matrix 在连续数据流上的指数移动平均，并将这些动态元可塑状态转化为有界乘性掩码，在优化步骤中预条件原始梯度，从而选择性衰减对重要历史参数的更新。
Result: 在 Split CIFAR-100 基准上，SynGAP 相比 EWC++ 准确率提升 4 倍，比 Experience Replay（ER）高近 10%，且对两者的遗忘指标（forgetting measure）均降低超过 10%。在 CORe50 基准上达到约 68%，比优化器基线提升 10%。
Conclusion: 作者将连续的生物元可塑性数学形式化为稳定的基于梯度的正则化，称 SynGAP 为边缘（edge）自适应智能提供了一种稳健且内存高效的解决方案。

papers.title: Wolff-Parkinson-White Detection at 471:1 Class Imbalance: A Leakage-Controlled Study of the Data Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) syndrome is a congenital cardiac pre-excitation, clinically important and often missed on the resting 12-lead ECG. Detection is hard: the signature is subtle and the condition rare. We pool two public 12-lead corpora, PTB-XL and Chapman-Shaoxing-Ningbo: 66,951 recordings, 142 of them WPW, a prevalence of 0.21% (about 471:1). Under one pre-specified, leakage-controlled protocol, with a held-out fold contacted exactly once, we compare seven representations of the signal, holding the split and the evaluation fixed. Within these corpora and under a modest compute budget, added diversity and capacity do not raise the ceiling: the most orthogonal detector significantly hurts, a feature-union model matches a two-member vote, a convolutional network reaches the wavelet detector without exceeding it, and self-supervised pretraining fails a pre-specified gate. A leak-free learning curve, re-selecting features at every size, still rises at the full 115 positives for the strongest deployed detector (paired 90-to-100% difference +0.027, 95% CI [0.019, 0.033]), so it is not shown to have saturated. An error analysis tested against independent evidence finds that the missed cases have a narrower QRS, confirmed by an on-machine measurement outside our pipeline after we show the sign of this effect depends on which delineator measures it; that uncertain labels show no enrichment among the misses; and that some apparent false positives are recordings the corpus itself codes as pre-excited, placing part of the label problem in the negative class. We measure the optimism of non-nested selection at 0.11 to 0.13 average precision. The deployed output is a percentile rank in a frozen reference distribution, not a probability. On the held-out fold, on 14 positives, it reaches an average precision of 0.595 and an ROC area of 0.950. It is a screening pre-filter, not a diagnostic tool.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 7 figures. Code, frozen models, out-of-fold scores and the full decision log: https://github.com/nathaelaltman/wpw-ecg-detection
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) 综合征在 12 导联静息 ECG 上的检测问题，面对约 471:1 的极端类别不平衡（两个公开语料库共 66,951 条记录，其中 142 条 WPW）。作者在预先指定、防泄漏 (leakage-controlled) 的协议下，固定划分与评估方式，比较了七种信号表示，发现增加多样性与容量并未提升上限：自监督预训练未通过预设门槛，最强检测器为小波特征器，且学习曲线在 115 个阳性样本处尚未饱和。部署输出是冻结参考分布中的百分位排名而非概率，在 14 个阳性样本的留出折上达到平均精度 0.595、ROC 面积 0.950，作者明确将其定位为筛查预过滤器而非诊断工具。
Motivation: WPW 是先天性心脏预激，临床重要但常在心电图上被漏诊，其特征细微且发病率低，导致监督数据极其稀缺。现有研究容易因评估泄漏高估性能，本文旨在通过严格控制泄漏的协议，回答数据瓶颈是否限制了该任务的检测上限。
Method: 合并 PTB-XL 与 Chapman-Shaoxing-Ningbo 两个公开 12 导联语料库，采用预先指定的防泄漏协议，留出折仅接触一次。固定划分与评估，比较七种信号表示（包括特征并集、卷积网络、小波检测器、自监督预训练等），并在每个样本量下重新选择特征绘制无泄漏学习曲线；同时通过独立证据进行误差分析，并度量非嵌套选择的乐观偏差 (optimism)。
Result: 摘要报告：最正交的检测器显著损害性能，特征并集模型与两成员投票持平，卷积网络达到但未超过小波检测器，自监督预训练未通过预设门槛。最强部署检测器的学习曲线在 115 个阳性样本处仍上升（配对 90%-100% 差值为 +0.027，95% CI [0.019, 0.033]），未显示饱和；非嵌套选择的乐观偏差为 0.11–0.13 平均精度。留出折 14 个阳性样本上的平均精度为 0.595，ROC 面积为 0.950。
Conclusion: 作者强调该输出是筛查预过滤器而非诊断工具；漏诊病例 QRS 更窄，但该效应的符号取决于所用 delineator；部分看似假阳性的记录其实被语料库本身编码为预激，提示部分标签问题位于负类。当前结果只在所涉语料库与有限计算预算下成立，且性能尚未饱和。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DeMTS: Denoising Trajectories as Multivariate Time Series for Hallucination Detection in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (D-LLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for text generation. However, similar to autoregressive LLMs, D-LLMs remain vulnerable to hallucinations, where fluent outputs may contain factually incorrect or unsupported content. Although existing hallucination detection methods for D-LLMs attempt to leverage uncertainty trajectories of the denoising process to better identify hallucination signals, they typically compress the trajectories along either the temporal or token dimension, overlooking the useful information encoded in the complete two-dimensional token-step structure. Consequently, they may fail to capture hallucination-relevant patterns, such as inconsistent convergence and cross-token fault propagation, leading to suboptimal detection performance. To bridge this gap, we propose a D-LLM hallucination detection framework that formulates the Denoising trajectories as Multivariate Time Series over learnable latent variables (DeMTS for short). DeMTS employs a trajectory-preserving token-to-variable assignment module to convert token signals into stable latent variables. Based on these variables, we propose dynamic multivariate temporal modeling to progressively integrate inter-variable dependency modeling with temporal encoding for hallucination prediction. Extensive experiments on two D-LLMs backbones and three benchmarks demonstrate that DeMTS outperforms existing hallucination detection methods while maintaining strong robustness, efficiency, and cross-task transferability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散大语言模型 (D-LLM) 的幻觉检测问题，提出 DeMTS 框架，将去噪轨迹建模为可学习隐变量上的多元时间序列 (multivariate time series)。DeMTS 通过保持轨迹的 token 到变量分配模块将 token 信号转为稳定的隐变量，并用动态多元时间建模逐步融合变量间依赖与时间编码。在两种 D-LLM 骨干和三个基准上的实验表明，其检测性能优于现有方法，且具备较好的鲁棒性、效率与跨任务迁移性。
Motivation: 现有针对 D-LLM 的幻觉检测方法虽尝试利用去噪过程的确定性轨迹，但通常沿时间维或 token 维对轨迹进行压缩，丢失了完整二维 token-step 结构中的有用信息，从而难以捕捉不一致收敛和跨 token 故障传播等幻觉相关模式，导致检测性能次优。
Method: 提出 DeMTS 框架：先用轨迹保持的 token-to-variable 分配模块将 token 信号转化为稳定的隐变量，再基于这些变量进行动态多元时间序列建模，逐步整合变量间依赖建模与时间编码，用于幻觉预测。
Result: 在两种 D-LLM 骨干和三个基准上的大量实验表明，DeMTS 优于现有幻觉检测方法，同时保持较强的鲁棒性、效率和跨任务迁移能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调保留去噪轨迹的完整二维 token-step 结构并对其建模，有助于捕捉 D-LLM 中与幻觉相关的模式，从而提升检测效果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Accuracy and Reliability of Large Language Models in Cosmetic Chemistry and Skin Health: A Benchmarking Study
papers.abstract_en: As consumers increasingly turn to AI chatbots for skincare advice, the technical accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) in cosmetic chemistry remains largely under-evaluated. We benchmarked 14 LLMs on a structured set of topics related to cosmetic chemistry, including the chemical properties of specific cosmetic ingredients and common cosmetic scenarios that may be of interest to consumers. Web search was disabled throughout to assess each model's internalized knowledge rather than its internet retrieval capacity. Overall performance was poor, with the most pronounced deficits in quantitative reasoning and structural identification tasks. While models handled general skincare questions with reasonability, responses consistently lacked the technical depth required for informed consumer decision-making. Notably, conversation with AI can pose a risk: outputs that sound authoritative but contain technical errors are less likely to generate skepticism compared to responses that explicitly acknowledge uncertainty. These findings suggest that general-purpose LLMs, trained predominantly on unverified public data, are currently not reliable sources of cosmetic chemistry information. Progress on two fronts, fine-tuning verified chemical and dermatological datasets, and substantial improvements to algorithmic reasoning, will likely be needed before these tools can be considered as resources for public use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对14个大型语言模型（LLM）在化妆品化学与皮肤健康知识上的准确性和可靠性进行基准测试，测试全程关闭联网搜索以评估各模型的内化知识而非检索能力。结果显示整体表现不佳，定量推理和结构识别任务缺陷最明显；模型能合理回答一般护肤问题，但回答普遍缺乏支撑消费者知情决策所需的技术深度。研究还指出，听起来权威但包含技术错误的AI输出比明确承认不确定性的回答更不易引发用户怀疑。
Motivation: 消费者越来越依赖AI聊天机器人获取护肤建议，但LLM在化妆品化学方面的技术准确性至今缺乏系统性评估。
Method: 作者围绕化妆品成分的化学性质与消费者关心的常见化妆品场景构建结构化测试集，对14个LLM进行benchmarking，并禁用web search以专门检验模型内部化知识。
Result: 总体表现差，定量推理与结构识别是最薄弱环节；一般护肤问题处理尚可，但技术深度不足。此外，权威腔调但含技术错误的输出相比承认不确定性的输出更难让用户产生怀疑。
Conclusion: 通用型LLM在化妆品化学领域目前不是可靠的信息来源；摘要强调需要两条进展路径：在经验证的化学与皮肤病学数据集上微调，以及显著改进算法推理能力，之后才可能作为面向公众的资源使用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Characterizing Rhetorical Misalignment in Decision-Making with Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Human decision-making is often shaped by a range of well-documented cognitive biases. As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly integrated into high-stakes human-AI decision-making, it is important to understand whether their outputs can amplify potential biases, how this influences human decisions, and crucially, whether it can lead to harmful consequences. In this work, we develop a decision-theoretic framework to study rhetorical misalignment, a failure mode where an LLM uses rhetorically inappropriate forms of presentation for a given decision context, thereby inducing suboptimal human decisions. We empirically investigate this phenomenon through a human-subject experiment in realistic clinical decision-making using a dataset curated from the United States Medical Licensing Examination. By measuring how LLM-generated information affects decisions, we observe that LLMs induce an average 2.81% rate of harmful decision flips across different models, where clinician participants change from a correct to an incorrect answer. Rationales reported by participants provide evidence that these revisions are closely related to the language used by LLMs that may induce different types of cognitive biases, including anchoring, authority bias, and loss aversion. To enable scalable evaluation, we instantiate our theoretical framework using decision-makers simulated by LLMs to computationally measure rhetorical misalignment. Our findings reveal a safety concern previously unrecognized in high-stakes domains: a model can be factually aligned yet still induce harm through its rhetorical presentation.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个决策论框架来研究修辞错位 (rhetorical misalignment)：LLM 在给定决策语境中使用修辞上不恰当的呈现形式，从而诱导次优的人类决策。作者在基于美国执业医师资格考试数据的临床决策场景中开展人类被试实验，发现 LLM 平均诱导 2.81% 的有害决策翻转（参与者从正确答案改为错误答案）。随后用 LLM 模拟决策者将框架实例化，以实现可扩展的评估，并指出一个此前未被认识的安全问题：模型可以事实对齐 (factually aligned) 但仍通过修辞呈现造成伤害。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地融入高风险人机决策，但现有研究主要关注其输出是否放大认知偏差，缺乏对呈现形式 (rhetorical presentation) 如何系统性地影响人类决策的刻画。
Method: 作者建立决策论框架定义并测量修辞错位，通过从美国执业医师资格考试提取的数据集进行真实临床决策的人类被试实验，并用 LLM 模拟决策者来实例化该框架，实现计算化的可扩展评估。
Result: 实验显示 LLM 在不同模型上平均诱导 2.81% 的有害决策翻转；参与者给出的理由表明，这些修订与 LLM 语言可能诱发的多种认知偏差相关，包括锚定 (anchoring)、权威偏差 (authority bias) 和损失厌恶 (loss aversion)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在高风险领域中存在一个此前未被认识的安全隐患：即使模型在事实上与正确答案对齐，其修辞呈现仍可能诱导人类做出有害决策。

papers.title: Inference-Time Mitigation of Adversarial Political Bias in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become the mainstay for information retrieval and summarization tasks, ensuring that they are always non-partisan and invulnerable to political bias is a critical step towards safer and more trustworthy Artificial Intelligence (AI). Current model alignment paradigms, such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), make LLMs follow overarching safety instructions. However, this instruction tuning can be exploited via adversarial prompt injection and be used to generate unsafe content. In particular, political bias has not been specifically targeted by modern alignment techniques as harmful and biased content. To address this vulnerability of LLMs, we propose mitigation strategies using Chain of Thought (CoT) prompting and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Using a public dataset of legislative videos, we generate summaries using LLMs, inject bias via adversarial prompting and evaluate their performance on a four axis scale designed for political summarization. In this paper, we present different methods to shield LLMs against the injection of political bias. Our results demonstrate that the proposed Recursive Self-Correction approach raises model performance from a Political Neutrality Likert scale baseline of 2.14 to 4.56, averaged across all models, demonstrating effective inference-time mitigation of political bias in LLM-generated summaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）在信息检索与摘要任务中因对抗性提示注入（adversarial prompt injection）产生政治偏见的问题，提出推理阶段的缓解策略。作者使用立法视频的公开数据集生成摘要，通过对抗提示注入偏见，并在专为政治摘要设计的四轴量表上评估。结果表明，所提出的 Recursive Self-Correction 方法将各模型平均的政治中立 Likert 量表得分从 2.14 基线提升到 4.56，实现有效的推理阶段政治偏见缓解。
Motivation: 现有对齐范式（如 RLHF）让 LLM 遵循总体安全指令，但指令微调可被对抗性提示注入利用以生成不安全内容；政治偏见尚未被现代对齐技术专门视为有害或偏见内容加以处理，因此需要针对这一漏洞的缓解方案。
Method: 提出基于 Chain of Thought (CoT) 提示和 Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) 的缓解策略，并利用立法视频公开数据集生成摘要、注入偏见，在四轴量表上评估。文中呈现多种防护方法，核心是 Recursive Self-Correction 方法。
Result: 摘要报告 Recursive Self-Correction 方法将各模型平均的政治中立 Likert 量表得分从 2.14 基线提升到 4.56，表明该推理阶段方法能有效缓解 LLM 生成摘要中的政治偏见。
Conclusion: 摘要认为所提出的推理阶段缓解策略能有效抵御 LLM 摘要生成中的政治偏见注入，主要评估场景为立法视频摘要及其四轴评分量表。

papers.title: LLM Safety Alignment in Low-Resource Languages: A Systematic Literature Review
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved substantial progress in safety alignment, yet their safety guarantees remain significantly weaker in low-resource and multilingual settings than in high-resource languages. In this paper, we conduct a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) of LLM safety alignment in low-resource languages by adopting the PRISMA 2020 methodology. Out of roughly 1,500 papers identified from Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and OpenAlex, 50 relevant studies have been selected and analyzed. Our review is organized around four themes: safety alignment methods, multilingual safety risks, evaluation benchmarks, and cross-lingual transferability. We further propose a taxonomy of safety alignment approaches based on three adaptation mechanisms: data adaptation, objective optimization, and mechanistic alignment. Across literature, translated English benchmarks fail to sufficiently represent culturally rooted harms, and multilingual models are more vulnerable to cross-lingual jailbreaks, code-switching attacks, and safety degradation in underrepresented languages. These failures are driven by several key factors, including uneven multilingual pre-training coverage, insufficient native-language preference data, poor transfer of safety representations, and a lack of culturally aware evaluation frameworks. The review also notes that many low-resource languages, especially African languages, have fewer safety benchmarks available than other multilingual regions. Overall, the results reveal a persistent multilingual safety gap, and suggest that future progress will require culturally grounded benchmarks, participatory data collection, balanced multilingual pre-training, and scalable multilingual alignment methods.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对低资源语言下的大语言模型安全对齐进行了系统性文献综述，采用 PRISMA 2020 方法，从约 1,500 篇论文中筛选出 50 篇进行分析。综述围绕安全对齐方法、多语言安全风险、评估基准和跨语言迁移性四个主题展开，并提出基于数据适应、目标优化和机制对齐三种适应机制的分类法。结论指出翻译后的英文基准不足以代表文化相关的危害，多语言模型在跨语言越狱、代码切换攻击和未充分表示语言上的安全退化方面更为脆弱。
Motivation: 大语言模型在安全对齐上已有显著进展，但低资源和多语言场景下的安全保证明显弱于高资源语言，而该问题缺乏系统的文献梳理。
Method: 采用 PRISMA 2020 系统文献综述方法，从 Semantic Scholar、arXiv 和 OpenAlex 检索约 1,500 篇论文，筛选出 50 篇相关研究，并围绕四个主题提出基于数据适应、目标优化和机制对齐三种适应机制的分类法。
Result: 综述发现翻译的英文基准不足以代表文化根源性危害；多语言模型更容易受到跨语言越狱、代码切换攻击以及未充分表示语言上的安全退化。这些失败源于多语言预训练覆盖不均、本地语言偏好数据不足、安全表示迁移不佳以及缺乏文化感知的评估框架；此外，许多低资源语言（尤其是非洲语言）的安全基准数量少于其他多语言地区。
Conclusion: 结果表明多语言安全差距持续存在，未来进展需要文化根基的基准、参与式数据收集、均衡的多语言预训练以及可扩展的多语言对齐方法。

papers.title: Local AI pre-screening for human triple-blind peer review in health sciences
papers.abstract_en: Academic peer review is under mounting strain: NeurIPS 2025 received 21,575 submissions, ICLR 2025 received 11,603, and ICML 2025 received 12,107. This volume has outpaced the supply of qualified reviewers, and large language models (LLMs) are already filling the gap, largely undisclosed. An independent analysis of ICLR 2026 found roughly 21% of its 75,800 peer reviews were fully AI-generated, with over half showing some AI involvement (up from 15.8% in 2024). Documented risks include hallucinated citations in accepted papers and hidden prompt-injection instructions embedded in manuscripts to manipulate AI reviewers into favorable assessments. We propose a triple-blind, multi-LLM pre-screening framework for peer review, developed for a health sciences journal, that formalizes and discloses AI involvement while preserving human reviewers as the final decision-making authority. The framework routes a submission through five stages -- sanitization/anonymization, parallel AI pre-screening, an automated check gate, blinded human review, and editorial adjudication -- with return-to-author loops at the check and editor stages. Addressing the confidentiality concerns behind NIH/NSF bans on submitting unpublished proposals to third-party generative AI, all three AI reviewers run on locally-hosted, open-weight LLMs, keeping manuscript content within the journal infrastructure. The closest precedent, Shen et al., benchmarked five open-source LLMs on quartile classification of 200 manuscripts and found accuracy insufficient (35% exact-match) for autonomous use, supporting our decision to retain mandatory human adjudication. This transparent, human-supervised design offers a defensible alternative to today's opaque, unregulated AI use in peer review, potentially reducing the substantial delay of traditional review (avg. 13 weeks to first decision) without displacing human judgment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对学术同行评审中大量未披露的 AI 参与问题，提出一个用于健康科学期刊的三盲、多 LLM 预筛框架。流程包含五个阶段（匿名化、并行 AI 预筛、自动检查门、盲审、编辑裁决），并保留人类评审的最终决定权。三个 AI 评审器全部使用本地部署的开源权重 LLM，将稿件内容限制在期刊基础设施内，以回应 NIH/NSF 对第三方生成式 AI 的保密禁令。
Motivation: 同行评审压力持续增大（NeurIPS 2025 收到 21,575 篇投稿），合格评审者不足，LLM 已在未被披露的情况下填补缺口；独立分析发现 ICLR 2026 约 21% 的评审完全由 AI 生成，且存在幻觉引用和通过 prompt injection 操纵 AI 评审的风险，因此需要将 AI 参与正式化并保持透明。
Method: 提出一个三盲、多 LLM 预筛框架，将稿件依次经过五个阶段：去标识化/匿名化、并行 AI 预筛、自动检查门、盲审和编辑裁决，并在检查门与编辑阶段设置返修回作者循环。所有三个 AI 评审器均为本地托管的开源权重 LLM，手稿内容不离开期刊基础设施。
Result: 摘要引用证据支持该设计：ICLR 2026 约 21% 的评审完全由 AI 生成，超过一半存在 AI 参与（2024 年为 15.8%）；Shen 等人的基准测试中，五个开源 LLM 对 200 篇手稿的四分位分类准确率仅为 35% 精确匹配，不足以自主使用，因此需要保留强制人工裁决。
Conclusion: 该透明且人类监督的设计为当前不透明、缺乏监管的 AI 评审使用方式提供了可辩护的替代方案，有可能缩短传统评审的延迟（平均 13 周出首次决定），同时不取代人类判断。

papers.title: Learning Agent Execution for KV-Cache Management in Agentic Serving
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems have emerged as an important deployment paradigm for AI services, where each user request is decomposed into a sequence of specialized agents. Across these workflows, every agent repeatedly executes a fixed context consisting of system prompts, tool definitions, and few-shot examples, creating substantial opportunities for KV-cache reuse. Existing LLM serving systems, however, manage KV-cache reactively using prefix caching and recency-based replacement, causing reusable agent contexts to be evicted before their next invocation and forcing repeated recomputation. We present CacheScout, an agent-aware KV-cache runtime layer for multi-agent LLM serving. The key insight is that future KV-cache reuse is governed by agent execution semantics rather than cache recency alone. CacheScout captures these semantics by learning agent execution transitions online, without requiring predefined workflow graphs or offline training, and uses the learned execution model to guide both cache eviction and proactive prefetching while leaving the serving critical path unchanged. We implement CacheScout on top of vLLM. Across representative real-world multi-agent workloads, CacheScout improves KV-cache hit rate by 10-18 percentage points, reduces mean TTFT by 18-45%, lowers mean per-turn latency by 29-38%, and increases peak throughput by up to 57%. These benefits also generalize to larger models, reducing TTFT by up to 54% while sustaining 37% higher throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CacheScout，一个面向多智能体 LLM 服务的智能体感知 KV-cache 运行时层。其核心观察是未来 KV-cache 复用由智能体执行语义决定，而非仅由缓存近期性决定；CacheScout 通过在线学习智能体执行转移来指导缓存淘汰与主动预取，无需预定义工作流图或离线训练。基于 vLLM 的实现显示在真实多智能体负载上显著提升 KV-cache 命中率、降低 TTFT 与每轮延迟，并提高峰值吞吐。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统中每个智能体反复执行固定的系统提示、工具定义和 few-shot 上下文，存在大量 KV-cache 复用机会；但现有 LLM 服务系统仅用前缀缓存和基于近期性的替换策略被动管理缓存，导致可复用上下文在下次调用前被逐出，被迫重复计算。
Method: CacheScout 在线学习智能体执行转移（agent execution transitions），无需预定义工作流图或离线训练，利用学习到的执行模型同时指导缓存淘汰（cache eviction）和主动预取（proactive prefetching），且不改变服务关键路径；实现基于 vLLM。
Result: 在代表性真实多智能体负载上，CacheScout 将 KV-cache 命中率提高 10-18 个百分点，平均 TTFT 降低 18-45%，平均每轮延迟降低 29-38%，峰值吞吐最高提升 57%；在更大模型上 TTFT 最高降低 54%，同时吞吐提升 37%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调未来 KV-cache 复用由智能体执行语义主导，在线学习执行模型能显著改善多智能体 LLM 服务的缓存效率，且收益可泛化到更大模型。

papers.title: A Human-Centred Approach to Benchmarking LLMs for Parenting Advice
papers.abstract_en: People are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) to seek advice, including for parenting. Parenting is a critical and socially sensitive domain. Thus, evaluating advice provided by LLMs requires indicators beyond aggregated information quality benchmarks to consider relational and behavioural elements of the responses. With a multi-dimensional rubric created by parenting experts, this paper evaluates 15 LLMs across 100 parenting scenarios in 2 languages (English and Chinese), using an LLM-as-a-judge method. Results show that aggregate scores can hide rubric item-specific weaknesses, models implicitly encourage different parenting styles, and language influences responses. We highlight the importance of evaluation output auditability and challenges involved in evaluating LLM-generated advice in domains like parenting. Our findings provide important insights for selecting LLMs for direct user engagement and the development of user-facing parenting advice applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种以人为中心的评估框架，用于评测大语言模型（LLM）在育儿建议这一高敏感社会领域中的表现。研究者与育儿专家共同制定多维评分标准，采用 LLM-as-a-judge 方法，在英语和中文两种语言下对 15 个 LLM 在 100 个育儿场景中的回答进行评估。结果显示，聚合分数会掩盖评分细则层面的具体弱点，模型会隐式鼓励不同的育儿风格，且语言会影响回答内容。
Motivation: 人们越来越多地使用 LLM 寻求育儿建议，而育儿是高度敏感的社会领域，仅用聚合的信息质量指标无法充分评估回答中的关系性与行为性要素，需要更精细的多维评估标准。
Method: 由育儿专家构建多维评分标准，选取 15 个 LLM 与 100 个育儿场景，覆盖英语和中文两种语言，并使用 LLM-as-a-judge 方法对模型回答进行评分。
Result: 聚合分数会掩盖评分细则层面上的具体弱点；不同模型隐式鼓励不同的育儿风格；语言因素会影响模型回答。
Conclusion: 研究强调在育儿等敏感领域评估 LLM 生成建议时，评估输出的可审计性至关重要，并为用户直接使用 LLM 及开发面向用户的育儿建议应用提供了模型选择依据。

papers.title: AutoMem: A Text-Gradient Recursive Self-Improvement Framework for Automated Memory Architectures Search
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is increasingly central to LLM agents, yet memory design remains a highly coupled architecture problem: what to encode, how to store it, how to retrieve it, and how to manage it can vary substantially across tasks and backbone models. We construct a discrete search space with 5 encoders, 5 stores, 6 retrievers, and 4 managers, and show that no single memory architecture consistently dominates: different tasks favor different module combinations, leading to substantial performance gaps. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{AutoMem}, a text-gradient recursive self-improvement framework for task-adaptive memory architecture search. \textsc{AutoMem} optimizes over the factored space through two components: Experience-Guided Architecture Search, which proposes candidate architectures from historical search trajectories and accumulated reflections, and Failure-Guided Module Diagnosis, which localizes memory-related failures to specific modules and converts them into targeted textual feedback. Experiments on GAIA, WebWalkerQA, and xBench-DeepSearch across two LLM backbones show that \textsc{AutoMem} consistently discovers task-adaptive memory architectures that outperform the strongest human-designed memory baselines, improving accuracy by $2.8$ points on average across six benchmark-backbone settings. Further analysis shows that \textsc{AutoMem} achieves a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, reducing token cost by $14.3\%$ over the strongest accuracy baselines under Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, while also finding stronger architectures than substantially larger random searches within only a few guided iterations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoMem，一个基于文本梯度的递归自改进框架，用于任务自适应的 LLM 长时记忆架构搜索。作者构建了包含 5 个编码器、5 个存储、6 个检索器和 4 个管理器的离散搜索空间，并发现不同任务偏好不同的记忆模块组合、无单一架构一致占优。AutoMem 通过经验引导架构搜索与失败引导模块诊断进行优化，在多个基准和 LLM 骨干上稳定发现优于最强人工设计记忆基线的任务自适应架构。
Motivation: 长时记忆对 LLM agent 越来越关键，但记忆设计是高度耦合的架构问题：编码什么、如何存储、检索和管理在不同任务与骨干模型间差异很大，且没有单一记忆架构能一致占优，导致显著性能差距。
Method: AutoMem 包含两个组件：经验引导架构搜索（Experience-Guided Architecture Search）从历史搜索轨迹和累积反思中提出候选架构；失败引导模块诊断（Failure-Guided Module Diagnosis）将记忆相关失败定位到具体模块并转化为针对性文本反馈，以文本梯度方式递归地自改进搜索。
Result: 在 GAIA、WebWalkerQA 和 xBench-DeepSearch 两个 LLM 骨干的六个基准-骨干设置上，AutoMem 平均提升准确率 2.8 点；在 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 上比最强准确率基线降低 14.3% token 成本；仅用少量引导迭代即可找到强于更大规模随机搜索的架构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AutoMem 能持续发现优于最强人工设计基线的任务自适应记忆架构，并在准确率与效率之间取得有利权衡；摘要未提及明显局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Explaining Reinforcement Learning Decisions in Self-adaptive Systems
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been extensively used in autonomous and self-* systems, but RL policies, especially deep RL ones relying on neural networks, lack transparency and are difficult to understand. This can lead to diminished user trust, and makes for a more challenging verification of systems. To address this challenge, this paper introduces Explanations using Alternative Realities for Reinforcement Learning (EARL), a Python library to produce counterfactual explanations in RL settings. This library allows the user to produce explanations by exploring What-if scenarios to clarify agent behavior by comparing possible outcomes. Counterfactual explanations have been shown to be intuitive and user-friendly in psychology research, but have only recently been explored in RL, with existing implementations usually limited to toy examples and benchmarks. EARL supports counterfactual explanation generation in realistic RL-based self-adaptive systems. To demonstrate its applicability, we demonstrate its use in a simulation of CitiBikes, a self-adaptive bike-sharing system, and we provide evaluations showing how it performs in real applications.
papers.comment: Accepted in the 20th Colombian Computing Congress. 13 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EARL (Explanations using Alternative Realities for Reinforcement Learning)，一个用于在强化学习 (RL) 设置中生成反事实解释 (counterfactual explanations) 的 Python 库，旨在提升深度 RL 策略在自主与自适应性系统中的透明度和可验证性。该库支持通过 What-if 场景比较可能结果来解释智能体行为，并在模拟的 CitiBikes 共享单车自适应系统中进行了演示和评估。
Motivation: RL 策略，尤其是依赖神经网络的深度 RL，缺乏透明性且难以理解，这会削弱用户信任并增加系统验证难度。现有 RL 反事实解释实现通常局限于玩具示例和基准，难以适用于现实的自适应系统。
Method: 提出 EARL 库，利用反事实解释方法，通过探索替代现实 (alternative realities) 的 What-if 场景来比较可能结果，从而在现实的基于 RL 的自适应系统中生成可解释的智能体行为说明。
Result: 在 CitiBikes 共享单车自适应系统仿真中演示了 EARL 的可用性，并提供了其在真实应用中的性能评估。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 EARL 能够将反事实解释扩展到现实规模的 RL 自适应系统，但未提供具体数值结果或对比基线。

papers.title: PIKFNO: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Physics Informed Kernel Function
papers.abstract_en: This work proposes a new interpretable neural operator framework, termed the Physics Informed Kernel Function Neural Operator (PIKFNO), which explicitly incorporates physics informed kernel functions derived from governing equations into the neural operator architecture. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which rely on deep networks to implicitly learn basis functions, PIKFNO constrains the trunk network through physics informed kernel functions, thereby aligning its operator structure with the kernel expansions used in meshless collocation methods. Two construction strategies are introduced: one learns kernel functions directly from data, where the learned kernel can be regarded as a nonsingular fundamental solution, while the other builds them through transformations of analytical fundamental solutions. Numerical experiments demonstrate that PIKFNO achieves high predictive accuracy with substantially improved interpretability and superior generalization under limited training data. The proposed framework offers a new pathway for developing efficient, physically consistent, and interpretable neural operators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释的神经算子框架 PIKFNO，将源于控制方程的物理信息核函数显式嵌入神经算子架构，使 trunk 网络受核函数约束，从而与无网格配点法中的核展开对齐。摘要报告其在有限训练数据下达到高预测精度，并显著提升可解释性与泛化能力。
Motivation: 传统神经算子如 DeepONet 依赖深度网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏可解释性且与经典数值方法的结构脱节；作者希望使算子结构与无网格配点法的核展开对齐。
Method: 提出两种物理信息核函数的构建策略：一种直接从数据学习核函数（可视为非奇异基本解），另一种通过解析基本解的变换构造，并将核函数显式约束 trunk 网络。
Result: 数值实验表明 PIKFNO 在有限训练数据下具备高预测精度、明显更好的可解释性以及更优的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该框架为发展高效、物理一致且可解释的神经算子提供了新途径；摘要未涉及天气或降水等具体应用领域。

papers.title: Calibrated Trust, Not Sharper Prediction: An Empirical Test of Uncertainty Fusion
papers.abstract_en: A recurring proposal in legal AI is to improve case-outcome prediction by fusing uncertainty tools (evidence graphs with belief propagation, sequential Bayesian odds updating, Dempster-Shafer combination, and conformal prediction) into one pipeline. We test this on 1,000 real European Court of Human Rights cases from LexGLUE and FairLex, predicting whether the Court found a Convention violation from the case's fact paragraphs. We compare three families across two frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5) as per-fact evidence estimators: (A) the raw LLM, (B) the LLM routed through the fusion pipeline, and (C) a term-frequency baseline through the same pipeline. Across roughly 4,750 tests we find: (1) on discrimination (AUROC around 0.83) the pipeline yields no improvement over either the raw LLM or the baseline; a frontier LLM used directly is the strongest single discriminator. (2) Naively composing an LLM with Bayesian-odds and Dempster-Shafer fusion more than doubles calibration error (ECE from about 0.16 to 0.46) via a prior-mismatch mechanism that replicates across both models. (3) Dempster-Shafer fusion is actively unsafe on long chains, committing confidently to wrong labels at below-chance accuracy; we recommend removing it. (4) The pipeline's genuine value is operational: routed through a conformal selective-prediction layer, the system decides which cases to automate and which to escalate. After removing Dempster-Shafer, recalibrating, and applying class-conditional risk control on the full 1,000-case set, the tuned engine auto-clears at 96.8 percent accuracy with 0.5 percent errors escaping and 96.3 percent caught for review, versus 85.9 / 3.8 / 72.1 for an untuned baseline. The contribution of such pipelines in law is calibrated trust, not sharper prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文实证检验了将不确定性工具（证据图+信念传播、序贯贝叶斯赔率更新、Dempster-Shafer 组合、保形预测）融合为法律案件结果预测流水线的效果。实验基于 LexGLUE 和 FairLex 中的 1,000 个真实欧洲人权法院案例，使用 Claude Opus 4.8 和 GPT-5.5 两个前沿 LLM 作为逐事实证据估计器，进行了约 4,750 次测试。结果显示融合流水线在判别能力上不优于直接使用 LLM；天真组合会使校准误差翻倍以上（ECE 从约 0.16 到 0.46）；Dempster-Shafer 融合在长链上不安全。移除 Dempster-Shafer、重新校准并应用类条件风险控制后，系统以 96.8% 准确率自动清除、0.5% 错误漏出、96.3% 错误被捕获审查，优于未调整基线的 85.9%/3.8%/72.1%。
Motivation: 法律 AI 中反复出现通过融合多种不确定性工具来改进案件结果预测的提议，但缺乏真实数据上的系统实证检验。作者希望测试此类流水线是否真的能带来预测性能提升。
Method: 在 1,000 个真实 ECHR 案例上比较三个家族：原始 LLM、经融合流水线路由的 LLM、以及通过同一流水线的词频基线；以两个前沿 LLM 作为逐事实证据估计器，并对比四种不确定性工具的组合效果。
Result: 在歧视类案件（AUROC 约 0.83）上融合流水线相对原始 LLM 或基线无改进；天真组合使 ECE 从约 0.16 升至 0.46；Dempster-Shafer 融合会在长链上以低于随机的准确率自信地犯错。移除 Dempster-Shafer 并调优后，引擎达到 96.8% 自动清除准确率、0.5% 错误漏出、96.3% 错误被捕获审查，对比未调优基线的 85.9%/3.8%/72.1%。
Conclusion: 作者强调此类不确定性融合流水线在法律领域的真实价值是产生校准的信任（calibrated trust），而非更尖锐的预测，并建议从流水线中移除 Dempster-Shafer 融合。

papers.title: Large Language Models and their Awareness of Mechanics and Spatial Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on established code-generation and mathematical-reasoning benchmarks, but their capabilities in mechanics and spatial geometry, here denoted as mechanical engineering awareness, has not been quantified systematically. We present MecEng, a fully automated benchmark that evaluates LLMs on the creation of multibody simulation models from parameterized textual descriptions. The benchmark comprises 84 generic tasks on three difficulty levels, ranging from rigid-body systems with joints and contact to flexible multibody systems that require exact 3D geometry generation, tetrahedral finite-element meshing, and Hurty-Craig-Bampton model order reduction of machine parts. A dedicated pipeline with LLMs generates simulation-ready geometry from text using Netgen, and builds multibody system models for the code Exudyn, which are then verified against expert ground truth on several levels: system-graph isomorphism including graph node annotations, numerical solutions, and part-specific measures such as mass, geometry, and eigenfrequencies. In total, 32 open-weight and two proprietary LLMs are evaluated. On rigid-body tasks, the best open-weight model obtains an overall success rate of 86.0%, compared to 91.4% for the strongest proprietary model, while flexible multibody tasks remain considerably harder. Additional studies quantify the influence of sampling temperature, reasoning, prompt design, model size, and LLM-release date. The results indicate rapidly improving, but still error-prone, mechanical engineering awareness of current LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MecEng，一个全自动基准，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）从参数化文本描述创建多体仿真模型的能力，涵盖刚体系统、接触和柔性多体系统（含四面体有限元网格和模型降阶）。基准包含 84 个任务、三个难度等级，并通过系统图同构、数值解和部件级指标（质量、几何、固有频率）与专家真值对比验证。作者评估了 32 个开源权重模型和 2 个专有模型，结果显示最佳开源模型在刚体任务上成功率为 86.0%，最强专有模型为 91.4%，而柔性多体任务仍显著更难。
Motivation: LLM 在代码生成和数学推理基准上表现良好，但它们在力学与空间几何（即机械工程感知）方面的能力尚未被系统量化，缺少一个可重复的评测基准。
Method: 构建 MecEng 基准，包含 84 个参数化文本描述的多体仿真建模任务；使用专用流水线让 LLM 借助 Netgen 从文本生成仿真就绪几何，并为 Exudyn 代码构建多体系统模型；再通过系统图同构（含图节点注释）、数值解以及质量、几何和固有频率等部件级指标进行多层验证。
Result: 在刚体任务上，最佳开源模型总体成功率为 86.0%，最强专有模型为 91.4%；柔性多体任务难度明显更高。额外研究量化了采样温度、推理、提示设计、模型规模和 LLM 发布日期的影响，表明当前 LLM 的机械工程感知能力快速提升但仍易出错。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM 在机械工程感知方面正在快速进步但仍存在明显错误，柔性多体建模仍是瓶颈。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DumpsterCluster: From Dumpster Diving to Serving LLaMA-70B on $60 GPUs
papers.abstract_en: As AI datacenters retire functional GPUs, vast quantities of still capable accelerators enter secondary markets. This paper investigates whether these retired GPUs can find a productive afterlife to form a DumpsterCluster that can serve modern LLM inference, and under what conditions such repurposing is economically viable and environmentally sustainable. We physically built a 128-GPU DumpsterCluster from scratch using only second-hand components and ran it for one year. At current market prices (\$22K for the DumpsterCluster vs. \$600K for an 8-GPU B200 system), the economic advantages are substantial. Through pipeline-parallel optimizations, our V100 based DumpsterCluster achieves competitive LLaMA-70B throughput, validating production viability. However, our deployment reveals critical context dependencies. Older GPUs consume significantly more energy per token, making total cost of ownership favorable only in regions with inexpensive electricity. Under grid-average carbon intensity, second-hand systems can produce approximately 4x higher total carbon emissions per token for 8B models, and over 40x for 70B models, compared to current-generation hardware. These findings show that GPU afterlife is not universally sustainable - hardware repurposing must be strategically coupled with low carbon energy sources. When deployed in regions with favourable energy economics and clean electricity, second-hand GPUs offer a viable pathway for expanding AI capacity while advancing affordability, energy security, and environmental responsibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨退役GPU能否通过二手硬件组成DumpsterCluster来服务现代LLM推理，并分析其经济与环境可持续性。作者用二手部件从零构建了一个128-GPU的V100集群并运行一年，在流水线并行优化下达到有竞争力的LLaMA-70B吞吐量，成本远低于新硬件。但部署显示旧GPU每token能耗和碳排放显著更高，只有搭配低廉电价和清洁电力时才具备可行性。
Motivation: AI数据中心持续淘汰仍可用的GPU，大量二手加速器进入市场；论文试图回答这些退役GPU能否在生产环境中服务LLM推理，以及在什么条件下这种再利用在经济上可行且环境上可持续。
Method: 作者用纯二手组件物理搭建了一个128-GPU的DumpsterCluster并运行一年，通过流水线并行优化（pipeline-parallel optimizations）来服务LLaMA-70B推理，并与8-GPU B200系统进行成本和吞吐量对比。
Result: 在市场价格上，DumpsterCluster约2.2万美元，而8-GPU B200系统约60万美元；V100集群在LLaMA-70B上取得有竞争力的吞吐量。然而在电网平均碳强度下，二手系统每token总碳排放量对8B模型约为当前硬件的4倍，对70B模型超过40倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调GPU的二次利用并非普遍可持续，必须与低碳能源和低廉电价相结合；在能源经济有利且电力清洁的地区，二手GPU才能成为扩展AI算力的可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do LLM Agents Negotiate Rationally? A Mechanism-Design Framework for Verifiable Multi-Agent Interaction over A2A/MCP
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM-agent frameworks increasingly interoperate through standards such as Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-to-tool access and Google's Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol for agent delegation and negotiation. However, these protocols specify transport and discovery rather than strategic correctness and do not guarantee efficient, individually rational, or strategy-proof outcomes. We introduce a framework that (i) encodes classical negotiation mechanisms, including alternating-offers bargaining and Vickrey-Clarke-Groves-style auctions, as constraints over A2A message schemas; (ii) provides a lightweight runtime verification and repair layer that checks messages against protocol invariants; and (iii) offers a benchmark of negotiation and allocation tasks with known optimal solutions for measuring deviations from game-theoretic predictions. We evaluate multiple LLM backbones using unstructured dialogue, structured protocols, and structured protocols with verification. Across negotiation trials (N=30 per condition), verification reduces outcome variance, while structured protocols achieve 100 percent success for both models. After correcting parser artifacts, audited unstructured baselines achieve approximately 97 percent and 93.3 percent success. In auction experiments (N=30 per model), both models achieve 100 percent efficient allocation but differ sharply in truthful bidding: one bids its exact valuation in every trial, whereas the other does so in only 3.3 percent of trials. Thus, mechanism-level incentive compatibility does not automatically transfer to LLM-agent behavior. A three-party fair-allocation task produced only 4.2 percent usable outcomes; we report this negative result with a diagnosis. This work bridges classical multi-agent systems theory and modern LLM-agent infrastructure and defines verifiable interaction at the A2A protocol layer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现代 LLM 智能体框架基于 MCP 与 A2A 等标准互操作时缺乏战略正确性的问题，提出一个机制设计框架：将交替报价谈判、VCG 式拍卖等经典机制编码为 A2A 消息模式的约束，并提供运行时验证与修复层以及带已知最优解的多方谈判/分配基准。作者评估多个 LLM 后端在无结构对话、结构化协议和结构化协议加验证三种条件下的表现，发现验证能降低结果方差，结构化协议在两条模型上均达到 100% 成功，但拍卖中的诚实出价行为差异显著；三方公平分配任务仅产生 4.2% 可用结果，作者将其作为附诊断的负面结果报告。
Motivation: A2A/MCP 等协议只规定传输与发现机制，不保证高效、个体理性或策略防护 (strategy-proof) 的结果，因此现有 LLM 智能体互操作缺少机制层面的战略正确性保障。
Method: 提出三类组件：一是把经典谈判机制（交替报价议价、VCG 式拍卖）写成 A2A 消息模式上的约束；二是轻量级运行时验证与修复层，检查消息是否违反协议不变量；三是带有已知最优解的谈判与资源分配基准任务，用于度量与博弈论预测的偏差。
Result: 在每条件 N=30 的谈判试验中，验证降低结果方差，结构化协议在两个模型上均实现 100% 成功；修正解析器伪影后，审计过的无结构基线分别达到约 97% 与 93.3% 成功。拍卖实验（每个模型 N=30）中两个模型都实现 100% 有效分配，但诚实竞价差异极大：一个模型每轮都按其真实估值出价，另一个模型仅 3.3% 的试验如此；三方公平分配任务只有 4.2% 的可用结果。
Conclusion: 机制层面的激励相容性不会自动迁移到 LLM 智能体行为上；该工作连接经典多智能体系统理论与现代 LLM 智能体基础设施，并在 A2A 协议层定义了可验证交互，同时以负面结果和诊断说明了公平分配中的困难。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Do LLMs Apply the Wrong Law? Diagnosing LLM Failures in Temporal Legal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Legal reasoning tasks such as legal judgment prediction (LJP) require identifying the temporally correct version of the law governing a case -- a capability we term temporal applicable-law determination. However, whether large language models (LLMs) can reliably perform this task remains unexplored. In this paper, we construct a benchmark to evaluate LLMs on temporal applicable-law determination, and systematically investigate why they fail at temporal legal reasoning. Our experiments reveal four key findings. First, LLMs exhibit a strong bias toward applying the most recently enacted law, regardless of when the legally relevant facts occurred. Second, this bias does not stem from an inability to understand that laws have temporal scope, nor from a lack of knowledge about historical statutes. Third, we provide behavioral evidence that reinforcement-learning-shaped explicit reasoning may be a key mechanism: while improving general reasoning ability, it reduces the diversity of reasoning paths, causing models to converge on applying the current law. Fourth, this produces a counterintuitive inverse relationship: models with stronger general reasoning ability tend to perform worse on temporal legal reasoning. Our findings offer concrete guidance for future work on improving LLM performance in temporally grounded legal reasoning.

papers.title: Understanding AI Anxiety in the Workplace: A Multimethod Investigation Using Fear Acquisition Theory and the Technology Acceptance Model
papers.abstract_en: As artificial intelligence (AI) rapidly diffuses and concerns about job displacement intensify, the psychological mechanisms underlying AI job replacement anxiety remain insufficiently understood. Drawing on Integrated Fear Acquisition Theory and the Technology Acceptance Model, the present research investigates whether AI job replacement anxiety can be elicited through vicarious exposure to narratives emphasizing AI-over-human control, and whether perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use of AI moderate this response. Across two studies, we examine AI job replacement anxiety as a response that emerges through vicarious exposure to narratives emphasizing AI agency and human control loss, rather than through direct personal experience of job displacement. Study 1 employed a randomized experiment (N = 316), demonstrating that such exposure increased AI job replacement anxiety. This effect was moderated by perceived usefulness of AI, but not by perceived ease of use, and remained robust after controlling for core self-evaluations. Study 2 (N = 995) replicated the association between perceived AI-over-human control and job replacement anxiety in an observational design and provided convergent evidence for the moderating role of perceived usefulness, supporting the external validity of the findings. Together, the results provide the first causal evidence that perceptual and vicarious processes can trigger AI job replacement anxiety. By shifting attention from structural labor-market conditions to how AI agency is perceived and communicated, this work offers a mechanism-based account of when and why AI-related job fears arise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于整合恐惧获得理论 (Integrated Fear Acquisition Theory) 与技术接受模型 (Technology Acceptance Model)，通过两项研究检验AI工作替代焦虑是否可由替代性接触 (vicarious exposure) 引发。研究1为随机实验（N=316），发现接触强调AI控制力的叙事会提高焦虑，且该效应受感知有用性调节而非感知易用性；研究2（N=995）在观察性设计中复现了感知AI控制与焦虑的关联。作者称这是关于感知和替代性过程可触发AI工作替代焦虑的首个因果证据。
Motivation: AI快速扩散与岗位替代担忧加剧，但AI工作替代焦虑背后的心理机制仍不清楚；既有研究多关注结构性劳动力市场条件，而较少考察AI主体性如何被感知与传播。
Method: 采用多方法设计：研究1为随机化实验，通过强调AI相对于人类的控制力与人类控制丧失的叙事进行替代性暴露，测量AI工作替代焦虑，并检验感知有用性和感知易用性的调节作用，同时控制核心自我评价；研究2为观察性设计（N=995），用于复现和验证外部效度。
Result: 研究1显示替代性暴露显著提高AI工作替代焦虑，该效应受感知有用性调节，不受感知易用性调节，并在控制核心自我评价后仍然稳健；研究2复现了感知AI控制与替代焦虑之间的关联，并再次支持感知有用性的调节作用。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果表明，AI工作替代焦虑可以通过感知与替代性过程被诱发，不应只归因于结构性劳动力市场因素；理解AI能动性如何被感知和沟通，有助于解释与预测AI相关职业担忧的成因。

papers.title: Plausible but Not Valid: A Psychometric Audit of LLMs as Synthetic Survey Respondents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic survey respondents, but existing evaluations ask whether answers look plausible at the individual level. We argue the right question is psychometric: do LLMs preserve the joint distribution, latent structure, reliability, mediation pathways, and demographic effects of real human survey data? We introduce a Lithuanian organisational-psychology dataset (n=263 employees; Dunham Attitudes Toward Change, UWES-17, Koopmans IWPQ; 68 items, 12 subscales) and condition a 37-model lineup spanning OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and twelve open-weight families on real respondent profiles under a five-level persona-disclosure ladder, presentation and reasoning-effort ablations, counterfactual demographic swaps (gender, role, education), a cross-language check, and a verbatim-recall memorization probe. The resulting Psychometric Similarity Score (PSS) is anchored against five non-LLM statistical baselines and a held-out human-vs-human ceiling, with respondent-bootstrap confidence intervals and an item-permutation null for Tucker's phi. LLMs reproduce the qualitative direction of human psychometric relationships, but a Gaussian-copula baseline beats every LLM on the sample-driven PSS components; the LLM "crowd" is more similar to itself (mean inter-LLM PSS 0.73) than to humans; and memorization does not drive the leaderboard (recall-PSS rank correlation 0.00). Counterfactual swaps reveal education-driven effects (mean |d|=0.56) that dwarf gender (0.12) and role (0.18); Tucker's phi on UWES falls inside the permutation null for 8 of 37 models. Downstream, every LLM shows a strong acquiescence shift (+0.84 SD), synthetic-trained regressors lose predictive validity on held-out humans (mean R^2 -0.18 vs 0.28), and models fabricate indirect effects on 3 of 10 placebo mediation paths. LLM samples are not a drop-in replacement for human survey data.
papers.comment: 50 pages, 9 figures. Under review. Code and data will be released upon publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 LLM 作为合成调查受访者的效度进行心理测量学审计，认为仅看单题答案是否逼真不够，关键是 LLM 是否保留真实调查数据的联合分布、潜在结构、信度、中介路径与人口学效应。作者引入立陶宛组织心理学数据集（n=263，68 题，12 个子量表），用 37 个模型在多种人格揭示层级、消融、反事实人口学置换与记忆探测下比较，提出心理测量相似度分数（PSS），并以多个非 LLM 统计基线和人类-人类上限为锚。结果显示 LLM 能复现人类关系的定性方向，但高斯 copula 基线在样本驱动 PSS 上超过所有 LLM，且 LLM 群体彼此更相似，存在显著默许偏移与下游预测效度损失。
Motivation: 现有评估只问 LLM 回答在个体层面是否看起来合理，忽略了作为合成调查受访者时 LLM 是否保留人类数据的联合分布、潜在结构、信度、中介路径与人口学效应的心理测量学问题。
Method: 构建 37 个模型的测试阵容（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 及 12 个开源权重家族），采用五级人格披露阶梯、呈现与推理努力消融、反事实人口学交换（性别、角色、教育）、跨语言检查和逐字回忆记忆探测；提出以五个非 LLM 统计基线和人类-人类上限为锚的 PSS，并用 respondent-bootstrap 置信区间和 Tucker's phi 的项目置换零分布进行推断。
Result: 摘要报告：高斯 copula 基线在每个样本驱动 PSS 分量上击败所有 LLM；LLM 间平均 PSS 为 0.73，高于 LLM 与人类的相似度；记忆探测与排行榜秩相关为 0.00；教育交换效应（均值 |d|=0.56）远大于性别（0.12）与角色（0.18）；37 个模型中有 8 个在 UWES 上的 Tucker's phi 落入置换零分布；所有 LLM 都有 +0.84 SD 的默许偏移，合成训练回归器对留出人类的预测效度下降（均值 R^2 从 0.28 到 -0.18），并在 10 条安慰剂中介路径中虚构了 3 条间接效应。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LLM 样本不能作为人类调查数据的即插即用替代品；尽管 LLM 能复现人类心理测量关系的定性方向，但在保持联合分布、信度和下游效度方面系统性地偏离真实数据。

papers.title: A Temporal Reasoning Benchmarking Framework for LRMs via Difficulty-controlled and Dynamic Test Generation
papers.abstract_en: Defining the reasoning boundaries and ensuring the reliability of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) remains a critical challenge. Current benchmarks primarily rely on static datasets susceptible to data contamination or synthetic tasks lacking fine-grained difficulty control. Furthermore, standard outcome-based evaluations often conceal reasoning flaws by neglecting the reasoning process. To address these limitations, we introduce TRACE, a testing framework that models temporal reasoning as constraint satisfaction problems via Allen's Interval Algebra. This approach enables precise regulation of logical complexity and incorporates a Trace-Based Verification Oracle to validate reasoning faithfulness. Using this framework, we construct TRACEBench, an extensive benchmark comprising 1,200 synthesized test instances across graded difficulty levels. We employ TRACE to evaluate eight widely used LRMs on TRACEBench. The results confirm a strong negative correlation between model performance and our difficulty metric (Pearson's r approximately -0.96), validating the effectiveness of our difficulty control mechanism. Moreover, our trace-based analysis exposes significant discrepancies between reasoning validity and final answers, revealing a high spurious guessing rate of approximately 28% in mid-sized models. In addition, we diagnose scale-dependent failure modes, ranging from Degenerative Loops in small models to Reasoning Explosion in advanced architectures. TRACE thus provides a robust, automated platform for benchmarking the true temporal reasoning capabilities of LRMs.
papers.comment: Accepted to ISSTA 2026. 23 pages including references, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE，一个面向大型推理模型（LRM）的时间推理基准测试框架，利用 Allen 区间代数将时间推理建模为约束满足问题，以精确调控逻辑复杂度，并加入基于轨迹的验证预言机（Trace-Based Verification Oracle）来检查推理忠实性。基于该框架构造了包含 1,200 个按难度分级测试实例的 TRACEBench，并评估了八个主流 LRM。结果显示模型性能与难度指标呈强负相关（Pearson r 约 -0.96），同时暴露出最终答案与推理有效性之间的显著偏差，中尺寸模型的虚假猜测率约 28%。
Motivation: 现有时间推理基准大多依赖易受数据污染影响的静态数据集，或缺乏细粒度难度控制的合成任务；同时，基于结果的评估往往忽略推理过程，无法揭示推理缺陷。
Method: TRACE 将时间推理任务转化为基于 Allen 区间代数的约束满足问题，从而实现逻辑复杂度的精确调节，并结合轨迹验证预言机对推理过程进行忠实性检查。
Result: 在 TRACEBench 上评估八个 LRM，性能与所提难度指标呈强负相关（Pearson r 约 -0.96）；轨迹分析暴露高虚假猜测率（中尺寸模型约 28%）；并诊断出随规模变化的失败模式，包括小型模型中的退化循环（Degenerative Loops）和高级架构中的推理爆炸（Reasoning Explosion）。
Conclusion: TRACE 为基准测试 LRM 的真实时间推理能力提供了一个稳健、自动化的平台，并验证了其难度控制机制的有效性以及结果导向评估可能掩盖推理问题的观点。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Wiola 13M, a Gated Spiral Attention Architecture for Parameter Efficient Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Small language models in the ten to one hundred million parameter range are attractive for on device inference, rapid experimentation, and controlled scientific study, yet most of them reuse the standard transformer block without adaptation to the small scale regime. We present Wiola, a decoder only language model whose novelty is concentrated in three drop in components of every layer. First, Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding perturbs the standard rotary frequencies by a slowly growing per dimension factor so that phase trajectories fan outward, improving long range discrimination while adding no parameters. Second, Gated Spiral Attention introduces a per head, content adaptive scalar gate derived from a causal cumulative statistic of the query stream, providing an implicit and differentiable form of soft head selection at negligible cost. Third, the Butterfly feed forward block replaces the conventional expansion layer with a multiplicative interaction and an intra block bypass path, matching the parameter count of a four times gated linear unit block while improving gradient flow in shallow stacks. We formalize each component, derive exact parameter and computation budgets, and prove that the gated attention admits an exact and numerically verified equivalence between full sequence training and cached autoregressive decoding, so that no approximation is introduced at inference time. We also describe a fully reproducible training and evaluation protocol on a standard tiny story corpus. The reference implementation is released as an open source package with weights ready publishing support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Wiola，一个 13M 参数规模的仅解码器 (decoder-only) 小语言模型，其创新集中在每个 Transformer 层的三个即插即用组件：Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding、Gated Spiral Attention 和 Butterfly feed forward block。作者形式化了各组件，给出精确的参数与计算开销预算，并证明门控注意力在整序列训练与缓存自回归解码之间具有精确等价性，推理时不引入近似。文章还给出在标准 tiny story 语料上的可复现训练与评估协议，并开源实现。
Motivation: 十到一亿参数规模的小语言模型适合端侧推理和快速实验，但大多数模型直接复用标准 Transformer 模块，没有针对小规模尺度做适配，本文针对这一空白提出定制化架构。
Method: 在每层引入三个替代组件：Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding 用逐维度缓慢增长因子扰动标准旋转频率，使相位轨迹向外扩散以改善长距离区分度且不增加参数；Gated Spiral Attention 基于查询流的因果累积统计量生成每头内容自适应标量门，以极低成本实现隐式且可微的软头选择；Butterfly 前馈块用乘性交互和块内旁路路径替代常规扩展层，在参数数量与四倍门控线性单元块相当的情况下改善浅层堆叠中的梯度流动。
Result: 摘要给出了各组件精确的参数与计算预算推导，并证明了门控注意力在整序列训练与缓存自回归解码之间存在精确且数值验证的等价性；同时提供了在标准 tiny story 语料上完全可复现的训练和评估协议，但未报告具体基准数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为这三个组件可以低成本地为小规模语言模型提供更好的长距离区分、隐式头选择与梯度流动，并强调无需在推理时引入近似；实现与权重以开源形式发布。

papers.title: Extend the Safety Horizon for Intelligent Transportation Systems through Semantic-Aware Cooperative Perception
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative perception enables vehicles and infrastructure to exchange sensor data via Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication, extending sensing coverage beyond occlusions and mitigating blind spots. While critical for autonomous driving and safety, practical deployments often rely on bandwidth-efficient late fusion. Recently, intermediate fusion has emerged as a promising approach for an optimal bandwidth-accuracy trade-off. However, in dense urban environments, cumulative bandwidth demands can overwhelm network capacity, potentially compromising safety-critical Cooperative Intelligent Transport Systems (C-ITS) functions. To alleviate these problems, this paper proposes Hierarchical Multi-Scale Semantic-Aware Cooperative Perception (HMS-SCP), a robust noise-resilient and bandwidth-efficient framework for task-oriented semantic communication in cooperative perception. HMS-SCP employs a spatial importance predictor to identify task-relevant grid elements at each scale, which are then directly mapped into complex-valued symbols for Joint Source-Channel Coding (JSCC). Unlike prior methods that rely on high-dimensional symbol projections for robustness, HMS-SCP exploits structural semantic redundancy across multiple scales to enhance resilience against channel noise, while maintaining an ultra-low symbol rate. This design significantly reduces bandwidth consumption and mitigates network congestion in high-density vehicular environments. Extensive evaluations on the simulated OPV2V and real-world DAIR-V2X datasets demonstrate that HMS-SCP effectively prevents performance collapse under severe Rayleigh fading and extreme compression ratio, maintaining high-confidence far-field detection with a real-time latency of below 16~ms, well within the safety-critical thresholds for dynamic V2X environments.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables, Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems (T-ITS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向协作感知 (cooperative perception) 的分层多尺度语义感知框架 HMS-SCP，用于车联网 (V2X) 环境下的任务导向语义通信。该方法通过空间重要性预测器筛选各尺度的任务相关网格元素，并将其直接映射为复值符号进行联合信源信道编码 (JSCC)，利用跨尺度的结构语义冗余抵抗信道噪声，同时保持极低符号率。在模拟数据集 OPV2V 和真实数据集 DAIR-V2X 上，该方法在严重瑞利衰落和极端压缩比下避免了性能崩溃，并保持低于 16 ms 的实时延迟。
Motivation: 实际部署的协作感知常依赖带宽高效的 late fusion，但在密集城市环境中，累计带宽需求可能压垮网络容量，危及安全关键的 C-ITS 功能；intermediate fusion 虽能取得带宽-精度折中，其带宽压力仍需进一步缓解。
Method: 提出 HMS-SCP，一种抗噪且带宽高效的语义通信框架；它使用空间重要性预测器在每个尺度上识别任务相关的网格元素，并直接将它们映射为复值符号用于 JSCC。与依赖高维符号投影的既有方法不同，HMS-SCP 利用多尺度间的结构语义冗余来增强对信道噪声的鲁棒性，同时维持超低符号率。
Result: 在模拟数据集 OPV2V 和真实数据集 DAIR-V2X 上的评估显示，HMS-SCP 在严重瑞利衰落和极端压缩比下仍能防止性能崩溃，维持高置信度的远场检测，并以低于 16 ms 的延迟满足动态 V2X 环境的安全临界阈值。
Conclusion: 作者认为，利用多尺度语义冗余而非高维投影，可以显著降低协作感知的带宽消耗并缓解高密度车辆环境中的网络拥塞，同时保持抗噪声能力与实时性。

papers.title: Demo: Real-time Generative Multicasting with On-Device Intent-aware Semantic Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: We present a demonstration for generative multicasting with on-device, intent-aware semantic decomposition. At the transmitter, DNN-based segmentation extracts a semantic map from the source video, decomposing it into multiple sub-signal classes based on multi-user receiver intents. The transmitter broadcasts the semantic map to all users over shared wireless/network resources, thereby utilizing orthogonal resources only to transmit the sub-signal classes intended for each user. Users partially reconstruct and partially synthesize the signal by combining the received intended classes with non-intended classes locally synthesized by a generative model from the semantic map. We derive the rate-distortion/perception curves for reconstruction/synthesis with the generative model, to adaptively set compression rates for the semantic map and intended classes. Generative multicasting significantly reduces the wireless/network resources required for existing/emerging multimedia multicasting applications. The system is real-time on a Google Coral Edge TPU with 4 TOPS (int8). This is the first demonstration of generative multicasting representing a substantial advancement in on-device generative SemCom.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文演示一种生成式组播（generative multicasting）系统：发射端用 DNN 分割从源视频提取语义图，并按多用户接收意图将其分解成多个子信号类；语义图通过共享无线/网络资源广播，仅用正交资源传输每个用户意图相关的子信号类。用户在接收目标类的同时，用生成模型从语义图本地合成非目标类，实现部分重建、部分合成。系统在 Google Coral Edge TPU（4 TOPS int8）上实时运行，并推导了率失真/感知（rate-distortion/perception）曲线用于自适应设置压缩率。
Motivation: 现有及新兴多媒体组播应用消耗大量无线/网络资源；作者希望在设备端利用语义通信（SemCom）与生成模型，把共享资源用在广播语义图上，只对每个用户实际意图对应的内容类使用正交资源，从而降低组播资源开销。
Method: 提出发射端 DNN 分割提取语义图并按多用户意图分解子信号类；基站或发射端广播语义图，仅对每个用户的目标类分配正交资源；接收端用生成模型从语义图本地合成非目标类并与接收到的类结合。作者推导重建/合成过程的率失真/感知曲线，用以自适应设置语义图和目标类的压缩率。
Result: 摘要报告该方法显著减少多媒体组播所需的无线/网络资源，并能在 Google Coral Edge TPU（4 TOPS int8）上实时运行；作者称这是生成式组播的首次演示，代表设备端生成式语义通信的实质性进展。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该演示是生成式组播的首个实现，并指出其在设备端生成式 SemCom 方向上具有重要推进意义；摘要未讨论具体基线与更多局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Intelligent Base Station Deployment in Urban Wireless Networks: A Geographic Data-Informed Digital Twin Approach
papers.abstract_en: The placement of base station (BS) is a fundamental determinant of coverage and capacity of urban wireless networks. Yet large-scale BS deployment optimization remains challenging due to its dependency on site-specific radio propagation and user spatial distributions, both of which are unfortunately difficult to obtain prior to deployment. To overcome this barrier, we propose an intelligent BS deployment framework that integrates a geographic data-informed wireless network digital twin (DT) with deep reinforcement learning (DRL), enabling sample-free macro BS deployment optimization from solely open geographic data, without on-site measurements, real user trajectories, or exhaustive ray tracing. The proposed DT incorporates a sample-free radio map prediction model with hybrid input representation to achieve kilometer-scale signal strength estimation in milliseconds, complemented by a diffusion-based generative model for trajectory synthesis to collectively characterize channel and user distributions. Leveraging the DT as a virtual training environment, we formulate BS deployment as a multi-step Markov decision process (MDP) and solve it via a spatially structured DRL algorithm. A local search process and a Wasserstein distance-based deployment buffer are further incorporated to efficiently explore the large combinatorial solution space. Experimental results in real-world urban scenarios demonstrate that the geographic data-informed DT attains accuracy comparable to 100-sample-based prediction, and the intelligent BS deployment framework achieves up to 98.9% of the idealized benchmark performance while reducing optimization overhead by over 99%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于地理数据的无线网络数字孪生（digital twin, DT）框架，结合深度强化学习（DRL）实现宏基站（macro BS）部署优化，仅依赖开放地理数据，无需实地测量、真实用户轨迹或穷举射线追踪。DT 集成了无采样的无线电地图预测模型和基于扩散模型的轨迹合成，可在毫秒级完成公里尺度信号强度估计；基站部署被建模为多步马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）并通过空间结构化的 DRL 求解。在真实城市场景中，该框架达到理想基准性能的 98.9%，同时优化开销降低超过 99%。
Motivation: 基站位置是城市无线网络覆盖和容量的基本决定因素，但大规模部署优化依赖部署前难以获取的站点特定传播特性和用户空间分布。传统方法需要现场测量或穷举射线追踪，成本高且难以扩展。
Method: 提出将地理数据驱动的无线网络数字孪生与 DRL 集成的智能部署框架；DT 包含具有混合输入表示的无采样无线电地图预测模型和用于轨迹合成的扩散生成模型，并作为虚拟训练环境；部署问题被形式化为多步 MDP，采用空间结构化 DRL 算法求解，并引入局部搜索与基于 Wasserstein 距离的部署缓冲区以高效探索大规模组合解空间。
Result: 实验表明，地理数据驱动的 DT 能达到与基于 100 样本预测相当的精度；智能部署框架在真实城市场景中可实现理想基准性能的 98.9%，并将优化开销减少超过 99%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调仅利用开放地理数据即可实现无现场测量的宏基站部署优化，为城市无线网络规划提供了一种低开销的数字孪生驱动方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Position: Medical AI Neglects Real Treatment Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Medical AI has rapidly improved its ability to perform diagnostic and prognostic tasks that lead to treatment decisions. But understanding of treatment itself is still inadequately trained and evaluated, using human opinions and syntheses (especially texts such as biomedical publications and clinical practice guidelines) rather than actual underlying data on treatment outcomes. This neglect seriously limits the potential of medical AI, and is already causing deficiencies in both frontier models and major benchmarks, as argued in this position paper. Real treatment outcomes, drawn from sources such as observational databases and randomized experiments, should be substantially incorporated into both training and evaluation. Improving these outcomes should be reemphasized as the downstream goal of all medical AI.

papers.title: Geometry Is Not Robustness: A Trajectory-Level Study of PGD Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) is widely used to evaluate adversarial robustness, typically via final adversarial accuracy, which does not capture model behaviour throughout the attack. Recent work proposes trajectory-level diagnostics, such as loss evolution, gradient alignment, and steps-to-failure, for deeper insight into adversarial optimisation dynamics. However, whether these diagnostics reliably indicate robustness strength remains unclear. We conduct a trajectory-level investigation of PGD attacks on convolutional neural networks trained on Fashion-MNIST. We compare clean-trained and adversarially-trained models across multiple robustness regimes, using rigorous 20-step PGD evaluations with random initialisation and multiple restarts for robustness measurement, and single-initialisation trajectory recording for diagnostics. We record full PGD trajectories across 3000 clean-correct samples per model and analyse loss evolution, gradient alignment, and failure timing across attack iterations. Our results reveal a clear robustness hierarchy across models; however, trajectory metrics do not contribute equally to its identification. Mean loss trajectories and gradient alignment patterns appear quantitatively similar across adversarially-trained models with substantially different robust accuracies. In contrast, steps-to-failure distributions provide a clearer separation of robustness regimes, directly reflecting functional resistance to adversarial perturbation. These findings indicate that trajectory-level diagnostics describe optimisation geometry but do not independently measure adversarial robustness. Their interpretability depends on robustness regime, attack strength, and multi-metric evaluation. Trajectory-level analysis should be a complementary diagnostic tool, interpreted in context, rather than a replacement for standard robustness measurements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 Fashion-MNIST 上训练的卷积神经网络开展 PGD 攻击的轨迹级 (trajectory-level) 研究，比较了干净训练与多种鲁棒训练模型在 20 步 PGD 下的损失演化、梯度对齐 (gradient alignment) 与失效步数 (steps-to-failure)。结果表明不同模型间存在清晰的鲁棒性层级，但各轨迹指标对识别该层级的贡献并不均衡：平均损失轨迹和梯度对齐在鲁棒准确率差异显著的对抗训练模型之间表现相似，而失效步数分布的区分度更好。作者据此认为轨迹级诊断刻画的是优化几何而非鲁棒性本身。
Motivation: PGD 评估通常只报告最终对抗准确率，无法捕捉模型在攻击全程中的行为；近期工作提出损失演化、梯度对齐、失效步数等轨迹级诊断，但这些指标是否可靠反映鲁棒性强弱仍缺乏验证。
Method: 在 Fashion-MNIST 上比较干净训练与对抗训练模型在多种鲁棒性机制下的表现；鲁棒性测量采用 20 步 PGD、随机初始化和多次重启，诊断则记录单初始化的完整 PGD 轨迹，每模型分析 3000 个干净分类正确样本，考察各攻击迭代下的损失演化、梯度对齐与失效时序。
Result: 摘要报告模型间存在明确的鲁棒性层级；但平均损失轨迹与梯度对齐模式在鲁棒准确率差异较大的对抗训练模型间定量相似，只有失效步数分布能更清晰地区分不同鲁棒性机制，直接反映对对抗扰动的功能性抵抗。
Conclusion: 轨迹级诊断描述的是优化几何，不能独立度量对抗鲁棒性；其可解释性依赖鲁棒性机制、攻击强度与多指标评估，应作为标准鲁棒性测量的补充诊断工具而非替代。
Relevance: 5
