papers.title: 6G Native AI and Channel Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and wireless communications is widely regarded as a core objective of sixth-generation (6G) systems. However, both the meaning of native AI and the type of AI capability that should be embedded into future wireless systems remain open to interpretation. This paper discusses 6G native AI from a system-design perspective and argues that native AI should be co-designed, optimized, and deployed as an intrinsic component of the wireless system rather than as a removable post-deployment add-on. From this perspective, conventional task-specific supervised models are difficult to use as the main technical basis of native AI because they depend heavily on labeled data, generalize poorly across propagation conditions, and require fragmented designs for different channel-related tasks. Motivated by these limitations, we position channel foundation models (CFMs) as a channel-centric foundation-model paradigm for 6G native AI. We define the scope of CFMs, clarify their differences from task-specific wireless AI models and large language models, and summarize three pretraining families: generative, discriminative, and hybrid pretraining. We further discuss how CFMs may support physical-layer processing, radio access network intelligence, and integrated sensing and communications. Preliminary CSI-CLIP-based results are included as bounded evidence that CFM-style pretraining can improve positioning and beam prediction when task-specific labels are limited.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从系统设计视角讨论6G原生AI（native AI），主张原生AI应作为无线系统的内在组成部分被共同设计、优化和部署，而非事后附加的模块。作者将信道基础模型（channel foundation models, CFMs）定位为6G原生AI的信道中心范式，界定其范围，区分其与任务特定无线AI模型及大语言模型的差异，并总结生成式、判别式和混合式三类预训练路线。摘要还给出基于CSI-CLIP的初步结果，显示在任务标签有限时CFM式预训练可改善定位与波束预测。
Motivation: 6G将AI与无线通信的融合列为核心目标，但‘原生AI’的含义以及应嵌入何种AI能力仍无定论；传统任务特定监督模型依赖标注数据、跨传播条件泛化差、需要为不同信道任务碎片化设计，因此难以作为原生AI的主要技术基础。
Method: 提出以信道基础模型（CFM）作为6G原生AI的信道中心范式，明确CFM的范围，并梳理生成式、判别式与混合式三种预训练族；同时讨论CFM如何支撑物理层处理、无线接入网智能和通感一体化（integrated sensing and communications）。
Result: 初步CSI-CLIP实验作为有界证据表明，在任务特定标签有限时，CFM式预训练可改善定位（positioning）和波束预测（beam prediction）；摘要未给出量化指标。
Conclusion: 摘要将CFM视为6G原生AI的一种可行路径，并强调初步结果仅为bounded evidence，说明该工作整体处于概念界定与早期验证阶段。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Toward Safe LLM Agents: A Survey of Specification, Verification, and Enforcement
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly perform irreversible real-world actions, including database updates, API calls, file operations, and autonomous use of tools. However, no existing system provides formally grounded, task-level safety guarantees for the plans these agents generate. Research remains fragmented across specification, verification, and enforcement, limiting understanding of the strengths and limitations of existing approaches. To address this gap, we conducted a PRISMA 2020 systematic review of 38 studies published between 2022 and 2026 and retrieved from six academic databases. Our analysis reveals four key findings. First, the specification bottleneck remains the primary challenge: natural-language-to-formal translation achieves only 24% to 35% semantic correctness, undermining downstream verification. Second, runtime monitoring is the most mature enforcement strategy, reducing unsafe actions by 40% to 65% in controlled settings, but it does not provide complete safety guarantees. Third, the verifier tax shows that blocking 94% of unsafe actions can still result in less than 5% safe task completion because agents exploit alternative unsafe paths. Finally, no existing approach simultaneously achieves soundness, scalability, semantic correctness, and task-level safety preservation. We contribute a three-level taxonomy, a comparative analysis of existing techniques, a synthesis of evidence on the verifier tax, and a ten-problem research agenda for trustworthy agentic AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于 LLM 智能体安全性的系统综述，基于 PRISMA 2020 方法对 2022 至 2026 年间的 38 项研究进行梳理，提出三层分类法（specification、verification、enforcement）并总结四项关键发现：自然语言到形式化转换的语义正确率仅 24%-35%，运行时监控是最成熟的执行策略但无法提供完整保证，阻断 94% 不安全动作仍可能导致不足 5% 的安全任务完成率（verifier tax），且现有方法无法同时满足健全性、可扩展性、语义正确性与任务级安全保持。论文还给出了关于可信任智能体 AI 的十项研究议程。
Motivation: LLM 智能体日益执行不可逆的真实世界操作（数据库更新、API 调用、文件操作和工具使用），但现有系统无法为其生成的计划提供形式化且有依据的任务级安全保证。相关研究在 specification、verification、enforcement 三个方向碎片化，缺乏对现有方法优劣的整体认识。
Method: 作者采用 PRISMA 2020 系统综述方法，从六个学术数据库检索 2022 至 2026 年间发表的文献，筛选出 38 项研究，并进行分类、对比与证据综合。
Result: 分析揭示四项核心发现：自然语言到形式化翻译的语义正确率仅 24%-35%，构成规范瓶颈；运行时监控可将受控环境中的不安全动作减少 40%-65%，但非完全保证；verifier tax 现象表明即使阻断 94% 的不安全动作，安全任务完成率仍可能低于 5%，因为智能体可走替代的不安全路径；现有方法均无法同时达到健全性、可扩展性、语义正确性和任务级安全保持。
Conclusion: 作者贡献了三层分类法、现有技术对比分析、关于 verifier tax 的证据综合，以及面向可信任智能体 AI 的十项研究议程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Hallucination Snowball: Modeling Error Propagation as State Transitions in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Sequential multi-agent LLM pipelines chain specialized agents without verification at handoffs, creating a structural flaw with measurable and severe consequences. We show that hallucinations injected at Stage 1 do not merely persist; they transform: raw numerical facts become derived computations, then narrative prose, then editorially approved conclusions. At each transformation, detectability degrades near-irreversibly. We formalize this as the hallucination snowball effect, a first-order Markov process over four states (Raw Fact $\to$ Derived $\to$ Narrative $\to$ Invisible) with empirically measured per-boundary escape probabilities of 24.6%, 48.3%, and 89.3%. Across 346 automatically injected hallucinations in a 4-agent financial analysis pipeline on FinanceBench, gpt-4o detection drops from 72.0% at Stage 1 to 50.9% at Stage 4, and 23.7% of hallucinations survive completely undetected in the final output. Even the strongest model tested (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, 87.0% at Stage 1) faces a structural ceiling; projected Stage 4 detection is only ${\sim}$60--65%. Critically, boundary gates using identical RAG verification tools reduce hallucination survival from 58.4% to 16.2% versus end-of-pipeline checking (Cohen's $h = -0.911$, $p < 0.000001$), while end-checking alone achieves merely 2.3 pp improvement over no verification. When you verify matters more than whether you verify. Our model predicts survival for $n$-agent linear pipelines and prescribes optimal verification resource allocation: invest at $S_1{\to}S_2$ first, where 75.4% of hallucinations are still catchable, not at $S_3{\to}S_4$ where 89.3% have already escaped.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures; accepted at the FAGEN Workshop (Failure Modes in Agentic AI), ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究顺序多智能体 LLM 流水线中幻觉在阶段间传递并逐级转换的现象，提出“幻觉雪球效应”模型，将幻觉状态建模为四态一阶马尔可夫过程（Raw Fact → Derived → Narrative → Invisible），并用 FinanceBench 上 4 智能体金融分析流水线的 346 次注入幻觉实测各边界逃逸概率。结果显示 gpt-4o 的检测率从 Stage 1 的 72.0% 降至 Stage 4 的 50.9%，23.7% 的幻觉在最终输出中完全未被发现；作者还对比了边界验证与端到端检查的效果，指出验证时机比是否验证更重要。
Motivation: 顺序多智能体 LLM 流水线在交接（handoff）时缺少验证，幻觉不仅持续存在还会逐阶段转变——从原始数字变为推导计算、叙事散文、最终编辑批准的结论，可检测性近乎不可逆地下降，形成具有可测量且严重后果的结构性缺陷。
Method: 将幻觉传播形式化为四态一阶马尔可夫过程，用 346 个注入幻觉在 FinanceBench 的 4 智能体金融流水线中实测每边界逃逸概率；并对比使用相同 RAG 验证工具的边界门控（boundary gates）与端到端检查，提出 n 智能体线性流水线的幻觉存活预测及最优验证资源分配策略。
Result: 摘要报告的每边界逃逸概率为 24.6%、48.3%、89.3%；gpt-4o 检测率从 Stage 1 的 72.0% 降至 Stage 4 的 50.9%，23.7% 的幻觉完全未被检测。最强测试模型 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 在 Stage 1 达 87.0%，但 Stage 4 的投影检测率仅约 60–65%。边界验证将幻觉存活率从 58.4% 降至 16.2%（Cohen's h = -0.911, p < 0.000001），端到端检查相比不验证仅提升 2.3 个百分点。

papers.title: An Agentic Framework Using Rules and LLMs for Embedding and Annotating Descriptive Document Layouts: A Plant Science Use Case
papers.abstract_en: Background: Recent advances in information retrieval (IR) leverage both dense and sparse representations, large language models (LLMs), and specialized retrieval models to improve ranking accuracy, relevance, and cross-lingual performance. Complementary techniques such as passage indexing, document layout analysis, and semantic knowledge representation further enhance retrieval effectiveness by capturing fine-grained contextual and structural information. Emerging agentic LLM frameworks extend these capabilities by enabling planning, iterative reasoning, tool use, and multi-agent collaboration, thereby broadening applications across diverse domains. These frameworks also emphasize rigorous evaluation, ethical considerations, and trustworthiness, ensuring responsible deployment in real-world settings. We propose a modular, agent-based pipeline for botanical trait extraction. Optical character recognition (OCR) converts PDFs into machine-readable text, while segmentation and indexing organize content by genus and species. Rule-based parsers extract structured botanical traits, and ensembles of large language models (LLMs) expand trait vocabularies and resolve ambiguities. This approach ensures accurate species recognition, scalable annotation, and explainable integration of textual botanical descriptions, enabling robust and interpretable data extraction across large botanical corpora. Results: Using three regional botanical datasets, our system extracted 55,737 trait annotations across 4,961 species, averaging 9.1 traits per species. Integration of LLM-based enrichment improved coverage for 75% of traits, increasing total annotations by 59%. While the choice of OCR engine had a minor effect on species recognition, overall annotation counts remained stable, demonstrating the robustness, scalability, and reliability of the pipeline for large-scale botanical trait extraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个模块化、基于智能体（agent-based）的流水线，用于从植物学文献PDF中提取性状标注。流水线先用OCR将PDF转为文本，按属种进行切分与索引，再用基于规则的解析器抽取结构化性状，并集成多个大语言模型（LLM）扩充性状词汇并消解歧义。在三个区域性植物学数据集上，系统提取了4,961个物种的55,737条性状标注，平均每物种9.1条；LLM enrichment将75%性状的覆盖度提升，总标注量增加59%。
Motivation: 植物学文献中存在大量非结构化的形态描述文本，需要一种可扩展且可解释的方式从中抽取结构化性状数据；仅靠规则或仅靠LLM难以同时保证准确率、覆盖率和可解释性。
Method: 提出模块化agent流水线：OCR将PDF转为机器可读文本，分割与索引按属种组织内容，规则解析器抽取结构化植物性状，多个LLM组成的集成用于扩展性状词汇表并解决歧义。
Result: 在三个区域植物学数据集上提取了4,961个物种的55,737条性状标注，平均每物种9.1条；LLM enrichment将75%性状的覆盖度提升，总标注量增加59%。OCR引擎选择对物种识别影响较小，标注总数保持稳定。
Conclusion: 作者认为该流水线在大规模植物学性状提取上具有稳健性、可扩展性和可靠性，能够实现准确物种识别、可扩展标注以及可解释的文本描述集成。

papers.title: Efficient Block-Layer Parallel Inference for Vision-Language-Action on Hybrid Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are becoming a promising paradigm for autonomous driving, but their deployment on existing vehicle platforms remains difficult because they introduce both high inference latency and strong GPU-side resource pressure. In a full autonomous driving stack, this problem is even more pronounced: legacy vehicle platforms were provisioned for modular pipelines, yet after several planning-related functions are absorbed into a unified VLA model, part of the original CPU budget becomes underutilized, while the visual encoder and the main reasoning path still concentrate most computation and memory demand on the GPU. As a result, directly deploying VLA together with the rest of the onboard system can be hard under realistic GPU memory constraints. To address this issue, we present a hybrid CPU--GPU inference framework with flexible resource scheduling for autonomous driving. Our design partitions the VLA backbone at the block-layer granularity, executes the visual encoder and LLM prefix on the GPU, and offloads the LLM suffix to the CPU through a cross-frame asynchronous pipeline, thereby exposing a schedulable boundary for redistributing compute and memory pressure across heterogeneous processors. We evaluate the proposed framework on two representative driving VLA models, Orion and MindDrive. On Bench2Drive, our method reduces average latency from 521ms to 408.0ms for Orion and from 443ms to 306.2ms for MindDrive, corresponding to 21.7% and 30.9% reduction, respectively. For Orion, the estimated peak GPU memory is further reduced from 45GB to 29GB. In real-vehicle deployment under coexistence with Autoware.Universe, native Orion cannot run because the onboard GPU memory budget is insufficient, whereas the hybrid version runs successfully together with the full vehicle stack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在车载平台上推理延迟高、GPU内存压力大的问题，提出一种混合 CPU-GPU 推理框架，按块层（block-layer）粒度划分 VLA 主干，将视觉编码器和 LLM 前缀放在 GPU，把 LLM 后缀通过跨帧异步流水线卸载到 CPU。在 Bench2Drive 上用 Orion 和 MindDrive 两个驾驶 VLA 模型验证，平均延迟分别从 521ms 降到 408.0ms、从 443ms 降到 306.2ms，Orion 的峰值 GPU 内存从 45GB 降至 29GB；在真实车辆上与 Autoware.Universe 共存时，混合版本可在原生版本因显存不足无法运行的条件下成功部署。
Motivation: VLA 模型成为自动驾驶的重要范式，但在现有车载平台上部署困难：统一 VLA 模型吸收若干规划功能后，原 CPU 预算部分闲置，而视觉编码器和主要推理路径仍把大部分计算与内存集中在 GPU 上，使得在现实 GPU 内存限制下难以与整车其他系统共同部署。
Method: 提出混合 CPU-GPU 推理框架，带灵活资源调度；以块层（block-layer）粒度切分 VLA 主干，GPU 执行视觉编码器和 LLM 前缀，CPU 通过跨帧异步流水线承接 LLM 后缀，从而在异构处理器之间形成可调度的边界来重新分配计算和内存压力。
Result: 在 Bench2Drive 上，Orion 平均延迟由 521ms 降至 408.0ms（降低 21.7%），MindDrive 由 443ms 降至 306.2ms（降低 30.9%）；Orion 的估计峰值 GPU 内存从 45GB 降至 29GB。在真实车辆部署中，与 Autoware.Universe 共存时，原生 Orion 因车载 GPU 内存预算不足无法运行，而混合版本能伴随完整车辆软件栈成功运行。
Conclusion: 作者表明通过块层粒度的异构 CPU-GPU 推理和跨帧异步流水线，可以在满足车载 GPU 内存约束的同时显著降低 VLA 推理延迟，使混合部署在真实整车栈中可行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Euclid-Omni : A Unified Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Plane Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Euclidean geometry is a compelling testbed for AI reasoning, as it demands the combination of intuitive diagram understanding, axiomatic deduction, and algebraic computation. Yet, existing approaches typically address only a subset of these abilities or struggle with competition-level problems. We introduce \textit{Euclid-Omni}, a unified neuro-symbolic framework that couples a formal geometry system with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to tackle both calculation- and proving-style problems, in formal and natural languages, up to Olympiad-level difficulty. At its core, we develop \textit{Euclidea}, a versatile symbolic geometry solver that automatically generates reasoning steps through deductive inference and algebraic computation. Building on this, we develop a data-generation pipeline that synthesizes symbolic problems and solutions, renders diagrams, and translates them into natural language, producing large-scale, diverse datasets for training LLMs and VLMs across a wide range of reasoning settings. Experiments show that VLMs trained on our synthetic data achieve superior performance on calculation tasks, and that LLMs combined with \textit{Euclidea} are competitive with state-of-the-art systems on Olympiad-level proving problems, despite using orders of magnitude less compute and training data. Code and scripts are publicly available at https://github.com/20171130/Euclid-Omni
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Euclid-Omni，一个统一神经符号框架，将形式化几何系统 Euclidea 与 LLM/VLM 结合，用于处理平面几何中的计算题和证明题，支持形式语言与自然语言，目标覆盖至奥林匹克级别难度。作者构建数据生成管线，自动合成符号问题与解答、渲染图形并翻译为自然语言，以大规模训练 LLM/VLM。实验显示 VLM 在计算任务上表现优越，LLM 结合 Euclidea 在奥林匹克级证明问题上与最先进系统竞争，且所需计算量和训练数据少几个数量级。
Motivation: 欧氏几何推理要求同时具备图形理解、公理演绎和代数计算能力，而现有方法通常只覆盖其中部分能力，或难以应对竞赛级问题。
Method: 提出 Euclid-Omni，核心是名为 Euclidea 的符号几何求解器，通过演绎推理和代数计算自动生成推理步骤；在此基础上构建数据生成管线，从符号问题合成、图形渲染到自然语言翻译，为 LLM 和 VLM 生成大规模多样化训练数据。
Result: 实验表明，基于合成数据训练的 VLM 在计算类任务上取得优越性能；LLM 与 Euclidea 结合后在奥林匹克级证明问题上可媲美最先进系统，同时使用少几个数量级的计算量和训练数据。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一神经符号框架能够同时覆盖计算与证明、形式语言与自然语言多种几何推理场景，并公开了代码和脚本。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Generative Fuzzy System: Fuzzy Inference Guided Large Model Interactive Question Answering Framework
papers.abstract_en: In Multimodal Question Answering (MQA), models are required to jointly encode and integrate heterogeneous information from multiple modalities, including text, images, and speech, to perform complex semantic reasoning and decision making. Despite recent advances, existing approaches, including traditional deep learning models and Large Models (LMs) or prompt-based frameworks, continue to face several critical challenges. First, modality bias arises from discrepancies in feature distributions across different modalities, which limits effective cross modal collaborative understanding. Second, many questions require knowledge drawn from multiple domains, introducing significant uncertainty. Third, current methods often rely on shallow semantic matching, resulting in limited reasoning depth an reduced interpretability. To address these issues, inspired by the traditional fuzzy system (FS) framework, we propose a fuzzy-inference-guided multimodal generative architecture termed the Multi-Modal Generative Fuzzy System (MMGFS). The main contributions of MMGFS are two folds. First, it alleviates modality bias through a multimodal collaborative rumination mechanism. Second, it introduces fuzzy rules and a multi-hop inference mechanism to support cross-domain knowledge fusion and hierarchical reasoning, thereby strengthening uncertainty modelling and deepening semantic understanding. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on open-domain question answering datasets, including MultimodalQA and WebQA, as well as domain-specific benchmarks, including BioMol-VQA and EHRxQA. Experimental results demonstrate that MMGFS consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple datasets. It effectively mitigates modality bias and question uncertainty while achieving superior performance in answer accuracy, consistency, and generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态问答 (MQA) 中的模态偏差、跨领域不确定性和浅层语义匹配问题，提出一种受传统模糊系统 (fuzzy system) 启发的多模态生成式架构 MMGFS (Multi-Modal Generative Fuzzy System)。该架构通过多模态协同反思机制缓解模态偏差，并引入模糊规则与多跳推理机制以支持跨领域知识融合和层级推理。在 MultimodalQA、WebQA 以及 BioMol-VQA、EHRxQA 等数据集上的实验显示，MMGFS 在答案准确性、一致性和泛化性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多模态问答方法（包括传统深度学习和基于大模型/提示的方法）仍面临模态偏差、多领域知识带来的不确定性以及推理深度不足和可解释性有限等关键挑战。
Method: 提出 MMGFS，一种模糊推理引导的多模态生成架构：包含多模态协同反思机制以缓解模态偏差，并利用模糊规则和多跳推理机制进行跨域知识融合与层级语义理解。

papers.title: Evaluating the impact of adversarial traffic patterns on vanet communication using veins simulation
papers.abstract_en: Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) are a key component of intelligent transportation systems, enabling real-time communication between vehicles. However, their open and dynamic nature makes them highly vulnerable to adversarial behaviors that can disrupt communication reliability. This paper investigates the impact of adversarial traffic patterns on VANET performance using the Veins simulation framework integrated with OMNeT++ and SUMO. We design and evaluate multiple adversarial scenarios, including message flooding, false information dissemination, and coordinated congestion attacks, under varying traffic densities and mobility conditions. The study measures key performance metrics such as packet delivery ratio (PDR), end-to-end delay, and network throughput. Experimental results show that adversarial traffic can reduce PDR by up to 96.55%, with message flooding at low density producing a throughput reduction of 27.89%, and significantly degrade overall network efficiency. The findings highlight critical vulnerabilities in VANET communication and provide insights into designing more resilient and secure vehicular networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用 Veins 仿真框架（集成 OMNeT++ 与 SUMO）评估对抗性交通模式对 VANET 通信性能的影响。摘要报告了消息洪泛、虚假信息传播和协同拥塞攻击等多种对抗场景在不同交通密度和移动性条件下的表现，并测量数据包投递率（PDR）、端到端时延和网络吞吐量。实验显示对抗性交通最多可使 PDR 降低 96.55%，并显著恶化网络效率。
Motivation: VANET 的开放性和动态性使其易受对抗行为干扰，通信可靠性面临严重威胁；需要系统化的仿真研究来量化这些攻击的影响。
Method: 作者在 Veins 框架中结合 OMNeT++ 与 SUMO，设计了消息洪泛、虚假信息传播和协同拥塞攻击等对抗场景，并在不同交通密度与移动性条件下评估 PDR、端到端时延和吞吐量等关键性能指标。
Result: 摘要报告对抗性交通可降低 PDR 高达 96.55%；在低密度场景下，消息洪泛导致吞吐量减少 27.89%，整体网络效率显著下降。
Conclusion: 研究发现 VANET 通信存在关键漏洞，并为设计更具弹性和安全性的车载网络提供了洞察。

papers.title: Characterization of Thermal Systems from Noisy and Low-resolution Measurements Using Dynamic Mode Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Thermal monitoring in practical applications is often constrained by sparse sensing, measurement noise, and limited spatial resolution, which hinder the identification of heat transfer dynamics. In such settings, calibrating high-fidelity physical models is computationally demanding, motivating data-driven approaches. Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) provides a framework for extracting spatiotemporal structures from measurement data, but its standard formulation is sensitive to noise and degraded observations. This chapter examines the use of DMD under these constraints, focusing on preprocessing and truncation strategies that affect stability and interpretability. Two cases are considered: forced convection with thermocouple data and transient heat conduction from degraded thermal images. The number of retained modes is treated as a modeling parameter that governs the trade-off between reconstruction fidelity and noise sensitivity. The results indicate that DMD recovers dominant thermal behavior from both sparse and degraded datasets when the truncation level is appropriately selected. Low-rank models provide stable but simplified descriptions, while higher-rank models improve spatial detail at the cost of increased noise sensitivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在稀疏传感、测量噪声和低空间分辨率约束下，利用动态模态分解 (Dynamic Mode Decomposition, DMD) 从测量数据中提取热系统的传热动力学特征。作者将保留模态数视为建模参数，考察预处理与截断策略对稳定性和可解释性的影响，并以热电偶测得的受迫对流数据和退化热图像的瞬态热传导两个案例进行验证。结果表明，在适当选择截断水平时，DMD 能从稀疏和退化数据中恢复主导热行为。
Motivation: 实际热监测常受稀疏传感、测量噪声和低空间分辨率限制，妨碍传热动力学的识别；同时校准高保真物理模型计算代价高昂，因此需要数据驱动方法，而标准 DMD 对噪声和退化观测较为敏感。
Method: 采用 DMD 框架，重点研究预处理与截断策略对稳定性和可解释性的影响，把保留模态数作为调节重建保真度与噪声敏感性权衡的建模参数，并应用于热电偶数据和退化热图像两类场景。
Result: 摘要报告在截断水平选择适当时，DMD 能从稀疏和退化数据集中恢复主导热行为；低秩模型提供稳定但简化的描述，高秩模型改善空间细节但噪声敏感性增加。
Conclusion: 作者强调截断水平的恰当选择是 DMD 在噪声和低分辨率观测下有效工作的关键，其适用范围为热系统特征化；摘要未给出具体的定量实验数字。

papers.title: OGX: An Open-Source, Vendor-Neutral Generative AI Application Server
papers.abstract_en: OGX (Open GenAI Stack) is an open-source AI application server and Python library that implements the APIs of major frontier labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) with pluggable backend providers. Developers building agentic AI applications--such as retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, multi-turn agents, and tool-calling workflows--can develop against a single API surface and deploy with any combination of inference engine, vector database, and safety backend, without changing application code. OGX's primary focus is the Responses API for server-side agentic orchestration, conforming to the Open Responses specification. The server also supports the Anthropic Messages API and Google GenAI Interactions API, decoupling SDK choice from model and deployment decisions. With over 20 inference providers, 13 vector store backends, and a companion Kubernetes Operator for production deployment, OGX serves as the self-hosted, model-agnostic backend for AI-powered developer tools including Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, and OpenHands. The project has over 8,400 GitHub stars, 242 contributors, and 4,000 commits across nearly two years of public development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OGX (Open GenAI Stack) 是一个开源 AI 应用服务器和 Python 库，实现了 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等前沿实验室的 API，并提供可插拔的后端提供方。它主要聚焦于 Responses API 用于服务端 agentic 编排，同时支持 Anthropic Messages API 和 Google GenAI Interactions API，目标是让开发者通过单一 API 面切换推理引擎、向量数据库和安全后端。项目已有超过 8,400 个 GitHub stars、242 位贡献者和约 4,000 次提交。
Motivation: 构建 agentic AI 应用（如 RAG 流水线、多轮 agents、工具调用工作流）时，开发者常被锁定在特定模型或部署方案；OGX 旨在解耦 SDK 选择与模型及部署决策，使应用代码无需改动即可适配不同基础设施。
Method: 提供开源服务器和 Python 库，实现 Open Responses、Anthropic Messages、Google GenAI Interactions 等 API 规范，支持 20+ 推理提供方、13 个向量存储后端，并附带 Kubernetes Operator 用于生产部署。
Result: 摘要未给出量化实验指标，主要报告生态数据：20+ 推理提供方、13 个向量存储后端、8,400+ GitHub stars、242 位贡献者、约 4,000 次提交，并被 Claude Code、Codex CLI、OpenCode、OpenHands 等开发者工具用作自托管后端。
Conclusion: OGX 定位为自托管、模型无关的 AI 应用服务器，通过统一 API 面与可插拔后端实现生成式 AI 服务在不同推理引擎和存储之间的可移植部署。

papers.title: SKILL: Self-correcting Knowledge-guided Iterative Large Language Model Agent for Logic Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Logic synthesis optimization poses significant challenges due to exponentially growing search spaces, sparse reward signals, and diverse logic structures. Traditional expert-designed flows lack adaptability, while reinforcement learning (RL) methods often suffer from low sample efficiency and limited interpretability. We introduce SKILL, a Self-correcting Knowledge-guided Iterative Large Language Model Agent that unifies multi-agent LLM reasoning and RL-based environment interaction for automated synthesis optimization. SKILL coordinates three specialized LLMs: GPT-4o for strategic planning, Claude Sonnet 4 for detailed reasoning, and Gemini 2.5 Pro for efficient analysis with a PPO-based RL agent that learns actionable policies through direct interaction with synthesis tools. A novel self-correcting module monitors environment feedback (PDA metrics), detects suboptimal behaviors, and invokes LLM-guided recovery strategies. Evaluations on IWLS, OpenCores, and EPFL benchmarks show SKILL achieves a 12.4 % PDA improvement over expert flows and 86.3% success rate on logic systems up to 500K gates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SKILL，一个用于逻辑综合优化的自纠正知识引导迭代 LLM agent，统一了多 agent LLM 推理与基于 RL 的环境交互。系统由三个专门 LLM（GPT-4o 负责策略规划、Claude Sonnet 4 负责详细推理、Gemini 2.5 Pro 负责高效分析）加上一个基于 PPO 的 RL agent 组成，并通过自纠正模块根据环境反馈（PDA 指标）检测次优行为并触发 LLM 引导的恢复策略。在 IWLS、OpenCores 和 EPFL 基准上，SKILL 相比专家流程取得 12.4% 的 PDA 改进，并在最高 500K 门的逻辑系统上达到 86.3% 的成功率。
Motivation: 逻辑综合优化面临指数级增长的搜索空间、稀疏的奖励信号以及多样的逻辑结构，传统专家设计的流程缺乏适应性，而强化学习 (RL) 方法往往样本效率低且可解释性有限。
Method: SKILL 将多 agent LLM 推理与环境交互结合：GPT-4o 用于策略规划，Claude Sonnet 4 用于详细推理，Gemini 2.5 Pro 用于高效分析，并配备 PPO-based RL agent 通过与综合工具直接交互学习可执行的策略。自纠正模块监测 PDA 指标等环境反馈，检测次优行为并调用 LLM 引导的恢复策略。
Result: 在 IWLS、OpenCores 和 EPFL 基准上，SKILL 相对专家流程实现了 12.4% 的 PDA 提升，并在最高 500K 门的逻辑系统上取得 86.3% 的成功率。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 SKILL 通过自纠正的知识引导迭代方式在逻辑综合优化中优于专家流程，并能扩展到较大规模的逻辑系统。

papers.title: Longitudinal and Graph-Augmented Prediction of Adolescent Substance Use Onset in the ABCD Study
papers.abstract_en: Early identification of adolescent substance-use risk is an important prevention challenge, yet the relative value of baseline characteristics, longitudinal trajectories, and relational context remains unclear. Using data from approximately 11,860 participants in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study, we compare cross-sectional, longitudinal, and graph-based approaches for predicting alcohol sipping, alcohol use, marijuana use, and alcohol/marijuana use. We evaluate tree-based models, recurrent neural networks, and Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks (T-GCNs) constructed from family, school, and feature-similarity graphs. Longitudinal models consistently outperform baseline models, with temporal XGBoost achieving the strongest standalone performance. Although T-GCNs generally do not surpass temporal XGBoost, graph-derived risk scores provide complementary information. Combining temporal XGBoost and T-GCN predictions through score-level stacking yields the best performance across all outcomes, achieving AUC-ROC values above 0.79. Feature analyses identify peer deviance, age, externalizing symptoms, parental monitoring, cultural norms, and neighborhood context as important predictors of substance use onset. These findings demonstrate the value of longitudinal modeling for substance-use prediction and suggest that graph-based representations can provide effective auxiliary risk signals.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用ABCD研究中约11,860名青少年的数据，比较横截面、纵向和图增强方法预测物质使用起始（饮酒、大麻等）。结果显示纵向模型一致优于基线模型，时间XGBoost表现最强，将时间XGBoost与T-GCN分数级堆叠可在所有结局上取得最佳性能（AUC-ROC高于0.79）。特征分析识别出同伴偏差、年龄、外化症状等关键预测因子。
Motivation: 青少年物质使用风险的早期识别是重要的预防挑战，但基线特征、纵向轨迹和关系背景的相对价值尚不明确。
Method: 基于ABCD研究数据，比较树模型、循环神经网络（RNN）和基于家庭、学校及特征相似图构建的时间图卷积网络（T-GCN），并通过分数级堆叠（score-level stacking）集成时间XGBoost与T-GCN的预测。

Conclusion: 研究证明纵向建模对物质使用预测的价值，并表明图表示可提供有效的辅助风险信号。

papers.title: HarmProfile: Characterizing Harmful Distributions in Frontier LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Frontier large language models (LLMs) safety evaluation has largely treated harmful generation as an attack outcome rather than as an object of analysis. Consequently, little is known about the harmful outputs produced during model misbehavior, partly because large-scale, high-quality collections of frontier-LLM misbehavior are difficult to obtain. To address this gap, we introduce HarmProfile, a content-centric benchmark dataset that collects model misbehavior across diverse harm categories and model families, and defines the resulting harmful-output distribution as a model-level risk profile. The premise is that, just as linguistic behavior can be characterized from an utterance corpus, model risk can be characterized from the content, severity, and variation of its safety failures. HarmProfile contains over 80,000 validated artifacts from 23 frontier LLMs across 13 model families, organized into 15 harm categories and 57 subcategories. Using this corpus, we find that frontier LLMs reliably produce harmful content at scale, yet exhibit distinct risk profiles; both harmfulness and diversity grow with model capability, suggesting that frontier LLMs may appear safe yet harbor increasingly dangerous knowledge beneath the alignment surface. Our source code is available at https://github.com/fresh-ma/HarmProfile .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HarmProfile，一个以内容为中心的基准数据集，用于收集前沿大语言模型 (frontier LLM) 在多种危害类别和模型家族下的不良行为输出，并将这些有害输出分布定义为模型级风险画像 (risk profile)。数据集包含 80,000 多个经验证的样本，来自 23 个前沿 LLM、13 个模型家族，覆盖 15 个危害类别和 57 个子类别。基于该语料，研究发现前沿 LLM 能大规模稳定产生有害内容，不同模型呈现不同的风险画像，且危害性与多样性随模型能力提升而增长。
Motivation: 现有前沿 LLM 安全评估大多将有害生成视为攻击结果而非分析对象，导致对模型不良行为期间的有害输出缺乏系统性认识；同时，大规模、高质量的前沿模型不良行为数据难以获取，制约了该方向的研究。
Method: 作者构建 HarmProfile 内容中心基准，系统收集跨危害类别与模型家族的模型误行为输出，并借鉴语料语言学视角，用安全失败的内容、严重程度和变异来刻画模型级风险画像。
Result: HarmProfile 含 80,000 多个已验证样本，覆盖 23 个前沿 LLM、13 个模型家族、15 个危害类别和 57 个子类别；摘要报告前沿 LLM 能够大规模稳定产生有害内容，且不同模型具有显著不同的风险画像，危害性与多样性随模型能力增强而增长。
Conclusion: 作者认为前沿 LLM 可能表面安全，但在对齐 (alignment) 表面之下潜藏日益危险的知识，并公开了源代码供社区使用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Reactive to Autonomous: Evolution of AI Operations in Cloud Network Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: The operational model for cloud network infrastructure has undergone a fundamental transformation over the past decade. What began as manual, human-driven troubleshooting has evolved through scripted automation, rule-based systems, and AI-assisted operations into fully autonomous incident resolution. This paper traces the evolution of AI operations (AIOps) in cloud network infrastructure, identifying the architectural patterns, organizational challenges, and technical inflection points that enabled each generational transition. Drawing from production experience operating network infrastructure at hyperscale, we present a maturity model that characterizes five distinct operational generations, analyze the technical and organizational barriers that impede transitions between generations, and document the metrics that indicate readiness for increased autonomy. We show that the path from reactive to autonomous operations is not merely a technology problem but requires co-evolution of tooling, trust frameworks, knowledge management practices, and operational culture. Our findings provide a practical roadmap for infrastructure organizations seeking to adopt progressively autonomous AI operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文回顾了过去十年云网络基础设施运维从人工排障、脚本自动化、规则系统、AI 辅助到完全自主事件响应的演进过程，提出一个包含五个运维代际的成熟度模型，并基于超大规模网络基础设施的生产经验分析代际迁移的技术与组织障碍。作者认为从被动到自主运维不仅是技术问题，还需要工具、信任框架、知识管理与运维文化的共同演进。
Motivation: 云网络基础设施的运维模式已发生根本变化，但缺少对从人工到自主运维演进路径的系统性梳理，尤其是代际迁移的障碍与就绪度指标。
Method: 基于超大规模网络基础设施的生产经验，提出一个刻画五个不同运维代际的成熟度模型，分析阻碍代际迁移的技术与组织壁垒，并给出表明可提升自主性就绪度的指标。
Result: 摘要指出自主运维的路径需要工具、信任框架、知识管理实践与运维文化的协同演进，并为基础设施组织提供了逐步采用自主 AI 运维的实用路线图。
Conclusion: 论文强调从被动到自主运维的转变不仅是技术问题，组织与文化因素同等关键；该成熟度模型可作为基础设施组织规划自主运维转型的参考。

papers.title: WARA: Toward Automated Wireless Optimization Research with Closed-Loop LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of tool use, code execution, artifact inspection, and iterative revision, creating new opportunities for automating scientific and engineering research. To the best of our knowledge, this paper presents the first end-to-end autoresearch framework for the wireless domain, with a focus on wireless resource allocation optimization. We propose the Wireless AutoResearch Agent (WARA), a closed-loop multi-agent system for automated wireless optimization research. Given only an initial topic, WARA decomposes the workflow into three phases: research gap identification and problem proposal, wireless optimization modeling, algorithm design and experimentation, and research deliverable construction. Across these phases, WARA uses artifact-mediated control: upstream artifacts are consumed as inputs, structured outputs are stored for downstream use, and controller-managed gates validate consistency among models, algorithms, experiments, and claims. When validation fails, WARA repairs only the responsible artifact instead of restarting the whole workflow. We present a representative wireless resource allocation case study showing how WARA converts an initial topic into a complete research package with executable evidence and a synthesized technical manuscript. We further design a structured LLM-based ScoringAgent to evaluate manuscript-level research validity and optimization research maturity. Comparative results show that WARA substantially outperforms one-shot LLM generation and approaches the quality profile of recently accepted peer-reviewed technical papers. These results indicate that closed-loop artifact control is a promising path toward end-to-end LLM-assisted wireless optimization research. The source code is available at https://github.com/guoyuan-dotcom/WARA_CUHKSZ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Wireless AutoResearch Agent (WARA)，据作者称这是无线领域首个端到端自动科研 (autoresearch) 框架，专注于无线资源分配优化。给定一个初始研究主题，WARA 以闭环多智能体系统将工作流分解为研究空白识别与问题提出、无线优化建模与算法设计实验、研究成果构建三个阶段，并通过工件中介控制 (artifact-mediated control) 与控制器门控来保证模型、算法、实验和结论之间的一致性。作者用无线资源分配案例展示了从初始主题到完整研究包（含可执行证据与合成技术手稿）的转换，并设计了基于 LLM 的 ScoringAgent 评估手稿级研究有效性与优化研究成熟度。
Motivation: LLM 智能体已具备工具调用、代码执行、工件检视与迭代修订能力，为自动化科研创造了机会，但此前没有面向无线领域的端到端自动科研框架；无线优化研究自动化仍是一个空白。
Method: WARA 将流程分为三个阶段：研究空白识别与问题提出、无线优化建模及算法设计与实验、研究交付物构建；各阶段通过工件中介控制衔接，上游工件作为输入、结构化输出供下游使用，控制器门控校验一致性，校验失败时只修复出问题的工件而非重启整个流程。此外还提出结构化的 LLM 基 ScoringAgent 对手稿级研究有效性和优化研究成熟度进行打分。
Result: 在代表性无线资源分配案例中，WARA 能把初始主题转化为包含可执行证据和合成技术手稿的完整研究包；对比实验表明其明显优于一次性 (one-shot) LLM 生成结果，质量接近近期通过同行评审的技术论文。
Conclusion: 作者认为闭环工件控制是走向端到端 LLM 辅助无线优化研究的一条有前景的路径，并公开了源代码；论文聚焦无线资源分配优化场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Position: Want Better ML Reviews? Stop Asking Nicely and Start Incentivizing with a Credit System
papers.abstract_en: With soaring submission counts, stricter reciprocal review policies, widespread adoption of platforms like OpenReview, and without the offsetting pressure of publication fees, the machine learning (ML) community has one of the largest scholarly presences among all scientific fields. And yet, \textbf{almost \textit{everyone} has \textit{many} unpleasant things to share about their review experience.} Worse, there is little public space to seriously discuss, let alone debate, what makes a review system effective or how it might be improved.\quad In this position paper, we expand our discussion from two core problems: \textit{How can we reasonably limit submission volume?} and \textit{How can we incentivize good and discourage bad reviewing?} We first assess the strengths and shortcomings of existing attempts to address such problems. Specifically, we present four takes on some popular conference mechanisms and propose two alternative designs for improvement.\quad Our general position is that meaningful improvement in ML peer review won't come from polite best-practice suggestions tucked into Calls for Papers or Reviewer Guidelines: it requires \textbf{enforceable yet fine-grained procedural safeguards} paired with \textbf{a currency-like credit system (e.g., our proposed \textit{OpenReview Points})}. ML practitioners can ``earn'' such points by contributing good review practices, and ``spend'' them across one or multiple major conferences to redeem different kinds of ``perks,'' such as complimentary registration or the right to request additional review resources.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026 (Position Paper Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，讨论机器学习同行评审制度中的两个核心问题：如何合理限制投稿数量，以及如何激励优质评审、抑制劣质评审。作者评估了现有会议机制的优缺点，提出四项针对流行会议机制的观察，并给出两种替代设计方案。核心主张是，仅靠 Call for Papers 或 Reviewer Guidelines 中的礼貌性建议无法带来实质改进，需要可执行的细粒度程序保障，并配合类似货币的积分系统（如作者提出的 OpenReview Points）。
Motivation: 机器学习社区投稿量激增、互审政策趋严、OpenReview 等平台普及，且缺乏版面费这类压力，导致本领域学术评审体验差、问题普遍存在，但又几乎没有公开空间认真讨论评审系统如何改进。
Method: 作者提出两项改进设计，并具体描述一个名为 OpenReview Points 的信用积分系统：从业者通过践行良好评审实践赚取积分，并可在多个主要会议间消费积分，换取免费注册或申请额外评审资源等不同的待遇。
Result: 本文为立场论文，摘要未报告实证实验或量化结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ML 同行评审的有意义改进来自可执行的细粒度程序保障与货币化积分机制相结合，而不是依赖论文征稿或评审指南中的温和最佳实践建议。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Resolution Diffusion Models for Trajectory Generation in Urban Systems
papers.abstract_en: Understanding human mobility is critical for a wide range of urban applications, including traffic management, epidemic control, and urban planning. However, due to privacy concerns, the availability of large-scale public trajectory data remains limited, posing challenges for downstream mobility analysis. Existing methods for synthetic trajectory generation primarily focus on matching global distribution similarity, while often overlooking mobility patterns across different spatial and temporal resolutions that are essential for practical utility. To address these challenges, we propose a novel multi-resolution diffusion framework, MR-Traj, for large-scale trajectory generation. MR-Traj explicitly models trajectories as compositions of coarse-grained milestones and fine-grained segments, enabling the capture of complex spatial-temporal dependencies at multiple resolutions. Experimental results demonstrate that MR-Traj achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods in terms of global distribution similarity, while consistently outperforming them in modeling fine-resolution mobility patterns and supporting downstream urban mobility tasks. In addition, by introducing stochasticity at multiple resolution levels, MR-Traj generates more diverse trajectories, which empirically reduces trajectory linkage risk under a seed-guided data release setting. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ray0202/MR-Traj.

papers.title: Position: Certified Correctness in Neural Constraint Reasoning Requires Symbolic Integration
papers.abstract_en: Neural solvers for constraint satisfaction problems have achieved remarkable in-distribution accuracy, yet they suffer from a fundamental limitation persistent constraint violations occur under distribution shifts even when the model reports high confidence. This position paper argues that when hard constraints exist and the cost of verification is relatively low, neural constraint reasoning must prioritize symbolic integration over pure learning. We justify our focus on Sudoku as a representative NP-complete testbed because it exhibits a sharp asymmetry between easy verification and hard solving: checking a candidate solution requires only polynomial time $O(n^{2})$, while finding a solution may require exponential search. Through a comprehensive survey of solving methods spanning deterministic algorithms, metaheuristic optimization, learning-based approaches, and language-conditioned reasoning, we demonstrate that neural-only methods without instance-level certification fail to achieve the provable correctness that symbolic and neuro-symbolic approaches provide. We advocate for a bidirectional integration in which neural methods enhance symbolic solvers by learning heuristics and converting percepts into symbols, while symbolic methods verify neural outputs to ensure their reliability. To operationalize this position, we propose a multi-agent certified reasoning framework that demonstrates how this integration can achieve both computational efficiency and provable correctness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，主张在存在硬约束且验证成本较低时，神经约束推理必须优先采用符号集成，而非纯学习。作者以数独作为 NP 完全的代表性测试平台，因其验证候选解只需 O(n^2) 多项式时间而求解可能需指数搜索，并通过对求解方法的综述论证纯神经方法缺乏实例级认证，无法提供符号与神经符号方法可实现的可靠正确性。文章提出一个多智能体认证推理框架，作为双向集成的具体操作方案。
Motivation: 神经求解器在分布内准确率很高，但在分布偏移下即使模型报告高置信度仍会出现持续约束违反；当存在硬约束且验证成本较低时，依赖纯学习无法提供可证明的正确性保障。
Method: 本文为立场论述，未提出新的实验算法；通过综述确定性算法、元启发优化、学习方法和语言条件推理等求解方法，主张双向符号集成：神经方法学习启发式并将感知转换为符号以增强符号求解器，符号方法验证神经输出以保障可靠性，并据此提出多智能体认证推理框架。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验指标；核心论证结果是神经-only 方法在缺少实例级认证时无法达到符号与神经符号方法所提供的可证明正确性。
Conclusion: 作者主张当验证成本低于求解成本时应采用双向集成，使神经与符号方法相互增强，并称所提出的多智能体框架能够兼顾计算效率与可证明正确性；本文为立场论文，结论基于论辩与综述而非实证结果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Position: AI Governance Needs ISO-like Interoperability Protocols, Not Just Laws
papers.abstract_en: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems become deeply integrated into critical global infrastructure, the urgency for robust governance frameworks has intensified. However, current approaches, led by jurisdiction-specific laws, policies, and voluntary frameworks such as the EU AI Act, China's algorithm governance, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework in the U.S., create a fragmented regulatory landscape. In this position paper, we argue that \textbf{\textit{AI governance must be built not on laws alone, but on ISO-like interoperability protocols that enable standardized, machine-readable risk communication across borders}}. Drawing on the success of the GDPR, which was operationalized through standards like ISO 27001 and Privacy by Design, we propose the development of standardized AI \textit{nutrition labels} containing unified metrics for bias, energy usage, and data provenance to facilitate cross-jurisdictional compliance. These manifests would lower barriers for small and medium enterprises (SMEs), reduce redundant regulatory efforts, and build public trust. The paper addresses concerns that standards may stifle innovation by advocating for modular, versioned protocols designed to evolve in tandem with technological change. Overall, we call for a shift from siloed legal compliance toward interoperable technical conformance, enabling a shared global language for responsible AI deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Position Paper Track (Spotlight) (OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=TE3ceHd4YU)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，主张 AI 治理不能仅依赖法律，而应建立类似 ISO 的互操作性协议，实现跨辖区的标准化、机器可读的风险沟通。作者借鉴 GDPR 通过 ISO 27001 和 Privacy by Design 等标准落地的经验，提出开发统一的 AI 营养标签 (nutrition labels)，包含偏见、能耗和数据溯源等指标。论文还讨论了标准可能抑制创新的担忧，并倡导模块化、版本化的协议设计与技术同步演进。
Motivation: 当前 AI 治理由欧盟 AI Act、中国算法治理、美国 NIST AI RMF 等辖区特定法律和政策主导，造成碎片化的监管格局，缺乏跨边界的一致性和可操作性。
Method: 提出制定标准化的 AI 营养标签，统一偏见、能耗和数据溯源等度量，并采用模块化、版本化的协议设计，以便在技术变化时演进并降低合规壁垒。
Result: 本文为立场论文，无实证实验结果；主要论据是 GDPR 经由 ISO 27001 等标准成功运作的先例，以及互操作协议对中小企业 (SMEs) 降低门槛、减少重复监管并增强公众信任的预期收益。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁从各自为政的法律合规转向可互操作的技术一致性 (interoperable technical conformance)，以形成负责任 AI 部署的共享全球语言，同时强调协议设计需模块化和版本化以避免阻碍创新。

papers.title: From Doyle to AGM: A Survey and an Implementation Roadmap for Belief Change
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a targeted narrative review establishing the historical and theoretical foundations for computational belief change implementation. Seeded by Doyle and London's foundational 1980 taxonomy, we trace the evolution of belief revision from computational origins through the theoretical transformation of the AGM framework to contemporary approaches. Our analysis demonstrates how pre-AGM computational pragmatism relates to AGM theoretical constructs, revealing both continuities and transformations across this evolution. We analyze how each taxonomical category evolved in the post-AGM era, identifying the theoretical foundations and historical precedents that inform contemporary implementation challenges. This foundation enables subsequent research into robust computational blueprints that synthesize historical insights with formal guarantees, providing the baseline for systematic implementation analysis and engineering-focused belief change research.
papers.comment: Author's accepted manuscript of an article published in The European Journal on Artificial Intelligence 2026 (SAGE). 65 pages, 2 figures. Final published version available at https://doi.org/10.1177/30504554261426170
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇针对信念变化（belief change）的定向综述（targeted narrative review），旨在为计算实现建立历史与理论基础。以 Doyle 和 London 于 1980 年提出的基础分类法为起点，文章追溯了信念修正从计算起源、经过 AGM 框架的理论转型、再到当代方法的演进，并展示了前 AGM 时代的计算实用主义与 AGM 理论建构之间的连续性与转变。
Motivation: 计算信念变化实现缺乏系统性的历史与理论基础，导致当代实现挑战难以被准确理解。作者希望通过梳理前 AGM 计算实用主义与 AGM 理论建构的关系，为工程导向的信念变化研究奠定基线。
Method: 采用定向叙事综述方法，以 Doyle 和 London 的 1980 年分类法为锚点，追踪信念修正的演化路径，并逐一分析各分类学范畴在 post-AGM 时代的演变，识别其理论基础与历史先例。
Result: 摘要表明该方法揭示了前 AGM 计算实用主义与 AGM 理论建构之间既连续又转变的关系，并明确了支撑当代实现挑战的理论基础与历史先例。
Conclusion: 作者认为这一基础可为后续研究提供基线，支持将历史洞察与形式化保证相结合的计算蓝图，从而推动系统化实现分析与工程导向的信念变化研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Position: Evaluations of AI Moral Reasoning Still Miss Half of the Picture
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on evaluating the moral competence of large language models (LLMs) has focused primarily on what we call the moral value problem, i.e., whether model outputs align with human moral values. In contrast, the moral norm problem, i.e., whether models can identify and correctly apply context-sensitive moral norms, remains underexplored. We posit that this imbalance stems from the field's reliance on descriptive ethics frameworks, such as Moral Foundations Theory and Kohlberg's stages of moral development, which emphasize value representation over normative application. We review existing benchmarks and evaluation methods, and show that they cluster heavily around the value problem, while discussion regarding normative ethics remains underrepresented. We identify three crucial gaps: (i) the absence of high-quality ground-truth data for moral norms and their applications, (ii) insufficient evaluation of intermediate reasoning processes, and (iii) limited attention to the identification of morally relevant features in context. Subsequently, we propose a research agenda that includes the development of standardized formal representations for normative theories, the construction of expert-annotated datasets capturing norm application, and evaluation protocols that explicitly distinguish between values-level and norms-level competence. Our goal is to encourage a more systematic study of normative reasoning in LLMs.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for archival publication at the ACL 2026 Workshop on Evaluating Evaluations (EvalEval)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，指出当前大语言模型 (LLM) 道德能力评估过度聚焦于"道德价值问题"（模型输出是否与人类道德价值一致），而"道德规范问题"（模型能否识别并正确应用情境敏感的规范）仍被忽视。作者回顾现有基准与评估方法，认为它们高度集中于价值层面，并识别出三个关键缺口，随后提出一套研究议程以推动规范推理的系统性研究。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 道德评估依赖描述性伦理学框架（如道德基础理论、Kohlberg 道德发展阶段），这些框架强调价值表征而非规范应用，导致道德规范问题 (moral norm problem) 长期未被充分探索。作者认为这种不平衡使评估只覆盖了"一半图景"。
Method: 本文为综述与立场论述：先梳理现有道德评估基准和方法，论证其集中于价值问题；然后指出三个缺口：缺乏道德规范及其应用的高质量地面真值数据、对中间推理过程的评估不足、对情境中道德相关特征识别的关注有限；最后提出研究议程，包括开发规范理论的标准形式化表示、构建专家标注的规范应用数据集，以及明确区分价值层与规范层能力的评估协议。
Result: 论文未报告新的实证结果；其核心贡献是基于文献回顾的论证，即现有评估在价值层面高度集中、在规范层面显著不足，并系统列出了三个具体研究缺口。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁更系统地研究 LLM 中的规范推理 (normative reasoning)，并强调需要将价值层能力与规范层能力明确区分开来进行评估。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 本文为综述与立场论述：先梳理现有道德评估基准和方法，论证其集中于价值问题；然后指出三个缺口：缺乏道德规范及其应用的高质量地面真值数据、对中间推理过程的评估不足、对情境中道德相关特征识别的关注有限；最后提出研究议程，包括开发规范理论的标准形式化表示、构建专家标注的规范应用数据集，以及明确区分价值层与规范层能力的评估协议。
summary_sections.result: 论文未报告新的实证结果；其核心贡献是基于文献回顾的论证，即现有评估在价值层面高度集中、在规范层面显著不足，并系统列出了三个具体研究缺口。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者呼吁更系统地研究 LLM 中的规范推理 (normative reasoning)，并强调需要将价值层能力与规范层能力明确区分开来进行评估。

papers.title: Position: AI Lock-In Is in Progress, and We Must Be Prepared
papers.abstract_en: AI safety research has mainly focused on two areas: technical alignment (ensuring AI systems produce human-aligned outputs) and the regulation of generative AI's societal impacts (including unemployment risk and labor market disruption). However, an equally important dimension remains underexplored: the risk inherent in dependence on AI systems themselves. In this position paper, we argue that AI safety research should address AI Lock-In, the phenomenon whereby excessive reliance on AI systems leads to human deskilling, diminishes human capacity for independent functioning, and creates systemic vulnerabilities when AI systems become unavailable or compromised. We highlight that AI Lock-In is a systemic threat that is already emerging at individual, societal, and national levels, one that could be dramatically amplified by AI service disruptions or geopolitical conflicts. Drawing on detailed scenarios, we investigate how AI Lock-In emerges and escalates across multiple levels, ranging from individual skill atrophy to national-scale infrastructure failures. To address this, we provide guidance on how such risks can be mitigated and prepared for at each level. We contend that proactively addressing AI Lock-In before such dependencies become entrenched, or even irreversible, is essential for preserving individual autonomy and national security.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，主张 AI 安全研究应关注被忽视的维度——对 AI 系统本身的依赖风险，即 AI Lock-In。作者认为过度依赖 AI 会导致人类技能退化 (deskilling)、削弱独立运作能力，并在 AI 不可用或受攻击时造成系统性脆弱性。论文通过多层级场景分析个体技能萎缩到国家基础设施失效的升级路径，并给出各层级的缓解与准备建议。
Motivation: 现有 AI 安全研究主要聚焦技术对齐与生成式 AI 社会影响监管，但对 AI 系统依赖本身带来的风险探讨不足；这种依赖风险正在个体、社会和国家层面浮现，并可能被服务中断或地缘政治冲突放大。
Method: 作为立场论文，作者基于详细场景分析，考察 AI Lock-In 如何在个体、社会和国家等不同层面出现与升级，并针对每个层面提供风险缓解与准备指引。
Result: 论文强调 AI Lock-In 是一个已在个体、社会和国家层面显现的系统性威胁，且可能因 AI 服务中断或地缘政治冲突而被显著放大；其影响范围从个人技能萎缩延伸至国家规模的基础设施失效。
Conclusion: 作者主张必须在 AI 依赖变得根深蒂固甚至不可逆转之前主动应对 AI Lock-In，这对维护个体自主性和国家安全至关重要。

papers.title: Forward Pass Domain Adaptation (Without Cross-Layer Backpropagation)
papers.abstract_en: Forward-Pass-Only MLP training (FPO) adapts large language models without a backward pass through the model body, achieving 2.7--3.2x the throughput of standard fine-tuning at ~40% less peak training memory, while leaving off-domain benchmarks within seed-noise of baseline, a property that full-network fine-tuning does not reliably reproduce. FPO rests on a single empirical observation: at late layers of a transformer, the output-layer prediction error approximates the true gradient with cosine similarity 0.47--0.59 across six public models we survey. We introduce a two-minute diagnostic that quantifies this approximation per layer for any model, identifying where late-layer adaptation is viable. Informed by the diagnostic, FPO computes a single error signal at the output and applies it to each target layer. No signal is propagated between layers, and no autograd graph is constructed at any point. We evaluate FPO on three model families (OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-8B, Falcon3-7B). Across all three, FPO produces in-domain perplexity improvement and leaves MMLU, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, and Winogrande within seed-noise of baseline. Localizing SFT to FPO's target layers to enter this regime is also feasible, but at 2.2x the wall-clock cost of FPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Forward-Pass-Only MLP training (FPO)，一种无需对模型主体做反向传播的大型语言模型域适应方法。FPO 基于一个经验观察：在 Transformer 后期层，输出层的预测误差与真实梯度的余弦相似度在六个公开模型上为 0.47–0.59。该方法只在输出层计算单一误差信号，并直接应用到每个目标层，层间不传递任何信号，也不构建 autograd 图。在 OLMo-2-7B、Qwen3-8B 和 Falcon3-7B 上，FPO 达到标准微调 2.7–3.2 倍的吞吐量，峰值训练内存降低约 40%，同时保持域外基准在 seed-noise 范围内。
Motivation: 标准全网络微调需要跨层反向传播，计算和内存开销大，且可能导致域外基准不可靠地偏离基线。现有方法难以在避免反向传播的同时保持域外性能稳定。
Method: 提出两分钟诊断工具，逐层量化输出层误差与真实梯度的近似程度，以判断后期层适应是否可行。据此，FPO 在输出层计算一个误差信号，并将其直接施加到每个目标层；不进行层间信号传播，任何阶段都不构建 autograd 图。
Result: 在三个模型族（OLMo-2-7B、Qwen3-8B、Falcon3-7B）上，FPO 产生域内困惑度改善，并将 MMLU、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag 和 Winogrande 保持在基线 seed-noise 范围内；吞吐量为标准微调的 2.7–3.2 倍，峰值内存减少约 40%。将 SFT 局部化到 FPO 目标层也可行，但墙钟成本是 FPO 的 2.2 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FPO 是无需跨层反向传播即可进行模型域适应的可行方案，并提供诊断工具来识别后期层适应可行的位置。摘要未强调明显局限，但局部 SFT 成本更高这一点暗示该机制对层选择敏感。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Global AI Regulations for FAIR and Ethics in High-Risk Use Cases: A Comparative Review
papers.abstract_en: AI governance is shifting from voluntary ethics to enforceable, risk-based regulation, yet cross-jurisdictional divergence creates compliance uncertainty for operators of high-stakes AI. We present a comparative matrix for the EU, US, and China that maps (i) risk classification triggers, (ii) binding obligations, (iii) enforcement and accountability mechanisms, and (iv) the degree to which FAIR principles are operationalised in practice. We stress-test the matrix on three high-impact domains: Electroencephalography (EEG)-guided rehabilitation robotics, AI-enabled debt collection in prospective Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) ecosystems, and AI-driven allocation of scarce Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) resources in emerging AI Factory infrastructures. Using primary legal texts and implementation evidence, we identify three recurring gaps: weak interoperability mandates, difficult operationalisation of cross-regime obligations (AI + sector regulation + data protection), and under-specified governance for critical digital infrastructure use cases. To bridge the implementation gap, we outline Knowledge Blocks, a machine-checkable compliance artefact pattern based on Resource Description Framework/Web Ontology Language (RDF/OWL), Shapes Constraint Language (SHACL), and Provenance Ontology (PROV-O), enabling audit-ready compliance-by-design across multiple regimes.
papers.comment: 6 pages. Accepted at the 50th IEEE Computers, Software, and Applications Conference (COMPSAC 2026), Madrid, Spain, July 7-10, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对欧盟、美国和中国的高风险 AI 监管进行对比，构建了比较矩阵，涵盖风险分类触发条件、约束性义务、执行与问责机制以及 FAIR 原则的落地程度。作者用脑电图引导康复机器人、CBDC 生态中的 AI 债务催收和 AI 工厂中 GPU 资源分配三个场景对矩阵进行压力测试，识别出互操作性、跨制度义务落实和关键数字基础设施治理三个缺口，并提出基于 RDF/OWL、SHACL 和 PROV-O 的 Knowledge Blocks 合规工件模式。论文是 6 页的会议短文，发表于 COMPSAC 2026。
Motivation: 现有 AI 治理正从自愿伦理转向可执行的基于风险的监管，但跨辖区规则差异使高利害 AI 运营者面临合规不确定性。论文旨在系统比较主要司法辖区的监管结构并找出实施缺口。
Method: 构建欧盟、美国、中国的比较矩阵，映射风险分类触发条件、约束性义务、执行与问责机制及 FAIR 原则的实践化程度；随后在三个高风险领域进行压力测试，并设计 Knowledge Blocks 这一基于 RDF/OWL、SHACL 与 PROV-O 的机器可检查合规工件模式。
Result: 摘要报告识别出三个反复出现的缺口：弱的互操作性要求、跨制度（AI 加行业监管加数据保护）义务难以操作化，以及关键数字基础设施用例的治理规范不足。
Conclusion: 为弥合实施缺口，作者提出 Knowledge Blocks 作为支持多制度下审计就绪的合规即设计（compliance-by-design）模式；论文强调基于标准本体和约束语言的机器可检查工件对于跨辖区合规的价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When to Communicate: Belief Distributions and KL Divergence for Principled Gating in Multi-Agent RL
papers.abstract_en: Effective communication in multi-agent reinforcement learning requires agents to decide not only \textit{what} to communicate, but when? Existing approaches either communicate at every timestep or learn a binary gate through REINFORCE policy gradients \cite{singh2019}, a high-variance signal that produces unstable and uninterpretable gating behavior. I propose a principled alternative: agents communicate only when the KL divergence between their learned belief distributions exceeds a fixed threshold. Each agent maintains a belief distribution over a latent world state computed as a softmax over its LSTM hidden state, and communicates only when belief disagreement is large enough to justify information exchange. I evaluate this approach on the Predator-Prey benchmark from IC3Net \cite{singh2019} across two environment sizes with 5 seeds each, and on MPE simple\_spread \cite{lowe2017}, comparing against IC3Net, CommNet, and an independent controller. On PP 10$\times$10, IC3Net outperforms KL-belief at all thresholds. On the harder PP 20$\times$20, a threshold ablation over $\varepsilon \in \{0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0\}$ reveals an inverted U-shape: $\varepsilon=0.5$ achieves 73.84 average steps and 42\% success rate versus IC3Net's 75.31 steps and 31\%, a gap of 1.47 steps and 11 percentage points with tighter seed variance. On MPE, the belief head improves mean reward by 12 points and reduces variance by 26$\times$ even when gating is inactive, suggesting two orthogonal contributions: principled gating when beliefs can converge, and improved latent representations that benefit coordination regardless.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于多智能体强化学习的通信门控机制：当智能体所学信念分布之间的 KL 散度超过固定阈值时才进行通信。每个智能体用 LSTM 隐状态的 softmax 维护对潜在世界状态的信念分布，仅当信念分歧足够大时交换信息。在 IC3Net 的 Predator-Prey 基准和 MPE simple_spread 上的实验显示，在困难的 PP 20x20 场景中阈值 ε=0.5 优于 IC3Net，而在 MPE 上信念头即使在门控不激活时也能提升奖励并大幅降低方差。
Motivation: 现有多智能体通信方法要么每步都通信，要么用 REINFORCE 学习的二元门控，后者方差高、训练不稳定且门控行为难以解释。作者希望提出一种有原则的通信时机决策方式。
Method: 每个智能体维护一个关于潜在世界状态的信念分布（LSTM 隐状态的 softmax），只有当两个智能体信念分布之间的 KL 散度超过固定阈值 ε 时才通信，用阈值消融替代 REINFORCE 门控。
Result: 在 PP 10x10 上 IC3Net 在所有阈值下优于 KL-belief；在更难的 PP 20x20 上，ε 消融呈现倒 U 形，ε=0.5 得到 73.84 平均步数和 42% 成功率，优于 IC3Net 的 75.31 步和 31%（相差 1.47 步和 11 个百分点），且种子方差更小。在 MPE 上，即使门控不激活，信念头也提升平均奖励 12 点并将方差降低 26 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为存在两个正交贡献：当信念能收敛时有原则的门控，以及改善的潜在表征本身就能促进协调。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Unwritten Benchmark: A New Challenge for Multimodal Machine Learning in Abstract Perceptual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Current multimodal models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in recognizing static visual and auditory content. However, their capacity for abstract perceptual reasoning, inferring unseen information from dynamic, generative processes, remains a critical and underexplored frontier. In this paper, we introduce The Unwritten Benchmark, a new challenge designed to probe this abstract perceptual and cognitive ability. We define the core task as acousto-kinematic word inference: models must decipher words, across 3 different writing styles, being written solely from the audio of pen scratches and the video of hand movements, without any visible ink trace. Our evaluation results reveal a profound gap between human and machine performance: while human participants achieve high ordered letter accuracy (over 80%), leading Multimodal Machine Learning Models, including GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5-Pro, struggle significantly, failing to surpass 10%. Furthermore, we identify a paradoxical fusion effect in the models, where providing both modalities often degrades performance rather than improving it. This finding indicates a fundamental breakdown in their ability to synthesize complementary perceptual cues for this cognitive task. These findings highlight significant limitations in both cross-modal causal reasoning and the understanding of the micro-kinematics essential for such cognitive and intuitive perceptual reasoning.
papers.comment: To be published in CVPR Findings 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 The Unwritten Benchmark，一个用于探测多模态模型抽象知觉推理能力的新基准。核心任务是声动词语推理 (acousto-kinematic word inference)：模型需要仅根据笔划声音音频和手部运动视频，在无可见墨迹的情况下识别三种书写风格的单词。评估结果显示人类有序字母准确率超过 80%，而 GPT-4o 和 Gemini 2.5-Pro 等领先多模态模型未能超过 10%；此外还发现一个悖论式的融合效应，即同时提供两种模态反而常使性能下降。
Motivation: 现有多模态模型在识别静态视觉和听觉内容方面表现优异，但从动态生成过程中推断未见信息的抽象知觉推理能力仍是关键且未充分探索的前沿。该论文旨在填补这一空白，并揭示模型在跨模态因果推理 (cross-modal causal reasoning) 与微观运动学 (micro-kinematics) 理解上的根本性不足。
Method: 作者定义了一个新的挑战任务 acousto-kinematic word inference，构建包含三种书写风格、仅有笔划声音和手部运动视频而无可见墨迹的数据集，并系统评估人类被试与多个领先多模态大模型在该任务上的表现。
Result: 人类被试的有序字母准确率超过 80%，而包括 GPT-4o 和 Gemini 2.5-Pro 在内的领先多模态模型准确率均未超过 10%。研究还发现模型的融合效应悖论：同时输入音频和视频两种模态时，性能往往比单一模态更差，说明模型无法为这类认知任务合成互补的知觉线索。
Conclusion: 这些发现凸显了现有多模态模型在跨模态因果推理以及对微观运动学的理解上存在显著局限，而这些能力对此类认知性和直觉性知觉推理至关重要。

papers.title: Orbital AI Computing: Carbon Tradeoffs Across Satellite Scale
papers.abstract_en: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) computing is emerging for low-latency, globally distributed AI services, enabled by advances in satellite constellations and reusable launch systems. However, its sustainability remains unclear. Prior work introduces ESpaS, a framework for estimating lifecycle carbon intensity, but models systems using generic datacenter configurations and does not capture modern AI hardware, where power, mass, and compute characteristics vary widely and launch emissions scale with system mass. In this work, we extend ESpaS with accelerator-aware modeling and evaluate two representative systems: a lightweight Jetson AGX Orin for small satellites and a high-performance DGX H100 enabled by large-payload launch platforms. We show that launch emissions act as a fixed carbon overhead: low-mass systems minimize absolute emissions, while high-performance systems amortize this cost more effectively, reducing carbon intensity. Consequently, the space-ground tradeoff is highly sensitive to hardware choice, highlighting the need for accelerator-aware baselines in orbital AI computing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低地球轨道（LEO）AI 计算的生命周期碳强度问题，扩展了 ESpaS 框架以纳入加速器感知建模，并评估两种代表性系统：轻量级 Jetson AGX Orin（用于小卫星）与高性能 DGX H100（由大载荷发射平台支持）。结果显示发射排放构成固定碳开销：低质量系统最小化绝对排放，而高性能系统能更有效地摊销该成本从而降低碳强度；空间-地面权衡对硬件选择高度敏感。
Motivation: 现有 ESpaS 框架使用通用数据中心配置估算生命周期碳强度，未捕获现代 AI 硬件在功率、质量和计算特性上的差异，且发射排放随系统质量变化，导致轨道 AI 可持续性评估不准确。
Method: 扩展 ESpaS，引入加速器感知（accelerator-aware）建模，并对小卫星上的 Jetson AGX Orin 与大载荷发射平台支持的 DGX H100 两种代表性系统进行生命周期碳排放评估。
Result: 摘要报告发射排放作为固定碳开销：低质量系统使绝对排放最小，而高性能系统更有效地摊销该固定成本从而降低碳强度，空间-地面碳权衡强烈依赖硬件选择。
Conclusion: 摘要强调轨道 AI 计算需要加速器感知的基线来正确评估碳权衡，但未报告具体数值结果或部署范围限制。

papers.title: Learning Discrete Riemannian Metrics for Physical Fields with Cochain-Frame Equivarianc
papers.abstract_en: Physical fields on meshes require a separation between topology and geometry: conservation laws are topological and should be exact, while geometry, material response, and anisotropic coupling must be learned from data. Existing neural surrogates often mix these roles inside unconstrained message passing. We introduce Riemannian Hodge Message Passing (RHMP), which turns this separation into an architectural principle. RHMP fixes the cellular coboundaries ($d_k$) determined by oriented incidence and learns symmetric positive-definite cochain metrics ($H_k$) for geometry-dependent propagation. Treating $H_k$ as the learned metric motivates cochain-frame equivariance: physical propagation should be invariant to orthogonal changes of the hidden cochain feature basis. RHMP implements this principle with metric-weighted Hodge blocks ($d_k^\top H_{k+1}d_k$), yielding exact cochain-complex identities ($d_{k+1}d_k=0$), nonnegative Hodge energies, positive-semidefinite operators, and exact Abelian curvature invariance. Across seven physical benchmarks spanning fluids, electromagnetism, gauge fields, and variable-mesh CFD, RHMP achieves the best overall performance, with the largest gains when topology, learned geometry, and field structure interact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Riemannian Hodge Message Passing (RHMP)，将网格上物理场的拓扑与几何学习相分离：固定由有向关联矩阵确定的 cellular coboundaries（上边界算子），仅学习对称正定的 cochain metrics（离散黎曼度量）用于几何相关的传播。RHMP 以 metric-weighted Hodge blocks（d_k^⊤ H_{k+1} d_k）实现 cochain-frame equivariance，并保证精确的 cochain-complex 恒等式 d_{k+1}d_k=0、非负 Hodge 能量、半正定算子以及精确的 Abelian 曲率不变性。在流体、电磁、规范场和变网格 CFD 共七个物理基准上取得整体最佳性能。
Motivation: 物理场在网格上的建模需要把拓扑与几何分开：守恒律是拓扑性的、应当精确保持，而几何、材料响应和各向异性耦合需要从数据中学习；现有神经替代模型常把这些角色混在无约束的消息传递中。
Method: RHMP 把拓扑与几何的分离作为架构原则，固定由 oriented incidence 确定的 cellular coboundaries，并将对称正定的 cochain metrics H_k 作为可学习度量；通过 metric-weighted Hodge blocks 构造消息传递，使物理传播对隐藏 cochain 特征基的正交变化保持不变。
Result: 在覆盖流体、电磁、规范场和变网格 CFD 的七个物理基准上，RHMP 达到最佳整体性能，且最大提升出现在拓扑、学习到的几何与场结构相互作用的场景。
Conclusion: 作者主张将拓扑与几何分离并学习离散黎曼度量是一种有效的架构原则，强调 RHMP 能获得精确的算子性质与非负能量等理论保证；摘要未讨论具体局限。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Large Language Models Show Metacognitive Sensitivity in Medical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated and used in medicine, but clinical usefulness depends on answer accuracy and whether confidence tracks evidence quality and uncertainty. We developed a controlled, psychophysics-inspired clinical benchmark to test diagnostic choice and confidence behavior in a medical LLM. The benchmark focused on probable Alzheimer-type neurocognitive disorder (AT-NCD) versus depression-related cognitive impairment (DRCI). We generated 45 synthetic vignettes varying evidence strength, conflicting evidence, and missing information. Each vignette was presented under three prompt variants, yielding 135 trials. In a pilot run with gpt-4.1-nano, all trials produced valid structured outputs. Across forced-choice trials, diagnostic accuracy was 93.5%, mean confidence was 78.4%, and AUROC2 was 0.876. Confidence increased with evidence distance from the diagnostic boundary, decreased when information was missing, and remained higher on correct than incorrect trials after adjustment for evidence strength and prompt format. These findings indicate partial metacognitive sensitivity rather than globally uninformative confidence. However, errors clustered in moderate, conflicting AT-NCD cases, where the model shifted toward DRCI and retained more confidence than empirical accuracy justified. Model comparison suggested that confidence quality should be measured directly rather than inferred from benchmark accuracy or model capability alone. This study establishes a reproducible framework for evaluating evidence sensitivity, metacognitive sensitivity, and localized calibration failure in medical LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个受心理物理学启发的受控临床基准，用于评估医学大语言模型（LLM）在诊断选择与置信度报告上的元认知敏感性。在45个合成病例（135次试验）的试点运行中，gpt-4.1-nano的诊断准确率为93.5%，平均置信度为78.4%，AUROC2为0.876。置信度随证据强度变化并部分反映正确性，但错误却集中在中等冲突的AT-NCD病例中并伴随过度自信。
Motivation: 临床中LLM的可用性不仅取决于答案准确性，还取决于置信度能否跟踪证据质量和不确定性；现有评估往往忽视这一点。作者因此设计了能分离证据强度、冲突证据和缺失信息的基准来检验置信行为。
Method: 作者开发了心理物理学启发的受控基准，聚焦于可能的阿尔茨海默型神经认知障碍（AT-NCD）与抑郁相关认知障碍（DRCI）的鉴别诊断。生成45个改变证据强度、冲突证据和缺失信息的合成病例，每个病例在三种提示变体下呈现，共135次试验，并以gpt-4.1-nano进行试点。
Result: 试点中所有试验均产生有效结构化输出；强迫选择任务诊断准确率93.5%，平均置信度78.4%，AUROC2为0.876。置信度随与诊断边界的证据距离增加而上升，信息缺失时下降，且在调整证据强度和提示格式后，正确试验的置信度仍高于错误试验。错误集中在中等冲突的AT-NCD病例，模型偏向DRCI并保持高于经验准确性所允许的置信度。
Conclusion: 研究表明该LLM具有部分元认知敏感性而非全局无信息的置信度，但也暴露出局部校准失败。作者强调应直接测量置信度质量，而非仅从基准准确率或模型能力推断，并提出了一个可复现的医学LLM评估框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Auxiliary uncertainty signals for LLM-assisted systematic review screening: a benchmark across eight Cohen drug-class reviews
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for title-abstract screening in systematic reviews, but their decisions lack calibrated uncertainty. We show that an auxiliary BERT+GCN classifier supplies a structured uncertainty signal that improves LLM screening efficiency, and we identify the prompt-delivery strategy that maximises the benefit-to-cost ratio. We evaluate five LLM prompt-delivery conditions on eight drug-class datasets from the Cohen (2006) benchmark using 3 seeds x 5-fold stratified cross-validation (600 fold-level results). A BERT+GCN model trained per fold classifies each test paper as INCLUDE, EXCLUDE, or MAYBE via two spectral tests (algebraic radical and categorical paradox). Conditions vary information content (none / label / full scores), selectivity (all papers vs. MAYBE only), and timing (proactive vs. reactive two-pass). A cross-model pilot against gpt-4.1-mini on three datasets tests cross-generation transfer. Three findings: (i) Full-context delivery yields significant gains in F1 (+0.011, paired Wilcoxon p=0.008) and WSS@95 (+0.050, p=0.039) at a 1.28x token-cost premium, while preserving recall. (ii) MAYBE-only routing is Pareto-optimal: highest mean recall (0.92) and AUC-ROC (0.54) at only 1.05x baseline cost -- one sixth of full-context overhead. (iii) The two-pass design escalates 22.2% +/- 8.8% of records yet never revises its decision (0% flip rate across all datasets and folds), giving decisive evidence that current instruction-tuned LLMs cannot self-triage. The cross-model pilot shows an identical +0.8% recall uplift for both LLM generations. A per-paper ablation across 20,796 observations shows the dual paradox test reduces empirically to a one-line logit-gap criterion. We release the full pipeline; the 600-run experiment replays in under one hour from cached LLM responses.

TL;DR: 本文针对系统综述中标题-摘要筛选环节，探讨大语言模型 (LLM) 决策缺乏校准不确定性 (calibrated uncertainty) 的问题，提出用辅助 BERT+GCN 分类器提供结构化不确定性信号来提升 LLM 筛选效率。作者在 Cohen (2006) 八个药物类别数据集上，以 3 seeds × 5 折分层交叉验证评估五种提示交付条件（共 600 个折级结果），并报告了收益-成本最优的提示策略。主要发现包括：全上下文交付显著提升 F1 和 WSS@95，但代价是 1.28 倍 token 成本；仅对 MAYBE 记录路由是 Pareto 最优；而两遍 (two-pass) 设计从不修改决策，说明当前指令微调 LLM 无法自我分流。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地被用于系统综述的标题-摘要筛选，但其预测缺乏经校准的不确定性信号，导致筛选效率受限；现有方法没有系统评估外部辅助不确定性信号如何与不同提示交付策略结合。
Method: 提出一种逐折训练的 BERT+GCN 辅助分类器，通过代数根 (algebraic radical) 和类别悖论 (categorical paradox) 两个谱检验 (spectral tests) 将每篇测试论文分为 INCLUDE、EXCLUDE 或 MAYBE；随后在五种条件中变化信息内容（无/标签/完整分数）、选择性（全部论文 vs. 仅 MAYBE）和时序（主动 vs. 反应式两遍），并针对 gpt-4.1-mini 在三个数据集上做跨代迁移试点。
Result: 全上下文交付在 1.28 倍 token 成本下带来 F1 +0.011 (paired Wilcoxon p=0.008) 和 WSS@95 +0.050 (p=0.039)，且保持召回率；MAYBE-only 路由在仅 1.05 倍基线成本下取得最高平均召回率 0.92 和 AUC-ROC 0.54，开销仅为全上下文的六分之一；两遍设计升级了 22.2% ± 8.8% 的记录但翻转率为 0%；跨模型试点显示两代 LLM 均有相同的 +0.8% 召回率提升。基于 20,796 条观测的逐论文消融表明，双重悖论检验实际可简化为一行 logit-gap 准则。
Conclusion: 作者认为实验为‘当前指令微调 LLM 无法自我分流’提供了决定性证据，并指出辅助不确定性信号应以 MAYBE-only 的轻量路由方式接入；同时发布了完整流程，600 次运行可从缓存的 LLM 响应在一小时内重放。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FLOPs vs Real Work: The Importance of Replication in AI Efficiency Assessment
papers.abstract_en: AI efficiency has recently taken the spotlight in both academy and industry due to massive model scales, high energy demands, and environmental costs. While reporting Floating Point Operations (FLOPs) is a traditional approach for assessing computational costs, the relationship between FLOPs and execution time is not straightforward, as layers with the same number of FLOPs may not have the same execution time because some operations are more easily parallelized than others. This paper sets out to replicate the original experiments from a study that proposed the $α-FLOPs$ estimation formula to verify whether the results remain applicable on newer, more powerful hardware. During the replication process, we identify limitations in the replication materials provided by the original study, including a lack of specific dependency details and transparency regarding regression data. Our results validate the thesis that raw FLOPs alone are not an appropriate metric for execution time, as spatial dimensions remain more easily parallelized than kernel dimensions. However, fine-grained measurements reveal that the relationship is much less straightforward than previously shown, with newer hardware exhibiting instabilities and discontinuities in execution time, including jumps and oscillations, that the $α-FLOPs$ formula generally underestimates. Ultimately, this work validates the empirical findings from the original study but shows negative results when applying the $α-FLOPs$ estimation. We also highlight the critical need for complete and accurate replication packages for research on hardware-dependent efficiency assessment and provide a complete replication package for our implementation to facilitate further study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对提出 α-FLOPs 估算公式的原始研究进行复制实验，在更新的硬件上重新检验 FLOPs 与执行时间的关系。摘要表明原始结论仍然成立：FLOPs 本身不是执行时间的合适代理，空间维度比 kernel 维度更易并行化；但细粒度测量显示新硬件上执行时间存在不稳定和不连续现象，α-FLOPs 公式通常低估实际值。作者同时指出原始研究复现材料的不足，并公开了完整的复现包。
Motivation: AI 效率评估常用 FLOPs，但 FLOPs 与执行时间并非直接对应，因为不同层和操作的可并行化程度不同；同时新的硬件环境可能改变原有估算模型的有效性，需要通过复制研究验证。
Method: 针对提出 α-FLOPs 估算公式的原始研究开展复制实验，在更新的硬件上复现其原始实验设置，并进行细粒度执行时间测量；同时审查原始研究提供的复现材料，识别依赖信息和回归数据透明度方面的缺失。
Result: 结果支持 FLOPs 不能作为执行时间合适指标的论点，空间维度相比 kernel 维度仍更易并行化；但新硬件上出现执行时间的跳变和振荡等不稳定现象，α-FLOPs 公式普遍低估真实执行时间，呈现负面结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为原始研究的经验性结论依然有效，但其 α-FLOPs 估算在新硬件上不再可靠；研究强调针对硬件依赖型效率评估需要完整准确的复现包，并为此提供了自己的复现实现。
Relevance: 5
